ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:12, 13; footnote) The Word is also named "King of kings and Lord of lords. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 19:16) Woyɔ Yesu be ‘fiawo katã ƒe Fia kple aƒetɔwo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ.’​ 1 Timoteo 6:14, 15.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:16) Jesus is called "the King of those who rule as kings and Lord of those who rule as lords. "​ 1 Timothy 6:​14, 15.

EWE: Nya la nye Mawu ƒe nyanuɖela.
ENGLISH: The Word serves as God’s spokesman.

EWE: Dzesideŋkɔ "Nya la " fia be Mawu toa ame si ŋu ŋkɔ ma le la dzi gblɔa eƒe gbedeasiwo kple mɔfiamewo.
ENGLISH: The title "the Word " apparently identifies its bearer as one whom God uses to convey information and instructions.

EWE: Yesu gblɔ be Mawu zãa ye aleae esi wògblɔ be: "Fofo si dɔm ɖa la ŋutɔe na nya si magblɔ kple ale si maƒo nui ƒe sem. . . .
ENGLISH: Jesus said that he performed this role: "The Father who sent me has himself given me a commandment about what to say and what to speak. . . .

EWE: Eya ŋuti nya siwo megblɔna la, megblɔa wo abe ale si tututu Fofo la gblɔ wo nam ene. "​ Yohanes 12:49, 50.
ENGLISH: So whatever I speak, I speak just as the Father has told me. "​ John 12:49, 50.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye Torah?
ENGLISH: What Is the Torah?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Woɖe nya "Torah " tso Hebrigbe me nya tohrah me, eye woate ŋu aɖe egɔme be "nufiame " alo "se. "
ENGLISH: The English word "Torah " comes from the Hebrew word tohrah, which can be translated as "instruction, " "teaching, " or "law. "

EWE: (Lododowo 1:8; 3:1; 28:4) Kpɔɖeŋu siwo gbɔna la ɖe ale si wozãa Hebrigbe me nya sia le Biblia me fia.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 1:8; 3:1; 28:4) The following examples show how this Hebrew word is used in the Bible.

EWE: Biblia-gbalẽ atɔ̃ gbãtɔwo, siwo nye 1 Mose, 2 Mose, 3 Mose, 4 Mose kple 5 Mose ye woyɔna zi geɖe be Tohrah.
ENGLISH: tohrah often refers to the first five books of the Bible​ Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy.

EWE: Wogayɔna wo be Pentateuch, si woɖe tso Helagbe nya aɖe si gɔmee nye "agbalẽ atɔawo ƒe babla " la me.
ENGLISH: These are also called the Pentateuch, from a Greek word meaning "fivefold volume. "

EWE: Mose ye ŋlɔ Torah la, eya ta woyɔnɛ be "Mose ƒe Segbalẽa. "
ENGLISH: The Torah was written by Moses, so it is called "the book of the Law of Moses. "

EWE: (Yosua 8:31; Nehemiya 8:1) Anɔ eme be agbalẽ ɖekae wònye hafi, gake emegbe wova mae ɖe akpa atɔ̃ me ale be ekɔkɔ kple ezazã nanɔ bɔbɔe wu.
ENGLISH: (Joshua 8:​31; Nehemiah 8:1) Evidently, it was originally written as one book but was later divided for easier handling.

EWE: Wogazãa nya Tohrah tsɔ ɖɔa se siwo wona Israel ku ɖe nanewo koŋ ŋu, le kpɔɖeŋu me, "nuvɔ̃vɔsa la ŋuti se [tohrah], " "anyidɔ ŋuti se " kple "se na Naziritɔ. " 3 Mose 6:25; 14:57; 4 Mose 6:13.
ENGLISH: tohrah is also used for the laws given to Israel on a particular subject, such as "the law [tohrah] of the sin offering, " "the law about leprosy, " and "the law about the Nazirite. "​ Leviticus 6:​25; 14:57; Numbers 6:​13.

EWE: Ɣeaɖewoɣi la, Tohrah gafiaa nufiame si tso dzilawo, nunyalawo, alo Mawu ŋutɔ gbɔ. Lododowo 1:8; 3:1; 13:14; Yesaya 2:3, etenuŋɔŋlɔ.
ENGLISH: tohrah sometimes refers to instruction and teaching, whether from parents, wise ones, or God himself.​ Proverbs 1:8; 3:1; 13:14; Isaiah 2:3, footnote.

EWE: Nya kawoe le Torah, alo Pentateuch la me?
ENGLISH: What is in the Torah, or Pentateuch?

EWE: Nuwo wɔɣi ƒe ŋutinya kpakple ale si Mawu wɔ nu kple amegbetɔwo tso gɔmedzedzea me va de asi na Mose ƒe kuɣi. 1 Mose 1:27, 28; 5 Mose 34:5.
ENGLISH: The history of God’s dealings with humankind from creation to the death of Moses.​ Genesis 1:​27, 28; Deuteronomy 34:5.

EWE: Mose ƒe Sea ŋuti ɖoɖowo hã le eme.
ENGLISH: The regulations of the Mosaic Law.

EWE: (2 Mose 24:3) Sedede siwo wu 600 ye le Sea me.
ENGLISH: (Exodus 24:3) That Law is made up of more than 600 statutes.

EWE: Wo dometɔ si xɔ ŋkɔ wue nye Shema, alo Yudatɔwo ƒe xɔsemeʋuʋu.
ENGLISH: Prominent among them is the Shema, or Jewish confession of faith.

EWE: Shema la ƒe akpa aɖe gblɔ be: "Tsɔ wò dzi blibo kple wò luʋɔ blibo kpakple wò ŋusẽ blibo lɔ̃ Yehowa wò Mawu la. " (5 Mose 6:4-9) Yesu gblɔ be, esiae nye "sedede gãtɔ kple gbãtɔ. "
ENGLISH: One portion of the Shema says: "You must love Jehovah your God with all your heart and all your soul and all your strength. "
(Deuteronomy 6:​4-9) Jesus described this as "the greatest and first commandment. "​ Matthew 22:36-​38.

EWE: Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ Yehowa, dze le eme zi 1,800 aɖewo.
ENGLISH: Some 1,800 occurrences of the divine name, Jehovah.

EWE: Torah la mede se ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋkɔa yɔyɔ ŋu o, ke boŋ sewo le eme siwo bia tso amewo si be woayɔ ŋkɔa. 4 Mose 6:22-27; 5 Mose 6:13; 10:8; 21:5.
ENGLISH: Rather than prohibit the use of God’s name, the Torah contains commands that required God’s people to pronounce it.​ Numbers 6:​22-​27; Deuteronomy 6:​13; 10:8; 21:5.

EWE: Susu totro siwo le amewo si ku ɖe Torah la ŋu
ENGLISH: Misconceptions about the Torah

EWE: Susu totro: Ele be se siwo le Torah me la nanɔ anyi tegbee, mele be woadzudzɔ wo dzi wɔwɔ o.
ENGLISH: Misconception: The laws of the Torah are eternal, never to be set aside.

EWE: Nyateƒea: Le Biblia gɔmeɖeɖe aɖewo me la, wogblɔ tso Torah la me se kple ɖoɖo aɖewo, abe esiwo ku ɖe Sabat, nunɔlanyenyea kple Avuléŋkekea ene ŋu be wonye "ɖoɖo mavɔ, " alo be ele be woawɔ wo dzi "tegbee. " (2 Mose 31:16; 40:15; 3 Mose 16:33, 34, Eʋegbe Biblia) Ke hã, Hebrigbe me nya si wozã le kpuikpui mawo me la agate ŋu afia nu si ayi edzi va de asi na etsɔme ʋĩi, ke menye nu si woawɔ tegbee kokoko o.
ENGLISH: Fact: Some Bible translations do refer to specific statutes of the Torah​ including those related to the Sabbath, the priesthood, and the Day of Atonement​ as being "perpetual " or "everlasting. " (Exodus 31:16; 40:15; Leviticus 16:33, 34, King James Version) However, the Hebrew word used in these verses can also mean lasting into the indefinite future, not necessarily lasting forever.

EWE: Esi wowɔ Mose Ƒe Se ƒe nubablaa ŋu dɔ abe ƒe 900 ene megbe la, Mawu gblɔe ɖi be yeava tsɔ ‘nubabla yeye’ aɖe aɖɔlii.
ENGLISH: After the Mosaic Law covenant had been in force for about 900 years, God foretold that he would replace it with "a new covenant. "

EWE: (Yeremiya 31:31-33) "Esi [Mawu gblɔ] be ‘nubabla yeye’ la, ena [nubabla] gbãtɔ la do xoxo. "
ENGLISH: (Jeremiah 31:31-​33) By "saying ‘a new covenant,’ [God] made the former [covenant] obsolete. "

EWE: (Hebritɔwo 8:7-13) Wonɔ te ɖe Yesu Kristo ƒe kua dzi ɖɔlii ƒe 2,000 aɖewoe nye esi va yi. Efesotɔwo 2:15.
ENGLISH: (Hebrews 8:​7-​13) It was replaced about 2,000 years ago on the basis of the death of Jesus Christ.​ Ephesians 2:​15.

EWE: Susu totro: Ele be woade bubu Yudatɔwo ƒe kɔnyinyiwo ŋuti sewo kple Talmud la ŋu abe ale si ko wodea bubu Torah la hã ŋu ene.
ENGLISH: Misconception: Jewish oral traditions and the Talmud have authority equal to the written Torah.

EWE: Nyateƒea: Ŋɔŋlɔawo me kpeɖodzi aɖeke meli be Mawu tsɔ kɔnyinyiwo ŋuti sewo kpe ɖe Torah la me nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu o.
ENGLISH: Fact: There is no Scriptural evidence that God gave Moses an oral law to accompany the written Torah.

EWE: Ke boŋ, Biblia gblɔ be: "Yehowa gagblɔ na Mose be: ‘Ŋlɔ nya siawo ɖi.’ " (2 Mose 34:27) Kɔnyinyiwo ŋuti se, siwo wova ŋlɔ ɖi emegbe si woyɔna be Mishnah, lae wokeke ɖe enu wòva zu agbalẽ si nye Talmud la. Farisitɔwo gbɔe Talmud la zazã dze egɔme tsoe, eye Yudatɔwo ƒe kɔnyinyiwo ŋuti se kple ɖoɖowoe le eme.
ENGLISH: Instead, the Bible states: "Jehovah went on to say to Moses: ‘You are to write down these words.’ " (Exodus 34:27) The oral law, later written down and known as the Mishnah and finally expanded into the Talmud, consists of Jewish traditions that began with the Pharisees.

EWE: Zi ge ɖe la, kɔnyinyi mawo tsia tsitre ɖe Torah la ŋu.
ENGLISH: These traditions often conflicted with the Torah.

EWE: Le esia ta, Yesu gblɔ na Farisitɔwo be: "Miena Mawu ƒe nya la zu dzodzro le miaƒe kɔnyinyiwo ta. " Mateo 15:1-9.
ENGLISH: For this reason, Jesus told the Pharisees: "You have made the word of God invalid because of your tradition. "​ Matthew 15:​1-9.

EWE: Susu totro: Mele be woafia Torah la me nyawo nyɔnuwo o.
ENGLISH: Misconception: Women should not be taught the Torah.

EWE: Nyateƒea: Wogblɔ le Mose ƒe Sea me be ele be woaxlẽ Se bliboa me nyawo na Israel-viwo katã, nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo hã le eme.
ENGLISH: Fact: The Mosaic Law included a regulation that the entire Law be read to all the people of Israel, including the women and children.

EWE: Nu ka tae?
ENGLISH: Why?

EWE: "Ne woaɖo to, eye woasrɔ̃ ale si woavɔ̃ Yehowa [woƒe] Mawu la, eye woawɔ Se [la] me nyawo katã dzi pɛpɛpɛ. " 5 Mose 31:10-12.
ENGLISH: "In order that they may listen and learn about and fear Jehovah [their] God and take care to carry out all the words of [the] Law. "​ Deuteronomy 31:10-​12.

EWE: Susu totro: Nya ɣaɣlawo le Torah la me.
ENGLISH: Misconception: The Torah contains hidden messages.

EWE: Nyateƒea: Mose, ame si ŋlɔ Torah la me nyawo ɖi la, gblɔ be emenyawo me kɔ, ame sia ame ate ŋu ase wo gɔme, eye womele ɣaɣla o.
ENGLISH: Fact: Moses, who recorded the Torah, stated that its message is clear and accessible to all, not hidden in a code.

EWE: (5 Mose 30:11-14) Nya si amewo gblɔna be nya ɣaɣlawo be ɖe Torah me la dzɔ tso Yudatɔwo ƒe vivimenunya si woyɔna be Kabbalah, si me ‘wokpaa nyawo le aɖaŋutɔe’ tsɔ ɖea Ŋɔŋlɔawo me, la me. 2 Petro 1:16.
ENGLISH: (Deuteronomy 30:11-​14) The theory that there are hidden messages in the Torah is rooted in Kabbalah, or traditional Jewish mysticism, which uses "artfully contrived " methods to interpret the Scriptures. ​ 2 Peter 1:​16.

EWE: Gɔmesese Kae Nɔa Xexlẽdzesiwo Si Le Biblia Me?
ENGLISH: What Do Numbers Mean in the Bible?

EWE: Ðe Biblia Da Asi Ðe Xexlẽdzesifakaka Dzia?
ENGLISH: Is Numerology Biblical?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Zi geɖe la, xexlẽdzesi siwo le Biblia me la fiaa xexlẽdzesi ŋutɔŋutɔwo, gake ɣeaɖewoɣi la wozãa wo tsɔ fia nu bubuwo.
ENGLISH: Numbers in the Bible can often be taken literally, but they are sometimes used as symbols.

EWE: Zi geɖe la, nya siwo ƒo xlã nya la ɖenɛ fiana nenye be ɖe wozãe wòfia nu bubu aɖe.
ENGLISH: The context usually indicates whether a particular number is used as a symbol.

EWE: Kpɔ xexlẽdzesi siwo wozã le Biblia me wofia nu bubuwo dometɔ aɖewo ɖa:
ENGLISH: Consider these examples of the symbolic meaning of numbers in the Bible:

EWE: 1 Ðekawɔwɔ.
ENGLISH: 1 Unity.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Yesu do gbe ɖa na Mawu ku ɖe eyomedzelawo ŋu be: "Wo katã woawɔ ɖeka, abe ale si wò, Fofo la, nèwɔ ɖeka kplim, eye nye hã mewɔ ɖeka kpli wò la ene. " Yohanes 17:21; Mateo 19:6.
ENGLISH: For instance, Jesus prayed to God that his followers "may all be one, just as you, Father, are in union with me and I am in union with you. "​ John 17:21; Matthew 19:6.

EWE: 2 Le senyawo me la, ɖasefo eve ɖoa kpe nya ƒe nyateƒenyenye dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 In a legal setting, two witnesses verify the truth of a matter.

EWE: (5 Mose 17:6) Nenema kee ne wogbugbɔ ŋutega alo nya aɖe gblɔ zi eve la, enye kpeɖodzi be nyaa nye nya vavã eye kakaɖedzi le eŋu.
ENGLISH: (Deuteronomy 17:6) Similarly, the repetition of a vision or a statement confirms the matter as sure and true.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, esime Yosef ɖe drɔ̃e si Farao ku gɔme nɛ la, egblɔ be: "Esi Farao ku drɔ̃ea zi eve la, efia be Mawu vavã la ɖoe kplikpaa, eye Mawu vavã la le ewɔ ge kpuie. " (1 Mose 41:32) Le nyagblɔɖiwo me la, "dzoevee " tea ŋu fiaa dziɖuɖu ƒokpli eve abe ale si woɖe eme na nyagblɔɖila Daniel ku ɖe Medo-Persia Fiaɖuƒea ŋu ene.​ Daniel 8:​20, 21; Nyaɖeɖefia 13:11.
ENGLISH: For example, when Joseph interpreted a dream given to Pharaoh of Egypt, he said: "The fact that the dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice means that the thing is firmly established on the part of the true God. " (Genesis 41:32) In prophecy, "two horns " can represent dual rulership, as the prophet Daniel was told regarding the Medo-Persian Empire.​ Daniel 8:​20, 21; Revelation 13:11.

EWE: 3 Abe ale si ko ɖasefo etɔ̃ ɖoa kpe nya ƒe nyateƒenyenye dzi keŋkeŋ ene la, nenema kee ne wogbugbɔ nya aɖe gblɔ zi etɔ̃ la, etea gbe ɖe edzi keŋkeŋ be nyaa nye nyateƒe.​ Ezekiel 21:27; Dɔwɔwɔwo 10:9-16; Nyaɖeɖefia 4:8; 8:13.
ENGLISH: 3 Just as three witnesses would firmly prove a matter to be true, a threefold repetition seems to establish it firmly or emphasize it.​ Ezekiel 21:27; Acts 10:​9-​16; Revelation 4:8; 8:​13.

EWE: 4 Efia nane ƒe nɔnɔme alo eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe blibonyenye abe ale si wòdze le nyagbe si nye "anyigba ƒe dzogoe eneawo " me ene. Nyaɖeɖefia 7:1; 21:16; Yesaya 11:12.
ENGLISH: 4 This can represent completeness in form or function, as in the expression "the four corners of the earth. "​ Revelation 7:1; 21:16; Isaiah 11:12.

EWE: 6 Xexlẽdzesi sia fia be ɖeka to le adre, si fia nu ƒe dede keŋkeŋ zi geɖe la me, xexlẽdzesi ade ate ŋu afia nu si mede o, mede blibo o alo nu si do ƒome kple Mawu ƒe futɔwo.​ 1 Kronika 20:6; Daniel 3:1; Nyaɖeɖefia 13:18.
ENGLISH: 6 Being one less than seven, which often represents completeness, six can stand for something incomplete or imperfect or something associated with God’s enemies.​ 1 Chronicles 20:6; Daniel 3:1; Revelation 13:18.

EWE: 7 Wozãa xexlẽdzesi sia wòfiaa nu si de keŋkeŋ.
ENGLISH: 7 This number is often used to represent the idea of completeness.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Mawu de se na Israel-viwo be woazɔ aƒo xlã Yeriko-dua ŋkeke adre, eye le ŋkeke adrelia dzi la woaƒo xlã dua zi adre sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: For instance, the Israelites were commanded by God to march around Jericho on seven successive days and to march around seven times on the seventh day.

EWE: (Yosua 6:15) Wozãa xexlẽdzesi adre le gɔmesese sia nu le Biblia me zi geɖe.
ENGLISH: (Joshua 6:​15) The Bible contains many similar examples of such a use of the number seven.

EWE: (3 Mose 4:6; 25:8; 26:18; Psalmo 119:164; Nyaɖeɖefia 1:20; 13:1; 17:10) Esi Yesu gblɔ na Petro be wòatsɔ ake ehavi menye "va se ɖe zi adre o, ke boŋ va se ɖe zi blaadre vɔ adre " la, ale si wògbugbɔ xexlẽdzesi adre yɔ le afi sia fia be "seɖoƒe meli " na zi neni si wòatsɔ ake o. Mateo 18:21, 22.
ENGLISH: (Leviticus 4:6; 25:8; 26:18; Psalm 119:164; Revelation 1:​20; 13:1; 17:10) When Jesus told Peter that he should forgive his brother "not, Up to seven times, but, Up to seventy-seven times, " the repetition of "seven " conveyed the thought of "without limit. "​ Matthew 18:21, 22.

EWE: 10 Xexlẽdzesi sia ate ŋu afia nane ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ katã alo eƒe ƒuƒoƒo.​ 2 Mose 34:28; Luka 19:13; Nyaɖeɖefia 2:10.
ENGLISH: 10 This number can stand for the entirety or aggregate of something.​ Exodus 34:28; Luke 19:13; Revelation 2:​10.

EWE: 12 Edze abe xexlẽdzesi sia fia Mawu ƒe ɖoɖo si sɔ blibo ene.
ENGLISH: 12 This number seems to represent a complete, divine arrangement.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, apostolo Yohanes kpɔ dziƒowo le ŋutega aɖe me, ekpɔ du aɖe, "woɖo gɔmeɖokpe wuieve na dua ƒe gli la . . . eye woŋlɔ Alẽvi la ƒe apostolo wuieveawo ƒe ŋkɔ wuieveawo ɖe wo ŋu. "
ENGLISH: For example, the vision of heaven given to the apostle John included a city with "twelve foundation stones, and on them the twelve names of the twelve apostles. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 21:14; 1 Mose 49:28) Gɔmesese sia ke tea ŋu nɔa xexlẽdzesi siwo woate ŋu ama ɖe teƒe 12 pɛpɛpɛ hã si.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 4:4; 7:4-8.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 21:14; Genesis 49:28) Multiples of 12 can have a similar meaning.​ Revelation 4:4; 7:​4-8.

EWE: 40 Wozãa xexlẽdzesi 40 tsɔ do ƒome kple toheɣi kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbedeasi geɖewo.​ 1 Mose 7:4; Ezekiel 29:11, 12.
ENGLISH: 40 Several judgment or punishment periods were linked with the number 40.​ Genesis 7:4; Ezekiel 29:11, 12.

EWE: Xexlẽdzesifakaka
ENGLISH: Numerology and gematria

EWE: Ale si wozã xexlẽdzesiwo le Biblia me woƒe gɔmesese fiaa nu bubuwo la to vovo sãa na xexlẽdzesifakaka. Le xexlẽdzesifakaka ya gome la, wokaa afa dia xexlẽdzesiwo ƒe gɔmesese kple gɔmesese si le xexlẽdzesiwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒowo si.
ENGLISH: These symbolic meanings of numbers in the Bible are different from numerology, which involves looking for an occult meaning in numbers, their combinations, and numerical totals.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Yudatɔwo ƒe Nyaɣaɣlafialawo xɔe se be gɔmesese ɣaɣla aɖe nɔa nuŋlɔdzesi ɖe sia ɖe si le Hebri Ŋɔŋlɔawo me la si.
ENGLISH: For example, Jewish Cabalists have analyzed the Hebrew Scriptures using a technique called gematria, which looks for a hidden code in the numerical equivalents of letters.

EWE: Xexlẽdzesiwo tsia tsitre ɖi na nuŋlɔdzesi ɖe sia ɖe.
ENGLISH: Numerology is a form of divination, which God condemns.​ Deuteronomy 18:10-​12.

EWE: Mawu lé fu xexlẽdzesifakaka.​ 5 Mose 18:10-12.
ENGLISH: What Does Bible Chronology Indicate About the Year 1914?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Biblia ƒe ɣeyiɣikɔntabubuwo ɖee fia be woɖo Mawu Fiaɖuƒea anyi le dziƒo le ƒe 1914 me.
ENGLISH: Bible chronology indicates that God’s Kingdom was established in heaven in 1914.

EWE: Esia dze le Biblia-gbalẽ si nye Daniel ƒe ta 4 me.
ENGLISH: This is shown by a prophecy recorded in chapter 4 of the Bible book of Daniel.

EWE: Nyagblɔɖia me nya veviwo.
ENGLISH: Overview of the prophecy.

EWE: Ekpɔ ati gã aɖe le drɔ̃ea me, eye wolã ati la ƒu anyi. Woxe mɔ na eƒe takpoea be magadze o "ɣeyiɣi adre. "
ENGLISH: God caused King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon to have a prophetic dream about an immense tree that was chopped down.

EWE: Le esia megbe la, ati la agadze ake.​ Daniel 4:​1, 10-​16.
ENGLISH: Its stump was prevented from regrowing for a period of "seven times, " after which the tree would grow again.​ Daniel 4:​1, 10-​16.

EWE: Nyagblɔɖia ƒe emevava gbãtɔ.
ENGLISH: The prophecy’s initial fulfillment.

EWE: Ati gã la le tsitre ɖi na Fia Nebukadnezar ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: The great tree represented King Nebuchadnezzar himself.

EWE: (Daniel 4:​20-​22) ‘Wolãe ƒu anyi’ le kpɔɖeŋumɔ nu esime wòku tsu ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe eye wòdzo le zi dzi hena ɣeyiɣi adre.
ENGLISH: (Daniel 4:​20-​22) He was figuratively ‘chopped down’ when he temporarily lost his sanity and kingship for a period of seven years.

EWE: (Daniel 4:​25) Esi Mawu na Nebukadnezar ƒe mo kɔ la, egagbugbɔ xɔ eƒe fiazikpuia eye wòlɔ̃ ɖe edzi be Mawue nye dziɖula.​ Daniel 4:​34-​36.
ENGLISH: (Daniel 4:​25) When God restored his sanity, Nebuchadnezzar regained his throne and acknowledged God’s rulership.​ Daniel 4:​34-​36.

EWE: Nu siwo ɖo kpe edzi be ele be nyagblɔɖia nava eme le mɔ si lolo wu nu.
ENGLISH: Evidence that the prophecy has a greater fulfillment.

EWE: Nu si koŋ tae wogblɔ nya sia ɖi ɖo lae nye be "agbagbeawo nanyae be Dziƒoʋĩtɔ lae nye Dziɖula si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe amegbetɔwo ƒe fiaɖuƒewo dzi, eye ame si dze eŋu la, eyae wòtsɔnɛ nana, eye wòtsɔa ame tsɛtɔ le amegbetɔwo dome gɔ̃ hã ɖoa enu. "
ENGLISH: The whole purpose of the prophecy was that "people living may know that the Most High is Ruler in the kingdom of mankind and that he gives it to whomever he wants, and he sets up over it even the lowliest of men. "

EWE: (Daniel 4:17) Fia Nebukadnezar dadala mae Mawu di be yeatsɔ dziɖuɖu ma ana mlɔeba?
ENGLISH: (Daniel 4:​17) Was proud Nebuchadnezzar the one to whom God ultimately wanted to give such rulership?

EWE: Ao, elabena Mawu ɖee fia Fia Nebukadnezar le drɔ̃e aɖe si nye nyagblɔɖi me do ŋgɔ xoxo be fiaɖuƒe sia mayi ɖe eya ŋutɔ loo alo amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖula bubu aɖeke si me o.
ENGLISH: No, for God had earlier given him another prophetic dream showing that neither he nor any other political ruler would fill this role.

EWE: Ke boŋ Mawu "aɖo fiaɖuƒe aɖe anyi, si matsrɔ̃ gbeɖegbeɖe o. "​ Daniel 2:​31-​44.
ENGLISH: Instead, God would himself "set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed. "​ Daniel 2:​31-​44.

EWE: Do ŋgɔ na nudzɔdzɔ ma la, Mawu ɖo fiaɖuƒe aɖe si tsi tre ɖi na eƒe dziɖuɖu ɖe anyigba dzi la anyi: eyae nye blema Israel.
ENGLISH: Previously, God had set up a kingdom to represent his rulership on earth: the ancient nation of Israel.

EWE: Mawu ɖe mɔ ‘wotsrɔ̃’ fiaɖuƒe ma elabena eƒe fiawo mewɔ nuteƒe nɛ o, gake egblɔe ɖi be yeatsɔ fiaɖuƒea ana "ame si tɔ wònye le se nu. "
ENGLISH: God allowed that kingdom to be made "a ruin " because its rulers had become unfaithful, but he foretold that he would give kingship to "the one who has the legal right. "

EWE: (Ezekiel 21:25-​27) Biblia ɖee fia be Yesue nye ame si woɖe mɔ na le se nu be wòaxɔ fiaɖuƒe mavɔ sia.
ENGLISH: (Ezekiel 21:25-​27) The Bible identifies Jesus Christ as the one legally authorized to receive this everlasting kingdom.

EWE: (Luka 1:​30-​33) Yesu to vovo na Nebukadnezar dadala ma, elabena Yesu ‘bɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi le dzi me’ abe ale si tututu wogblɔe ɖi ene.​ Mateo 11:29.
ENGLISH: (Luke 1:​30-​33) Unlike Nebuchadnezzar, Jesus is "lowly in heart, " just as it was prophesied.​ Matthew 11:29.

EWE: Nu kae ati si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Daniel 4 la fia?
ENGLISH: What does the tree of Daniel chapter 4 represent?

EWE: Wozãa atiwo tsɔ tsia tsitre ɖi na fiaɖuƒewo ɣeaɖewoɣi le Biblia me.
ENGLISH: In the Bible, trees sometimes represent rulership.

EWE: (Ezekiel 17:22-​24; 31:​2-5) Le nyagblɔɖi si le Daniel ta 4 ƒe emevava gãtɔa me la, ati la le tsitre ɖi na Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu.
ENGLISH: (Ezekiel 17:22-​24; 31:​2-5) In the greater fulfillment of Daniel chapter 4, the immense tree symbolizes God’s rulership.

EWE: Nu kae atia lalã ƒu anyi fia?
ENGLISH: What does the tree’s being chopped down mean?

EWE: Abe ale si ko atia lalã ƒu anyi fia be Nebukadnezar maganye fia o va se ɖe ɣeyiɣi aɖe la, nenema kee wòfia hã be Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu le anyigba dzi me atso hena ɣeyiɣi aɖe.
ENGLISH: Just as the chopping down of the tree represented an interruption in Nebuchadnezzar’s kingship, it also represented an interruption in God’s rulership on earth.

EWE: Esia va eme esime Nebukadnezar va tsrɔ̃ Yerusalem, du si me Israel fiawo nɔa "Yehowa ƒe fiazikpui dzi " henyea Yehowa ŋutɔ teƒenɔlawo le.​ 1 Kronika 29:23.
ENGLISH: This happened when Nebuchadnezzar destroyed Jerusalem, where the kings of Israel sat on "Jehovah’s throne " as representatives of God himself.​ 1 Chronicles 29:23.

EWE: Nu kae "ɣeyiɣi adre " la le tsitre ɖi na?
ENGLISH: What do the "seven times " represent?

EWE: "Ɣeyiɣi adre " la le tsitre ɖi na ɣeyiɣi si Mawu ɖe mɔ na dukɔwo be woaɖu anyigba dzi esime fiaɖuƒe si Mawu ɖo la ɖeke meli ade nu woƒe nyawo me o.
ENGLISH: The "seven times " represent the period during which God allowed the nations to rule over the earth without interference from any kingdom that he had set up.

EWE: Le Biblia ƒe ɣeyiɣikɔntabubu nu la, "ɣeyiɣi adre " la dze egɔme le October 607 Do Ŋgɔ Na Yesu, esime Babilontɔwo tsrɔ̃ Yerusalem. ​ 2 Fiawo 25:1, 8-10.
ENGLISH: The "seven times " began in October 607 B.C.E., when, according to Bible chronology, Jerusalem was destroyed by the Babylonians. ​ 2 Kings 25:​1, 8-​10.

EWE: Ƒe nenie "ɣeyiɣi adre " la axɔ?
ENGLISH: How long are the "seven times "?

EWE: Mate ŋu anye ƒe adre ŋutɔŋutɔ abe ale si wònɔ le Nebukadnezar gome ene o.
ENGLISH: They could not be merely seven years as in Nebuchadnezzar’s case.

EWE: Yesu na míekpɔ ŋuɖoɖoa esi wògblɔ be "dukɔwo atu afɔ Yerusalem [si le tsitre ɖi na Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu] dzi va se ɖe esime dukɔwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiawo nawu enu. "
ENGLISH: Jesus indicated the answer when he said that "Jerusalem [a symbol of God’s rulership] will be trampled on by the nations until the appointed times of the nations are fulfilled. "

EWE: (Luka 21:24) "Dukɔwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiawo " si nye ɣeyiɣi si Mawu ɖe mɔ be dukɔwo natu afɔ "Yerusalem dzi " kee nye "ɣeyiɣi adre " si nu woƒo nu tsoe le Daniel ta 4.
ENGLISH: (Luke 21:24) "The appointed times of the nations, " the period during which God allowed his rulership to be "trampled on by the nations, " are the same as the "seven times " of Daniel chapter 4.

EWE: Esia fia be esime Yesu nɔ anyigba dzi gɔ̃ hã la, "ɣeyiɣi adre " la mekpɔ wu enu o.
ENGLISH: This means that the "seven times " were still under way even when Jesus was on earth.

EWE: Biblia kpe ɖe mía ŋu míenya ɣeyiɣi didi si "ɣeyiɣi adre " si wogblɔ ɖi la axɔ.
ENGLISH: The Bible provides the way to determine the length of those prophetic "seven times. "

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be ɣeyiɣi etɔ̃ kple afã ƒe didimee nye ŋkeke 1,260. "Ɣeyiɣi adre " nye ema ƒe teƒe eve alo ŋkeke 2,520.
ENGLISH: It says that three and a half "times " equal 1,260 days, so "seven times " equal twice that number, or 2,520 days.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 12:6, 14) Ne míezã nyagblɔɖi ƒe ɣeyiɣikɔntabubu si nye ‘ŋkeke ɖeka na ƒe ɖeka’ la, ke ŋkeke 2,520 tsi tre ɖi na ƒe 2,520.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 12:​6, 14) Applying the prophetic rule "a day for a year, " the 2,520 days represent 2,520 years.

EWE: Eya ta "ɣeyiɣi adre " alo ƒe 2,520 wu enu le October 1914 me.​ 4 Mose 14:34; Ezekiel 4:6.
ENGLISH: Therefore, the "seven times, " or 2,520 years, would end in October 1914.​ Numbers 14:34; Ezekiel 4:6.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia Ƒe Agbalẽa Aleke Nàwɔ Ase Egɔme?
ENGLISH: The Book of Revelation​ What Does it Mean?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Ŋkɔ si le Biblia-gbalẽ si nye Nyaɖeɖefia si le Helagbe me lae nye Apokalypsis si gɔmee nye "Nukoklo le nu ŋu " alo "Nuɖeɖe ɖe go. "
ENGLISH: The Greek name of the Bible book of Revelation, Apokalypsis (apocalypse), means "Uncovering " or "Disclosure. "

EWE: Esia ɖe gɔmesese si le ŋkɔ Nyaɖeɖefia ŋu la fia, elabe aklo nu le nya siwo le ɣaɣla la dzi eye wòaɖe nu siwo ava dzɔ le eŋɔŋlɔ megbe la ɖe go.
ENGLISH: This name indicates the meaning of Revelation​ it uncovers matters that had been hidden and discloses events that would happen long after it was written.

EWE: Nyagblɔɖi siwo le eme dometɔ geɖe mekpɔ va eme o.
ENGLISH: Many of its prophecies are yet to be fulfilled.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me nya veviwo
ENGLISH: Overview of the book of Revelation

EWE: Ŋgɔdonya.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 1:1-9.
ENGLISH: Introduction.​ Revelation 1:​1-9.

EWE: Gbedeasi si tso Yesu gbɔ na hame adreawo.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 1:10–3:22.
ENGLISH: Messages from Jesus to the seven congregations.​ Revelation 1:10–​3:​22.

EWE: Ŋutega si me Mawu nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi le dziƒo le.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 4:1-​11.
ENGLISH: A vision of God on his throne in heaven.​ Revelation 4:1-​11.

EWE: Ŋutega vovovowo, ɖe sia ɖe kplɔa ame yia esi kplɔe ɖo gbɔ:
ENGLISH: A series of visions, each one leading into the next:

EWE: Nutrenu adreawo.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 5:1–​8:6.
ENGLISH: Seven seals.​ Revelation 5:1–​8:6.

EWE: Kpẽ adre, esi woku etɔ̃ mamlɛawo la, fuwɔame etɔ̃ va.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 8:7–​14:20.
ENGLISH: Seven trumpets, the last three of which introduce three woes.​ Revelation 8:7–​14:20.

EWE: Kplu adre, fuwɔame si nye Mawu ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la le ɖe sia ɖe me, eye woakɔ wo ɖe anyigba la dzi.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 15:1–​16:21.
ENGLISH: Seven bowls, each containing a plague representing a divine judgment to be poured out on the earth.​ Revelation 15:1–​16:21.

EWE: Ŋutega si me wotsrɔ̃ Mawu ƒe futɔwo le.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:1–​20:10.
ENGLISH: Visions of the destruction of God’s enemies.​ Revelation 17:1–​20:10.

EWE: Ŋutega siwo ku ɖe ale si Mawu ayra dziƒo kple anyigba la ŋu.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 20:11–​22:5.
ENGLISH: Visions of blessings from God for heaven and earth.​ Revelation 20:11–​22:5.

EWE: Etaƒoƒo.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 22:​6-​21.
ENGLISH: Conclusion.​ Revelation 22:​6-​21.

EWE: Nu vevi siwo akpe ɖe ŋuwò nàse Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa gɔme
ENGLISH: Keys to understanding the book of Revelation

EWE: Emenyawo ƒe gɔmesese ɖea vi na Mawu subɔlawo, menana be vɔvɔ̃ ɖoa wo alo ŋɔ dzia wo o.
ENGLISH: Its meaning is positive, not fearful or terrifying to those who serve God.

EWE: Togbɔ be ame geɖewo gblɔna be tsɔtsrɔ̃ ƒe nyawoe le Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me hã la, le agbalẽa ƒe gɔmedzedze kple eƒe nuwuwu la, wogblɔ be ame siwo xlẽa agbalẽ sia, sea emenyawo gɔme hewɔa wo dzi la akpɔ dzidzɔ.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 1:3; 22:7.
ENGLISH: While many associate the word "apocalypse " with great disaster, the book of Revelation begins and ends by saying that those who read, understand, and apply its message would be happy for doing so.​ Revelation 1:3; 22:7.

EWE: Wozã "dzesiwo, " alo kpɔɖeŋu geɖewo le Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me, eye mele be míase wo gɔme be nenemae wole ŋutɔŋutɔ o.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 1:1.
ENGLISH: Revelation uses many "signs, " or symbols, that are not to be understood literally.​ Revelation 1:1.

EWE: Woƒo nu tso ame vevitɔwo, nu vevitɔwo kple dzesi siwo dze le Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me la ŋu do ŋgɔ le Biblia ƒe akpa bubuwo:
ENGLISH: Many major entities and symbols in the book of Revelation are introduced earlier in the Bible:

EWE: Yehowa​ eyae nye "Mawu vavã le dziƒo, " eyae nye nuwo katã Wɔla.​ 5 Mose 4:39; Psalmo 103:19; Nyaɖeɖefia 4:11; 15:3.
ENGLISH: Jehovah​ "the true God in the heavens " and Creator of all things.​ Deuteronomy 4:​39; Psalm 103:19; Revelation 4:​11; 15:3.

EWE: Yesu Kristo​ "Mawu ƒe Alẽvi " la. Yohanes 1:29; Nyaɖeɖefia 5:6; 14:1.
ENGLISH: Jesus Christ​ "the Lamb of God. "​ John 1:​29; Revelation 5:6; 14:1.

EWE: Satana Abosam​ Mawu ƒe futɔ.​ 1 Mose 3:14, 15; Yohanes 8:44; Nyaɖeɖefia 12:9.
ENGLISH: Satan the Devil​ God’s adversary.​ Genesis 3:​14, 15; John 8:​44; Revelation 12:9.

EWE: Babilon Gã​ hã nye Mawu kple eƒe amewo ƒe futɔ, eye wònye aʋatsodzixɔsewo tsoƒe hã abe ale si ko wònɔ le blema Babilon (Babel) gome ene.​ 1 Mose 11:2-9; Yesaya 13:1, 11; Nyaɖeɖefia 17:4-6; 18:4, 20.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great​ like ancient Babylon (Babel), an enemy of Jehovah God and his people and a source of religious lies.​ Genesis 11:​2-9; Isaiah 13:​1, 11; Revelation 17:​4-6; 18:​4, 20.

EWE: "Atsiaƒu "​ amegbetɔ vɔ̃ɖi siwo tsi tre ɖe Mawu ŋu.​ Yesaya 57:20; Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1; 21:1.
ENGLISH: "The sea "​ wicked mankind opposed to God.​ Isaiah 57:20; Revelation 13:1; 21:1.

EWE: Avɔgbadɔ si nɔ anyi le blema si me wodea ta agu na Mawu le me nu siwo sɔ kple agbalẽ sia me nuwo​ wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye nubablaɖaka, atsiaƒu si le abe ahuhɔ̃e ene (ze hena ŋutikɔklɔ), akaɖiwo, dzudzɔdonu ʋeʋĩ kple vɔsamlekpui.​ 2 Mose 25:10, 17, 18; 40:24-32; Nyaɖeɖefia 4:5, 6; 5:8; 8:3; 11:19.
ENGLISH: Features corresponding to the ancient tabernacle used for God’s worship​ including the ark of the covenant, the glassy sea (basin for washing), lamps, offerings of incense, and an altar of sacrifice.​ Exodus 25:10, 17, 18; 40:24-32; Revelation 4:​5, 6; 5:8; 8:3; 11:19.

EWE: Lã wɔadã la​ si le tsitre ɖi na amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖuwo.​ Daniel 7:1-8, 17-26; Nyaɖeɖefia 13:2, 11; 17:3.
ENGLISH: Wild beasts​ symbolizing human governments.​ Daniel 7:​1-8, 17-​26; Revelation 13:​2, 11; 17:3.

EWE: Xexlẽdzesi siwo wozã le kpɔɖeŋumɔ nu.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 1:20; 8:13; 13:18; 21:16.
ENGLISH: Numbers used symbolically.​ Revelation 1:​20; 8:​13; 13:18; 21:16.

EWE: Ŋutegaawo ku ɖe "Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke " la ŋu, eye ŋkeke sia dze egɔme esime woɖo Mawu Fiaɖuƒea anyi le ƒe 1914 me eye Yesu zu Fia dze dziɖuɖu gɔme.
ENGLISH: The visions apply to "the Lord’s day, " which began when God’s Kingdom was set up in 1914 and Jesus began ruling as King.

EWE: Ne míedi be míase Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa gɔme la, míehiã nu siwo kpena ɖe mía ŋu míesea Biblia ƒe akpa bubuwo gɔme la ke.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 1:​10) We can therefore expect the main fulfillment of Revelation to be in our time.

EWE: Wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye nunya si tso Mawu gbɔ kple ame siwo se egɔme xoxo la ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu.​ Dɔwɔwɔwo 8:26-39; Yakobo 1:5.
ENGLISH: To understand the book of Revelation, we need the same things that help us to understand the rest of the Bible, including wisdom from God and assistance from those who already understand it.​ Acts 8:​26-​39; James 1:5.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye Yerusalem Yeyea?
ENGLISH: What Is New Jerusalem?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Nya "Yerusalem Yeye, " dze zi eve le Biblia me, eye enye kpɔɖeŋudu si le tsitre ɖi na Yesu yomedzelawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo aɖe si aɖu fia kplii le dziƒo le Mawu Fiaɖuƒea me.
ENGLISH: "New Jerusalem, " an expression that appears twice in the Bible, is a symbolic city that represents the group of Jesus’ followers who go to heaven to rule with him in God’s Kingdom.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 3:12; 21:2) Biblia ɖee fia be woagate ŋu ayɔ ƒuƒoƒo sia be Kristo ƒe ŋugbetɔ la.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 3:​12; 21:2) The Bible shows that this group can also be called the bride of Christ.

EWE: Nu siwo akpe ɖe ŋuwò nànya nu si Yerusalem Yeyea nye
ENGLISH: Keys to identifying New Jerusalem

EWE: Dziƒoe Yerusalem yeyea le.
ENGLISH: New Jerusalem is in heaven.

EWE: Ɣesiaɣi si Biblia ƒo nu tso Yerusalem Yeyea ŋu la, egblɔna be ele ɖiɖim tso dziƒo, afi si mawudɔlawo le dua ƒe agbowo nu dzɔm le.
ENGLISH: Each time the Bible mentions New Jerusalem, it is said to come down from heaven, where angels guard the city’s gates.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 3:12; 21:2, 10, 12) Azɔ hã, ale si gbegbe dua loloe la na eme kɔ be menye anyigba dzie wòle o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 3:​12; 21:​2, 10, 12) Also, the city’s great size proves that it could not be on earth.

EWE: Ele dzogoe ene me, eye eƒe didime kple kekeme siaa le "stadio akpe wuieve. "
ENGLISH: It is a cube measuring "12,000 stadia, " or "furlongs, " around.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 21:16) Esia fia be eƒe kɔkɔme anye kilometa 560 kloe, eye aɖo keke yamenutowo me ʋĩi ke.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 21:16; King James Version) Its sides would thus be almost 560 kilometers (350 mi) high, extending into space.

EWE: Yesu yomedzelawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si wogayɔna be Kristo ƒe ŋugbetɔ lae nye Yerusalem Yeyea.
ENGLISH: New Jerusalem is made up of a group of Jesus’ followers, the bride of Christ.

EWE: Woyɔ Yerusalem Yeyea be "ŋugbetɔ la, ame si nye Alẽvi la srɔ̃. "
ENGLISH: New Jerusalem is called "the bride, the Lamb’s wife. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 21:9, 10) Le mawunyakpukpui ma me la, Alẽvi la le tsitre ɖi na Yesu Kristo.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 21:​9, 10) In this symbolic description, the Lamb refers to Jesus Christ.

EWE: (Yohanes 1:29; Nyaɖeɖefia 5:12) "Alẽvi la srɔ̃, " si nye Kristo ƒe ŋugbetɔ la le tsitre ɖi na Kristotɔ siwo awɔ ɖeka kple Yesu le dziƒo.
ENGLISH: (John 1:​29; Revelation 5:​12) "The Lamb’s wife, " Christ’s bride, represents Christians who will be united with Jesus in heaven.

EWE: Biblia tsɔ ƒomedodo sia si le Yesu kple Kristotɔ siawo dome la sɔ kple ƒomedodo si le srɔ̃ŋutsu kple srɔ̃nyɔnu dome.
ENGLISH: The Bible likens the relationship between Jesus and these Christians to that of a husband and wife.

EWE: (2 Korintotɔwo 11:2; Efesotɔwo 5:23-25) Tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, woŋlɔ "Alẽvi la ƒe apostolo wuieveawo ƒe ŋkɔ wuieveawo " ɖe Yerusalem Yeyea ƒe gɔmeɖokpewo dzi.
ENGLISH: (2 Corinthians 11:2; Ephesians 5:​23-​25) In addition, the foundation stones of New Jerusalem are inscribed with "the 12 names of the 12 apostles of the Lamb. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 21:14) Nya sia kpe ɖe mía ŋu míenya nu si Yerusalem Yeyea nye, elabena wotu Kristotɔ siwo ayi dziƒo la ɖe "apostoloawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe gɔmeɖoanyi dzi. " Efesotɔwo 2:20.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 21:14) This detail helps to confirm the identity of New Jerusalem, since Christians who are called to life in heaven are "built up on the foundation of the apostles and prophets. "​ Ephesians 2:​20.

EWE: Yerusalem Yeyea nye dziɖuɖu aɖe ƒe akpa aɖe.
ENGLISH: New Jerusalem is part of a government.

EWE: Blema Yerusalem ye nye Israel ƒe fiadu, afi si Fia David, via Salomo kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo nɔ "Yehowa ƒe fiazikpui dzi " heɖu fia le. (1 Kronika 29:23) Eya ta, Yerusalem, si woyɔ be "du kɔkɔe " la, nɔ tsitre ɖi na Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu to David ƒe fiaƒomea dzi.
ENGLISH: Ancient Jerusalem was the capital of Israel, the place where King David, his son Solomon, and their descendants ruled "on Jehovah’s throne. " (1 Chronicles 29:23) Jerusalem, called "the holy city, " thus represented God’s rulership in the family line of David.

EWE: (Nehemiya 11:1) Woyɔ Yerusalem Yeyea, hã be "du kɔkɔe, " eye du sia me tɔwoe nye ame siwo akpe ɖe Yesu ŋu le dziƒo woaɖu "fia ɖe anyigba la dzi. " Nyaɖeɖefia 5:9, 10; 21:2.
ENGLISH: (Nehemiah 11:1) New Jerusalem, also called "the holy city, " is made up of those who join Jesus in heaven "to rule as kings over the earth. "​ Revelation 5:​9, 10; 21:2.

EWE: Yerusalem Yeyea ahe yayrawo vɛ na anyigbadzitɔwo.
ENGLISH: New Jerusalem brings blessings to people on earth.

EWE: Wogblɔ tso Yerusalem Yeyea ŋu be ele "ɖiɖim tso dziƒo gbɔna tso Mawu gbɔ, " si fia be Mawu zãnɛ tsɔ kpɔa anyigbadzinyawo gbɔe.
ENGLISH: New Jerusalem is depicted as "coming down out of heaven from God, " showing that God uses it to affect matters outside of heaven.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 21:2) Nyagbe ma ɖee fia be Yerusalem Yeyea do ƒome kple Mawu Fiaɖuƒea, elabena Mawu zãa Fiaɖuƒe ma tsɔ nana eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu vaa eme "le anyigba dzi abe ale si wòle le dziƒo ene. "
ENGLISH: (Revelation 21:2) This expression links New Jerusalem with God’s Kingdom, which God uses to accomplish his will "as in heaven, also on earth. "

EWE: (Mateo 6:10) Yayra siwo Mawu ɖo be yeahe vɛ na anyigbadzitɔwo la dometɔ aɖewoe nye esiawo:
ENGLISH: (Matthew 6:​10) God’s purpose for people on earth includes these blessings:

EWE: Aɖe nu vɔ̃ ɖa.
ENGLISH: Removal of sin.

EWE: "Agbetsitɔsisi " aɖe sina tso Yerusalem Yeyea ɖadea tsi ‘agbeti’ siwo "nye dɔyɔgbe na dukɔwo. "
ENGLISH: "A river of water of life " flows from New Jerusalem and supports "trees of life " that are "for the healing of the nations. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 22:1, 2) Ŋutilãmedɔyɔyɔ kple gbɔgbɔmedɔyɔyɔ sia aɖe nu vɔ̃ ɖa eye wòana amewo nanɔ agbe si de blibo, abe ale si Mawu ɖoe tso gɔmedzedzea me ene. Romatɔwo 8:21.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 22:​1, 2) This physical and spiritual healing will remove sin and enable people to gain perfect life, as God originally intended.​ Romans 8:​21.

EWE: Ƒomedodo nyui anɔ Mawu kple amegbetɔwo dome.
ENGLISH: Good relations between God and humankind.

EWE: Nu vɔ̃ gblẽ ƒomedodo si le Mawu kple amegbetɔwo dome.
ENGLISH: Sin has alienated humans from God.

EWE: (Yesaya 59:2) Ne Mawu ɖe nu vɔ̃ ɖa la, nyagblɔɖi sia ava eme bliboe: "Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la le amegbetɔwo gbɔ, eye wòanɔ anyi kpli wo, eye woanye eƒe dukɔ.
ENGLISH: (Isaiah 59:2) The removal of sin will allow for the complete fulfillment of this prophecy: "The tent of God is with mankind, and he will reside with them, and they will be his people.

EWE: Eye Mawu ŋutɔ anɔ anyi kpli wo. " Nyaɖeɖefia 21:3.
ENGLISH: And God himself will be with them. "​ Revelation 21:3.

EWE: Fukpekpe kple ku nu ayi.
ENGLISH: The end of suffering and death.

EWE: Mawu ato eƒe Fiaɖuƒea dzi "atutu aɖatsi sia aɖatsi ɖa le woƒe ŋkume, eye ku maganɔ anyi akpɔ o, konyifafa kple ɣlidodo kpakple vevesese hã maganɔ anyi o. " Nyaɖeɖefia 21:4.
ENGLISH: By means of his Kingdom, God "will wipe out every tear from their eyes, and death will be no more, neither will mourning nor outcry nor pain be anymore. "​ Revelation 21:4.

EWE: Nu Kae Lã Wɔadã Si To Ta Adre Le Nyaɖeɖefia Ta 13 La Nye?
ENGLISH: What Is the Seven-Headed Wild Beast of Revelation Chapter 13?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: PThe Bible’s answer

EWE: Lã wɔadã si to ta adre si ŋuti woƒo nu le zi gbãtɔ le Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1 la nye xexea me katã ƒe dunyahenuɖoanyi la.
ENGLISH: The wild beast with seven heads introduced at Revelation 13:1 represents the worldwide political system.

EWE: Ŋutete, ŋusẽ kple fiazikpui le esi, esia ɖee fia be dunyahehe ƒe nuɖoanyie.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 13:2.
ENGLISH: It has authority, power, and a throne, which point to its being a political entity.​ Revelation 13:2.

EWE: Eɖua "to sia to kple ame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple dukɔ sia dukɔ dzi, " eya ta ekeke ta wu dukɔ ɖekaɖekawo ko.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 13:7.
ENGLISH: It rules over "every tribe and people and tongue and nation, " so it is greater than a single national government.​ Revelation 13:7.

EWE: Lã ene siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Daniel 7:​2-8 ƒe ŋutinuwo dze le eŋu, ele abe lãklẽ ene, eƒe afɔwo le abe sisiblisi tɔwo ene, eƒe nu le abe dzata ƒe nu ene, eye dzo ewo le eta.
ENGLISH: It combines features of the four beasts described in the prophecy at Daniel 7:​2-8, including the appearance of a leopard, the feet of a bear, a lion’s mouth, and ten horns.

EWE: Wogblɔ le lã siwo ŋuti woƒo nu tsoe le Daniel ƒe nyagblɔɖia me ŋu be wonye fiawo alo fiaɖuƒe siwo ɖu dzi kplɔ wo nɔewo ɖo.
ENGLISH: The beasts in Daniel’s prophecy are identified as specific kings, or political kingdoms, that rule in succession over empires.

EWE: (Daniel 7:​17, 23) Eya ta lã wɔadã si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Nyaɖeɖefia ta 13 la nye dunyahehabɔbɔ ƒokpli.
ENGLISH: (Daniel 7:​17, 23) Thus, the wild beast of Revelation chapter 13 represents a composite political organization.

EWE: Edo go "tso atsiaƒu me, " esia fia be etso amegbetɔƒomea me tɔ siwo nye agbodzelawo, siwo gbɔ amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖuwo tsona la me.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1; Yesaya 17:12, 13.
ENGLISH: It ascends "out of the sea, " that is, from the turbulent masses of mankind that are the source of human governments.​ Revelation 13:1; Isaiah 17:12, 13.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be lã wɔadã la ƒe xexlẽdzesi alo eƒe ŋkɔ​ 666​ nye "ame ƒe xexlẽdzesi. "
ENGLISH: The Bible says that the number, or name, of the beast​ 666​ is "a man’s number. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:17, 18) Nyagbɔgblɔ ma fia be lã wɔadã si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Nyaɖeɖefia ta 13 la nye amegbetɔwo ƒe habɔbɔ, ke menye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo tɔe o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:17, 18) That expression indicates that the beast of Revelation chapter 13 is a human entity, not a spirit or demon entity.

EWE: Togbɔ be dukɔwo ƒe nu mesɔna le nu geɖewo me o hã la, wowɔ ɖeka heɖoe kplikpaa be yewoakpɔ yewoƒe ŋusẽa ta eye wogbe be yewomabɔbɔ ɖe Mawu Fiaɖuƒea te o.
ENGLISH: Even though nations may agree on few things, they unite in their determination to maintain their authority rather than submit to the rule of God’s Kingdom.

EWE: (Psalmo 2:2) Dukɔwo aƒo woƒe aʋakɔwo hã nu ƒu be yewoawɔ aʋa kple Mawu ƒe aʋakɔ si anɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe kpɔkplɔ te la le Armagedon me, gake woatsrɔ̃ dukɔawo le aʋa sia me.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 16:14, 16; 19:19, 20.
ENGLISH: (Psalm 2:2) They will also join forces to battle God’s armies commanded by Jesus Christ at Armageddon, but this war will result in the nations being destroyed.​ Revelation 16:14, 16; 19:19, 20.

EWE: "Dzo ewo kple ta adre "
ENGLISH: "Ten horns and seven heads "

EWE: Wozãa xexlẽdzesi aɖewo le kpɔɖeŋumɔ nu le Biblia me.
ENGLISH: Certain numbers are used symbolically in the Bible.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, xexlẽdzesi siwo nye ewo kple adre fiaa blibonyenye.
ENGLISH: For example, ten and seven represent completeness.

EWE: Nu vevi si akpe ɖe mía ŋu míase nu si tututu Nyaɖeɖefia ta 13 me lã wɔadã ƒe "dzo ewo kple ta adre " fia lae nye "lã wɔadã la ƒe legba " si ŋu wova ƒo nu tsoe le Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me​ ebiã helĩhelĩ eye ta adre kple dzo ewo li nɛ.
ENGLISH: The key to understanding the specific meaning of the "ten horns and seven heads " of the beast of Revelation chapter 13 is an "image of the wild beast " identified later in Revelation​ a bright-red beast that has seven heads and ten horns.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1, 14, 15; 17:3) Biblia gblɔ be lã wɔadã dzĩ sia ƒe ta adreawo le tsitre ɖi na "fia adre " alo dziɖuɖu adre.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:9, 10.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:​1, 14, 15; 17:3) The Bible says that the seven heads of this red beast mean "seven kings, " or governments.​ Revelation 17:​9, 10.

EWE: Nenema ke lã wɔadã si to ta adre si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1 la hã le tsitre ɖi na dziɖuɖu adre. Wonye fiaɖuƒe vevitɔ siwo ɖu dzi le amegbetɔwo ƒe ŋutinya me eye woxɔ ŋgɔ le Mawu ƒe amewo tete ɖe anyi me. Woawoe nye Egipte, Asiria, Babilon, Medo-Persia, Hela, Roma kple Anglo-Amerika.
ENGLISH: Likewise, the seven heads of the beast of Revelation 13:1 represent seven governments: the primary political powers that have dominated through history and have taken the lead in oppressing God’s people​ Egypt, Assyria, Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece, Rome, and Anglo-America.

EWE: Ne míeƒo nya ta be dzo ewoawo le tsitre ɖi na dziɖuɖu nɔɖokuisiwo katã, gãwo kple sueawo siaa la, ekema fiakuku siwo le dzoawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋu ɖee fia be dukɔawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple fiaɖuƒe vevitɔ si le woƒe ɣeyiɣia me la ɖua dzi le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me.
ENGLISH: If we conclude that the ten horns represent all sovereign states, small and large, then the diadem, or crown, on each horn shows that each nation rules concurrently with the primary political power of the time.

EWE: Nu Kae Lã Wɔadã Si Biã Helĩhelĩ Si Ŋuti Woƒo Nu Tsoe Le Nyaɖeɖefia Ta 17 La Nye?
ENGLISH: What Is the Scarlet-Colored Beast of Revelation Chapter 17?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ si ŋuti woƒo nu tsoe le Nyaɖeɖefia Ta 17 le tsitre ɖi na habɔbɔ aɖe si ƒe taɖodzinue nye be yeana dukɔ siwo katã le anyigba dzi nawɔ ɖeka eye yeanye woƒe teƒenɔla.
ENGLISH: The scarlet-colored beast, described in Revelation chapter 17, is a symbol of the organization whose purpose is to unite and represent the nations of the world.

EWE: Tsã la, eyae nye Dukɔwo ƒe Nubabla, gake eyae va zu Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo egbea.
ENGLISH: It first existed as the League of Nations and is now the United Nations.

EWE: Ale si nàwɔ akpɔ lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ la adze sii
ENGLISH: Keys to identifying the scarlet-colored beast

EWE: Dunyahehe ƒe habɔbɔ.
ENGLISH: A political entity.

EWE: ‘Ta adre’ le lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ la si, eye mawunyakpukpuia gblɔ be ta siawo le tsitre ɖi na "to adre " kple "fia adre " alo xexemedziɖuɖu sesẽ adre.
ENGLISH: The scarlet-colored beast has "seven heads " that are said to represent "seven mountains " and "seven kings, " or ruling powers.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:9, 10) Wozãa towo kple lã wɔadãwo le Biblia me wole tsitre ɖi na dziɖuɖuwo.​ Yeremiya 51:24, 25; Daniel 2:44, 45; 7:17, 23.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:​9, 10) Mountains and beasts are used in the Bible as symbols of governments.​ Jeremiah 51:24, 25; Daniel 2:​44, 45; 7:​17, 23.

EWE: Eɖi xexea me dunyahehe ƒe nuɖoanyia.
ENGLISH: A likeness of the worldwide political system.

EWE: Lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ la ɖi lã wɔadã si to ta adre si ŋuti woƒo nu tsoe le Nyaɖeɖefia ta 13 me, si le tsitre ɖi na xexea me ƒe dunyahehe ƒe nuɖoanyiawo.
ENGLISH: The scarlet-colored beast resembles the seven-headed beast of Revelation chapter 13, which represents the worldwide political system.

EWE: Lã evea siaa to ta adre kple dzo ewo, eye busuŋkɔwo le wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: Both beasts have seven heads, ten horns, and blasphemous names.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1; 17:3) Woɖi wo nɔewo ale gbegbe be womate ŋu agblɔ be nu dogoɖenunue o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:1; 17:3) These similarities are too striking to be a coincidence.

EWE: Lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ la nye lã wɔadã la ƒe legba alo eƒe nɔnɔmewɔwɔ, si le tsitre ɖi na xexea me dunyahehe ƒe nuɖoanyia.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 13:15.
ENGLISH: The scarlet-colored beast is an image, or likeness, of the worldwide political system.​ Revelation 13:15.

EWE: Exɔ ŋusẽ tso fia bubuwo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: Power from other rulerships.

EWE: Lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ la ‘do tso’ alo dzɔ tso fiaɖuƒe bubuwo me.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:11, 17.
ENGLISH: The scarlet-colored beast "springs from, " or owes its existence to, other ruling forces.​ Revelation 17:11, 17.

EWE: Edo ka kple subɔsubɔhawo.
ENGLISH: Linked with religion.

EWE: Babilon Gã la, si nye alakpasubɔsubɔha siwo katã le xexea me, bɔbɔ nɔ lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ la dzi, eye esia ɖee fia be subɔsubɔhawo kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe lã sia dzi.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:3-5.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great, the world’s collective body of false religions, sits on the scarlet-colored beast, showing that the beast is influenced by religious groups.​ Revelation 17:​3-5.

EWE: Edoa vlo Mawu.
ENGLISH: Dishonors God.

EWE: "Busuŋkɔwo " yɔ lã la ŋuti fũu. Nyaɖeɖefia 17:3.
ENGLISH: The beast is "full of blasphemous names. "​ Revelation 17:3.

EWE: Adzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ sẽe.
ENGLISH: Temporarily inactive.

EWE: Woadee "aʋli me " alo adzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ sẽe, gake agado ake.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:8.
ENGLISH: The scarlet-colored beast would be in "the abyss, " or inactive, for a time but would rise again.​ Revelation 17:8.

EWE: Biblia me nyagblɔɖiawo va eme
ENGLISH: Bible prophecy fulfilled

EWE: Kpɔ ale si Dukɔwo ƒe Nubabla kple Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo si va kplɔe ɖo la ƒe ŋutinya ɖo kpe edzi be Biblia me nyagblɔɖi si ku ɖe lã wɔadã si biã helĩhelĩ ŋu va eme la ɖa.
ENGLISH: Consider how the United Nations and its predecessor, the League of Nations, have fulfilled the Bible’s prophecy of the scarlet-colored beast.

EWE: Dunyahehe ƒe habɔbɔ.
ENGLISH: A political entity.

EWE: Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo de dunyahehe ƒe nuɖoanyi dzi to ale si wòna "dziɖuŋusẽ ƒe sɔsɔminasɔe Emetɔwo katã " me.
ENGLISH: The United Nations supports the political system by upholding "the sovereign equality of all its Members. "

EWE: Eɖi xexea me dunyahehe ƒe nuɖoanyia.
ENGLISH: A likeness of the worldwide political system.

EWE: Le ƒe 2011 me la, Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo gblɔ be dukɔ yeye aɖe va ɖo ye me, esiae nye dukɔ 193 lia.
ENGLISH: In 2011, the United Nations added its 193rd member state.

EWE: Eya ta etea ŋu ƒoa adegbe be yee le dukɔwo kple anyigbadzinɔla akpa gãtɔ teƒe.
ENGLISH: Thus, it claims to represent the vast majority of nations and peoples in the world.

EWE: Exɔ ŋusẽ tso fia bubuwo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: Power from other rulerships.

EWE: Dukɔ siwo le Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo mee na wòli, ŋusẽ agbɔsɔsɔme si dukɔ siawo nɛ la koe nye ŋusẽ si katã le esi.
ENGLISH: The United Nations owes its existence to its member nations and has only as much power and authority as they grant to it.

EWE: Edo ka kple subɔsubɔhawo.
ENGLISH: Linked with religion.

EWE: Xexea me ƒe subɔsubɔhawo doa alɔ Dukɔwo ƒe Nubabla kple Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo siaa ɖaa.
ENGLISH: Both the League of Nations and the United Nations have consistently received the backing of the world’s religions.

EWE: Edoa vlo Mawu.
ENGLISH: Dishonors God.

EWE: Woɖo Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo anyi be wòana "ŋutifafa kple dedienɔnɔ nanɔ dukɔwo dome. "
ENGLISH: The United Nations was established "to maintain international peace and security. "

EWE: Togbɔ be adze abe taɖodzinu nyui aɖee nye esia ene hã la, ɖe Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo doa vlo Mawu to asiƒuƒu akɔ be yeawɔ nu si Mawu gblɔ be yeƒe Fiaɖuƒea ɖeka ko nava wɔ la.​ Psalmo 46:9; Daniel 2:​44.
ENGLISH: While this goal might seem to be praiseworthy, the UN actually dishonors God by claiming to do what he has said only his Kingdom will accomplish.​ Psalm 46:9; Daniel 2:​44.

EWE: Adzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ sẽe.
ENGLISH: Temporarily inactive.

EWE: Dukɔwo ƒe Nubabla si woɖo anyi le Xexemeʋa I megbe kpuie be wòakpɔ ŋutifafa ta la mete ŋu wɔe be dukɔwo medze wo nɔewo dzi o.
ENGLISH: The League of Nations, which was formed shortly after World War I to maintain peace, was unable to prevent international aggression.

EWE: Edzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ esime Xexemeʋa II dze egɔme le ƒe 1939 me.
ENGLISH: It ceased to function when World War II began in 1939.

EWE: Esi Xexemeʋa II wu enu le ƒe 1945 me la, woɖo Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo anyi.
ENGLISH: In 1945, after World War II ended, the United Nations was formed.

EWE: Eƒe taɖodzinuwo, nyawo gbɔ kpɔkpɔ kple eƒe ɖoɖowo sɔ kple Dukɔwo ƒe Nubabla tɔ ale gbegbe.
ENGLISH: Its purposes, methods, and structure closely resemble those of the League of Nations.

EWE: Nu Kae 666 Fia?
ENGLISH: What Does 666 Mean?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Le Biblia-gbalẽ mamlɛtɔ ƒe nya nu la, 666 nye lã wɔadã aɖe ƒe xexlẽdzesi alo ŋkɔ. Wokpɔ lã wɔadã sia si si ta adre le eye wòto dzo ewo la do tso atsiaƒu me.
ENGLISH: According to the last book in the Bible, 666 is the number, or name, of the wild beast with seven heads and ten horns that comes out of the sea.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:1, 17, 18) Lã sia le tsitre ɖi na xexea me ƒe dunyahenuɖoanyi siwo ɖua "to sia to kple ame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple dukɔ sia dukɔ dzi. "
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:​1, 17, 18) This beast is a symbol of the worldwide political system, which rules over "every tribe and people and tongue and nation. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:7) Ŋkɔ 666 ɖee fia be dunyahenuɖoanyi siawo do kpo nu kura le Mawu ŋkume.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:7) The name 666 identifies the political system as a gross failure in God’s sight.

EWE: Le mɔ ka nu?
ENGLISH: How?

EWE: Menye dzesi dzro aɖe koe o.
ENGLISH: More than a label.

EWE: Gɔmesese nɔa ŋkɔ siwo Mawu naa amewo kple nuwo la si.
ENGLISH: Names given by God have meaning.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Mawu na ŋkɔ Abram, si gɔmee nye "Fofo Le Kɔkɔƒe (Wodoe Ðe Dzi) " be Abraham, si gɔmee nye "Amehawo Fofo (Ame Geɖewo Fofo) " esime Mawu do ŋugbe nɛ be yeana wòazu "dukɔ geɖewo fofo. " (1 Mose 17:5, etenuŋɔŋlɔ) Nenema ke Mawu na ŋkɔ 666 lã wɔadã la tsɔ fia nane koŋ tso eƒe nɔnɔme ŋu.
ENGLISH: For example, God gave the man Abram, which means "Father Is High (Exalted), " the name Abraham, which means "Father of a Crowd (Multitude), " when God promised that He would make Abraham "a father of many nations. " (Genesis 17:5, footnotes) Likewise, God named the beast 666 as a symbol of its defining attributes.

EWE: Xexlẽdzesi ade fia blibomademade.
ENGLISH: The number six implies imperfection.

EWE: Zi geɖe la, wozãa xexlẽdzesiwo le kpɔɖeŋumɔ nu le Biblia me.
ENGLISH: Often, numbers are used as symbols in the Bible.

EWE: Xexlẽdzesi si nye adre fiaa nu si de keŋkeŋ alo de blibo.
ENGLISH: Seven typically represents completeness or perfection.

EWE: Ade, si nye ɖeka to le adre me, fiaa nu si mede blibo o alo do kpo nu le Mawu ŋkume, eye wotea ŋu zãnɛ hã tsɔ doa ƒome kple Mawu ƒe futɔwo.​ 1 Kronika 20:6; Daniel 3:1.
ENGLISH: Six, being one short of seven, can denote something incomplete or flawed in God’s eyes, and it can be associated with God’s enemies.​ 1 Chronicles 20:6; Daniel 3:1.

EWE: Wogblɔe zi etɔ̃ tsɔ te gbe ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: Three times for emphasis.

EWE: Ɣeaɖewoɣi la, wogblɔa nyawo zi etɔ̃ le Biblia me tsɔ tea gbe ɖe nyaa dzi.
ENGLISH: The Bible sometimes stresses a matter by stating it three times.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 4:8; 8:13) Eya ta ŋkɔ 666 te gbe ɖe ale si Mawu bua amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖuwo be wodo kpo nu keŋkeŋ la dzi.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 4:8; 8:​13) So the name 666 powerfully emphasizes that God views human political systems as gross failures.

EWE: Womete ŋu he ŋutifafa kple dedienɔnɔ mavɔ vɛ o. Mawu Fiaɖuƒea koe ahe nu siawo vɛ.
ENGLISH: They have been unable to bring lasting peace and security​ things that only God’s Kingdom will achieve.

EWE: Lã wɔadã la ƒe dzesi
ENGLISH: The mark of the beast

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be amewo xɔ "lã wɔadã la ƒe dzesi, " elabena "wodze lã la yome " hede ta agu nɛ.
ENGLISH: The Bible says that people receive "the mark of the wild beast " because they follow it "with admiration, " to the point of worshipping it.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:3, 4; 16:2) Wowɔa esia ne wode ta agu na woƒe dukɔa, eƒe dzesiwo kple eƒe aʋawɔŋusẽwo.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:​3, 4; 16:2) They do this by giving worshipful honor to their country, its symbols, or its military might.

EWE: Numekugbalẽ aɖe (The Encyclopedia of Religion) gblɔ be: "Dulɔlɔ̃ va zu subɔsubɔmɔnu vevitɔ le egbexexea me. "
ENGLISH: As The Encyclopedia of Religion states: "Nationalism has become a dominant form of religion in the modern world. "

EWE: Aleke ame xɔa lã wɔadã la ƒe dzesia ɖe eƒe nuɖusi alo ŋgonu?
ENGLISH: How is the mark of the beast placed on someone’s right hand or forehead?

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 13:16) Mawu gblɔ tso se siwo wòde na Israel-dukɔa ŋu be: "Mibla wo ɖe miaƒe asi ŋu abe ŋkuɖodzinu ene, eye woanɔ abe ŋgoblanu ene le miaƒe ŋgonu. " (5 Mose 11:18) Esia mefia be Israel-viwo nade dzesi woƒe asiwo ŋu kple ŋgonu ŋutɔŋutɔ o, ke boŋ nu si wòfiae nye be Mawu ƒe nyawo nafia mɔ wo le woƒe nuwɔnawo kple woƒe tamesusuwo katã me.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 13:16) Regarding his commands to the nation of Israel, God said: "Bind them as a reminder on your hand, and they should be like a headband on your forehead. " (Deuteronomy 11:18) This meant, not that the Israelites were to mark their literal hands and foreheads, but that God’s words would guide all their actions and thoughts.

EWE: Nenema ke mefia be ame siwo dea ta agu na lã la taa 666 ɖe ŋuti ŋutɔŋutɔ o, ke boŋ nu si dzesia fia le ame siawo ŋu le kpɔɖeŋumɔ nue nye be woɖe mɔ xexe sia me dziɖuɖuwo kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe woƒe agbe dzi.
ENGLISH: Likewise, rather than being something literal such as a 666 tattoo, the mark of the beast symbolically identifies those who let the political system rule their lives.

EWE: Ame siwo xɔ lã ƒe dzesia la tsi tre ɖe Mawu ŋu.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 14:9, 10; 19:19-21.
ENGLISH: Those with the mark of the beast place themselves in opposition to God.​ Revelation 14:​9, 10; 19:19-​21.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye Babilon Gã La?
ENGLISH: What Is Babylon the Great?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Babilon Gã si woɖɔ le Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me la le tsitre ɖi na xexea me ƒe alakpasubɔsubɔhawo katã ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, eye Mawu lé fui.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great, described in the book of Revelation, is the world’s collective body of false religions, which God rejects.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 14:8; 17:5; 18:21) Togbɔ be subɔsubɔha siawo to vovo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ le mɔ geɖewo nu hã la, wo katã wokplɔa amewo tranae ale be womagasubɔ Yehowa, Mawu vavã la o.​ 5 Mose 4:35.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 14:8; 17:5; 18:21) Although those religions differ in many respects, in one way or another they all lead people away from the worship of the true God, Jehovah.​ Deuteronomy 4:​35.

EWE: Nu siwo akpe ɖe ŋuwò nàde dzesi Babilon Gã la
ENGLISH: Keys to identifying Babylon the Great

EWE: Babilon Gã la nye dzesi.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great is a symbol.

EWE: Biblia ɖɔe be enye "nyɔnu " eye wònye "gbolo gã " eye ŋkɔ si nye "nya ɣaɣla " le esi, eyae nye "Babilon Gã la. " (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:1, 3, 5) Esi wònye be ɖe woɖe Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me nyawo fia to "dzesiwo me " ta la, esɔ be míaƒo nya ta be menye nyɔnu ŋutɔŋutɔe Babilon Gã la nye o, ke nane ƒe dzesi ko wònye.
ENGLISH: The Bible describes her as "a woman " and a "great prostitute, " having a name that is "a mystery: ‘Babylon the Great.’ " (Revelation 17:​1, 3, 5) The book of Revelation is presented "in signs, " so it is reasonable to conclude that Babylon the Great is a symbol, not a literal woman.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 1:1) Tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, ‘ebɔbɔ nɔ tsi geɖewo dzi,’ si tsi tre ɖi na "amewo kple amehawo kple dukɔwo kpakple gbegbɔgblɔwo. "
ENGLISH: (Revelation 1:1) In addition, she "sits on many waters, " which represent "peoples and crowds and nations and tongues. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:1, 15) Nyɔnu ŋutɔŋutɔ mate ŋu awɔ nu sia o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:​1, 15) A literal woman could not do that.

EWE: Babilon Gã la le tsitre ɖi na xexea me katã ƒe nuɖoanyi aɖe.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great represents an international entity.

EWE: Woyɔe be "du gã, si ƒe fiaɖuƒe kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe anyigbadzifiawo dzi. "
ENGLISH: She is called "the great city that has a kingdom over the kings of the earth. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:18) Esia fia be ekeke ta eye eƒe ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi de du.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:18) Thus, she has international scope and influence.

EWE: Babilon Gã la nye subɔsubɔhabɔbɔ, ke menye dunyaheha alo asitsaha o.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great is a religious entity, not a political or commercial one.

EWE: Blema Babilon nye du si xɔ ŋkɔ le subɔsubɔnyawo me, wonyae ɖe eƒe "gbesawo " kple eƒe "dzosasa geɖeawo " ta.
ENGLISH: Ancient Babylon was a profoundly religious city, known for its use of spiritistic "spells " and "sorceries. "

EWE: (Yesaya 47:1, 12, 13; Yeremiya 50:1, 2, 38) Alakpasubɔsubɔ si Mawu vavã, Yehowa, lé fui la yi edzi le du ma me.
ENGLISH: (Isaiah 47:​1, 12, 13; Jeremiah 50:​1, 2, 38) In fact, false religion in opposition to the true God, Jehovah, was practiced there.

EWE: (1 Mose 10:8, 9; 11:2-4, 8) Babilon-fiawo do wo ɖokuiwo ɖe dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu eye wotsi tre ɖe eƒe subɔsubɔ ŋu.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 10:​8, 9; 11:​2-4, 8) The rulers of Babylon arrogantly exalted themselves above Jehovah and his worship.

EWE: (Yesaya 14:4, 13, 14; Daniel 5:2-4, 23) Nenema kee wonya Babilon Gã la hã ɖe eƒe "gbɔgbɔyɔnuwɔnawo " ta.
ENGLISH: (Isaiah 14:​4, 13, 14; Daniel 5:​2-4, 23) Likewise, Babylon the Great is known for her "spiritistic practices. "

EWE: Esia ɖee fia be enye subɔsubɔhabɔbɔ.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 18:23.
ENGLISH: That shows her to be a religious organization.​ Revelation 18:23.

EWE: Babilon Gã la menye dunyahehabɔbɔ o, elabena Biblia gblɔ be, "anyigbadzifiawo " xa nu esi wotsrɔ̃e.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great cannot be a political entity, because "the kings of the earth " mourn her destruction.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:1, 2; 18:9) Menye asitsahabɔbɔ hãe wònye o, elabena Biblia me nyawo ɖee fia be eto vovo na "anyigbadzisitsalawo. "​ Nyaɖeɖefia 18:11, 15.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:​1, 2; 18:9) Neither is she a commercial power, because the Bible distinguishes her from "the merchants of the earth. "​ Revelation 18:11, 15.

EWE: Babilon Fia Nabonido ƒe Kpetata si dzi mawuetɔ̃ƒokpli siwo nye Sin, Istar, kple Samas ƒe tata le
ENGLISH: Stela of Babylonian King Nabonidus with symbols of the triad of gods Sin, Ishtar, and Shamash

EWE: Babilon Fia Nabonido ƒe Kpetata si dzi mawuetɔ̃ƒokpli siwo nye Sin, Istar, kple Samas ƒe tata le
ENGLISH: Stela of Babylonian King Nabonidus with symbols of the triad of gods Sin, Ishtar, and Shamash

EWE: Ale si woɖɔ Babilon Gã la sɔ kple alakpasubɔsubɔhawo pɛpɛpɛ.
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great fits the profile of false religion.

EWE: Le esi woafia amewo ale si woawɔ ate ɖe Mawu vavã, Yehowa, ŋu teƒe la, ɖe wonana amewo subɔa mawu bubuwo boŋ.
ENGLISH: Rather than teaching people how to draw closer to the true God, Jehovah, false religion actually leads them to worship other gods.

EWE: Biblia yɔ nuwɔna sia be "gbɔgbɔmehasi. " (3 Mose 20:6; 2 Mose 34:15, 16) Mawuɖekaetɔ̃ alo Trinita Kɔkɔe kple luʋɔ makumaku ƒe nufiafiawo kpakple nuwɔnawo abe nɔnɔmewɔwɔwo zazã le subɔsubɔ me la dzɔ tso blema Babilon, eye woyi edzi xɔ aƒe ɖe alakpasubɔsubɔhawo me.
ENGLISH: The Bible calls this "spiritual prostitution. " (Leviticus 20:6; Exodus 34:15, 16) Beliefs such as the Trinity and the immortality of the soul and practices such as the use of images in worship date back to ancient Babylon and continue to permeate false religion.

EWE: Xexea me nuwo lɔlɔ̃ hã xɔ aƒe ɖe wo me.
ENGLISH: These religions also blend their worship with love for the world.

EWE: Biblia yɔ nuteƒemawɔmawɔ sia tɔgbi be gbɔgbɔmehasiwɔwɔ.​ Yakobo 4:4.
ENGLISH: The Bible refers to this form of unfaithfulness as spiritual adultery.​ James 4:4.

EWE: Biblia ɖɔ Babilon Gã la be ‘edo aɖabɛwu kple awu dzĩ’ eye "wòtsɔ sika kple kpe xɔasiwo kple dzonuwo ɖo atsyɔ̃ na eɖokui, " si ɖe eƒe kesinɔtɔnyenye fia. Alea kee wòle le alakpasubɔsubɔhawo hã gome.
ENGLISH: False religion’s wealth and showy display of it match the picture that the Bible paints of Babylon the Great, who is "clothed in purple and scarlet " and "adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:4) Babilon Gã la mee "anyigbadziŋunyɔnuwo " alo nufiafia kple nuwɔna siwo katã medea bubu Mawu ŋu o la dzɔ tso.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:4) Babylon the Great is the source of "the disgusting things of the earth, " or the teachings and actions that actually dishonor God.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:5) Ame siwo le alakpasubɔsubɔhawo me woe nye "amewo kple amehawo kple dukɔwo kpakple gbegbɔgblɔwo " siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Babilon Gã la.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:15.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:5) The members of false religion are the "peoples and crowds and nations and tongues " who support Babylon the Great.​ Revelation 17:15.

EWE: Babilon Gã lae le megbe na "ame siwo katã wowu le anyigba dzi la. "
ENGLISH: Babylon the Great is responsible for the deaths "of all those who have been slaughtered on the earth. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 18:24) Le amegbetɔwo ƒe ŋutinya me la, alakpasubɔsubɔhawo da megbe na aʋawɔwɔ kple nu vlo wɔwɔwo, eye womefiaa woƒe hameviwo nyateƒe si ku ɖe Yehowa si nye lɔlɔ̃ Mawu la ŋu o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 18:24) Throughout history, false religion has not only fomented wars and fueled acts of terrorism but has also failed to teach people the truth about Jehovah, the God of love.

EWE: (1 Yohanes 4:8) Esia na wokɔ ʋu geɖe ɖi.
ENGLISH: (1 John 4:8) This failure has contributed to much bloodshed.

EWE: Eya ta esɔ be ame siwo katã di be yewoadze Mawu ŋu la ‘nado go le’ Babilon Gã la me, si fia be woaɖe wo ɖokuiwo ɖa tso alakpasubɔsubɔhawo gbɔ.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 18:4; 2 Korintotɔwo 6:14-17.
ENGLISH: For good reason, those who want to please God must "get out of her, " separating themselves from false religion.​ Revelation 18:4; 2 Corinthians 6:​14-​17.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye ‘Dzota’ La?
ENGLISH: What Is the Lake of Fire?

EWE: Eya Kee Nye Dzo Mavɔ Alo Gehena?
ENGLISH: Is It the Same as Hell or Gehenna?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Dzota nye kpɔɖeŋu na tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ.
ENGLISH: The lake of fire is a symbol of eternal destruction.

EWE: Esɔ kple Gehena, gake eto vovo na tsiẽƒe si gɔme woɖena le Biblia aɖewo me be dzo mavɔ.
ENGLISH: It is the same as Gehenna, but it is different from hell, which is the common grave of mankind.

EWE: Menye ta ŋutɔŋutɔe o
ENGLISH: Not a literal lake

EWE: Mawunyakpukpui atɔ̃ siwo me "dzota " dze le la ɖee fia be menye ta ŋutɔŋutɔe o, ke boŋ kpɔɖeŋumɔ nue wozãe le.
ENGLISH: The five Bible verses that mention "the lake of fire " show it to be a symbol rather than a literal lake.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 19:20; 20:10, 14, 15; 21:8) Wotsɔ nu vovovo siawo ƒu gbe ɖe dzota la me:
ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:20; 20:10, 14, 15; 21:8) The following are cast into the lake of fire:

EWE: Abosam.
ENGLISH: The Devil.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 20:10) Esi wònye gbɔgbɔmenuwɔwɔe Abosam nye ta la, dzo ŋutɔŋutɔ mate ŋu afiãe o.​ 2 Mose 3:2; Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo 13:20.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 20:10) As a spirit creature, the Devil cannot be harmed by literal fire.​ Exodus 3:2; Judges 13:20.

EWE: Ku.
ENGLISH: Death.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 20:14) Menye ŋutilãmenue ku nye o, efia dɔmawɔmawɔ alo agbemanɔmanɔ.(Nyagblɔla 9:10) Dzo mate ŋu afiã ku ŋutɔŋutɔ o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 20:14) This is not a literal entity but represents a state of inactivity, the absence of life. (Ecclesiastes 9:​10) Death cannot literally be burned.

EWE: "Lã wɔadã la kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila. "
ENGLISH: "The wild beast " and "the false prophet. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 19:20) Esi wònye be kpɔɖeŋunuwoe nu siawo nye ta la, ɖe susu mele be míaƒo nya ta be kpɔɖeŋunue dzota si me wotsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖo la hã nye oa?​ Nyaɖeɖefia 13:11, 12; 16:13.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:20) Since these are symbols, doesn’t it seem reasonable to conclude that the lake they are thrown into is also a symbol?​ Revelation 13:11, 12; 16:13.

EWE: Etsi tsitre ɖi na tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ
ENGLISH: A symbol of eternal destruction

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be dzota la "le tsitre ɖi na ku evelia. "
ENGLISH: The Bible says that the lake of fire "means the second death. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 20:14; 21:8) Ku gbãtɔ si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Biblia me lae nye ku si Adam ƒe nu vɔ̃ he va mía dzi eye woate ŋu aɖe amewo tso ku sia me to tsitretsitsia dzi.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 20:14; 21:8) The first kind of death mentioned in the Bible resulted from Adam’s sin.

EWE: Eye Mawu ava ɖe ku sia ɖa mlɔeba.​ 1 Korintotɔwo 15:21, 22, 26.
ENGLISH: This death can be reversed by resurrection and will eventually be eliminated by God.​ 1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 26.

EWE: Womete ŋu aɖe ame tso kpɔɖeŋudzota la me o
ENGLISH: There is no release from the symbolic lake of fire

EWE: Dzota ya le tsitre ɖi na ku ƒomevi bubu alo ku evelia.
ENGLISH: The lake of fire represents a different, or second, kind of death.

EWE: Togbɔ be eya hã nye agbemanɔmanɔ keŋkeŋ ƒe nɔnɔme hã la, eto vovo sãsãsã na gbãtɔa, elabena Biblia megblɔ nya aɖeke tso tsitretsitsi tso ku sia me ŋu o.
ENGLISH: Although it too represents a state of total inactivity, it is different in that the Bible says nothing about a resurrection from the second death.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Biblia gblɔ be "ku kple Tsiẽƒe ƒe safuiwo le " Yesu si, eye esia ɖee fia be ŋusẽ le esi be wòafɔ ame siwo ku le Adam ƒe nu vɔ̃a ta la.
ENGLISH: For example, the Bible says that Jesus has "the keys of hell and of death, " showing that he has the authority to release people from the death brought by Adam’s sin.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 1:18; 20:13) Ke hã, dzota ya ƒe safui mele Yesu loo alo ame bubu aɖeke si o.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 1:​18; 20:13, King James Version) However, neither Jesus nor anyone else has a key to the lake of fire.

EWE: Kpɔɖeŋudzota sia le tsitre ɖi na tohehe mavɔ si nye tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ.​ 2 Tesalonikatɔwo 1:9.
ENGLISH: That symbolic lake represents eternal punishment in the form of permanent destruction.​ 2 Thessalonians 1:9.

EWE: Dzota la kee nye Gehena, si gɔmee nye Hinom Bali
ENGLISH: Identical to Gehenna, the Valley of Hinnom

EWE: Nya Gehena (Helagbe, geenna) dze le Biblia me zi 12 sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: Gehenna (Greek geenna) is mentioned 12 times in the Bible.

EWE: Eya hã nye tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ, abe ale si wòle le dzota gome ene.
ENGLISH: Like the lake of fire, it is a symbol of eternal destruction.

EWE: Togbɔ be woɖe nya sia gɔme le Biblia aɖewo me be "dzo mavɔ " (tsiẽƒe) hã la, Gehena to vovo na tsiẽƒe (Hebrigbe sheohl, Helagbe haides).
ENGLISH: Although some translations render this word as "hell, " Gehenna is different from hell (Hebrew sheohl, Greek haides).

EWE: Blema Hinom Bali si nɔ Yerusalem-dua godo si me dzo nɔa bibim le ɖaa
ENGLISH: The ancient valley of Hinnom outside the wall of Jerusalem with a fire constantly burning

EWE: Hinom Bali
ENGLISH: The Valley of Hinnom

EWE: "Gehena " ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe tẽe nye "Hinom Bali, " si nye bali aɖe le Yerusalem-dua godo tututu.
ENGLISH: The word "Gehenna " literally means "Valley of Hinnom, " referring to a valley just outside Jerusalem.

EWE: Le Biblia-ŋlɔɣiwo la, dua me tɔwo kɔa gbeɖuɖɔ le balia me.
ENGLISH: In Bible times, the city residents used this valley as a garbage dump.

EWE: Wona dzo nɔa bibim le afi ma ɣesiaɣi ale be gbeɖuɖɔwo nabi; eye nyéwo ɖua nu siwo dzoa mete ŋu fiã o.
ENGLISH: They kept a fire constantly burning there to destroy refuse; maggots consumed anything that the fire did not reach.

EWE: Yesu zã Gehena tsɔ wɔ kpɔɖeŋu na tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ.
ENGLISH: Jesus used Gehenna as a symbol of everlasting destruction.

EWE: (Mateo 23:33) Egblɔ be "nyéwo mekuna " le Gehena o, "eye dzo metsina " le afi ma o.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 23:33) He said that in Gehenna "the maggot does not die and the fire is not put out. "

EWE: (Marko 9:47, 48) Eto nya siawo dzi le nu ƒom tso nu siwo yia edzi le Hinom Bali la me kple nyagblɔɖi si le Yesaya 66:24 me hã ŋu. Mawunyakpukpui ma gblɔ be: "Woado ayi aɖakpɔ ame siwo da vo ɖe ŋunye la ƒe kukuawo; elabena woƒe nyéwo maku o, eye woƒe dzo la matsi o. "
ENGLISH: (Mark 9:​47, 48) He thus alluded to the conditions in the Valley of Hinnom and also to the prophecy at Isaiah 66:24, which says: "They will go out and look on the carcasses of the men who rebelled against me; for the worms on them will not die, and their fire will not be extinguished. "

EWE: Yesu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu sia mefia funyafunyawɔwɔ ame o, ke boŋ tsɔtsrɔ̃ ɖikaa.
ENGLISH: Jesus’ illustration describes, not torture, but complete annihilation.

EWE: Ŋutilã kukuwo domee dzo kple nyéwo gblẽna, menye ame gbagbewo o.
ENGLISH: The worms and fire consume carcasses, or dead bodies, not living people.

EWE: Biblia megblɔ nya aɖeke si fia be ame siwo yi Gehena la ate ŋu afɔ o.
ENGLISH: The Bible gives no indication of any return from Gehenna.

EWE: "Dzota " la kple "Gehena ƒe dzo la " siaa le tsitre ɖi na tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ. Nyaɖeɖefia 20:14, 15; 21:8; Mateo 18:9.
ENGLISH: "The lake of fire " and "the fiery Gehenna " both represent permanent, everlasting destruction.​ Revelation 20:14, 15; 21:8; Matthew 18:9.

EWE: Aleke "woawɔ fu wo zã kple keli tegbetegbee "?
ENGLISH: How "tormented day and night forever and ever "?

EWE: Ne tsɔtsrɔ̃ koe dzota la le tsitre ɖi na ɖe, ke nu ka tae Biblia gblɔ be "woawɔ fu " Abosam, lã wɔadã la kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila la le eme "zã kple keli tegbetegbee "?
ENGLISH: If the lake of fire is a symbol of destruction, why does the Bible say that in it the Devil, the wild beast, and the false prophet "will be tormented day and night forever and ever "?

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 20:10) Na míadzro susu ene siwo tae mate ŋu anye be fuwɔwɔ ame ŋutɔŋutɔe wowɔnɛ le afi sia o la me:
ENGLISH: (Revelation 20:10) Consider four reasons why this torment does not refer to literal torture:

EWE: Hafi woate ŋu anɔ funyafunya wɔm Abosam tegbee la, ke ahiã be wòanɔ agbe tegbee.
ENGLISH: For the Devil to be tortured eternally, he would have to be kept alive forever.

EWE: Evɔ Biblia gblɔ be woaxɔ ŋusẽ le esi alo atsrɔ̃e ɖa keŋkeŋ.​ Hebritɔwo 2:​14.
ENGLISH: However, the Bible says that he will be brought to nothing, or put out of existence.​ Hebrews 2:​14.

EWE: Mawu ƒe nunanae agbe mavɔ nye, menye tohehee o.​ Romatɔwo 6:​23.
ENGLISH: Everlasting life is a gift from God, not a punishment.​ Romans 6:​23.

EWE: Kpɔɖeŋunuwoe lã wɔadã la kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila nye, eya ta womate ŋu awɔ funyafunya wo o.
ENGLISH: The wild beast and the false prophet are symbols and cannot experience literal torture.

EWE: Biblia me nyawo ɖee fia be funyafunya si woawɔ Abosam la tsi tsitre ɖi na mɔxexe ɖe enu alo etsɔtsrɔ̃ ɖa tegbee.
ENGLISH: The context of the Bible indicates that the torment of the Devil is everlasting restraint or destruction.

EWE: Nyagbe "woawɔ fu " si wozã le Biblia me la agate ŋu afia "mɔxexe ɖe ame nu. "
ENGLISH: The word used for "torment " in the Bible can also mean "a condition of restraint. "

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, woɖe Helagbe me nya si gɔmee nye "ŋutasẽlawo " gɔme le Biblia geɖewo me le Mateo 18:34 be "gaxɔdzikpɔlawo. " Esia ɖee fia be kadodo aɖe le ‘fuwɔwɔ ame’ kple "mɔxexe ɖe ame nu " dome.
ENGLISH: For example, the Greek word for "tormentors " used at Matthew 18:34 is rendered as "jailers " in many translations, showing the connection between the words "torment " and "restraint. "

EWE: Nenema ke le Mateo 8:​29 kple Luka 8:​30, 31 siwo ƒo nu tso nudzɔdzɔ ɖeka ŋu la, wotsɔ ‘fuwɔame’ sɔ kple ‘aʋli me,’ si le tsitre ɖi na dɔmawɔmawɔ alo ku.
ENGLISH: Likewise, the parallel accounts at Matthew 8:​29 and Luke 8:​30, 31 equate "torment " with "the abyss, " a figurative place of complete inactivity or death.

EWE: (Romatɔwo 10:7; Nyaɖeɖefia 20:1, 3) Le nyateƒe me la, wozã "woawɔ fu " alo "wɔ fu " le kpɔɖeŋunyagbɔgblɔ nu le Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa me zi geɖe. Nyaɖeɖefia 9:5; 11:10; 18:7, 10.
ENGLISH: (Romans 10:7; Revelation 20:​1, 3) In fact, several times the book of Revelation uses the word "torment " in a symbolic sense.​ Revelation 9:5; 11:10; 18:​7, 10.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye "Ŋkeke Mamlɛawo " Alo "Nuwuɣi " La Ƒe Dzesi?
ENGLISH: What Is the Sign of "the Last Days, " or "End Times "?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Biblia gblɔ nudzɔdzɔ kple nɔnɔme siwo ade dzesi "nuɖoanyi [sia] ƒe nuwuɣi " alo ɣeyiɣi siwo ado ŋgɔ na "xexea me ƒe nuwuwu " la ɖi.
ENGLISH: The Bible describes events and conditions that would mark "the conclusion of the [current] system of things, " or "the end of the world. "

EWE: (Mateo 24:3; Eʋegbe Biblia) Biblia yɔ ɣeyiɣi sia be "ŋkeke mamlɛawo, " "nuwuwu ƒe ɣeyiɣi, " alo "nuwuɣi " la. (2 Timoteo 3:1; Daniel 8:​19; Eʋegbe Biblia) Nyagblɔɖi siwo le eme vam ku ɖe ŋkeke mamlɛawo, alo nuwuɣia, ŋu dometɔ vevi aɖewoe nye esi:
ENGLISH: (Matthew 24:3; King James Version) The Bible calls this time period "the last days " and the "time of the end, " or "end times. " (2 Timothy 3:1; Daniel 8:​19; Easy-to-Read Version) The following are some outstanding features of last-days, or end-times, prophecies:

EWE: Aʋawɔwɔ dziŋɔwo.​ Mateo 24:7; Nyaɖeɖefia 6:4.
ENGLISH: War on a large scale.​ Matthew 24:7; Revelation 6:4.

EWE: Dɔwuame.​ Mateo 24:7; Nyaɖeɖefia 6:​5, 6.
ENGLISH: Famine.​ Matthew 24:7; Revelation 6:​5, 6.

EWE: Anyigbaʋuʋu gãwo.​ Luka 21:11.
ENGLISH: Great earthquakes.​ Luke 21:11.

EWE: Dɔvɔ̃wo.​ Luka 21:11.
ENGLISH: Pestilences, or epidemics of "terrible diseases. "​ Luke 21:11, Contemporary English Version.

EWE: Nu vlo wɔwɔ ƒe dzidziɖedzi.​ Mateo 24:12.
ENGLISH: Increase of crime.​ Matthew 24:12.

EWE: Amegbetɔwo le anyigba la gblẽm.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 11:18.
ENGLISH: Ruining of the earth by mankind.​ Revelation 11:18.

EWE: Amewo ƒe nɔnɔme le gbegblẽm ɖe edzi, elabena ame geɖewo nye "ame madakpewo, ame mawɔnuteƒewo, . . . ame siwo melɔ̃na ɖe ɖoɖo aɖeke dzi o, ameŋugblẽlawo, ame siwo meɖua wo ɖokuiwo dzi o, ame wɔadãwo, ame siwo melɔ̃a nu nyui o, yomemɔfialawo, totrilawo, ame siwo doa wo ɖokuiwo ɖe dzi glodzoo. "​ 2 Timoteo 3:1-4.
ENGLISH: Deterioration of people’s attitudes, as shown by many who are "unthankful, disloyal, . . . not open to any agreement, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, without love of goodness, betrayers, headstrong, puffed up with pride. "​ 2 Timothy 3:​1-4.

EWE: Ƒomewo le gbagbãm, elabena ƒometɔ aɖewo ‘megalɔ̃a ame ƒe nya o,’ eye ɖevi geɖe ‘megaɖoa to wo dzilawo o.’​ 2 Timoteo 3:2, 3.
ENGLISH: Breakdown of the family, with people who have "no natural affection " and children who are "disobedient to parents. "​ 2 Timothy 3:​2, 3.

EWE: Ame akpa gãtɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na Mawu yi to.​ Mateo 24:12.
ENGLISH: Love of God growing cold in most people.​ Matthew 24:12.

EWE: Subɔsubɔhawo ƒe alakpanuwɔwɔwo le dzedzem gaglãa.​ Mateo 24:12.
ENGLISH: Noteworthy displays of religious hypocrisy.​ 2 Timothy 3:5.

EWE: Biblia me nyagblɔɖiwo gɔmesese ɖe edzi, esiwo ku ɖe ŋkeke mamlɛawo ŋu hã le eme.​ Daniel 12:4.
ENGLISH: Increased understanding of Bible prophecies, including those related to the last days.​ Daniel 12:4.

EWE: Gbeƒãɖeɖe Fiaɖuƒe ŋuti nya nyuia le xexea me godoo.​ Mateo 24:14.
ENGLISH: Global preaching of the good news of the Kingdom.​ Matthew 24:14.

EWE: Ame akpa gãtɔ metsɔ ɖeke le kpeɖodzi siwo ɖee fia be nuwuwua gogo me o, eye eɖia kokoe na wo gɔ̃ hã.​ Mateo 24:37-​39; 2 Petro 3:​3, 4.
ENGLISH: Widespread apathy and even ridicule toward the evidence of the approaching end.​ Matthew 24:37-​39; 2 Peter 3:​3, 4.

EWE: Nyagblɔɖi siawo katã le eme vam le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, ke menye wo dometɔ ʋɛ aɖewo alo wo dometɔ akpa gãtɔ ko o.​ Mateo 24:33.
ENGLISH: The simultaneous fulfillment of all these prophecies, not just a few or even most of them.​ Matthew 24:33.

EWE: "Ŋkeke mamlɛawo " mee míele vavã?
ENGLISH: Are we living in "the last days "?
Yes.

EWE: Nu siwo le dzɔdzɔm le xexea me kple Biblia ƒe ɣeyiɣikɔntabubuwo ɖee fia be ŋkeke mamlɛawo dze egɔme tso ƒe 1914 me.
ENGLISH: World conditions as well as Bible chronology indicate that the last days began in 1914.

EWE: Ɣemaɣi la, Mawu Fiaɖuƒea dze dziɖuɖu gɔme le dziƒo, eye tɔtrɔ siwo wòhe vɛ dometɔ ɖekae nye be wonya Satana Abosam kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le dziƒo ɖo ɖe anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: At that time, God’s Kingdom began ruling in heaven, and one of its first actions was to expel Satan the Devil and the demons from heaven and restrict their activity to the earth.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 12:7-12) Ale si Satana le ŋusẽ kpɔm ɖe amegbetɔwo dzi egbea la dzena le woƒe nuwɔna kple nɔnɔme gbegblẽwo me, si wɔe be ŋkeke mamlɛawo nye ‘ɣeyiɣi sesẽ siwo me nɔnɔ sesẽ’ vavã.​ 2 Timoteo 3:1.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 12:​7-​12) Satan’s influence on mankind can be seen in many of the bad attitudes and actions that make the last days "critical times hard to deal with. "​ 2 Timothy 3:1.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye Xaxa Gã La?
ENGLISH: What Is the Great Tribulation?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Biblia gblɔe ɖi be ɣeyiɣi sia ava le "ŋkeke mamlɛawo " alo "nuwuɣi " la me.
ENGLISH: The great tribulation will bring the greatest time of trouble ever to come upon mankind.

EWE: (2 Timoteo 3:1; Daniel 12:4) "Anye xaxa si tɔgbi meva kpɔ tso esime Mawu wɔ xexea va se ɖe fifi o, eye etɔgbi megale vava ge ake o. "​ Marko 13:19; Daniel 12:1; Mateo 24:21, 22.
ENGLISH: According to Bible prophecy, it will occur during "the last days, " or "the end time. " (2 Timothy 3:1; Daniel 12:4, New American Bible) It will be "a tribulation such as has not occurred from the beginning of the creation that God created until that time, and will not occur again. "​ Mark 13:19; Daniel 12:1; Matthew 24:21, 22.

EWE: Nu siwo adzɔ le xaxa gã la me
ENGLISH: Events during the great tribulation

EWE: Alakpasubɔsubɔhawo tsɔtsrɔ̃.
ENGLISH: Destruction of false religion.

EWE: Woatsrɔ̃ alakpasubɔsubɔhawo alɔ tsɔtsɔe wòawɔ nuku na amewo.
