ENGLISH: With surprising speed, false religion will be destroyed.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 17:​1, 5; 18:​9, 10, 21) Dunyaheŋusẽ siwo katã le megbe na Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo ye Mawu azã atsɔ awɔ esia.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 17:3, 15-18.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 17:​1, 5; 18:​9, 10, 21) The political powers represented by the United Nations will carry out God’s will in taking this action.​ Revelation 17:​3, 15-​18.

EWE: Subɔsubɔha vavãtɔ dzi dzedze.
ENGLISH: Attack on true religion.

EWE: Dukɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si woyɔ le Ezekiel ƒe ŋutega me be "Gog, si tso Magog-nyigba dzi " la adze agbagba be yeatsrɔ̃ ame siwo le subɔsubɔha vavãtɔ me.
ENGLISH: A coalition of nations, referred to in Ezekiel’s vision as "Gog of the land of Magog, " will try to annihilate those who practice true religion.

EWE: Gake Mawu akpɔ esubɔlawo ta tso tsɔtsrɔ̃ ma me.​ Ezekiel 38:​1, 2, 9-​12, 18-​23.
ENGLISH: However, God will protect his worshippers from destruction.​ Ezekiel 38:​1, 2, 9-​12, 18-​23.

EWE: Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ anyigbadzinɔlawo.
ENGLISH: Judgment of earth’s inhabitants.

EWE: Yesu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu amewo katã, eye "wòama amewo me tso wo nɔewo gbɔ, abe ale si alẽkplɔla maa alẽwo tso gbɔ̃wo gbɔe ene. "
ENGLISH: Jesus will judge all mankind and "will separate people one from another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats. "

EWE: (Mateo 25:31-​33) Nu si dzi Yesu anɔ te ɖo adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu amee nye nenye be amea na kpekpeɖeŋu ‘nɔviawo,’ siwo nye ame siwo aɖu fia kplii le dziƒo, alo mena kpekpeɖeŋu wo o.​ Mateo 25:34-​46.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 25:31-​33) The basis for his judgment will be the support, or lack of support, that each person gave to Jesus’ "brothers, " those who will rule with him in heaven.​ Matthew 25:34-​46.

EWE: Ame siwo aɖu dzi le Fiaɖuƒea me nu ƒoƒo ƒu.
ENGLISH: Gathering of Kingdom rulers.

EWE: Nuteƒewɔla siwo wotia be woaɖu fia kple Kristo la awu woƒe anyigbadzigbenɔnɔ nu eye woafɔ wo ɖe tsitre woayi dziƒo.​ Mateo 24:31; 1 Korintotɔwo 15:50-53; 1 Tesalonikatɔwo 4:15-17.
ENGLISH: Faithful ones who have been chosen to rule with Christ will finish their earthly course and be resurrected to life in heaven.​ Matthew 24:31; 1 Corinthians 15:50-​53; 1 Thessalonians 4:​15-​17.

EWE: Armagedon.
ENGLISH: Armageddon.

EWE: Wogayɔ "Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe ŋkeke gã la ƒe aʋawɔwɔ " la be "Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la. "
ENGLISH: This "war of the great day of God the Almighty " is also called "the day of Jehovah. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 16:14, 16; Yesaya 13:9; 2 Petro 3:12) Kristo atsrɔ̃ ame siwo woabu fɔ le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ mamlɛa me.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 16:14, 16; Isaiah 13:9; 2 Peter 3:​12) Those judged adversely by Christ will be destroyed.

EWE: (Zefaniya 1:18; 2 Tesalonikatɔwo 1:6-10) Esiawo dometɔ aɖee nye xexea me katã ƒe dunyahenuɖoanyia, si woɖɔ le Biblia me be lã wɔadã si ta adre li na la.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 19:19-​21.
ENGLISH: (Zephaniah 1:​18; 2 Thessalonians 1:​6-​10) This will include the destruction of the worldwide political system, pictured in the Bible by a seven-headed wild beast.​ Revelation 19:19-​21.

EWE: Nu siwo adzɔ le xaxa gã la megbe
ENGLISH: Events after the great tribulation

EWE: Satana kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo lelé ade aʋli me.
ENGLISH: Confinement of Satan and the demons.

EWE: Mawudɔla sẽŋu aɖe alé Satana kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ade "aʋli me, " si fia dɔmawɔmawɔ ƒe nɔnɔme si sɔ kple ku.
ENGLISH: A great angel will hurl Satan and the demons "into the abyss, " a symbol of deathlike inactivity.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 20:​1-3) Woate ŋu atsɔ nɔnɔme si me Satana anɔ le aʋlia me asɔ kple gamenɔnɔ; magate ŋu akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe naneke dzi le teƒe aɖeke o.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 20:7.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 20:​1-3) Satan’s condition in the abyss could be likened to being in prison; he will be unable to influence affairs elsewhere.​ Revelation 20:7.

EWE: Ƒe Akpa Ðeka Dziɖuɖua dze egɔme.
ENGLISH: The Millennium begins.

EWE: Mawu Fiaɖuƒea adze eƒe ƒe 1,000 dziɖuɖua, si ahe yayra manyagblɔwo vɛ na amegbetɔwo la gɔme.
ENGLISH: God’s Kingdom will begin its 1,000-year reign, which will bring great blessings to mankind.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 5:​9, 10; 20:​4, 6) "Ameha gã " aɖe si xexlẽme meli na o ado "go tso xaxa gã la me, " si fia be woatsi agbe eye woakpɔ Ƒe Akpe Ðeka Dziɖuɖua ƒe gɔmedzedze le anyigba dzi.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 7:​9, 14; Psalmo 37:​9-​11.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 5:​9, 10; 20:​4, 6) An unnumbered "great crowd " will "come out of the great tribulation, " surviving it to see the start of the Millennium on earth.​ Revelation 7:​9, 14; Psalm 37:​9-​11.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye Armagedon-ʋa La?
ENGLISH: What Is the Battle of Armageddon?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Armagedon-ʋa nye aʋa mamlɛtɔ si ayi edzi le Mawu kple amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖuwo dome.
ENGLISH: The battle of Armageddon refers to the final war between human governments and God.

EWE: Fifia gɔ̃ hã la, dziɖuɖu siawo kple wo dzi delawo tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu ŋu le esi wogbe be yewomabɔbɔ ɖe eƒe dziɖuɖu te o ta.
ENGLISH: These governments and their supporters oppose God even now by refusing to submit to his rulership.

EWE: (Psalmo 2:2) Armagedon-ʋaa ava ɖe amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖuwo ɖa.​ Daniel 2:​44.
ENGLISH: (Psalm 2:2) The battle of Armageddon will bring human rulership to an end.​ Daniel 2:​44.

EWE: Zi ɖeka koe nya "Armagedon " dze le Biblia bliboa me le Nyaɖeɖefia 16:16.
ENGLISH: The word "Armageddon " occurs only once in the Bible, at Revelation 16:16.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe agbalẽa gblɔe ɖi be woaƒo "anyigba blibo la dzi fiawo " nu ƒu "hena Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe ŋkeke gã la ƒe aʋawɔwɔ " "ɖe teƒe, si woyɔna le Hebrigbe me be Harmagedon [Armagedon]. "​ Nyaɖeɖefia 16:14.
ENGLISH: Prophetically, Revelation shows that at "the place that is called in Hebrew Armageddon, " "the kings of the entire inhabited earth " will be gathered "together to the war of the great day of God the Almighty. "​ Revelation 16:14.

EWE: Ame kawoe awɔ Armagedon-ʋa la?
ENGLISH: Who will fight at Armageddon?

EWE: Yesu Kristo anɔ ŋgɔ na Mawu ƒe dziƒoʋakɔ la woaɖu Mawu ƒe futɔwo dzi.
ENGLISH: Jesus Christ will lead a heavenly army to victory over God’s enemies.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 19:11-16, 19-21) Futɔ siawo dometɔ aɖewoe nye ame siwo tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ŋu eye wodoa vlo Mawu.​ Ezekiel 39:7.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:11-​16, 19-​21) These enemies include those who oppose God’s authority and who treat God with contempt.​ Ezekiel 39:7.

EWE: Ðe woawɔ Armagedon-ʋa la le Asia ƒe ɣedzeƒenutowo mea?
ENGLISH: Will Armageddon literally be fought in the Middle East?

EWE: Ao.
ENGLISH: No.

EWE: Menye nuto ɖeka aɖe me koe woawɔ Armagedon-ʋa la le o, ke boŋ anyigba blibo la katã dzie.​ Yeremiya 25:32-34; Ezekiel 39:17-20.
ENGLISH: Rather than being restricted to one area, the battle of Armageddon will encompass the whole earth.​ Jeremiah 25:32-​34; Ezekiel 39:17-​20.

EWE: Wogayɔa Armagedon be "Har–​Magedon " (Hebrigbe me nya Har Meghiddhon), si fia "Megido To. "
ENGLISH: Armageddon, sometimes rendered "Har–​Magedon " (Hebrew Har Meghiddohn), means "Mountain of Megiddo. "

EWE: Le blema la, Megido nye blema Israel ƒe nuto aɖe.
ENGLISH: Megiddo was once a city in the territory of ancient Israel.

EWE: Wowɔ aʋa gãwo le nuto ma me eye woŋlɔ aʋa siawo dometɔ aɖewo ƒe ŋutinya ɖe Biblia me.
ENGLISH: History tells of decisive battles that were fought in its vicinity, including some that are recorded in the Bible.

EWE: (Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo 5:19, 20; 2 Fiawo 9:27; 23:29) Ke hã, Armagedon mate ŋu afia teƒe ŋutɔŋutɔ aɖe si le blema Megido o.
ENGLISH: (Judges 5:​19, 20; 2 Kings 9:​27; 23:29) However, Armageddon cannot refer to the literal area near ancient Megiddo.

EWE: To gã aɖeke mele afi ma o, eye Mawu ƒe futɔ siwo le aʋa wɔ ge kplii la katã hã mate ŋu anɔ Yezreel-balia me o.
ENGLISH: There is no large mountain there, and even the entire adjoining Low Plain of Jezreel could not contain all those who will fight against God.

EWE: Ke boŋ Armagedon nye dzesi na nɔnɔme aɖe si ado mo ɖa le anyigba dzi esime dukɔwo katã atso ɖe Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu ŋu.
ENGLISH: Instead, Armageddon is the worldwide situation in which the nations assemble in their last stand against rule by God.

EWE: Togbɔ be míenya aʋawɔnu siwo tututu Mawu azã o hã la, nu siwo wòzã tsɔ wɔ aʋa le blema la gakpɔtɔ le esi.
ENGLISH: What will conditions be like during the battle of Armageddon?

EWE: Wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye tsikpewo, anyigbaʋuʋuwo, tsiɖɔɖɔwo, tsidzadza gãwo, dzo kple aŋɔ, dzikedzo kple dɔléle vɔ̃ɖiwo.
ENGLISH: While we do not know how God will use his power, he will have at his disposal weapons such as those he has used in the past​ hail, earthquake, flooding downpour, fire and sulfur, lightning, and disease.

EWE: (Hiob 38:22, 23; Ezekiel 38:19, 22; Habakuk 3:10, 11; Zakariya 14:12) Eye ate ŋu adzɔ hã be Mawu ƒe futɔwo natɔtɔ ahawu wo nɔewo, ke hã woakpɔe adze sii kɔtɛe be Mawue le aʋa wɔm kple yewo.​ Ezekiel 38:21, 23; Zakariya 14:13.
ENGLISH: (Job 38:22, 23; Ezekiel 38:19, 22; Habakkuk 3:​10, 11; Zechariah 14:12) In confusion, at least some of God’s enemies will kill each other, yet they will ultimately realize that it is God who is fighting against them.​ Ezekiel 38:21, 23; Zechariah 14:13.

EWE: Ðe Armagedon anye xexea me ƒe nuwuwua?
ENGLISH: Will Armageddon be the end of the world?

EWE: Manye míaƒe anyigba la ƒe nuwuwu o, elabena anyigba anye amegbetɔwo nɔƒe tegbee.
ENGLISH: It will not be the end of our planet, since the earth is mankind’s eternal home.

EWE: (Psalmo 37:29; 96:10; Nyagblɔla 1:4) Armagedon manye amegbetɔƒomea ƒe nuwuwu o, ɖe Mawu le aʋa sia dzi to ge boŋ aɖe esubɔla siwo anye "ameha gã " aɖe.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 7:9, 14; Psalmo 37:34.
ENGLISH: (Psalm 37:29; 96:10; Ecclesiastes 1:4) Rather than destroying humanity, Armageddon actually saves it, because "a great crowd " of God’s servants will survive.​ Revelation 7:​9, 14; Psalm 37:34.

EWE: Togbɔ be nya "xexea me " fiaa anyigba le Biblia me hã la, wotea ŋu zãnɛ le Biblia me ɣeaɖewoɣi wòfiaa amegbetɔ vɔ̃ɖi siwo tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu ŋu.
ENGLISH: Besides referring to the earth, though, the word "world " in the Bible sometimes refers to wicked human society opposed to God.

EWE: (1 Yohanes 2:15-17) Le gɔmesese sia ya nu la, Armagedon nye "xexea me ƒe nuwuwu. "​ Matthew 24:3, Eʋegbe Biblia.
ENGLISH: (1 John 2:​15-​17) In this sense, Armageddon will bring "the end of the world. "​ Matthew 24:3, King James Version.

EWE: Ɣekaɣie Armagedon-ʋaa adzɔ?
ENGLISH: When will Armageddon take place?

EWE: Esime Yesu nɔ nu ƒom tso "xaxa gã " si ƒe nuwuwue Armagedon-ʋaa adzɔ ŋu la, egblɔ be: "Le ŋkeke ma kple gaƒoƒo ma ŋuti la, ame aɖeke menyae o, mawudɔla siwo le dziƒo la menyae o, eye Vi la hã menyae o, negbe Fofo la ko. "
ENGLISH: When discussing the "great tribulation " that culminates in the battle of Armageddon, Jesus said: "Concerning that day and hour nobody knows, neither the angels of the heavens nor the Son, but only the Father. "

EWE: (Mateo 24:21, 36) Ke hã, Biblia ɖee fia be Armagedon-ʋaa adzɔ le Yesu ƒe anyinɔɣi si womakpɔ kple ŋku o la me, eye eƒe anyinɔɣi sia dze egɔme le ƒe 1914 me.​ Mateo 24:37-​39.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 24:21, 36) Nevertheless, the Bible does show that Armageddon takes place during Jesus’ invisible presence, which began in 1914.​ Matthew 24:37-​39.

EWE: Ðe Woatsrɔ̃ Anyigba La?
ENGLISH: Will the Earth Be Destroyed?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Kpao, womatsrɔ̃ anyigba, atɔ dzoe wòafiã, alo awɔ bubu ɖe eteƒe gbeɖe o.
ENGLISH: No, planet Earth will never be destroyed, burned in fire, or replaced.

EWE: Biblia fia nu be Mawu wɔ anyigba la be woanɔ edzi tegbee.
ENGLISH: The Bible teaches that God created the earth to be inhabited forever.

EWE: "Ame dzɔdzɔewo anyi anyigba la dome, eye woanɔ edzi tegbee. " Psalmo 37:29.
ENGLISH: "The righteous will possess the earth, and they will live forever on it. "​ Psalm 37:29.

EWE: "[Mawu] ɖo anyigba gɔme anyi ɖe eƒe anyinɔwo dzi; maʋã akpɔ o tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. " Psalmo 104:5.
ENGLISH: "[God] has established the earth on its foundations; it will not be moved from its place forever and ever. "​ Psalm 104:5.

EWE: "Anyigba . . . li tegbee. " Nyagblɔla 1:4.
ENGLISH: "The earth remains forever. "​ Ecclesiastes 1:4.

EWE: "Anyigba la Mèla kple Ewɔla, Ame si ɖo egɔme anyi, menye ɖeko wòwɔe dzodzro o, ke boŋ ɖe wòmèe be woanɔ edzi. " Yesaya 45:18.
ENGLISH: "The One who formed the earth, its Maker who firmly established it, . . . did not create it simply for nothing, but formed it to be inhabited. "​ Isaiah 45:18.

EWE: Ðe amegbetɔwo agblẽ anyigba la?
ENGLISH: Will humans ruin the earth?

EWE: Mawu maɖe mɔ be amegbetɔwo nato ɖiƒoƒonuwɔnawo, aʋawɔwɔ alo mɔ bubu aɖeke dzi agblẽ anyigba gbidii o.
ENGLISH: God will not allow humans to ruin the earth completely by pollution, warfare, or any other means.

EWE: Ke boŋ ‘atsrɔ̃ ame siwo le anyigba la gblẽm.’
ENGLISH: Rather, he will "bring to ruin those ruining the earth. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 11:18) Aleke wòawɔ esiae?
ENGLISH: (Revelation 11:18) How will he accomplish that?

EWE: Mawu aɖɔli amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖu siwo mete ŋu kpɔ anyigbaa ta o la kple eƒe Dziƒofiaɖuƒe deblibo la.
ENGLISH: God will replace human governments, which have been unable to protect the earth, with a perfect heavenly Kingdom.

EWE: (Daniel 2:44; Mateo 6:9, 10) Mawu ƒe Vi, Yesu Kristo ye anye Fiaɖuƒe ma ƒe Fia.
ENGLISH: (Daniel 2:​44; Matthew 6:​9, 10) That Kingdom will be ruled by God’s Son, Jesus Christ.

EWE: (Yesaya 9:6, 7) Esime Yesu nɔ anyigba dzi la, ekpɔ ŋusẽ wɔnuku ɖe dzɔdzɔmeŋusẽwo dzi.
ENGLISH: (Isaiah 9:​6, 7) When on earth, Jesus exercised miraculous powers over natural elements.

EWE: (Marko 4:35-41) Eya ta abe Mawu Fiaɖuƒea ƒe Fia ene la, Yesu akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe anyigba la kple emenuwo dzi.
ENGLISH: (Mark 4:​35-​41) As the King of God’s Kingdom, Jesus will exercise full control over earth and its elements.

EWE: Agbugbɔ awɔ alo atrɔ asi le anyigbadzinuwo ŋu woazu yeye, abe ale si wònɔ va yi le Eden-bɔ me ene. Mateo 19:28; Luka 23:43.
ENGLISH: He will re-create, or renew, conditions on earth, making them similar to those that existed in the garden of Eden.​ Matthew 19:28; Luke 23:43.

EWE: Ðe Biblia megblɔ be woatɔ dzo anyigbaa oa?
ENGLISH: Doesn’t the Bible teach that the earth will be burned in fire?

EWE: Ao, menye nenemae o.
ENGLISH: No, it does not.

EWE: Susu totro sia tso ale si amewo mese 2 Petro 3:7 me nyawo gɔme nyuie o la gbɔ, afi ma gblɔ be: ‘Wodzra dziƒo kple anyigba si li fifia la ɖo ɖi na dzo.’
ENGLISH: Such a misconception often comes from a misunderstanding of 2 Peter 3:7, which says: "The heavens and the earth that now exist are reserved for fire. "

EWE: Kpɔ susu vevi eve siwo kpe ɖe mía ŋu míese nu si nya mawo fia gɔme la ɖa:
ENGLISH: Consider two important points that help us understand the meaning of those words:

EWE: Biblia zãa nya "dziƒo, " "anyigba, " kple "dzo " wofiaa nu vovovowo.
ENGLISH: The Bible uses the terms "heavens, " "earth, " and "fire " to refer to more than one thing.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, 1 Mose 11:1 gblɔ be: "Anyigba blibo la katã doa gbe ɖeka. "
ENGLISH: For example, Genesis 11:1 says: "All the earth continued to be of one language. "

EWE: Le afi sia la, "anyigba " la fia amegbetɔƒomea.
ENGLISH: Here, "earth " refers to human society.

EWE: Nya siwo ƒo xlã 2 Petro 3:7 na míese nu si dziƒo, anyigba kple dzo siwo woyɔ le afi ma fia la gɔme.
ENGLISH: The context of 2 Peter 3:7 indicates the meaning of the heavens, earth, and fire mentioned there.

EWE: Hafi Petro nagblɔ nya si le kpukpui 7 me la, eƒo nu tso Noa ƒe ŋkekea me Tsiɖɔɖɔa me nudzɔdzɔa ŋu le kpukpui 5 kple 6 me.
ENGLISH: Verses 5 and 6 draw a parallel with the Flood of Noah’s day.

EWE: Ɣemaɣi la, wotsrɔ̃ blema xexea, gake womewɔ naneke míaƒe anyigba la o.
ENGLISH: On that occasion, an ancient world was destroyed, yet our planet did not disappear.

EWE: Ke boŋ, Tsiɖɔɖɔa tsrɔ̃ "anyigba " alo ameƒome sẽŋuta la.
ENGLISH: Instead, the Flood wiped out a violent society, or "earth. "

EWE: (1 Mose 6:11) Etsrɔ̃ "dziƒo " tɔgbi aɖe si nye ame siwo nɔ ameƒomea dzi ɖum ɣemaɣi la hã.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 6:​11) It also destroyed a kind of "heavens "​ the people who ruled over that earthly society.

EWE: Eya ta ame vɔ̃ɖiwoe wotsrɔ̃, ke menye míaƒe anyigba la ŋutɔ o.
ENGLISH: Thus, wicked people were destroyed, not our planet.

EWE: Noa kple eƒe ƒomea tsi agbe le xexe ma tsrɔ̃ɣi eye wonɔ anyigba la dzi le Tsiɖɔɖɔa megbe. 1 Mose 8:15-18.
ENGLISH: Noah and his family survived the destruction of that world and inhabited the earth after the Flood.​ Genesis 8:​15-​18.

EWE: Abe Tsiɖɔɖɔa ene la, tsɔtsrɔ̃, alo "dzo " si ŋu 2 Petro 3:7 ƒo nu tsoe la ahe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe xexea va nuwuwui, ke menye anyigba la ŋutɔ o.
ENGLISH: Similar to the waters of the Flood, the destruction, or "fire, " of 2 Peter 3:7 will bring an end to the world of wicked people, not to planet Earth.

EWE: Mawu do "dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye, siwo me dzɔdzɔenyenye anɔ " la ŋugbe na mí. (2 Petro 3:13) "Dziƒo yeye " alo dziɖuɖu yeye si nye Mawu Fiaɖuƒea aɖu "anyigba yeye, " alo amegbetɔƒome yeye dzi.
ENGLISH: God promises "new heavens and a new earth " in which "righteousness is to dwell. " (2 Peter 3:​13) A "new earth, " or new human society, will be ruled over by "new heavens, " or new leadership​ God’s Kingdom.

EWE: Le Fiaɖuƒe ma ƒe dziɖuɖu te la, anyigbaa azu paradiso si me ŋutifafa axɔ aƒe ɖo.
ENGLISH: Under the rule of that Kingdom, the earth will become a peaceful paradise.​ Revelation 21:​1-4.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia 21:1-4.
ENGLISH: When Will the World End?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Ele vevie be míase ale si Biblia zã nya "xexea " gɔme, esia akpe ɖe mía ŋu míanya ɣeyiɣi si xexea ƒe nuwuwu ava.
ENGLISH: To know when the end of the world will happen, it is necessary to understand how the Bible uses the term "world. "

EWE: Zi geɖe la, Helagbe me nya ko′smos, si gɔme woɖena be "xexea, " fiana amegbetɔƒomea, vevietɔ ame siwo meɖoa to Mawu alo wɔa eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o.
ENGLISH: The Greek word kosmos, usually translated "world, " most often refers to the world of humankind, especially the part that is out of harmony with God and his will.

ENGLISH: Matthew 2:9.
