ENGLISH: The appearance of the "star " set in motion events that threatened the life of Jesus and resulted in the murder of innocent children.

EWE: Esi ɣletivimefakalawo dzo le Betlehem la, Mawu xlɔ̃ nu wo be woagatrɔ ayi ɖe Herodes gbɔ o.
ENGLISH: When the astrologers left Bethlehem, God warned them not to return to Herod.

EWE: Mateo 2:12.
ENGLISH: Matthew 2:12.

EWE: Aleke Herodes wɔ nui?
ENGLISH: How did Herod react?

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be: "Esi Herodes kpɔ be ɣletivimefakalaawo flu ye la, edo dziku vevie, eye wòdɔ amewo woyi Betlehem kple eƒe nutowo katã me ɖawu ŋutsuvi siwo katã xɔ ƒe eve kple esiwo mexɔ nenema haɖe o la ɖe ale si wòbia ɣeyiɣi la tsitotsito tso ɣletivimefakalaawo gbɔe la nu. "
ENGLISH: The Bible says: "Herod, seeing that he had been outwitted by the astrologers, flew into a great rage, and he sent out and had all the boys in Bethlehem and in all its districts killed, from two years of age and under, according to the time that he had carefully ascertained from the astrologers. "

EWE: (Mateo 2:16) Mate ŋu adzɔ gbeɖe be nu vɔ̃ɖi ma natso Mawu gbɔ o.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 2:16) God would not have caused such a wicked thing to be done.

EWE: Hiob 34:10.
Afi Kae Kain Kpɔ Srɔ̃ Le Ðe?
ENGLISH: Who Was Cain’s Wife?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Atsu kple asi gbãtɔ ƒe ŋgɔgbevi si nye Kain la, anya ɖe nɔvianyɔnu loo, alo nyɔnu bubu si nye eƒe ƒometɔ kplikplikpli.
ENGLISH: Cain, the eldest child of the first human couple, married one of his sisters or another close female relative.

EWE: Ne míedzro nya si Biblia gblɔ tso Kain kple eƒe ƒomea ŋu me la, míate ŋu aƒo nya ta alea.
ENGLISH: This conclusion may be drawn by considering what the Bible says about Cain and his family.

EWE: Kain kple eƒe ƒomea ŋuti nya veviwo
ENGLISH: Facts about Cain and his family

EWE: Amegbetɔwo katã dzɔ tso Adam kple Xawa me.
ENGLISH: All humans descended from Adam and Eve.

EWE: Mawu ‘na dukɔ sia dukɔ dzɔ tso ame ɖeka [Adam] me, be woanɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.’
ENGLISH: God "made out of one man [Adam] every nation of men to dwell on the entire surface of the earth. "

EWE: (Dɔwɔwɔwo 17:26) Adam srɔ̃, Xawa, va nye "amegbetɔwo katã dada. " (1 Mose 3:20) Eya ta Kain anya ɖe Adam kple Xawa ƒe dzidzimeviawo dometɔ ɖeka.
ENGLISH: (Acts 17:26) Adam’s wife, Eve, became "the mother of everyone living. " (Genesis 3:​20) Therefore, Cain must have married a fellow descendant of Adam and Eve.

EWE: Kain kple nɔvia Abel ye Xawa dzi gbã hafi va dzi vi bubuwo.
ENGLISH: Cain and his brother Abel were the first of a number of children born to Eve.

EWE: (1 Mose 4:1, 2) Esi wonya Kain de gbe le esi wòwu nɔvia ta la, egblɔ be: "Ame sia ame si akpɔm la, awum kokoko. " (1 Mose 4:14) Ame kae Kain nɔ vɔvɔ̃m na?
ENGLISH: (Genesis 4:​1, 2) When Cain was banished for killing his brother, he complained: "Anyone who finds me will certainly kill me. " (Genesis 4:​14) Of whom was Cain afraid?

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be Adam ‘dzi ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo.’ (1 Mose 5:4) Edze ƒãa be, Adam kple Xawa ƒe dzidzimevi siawo dometɔ aɖe ate ŋu awu Kain.
ENGLISH: The Bible says that Adam "became father to sons and daughters. " (Genesis 5:4) Evidently, these other descendants of Adam and Eve could have posed a threat to Cain.

EWE: Le amegbetɔwo ƒe ŋutinya ƒe gɔmedzedze la, enye nu si bɔ be ame naɖe eƒe ƒometɔ.
ENGLISH: Early in human history, marrying one’s relative was not uncommon.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, nuteƒewɔla Abraham ɖe fofoa ƒe vi.
ENGLISH: The faithful man Abraham, for example, married his half sister.

EWE: (1 Mose 20:12) Ƒe alafa geɖe le Kain ƒe ku megbe hafi wova de se ɖe srɔ̃ɖeɖe sia tɔgbi ŋu le Mose ƒe Sea me.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 20:12) The first prohibitions against such marriage appeared in the Mosaic Law, which was codified centuries after Cain’s day.

EWE: (3 Mose 18:9, 12, 13) Edze be dɔléle siwo ate ŋu aɖe fu na ɖevi siwo ƒometɔ kplikplikpli siwo ɖe wo nɔewo dzi mebɔ ɣemaɣi abe ale si wòle egbea ene o.
ENGLISH: (Leviticus 18:​9, 12, 13) It seems that children born to close relatives back then were not as prone to birth defects as they are today.

EWE: Adam, Xawa, kple woƒe ƒomea ŋu nya si le Biblia me la nye ŋutinya si nye nyateƒe.
ENGLISH: The Bible presents the account of Adam, Eve, and their family as accurate history.

EWE: Menye Mose ƒe agbalẽ gbãtɔ si Mose ŋlɔ ko mee dzidzimeŋutinya deto si dze egɔme tso Adam dzi la le o, ke ele ŋutinyaŋlɔla Ezra kple Luka hã ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me.
ENGLISH: Detailed genealogies going back to Adam can be found not only in the book of Genesis, written by Moses, but also in the writings of the historians Ezra and Luke.

EWE: (1 Mose 5:3-5; 1 Kronika 1:1-4; Luka 3:38) Biblia ŋlɔlawo ƒoa nu tso Kain ƒe ŋutinya ŋu abe nu si dzɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ ene. Hebritɔwo 11:4; 1 Yohanes 3:12; Yuda 11.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 5:​3-5; 1 Chronicles 1:​1-4; Luke 3:​38) Bible writers cite the story of Cain as a historical event.​ Hebrews 11:4; 1 John 3:​12; Jude 11.

EWE: Nu Kae Nye Nubablaɖaka La?
ENGLISH: What Is the Ark of the Covenant?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Nubablaɖaka la nye aɖaka kɔkɔe aɖe si blema Israel-viwo nɔ te ɖe Mawu ƒe sedede kple eƒe mɔfiamewo dzi wɔ.
ENGLISH: The ark of the covenant was a sacred chest made by the ancient Israelites according to the command and design of God.

EWE: Eya mee wotsɔ "Ðaseɖiɖikpe, " si nye kpe eve siwo dzi Se Ewoawo nɔ la da ɖo be woanɔ dedie.​ 2 Mose 25:8-10, 16; 31:18.
ENGLISH: It housed and protected "the Testimony, " the Ten Commandments written on two stone tablets.​ Exodus 25:​8-​10, 16; 31:18.

EWE: Ale si wowɔe.
ENGLISH: Construction.

EWE: Aɖakaa didi sentimeta 111, ekeke sentimeta 67, eye wòkɔkɔ sentimeta 67.
ENGLISH: The Ark measured 2.5 cubits long, 1.5 cubits wide, and 1.5 cubits high (111 x 67 x 67 cm; 44 x 26 x 26 in.).

EWE: Wotsɔ akasiati kpae hefa sika ɖe eme kple ekɔgo, eye wotsɔ sika ɖo to nɛ kpe ɖo wònya kpɔ.
ENGLISH: It was built of acacia wood and was overlaid inside and out with gold, with an artistic border.

EWE: Wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ wɔ eƒe nutunu, eye wowɔ sikakerubi eve ɖe nutunua ƒe go eveawo dzi.
ENGLISH: Its cover, made of solid gold, featured two golden cherubs, one at each end.

EWE: Kerubiawo dze ŋgɔ wo nɔewo hede mo to ɖe nutunu la dzi, eye woke woƒe aʋalawo do ɖe dzi wòtsyɔ nutunua dzi.
ENGLISH: They faced each other with their faces toward the cover and their wings extending upward, overshadowing the cover.

EWE: Sikasigɛ ene le Aɖakaa ƒe dzogoewo dzi le afɔtiawo gbɔ lɔƒo.
ENGLISH: The Ark had four rings of cast gold above its feet.

EWE: Wotsɔa kpo siwo wotsɔ akasiati kpa hefa sika ɖe wo ŋu la ƒona ɖe asigɛawo me tsɔ kɔa aɖakaa.​ 2 Mose 25:10-21; 37:6-9.
ENGLISH: Acacia-wood poles overlaid with gold were put through the rings and were used for carrying the Ark.​ Exodus 25:10-​21; 37:​6-9.

EWE: Afi si wònɔ.
ENGLISH: Location.

EWE: Gbã la, woda aɖakaa ɖe avɔgbadɔa ƒe Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe; enye agbadɔ si me wosubɔna le, si wote ŋu kakana gatuna ne woʋu yi teƒe bubu, eye eya kple Aɖakaa ye wowɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me.
ENGLISH: The Ark was initially kept in the Most Holy compartment of the tabernacle, a transportable tent of worship that was made at the same time as the Ark.

EWE: Wotsɔ xɔmetsovɔ xe Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒea ŋkume be nunɔlawo kple ame bubuwo nagakpɔe o.
ENGLISH: The Most Holy was screened off from the view of the priests and the people.

EWE: (2 Mose 40:3, 21) Nunɔlagãa koe gena ɖe afi ma hekpɔa Aɖakaa zi ɖeka le ƒe me, le Avuléŋkekea dzi.
ENGLISH: (Exodus 40:​3, 21) Only the high priest could enter this compartment, one day each year on Atonement Day, and see the Ark.

EWE: (3 Mose 16:2; Hebritɔwo 9:7) Emegbe wova kɔ Nubablaɖakaa yi Salomo ƒe gbedoxɔa ƒe Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒea.​ 1 Fiawo 6:14, 19.
ENGLISH: (Leviticus 16:2; Hebrews 9:7) Later, the Ark was moved to the Most Holy in Solomon’s temple.​ 1 Kings 6:​14, 19.

EWE: Nubablaɖakaa le avɔgbadɔa ƒe Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe
ENGLISH: The ark of the covenant inside the Most Holy compartment of the tabernacle

EWE: Taɖodzinu si nɔ eŋu.
ENGLISH: Purpose.

EWE: Nu kɔkɔe siwo ɖoa ŋku nu si Mawu bla kple Israel-viwo le Sinai Toa gbɔ dzi na wo lae wodzra ɖo ɖe Aɖakaa me.
ENGLISH: The Ark was an archive for sacred items that would remind the Israelites of the covenant, or agreement, that God had made with them at Mount Sinai.

EWE: Wogazãnɛ etɔxɛ hã le Avuléŋkekea ƒe wɔnawo me.​ 3 Mose 16:3, 13-17.
ENGLISH: It also played a key role in the Atonement Day ceremony.​ Leviticus 16:​3, 13-17.

EWE: Nu siwo nɔ eme.
ENGLISH: Contents.

EWE: Kpe siwo dzi woŋlɔ Se Ewoawo ɖoe nye nu gbãtɔ siwo wotsɔ de Aɖakaa me.
ENGLISH: The stone tablets inscribed with the Ten Commandments were the first items placed in the Ark.

EWE: (2 Mose 40:20) Wova de sikaze si me mana le kple "Aron ƒe atikplɔ si ƒo se " la hã eme emegbe.
ENGLISH: (Exodus 40:20) A golden jar of manna and "Aaron’s rod that budded " were later added.

EWE: (Hebritɔwo 9:4; 2 Mose 16:33, 34; 4 Mose 17:10) Edze ƒãa be wova ɖe zea kple atikplɔa ɖa le Aɖakaa me, elabe nu siawo menɔ eme esime wotsɔe yi gbedoxɔa me o.​ 1 Fiawo 8:9.
ENGLISH: (Hebrews 9:4; Exodus 16:33, 34; Numbers 17:10) Evidently, the jar and rod were removed at some point, because they were not in the Ark when it was moved into the temple.​ 1 Kings 8:9.

EWE: Ale si woakɔe.
ENGLISH: Transport.

EWE: Lewi viwoe tsɔa kpo siwo wotsɔ akasiati kpa la kɔa Aɖakaa ɖe abɔta.
ENGLISH: The Ark was to be carried by the Levites on their shoulders by means of the acacia-wood poles.

EWE: (4 Mose 7:9; 1 Kronika 15:15) Kpoawo nɔ Aɖakaa ŋu ɣesiaɣi, eya ta mahiã be Lewi viwo naka asi Aɖakaa ŋutɔ ŋu ɣeaɖekeɣi o.
ENGLISH: (Numbers 7:9; 1 Chronicles 15:15) The poles remained attached to the Ark at all times, so the Levites never had to touch the Ark.

EWE: (2 Mose 25:12-16) Wotsɔa "xɔmetsovɔ " si ma Kɔkɔeƒea kple Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒea dome la tsyɔa Aɖakaa dzi hafi kɔnɛ.​ 4 Mose 4:5, 6.
ENGLISH: (Exodus 25:12-​16) "The screening curtain " that separated the Holy and the Most Holy was used to cover the Ark while it was being carried.​ Numbers 4:​5, 6.

EWE: Nu si wòtsi tre ɖi na.
ENGLISH: Symbolism.

EWE: Afi sia afi si Aɖakaa le la, enyea dzesi be Mawu le afi ma.
ENGLISH: The Ark was associated with God’s presence.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, alilikpo si nɔa Aɖakaa tame le Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒea kple esi nɔa Israel-viwo ƒe asaɖaa tame la siaa nyea dzesi be Yehowa le wo dome eye eƒe yayra le wo dzi.
ENGLISH: For example, the cloud that appeared over the Ark in the Most Holy and at Israelite encampments was a sign of Jehovah’s presence and blessing.

EWE: (3 Mose 16:2; 4 Mose 10:33-36) Azɔ hã, esi Biblia gblɔ be Yehowa "bɔbɔ nɔ kerubiwo tame " la, kerubi eve siwo nɔ Aɖakaa ƒe nutunua dzi ŋue wònɔ nu ƒom tsoe.
ENGLISH: (Leviticus 16:2; Numbers 10:33-​36) Also, the Bible says that Jehovah "[sat] enthroned above the cherubs, " referring to the two cherubs on the Ark’s cover.

EWE: (1 Samuel 4:4; Psalmo 80:1) Eya ta kerubi siawo nɔ "tsitre ɖi na " Yehowa ƒe "tasiaɖam " la.
ENGLISH: (1 Samuel 4:4; Psalm 80:1) Thus, these cherubs were "the representation of the chariot " of Jehovah.

EWE: (1 Kronika 28:18) Esi Fia David nya nu si Aɖakaa le tsitre ɖi na ta la, esi wokɔ Aɖakaa yi Zion la, ete ŋu gblɔ be Yehowa "le Zion. "​ Psalmo 9:11.
ENGLISH: (1 Chronicles 28:18) Because of what the Ark symbolized, King David could write that Jehovah was "dwelling in Zion " after the Ark was moved there.​ Psalm 9:​11.

EWE: Ŋkɔ siwo wogayɔna nɛ.
ENGLISH: Designations.

EWE: Biblia zã ŋkɔ vovovowo na aɖaka kɔkɔe ma; wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye "Ðaseɖiɖiɖaka, " "nubablaɖaka, " ‘Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka,’ kple "Aɖaka, si nye wò [Yehowa ƒe] ŋusẽ ƒe dzesi. "​ 4 Mose 7:89; Yosua 3:6, 13; 2 Kronika 6:41.
ENGLISH: The Bible uses a variety of terms for that sacred chest, including "the ark of the Testimony, " "the ark of the covenant, " "the Ark of Jehovah, " and "the Ark of your [Jehovah’s] strength. "​ Numbers 7:​89; Joshua 3:​6, 13; 2 Chronicles 6:​41.

EWE: Woyɔa Aɖakaa ƒe nutunu la be "avuléle ƒe nutunu " alo "amenuveveteƒe. " (1 Kronika 28:11; Agbenya La) Ŋkɔ sia he susu yi mɔ tɔxɛ si nu wozãa nutunua le le Avuléŋkekea dzi la dzi, esime Israel ƒe nunɔlagã hlẽa vɔsalãa ƒe ʋu ɖe nutunua ŋgɔ kple egbɔ lɔƒo.
ENGLISH: The cover of the Ark was called "the propitiatory cover, " or "the mercy seat. " (1 Chronicles 28:11; King James Version) This term refers to the special function of the cover on the Day of Atonement, when the high priest of Israel would spatter the blood of sacrificed animals toward and before the cover.

EWE: Nu siawo siwo nunɔlagã wɔna la léa avu ɖe "eya ŋutɔ ɖokui kple eƒe aƒe la kpakple Israel ƒe ha blibo la katã " ƒe nu vɔ̃wo ta, alo tsyɔa wo dzi.​ 3 Mose 16:14-17.
ENGLISH: These actions of the high priest made propitiation for, or covered, sins "in behalf of himself and his house and in behalf of the entire congregation of Israel. "​ Leviticus 16:14-​17.

EWE: Ðe nubablaɖaka la gali egbea?
ENGLISH: Does the ark of the covenant exist today?

EWE: Kpeɖodzi aɖeke meli be eli o.
ENGLISH: There is no evidence that it does.

EWE: Biblia ɖee fia be Aɖakaa megahiã o, elabena nubabla si do ƒome kplii la megali o, eye "nubabla yeye " si wotu ɖe Yesu ƒe vɔsaa dzi la va xɔ ɖe eteƒe.
ENGLISH: The Bible shows that the Ark is no longer needed because the covenant associated with it has been replaced with "a new covenant, " one based on Jesus’ sacrifice.

EWE: (Yeremiya 31:31-33; Hebritɔwo 8:13; 12:24) Biblia gblɔe ɖi hã be ɣeyiɣi aɖe ava si nubablaɖakaa maganɔ anyi o, eye Mawu ƒe amewo magaɖo ŋku edzi o.​ Yeremiya 3:16.
ENGLISH: (Jeremiah 31:31-​33; Hebrews 8:​13; 12:24) The Bible thus foretold a time when the ark of the covenant would be no more, yet God’s people would not miss it.​ Jeremiah 3:​16.

EWE: Apostolo Yohanes kpɔ nubablaɖakaa le dziƒo le ŋutega aɖe si woɖe fiae esime woɖo nubabla yeyea anyi vɔ megbe la me.
ENGLISH: In a vision given to the apostle John after the new covenant was established, the ark of the covenant appeared in heaven.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 11:15, 19) Kpɔɖeŋuɖaka sia nye dzesi be Mawu le afi ma eye be eƒe yayra le nubabla yeyea dzi.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 11:15, 19) This symbolic Ark represents God’s presence and his blessing on the new covenant.

EWE: Ðe Aɖakaa kpɔa Israel-viwo ta le nukumɔ aɖe nua?
ENGLISH: Did the Ark serve as a sort of magic charm?

EWE: Ao.
ENGLISH: No.

EWE: Ne nubablaɖaka le Israel-viwo gbɔ la, menye kpeɖodzi be woakpɔ dzidzedze o.
ENGLISH: Possessing the ark of the covenant did not guarantee success.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Aɖakaa nɔ wo gbɔ esi wokpe aʋa kple Ai, gake woɖu wo dzi le esi wo dometɔ ɖeka mewɔ nuteƒe o ta.
ENGLISH: For example, the Israelites had the Ark in their camp when battling the city of Ai, yet they suffered defeat because of one Israelite’s unfaithfulness.

EWE: (Yosua 7:1-6) Emegbe Filistitɔwo ɖu wo dzi togbɔ be wokɔ nubablaɖakaa yi aʋagbea dzi hã.
ENGLISH: (Joshua 7:​1-6) Later, they were defeated by the Philistines despite taking the ark of the covenant to the battlefield.

EWE: Nunɔla siwo nye Hofni kple Finehas ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo tae woɖu wo dzi ɖo.
ENGLISH: That conquest was due to the wickedness of the Israelite priests Hophni and Phinehas.

EWE: (1 Samuel 2:​12; 4:​1-​11) Filistitɔwo xɔ Aɖakaa le Israel-viwo si le aʋa ma me tsɔ yi wo gbɔ, gake Mawu wɔ fu wo vevie va se ɖe esime wogbugbɔ Aɖakaa va Israel.​ 1 Samuel 5:11–6:​5.
ENGLISH: (1 Samuel 2:​12; 4:​1-​11) The Philistines captured the Ark in that battle, but God struck them with plagues until they returned it to Israel.​ 1 Samuel 5:11–6:​5.

EWE: Nubablaɖakaa ƒe ŋutinya
ENGLISH: History of the ark of the covenant

EWE: Ƒe (D.Y.)
ENGLISH: Year (B.C.E.)

EWE: Nudzɔdzɔ
ENGLISH: Event

EWE: Bezalel kple ame siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la zã nu siwo Israel-viwo dzɔ tsɔ kpa Aɖakaa.​ 2 Mose 25:1, 2; 37:1.
ENGLISH: Made by Bezalel and his assistants using materials contributed by the Israelites.​ Exodus 25:​1, 2; 37:1.

EWE: Mose kɔ Aɖakaa, avɔgbadɔa kple nunɔlawo ŋu.​ 2 Mose 40:1-3, 9, 20, 21.
ENGLISH: Inaugurated by Moses along with the tabernacle and priesthood.​ Exodus 40:​1-3, 9, 20, 21.

EWE: Tso ƒe 1512 va se ɖe ƒe 1070 megbe
Wotsɔe yi teƒe vovovowo.​ Yosua 18:1; Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo 20:26, 27; 1 Samuel 1:24; 3:3; 6:11-14; 7:1, 2.
ENGLISH: Moved to various locations.​ Joshua 18:1; Judges 20:26, 27; 1 Samuel 1:​24; 3:3; 6:​11-​14; 7:​1, 2.

EWE: Ƒe 1070 megbe
ENGLISH: After 1070

EWE: Fia David tsɔe va Yerusalem.​ 2 Samuel 6:12.
ENGLISH: Brought to Jerusalem by King David.​ 2 Samuel 6:​12.

EWE: Wotsɔe va da ɖe Salomo ƒe gbedoxɔa me le Yerusalem.​ 1 Fiawo 8:1, 6.
ENGLISH: Moved into Solomon’s temple in Jerusalem.​ 1 Kings 8:​1, 6.

EWE: Fia Yosiya trɔe gbɔ va gbedoxɔa me.​ 2 Kronika 35:3.
ENGLISH: Returned to the temple by King Josiah.​ 2 Chronicles 35:3.

EWE: Do ŋgɔ na ƒe 607
ENGLISH: Before 607

EWE: Womeyɔe de nu siwo Babilontɔwo lɔ tso gbedoxɔa me dzoe esi wotsrɔ̃ gbedoxɔa le ƒe 607 D.Y. me la dome o, eye menɔ nu siwo wogatrɔ tso Babilon gbɔe va Yerusalem emegbe la dome o.​ 2 Fiawo 25:13-17; Ezra 1:7-11.
ENGLISH: Apparently removed from the temple. It is not mentioned in the inventories of articles taken to Babylon when the temple was destroyed in 607 B.C.E. or of those articles later returned to Jerusalem.​ 2 Kings 25:13-​17; Ezra 1:​7-​11.

EWE: Romaʋafia Pompey ɖu Yerusalem dzi eye wòge ɖe Kɔkɔeƒewo Ƒe Kɔkɔeƒea hegblɔ be yemekpɔ aɖakaa le afi ma o.
ENGLISH: Declared to be missing by Roman General Pompey when he conquered Jerusalem and inspected the Most Holy of the temple.

EWE: Nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ Dzie Mawu To Wɔ Nu Gbagbe Vovovoawoa?
ENGLISH: Did God Use Evolution to Create the Different Types of Life?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Ao.
ENGLISH: No.

EWE: Biblia gblɔe eme kɔ nyuie be Mawu wɔ amegbetɔwo kpakple nu miemiewo kple lãwo le wo "ƒomeviwo " nu.
ENGLISH: The Bible clearly states that God created humans as well as different "kinds " of animal and plant life.

EWE: (1 Mose 1:12, 21, 25, 27; Nyaɖeɖefia 4:11) Egblɔe hã be Adam kple Xawa, siwo nye mía dzila gbãtɔwo, mee ameƒome bliboa dzɔ tso.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 1:12, 21, 25, 27; Revelation 4:11) It says that the entire human family descended from Adam and Eve, our first parents.

EWE: (1 Mose 3:20; 4:1) Biblia meda asi ɖe dzixɔse si nye be nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ dzie Mawu to wɔ nu gbagbe vovovoawo la dzi, abe ale si ame aɖewo susuna ene o.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 3:20; 4:1) The Bible account does not support the theory that God used evolution to bring about the different kinds of life, sometimes called theistic evolution.

EWE: Ke hã nya aɖeke mele Biblia me si tsi tre ɖe nya si dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo gblɔna be nuwɔwɔ siwo le hatsotso ɖeka me ate ŋu ato vovo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ la ŋu o.
ENGLISH: The fact is, though, that nothing in the Bible conflicts with scientific observations that variations occur within each kind of life.

EWE: Nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ dzie Mawu to wɔ nu gbagbewoa?
ENGLISH: Did God use evolution?

EWE: Ðe nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ ƒe nufiafia wɔ ɖeka kple nu si Biblia fia?
ENGLISH: Is evolution compatible with the Bible?

EWE: Nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ dzie Mawu to wɔ nu gbagbewoa?
ENGLISH: What about the ability of plants and animals to adapt?

EWE: Ame siwo xɔe se be nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ dzie Mawu to wɔ nu gbagbewo la ƒe susu le ale si wòwɔe ŋu la to vovo.
ENGLISH: Did God use evolution? The term "theistic evolution " refers to a broad variety of ideas.

EWE: Le Encyclopædia Britannica ƒe nya nu la, "ale si nɔnɔmeawo le le dzɔdzɔme nu ye wɔnɛ be nu gbagbewo va toa vovo.
ENGLISH: According to the Encyclopædia Britannica, the term promotes the idea that "natural selection is one of the mechanisms with which God directs the natural world. "

EWE: Ame aɖewo xɔe se be esia nye mɔ aɖe si dzi Mawu to na be nu gbagbe ƒomevi vovovowo va li. "
ENGLISH: Theistic evolution can also include the following ideas:

EWE: Susu vovovo siwo le ame mawo si la ƒe ɖewoe nye:
ENGLISH: All living organisms descended from common ancestors in the distant past.

EWE: Nu gbagbe ƒomeviwo katã dzɔ tso nu ɖeka aɖe me wotɔwotɔwoe tso gbe aɖe gbe ʋĩi ke. Nu gbagbe ƒomevi aɖe ate ŋu atrɔ azu nu gbagbe ƒomevi bubu kura.
ENGLISH: One kind of life-form can evolve into a completely different kind of life-form, a concept that is sometimes referred to as macroevolution.

EWE: Le mɔ aɖe nu la, Mawu gbɔe wòtso be tɔtrɔ siawo yia edzi.
ENGLISH: God is somehow ultimately responsible for these processes.

EWE: Ðe nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ ƒe nufiafia wɔ ɖeka kple nu si Biblia fia?
ENGLISH: Is evolution compatible with the Bible?

EWE: Dzixɔse si nye be nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ dzie Mawu to wɔ nu gbagbewo la le fiafiam be nya si Biblia gblɔ tso xexemewɔwɔ ŋu, si le Mose Ƒe Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ me la mede keŋkeŋ o.
ENGLISH: Theistic evolution implies that the Bible’s account of creation in Genesis is not completely accurate.

EWE: Ke hã Yesu he susu yi xexemewɔwɔ ƒe ŋutinya ma si le Mose Ƒe Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ me la dzi be enye nu si dzɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: However, Jesus referred to the Genesis account as historical fact.

EWE: (1 Mose 1:26, 27; 2:18-24; Mateo 19:4-6) Biblia gblɔ be hafi Yesu nava anyigba dzi la, enɔ dziƒo le Mawu gbɔ, eye wòkpe asi ɖe Mawu ŋu wowɔ "nuwo katã. "
ENGLISH: (Genesis 1:26, 27; 2:18-24; Matthew 19:4-6) The Bible says that before coming to earth, Jesus lived in heaven with God and was involved in helping God to bring "all things " into existence.

EWE: (Yohanes 1:3) Eya ta susu si nye be nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ dzie Mawu to wɔ nu gbagbe vovovowo la mewɔ ɖeka kple Biblia ƒe nufiafia o.
ENGLISH: (John 1:3) Therefore, the idea that God used evolution to bring about different life-forms is incompatible with Bible teachings.

EWE: Ðe ale si atiwo kple lãwo tea ŋu trɔna ɖe nuto si me wole ƒe nɔnɔme nu la ɖo kpe nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ ƒe nufiafia dzia?
ENGLISH: What about the ability of plants and animals to adapt?

EWE: Biblia meɖe nu me ku ɖe ale si gbegbe nu gbagbewo ate ŋu ato vovo tso wo ƒomevi siwo li xoxo gbɔ la ŋu o.
ENGLISH: The Bible does not explain how much variation can occur within a kind.

EWE: Gake metsi tre ɖe nyateƒenya si nye be tɔtrɔ viviviwo tea ŋu vana le nu gbagbe siwo Mawu wɔ la ƒe dzidzimeviwo ŋu alo be wotea ŋu trɔna ɖe nuto si me wole la ƒe nɔnɔmewo nu la ŋu hã o.
ENGLISH: Neither does it contradict the fact that the different kinds of animals and plants created by God can vary as they breed or adapt to new environments.

EWE: Togbɔ be ame aɖewo susuna be tɔtrɔ mawo ɖo kpe nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ ƒe nufiafia dzi hã la, menye nu gbagbe bubu sãa ye dona tso tɔtrɔ mawo me o.
ENGLISH: Although some view such adaptations as a form of evolution, no new kind of life is produced.

EWE: Ðe Biblia Ate Ŋu Ana Dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ Nanɔ Nye Ƒomea Mea?
ENGLISH: Can the Bible Help Me to Have a Happy Family?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer
Yes.

EWE: Biblia me aɖaŋuɖoɖo siwo me nunya le siwo kpe ɖe ŋutsu kple nyɔnu miliɔn geɖewo ŋu woƒe ƒomea le dzidzɔ kpɔm la dometɔ ʋɛ aɖewoe nye esiawo:
ENGLISH: Here’s a sample of wise advice based on the Bible that has helped millions of men and women to gain family happiness:

EWE: De wò srɔ̃ɖeɖea agbalẽ me alo ɖe srɔ̃ le se nu.
ENGLISH: Legalize your marriage.

EWE: Ale si srɔ̃ɖeɖe le se nu biana be woawɔ nuteƒe na ame srɔ̃ le ame ƒe agbe me katã nye gɔmeɖoanyi na ƒome kpɔdzidzɔ.​ Mateo 19:4-6.
ENGLISH: The lifetime commitment of a legal marriage is the foundation for a happy family.​ Matthew 19:4-6.

EWE: Ðe lɔlɔ̃ kple bubu fia.
ENGLISH: Show love and respect.

EWE: Esia bia be nàwɔ nu ɖe srɔ̃wòa ŋu abe ale si nàdi be wòawɔ nu ɖe ye ŋu ene.​ Mateo 7:12; Efesotɔwo 5:25, 33.
ENGLISH: This includes treating your mate in the way that you would like to be treated.​ Matthew 7:12; Ephesians 5:25, 33.

EWE: Ƒo asa na nya tɔamewo gbɔgblɔ.
ENGLISH: Avoid harsh words.

EWE: Ƒo nu tufafatɔe, nenye be srɔ̃wòa gblɔ nya aɖe alo wɔ nane wòve wò hã.
ENGLISH: Speak kindly, even if your mate says or does something hurtful.

EWE: (Efesotɔwo 4:31, 32) Biblia gblɔ le Lododowo 15:1 gblɔ be: "Nyaŋuɖoɖo fafɛ tsia dziku nu; ke gbe da ɖe ame gbɔ nana dɔmedzoe flana. "
ENGLISH: (Ephesians 4:31, 32) As the Bible says at Proverbs 15:1: "An answer, when mild, turns away rage, but a word causing pain makes anger to come up. "

EWE: Miwɔ nuteƒe na mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: Be faithful to each other.

EWE: Ðoe be ye srɔ̃ ɖeka ƒe nu koe alé dzi na ye eye eya ɖeka ko ƒe nue adzro ye.
ENGLISH: Reserve your romantic and sexual attention only for your spouse.

EWE: (Mateo 5:28) Biblia gblɔ be: "Bubu nanɔ srɔ̃ɖeɖe me le amewo katã dome, eye womagaƒo ɖi srɔ̃ɖeba la o. " Hebritɔwo 13:4.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 5:28) The Bible says: "Let marriage be honorable among all, and the marriage bed be without defilement. "​ Hebrews 13:4.

EWE: He viwòwo le lɔlɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: Train your children with love.

EWE: Mègafa akpa o eye wò nya me megasẽ hã akpa.​ Lododowo 29:15; Kolosetɔwo 3:21.
ENGLISH: Avoid both leniency and harshness.​ Proverbs 29:15; Colossians 3:21.

EWE: Ðe Ga Nye Nu Vɔ̃ɖiwo Katã Ƒe Kea?
ENGLISH: Is Money the Root of All Evil?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Ao.
ENGLISH: No.

EWE: Biblia megblɔ be ga nye nu vɔ̃ɖi o, eye megblɔ hã be gae le megbe na nu vɔ̃ɖi ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe o.
ENGLISH: The Bible does not say that money is evil, nor does it identify money as the underlying cause of all bad things.

EWE: Nya si amewo lɔ̃a gbɔgblɔ be "ga nye nu vɔ̃ɖiwo katã ƒe ke " la nye mawunyakpukpui aɖe me nyawo ƒe akpa aɖe si wotro gboe.
ENGLISH: The common expression "money is the root of all evil " is an incomplete and misleading Bible quotation.

EWE: Nya si Biblia gblɔ boŋue nye be "nu vɔ̃wo katã ƒe ke enye galɔlɔ̃. " 1 Timoteo 6:10, Eʋegbe Biblia, míawoe te gbe ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: The Bible actually says that "the love of money is the root of all evil. " 1 Timothy 6:10, King James Version, emphasis ours.

EWE: Nya kae Biblia gblɔ tso ga ŋu?
ENGLISH: What does the Bible say about money?

EWE: Nu ka tae Biblia xlɔ̃ nu mí tso galɔlɔ̃ ŋu?
ENGLISH: Why does the Bible warn about the love of money?

EWE: Aleke aɖaŋu si Biblia ɖo ku ɖe ga ŋu la ate ŋu aɖe vi na mí?
ENGLISH: How can we benefit from the Bible’s advice on money?

EWE: Mawunyakpukpui siwo ƒo nu tso ga ŋu
ENGLISH: Bible verses about money

EWE: Nya kae Biblia gblɔ tso ga ŋu?
ENGLISH: What does the Bible say about money?

EWE: Biblia na eme kɔ be ne ame zã ga nyuie la, ate ŋu aɖe vi nɛ, eye ate ŋu ‘akpɔ eta’ gɔ̃ hã.
ENGLISH: The Bible acknowledges that money, when used wisely, can be useful, even serving as "a protection. "

EWE: (Nyagblɔla 7:12) Gakpe ɖe eŋu la, Biblia kafu ame siwo nyoa dɔme na ame, eye dɔmenyo sia ate ŋu anye ganana ame hã.
ENGLISH: (Ecclesiastes 7:12) Additionally, the Bible commends those who show generosity toward others, which may include monetary gifts.

EWE: Lododowo 11:25.
ENGLISH: Proverbs 11:25.

EWE: Gake Biblia xlɔ̃ nu mí be míagana ga nanye nu vevitɔ na mí le agbe me o.
ENGLISH: At the same time, the Bible cautions against making money the focus of life.

EWE: Egblɔ be: "Mina miaƒe agbenɔnɔ navo tso galɔlɔ̃ me, eye nu siwo le mia si fifia la nadze mia ŋu. "
ENGLISH: It says: "Let your way of life be free of the love of money, while you are content with the present things. "

EWE: (Hebritɔwo 13:5) Nu si nya mawo fiae nye be míagana ga nanɔ vevie na mí akpa alo be míati kesinɔnuwo yome o.
ENGLISH: (Hebrews 13:5) The lesson is to keep money in its place and not pursue wealth.

EWE: Ke boŋ, ne nu siwo hiã mí ŋutɔŋutɔ, abe nuɖuɖu, nudodo kple mlɔƒe ene su mía si la, míana nu siawo nadze mía ŋu.
ENGLISH: Instead, we should aim to be content with the things we really need, such as food, clothing, and shelter.

EWE: 1 Timoteo 6:8.
ENGLISH: 1 Timothy 6:8.

EWE: Nu ka tae Biblia xlɔ̃ nu mí tso galɔlɔ̃ ŋu?
ENGLISH: Why does the Bible warn about the love of money?

EWE: Ŋuklẽlawo makpɔ agbe mavɔ o.
ENGLISH: Greedy people will not gain everlasting life.

EWE: (Efesotɔwo 5:5) Susu ɖeka si tae nye be, ŋukeklẽ sɔ kple trɔ̃subɔsubɔ, alo alakpasubɔsubɔ.
ENGLISH: (Ephesians 5:5) For one thing, greed is a form of idolatry, or false worship.

EWE: (Kolosetɔwo 3:5) Susu bubu hãe nye be zi geɖe la, ŋuklẽlawo wɔa nu tovowo ne wole agbagba dzem be nu siwo yewodi la nasu yewo si.
ENGLISH: (Colossians 3:5) For another, in their effort to get what they desire, the greedy often abandon good principles.

EWE: Lododowo 28:20 gblɔ be: "Ame si tsi klokloklo ɖe hokpɔkpɔ ŋu la, fɔɖiɖi magbe eŋu nɔnɔ o. "
ENGLISH: Those "hastening to get rich will not remain innocent, " says Proverbs 28:20.

EWE: Ŋukeklẽ ate ŋu ana amewo nawɔ nu vlowo, abe adzodada, ametafatafa, amefifi, alo amewuwu ene gɔ̃ hã.
ENGLISH: They might even be tempted to commit crimes, such as blackmail, extortion, fraud, kidnapping, or murder.

EWE: Ne galɔlɔ̃ mena ame ƒo eɖokui ɖe nu vlowo wɔwɔ me o gɔ̃ hã la, nu gbegblẽ bubuwo ate ŋu ado tso eme.
ENGLISH: Even if the love of money does not lead to bad behavior, it can have other negative consequences.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be "ame siwo ɖoe kplikpaa be yewoazu kesinɔtɔwo la gena ɖe tetekpɔ kple mɔ̃tetre kpakple movidzɔdzɔ ƒe nudzodzro geɖe, siwo wɔa nu vevi ame . . . la me. " 1 Timoteo 6:9.
ENGLISH: The Bible says that "those who are determined to be rich fall into temptation and a snare and many senseless and harmful desires. " 1 Timothy 6:9.

EWE: Aleke aɖaŋu si Biblia ɖo ku ɖe ga ŋu la ate ŋu aɖe vi na mí?
ENGLISH: How can we benefit from the Bible’s advice on money?

EWE: Ne mímeɖe mɔ galɔlɔ̃ wɔe be míedana le Mawu ƒe se kple nudidiwo dzi o la, míase le mía ɖokui me be bubu le mía ŋu, eye Mawu hã akpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe mía ŋu ahakpe ɖe mía ŋu.
ENGLISH: If we do not compromise moral and spiritual values for the sake of money, we will have self-respect along with God’s favor and support.

EWE: Mawu do ŋugbe na ame siwo dzea agbagba vevie be yewoadze eŋu la be: "Nyemaɖe asi le ŋuwò akpɔ o, eye nyemagblẽ wò ɖi hã akpɔ o. "
ENGLISH: To those who sincerely try to please him, God promises: "I will never leave you, and I will never abandon you. "

EWE: (Hebritɔwo 13:5, 6) Mawu gaka ɖe edzi na mí hã be "woayra nuteƒewɔla geɖe. "
ENGLISH: (Hebrews 13:5, 6) He also assures us that "a faithful man will receive many blessings. "

EWE: Lododowo 28:20.
ENGLISH: Proverbs 28:20.

EWE: Mawunyakpukpui Siwo Ƒo Nu Tso Ga Ŋu
ENGLISH: Bible Verses About Money

EWE: Nyagblɔla 7:12: "Ga . . . kpɔa ame ta. "
ENGLISH: Ecclesiastes 7:12: "Money is a protection. "

EWE: Nu si wòfia: Ne míezã ga nyuie la, ate ŋu aɖe vi na mí, elabena etea ŋu nana ame nɔa dedie le go aɖewo me.
ENGLISH: Meaning: When used wisely, money can be beneficial because it adds a measure of security.

EWE: Luka 12:15: "Ne nu gbogbo aɖewo le ame si hã la, nu siawo mana agbee o. "
ENGLISH: Luke 12:15: "Even when a person has an abundance, his life does not result from the things he possesses. "

EWE: Nu si wòfia: Menye gae nye nu vevitɔ le agbe me o, eye menye eyae ana míakpɔ ɖeɖe hã o.
ENGLISH: Meaning: Money is not the most important thing in life, and it will not contribute to our salvation.

EWE: 1 Timoteo 6:10: "Nu vɔ̃ɖi ƒomeviwo katã ƒe ke ɖekae nye galɔlɔ̃, eye esi ame aɖewo ti lɔlɔ̃ sia yome la, wotra mɔ tso xɔse la gbɔ, eye wotsɔ vevesese geɖe ŋɔ wo ɖokuiwo flofloflo. "
ENGLISH: 1 Timothy 6:10: "The love of money is a root of all sorts of injurious things, and by reaching out for this love some have been led astray from the faith and have stabbed themselves all over with many pains. "

EWE: Nu si wòfia: Menye nu gbegblẽe ga nye o.
ENGLISH: Meaning: Money in itself is not wrong.

EWE: Gake ame siwo lɔ̃ ga eye wona wònye nu vevitɔ na wo le agbe me la hea kuxiwo vaa wo ɖokuiwo dzi, le kpɔɖeŋu me, woƒe ƒomewo gbãna alo lãmesẽnyawo ɖea fu na wo le dɔwɔwɔ atraɖii ta.
ENGLISH: But people who love money who make it their main focus in life bring problems on themselves, such as broken families and poor health from overwork.

EWE: Hebritɔwo 13:5: "Mina miaƒe agbenɔnɔ navo tso galɔlɔ̃ me, eye nu siwo le mia si fifia la nadze mia ŋu. "
ENGLISH: Hebrews 13:5: "Let your way of life be free of the love of money, while you are content with the present things. "

EWE: Nu si wòfia: Le esi míadi godoo be míazu kesinɔtɔwo teƒe la, nunya anɔ eme be ne nu siwo hiã mí ŋutɔŋutɔ su mía si ko la, míana nu mawo nadze mía ŋu.
ENGLISH: Meaning: Instead of pursuing wealth at all costs, we are wise to be content with what we really need.

EWE: Mateo 19:24: "Ele bɔbɔe na kposɔ be wòato abui ƒe vo me wu be kesinɔtɔ nayi ɖe Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la me. "
ENGLISH: Matthew 19:24: "It is easier for a camel to get through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of God. "

EWE: Nu si wòfia: Ðeko Yesu kpe ɖekakpui kesinɔtɔ aɖe be wòadze ye yome koe nye ema wògblɔ nya mawo.
ENGLISH: Meaning: Jesus had just invited a rich young man to follow him.

EWE: Ðekakpuia mewɔ ɖe amekpekpea dzi o, elabena eƒe dzi ku ɖe eƒe nunɔamesiwo ŋu akpa.
ENGLISH: The man refused because he was too attached to his possessions.

EWE: Eya ta nuxlɔ̃amee Yesu ƒe nya mawo nye.
ENGLISH: So Jesus was giving a warning.

EWE: Ne kesinɔnuwo didi le vevie na ame aɖe wu Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu wɔwɔ la, agbe mavɔ kpɔkpɔ ate ŋu ato eŋu.
ENGLISH: A person who puts riches before God risks losing everlasting life.

EWE: Gakuxi Kple Fenyinyi Ðe Biblia Ate Ŋu Akpe Ðe Mía Ŋua?
ENGLISH: Money Problems and Debt Can the Bible Help?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer
Yes.

EWE: Biblia me mɔfiame ene siwo gbɔna ate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò le ganyawo kple fenyinyawo gome:
ENGLISH: The following four Bible principles can help you with money problems and debt:

EWE: Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe gazazã ŋu.
ENGLISH: Plan your spending.

EWE: "Veviedola ƒe tameɖoɖo hea viɖe vɛ, ke ame si tsi klokloklo la, dea hiã aƒe. "
ENGLISH: "The plans of the diligent one surely make for advantage, but everyone that is hasty surely heads for want. "

EWE: (Lododowo 21:5) Mègatsi dzi nàƒle nane le esi wole edzram ta ko o.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 21:5) Don’t rush to buy something just because it’s on sale.

EWE: Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe gazazã ŋu eye nàzɔ ɖe edzi pɛpɛpɛ.
ENGLISH: Make a financial plan​ a budget​ and stick to it.

EWE: Mègade ɖokuiwò fe me dzodzro o.
ENGLISH: Avoid unnecessary debt.

EWE: "Ame si doa nugbana la, dɔla wònye na agbanatɔ. "
ENGLISH: "The borrower is servant to the man doing the lending. "

EWE: (Lododowo 22:7) Ne fe aɖewo le ŋuwò xoxo eye mètea ŋu le wo xem o la, dzro ɖoɖo bubu si nu nàdi be yeaxe fea le la kple wò fetɔa.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 22:7) If you are already in debt and can’t meet your obligations, try to negotiate new payment plans with your creditors.

EWE: Ƒo koko nɛ.
ENGLISH: Be persistent.

EWE: Wɔ ɖe aɖaŋu si Biblia ɖo na ame si mebu nuwo ŋu nyuie o hafi de megbe na ame le fenyinyi me o la dzi be: "[Xlã] ɖokuiwò ɖe eƒe afɔ nu, eye nàƒoe ɖe hawòvi nu.
ENGLISH: Use the Bible’s advice to one who unwisely guaranteed a loan and thus took on responsibility for the debt: "Humble yourself, and pester your neighbor.

EWE: Mègana alɔ̃ nava wò ŋku dzi o, eye akɔlɔ̃e megaɖo wò aɖaba me o. "
ENGLISH: Don’t let your eyes rest or your eyelids close. "

EWE: (Lododowo 6:1-5) Ne meda asi ɖe ɖoɖo si nèwɔ be yeaxe fea nɛ dzi o zi gbãtɔ o hã la, yi ebiabia dzi.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 6:1-5, God’s Word Bible) Even if your first request isn’t successful, keep on asking for an adjustment.

EWE: Na susu nyuitɔ nanɔ asiwò ɖe ga ŋu.
ENGLISH: Keep money in its proper place.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be: "Ŋubiãla le yɔyɔm ɖe kesinɔnu ŋu; ke menyae be, hiã le ye dzi va ge o. "
ENGLISH: "Don’t be selfish and eager to get rich​ you will end up worse off than you can imagine. "

EWE: (Lododowo 28:22) Eya ta menye ɖeko ŋubiabiã kple ŋukeklẽ ana nàzu feme o, ke ana hã be magatsi dzi ɖe wo kple Mawu dome ƒomedodo ŋu o.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 28:22, Contemporary English Version) Envy and greed not only can lead to financial ruin but also can crowd out spiritual matters.

EWE: Na nu si le asiwò la nadze ŋuwò.
ENGLISH: Be content.

EWE: "Ne nunyiame kple avɔtata le mía si la, mina nu siawo nasɔ gbɔ na mí. " (1 Timoteo 6:8) Ga mate ŋu aƒle dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ alo dzidzeme o.
ENGLISH: "Having sustenance and covering, we shall be content with these things. " (1 Timothy 6:8) Money can’t buy happiness or contentment.

EWE: Ame siwo kpɔa dzidzɔ wu le xexea me la dometɔ aɖewo menye gatɔ gãwo o.
ENGLISH: Some of the happiest people in the world do not have a lot of money.

EWE: Nu siwo le wo si nye lɔlɔ̃ si le woƒe ƒomea me, lɔlɔ̃ si le wo kple wo xɔlɔ̃wo dome, kpakple xɔlɔ̃kadodo si le wo kple Mawu dome. Lododowo 15:17; 1 Petro 5:6, 7.
ENGLISH: What they do have is the love of family and friends and a friendship with God.​ Proverbs 15:17; 1 Peter 5:6, 7.

EWE: Nyemele Ta Kpɔm Na Nye Agbe O Ðe Subɔsubɔ, Mawu Alo Biblia Ate Ŋu Akpe Ðe Ŋunyea?
ENGLISH: I Don’t Feel Good About My Life Can Religion, God, or the Bible Help?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Ɛ̃ woate ŋui.
ENGLISH: Yes.

EWE: Biblia, si nye blemagbalẽ si me nunya yɔ fũu, la ɖoa agbemebiabia veviwo ŋu eye ate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò nàkpɔ dzidzɔ ahase le ɖokuiwò me be yele dedie.
ENGLISH: The Bible, an ancient book of wisdom, provides answers to life’s important questions and can help you to feel better and have a sense of well-being.

EWE: Kpɔ nyabiase siwo ŋu wòɖo la dometɔ aɖewo ɖa.
ENGLISH: Consider some questions that it answers.

EWE: Ðe Wɔla aɖe lia?
ENGLISH: Is there a Creator?

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be Mawue "wɔ nuwo katã. "
ENGLISH: The Bible says that God "created all things. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 4:11) Esi Mawu nye mía Wɔla ta la enya nu siwo míehiã be míase vivi na agbea ahakpɔ dzidzeme.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 4:11) As our Creator, God knows what we need to feel good and to find fulfillment in life.

EWE: Ðe Mawu tsɔa ɖe le eme nama?
ENGLISH: Does God care about me?

EWE: Le esi míanɔ Mawu bum be enye ame si ɖe eɖokui ɖe aga sãa tso míagbɔ teƒe la, Biblia gblɔ na mí be: "Mele adzɔge tso mía dometɔ aɖeke gbɔ hafi o. "
ENGLISH: Rather than portraying God as aloof from mankind, the Bible says: "He is not far off from each one of us. "

EWE: (Dɔwɔwɔwo 17:27) Etsɔ ɖe le nu siwo dzɔna ɖe dziwò la me vevie eye wòdina be yeakpe ɖe ŋuwò nakpɔ dzidzedze le agbe me.
ENGLISH: (Acts 17:27) He is interested in what happens to you and wants to help you succeed in life.

EWE: Yesaya 48:17, 18; 1 Petro 5:7.
ENGLISH: Isaiah 48:17, 18; 1 Peter 5:7.

EWE: Nu ka tae Mawu nyanya akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàkpɔ dzidzɔ?
ENGLISH: How can knowing God help me to feel better?

EWE: Ðe Mawu wɔ mí be míatsi dzi ɖe "gbɔgbɔmenuwo, " si fia didi si le mía me be míase nu si tae Mawu wɔ mí ɖo la gɔme ŋu.
ENGLISH: God created us with a "spiritual need, " an innate hunger to understand the meaning and purpose of life.

EWE: (Matthew 5:3) Nu si gbɔgbɔmenu siawo fia la dometɔ aɖee nye didi si le mía me be míanya mía Wɔla ale be míadze xɔlɔ̃e.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 5:3) Our spiritual need also includes a desire to know our Creator and to have a relationship with him.

EWE: Mawu akpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe agbagba si nàdze be yeadze sii, elabena Biblia gblɔ: "Mite ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye ate ɖe mia ŋu. "
ENGLISH: God will welcome your efforts to get to know him, for the Bible says: "Draw close to God, and he will draw close to you. "

EWE: Yakobo 4:8.
ENGLISH: James 4:8.

EWE: Ame miliɔn geɖe va kpɔe be xɔlɔ̃dzedze Mawu na yewoƒe agbe va ɖɔ ʋu eye wònana wonyana nu si woawɔ be agbea nadze edzi na wo.
ENGLISH: Millions of people have found that building a friendship with God has improved their overall well-being and shown them how to feel good about their lives.

EWE: Ne ènya Mawu la mefia be èvo tso kuxiwo me o gake eƒe nunya si dze le Biblia me ate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò
ENGLISH: While knowing God will not make your life trouble-free, his wisdom found in the Bible can help you to

EWE: Nàkpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ƒomegbenɔnɔ me.
ENGLISH: Have a happier family life.

EWE: Ŋutifafa nanɔ wò kple ame bubuwo dome.
ENGLISH: Enjoy peace with others.

EWE: Nànɔ te ɖe kuxi vovovowo abe blanuiléledɔ, ganyawo ƒe sesẽ kple dɔ mavɔleameŋu ene nu.
ENGLISH: Deal with problems as varied as depression, stress about money, and chronic illness.

EWE: Subɔsubɔha siwo zãa Biblia la dometɔ geɖe menɔa agbe ɖe Biblia ƒe nufiafiawo nu ŋutɔŋutɔ o.
ENGLISH: Many religions that use the Bible do not actually follow its teachings.

EWE: Ke hã, subɔsubɔha vavã me tɔwo ya wɔna ɖe Biblia ƒe nufiafiawo dzi pɛpɛpɛ, eye woate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò nànya Mawu nyuie.
ENGLISH: In contrast, true religion, which adheres to what the Bible really says, will help you to get to know God.

EWE: Nya Kae Biblia Gblɔ Tso Dzikudodo Ŋu?
ENGLISH: What Does the Bible Say About Anger?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Biblia na míenya be dziku si dzi womeɖu o la gblẽa nu vevie; egblẽa nu le ame si le dzikua dom kple ame siwo dome wòle la siaa ŋu.
ENGLISH: The Bible teaches that uncontrolled anger is harmful, both to the person who harbors it and to those around him.

EWE: (Lododowo 29:22) Togbɔ be asɔ be ame nado dziku ɣeaɖewoɣi hã la, Biblia gblɔ be ame siwo yia edzi nɔa ‘dɔmedzoe dom’ la makpɔ ɖeɖe o.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 29:22) Although anger may be justified at times, the Bible says that those who continue to have "fits of anger " will not gain salvation.

EWE: (Galatiatɔwo 5:19-21) Mɔfiame veviwo le Biblia me siwo ate ŋu akpe ɖe ame ŋu wòaɖu dziku dzi.
ENGLISH: (Galatians 5:​19-​21) The Bible contains principles that can help a person deal with anger.

EWE: Ɣesiaɣie wònye nu gbegblẽ be ame nado dzikua?
ENGLISH: Is anger always wrong?

EWE: Dziku ka ƒomevie menyo o?
ENGLISH: When is anger wrong?

EWE: Aleke nàwɔ aɖu dziku dzi?
ENGLISH: How can you deal with anger?

EWE: Mawunyakpukpui siwo ku ɖe dzikudodo ŋu
ENGLISH: Bible verses about anger

EWE: Ɣesiaɣie wònye nu gbegblẽ be ame nado dzikua?
ENGLISH: Is anger always wrong?

EWE: Ao.
ENGLISH: No.

EWE: Asɔ be ame nado dziku le go aɖewo me.
ENGLISH: Anger may be justified in some cases.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, esi nuteƒewɔla Nehemiya se be wonɔ ye hati tadeagulawo tem ɖe anyi la, ‘dɔme vee ŋutɔ.’ Nehemiya 5:6.
ENGLISH: For example, the faithful man Nehemiah "became very angry " when he learned that some of his fellow worshippers were being oppressed.​ Nehemiah 5:6.

EWE: Mawu doa dziku ɣeaɖewoɣi.
ENGLISH: At times, God feels anger.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, esi eƒe ame siwo nɔ anyi le blema la tu nu, si wobla be yewoasubɔ eya ɖeka ko eye wova te alakpamawuwo subɔsubɔ la, "Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe " wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: For example, when his ancient people broke their agreement to worship only him and started to serve false gods, "Jehovah’s anger blazed against " them.

EWE: (Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo 2:13, 14) Ke hã, dziku mele Yehowa Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme veviawo dome o.
ENGLISH: (Judges 2:​13, 14) Even so, anger is not a dominant aspect of Jehovah God’s personality.

EWE: Ɣesiaɣi si wòdo dziku la, etɔ dzɔna eye eléa enu hã. 2 Mose 34:6; Yesaya 48:9.
ENGLISH: His anger is always justified and controlled.​ Exodus 34:6; Isaiah 48:9.

EWE: Dziku ka ƒomevie menyo o?
ENGLISH: When is anger wrong?

EWE: Dziku si ƒomevi menyo o ye nye ne ame do dziku madzemadzee alo melé eƒe dzikua nu o, eye dziku sia ƒomevie amegbetɔ madeblibowo ɖena fiana zi geɖe.
ENGLISH: Anger is wrong when it is uncontrolled or unjustified, which is often the case with the anger displayed by imperfect humans.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me:
ENGLISH: For example:

EWE: Kain "do dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ " esi Mawu gbe eƒe vɔsaa.
ENGLISH: Cain "grew hot with anger " when God rejected his sacrifice.

EWE: Kain ɖe mɔ eƒe dzikua nu va sẽ ale gbegbe be wòwu nɔvia. 1 Mose 4:3-8.
ENGLISH: Cain allowed his anger to fester to the point that he murdered his brother.​ Genesis 4:​3-8.

EWE: ‘Dzi ku’ nyagblɔɖila Yona "vevie " esi Mawu kpɔ nublanui na Niniwetɔwo.
ENGLISH: The prophet Jonah "became hot with anger " when God showed mercy to the Ninevites.

EWE: Mawu ɖɔ Yona ɖo hena wònya be ‘mesɔ be wòado dɔmedzoe nenema gbegbe’ o, eye be ɖe wòle be eƒe dɔme natrɔ ɖe nu vɔ̃ wɔla mawo siwo trɔ dzi me la ŋu hafi.
ENGLISH: God corrected Jonah, pointing out that it was not "right for [him] to be so angry " and that he should have felt compassion for those repentant sinners.​ Jonah 3:⁠10–​4:​1, 4, 11.

EWE: Yona 3:10–4:1, 4, 11. Kpɔɖeŋu siawo ɖee fia be amegbetɔ madeblibowo ƒe "dziku mewɔa nu si le dzɔdzɔe le Mawu ŋkume o. " Yakobo 1:20.
ENGLISH: These examples illustrate that for imperfect humans, "man’s anger does not bring about God’s righteousness. "​ James 1:​20.

EWE: Aleke nàwɔ aɖu dziku dzi?
ENGLISH: How can you deal with anger?

EWE: De dzesi nu si dziku si dzi womeɖu o gblẽna.
ENGLISH: Recognize the danger of uncontrolled anger.

EWE: Ame aɖewo asusu be ne yewona yewoƒe dziku fla la, ke efia be yewosẽ ŋu.
ENGLISH: Some may think that unleashing their anger is a sign of strength.

EWE: Gake ne míagblɔe ŋutɔŋutɔ la, gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ gã aɖe le ame si metea ŋu ɖua eƒe dziku dzi o la ŋu.
ENGLISH: In reality, someone who cannot control his anger has a serious weakness.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be: "Ame si meɖua eƒe dziku dzi o la le abe du si ŋu wogbã gli le wòtsi nuvo ene. "
ENGLISH: "As a city broken through, without a wall, is the man who cannot control his temper. "

EWE: (Lododowo 25:28; 29:11) Gake ne míetea ŋu ɖua míaƒe dziku dzi la, míeɖenɛ fiana be míesẽ ŋu vavã eye míesea nu gɔme.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 25:28; 29:11) On the other hand, when we cultivate the ability to control our anger, we demonstrate true strength and discernment.

EWE: (Lododowo 14:29) Biblia gblɔ be: "Ame si gbɔa dzi ɖi blewu la nyo wu kalẽtɔ. " Lododowo 16:32.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 14:29) The Bible says: "The one slow to anger is better than a mighty man. "​ Proverbs 16:32.

EWE: Ðu wò dzikua dzi hafi wòana nàwɔ nu si ava ve wò emegbe.
ENGLISH: Deal with anger before it causes you to do something you will regret.

EWE: Psalmo 37:8 gblɔ be: "Wò dɔmedzoe nu nefa, eye nàdzudzɔ dzikudodo; dzi megaku wò ne nàtrɔ ɖe vɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋu o. "
ENGLISH: "Let go of anger and abandon rage, " says Psalm 37:8, adding: "Do not become upset and turn to doing evil. "

EWE: De dzesii be ne míedo dziku la, míate ŋu atiae be míaɖe asi le dzikua ŋu ale be wòagana míatrɔ ɖe "vɔ̃wɔwɔ " ŋu o.
ENGLISH: Notice that when we feel angry, we have a choice​ we can choose to let it go before we end up "doing evil. "

EWE: Efesotɔwo 4:26 gblɔ be, "mibi dzi, ke migawɔ nu vɔ̃ o. "
ENGLISH: As Ephesians 4:​26 says, "be wrathful, but do not sin. "

EWE: Ne anya wɔ la, dzo le teƒea hafi dzikua nado gã ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: If possible, take your leave when anger starts to build.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be: "Dzregɔmetoto le abe ale si woŋɔa tɔʋui ene; eya ta dzudzɔ hafi wòava zu dzre. "
ENGLISH: "Beginning a fight is like opening a floodgate, " says the Bible. "Before the quarrel breaks out, take your leave. "

EWE: (Lododowo 17:14) Togbɔ be nunya le eme be nàkpɔ masɔmasɔ siwo ɖo wò kple ame bubuwo dome gbɔ kaba hã la, ɖewohĩ ahiã be wò kple ame kemɛa ƒe dzi nafa hafi miate ŋu adzro nyaa me tufafatɔe.
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 17:14) Although it is wise to settle differences with others quickly, both you and the other person may first need to cool down before you can discuss matters calmly.

EWE: Nya nya bliboa.
ENGLISH: Get the facts.

EWE: Lododowo 19:11 gblɔ be: "Ame si sea nu gɔme nyuie la, medoa dziku kabakaba o. "
ENGLISH: "The insight of a man certainly slows down his anger, " says Proverbs 19:11.

EWE: Nunya anɔ eme be míanya nya bliboa hafi aƒo nya ta.
ENGLISH: We are wise to gather all the facts before forming a conclusion.

EWE: Ne míeɖo to se nyaa ƒe akpa sia akpa nyuie la, anɔ bɔbɔe be míaƒo asa na dzikudodo madzemadzee.
ENGLISH: When we carefully listen to all sides of a matter, we are less likely to feel unjustified anger.​ James 1:​19.

EWE: Yakobo 1:19.
ENGLISH: Pray for peace of mind.

EWE: Gbedodoɖa ate ŋu ana be "Mawu ƒe ŋutifafa, si ƒo gɔmesesewo katã ta " nasu asiwò.
ENGLISH: Prayer can help you experience "the peace of God that surpasses all understanding. "

EWE: (Filipitɔwo 4:7) Gbedodoɖa nye mɔ vevi aɖe si dzi míetona xɔa Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔea, eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔea wɔnɛ be míeɖea nɔnɔme nyuiwo abe dzigbɔɖi, ŋutifafa kple ɖokuidziɖuɖu ene fiana.
ENGLISH: (Philippians 4:7) Prayer is one of the main ways we receive God’s holy spirit, which can produce in us such qualities as peace, patience, and self-control.​ Luke 11:13; Galatians 5:​22, 23.

EWE: Luka 11:13; Galatiatɔwo 5:22, 23.
ENGLISH: Choose your associates carefully.

EWE: Wogblɔna be akpatɔ gbɔnɔla mesẽa akpa dzena o.
ENGLISH: We tend to become like the people we associate with.

EWE: (Lododowo 13:20; 1 Korintotɔwo 15:33) Eya ta esɔ nyuie be Biblia xlɔ̃ nu mí be: "Mègade ha kple dɔmedzoetɔ o, eye mègado ka kple dzikutɔ o. "
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 13:20; 1 Corinthians 15:33) For good reason, the Bible warns: "Do not keep company with a hot-tempered man or get involved with one disposed to rage. "

EWE: Nu ka tae?
ENGLISH: Why?

EWE: Ale be nàgava "srɔ̃ eƒe mɔwo eye wòazu mɔ̃ aɖe wò o. " Lododowo 22:24, 25.
ENGLISH: "So that you never learn his ways and ensnare yourself. "​ Proverbs 22:24, 25.

EWE: Mawunyakpukpui siwo ku ɖe dzikudodo ŋu
ENGLISH: Bible verses about anger

EWE: Lododowo 16:32: "Ame si gbɔa dzi ɖi blewu la nyo wu kalẽtɔ. "
ENGLISH: Proverbs 16:32: "The one slow to anger is better than a mighty man. "

EWE: Efia be: Ne èɖua wò dziku dzi la, ke èle eɖem fia be yesẽ ŋu.
ENGLISH: Meaning: It is a sign of strength to control your anger.

EWE: Lododowo 17:14: "Dzregɔmetoto le abe ale si woŋɔa tɔʋui ene; eya ta dzudzɔ hafi wòava zu dzre. "
ENGLISH: Proverbs 17:14: "Beginning a fight is like opening a floodgate; before the quarrel breaks out, take your leave. "

EWE: Efia be: Ne èkpɔe be dɔmedzoe te flafla la, dzo le teƒea kpoo.
ENGLISH: Meaning: If tempers are flaring, leave the scene.

EWE: Lododowo 19:11: "Ame si sea nu gɔme nyuie la, medoa dziku kabakaba o. "
ENGLISH: Proverbs 19:11: "The insight of a man certainly slows down his anger. "

EWE: Efia be: Míate ŋu aƒo asa na dzikudodo dzodzro ne míede ŋugble le nyaa ƒe akpa sia akpa ŋu, ke menye be míaƒo nya ta evɔ míenya nya bliboa o.
ENGLISH: Meaning: We can prevent unnecessary anger by considering all aspects of a situation rather than forming conclusions before we have all the facts.

EWE: Lododowo 22:24, 25: "Mègade ha kple dɔmedzoetɔ o, eye mègado ka kple dzikutɔ o, ne nàva srɔ̃ eƒe mɔwo . . . o. "
ENGLISH: Proverbs 22:24, 25: "Do not keep company with a hot-tempered man or get involved with one disposed to rage, so that you never learn his ways. "

EWE: Efia be: Ne míedea ha kple ame siwo doa dziku kabakaba la, míate ŋu ava nɔ abe woawo ke ene.
ENGLISH: Meaning: If we associate with people who are prone to anger, we will probably become like them.

EWE: Lododowo 29:11: "Bometsila dudua eƒe seselelãme katã kɔna ɖi. "
ENGLISH: Proverbs 29:11: "A stupid person gives vent to all his feelings. "

EWE: Efia be: Nunya le eme be míaɖu míaƒe seselelãmewo dzi tsɔ wu be míaɖe mɔ woakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe mía dzi.
ENGLISH: Meaning: We are wise to control our emotions rather than to let them control us.

EWE: Galatiatɔwo 5:22, 23: "Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe kutsetse ye nye lɔlɔ̃, dzidzɔ, ŋutifafa, dzigbɔgbɔ blewu, dɔmenyonyo, nyuiwɔwɔ, xɔse, tufafa, ɖokuidziɖuɖu. "
ENGLISH: Galatians 5:​22, 23: "The fruitage of the spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, mildness, self-control. "

EWE: Efia be: Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔea, alo eƒe dɔwɔŋusẽa, ate ŋu ana míatu nɔnɔme siwo akpe ɖe mía ŋu míaɖu dziku dzi la ɖo.
ENGLISH: Meaning: God’s holy spirit, or his power in action, can produce in us qualities that help to counter anger.

EWE: Efesotɔwo 4:26: "Mibi dzi, ke migawɔ nu vɔ̃ o. "
ENGLISH: Ephesians 4:​26: "Be wrathful, but do not sin. "

EWE: Efia be: Menye ɣesiaɣie míate ŋu aƒo asa na dzikudodo o, gake míate ŋu aɖu míaƒe dziku dzi.
ENGLISH: Meaning: We cannot always prevent ourselves from feeling anger, but we can control how we deal with it.

EWE: Yakobo 1:19: "Ame sia ame naɖe abla le nusese me, nanɔ blewu le nuƒoƒo me, nanɔ blewu le dziku me. "
ENGLISH: James 1:​19: "Everyone must be quick to listen, slow to speak, slow to anger. "

EWE: Efia be: Ne míenye toɖola nyuiwo la, ate ŋu ana míanɔ blewu le dziku me.
ENGLISH: Meaning: We can slow down our anger by being a good listener.

EWE: Ame Nyui Aɖe Koe Yesu Nyea?
ENGLISH: Was Jesus Just a Good Man?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Ame si Yesu nye la yi ŋgɔ wu ema.
ENGLISH: Jesus was more than just a good man.

EWE: Ne mede ɖeke o la, enye ame si ƒe agbenɔnɔ kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe amewo dzi wu le ŋutinya me.
ENGLISH: At the very least, he has proved to be the most influential man in human history.

EWE: De dzesi nya siwo ŋutinyaŋlɔla kple agbalẽŋlɔla xɔŋkɔ siawo gblɔ tso eŋu:
ENGLISH: Note what these famous historians and writers have said about him:

EWE: "Ðikeke mele eme o be Yesu Nazaretetɔ . . . lae nye ame vevitɔ kekeake si nɔ anyi kpɔ. "
ENGLISH: "Jesus of Nazareth . . . is easily the dominant figure in history. "

EWE: Eŋlisiawo ƒe ŋutinyaŋlɔla H. G. Wells.
ENGLISH: H. G. Wells, English historian.

EWE: "[Yesu] ƒe agbenɔnɔe kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe amewo dzi wu le anyigba sia dzi, eye wòyi edzi le ŋusẽ kpɔm ɖe amewo dzi geɖe wu. "
ENGLISH: "[Jesus’] life is the most influential ever lived on this planet and its effect continues to mount. "

EWE: Amerikatɔwo ƒe ŋutinyaŋlɔla kple agbalẽŋlɔla Kenneth Scott Latourette.
ENGLISH: Kenneth Scott Latourette, American historian and author.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ nu si tae Yesu ƒe agbenɔnɔ kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe amewo dzi wu ame nyui ɖe sia ɖe si nɔ anyigba dzi kpɔ tɔ la na mí.
ENGLISH: The Bible identifies why Jesus has had a greater impact than any other good man who ever lived.

EWE: Esi Yesu bia eyomedzela siwo nɔa eŋu kplikplikpli la be ame kae wobuna be yenye hã la, wo dometɔ ɖeka ɖo eŋu wòsɔ nyuie be: "Wòe nye Kristo la, Mawu gbagbe la ƒe Vi. "
ENGLISH: When Jesus asked his closest followers who they thought he was, one of them correctly answered: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God. "

EWE: Mateo 16:16.
ENGLISH: Matthew 16:16.

EWE: Yesue Nye Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔa?
ENGLISH: Is Jesus Almighty God?

EWE: Ale si Bibia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Yesu ƒe futɔwo tsɔ nya ɖe eŋu be etsɔ eɖokui sɔ kple Mawu.
ENGLISH: Jesus’ opposers accused him of making himself equal to God.

EWE: (Yohanes 5:18; 10:30-33) Ke hã Yesu megblɔ kpɔ be yele tasɔsɔ me kple Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la o.
ENGLISH: (John 5:18; 10:30-33) However, Jesus never claimed to be on the same level as Almighty God.

EWE: Egblɔ be: "Fofo la lolo wum. "
ENGLISH: He said: "The Father is greater than I am. "

EWE: Yohanes 14:28.
ENGLISH: John 14:28.

EWE: Yesu yomedzelawo mebu Yesu be esɔ kple Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la o.
ENGLISH: Jesus’ early followers did not view him as being equal to Almighty God.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, apostolo Paulo ŋlɔ ɖi be esi wofɔ Yesu ɖe tsitre megbe la, "Mawu [do Yesu] ɖe dzi wòle nɔƒe kɔkɔ aɖe. "
ENGLISH: For example, the apostle Paul wrote that after Jesus was resurrected, God "exalted him [Jesus] to a superior position. "

EWE: Eme kɔ ƒãa be Paulo mebui be Yesue nye Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la o.
ENGLISH: Obviously, Paul did not believe that Jesus was Almighty God.

EWE: Ne menye nenema o la, aleke wɔ Mawu agado Yesu ɖe dzi wòava nɔ ɖoƒe kɔkɔ?
ENGLISH: Otherwise, how could God exalt Jesus to a superior position?

EWE: Filipitɔwo 2:9.
ENGLISH: Philippians 2:9.

EWE: Nu Ka Tae Woyɔa Yesu Be Mawu Ƒe Vi?
ENGLISH: Why Is Jesus Called the Son of God?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Woyɔa Yesu le Biblia me zi geɖe be "Mawu ƒe Vi. "
ENGLISH: The Bible often calls Jesus "the Son of God. "

EWE: (Yohanes 1:49) Biblia zã nyagbɔgblɔ "Mawu ƒe Vi " le gɔmesesea nu be Mawue nye Wɔla la, alo agbe ɖe sia ɖe Dzɔtsoƒe eye Yesu ƒe agbe hã le eme.
ENGLISH: (John 1:49) The expression "Son of God " acknowledges that God is the Creator, or Source, of all life, including that of Jesus.

EWE: (Psalmo 36:9; Nyaɖeɖefia 4:11) Biblia megblɔ be Mawu dzi Yesu abe ale si amegbetɔwo dzia vi ene o.
ENGLISH: (Psalm 36:9; Revelation 4:11) The Bible does not teach that God literally fathered a child in the same way that humans produce children.

EWE: Woyɔa mawudɔlawo hã le Biblia me be "Mawu vavã la ƒe viwo. "
ENGLISH: The Bible also calls the angels "sons of the true God. "

EWE: (Hiob 1:6) Biblia gblɔ tso amegbetɔ gbãtɔ, Adam, ŋu be enye "Mawu ƒe vi. "
ENGLISH: (Job 1:6) And the Bible says that the first human, Adam, was a "son of God. "

EWE: (Luka 3:38) Ke hã, esi wònye be Yesue nye Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ gbãtɔ, eye eya koe nye ame si Mawu ŋutɔ wɔ tẽe ta la, Biblia gblɔ tso Yesu ŋu be enye Mawu ƒe Vi vevitɔ.
ENGLISH: (Luke 3:38) However, because Jesus was God’s first creation and the only one created directly by him, the Bible describes Jesus as the foremost Son of God.

EWE: Ðe Yesu nɔ dziƒo kpɔ hafi wova dzii ɖe anyigba dzia?
ENGLISH: Did Jesus live in heaven before he was born on earth?

EWE: Nu kawoe Yesu nɔ wɔwɔm le dziƒo hafi va anyigba dzi?
ENGLISH: What did Jesus do before he came to the earth?

EWE: Ðe Yesu nɔ dziƒo kpɔ hafi wova dzii ɖe anyigba dzia?
ENGLISH: Did Jesus live in heaven before he was born on earth?
Yes.

EWE: Yesu nye gbɔgbɔmenuwɔwɔ nɔ dziƒo hafi wova dzii ɖe anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: Jesus was a spirit creature in heaven before he was born as a human on earth.

EWE: Yesu ŋutɔ gblɔ be: "Meɖi tso dziƒo va. "
ENGLISH: Jesus himself said: "I have come down from heaven. "

EWE: Yohanes 6:38; 8:23.
Mawu wɔ Yesu hafi wɔ nu bubu ɖe sia ɖe.
ENGLISH: God created Jesus before he created anything else.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ tso Yesu ŋu be:
ENGLISH: Regarding Jesus, the Bible says:

EWE: "Eyae nye . . . nuwɔwɔwo katã ƒe gbãtɔ. "
ENGLISH: "He is . . . the firstborn of all creation. "

EWE: Kolosetɔwo 1:15.
ENGLISH: Colossians 1:15.

EWE: Eyae nye "Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze. "
ENGLISH: He is "the beginning of the creation by God. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia 3:14.
ENGLISH: Revelation 3:14.

EWE: Yesu ŋue wogblɔ le be enye "ame si dzɔɣi tso blemablema ke, tso gbe aɖe gbe ʋĩi ke. "
ENGLISH: Jesus fulfilled the prophecy about the one "whose origin is from ancient times, from the days of long ago. "

EWE: Mika 5:2; Mateo 2:4-6.
ENGLISH: Micah 5:2; Matthew 2:4-6.

EWE: Nu kawoe Yesu nɔ wɔwɔm le dziƒo hafi va anyigba dzi?
ENGLISH: What did Jesus do before he came to the earth?

EWE: Enɔ ɖoƒe kɔkɔ aɖe le dziƒo.
ENGLISH: He held an exalted heavenly position.

EWE: Yesu he susu yi ɖoƒe sia dzi esi wòdo gbe ɖa be: "Fofo, tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si nɔ asinye le gbɔwò hafi xexea va dzɔ la dom ɖe dzi. "
ENGLISH: Jesus referred to this position when he prayed: "Father, glorify me . . . with the glory that I had alongside you before the world was. "

EWE: Yohanes 17:5.
ENGLISH: John 17:5.

EWE: Ekpe ɖe Fofoa ŋu le nu bubuwo katã wɔwɔ me.
ENGLISH: He helped his Father create all other things.

EWE: Yesu wɔ dɔ aduadu kple Mawu abe "dɔwɔla bibi " ene.
ENGLISH: Jesus worked alongside God "as a master worker. "

EWE: (Lododowo 8:30) Biblia gblɔ le Yesu ŋu be: "Eya dzie woto wɔ nu bubu siwo katã le dziƒowo kple anyigba dzi. "
ENGLISH: (Proverbs 8:30) Regarding Jesus, the Bible says: "By means of him all other things were created in the heavens and on the earth. "

EWE: Kolosetɔwo 1:16.
ENGLISH: Colossians 1:16.

EWE: Mawu to Yesu dzi wɔ nu bubuwo katã.
ENGLISH: God worked through Jesus to bring every other creation into existence.

EWE: Wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye mawudɔlawo kple xexe gbahooa.
ENGLISH: This creation included all other spirit creatures, as well as the physical universe.

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 5:11) Le mɔ aɖe nu la, míate ŋu atsɔ ale si Mawu kple Yesu wɔ dɔ aduadui la asɔ kple ale si xɔtuɖaŋunyala kple xɔtula wɔa dɔe.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 5:11) In some respects, this cooperation between God and Jesus was like that of an architect working with a builder.

EWE: Xɔtuɖaŋunyalaa wɔa ale si woatu xɔa ƒe nɔnɔmetata, eye xɔtulaa kpɔa nɔnɔmetataa dzi tua xɔa.
ENGLISH: The architect creates the design; the builder brings the design to reality.

EWE: Yesu nye Nya la.
ENGLISH: He served as the Word.

EWE: Esi Biblia nɔ nu ƒom tso Yesu ƒe agbenɔnɔ le dziƒo do ŋgɔ na eƒe anyigba dzi vava ŋu la, eyɔe be "Nya la. "
ENGLISH: When speaking of Jesus’ prehuman life, the Bible calls Jesus "the Word. "

EWE: (Yohanes 1:1) Anɔ eme be esia fia be Mawu to Via dzi tsɔ gbedeasiwo kple mɔfiamewo na mawudɔla bubuawo.
ENGLISH: (John 1:1) Evidently, this means that God used his Son to convey information and instructions to other spirit creatures.

EWE: Azɔ hã, anɔ eme be Mawu zã Yesu abe eƒe Nyanuɖela ene tsɔ ƒo nu na amegbetɔwo le anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: Jesus also seems to have acted as God’s Spokesman to humans on earth.

EWE: Anɔ eme be Mawu ƒo nu to Yesu dzi abe Nya la ene esime wònɔ mɔfiame nam Adam kple Xawa le Eden-bɔa me.
ENGLISH: God likely spoke through Jesus as the Word when giving instructions to Adam and Eve in the garden of Eden.

EWE: (1 Mose 2:16, 17) Ðewohĩ Yesu ye nye mawudɔla si kplɔ blema Israel-viwo le gbea dzi, ame si ƒe gbe dzi wòle be Israel-viwo nawɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
ENGLISH: (Genesis 2:16, 17) Jesus may have been the angel who guided the ancient Israelites through the wilderness and whose voice the Israelites were strictly to obey.
Exodus 23:20-23.

EWE: Ame Kae Nye Kristo Ƒe Futɔ La?
ENGLISH: Who Is the Antichrist?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Kristo ƒe futɔ la menye ame ɖeka alo habɔbɔ ɖeka aɖe koŋ o, elabe Biblia gblɔ be "Kristo ƒe futɔ geɖewo " li. (1 Yohanes 2:18) Helagbe me nya si gɔme woɖe be "Kristo ƒe futɔ " la fia "ame si tsi tsitre ɖe Kristo ŋu alo tsɔ eɖokui ɖo eteƒe. " Ame sia ame si wɔa nu siwo gbɔna la nye Kristo ƒe futɔ:
ENGLISH: The antichrist is not merely one individual person or entity, for the Bible says that there are "many antichrists. " (1 John 2:​18) Rather, the term "antichrist, " which comes from a Greek word meaning "against (or instead of) Christ, " refers to anyone who does the following:

EWE: Egblɔna be menye Yesue nye Kristo (Mesia) la o alo gblɔna be menye Mawu ƒe Vie wònye o.​ 1 Yohanes 2:18.
ENGLISH: Denies that Jesus is the Christ (Messiah) or denies that he is the Son of God.​ 1 John 2:​22.

EWE: Etsia tsitre ɖe Kristo, Mawu ƒe Amesiamina la, ŋu.​ Psalmo 2:1, 2; Luka 11:23.
ENGLISH: Opposes the Christ, God’s Anointed One.​ Psalm 2:​1, 2; Luke 11:23.

EWE: Egblɔna be yee nye Kristo la.​ Mateo 24:24.
ENGLISH: Pretends to be the Christ.​ Matthew 24:24.

EWE: Etia Kristo yomedzelawo yome, elabe Yesu bua nu sia nu si wowɔ ɖe wo ŋu be ye ŋutɔ ŋue wòwɔe ɖo.​ Dɔwɔwɔwo 9:5.
ENGLISH: Persecutes the followers of Christ, since Jesus views what is done to them as being done to him.​ Acts 9:5.

EWE: Edaa alakpa be Kristotɔe yenye evɔ tsɔa sedzimawɔmawɔ kple amebeble ɖoa dɔe.​ Mateo 7:22, 23; 2 Korintotɔwo 11:13.
ENGLISH: Falsely claims to be a Christian while practicing lawlessness or deception.​ Matthew 7:​22, 23; 2 Corinthians 11:13.

EWE: Biblia yɔ ame siwo wɔa nu siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe be Kristo ƒe futɔwo eye wògayɔ wo katã abe ƒuƒoƒo ene be "Kristo ƒe futɔ. " (2 Yohanes 7) Kristo ƒe futɔ la do zi gbãtɔ le apostoloawo ƒe ŋkekeawo me eye wògale dɔ dzi vevie va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: Besides speaking of individuals who take such actions as being antichrists, the Bible also refers to them collectively as "the antichrist. " (2 John 7) The antichrist first appeared in the time of the apostles and has been active ever since.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ esia ɖi.​ 1 Yohanes 4:3.
ENGLISH: Bible prophecy foretold just such a development.​ 1 John 4:3.

EWE: Ale si nàwɔ akpɔ Kristo ƒe futɔ la adze sii
ENGLISH: How to identify antichrists

EWE: Wogblɔa alakpanyawo tso Yesu ŋu.
ENGLISH: They promote false ideas related to Jesus.

EWE: (Mateo 24:9, 11) Le kpɔɖeŋu me, ame siwo fiaa Trinita Kɔkɔe alo Mawuɖekaetɔ̃ alo fiaa nu be Yesue nye Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la tsia tsitre ɖe nya si Yesu gblɔ be "Fofo la lolo wum " la ŋu tẽe.​ Yohanes 14:28.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 24:​9, 11) For example, those who teach the Trinity or that Jesus is Almighty God actually oppose the teachings of Jesus, who said: "The Father is greater than I am. "​ John 14:28.

EWE: Kristo ƒe futɔ la medaa asi ɖe nu si Yesu fiaa ku ɖe Mawu Fiaɖuƒea ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu la dzi o.
ENGLISH: Antichrists reject what Jesus said about how God’s Kingdom operates.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, sɔlemehakplɔla aɖewo gblɔna be amegbetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖuwo zãmee Kristo le le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me.
ENGLISH: For instance, some religious leaders say that Christ works through human governments.

EWE: Ke hã woƒe nufiafia sia tsi tsitre ɖe Yesu ŋu, elabe eya ŋutɔ gblɔ be: "Nye Fiaɖuƒe menye xexe sia ƒe akpa aɖeke o. "​ Yohanes 18:36.
ENGLISH: Yet, this teaching contradicts Jesus, who said: "My Kingdom is no part of this world. "​ John 18:36.

EWE: Wogblɔna be Yesue nye yewoƒe Aƒetɔ gake womewɔna ɖe eƒe sededewo dzi o. Eƒe sedede siawo dometɔ ɖekae nye be woaɖe gbeƒã Fiaɖuƒea ŋuti nya nyuia.​ Mateo 28:19, 20; Luka 6:46; Dɔwɔwɔwo 10:42.
ENGLISH: They say that Jesus is their Lord, but they do not obey his commands, including the one to preach the good news of the Kingdom.​ Matthew 28:19, 20; Luke 6:​46; Acts 10:42.

EWE: Ame Kae Alo Nu Kae Nye Mawu Ƒe Nya La?
ENGLISH: Who or What Is the Word of God?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Zi geɖe la, nyagbɔgblɔ "Mawu ƒe nya " fiaa Mawu ƒe gbedeasi alo nya siwo wògblɔ.
ENGLISH: The expression "the word of God " usually refers to a divine message or to a collection of those messages.

EWE: (Luka 11:28) Wozãa "Mawu Ƒe Nya " alo "Nya La " le teƒe ʋɛ aɖewo wònyea dzesideŋkɔ.​ Nyaɖeɖefia 19:13; Yohanes 1:14.
ENGLISH: (Luke 11:28) In a few places, "The Word of God " or "the Word " is used as a personal title.​ Revelation 19:13; John 1:​14.

EWE: Mawu ƒe gbedeasi.
ENGLISH: A divine message.

EWE: Nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔna zi geɖe be gbedeasi siwo yewogblɔna la nye Mawu ƒe nya.
ENGLISH: The prophets often stated that the messages they delivered were God’s word.

EWE: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, Yeremiya dze eƒe nyagblɔɖi gbedeasia gɔme be, "Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam. "
ENGLISH: For example, Jeremiah introduced his prophetic messages with the expression "the word of Jehovah came to me. "

EWE: (Yeremiya 1:4, 11, 13; 2:1) Hafi nyagblɔɖila Samuel nagblɔ na Saul be Mawu tiae be wòanye fia la, nyagblɔɖilaa gblɔ be: "Tɔ ne magblɔ Mawu ƒe gbe na wò. "​ 1 Samuel 9:27.
ENGLISH: (Jeremiah 1:​4, 11, 13; 2:1) Before telling Saul that God had chosen him as king, the prophet Samuel said: "Stand still now, so that I may let you hear the word of God. "​ 1 Samuel 9:​27.

EWE: Dzesideŋkɔ.
ENGLISH: A personal title.

EWE: Biblia zã "Nya la " wònye dzesideŋkɔ na Yesu Kristo esime wònye gbɔgbɔmenuwɔwɔ le dziƒo kple esime wònye amegbetɔ nɔ anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: "The Word " also appears in the Bible as a title for Jesus Christ, both as a spirit in heaven and as a human on earth.

EWE: Kpɔ susu siwo tae míate ŋu aƒo nya ta alea ɖo la ɖa:
ENGLISH: Consider some reasons for this conclusion:

EWE: Nya la nɔ agbe do ŋgɔ na nuwɔwɔ bubuwo katã.
ENGLISH: The Word lived before all other creation.

EWE: "Le gɔmedzedzea me, Nya la li, . . .
ENGLISH: "In the beginning was the Word . . .

EWE: Ame sia nɔ anyi kple Mawu le gɔmedzedzea me. "
ENGLISH: This one was in the beginning with God. "

EWE: (Yohanes 1:1, 2) Yesue nye "nuwɔwɔwo katã ƒe gbãtɔ . . .
ENGLISH: (John 1:​1, 2) Jesus is "the firstborn of all creation . . .

EWE: Etre dzɔdzɔ na nu bubuwo katã hã. "​ Kolosetɔwo 1:13-15, 17.
ENGLISH: He is before all other things. "​ Colossians 1:​13-​15, 17.

EWE: Nya la va anyigba dzi abe amegbetɔ ene.
ENGLISH: The Word came to earth as a human.

EWE: "Nya la va zu amegbetɔ, enɔ mía dome. "
ENGLISH: "The Word became flesh and resided among us. "

EWE: (Yohanes 1:14) Kristo Yesu ‘ɖi gbɔlo eɖokui, eye wòtsɔ kluvi ƒe nɔnɔme heva zu amegbetɔ.’​ Filipitɔwo 2:5-7.
ENGLISH: (John 1:​14) Christ Jesus "emptied himself and took a slave’s form and became human. "​ Philippians 2:​5-7.

EWE: Nya la nye Mawu ƒe Vi.
ENGLISH: The Word is God’s Son.

EWE: Esi apostolo Yohanes gblɔ be "Nya la va zu amegbetɔ " vɔ la, eyi edzi be: "Míekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe si le abe tenuvi ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe tso fofoa gbɔ ene. "
ENGLISH: After stating that "the Word became flesh, " as quoted above, the apostle John continued: "We had a view of his glory, a glory such as belongs to an only-begotten son from a father. "

EWE: (Yohanes 1:14) Yohanes gaŋlɔ hã be: "Yesu Kristoe nye Mawu ƒe Vi la. "​ 1 Yohanes 4:15.
ENGLISH: (John 1:​14) John also wrote: "Jesus is God’s Son. "​ 1 John 4:​15.

EWE: Mawu ƒe nɔnɔmewo le Nya la si.
ENGLISH: The Word possesses godlike attributes.

EWE: "Nya la nye mawu aɖe. "
ENGLISH: "The Word was a god, " or "was divine. "

EWE: (Yohanes 1:1) Yesu "ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe fia eye wònye eƒe amenyenye ƒe nɔnɔme pɛpɛpɛ. "​ Hebritɔwo 1:2, 3.
ENGLISH: (John 1:1; An American Translation) Jesus is "the reflection of God’s glory and the exact representation of his very being. "​ Hebrews 1:​2, 3.

EWE: Nya la nye fia.
ENGLISH: The Word rules as a king.

EWE: Biblia gblɔ be "fiakuku geɖewo le ta " na Mawu ƒe Nya la.
ENGLISH: The Bible states that on the head of the Word of God are "many royal headbands. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 19:12, 13) Wogayɔ Nya la be "fiawo dzi Fia kple aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ. "
ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:12, 13; footnote) The Word is also named "King of kings and Lord of lords. "

EWE: (Nyaɖeɖefia 19:16) Woyɔ Yesu be ‘fiawo katã ƒe Fia kple aƒetɔwo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ.’​ 1 Timoteo 6:14, 15.
ENGLISH: (Revelation 19:16) Jesus is called "the King of those who rule as kings and Lord of those who rule as lords. "​ 1 Timothy 6:​14, 15.

EWE: Nya la nye Mawu ƒe nyanuɖela.
ENGLISH: The Word serves as God’s spokesman.

EWE: Dzesideŋkɔ "Nya la " fia be Mawu toa ame si ŋu ŋkɔ ma le la dzi gblɔa eƒe gbedeasiwo kple mɔfiamewo.
ENGLISH: The title "the Word " apparently identifies its bearer as one whom God uses to convey information and instructions.

EWE: Yesu gblɔ be Mawu zãa ye aleae esi wògblɔ be: "Fofo si dɔm ɖa la ŋutɔe na nya si magblɔ kple ale si maƒo nui ƒe sem. . . .
ENGLISH: Jesus said that he performed this role: "The Father who sent me has himself given me a commandment about what to say and what to speak. . . .

EWE: Eya ŋuti nya siwo megblɔna la, megblɔa wo abe ale si tututu Fofo la gblɔ wo nam ene. "​ Yohanes 12:49, 50.
ENGLISH: So whatever I speak, I speak just as the Father has told me. "​ John 12:49, 50.

EWE: Ame Kae Nye Mawudɔla Gãtɔ Mikael?
ENGLISH: Who Is the Archangel Michael?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Edze ƒãa be Mikael, si subɔsubɔha aɖewo yɔna be "Mikael Kɔkɔe, " ye nye ŋkɔ si wona Yesu le dziƒo hafi wòva anyigba dzi kple esi wòtrɔ yi dziƒo.
ENGLISH: Michael, referred to by some religions as "Saint Michael, " is evidently a name given to Jesus before and after his life on earth.

EWE: Mikael ʋli nya kple Satana le Mose ƒe kukua ŋu, eye wògakpe ɖe mawudɔla aɖe hã ŋu wòtsɔ Mawu ƒe gbedeasi yi na nyagblɔɖila Daniel.
ENGLISH: Michael disputed with Satan after the death of Moses and helped an angel deliver God’s message to the prophet Daniel.

EWE: (Daniel 10:13, 21; Yuda 9) Ŋkɔ Mikael gɔmee nye "Ame Kae Le Abe Mawu Ene, " eye Yesu nɔ agbe wòsɔ kple ŋkɔ ma, elabena eʋli Mawu ƒe dziɖulanyenye ta eye wòwɔ aʋa kple Mawu ƒe futɔwo.​ Daniel 12:1; Nyaɖeɖefia 12:7.
ENGLISH: (Daniel 10:13, 21; Jude 9) Michael lives up to the meaning of his name​ "Who Is Like God? "​ by defending God’s rulership and fighting God’s enemies.​ Daniel 12:1; Revelation 12:7.

EWE: Kpɔ susu siwo tae wòsɔ be woaƒo nya ta be Yesue nye mawudɔla gãtɔ Mikael la ɖa.
ENGLISH: Consider why it is reasonable to conclude that Jesus is the archangel Michael.

EWE: Mikael ye nye "mawudɔla gãtɔ " la.
ENGLISH: Michael is "the archangel. "

EWE: (Yuda 9) Dzesideŋkɔ "mawudɔla gãtɔ, " si fia "mawudɔlawo ƒe tatɔ " la dze le Biblia me zi eve pɛ ko.
ENGLISH: (Jude 9) The title "archangel, " meaning "chief of the angels, " appears in only two Bible verses.

EWE: Le go evea siaa me la, womegblɔ be "mawudɔla gãtɔwo " abe ɖe wosɔ gbɔ ene o; esia fia be mawudɔla ɖeka ŋu koe ŋkɔ ma le.

ENGLISH: Regarding the references made by first- and second-century historians to Jesus and the early Christians, the Encyclopædia Britannica, 2002 Edition, says: "These independent accounts prove that in ancient times even the opponents of Christianity never doubted the historicity of Jesus, which was disputed for the first time and on inadequate grounds at the end of the 18th, during the 19th, and at the beginning of the 20th centuries. "

EWE: Le ƒe 2006 me la, agbalẽ aɖe (Jesus and Archaeology) gblɔ be: "Agbalẽnyala xɔŋkɔ siwo li egbea dometɔ aɖeke meke ɖi be Yudatɔ aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Yesu si nye Yosef vi la nɔ anyi kpɔ o; wo dometɔ geɖe lɔ̃na ɖe edzi enumake be yewova nya nu geɖe tso eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo kple eƒe nufiafia veviwo ŋu. "
ENGLISH: In 2006, the book Jesus and Archaeology said: "No reputable scholar today questions that a Jew named Jesus son of Joseph lived; most readily admit that we now know a considerable amount about his actions and his basic teachings. "

EWE: Biblia ƒo nu tso Yesu ŋu be enye ame ŋutɔŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: The Bible portrays Jesus as a real person.

EWE: Eyɔ etɔgbuiawo ŋkɔwo eye wòƒo nu tso edzilawo kple nɔviawo ŋu hã.
ENGLISH: It provides the names of his ancestors and immediate family.

EWE: (Mateo 1:1; 13:55) Biblia yɔ ame xɔŋkɔ siwo nɔ anyi le Yesu ƒe ɣeyiɣia me ƒe ŋkɔwo hã.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 1:1; 13:55) It also gives the names of prominent rulers who were contemporaries of Jesus.

EWE: (Luka 3:1, 2) Nuŋlɔɖi vevi siawo na numekulawo tea ŋu kua nu me hekpɔa kpeɖodzi be Biblia me nuŋlɔɖiwo de pɛpɛpɛ.
ENGLISH: (Luke 3:1, 2) Those details allow researchers to verify the accuracy of the Bible accounts.

EWE: Ðe Yesu Ƒe Agbemeŋutinya Si Le Biblia Me La De Pɛpɛpɛa?
ENGLISH: Does the Bible Contain an Accurate Record of Jesus’ Life?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Biblia-ŋlɔla Luka gblɔ tso Yesu ƒe agbemeŋutinya si wòŋlɔ la ŋu be: "Nye hã meku nuwo katã me tsitotsito tso gɔmedzedzea me. "
ENGLISH: The Bible writer Luke said regarding his account of Jesus’ life: "I have traced all things from the start with accuracy. "

EWE: Luka 1:3.
ENGLISH: Luke 1:3.

EWE: Ame aɖewo gblɔna be wotrɔ Yesu ƒe agbemeŋutinya siwo woŋlɔ ɖe Nyanyuigbalẽwo, siwo nye agbalẽ siwo eŋɔlimetɔ siwo nye Mateo, Marko, Luka kple Yohanes ŋlɔ, la me nyawo le ƒe alafa enelia le Yesu dzidzi megbe me.
ENGLISH: Some claim that accounts of Jesus’ life as recorded in the Gospels the writings of his contemporaries Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John were altered sometime in the fourth century.

EWE: Gake wova ke ɖe Yohanes ƒe Nyanyuigbalẽa ƒe asinuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ kakɛ aɖe ŋuti le Egipte le ƒe 1900-ƒeawo ƒe gɔmedzedze.
ENGLISH: However, a valuable fragment of John’s Gospel was found in Egypt at the turn of the 20th century.

EWE: Woyɔa asinuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ kakɛ sia egbea be Papyrus Rylands 457 (P52) eye wodzrae ɖo ɖe John Rylands Library si le Manchester le England (Angleterre).
ENGLISH: It is now known as the Papyrus Rylands 457 (P52) and is preserved at the John Rylands Library, Manchester, England.

EWE: Nya siwo dze le Yohanes 18:31-33, 37, 38 le egbe Bibliawo mee le edzi.
ENGLISH: It contains what is John 18:31-33, 37, 38 in modern Bibles.

EWE: Esiae nye Kristotɔwo Ƒe Hela Ŋɔŋlɔawo alo Nubabla Yeyea ƒe asinuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ kakɛ xoxotɔ si ŋu woke ɖo.
ENGLISH: This is the oldest known manuscript fragment of the Christian Greek Scriptures.

EWE: Agbalẽnyala geɖe xɔe se be ƒe 125 me lɔƒoe woŋlɔe.
ENGLISH: Many scholars believe that it was written about 125 C.E., a mere quarter of a century or so after the original was written.

EWE: Esia anye ƒe 25 alo esi wu nenema vie ko esime Yohanes ŋutɔ ŋlɔ eƒe agbalẽa megbe.
ENGLISH: The text of the fragment agrees nearly exactly with that in later manuscripts.

EWE: Aleke Yesu Ƒe Dzedzeme Nɔ?
ENGLISH: What Did Jesus Look Like?

EWE: Ale si Biblia ɖo eŋui
ENGLISH: The Bible’s answer

EWE: Esi Biblia meɖɔ Yesu ƒe dzedzeme o ta la, ame aɖeke menya ale si tututu eƒe dzedzeme nɔ o.
ENGLISH: No one knows exactly what Jesus looked like, since his physical appearance is not described in the Bible.

EWE: Esia fia be Yesu ƒe dzedzeme nyanya mele vevie o.
ENGLISH: This indicates that Jesus’ physical features are not important.

EWE: Ke hã, Biblia kpe ɖe mía ŋu míenya ale si Yesu ƒe dzedzeme anya anɔ.
ENGLISH: However, the Bible does give us some idea of Jesus’ general appearance.

EWE: Eƒe Dzedzeme: Yudatɔe Yesu nye eya ta eƒe dzedzeme anya nɔ abe nɔa si nye Sem ƒe dzidzimevi la tɔ ene.
ENGLISH: Features: Jesus was a Jew and likely inherited common Semitic traits from his mother.

EWE: (Hebritɔwo 7:14) Anye be eƒe dzedzeme menɔ etɔxɛ o.
ENGLISH: (Hebrews 7:​14) It is unlikely that his features were especially distinctive.

EWE: Ɣeaɖeɣi la, ete ŋu zɔ mɔ le adzame tso Galilea yi Yerusalem eye ame aɖeke mekpɔe dze sii o.
ENGLISH: On one occasion he was able to travel in secret from Galilee to Jerusalem without being recognized.

EWE: (Yohanes 7:10, 11) Eye edze abe ne Yesu le eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dome kura gɔ̃ hã la, vovototo boo aɖeke menɔa eya kple woawo dome o.
ENGLISH: (John 7:​10, 11) And he apparently did not stand out even among his closest disciples.

EWE: Àɖo ŋkui be, ɖe Yuda Iskariot wɔ nane tsɔ de dzesi Yesu hafi amehawo va lée.​ Mateo 26:47-49.
ENGLISH: Recall that Judas Iscariot had to identify Jesus to the armed crowd that arrested him.​ Matthew 26:47-​49.

EWE: Eƒe ɖa ƒe didime: Ða legbe menya nɔ ta na Yesu o elabe Biblia gblɔ be "ne ɖa legbe le ta na ŋutsu la, enye ŋukpe nɛ. "​ 1 Korintotɔwo 11:14.
ENGLISH: Hair length: It is unlikely that Jesus’ hair was long, because the Bible says that "long hair is a dishonor to a man. "​ 1 Corinthians 11:14.

EWE: Eƒe ge: Yesu ɖo ge.
ENGLISH: Beard: Jesus wore a beard.

EWE: Ewɔ ɖe se si wode na Yuda ŋutsuwo be ‘woagafɔ woƒe ge dzi ɖewoɖewoe o’ la dzi.
ENGLISH: He followed Jewish law, which prohibited adult males from ‘disfiguring the edges of their beard.’

EWE: (3 Mose 19:27; Galatiatɔwo 4:4) Azɔ hã, Biblia ƒo nu tso Yesu ƒe ge ŋu le nyagblɔɖi aɖe si ku ɖe eƒe fukpekpewo ŋu me.​ Yesaya 50:6.
ENGLISH: (Leviticus 19:27; Galatians 4:4) Also, the Bible mentions Jesus’ beard in a prophecy about his suffering.​ Isaiah 50:6.

EWE: Eƒe ametia: Nu sia nu ɖee fia be ŋusẽ nɔ Yesu ŋu.
ENGLISH: Body: All indications are that Jesus was physically robust.

EWE: Esi wònɔ eƒe subɔsubɔdɔa wɔm la, ezɔa mɔ kilometa gbogbo aɖewo.
ENGLISH: During his ministry, he traveled many miles.

EWE: (Mateo 9:35) Ekɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe gbedoxɔa ŋu zi eve, esi wòtrɔ gaɖɔlilawo ƒe gawo ƒu gbe eye wòtu asi woƒe kplɔ̃wo ƒu anyi, eye gbe ɖeka etsɔ atam nya lãwo do goe le gbedoxɔa me.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 9:​35) He cleansed the Jewish temple twice, overturning the tables of money changers, and once drove out livestock with a whip.

EWE: (Luka 19:45, 46; Yohanes 2:14, 15) Numekugbalẽ aɖe gblɔ be: "Nyanyuigbalẽawo ŋlɔlawo katã ƒe nyawo ɖee fia be [Yesu] nɔ lãmesẽ me eye ŋusẽ nɔ eŋu. "​ McClintock kple Strong ƒe Cyclopedia Babla IV, axa 884.
ENGLISH: (Luke 19:45, 46; John 2:​14, 15) McClintock and Strong’s Cyclopedia states: "The whole evangelical narrative indicates [Jesus’] sound and vigorous bodily health. "​ Volume IV, page 884.

EWE: Eƒe mo ƒe dzedzeme: Yesu doa vivi ɖe ame ŋu hekpɔa nublanui na ame, ɖikeke mele eme o be esia dzena le mo nɛ.
ENGLISH: Facial expressions: Jesus was warm and compassionate, and his facial expressions no doubt reflected this.

EWE: (Mateo 11:28, 29) Ame ƒomevi vovovowo te ŋu tena ɖe eŋu hena akɔfafa kple kpekpeɖeŋu.
ENGLISH: (Matthew 11:28, 29) People of all sorts sought him out for comfort and help.

EWE: (Luka 5:12, 13; 7:37, 38) Egbɔ nɔnɔ dzɔa dzi na ɖeviwo gɔ̃ hã.​ Mateo 19:13-15; Marko 9:35-37.
ENGLISH: (Luke 5:​12, 13; 7:​37, 38) Even children felt at ease in his presence.​ Matthew 19:13-​15; Mark 9:​35-​37.

EWE: Susu totro siwo le amewo si ku ɖe Yesu ƒe dzedzeme ŋu
ENGLISH: Misconceptions about Jesus’ appearance
