EWE: 15 Wova Yesu gbɔ eye wokpɔ ŋutsu si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe aʋakɔa nɔ la, edo awu henɔ anyi, eye eƒe mo kɔ, ale vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo.
ENGLISH: 39 For I tell you, you shall not see me henceforth until you say ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’ " Matthew 24:1-51

EWE: 16 Eye ame siwo kpɔ nu si dzɔ ɖe ŋutsu si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃awo nɔ tsã kple haawo dzi la, ka eta na vavalawo.
ENGLISH: 24 And Jesus came out from the temple-precinct and was going on his way; and his disciples came up to show him the architecture of the precinct.

EWE: 17 Eya ta woɖe kuku na Yesu vevie be wòadzo le yewoƒe nutoa me.
ENGLISH: 2 And he answered them "You see all this, do you not?

EWE: 18 Ke esi wòle gegem ɖe tɔdziʋua me la, ŋutsu si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo nɔ la ɖe kuku nɛ vevie be yeayi kplii.
ENGLISH: I tell you verily, there shall not be one stone left upon another here that shall not be torn down. "

EWE: 19 Gake mena mɔe o, ke boŋ egblɔ nɛ be: "Yi aƒe me le ƒowòmetɔwo gbɔ, eye nàgblɔ nu siwo katã Yehowa wɔ na wò kple ale si wòkpɔ nublanui na wòe la na wo. " 20 Ŋutsu sia dzo hede asi gbeƒãɖeɖe me le Dekapoli tso nu siwo katã Yesu wɔ nɛ la ŋuti, eye wòwɔ nuku na ameawo katã.
ENGLISH: 3 And as he was sitting on the Mount of Olives the disciples came to him by themselves, saying "Tell us when this will be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the final time. "

EWE: 21 Esi Yesu ɖo tɔdziʋua gatso ƒua va go kemɛ dzi la, ameha gã aɖe ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋu, esime wònɔ ƒua nu.
ENGLISH: 4 And Jesus answered them "Look out that no one deludes you.

EWE: 22 Ke ƒuƒoƒea dzi kpɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka si ŋkɔe nye Yairo la va, eye esi wòkpɔe la, edze klo ɖe eƒe afɔnu.
ENGLISH: 5 For many will come under my name, saying ‘I am the Messiah,’ and delude many.

EWE: 23 Eye wòɖe kuku nɛ vevie ŋutɔ be: "Vinyenyɔnuvi dze dɔ vevie.
ENGLISH: 6 And you are going to hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that you are not disquieted; for they have to come, but it is not yet the end.

EWE: Meɖe kuku, va da asi ɖe edzi bena eƒe lãme nasẽ ne wòatsi agbe. " 24 Eye wòyi kplii, ke ameha gã aɖe dze eyome, eye womimii ɖo.
ENGLISH: 7 For nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in one place and another; 8 but all this is the beginning of the birth-pangs.

EWE: 25 Azɔ nyɔnu aɖe si nɔ ʋusisidɔ lém ƒe wuieve sɔŋ la hã le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 9 Then they will have you arrested and cruelly treated, and will kill you, and you will be hated by all the nations because of my name.

EWE: 26 Nyɔnu sia kpe fu le atikewɔla geɖewo si me, eye wògblẽ eƒe nunɔamesiwo katã, gake dɔa meka ɖe eme nɛ o, ke boŋ ɖeko wòganyra ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: 22 And if those days had not been cut short no flesh would have come safe through; but because of the chosen those days will be cut short.

EWE: 27 Esi wòse Yesu ŋkɔ la, eto ameha la dome va Yesu megbe, eye wòka asi eƒe awudziwui ŋu, 28 elabena egblɔna le eɖokui me be: "Ne meka asi eƒe awudziwui teti ŋu la, mahaya. " 29 Eye enumake ʋusisi la nu tso, eye wòse le lãme be dɔléle vɔ̃ɖi la vɔ na ye.
ENGLISH: 23 Then if anybody says to you ‘here is the Messiah at this place or this’ do not believe it; 24 for there will arise pretended Messiahs and pretended prophets, and they will exhibit great tokens and wonders, so as to delude even the chosen if possible; 25 now I have told you beforehand.

EWE: 30 Enumake Yesu de dzesii be ŋusẽ do go le ye me, ale wòtrɔ le ameha la dome hebia be: "Ame kae ka asi nye awudziwuiwo ŋu? " 31 Ke eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ nɛ be: "Èkpɔe be ameha la mimi wò ɖo tso hafi nèle biabiam be, ‘Ame kae ka asi ŋunye?’ " 32 Ke etsa ŋku godoo va kpe be yeakpɔ ame si wɔ nu sia.
ENGLISH: 26 So if they say to you ‘here he is, in the wilderness,’ do not go out; ‘here he is, in the closets,’ do not believe it; 27 for as the lightning comes out of the eastern horizon and shines to the western, so shall be the coming of the Son of Man; 28 wherever the carcass is, there the vultures will gather.

EWE: 33 Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo nyɔnu la, eye wòle dzodzom nyanyanya, elabe enya nu si dzɔ ɖe edzi, eye wòva dze klo ɖe Yesu ŋkume hegblɔ nyateƒea katã nɛ.
ENGLISH: 32 But learn from the fig-tree this parable: when its twigs come to be tender and put out their leaves you know that the summer is near; 33 so you too, when you see all this, are to know that he is near, at the doors.

EWE: 34 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Vinyenyɔnu, wò xɔse na nèhaya. Heyi le ŋutifafa me, eye nàhaya tso wò dɔléle vɔ̃ɖi la si me. "
ENGLISH: 34 I tell you verily that this generation shall not pass away till all this has taken place.

EWE: 35 Esi wògale nuƒoƒo dzi la, ame aɖewo tso ƒuƒoƒedzikpɔla Yairo ƒe aƒe me va gblɔ be: "Viwònyɔnuvi la ku!
ENGLISH: 35 The heavens and the earth shall pass away, but my words shall not.

EWE: 38 Ale wova ƒuƒoƒedzikpɔla la ƒe aƒe me, eye wòkpɔ be teƒea tɔ zi eye amewo le avi fam hele ɣli dom bobobo.
ENGLISH: 36 But as to that day and hour nobody knows, not even the angels of heaven nor the Son, but the Father alone.

EWE: 39 Esi wòge ɖe aƒea me la, ebia wo be: "Nu ka tae miele avi fam ale hena aƒea me tɔ zi?
ENGLISH: 37 For as were the days of Noah, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

EWE: Ðevia meku o, ke boŋ alɔ̃ dɔm wòle. " 40 Ale wode asi ekoko me. Ke esi wòna wo katã do go la, ekplɔ ɖevia fofo kple dadaa kpakple ame siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la ɖe asi, eye wòyi afi si ɖevia le.
ENGLISH: 38 For as in those days before the flood they ate and drank, married and got their children married, till the day that Noah went into the ark, 39 and before they knew it the flood came and carried off one and all, so shall be also the coming of the Son of Man.

EWE: 41 Esi wòlé ɖevia ƒe alɔnu la, egblɔ nɛ be: "Talita kumi, " si gɔmee nye: "Nyɔnuvi, mele egblɔm na wò be, ‘tsi tsitre!’ " 42 Enumake nyɔnuvia tsi tsitre eye wòzɔ azɔli.
ENGLISH: 40 Then there will be two men in the field, one is taken along and one is left; 41 two women grinding at the mill, one is taken along and one is left.

EWE: (Nyɔnuvi la xɔ ƒe wuieve.) Eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe edzilawo eye wogli kple dzidzɔ.
ENGLISH: 42 "So keep awake, because you do not know on what day your Master is coming.

EWE: 43 Ke ede se na wo vevie be womegana ame aɖeke nase nya sia o, eye wògblɔ na wo be woadi nane nɛ wòaɖu.
ENGLISH: 43 But be sure of this, that if the man of the house had known at what time of the night the thief was coming he would have kept awake and not allowed his house to be broken into.

EWE: Marko 6:1-56 6 Yesu dzo le afi ma va wo de, eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo le eyome.
ENGLISH: 44 Accordingly be ready yourselves, because it will be at the moment when you are not thinking of it that the Son of Man comes.

EWE: 2 Esi Sabat ɖo la, ede asi nufiafia me le ƒuƒoƒe la, eye ame siwo se eƒe nyawo la dometɔ akpa gãtɔ ƒe nu ku, eye wogblɔ be: "Afi kae ame sia kpɔ nu siawo tsoe?
ENGLISH: 45 Who, then, is the faithful and intelligent servant whom the master has set over his household to give them their food at the right time? 46 Happy is that servant whom his master, when he comes, shall find doing thus: 47 I tell you verily he will set him over all his property.

EWE: Nu ka tae woana nunya sia gbegbee, eye aleke wɔ wòte ŋu le ŋusẽdɔ siawo gbegbe wɔm? 3 Alo menye Maria ƒe vi, si nye atikpala lae nye esia, eye wònye Yakobo, Yosef, Yuda kple Simon nɔvi oa? Eye ɖe nɔvianyɔnuwo hã mele mía dome afi sia oa? "
ENGLISH: 48 But if that worthless servant says to himself ‘My master is staying late’ 49 and begins to beat his fellowservants and eats and drinks with the drunken, 50 that servant’s master will come on a day when he does not expect it and at an hour that he does not know, 51 and will cut him in two and allot him a part among the hypocrites: there will the weeping and the grinding of teeth be.

EWE: Eya ta eƒe nyawo ɖia wo nu.
ENGLISH: Matthew 25:1-46

EWE: 4 Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Wodea bubu nyagblɔɖila ŋu le afi sia afi negbe le wo de, eƒe ƒometɔwo dome kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe me ko womebunɛ le o. " 5 Eya ta mete ŋu wɔ ŋusẽdɔ aɖeke le afi ma o, negbe dɔnɔ ʋɛ aɖewo dzi ko wòda asi ɖo heda gbe le wo ŋu. 6 Le nyateƒe me la, woƒe dzimaxɔse la wɔ moyaa nɛ.
ENGLISH: 25 "Then the Reign of Heaven will resemble ten maidens who took their torches and went out to meet a bridegroom. 2 And five of them were foolish and five sensible; 3 for the foolish ones did not take oil with them when they took their torches, 4 but the sensible took oil in pitchers with their torches.

EWE: Eye wòyi ɖatsa le kɔƒe siwo ƒo xlã afi ma la me hele nu fiam.
ENGLISH: 5 And as the bridegroom was long in coming they all grew drowsy and fell asleep.

EWE: 7 Azɔ Yesu yɔ Ame Wuieveawo, eye wòdɔ wo eveeve, eye wòna ŋusẽ wo ɖe gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo dzi.
ENGLISH: 6 But at midnight there came a shout ‘Here is the bridegroom! come out to meet him!’ 7 Then all those maidens woke up and put their torches in order.

EWE: 8 Ede se na wo hã be womegatsɔ naneke ɖe asi na mɔzɔzɔa o, negbe atizɔti ko, womegatsɔ abolo alo nuɖuɖukotoku o, eye ga aɖeke naganɔ woƒe gabutuwo me o, 9 woado afɔkpa, gake womegado awu eve o. 10 Egagblɔ na wo hã be: "Ne mieyi du aɖe me la, minɔ aƒe si me miedze la me va se ɖe esime miadzo le dua me.
ENGLISH: 8 And the foolish ones said to the sensible ones ‘Give us some of your oil, because our torches are going out’; 9 but the sensible ones answered ‘It might not be sufficient for us and you both; better go to those who have it to sell and buy yourselves some.’ 10 But while they were away buying, the bridegroom came, and the ones who were ready went in with him to the wedding, and the door was shut.

EWE: 11 Eye afi sia afi si womexɔ mi alo ɖo to mi le o la, ne miele dzodzom le afi ma la, miʋuʋu ke le miaƒe afɔwo ŋu ɖe anyi wòanye ɖaseɖiɖi ɖe wo ŋu. " 12 Ale wodze mɔ eye woɖe gbeƒã be amewo natrɔ dzi me, 13 wonya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ geɖewo do goe, wosi ami na dɔnɔ geɖewo eye woda dɔ na wo.
ENGLISH: 11 And afterward the rest of the maidens also came saying ‘Sir, sir, open to us.’ 12 But he answered ‘I tell you verily, I do not know you.’ 13 So keep awake, because you do not know the day nor the hour.

EWE: 14 Azɔ Fia Herodes se nya siawo, elabena Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ ɖi hoo, eye amewo le gbɔgblɔm be: "Wofɔ Yohanes Amenyrɔɖetsimela tso ame kukuwo dome, eye esia tae wòte ŋu le ŋusẽdɔwo wɔm ɖo. " 15 Ke ame bubuwo nɔ gbɔgblɔm be: "Eliya ye. "
ENGLISH: 14 "For it is as when a man who was going abroad called his servants and handed over his property to them 15 and gave to one five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his individual ability, and went away.

EWE: Bubuwo hã be: "Nyagblɔɖilae wònye abe blemanyagblɔɖilawo dometɔ ɖeka ene. " 16 Ke esi Herodes see la, egblɔ be: "Yohanes si nu metso ta le lae wofɔ ɖe tsitre. " 17 Elabena do ŋgɔ la, Herodes ŋutɔ dɔ ame wolé Yohanes tu ɖe gaxɔ me le Herodia, si nye nɔvia Filipo srɔ̃ ta, elabe exɔe ɖe.
ENGLISH: 16 At once the one who had received the five talents went and set up a business with them and made five more; 17 similarly the one who had received the two made two more; 18 but the one who had received the one went off and dug in the ground and hid his master’s money.

EWE: 18 Elabena Yohanes gblɔ na Herodes enuenu be: "Se meɖe mɔ na wò be nàxɔ nɔviwò srɔ̃ aɖe o. " 19 Eya ta Herodia lé Yohanes ɖe dɔme, eye wòdi be yeawui, ke mete ŋui o.
ENGLISH: 28 So take the talent away from him and give it to the one with the ten talents; 29 for everyone who has shall have more given to him, and shall have enough and to spare, but from him who has not there shall be taken away even what he has.

EWE: 20 Herodes vɔ̃na na Yohanes, elabena enyae be ame dzɔdzɔe kple ame kɔkɔe wònye, eye wòkpɔa egbɔ be ele dedie.
ENGLISH: 30 And put out the inefficient servant into the outside darkness; there will the’ weeping and the grinding of teeth be.’

EWE: Eye ne eɖo to se eƒe nyawo vɔ la, menyaa nu si wòawɔ o, ke hã esea eƒe nyawo kple dzidzɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 And when Jesus was in Bethany at the house of Simon the leper, 7 a woman with an alabaster vial of high-priced perfume approached him and poured it on his head while he was at the table.

EWE: 21 Ke mɔnu aɖe va ʋu na Herodia gbe ɖeka, esi Herodes ɖo kplɔ̃ le eƒe dzigbeŋkeke dzi na eƒe amegãwo kple aʋafiagãwo kpakple Galilea ame ŋkutawo le fiẽ aɖe.
ENGLISH: 8 And the disciples took offense at the sight, saying "Why this waste? 9 for this could have been sold for a good deal and given to poor people. " 10 And Jesus, finding it out, said to them "Why are you worrying the woman? for she has done a good deed to me; 11 for you always have the poor with you, but me you do not always have.

EWE: 22 Herodia vinyɔnuvi va ɖu ɣe wòdze Herodes kple ame siwo le kplɔ̃ ŋu kplii la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 12 For she, in putting this perfume on my body, has done this toward burying me.

EWE: Fia la gblɔ na nyɔnuvia be: "Bia nu sia nu si nèdi lam, eye mana wò. " 23 Ɛ̃, eka atam nɛ be: "Nu sia nu si nàbiam la, mana wò, va se ɖe nye fiaɖuƒea ƒe afã ke hã dzi. " 24 Eya ta edo go yi ɖabia dadaa be: "Nu kae mabia? "
ENGLISH: 21 And while they were eating he said "I tell you verily that one of you will have me arrested. " 22 And, greatly pained, they began each one to say to him "Am I the one, sir? " 23 And he answered "He who dipped his hand in the dish with me, he will have me arrested.

EWE: Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Yohanes Amenyrɔɖetsimela ƒe ta. " 25 Enumake eɖe abla va fia la gbɔ hebia nu si wòdi, gblɔ be: "Medi be nàtsɔ Yohanes Amenyrɔɖetsimela ƒe ta de agba me nam fifi laa. " 26 Togbɔ be nya sia te ɖe fia la dzi vevie hã la, medi be yeagbe enana o, le atam siwo wòka kple ame kpekpeawo ta.
ENGLISH: 24 The Son of Man goes as is written of him; but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is put under arrest! it would have been well for that man if he had not been born. " 25 And Judas, who was to have him arrested, answered him "Am I the one, Rabbi? " He said to him "As you say. "

EWE: 27 Eya ta fia la dɔ eŋusrafo ɖeka ɖa enumake heɖe gbe nɛ be wòatsɔ Yohanes ƒe ta avɛ. Eyi ɖatso ta le enu le gaxɔa me, 28 eye wòtsɔ ta la de agba me vɛ hetsɔe na nyɔnuvia, eye nyɔnuvia tsɔe yi na dadaa.
ENGLISH: 26 And while they were eating Jesus took a cake of bread, and spoke the blessing and broke it, and, giving it to the disciples, said "Take this and eat it; this is my body. " 27 And he took a cup and gave thanks over it and gave it to them, saying "Drink of it, all of you; 28 for this is my covenant blood poured out for many to the pardoning of sins.

EWE: 29 Esi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo see la, wova tsɔ eƒe kukua yi ɖaɖi ɖe yɔdo me.
ENGLISH: 29 But I tell you, henceforth I will not drink of this produce of the vine till that day when I drink it new in my Father’s reign with you. "

EWE: 30 Apostoloawo va ƒo ƒu ɖe Yesu gbɔ, eye wogblɔ nu siwo katã wowɔ kple nu siwo wofia la nɛ.
ENGLISH: 30 And they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.

EWE: 32 Eya ta woawo ɖeɖe woɖo tɔdziʋu yi ɖe teƒe aɖe si ame aɖeke mele o. 33 Gake amewo kpɔ wo esime wodzo yina, eye ame geɖewo see, eye woƒu du tso duawo katã me yi afi ma, eye wotre ɖoɖo na wo. 34 Esi wòɖi go la, ekpɔ ameha gbogbo aɖewo, eye woƒe nu wɔ nublanui nɛ, elabena wole abe alẽ siwo nu kplɔla aɖeke mele o la ene. Eye wòde asi nu geɖewo fiafia me wo.
ENGLISH: 31 Then Jesus said to them "You will be staggered over me this night all of you; for it is written ‘I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will scatter’; 32 but after my rising I will go ahead of you to Galilee. " 33 But Peter answered him "If everybody will be staggered over you, I never will be staggered. " 34 Jesus said to him "I tell you verily that this night, before a cock has crowed, you will disown me three times. " 35 Said Peter to him "Even if I have to die with you I will not disown you "; and so said all the disciples.

EWE: 35 Le ɣetrɔ me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ gblɔ nɛ be: "Teƒe sia tso abo, eye zã le dodom. 36 Ðe asi le wo ŋu ne woayi agbleta kple kɔƒe siwo ƒo xlã mí la me aɖaƒle nu aɖu. " 37 Ke eɖo eŋu na wo be: "Miawo ŋutɔwo mina nu wo woaɖu. " Ke wogblɔ nɛ be: "Ðe míayi aɖaƒle abolo denario alafa eve nu na ameawo woaɖua? " 38 Egblɔ na wo be: "Abolo nenie le mia si? Miyi ɖakpɔe ɖa! " Esi woyi gbɔ la, wogblɔ nɛ be: "Abolo atɔ̃ kple tɔmelã eve. " 39 Yesu gblɔ na ameawo be woanɔ anyi le hatsotsowo me ɖe gbe mumuawo dzi. 40 Eya ta wonɔ anyi ɖe hatsotsowo me, ɖewo alafa, ɖewo blaatɔ̃. 41 Esi wòtsɔ abolo atɔ̃awo kple tɔmelã eveawo la, efɔ mo dzi kpɔ dziƒo, eye wòyra ɖe wo dzi. Eye wòŋe aboloawo me hetsɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be woatsɔ wo aɖo ameawo kɔme, eye wòma tɔmelã eveawo me na wo katã. 42 Ale wo katã woɖu nu ɖi ƒo; 43 eye woƒo abolo kakɛawo nu ƒu wòyɔ kusi wuieve, tɔmelã siwo susɔ ya mele eme o.
ENGLISH: 36 Then Jesus came with them to an enclosure known as Gethsemane, and said to the disciples "Sit here while I go there and pray. " 37 And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be unhappy and uneasy; 38 then he said to them "My soul is sad, deathly sad; stay here and keep awake with me "; 39 and he went a little further and threw himself down on his face praying "Father, if it is possible let this cup pass away from me; yet not as I will but as you will. " 40 And he came to the disciples and found them asleep, and said to Peter "Were you so unable to keep awake with me one moment? 41 Keep awake and pray, that you may not fall under temptation: the spirit is enthusiastic but the flesh is weak. " 42 Again he went away for the second time and prayed "Father, if this cannot pass away without my drinking it, your will be done. " 43 And he came and found them asleep again, for their eyes were heavy.

EWE: 44 Ame siwo ɖu aboloawo la ƒe xexlẽme le ŋutsu akpe atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 44 And he left them and went away again and prayed for the third time, saying the same words again.

EWE: 45 Emegbe ena eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo tɔdziʋua dze ŋgɔ ɖo ta Betsaida le ƒua ƒe go kemɛ dzi eye eya ŋutɔ do mɔ amehaawo. 46 Esi wòdo hedenyuie na wo vɔ la, eyi ɖe to aɖe dzi be yeado gbe ɖa.
ENGLISH: 45 Then he came to the disciples and said to them "Well, then, sleep and rest; the moment is close at hand, and the Son of Man is to be given up into the hands of sinners 46 rise, let us be going; here is the one who gives me up to them, close at hand. "

EWE: 47 Esi fiẽsi ɖo la, tɔdziʋu la ɖo ƒu la titina, ke eya ɖeka susɔ ɖe go dzi.
ENGLISH: 47 And while he was still speaking, in came Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great crowd with swords and sticks from the chief priests and elders of the people.

EWE: 48 Eye esi wòkpɔ be ʋua kuku le sesẽm na wo, elabena ya ƒo va le wo kpem, anɔ zã ƒe ŋudzɔɣi enelia lɔƒo la, ezɔ ƒua dzi gbɔna wo gbɔ; ke ewɔ abe ɖe wòdi be yeato wo ŋu ayi ene.
ENGLISH: 48 And the one who was giving him up had given them a sign, telling them "Whichever I kiss is he; take him. " 49 And at once he went up to Jesus and said "Good evening, Rabbi, " and went to kissing him.

EWE: Eye wodo ɣli. 50 Elabena wo katã wokpɔe, eye dzika tso wo ƒo.
ENGLISH: 50 But Jesus said to him "What you are here for, comrade! "

EWE: Ke eƒo nu gblɔ na wo enumake be: "Miaƒe dzi nedze eme!
ENGLISH: Then they came up and put their hands on him and took him.

EWE: Nyee; migavɔ̃ o. " 51 Ege ɖe tɔdziʋua me le wo gbɔ, eye ya la dzudzɔ ƒoƒo.
ENGLISH: 51 And lo, one of those who were with Jesus reached and drew his sword and hit the high priest’s servant and took off his ear.

" 4 And his disciples answered him "Where can one get these their fill of bread here in the wilderness? " 5 and he asked them "How much bread have you? " and they said "Seven cakes. " 6 And he instructed the crowd to take their places on the ground, and took the seven cakes and gave thanks and broke them and gave them to the disciples to put around; and they set them before the crowd.

EWE: 7 Eye ne miese aʋawɔwɔwo kple aʋawɔwɔwo ŋu nyawo la, dzika megatso mia ƒo o; ele be nu siawo nava eme, gake nuwuwu la meɖo haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 7 And they had a few little fish; and he blessed these too and told them to put them around.

EWE: 8 "Elabena dukɔ atso ɖe dukɔ ŋu, eye fiaɖuƒe ɖe fiaɖuƒe ŋu; anyigba aʋuʋu le teƒeteƒewo; nuɖuɖu hã ave.
ENGLISH: 8 And they all ate and had their fill; and they took up surplus fragments, seven hampers.

EWE: 9 "Ke miawo la, mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie.
ENGLISH: 9 And there were about four thousand of them.

EWE: 10 Eye ele be woaɖe gbeƒã nya nyui la le dukɔwo katã me gbã.
ENGLISH: And he dismissed them, 10 and at once got into the boat with his disciples and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

EWE: 11 Ke ne wokplɔ mi yina ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la, migatsi dzimaɖi le nya si miagblɔ ŋu o; ke boŋ nya sia nya si woana mi le gaƒoƒo ma me la, migblɔe, elabena menye miawoe le nu ƒom o, ke boŋ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe lae.
ENGLISH: 11 And the Pharisees went out and began to debate with him, seeking from him a token from heaven, by way of testing him.

EWE: 12 Gawu la, nɔvi ade nɔvi asi be woawu, eye fofo ade vi asi, eye ɖeviwo atso ɖe wo dzilawo ŋu ahana woawu wo.
ENGLISH: 12 And he heaved a sigh and said "Why does this generation seek a token?

EWE: 13 Eye amewo katã alé fu mi le nye ŋkɔ la ta. Ke ame si do dzi va se ɖe nuwuwu la, eyae akpɔ ɖeɖe.
ENGLISH: I tell you verily this generation shall not be given a token "; 13 and he left them and went on board again and went off to the other side.

EWE: 14 "Ke ne miekpɔ ŋunyɔnu si ahe aƒedozuzu vɛ la wòle afi si mele be wòanɔ o la, (nuxlẽla newɔ gɔmesese ŋu dɔ) ekema ame siwo le Yudea nasi ayi towo dzi.
ENGLISH: 14 And they forgot to take bread, and had not but one cake with them in the boat.

EWE: 15 Ame si le xɔ ta la megaɖi alo ayi eme be yeatsɔ nane tso yeƒe xɔ me o, 16 eye ame si le agble la nagatrɔ agbɔ be yeatsɔ yeƒe awudziwui o.
ENGLISH: 15 And he was charging them "See that you keep clear of Pharisee yeast and Herod’s yeast "; 16 and they questioned together, saying that they had not bread.

EWE: 17 Baba na funɔwo kple ame siwo le no nam vi le ŋkeke mawo me! 18 Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi be miaƒe sisiɣi nagadze vuvɔŋɔli me o; 19 elabena ŋkeke mawo anye xaxa si tɔgbi meva kpɔ tso esime Mawu wɔ xexea va se ɖe fifi o, eye etɔgbi megale vava ge ake o. 20 Le nyateƒe me la, ne ɖe Yehowa metso ŋkeke mawo dzi o la, ŋutilã aɖeke makpɔ ɖeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 17 And, finding it out, he said to them "Why are you questioning because you have not bread? do you not yet see the point nor understand? are your hearts caked into lumps? 18 having eyes, do you not see, and having ears do you not hear? and do you not remember 19 when I broke the five cakes of bread to be given out to the five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments you took up? "

EWE: Ke le ame tiatiawo ta la, etso ŋkeke mawo dzi. 21 "Eye ne ame aɖe gblɔ na mi be, ‘Kpɔ ɖa, Kristo la le afii!’ alo ‘Kpɔ ɖa, eyae nye ema ɖaa!’ la, migaxɔe se o.
ENGLISH: They told him "Twelve. " 20 "When I broke the seven to be given out to the four thousand, how many hamperfuls of fragments did you take up? " and they said "Seven, " 21 And he said to them "Do you not understand yet? "

EWE: 22 Elabena aʋatsokristowo kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖilawo ado, eye woawɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo bena, ne woate ŋui la, woaflu ame tiatiawo. 23 Eya ta minɔ ŋudzɔ.
ENGLISH: 22 And they came to Bethsaida; and they brought him a blind man, and appealed to him to touch him.

EWE: Mena toklã mi tso nya sia nya ŋu. 24 "Ke le ŋkeke mawo me le xaxa ma megbe la, ɣe ado viviti, eye ɣleti magaɖi o, 25 ɣletiviwo anɔ gegem tso dziƒo, eye woaʋuʋu dziƒowo ƒe ŋusẽwo.
ENGLISH: 23 And he took hold of the blind man’s hand and took him outside the village, and, spitting into his eyes and laying his hands on him, put the question to him "Can you see anything? " 24 and he looked up and said "I can see men, because I see creatures like trees walking. " 25 Then he laid his hands on his eyes again, and his eyesight was good, and he was restored and was able to see everything distinctly.

EWE: 26 Ɣemaɣi la, woakpɔ Amegbetɔvi la le alilikpowo me gbɔna kple ŋusẽ gã kpakple ŋutikɔkɔe.
ENGLISH: 26 And he sent him home, saying "Do not even go into the village. "

EWE: 27 Eye wòadɔ mawudɔlawo ɖa wòaƒo eƒe ame tiatiawo nu ƒu tso anyigba ƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi, tso anyigba ƒe seƒe va se ɖe dziƒo ƒe seƒe ke. 28 "Ke misrɔ̃ nu sia tso gboti ŋu: Ne eɖe alɔ fẽwo, eye wònya to aŋgbawo ko la, mienyana be dzomeŋɔli gogo. 29 Nenema kee ne miekpɔ nu siawo le dzɔdzɔm la, minyae be Amegbetɔvi la gogo ʋɔtruawo nu.
ENGLISH: 27 And Jesus and his disciples went out to the villages of Caesarea Philippi; and on the road he questioned his disciples, asking them "Who do people say I am? " 28 And they told him "John the Baptist; and others Elijah; and others one of the prophets. " 29 And he put the question to them, "But who do you say I am? "

EWE: 30 Vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, dzidzime sia nu mele yiyi ge akpɔ o, va se ɖe esime nu siawo katã va eme.
ENGLISH: Peter answered him "You are the Messiah. " 30 And he told them peremptorily not to tell anybody about him.

EWE: 31 Dziƒo kple anyigba nu ava yi, ke nye nyawo ya nu mava yi akpɔ o. 32 "Le ŋkeke ma alo gaƒoƒo la ŋuti la, ame aɖeke menyae o, mawudɔla siwo le dziƒo la menyae o, eye Vi la hã menyae o, negbe Fofo la ko.
ENGLISH: 31 And he began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer a great deal, and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and rise after three days; 32 and he made the statement openly.

EWE: 33 Mikpɔ nyuie, minɔ ŋudzɔ, elabena mienya ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖi la o.
ENGLISH: And Peter took him in hand and began to rebuke him; 33 but he, turning back and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter and said "Go behind me, Satan, because you do not have God’s ideas but men’s. "

EWE: 34 Ele abe ŋutsu aɖe si zɔ mɔ yi duta, eye wògblẽ eƒe aƒe ɖi la ene.
ENGLISH: 34 And he called the crowd to him, with his disciples, and said to them "If anyone wishes to come after me, let him disown himself and take up his cross and follow me.

EWE: Ena ŋusẽ eƒe kluviwo, ede dɔ asi na wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe, eye wòde se na agbonudzɔla la be wòanɔ ŋudzɔ.
ENGLISH: 35 For whoever wishes to save his self will lose it, but whoever loses his self on my account and the gospel’s will save it.

EWE: 35 Eya ta minɔ ŋudzɔ, elabena mienya ɣekaɣi aƒetɔ la le vava ge o, eɖanye fiẽ alo zãtiƒe alo do ŋgɔ na fɔŋli alo ŋdi kanya o; 36 ale be ne eva ɖo le vo me la, wòagakpɔ mi le alɔ̃ me o. 37 Ke nya si gblɔm mele na mi la, amewo katãe mele egblɔm na be: Minɔ ŋudzɔ. "
ENGLISH: 36 For what good does it do a man to make a profit of the whole world and a loss of his self? 37 for what should a man give as an equivalent for his self? 38 For whoever is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man too will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels. "

EWE: Marko
ENGLISH: Mark

EWE: Eye nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple agbalẽfialawo le mɔnu dim be yewoato ayemɔ aɖe dzi alé Yesu awu; 2 elabena wogblɔ be: "Menye le ŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi o; ɖewohĩ zi ava tɔ le dukɔ la me. "
ENGLISH: 9 And he said to them "I tell you verily that there are some here standing among you who shall not taste death till they see the Reign of God begun in power. "

EWE: 3 Esi wòle nuɖuƒe le Simon anyidɔléla ƒe me le Betania la, nyɔnu aɖe va do kple alabastrogoe si me ami ʋeʋĩ aɖe, si nye nardomi akuakua, si xɔ asi ŋutɔ la le.
ENGLISH: 2 And after six days Jesus took Peter and James and John and brought them up on the side of a high mountain alone by themselves, and was transfigured before them; 3 and his clothes became glittering, exceedingly white, such as no fuller on earth can whiten so.

EWE: Eŋe alabastrogoe la ƒe kɔme eye wòtrɔ ami la kɔ ɖe Yesu ƒe tame.
ENGLISH: 4 And there appeared to them Elijah with Moses, and they talked with Jesus.

EWE: 4 Eye ameawo dometɔ aɖewo do dɔmedzoe gblɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: "Nu ka tae wogblẽ ami ʋeʋĩ sia dome ale? 5 Elabena woate ŋu adzra ami ʋeʋĩ sia wòawu denario alafa etɔ̃ eye woatsɔ ga la ana ame dahewo ɖe! " Wodo dɔmedzoe ɖe nyɔnua ŋu vevie. 6 Ke Yesu gblɔ be: "Miɖe asi le eŋu. Nu ka tae miele fu ɖem nɛ?
ENGLISH: 5 And Peter answered by saying to Jesus "Rabbi, it is a good thing we are here: let us make three booths, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah " 6 for he did not know what answer to make, because they were terrified.

EWE: Dɔ nyui aɖee wòwɔ nam. 7 Elabena ame dahewo le mia gbɔ ɖaa, eye miate ŋu anyo dɔme na wo ɣesiaɣi si mielɔ̃, ke nye ya nyemanɔ mia gbɔ ɖaa o. 8 Ewɔ nu si wòate ŋui; edo ŋgɔ si ami ʋeʋĩ na nye ŋutilã hena ɖiɖi.
ENGLISH: 7 And there came a cloud overshadowing them, and there came a voice out of the cloud, "This is my dear son, listen to him. " 8 And of a sudden they looked around and no longer saw any body but Jesus alone with themselves.

EWE: 9 Vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, afi sia afi si woaɖe gbeƒã nya nyui la le le xexe bliboa me la, woagblɔ nu si nyɔnu sia wɔ la hã atsɔ aɖo ŋku edzii. " 10 Eye Yuda Iskariot, si nye Ame Wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka, yi nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo gbɔ be yeade Yesu asi na wo.
ENGLISH: 9 And as they were coming down from the mountain he charged them never to tell anybody the story of what they had seen till the Son of Man rose from the dead; 10 and they held the word fast to themselves, debating what rising from the dead was.

EWE: 11 Esi wose nyaa la, dzi dzɔ wo ŋutɔ, eye wodo ŋugbe be yewoana klosalogae. Eya ta enɔ mɔnu dim be yeadee asi. 12 Ke le Amɔwɔ Maʋamaʋã Bolo Ŋkekenyui la ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ, si dzi wotsɔa ŋutitotolãa saa vɔe le dzi la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo biae be: "Afi kae nèdi be míadzra ɖo na wò be nàɖu ŋutitotoa le? " 13 Ale wòdɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃la eve gblɔ na wo be: "Miyi ɖe dua me, eye ŋutsu aɖe si tsɔ tsize la ado go mi.
ENGLISH: 11 And they put the question to him "Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first? " 12 and he said to them "Elijah comes first and restores everything and how is it it is written about the Son of Man that he should suffer a great deal and be scorned? 13 But I tell you that Elijah has come and they have done to him whatever they wished, as is written about him. "

EWE: Midzra afi ma ɖo na nua ɖuɖu. " 16 Eya ta nusrɔ̃laawo do go yi dua me, eye wokpɔe abe ale si tututu wògblɔe na wo ene; eye wodzra ɖo ɖe Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 14 And when they got to the disciples they saw a great crowd around them, and scribes debating with them.

EWE: 17 Esi fiẽsi ɖo la, eya kple Ame Wuieveawo va afi ma. 18 Eye esi wole nu ɖum le kplɔ̃ ŋu la, Yesu gblɔ be: "Vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, mi ame siwo le nu ɖum kplim la dometɔ ɖeka adem asi. " 19 Wode asi nuxaxa me hele ebiam ɖekaɖeka be: "Menye nyee o ɖe? " 20 Egblɔ na wo be: "Mi Ame Wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka si le asi dem agba ɖeka me kplim ye.
ENGLISH: 15 And at once all the crowd were taken aback at seeing him; and they ran up and greeted him, 16 and he put the question to them "What are you debating with them about? " 17 And one of the crowd answered him "Teacher, I have brought my son to you, that has a dumb spirit, 18 and wherever it gets at him it strikes him down, and he foams and sets his teeth hard and withers up; and I told your disciples to expel it and they were not able. " 19 And he answered them "O unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him to me "; 20 and they brought him to him.

EWE: 21 Elabena Amegbetɔvi la le kuku ge abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi le eŋuti ene, gake baba na ame ma, si ade Amegbetɔvi la asi!
ENGLISH: And upon seeing him the demon threw him into a convulsion at once, and he fell on the ground and rolled there foaming.

EWE: Ne ɖe womegaxa ame ma dzi o la, anye ne enyo nɛ wu. " 22 Eye esi wole nua ɖum la, etsɔ abolo, yra ɖe edzi, ŋe eme, eye wòtsɔe na wo hegblɔ be: "Mixɔe; esia le tsitre ɖi na nye ŋutilã. " 23 Eye esi wòtsɔ kplu ɖe asi la, eda akpe ɖe eta, eye wòtsɔe na wo, eye wo katã wonoe le enu.
ENGLISH: 21 And he questioned his father, "How long has he had this? " and he said "Since his childhood; 22 and it has often thrown him into fire and into water, to make away with him; but if you can do anything have pity on us and help us. " 23 And Jesus said to him "‘If you can’!

EWE: 27 Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Mi katã miagblẽm ɖi, elabena woŋlɔe ɖi be: ‘Mada nu alẽkplɔla la, eye alẽawo aka hlẽ.’ 28 Ke ne wofɔm ɖe tsitre la, madze mia ŋgɔ ayi Galilea. " 29 Ke Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Ne ame susɔeawo katã gblẽ wò ɖi hã la, nye ya nyemagblẽ wò ɖi o. " 30 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Vavã mele egblɔm na wò be: Le zã sia tututu me la, hafi koklo naku atɔ zi eve la, àgbe nu le gbɔnye zi gbɔ zi etɔ̃. " 31 Ke Petro gate gbe ɖe edzi vevie wu be: "Ne ahiã be maku kpli wò hã la, nyemagbe nu le gbɔwò akpɔ o. " Ame susɔeawo hã gblɔ nenema ke.
ENGLISH: Everything is possible to him who believes! " 24 At once the child’s father gave a cry "I believe; help my unbelievingness. " 25 And Jesus, seeing that a crowd was running up, said peremptorily to the unclean spirit "Dumb and deaf spirit, I order you, come out of him and do not come into him again. " 26 And with a scream and many convulsions it came out, and he became as if dead, so that most of them said he was dead; 27 but Jesus grasped his hand and raised him, and he stood up.

EWE: 32 Azɔ wova ɖo teƒe si woyɔna be Getsemane, eye wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: "Minɔ anyi ɖe afi sia ne mayi aɖado gbe ɖa. " 33 Ekplɔ Petro, Yakobo kple Yohanes ɖe ŋuti, ede asi nuxaxa me vevie eye wòtsi dzi ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 28 And when he came indoors and they were by themselves his disciples put the question to him "How was it we could not expel it? " 29 and he said to them "This kind cannot be got out by anything but prayer. "

EWE: 34 Egblɔ na wo be: "Mele nu xam ale gbegbe be ɖeko wòle abe ɖe mele kukum ene. Minɔ afi sia, eye minɔ ŋudzɔ. " 35 Esi wòzɔ yi ŋgɔ vie la, edze klo tsyɔ mo anyi hede asi gbedodoɖa me be, ne anya wɔ la, gaƒoƒo la nato ye ŋu ayi.
ENGLISH: 30 And they went out from there and went along through Galilee; and he would not have anyone know of it, 31 for he was teaching his disciples and telling them that the Son of Man was to be given up into the hands of men, and they would kill him, and when he had been killed he would rise after three days.

EWE: 36 Eye wògblɔ be: "Abba, Fofo, ètea ŋu wɔa nuwo katã; na kplu sia nato ŋunye.
ENGLISH: 32 But they failed to understand the word, and were afraid to question him.

EWE: Gake menye nu si medi o, ke boŋ nu si nèdi. " 37 Etrɔ va kpɔ wo wole alɔ̃ dɔm, eye wògblɔ na Petro be: "Simon, alɔ̃ dɔm nèlea?
ENGLISH: 33 And they came to Capernaum; and when he got into the house he put the question to them "What were you talking over on the road? " 34 But they were silent, for they had been arguing together on the road about which was greatest.

EWE: Màte ŋu anɔ ŋudzɔ gaƒoƒo ɖeka oa? 38 Minɔ ŋudzɔ, eye minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi be miagadze tetekpɔ me o. Nyateƒee, gbɔgbɔ la le lɔlɔ̃m, gake ŋutilãa ya gbɔdzɔ. " 39 Eye wògadzo yi ɖado gbe ɖa hegblɔ nya mawo ke.
ENGLISH: 35 And he sat down and called the Twelve and said to them "If one means to be first, he shall be last of all and serving-man to all. " 36 And he took a child and set it in the middle among them, and, putting his arms around it, said to them 37 "Anybody who receives one of the children in my name is receiving me, and anybody who receives me is receiving not me but him who sent me. " 38 John said to him "Teacher, we saw somebody expelling demons in your name, and we stopped him because he did not follow us. " 39 But Jesus said "Do not stop him, for there is no one who will work a miracle in my name and be able to go right to abusing me.

EWE: 40 Egatrɔ va, eye wòkpɔ wo wole alɔ̃ dɔm, elabena alɔ̃ bla ŋku na wo, eya ta womenya nya si woagblɔ atsɔ aɖo eŋu nɛ o.
ENGLISH: 40 For he who is not against us is for us.

EWE: 41 Egava zi etɔ̃lia eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Ɣeyiɣi sia mee mianɔ alɔ̃ dɔm ahanɔ ɖiɖim ɖe emea? Esɔ gbɔ! Gaƒoƒo la de! Kpɔ ɖa! Wotsɔ Amegbetɔvi la de asi na nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo. 42 Mitso, mina míadzo. Kpɔ ɖa! Ame si dem asi la gogo. "
ENGLISH: 41 For anybody who gives you a cup of water to drink on the ground that you belong to the Messiah, I tell you verily, shall not lose his reward; 42 and anybody who trips up one of these little ones who believe, it would sooner be a good thing for him if he had an ass-power millstone hanging round his neck and had been thrown into the sea.

EWE: 43 Esi wògale nuƒoƒo dzi la, kasia Yuda, si nye Ame Wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka la va do, eye ameha aɖe si lé yiwo kple kpowo ɖe asi la tso nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo, agbalẽfialawo kple dumegãwo gbɔ kplɔe ɖo.
ENGLISH: 43 And if your hand trips you up, cut it off: it is better that you pass into life one-armed than that with both your hands you should go into hell, into the inextinguishable fire.

EWE: 44 Ke ame si dee asi la ɖo dzesi ɖi na wo be: "Ame si magbugbɔ nu na la, eyae; milée, mikplɔe yii eye miaƒe ŋku nanɔ eŋu. " 45 Eye Yuda zɔ tẽe te ɖe eŋu hegblɔ be: "Rabi! " eye wògbugbɔ nu nɛ.
ENGLISH: 44 45 And if your foot trips you up, cut it off: it is better that you pass into life a cripple than that with both your feet you should be thrown into hell.

EWE: 46 Ameawo dze edzi eye wolée. 47 Ke ame siwo le tsitre ɖe afi ma la dometɔ ɖeka ɖe eƒe yi heda nunɔlagã ƒe kluvi eye wòkpa to nɛ. 48 Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Yiwo kple kpowoe mietsɔ va be yewoalém abe adzodala enea? 49 Menɔa mia gbɔ le gbedoxɔa me gbe sia gbe nɔa nu fiam, gake mielém kpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 46 47 And if your eye trips you up, tear it out; it is better that you pass into the Reign of God one-eyed than that with two eyes you should be thrown into hell, 48 where their worm does not die and their fire does not go out.

EWE: Ke edzɔ alea be Ŋɔŋlɔawo nava eme. "
ENGLISH: 49 For everyone shall be salted with fire.

EWE: 50 Eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo katã gblẽe ɖi hesi dzo.
ENGLISH: 50 Salt is a good thing, but if the salt has lost its saltness what will you season it with?

EWE: 51 Gake ɖekakpui aɖe si do aklalawu ko la kplɔe ɖo, eye ameawo di be yewoalée, 52 ke egblẽ eƒe aklalawua ɖi hesi amamae.
ENGLISH: Have salt in yourselves and be at peace with each other. " Mark 10:1-52

EWE: 53 Azɔ wokplɔ Yesu yi nunɔlagã la gbɔ, eye nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple dumegãwo kpakple agbalẽfialawo katã va ɖi anyi.
ENGLISH: 10 And he went away from there and came into the territory of Judea and the other side of the Jordan; and crowds collected around him again, and he taught them again as was his custom.

EWE: 54 Ke Petro le eyome le adzɔge ʋĩi heva keke nunɔlagã la ƒe aƒea me ke; eye wònɔ anyi ɖe subɔviawo gbɔ le dzo ƒum.
ENGLISH: And 2 Pharisees approached him and put the question to him, to test him, whether it is lawful for a husband to divorce a wife.

EWE: 55 Ɣemaɣi la, nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple Sanhedrin blibo la le ame siwo aɖi ɖase si woatsɔ atso Yesu nu la dim, ne woawui, gake womekpɔ ɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 3 But he answered them "What commands did Moses give you? " 4 And they said "Moses permitted writing a certificate of separation and divorcing her; " 5 But Jesus said to them "It was in view of your obduracy that he wrote you this commandment.

EWE: 56 Le nyateƒe me la, ame geɖewo le aʋatsoɖase ɖim le eŋuti, gake wo dometɔ aɖeke ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi mesɔ kple nɔvia tɔ o.

ENGLISH: 31 And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and was teaching them on the sabbath, 32 and they were astonished at his teaching because his words were spoken with authority.

EWE: 33 Azɔ ŋutsu aɖe si me gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ aɖe le la le ƒuƒoƒe la, eye wòdo ɣli sesĩe be: 34 "Agoo gbɔ! Nya kae le mí kpli wò dome, wò, Yesu Nazaretetɔ? Ðe nèva be yeatsrɔ̃ mía?
ENGLISH: 33 And in the synagogue there was a man under the control of an unclean demon, and he shouted out loudly 34 "Ha, what have you to do with us, Jesus, you Nazarene? have you come to destroy us?

EWE: Menya ame si tututu nènye. Mawu ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ lae nènye. " 35 Ke Yesu ka mo nɛ be: "Zi ɖoɖoe, eye nàdo go le eme. "
ENGLISH: I know you, I know who you are, the Holy One of God. " 35 And Jesus rebuked him, saying "Silence, and come out of him. "

EWE: Eye esi gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la tsɔ amea xlã ɖe anyi le wo dome la, edo go le eme, eye mewɔ nu vevi aɖekee o.
ENGLISH: And, after flinging him out on the floor, the demon came out of him without doing him any harm.

EWE: 36 Esia wɔ moyaa na wo katã, eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo be: "Nya kae nye esia? Elabena ŋusẽ le esi wòɖea gbe na gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo, eye wodoa go! " 37 Ale eŋu nya kaka le nuto ma katã me.
ENGLISH: 36 And amazement came upon them all, and they talked to each other, saying "What does this mean, that he gives orders with authority and power to the unclean spirits and they come out? " 37 and a noise about him went out to every place in the region.

EWE: 38 Esi wòdzo le ƒuƒoƒea la, eva Simon ƒe me.
ENGLISH: 38 And he rose and left the synagogue and came to Simon’s house.

EWE: Ke asrã sesẽ aɖe lé Simon lɔ̃xo, eye woɖe kuku nɛ be wòakpe ɖe eŋu. 39 Yesu tsi tsitre, ebi ɖe edzi, eye wòblu ɖe asrã la ta, eye asrã la dzo le edzi.
ENGLISH: And Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering with a severe fever, and they asked him to do something for her; 39 and he went and stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her; and immediately she got up and waited on their needs.

EWE: Enumake nyɔnua fɔ hede asi wo subɔsubɔ me. 40 Ke esi ɣe le to ɖom la, ame siwo si dɔ vovovo lélawo le la kplɔ wo va egbɔ.
ENGLISH: 40 And after sunset one and all who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on each one of them and cured them.

EWE: Eda eƒe asiwo ɖe wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzi heda dɔa na wo. 41 Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo hã doa go le ame geɖewo me hedoa ɣli be: "Wòe nye Mawu ƒe Vi la. "
ENGLISH: 41 And demons also came out from many, shouting out "You are the Son of God "; and he stopped them peremptorily and would not allow them to speak, because they knew him to be the Messiah.

EWE: Ke ekaa mo na wo, eye meɖea mɔ na wo be woaƒo nu o, elabena wonya be eyae nye Kristo la. 42 Esi ŋu ke la, edzo yi teƒe aɖe si ame aɖeke mele o. Ke amehawo dii heva afi si wòle, eye wodi be yewoasikae ɖi be wòagadzo le yewo gbɔ o.
ENGLISH: 42 And when daylight came he went out and away to a lonely place; and the crowds went in quest of him and came to where he was, and held him back to keep him from going away from them.

EWE: 43 Ke egblɔ na wo be: "Ele nam be magblɔ Mawu Fiaɖuƒe ŋuti nya nyui la na du bubuwo hã, elabena esia tae wodɔm ɖo. " 44 Eya ta eyi edzi ɖe gbeƒã le ƒuƒoƒewo le Yudea.
ENGLISH: 43 But he said to them "I must bring word of the Reign of God to the other cities too, because that is what I was sent for. " 44 And he was making his proclamation in the synagogues of Palestine.

EWE: Luka
ENGLISH: Luke

EWE: 5 Gbe ɖeka Yesu le tsitre ɖe Genezaret-ta la to, eye ameha la mimii ɖo hele Mawu ƒe Nya la sem. 2 Eye wòkpɔ tɔdziʋu eve le ta la to, ɖɔkplɔlawo do go le wo me hele woƒe ɖɔwo kpalam.
ENGLISH: 5 And while the crowd was pressing upon him and listening to the word of God, he was standing by the edge of the Lake of Gennesaret 2 and saw two boats standing at the water’s edge; but the fishermen had got out of them and were washing the nets.

EWE: 3 Esi wòge ɖe tɔdziʋuawo dometɔ ɖeka, si nye Simon tɔ me la, ebia tso esi be wòakui ate ɖa le goa ŋu vie.
ENGLISH: 3 And he got into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land; and he sat down and taught the crowds from the boat.

EWE: Azɔ enɔ anyi ɖe tɔdziʋua me, eye wòde asi nufiafia amehawo me. 4 Esi wòwu nuƒoa nu la, egblɔ na Simon be: "Ku ʋua yi afi si goglo, ne miaɖi miaƒe ɖɔawo aɖe lã. " 5 Ke Simon ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Nufiala, míeku kutri zã blibo la katã, ke míeɖe naneke o, gake maɖi ɖɔawo le wò nya la nu. " 6 Eye esi woɖi ɖɔawo la, woɖe lã geɖe ale gbegbe be ɖeko woƒe ɖɔawo de asi vuvu me. 7 Eya ta womia asi wo tɔ siwo le tɔdziʋu kemɛa me be woava kpe ɖe yewo ŋu, eye wova, eye woɖe lãwo de ʋu eveawo me woyɔ fũu, ale be wode asi toyiyi me.
ENGLISH: 4 And when he stopped speaking he said to Simon "Put out to the deep water and let down your nets for a catch. " 5 And Simon answered "Master, we worked hard all night and got nothing; but at your word I will let down the nets. " 6 And they did this and enclosed a great number of fish, and their nets were tearing, 7 and they beckoned to their partners in the other boat to come and lend a hand; and they came, and filled both boats so that they were on the point of going to the bottom.

EWE: 8 Esi Simon Petro kpɔ esia la, edze klo ɖe Yesu ŋkume gblɔ be: "Aƒetɔ, dzo le gbɔnye, elabena nu vɔ̃ wɔlae menye. " 9 Elabe lã siwo woɖe la wɔ nuku na eya kple ame siwo katã le egbɔ, 10 nenema kee wòwɔ nuku na Yakobo kple Yohanes, ame siwo nye Zebedeo viwo eye woganye Simon ƒe hadɔwɔlawo hã.
ENGLISH: 8 And at seeing it Simon Peter threw himself down at Jesus’s knees, saying "Take yourself away from me, because I am a sinful man, sir "; 9 for amazement had come over him and all who were with him at the haul of fish that they had caught, 10 and over James and John the sons of Zebedee too, who were in business with Simon.

EWE: Ke Yesu gblɔ na Simon be: "Mègavɔ̃ o. Tso fifia dzi la, ànɔ amewo ɖem agbagbee. " 11 Ale woku tɔdziʋuawo va ɖi go, eye wogblẽ nu sia nu ɖi hedze eyome.
ENGLISH: And Jesus said to Simon "Do not be afraid; henceforth you shall be catching men. " 11 And when they had brought their boats to land they left everything and followed him.

EWE: 12 Ɣebubuɣi esi wòle duawo dometɔ ɖeka me la, kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu aɖe si anyidɔ xɔ ŋuti katã na lae nye esi! Esi wòkpɔ Yesu la, etsyɔ mo anyi ɖe eŋkume heɖe kuku nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, ne èlɔ̃ ko la, àte ŋu ana ŋutinye nakɔ. " 13 Ale wòdo asi ɖa ka asi eŋu gblɔ be: "Melɔ̃! Ŋutiwò nekɔ. "
ENGLISH: 12 And while he was in one of the cities, there there appeared a man full of leprosy; and, seeing Jesus, he threw himself down on his face and implored him, saying "Sir, if you will you can cleanse me; " 13 And he reached out his hand and touched him, saying "I will; be cleansed "; and at once the leprosy went away from him.

EWE: Enumake anyidɔ la vɔ nɛ. 14 Eye wòde se na amea be megagblɔe na ame aɖeke o. Egblɔ nɛ be: "Heyi nàtsɔ ɖokuiwò afia nunɔla, eye nàsa vɔ atsɔ akɔ ɖokuiwò ŋu abe ale si Mose de see ene, be wòanye kpeɖodzi na wo. " 15 Ke Yesu ŋuti nya le kakam ɖe edzi geɖe wu, eye ameha geɖewo va ƒoa ƒu be yewoaɖo toe, eye wòada yewoƒe dɔwo na yewo.
ENGLISH: 14 And he instructed him not to tell anybody, but "go show yourself to the priest and make the offerings on account of your cleansing as Moses directed, for an attestation to them. " 15 But the talk about him spread all the more, and great crowds came together to hear and to be cured of their sicknesses; 16 but he kept out of the way in lonely places and prayed.

EWE: 16 Ke hã edzona yia gbedadaƒo ɖadoa gbe ɖa. 17 Esi wònɔ nu fiam le ŋkeke mawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi la, Farisitɔwo kple Sefiala siwo tso Galilea kple Yudea kpakple Yerusalem duwo katã me la bɔbɔ nɔ afi ma; eye Yehowa na ŋusẽe be wòada dɔ. 18 Eye kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsuwo kɔ lãmetututɔ aɖe ɖe aba dzi vɛ, eye wodze agbagba be yewoakɔe ava afi si Yesu le ahadae ɖe eŋkume. 19 Ke esi womekpɔ mɔ aɖeke kɔe ge ɖe xɔa me o le ameha ta la, wolia xɔ la tame, eye woɖiɖi ŋutsua kple aba la to xɔgbakpeawo dome ɖe ame siwo le Yesu ŋkume la dome.
ENGLISH: 17 And on one of the days he was teaching, and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come from every village in Galilee and Judea and Jerusalem, and there was power of the Lord for his healing, 18 and men arrived bringing on a couch a man who was paralyzed; and they tried to bring him in and lay him before him, 19 and, not finding any way to bring him in because of the crowd, they got up on the roof and let him down through the tiles, cot and all, into the middle before Jesus.

EWE: 20 Esi wòkpɔ woƒe xɔse la, egblɔ be: "Ŋutsu, wotsɔ wò nu vɔ̃wo ke wò. " 21 Enumake agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo de asi wo nɔewo biabia me be: "Ame kae nye esi le busunyawo gblɔm ale? Ame kae ate ŋu atsɔ nu vɔ̃ ake, ne menye Mawu ɖeka ko oa? " 22 Ke esi Yesu nya be wole tame bum alea la, ebia wo be: "Nu ka ŋu bum miele le miaƒe dziwo me? 23 Kae bɔbɔ wu, be woagblɔ be, ‘Wotsɔ wò nu vɔ̃wo ke wò’ loo, alo be woagblɔ be, ‘Tso nàzɔ’? 24 Ke be miadze sii be ŋusẽ le Amegbetɔvi la si be wòatsɔ nu vɔ̃wo ake le anyigba dzi . . . " egblɔ na lãmetututɔa be: "Mele egblɔm na wò be, Tso nàtsɔ wò aba, eye nàyi aƒewò me. " 25 Ale wòtso le wo ŋkume, tsɔ eƒe aba, eye wòɖo ta aƒe me hele Mawu kafum.
ENGLISH: 20 And, seeing their faith, he said "Man, you are forgiven for your sins. " 21 And the scribes and the Pharisees began to question, saying "Who is this that speaks blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God alone? " 22 But Jesus, recognizing their questionings, answered them "Why are you inwardly questioning? 23 which is easier, to say ‘you are forgiven for your sins’ or to say ‘rise and walk’? 24 But, that you may know that the Son of Man has authority to forgive sins on earth " said he to the paralyzed man, "I say to you, Rise, and take up your cot and go home. " 25 And immediately he stood up before them and took up what he had been lying on, and went off to his home glorifying God.

EWE: 26 Ewɔ nuku na wo katã ale gbegbe, eye vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo, ale wokafu Mawu gblɔ be: "Míekpɔ nu wɔnukuwo egbea lo! "
ENGLISH: 26 And surprise came over them one and all, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying "We have seen strange things today. "

EWE: 27 Ke le nu sia megbe la, edo go, eye wòkpɔ adzɔxɔla aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Lewi wòbɔbɔ nɔ adzɔxɔƒe, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Dze yonyeme. " 28 Eye wògblẽ nu sia nu ɖi tso dze eyome.
ENGLISH: 27 And after this he went out and observed a customhouse officer, Levi by name, sitting in the customhouse office, and said to him "Follow me "; 28 and he left everything and rose and followed him.

EWE: 29 Lewi ɖo kplɔ̃ gã aɖe nɛ le eƒe me, eye adzɔxɔla geɖe kple ame bubuwo le kplɔ̃a ŋu le nuɖuƒea kpli wo. 30 Eya ta Farisitɔwo kple woƒe agbalẽfialawo lĩ liʋiliʋĩ hebia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: "Nu ka tae mieɖua nu, eye mienoa nu kple adzɔxɔlawo kpakple nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo? " 31 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ame siwo le lãmesẽ me la mehiã gbedala o, negbe ame siwo le dɔ lém ko.
ENGLISH: 29 And Levi gave a great banquet for him in his house: and there was a great crowd of customhouse officers and so on who were at the table with them, 30 and the Pharisees and their scribes complained to his disciples "Why do you eat and drink with customhouse officers and people of bad character? " 31 And Jesus answered them "Not the able-bodied, but the ill, need a physician; 32 I have not come to call saints, but sinners, to repentance. "

EWE: 32 Menye ame dzɔdzɔewo yɔ gee meva o, ke boŋ nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo yɔ gee meva be woatrɔ dzi me. " 33 Wogblɔ nɛ be: "Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo tsia nu dɔna edziedzi henɔa kokoƒoƒo dzi, eye Farisitɔwo ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo hã wɔna nenema ke, gake tɔwòwo ya ɖua nu noa nu. " 34 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ðe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ xɔlɔ̃wo atsi nu adɔ esime ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la le wo gbɔa? 35 Ke ŋkekewo li gbɔna, esime woakplɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la adzoe le wo gbɔ; ekema woatsi nu adɔ le ŋkeke mawo me. " 36 Egado lo aɖe hã na wo be: "Ame aɖeke melãa awudziwui yeye tsɔ kaa awudziwui xoxo o. Ne ewɔe nenema la, yeyea ƒe kakɛa aho ɖa, eye masɔ ɖe awu xoxoa nu o.
ENGLISH: 33 And they said to him "John’s disciples fast frequently and make prayers, and so do those of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink. " 34 But Jesus said to them "Can you make the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them? 35 but there will come days, and when the bridegroom is taken from them, then they will fast in those days. " 36 And he told them a parable too: "Nobody cuts a patch from a new cloak and sews it on an old cloak; if one does, he will be cutting the new one and the patch from the new one will not match the old one.

EWE: 37 Azɔ hã, ame aɖeke mekɔa wain yeye ɖe lãgbalẽgolo xoxowo me o. Ne ewɔe nenema la, wain yeye la ana goloawo nawó, eye wòaƒu gbe, eye lãgbalẽgoloawo dome agblẽ.
ENGLISH: 37 And nobody puts new wine in old skins; if one does, the new wine will burst the skins, and it will run out and the skins will be wasted; 38 but new wine is to be put in fresh skins.

EWE: 39 Ame aɖeke menoa wain xoxo vɔ gadia yeyea o, elabena egblɔna be: ‘Xoxoa nyo.’ "
ENGLISH: 39 And nobody when he has been drinking old wine wants new; for he says ‘The old is best.’ "

EWE: Luka
ENGLISH: Luke

EWE: 6 Gbe ɖeka esi Yesu to lugble aɖewo me va yina le sabat aɖe dzi la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋe luwo, eye wotugui kple asi nɔ ɖuɖum.
ENGLISH: 6 And on a sabbath it befell that he was walking through grainfields and his disciples were picking and eating the ears, rubbing them down in their hands.

EWE: 2 Eya ta Farisitɔ aɖewo bia wo be: "Nu ka tae miele nu si mele se nu o wɔm le Sabat dzi? " 3 Ke Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ðe miexlẽ nu si David wɔ, esime dɔ wu eya kple eŋutimewo, kple 4 ale si wòge ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me, xɔ ŋkumeɖobolowo heɖu, eye wòna ɖe eŋutimewo hã, evɔ se meɖe mɔ na ame aɖeke be wòaɖu wo o, negbe nunɔlawo ko la oa? " 5 Eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Sabat la ƒe Aƒetɔe Amegbetɔvi la nye. "
ENGLISH: 2 But some of the Pharisees said "Why are you doing what is not lawful on the sabbath? " 3 And Jesus replied to them "Have you not even read this that David did when he, and those who were with him, were hungry? 4 that he went into the house of God and took and ate the showbread, and gave it to those who were with him, which it is not lawful that anybody but the priests alone should eat? " 5 and he said to them "The Son of Man is master of the sabbath. "

EWE: 6 Le sabat bubu aɖe dzi la, eyi ƒuƒoƒe la eye wòde asi nufiafia me. Eye ŋutsu aɖe si titi lé nuɖusi na la le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 6 And on another sabbath it befell that he went into the synagogue and was teaching; and there was a man there whose right hand was shriveled.

EWE: 7 Eya ta agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo le ŋku lém ɖe Yesu ŋu tututu be yewoakpɔe ɖa be ada dɔ le Sabat la dzi hã, ne yewoatsɔ nya ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 7 And the scribes and the Pharisees were watching him to see if he cured on the sabbath, that they might find a chance to arraign him; 8 but he knew their designs.

EWE: 8 Ke esi wònya woƒe tamesusuwo ta la, egblɔ na ame si titi lé asi na la be: "Tso nàva tɔ ɖe titina. "
ENGLISH: And he said to the man with his hand shriveled "Rise and stand forward "; and he got up and stood.

EWE: Eye wòtso yi ɖatsi tsitre ɖe afi ma. 9 Azɔ Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Mabia mi se: Ðe se ɖe mɔ be woawɔ nu nyui alo awɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi le Sabat dzi, be woaɖe agbe aɖe loo alo atsrɔ̃ea? " 10 Esi wòtsa ŋku le wo dzi godoo la, egblɔ na amea be: "Mlo asi. " Emloe, eye eƒe asi la ɖɔ ɖo.
ENGLISH: 9 And Jesus said to them "I put the question to you whether it is lawful on the sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save a life or to kill "; 10 and he looked around at them all and said to him "Stretch out your hand "; and he did, and his hand was restored.

EWE: 11 Ke wodo dziku helĩhelĩ, eye wode adaŋu le wo nɔewo dome le nu si woawɔ Yesu la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 11 But they were seized with fatuity, and talked together of what they should do to Jesus.

EWE: 13 Esi ŋu ke la, eyɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va eɖokui gbɔ, eye wòtia ame wuieve le wo dome, eye wòna ŋkɔ wo be apostolowo. 14 Woƒe ŋkɔwoe nye: Simon si wòna ŋkɔe be Petro kple nɔvia Andrea, Yakobo, Yohanes, Filipo, Bartolomeo, 15 Mateo, Toma, Yakobo, Alfeo vi, Simon si woyɔna be "veviedola la, " 16 Yuda, Yakobo vi, kple Yuda Iskariot, ame si va zu yomemɔfiala. 17 Eye Yesu ɖi tso to la dzi kpli wo heva tɔ ɖe gbadzaƒe aɖe, eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe ha gã aɖe kple ameha gã aɖe nɔ eŋu siwo tso Yudea katã kple Yerusalem kpakple Tiro kple Sidon ƒutanutowo me va be yewoaɖo toe eye wòada yewoƒe dɔwo na yewo. 18 Eda dɔ na ame siwo gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo le fu ɖem na la gɔ̃ hã. 19 Eye ameha blibo la le didim be yewoaka asi eŋu, elabena ŋusẽ doa go le eme daa gbe le wo katã ŋu.
ENGLISH: 12 And in those days it befell that he went out on the mountainside to pray, and spent the whole night in prayer to God; 13 and when day came he called his disciples to him, and, choosing out twelve of them, the same whom he named apostles, 14 Simon, the same whom he named Peter, and his brother Andrew, and James and John and Philip and Bartholomew 15 and Matthew and Thomas and James the son of Alpheus, and Simon known as the Zealot, 16 and Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscarioth who turned traitor, 17 and coming down with them, he took his stand in a level place, he and a great crowd of his disciples, and a great multitude of the people from all Palestine and Jerusalem and the Tyre and Sidon coast, who came to hear him and be healed from their diseases; 18 and those who were molested by unclean spirits were cured; 19 and all the crowd were trying to get a chance to touch him, because a power went out from him and healed all.

EWE: 20 Eye wòfɔ kɔ dzi kpɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo hede asi gbɔgblɔ me be:
ENGLISH: 20 And he raised his eyes to his disciples and said

EWE: "Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye mi ame dahewo, elabena mia tɔe nye Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la.
ENGLISH: "Happy you that are poor, because yours is the Reign of God.

EWE: 21 "Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye mi ame siwo dɔ le wuwum fifia, elabena miava ɖi ƒo.
ENGLISH: 21 Happy you that are hungry now, because you shall be fed to the full.

EWE: "Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye mi ame siwo le avi fam fifia, elabena miava ko nu.
ENGLISH: Happy you that weep now, because you shall laugh.

EWE: 22 "Dzidzɔtɔwoe mienye ne amewo lé fu mi, eye woɖe mi le ha me, eye wodzu mi heƒo ɖi miaƒe ŋkɔ abe vɔ̃wɔlawo ene le Amegbetɔvi la ta.
ENGLISH: 22 Happy are you when men hate you and when they ostracize you and twit you and proscribe your name as vile on account of the Son of Man.

EWE: 23 Mitso aseye gbe ma gbe, eye migli kple dzidzɔ, elabena kpɔ ɖa, miaƒe fetu lolo le dziƒo, elabe nu mawo kee wo tɔgbuiwo wɔ nyagblɔɖilawo.
ENGLISH: 23 On that day be glad and dance, for your reward in heaven is great; for their fathers did the same sort of things to the prophets.

EWE: 24 "Ke baba na mi kesinɔtɔwo, elabena miele miaƒe akɔfafa katã kpɔm xoxo.
ENGLISH: 24 Woe to you that are rich though, because you have had your comforting.

EWE: 25 "Baba na mi ame siwo ɖi ƒo fifia, elabena dɔ ava wu mi.
ENGLISH: 25 Woe to you that are filled now, because you shall be hungry.

EWE: "Baba na mi ame siwo le nu kom fifia, elabena miava fa konyi ahafa avi.
ENGLISH: Woe, you that laugh now, because you shall mourn and weep.

EWE: 26 "Baba na mi, ne amewo katã ƒoa nu nyui le mia ŋu, elabena nu siawoe wo tɔgbuiwo wɔ na aʋatsonyagblɔɖilawo.
ENGLISH: 26 Woe when all men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same sort of thing to the pretended prophets.

EWE: 27 "Ke mele egblɔm na mi ame siwo le to ɖom la be: Miyi edzi mialɔ̃ miaƒe futɔwo, miawɔ nyui na ame siwo léa fu mi, 28 miyra ame siwo ƒoa fi dea mi, minɔ gbe dom ɖa ɖe ame siwo dzua mi la ta. 29 Ne ame aɖe ƒo tome na wò la, trɔ evelia hã nɛ; eye ne ame aɖe xɔ wò awudziwui la, mègagbe awutewui la hã tsɔtsɔ nɛ o. 30 Na nu ame sia ame si le nu biam wò, eye ame si tsɔ wò nuwo dzoe la, mègabia be wòagbugbɔ wo avɛ na ye o.
ENGLISH: 27 "But I tell you who hear me, love your enemies, do good turns to those who hate you, 28 bless those who curse you, pray for those who do spiteful things to you; 29 to him who cuffs you on the cheek offer the other cheek too, and from him who takes away your cloak do not withhold your shirt either; 30 give to everybody who asks you, and do not demand your things back from the one who takes them; 31 and as you would have men do to you, do likewise to them.

EWE: 31 "Eye ale si ko miedina be amewo nawɔ na mi la, miwɔ nenema ke na wo. 32 "Ne ame siwo lɔ̃a mi koe mielɔ̃na ɖe, kafukafu kae wònye na mi?
ENGLISH: 32 And if you love those who love you, what credit is it to you? for sinners too love those who love them.

EWE: 33 Eye ne miewɔa nyui na ame siwo wɔa nyui na mi ɖe, kafukafu ka wònye na mi?
ENGLISH: 33 And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is it to you? sinners too do the same.

EWE: Nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo kura gɔ̃ hã wɔna nenema ɖe. 34 Eye ne miedoa nu na ame siwo miekpɔa mɔ be woaxee na mi la, kafukafu kae wònye na mi?
ENGLISH: 34 And if you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is it to you? sinners too lend to sinners to receive payment in full.

EWE: 35 Ke boŋ miyi edzi mialɔ̃ miaƒe futɔwo, eye miwɔ nyui, mido nu na ame, eye miganɔ mɔ kpɔm be woaxee ɖe eteƒe na yewo o; ekema miaƒe fetu alolo, eye mianye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe viwo, elabena enyoa dɔme na ame madakpewo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.
ENGLISH: 35 But do love your enemies, and do good and lend without hoping to get any payment; and your reward shall be great, and you shall be sons of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.

EWE: 36 Minɔ nublanui kpɔm na amewo, abe ale si ko mia Fofo kpɔa nublanui ene.
ENGLISH: 36 Be tenderhearted, as your Father is.

EWE: 37 "Azɔ hã midzudzɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ame, ekema womadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi o; midzudzɔ fɔbubu ame, ekema womabu fɔ mi o.
ENGLISH: 37 And do not be judging, and you shall not be judged; and do not condemn, and you shall not be condemned.

EWE: Mitsɔ nɔ amewo kem, ekema woatsɔ ake miawo hã. 38 Minɔ nu nam amewo, eye amewo ana nu mi. Woadzidze nu nyuie, atee, aʋuʋui wòagbagba akɔ ɖe avɔ me na mi.
ENGLISH: Release and you shall be released; 38 give and you shall have gifts given to you; good measure, pressed in, shaken down, running over, they will give into your lap.

EWE: Elabena dzidzenu si mietsɔ le nu dzidzem na amewo la kee woatsɔ adzidzee na mi. "
ENGLISH: For the measure that you measure out shall be measured back to you. "

EWE: 39 Azɔ edo lo aɖe hã na wo be: "Ðe ŋkuagbãtɔ ate ŋu akplɔ ŋkuagbãtɔa? Ðe wo kple evea siaa madze do me oa? 40 Nusrɔ̃vi mewua eƒe nufiala o, ke ame sia ame si wofia nui nyuie la anɔ abe eƒe nufiala ene.
ENGLISH: 39 And he also told them a parable: "Can a blind man guide a blind man? will they not both tumble into a pit? 40 a pupil is not above his teacher, but everyone thoroughly trained will be like his teacher.

EWE: 41 Ekema nu ka tae nèkpɔa ati fefee si le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku dzi, gake mèkpɔa atikpo si le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi ya o? 42 Aleke wɔ nàgblɔ na nɔviwò be, ‘Nɔvinye, na maɖe ati fefee si le ŋku dzi na wò,’ evɔ wò ŋutɔ mèle atikpo si le wò ŋku dzi la kpɔm o?
ENGLISH: 41 And why is it that you can see the particle of straw in your brother’s eye, but do not observe the beam of timber in your own eye? 42 how can you say to your brother ‘Brother, let me get out the particle in your eye,’ when you cannot see the timber in your own eye?

EWE: Alakpanuwɔla! Ðe atikpo la ɖa le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi gbã, ekema àte ŋu akpɔ nu nyuie aɖe ati fefee si le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku dzi la.
ENGLISH: Hypocrite, first get the timber out of your eye, and then you will have good eyesight to get out the particle in your brother’s eye.

EWE: 43 "Elabena ati nyui aɖeke meli si tsea ku manyomanyo o, eye ati manyomanyo aɖeke meli si tsea ku nyui o. 44 Elabena ati sia ati ƒe tsetsee wotsɔna dzea sii. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, womegbea gbowo le srẽwo dzi o, eye wometsoa wainkpowo le aŋɔkawo dzi o.
ENGLISH: 43 For there is no such thing as a good tree producing foul fruit, nor yet a foul tree producing good fruit; 44 for each tree is known by its particular fruit; for people do not pick figs off thorns, nor gather grapes off a bramble.

EWE: 45 Ame nyui ɖea nu nyui doa goe tso eƒe dzi ƒe nu nyui dzraɖoƒe, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖea nu vɔ̃ɖi doa goe tso eƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi dzraɖoƒe; elabena nu si yɔ ame ƒe dzi me lae eƒe nu gblɔna.
ENGLISH: 45 A good man brings forth a good thing out of the good stock in his heart, and a bad man out of the bad a bad thing; for what his mouth speaks comes out of what is overflowing in his heart.

EWE: 46 "Ke nu ka ŋutie miele yɔyem be ‘Aƒetɔ! Aƒetɔ!’ evɔ miewɔa nya siwo megblɔna ya dzi o? 47 Ame sia ame si vaa gbɔnye, eye wòsea nye nyawo hewɔa wo dzi la, mafia ame si wòɖi la mi: 48 Eɖi ame aɖe si le xɔ tum, eɖe do wògoglo, eye wòɖo egɔme anyi ɖe agakpe dzi.
ENGLISH: 46 "And why do you call me ‘Sir,’ ‘Sir,’ and not do what I say? 47 Everyone who comes to me and hears my words and does them, I will let you know whom he is like: 48 he is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid a foundation on the rock, and when a flood came the river dashed against that house and was not able to shake it, because it was built well.

EWE: Ke esi tɔ ɖɔ la, tɔɖɔɖɔ la va lɔ xɔ ma, gake mete ŋu ʋuʋui o, elabena wotui nyuie. 49 Ke ame si senɛ gake mewɔa edzi o la ɖi ame si tu xɔ ɖe anyigba, eye meɖo gɔmeɖoanyi nɛ o.
ENGLISH: 49 But he who hears and does not do is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the river dashed, and at once it fell in and was a total wreck. "

EWE: Luka
ENGLISH: Luke

EWE: 7 Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siwo le esi na ameawo vɔ la, edzo yi Kapernaum.
ENGLISH: 7 After he had finished speaking all his words in the hearing of the people, he came into Capernaum.

EWE: 2 Ke asrafomegã aɖe ƒe kluvi, si gbɔ melɔ̃a nu le o la, dze dɔ vevie, eye wòɖo kudo nu. 3 Esi wòse Yesu ŋkɔ la, edɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe dumegãwo ɖe egbɔ be woaɖe kuku nɛ ne wòava da gbe le yeƒe kluvia ŋu. 4 Wova Yesu gbɔ va ɖe kuku nɛ vevie be: "Ame sia dze nàwɔ nu sia nɛ, 5 elabena elɔ̃ míaƒe dukɔa, eye eyae tu míaƒe ƒuƒoƒea. " 6 Eya ta Yesu tso kplɔ wo ɖo.
ENGLISH: 2 And a certain centurion’s servant, whom he prized highly, was ill and ready to die; 3 and, hearing about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant’s life; 4 and they came to Jesus and appealed to him earnestly, saying "He deserves to have you do this for him; 5 for he loves our nation, and it was he who built us the synagogue. " 6 And Jesus went with them.

EWE: Ke esi wòle aƒea gogom la, asrafomegã la dɔ exɔlɔ̃wo ɖe egbɔ be woagblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, mègaxa ɖe fu na ɖokuiwò o, elabena nyemedze be nàva aƒenye me o. 7 Esia tae nyemebu ɖokuinye be medze ava gbɔwò o. Ke boŋ ɖe gbe ko, eye nye subɔvi la ƒe lãme asẽ.
ENGLISH: But when he was now not far from the house the centurion sent friends to him with the message "Sir, do not put yourself out, for I am not fit to have you come under my roof 7 that is the reason why I did not presume to come to you myself but say the word, and let my boy be healed.

EWE: 8 Elabena nye hã mele ame aɖe ƒe ŋusẽ te, eye asrafowo le nye hã tenye, eye megblɔna na ame sia be, ‘Heyi!’ eye wòyina, megblɔna na ame bubu be, ‘Va!’ eye wòvana, eye megblɔna na nye kluvi be, ‘Wɔ esia!’ eye wòwɔnɛ. " 9 Esi Yesu se nya siawo la, ŋutsua ƒe nu wɔ nuku nɛ, eye wòtrɔ ɖe ameha si kplɔe ɖo la ŋu gblɔ be: "Mele egblɔm na mi be, nyemekpɔ xɔse gã sia tɔgbi le Israel gɔ̃ hã kpɔ o. " 10 Eye esi ame siwo wodɔ la trɔ yi aƒea me la, wokpɔe be kluvi la ƒe lãme sẽ.
ENGLISH: 8 For I too am a man in a position under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to this one ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant ‘Do this,’ and he does it. " 9 And Jesus, hearing this, wondered at him, and turned and said to the crowd that was following him "I tell you, I have not found so much faith even in Israel. " 10 And the men that had been sent to him returned to the house and found the servant well.

EWE: 11 Le esia megbe kpuie la, Yesu dze mɔ yina du aɖe si woyɔna be Nain me, eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple ameha gã aɖe le eyome. 12 Esi wògogo dua ƒe agbo nu la, kpɔ ɖa, wokɔ ame kuku aɖe si nye vi ɖeka hɔ̃ na dadaa la va yina. Ahosi hãe dadaa nye. Ameha gã aɖe hã tso dua me kplɔ nyɔnua ɖo.
ENGLISH: 11 And before long he went to a city named Nain, and his disciples and a great crowd were going along with him; 12 and when he drew near the gate of the city, there was a man being carried out dead who was his mother’s only son, and she was a widow; and there was quite a crowd from the city with her.

EWE: 13 Esi Aƒetɔ la kpɔ nyɔnua la, eƒe nu wɔ nublanui nɛ, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Dzudzɔ avifafa. " 14 Eye wòte ɖe amekukutsɔnu la ŋu heka asi eŋu, ale be etsɔlawo tɔ. Eye wògblɔ be: "Ðekakpui, mele egblɔm na wò be, fɔ! " 15 Eye ame kuku la fɔ bɔbɔ nɔ anyi hede asi nuƒoƒo me, eye Yesu tsɔe na dadaa.
ENGLISH: 13 And at seeing her the Lord was sorry for her and said to her "Do not weep, " 14 and went up and touched the coffin; and the bearers stopped, and he said "Young man I am speaking to you rise! " 15 and the dead man sat up and began to speak; and he gave him to his mother.

EWE: 16 Ale vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo katã, eye wode asi Mawu kafukafu me be: "Wona nyagblɔɖila gã aɖe do le mía dome, " eye "Mawu trɔ susu ɖe eƒe dukɔ la ŋu. " 17 Eye eŋuti nya sia kaka yi Yudea katã kple nuto siwo katã ƒo xlãe la me.
ENGLISH: 16 And fear came over them all, and they glorified God, saying "a great prophet has arisen among us " and "God has visited his people "; 17 and this talk about him went out all over Palestine and all its neighborhood.

EWE: 18 Eye Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va gblɔ nya siawo katã nɛ. 19 Eya ta Yohanes yɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ eve hedɔ wo ɖe Aƒetɔ la gbɔ be woabiae be: "Wòe nye Ame Si Gbɔna laa, alo ɖe míakpɔ mɔ na ame bubua? " 20 Esi ŋutsuawo va egbɔ la, wogblɔ be: "Yohanes Amenyrɔɖetsimela dɔ mí ɖe gbɔwò be míabia be, ‘Wòe nye Ame Si Gbɔna la, alo ɖe míakpɔ mɔ na ame bubua?’ " 21 Le gaƒoƒo ma dzi la, eda gbe le ame geɖewo ŋu, eye wòyɔ dɔ ame siwo le dɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo lém, enya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do goe le amewo me, eye wòna ŋkuagbãtɔ geɖewo hã kpɔ nu. 22 Eɖo eŋu na wo be: "Miheyi ɖagblɔ nu siwo miekpɔ kple nu siwo miese la na Yohanes: Ŋkuagbãtɔwo le nu kpɔm, bunɔwo le zɔzɔm, anyidɔlélawo ŋuti le kɔkɔm, tokunɔwo le nu sem, wole ame kukuwo fɔm ɖe tsitre, eye wole nya nyui la gblɔm na ame dahewo.
ENGLISH: 18 And John’s disciples reported to him about all this; 19 and John called to him two disciples of his and sent them to the Lord with the message "Are you the Coming One or are we to expect another? " 20 And the men came to him and said "John the Baptist has sent us to you to ask, are you the Coming One or are we to expect another? " 21 Thereupon he cured many of diseases and defects and evil spirits, and granted sight to many blind men, 22 and answered them by saying "Go and report to John what you saw and heard: blind men are recovering their sight, cripples are walking, lepers are being cleansed and deaf men are hearing, dead men are being raised, poor men are being given the gospel; 23 and happy is anyone who is not staggered over me. "

EWE: 23 Dzidzɔtɔe nye ame si mekpɔ nuɖiaɖia le ŋunye o. " 24 Esi Yohanes ƒe ame dɔdɔawo dzo la, Yesu de asi gbɔgblɔ me na amehaawo tso Yohanes ŋu be: "Nu kae miedo go yi gbedzi be yewoaɖakpɔ? Aɖa si ya le ƒoƒom loo? 25 Ekema nu kae miedo go yi be yewoaɖakpɔ? Ame si do awu nyuiwoa? Kpɔ ɖa, ame siwo le awu dzeaniwo me hele agbe ɖum la le fiasãwo me.
ENGLISH: 24 And when John’s messengers had gone Jesus began to say to the crowds about John "What did you go out into the wilderness for? to gaze at reeds shaking in the wind? 25 But what did you go out for? to see a man robed in soft fabrics? for those who are in magnificent clothing and in luxury, go to royal palaces.

EWE: 26 Ekema nu ka tututue miedo go yi be yewoaɖakpɔ?
ENGLISH: 26 But what did you go out for? to see a prophet?

EWE: Ɛ̃, mele egblɔm na mi be ewu nyagblɔɖila sãsãsã. 27 Eya ŋue woŋlɔ ɖi le be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, mele nye dɔla dɔm ɖe ŋgɔwò, ame si adzra wò mɔ dzi ɖo le ŋgɔwò.’ 28 Mele egblɔm na mi be: Le ame siwo nyɔnuwo dzi dome la, ɖeke menye gã wu Yohanes o, gake ame si nye suetɔ le Mawu Fiaɖuƒea me la nye gã wui. " 29 (Esi dukɔ la kple adzɔxɔlawo se nya sia la, wolɔ̃ ɖe edzi be Mawu le dzɔdzɔe, elabena wolɔ̃ Yohanes nyrɔ wo.
ENGLISH: Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet; 27 this is he of whom it is written ‘Lo, I am sending before your face my messenger who shall prepare your road before you.’ 28 I tell you, among all that are born of women no one is greater than John; but the littlest in the Reign of God is greater than he.

EWE: 30 Ke Farisitɔwo kple ame siwo nya Sea nyuie ya gbe Mawu ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo si wòna wo la, elabena womelɔ̃ Yohanes nyrɔ wo o.)
ENGLISH: 29 And all the people and the customhouse officers, when they heard, justified God, receiving John’s baptism; 30 but the Pharisees and the legists set aside God’s plan for themselves, not receiving baptism from him.

EWE: 31 Yesu yi edzi gblɔ be: "Ekema ame kae matsɔ dzidzime sia me tɔwo asɔ kplii, eye ame kae woɖi? 32 Woɖi ɖevi siwo bɔbɔ nɔ ablɔ me eye wodo ɣli gblɔ na wo nɔewo be, ‘Míeku dze na mi, ke mieɖu ɣe o; míedzi konyifaha, ke miefa avi o.’ 33 Nenema kee Yohanes Amenyrɔɖetsimela va; meɖua nu o, menoa wain o, ke miegblɔna be: ‘Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le eme.’ 34 Amegbetɔvi la va; eɖua nu noa nu, ke miegblɔna be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa! Nu tsu ɖula kple wain tsu nola, adzɔxɔlawo kple nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo xɔlɔ̃!’ 35 Gake nunya ƒe viwo katãe wotsɔ tsoa afia dzɔdzɔe nɛ. "
ENGLISH: 31 To what, then, shall I compare the men of this generation, and what are they like? 32 they are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other, that say ‘We played to you and you did not dance, we lamented and you did not weep.’ 33 For John the Baptist has come not eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say ‘He has a demon’; 34 the Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say ‘Here is a gormandizer and a drinker, a friend of customhouse officers and people of bad character’; 35 and wisdom is justified by all her children. "

EWE: 36 Ke Farisitɔ aɖe nɔ ebiam enuenu be wòava ɖu nu kpli ye. Eya ta eyi Farisitɔa ƒe me, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ kplɔ̃ ŋu.
ENGLISH: 36 And one of the Pharisees asked him to eat with him, and he went into the Pharisee’s house and took a place at the table.

EWE: 37 Eye kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnu aɖe si wonya le dua me be enye nu vɔ̃ wɔla la se be Yesu le nu ɖum le kplɔ̃ ŋu le Farisitɔa ƒe me, eye wòtsɔ alabastrogoe si me ami ʋeʋĩ le la vɛ. 38 Eva le tsitre ɖe Yesu megbe le eƒe afɔ gbɔ hele avi fam, eye wòfaa aɖatsi ɖe eƒe afɔwo dzi hetsɔa eƒe taɖa tutua afɔawo ŋu. Egbugbɔ eƒe afɔwo hã, eye wòtsɔ ami ʋeʋĩ la si na wo.
ENGLISH: 37 Now a sinful woman in the city, having ascertained that he was at the table in the Pharisee’s house, got an alabaster vial of perfume 38 and stood behind him by his feet weeping, and began to wet his feet with her tears and wiped them off with the hair of her head, and kept kissing his feet and rubbing them with the perfume.

EWE: 39 Esi Farisitɔ si kpee la kpɔ nu sia la, egblɔ le eɖokui me be: "Ne nyagblɔɖilae ame sia nye vavã la, anye ne enya ame si ƒomevi nyɔnu sia si le asi kam eŋu la nye, anye ne adze sii be nu vɔ̃ wɔlae wònye. " 40 Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Simon, nya aɖe le asinye medi be magblɔ na wò. "
ENGLISH: 39 And when the Pharisee that had invited him saw it he thought to himself "If this man were a prophet he would know who and what the woman that is touching him is, that she is a sinner. " 40 And Jesus answered him "Simon, I have something to say to you. "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu be: "Nufiala, gblɔe! " 41 "Ame eve nyi fe le gadola aɖe ŋu; ame ɖeka nyi denario alafa atɔ̃ ƒe fe, ke evelia ya nyi blaatɔ̃ ƒe fe.
ENGLISH: And he said "Say it, sir. " 41 "Once upon a time there was a lender who had two debtors: the one owed five hundred denarii and the other fifty.

EWE: 42 Esi naneke mele wo si woatsɔ axe fea o ta la, etsɔe ke wo ame eve la katã faa.
ENGLISH: 42 As they were not able to pay, he gave them both a release.

EWE: Ke wo dometɔ kae alɔ̃e wu? " 43 Simon ɖo eŋu be: "Mesusu be ame si wòtsɔ geɖe ke faa lae. "
ENGLISH: Then which of the two will love him the most? " 43 Simon answered "I suppose, the one to whom he gave the release for most. "

EWE: Egblɔ nɛ be: "Èɖo eŋu nyuie. " 44 Azɔ etrɔ ɖe nyɔnu la ŋu hegblɔ na Simon be: "Èle nyɔnu sia kpɔma?
ENGLISH: And he said to him "You judge rightly. " 44 And, turning to the woman, he said to Simon "Do you see this woman?

EWE: Meva aƒewò me; mèna tsim be maklɔ afɔe o. Ke nyɔnu sia fa aɖatsi ɖe nye afɔwo dzi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe taɖa tutu wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: I came into your house; you did not give me water for my feet; but she wetted my feet with her tears and wiped them off with her hair.

EWE: 45 Mègbugbɔ nu nam o, ke tso esime meva la, nyɔnu sia yi edzi le nye afɔwo ŋu gbugbɔm.
ENGLISH: 45 You did not give me a kiss; but she has kept kissing my feet without a pause ever since I came in.

EWE: 46 Mèkɔ ami ɖe ta nam o, ke nyɔnu sia kɔ ami ʋeʋĩ ɖe nye afɔwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 46 You did not put oil on my head; but she has been putting perfume on my feet.

EWE: 47 Esia ta mele egblɔm na wò be, togbɔ be eƒe nu vɔ̃wo sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ hã la, wotsɔ wo kee, elabena eɖe lɔlɔ̃ geɖe fia. Ke ame si wotsɔ ʋɛ aɖe ko ke la, eɖea lɔlɔ̃ ʋɛ aɖe ko fiana. " 48 Eye wògblɔ na nyɔnua be: "Wotsɔ wò nu vɔ̃wo ke wò. " 49 Ame siwo le kplɔ̃a ŋu kplii la te gbɔgblɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: "Ame kae nye ame sia si tsɔa nu vɔ̃wo gɔ̃ hã kena? " 50 Ke egblɔ na nyɔnu la be: "Wò xɔse ɖe wò; dzo yi le ŋutifafa me. "
ENGLISH: 47 For which reason I tell you her many sins are forgiven; because she has loved much, but he who is forgiven little loves little. " 48 And he said to her "Your sins are forgiven "; 49 and those who were at the table with him began to say to themselves "Who is this that even forgives sins? " 50 But he said to the woman "Your faith has saved you; go, and good betide you. "

EWE: Luka
ENGLISH: Luke

EWE: 8 Le esia megbe kpuie la, enɔ gbeƒã ɖem Mawu Fiaɖuƒe ŋuti nya nyui la tso du me yi du me kple kɔƒe me yi kɔƒe me. Eye Ame Wuieveawo nɔ eŋu 2 hekpe ɖe nyɔnu aɖewo siwo me wònya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do goe le eye wòda dɔ na wo la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 And thereafter he was making a tour city by city and village by village, preaching and bringing word of the Reign of God, and with him the Twelve 2 and certain women who had been cured of evil spirits and sickness, Mary known as the Magdalene, from whom seven demons had come out, 3 and Johanna the widow of Herod’s superintendent Chuzas, and Susanna, and many others, who supplied the men’s needs out of their property, 4 and as a great crowd was coming together, and the people from city after city were flocking to him, he said in a parable 5 "The sower went out to sow his seed.

EWE: Nyɔnu siawoe nye: Maria si woyɔna be Magdalatɔ, ame si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ adre do go le; 3 Yohana, si nye Kuza, Herodes ƒe nuwo dzi kpɔla srɔ̃; Susana, kple nyɔnu bubu geɖe siwo tsɔ woƒe nunɔamesiwo le wo subɔm. 4 Ke esi ameha gã aɖe hekpe ɖe ame siwo tso du vovovowo me ŋu va ƒo ƒu ɖe egbɔ la, edo lo na wo be: 5 "Nukuwula aɖe do go yi nuku wu ge. Esi wòle nukua wum la, ɖewo ge ɖe mɔ to, eye woɖo afɔ wo dzi, eye dziƒoxewo va mi wo. 6 Bubuwo ge ɖe kpenyigba dzi, eye esi womie la, woyrɔ, elabena womekpɔ tsi o. 7 Bubuwo hã ge ɖe ŋùwo me, eye ŋùawo mie kpli wo hevu tsyɔ wo dzi. 8 Ke bubuwo ge ɖe anyigba nyui dzi, eye esi womie la, wotse teƒe alafa ɖeka. "
ENGLISH: And in his sowing some fell on the roadside and was trampled on, and the birds of the air ate it up; 6 and some more dropped on the rock, and after it came up it dried out because of not having any moisture; 7 and some more fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up with it and smothered it; 8 and some more fell on the good soil, and after it came up it produced a hundredfold crop. "

EWE: Esi wòle nya siawo gblɔm la, edo ɣli gblɔ be: "Ame si to senu li na la, nesee. "
ENGLISH: Saying this, he called out "Let him who has ears to hear, hear! "

EWE: 9 Ke eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bia lododo la gɔmee. 10 Egblɔ be: "Miawo la, wona mi be miase Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la ƒe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔeawo gɔme, ke ame susɔewo la, wogblɔa nyaawo na wo le lododowo me, ale be togbɔ be wole nu kpɔm hã la, womadze sii o, eye togbɔ be wole nu sem hã la, womase egɔme o.
ENGLISH: 9 And his disciples put the question to him what that parable stood for; 10 and he said "To you it is given to know the secrets of the Reign of God; but to the rest it is in parables, that when they see they may not see and when they hear they may not understand.

EWE: 11 Azɔ nu si lododoa fiae nye esi: Nuku lae nye Mawu ƒe nya la.
ENGLISH: 11 But this is what the parable stands for.
