ENGLISH: 11 And Herod, with his soldiery, scorned him and made fun of him, and put splendid vestures on him and sent him back to Pilate; 12 and that very day Herod and Pilate became friends, for they had previously been at enmity.

EWE: 13 Eye Pilato yɔ nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo, dziɖulawo kple dukɔ la ƒo ƒu, 14 eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Miekplɔ ame sia vɛ nam be ele adã dem tame na dukɔ la be wòadze aglã. Eye kpɔ ɖa, medzro eƒe nya me le mia ŋkume, ke nyemekpɔ agɔdzedze aɖeke le ame sia ŋu le nya siwo mietsɔ ɖe eŋu la me o.
ENGLISH: 13 But Pilate, calling together the chief priests and the rulers and the people, 14 said to them "You brought this man to me as an alienator of the people, and here have I examined this man before you and not found in him anything punishable under the accusations you bring against him; 15 neither did Herod, for he sent him back to us.

EWE: 15 Herodes hã mekpɔ naneke le eŋu o, elabena egbugbɔe ɖo ɖe mí, eye mikpɔ ɖa, mewɔ naneke si dze ku o. 16 Eya ta mahe to nɛ, eye maɖe asi le eŋu. " 17 18 Gake ameha blibo la do ɣli be: "Bu mo na ame sia, eye nàɖe asi le Baraba ŋu na mí! " 19 (Wode ame sia gaxɔ me le aglãdzedze ɖe dziɖuɖua ŋu le dua me kple amewuwu ta.) 20 Eye Pilato gaƒo nu kpli wo, elabena edi be yeaɖe asi le Yesu ŋu.
ENGLISH: And here he has committed no act to deserve death; 16 so I will give him a lesson and release him. " 17 18 But they screamed out, the whole mass of them, "Get that fellow out of the way and release Bar-Abbas for us " 19 which Bar-Abbas had been thrown into prison for a certain riot that had taken place in the city, and for murder.

EWE: 21 Eye wode asi ɣlidodo me be: "Hee ɖe ati ŋu! Hee ɖe ati ŋu! " 22 Egblɔ na wo zi etɔ̃lia be: "Nu ka ta? Nu vɔ̃ɖi kae ame sia wɔ?
ENGLISH: 20 And Pilate called out to them again, wanting to release Jesus; 21 but they raised a hue and cry "Crucify, crucify him. " 22 And he said to them a third time "Why, what harm has this man done?

EWE: Nyemekpɔ naneke si dze ku le eŋu o; eya ta mahe to nɛ, eye maɖe asi le eŋu. " 23 Gake amewo ganɔ ɣli dom sesĩe kokoko be wòawui, eye woƒe gbe de dzi wu etɔ. 24 Eya ta Pilato tso nya me be woawɔ woƒe biabia la dzi na wo: 25 Eɖe asi le ame si wode gaxɔ me le aglãdzedze ɖe dziɖuɖua ŋu kple amewuwu ta, si biam wole la ŋuti, ke etsɔ Yesu de asi be woawɔ nu si wolɔ̃ la ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: I have not found in him anything punishable with death; so I will give him a lesson and release him. " 23 But they pressed their demand with loud cries, asking that he be crucified, and their cries prevailed, 24 and Pilate passed sentence that what they asked should be done; 25 and he released the man thrown into prison for riot and murder, whom they asked for, but gave Jesus up to their will.

EWE: 26 Ke esi wokplɔe yina la, wolé Simon, Kirenetɔ aɖe si tso agbleta gbɔna la, eye wona wòtsɔ fuwɔameti la dze Yesu yome.
ENGLISH: 26 And as they were leading him to execution they took one Simon, a Cyrenian, who was coming from the country, and put the cross on him to carry it behind Jesus.

EWE: 27 Ke ameha gã aɖe kplɔe ɖo, eye nyɔnu siwo le nu xam hele avi fam vevie ɖe eŋu la le wo dome. 28 Yesu trɔ ɖe nyɔnuawo ŋu gblɔ be: "Yerusalem-nyɔnuwo, midzudzɔ avifafa ɖe tanye. Ke boŋ mifa na mia ɖokuiwo kple mia viwo; 29 elabena, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, esime woagblɔ be, ‘Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye konɔwo, dɔ siwo medzi vi o kpakple no siwo mena no vi kpɔ o!’ 30 Ekema woagblɔ na towo be, ‘Mimu dze mía dzi!’ eye woagblɔ na togbɛwo be, ‘Mitsyɔ mía dzi!’ 31 Ne wole nu siawo wɔm esime atia le mumu ɖe, nu kae adzɔ ne eƒu? " 32 Ke wokplɔ ŋutsu eve bubu siwo nye nu vlo wɔlawo hã yina wuwu ge kpe ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 27 And there followed him a great number of the people, and of women who bewailed and lamented him; 28 but Jesus turned toward them and said "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me, but do weep for yourselves and your children; 29 for here are days coming in which they will say ‘Happy are the barren, and the bodies that have not held children, and the breasts that have not fed.’ 30 Then they will begin to say to the mountains ‘Fall on us’ and to the hills ‘Cover us’; 31 because if they do this with a green stick, what will be done with the dry one? " 32 And two other criminals also were led with him to be put to death.

EWE: 33 Eye esi woɖo teƒe si woyɔna be Ametakoliƒe la, wohe eya kple nu vlo wɔlaawo ɖe ati ŋu le afi ma, ɖeka ɖe eƒe ɖusime, eye evelia ɖe eƒe miame.
ENGLISH: 33 And when they came to the place known as the Skull, there they crucified him, and the criminals, one on the right and one on the left.

EWE: 34 Gake Yesu gblɔ be: "Fofo, tsɔe ke wo, elabena womenya nu si wɔm wole o. "
ENGLISH: 34 [But Jesus said "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing. "]

EWE: Wodzidze nu hã ɖe eƒe awuwo dzi be woama wo. 35 Eye amewo tɔ ɖi le nu kpɔm.
ENGLISH: And to divide up his clothes they threw lots; 35 and the people stood looking on.

EWE: 39 Ke nu vlo wɔla siwo wohe ɖe ati ŋu le afi ma la dometɔ ɖeka ɖe alɔme le eŋu be: "Menye wòe nye Kristo la oa? Ekema xɔ na ɖokuiwò eye nàxɔ na míawo hãe! " 40 Ke ame evelia ka mo nɛ be: "Alo wò hã, esi nèle fɔbubu ma ke me la, ɖe mèvɔ̃a Mawu oa? 41 Míawo ya míedze na tohehe sia, elabena nu siwo míewɔ la ƒe fetu xɔm míele; ke ame sia ya mewɔ nu tovo aɖeke o. " 42 Eye wògagblɔ be: "Yesu, ɖo ŋku dzinye ne èva ɖo wò Fiaɖuƒe la me. " 43 Egblɔ nɛ be: "Vavã mele egblɔm na wò egbea be, ànɔ Paradiso me kplim. "
ENGLISH: And the rulers too sneered at him, saying "He saved others; let him save himself, if this is God’s chosen Messiah. " 36 And the soldiers too made fun of him, putting vinegar up to him 37 and saying "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself. " 38 And there was an inscription over him too, "This is the king of the Jews. " 39 And one of the criminals that were hanging there taunted him: "You are the Messiah, aren’t you? save yourself and us "; 40 but the other answered him in rebuke, "Do you not even fear God, when you are under the same sentence? 41 and we justly, for we are being paid as our acts deserved, but this man had done nothing out of the way, " 42 and said, "Jesus, remember me when you come to your Reign "; 43 and he said to him "I tell you verily, today you shall be with me in Paradise. "

EWE: 44 Gaƒoƒo adelia lɔƒo ɖo azɔ, ke viviti do ɖe anyigba blibo la katã dzi va se ɖe gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi, 45 elabena ɣe ƒe keklẽ nu tsi; eye gbedoxɔmetsovɔ la dze ɖe eve. 46 Eye Yesu do ɣli sesĩe gblɔ be: "Fofo, asiwò mee metsɔ nye gbɔgbɔ de. "
ENGLISH: 44 And it was now about twelve o’clock, and there came a darkness all over the land till three, 45 the sun going dark; and the curtain of the temple split down the middle, 46 and Jesus, with a loud cry, said "Father, to your hands I commit my spirit "; and with this he expired.

EWE: Esi wògblɔ esia vɔ ko la, eku. 47 Esi asrafomegã la kpɔ nu si dzɔ la, ekafu Mawu gblɔ be: "Vavãe, ame dzɔdzɔe ame sia nye. " 48 Esi ameha siwo katã va ƒo ƒu ɖe afi ma le nu sia kpɔm la kpɔ nu siwo dzɔ la, wotrɔ dzo hele akɔta ƒom.
ENGLISH: 47 And the centurion, seeing what had happened, glorified God, saying "This man really was a saint "; 48 and all the crowds that had thronged to that sight returned beating their breasts after they saw what happened.

EWE: 49 Eƒe ame nyanyɛwo katã hã le tsitre ɖe adzɔge. Nyɔnu siwo kplɔe ɖo tso Galilea hã tɔ ɖe afi ma le nu siawo kpɔm.
ENGLISH: 49 And all his acquaintances were standing at a distance, and so were women who had come along with him from Galilee, seeing these things.

EWE: Etso Yudeatɔwo ƒe du Arimatia me, eye wòle Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la lalam. 52 Ame sia yi Pilato gbɔ hebia be woatsɔ Yesu ƒe kukua na ye yeaɖi. 53 Eɖee le ati la ŋuti, eye wòxatsa aklala biɖibiɖi ɖe eŋu hetsɔe mlɔ yɔdo si woɖe ɖe agakpe, si me wometsɔ ame aɖeke mlɔ kpɔ o la me.
ENGLISH: 50 And now a man by name Joseph, who was a member of the Council, a good honest man 51 (he had not assented to their plan and their action) from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, one who was watching for the Reign of God, 52 this man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’s body, 53 and took it down and wrapped it in a linen wrapper and laid it in a rock-cut tomb where as yet no one was lying.

EWE: 54 Ke Dzadzraɖoŋkekee, eye Sabat la le ɖoɖom. 55 Nyɔnu siwo kplɔe ɖo tso Galilea va la hã yi, eye wokpɔ yɔdo la kple ale si wotsɔ eƒe kukua mlɔ emee, 56 eye wotrɔ dzo be yewoaɖadzra atike ʋeʋĩwo kple ami ʋeʋĩwo ɖo.
ENGLISH: 54 And it was Friday, and the eve of the sabbath had begun; 55 but the women who had come from Galilee with him followed after and viewed the tomb, and how his body was laid, 56 and returned and got ready spices and perfumes.

EWE: Gake wodzudzɔ le Sabat la dzi abe ale si se la bia ene.
ENGLISH: And through the sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

EWE: Luka
ENGLISH: Luke

EWE: 24 Le kwasiɖaa ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la, nyɔnuawo yi yɔdo la to le ŋdi kanya, eye wotsɔ atike ʋeʋĩ siwo wodzra ɖo la ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 24 But on the first of the week at early dawn they came to the tomb bringing the spices they had got ready.

EWE: 2 Gake wokpɔ be womli kpe la ɖa le yɔdoa nu, 3 eye esi woge ɖe eme la, womekpɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe kukua o.
ENGLISH: 2 And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb; 3 but when they went in they did not find the body.

EWE: 4 Esi wotɔtɔ hetsi yaa le esia ŋuti la, kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu eve siwo le awu dadzowo me le tsitre ɖe wo gbɔ. 5 Nyɔnuawo vɔ̃ ŋutɔ, eye wode mo to, eya ta ŋutsuawo bia wo be: "Nu ka tae miele ame gbagbe dim le ame kukuwo dome? 6 Mele afi sia o, ke boŋ wofɔe ɖe tsitre. Miɖo ŋku nya si wògblɔ na mi esime wònɔ Galilea la dzi, 7 be woade Amegbetɔvi la asi na nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo, eye woahee ɖe ati ŋu, gake afɔ le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe. " 8 Ale wɔ woɖo ŋku eƒe nyawo dzi, 9 eye wotrɔ tso yɔdoa to va ka nya siawo katã ta na Ame Wuiɖekɛawo kple ame susɔeawo katã.
ENGLISH: 4 And while they were in perplexity over this, lo, there before them stood two men in vestures flashing with light; 5 and, when they were terror-struck and stood bending their faces to the ground, these said to them "Why are you looking for the living among the dead? 6 Remember how he told you, while he was still in Galilee, 7 that the Son of Man must be given over into the hands of sinful men and crucified, and rise on the third day. " 8 And they remembered his words, 9 and returned and reported all this to the Eleven and all the rest.

EWE: 10 Nyɔnu siawoe nye Maria Magdalatɔ, Yohana kple Yakobo dada Maria. Eye nyɔnu bubu siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la hã nɔ nya siawo gblɔm na apostoloawo. 11 Gake nya siawo ɖi bometsinya na wo, eye womexɔ nyɔnuawo dzi se o.
ENGLISH: 10 There were the Magdalene Mary and Johanna, and James’s Mary, and the rest with them; they told the apostles this, 11 and the statements appeared to them like nonsense, and they disbelieved the women.

EWE: 12 Gake Petro tsi tsitre, eye wòƒu du yi yɔdo la to, esi wòbɔbɔ do mo ɖe eme la, aklalawo ko wòkpɔ.

Ale wòtrɔ dzo hele nu si dzɔ la ŋu bum. 13 Ke gbe ma gbe tututu la, wo dometɔ eve le mɔ dzi yina kɔƒe aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Emaus la me, kɔƒe sia didi tso Yerusalem gbɔ abe agbadroƒe adre lɔƒo ene, 14 eye wole dze ɖom tso nu siwo katã dzɔ la ŋuti. 15 Ke esi wole dze ɖom hele nya siawo dzakam la, Yesu ŋutɔ te ɖe wo ŋu eye wòzɔ kpli wo, 16 ke womete ŋu kpɔe dze sii o. 17 Ebia wo be: "Nya kawo me dzrom miele vevie le mɔa dzi? "
ENGLISH: 13 And lo, that very day two of them were on their way to a village seven miles out from Jerusalem, named Emmaus, 14 conversing together about all these things that had befallen; 15 and while they were conversing and discussing, Jesus himself drew near and went along with them 16 (but their eyes were held from recognizing him) 17 and said to them "What talk is this that you are carrying on with each other as you walk? " and they stood still with dejected faces.

EWE: Ale wotɔ heɖo nublanuimo. 18 Eye wo dometɔ si ŋkɔe nye Kleopa biae be: "Amedzroe nènye le Yerusalem eye wò ɖeɖe koe li, eye mènya nu siwo dzɔ le afi ma le ŋkeke siawo me oa? " 19 Ebia wo be: "Nu kawoe? "
ENGLISH: 18 And one, Cleopas by name, answered him "Are you the one man who is visiting Jerusalem and has not learned of the things that have been going on in it these days? " 19 And he said to them "What things? "

EWE: Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Nu siwo ku ɖe Yesu Nazaretetɔ la, ame si zu nyagblɔɖila sẽŋu le nya kple nuwɔna me le Mawu kple dukɔ blibo la katã ŋkume, 20 kple ale si míaƒe nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple dziɖulawo dee asi wotso kufia nɛ, eye wohee ɖe ati ŋu la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: And they said to him "About Jesus the Nazarene, who showed himself a prophet powerful in deed and word before God and all the people, 20 and how the chief priests and our rulers gave him over to a sentence of death and crucified him; 21 but we were hoping it was he who was to redeem Israel.

EWE: 21 Evɔ míawo ya míenɔ mɔ kpɔm be ame siae aɖe Israel; hekpe ɖe nu siawo katã ŋu la, egbee nye ŋkeke etɔ̃lia tso esime nu siawo dzɔ.
ENGLISH: Yes, and, besides all this, now is the third day since these things happened.

EWE: 22 Gawu la, mía dome nyɔnu aɖewo hã va gblɔ nukunya aɖe na mí, elabena woyi yɔdo la to ŋdi kanya, 23 esi womekpɔ eƒe kukua o la, wova gblɔ be yewokpɔ mawudɔla aɖewo hã, siwo gblɔ na yewo be egbɔ agbe. 24 Eya ta mía dometɔ aɖewo yi yɔdoa to, eye wokpɔe abe ale si tututu nyɔnuawo gblɔe ene, ke womekpɔ eya ŋutɔ o. " 25 Eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Oo ame masenugɔmewo kple ame siwo ƒe dzi mexɔa nya siwo katã nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔ la dzi sena kaba o! 26 Ðe mehiã be Kristo la nakpe fu siawo, eye wòayi eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me oa? " 27 Eye esi wòdze egɔme tso Mose kple Nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo katã dzi la, eɖe nu siwo ku ɖe eya ŋutɔ ŋu le Ŋɔŋlɔawo katã me la me na wo.
ENGLISH: 22 Yes, and some women in our party have been startling us: having been to the tomb at daybreak 23 and not found his body, they came telling us they had also seen a manifestation of angels, who said he was alive; 24 and some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found things the same as the women said, but him they did not see. " 25 And he said to them "O you stupid men, with hearts slow to believe on everything that the prophets spoke! 26 did not the Messiah have to suffer these things and enter on his glory? " 27 and, beginning with Moses and all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things about himself.

EWE: 28 Mlɔeba wogogo kɔƒe si me yim wole, eye wòwɔ abe ɖe wòle eme tsom ene. 29 Ke woƒoe ɖe enu gblɔ be: "Tsi mía gbɔ, elabena fiẽ ɖo, eye ŋkekea wu enu vɔ. " Ale wòyi be yeatsi wo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 28 And they drew near the village where they were going, and he pretended to be going further; 29 and they pressed him insistently with the invitation "Stay with us, because it is toward evening and the day is already getting low, " and he went in to stay with them.

EWE: 30 Esi Yesu bɔbɔ nɔ kplɔ̃ ŋu kpli wo be yewoaɖu nu la, etsɔ abolo, eyra ɖe edzi, eye wòŋe eme tsɔ na wo.
ENGLISH: 30 And when he went to the table with them he took the bread, and spoke the blessing and broke it and handed it to them.

EWE: 31 Ale woƒe ŋkuwo ʋu, eye wokpɔ Yesu dze sii, ke ebú vĩi le wo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 31 And their eyes were opened and they recognized him; and he became invisible to them.

EWE: 32 Eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo be: "Ðe míaƒe dzi melé dzo le mía me, esi wòle nu ƒom na mí le mɔa dzi hele Ŋɔŋlɔawo me ɖem na mí tsitotsito oa? " 33 Le gaƒoƒo ma tututu me la, wotso dze mɔ, eye wogbugbɔ va Yerusalem, eye wokpɔ Ame Wuiɖekɛawo kple ame siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la woƒo ƒu ɖi 34 hele gbɔgblɔm be: "Wofɔ Aƒetɔ la ɖe tsitre vavã, eye wòɖe eɖokui fia Simon! " 35 Eye woawo hã wogblɔ nu siwo dzɔ le mɔa dzi kple ale si wokpɔ eya amea dze sii le aboloa ŋeŋe me la na wo.
ENGLISH: 32 And they said to each other "Were not our hearts burning in us as he talked to us on the road, as he opened the scriptures to us? " 33 and that very moment they rose and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and those who were with them collected together, 34 saying "The Lord has really risen, and has appeared to Simon, " 35 and gave an account of their experiences on the road and how he became known to them in the breaking of the bread.

EWE: 36 Esi wole nu ƒom tso nu siawo ŋu la, eya ŋutɔ va tsi tsitre ɖe wo titina hegblɔ na wo be: "Ŋutifafa na mi. " 37 Gake dzika tso wo ƒo, wovɔ̃ ŋutɔ, eye wosusu be gbɔgbɔ aɖe kpɔm yewole.
ENGLISH: 36 And while they were thus speaking he himself stood in their midst.

EWE: 38 Eya ta egblɔ na wo be: "Nu ka ŋuti mietɔtɔ, eye ɖikeke ɖo miaƒe dziwo me? 39 Mikpɔ nye asiwo kple nye afɔwo ɖa, eye miakpɔe be nye ŋutɔŋutɔe; mili asi ŋunye kpɔ, elabena ŋutilã kple ƒu mele gbɔgbɔ si, abe ale si miele ekpɔm le ŋunye la ene o. " 40 Eye esi wògblɔ esia la, etsɔ eƒe asiwo kple afɔwo fia wo. 41 Ke esi womele edzi xɔm le sesem o le dzidzɔ si gbegbe wokpɔ kple ale si wòwɔ nuku na wo ta la, ebia wo be: "Nuɖuɖu aɖe le mia si le afi sia? " 42 Eye wotsɔ tɔmelã memee kakɛ aɖe nɛ, 43 eye wòxɔe ɖu le wo ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 37 And they, terror-struck and unnerved, thought they were seeing a spirit; 38 and he said to them "Why are you alarmed, and why do questionings come up in your hearts? 39 see my hands and my feet, that it is I myself; feel of me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have. " 40 41 And while they were still disbelieving for very joy and wondering at it, he said to them "Have you anything eatable here? " 42 And they handed him part of a broiled fish, 43 and he took it before them and ate it.

EWE: 44 Azɔ egblɔ na wo be: "Nya siawoe megblɔ na mi esi megali kpli mi be nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe Sea kple Nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo kpakple Psalmowo me le ŋunye la nava eme. " 45 Eye wòʋu woƒe susu be woase Ŋɔŋlɔawo gɔme, 46 eye wògblɔ na wo be, "Nya siae woŋlɔ ɖi: be Kristo la akpe fu, eye wòafɔ tso ame kukuwo dome le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe, 47 eye woaɖe gbeƒã dzimetɔtrɔ hena nu vɔ̃wo tsɔtsɔ ke le dukɔwo katã me le eƒe ŋkɔ la me esia adze egɔme tso Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: 44 And he said to them "These are my words that I spoke to you while I was still with you, that everything written in the law of Moses and the prophets and the psalms about me must be fulfilled. " 45 Then he opened their mind to understand the scriptures, 46 and said to them "Thus it is written, that the Messiah suffer and rise from the dead on the third day, 47 and that repentance to the pardoning of sins be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning with Jerusalem.

EWE: 48 Mianye ɖaseɖilawo le nu siawo ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 48 You are witnesses to these things.

EWE: 49 Eye kpɔ ɖa, maɖo nu si ŋugbe Fofonye do la ɖe mia dzi. Ke minɔ dua me va se ɖe esime woana ŋusẽ mi tso dziƒo. "
ENGLISH: 49 And lo, I am sending out upon you what my Father promised; but do you keep in the city till you are clothed with power from on high. "

EWE: 50 Eye wòkplɔ wo do go va se ɖe keke Betania ke, eye wòkɔ eƒe asiwo dzi heyra wo. 51 Esi wòle wo yram la, woɖee ɖa le wo ŋu, eye wokɔe yi dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 50 And he brought them out nearly to Bethany, and raised his hands and blessed them; 51 and in the act of blessing them he moved away from them.

EWE: 52 Eye wobɔbɔ nɛ, eye wogbugbɔ va Yerusalem kple dzidzɔ gã aɖe. 53 Eye wonɔa gbedoxɔa me ɖaa henɔa Mawu kafum.
ENGLISH: 52 And they returned to Jerusalem in great gladness, 53 and were in the temple-precinct continually, blessing God.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 1 Le gɔmedzedzea me, Nya la li, eye Nya la li kple Mawu, eye Nya la nye mawu aɖe.
ENGLISH: 1 At the first there was the Word, and the Word was where God was, and the Word was God.

EWE: 2 Ame sia nɔ anyi kple Mawu le gɔmedzedzea me.
ENGLISH: 2 He was at the first where God was.

EWE: 3 Eya dzi wowɔ nuwo katã toe, eye eya manɔmee la, womewɔ nu ɖeka pɛ hã o.
ENGLISH: 3 Everything was made by his agency, and not a thing that was made was made without his agency.

EWE: Nu si wowɔ 4 to edzi lae nye agbe, eye agbe lae nye amewo ƒe kekeli la. 5 Eye kekeli la le keklẽm le viviti la me, gake viviti la meɖu edzi o.
ENGLISH: 4 In him there was life, and the life was the light of men; 5 and the light is shining in the darkness, and the darkness has not taken it in.

EWE: 6 Ŋutsu aɖe va do, si wodɔ ɖa abe Mawu teƒenɔla ene; eŋkɔe nye Yohanes.
ENGLISH: 6 There was a man sent from God whose name was John.

EWE: 7 Ame sia va abe ɖaseɖila ene, ne wòaɖi ɖase le kekeli la ŋu, ale be ame ƒomeviwo katã naxɔ ase to edzi.
ENGLISH: 7 This man came for testimony, to testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

EWE: 8 Menye eyae nye kekeli ma o, ke boŋ ɖe wòva be yeaɖi ɖase le kekeli ma ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 He was not the light but to testify about the light.

EWE: 9 Kekeli vavãtɔ si klẽna na ame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ƒe xexea me vava le aƒe tum.
ENGLISH: 9 There was coming into the world the true light that lights every man.

EWE: 10 Enɔ xexea me, eye xexea va dzɔ to edzi, gake xexea medze sii o. 11 Eva eya ŋutɔ wo de, gake wo de tɔwo mexɔe o.
ENGLISH: 10 He was in the world, and the world was made by his agency, and the world did not know him; 11 he came to what belonged to him, and those who belonged to him did not receive him.

EWE: 12 Gake ame siwo katã xɔe la, ena ŋusẽ wo be woazu Mawu ƒe viwo, elabena woxɔ eƒe ŋkɔ dzi se. 13 Eye menye ʋu alo ŋutilã ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu alo ŋutsu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu mee wodzi wo tsoe o, ke boŋ tso Mawu me.
ENGLISH: 12 But to as many as accepted him he gave the chance to become children of God, to those who believe in his name, 13 who were born not from blood nor from will of flesh nor from will of man, but from God.

EWE: 14 Ale Nya la va zu amegbetɔ, enɔ mía dome, eye míekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe si le abe tenuvi ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe tso fofoa gbɔ ene; eye Mawu ƒe amenuveve kple nyateƒe yɔe fũu.
ENGLISH: 14 And the Word became flesh and abode among us and we saw his glory, glory such as that of an only son from the Father, full of grace and truth.

EWE: 15 (Yohanes ɖi ɖase le eŋu, ɛ̃ ekɔ gbe dzi gblɔe be: "Ame sia ŋue megblɔ le be, ‘Ame si le megbenye gbɔna la nye gã wum, elabena eli hafi meva dzɔ.’ ") 16 Elabena esi amenuveve kple nyateƒe yɔe fũu ta la, míexɔ amenuveve ɖe amenuveve dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 John testifies of him and shouts "This was the one I spoke of when I said ‘He who is coming behind me has got ahead of me,’ because he was before I was, " 16 because out of his fullness all of us have had portions, and grace for grace.

EWE: 17 Elabena wotsɔ Se la na to Mose dzi, ke amenuveve kple nyateƒe la va to Yesu Kristo dzi.
ENGLISH: 17 For the law was given through Moses, grace and truth came in through Jesus Christ.

EWE: 18 Ame aɖeke mekpɔ Mawu ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o; tenuvi si le abe Mawu ene si le Fofoa xa lae ɖe ame si wònye la fia.
ENGLISH: 18 Nobody ever has seen God; an Only Born God, he who is in the Father’s bosom, he gave the account of him.

EWE: 19 Esiae nye Yohanes ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi esi Yudatɔwo dɔ nunɔlawo kple Lewitɔwo tso Yerusalem ɖo ɖee be woabiae be: "Ame kae nènye? " 20 Mesẽ nu o, ke boŋ eʋu eme kɔtɛ be: "Menye nyee nye Kristo la o. " 21 Eye wobiae be: "Ekema ame kae nènye?
ENGLISH: 19 And this is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites to him from Jerusalem to ask him "Who are you? " 20 and he answered and made no denial.

EWE: Wòe nye Eliya? " Eɖo eŋu be: "Menye nyee o. " "Wòe nye Nyagblɔɖila la? "
ENGLISH: And he said "I am not the Messiah. " 21 And they asked him "Then what? are you Elijah? " and he said "I am not. "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu be: "Ao! " 22 Eya ta wobiae be: "Ame ka gɔ̃e nènye?
ENGLISH: 28 This happened in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

EWE: Gblɔe na mí ale be míana ŋuɖoɖo ame siwo dɔ mí ɖa.
ENGLISH: 29 The next day he saw Jesus coming toward him, and said "There is God’s lamb that takes away the world’s sin.

EWE: 25 Eya ta wobiae be: "Ne menye wòe nye Kristo la alo Eliya alo Nyagblɔɖila la o la, ekema nu ka tae nèle amewo nyrɔm? " 26 Yohanes ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Nye la, mele amewo nyrɔm ɖe tsi me.
ENGLISH: 30 That is the one about whom I said ‘There is coming behind me a man who has got ahead of me,’ because he was before I was.

EWE: Ame aɖe le tsitre ɖe mia dome, si mienya o, 27 ame si le megbenye gbɔna, si ƒe afɔkpaka nyemedze atu o. " 28 Nu siawo va eme le Betania le Yordan godo, afi si Yohanes le amewo nyrɔm le.
ENGLISH: 31 And I did not know him, but it was to have him disclosed to Israel that I came baptizing in water. " 32 And John testified "I have seen the Spirit coming down like a dove out of the sky, and it rested on him.

EWE: 33 Nye ŋutɔ hã nyemenyae tsã o, ke Ame si dɔm be matsɔ tsi anyrɔ amewo lae gblɔ nam be: ‘Ame si dzi nèkpɔ be gbɔgbɔ la le ɖiɖim ɖo, eye wònɔ edzi la, eyae tsɔa gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe nyrɔa amewo.’ 34 Mekpɔe, eye meɖi ɖase be ame siae nye Mawu ƒe Vi la. "
ENGLISH: 33 And I did not know him; but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me ‘The one on whom you see the Spirit come down and rest on him, he is the one that baptizes in Holy Spirit’; 34 and I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God. "

EWE: 35 Esi ŋu gake la, Yohanes kple eƒe nusrɔ̃la eve va tɔ ɖi, 36 esi wòkpɔ Yesu wòva yina la, egblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu ƒe Alẽvi lae nye ekem! " 37 Esi nusrɔ̃la eveawo se nya si wògblɔ la, wodze Yesu yome.
ENGLISH: 35 The next day John was standing there again, and two of his disciples, 36 and he looked at Jesus walking along and said "There is God’s lamb "; 37 and the two disciples heard him speak, and followed Jesus.

EWE: 38 Yesu trɔ, eye esi wòkpɔ wo le eyome la, ebia wo be: "Nu ka dim miele? " Wobiae be: "Rabi (si gɔmee nye "Nufiala " ), afi kae nènɔna? " 39 Eɖo eŋu na wo be: "Miva kpɔe ɖa. "
ENGLISH: 38 And Jesus turned and saw them following him and said to them "What do you want? " and they said to him "Rabbi (which translated means Teacher), where are you staying? " 39 He said to them "Come and you shall see. "

EWE: Eya ta woyi ɖakpɔ afi si wònɔna, le gaƒoƒo ewolia lɔƒo, eye wonɔ egbɔ gbe ma gbe.
ENGLISH: So they came and saw where he was staying, and stayed with him that day; it was about four o’clock.

EWE: 40 Ame eve siwo se nya si Yohanes gblɔ, eye wokplɔ Yesu ɖo la dometɔ ɖekae nye Andrea, Simon Petro nɔvi. 41 Ame sia kpɔ eya ŋutɔ nɔvia Simon gbã, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Míekpɔ Mesia la " (Mesia gɔmee nye "Kristo "), 42 eye wòkplɔe yi Yesu gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 40 Simon Peter’s brother Andrew was one of the two that heard from John and followed him; 41 he found his own brother Simon first and said to him "We have found the Messiah " (which means Anointed; translated into Greek it is Christ).

EWE: Esi Yesu kpɔe la, egblɔ be: "Wòe nye Simon, Yohanes vi; woayɔ wò be Kefas " (si gɔmee nye "Petro " ). 43 Esi ŋu ke la, Yesu di be yeadzo ayi Galilea.
ENGLISH: 42 He brought him to Jesus; Jesus looked at him and said "You are Simon the son of John, you shall be called Cephas " (which means a rock; translated into Greek, the name is Peter).

EWE: Eye esi wòkpɔ Filipo la, egblɔ nɛ be: "Dze yonyeme. " 44 Ke Filipo tso Betsaida, si nye du si me Andrea kple Petro hã tso.
ENGLISH: 43 The next day he wanted to go out to Galilee, and found Philip, and said to him "Follow me. " 44 And Philip was from Bethsaida, Andrew and Peter’s city.

EWE: 45 Filipo kpɔ Nataniel, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Míekpɔ ame si ŋuti woƒo nu tsoe le Mose ƒe Se la kple Nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me, si nye Yesu, Yosef vi tso Nazaret. " 46 Ke Nataniel biae be: "Ðe nu nyui aɖe ate ŋu ado tso Nazaret mahã? "
ENGLISH: 45 Philip found Nathanael and said to him "We have found the one that Moses wrote of in the Law, and that the prophets wrote of, Jesus the son of Joseph from Nazareth "; 46 and Nathanael said to him "Can there be anything good out of Nazareth? "

EWE: Filipo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Va kpɔ. " 47 Esi Yesu kpɔ Nataniel wògbɔna egbɔ la, egblɔ tso eŋu be: "Kpɔ ɖa, Israel-vi akuakua, si me alakpa aɖeke mele o ye nye esi. " 48 Nataniel biae be: "Aleke nèwɔ nyam? "
ENGLISH: Philip said to him "Come and see. " 47 Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and said of him "Here comes a genuine Israelite with no adulteration. " 48 Nathanael said to him "What have you known about me? "

EWE: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Hafi Filipo nayɔ wò, esi nèle gbotia te la, mekpɔ wò. " 49 Nataniel ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Rabi, wòe nye Mawu ƒe Vi la, wòe nye Israel ƒe Fia. " 50 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Esi megblɔ na wò be mekpɔ wò le gbotia te tae nèxɔe se ɖoa? Èle nu siwo lolo wu esiawo la kpɔ ge. " 51 Egagblɔ nɛ be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be: Miakpɔ dziƒo nu wòaʋu, eye mawudɔlawo anɔ dzi liam ahanɔ ɖiɖim ava Amegbetɔvi la gbɔ. "
ENGLISH: Jesus replied "Before Philip called you I saw you when you were under the fig-tree. " 49 Nathanael answered "Rabbi, you are the son of God, you are the king of Israel. " 50 Jesus replied "Because I said to you I saw you under the fig-tree do you believe? you shall see greater things than these, " 51 and said to him "Verily, verily I tell you, you and the rest shall see the heavens standing open and God’s angels going up and coming down to the Son of Man. "

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 2 Le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, woɖu srɔ̃ɖeŋkekenyui le Kana le Galilea, eye Yesu dada hã va afi ma. 2 Wokpe Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo hã va srɔ̃ɖeŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe.
ENGLISH: 2 And the next day but one there was a wedding at Cana in Galilee, and Jesus’s mother was there; 2 and Jesus too, and his disciples, were invited to the wedding.

EWE: 3 Esi wain vɔ le wo si la, Yesu dada gblɔ nɛ be: "Wain vɔ le wo si. " 4 Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nyɔnu, afi kae nya sia ka na nye kpli wò?
ENGLISH: 3 And when they ran short of wine Jesus’s mother said to him "They have no wine "; 4 and Jesus said to her "What have you to do with my affairs, woman? the hour for me is not come yet. "

EWE: Nye gaƒoƒo la meɖo haɖe o. " 5 Dadaa gblɔ na ame siwo le subɔsubɔm la be: "Nu sia nu si wòagblɔ na mi la, miwɔe. " 6 Woɖi kpezɔ ade ɖe afi ma abe ale si Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔɖoɖoa bia ene, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ate ŋu axɔ tsi dzidzenu eve alo etɔ̃. 7 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Midu tsi ɖe zɔawo me woayɔ. "
ENGLISH: 5 His mother said to the waiters "Whatever he says to you, do it. " 6 And there were six stone water-jars there, holding twenty or thirty gallons each, set out in accordance with the Jews’ rites of cleansing.

EWE: Eya ta wodu tsia kɔ ɖe wo me woyɔ banaa. 8 Eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Azɔ miku ɖe yi na srɔ̃ɖeɖoɖoa dzi kpɔla la. "
ENGLISH: 7 Jesus said to them "Fill the jars with water "; and they filled them clear up; 8 and he said to them "Now dip some out and take it to the toastmaster. "

EWE: Eye wokui yi.
ENGLISH: And they took it to him.

EWE: 9 Ke esi srɔ̃ɖeɖoɖoa dzi kpɔla la ɖɔ tsi si wotrɔ wòzu wain la kpɔ evɔ menya afi si wòtso o (togbɔ be subɔla siwo ku tsia yii ya nya hã) la, srɔ̃ɖeɖoɖoa dzi kpɔla la yɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la 10 hegblɔ nɛ be: "Ame sia ame tsɔa wain nyuitɔ ɖoa anyi gbã, eye ne wonoe mu vɔ la, etsɔa manyomanyoa vanɛ. Wò ya èdzra wain nyui la ɖo va se ɖe fifia. " 11 Yesu wɔ nu sia le Kana le Galilea wònye eƒe nukunu gbãtɔ, eye wòna eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la dze; ale eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo xɔ edzi se.
ENGLISH: 9 And when the toastmaster tasted the water, which had become wine, and did not know where it came from (but the waiters who had dipped the water out knew), the toastmaster called out to the bridegroom 10 "Everybody puts on the good wine first and the poorer when they get under the influence; you have kept the good wine till now. " 11 This, the first of the tokens, Jesus did at Cana in Galilee, and disclosed his glory, and his disciples believed in him.

EWE: 12 Esia megbe Yesu kple dadaa, nɔviaŋutsuwo kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo trɔ yi Kapernaum, gake ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo koe wonɔ afi ma.
ENGLISH: 12 After that he came down to Capernaum, he and his mother and his brothers and his disciples, and they stayed there not many days.

EWE: 13 Azɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la le ɖoɖom, eye Yesu yi Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: 13 And the Jews’ passover was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

EWE: 14 Eye wòkpɔ ame siwo le nyiwo, alẽwo kple ahɔnɛwo dzram le gbedoxɔa me kpakple gaɖɔlila siwo nɔ anyi ɖe woƒe zikpuiwo dzi. 15 Ale wògbi ka tsɔ wɔ atam henya ame mawo katã kpakple woƒe alẽwo kple nyiwo do goe le gbedoxɔa me, etrɔ gaɖɔlilawo ƒe gakuwo kɔ ɖe anyi, eye wòmu woƒe kplɔ̃wo. 16 Eye wògblɔ na ame siwo le ahɔnɛawo dzram la be: "Mitsɔ nu siawo dzoe le afi sia!
ENGLISH: 14 And he found in the temple-precinct the sellers of cattle and sheep and pigeons and the money-changers in their seats, 15 and he made a whip out of bits of rope and drove them all out of the temple-precinct, and the sheep and the cattle, and spilled the money-changers’ coins and upset their tables, 16 and said to the pigeon-sellers "Get these away from here; do not make my Father’s house a market. " 17 His disciples remembered that it is written "Jealousy for thy house will eat me up. "

EWE: Migatsɔ Fofonye ƒe aƒe la wɔ asitsaƒee o! " 17 Ale eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo ŋku edzi be woŋlɔ ɖi be: "Ŋuʋaʋã ɖe wò aƒe la ŋu abi le menye abe dzo ene. " 18 Eya ta Yudatɔwo biae be: "Dzesi kae nàwɔ atsɔ aɖee afia be yekpɔ mɔ awɔ nu siawo? " 19 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Migbã gbedoxɔ sia, eye magatui le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me. " 20 Yudatɔwo biae be: "Ƒe blaene vɔ adee wotsɔ tu gbedoxɔ sia, eye wò ya àgbugbɔ atui le ŋkeke etɔ̃ mea? " 21 Ke gbedoxɔ si ŋu wòle nu ƒom tso lae nye eƒe ŋutilã.
ENGLISH: 18 So the Jews replied "What token do you show us, that you are doing this? " 19 Jesus replied "Wreck this temple and I will set it up in three days. " 20 So the Jews said "It took forty-six years to build this temple, and will you set it up in three days? " 21 But he was speaking of the temple of his body; 22 so when he rose from the dead his disciples remembered that he said that, and believed the text of scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.

EWE: 23 Esi wòle Yerusalem le Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi la, ame geɖewo xɔ eƒe ŋkɔ la dzi se, le esi wokpɔ nukunu siwo wɔm wòle la ta.
ENGLISH: 23 And while he was in Judea at passover at the feast many believed in his name as they saw the tokens he was doing.

EWE: 24 Ke Yesu ya meka ɖe wo dzi tututu o, elabena enya wo katã, 25 eye mehiã be ame aɖeke naɖi ɖase le amegbetɔ ŋu nɛ o, elabena enya nu si le amegbetɔ me.
ENGLISH: 24 But Jesus himself did not trust himself to them, because he knew everybody 25 and did not need to have anybody testify about man, for he himself knew what was in man.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 3 Ame aɖe tso Farisitɔwo dome, eŋkɔe nye Nikodemo, eye wònye Yudatɔwo ƒe kplɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 3 Jesus replied "Verily, verily I tell you, if a man is not born over, he cannot see the Reign of God. "

EWE: 2 Ame sia va egbɔ le zã me, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Rabi, míenya be nufialae nènye, eye ètso Mawu gbɔ va; elabena ame aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dzesi siwo nèwɔna o, negbe ɖe Mawu li kplii. " 3 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò be, ne womegbugbɔ ame dzi o la, mate ŋu akpɔ Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la o. " 4 Nikodemo biae be: "Aleke woawɔ adzi ame si nye ame tsitsi?
ENGLISH: 4 Nicodemus said to him "How can a man be born when he is old? can he get into his mother’s body a second time and be born? "

EWE: Mate ŋu agbugbɔ ayi dadaa ƒe dɔ me be woagadzii zi evelia o ɖe? " 5 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò be, ne wometsɔ tsi kple gbɔgbɔ dzi ame o la, mate ŋu age ɖe Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la me o.
ENGLISH: 5 Jesus answered "Verily, verily I say to you, if one is not born from water and spirit he cannot get into the Reign of God.

EWE: 6 Nu si wodzi tso ŋutilã me la, ŋutilã wònye, eye nu si wodzi tso gbɔgbɔ me la, gbɔgbɔ wònye.
ENGLISH: 6 What is born from the flesh is flesh and what is born from the spirit is spirit.

EWE: 7 Megawɔ moyaa na wò be megblɔ na wò be: Ele be woagbugbɔ mi adzi o.
ENGLISH: 7 Do not wonder at my telling you ‘you must be born over.’ 8 The wind blows where it chooses, and you hear the sound of it but do not know where it comes from and where it is going.

EWE: 8 Ya ƒona yia afi si wòdi, eye èsea eŋkɔ, ke mènyaa afi si wòtso kple afi si wòyina o.
ENGLISH: Anyone who is born from the spirit is like that. "

EWE: Nenema kee ame sia ame si wodzi tso gbɔgbɔ me la hã le. "
ENGLISH: 9 Nicodemus replied "How can those things be done? "

EWE: 9 Nikodemo biae be: "Aleke nu siawo ate ŋu adzɔe? " 10 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Nufialae nènye le Israel, aleke wɔ mènya nu siawo o? 11 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò be, nu si míenya la ŋue míeƒoa nu le, eye nu si míekpɔ la ŋue míeɖia ɖase le, ke miexɔa ɖase si míeɖina la o.
ENGLISH: 10 Jesus replied "Are you the teacher of Israel and do you not get the meaning of that? 11 Verily, verily, I tell you that we are speaking of what we know and testifying to what we have seen, and you are not receiving our testimony.

EWE: 12 Ne meƒo nu le anyigbadzinuwo ŋu na mi, eye miexɔe se o ɖe, aleke miawɔ axɔe ase ne meƒo nu le dziƒonuwo ŋu na mi? 13 Azɔ hã ame aɖeke melia yi dziƒo o, negbe ame si ɖi tso dziƒo va la ko, si nye Amegbetɔvi la.
ENGLISH: 12 If I tell you the earthly side and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you the heavenly side? 13 And nobody has gone up to heaven but he who came down out of heaven, the Son of Man.

EWE: 14 Abe ale si Mose kɔ da la ɖe dzi le gbea dzi ene la, nenema kee woakɔ Amegbetɔvi la hã ɖe dzii, 15 ale be ame sia ame si xɔa edzi sena la nakpɔ agbe mavɔ.
ENGLISH: 14 And as Moses raised the snake aloft in the desert, so the Son of Man must be raised aloft, 15 that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life.

EWE: 16 "Elabena Mawu lɔ̃ xexea ale gbegbe be wòtsɔ eƒe Tenuvi la na, be ame sia ame si xɔa edzi sena la nagatsrɔ̃ o, ke boŋ wòakpɔ agbe mavɔ.
ENGLISH: 16 For God so loved the world that he gave his only son that everyone who believes in him might not perish but have eternal life.

EWE: 17 Elabena Mawu medɔ Via ɖo ɖe xexea me be wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea o, ke boŋ be woaɖe xexea to edzi.
ENGLISH: 17 For God did not send the Son into the world to judge the world but in order to have the world saved through him.

EWE: 18 Ame si xɔa edzi sena la, womadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui o. Ame si mexɔa edzi sena o la, wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnui xoxo, elabena mexɔ Mawu ƒe Tenuvi la ƒe ŋkɔ dzi se o.
ENGLISH: 18 He who believes in him is not judged; he who does not believe is already judged because he has not believed in the name of God’s only son.

EWE: 19 Ke nu si ta wole ʋɔnu drɔ̃m ɖo lae nye esi: kekeli la va xexea me, ke amewo lɔ̃ viviti la wu kekeli la, elabena woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi.
ENGLISH: 19 And this is the judgment, that the light has come into the world and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their doings were bad.

EWE: 20 Elabena ame si wɔa nu gbegblẽwo la léa fu kekeli la, eye mevaa kekeli la gbɔ o, be woagaklo nu le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo dzi o. 21 Ke ame si wɔa nu nyui la vaa kekeli la gbɔ, ne eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nadze ƒãa be wowɔ ɖeka kple Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu. "
ENGLISH: 20 For anyone who is misbehaving hates the light and does not come to the light, that his doings may not be exposed; 21 but he who is doing as truth would have him comes to the light that his doings may be disclosed, because they are work done in God. "

EWE: 22 Le nu siawo megbe la, Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo yi Yudea ƒe kɔƒenutoa me, eye wònɔ afi ma kpli wo ɣeyiɣi aɖe, eye wònɔ amewo nyrɔm.
ENGLISH: 22 After this Jesus and his disciples came into Judea, and he spent a while with them there and baptized.

EWE: 23 Ke Yohanes hã le amewo nyrɔm le Aenon, si te ɖe Salim ŋu, elabena tsi gbogbo aɖe le afi ma, eye amewo vana eye wònyrɔa wo; 24 elabena womede Yohanes gaxɔ me haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 23 And John too was baptizing at Enon near Salim, because there was much water there; and they came and had themselves baptized, 24 for John had not yet been thrown into prison.

EWE: 26 Emegbe wova Yohanes gbɔ eye wogblɔ nɛ be: "Rabi, kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu si wò kplii mienɔ Yordan godo, si ŋu nèɖi ɖase le lae nye ema le amewo nyrɔm, eye amewo katã le egbɔ yim. " 27 Yohanes ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ame aɖeke mate ŋu axɔ naneke o, negbe ɖe wonae tso dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 25 So there came up an argument on the part of John’s disciples with a Jew about cleansing; 26 and they came to John and said to him "Rabbi, the one that was with you on the other side of the Jordan, the one you testified for there he is baptizing and everybody is coming to him. "

EWE: 28 Miawo ŋutɔwoe nye nye ɖasefo be megblɔ be, ‘Menye nyee nye Kristo la o, ke boŋ be, ɖe wodɔm ɖe ame ma ŋgɔ.’ 29 Ame si si ŋugbetɔ le la, eyae nye ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 27 John replied "A man cannot take anything if it is not given to him from heaven. 28 You yourselves bear me witness that I said I was not the Messiah, but that I had been sent before him.

EWE: Ke ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la xɔlɔ̃ si le tsitre ɖi le to ɖomee la kpɔa dzidzɔ gã ne ese ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ƒe gbe. Eya ta nye dzidzɔ la zu blibo.
ENGLISH: 29 The one who has the bride is bridegroom; but the bridegroom’s friend who stands and hears him is right joyous over the bridegroom’s voice; so this joy is mine in full measure.

EWE: 30 Eya anɔ dzidzim ɖe edzi, ke nyea manɔ to yim. "
ENGLISH: 30 He must grow, but I must dwindle.

EWE: 31 Ame si tso dziƒo va la ƒo ame bubuwo katã ta. Ame si tso anyigba dzi la, anyigba dzi wòtso, eye anyigbadzinuwo ŋue wòƒoa nu le. Ame si tso dziƒo va la ƒo ame bubuwo katã ta.
ENGLISH: 31 He who comes from above is above all: he who is from the earth is a thing of earth and speaks things of earth; he who comes from heaven is above all.

EWE: 32 Nu si wòkpɔ kple nu si wòse la ŋue wòɖia ɖase le, ke ame aɖeke mele eƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la xɔm o.
ENGLISH: 32 What he has seen and heard, to that he testifies, and nobody accepts his testimony.

EWE: 33 Ame si xɔ eƒe ɖaseɖiɖia la, eya ɖo kpe edzi be Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ. 34 Elabena ame si Mawu dɔ la gblɔa Mawu ƒe nyawo, elabe Mawu mevea nu le gbɔgbɔ la nana me o.
ENGLISH: 33 He who has accepted his testimony has set his seal to it that God is true; 34 for he whom God has sent speaks God’s words, for he does not give the Spirit by measure.

EWE: 35 Fofo la lɔ̃ Vi la, eye wòtsɔ nuwo katã de esi.
ENGLISH: 35 The Father loves the Son, and has given everything into his hand.

EWE: 36 Ame si xɔa Vi la dzi sena la, agbe mavɔ le esi; ame si meɖoa to Vi la o la, makpɔ agbe o, ke boŋ Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe tsia edzi.
ENGLISH: 36 He who believes in the Son has eternal life; but he who disobeys the Son will not see life, but God’s anger rests on him. "

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 4 Esi Aƒetɔ la nyae be Farisitɔwo see be yeƒe nusrɔ̃lawo le agbɔ sɔm wu Yohanes tɔwo, eye yele wo nyrɔm 2 evɔ la, Yesu ŋutɔ menyrɔ amewo o, ke boŋ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawoe 3 la, edzo le Yudea, eye wògatrɔ yi Galilea.
ENGLISH: 4 So when the Lord found that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John 2 yet Jesus did not himself baptize, but his disciples 3 he left Judea and went back to Galilee.

EWE: 4 Ke ehiã be wòato Samaria.
ENGLISH: 4 And he had to go through Samaria.

EWE: 5 Eya ta eva ɖo Samaria du aɖe si woyɔna be Sixar la me. Du sia gogo anyigba si Yakob tsɔ na via Yosef.
ENGLISH: 5 So he came to a city in Samaria called Sychar, near the piece of land Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

EWE: 6 Yakob ƒe vudo hã le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 6 And there was a well there, Jacob’s well.

EWE: Gaƒoƒo adelia me lɔƒoe. 7 Ke Samaria-nyɔnu aɖe va tsi du ge.
ENGLISH: So Jesus, being spent with travel, was sitting by the well in that condition; it was about twelve o’clock; 7 a woman of Samaria came to draw water.

EWE: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Na tsi vi aɖem mano. " 8 (Elabena eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dzo yi dua me be yewoaɖaƒle nuɖuɖu.) 9 Samaria-nyɔnu la biae be: "Aleke wɔ wò, Yudatɔ, nèle tsi biamem be yeano, evɔ Samaria-nyɔnue menye? "
ENGLISH: Jesus said to her "Let me have a drink "; 8 for his disciples had gone off to the city to buy food. 9 So the Samaritan woman said to him "How come you, a Jew, to ask me, a Samaritan woman, for a drink? " for the Jews do not associate with the Samaritans.

EWE: (Elabena Yudatɔwo kple Samariatɔwo menyina o.) 10 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ne ɖe nènya Mawu ƒe nunana faa la kple ame si le biawòm be, ‘Na tsi vi aɖem mano’ la, anye ne wò boŋ àbiae, eye wòana agbetsi wò. " 11 Egblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, tsikunu si nàtsɔ adu tsia teti hã mele asiwò o, eye vudoa hã goglo.
ENGLISH: 10 Jesus replied "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that is saying to you ‘Let me have a drink,’ you would have asked him and he would have given you living water. "

EWE: Ekema afi kae nèkpɔ agbetsi sia tsoe? 12 Mènye gã wu mía tɔgbui Yakob, ame si ɖe vudoa na mí, eye eya kple viawo kpakple eƒe lãwo no emetsi o ɖe? " 13 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ame sia ame si noa tsi sia ƒe ɖe la, tsikɔ agawui.
ENGLISH: 11 She said to him "Sir, you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep; so where do you get the living water? 12 Do you amount to more than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, and his sons and his stock? "

EWE: 14 Ke ame sia ame si ano tsi si manae ƒe ɖe la, tsikɔ magawui akpɔ o, ke boŋ tsi si manae la azu tsi dzidzi le eme, eye wòayɔ agbagba ahana agbe mavɔe. " 15 Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, na tsi siam, ne tsikɔ magawum alo manɔ afi sia vam ava nɔ tsi dum azɔ o. "
ENGLISH: 13 Jesus replied "Anyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again; 14 but whoever drinks the water that I will give him shall have no thirst forevermore, but the water that I will give him shall become in him a fountain of gushing water to eternal life. "

EWE: 16 Egblɔ nɛ be: "Yi nàyɔ srɔ̃wò vɛ. " 17 Nyɔnua ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Srɔ̃ mele asinye o. "
ENGLISH: 16 He said to her "Go call your husband and come here. " 17 The woman replied "I have no husband. "

EWE: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Èto nyateƒe esi nègblɔ be, ‘Srɔ̃ mele asinye o.’ 18 Elabena srɔ̃ atɔ̃ nɔ asiwò kpɔ, eye ŋutsu si gbɔ nèle fifia la, menye srɔ̃wò wònye o.
ENGLISH: Jesus said to her "You are right in saying ‘I have no husband,’ 18 for you have had five husbands and the one you have now is no husband of yours; you have told the truth in that. "

EWE: Èto nyateƒe le nya sia me. " 19 Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, mekpɔe dze sii be nyagblɔɖilae nènye.
ENGLISH: 19 The woman said to him "Sir, I see you are a prophet.

EWE: 20 Mía tɔgbuiwo de ta agu le to sia dzi, ke miawo ya miebe Yerusalem ye nye teƒe si wòle be amewo nade ta agu le. " 21 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nyɔnu, xɔ dzinye se, gaƒoƒo la gbɔna, esime menye to sia dzi alo Yerusalem ye miade ta agu na Fofo la le o.
ENGLISH: 20 Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you say the place to worship in is at Jerusalem. "

EWE: 22 Miawo la, miedea ta agu na nu si mienya o; míawo la, míedea ta agu na nu si míenya, elabena xɔxɔ la tso Yudatɔwo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 21 Jesus said to her "Believe me, woman, there is a moment coming when you will not be worshiping the Father either on this mountain or at Jerusalem.

EWE: 23 Gake gaƒoƒo la gbɔna, eye wòde azɔ, esime nyateƒetadeagulawo ade ta agu na Fofo la le gbɔgbɔ kple nyateƒe me, elabena le nyateƒe me la, ame siawo tɔgbi dimee Fofo la le be woade ta agu na ye.
ENGLISH: 22 You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, because salvation is of the Jews; 23 but there is a moment coming, and it is here now, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth for the Father aims to have his worshipers such.

EWE: 24 Mawu nye Gbɔgbɔ, eye ele be ame siwo le ta dem agu nɛ la nade ta agu le gbɔgbɔ kple nyateƒe me. " 25 Nyɔnu la gblɔ nɛ be: "Menyae be Mesia, si woyɔna be Kristo la gbɔna.
ENGLISH: 24 God is a spirit, and those who worship must worship in spirit and truth. " 25 The woman said to him "I know there is a Messiah coming " (the one who in Greek is called Christ); "when he comes he will tell us the whole story. "

EWE: Ne eva ɖo la, agblɔ nu sia nu na mí kɔtɛ. " 26 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nye ame si le nu ƒom na wò la, nyee. "
ENGLISH: 26 Jesus said to her "It is I, I who am speaking to you. "

EWE: 27 Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va ɖo, eye wòwɔ moyaa na wo be ele nu ƒom kple nyɔnu. Gake wo dometɔ aɖeke mebiae be, "Nu ka dim nèle? " alo "Nu ka tae nèle nu ƒom kple nyɔnua? " o.
ENGLISH: 27 And upon that his disciples came, and wondered that he was talking with a woman; however, nobody said "What are you after? " or "Why are you talking with her? "

EWE: 28 Eye nyɔnua gblẽ eƒe tɔmedeze la ɖi, eye wòyi dua me ɖagblɔ na amewo be: 29 "Miva kpɔ ame aɖe si gblɔ nu siwo katã mewɔ kpɔ la nam ɖa.
ENGLISH: 28 So the woman left her jar and went off to the city and said to the men 29 "Come see a man that told me everything I had done; do you suppose that is the Messiah? "

EWE: Ðe manye ame siae nye Kristo la oa? " 30 Eye wodo go le dua me va Yesu gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 30 They came out of the city and were coming to him. 31 In the meantime the disciples asked him "Rabbi, eat something. "

EWE: 31 Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, nusrɔ̃lawo le eƒom ɖe enu be: "Rabi, ɖu nu! " 32 Ke egblɔ na wo be: "Nuɖuɖu le asinye maɖu, si miawo mienya o. " 33 Eya ta nusrɔ̃lawo bia wo nɔewo be: "Alo ɖe ame aɖe tsɔ nane vɛ nɛ wòɖua? " 34 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Nye nuɖuɖue nye be mawɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye mawu dɔ si wòde asi nam la nu.
ENGLISH: 32 But he said to them "I have a meal to eat that you do not know of. " 33 So the disciples said to each other "Did someone bring him something to eat? " 34 Jesus said to them "It is my food that I should do the will of the one who sent me and carry his work through.

EWE: 35 Menye gbɔgblɔm miele be esusɔ ɣleti ene hafi nuŋeɣi naɖo oa? Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 35 You say, do you not, ‘Another four months and harvest comes’? here I am telling you, raise your eyes and look at the fields to see that they are white for harvest already.

EWE: Mele egblɔm na mi be: Mifɔ mo dzi ne miakpɔ agbleawo dzi ɖa, be woƒu na ŋeŋe. Fifia gɔ̃ hã la, 36 nuŋela le fetu xɔm, eye wòle kutsetse nu ƒom ƒu hena agbe mavɔ, ale be nuƒãla kple nuŋela siaa nakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖekae.
ENGLISH: 36 The reaper gets pay and gathers fruit for eternal life, that together the sower and the reaper may be glad, 37 for in this matter the saying holds good that the sower is one man and the reaper another.

EWE: 37 Elabena nya si wogblɔ la nye nyateƒe le go sia me be: Ame aɖe ƒãa nu eye ame bubu ŋenɛ. 38 Medɔ mi be miaŋe nu si ŋu miedze agbagba aɖeke le o.
ENGLISH: 38 I sent you to reap what you have not labored on; others have labored and you have come into their labor. "

EWE: 39 Samariatɔ geɖe siwo tso du ma me xɔ Yesu dzi se le ɖase si nyɔnua ɖi na wo be, "Egblɔ nu siwo katã mewɔ kpɔ la nam " la ta. 40 Eya ta esi Samariatɔawo va egbɔ la, woɖe kuku nɛ be wòanɔ yewo gbɔ, eye wònɔ afi ma ŋkeke eve. 41 Esia wɔe be ame bubu geɖewo gaxɔ edzi se le nu siwo wòfia wo la ta, 42 eye wogblɔ na nyɔnua be: "Meganye wò nyawo tae míexɔe se ɖo o; elabena míawo ŋutɔwo míesee, eye míenyae be ame siae nye xexea ɖela vavã. "
ENGLISH: 39 And out of that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the woman’s words as she testified "He told me everything I had done. " 40 So when the Samaritans came to him they asked him to stay with them, and he stayed there two days, 41 and many more believed because of his words 42 and said to the woman "We are no longer believing because of your talk, for we have heard for ourselves and know that this positively is the Savior of the World. "

EWE: 43 Le ŋkeke eve megbe la, edzo le afi ma yi Galilea. 44 Ke Yesu ŋutɔ ɖi ɖase be womedea bubu nyagblɔɖila aɖeke ŋu le wo de o.
ENGLISH: 43 But after the two days he went out from there to Galilee; 44 for Jesus himself attested that a prophet does not have honor in his hometown.

EWE: 45 Eya ta esi wòva ɖo Galilea la, Galileatɔwo xɔe, le esi wokpɔ nu siwo katã wòwɔ le Yerusalem le ŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi la ta, elabena woawo hã wode ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe.
ENGLISH: 45 So when he came to Galilee the Galileans received him, having seen all the things he did at Jerusalem at the feast; for they too had been to the feast.

EWE: 46 Eye wògava Kana le Galilea, afi si wòtrɔ tsi wòzu wain le.
ENGLISH: 46 So he came again to Cana in Galilee, where he made the water wine.

EWE: Ke fiaŋume aɖe le afi ma, si viŋutsu dze dɔ le Kapernaum. 47 Esi ŋutsu sia se be Yesu tso Yudea va Galilea la, eyi egbɔ, eye wòɖe kuku nɛ be wòava da gbe le ye via ŋu, elabena eɖo kudo nu.
ENGLISH: And there was a certain royal official whose son was sick at Capernaum; 47 this man heard that Jesus had come from Jerusalem to Galilee, and went to him and asked that he would come down and heal his son, for he was going to die.

EWE: 48 Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Ne miekpɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo o kpaa miaxɔe ase o. " 49 Fiaŋume la gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, va miyi kaba hafi vinye sue la naku. " 50 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Heyi, viwò la le agbe. " Ŋutsua xɔ nya si Yesu gblɔ nɛ la dzi se, eye wòdzo.
ENGLISH: 48 So Jesus said to him "Unless you see tokens and wonders you will not believe "; 49 the official said to him "Sir, come down before my child dies. " 50 Jesus said to him "Go along, your son recovers "; the man believed the word Jesus gave him and went.

EWE: 51 Ke esi wòle mɔ dzi yina la, eƒe kluviwo va kpee gblɔ nɛ be viaŋutsuvia tsi agbe.
ENGLISH: 51 And when he was already coming down his servants met him saying his child was recovering.

EWE: 52 Eya ta ebia wo be gaƒoƒo ka mee wòhaya hã. Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Asrã la dzo le edzi etsɔ le gaƒoƒo adrelia dzi. " 53 Eya ta fofoa kpɔe dze sii be gaƒoƒo ma tututu mee Yesu gblɔ na ye be: "Viwò la le agbe. " Ale eya kple eƒe aƒe blibo la katã zu xɔsetɔwo.
ENGLISH: 52 So he inquired from them the hour at which he showed improvement; so they told him "The fever left him at one in the afternoon yesterday. " 53 So the father knew it was at that hour at which Jesus said to him "your son recovers, " and believed, he and his whole family.

EWE: 54 Esiae nye nukunu evelia si Yesu wɔ esime wòdzo le Yudea va Galilea.
ENGLISH: 54 This second token Jesus did again when he had come out of Judea to Galilee.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 5 Le esia megbe la, Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋkekenyui aɖe ɖo, eye Yesu yi Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: 5 After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

EWE: 2 Ke ta aɖe le Yerusalem le Alẽgbo la gbɔ, si woyɔna le Hebrigbe me be Betzata, eye akpata atɔ̃ le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 2 And at Jerusalem there is at the Sheep Gate a pool, the one spoken of in Hebrew as Bethzatha, with five porches; 3 in these were lying a multitude of the sick, blind, lame, atrophied.

EWE: 3 Dɔnɔ gbogbo aɖewo, siwo nye ŋkuagbãtɔwo, bunɔwo kple titilélawo, mlɔ anyi ɖe afi ma. 4 5 Ke ŋutsu aɖe le afi ma, si le dɔ lém ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ enyie nye ema.
ENGLISH: 4 5 And there was a certain man there who had had thirty-eight years of his disease; 6 seeing him lying there, and finding that he had had a long time of it, Jesus said to him "Do you want to get well? "

EWE: 6 Esi Yesu kpɔ ŋutsu sia le anyimlɔƒe, eye wònya be ɣeyiɣi didi aɖee nye ema wòle dɔ lém la, ebiae be: "Èdi be wò lãme nasẽa? " 7 Dɔnɔa ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, ame aɖeke mele asinye akɔm ada ɖe ta la me ne woblu tsia o, eye kaka maɖo la, ame bubu gena ɖe eme doa ŋgɔ nam. " 8 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Tso!
ENGLISH: 7 The sick man answered him "Sir, I do not have a man to throw me into the pool when the water is disturbed, and while I am coming somebody else gets down ahead of me. "

EWE: Tsɔ wò aba, eye nàzɔ. " 9 Ale ŋutsua ƒe lãme sẽ enumake, eye wòtsɔ eƒe aba hede asi zɔzɔ me. Ke gbe ma gbe nye Sabat.
ENGLISH: 8 Jesus said to him "Rise, take up your pallet, and walk. " 9 And at once the man became well and took up his pallet and walked.

EWE: 10 Eya ta Yudatɔ aɖewo gblɔ na ame si ŋu woda gbe le la be: "Egbee nye Sabat, eye se meɖe mɔ be nàtsɔ wò aba o. " 11 Gake eɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ame si da gbe le ŋunye lae gblɔ nam be, ‘Tsɔ wò aba, eye nàzɔ.’ " 12 Wobiae be: "Ame kae gblɔ na wò be, ‘Tsɔ wò aba, eye nàzɔ’? " 13 Ke ame si ŋu woda gbe le la menya ame la o, elabena Yesu dzo le afi ma hebu ɖe ameha la dome.
ENGLISH: And it was sabbath that day; 10 so the Jews said to the cured man "It is sabbath, and it is not lawful for you to carry your pallet. " 11 But he answered "The one that made me well, he said to me ‘Take up your pallet and walk.’ " 12 They asked him "Who was the man that said to you ‘Take it up and walk’? " 13 But the cured man did not know who it was; for Jesus had slipped away, there being a crowd in the place.

EWE: 14 Le nu siawo megbe la, Yesu kpɔe le gbedoxɔa me, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Kpɔ ɖa, wò lãme sẽ. Mègawɔ nu vɔ̃ azɔ o, ne nu si vɔ̃ɖi wu esia nagadzɔ ɖe dziwò o. " 15 Ŋutsu la yi ɖagblɔ na Yudatɔwo be Yesue da gbe le ye ŋu. 16 Le esia ta Yudatɔwo ti Yesu yome vevie, elabena ele nu siawo wɔm le Sabat dzi.
ENGLISH: 14 After this Jesus found him in the temple-precinct and said to him "There, you have got well; do not sin anymore, so that you will not have something worse. " 15 The man went off and told the Jews it was Jesus that had made him well; 16 and because of that the Jews persecuted Jesus, since he had done that on a sabbath.

EWE: 17 Ke egblɔ na wo be: "Fofonye le dɔ wɔm va se ɖe fifi, eye nye hã mele dɔ wɔm. " 18 Esia tae Yudatɔwo gadi vevie wu be yewoawui, elabena menye ɖeko wòle dadam le Sabat la dzi o, ke ele Mawu hã yɔm be ye Fofo hetsɔ eɖokui le sɔsɔm kple Mawu.
ENGLISH: 17 But he answered them "My Father is working till now, and I am working. " 18 So because of that the Jews tried the more to kill him since he was not only overriding the obligation of the sabbath but also calling God his father, claiming to be equal to God.

EWE: 19 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, Vi la mate ŋu awɔ nu ɖeka pɛ hã le eɖokui si o, negbe nu siwo wòkpɔ Fofoa wòle wɔwɔm la ko.
ENGLISH: 19 So Jesus replied "Verily, verily I tell you, the Son cannot do anything from himself unless he sees the Father do a thing; for what he does, that the Son likewise does.

EWE: 20 Elabena Fofo la lɔ̃a Vi la, eye wòfiaa nu siwo katã eya ŋutɔ wɔna lae, eye afia dɔ siwo lolo wu esiawo lae, ne wòawɔ moyaa na mi.
ENGLISH: 20 For the Father loves the Son and shows him everything that he himself is doing, and will show him greater works than these for you to wonder at.

EWE: 21 Elabena ale si ko Fofo la fɔa ame kukuwo hegbɔa agbe wo la, nenema kee Vi la hã gbɔa agbe ame siwo wòdi.
ENGLISH: 21 For as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son too gives life to whom he will.

EWE: 22 Elabena Fofo la medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame aɖeke o, ke boŋ etsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la katã de asi na Vi la, 23 ne amewo katã nade bubu Vi la ŋu abe ale si ko wodea bubu Fofo la ŋu ene.
ENGLISH: 22 For the Father does not judge anyone either, but he has given all jurisdiction to the Son, 23 that all may honor the Son as they honor the Father.

EWE: Ame si medea bubu Vi la ŋu o la, medea bubu Fofo si dɔe ɖa la hã ŋu o.
ENGLISH: He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him.

EWE: 24 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ame si sea nye nya, eye wòxɔa Ame si dɔm ɖa la dzi sena la, agbe mavɔ le esi, eye womadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui o, ke boŋ eto ku me yi agbe me.
ENGLISH: 24 Verily, verily I tell you that he who hears my words and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and does not come under judgment but has passed from death to life.

EWE: 25 "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, gaƒoƒo la gbɔna, eye wòde azɔ, esime ame kukuwo ase Mawu ƒe Vi la ƒe gbe, eye ame siwo ɖo to la anɔ agbe. 26 Elabena ale si agbe le Fofo la ŋutɔ mee la, nenema kee wòna agbe le Vi la hã me. 27 Eye wòna ŋusẽe be wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, elabena Amegbetɔvi wònye.
ENGLISH: 25 Verily, verily I tell you that there is a moment coming, and it is here now, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will come to life, 26 for as the Father has life in himself so he has given it to the Son to have life in himself; 27 and he has given him authority to administer judgment because he is Son of Man.

EWE: 28 Esia megawɔ nuku na mi o, elabena gaƒoƒo la gbɔna, esime ame siwo katã le ŋkuɖodziyɔdowo me la ase eƒe gbe, 29 eye woado go, ame siwo wɔ nu nyuiwo la, hena agbe ƒe tsitretsitsi, eye ame siwo wɔ nu vlowo la, hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe tsitretsitsi.
ENGLISH: 28 Do not wonder at this, because there is a moment coming at which all in the tombs will hear his voice 29 and pass out, those who have done what was good to resurrection of life, those who have misbehaved to resurrection of judgment.

EWE: 30 Nyemate ŋu awɔ naneke le ɖokuinye si o; nu si mese la nue medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖo; eye ʋɔnu si medrɔ̃na la le dzɔdzɔe, elabena nyemewɔa nye ŋutɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nue mewɔna.
ENGLISH: 30 I cannot do anything from myself: I pronounce judgment as I hear, and my judgment is just because I am not looking out for my will but for the will of the one that sent me.

EWE: 31 "Ne nye ɖeka meɖi ɖase le ɖokuinye ŋu la, ekema nye ɖaseɖiɖi la menye nyateƒe o. 32 Ame bubu aɖe li, si ɖia ɖase le ŋunye, eye menya be ɖase si wòɖina le ŋunye la nye nyateƒe.
ENGLISH: 31 "If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true; 32 there is another who testifies about me, and I know the testimony he gives about me is true.

EWE: 33 Miedɔ amewo ɖo ɖe Yohanes gbɔ, eye wòɖi ɖase le nyateƒenya la ŋu na mi. 34 Gake nyemehiã amegbetɔ ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi le ŋutinye o, ke mele nya siawo gblɔm ne miakpɔ ɖeɖe.
ENGLISH: 33 You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth; 34 but I do not draw on a man for testimony, but am saying these things that you may be saved.

EWE: 35 Yohanes nye akaɖi si le bibim hele keklẽm, eye miedi be yewoakpɔ dzidzɔ gã aɖe le eƒe kekeli la me ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.
ENGLISH: 35 He was the lamp that burned and shone; and you were willing to jubilate in his light for a moment.

EWE: 36 Ke ɖaseɖiɖi si lolo wu Yohanes tɔ la le asinye, elabena dɔ siwo tututu Fofonye de asi nam be mawɔ, siwo wɔm mele la, woawoe le ɖase ɖim le ŋunye be Fofo lae dɔm ɖa.
ENGLISH: 36 But I have greater testimony than John’s; for the works that the Father has given it to me to carry through, the very works that I am doing, testify about me that the Father has sent me.

EWE: 37 Eye Fofo si dɔm ɖa la ŋutɔ ɖi ɖase le ŋunye.
ENGLISH: 37 And the Father who sent me, he has testified about me.

EWE: Miese eƒe gbe ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o, eye miekpɔ eƒe nɔnɔme hã kpɔ o, 38 eye eƒe nya la mele mia me o, elabena miexɔ ame si wòdɔ ɖa la dzi se o.
ENGLISH: You have never yet heard his voice nor seen his form, 38 and you do not have his word resting in you, because you do not believe him whom he sent.

EWE: 39 "Miele Ŋɔŋlɔawo me dzrom tsitotsito, elabena miesusuna be yewoato wo dzi akpɔ agbe mavɔ; evɔ woawo kee le ɖase ɖim le ŋunye. 40 Gake miedi be yewoava gbɔnye ne miakpɔ agbe o.
ENGLISH: 39 You search through the scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life, and they are what testify about me, 40 and you are not willing to come to me to have life.

EWE: 41 Nyemexɔa kafukafu tso amewo gbɔ o, 42 ke menyae nyuie be mielɔ̃ Mawu o.
ENGLISH: 41 I do not accept glory from men; 42 but I know you as not having the love of God in you.

EWE: 43 Meva le Fofonye ƒe ŋkɔ me, ke miexɔm o. Nenye ame bubu aɖee va le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔ me la, anye ne miaxɔ ame ma ya.
ENGLISH: 43 I have come in my Father’s name and you do not accept me; if another comes in his own name you will accept him.

EWE: 44 Aleke wɔ miaxɔ dzinye ase, esi miele kafukafu xɔm tso mia nɔewo gbɔ, evɔ miele kafukafu si tso Mawu ɖeka kolia la gbɔ ya dim o? 45 Migasusu be matso mia nu na Fofo la o; ame aɖe li si tsoa mia nu; eyae nye Mose, ame si dzi mieda miaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖo. 46 Le nyateƒe me la, ɖe miexɔ Mose dzi se la, anye ne miexɔ dzinye se, elabena eŋlɔ nu tso ŋunye.
ENGLISH: 44 How can you believe when you accept glory from each other and do not look out for the glory that comes from the only God? 45 Do not think I will accuse you to the Father; there is one who does accuse you, Moses, to whom you have pinned your hopes; 46 for if you believed Moses you would be believing me, for he wrote about me.

EWE: 47 Ke ne miexɔ nu siwo wòŋlɔ ɖi la dzi se o ɖe, aleke miawɔ axɔ nye nyawo dzi ase? "
ENGLISH: 47 But if you do not believe his writings how will you believe my sayings? "

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 6 Le esia megbe la, Yesu tso Galilea-ƒu si wogayɔna be Tiberia la, yi ɖe eƒe go kemɛ dzi.
ENGLISH: 6 After this Jesus went off to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (of Tiberias).

EWE: 2 Eye ameha gã aɖe dze eyome, elabena wokpɔ nukunu siwo wòwɔ heda gbe le dɔnɔwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 2 And a great crowd followed him, because they saw the tokens he was doing on the sick.

EWE: 3 Eya ta Yesu yi to aɖe dzi, eye eya kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bɔbɔ nɔ afi ma.
ENGLISH: 3 And Jesus went up on the mountainside and sat there with his disciples.

EWE: 4 Ke Yudatɔwo ƒe Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la gogo.
ENGLISH: 4 And the passover, the Jews’ feast, was near.

EWE: 5 Esi Yesu fɔ mo dzi, eye wòkpɔ be ameha gã aɖe gbɔna ye gbɔ la, ebia Filipo be: "Afi kae míakpɔ abolo le aƒle na ame siawo woaɖu? " 6 Ke hã ɖe wògblɔ esia be yeatsɔ adoe kpɔ, elabena eya ŋutɔ nya nu si wɔ ge wòala.
ENGLISH: 5 So Jesus, raising his eyes and seeing the sight of a great crowd coming to him, said to Philip "Where shall we buy bread for these to eat? " 6 But he was saying this to test him; for he himself knew what he was going to do.

EWE: 7 Filipo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Abolo denario alafa eve gɔ̃ hã made wo nu be wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nakpɔ vi aɖe aɖu o. " 8 Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka si nye Andrea, Simon Petro nɔvi, gblɔ nɛ be: 9 "Ŋutsuvi aɖe le afii, si si ƒobolo atɔ̃ kple tɔmelã sue eve le. Gake afi kae esia ade na ame gbogbo siawo? "
ENGLISH: 7 Philip answered him "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not enough for them each to take a little bit. " 8 One of his disciples, Simon Peter’s brother Andrew, said to him 9 "There is a child here who has five barley cakes and two fish for relish; but what is that for so many? "

EWE: 10 Yesu gblɔ be: "Mina ameawo nanɔ anyi. "
ENGLISH: 10 Jesus said "Have the men take their seats. "

EWE: Gbe mumu geɖe le afi ma, eya ta ameawo nɔ anyi; woanɔ ŋutsu akpe atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: And there was much grass in the place; so the men took their seats, in number about five thousand.

EWE: 11 Yesu tsɔ aboloawo, eye esi wòda akpe vɔ la, ema wo na ame siwo bɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, nenema kee wòma tɔmelã sueawo hã na wo, eye ame sia ame xɔ ale si nu wòdi.
ENGLISH: 11 So Jesus took the cakes and gave thanks and distributed to the men on the grass, similarly of the fish too, as much as they wanted.

EWE: 12 Ke esi ameawo ɖi ƒo vɔ la, egblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: "Miƒo kakɛ siwo susɔ la nu ƒu, ne naneke dome nagagblẽ o. " 13 Eya ta woƒo wo nu ƒu, eye ƒobolo atɔ̃ siwo ameawo ɖu ƒe kakɛ siwo susɔ la yɔ kusi wuieve.
ENGLISH: 12 And when they were filled he said to his disciples "Pick up the fragments that were left over so that there shall not be anything lost. " 13 So they did it, and filled twelve baskets with fragments that the eaters had had left over from the five barley cakes.

EWE: 14 Eye esi ameawo kpɔ nukunu siwo wòwɔ la, wode asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Vavãe, ame siae nye Nyagblɔɖila si ƒe nya wogblɔ ɖi be ava xexea me la. " 15 Ke esi Yesu nya be wogbɔna ye lé ge aɖo fiae la, egaɖe eɖokui ɖe aga yi to la dzi.
ENGLISH: 14 So the men, seeing the token he did, said "This positively is the prophet that was to come into the world. " 15 So Jesus, finding that they were going to come and seize him to make a king of him, withdrew to the mountainside again alone by himself.

EWE: 16 Esi fiẽ ɖo la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖi va ƒua nu, 17 eye woɖo tɔdziʋu aɖe hekui ɖo ta Kapernaum. Ke zã do xoxo, gake Yesu meva wo gbɔ haɖe o. 18 Ƒu la dze agbo elabena ya sesẽ aɖe nɔ ƒoƒom.
ENGLISH: 16 And when it came evening his disciples went down to the sea 17 and got into a boat and were coming to Capernaum on the other side of the sea; and darkness had already come down and Jesus had not yet come to them, 18 and the sea was being stirred up as a high wind blew.

EWE: 19 Ke esi woku tɔdziʋua anɔ agbadroƒe etɔ̃ alo ene la, wokpɔ Yesu wòle ƒua dzi zɔm gbɔna ʋua gbɔ, eye vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo.
ENGLISH: 19 So they had rowed about three or four miles when they saw Jesus walking on the sea and getting near the boat, and they were afraid.

EWE: 20 Ke egblɔ na wo be: "Nyee, migavɔ̃ o! " 21 Eye wolɔ̃ be yewoaxɔe ɖe tɔdziʋua me, eye ʋu la va ɖi go ɖe afi si tututu woyina.
ENGLISH: 20 But he said to them "It is I, do not be afraid "; 21 so they were willing to take him into the boat, and at once the boat was at the land they were bound for.

EWE: 22 Esi ŋu ke la, ameha si nɔ ƒua ƒe go kemɛ dzi la kpɔ be tɔdziʋu bubu aɖeke mele afi ma o, negbe sue aɖe ko, eye be Yesu meɖo tɔdziʋua kple eƒe nusrɔ̃laawo o, ke boŋ eƒe nusrɔ̃laawo ɖeɖe koe dzo.
ENGLISH: 22 The next day the crowd that was standing on the other side of the sea saw that there had been no other boat there but one, and that Jesus had not got into the boat with his disciples but the disciples had gone off alone.

EWE: 23 Ke tɔdziʋuwo tso Tiberia va afi si medidi tso teƒe si woɖu abolo si ta Aƒetɔ la da akpe ɖo la gbɔ o. 24 Eya ta esi ameha la kpɔ be Yesu alo eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mele afi ma o la, woɖo woƒe tɔdziʋuwo, eye wova Kapernaum be yewoadi Yesu. 25 Esi woke ɖe eŋu le ƒua ƒe go kemɛ dzi la, wobiae be: "Rabi, ɣekaɣie nèva ɖo afi sia? " 26 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, menye esi miekpɔ dzesiwo tae miele diyem ɖo o, ke boŋ esi mieɖu abolo ɖi ƒo tae.
ENGLISH: 23 But boats from Tiberias came near the place where they had eaten the bread after the Lord gave thanks; 24 so when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples, they themselves went on board the boats and came to Capernaum looking for Jesus; 25 and, finding him on the other side of the sea, they said to him "Rabbi, when did you get here? " 26 Jesus replied to them "Verily, verily I tell you, you are looking for me not because you saw tokens but because you ate out of the bread and satisfied your appetites.

EWE: 27 Miwɔ dɔ, menye ɖe nuɖuɖu si gblẽna ta o, ke boŋ ɖe nuɖuɖu si megblẽna o, si naa agbe mavɔ, si Amegbetɔvi la ana mi la ta; elabena ame sia ŋue Fofo la, si nye Mawu ŋutɔ, kpɔ ŋudzedze ɖo. "
ENGLISH: 27 Work not for perishable food but for the food that lasts into eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you, for him the Father, God, sealed. "

EWE: 28 Eya ta wobiae be: "Nu kae míawɔ bena míawɔ Mawu ƒe dɔwo? " 29 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Mawu ƒe dɔ lae nye be miaxɔ ame si wòdɔ ɖa la dzi ase. " 30 Eye wogblɔ nɛ be: "Ekema dzesi ka wɔm nèle be míakpɔ ahaxɔ dziwò ase? Dɔ ka wɔm nèle? 31 Mía tɔgbuiwo ɖu mana le gbea dzi, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene be, ‘Ena abolo wo tso dziƒo woɖu.’ " 32 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be: Mose mena abolo vavã si tso dziƒo la mi o, ke azɔ la Fofonye na abolo vavã si tso dziƒo la mi.
ENGLISH: 28 So they said to him "What shall we do to do God’s work? " 29 Jesus replied to them "This is God’s work, for you to believe in the one he sent. " 30 So they said to him "Then what token do you do so that we may see and believe you? what do you do? 31 Our fathers ate the manna in the desert, as it says ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ " 32 So Jesus said to them "Verily, verily I tell you, not Moses has given you the bread from heaven, but my Father is giving you the true bread from heaven; 33 for God’s bread is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives the world life. " 34 So they said to him "Sir, give us this bread always. "

EWE: 33 Elabena Mawu ƒe abolo lae nye ame si ɖi tso dziƒo va, eye wònaa agbe xexea. " 34 Eya ta wogblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, nɔ abolo sia nam mí ɖaa. " 35 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Nyee nye agbebolo la.
ENGLISH: 35 Jesus said to them "I am the bread of life; he who comes to me shall not go hungry, and he who believes in me shall not go thirsty, ever; 36 but I told you you have even seen and do not believe.

EWE: 37 Ame sia ame si Fofo la tsɔ nam la ava gbɔnye, eye ame si vaa gbɔnye la, nyemanyae ɖa akpɔ o; 38 elabena meɖi tso dziƒo va, menye be mawɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke boŋ be mawɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu.
ENGLISH: 37 Whatever the Father gives me will come to me; and I will not turn out the one who comes to me, 38 because I have come down from heaven not to do my will but the will of the one who sent me.

EWE: 39 Ke esiae nye ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu be magabú ame siwo katã wòtsɔ nam la dometɔ aɖeke o, ke boŋ mafɔ wo ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke mamlɛa dzi.
ENGLISH: 39 And this is the will of the one who sent me, that of whatever he has given me I should not lose any but should raise it on the Last Day.

EWE: 40 Elabena esiae nye Fofonye ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu be ame sia ame si kpɔa Vi la, eye wòxɔa edzi sena la nakpɔ agbe mavɔ, eye mafɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke mamlɛa dzi. "
ENGLISH: 40 For this is my Father’s will, that whoever sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life and I should raise him on the Last Day. "

EWE: 41 Eye Yudatɔwo de asi liʋiliʋĩlilĩ me le eŋu, le esi wògblɔ be: "Nyee nye abolo si ɖi tso dziƒo va " la ta. 42 Eye wode asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Menye Yesu, Yosef vi, ame si fofo kple dada míenya lae nye esia oa?
ENGLISH: 41 So the Jews complained of him because he said "I am the bread that came down from heaven, " 42 and said "Why, this is Jesus the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know; how is he saying now ‘I have come down from heaven’? "

EWE: Aleke wɔ wòle gbɔgblɔm fifia be, ‘Meɖi tso dziƒo va’? " 43 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Midzudzɔ liʋiliʋĩlilĩ le mia nɔewo dome.
ENGLISH: 43 Jesus replied to them "Do not complain to each other.

EWE: 44 Ame aɖeke mate ŋu ava gbɔnye o, negbe ɖe Fofo si dɔm ɖa la, hee vɛ, eye mafɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke mamlɛa dzi.
ENGLISH: 44 Nobody can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him and I shall raise him on the Last Day.

EWE: 45 Woŋlɔ ɖe Nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe agbalẽwo me be: ‘Eye Yehowa afia nu wo katã.’ Ame sia ame si ɖoa to Fofo la, eye wòsrɔ̃a nu tso egbɔ la, vaa gbɔnye. 46 Ame aɖeke mekpɔ Fofo la kpɔ o, negbe ame si tso Mawu gbɔ ko; ame siae kpɔ Fofo la.
ENGLISH: 45 It says in the prophets ‘and they shall all be taught of God’; everyone who has heard from the Father and has learned comes to me; 46 not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God, he has seen the Father.

EWE: 47 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ame si xɔe se la, agbe mavɔ le esi.
ENGLISH: 47 "Verily, verily I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.

EWE: 48 "Nyee nye agbebolo la.
ENGLISH: 48 I am the bread of life.

EWE: 49 Mia tɔgbuiwo ɖu mana le gbea dzi, gake woku. 50 Esiae nye abolo si ɖi tso dziƒo va, eye ame sia ame si aɖu eƒe ɖe la, maku o.
ENGLISH: 49 Your fathers ate the manna in the desert and died; 50 this is the bread that comes down from heaven for a man to eat of and not die.

EWE: 51 Nyee nye agbebolo si ɖi tso dziƒo va. Ne ame aɖe ɖua abolo sia ƒe ɖe la, anɔ agbe tegbee; eye le nyateƒe me la, abolo si mana ɖe xexea ƒe agbe ta lae nye nye ŋutilã. "
ENGLISH: 51 I am the living bread that came down from heaven; if one eats of this bread he will live forever; yes, and the bread that I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world. "

EWE: 52 Eya ta Yudatɔwo de asi nyahehe me le wo nɔewo dome be: "Aleke wɔ ame sia atsɔ eƒe ŋutilã ana mí be míaɖu? " 53 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ne mieɖu Amegbetɔvi la ƒe ŋutilã, eye mieno eƒe ʋu o la, miakpɔ agbe o.
ENGLISH: 52 So the Jews wrangled with each other, saying "How can this man give us his flesh to eat? " 53 So Jesus said to them "Verily, verily I tell you, if you do not eat the Son of Man’s flesh and drink his blood you do not have life in you.

EWE: 54 Ame si ɖua nye ŋutilã, eye wònoa nye ʋu la, agbe mavɔ le esi, eye mafɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke mamlɛa dzi; 55 elabena nye ŋutilã nye nuɖuɖu vavã, eye nye ʋu nye nunono vavã.
ENGLISH: 54 He who does feast on my flesh and drink my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him on the Last Day; 55 for my flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.

EWE: 56 Ame si ɖua nye ŋutilã, eye wònoa nye ʋu la wɔa ɖeka kplim, eye nye hã mewɔa ɖeka kplii.
ENGLISH: 56 He who feasts on my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in him.

EWE: 57 Ale si ko Fofo gbagbe la dɔm ɖa, eye mele agbe le Fofo la ta la, nenema kee ame si ɖuam la, ame ma hã anɔ agbe le tanye.
ENGLISH: 57 As the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, he also who feasts on me will live too because of me.

EWE: 58 Esia nye abolo si ɖi tso dziƒo va. Mele abe esi mia tɔgbuiwo ɖu gake woku la ene o.
ENGLISH: 58 This is the bread that came down from heaven, not as the fathers ate and died; he who feasts on this bread will live forever. "

EWE: Ame si ɖua abolo sia la anɔ agbe tegbee. " 59 Nya siawoe wògblɔ esime wòle nu fiam le ƒuƒoƒe aɖe le Kapernaum. 60 Esi wosee la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ geɖe gblɔ be: "Tsoo! Nya sesẽ kae nye esia; ame kae ate ŋu ado dzi anɔ nya sia sem? " 61 Ke esi Yesu nya be yeƒe nusrɔ̃lawo le liʋiliʋĩ lĩm le nya sia ŋu la, ebia wo be: "Ðe nya sia ɖia mia nua? 62 Ekema nu kae miawɔ ne miekpɔ Amegbetɔvi la wòyina dziƒo afi si wònɔ tsã? 63 Gbɔgbɔ lae naa agbe, ŋutilã ya menyo na naneke o. Nya siwo megblɔ na mi la, gbɔgbɔ kple agbee wonye.
ENGLISH: 59 This he said in a synagogue as he was teaching in Capernaum; 60 so many of his disciples, hearing it, said "These words come hard; who can listen to him? " 61 But Jesus, knowing in himself that his disciples were complaining about this, said to them "Does this stagger you? 62 so if you see the Son of Man go up where he was formerly 63 The spirit is what gives life; the flesh is of no use; the words I have spoken to you are spirit and are life.

EWE: 64 Gake mia dometɔ aɖewo mexɔe se o. "
ENGLISH: 64 But there are some of you that do not believe. "

EWE: Elabena tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la, Yesu nya ame siwo mexɔe se o kple ame si ava dee asi.
ENGLISH: For Jesus knew from the first who it was that did not believe and who it was that was to be the agent in his arrest.

EWE: 65 Egagblɔ be: "Esia tae megblɔ na mi be, ame aɖeke mate ŋu ava gbɔnye o, negbe ɖe Fofo la ɖe mɔ nɛ hafi. "
ENGLISH: 65 And he said "That is why I have been saying to you that nobody can come to me unless it is given to him from the Father. "

EWE: 66 Le esia ta eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ geɖewo trɔ yi nu siwo le megbe la gbɔ, eye womegazɔna kplii o.
ENGLISH: 66 At this many of his disciples backed off and no longer went about with him.

EWE: Agbe mavɔ nyawo le asiwò. 69 Míexɔe se, eye míeva dze sii be wòe nye Mawu ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la. " 70 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ðe menye mi ame wuievee metia oa? Gake mia dometɔ ɖeka nye amegɔmezɔla. " 71 Le nyateƒe me la, Yuda, Simon Iskariot vi la, ŋu nya gblɔm wòle; elabena togbɔ be ame sia nye Ame Wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka hã la, egbɔna ede ge asi.
ENGLISH: 67 So Jesus said to the Twelve "Do you too mean to go? " 68 Simon Peter answered him "Sir, to whom shall we go? you have words of eternal life, 69 and for our part we do believe and know that you are God’s Holy One. " 70 Jesus answered them "Did I not choose you twelve? and one of you is a backbiter. " 71 He meant Judas the son of Simon an Iscariot; for he, one of the Twelve, was going to be the agent in his arrest.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 7 Le nu sia megbe la, Yesu yi ɖatsa le Galilea, elabena medi be yeatsa le Yudea o, le esi Yudatɔwo le didim be yewoawui ta.
ENGLISH: 7 And after this Jesus went about in Galilee; for he would not go about in Judea because the Jews were trying to kill him.

EWE: 2 Ke Yudatɔwo ƒe Agbadɔŋkekenyui la tu aƒe. 3 Eya ta nɔviaŋutsuwo gblɔ nɛ be: "Dzo le afi sia nàyi Yudea, ne wò nusrɔ̃lawo hã nakpɔ dɔ siwo wɔm nèle. 4 Elabena ame si di be amewo nanya ye la, mewɔa nu le bebeme o.
ENGLISH: 2 And the Jews’ Feast of Booths was near; 3 so his brothers said to him "Get away from here and go to Judea so that your disciples too will see your deeds that you do; 4 for nobody does anything in secret and tries to be personally a public figure.

EWE: Ne èwɔa nu siawo la, ekema ɖe ɖokuiwò fia xexea. " 5 Le nyateƒe me la, nɔviawo mexɔ edzi se o.
ENGLISH: If you are doing these things, make yourself visible to the world. " 5 For even his brothers did not believe in him.
