EWE: 6 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Nye ɣeyiɣi mede haɖe o, ke ɣeyiɣi ɖe sia ɖe sɔ na miawo ya.
ENGLISH: 6 So Jesus said to them "My time is not come yet, but your time is always ready.

EWE: 7 Susu aɖeke meli si ta xexea alé fu mi ɖo o, ke eléa fu nye ya, elabena meɖia ɖase le eŋu be eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi.
ENGLISH: 7 The world cannot hate you; but me it does hate, because I testify about it that its doings are bad.

EWE: 8 Miawo miyi ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe; nye ya nyemele ŋkekenyui sia ɖuƒe yi ge fifia o, elabena nye ɣeyiɣi mede haɖe o. " 9 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo na wo vɔ la, etsi Galilea.
ENGLISH: 8 Go up to the feast yourselves; I am not going up to this feast yet, because my time is not fully come. " 9 And, saying this to them, he stayed in Galilee.

EWE: 10 Ke esi nɔviawo yi ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe la, eya hã va yi, meyi gaglãa o, ke boŋ le adzame.
ENGLISH: 10 But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, he too went up, not openly but as it were in secret.

EWE: 11 Eya ta Yudatɔwo nɔ edim le ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe nɔ gbɔgblɔm be: "Afi kae ŋutsu ma le? " 12 Eye amehaawo do dalĩ le nya geɖewo gblɔm le eŋu. Wo dometɔ aɖewo le gbɔgblɔm be: "Ame nyui wònye. " Bubuwo gblɔ be: "Menye ame nyui aɖekee o.
ENGLISH: 11 So the Jews looked for him at the feast and said "Where is he? " 12 and there was a great deal of complaining about him in the crowds some said "He is good, " others said "No, he misleads the crowd. " 13 However, nobody spoke publicly of him for fear of the Jews.

EWE: 14 Ke esi ŋkekenyui la ƒe afã nu va yi vɔ la, Yesu yi gbedoxɔa me, eye wòde asi nufiafia me.
ENGLISH: 14 But when the feast was already at its middle Jesus went up to the temple-precinct and taught.

EWE: 15 Ale Yudatɔwo tsi yaa henɔ gbɔgblɔm be: "Aleke ame sia wɔ nya Ŋɔŋlɔawo, esi mesrɔ̃ nu le suku aɖeke o? " 16 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Nu si mefiana la menye tɔnye o, ke boŋ ame si dɔm ɖa la tɔe.
ENGLISH: 15 So the Jews wondered, saying "How is it this man knows books without having learned? "

EWE: 17 Ne ame aɖe di be yeawɔ Eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, anya nenye be nufiafia la tso Mawu gbɔ loo alo nye ŋutɔe le nu si mesusu la gblɔm.
ENGLISH: 16 So Jesus replied to them "My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me; 17 if one wants to do his will he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or I am speaking from myself.

EWE: 18 Ame si ƒoa nu tso nu si eya ŋutɔ susu ŋu la, le eya ŋutɔ ƒe kafukafu dim; ke ame si dia ame si dɔe ɖa la ƒe kafukafu la, enye nyateƒetɔ, eye alakpa aɖeke mele eme o.
ENGLISH: 18 He who speaks from himself aims at his own glory; but he who aims at the glory of the one who sent him, he is true and there is no wrong in him.

EWE: 19 Ðe menye Mose ye tsɔ Se la na mi oa?
ENGLISH: 19 Did not Moses give you the law? and no one of you lives up to the law.

EWE: Gake mia dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã mewɔa Se la dzi o.
ENGLISH: Why are you trying to kill me? "

EWE: Nu ka tae miedi be yewoawum? " 20 Ameha la ɖo eŋu be: "Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewò.
ENGLISH: 20 The crowd answered "You are possessed; who is trying to kill you? "

EWE: Ame kae di be yeawu wò? " 21 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Dɔ ɖeka ko mewɔ, eye wòwɔ nuku na mi katã.
ENGLISH: 21 Jesus replied to them "I did one deed and you are all wondering because of that.

EWE: 22 Mibu eŋu kpɔ. Mose de aʋatsotso ƒe se la na mi (menye Mose gbɔe wòtso o, ke etso tɔgbuiawo gbɔ boŋ), eye mietsoa aʋa na ame le sabat dzi.
ENGLISH: 22 Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and on the sabbath you circumcise a man.

EWE: 23 Ne wotsoa aʋa na ame le sabat dzi be woagada Mose ƒe Se la dzi o ɖe, ekema nu ka tae miedo dziku ɖe ŋunye vevie le esi meda gbe le ame aɖe ŋu le sabat dzi? 24 Midzudzɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ amewo le ale si wodzena le gotae la nu, ke boŋ midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe. "
ENGLISH: 23 If a man receives circumcision on the sabbath in order that Moses’s law may not be slighted, are you exasperated with me because I made a whole man well on the sabbath? 24 Do not judge by appearances, but pass the just judgment. "

EWE: 25 Eye Yerusalemtɔ aɖewo de asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Menye ame sia dimee wole be woawu oa? 26 Ke kpɔ ɖa, ele nu ƒom le dutoƒo, evɔ womele nya aɖeke gblɔm nɛ o. Alo ɖe dumegãwo va dze sii azɔ be ame siae nye Kristo la? 27 Ke míenya afi si ame sia tso; gake ne Kristo la va la, ame aɖeke manya afi si wòtso o. " 28 Eya ta esi Yesu le nu fiam le gbedoxɔa me la, ekɔ gbe dzi gblɔ be: "Ɛ̃, mienyam, eye mienya afi si metso hã. Eye nyemeva le nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye si o, ke boŋ Ame si dɔm ɖa la li ŋutɔŋutɔ, gake mienyae o. 29 Nye ya menyae, elabena eteƒenɔlae menye, eye eyae dɔm ɖa. " 30 Eya ta togbɔ be wodi be yewoalée hã la, ame aɖeke meka asi eŋu o, elabena eƒe gaƒoƒo la mede haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 25 So some of the Jerusalemites said "Why, this is the one they are trying to kill; 26 and here he is speaking publicly and they are saying nothing to him can it be that the rulers have positively found out that this is the Messiah? 27 But we know where this man is from; but when the Messiah comes nobody knows where he is from. " 28 So Jesus, as he was teaching in the temple-precinct, cried out "You both know me and know where I am from; and I have not come of myself, but the one who sent me is genuine whom you do not know; 29 I know him, because I am from him and he sent me. " 30 So they meant to arrest him and nobody laid a hand on him, because his hour had not come yet.

EWE: 31 Ke ameha la dometɔ geɖewo xɔ edzi se, eye wode asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Ne Kristo la va la, ɖe wòawɔ nukunu gãwo wu esiwo wɔm ŋutsu sia lea? "
ENGLISH: 31 And of the crowd many believed in him and said "Will the Messiah, when he comes, do more tokens than this man has? "

EWE: 32 Farisitɔwo se dalĩ si dom ameha la le le eŋuti le nya siawo ta, eye nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple Farisitɔwo dɔ atikplɔtɔwo ɖa be woaɖalée.
ENGLISH: 32 The Pharisees heard the crowd voicing these thoughts about him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

EWE: 33 Eye Yesu gblɔ be: "Maganɔ mia gbɔ vie hafi adzo ayi ame si dɔm ɖa la gbɔ. 34 Miadim, ke miakpɔm o, eye afi si manɔ la, miate ŋu ava afi ma o. " 35 Eya ta Yudatɔwo gblɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: "Afi kae ame sia ɖo be yeayi, si tae míagakpɔe o? Alo ɖe wòɖoe be yeayi Yudatɔ siwo kaka ɖe Helatɔwo dome la gbɔ aɖafia nu Helatɔwoa? 36 Nya sia si wògblɔ be, ‘Miadim, ke miakpɔm o, eye afi si manɔ la, miate ŋu ava afi ma o’ la gɔme ɖe? "
ENGLISH: 33 So Jesus said "I am to be with you a little while longer and go to the one that sent me; 34 you will look for me and not find me, and where I am you cannot come. " 35 So the Jews said to each other "Where is the man going, that we shall not find him? is he going to the colonies among the Greeks to teach the Greeks? 36 What is the idea of that that he said, ‘You will look for me and not find me, and where I am you cannot come’? "

EWE: 37 Ke le ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ, si nye ŋkekenyui la ƒe ŋkeke vevitɔ dzi la, Yesu tsi tsitre, eye wògblɔ sesĩe be: "Ne tsikɔ le ame aɖe wum la, neva gbɔnye ne wòano tsi.
ENGLISH: 37 And on the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out "If anybody is thirsty, come to me and drink.

EWE: 38 Ame si xɔa dzinye sena la, ‘Agbetsitɔsisiwo asi tso eme,’ " abe ale si ko ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔe ene.
ENGLISH: 38 He who believes in me will, as the text said, have rivers of living water flowing out of his body. " 39 And this he said with reference to the Spirit which those who believed in him were to receive; for there was not yet any Spirit, because Jesus was not glorified yet.

EWE: 39 Ke egblɔ esia le gbɔgbɔ si ame siwo xɔ edzi se la axɔ kpuie la ŋu; elabena womexɔ gbɔgbɔ la haɖe o, le esi womedo Yesu ɖe dzi haɖe o ta.
ENGLISH: 50 Nicodemus, he who had come to him before, said to them, being one of them, 51 "Does your law pass judgment on a man without having first heard him and found out what he is doing? " 52 They replied to him "Are you too from Galilee?

EWE: 40 Ame siwo se nya sia la dometɔ aɖewo gblɔ be: "Vavãe, ame siae nye Nyagblɔɖila la. " 41 Bubuwo le gbɔgblɔm be: "Ame siae nye Kristo la. "
ENGLISH: Look up and see that there does not arise a prophet from Galilee. " John 7:53 and John 8:1-11 are printed at the end of John.

EWE: Ke ame aɖewo hã bia be: "Ðe Kristo la atso Galilea? 42 Ðe ŋɔŋlɔ la megblɔ be David ƒe dzidzime la mee Kristo la adzɔ tso, eye wòatso Betlehem, si nye kɔƒe si me David nɔ la me oa? " 43 Eya ta ameha la dome ma le eta.
ENGLISH: STORY OF A WOMAN CAUGHT IN ADULTERY Not a part of any of the four gospels, but regarded as genuine gospel history.

EWE: 44 Togbɔ be wo dometɔ aɖewo di be yewoalée hã la, ame aɖeke meka asi eŋu o.
ENGLISH: The verses are numbered as part of the seventh and eighth chapters of John.

EWE: Dzro eme, eye àkpɔe be nyagblɔɖila aɖeke matso Galilea o. "
ENGLISH: 53 And they went their ways, each to his home.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 8 12 Eye Yesu gagblɔ na wo be: "Nyee nye xexea ƒe kekeli.
ENGLISH: 8 And Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

EWE: Ame si dzea yonyeme la mele viviti me zɔ ge akpɔ o, ke boŋ agbe ƒe kekeli anɔ esi. " 13 Eya ta Farisitɔwo gblɔ nɛ be: "Wò ŋutɔe le ɖase ɖim le ɖokuiwò ŋu; wò ɖaseɖiɖi la menye nyateƒe o. " 14 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ne nye ŋutɔe le ɖase ɖim le ɖokuinye ŋu hã la, nye ɖaseɖiɖi la nye nyateƒe, elabena menya afi si metso kple afi si meyina.
ENGLISH: 5 And in the law Moses commanded us to stone such; so what do you say? " 6 But Jesus bent over and wrote something down on the ground with his finger. 7 But when they kept pressing the question on him he straightened up and said to them "For the first let the sinless one of you throw a stone at her " 8 and bent down again and wrote on the ground. 9 And they, hearing that, went out one by one, beginning with the oldest, and he was left alone, and the woman, who was in the middle.

EWE: Ke miawo ya mienya afi si metso kple afi si meyina o.
ENGLISH: And Jesus said "Neither do I; go; no more sinning from now on. "

EWE: 15 Miedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu le amegbetɔwo ƒe nukpɔkpɔ nu; nye ya nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame aɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 14 Jesus replied to them "Even if I am giving testimony about myself, my testimony is true, because I know where I came from and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from or where I am going. 15 You judge from the standpoint of the flesh.

EWE: 16 Eye ne medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu hã la, nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la nye nyateƒe, elabena menye nye ɖekae li o, ke boŋ Fofo si dɔm ɖa la li kplim.
ENGLISH: I do not judge anybody; 16 and if I do judge my judgment is true, because I am not alone but I and the one who sent me; 17 and it is written in your law too that two men’s testimony is true.

EWE: 17 Woŋlɔ ɖe miawo ŋutɔ miaƒe Se la me hã be: ‘Ame eve ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi nye nyateƒe.’ 18 Nyee nye ame si le ɖase ɖim le ɖokuinye ŋuti, eye Fofo si dɔm ɖa la hã le ɖase ɖim le ŋunye. " 19 Eya ta wobiae be: "Afi kae Fofowò le? "
ENGLISH: 18 It is I that testify about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me. "

EWE: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Mienyam o, eye mienya Fofonye hã o.
ENGLISH: 19 So they said to him "Where is your Father? "

EWE: Ne ɖe mienyam la, anye ne mienya Fofonye hã. " 20 Egblɔ nya siawo le teƒe si nudzɔɖakawo nɔna esime wòle nu fiam le gbedoxɔa me. Ke hã ame aɖeke melée o, elabena eƒe gaƒoƒo la meɖo haɖe o.
ENGLISH: Jesus answered "You do not know either me or my Father; if you knew me you would know my Father too. " 20 These words he spoke in the treasury, teaching in the temple-precinct, and nobody arrested him because his hour had not come yet.

EWE: 21 Eya ta egagblɔ na wo be: "Nye la mele dzodzo ge, eye miadim, gake miaku ɖe miaƒe nu vɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: 21 So he said to them again "I am going, and you will look for me and will die in your sins; where I am going you cannot come. "

EWE: Afi si yim mele la, miate ŋu ava o. " 22 Yudatɔwo de asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Ðe wòyina eɖokui wu gea? Elabena egblɔ be, ‘Afi si yim mele la, miate ŋu ava o.’ " 23 Egagblɔ na wo be: "Miawo la, anyigba dzie mietso; nye ya dziƒoe metso. Miawo mietso xexe sia me; nye ya nyemetso xexe sia me o. 24 Eya tae megblɔ na mi be: Miaku ɖe miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo me ɖo.
ENGLISH: 22 So the Jews said "Will he kill himself, that he says ‘Where I am going you cannot come’? " 23 And he said to them "You belong to those below, I belong to those above; you are out of this world, I am not out of this world; 24 so I told you you would die in your sins, for if you do not believe I am the one, die in your sins you will. "

EWE: Elabena ne miexɔe se be nyee o la, miaku ɖe miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo me. " 25 Eya ta wobiae be: "Ame kae nènye? "
ENGLISH: 25 So they said to him "Who are you? " Jesus said to them ". . . in the first place that I am even speaking to you.

EWE: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Nu ka tae megale nu ƒom kpli mi ɖo ya? 26 Nya geɖewo le asinye magblɔ tso mia ŋu, eye nu geɖewo li si ŋu madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le.
ENGLISH: 26 I have much speaking and judging about you to do; but the one who sent me is truthful, and I speak into the world what I heard from him. "

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, Ame si dɔm ɖa la nye nyateƒetɔ, eye nu siwo tututu mese tso egbɔ la, nu siawo gblɔm mele le xexea me. " 27 Womese egɔme be Fofo la ŋue wòle nu ƒom le na yewo o.
ENGLISH: 27 They did not see that he meant the Father.

EWE: 28 Eye Yesu gblɔ be: "Ne miehe Amegbetɔvi la ɖe ati ŋu vɔ hafi miadze sii be nyee, eye be nyemewɔa naneke le ɖokuinye si o; ke boŋ nu siwo tututu Fofo la fiam lae megblɔna.
ENGLISH: 28 So Jesus said "When you raise the Son of Man aloft, then you will find out that I am the one and am doing nothing of myself, but as the Father instructed me, so I speak.

EWE: 29 Eye Ame si dɔm ɖa la li kplim; megblẽ nye ɖeka ɖi o, elabena mewɔa nu siwo dzea eŋu ɣesiaɣi. " 30 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo la, ame geɖewo xɔ edzi se.
ENGLISH: 29 And the one who sent me is with me; he does not leave me alone, because I always do what is pleasing to him. " 30 As he spoke these words many believed in him.

EWE: 31 Yesu gagblɔ na Yudatɔ siwo xɔ edzi se la be: "Ne mieyi edzi lé nye nya la me ɖe asi la, ekema nye nusrɔ̃lawo mienye vavã, 32 eye miadze si nyateƒe la, eye nyateƒe la ana ablɔɖe mi. " 33 Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwoe míenye, eye míenye kluviwo na ame aɖeke kpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 31 So Jesus said to the Jews that had believed him "If you remain in my words you are really disciples of mine 32 and shall know the truth, and the truth will set you free. " 33 They answered back "We are Abraham’s descendants and have never yet been slaves to anybody; how is it you say ‘you will be set free’? "

EWE: Nu ka ŋuti nègblɔ be, ‘Woana ablɔɖe mi’? " 34 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ame sia ame si wɔa nu vɔ̃ la, nu vɔ̃ ƒe kluvi wònye.
ENGLISH: 34 Jesus answered "Verily, verily I tell you that everyone who commits sin is a slave of sin.

EWE: 35 Eye kluvi menɔa aƒe me ɖaa o; vi ya nɔa anyi ɖaa.
ENGLISH: 35 And the slave does not stay in the house forever; the son does.

EWE: 36 Eya ta ne Vi la na ablɔɖe mi la, ekema mianye ablɔɖeviwo vavã.
ENGLISH: 36 So if the Son sets you free you will be really free.

EWE: 37 Menya be Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwoe mienye.
ENGLISH: 37 I know you are Abraham’s descendants; but you are trying to kill me because my words do not find room in you.

EWE: Gake miele didim be yewoawum, elabena miexɔ nye nufiafia la o.
ENGLISH: 38 I speak what I have seen in Father’s home; so do on your part what you heard from Father. "

EWE: 38 Nu siwo mekpɔ le Fofonye gbɔ lae megblɔna; eye miawo hã nu siwo miese tso mia fofo gbɔ lae miewɔna. " 39 Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Mía fofoe nye Abraham. "
ENGLISH: 39 They replied "Abraham is our father. "

EWE: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Ne Abraham viwoe mienye la, anye ne miawɔ Abraham ƒe dɔwo.
ENGLISH: Jesus said to them "If you are Abraham’s children, do Abraham’s deeds.

EWE: 40 Ke azɔ miele didim be yewoawu, nye ame si gblɔ nyateƒe si mese tso Mawu gbɔ la na mi. Abraham mewɔ nu alea o.
ENGLISH: 40 But now you are trying to kill me, a man that have spoken the truth to you, which I heard from God; Abraham did not do that.

EWE: 41 Mia fofo ƒe dɔwo miewɔna. "
ENGLISH: 41 You are doing your father’s deeds. "

EWE: Wogblɔ nɛ be: "Menye ahasiviwo míenye o; Fofo ɖekae le mía si, eyae nye Mawu. "
ENGLISH: They said to him "We were not born illegitimately; we have one father, God. "

EWE: 42 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Ne Mawue nye mia Fofo la, anye ne mielɔ̃m, elabena Mawu gbɔe metso va afi sia. Nyemeva le ɖokuinye si o, ke boŋ Ame mae dɔm ɖa.
ENGLISH: 42 Jesus said to them "If God were your father you would love me, for I went out from God and come from him; for I have not come of myself either, but he sent me.

EWE: 43 Nu ka tae miese nya si gblɔm mele la gɔme o? Elabena miate ŋu ase nye nya o.
ENGLISH: 43 Why do you not get the meaning of my talk? because you cannot hear my words.

EWE: 44 Miawo la mietso mia fofo si nye Abosam me, eye mia fofo la ƒe nudzodzrowoe miedina be yewoawɔ.
ENGLISH: 44 You come of your father the Devil, and it is your father’s desires that you want to act out.

EWE: Eya la amewulae wònye tso eƒe aglãdzeɣi ke, eye meli ke ɖe nyateƒe la me o, elabena nyateƒe mele eme o.
ENGLISH: He was a man-killer from the first, and did not keep his stand in the truth because there is no truth in him.

EWE: Ne ele aʋatso kam la, eƒoa nu tso eɖokui me, elabena aʋatsokala kple aʋatsokafofo wònye.
ENGLISH: When he speaks falsehood he speaks a thing of his own, because he is a liar and father of it.

EWE: 45 Ke esi nye ya mele nyateƒe tom ta la, miexɔ dzinye se o.
ENGLISH: 45 And because I tell the truth you do not believe me.

EWE: 46 Mia dometɔ kae ate ŋu abu fɔm le nu vɔ̃ aɖe ŋu?
ENGLISH: 46 Which of you convicts me of a sin?

EWE: Ne nyateƒe tom mele la, ekema nu ka tae miexɔ dzinye se o? 47 Ame si tso Mawu me la ɖoa to Mawu ƒe nyawo.
ENGLISH: If I tell truth, why do you not believe me? 47 He who is from God hears God’s words; consequently it is because you are not from God that you do not hear. "

EWE: Esia tae mieɖoa to o, elabena mietso Mawu me o. "
ENGLISH: 48 The Jews replied "Are we not right in saying you are a Samaritan and have a demon? "

EWE: 48 Yudatɔwo gblɔ nɛ be: "Ðe míegblɔe wòsɔ be, ‘Samariatɔ nènye, eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewò oa’? " 49 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ mele menye o, ke boŋ mele bubu dem Fofonye ŋu, ke miawo miele vlo domem.
ENGLISH: 49 Jesus answered "I do not have a demon; but I am honoring my Father and you are dishonoring me.

EWE: 50 Ke nyemele kafukafu dim na ɖokuinye o; Ame aɖe li, si le edim, eye wònye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la.
ENGLISH: 50 But I am not looking out for my glory; there is one who looks out and judges.

EWE: 51 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ne ame aɖe wɔa nye nya dzi la, maɖɔ ku akpɔ gbeɖe o. " 52 Yudatɔwo gblɔ nɛ be: "Azɔ ko míenya be gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewò.
ENGLISH: 51 Verily, verily I tell you, if one keeps my words he shall not behold death forevermore. " 52 The Jews said to him "Now we know you have a demon.

EWE: Abraham ku, nyagblɔɖilawo hã ku, evɔ wò ya nèle gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Ne ame aɖe wɔ nye nya dzi la, maɖɔ ku akpɔ gbeɖe o.’ 53 Ðe nènye gã wu mía fofo Abraham, ame si ku la? Nyagblɔɖilawo hã ku.
ENGLISH: Abraham died, and the prophets, and you say ‘if one keeps my words he shall not taste death forevermore.’ 53 Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? and the prophets died; whom are you claiming to be? "

EWE: Ame kae nèle ɖokuiwò bumee? " 54 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Ne nye ŋutɔe kafua ɖokuinye la, ekema nye kafukafu la menye naneke o.
ENGLISH: 54 Jesus answered "If I glorify myself there is nothing to my glory.

EWE: Fofonye, si miebe eyae nye miaƒe Mawu lae kafuam. 55 Gake mienyae o, ke nye ya menyae.
ENGLISH: It is my Father that glorifies me, who you say is your God, 55 and you do not know him.

EWE: Eye ne megblɔ be nyemenyae o la, ekema mezu aʋatsokala abe miawo ke ene.
ENGLISH: But I do know him; and if I say I do not know him I shall be a liar like you; but I know him and keep his words.

EWE: Gake menyae, eye meléa eƒe nya la me ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 56 Your father Abraham exulted that he should see my day, and he saw it and was glad. "

EWE: 56 Mia fofo Abraham tso aseye be yeakpɔ nye ŋkeke la, ekpɔe hã, eye dzi dzɔe. " 57 Yudatɔwo biae be: "Mèkpɔ xɔ ƒe blaatɔ̃ haɖe o, evɔ nèbe yekpɔ Abraham mahã? " 58 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, hafi Abraham nava dzɔ la, nye ya meli xoxo. " 59 Ale wofɔ kpewo be yewoaƒui, ke Yesu si bè, eye wòdo go le gbedoxɔa me.
ENGLISH: 57 So the Jews said to him "You are not yet fifty years old, and has Abraham seen you? " 58 Jesus said to them "Verily, verily I tell you, before there was an Abraham I am. " 59 So they picked up stones to throw at him. But Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple-precinct.

ENGLISH: John

EWE: 9 Esi wòtso eme va yina la, ekpɔ ŋutsu aɖe si wodzi ŋkuagbãtɔe.
ENGLISH: 9 And as he passed along he saw a man blind from birth.

EWE: 2 Eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo biae be: "Rabi, ame kae wɔ nu vɔ̃ be wodzi ame sia ŋkuagbãtɔe, eya ŋutɔe loo alo edzilawo yea? " 3 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Menye ame sia alo edzilawoe wɔ nu vɔ̃ o, ke boŋ be woaɖe Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo afia to edzi tae.
ENGLISH: 2 And his disciples asked him "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he should be born blind? " 3 Jesus answered "Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but it was in order that God’s doings might be disclosed in him.

EWE: 4 Zi ale si ŋkeke li la, ele be míawɔ Ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe dɔwo; zã le dodo ge, esime ame aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dɔ o.
ENGLISH: 4 We must do the work of the one who sent me while it is day; there is coming a night when nobody can work.

EWE: 5 Zi ale si mele xexea me la, nyee nye xexea ƒe kekeli. " 6 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, eɖe ta ɖe anyigba, eye wòtsɔ ta la nya anyi, eye wòtsɔ anyi la sisi ɖe ŋutsua ƒe ŋkuwo dzi, 7 eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Heyi ɖaklɔ ŋkume le Siloam-ta la me " (woɖea Siloam gɔme be "Wodɔe Ða ").
ENGLISH: 5 When I am in the world I am the light of the world. " 6 Saying this, he spat on the ground and made mud out of the spit, and put the mud on his eyes, 7 and said to him "Go wash your face in the pool of Siloam " (the translation of which is "Sent ").

EWE: Eya ta eyi ɖaklɔ ŋkume, eye wòle nu kpɔm hafi trɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: So he went and washed his face, and came back able to see.

EWE: 8 Eye eƒe aƒelikawo kple ame siwo kpɔnɛ wònɔa nu biam tsã la de asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Menye ame siae bɔbɔ nɔa anyi nɔa nu biam oa? " 9 Ame aɖewo gblɔ be: "Eyae. "
ENGLISH: 8 So the neighbors and those who had formerly seen him to be a beggar said "Is not this the one that was sitting and begging? " 9 Some said "This is the one "; others said "No, but he is like him. "

EWE: Bubuwo hã be: "Kpao, amee ɖi ame. "
ENGLISH: He said "I am the one. "

EWE: Gake ŋutsua ŋutɔ gblɔ be: "Nyee. " 10 Eya ta wobiae be: "Ekema aleke wɔ wò ŋkuwo ʋu? " 11 Eɖo eŋu be: "Ame si woyɔna be Yesu lae nya anyi tsɔ sisi ɖe nye ŋkuwo dzi, eye wògblɔ nam be, ‘Yi ɖaklɔ ŋkume le Siloam-ta la me.’ Eya ta meyi ɖaklɔ ŋkume, eye mele nu kpɔm. " 12 Eye wobiae be: "Afi kae wòle? "
ENGLISH: 10 So they said to him "Then how were your eyes opened? " 11 He answered "The man known as Jesus made mud and rubbed it on my eyes and told me ‘go to Siloam and wash your face’; so I went and washed my face and had my eyesight back. " 12 And they said to him "Where is he? "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu be: "Nyemenya o. "
ENGLISH: He said "I do not know. "

EWE: 13 Wokplɔ ŋutsu si nye ŋkuagbãtɔ tsã la yi Farisitɔwo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 13 So they brought him (the once blind man) to the Pharisees.

EWE: 14 Ke ŋkeke si dzi Yesu nya anyi tsɔ ʋu ŋku na amea la nye Sabat.
ENGLISH: 14 And the day on which Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes was sabbath.

EWE: 15 Eya ta Farisitɔwo hã gabiae be wòagblɔ ale si wòwɔ hafi eƒe ŋku ʋu la na yewo.
ENGLISH: 15 So the Pharisees too asked him again how he recovered his sight.

EWE: Egblɔ na wo be: "Esisi anyi ɖe nye ŋkuwo dzi, eye meyi ɖaklɔe, eye mele nu kpɔm. " 16 Le esia ta Farisitɔ aɖewo de asi gbɔgblɔ me be: "Menye Mawu gbɔe ame sia tso o, elabena mewɔna ɖe Sabat la dzi o. " Bubuwo hã gblɔ be: "Aleke nu vɔ̃ wɔla ate ŋu awɔ dzesi siawo tɔgbi? " Ale mama ɖo wo dome.
ENGLISH: And he said to them "He put mud on my eyes, and I washed my face, and can see. " 16 So some of the Pharisees said "This man is not from God, because he does not keep the sabbath "; others said "How can a sinful man do such tokens? " and there was a split among them.

EWE: 17 Eye wogabia ŋkuagbãtɔ la be: "Esi wònye wòe wòʋu ŋku na ɖe, nya ka gblɔm nèle le eŋu? "
ENGLISH: 17 So they said to the blind man again "What do you say about him because he opened your eyes? "

EWE: Ŋutsua ɖo eŋu be: "Nyagblɔɖilae wònye. "
ENGLISH: And he said "That he is a prophet. "

EWE: 19 Eye wobia wo be: "Mia vi si miebe yewodzi ŋkuagbãtɔ lae nye esia? Aleke wɔ wòle nu kpɔm fifia? " 20 Edzilawo ɖo eŋu be: "Míenya be mía vie wònye, eye ŋkuagbãtɔe wònye míedzi. 21 Ke ale si wòdzɔe be wòle nu kpɔm azɔ la, míenyae o, eye míenya ame si ʋu ŋku nɛ hã o. Mibiae. Etsi. Eya ŋutɔ neɖe eɖokui nu. " 22 Edzilawo gblɔ nya siawo, elabena wole vɔvɔ̃m na Yudatɔwo, elabena Yudatɔwo ɖoe da ɖi be, ne ame aɖe ʋu eme be eyae nye Kristo la, woanyae le ƒuƒoƒe la.
ENGLISH: 18 So the Jews did not believe about him that he had been blind and had recovered his sight until they had called his parents, the cured man’s, 19 and asked them "This is your son, who you say was born blind; then how is it he can see now? " 20 So his parents replied "We know that this is our son and that he was born blind; 21 but how it is he can see now we do not know, or who opened his eyes; we do not know, ask him; he is of age, he will speak for himself. " 22 This his parents said because they were afraid of the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if anybody acknowledged him as Messiah he should be excommunicated.

EWE: 23 Esia tae edzilaawo gblɔ be: "Etsi. Mibia eya ŋutɔ. "
ENGLISH: 23 This was why his parents said "he is of age, he will speak for himself. "

EWE: 24 Eya ta wogayɔ ame si nye ŋkuagbãtɔ tsã la vɛ zi evelia, eye wogblɔ nɛ be: "Tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe na Mawu nàto nyateƒe na mí; míawo ya míenya be nu vɔ̃ wɔlae ame sia nye. " 25 Eɖo eŋu be: "Ne nu vɔ̃ wɔlae wònye la, nye ya nyemenya o.
ENGLISH: 24 So they called in for the second time the man who had been blind, and said to him "Give glory to God; we know that this man is sinful. " 25 So he answered "Whether he is sinful I do not know; one thing I do know, that I was blind and now can see. "

EWE: Nu ɖeka ko menya: eyae nye be ŋkuagbãtɔe menye tsã, ke azɔ la mele nu kpɔm. " 26 Wobiae be: "Nu kae wòwɔ na wò? Aleke wòwɔ ʋu wò ŋkuawo na wò? " 27 Eɖo eŋu na wo be: "Megblɔe na mi xoxo, gake miesee o. Nu ka tae miedi be yewoagasee?
ENGLISH: 26 So they said to him "What did he do to you? how did he open your eyes? " 27 He answered "I told you already and you did not hear; what do you want to hear again for? do you too want to become disciples of him? " 28 And they abused him and said "You are a disciple of him, but we are disciples of Moses.

EWE: Alo ɖe miawo hã miedi be yewoazu eƒe nusrɔ̃lawoa? " 28 Eye wogblɔ nɛ fewuɖutɔe be: "Wòe nye eƒe nusrɔ̃la, míawo ya Mose ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo míenye.
ENGLISH: 29 We know God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man we do not know where he comes from. "

EWE: 29 Míenya be Mawu ƒo nu kple Mose; ke ame sia ya míenya afi si wòtso o. " 30 Ŋutsua ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ewɔ nuku ŋutɔ be mienya afi si wòtso o, evɔ wòte ŋu ʋu nye ŋkuwo.
ENGLISH: 30 The man replied "Now that is just what is remarkable, that you do not know where he comes from and he opened my eyes.

EWE: 31 Míenya be Mawu meɖoa to nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo o, gake ne ame aɖe vɔ̃a Mawu, eye wòwɔa eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, Mawu ɖoa toe.
ENGLISH: 31 We know that God does not listen to sinners, but if one is religious and does his will, him he does listen to.

EWE: 32 Tso keke blema ke la, míesee kpɔ be ame aɖe ʋu ŋku na ame si wodzi ŋkuagbãtɔe o.
ENGLISH: 32 Since the beginning of time it was never heard that anybody had opened the eyes of a person born blind.

EWE: 33 Ne menye Mawu gbɔe ame sia tso o la, mate ŋu awɔ naneke o. " 34 Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Wò ame si wodzi ɖe nu vɔ̃ me koŋ la, wòe be yeafia nu mía? "
ENGLISH: 33 If this man were not from God he could not do anything. " 34 They replied "You were born all in sins, and are you teaching us? " and turned him out.

EWE: Eye wonyae do goe! 35 Yesu see be wonyae do goe, eye esi wòkpɔe la, ebiae be: "Èxɔ Amegbetɔvi la dzi sea? " 36 Ŋutsua ɖo eŋu be: "Aƒetɔ, ame kae nye ame ma, be maxɔ edzi ase? " 37 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Èkpɔe, eye le nyateƒe me la, nye ame si le nu ƒom kpli wò lae. " 38 Egblɔ be: "Aƒetɔ, mexɔ edzi se. "
ENGLISH: 35 Jesus heard that they had turned him out, and found him and said to him "You believe on the Son of Man? " 36 He replied "And who is he, sir? so that I may believe in him. " 37 Jesus said to him "You have seen him, yes, and he is the one that is speaking with you. " 38 And he said "I believe, sir, " and did reverence to him.

EWE: Eye wòdze klo tsyɔ mo anyi ɖe eŋkume. 39 Yesu gblɔ be: "Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ si ta meva xexea me ɖo lae nye be ame siwo mele nu kpɔm o la nakpɔ nu, eye ame siwo le nu kpɔm la nazu ŋkuagbãtɔwo. " 40 Farisitɔ siwo le egbɔ la se nya siawo, eye wobiae be: "Gake míawo ya míenye ŋkuagbãtɔwo o ɖe? " 41 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Ne ŋkuagbãtɔwoe mienye la, anye ne nu vɔ̃ aɖeke mele mia ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 39 And Jesus said "It was for a judgment I came into this world: that those who cannot see may see and those who can may become blind. " 40 Some of the Pharisees, those who were with him, heard this and said to him "Are we blind too? "

EWE: Gake miele gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Míele nu kpɔm.’ Eya ta miaƒe nu vɔ̃ la tsi anyi. "
ENGLISH: 41 Jesus said to them "If you were blind you would not have any sin; but now you say ‘We can see’ your sin stands.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 10 "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ame si metoa agbo la nu gena ɖe alẽkpo la me o, ke boŋ wòlia teƒe bubu gena ɖe eme la, fiafitɔ kple adzodalae wònye. 2 Ke ame si toa agboa nu gena ɖe eme la, eyae nye alẽawo ƒe kplɔla.
ENGLISH: 10 "Verily, verily I tell you, he who does not come into the fold of sheep through the door but climbs in elsewhere, that man is a thief and a robber; 2 but he who comes in through the door is shepherd of those sheep.

EWE: 3 Agbonudzɔla la ʋunɛ nɛ, eye alẽawo sea eƒe gbe. Eyɔa eƒe alẽwo ƒe ŋkɔ, eye wòkplɔa wo doa goe.
ENGLISH: 3 To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his sheep by name and leads them out.

EWE: 4 Ne ekplɔ eya ŋutɔ tɔwo katã do goe la, edzea wo ŋgɔ, eye alẽawo dzea eyome, elabena wodze si eƒe gbe.
ENGLISH: 4 When he gets out all that are his, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice; 5 but a man they do not belong to they will not follow but will run away from him, because they do not know the voices of men they do not belong to. "

EWE: 5 Womadze ame tutɔ yome gbeɖe o, ke boŋ woasi le egbɔ, elabena womedzea si ame tutɔwo ƒe gbe o. " 6 Yesu do lo sia na wo, gake womese nya siwo gblɔm wòle na wo la gɔme o.
ENGLISH: 6 This parable Jesus told them; but they did not know what the things he spoke to them meant.

EWE: 7 Eya ta Yesu gagblɔ be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be: Nyee nye agbo na alẽawo.
ENGLISH: 7 So Jesus said again "Verily, verily I tell you that I am the door for the sheep.

EWE: 8 Ame siwo katã va ɖe tenyeƒe la, fiafitɔwo kple adzodalawo wonye; ke alẽawo meɖo to wo o.
ENGLISH: 8 All that came before me are thieves and robbers; but the sheep did not listen to them.

EWE: 9 Nyee nye agbo la; ame sia ame si toa menye yina ɖe eme la akpɔ ɖeɖe, eye wòayi ɖe eme agado go, eye wòakpɔ gbeɖuƒe.
ENGLISH: 9 I am the door; anyone who enters through me will be safe and sound and go in and out and find pasturage.

EWE: 10 Fiafitɔ la mevana ne menye le fififi, amewuwu kple nugbegblẽ ta o. Nye la meva be woakpɔ agbe, eye be woakpɔe le agbɔsɔsɔ me.
ENGLISH: 10 The thief comes only to steal and kill and waste; I came that they may have life and plenty of it.

EWE: 11 Nyee nye alẽkplɔla nyui la; alẽkplɔla nyui la tsɔa eƒe agbe ɖoa anyi ɖe alẽawo ta.
ENGLISH: 11 I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

EWE: 12 Ne apadɔwɔla, si woxɔ be wòakpɔ alẽawo dzi, eye alẽawo menye etɔ o, kpɔ amegãxi wògbɔna la, egblẽa alẽawo ɖi hesina eye amegãxi la léa ɖewo eye mamlɛawo kana gbẽe 13 elabena apadɔwɔla wònye, eye meléa be na alẽawo o. 14 Nyee nye alẽkplɔla nyui la.
ENGLISH: 12 The hired man, who is not actual shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and runs, and the wolf carries them off and scatters them; 13 because he is a hired man and does not care about the sheep.

EWE: Menya nye alẽwo, eye nye alẽawo nyam, 15 abe ale si ko Fofo la nyam, eye nye hã menya Fofo la ene; eye metsɔ nye agbe ɖo anyi ɖe alẽawo ta.
ENGLISH: 14 I am the good shepherd, and I know mine and mine know me, 15 as the Father knows me and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.

EWE: 16 "Eye alẽ bubuwo le asinye, siwo metso alẽkpo sia me o; ele nam be makplɔ woawo hã vɛ, eye woase nye gbe, eye woazu alẽha ɖeka, alẽkplɔla ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 16 And I have other sheep which do not belong to this fold; those too I must bring, and they will hear my voice, and there will come to be one flock, one shepherd.

EWE: 17 Esia tae Fofo la lɔ̃am ɖo, elabena metsɔ nye agbe ɖo anyi, ne magaxɔe ake.
ENGLISH: 17 "That is why the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, to take it again.

EWE: 18 Ame aɖeke mexɔe le asinye o, ke boŋ nye ŋutɔe tsɔe na le ɖokuinye si.
ENGLISH: 18 Nobody has deprived me of it, but I lay it down of my own accord.

EWE: Ŋusẽ le asinye be matsɔe ana, eye ŋusẽ le asinye be magaxɔe. Fofonyee de esia ƒe se nam. "
ENGLISH: I am authorized to lay it down and I am authorized to take it again; I was given this commission by my Father. "

EWE: 19 Mama gaɖo Yudatɔwo dome le nya siawo ta.
ENGLISH: 19 There came a split among the Jews again because of these words.

EWE: 20 Wo dometɔ geɖewo le gbɔgblɔm be: "Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le eme, aɖaʋatɔe. Nu ka tae miele to ɖomee? " 21 Bubuwo be: "Menye ame si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le ƒe nyawoe nye esiawo o. Ðe gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ ate ŋu aʋu ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔwoa? "
ENGLISH: 20 And many of them said "He has a demon-possession and is out of his head; why do you listen to him? " 21 others said "These words are not a possessed man’s; can a demon-possession open blind men’s eyes? "

EWE: 22 Ɣemaɣi Gbedoxɔŋukɔkɔŋkekenyui la ɖo edzi le Yerusalem. Vuvɔŋɔlie, 23 eye Yesu le tsa ɖim le gbedoxɔa me le Salomo ƒe akpata la me.
ENGLISH: 22 At that time came the feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem; it was winter; 23 and Jesus was walking in the temple-precinct, in Solomon’s Porch.

EWE: 24 Eye Yudatɔwo va ƒo xlãe hebiae be: "Ɣekaɣi nàna míalala ase ɖo? Ne wòe nye Kristo la, gblɔe na mí faa. " 25 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Megblɔe na mi, gake miexɔe se o.
ENGLISH: 24 So the Jews surrounded him and said to him "How long are you keeping us in suspense? if you are the Messiah, tell us frankly. " 25 Jesus answered them "I told you and you do not believe.

EWE: Dɔ siwo wɔm mele le Fofonye ƒe ŋkɔ me la, woawoe le ɖase ɖim le ŋunye. 26 Ke miawo ya miexɔe se o, elabena menye nye alẽwoe mienye o.
ENGLISH: The very deeds I am doing in my Father’s name testify about me; 26 but you do not believe because you are not sheep of mine.

EWE: 27 Nye alẽwo sea nye gbe, menya wo, eye wodzea yonyeme. 28 Menaa agbe mavɔ wo, womatsrɔ̃ akpɔ gbeɖe o, eye ame aɖeke mele wo xɔ ge le asinye sesẽe o.
ENGLISH: 27 My sheep listen to my voice, and I know them, and they follow me, 28 and I give them eternal life, and they shall not be lost forevermore, and no one will carry them off out of my hands.

EWE: 29 Nu si Fofonye tsɔ nam la xɔ asi wu nu bubuwo katã, eye ame aɖeke mate ŋu axɔ wo le Fofo la si sesẽe o.
ENGLISH: 29 My Father who has given to me is greatest of all things, and nobody can carry off out of the Father’s hands.

EWE: 30 Nye kple Fofo la míele ɖeka. "
ENGLISH: 30 I and the Father are one. "

EWE: 31 Yudatɔwo gafɔ kpe be yewoaƒui.
ENGLISH: 31 Again the Jews lifted stones to stone him.

EWE: 32 Yesu bia wo be: "Mewɔ dɔ nyui geɖe siwo Fofonye de asi nam la fia mi.
ENGLISH: 32 Jesus answered "I showed you many good works from the Father; for which of them are you stoning me? "

EWE: Dɔ siawo dometɔ ka tae miele kpe ƒu gem ɖo? " 33 Yudatɔwo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Menye dɔ nyui wɔwɔ tae míele kpe ƒu ge wò ɖo o, ke boŋ le busunyagbɔgblɔ ta; elabena togbɔ be amegbetɔe nènye hã la, èwɔ ɖokuiwò mawui. " 34 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ðe womeŋlɔ ɖe miaƒe Se la me be, ‘Mebe: "Mawuwo mienye " oa’? 35 Ne eyɔ ame siwo Mawu ƒe nya la bu fɔ la be ‘mawuwo,’ evɔ wogadea asixɔxɔ ŋɔŋlɔ la ŋu la, 36 ɖe miele gbɔgblɔm na nye, ame si ŋuti Fofo la kɔ hedɔ ɖe xexea me la be, ‘Ègblɔ busunya,’ elabena megblɔ be ‘Mawu ƒe Vie menyea’? 37 Ne nyemele Fofonye ƒe dɔwo wɔm o la, ekema migaxɔ dzinye se o.
ENGLISH: 33 The Jews answered "We are not stoning you in reference to a good work, but to a blasphemy and because you, being a man, are claiming to be God. " 34 Jesus answered "Is it not set down in your law ‘I said, You are gods’? 35 If he called those men gods, those who had had God’s word coming to them, and the text cannot be invalidated, 36 do you say of the one whom the Father consecrated and sent into the world ‘You are blaspheming’ because I said ‘I am God’s son’? 37 If I do not do my Father’s deeds, do not believe me; 38 but if I do, even if you do not believe me believe the deeds, that you may find out and know that the Father is in me and I am in the Father. "

EWE: 40 Eye wògadzo yi Yordan godo, le afi si Yohanes nɔ amewo nyrɔm le tsã, eye wònɔ afi ma. 41 Ame geɖewo va egbɔ, eye wode asi gbɔgblɔ me le wo nɔewo dome be: "Yohanes mewɔ dzesi ɖeka pɛ hã o, gake nya siwo katã Yohanes gblɔ tso ame sia ŋu la nye nyateƒe. " 42 Eye ame geɖewo xɔ edzi se le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 39 So they again meant to arrest him; and he came out of their hands, 40 and went off across the Jordan again to the place where John had first been when he was baptizing, and stayed there; 41 and many came to him and said "John did not do any token, but everything John said about this man was true "; 42 and many believed in him there.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 11 Azɔ ŋutsu aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Lazaro la le dɔ lém. Etso Betania, si nye kɔƒe si me Maria kple nɔvianyɔnu Marta tso.
ENGLISH: 11 But there was a certain man who was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

EWE: 2 Maria siae kɔ ami ʋeʋĩ ɖe tame na Aƒetɔ la hetsɔ eƒe taɖa tutu eƒe afɔwo ŋu; nɔviae nye Lazaro si le dɔ lém la.
ENGLISH: 2 And it was the Mary that put perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet off with her hair whose brother Lazarus was sick.

EWE: 3 Eya ta nɔvianyɔnuawo ɖo du ɖe Yesu be: "Aƒetɔ, kpɔ ɖa, ame si gbɔ mèlɔ̃a nu le o la le dɔ lém. " 4 Ke esi Yesu see la, egblɔ be: "Menye kudɔe dɔléle sia nye o, ke boŋ woato edzi ahe ŋutikɔkɔe vɛ na Mawu, eye woado Mawu ƒe Vi la ɖe dzi. " 5 Yesu lɔ̃a Marta kple nɔvianyɔnua kpakple Lazaro.
ENGLISH: 3 So the sisters sent word to him "Sir, the man you are fond of is sick! " 4 And when Jesus heard it he said "This sickness is not for death, but for God’s glory, that the Son of God may be glorified through it. " 5 And Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

EWE: 6 Gake esi wòse be ele dɔ lém la, egatsi afi si wòle la ŋkeke eve. 7 Eye le esia megbe la, egblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo be: "Mina míatrɔ ayi Yudea. " 8 Nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ nɛ be: "Rabi, nyitsɔ laa koe Yudeatɔwo di be yewoaƒu kpe wò, eye nègale afi ma yi gea? " 9 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Alo menye gaƒoƒo wuievee kekeli nɔa anyi le ŋkeke me oa?
ENGLISH: 6 So when he heard that he was sick what he did then was to stay two days in the place where he was; 7 then after that he said to the disciples "Let us go to Judea again. " 8 The disciples said to him "Rabbi, just now the Jews were meaning to kill you, and are you going there again? " 9 Jesus answered "There are twelve hours to a day, are there not?

EWE: Ne ame aɖe le zɔzɔm le kekeli nu le ŋkeke me la, meklia nu o, elabena kekelia na wòle nu kpɔm. 10 Gake ne ame aɖe le zɔzɔm le zã me la, eklia nu, elabena kekeli mele eme o. "
ENGLISH: If one walks in the day he does not stub his toe, because he sees this world’s light; 10 but if one walks in the night he does, because he does not have the light in him. "

EWE: 11 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, egblɔ kpee be: "Mía xɔlɔ̃ Lazaro le alɔ̃ dɔm, gake meyina be maɖanyɔe. " 12 Nusrɔ̃laawo gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, ne alɔ̃ dɔmee wòle la, ekema eƒe lãme asẽ. " 13 Togbɔ be eƒe ku ŋue Yesu le nu ƒom tsoe hã la, woawo ya wosusui be alɔ̃ ŋutɔŋutɔ wòwɔnɛ.
ENGLISH: 11 This he said, and after that he said to them "Our friend Lazarus has gone to rest, but I am on my way to wake him up. " 12 So the disciples said to him "Sir, if he is getting rest he will recover. " 13 But Jesus had been speaking of his death; but they thought he was speaking of the rest of sleep.

EWE: 14 Eya ta Yesu ʋu eme na wo kɔtɛ be: "Lazaro ku, 15 eye dzi le dzɔyem le mia ta be nyemele afi ma o, ne miaxɔe ase.
ENGLISH: 14 So then Jesus said to them plainly "Lazarus is dead, 15 and I am glad on your account, so that you may believe, that I was not there; but let us go to him. "

EWE: Ke mina míayi egbɔ. " 16 Eya ta Toma, si woyɔna be Venɔvi la, gblɔ na etɔ nusrɔ̃lawo be: "Mina míawo hã míayi, ne míaku kplii. "
ENGLISH: 16 So Thomas, known as the Twin, said to his fellow-disciples "Let us go too, to die with him. "

EWE: 17 Esi Yesu va ɖo la, ekpɔ be Lazaro xɔ ŋkeke ene xoxo le yɔdoa me.
ENGLISH: 17 So Jesus came and found him in the tomb, where he had been four days already.

EWE: 18 Betania te ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye wo dome anɔ agbadroƒe eve.
ENGLISH: 18 And Bethany was near Jerusalem, rather more than a mile and a half off.

EWE: 19 Eye Yudatɔ geɖewo va Marta kple Maria gbɔ, be yewoafa akɔ na wo le wo nɔviŋutsua ƒe ku ta.
ENGLISH: 19 And many of the Jews had come to Mary and Martha’s to condole with them about their brother.

EWE: 20 Esi Marta se be Yesu gbɔna la, eyi ɖakpee; ke Maria ya nɔ anyi ɖe aƒea me.
ENGLISH: 20 So Martha, when she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him; but Mary was sitting in the house.

EWE: 21 Eye Marta gblɔ na Yesu be: "Aƒetɔ, ne ɖe nèle afi sia la, anye ne nɔvinye la meku o.
ENGLISH: 21 So Martha said to Jesus "Sir, if you had been here my brother would not have died; 22 and even now I know that whatever you ask God for, God will give to you. "

EWE: 22 Gake fifia gɔ̃ hã menya be nu sia nu si nàbia Mawu la, Mawu ana wò. " 23 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nɔviwò la atsi tsitre. " 24 Marta gblɔ nɛ be: "Menya be afɔ le tsitretsitsi la me le ŋkeke mlɔetɔ dzi. " 25 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nyee nye tsitretsitsi la kple agbe la.
ENGLISH: 23 Jesus said to her "Your brother shall rise. " 24 Martha said to him "I know he will rise in the resurrection on the last day. "

EWE: Ame si xɔa dzinye sena la, ne eku hã la, agagbɔ agbe; 26 eye ame sia ame si le agbe, eye wòxɔa dzinye sena la, maku akpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 25 Jesus said to her "I am Resurrection and Life; he who believes in me shall live even if he dies, 26 and anyone who lives and believes in me shall not die ever.

EWE: Èxɔ esia dzi sea? " 27 Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ɛ̃, Aƒetɔ, mexɔe se be wòe nye Kristo la, Mawu ƒe Vi si gbɔna xexea me. " 28 Esi wògblɔ esia vɔ la, eyi ɖayɔ nɔvia Maria hegblɔ nɛ dzaa be: "Nufiala la va, eye ele yɔwòm. " 29 Esi wòsee la, etso kpla, eye wòdze mɔ yi egbɔ.
ENGLISH: Do you believe that? " 27 She said to him "Yes, sir: I am believing that you are the Messiah, the son of God, who was to come into the world. " 28 And, saying this, she went away and called her sister Mary privately, saying "The Teacher is here and is calling you. " 29 And she, when she heard, started up and came to him.

EWE: 30 Yesu mekpɔ va ɖo kɔƒea me haɖe o, ke boŋ egale afi si Marta va kpee le la.
ENGLISH: 30 And Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still at the place where Martha met him.

EWE: 31 Esi Yudatɔ siwo le Maria gbɔ le aƒea me le akɔ fam nɛ la kpɔ be etso kpla do go la, wodze eyome, elabena wosusu be eyina avi fa ge le yɔdoa to.
ENGLISH: 31 So the Jews that were in the house with her and were comforting her, seeing that Mary started up and went out, followed her, thinking she was going to the tomb to weep there.

EWE: 32 Esi Maria va ɖo afi si Yesu le, eye wòkpɔe la, ebɔbɔ tsyɔ mo anyi ɖe eƒe afɔnu gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, ne ɖe nèle afi sia la, anye ne nɔvinye la meku o. " 33 Eya ta esi Yesu kpɔe wòle avi fam, eye Yudatɔ siwo va kplii la hã le avi fam la, eɖe hũ le eɖokui me, eye wòxa nu vevie.
ENGLISH: 32 So when Mary came where Jesus was, at seeing him she threw herself down at his feet, saying to him "Sir, if you had been here my brother would not have died. " 33 So Jesus, when he saw her weeping and saw the Jews that had come with her weeping, controlled himself with an effort and showed agitation, 34 and said "Where have you laid him? "

EWE: 34 Ebia be: "Afi kae mietsɔe yi ɖamlɔ? "
ENGLISH: They said to him "Sir, come and see. "

EWE: Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, va kpɔe ɖa. " 35 Yesu fa avi.
ENGLISH: 35 Jesus wept.

EWE: 36 Eya ta Yudatɔwo te gbɔgblɔ be: "Mikpɔ ale si gbegbe wòlɔ̃e ɖa! " 37 Ke wo dometɔ aɖewo gblɔ be: "Aleke wɔ ŋutsu sia si ʋu ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔa la, mete ŋu xe mɔ na ame sia ƒe ku ya o? "
ENGLISH: 36 So the Jews said "See how he loved him. " 37 But some of them said "Could not this man who opened the blind man’s eyes cause this man not to die too? "

EWE: 38 Eye esi Yesu gaɖe hũ le eɖokui me vɔ la, eva yɔdo la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 38 So Jesus, again controlling himself, came to the tomb.

EWE: Agadoe wònye, eye kpe le enu.
ENGLISH: And it was a cave, and there was a stone laid over it.

EWE: 39 Yesu gblɔ be: "Miɖe kpe la ɖa. "
ENGLISH: 39 Jesus said "Lift off the stone. "

EWE: Ke ame kukua nɔvinyɔnu Marta gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, fifia anɔ ʋeʋẽm, elabena ŋkeke enee nye esia. " 40 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Ðe nyemegblɔe na wò be ne èxɔe se la, àkpɔ Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe oa? " 41 Eya ta woɖe kpe la ɖa.
ENGLISH: Martha, the sister of the deceased, said to him "Sir, he is smelling by now, for it is four days. " 40 Jesus said to her "Did I not tell you that if you believed you should see God’s glory? " 41 So they lifted the stone off.

EWE: Azɔ Yesu wu mo dzi gblɔ be: "Fofo, meda akpe na wò be èɖo tom.
ENGLISH: And Jesus raised his eyes upward and said "Father, I thank you that you heard me.

EWE: 42 Nyateƒee, menya be èɖoa tom ɣesiaɣi; ke ameha si le tsitre ɖe afi sia tae megblɔe ɖo, ne woaxɔe ase be wòe dɔm ɖa. " 43 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, edo ɣli sesĩe be: "Lazaro lee, do go! " 44 Enumake ame si ku la do go, eye ameɖivɔ siwo wotsɔ bla asi kple afɔ nɛ gakpɔtɔ le eŋu, avɔ si wotsɔ bla mo nɛ la hã gakpɔtɔ le mo nɛ.
ENGLISH: 42 And I knew you always do hear me; but I said it because of the crowd standing around me, that they may believe that you sent me. " 43 And, having said this, he shouted in a loud voice "Lazarus, come out here! " 44 Out came the man that had died, with his feet and hands tied with strips of cloth and his face tied up in a handkerchief.

EWE: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Mitui, ne wòadzo. "
ENGLISH: Jesus said to them "Untie him and let him go. "

EWE: 45 Eya ta Yudatɔ siwo va Maria gbɔ, eye wokpɔ nu siwo wòwɔ la, dometɔ geɖewo xɔ edzi se, 46 gake wo dometɔ aɖewo yi Farisitɔwo gbɔ ɖagblɔ nu siwo Yesu wɔ la na wo.
ENGLISH: 45 So a great many of the Jews, such as had come to Mary’s and witnessed what he did, believed in him; 46 but some of them went off to the Pharisees and told them the things Jesus had done.

EWE: 47 Ale nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple Farisitɔwo ƒo Sanhedrin la nu ƒu hegblɔ be: "Nu ka wɔ ge míala, elabena ame sia le dzesi geɖewo wɔm? 48 Ne míeɖe mɔ nɛ alea la, ekema wo katã woaxɔ edzi ase, eye Romatɔwo ava xɔ míaƒe nɔƒe kple míaƒe dukɔa siaa le mía si. " 49 Ke wo dometɔ ɖeka si ŋkɔe nye Kayafa, eye wònye nunɔlagã le ƒe ma me la, gblɔ na wo be: "Mienya naneke kura o. 50 Ðe miekpɔe dze sii be ade mia dzi be ame ɖeka naku ɖe dukɔa ta wu be dukɔ bliboa natsrɔ̃ oa? " 51 Ke menye eya ŋutɔ ɖokui sie wògblɔ nya sia le o, ke boŋ esi wònye nunɔlagã le ƒe ma me ta la, egblɔe ɖi be, ele be Yesu naku ɖe dukɔ la ta, 52 eye menye ɖe dukɔ la ɖeɖe ko ta o, ke boŋ be wòaƒo Mawu ƒe vi siwo ka hlẽ la hã nu ƒu ɖekae.
ENGLISH: 47 So the chief priests and the Pharisees got together a Sanhedrin and said "What are we doing that this man is doing so many tokens? 48 if we let him go on like this everybody will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation. " 49 But one of them, a certain Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them "You folks do not know anything, 50 and you do not reflect that it is best for you to have one man die for the people and not the whole nation perish. " 51 And this he did not say of his own accord, but, being high priest that year, prophetically, that Jesus was to die for the nation, 52 and not only for the nation but to bring together God’s scattered children too into one.

EWE: 53 Ale tso ŋkeke ma dzi la, woɖo nugbe be yewoawui.
ENGLISH: 53 So from that day on they planned to kill him.

EWE: 54 Eya ta Yesu megadona ɖe Yudatɔwo dome o, ke boŋ edzo le afi ma yi nuto aɖe si te ɖe gbedzi ŋu, le du si woyɔna be Efrayim la me, eye eya kple nusrɔ̃laawo tsi afi ma.
ENGLISH: 54 So Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but went away from there to the country near the desert, to a city called Ephraim, and stayed there with the disciples.

EWE: 55 Ke Yudatɔwo ƒe Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la le ɖoɖom, eye anyigba la dzi tɔ geɖewo tso kɔƒenutowo me va Yerusalem do ŋgɔ na Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la, ne woakɔ wo ɖokuiwo ŋu le kɔa nu.
ENGLISH: 55 But it was near the Jews’ passover, and many from the country went up to Jerusalem before the passover to purify themselves.

EWE: 56 Azɔ wole Yesu dim, eye wole tsitre ɖe gbedoxɔa me, le wo nɔewo biam be: "Nu kae miesusu? Ðe megbɔna ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe kura oa? " 57 Ke nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple Farisitɔwo de se be, ne ame aɖe nya afi si Yesu le la, nena yewoanya, ne yewoalée.
ENGLISH: 56 So they looked for Jesus, and said as they stood together in the temple-precinct "What do you think? that he will not come to the feast? " 57 And the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anybody found out where he was he should give information, so that they might arrest him.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 12 Ŋkeke ade do ŋgɔ na Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi la, Yesu va ɖo Betania, afi si Lazaro si wòfɔ tso ame kukuwo dome la le.
ENGLISH: 12 So Jesus came six days before the passover to Bethany, where Lazarus, whom Jesus raised from the dead, was.

EWE: 2 Eya ta woɖo fiẽnuɖukplɔ̃ nɛ le afi ma, eye Marta le wo subɔm, eye Lazaro hã le ame siwo le kplɔ̃a ŋu kplii la dome.
ENGLISH: 2 So they gave a dinner for him there, and Martha waited on them, but Lazarus was one of those who were at the table with him.

EWE: 3 Eye Maria tsɔ nardomi akuakua, si nye ami ʋeʋĩ xɔasi aɖe, pounde ɖeka, si ɖe Yesu ƒe afɔwo ŋuti hetsɔ eƒe taɖa tutu eƒe afɔawo ŋu. Ale ami la ƒe ʋeʋẽ lilili xɔ aƒea me keŋ.
ENGLISH: 3 So Mary took a pound of high-priced perfume, nard in pistachio oil, and rubbed Jesus’s feet and wiped his feet off with her hair; and the house was filled with the odor of the perfume.

EWE: 4 Ke eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka si nye Yuda Iskariot, si le ede ge asi kpuie la, gblɔ be: 5 "Nu ka tae womedzra ami ʋeʋĩ sia denario alafa etɔ̃ hetsɔ ga la na ame dahewo o? " 6 Ke hã menye esi wòtsɔ ɖe le eme na ame dahewo tae wògblɔ nya sia ɖo o, ke boŋ fiafitɔe wònye, eye gaɖaka la le egbɔ, eye wòfia ga siwo wodana ɖe eme la. 7 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ be: "Ðe asi le eŋu, ne wòawɔ esia atsɔ adzram ɖo ɖi na nye ɖigbe. 8 Elabena ame dahewo le mia gbɔ ɖaa, ke nye ya nyemanɔ mia gbɔ ɖaa o. "
ENGLISH: 4 And Judas the Iscariot, one of his disciples, the one who was going to be the agent in his arrest, 5 said "Why was this perfume not sold for three hundred denarii and given to poor people? " 6 (But he said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief, and, having the money-box, carried off what was dropped in.) 7 So Jesus said "Let her keep it for the day of my burial; 8 for you always have the poor with you, but you do not always have me. "

EWE: 9 Yudatɔ gbogbo aɖewo va nya be ele afi ma, eye wova, menye le Yesu ɖeɖe ko ta o, ke be yewoakpɔ Lazaro, ame si wòfɔ tso ame kukuwo dome la hã.
ENGLISH: 9 So the big crowd of the Jews found out that he was there, and they came not only because of Jesus but to see Lazarus too whom he raised from the dead.

EWE: 10 Azɔ nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo ɖo nugbe be yewoawu Lazaro hã, 11 elabena eya tae Yudatɔ geɖewo yia afi ma eye wole Yesu dzi xɔm le sesem ɖo.
ENGLISH: 10 And the chief priests planned to kill Lazarus too 11 because many of the Jews went because of him and believed in Jesus.

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa! Wò fia la gbɔna, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ tedzivi dzi. " 16 Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mese nu siawo gɔme gbã o, gake esi wova do Yesu ɖe dzi megbe la, woɖo ŋku edzi be woŋlɔ nu siawo ɖi tso eŋu, eye be wowɔ nu siawo nɛ.
ENGLISH: 12 The following day the big crowd that had come to the feast, hearing that Jesus was coming into Jerusalem, 13 took the fronds of the palm trees and went out to meet him and shouted "Hosanna! blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, and the king of Israel! " 14 And Jesus, having found a little donkey, mounted it, as it says 15 "Do not be afraid, daughter of Sion: here is your King coming to you, riding on an ass colt. " 16 These things the disciples did not find out in the first place; but when Jesus was glorified they remembered that it said these things of him and they had done these things to him.

EWE: 17 Eye ameha si nɔ eŋu esime wòyɔ Lazaro sesĩe tso yɔdoa me hefɔe tso ame kukuwo dome la hã le ɖase ɖim le eŋu.
ENGLISH: 17 So the crowd that had been with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead bore witness.

EWE: 18 Esia hã tae ameha la yi ɖakpee, elabena wose be ewɔ nukunu sia.
ENGLISH: 18 It was because of this, too, that the crowd met him, because they heard that he had done this token.

EWE: 19 Eya ta Farisitɔwo gblɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: "Miekpɔea, miete ŋu le naneke wɔm o. Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 19 So the Pharisees said to each other "You see you are doing no good: there is the world gone after him. "

EWE: Xexe blibo la katãe nye ema dze eyome hoo. " 20 Ke Helatɔ aɖewo le ame siwo va ta de ge agu le ŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi la dome. 21 Eya ta ame siawo te ɖe Filipo, si tso Betsaida le Galilea ŋu, eye woɖe kuku nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, míedi be míakpɔ Yesu. " 22 Filipo va gblɔe na Andrea. Eye Andrea kple Filipo va gblɔe na Yesu.
ENGLISH: 20 And there were certain Greeks who were among those who came up to do reverence at the feast; 21 so these approached Philip, the one who came from Bethsaida in Galilee, and asked him "Sir, we wish to see Jesus. " 22 Philip came and told Andrew; Andrew and Philip came and told Jesus.

EWE: 23 Ke Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Gaƒoƒo la de be woado Amegbetɔvi la ɖe dzi.
ENGLISH: 23 And Jesus answered them "The moment has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

EWE: 24 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ne lu ƒe ku mege ɖe anyigba heku o la, ku ɖeka ko wònyena; ke ne eku la, ekema etsea ku geɖe.
ENGLISH: 24 Verily, verily I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies it is still itself alone; but if it dies it bears a great crop.

EWE: 25 Ame si lɔ̃a eƒe agbe vevie la tsrɔ̃nɛ, ke ame si léa fu eƒe agbe le xexe sia me la akpɔ eta hena agbe mavɔ.
ENGLISH: 25 He who loves his life loses it, and he who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

EWE: 26 Ne ame aɖe di be yeanye nye subɔla la, nedze yonyeme, eye afi si mele la, afi mae nye subɔla hã anɔ.
ENGLISH: 26 If one is serving me let him follow me, and where I am, there my servant too will be.

EWE: Ne ame aɖe di be yeasubɔm la, Fofo la ade bubu eŋu.
ENGLISH: If one serves me, the Father will honor him.

EWE: 27 Fifia metɔtɔ, eye nya kae magblɔ? Fofo, ɖem tso gaƒoƒo sia me.
ENGLISH: 27 Now my soul is in a turmoil; and what shall I say?

EWE: Gake gaƒoƒo sia tae meva ɖo. 28 Fofo, do wò ŋkɔ ɖe dzi. "
ENGLISH: Father, save me from this moment but it was on this account that I came to this moment; 28 Father, glorify your name. "

EWE: Kasia gbe aɖe ɖi tso dziƒo gblɔ be: "Medoe ɖe dzi, eye magadoe ɖe dzi ake. " 29 Esi ameha si le afi ma see la, wo dometɔ aɖewo gblɔ be dzie ɖe gbe.
ENGLISH: So there came a voice out of the sky "I did, and will again. " 29 So the crowd that was standing there and heard said it had thundered; others said "An angel has spoken to him. "

EWE: Gake bubuwo hã gblɔ be: "Mawudɔla aɖee ƒo nu kplii. " 30 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Menye tanyee gbe sia ɖi ɖo o, ke boŋ mia tae.
ENGLISH: 30 Jesus replied "This voice did not come on my account but on yours.

EWE: 31 Azɔ wole ʋɔnu drɔ̃m xexe sia; azɔ woaɖe xexe sia dzi ɖula la ɖa. 32 Ke nye la, ne wohem ɖe ati ŋu la, mahe ame ƒomeviwo katã ɖe ɖokuinye ŋu. " 33 Le nyateƒe me la, egblɔ esia tsɔ fia ku si ƒomevi ku ge wògbɔna kpuie la.
ENGLISH: 31 Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be put out; 32 and I, if I am lifted off the earth, shall draw everybody to myself. " 33 (And this he said indicating what death he was to die.)

EWE: 34 Eye ameha la ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Míesee le Se la me be Kristo la anɔ anyi tegbee. Ekema nu ka tae nèle gbɔgblɔm be woahe Amegbetɔvi la ɖe ati ŋu?
ENGLISH: 34 So the crowd answered him "We heard out of the Law that the Messiah stays forever, and how is it you say that the Son of Man must be lifted off? what Son of Man is this? "

EWE: Ame kae nye Amegbetɔvi sia? " 35 Eya ta Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Kekeli la aganɔ mia dome vie.
ENGLISH: 35 So Jesus said to them "For a little while longer the light is among you.

EWE: Mizɔ esime kekeli la gale mia gbɔ, ne viviti la nagakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe mia dzi o; ame si zɔa viviti me la menyaa afi si yim wòle o.
ENGLISH: Walk while you have the light, that darkness may not overtake you and he who walks in the darkness does not know where he goes.

EWE: 36 Esi kekeli la gakpɔtɔ le mia gbɔ la, mixɔ kekeli la dzi se, ne miazu kekeli viwo. "
ENGLISH: 36 While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become sons of light. "

EWE: Yesu gblɔ nya siawo, eye wòdzo le wo gbɔ yi ɖaɣla eɖokui.
ENGLISH: These things Jesus uttered, and went off and hid from them.

EWE: 37 Togbɔ be ewɔ nukunu geɖewo wokpɔ hã la, womexɔ edzi se o, 38 ale nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe nya nava eme, egblɔ be: "Yehowa, ame kae xɔ nya si wose tso mía gbɔ la dzi se? Eye ame kae woɖe Yehowa ƒe alɔ fia? " 39 Susu si ta womete ŋu xɔe se o lae nye nya si Yesaya gagblɔ be: 40 "Egbã woƒe ŋkuwo, eye wòna woƒe dzi me sẽ, ne woagakpɔ nu kple woƒe ŋkuwo, eye woase egɔme kple woƒe dziwo, be woatrɔ ne wòada gbe le wo ŋu o. " 41 Yesaya gblɔ nya siawo, elabena ekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, eye wòƒo nu tso eŋu.
ENGLISH: 37 But after he had done so many tokens before them they did not believe in him, 38 that the prophet Isaiah’s word that he spoke might be fulfilled, "Lord, who believed our news, and to whom was the Lord’s arm revealed? " 39 This was why they could not believe, because Isaiah said again 40 "He has put out their eyes and caked their hearts that they may not see with their eyes and understand with their hearts and turn about, and I heal them. " 41 This Isaiah said because he had seen his glory and spoke of him.

EWE: 42 Togbɔ be ele alea hã, kplɔlawo dometɔ geɖe gɔ̃ hã xɔ edzi se, gake womeʋua eme be yewoxɔ edzi se o le Farisitɔwo ta, ale be woaganya wo ɖa le ƒuƒoƒe la me o; 43 elabena wolɔ̃ amewo ƒe kafukafu wu Mawu ƒe kafukafu kura.
ENGLISH: 42 Nevertheless, even of the rulers many did believe in him, but because of the Pharisees they did not avow it, that they might not be excommunicated; 43 for they cared more for men’s glory than for God’s.

EWE: 44 Ke Yesu do ɣli gblɔ be: "Ame si xɔa dzinye sena la, menye nye ɖeɖe ko dzie wòxɔna sena o, ke exɔa ame si dɔm ɖa la hã dzi sena; 45 eye ame si kpɔm la, ekpɔ Ame si dɔm ɖa la hã.
ENGLISH: 44 And Jesus shouted "He who believes in me is not believing in me but in the one who sent me, 45 and he who sees me is seeing the one who sent me.

EWE: 46 Kekeli menye va xexea me, ale be ame sia ame si xɔa dzinye sena la nagakpɔtɔ anɔ viviti la me o.
ENGLISH: 46 I have come into the world as a light, that anyone who believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

EWE: 47 Ke ne ame aɖe sea nye nyawo, eye mewɔa wo dzi o la, nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnui o; elabena nyemeva ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge xexea o, ke boŋ be maɖe xexea.
ENGLISH: 47 And if one hears my words and does not keep them, I do not judge him, not I; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.

EWE: Nya si megblɔ lae adrɔ̃ ʋɔnui le ŋkeke mamlɛa dzi. 49 Elabena nyemeƒo nu le ɖokuinye si o, ke boŋ Fofo si dɔm ɖa la ŋutɔe na nya si magblɔ kple ale si maƒo nui ƒe sem. 50 Eye menyae hã be eƒe sedede la naa agbe mavɔ. Eya ŋuti nya siwo megblɔna la, megblɔa wo abe ale si tututu Fofo la gblɔ wo nam ene. "
ENGLISH: 48 He who disregards me and does not take my words has the one who judges him; the word that I spoke, that word will judge him at the last day, 49 because I did not speak out of myself but the Father who sent me has himself given me orders what to say and to speak, 50 and I know that his orders are eternal life; so what I speak I speak just as the Father has told me. "

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 13 Azɔ Yesu nya do ŋgɔ na Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi be yeƒe gaƒoƒo la de be yeadzo le xexe sia me ayi Fofo la gbɔ, esi wòlɔ̃ etɔ siwo le xexea me la, elɔ̃ wo va se ɖe nuwuwu. 2 Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo nɔ fiẽnu ɖum eye Abosam dee Yuda Iskariot, Simon vi, ƒe dzi me xoxo be wòadee asi. 3 Esi Yesu nya be Fofo la tsɔ nuwo katã de asi na ye, eye be Mawu gbɔe yetso va, eye yeyina Mawu gbɔ la, 4 etsi tsitre le fiẽnua ɖuƒe, ɖe eƒe awudziwui da ɖi, eye wòtsɔ papahũ sa ɖe ali.
ENGLISH: 13 But before the feast of the passover Jesus, knowing that his moment had come for passing from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, loved them to the last; 2 and, there coming a dinner when the Devil had already put it in the heart of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon to have him arrested, 3 he, knowing that the Father had put everything in his hands and that he had come out from God and was going to God, 4 rose from the dinner and laid off his clothes and took a towel and tied it round him as breech-cloth; 5 then he put water in the pitcher and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them off with the towel he had on.

EWE: 5 Eku tsi ɖe agba gã aɖe me, eye wòde asi nusrɔ̃laawo ƒe afɔwo kɔklɔ me, eye wòtsɔa papahũ si wòsa ɖe ali la tutua wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 6 So he came to Simon Peter. He said to him "Sir, are you washing my feet? "

EWE: 6 Esi wòva ɖo Simon Petro dzi la, ebia Yesu be: "Aƒetɔ, wòe aklɔ afɔ nama? " 7 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Màse nu si wɔm mele la gɔme fifia o, gake àva se egɔme le nu siawo megbe. " 8 Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Gbeɖe, màklɔ afɔ nam akpɔ o. "
ENGLISH: 7 Jesus replied "What I am doing you do not know now, but you will find out later. " 8 Peter said to him "You shall never in the world wash my feet. "

EWE: Eye mia ŋuti ɖi, gake menye mi katãe o. " 11 Elabena enya ame si le ede ge asi.
ENGLISH: Jesus answered him "If I do not wash you you have nothing in common with me. "

EWE: Esia tae wògblɔ be: "Menye mi katã ŋutie ɖi o. "
ENGLISH: 9 Simon Peter said to him "Sir, not only my feet but my hands and head too. "

EWE: 12 Azɔ esi wòklɔ afɔ na wo vɔ la, edo eƒe awuwo, eye wògabɔbɔ nɔ kplɔ̃a ŋu hebia wo be: "Miese nu si mewɔ na mi la gɔmea? 13 Mieyɔam be ‘Nufiala’ kple ‘Aƒetɔ,’ eye esɔ nenema, elabena eyae menye.
ENGLISH: 12 So when he had washed their feet and had resumed his clothes and taken his place at the table again he said to them "Do you know what it is I have done to you? 13 You call me Teacher and Master, and you are right; for I am.

EWE: 14 Eya ta ne nye, ame si nye Aƒetɔ kple Nufiala, meklɔ afɔ na mi la, ekema ele na miawo hã be miaklɔe na mia nɔewo. 15 Elabena meɖo kpɔɖeŋu ɖi na mi be, ale si tututu mewɔ na mi la, miawo hã miawɔ nenema ke.
ENGLISH: 14 So if I the Teacher and Master washed your feet, you too are bound to wash each other’s feet; 15 for I gave you an example to have you too do as I did to you.

EWE: 16 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, kluvi mewua eƒe aƒetɔ o, eye ame dɔdɔ mewua ame si dɔe ɖa la o.
ENGLISH: 16 Verily, verily I tell you, a servant is not greater than his master, nor a representative than his sender.

EWE: 17 Ne mienya nu siawo la, ekema dzidzɔtɔwoe mianye ne miewɔa wo dzi.
ENGLISH: 17 If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.

EWE: 18 Menye mi katãe mewɔnɛ o; menya ame siwo metia.
ENGLISH: 18 I am not speaking of all of you; I know whom I chose; but it was in order that the text ‘He who was feeding on my bread raised his heel against me’ should be fulfilled.

EWE: Ke hã ele be ŋɔŋlɔ la nava eme be: ‘Ame si ɖua nye abolo la kɔ eƒe afɔkpodzi dzi ɖe ŋunye.’ 19 Tso esia dzi la, mele egblɔm na mi hafi wòava dzɔ, ale be ne eva dzɔ la, miaxɔe ase be nyee.
ENGLISH: 19 From now on I tell you before the event, that when it takes place you may know that I am the one.

EWE: 20 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ame si xɔa ame si medɔ ɖa la, xɔa nye hã, eye ame si xɔam la, xɔa Ame si dɔm ɖa la hã. "
ENGLISH: 20 Verily, verily I tell you, he who accepts anyone I send is accepting me, and he who is accepting me is accepting the one who sent me. "

EWE: 21 Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, etsi dzi vevie le eɖokui me, eye wògblɔ be: "Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, mia dometɔ ɖeka adem asi. " 22 Nusrɔ̃lawo kpɔ wo nɔewo ŋkume, eye wotsi yaa, elabena womenya wo dometɔ kae wòwɔnɛ o.
ENGLISH: 21 After saying these things Jesus showed agitation of spirit, and testified and said "Verily, verily I tell you that one of you will have me arrested. " 22 The disciples looked at each other, at a loss to know of whom he was speaking.

EWE: 23 Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka si gbɔ melɔ̃a nu le o la nɔ anyi ɖe egbɔ tututu. 24 Eya ta Simon Petro wɔ dzesi nɛ be: "Gblɔe na mí, ame kae wòwɔnɛ. " 25 Eya ta ame ma bi ɖe megbe ziɔ ɖe Yesu ƒe akɔta hebiae be: "Aƒetɔ, ame kae? " 26 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Ame si maka abolo atɔ agba me atsɔ ana lae. " Esi wòtsɔ abolo la tɔ agbaa me la, etsɔe na Yuda, Simon Iskariot vi la. 27 Esi Yuda xɔ abolo kakɛa vɔ la, Satana ge ɖe eme.
ENGLISH: 23 There was at the table, resting in Jesus’s bosom, one of his disciples whom Jesus loved; 24 so Simon Peter nodded to that one and said to him "Ask who it is he is speaking of. " 25 He, dropping back on Jesus’s breast from the position he was in, said to him "Sir, who is it? " 26 So Jesus answered "It is that one to whom I will give the piece of bread when I dip it in "; so he dipped the piece of bread in and gave it to Judas the son of Simon Iscariot; 27 and after the piece of bread, then Satan came into him.

EWE: Eya ta Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nu si wɔm nèle la, wɔe kaba. " 28 Ke hã, ame siwo le kplɔ̃a ŋu la dometɔ aɖeke menya nu si ta wògblɔ nya sia nɛ o. 29 Le nyateƒe me la, esi wònye Yuda gbɔe gaɖaka la le ta la, wo dometɔ aɖewo bu be ɖe Yesu le gbɔgblɔm nɛ be, "Ƒle nu siwo hiã na ŋkekenyui la, " alo be wòana nane ame dahewo.
ENGLISH: So Jesus said to him "Be quick about what you are doing. " 28 And none of those at the table knew what was the point of his saying this to him; 29 for some thought, since Judas had the money-box, Jesus was telling him "Buy what we need for the feast " or to give something to the poor.

EWE: 30 Eya ta esi wòxɔ abolo kakɛa vɔ la, edo go dzo enumake.
ENGLISH: 30 So he, after taking the piece of bread, went out at once.

EWE: Zã hã do ɣemaɣi.
ENGLISH: And it was night.

EWE: 31 Esi wòdzo la, Yesu gblɔ be: "Azɔ wodo Amegbetɔvi la ɖe dzi, eye wodo Mawu ɖe dzi to eya amea dzi.
ENGLISH: 31 So when he had gone out Jesus said "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in him.

EWE: 32 Mawu ŋutɔ adoe ɖe dzi, eye adoe ɖe dzi enumake.
ENGLISH: 32 If God is glorified in him, God on his part will glorify him in himself and glorify him at once.

EWE: 33 Vinyewo, ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe koe maganɔ anyi kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 33 Children, I shall be with you little longer.

EWE: Miadim; gake ale si megblɔe na Yudatɔwo be, ‘Afi si meyina la, miate ŋu ava o’ la, eya ko gblɔm mele na miawo hã azɔ.
ENGLISH: You will look for me, and as I said to the Jews ‘where I am going you cannot come,’ so I say to you now.

EWE: 34 Mele se yeye nam mi be mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo; ale si melɔ̃ mi la, miawo hã milɔ̃ mia nɔewo nenema ke.
ENGLISH: 34 I give you a new commandment, that you are to love each other: that as I loved you, you too are to love each other.

EWE: 35 Esia me amewo katã anyae le be nye nusrɔ̃lawo mienye, ne lɔlɔ̃ le mia dome. "
ENGLISH: 35 By this all will know that you are disciples of mine, if you have love for each other. "

EWE: 36 Simon Petro biae be: "Aƒetɔ, afi ka yim nèle? "
ENGLISH: 36 Simon Peter said to him "Sir, where are you going? "

EWE: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Afi si yim mele la, màte ŋu adze yonyeme fifia ayi o, ke emegbe la àdze yonyeme. " 37 Eye Petro biae be: "Aƒetɔ, nu ka tae nyemate ŋu adze yowòme fifia o?
ENGLISH: Jesus answered "Where I am going you cannot follow me now, but later you shall. " 37 Peter said to him "Sir, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you. "

EWE: Matsɔ nye agbe aɖo anyi ɖe tawò. " 38 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Àtsɔ wò agbe aɖo anyi ɖe tanyea? Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò be, koklo mele atɔ ku ge hafi nàgbe nu le gbɔnye zi etɔ̃ o. "
ENGLISH: 38 Jesus answered "You will lay down your life for me? verily, verily I tell you, not a cock will crow till you have disowned me three times.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 14 "Migana dzika natso mia ƒo o. Mixɔ Mawu dzi se; mixɔ nye hã dzinye se.
ENGLISH: 14 "Let your hearts not be alarmed: trust in God and trust in me.

EWE: 2 Fofonye ƒe me la, nɔƒe geɖewo li. Ne mele nenema o la, anye ne megblɔe na mi, elabena meyina be madzra teƒe ɖo ɖi na mi. 3 Eye ne meyi ɖadzra teƒe ɖo ɖi na mi vɔ la, magava, eye maxɔ mi ɖe nye ŋutɔ gbɔnye, ale be afi si mele la, miawo hã mianɔ afi ma.
ENGLISH: 2 In my Father’s house there are many habitations; if not, I would have told you because I go to get a place ready for you, 3 and if I go and get a place ready for you I come again and will take you home with me, that where I am you too may be.

EWE: 4 Afi si meyina la, mienya mɔ la. "
ENGLISH: 4 And where I am going you know the way. "

EWE: 5 Toma gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, míenya afi si yim nèle o, aleke míawɔ anya mɔa? "
ENGLISH: 5 Thomas said to him "Sir, we do not know where you are going; how do we know the way? "

EWE: 6 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Nyee nye mɔ la kple nyateƒe la kpakple agbe la. Ame aɖeke mevaa Fofo la gbɔ o, negbe to dzinye ko.
ENGLISH: 6 Jesus said to him "I am the way, and the truth, and the life; nobody comes to the Father except through me.

EWE: 7 Ne mienyam la, mianya Fofonye hã; tso fifia heyina la, mienyae, eye miekpɔe hã. "
ENGLISH: 7 If you knew me you would know my Father too. From now on you do know him and have seen him. "

EWE: 8 Filipo gblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, fia Fofo la mí, eye ema asɔ gbɔ na mí. "
ENGLISH: 8 Philip said to him "Sir, show us the Father and we are satisfied. "

EWE: Ame si kpɔm la, ekpɔ Fofo la hã. Aleke wɔ nèbe, ‘Fia Fofo la mí’? 10 Ðe mèxɔe se be mewɔ ɖeka kple Fofo la, eye Fofo la hã wɔ ɖeka kplim oa? Nya siwo gblɔm mele na mi la, menye nye ŋutɔ nye nyawoe o, ke boŋ Fofo si wɔ ɖeka kplim lae le eƒe dɔwo wɔm.
ENGLISH: 9 Jesus said to him "I have been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? he who has seen me has seen the Father; how is it you are saying ‘show us the Father’? 10 Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? the words that I say to you I do not say from myself, but the Father, abiding in me, is doing his work.

EWE: 11 Mixɔ dzinye se be mewɔ ɖeka kple Fofo la, eye Fofo la hã wɔ ɖeka kplim; ne miexɔe se o la, ekema mixɔe se le dɔwɔwɔawo ya ta.
ENGLISH: 11 Take my word for it that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or if not, believe because of the work itself.

EWE: 12 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ame si xɔa dzinye sena la hã awɔ dɔ siwo mewɔna; eye awɔ dɔ siwo lolo wu esiawo, elabena meyina Fofo la gbɔ. 13 Nu sia nu si miabia le nye ŋkɔ me la, mawɔe, ale be woado Fofo la ɖe dzi to Vi la dzi.
ENGLISH: 12 Verily, verily I tell you, he who believes in me will himself do the work I do, and do greater things than these, because I am going to the Father, 13 and whatever you ask in my name, that I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

EWE: 14 Ne miebia nane le nye ŋkɔ me la, mawɔe.
ENGLISH: 14 If you ask me anything in my name I will do it.

EWE: 15 "Ne mielɔ̃m la, ekema miawɔ nye sewo dzi. 16 Mabia Fofo la wòana kpeɖeŋutɔ bubu mi be wòanɔ mia gbɔ tegbee, 17 nyateƒegbɔgbɔ si xexea mate ŋu axɔ o, elabena mekpɔnɛ o, eye menyae hã o. Miawo ya mienyae, elabena enɔa mia gbɔ, eye wòle mia me.
ENGLISH: 15 "If you love me you will keep my commandments, 16 and I will request the Father and he will give you another spokesman to be with you forever, 17 the Spirit of Truth, which the world cannot receive because it does not perceive nor know it; you know it, because it stays with you and is in you.

EWE: 18 Nyemagblẽ mi ɖi tsyɔ̃eviwoe o. Magbɔ va mia gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 18 "I will not leave you bereaved; I am coming to you.

EWE: 19 Esusɔ vie ko xexea magakpɔm o, ke miawo ya miakpɔm, elabena mele agbe, eye miawo hã mianɔ agbe.
ENGLISH: 19 A little longer, and the world no longer perceives me, but you do, because I am alive and you will be.

EWE: 20 Gbe ma gbe miadze sii be mewɔ ɖeka kple Fofonye, eye be miewɔ ɖeka kplim, eye nye hã mewɔ ɖeka kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 20 On that day you will know that I am in my Father and you are in me and I am in you.

EWE: 21 Ame si léa nye sewo me ɖe asi, eye wòwɔa wo dzi la, eyae lɔ̃am.
ENGLISH: 21 He who has my commandments and keeps them, he is the one that loves me.

EWE: Azɔ ame si lɔ̃am la, Fofonye alɔ̃e, eye malɔ̃e, eye maɖe ɖokuinye afiae. "
ENGLISH: And he who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and manifest myself to him. "

EWE: 22 Yuda (menye Iskariot o) biae be: "Aƒetɔ, nu ka tae nèdi be yeaɖe ye ɖokui afia mí, ke menye xexea katã o? "
ENGLISH: 22 Judas, not the Iscariot, said to him "And what has happened, sir, that you are going to manifest yourself to us and not to the world? "

EWE: 23 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ne ame aɖe lɔ̃m la, alé nye nya la me ɖe asi, eye Fofonye alɔ̃e, eye míava nɔ egbɔ.
ENGLISH: 23 Jesus replied "If one loves me he will keep what I say; and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make a home with him.

EWE: 24 Ame si melɔ̃am o la mewɔa nye nyawo dzi o. Nya si sem miele la, menye tɔnyee o, ke boŋ Fofo si dɔm ɖa la tɔe.
ENGLISH: 24 He who does not love me does not keep the things I say; and the thing you hear me say is not my say, but the Father’s, who sent me.

EWE: 25 "Megblɔ nya siawo na mi, esi megale mia gbɔ. 26 Ke kpeɖeŋutɔ la, gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe si Fofo la aɖo ɖa le nye ŋkɔ me la, eya afia nuwo katã mi, eye wòaɖo ŋku nu siwo katã megblɔ na mi la dzi na mi.
ENGLISH: 25 "These words I have spoken to you while I remained with you; 26 but the Spokesman, the Holy Spirit that the Father will send in my name, he will teach you everything and remind you of everything that I said to you.

EWE: 27 Mele ŋutifafa gblẽm ɖi na mi; mele nye ŋutifafa nam mi.
ENGLISH: 27 "Peace I leave to you; my peace I give you; it is not as the world gives that I give to you.

EWE: Nyemele etsɔm na mi abe ale si xexea nanɛ ene o.
ENGLISH: Let your hearts not be alarmed nor daunted.

EWE: 28 Miesee megblɔ na mi be, ‘Mele dzodzom, eye magatrɔ ava mia gbɔ.’
ENGLISH: 28 You heard me say to you ‘I am going, and coming to you.’

EWE: Ne mielɔ̃m la, miakpɔ dzidzɔ be meyina Fofo la gbɔ, elabena Fofo la lolo wum.
ENGLISH: If you loved me you would be glad because I am going to my Father, because my Father is greater than I am.

EWE: 29 Eya ta megblɔe na mi hafi wòava dzɔ, ale be ne eva dzɔ la, miaxɔe ase.
ENGLISH: 29 And I have now been telling you before the things take place, in order that when they do you may believe.

EWE: 30 Nyemagaƒo nu geɖe kpli mi azɔ o, elabena xexea dzi ɖula la gbɔna, eye mekpɔ ŋusẽ aɖeke ɖe dzinye o.
ENGLISH: 30 "I shall not talk with you much more, for the ruler of the world is coming.

EWE: 31 Gake be xexea nanya be melɔ̃ Fofo la ta la, mele nu si tututu Fofo la de se nam be mawɔ la wɔm.
ENGLISH: And he has no hold on me, 31 but it is in order that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, so I do.

EWE: Mitso, mina míadzo le afi sia.
ENGLISH: Up, let us be going from here.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 15 "Nyee nye wainti vavã la, eye Fofonyee nye agbledela la. 2 Alɔ sia alɔ si le ŋunye, eye metsea ku o la, elãnɛ ɖa, eye ɖe sia ɖe si tsea ku la, eɖea eŋu, ale be wòatse ku geɖe wu.
ENGLISH: 15 "I am the true grapevine, and my Father is the farmer: 2 every branch on me that does not bear fruit he takes off, and every one that bears fruit he cleans up in order that it may bear more fruit.

EWE: 3 Mia ŋuti kɔ xoxo le nya si megblɔ na mi la ta.
ENGLISH: 3 You are clean already, because of the words I have spoken to you.

EWE: 4 Miwɔ ɖeka kplim, eye nye hã mawɔ ɖeka kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 4 Remain in me and have me remain in you; as the branch cannot bear fruit from itself if it does not remain in the vine, no more can you if you do not remain in me.

EWE: Ale si ko alɔ la mate ŋu atse ku le eɖokui si o, negbe ɖe wòle wainti la ŋu hafi la, nenema kee miawo hã miate ŋui o, negbe ɖe miewɔ ɖeka kplim hafi. 5 Nyee nye wainti la; miawoe nye alɔawo.
ENGLISH: 5 I am the vine, you are the branches; it is just he who remains in me and has me remain in him that bears much fruit because apart from me you cannot do anything.

EWE: Ame si wɔa ɖeka kplim, eye nye hã mewɔa ɖeka kplii la, ame sia tsea ku geɖe; elabena nye manɔmee la, miate ŋu awɔ naneke kura o. 6 Ne ame aɖe mewɔa ɖeka kplim o la, ele abe atilɔ si wolã ɖa tsɔ ƒu gbe ene, eye aƒu.
ENGLISH: 6 If one does not remain in me he is thrown outside like a branch and dries up, and they gather them and throw them in the fire and they are burned.

EWE: 7 Ne miewɔ ɖeka kplim, eye nye nyawo kpɔtɔ le mia me la, mibia nu sia nu si miedi, eye ava eme na mi.
ENGLISH: 7 If you do remain in me and my words remain in you, ask for what you will and you shall have it.

EWE: 8 Nu si me wodoa Fofonye ɖe dzi le lae nye be miayi edzi anɔ ku geɖe tsem, eye miaɖee afia be nye nusrɔ̃lawoe mienye.
ENGLISH: 8 It is in this my Father is glorified, that you should bear a great crop of fruit and turn out to be disciples of mine.

EWE: 9 Ale si ko Fofo la lɔ̃m, eye nye hã melɔ̃ mi la; miyi edzi mianɔ nye lɔlɔ̃ la me.
ENGLISH: 9 As the Father loved me, so did I love you; remain in my love.

EWE: 10 Ne mielé nye seawo me ɖe asi la, ekema miayi edzi anɔ nye lɔlɔ̃ la me, abe ale si ko meléa Fofonye ƒe sewo me ɖe asi, eye mekpɔtɔ le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ la me ene.
ENGLISH: 10 If you keep my commands, remain in my love you will, as I have kept my Father’s commands and am remaining in his love.

EWE: 11 "Nya siawoe megblɔ na mi, be nye dzidzɔ la nanɔ mia me, eye miaƒe dzidzɔ la nagba go.
ENGLISH: 11 "I have had this talk with you so that my joy may be in you and your joy be in full measure.

EWE: 12 Se si nam mele mie nye be, mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo, abe ale si melɔ̃ mi ene.
ENGLISH: 12 This is my command, that you are to love each other as I loved you.

EWE: 13 Lɔlɔ̃ gã wu esia megale ame aɖeke si, be ame natsɔ eƒe agbe aɖo anyi ɖe xɔlɔ̃awo ta o.
ENGLISH: 13 Nobody has a greater love than this, that one should lay down his life for his friends.

EWE: 14 Ne miewɔa nu siwo ƒe se mede na mi la, ekema xɔ̃nyewoe mienye.
ENGLISH: 14 You are friends of mine if you do what I command you to.
