EWE: 15 Nyemegayɔa mi be kluviwo o, elabena kluvi menyaa nu si eƒe aƒetɔ wɔna o. Ke boŋ meyɔa mi be xɔ̃nyewo, elabena nu siwo katã mese tso Fofonye gbɔ la, mena mienya wo.
ENGLISH: 15 I do not speak of you as servants any longer, because a servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have spoken of you as friends, because everything that I have heard from my Father I have made known to you.

EWE: 16 Menye miawoe tiam o, ke boŋ nyee tia mi, eye meɖo mi be miayi edzi anɔ ku tsem, eye miaƒe kutsetse la anɔ anyi ɖaa, ale be nu ka kee mieɖabia Fofo la le nye ŋkɔ me o, atsɔe ana mi.
ENGLISH: 16 It was not you that chose me, but I that chose you and made you such as to go ahead and bear fruit and have your fruit persist, to have the Father give you whatever you ask him for in my name.

EWE: 17 "Nu siawo ƒe se dem mele na mi, be mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 17 "I am giving you these commands so that you may love each other.

EWE: 18 Ne xexea lé fu mi la, minyae be etre fulélem.
ENGLISH: 18 If the world hates you, you know it has hated me before you.

EWE: 19 Ne ɖe mienye xexea ƒe akpa aɖe la, anye ne xexea alɔ̃ eya ŋutɔ tɔwo. Ke esi mienye xexea ƒe akpa aɖeke o, hafi boŋ metia mi tso xexea me la, esia tae xexea léa fu mi ɖo.
ENGLISH: 19 If you belonged to the world, the world would love what was its own; but because you do not belong to the world but I picked you out of the world, for that reason the world hates you.

EWE: 20 Nya si megblɔ na mi la nenɔ susu me na mi be: Kluvi mewua eƒe aƒetɔ o. Ne woti yonyeme la, woati miawo hã mia yome; ne wolé nye nya me ɖe asi la, woalé mia tɔ hã me ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 20 Remember the words that I said to you, ‘a servant is not greater than his master’: if they persecuted me, so they will you; if they kept my words, so they will yours.

EWE: 21 Ke woawɔ nu siawo katã ɖe mia ŋu le nye ŋkɔ la ta, elabena womenya Ame si dɔm ɖa la o.
ENGLISH: 21 But all this they will do to you on account of my name, because they do not know the one who sent me.

EWE: 22 Ne ɖe nyemeva ƒo nu kpli wo o la, anye ne womaɖi nu vɔ̃ ƒe fɔ o. Ke azɔ la, taflatsɛdodo aɖeke mele wo si le woƒe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti o.
ENGLISH: 22 If I had not come and spoken to them they would not have any sin; but now they do not have any excuse for sin.

EWE: 23 Ame si lé fum la lé fu Fofonye hã.
ENGLISH: 23 He who hates me is hating my Father too.

EWE: 24 Ne ɖe nyemewɔ dɔ siwo ame aɖeke mewɔ kpɔ o la le wo dome o la, anye ne womaɖi nu vɔ̃ ƒe fɔ o; ke azɔ la wokpɔ dɔ siwo mewɔ, eye wolé fu nye kple Fofonye siaa. 25 Gake ele alea be nya si woŋlɔ ɖe woƒe Se la me be, ‘Wolé fum dzodzro’ la nava eme. 26 Ne kpeɖeŋutɔ si maɖo ɖe mi tso Fofo la gbɔ, si nye nyateƒegbɔgbɔ si Fofo la nana, va ɖo la, eya aɖi ɖase le ŋunye; 27 eye miawo hã miaɖi ɖase, elabena mieli kplim tso gɔmedzedzea me ke.
ENGLISH: 24 If I had not done among them the works that nobody else did, they would not have any sin; but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father; 25 but it was so that the words written in their law should be fulfilled, ‘They hated me for nothing.’ 26 When the Spokesman comes whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of Truth that goes out from the Father’s presence, he will testify about me; 27 and you too testify, because you have been with me from the first.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 16 "Megblɔ nya siawo na mi, be woagaɖia mia nu o.
ENGLISH: 16 "I have had this talk with you so that you may not be staggered.

EWE: 2 Woanya mi ɖa le ƒuƒoƒewo. Ɛ̃, gaƒoƒo gbɔna esime ame sia ame si awu mi la asusu be yewɔ dɔ kɔkɔe na Mawu.
ENGLISH: 2 They will excommunicate you; yes, there is coming an hour in which everybody who kills you is to think he is presenting a religious service to God.

EWE: 3 Ke woawɔ nu siawo katã elabena womedze si Fofo la o, eye womedze si nye hã o.
ENGLISH: 3 And these things they will do because they have not learned to know the Father nor me.

EWE: 4 Ke hã, megblɔ nya siawo na mi, ale be ne ɣeyiɣia de, eye wova eme la, miaɖo ŋku edzi be megblɔe na mi.
ENGLISH: 4 But I have had this talk with you so that when the hour for them comes you may remember about them, that I told you.

EWE: "Nyemegblɔ nya siawo na mi do ŋgɔ o, elabena mele mia gbɔ.
ENGLISH: "But I did not tell you these things to begin with, because I was with you.

EWE: 5 Ke azɔ la meyina Ame si dɔm ɖa la gbɔ; evɔ mia dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã mebiam be, ‘Afi ka yim nèle?’ hã o. 6 Esi megblɔ nya siawo na mi ta la, nuxaxa yɔ miaƒe dziwo me fũu.
ENGLISH: 5 But now I am going to the one who sent me; and no one of you asks me ‘Where are you going?’ 6 but because I have had this talk with you grief has filled your hearts.

EWE: 7 Gake nyateƒe tom mele na mi, miaƒe nyonyo tae medzo yina ɖo.
ENGLISH: 7 But I tell you the truth, it is to your advantage to have me leave.

EWE: Elabena ne nyemedzo o la, kpeɖeŋutɔ la mava na mi gbeɖe o; gake ne medzo yi la, maɖoe ɖe mi.
ENGLISH: For if I do not leave, the Spokesman will not come to you; but if I go I will send him to you.

EWE: 8 Eye ne eva ɖo la, ana xexea nadze si nu si nu vɔ̃, dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nye la kɔtɛ: 9 gbã la, ana woadze si nu si nye nu vɔ̃, elabena womexɔa dzinye sena o; 10 emegbe ana woadze si nu si nye dzɔdzɔenyenye, elabena meyina Fofo la gbɔ, eye miagakpɔm azɔ o; 11 eye mlɔeba ana woadze si nu si nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, elabena wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexe sia dzi ɖula la.
ENGLISH: 8 And he, when he comes, will prove the case against the world as to wrong and as to right and as to judgment 9 as to wrong because they are not believing in me, 10 and as to right because I am going to the Father and you are seeing no more of me, 11 and as to judgment because the ruler of this world has been judged.

EWE: 12 "Nya geɖewo gale asinye magblɔ na mi hafi, gake miate ŋu atsɔ wo fifia o. 13 Ke ne eya, si nye nyateƒegbɔgbɔ la, va ɖo la, akpe ɖe mia ŋu miase nyateƒe la gɔme bliboe, elabena maƒo nu le eɖokui si o, ke boŋ nu siwo wòse lae wòagblɔ, eye wòagblɔ nu siwo ava dzɔ la na mi.
ENGLISH: 12 I have many more things to say to you, but you cannot carry the load now; 13 but when he, the Spirit of Truth, comes, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself but will speak just what he hears, and will announce to you what is coming.

EWE: 14 Eya adom ɖe dzi, elabena agblɔ nu siwo wòxɔ tso gbɔnye la na mi.
ENGLISH: 14 He will glorify me, because he will draw from what is mine and announce to you.

EWE: 15 Nu siwo katã le Fofo la si la, tɔnyee. Esia tae megblɔ be agblɔ nu siwo wòxɔ tso gbɔnye la na mi.
ENGLISH: 15 Everything that the Father has is mine; that is why I said he draws from what is mine and will announce to you.

EWE: 16 Esusɔ vie ko miagakpɔm o, gake madidi o miagakpɔm. "
ENGLISH: 16 "A little while and you are seeing no more of me, and again a little while and you will see me. "

EWE: 17 Eƒe nusrɔ̃la aɖewo bia wo nɔewo be: "Nya si wògblɔ na mí be, ‘Esusɔ vie ko, miagakpɔm o, gake madidi o miagakpɔm’ kple ‘elabena meyina Fofo la gbɔ’ la gɔme ɖe? " 18 Eya ta wobia be: "Nya si wògblɔ be, ‘esusɔ vie ko’ la gɔme ɖe?
ENGLISH: 17 So some of his disciples said to each other "What is this he is saying to us, ‘a little while and you are not seeing anything of me, and again a little while and you will see me’ and ‘because I am going to the Father’? " 18 So they said "What is this ‘little while’ he tells about? we do not know what he is driving at. "

EWE: Míenya nu si wòwɔnɛ o. " 19 Yesu nya be wodi be yewoabia nya ye, eya ta ebia wo be: "Nya si megblɔ be, ‘esusɔ vie ko, miagakpɔm o, gake madidi o miagakpɔm’ la dzakam mielea? 20 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, miafa avi, eye miafa konyi, ke xexea ya akpɔ dzidzɔ; miaxa nu, gake miaƒe nuxaxa la atrɔ azu dzidzɔ.
ENGLISH: 19 Jesus knew they were wanting to ask him, and said to them "Is it about this you are discussing with each other, that I said ‘a little while and you will not see anything of me, and again a little while and you will see me’? 20 Verily, verily I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice; you will be grieved, but your grief will become joy.

EWE: 21 Ne nyɔnu le ku lém la, esea veve vevie, elabena eƒe gaƒoƒo la ɖo; gake ne edzi via vɔ ko la, megaɖoa ŋku eƒe vevesese la dzi o, elabena ekpɔa dzidzɔ be yedzi ame ɖe xexea me.
ENGLISH: 21 When a woman is giving birth she feels grief because her time has come; but when she brings forth the child she no longer remembers the distress because of her gladness that a man has been born into the world.

EWE: 22 Eya ta miawo hã miele nu xam fifia; gake magakpɔ mi, eye miaƒe dzi akpɔ dzidzɔ, eye ame aɖeke maxɔ miaƒe dzidzɔ la le mia si o.
ENGLISH: 22 So you too now feel grief, but I will see you again and your hearts will be glad, and your gladness nobody will take away from you.

EWE: 23 Miele nya aɖeke kura bia gem le ŋkeke ma dzi o. Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, ne miebia nane Fofo la la, ana mi le nye ŋkɔ me.
ENGLISH: 23 And on that day you will ask nothing of me; verily, verily I tell you, if you ask the Father for anything he will give it to you in my name.

EWE: 24 Va se ɖe fifia la, miebia nu ɖeka teti hã le nye ŋkɔ me kpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 24 Up to now you have not asked for anything in my name; ask and you shall receive, that your gladness may be in full measure.

EWE: Mibia, eye miaxɔe, ale be miaƒe dzidzɔ nagba go. 25 "Megblɔ nya siawo na mi le lododowo me.
ENGLISH: 25 "In this talk with you I have spoken figuratively; a time is coming when I shall no longer speak figuratively to you but shall tell you plainly about the Father.

EWE: Gaƒoƒo la gbɔna, esime nyemagaƒo nu na mi le lododowo me o, ke boŋ maƒo nu tso Fofo la ŋu na mi tẽe. 26 Le ŋkeke ma me la, miabia nu Fofo la le nye ŋkɔ me; ke hã menye ɖe mele gbɔgblɔm be mabia nu Fofo la ɖe mia nu o.
ENGLISH: 26 On that day you will ask in my name, and I do not tell you I will solicit the Father on your behalf, 27 for the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came out from the Father’s presence.

EWE: 27 Elabena Fofo la ŋutɔ melɔ̃a nu le mia gbɔ o, le esi mielɔ̃a nu le gbɔnye o, eye miexɔe se be meva abe Mawu teƒenɔla ene ta. 28 Meva xexea me abe Fofo la teƒenɔla ene.
ENGLISH: 28 I came out of the Father and have come into the world; I am leaving the world again and going to the Father’s presence. "

EWE: Azɔ mele dzodzom le xexea me, eye meyina Fofo la gbɔ. " 29 Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ be: "Ehɛ̃!
ENGLISH: 29 His disciples said "There, now you are talking in plain language and not using any figure.

EWE: Azɔ ko nèle nu ƒom na mí tẽe, eye mègale lo dom na mí o. 30 Míenyae azɔ be ènya nuwo katã, eye mehiã be ame aɖeke nabia nya wò o.
ENGLISH: 30 Now we know that you know everything and do not need to have anybody ask you; by this we believe that you came out from God. "

EWE: Esia me míexɔe se le be Mawu gbɔe nètso va. " 31 Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Miexɔe se azɔa? 32 Kpɔ ɖa! Gaƒoƒo la gbɔna, eye wòde azɔ, esime miaka ahlẽ, eye mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ayi eƒe me, eye miagblẽ nye ɖeka ɖi. Gake menye nye ɖekae li o, elabena Fofo la li kplim.
ENGLISH: 31 Jesus answered "You believe now? 32 here is a moment coming, and it has come, for you to scatter to look after your own interests and leave me alone; and I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

EWE: 33 Megblɔ nya siawo na mi, be miato dzinye akpɔ ŋutifafa.
ENGLISH: 33 I have had this talk with you so that you may have peace in me.

EWE: Le xexea me la, miele xaxawo me tom, gake milé dzi ɖe ƒo! Nye la meɖu xexea dzi. "
ENGLISH: In the world you have distress; but courage, I have defeated the world. "

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 17 Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, ewu mo dzi kpɔ dziƒo gblɔ be: "Fofo, gaƒoƒo la de. Do viwò la ɖe dzi, ne viwò la hã nado wò ɖe dzi, 2 abe ale si ko nèna ŋusẽe ɖe ŋutilãwo katã dzi ene ale be wòana agbe mavɔ ame siwo katã nètsɔ nɛ. 3 Esiae nye agbe mavɔ la bena woanya wò, Mawu vavã ɖeka la, kple Yesu Kristo si nèdɔ ɖa la.
ENGLISH: 17 This talk Jesus gave, and raised his eyes toward heaven and said "Father, the moment has come; glorify your son that your son may glorify you, 2 as you gave him jurisdiction over all mortals that to all that you have given him he might give eternal life 3 and this is what the eternal life is, that they should know you, the only true God, and the one whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

EWE: 4 Medo wò ɖe dzi le anyigba dzi, esi mewu dɔ si nètsɔ nam be mawɔ la nu. 5 Eya ta Fofo, tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si nɔ asinye le gbɔwò hafi xexea va dzɔ la dom ɖe dzi le ɖokuiwò gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 4 I glorified you on earth, carrying through the work you have given me to do; 5 now glorify me in turn, Father, alongside yourself with the glory that I did have alongside you before the world was.

EWE: 6 "Meɖe wò ŋkɔ la fia ame siwo nèɖe tso xexea me nam.
ENGLISH: 6 "I disclosed your name to the men you gave me out of the world.

EWE: Tɔwòe wonye, eye nètsɔ wo nam, eye wolé wò nya la me ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: They were yours and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.

EWE: 7 Wova nyae azɔ be nu siwo katã nètsɔ nam la tso gbɔwò; 8 elabena megblɔ nya siwo nède asi nam la na wo, eye woxɔ wo, eye wova nyae vavã be tewòƒenɔlae menye va, eye woxɔe se be wòe dɔm ɖa.
ENGLISH: 7 They know now that everything you have ever given me is from you, 8 because I have given them the words that you gave me, and they had accepted them and knew to a certainty that I had come out from your presence, and had faith that you had sent me.

EWE: 9 Mele kuku ɖem ɖe wo ta, menye ɖe xexea ta o, ke boŋ ɖe ame siwo nètsɔ nam la ta, elabena tɔwòe wonye; 10 eye nu siwo katã nye tɔnye la, tɔwòe, eye tɔwòwo hã tɔnyee, eye wodom ɖe dzi le wo dome.
ENGLISH: 9 I am making request on their behalf; I do not make any on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those whom you have given to me, because they are yours, 10 and everything of mine is yours and what is yours is mine, and I am glorified in them; 11 and I am no longer in the world, and they are in the world, and I am coming to you.

EWE: 11 "Azɔ mele dzodzom le xexea me, eye megbɔna gbɔwò, gake woawo ya wole xexea me.
ENGLISH: "Holy Father, keep them in your name that you have given to me, that they may be one just as we are.

EWE: 12 Esi mele wo gbɔ la, medzɔ wo ŋu le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋkɔ si nètsɔ nam la ta; mekpɔ wo ta, eye wo dometɔ aɖeke metsrɔ̃ o, negbe tsɔtsrɔ̃vi la ko, ale be ŋɔŋlɔ la nava eme.
ENGLISH: 12 When I was with them, I kept them in your name that you have given to me, and kept guard over them, and no one of them was lost except, in order that the text should be fulfilled, the one who was bound to be lost.

EWE: 13 Ke azɔ megbɔna gbɔwò, eye mele nya siawo gblɔm le xexea me, ale be nye dzidzɔ la nayɔ wo fũu.
ENGLISH: 13 But now I am coming to you; and I am saying these things in the world that they may have my gladness brought to fullness in themselves.

EWE: 14 Metsɔ wò nya la na wo, ke xexea lé fu wo, elabena womenye xexea ƒe akpa aɖeke o, abe ale si ko nyemenye xexea ƒe akpa aɖeke o ene.
ENGLISH: 14 I have given them your word, and the world hated them because they do not belong to the world just as I do not.

EWE: 15 "Nyemele biabiam be nàɖe wo ɖa le xexea me o, ke boŋ be nàkpɔ wo ta le vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ta.
ENGLISH: 15 I am not asking that you take them clear out of the world, but that you keep them clear of what is bad.

EWE: 16 Womenye xexea ƒe akpa aɖeke o, abe ale si ko nyemenye xexea ƒe akpa aɖeke o ene.
ENGLISH: 16 They do not belong to the world just as I do not.

EWE: 17 Kɔ wo ŋu to nyateƒe la me; wò nya la nye nyateƒe.
ENGLISH: 17 Consecrate them by the truth; your word is truth.

EWE: 18 Abe ale si ko nèdɔm ɖe xexea me ene la, nye hã medɔ wo ɖe xexea me. 19 Eye mewɔ ɖokuinye kɔkɔe le wo ta, ne woawo hã woanɔ kɔkɔe to nyateƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 18 As you sent me into the world, so did I send them into the world; 19 and it is for them I consecrate myself, that they too may be consecrated by truth.

EWE: 20 "Nyemele esia biam na ame siawo ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ mele ebiam na ame siwo ava xɔ dzinye ase to woƒe nya me la hã, 21 ne wo katã woawɔ ɖeka, abe ale si wò, Fofo la, nèwɔ ɖeka kplim, eye nye hã mewɔ ɖeka kpli wò la ene, ale be woawo hã woawɔ ɖeka le mía me, ne xexea nanyae be wòe dɔm ɖa.
ENGLISH: 20 "And I ask on behalf not only of these but also of those who by their telling put faith in me, 21 that they may all be one, as you, Father, are in me and I am in you; that they too may be in us, that the world may believe that you sent me.

EWE: 22 Metsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si nètsɔ nam la na wo, ne woazu ɖeka, abe ale si míele ɖeka ene. 23 Mewɔ ɖeka kpli wo, eye nèwɔ ɖeka kplim, ale be woawɔ ɖeka bliboe, ne xexea nadze sii be wòe dɔm ɖa, eye be èlɔ̃ wo abe ale si nèlɔ̃m ene.
ENGLISH: 22 And I have given to them the glory that you have given to me, that they may be one as we are one: 23 I in them and you in me, that they may stand perfected into one, that the world may know that it was you who sent me and you loved them as you did me.

EWE: 24 Fofo, medi be ame siwo nètsɔ nam la nanɔ gbɔnye le afi si mele la, bena woakpɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe si nètsɔ nam, elabena èlɔ̃m do ŋgɔ na xexea ƒe gɔmeɖoanyiɣi. 25 Fofo dzɔdzɔe, nyateƒee, xexea medze si wò o, ke nye ya medze si wò, eye ame siawo va nyae be wòe dɔm ɖa. 26 Mena wonya wò ŋkɔ la, eye magana woanyae, ale be lɔlɔ̃ si nètsɔ lɔ̃m la nanɔ wo me, eye mawɔ ɖeka kpli wo. "
ENGLISH: 24 "What you have given me, Father I will that where I am they too be with me that they may see my glory which you have given to me because you loved me before the foundation of the world, 25 right-dealing Father; and the world did not know you, but I did, and these knew that it was you who sent me; 26 and I made known your name to them, and will make it known, that the love you had for me may be in them, and I in them. "

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 18 Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, eya kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo yi ɖato Kidron Bali la me yi abɔ aɖe si le afi ma la me.
ENGLISH: 18 With that Jesus went out, with his disciples, across Kidron Arroyo, where there was a garden, which he and his disciples went into.

EWE: 2 Yuda, ame si dee asi la, hã nya teƒea, elabena Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va ƒoa ƒu ɖe afi ma zi geɖe.
ENGLISH: 2 But Judas too, who was the agent in his arrest, knew about the place, because Jesus had often met with his disciples there.

EWE: 3 Eya ta Yuda kplɔ asrafoha la, nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple Farisitɔwo ƒe dɔlawo kpe ɖe eɖokui ŋu, eye wolé akakatiwo kple akaɖiwo kpakple lãnuwo ɖe asi va afi ma.
ENGLISH: 3 So Judas got the cohort and some officers from the chief priests and from the Pharisees, and came there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

EWE: 4 Ke esi Yesu nya nu siwo katã gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe edzi ta la, ezɔ va ŋgɔ hebia wo be: "Ame ka dim miele? " 5 Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Yesu, Nazaretetɔ lae. "
ENGLISH: 4 So Jesus, knowing everything that was coming upon him, went out and said to them "Whom are you looking for? " 5 They answered "Jesus the Nazarene. "

EWE: Egblɔ na wo be: "Nyee nye esi. "
ENGLISH: He said to them "I am the one. "

EWE: Yuda, ame si dee asi la, hã le tsitre ɖe wo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: And Judas too, the agent for the arrest, was standing with them.

EWE: 6 Ke esi Yesu gblɔ na wo be, "Nyee nye esi " la, wote yi megbe hedze anyi.
ENGLISH: 6 So when he said to them "I am the one " they went backward and fell to the ground.

EWE: 7 Eya ta egabia wo be: "Ame ka dim miele? " Wogblɔ be: "Yesu, Nazaretetɔ lae. " 8 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Megblɔ na mi xoxo be nyee. Eya ta ne nye dim miele la, ekema mina ame siawo ya nadzo. " 9 Ale be nya si wògblɔ la nava eme be, "Nyemebú ame siwo nètsɔ nam la dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã o. "
ENGLISH: 7 So he put the question to them again "Whom are you looking for? " and they said "Jesus the Nazarene. " 8 Jesus answered "I told you I am the one; so if you are looking for me, let these go off " 9 so that the words he had said, "of those whom you had given to me I did not lose any, " should be fulfilled.

EWE: 10 Kasia Simon Petro ɖe yi da nunɔlagã ƒe kluvi hekpa eƒe ɖusimeto ɖa.
ENGLISH: 10 So Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and hit the high priest’s slave and cut off his right ear.

EWE: Kluvi la ŋkɔe nye Malko.
ENGLISH: And the slave’s name was Malchus.

EWE: 11 Ke Yesu gblɔ na Petro be: "Gbugbɔ yi la de aku me. Ðe mele be mano kplu si Fofo la tsɔ nam la oa? "
ENGLISH: 11 So Jesus said to Peter "Put the sword in its sheath; when the Father has given me a cup am I not to drink it? "

EWE: 12 Eye asrafoha la kple aʋafiagã la kpakple Yudatɔwo ƒe dɔlawo lé Yesu heblae. 13 Wokplɔe yi Ana gbɔ gbã, elabena enye Kayafa, si nye nunɔlagã le ƒe ma me la, to.
ENGLISH: 12 So the cohort and the military tribune and the Jews’ officers arrested Jesus and bound him, 13 and took him first to Hannas; for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

EWE: 14 Le nyateƒe me la, Kayafa ye nye ame si ɖo aɖaŋu na Yudatɔwo be enyo wu sãsãsã be ame ɖeka naku ɖe dukɔ la ta. 15 Ke Simon Petro kple nusrɔ̃la bubu aɖe dze Yesu yome.
ENGLISH: 14 And Caiaphas was the one that had advised the Jews that it was "best to have one man die for the people. " 15 And Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus.

EWE: Nunɔlagã la dze si nusrɔ̃la ma, eya ta nusrɔ̃la ma kplɔ Yesu ɖo ge ɖe nunɔlagã la ƒe me, 16 ke Petro ya le tsitre ɖe xexe le ʋɔtrua nu.
ENGLISH: And that disciple was acquainted with the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard, 16 but Peter stood at the door outside.

EWE: Le esia ta nusrɔ̃la ma, si nunɔlagã la dze si la, do go, eye wòƒo nu kple agbonudzɔla la, eye wòkplɔ Petro ge ɖe eme.
ENGLISH: So the other disciple, the one that was acquainted with the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorwoman and brought Peter in.

EWE: 17 Eye dɔlanyɔnu, si nye agbonudzɔla la, bia Petro be: "Wò hã, menye ŋutsu sia ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖekae nènye oa? "
ENGLISH: 17 So the girl that was doorwoman said to Peter "Are you one of this man’s disciples too? "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu be: "Ao. " 18 Kluviwo kple dzɔlawo le tsitre ɖe afi ma le akadzo, si wodo la ƒum, elabena vuvɔ nɔ wɔwɔm. Petro hã le tsitre ɖe wo gbɔ le dzoa ƒum.
ENGLISH: He said "I am not. " 18 And the servants and the officers, having made a charcoal fire because it was cold, were standing and warming themselves; and Peter too was with them, standing and warming himself.

EWE: 19 Nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔ la bia gbe Yesu tso eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple eƒe nufiafia ŋu.
ENGLISH: 19 So the high priest asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

EWE: 20 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Meƒoa nu na xexea le dutoƒo. Mefiaa nu ɣesiaɣi le ƒuƒoƒewo kple gbedoxɔa me, afi si Yudatɔwo katã va ƒoa ƒu ɖo, eye nyemegblɔa nya aɖeke le bebeme o.
ENGLISH: 20 Jesus answered "I have spoken my words publicly to the world; I have always taught in synagogue and in the temple-precinct, where all the Jews come together, and have not spoken any word under cover.

EWE: 21 Nu ka tae nèle nya biamem? Bia ame siwo se nya siwo megblɔ na wo la. Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 21 Why do you ask me? ask those who have heard me what words I spoke to them; there they are, they know the things I said. "

EWE: Wonya nya siwo megblɔ. " 22 Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo la, dɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka si le tsitre ɖe afi ma la ƒo tome nɛ gblɔ be: "Aleae nàɖo nya ŋu na nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔa? " 23 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ne nya si megblɔ mesɔ o la, ekema gblɔ nu si gblẽ le eŋu; ke ne esɔ ɖe, nu ka tae nèƒom? " 24 Enɔ babla eye Ana ɖoe ɖe nunɔlagã Kayafa.
ENGLISH: 22 But when he said this, one of the officers, who was standing by, gave Jesus a slap and said "Do you answer the high priest like that? " 23 Jesus answered him "If I spoke amiss, bring the charge of misspeaking; if rightly, what are you beating me for? " 24 So Hannas sent him, bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

EWE: 25 Ke Simon Petro le tsitrenu ɖe afi ma le dzo ƒum.
ENGLISH: 25 But Simon Peter was standing and warming himself.

EWE: Eye wobiae be: "Menye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dome ɖekae nènye oa? "
ENGLISH: So they said to him "Are you one of his disciples too? "

EWE: Esẽ nu gblɔ be: "Ao. " 26 Nunɔlagã la ƒe kluviwo dometɔ ɖeka, si nye ŋutsu si ƒe to Petro kpa la ƒe ƒometɔ, biae be: "Menye wòe mekpɔ le abɔa me kplii oa? " 27 Gake Petro gasẽ nu, eye enumake koklo ku atɔ.
ENGLISH: He denied it and said "I am not. " 26 One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the one whose ear Peter had cut off, said "Didn’t I see you in the garden with him? " 27 So Peter denied again and at once a cock crowed.

EWE: 28 Azɔ le ŋdi kanya la, wokplɔ Yesu tso Kayafa gbɔ yi nutodziɖula la ƒe me.
ENGLISH: 28 So they took Jesus from Caiaphas to the praetorium.

EWE: Ke woawo ŋutɔwo mege ɖe nutodziɖula la ƒe aƒea me o, be woagagblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui o, ale be woate ŋu aɖu Ŋutitoto la.
ENGLISH: It was early in the morning; and they did not go in into the praetorium, that they might not be polluted but might eat the passover.

EWE: 29 Eya ta Pilato do go va wo gbɔ hebia wo be: "Nya kae mietsɔ ɖe ame sia ŋu? " 30 Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ne menye nu gbegblẽ wɔlae ame sia nye o la, anye ne míedee asi na wò o. " 31 Eya ta Pilato gblɔ na wo be: "Miawo ŋutɔwo mikplɔe yii, ne miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui le miaƒe se la nu. "
ENGLISH: 29 So Pilate came outside to them and said "What charges do you bring against this man? " 30 They replied "If the man had not committed a crime we should not have handed him over to you. " 31 So Pilate said to them "Take him yourselves, and pass judgment on him under your law. "

EWE: Yudatɔwo gblɔ nɛ be: "Se meɖe mɔ na mí be míawu ame o. " 32 Esia dzɔ, ne Yesu ƒe nya si wògblɔ le ku si ƒomevi ku ge wòala ŋu la nava eme.
ENGLISH: The Jews said to him "We are not permitted to put anybody to death " 32 so that Jesus’s words which he had spoken, indicating what death he was to die, should be fulfilled.

EWE: 33 Eya ta Pilato gage ɖe aƒea me ake, eye wòyɔ Yesu hebiae be: "Wòe nye Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia la? " 34 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò sie nèle nya sia biam le loo alo ame bubuwoe gblɔ ŋutinye nya na wòa? " 35 Pilato ɖo eŋu be: "Yudatɔe menyea?
ENGLISH: 33 So Pilate went in again into the praetorium and called Jesus and said to him "You are the King of the Jews? " 34 Jesus answered "Are you saying this of your own accord, or did others say it to you about me? " 35 Pilate answered "Am I a Jew?

EWE: Wò ŋutɔ wò dukɔ kple nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwoe tsɔ wò de asi nam.
ENGLISH: Your nation and the chief priests handed you over to me; what had you done? "

EWE: Nu kae nèwɔ? " 36 Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Nye Fiaɖuƒe menye xexe sia ƒe akpa aɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 36 Jesus answered "My kingship does not belong to this world.

EWE: Ne ɖe nye Fiaɖuƒe nye xexe sia ƒe akpa aɖe la, anye ne nye dɔlawo wɔ avu be woagatsɔm ade asi na Yudatɔwo o.
ENGLISH: If my kingship belonged to this world my subordinates would be making a fight to keep me from falling into the hands of the Jews; but in fact my kingship is not in this sphere. "

EWE: Ke abe ale si wòle ene la, nye Fiaɖuƒe metso afi sia o. " 37 Eya ta Pilato biae be: "Ekema, fiae nènyea? "
ENGLISH: 37 So Pilate said to him "Then you are a king? "

EWE: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: "Eya tututue nye ema nègblɔ be fiae menye.
ENGLISH: Jesus answered "As you say; I am a king.

EWE: Elabena esia tae wodzim ɖo, eye esia tae meva xexea me ɖo, be maɖi ɖase na nyateƒe la.
ENGLISH: I was born for this and have come into the world for this, that I might testify to the truth; everyone who belongs to the truth listens to my voice. "

EWE: Ame sia ame si le nyateƒea ƒe akpa dzi la ɖoa to nye gbe. " 38 Pilato biae be: "Nu kae nye nyateƒe? "
ENGLISH: 38 Pilate said to him "What is truth? "

EWE: Esi wògblɔ esia la, egado go yi Yudatɔwo gbɔ, eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Nyemekpɔ vodada aɖeke le eŋu o.
ENGLISH: And with this he went out to the Jews again and said to them "I do not find any case against him.

EWE: 39 Azɔ hã le miaƒe kɔa nu la, ele be maɖe asi le ame ɖeka ŋu na mi le Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi. Eya ta miedi be maɖe asi le Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la ŋu na mia? " 40 Eye wogado ɣli be: "Menye ame sia o, ke boŋ Baraba! "
ENGLISH: 39 But you have a custom that I should release one man for you at the passover; so do you want me to release the King of the Jews for you? " 40 So they went to shouting again, saying "Not this man but Bar-Abbas. "

EWE: Ke Baraba la, adzodalae wònye.
ENGLISH: And Bar-Abbas was a robber.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 19 Eya ta Pilato na woƒo Yesu kple atam. 2 Asrafoawo tsɔ ŋù lɔ̃ fiakuku ɖɔ nɛ, eye wodo awudziwui hɛ̃ aɖe nɛ; 3 eye wotena ɖe eŋu gblɔna be: "Míedo gbe na wò, Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia! "
ENGLISH: 19 So then Pilate took Jesus and flogged him; 2 and the soldiers braided a wreath of thorns and set it on his head and put a purple cloak round him, 3 and came to him and said "Good morning, King of the Jews! " and gave him slaps.

EWE: Woƒoa tome hã nɛ. 4 Pilato gado go va gblɔ na wo be: "Mikpɔ ɖa! Mekplɔe do goe vɛ na mi, be miadze sii be nyemekpɔ vodada aɖeke le eŋu o. " 5 Ale Yesu do va, ŋùfiakuku la le ta nɛ eye awudziwui dzĩ la le eŋu. Pilato gblɔ na wo be: "Mikpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 4 And Pilate came outside again and said to them "Here, I am bringing him outside to you so that you may know that I do not find any case against him "; 5 so Jesus came outside wearing the thorn wreath and the purple cloak; and he said to them "There is the man! "

EWE: Ŋutsu lae nye esi! " 6 Ke esi nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple dɔlawo kpɔe la, wodo ɣli be: "Hee ɖe ati ŋu!
ENGLISH: 6 So when the chief priests and the officers saw him they went to shouting "Crucify him, crucify him! "

EWE: Hee ɖe ati ŋu! "
ENGLISH: Pilate said to them "Take him yourselves and crucify him; for I do not find any case against him. "

EWE: Pilato gblɔ na wo be: "Miawo ŋutɔ mikplɔe yi, ne miahee ɖe ati ŋu, elabena nyemekpɔ vodada aɖeke le eŋu o. " 7 Yudatɔwo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Se le mía si, eye le se sia nu la, edze be wòaku, elabena ewɔ eɖokui Mawu ƒe vii. "
ENGLISH: 7 The Jews answered "We have a law, and according to the law he ought to die, because he claimed to be God’s son. "

EWE: 8 Esi Pilato se woƒe nyaawo la, vɔvɔ̃ gaɖoe ɖe edzi, 9 egage ɖe aƒea me, eye wòbia Yesu be: "Afi kae nètso? "
ENGLISH: 8 So when Pilate heard those words he was all the more afraid, 9 and went in again into the praetorium and said to Jesus "Where do you come from? " but Jesus did not give him any answer.

EWE: Ke Yesu meɖo nya aɖeke ŋu nɛ o. 10 Eya ta Pilato gblɔ nɛ be: "Mèle nyaa ŋu ɖo ge nam oa?
ENGLISH: 10 So Pilate said to him "Do you not speak to me? do you not know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you? "

EWE: Mènya be ŋusẽ le asinye be maɖe asi le ŋuwò, eye ŋusẽ le asinye be mahe wò ɖe ati ŋu oa? " 11 Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ŋusẽ aɖeke kura manɔ asiwò ɖe dzinye o, negbe ɖe wona wò tso dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 11 Jesus answered "You would not have any power at all against me if it were not given to you from above; for this reason the one who handed me over to you has the greater sin. "

EWE: Esia tae ame si tsɔm de asi na wò la ƒe nu vɔ̃ lolo wu. " 12 Esia na Pilato va nɔ mɔ si dzi wòato aɖe asi le eŋu la dim, ke Yudatɔwo do ɣli be: "Ne èɖe asi le ame sia ŋu la, ekema mènye Kaisaro xɔlɔ̃ o.
ENGLISH: 12 At that Pilate made a move to release him; but the Jews went to shouting "If you release this man you are no friend to Caesar; anyone who claims to be a king is opposing Caesar. "

EWE: Ame sia ame si wɔa eɖokui fiae la ƒoa nu tsia tsitre ɖe Kaisaro ŋu. " 13 Esi Pilato se nya siawo la, ekplɔ Yesu do goe, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui la dzi, le teƒe si woyɔna be Kpenyigba la. Woyɔa teƒe sia le Hebrigbe me be Gabata.
ENGLISH: 13 So, hearing those words, Pilate brought Jesus out and took his seat on a judgment-bench in a place called the Mosaic Pavement, or, in Hebrew, Gabbatha.

EWE: 14 Ke gbe ma gbee nye Dzadzraɖoŋkeke na Ŋutitoto la; anye gaƒoƒo adelia me lɔƒo.
ENGLISH: 14 And it was Passover Friday.

EWE: Eye wògblɔ na Yudatɔwo be: "Mikpɔ ɖa! Miaƒe fia lae nye esi! " 15 Ke wodo ɣli be: "Bu mo nɛ! Bu mo nɛ! Hee ɖe ati ŋu! "
ENGLISH: It was about twelve o’clock; and he said to the Jews "Here is your King. " 15 So they shouted "Get him away, get him away, crucify him! "

EWE: Pilato bia wo be: "Mahe miaƒe fia la ɖe ati ŋua? "
ENGLISH: Pilate said to them "Crucify your King? "

EWE: Nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo ɖo eŋu be: "Fia aɖeke mele mía si o, negbe Kaisaro ko. " 16 Ale wòɖe asi le eŋu na wo be woahee ɖe ati ŋu. Eye wokplɔ Yesu dzoe.
ENGLISH: The chief priests answered "We have no king but Caesar. " 16 So then he turned him over to them to be crucified.

EWE: 17 Eya ŋutɔ tsɔ fuwɔameti la zɔ yi teƒe si woyɔna be Ametakoliƒe. Woyɔa teƒe sia le Hebrigbe me be Golgata. 18 Wohee ɖe ati ŋu le afi ma, eye wohe ame eve bubu ɖe ati ŋu kpe ɖe eŋu, le eƒe axa eveawo dzi, eye Yesu le wo titina.
ENGLISH: So they took Jesus over, 17 and, carrying the cross for himself, he went out to the so-called Skull-Place, of which name the Hebrew is Golgotha, 18 where they crucified him, and with him two others, one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

EWE: 19 Azɔ hã Pilato ŋlɔ dzesideŋkɔ aɖe tsɔ ɖo fuwɔameti la ŋu. Nu si wòŋlɔ lae nye: "Yesu, Nazaretetɔ, Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia la. " 20 Yudatɔ geɖewo xlẽ dzesideŋkɔ sia, elabena afi si wohe Yesu ɖe ati ŋu le la gogo dua, eye woŋlɔe ɖe Hebrigbe, Latingbe kple Helagbe me.
ENGLISH: 19 And Pilate also wrote a sign and put it on the cross; and what was written was "Jesus the Nazarene, King of the Jews. " 20 So a great many of the Jews read that sign, because the place was near the city, where Jesus was crucified, and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

EWE: 21 Ke Yudatɔwo ƒe nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo gblɔ na Pilato be: "Mègaŋlɔ be, ‘Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia’ o, ke boŋ be egblɔ be, ‘Nyee nye Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia.’ " 22 Pilato ɖo eŋu be: "Nu si meŋlɔ la, meŋlɔe xoxo. "
ENGLISH: 21 So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate "Do not write ‘King of the Jews,’ but that he said ‘I am King of the Jews.’ " 22 Pilate answered "What I have written I have written. "

EWE: 23 Ke esi asrafowo he Yesu ɖe ati ŋu la, wotsɔ eƒe awudziwuiwo, eye woma wo ɖe akpa ene me, be asrafo ɖeka naxɔ ɖeka, eye wotsɔ awutewui la hã.
ENGLISH: 23 So the soldiers, when they crucified Jesus, took his clothes and made four parts, a part for each soldier, and the tunic.

EWE: Ke wometɔ awutewuia ya o, ɖe wolɔ̃e bliboe tso dzi va anyi. 24 Eya ta wogblɔ na wo nɔewo be: "Migana míadzee o, ke boŋ mina míadzidze nu ɖe edzi ne míakpɔ ame si tɔ wòanye. " Esia dzɔ, ne ŋɔŋlɔ la nava eme be: "Woma nye awuwo ɖe wo nɔewo dome, eye wodzidze nu ɖe nye awu dzi. "
ENGLISH: But the tunic was seamless, woven work all the way from the top; 24 so they said to each other "Let us not tear it, but toss for it to decide who shall have it " that the text might be fulfilled, "They divided my clothes among them and threw lots for my apparel. "

EWE: Eye nu siawo tututue asrafoawo wɔ.
ENGLISH: So those were the things the soldiers did.

EWE: 25 Ke Yesu dada kple dadaa nɔvinyɔnu kpakple Klopa srɔ̃ Maria, kple Maria Magdalatɔ le tsitre ɖe Yesu ƒe fuwɔameti la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 25 But by Jesus’s cross were standing his mother and his mother’s sister, Mary the daughter of Clopas, and Mary the Magdalene.

EWE: 26 Esi Yesu kpɔ dadaa kple nusrɔ̃la si wòlɔ̃na vevie wole tsitre ɖe afi ma la, egblɔ na dadaa be: "Nyɔnu, kpɔ ɖa! Viwòe nye esi! " 27 Egblɔ na nusrɔ̃la la be: "Kpɔ ɖa! Dawòe nye esi! "
ENGLISH: 26 So Jesus, seeing his mother and the disciple he loved standing beside her, said to his mother "Woman, there is your son "; 27 then he said to the disciple "There is your mother. "

EWE: Eye tso ɣemaɣi dzi la, nusrɔ̃la la kplɔe yi eya ŋutɔ ƒe me.
ENGLISH: And from that moment the disciple took her into his home.

EWE: 28 Le nu siawo megbe, esi Yesu nya be wowu nuwo katã nu vɔ azɔ, eye be ŋɔŋlɔ la nava eme la, egblɔ be: "Tsikɔ le wuyem. " 29 Ze aɖe le afi ma, si wain tsitsi yɔ fũu.
ENGLISH: 28 After that Jesus, knowing that everything was finished now, said "I am thirsty, " in order that the text might completely come true.

EWE: Eya ta wotsɔ ƒumekutsa de wain tsitsia me, tsɔe ɖo isop ti nu, eye wotsɔe ɖo nu nɛ.
ENGLISH: 29 There was a dish standing there full of vinegar; so they stuck a sponge full of the vinegar on a pilum and put it to his mouth.

EWE: 30 Ke esi Yesu ɖɔ wain tsitsia kpɔ la, egblɔ be: "Wowu enu! " eye esi wòbɔbɔ ta la, eƒe gbɔgbɔ nu tso.
ENGLISH: 30 So when Jesus had had the vinegar he said "It is finished " and bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

EWE: 31 Azɔ esi wònye Dzadzraɖoŋkekee, eye womedi be woƒe kukuawo natsi fuwɔametia ŋu le Sabat dzi o ta la (elabena Sabat gãe sabat ŋkeke ma nye), Yudatɔwo bia Pilato be wòana woaŋe woƒe afɔwo, eye woaɖe woƒe kukuawo adzoe.
ENGLISH: 31 So the Jews, since it was Friday, asked Pilate, in order that the bodies might not remain on the cross on the sabbath (for that sabbath was a great day) to have their legs broken and have them taken away.

EWE: 32 Eya ta asrafoawo va, eye woŋe ame eve siwo wohe ɖe ati ŋu kpe ɖe eŋu la ƒe afɔwo. 33 Ke esi wova Yesu gbɔ la wokpɔ be eku xoxo, eya ta womeŋe eƒe afɔwo o. 34 Gake asrafoawo dometɔ ɖeka tɔ akplɔ eƒe axadame, enumake ʋu kple tsi do go.
ENGLISH: 32 So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him; 33 but when in coming to Jesus they saw he had already died, they did not break his legs, 34 but one of the soldiers ran a pike into his side, and at once blood and water came out.

EWE: 35 Eye ame si kpɔ nu siawo teƒe lae ɖi ɖase le wo ŋu, eye eƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la nye nyateƒe, eye ame ma nya be nya si yegblɔna la nye nyateƒe, ne miawo hã miaxɔe ase.
ENGLISH: 35 And the one who saw it has testified, and his testimony is authentic, and he himself knows he is speaking the truth, that you too may believe.

EWE: 36 Le nyateƒe me la, nu siawo dzɔ, ne ŋɔŋlɔ la nava eme be: "Womaŋe eƒe ƒu ɖeka pɛ hã o. " 37 Eye ŋɔŋlɔ bubu hã gblɔ be: "Woafɔ ŋku ɖe ame si woƒo nu ɖo la dzi. "
ENGLISH: 36 For these things took place so that the text "not a bone of his is to be broken " should be fulfilled. 37 And again another text says "they shall look toward him whom they pierced. "

EWE: 38 Ke le nu siawo megbe la, Yosef si tso Arimatia, ame si nye Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la le adzame le vɔvɔ̃ na Yudatɔwo ta la, bia Pilato be yeaxɔ Yesu ƒe kukua, eye Pilato ɖe mɔ nɛ.
ENGLISH: 38 And after this was done Joseph from Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus but had kept it hidden for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away Jesus’s body; and Pilate gave permission.

EWE: Ale wòva tsɔ eƒe kukua yii. 39 Nikodemo, ame si va egbɔ va yi le zã me hã va, eye wòtsɔ mire kple aloe si wotsaka, si ade pounde alafa ɖeka kloe la vɛ.
ENGLISH: 39 And Nicodemus too, he who had in the first place come to Jesus by night, came bringing a mixture of myrrh and eaglewood, about a hundred pounds of it.

EWE: 40 Eya ta wotsɔ Yesu ƒe kukua, eye wosi atike ʋeʋĩwo nɛ heblae ɖe aklala me, abe ale si ko Yudatɔwo dzraa ame kuku ɖo hafi ɖina ene.
ENGLISH: 40 So they took Jesus’s body and tied it up in lawn sheets with the spices, as it is customary among the Jews to do in burying.

EWE: 41 Ke abɔ aɖe hã nɔ teƒe si wohee ɖe ati ŋu le, eye yɔdo yeye aɖe, si me wometsɔ ame aɖeke mlɔ kpɔ o la, le abɔ la me. 42 Esi wònye Yudatɔwo ƒe Dzadzraɖoŋkekee, eye yɔdoa hã gbɔ medidi o ta la, wotsɔ Yesu mlɔ eme.
ENGLISH: 41 And in the place where he was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which nobody had as yet been laid; 42 so, because of the Jews’ preparation day, they laid Jesus there because the tomb was nearby.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 20 Le kwasiɖaa ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la, Maria Magdalatɔ yi yɔdoa to le ŋdi kanya, esi xexea me mekpɔ kɔ haɖe o, eye wòkpɔ be womli kpe la ɖa xoxo le yɔdoa nu.
ENGLISH: 20 But on the first day of the week Mary the Magdalene came to the tomb in the early morning, while it was still dark, and saw the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

EWE: 2 Eya ta eƒu du va Simon Petro kple nusrɔ̃la kemɛ, si gbɔ Yesu melɔ̃a nu le o la gbɔ, eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Wokɔ Aƒetɔ la dzoe le yɔdoa me, eye míenya afi si wodae ɖo o. " 3 Eya ta Petro kple nusrɔ̃la kemɛa dze mɔ ɖo ta yɔdoa gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 2 So she ran and came to Simon Peter and the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them "They have taken the Lord away out of the tomb and we do not know where they have put him. " 3 So out went Peter, and the other disciple, and they came to the tomb.

EWE: 4 Wo ame evea de afɔ du me, ke nusrɔ̃la kemɛa ƒe afɔ tsɔ wu Petro tɔ, eye wòtre yɔdoa gbɔ ɖoɖo. 5 Esi wòdo kɔ ɖa la, ekpɔ be aklalaawo le eme, gake mege ɖe eme o.
ENGLISH: 4 And the two were running together, and the other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first, 5 and stooped and looked in and saw the sheets lying there, but he did not go in.

EWE: 6 Simon Petro hã le eyome va ɖo, eye wòge ɖe yɔdoa me. Eye wòkpɔ aklalaawo le eme. 7 Avɔ si wotsɔ bla ta nɛ hã le eme, gake mele aklalaawo gbɔ o, ke boŋ woƒoe da ɖe afi bubu.
ENGLISH: 6 So Simon Peter too came following him, and went into the tomb; and he saw the sheets lying there, 7 and the handkerchief that had been over his head not lying with the sheets but wrapped round and round separately in its individual place.

EWE: 8 Eya ta nusrɔ̃la si tre yɔdoa gbɔ ɖoɖo la hã ge ɖe eme azɔ, eye wòkpɔe, eye wòxɔe se.
ENGLISH: 8 So then the other disciple too went in, the one that had come to the tomb first, and he saw and believed.

EWE: 9 Elabena womekpɔ se ŋɔŋlɔ la gɔme haɖe be ele be wòafɔ tso ku me o.
ENGLISH: 9 For they did not yet know the text that said he must rise from the dead.

EWE: 10 Ale nusrɔ̃laawo gbugbɔ yi woƒe aƒewo me.
ENGLISH: 10 So the disciples went off home again.

EWE: 11 Ke Maria ya kpɔtɔ le tsitre ɖe yɔdoa to le avi fam.
ENGLISH: 11 But Mary was standing outside by the tomb weeping.

EWE: Esi wòle avia fam la, edo kɔ ɖa be yeakpɔ yɔdoa me, 12 eye wòkpɔ mawudɔla eve le awu ɣiwo me, ɖeka le afi si Yesu mlɔ la ƒe tade, eye evelia le eƒe afɔde.
ENGLISH: So while she was weeping she stooped and looked into the tomb 12 and saw two angels in white sitting one at the head and one at the feet where Jesus’s body had lain; 13 and they said to her "Woman, why are you weeping? "

EWE: 13 Eye wobiae be: "Nyɔnu, nu ka tae nèle avi fam? "
ENGLISH: She said to them "Because they have taken my Lord away and I do not know where they have put him. "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu na wo be: "Wokɔ nye Aƒetɔ la dzoe, gake nyemenya afi si wotsɔe yi ɖada ɖo o. " 14 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, etrɔ, eye wòkpɔ Yesu wòtɔ ɖe afi ma, ke mekpɔe dze sii be Yesue o.
ENGLISH: 14 Saying this, she turned round and saw Jesus standing there, and did not know it was Jesus.

EWE: 15 Yesu biae be: "Nyɔnu, nu ka tae nèle avi fam?
ENGLISH: 15 Jesus said to her "Woman, why are you weeping? whom are you looking for? "

EWE: Ame ka dim nèle? "
ENGLISH: She, thinking it was the caretaker of the garden, said to him "Sir, if you have carried him off, tell me where you put him and I will take him away. "

EWE: Esi wòsusu be abɔdzikpɔlae ta la, egblɔ nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, ne wòe kɔe dzoe la, ekema gblɔ afi si nètsɔe da ɖo la nam, ne mayi aɖakɔe. " 16 Yesu yɔe be: "Maria! "
ENGLISH: 16 Jesus said to her "Mary " She turned and said to him in Hebrew "Rabbuni! " that is to say, "Teacher! "

EWE: Etrɔ eye wòyɔe le Hebrigbe me be: "Raboni! " (si gɔmee nye "Nufiala! ") 17 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Dzudzɔ kuku ɖe ŋunye, elabena nyemekpɔ yi Fofo la gbɔ haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 17 Jesus said to her "Do not touch me, for I have not yet gone up to my Father.

EWE: Ke yi nɔvinyewo gbɔ, eye nàgblɔ na wo be, ‘Meyina Fofonye kple mia Fofo, nye Mawu kple mia Mawu la gbɔ.’ " 18 Maria Magdalatɔ la va gblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo be: "Mekpɔ Aƒetɔ la! " Eye wògblɔ nya siwo wògblɔ nɛ la na wo.
ENGLISH: But go to my brothers and tell them ‘I am going to my Father, your Father, my God, your God.’ " 18 Mary the Magdalene came reporting to the disciples "I have seen the Lord " and that he had said these things to her.

EWE: 19 Le ŋkeke ma, si nye kwasiɖaa ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ, ƒe fiẽ me, esi nusrɔ̃lawo le vɔvɔ̃m na Yudatɔwo ta la, wotu ʋɔtruawo le afi si wole, gake Yesu va tsi tsitre ɖe wo dome, eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Ŋutifafa na mi. " 20 Esi wògblɔ esia vɔ la, etsɔ eƒe asiwo kple axadame fia wo.
ENGLISH: 19 So when it was evening on that day, the first of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle of the company and said to them "Peace be to you "; 20 and with that he showed them his hands and his side.

EWE: Ale nusrɔ̃lawo kpɔ dzidzɔ le esi wokpɔ Aƒetɔ la ta.
ENGLISH: So the disciples were glad to see the Lord.

EWE: 21 Yesu gagblɔ na wo be: "Ŋutifafa na mi.
ENGLISH: 21 So Jesus said to them again "Peace be to you.

EWE: Abe ale si ko Fofo la dɔm ene la, nye hã mele mia dɔm. " 22 Esi wògblɔ esia la, egbɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Mixɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe.
ENGLISH: In the same way as the Father has sent me out, I am sending you "; 22 and with that he poured a breath over them and said to them "Take Holy Spirit.

EWE: 23 Ne mietsɔ amewo ƒe nu vɔ̃wo ke wo la, ekema wotsɔ wo ke wo; gake ame siwo ƒe nu vɔ̃wo mietsɔ ke o la, wometsɔ wo ke wo o. "
ENGLISH: 23 If you forgive anybody’s sins he has them forgiven; if you condemn anybody’s they are condemned. "

EWE: 24 Ke Toma, si nye Ame Wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka, ame si woyɔna be Venɔvi la, menɔ wo dome esime Yesu va o.
ENGLISH: 24 But Thomas, one of the Twelve, known as the Twin, was not with them when Jesus came.

EWE: 25 Eya ta nusrɔ̃la bubuawo gblɔ nɛ be: "Míekpɔ Aƒetɔ la! "
ENGLISH: 25 So the other disciples said to him "We have seen the Lord. "

EWE: 26 Ke le ŋkeke enyi megbe la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gale xɔ me, eye Toma hã le wo dome. Togbɔ be ʋɔtruawo le tutu hã la, Yesu va tsi tsitre ɖe wo dome hegblɔ be: "Ŋutifafa na mi. " 27 Eye wògblɔ na Toma be: "Ƒo wò asibidɛ ɖe afii, eye nàkpɔ nye asiwo, tsɔ wò asi ƒo ɖe nye axadame, dzudzɔ ɖikeke ne nàxɔ se. " 28 Toma ɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Nye Aƒetɔ kple nye Mawu! " 29 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Esi nèkpɔm tae nèxɔe sea?
ENGLISH: But he said to them "Unless I see in his hands the mark of the nails and put my finger into the mark of the nails and put my hand into his side I will not believe. " 26 And one week later the disciples were in there again, and Thomas with them; Jesus came while the doors were shut and stood in the middle of the company and said "Peace be to you. " 27 Then he said to Thomas "Bring on your finger and see about my hands, and bring your hand and put it into my side; and do not be a disbeliever but a believer. " 28 Thomas answered him "My Lord and my God! " 29 Jesus said to him "Because you have seen you have believed, have you?

EWE: Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye ame siwo mekpɔa nu hafi xɔna sena o. "
ENGLISH: Happy are those who did not see and believed. "

EWE: 30 Le nyateƒe me la, Yesu wɔ dzesi bubu geɖewo le eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋkume, siwo womeŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ xatsaxatsa sia me o. 31 Ke woŋlɔ esiawo ɖi, ne miaxɔe ase be Yesue nye Kristo la, Mawu ƒe Vi la, eye esi miexɔe se ta la, miakpɔ agbe to eƒe ŋkɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 30 Many more tokens Jesus did before the disciples, which are not written down in this book; 31 but these have been written down, in order that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that, believing, you may have life by his name.

EWE: Yohanes
ENGLISH: John

EWE: 21 Le nu sia megbe la, Yesu gaɖe eɖokui fia nusrɔ̃lawo le Tiberia-ƒua nu.
ENGLISH: 21 After this Jesus made himself visible to the disciples again at the sea of Tiberias.

EWE: Ale si wòɖe eɖokui fia woe nye esi: 2 Simon Petro, Toma (si woyɔna be Venɔvi), Nataniel, si tso Kana le Galilea, Zebedeo viwo, hekpe ɖe eƒe nusrɔ̃la eve bubu ŋu, nɔ afi ɖeka. 3 Simon Petro gblɔ na wo be: "Meyina tɔƒo. " Wogblɔ nɛ be: "Míayi kpli wò. "
ENGLISH: And he did it thus: 2 There were together Simon Peter and Thomas known as the Twin and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee and the sons of Zebedee and two more of his disciples; 3 Simon Peter said to them "I am going fishing "; they said to him "We are coming too. "

EWE: Ale woyi ɖage ɖe tɔdziʋua me, ke womeɖe lã aɖeke le zã ma me o.
ENGLISH: They went out and got into the boat, and in that night they caught nothing.

EWE: 4 Ke le fɔŋli la, Yesu va tɔ ɖe ƒua nu, gake nusrɔ̃lawo mekpɔe dze sii be Yesue o.
ENGLISH: 4 But when the morning was already breaking Jesus made his appearance standing on the beach; the disciples did not know, however, that it was Jesus.

EWE: 5 Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Vinyewo, nane le mia si miaɖua? "
ENGLISH: 5 So Jesus said to them "Boys, have you caught any? "

EWE: Woɖo eŋu be: "Ao! " 6 Egblɔ na wo be: "Mida ɖɔ la ɖe ʋua ƒe ɖusime, eye miakpɔ lã aɖe. "
ENGLISH: They answered "No. " 6 But he said to them "Throw the net to the right of the boat and you will. "

EWE: Eya ta woda ɖɔa, ke wode ehe ge do kpoe le lã gbogbo si woɖe ta.
ENGLISH: So they threw, and were not able to haul it in again because of the quantity of fish.

EWE: 7 Eye nusrɔ̃la si Yesu lɔ̃na vevie la gblɔ na Petro be: "Aƒetɔ lae! "
ENGLISH: 7 So the aforesaid disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter "It is the Lord. "

EWE: Esi Simon Petro se be Aƒetɔ lae la, etsɔ eƒe awudziwui do, elabena ele amama, eye wòdzo dze ƒua me doo.
ENGLISH: So Simon Peter, hearing that it was the Lord, tied his cape on as a loincloth, for he was naked, and threw himself into the sea.

EWE: 8 Gake nusrɔ̃la bubuawo ya le tɔdziʋu sue la me gbɔna hele ɖɔ si me lãawo yɔ fũu la hem, wo kple gota dome medidi o, anɔ abe meta blaasieke ko ene.
ENGLISH: 8 But the other disciples came in the boat (for they were not far from the land, but about a hundred yards), dragging the netful of fish.

EWE: 9 Esi wova ɖi go la, wokpɔ akadzo aɖe le afi ma, lãwo le edzi eye abolo hã le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 9 So when they stepped ashore they saw a bed of coals and a fish lying on it, and a cake of bread.

EWE: 10 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Mitsɔ lã siwo mieɖe fifi laa la ƒe ɖe vɛ. " 11 Eya ta Simon Petro yi ɖage ɖe ʋua me, eye wòhe ɖɔ si yɔ fũu kple lã gã alafa ɖeka blaatɔ̃ vɔ etɔ̃ la va gota. Togbɔ be lãawo sɔ gbɔ hã la, ɖɔa medze o.
ENGLISH: 10 Jesus said to them "Bring some of the fish you have just caught. " 11 So Simon Peter went aboard and hauled the net ashore full of large fishes, a hundred and fifty-three of them; and, many as there were, the net did not tear.

EWE: 12 Yesu gblɔ na wo be: "Miva ɖu ŋdinu. "
ENGLISH: 12 Jesus said to them "Come and have breakfast. "

EWE: Dzi menɔ nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ aɖeke ƒo ne wòabiae be: "Ame kae nènye? " hã o, elabena wonya be Aƒetɔ lae.
ENGLISH: The disciples did not any of them dare to challenge him with "Who are you? " knowing that it was the Lord.

EWE: 13 Yesu yi ɖatsɔ abolo la na wo, nenema kee wòtsɔ tɔmelã la hã na wo.
ENGLISH: 13 Jesus came and took the bread and passed it to them, and the fish too.

EWE: 14 Esiae nye zi etɔ̃lia si Yesu ɖe eɖokui fia nusrɔ̃laawo le eƒe fɔfɔ tso ku me megbe.
ENGLISH: 14 This made the third time Jesus had made himself visible to the disciples since he rose from the dead.

EWE: 15 Esi woɖu ŋdinu vɔ la, Yesu bia Simon Petro be: "Simon, Yohanes vi, èlɔ̃am wu esiawoa? "
ENGLISH: 15 So when they had had their breakfast Jesus said to Simon Peter "Simon son of John, do you care more for me than for this? "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ɛ̃, Aƒetɔ, ènya be nyemelɔ̃a nu le gbɔwò o. "
ENGLISH: He said to him "Yes, sir, you know that I love you. " He said to him "Tend my lambs! "

EWE: Egblɔ nɛ be: "Nyi nye alẽviawo. " 16 Egabiae zi evelia be: "Simon, Yohanes vi, èlɔ̃ma? "
ENGLISH: 16 He said to him again a second time "Simon son of John, do you care for me? "

EWE: Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Ɛ̃, Aƒetɔ, ènya be nyemelɔ̃a nu le gbɔwò o. "
ENGLISH: He said to him "Yes, sir, you know that I love you. " He said to him "Shepherd my sheep! "

EWE: Egblɔ nɛ be: "Kplɔ nye alẽ sueawo. " 17 Egabiae zi etɔ̃lia be: "Simon, Yohanes vi, mèlɔ̃a nu le gbɔnye oa? "
ENGLISH: 17 He said to him the third time "Simon son of John, do you love me? "

EWE: Ete ɖe Petro dzi be ebia ye zi etɔ̃lia be: "Mèlɔ̃a nu le gbɔnye oa? " Eya ta eɖo eŋu nɛ be: "Aƒetɔ, ènya nuwo katã, ènyae be nyemelɔ̃a nu le gbɔwò o. "
ENGLISH: Peter was pained that the third time he had said to him "Do you love me? " and said to him "Sir, you know everything, you know that I love you. "

EWE: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Nyi nye alẽ sueawo. 18 Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò be, esime mèkpɔ tsi alea o la, wò ŋutɔ èdoa awu heyia afi si nèdi.
ENGLISH: Jesus said to him "Tend my sheep! 18 Verily, verily I tell you, when you were a young man you put on your belt and walked where you wanted to; but when you come to be old you will stretch out your hands and somebody else will put a belt round you and carry you where you do not want him to. "

EWE: Ke ne èku amegã la, àkɔ wò abɔwo dzi, eye ame bubu ado awu na wò, eye wòakplɔ wò ayi afi si mèdi o. " 19 Egblɔ esia tsɔ fia ku si ƒomevi ku ge Petro gbɔna atsɔ ado Mawu ɖe dzii.
ENGLISH: 19 This he said indicating by what sort of death he would glorify God.

EWE: Eya ta esi wògblɔ nya sia la, egblɔ nɛ be: "Nɔ yonyeme ɖaa. "
ENGLISH: And with that he said to him "Follow me. "

EWE: 20 Esi Petro trɔ la, ekpɔ nusrɔ̃la si Yesu lɔ̃na vevie la wòdze wo yome; ame siae ziɔ ɖe eƒe akɔta le fiẽnuɖuɣia, eye wòbiae be: "Aƒetɔ, ame kae ade wò asi mahã? " 21 Eya ta esi Petro kpɔe la, ebia Yesu be: "Aƒetɔ, ke ame sia ya ɖe? " 22 Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: "Ne nye lɔlɔ̃nue wònye be wòanɔ anyi va se ɖe esime mava ɖe, afi kae wòka na wò? Wò ya yi edzi nànɔ yonyeme. " 23 Ale nya sia kaka ɖe nɔviawo dome be nusrɔ̃la ma maku o.
ENGLISH: 20 Peter turned round and saw the disciple that Jesus loved following, the same who at the dinner leaned back on his breast and said "Sir, who is the one to have you arrested? " 21 So, seeing him, Peter said to Jesus "And how about him, sir? " 22 Jesus said to him "If I want him to stay till I come, what is it to you? follow me yourself. " 23 So this saying went out among the brothers, that that disciple was not to die.

EWE: Gake Yesu megblɔ nɛ be maku o, ke boŋ egblɔ be: "Ne nye lɔlɔ̃nue wònye be wòanɔ anyi va se ɖe esime mava ɖe, afi kae wòka na wò? " 24 Nusrɔ̃la siae le ɖase ɖim le nu siawo ŋu, eyae ŋlɔ nu siawo, eye míenya be ɖase si wòɖina la nye nyateƒe.
ENGLISH: But Jesus did not say to him that he was not to die, but "If I want him to stay till I come. " 24 This is the disciple who testifies about these things and who wrote these things down; and we know that his testimony is true.

EWE: 25 Le nyateƒe me la, nu bubu geɖewo gali, siwo Yesu wɔ, eye ne ɖe woŋlɔ wo ɖi tsitotsito la, mesusu be xexe bliboa gɔ̃ hã mate ŋu akpɔ teƒe na agbalẽ siwo woaŋlɔ la o.
ENGLISH: 25 And there are many more things that Jesus did; if those are each one written down I do not think there will be room in the world itself for the books that are going to be written.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: Wokpɔe le ŋkeke blaeneawo me, eye wòƒo nu na wo tso Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la ŋu. 4 Esi wòkpe kpli wo la, ede se na wo be: "Migadzo le Yerusalem o, ke boŋ minɔ nu si ŋugbe Fofo la do, si ŋu nya miese tso gbɔnye la lalam; 5 elabena tsie Yohanes tsɔ nyrɔ amewo, ke le ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo megbe la, gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ye woatsɔ anyrɔ mi. " 6 Eya ta esi wokpe ta la, wobiae be: "Aƒetɔ, ɖe nègbugbɔ le fiaɖuƒe la ɖom anyi na Israel le ɣeyiɣi sia mea? " 7 Egblɔ na wo be: "Mehiã be mianya ɣeyiɣi alo azãgbe siwo Fofo la ɖo le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ nu la o.
ENGLISH: 1 I made my first relation, Theophilus, about all that Jesus had begun both doing and teaching 2 as far as to the day that he was taken up after he had by the Holy Spirit given injunctions to the apostles whom he had chosen; 3 to whom also, after he had suffered, he presented himself alive with many proofs, appearing to them during forty days and telling them the things that relate to the Reign of God; 4 and, while eating with them, he instructed them not to leave Jerusalem, but to "await the Father’s promise, which you heard from me, 5 ‘John baptized with water but you shall be baptized in Holy Spirit,’ not many days from now. " 6 So those who were together asked him "Lord, is it during this time that you restore the sovereignty to Israel? " 7 He said to them, "It is not yours to know times and dates, which the Father has put under his own jurisdiction.

EWE: 8 Ke boŋ miaxɔ ŋusẽ ne gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la va mia dzi, eye mianye nye ɖasefowo le Yerusalem kple Yudea blibo la katã kple Samaria, va se ɖe anyigba ƒe seƒe ke. 9 Esi wògblɔ nya siawo vɔ, eye wole ekpɔm la, wokɔe yi dzi, eye alilikpo xe wo ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 8 But you shall receive power, having the Holy Spirit come upon you, and shall be witnesses for me both in Jerusalem and throughout Judea and Samaria and to the remotest part of the earth. " 9 And, having said this, he was lifted up before their eyes, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

EWE: 10 Esi wokpɔtɔ nɔ dziŋgɔli me kpɔm gãa le ɣeyiɣi si me wòdzo yina la, kasia, ŋutsu evee nye esi le awu ɣiwo me va tɔ ɖe wo gbɔ 11 eye wobia wo be: "Galilea ŋutsuwo, nu ka tae mietɔ ɖi le dziƒo kpɔm? Yesu sia si woxɔ tso mia gbɔ yi dziƒo la, ava nenema ke abe ale si miekpɔe wòle dziƒo yim ene. " 12 Eye wotrɔ tso Amito la dzi yi Yerusalem. Amito la medidi tso Yerusalem gbɔ o, anɔ sabat ŋkeke ƒe azɔlizɔzɔ. 13 Esi woɖo dua me la, woyi dziƒoxɔ si me wonɔna la me. Ame siawoe nye Petro, Yohanes, Yakobo, Andrea, Filipo, Toma, Bartolomeo, Mateo, Yakobo si nye Alfeo vi, Simon veviedola la kple Yuda si nye Yakobo vi.
ENGLISH: 10 And while they had their gaze fixed on the sky as he went, lo, there were two men in white costumes standing by them; 11 who said, "Men of Galilee, why are you standing and looking up into the sky? this Jesus who has been taken up from you into the sky shall come in the same way as you viewed him going into the sky. " 12 Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain known as Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a sabbath-day’s journey off; 13 and when they came in they went up to the upper room where they were keeping themselves: Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alpheus and Simon the Zealot and Judas son of James.

EWE: 14 Ame siawo nɔ gbedodoɖa dzi kple tame ɖeka, wo kple nyɔnu aɖewo kpakple Yesu dada Maria kple Yesu nɔviŋutsuwo.
ENGLISH: 14 All these were unitedly devoting themselves to prayer, with the women and Jesus’s mother Mary, and with his brothers.

EWE: 17 Elabena woxlẽe ɖe mía dome, eye wòkpɔ gome le subɔsubɔdɔ sia me. 18 (Nenem me sia tsɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ ƒe fetu ƒle anyigba, eye esi wòge tsɔ ta va tu anyi la, eƒe ƒodo wó too, eye eƒe dɔmenuwo katã dudu ɖe anyi. 19 Ame siwo katã le Yerusalem la see, ale be wotsɔ ŋkɔ na anyigba ma le woƒe gbea me be Akeldama, si gɔmee nye "Ʋunyigba. ") 20 Elabena woŋlɔ ɖe Psalmowo me be: ‘Eƒe nɔƒe nazu aƒedo, eye ame aɖeke naganɔ eme o,’ eye ‘Ame bubu naxɔ eƒe dzikpɔkpɔdɔ la.’ 21 Eya ta ehiã be ŋutsu siwo dzea mía yome le ɣeyiɣi siwo katã me Aƒetɔ Yesu nɔ eƒe dɔwo wɔm le mía dome, 22 tso esime Yohanes nyrɔe va se ɖe gbe si gbe woxɔe tso mía gbɔ yi dziƒo la, ŋutsu siawo dometɔ ɖeka nazu ɖasefo kpe ɖe mía ŋu le eƒe tsitretsitsi la ŋu. " 23 Eya ta wotɔ asi ame eve dzi. Woawoe nye Yosef si woyɔna be Barsaba, si wogayɔna be Yusto, kple Matias. 24 Eye wodo gbe ɖa gblɔ be: "Oo Yehowa, wò ame si nya amewo katã ƒe dzi me, ɖe ame eve siawo dometɔ si nètia la fia, 25 be wòaxɔ ɖe subɔsubɔdɔ kple apostolonyenye sia, si gbɔ Yuda trɔ le helé eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ tsɔ la teƒe. " 26 Ale wodzidze nu ɖe wo dzi, eye nudzidze la dze Matias dzi, eye wobui kpe ɖe apostolo wuiɖekɛawo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 15 And in those days Peter stood up among the brothers and said, there being together a multitude of names, about a hundred and twenty: 16 "Brethren, the text which the Holy Spirit uttered beforehand through the mouth of David about Judas who was guide to those who arrested Jesus, 17 that he was counted among us and was allotted this commission, had to be fulfilled. " 18 (Now this man acquired a piece of land with the pay of his misdoing; and, coming down flat, he burst open in the middle, and all his entrails gushed out; 19 and it became well known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so that that piece of land was called in their language "Hakeldamach, " that is "the blood lot. ") 20 "For it is written in the book of Psalms ‘May his homestead be desolate and have no one living in it,’ and ‘Let another take his office.’ 21 So of the men who went with us at every time when the Lord Jesus was among us coming in and going out, 22 beginning with John’s baptizing and down to the day that he was taken up from us, one of these must become a witness of his resurrection with us. " 23 And they put forward two, Joseph known as Bar-Sabbas, who was also named Justus, and Matthias; 24 and they offered prayer, and said "Lord, knower of the hearts of all, do thou designate the one of these two whom thou hast called 25 to take the place in this commission and apostleship, from which Judas passed to go to his own place. " 26 And they took lots for them, and the lot fell upon Matthias, and he was counted in with the eleven apostles.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 2 Le Pentekoste Ŋkekenyuia dzi la, wo katã woƒo ƒu ɖe teƒe ɖeka. 2 Kasia wose nane ƒe ɖiɖi tso dziƒo abe yaƒoƒo sesẽ aɖe ene, eye wòxɔ aƒe si me wole la katã me. 3 Eye wokpɔ nane si le abe dzoƒaɖewo ene la va dze ɖe wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzi ɖekaɖeka, 4 eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe yɔ wo katã taŋ, eye wode asi gbe vovovowo dodo me, abe ale si gbɔgbɔ la dee nu na wo ene.
ENGLISH: 2 And when the day of Pentecost came around they were all in company together, 2 and suddenly there came a noise out of the sky, as if of a violent wind driving along, and filled the whole house where they were sitting; 3 and there appeared to them parted tongues as if of fire, and it lighted on each one of them; 4 and all of them were filled with Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit granted it to them.

EWE: 5 Ɣemaɣi la, Yudatɔ mawuvɔ̃la siwo tso dukɔ sia dukɔ me le dziƒoa te la nɔ Yerusalem. 6 Eya ta esi gbe sia ɖi la, ame gbogbo aɖe va ƒo ƒu, eye woƒe nu ku, elabena wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe see wole eya ŋutɔ degbe dom.
ENGLISH: 5 And there were Jews living in Jerusalem, godly men from every nation under the heavens; 6 and when this sound came the multitude came together and were bewildered that each one heard them speaking his own language.

EWE: 7 Le nyateƒe me la, wotsi yaa eye wogblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa, menye Galileatɔwoe ame siawo katã, siwo le nu ƒom la nye oa? 8 Ke aleke wɔ mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le eya ŋutɔ degbe sem? 9 Partiatɔwo, Mediatɔwo, Elamtɔwo, ame siwo tso Mesopotamia, Yudea, Kapadokia, Ponto, Asia nutowo me, 10 Frigia, Pamfilia, Egipte, Libia nuto siwo le Kirene gbɔ, kple amedzro siwo tso Roma, Yudatɔwo kple ame siwo trɔ dzi me zu Yudatɔwo siaa, 11 Kretatɔwo, kple Arabiatɔwo, wole nu ƒom tso Mawu ƒe nu dzɔtsuwo ŋu le mía degbe me míele sesem. " 12 Ɛ̃, wo katã woƒe mo wɔ yaa, wotɔtɔ, eye wonɔ wo nɔewo biam be: "Nu sia gɔme ɖe? " 13 Ke ame bubuwo ɖu fewu le wo ŋu gblɔ be: "Wain yeyee le wo mum. "
ENGLISH: 7 And they were surprised, and they wondered, saying "Why, here all these that are talking are Galileans, 8 and how is it we each hear in our own language that we were born in? 9 Parthians and Medes and Elamites and inhabitants of Mesopotamia and of Palestine and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia 10 and Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts in Africa about Cyrene; and the Romans, both Jews and proselytes, who are residing here; 11 Cretans and Arabs, we hear them speaking in our languages the grand works of God. " 12 And they were all of them surprised and puzzled, saying one to another "What may this be? " 13 but others said jeeringly "They are filled up with grape-juice. "

EWE: 14 Ke Petro kple Ame Wuiɖekɛawo tsi tsitre, eye wòkɔ gbe dzi ƒo nu na wo be: "Yudea ŋutsuwo kple mi Yerusalem nɔlawo katã, minya esia, eye miɖo to miase nye nyawo.
ENGLISH: 14 But Peter stood forward with the eleven and raised his voice and uttered these words to them: "Fellow-Jews, and all you who live in Jerusalem, be this known to you, and give ear to my words.

EWE: 15 Le nyateƒe me la, menye ahae ame siawo mu abe ale si miele esusum ene o, elabena ŋkekea ƒe gaƒoƒo etɔ̃lia koe nye esia. 16 Ke boŋ nya si wogblɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila Yoel dzie nye esi: 17 ‘Mawu gblɔ be, "Le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me la, matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ɖe akɔ ɖe ŋutilã ƒomeviwo katã dzi, eye mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo agblɔ nya ɖi, miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo akpɔ ŋutegawo, eye miaƒe amegãɖeɖiwo aku drɔ̃ewo, 18 eye matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ɖe akɔ ɖe nye kluviwo kple nye kosiwo gɔ̃ hã dzi le ŋkeke mawo me, eye woagblɔ nya ɖi.
ENGLISH: 15 For these men are not, as you assume, drunk; for it is three hours before noon; 16 but this is what was spoken of through the prophet Joel, 17 ‘And in the last days, says God, I will pour out streams of my Spirit on all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, 18 and your young men shall see visions and your old men shall dream dreams; yea, and on my servants, both men and women, will I pour out streams of my Spirit in those days, and they shall prophesy.

EWE: 19 Mana nukunuwo nadze le dziƒo kple dzesiwo le anyigba dzi, ʋu kple dzo kpakple dzudzɔ babla kɔtɔɔ. 20 Ɣe ado viviti, eye ɣleti azu ʋu, hafi Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke gã si nye atsyɔ̃ŋkeke la nava ɖo.
ENGLISH: 19 And I will display wonders in the heavens above and tokens on the earth beneath, blood and fire and fumes of smoke: 20 the sun shall be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the great and notable Day of the Lord comes.

EWE: 21 Eye ame sia ame si yɔa Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ la, woaɖee. " ’
ENGLISH: 21 And everyone who shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.’

EWE: 22 "Israel ŋutsuwo, mise nya siawo: Yesu, Nazaretetɔ la, nye ame si Mawu ɖe fia mi gaglãa. Mawu to ŋusẽdɔwo, nukunuwo kple dzesi siwo wòwɔ to edzi le mia dome la dzi ɖee fia, abe ale si miawo ŋutɔwo mienyae ene. 23 Ame sia, si wode asi le Mawu ƒe tameɖoɖo kple nunyanya do ŋgɔ nu la, mieto sedzimawɔlawo dzi hee ɖe ati ŋu, eye miewui. 24 Ke Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre esi wòɖee tso ku me, elabena ku mete ŋu yi edzi lée ɖi o.
ENGLISH: 22 "Men of Israel, listen to these words: Jesus the Nazarene, a man accredited to you by God through miracles and wonders and tokens which God did through him in your midst, as you yourselves know, 23 this man, given up by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge, you by ruffians’ hands spiked down, and took his life; 24 whom God raised, undoing the pangs of death, as it was not possible that he should be held by it.

EWE: 25 Elabena David gblɔ le eŋu be: ‘Metsɔa Yehowa ɖoa ŋkunyeme ɖaa, elabena ele nye ɖusime, be magaʋã akpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 25 For David says with reference to him ‘I looked to the Lord before me continually, because he is at my right hand that I may not be shaken.

EWE: 26 Esia tae nye dzi kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye nye aɖe tso aseye. Eye manɔ mɔkpɔkpɔ me; 27 elabena màgblẽm ɖe Tsiẽƒe o, eye màɖe mɔ be ame si wɔa nuteƒe na wò la nanyunyɔ o.
ENGLISH: 26 At this my heart is happy and my tongue exults; and withal my flesh shall dwell in hope, 27 because thou wilt not abandon my soul to the realm of death, nor give thy godly one to see decay.

EWE: 28 Èna menya agbemɔ la; àtsɔ dzidzɔ gã aɖi ƒo nam le ŋkuwòme.’
ENGLISH: 28 Thou hast made known to me the paths of life; thou wilt fill me full of happiness, with thy presence.’

EWE: 29 "Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwo, mina maƒo nu na mi faa tso tɔgbui David ŋu, be eku, eye woɖii, eye eƒe yɔdo le mía dome va se ɖe egbe sia.
ENGLISH: 29 Brethren, it is allowable to say to you frankly of David, the founder of our state, that he did pass away and was buried, and his tomb is among us to this day.

EWE: 30 Esi wònye nyagblɔɖila eye wònya be Mawu do ŋugbe na ye heka atam tsɔ ɖo kpe edzi be yeana yeƒe dzidzimeviwo dometɔ ɖeka nanɔ yeƒe fiazikpui dzi ta la, 31 ekpɔ Kristo la ƒe tsitretsitsi do ŋgɔ, eye wòƒo nu tso eŋu be womegblẽe ɖe Tsiẽƒe o, eye eƒe ŋutilã hã menyunyɔ o.
ENGLISH: 30 Therefore, being a prophet and knowing that God had sworn an oath to him to seat on his throne one of the fruit of his loins, 31 he foresaw and spoke of the resurrection of the Christ, that he neither was abandoned to the realm of death nor did his flesh see decay.

EWE: 32 Mawu fɔ nenem Yesu sia ɖe tsitre, eye mí katã míenye esia ƒe ɖasefowo.
ENGLISH: 32 This Jesus God raised to life; of which we are all of us witnesses.

EWE: 33 Eya ta esi wodoe ɖe dzi wòyi ɖale Mawu ƒe ɖusime, eye wòxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe si ŋugbe wodo la tso Fofo la gbɔ ta la, etrɔ nu si kpɔm miele hele sesem la kɔ ɖi.
ENGLISH: 33 So, being raised on high by God’s right hand and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you both see and hear.

EWE: 34 Elabena David melia yi dziƒo o, ke boŋ eya ŋutɔ gblɔ be, ‘Yehowa gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ be: "Bɔbɔ nɔ nye ɖusime, 35 va se ɖe esime matsɔ wò futɔwo awɔ wò afɔɖodzinui. " ’ 36 Eya ta Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la nanyae nyuie be, Mawu ɖo Yesu sia si miehe ɖe ati ŋu la wòzu Aƒetɔ kple Kristo. "
ENGLISH: 34 For David did not ascend to heaven, but he himself says ‘The Lord said to my lord "Sit at my right hand 35 till I make your enemies a footstool for your feet. "’ 36 So let all the house of Israel know positively that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified. "

EWE: 37 Esi wose nya siawo la, etɔ dzi na wo, eye wogblɔ na Petro kple apostolo susɔeawo be: "Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwo, nu kae míawɔ? " 38 Petro gblɔ na wo be: "Mitrɔ dzi me, eye mina woanyrɔ mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ɖe Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ me be woatsɔ miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ake mi, eye miaxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe nunana faa la.
ENGLISH: 37 And at hearing it they were pricked in their hearts, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles "What shall we do, brethren? " 38 And Peter said to them "Repent, and each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the pardoning of your sins, and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

EWE: 39 Elabena miawo kple mia viwo kpakple ame siwo katã le adzɔge ʋĩi, ame siwo katã Yehowa mía Mawu la ayɔ va eɖokui gbɔ la, tɔe nye ŋugbedodo la. " 40 Eye wògagblɔ nya bubu geɖewo tsɔ ɖi ɖase na wo tsitotsito, eye wòyi edzi xlɔ̃ nu wo be: "Mina woaɖe mi tso dzidzime gɔglɔ̃ sia me. " 41 Ale wonyrɔ ame siwo xɔ eƒe nya la kple dzi blibo, eye wotsɔ ame anɔ akpe etɔ̃ kpe ɖe wo ŋu gbe ma gbe.
ENGLISH: 39 For the promise is for you and for your children and for all who are far off, as many as the Lord our God shall call. " 40 And with many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying "Save yourselves from this cross-grained generation. "

EWE: 42 Eye woyi edzi lé fɔ ɖe apostoloawo ƒe nufiafiawo ŋu vevie, wodea ha ɖekae, ɖua nu ɖekae, eye wonɔa gbedodoɖa dzi.
ENGLISH: 41 So those who welcomed his words were baptized, and there were added on that day about three thousand souls; 42 and they applied themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the life of solidarity, to bread-breaking and to prayers.

EWE: 43 Nyateƒee, vɔvɔ̃ ɖo amewo katã, eye nukunu kple dzesi geɖewo nɔ eme vam to apostoloawo dzi.
ENGLISH: 43 And every soul was seized with fear, and many wonders and tokens were done through the apostles.

EWE: 44 Ame siwo katã va zu xɔsetɔwo la nɔ afi ɖeka, eye wowɔa nuwo katã ɖe du, 45 wodzraa woƒe nunɔamesiwo kple woƒe nuwo, eye womaa nu siwo wokpɔ la na wo katã, ame sia ame ɖe eƒe hiahiã nu. 46 Eye wonɔa gbedoxɔa me gbe sia gbe kple tame ɖeka, woɖua nu le aƒe vovovowo me, eye wotsɔa dzidzɔ gã kple dzimekɔkɔ maa woƒe nuɖuɖu kple wo nɔewo faa, 47 nɔa Mawu kafum, eye dukɔ blibo la vea wo nu. Azɔ hã, Yehowa tsɔa ame siwo xɔm wole ɖe agbe la kpena ɖe wo ŋu gbe sia gbe.
ENGLISH: 44 And all who believed had everything in common together, 45 and would sell their possessions and estates and portion them out to all as anyone needed them; 46 and day by day, unitedly attending in the temple-precinct and breaking bread at home, they partook of their food with blithe and simple hearts, 47 praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people; and the Lord added greatly day by day to the saved.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 3 Esi Petro kple Yohanes yina ɖe gbedoxɔa me le gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi le gbedoɖaɣi la, 2 wokɔ ŋutsu aɖe si nye tekunɔ tso esime wodzii la va yi. Wokɔnɛ va dana ɖe gbedoxɔa ƒe agbo si woyɔna be Agbo Nyui la nu gbe sia gbe, ne wòabia nu ame siwo yina ɖe gbedoxɔa me. 3 Esi wòkpɔ Petro kple Yohanes wole gegem ɖe gbedoxɔa me la, ebia wo be woakpɔ nublanui na ye ana nane ye.
ENGLISH: 3 And Peter and John were going up into the temple-precinct for the three o’clock prayer, 2 and there was being carried away a certain man who had been a cripple from his birth, whom they put at what is known as the Beautiful Gate of the temple-precinct day by day to ask for charity from those who were going into the precinct; 3 and he, seeing Peter and John about to enter the precinct, asked to receive charity.

EWE: 4 Ke Petro kple Yohanes kpɔ eƒe ŋkume dũu eye Petro gblɔ be: "Kpɔ mí ɖa. " 5 Eya ta efɔ ŋku ɖe wo dzi gãa hele mɔ kpɔm be yeakpɔ nane tso wo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 4 But Peter, fixing his eyes on him with John, said "Look at us. " 5 And he eyed them, expecting to receive something from them.

EWE: 6 Ke Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Klosalo kple sika mele asinye o, ke nu si le asinye la, eyae mana wò: Le Yesu Kristo, Nazaretetɔ la, ƒe ŋkɔa me la, zɔ azɔli! " 7 Ale wòlé eƒe nuɖusi be wòatso ɖe tsitrenu.
ENGLISH: 6 But Peter said "Silver and gold I do not own, but what I have, that I give you: by the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, walk! " 7 and he caught hold of his right hand and got him to rise.

EWE: Enumake ŋusẽ ɖo eƒe afɔ kple eƒe afɔkɔewo ŋu; 8 eye wòti kpo tsi tsitre hete azɔli zɔzɔ, eye wòge ɖe gbedoxɔa me kpli wo le zɔzɔm le kpo tim le Mawu kafum. 9 Eye amewo katã kpɔe wòle zɔzɔm hele Mawu kafum.
ENGLISH: And immediately his feet and ankles grew firm, 8 and he gave a jump and stood and walked, and came in with them into the precinct walking and jumping and praising God, 9 and all the people saw him walking and praising God.

EWE: 10 Wokpɔe dze sii be eyae nye ŋutsu si nɔa anyi ɖe gbedoxɔ ƒe Agbo Nyui la nu nɔa nu biam, ale woƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo, le nu si dzɔ la ta.
ENGLISH: 10 And they recognized him as the one who had been sitting at the Beautiful Gate of the temple for charity, and were filled with amazement and surprise at what had befallen him.

EWE: 11 Ke esi ŋutsua lé ɖe Petro kple Yohanes ŋu goŋgoŋ la, amewo katã ƒu du va ƒo ƒu ɖe wo ŋu le teƒe si woyɔna be Salomo ƒe Akpata la me, eye woƒe nu ku.
ENGLISH: 11 And while he held Peter and John all the people came running together about them in what is known as Solomon’s Portico, utterly amazed.

EWE: 12 Esi Petro kpɔ esia la, egblɔ na ameawo be: "Israel ŋutsuwo, nu ka tae nu sia le nuku wɔm na mi ale, alo nu ka tae miefɔ ŋku ɖe mía dzi, abe míawo ŋutɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ alo mawusosroɖae na wòzɔ azɔli ene? 13 Abraham kple Isak kpakple Yakob ƒe Mawu, mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, do eƒe Subɔla, Yesu, ɖe dzi, ame si miawo miede asi hegbe nu le egbɔ le Pilato ŋkume, togbɔ be eɖoe be yeaɖe asi le eŋu hafi. 14 Ɛ̃, miegbe nu le kɔkɔetɔ kple dzɔdzɔetɔ ma gbɔ, eye miebia be woaɖe asi le ŋutsu si nye amewula boŋ ŋu na mi, 15 eye miewu Kplɔla Vevitɔ si naa agbe la boŋ.
ENGLISH: 12 And, seeing this, Peter answered by saying to the people "Men of Israel, why are you wondering at this, or fixing your eyes on us as if by our own power or piety we had caused him to walk? 13 The God of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus, whom you had had arrested and had repudiated in Pilate’s presence when he had passed judgment for releasing him 14 but you repudiated the Holy and Righteous and asked to have a murderer granted to you, 15 and killed the Founder of Life; whom God raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses.

EWE: Ke Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye míenye nu sia ŋuti ɖasefowo. 16 Eƒe ŋkɔ, kple ŋkɔ sia si dzi míexɔ se la, mee ŋusẽ ɖo ŋutsu sia si kpɔm miele henya nyuie la ŋu le.
ENGLISH: 16 And upon faith in his name he has put firmness into the limbs of this man whom you see and know; and the faith that comes through him has given him this absolute soundness before you all.

EWE: 17 Ke azɔ nɔviwo, menya be nu si miewɔ la, miewɔe le manyamanya me, abe miaƒe dziɖulawo ke ene. 18 Ke mɔ sia dzie Mawu to na nya siwo wògblɔ do ŋgɔ to nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nu me be yeƒe Kristo la akpe fu la va eme.
ENGLISH: 17 And now, brothers, I know you acted in ignorance, and so did your rulers; 18 but what God had announced beforehand through the mouths of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

EWE: 19 "Eya ta mitrɔ dzi me, eye migbugbɔ, ne woatutu miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ɖa, ale be miakpɔ dzidzemeɣiwo tso Yehowa ŋutɔ gbɔ, 20 ne wòaɖo Kristo si wòtia na mi la ɖa, si nye Yesu. 21 Ele be dziƒo naxɔ ame sia ɖi, va se ɖe ɣeyiɣi si me woaɖɔ nuwo katã ɖo, abe ale si Mawu gblɔe to eƒe blema nyagblɔɖila kɔkɔewo ƒe nu me ene.
ENGLISH: 19 So repent and turn back so as to have your sins wiped out, that seasons of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord 20 and that he may send the Christ appointed for you, Jesus, 21 whom heaven must receive until the times for putting into effect everything that God has spoken of through the mouths of his holy prophets from of old.

EWE: Miɖo toe le nya siwo katã wòagblɔ na mi la me. 23 Le nyateƒe me la, ame sia ame si maɖo to Nyagblɔɖila ma o la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa keŋkeŋ le dukɔ la dome.’ 24 Eye nyagblɔɖila siwo katã nɔ anyi tso Samuel dzi, kple ame siwo katã va ɖe eyome la dometɔ geɖe, gblɔ nya ɖi le ŋkeke siawo hã ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 22 Moses said ‘The Lord God will raise up for you from among your brothers a prophet, like me; to him you shall listen in everything that he speaks of to you; 23 and every soul that does not listen to that prophet shall be rooted out from the people’; 24 and so did all the prophets, from Samuel on, as many as spoke, announce these days.

EWE: 25 Miawoe nye nyagblɔɖilawo kple nu, si Mawu bla kple mia tɔgbuiwo la ƒe viwo, esi wògblɔ na Abraham be: ‘Eye to wò dzidzimevi la dzi woayra anyigbadziƒomewo katã.’ 26 Esi Mawu na eƒe Subɔla la do vɔ la, miawo gbɔe wòdɔe ɖo gbã be wòatrɔ mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ɖa tso miaƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo gbɔ, ne wòayra mi. "
ENGLISH: 25 You are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant that God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham ‘And in your descendants all the clans of the earth shall be blessed.’ 26 For you first God raised up his Servant and sent him to bless you by turning you each away from your crimes. "

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 4 Ke esi ame eveawo le nu ƒom na ameawo la, nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple gbedoxɔa dzi kpɔlawo ƒe amegã kpakple Zadukitɔwo va do ɖe wo dzi. 2 Wodo dziku ɖe apostoloawo ŋu be wole nu fiam ameawo, eye wole egblɔm le dutoƒo be Yesu fɔ tso ku me. 3 Eya ta wolé wo de gaxɔ me va se ɖe esime ŋu ke, elabena fiẽsi ɖo xoxo.
ENGLISH: 4 And while they were speaking to the people, in came the priests and the provost of the temple and the Sadducees, 2 nettled because they were teaching the people and announcing resurrection from the dead in the case of Jesus, 3 and laid hands on them and put them in custody till the next day, for it was already evening.

EWE: 4 Ke ame siwo se nuƒoa la dometɔ geɖewo xɔe se, eye ŋutsuawo ƒe xexlẽme ade ame akpe atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 4 But many of those who had heard the word believed, and the number, of men, came to be about five thousand.

EWE: 5 Esi ŋu ke la, woƒe dziɖulawo, amegãwo kple agbalẽfialawo va kpe ta le Yerusalem, 6 hekpe ɖe nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔ Ana, Kayafa, Yohanes, Aleksandro kple nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔ la ƒe ƒometɔwo katã ŋu. 7 Wona Petro kple Yohanes va tsi tsitre ɖe wo dome, eye wobia wo be: "Ŋusẽ kae mietsɔ wɔ nu sia, eye ame ka ƒe ŋkɔ mee miewɔe le?
