" 8 Ale Petro, ame si gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe yɔ fũu la, gblɔ na wo be: "Mi dukɔ la ƒe dziɖulawo kple amegãwo, 9 ne wole nya biam mí egbea le dɔ nyui si míewɔ na tekunɔ aɖe ta, eye miedi be yewoanya ame si na ŋutsu sia haya la, 10 ekema mia kple Israel dukɔ blibo la katã minyae be, Yesu Kristo, Nazaretetɔ la, ame si miawo miehe ɖe ati ŋu, gake Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, eya ƒe ŋkɔ mee ŋutsu sia ƒe lãme sẽ le eye wòle tsitre ɖe mia ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 5 But on the next day their rulers and elders and scribes met at Jerusalem, 6 and High Priest Hannas and Caiaphas and Jonathan and Alexander and as many as came of high-priestly family, 7 and they set them in the middle and inquired "By what power or by what name did you do that? " 8 Then Peter, filled with Holy Spirit, said to them "Rulers of the people and elders, 9 if we are today being examined as to a benefit done to a sick man, by whose means he has been made well, 10 be it known to you all and to all the people of Israel that it is just by the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands here before you sound and well.

EWE: 11 Esiae nye ‘kpe si mi xɔtulawo miebu ɖe naneke me o, si va zu dzogoedzikpe vevitɔ la.’ 12 Gawu la, xɔxɔ la megale ame bubu aɖeke me o, elabena ŋkɔ bubu aɖeke mele dziƒoa te, si wona amegbetɔwo, si dzi míato akpɔ xɔxɔ o. "
ENGLISH: 11 This is the stone scorned by you the builders, that has come to be the top of the corner.

EWE: 13 Ke esi wokpɔ ale si Petro kple Yohanes ƒo nu kakaɖedzitɔe, evɔ wonya be womenya agbalẽ o, eye wonye ame tsɛwo la, woƒe mo wɔ yaa ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 12 And by nothing else is there salvation for there is not another name under the heavens, given among men, that we must be saved by. "

EWE: Ale wova dze sii be wonɔ Yesu ŋu. 14 Esi wole ame si woda dɔ na la kpɔm wòle tsitre ɖe wo gbɔ ta la, nya aɖeke megale wo si woagblɔ ɖe wo ŋu o. 15 Eya ta woɖe gbe na wo be woado le Sanhedrin takpexɔ la me, eye wode adaŋu kple wo nɔewo 16 gblɔ be: "Nu kae míawɔ ame siawo?
ENGLISH: 13 And, seeing the outspokenness of Peter and John, and perceiving that they were plain illiterate men, they wondered at it; and they recognized them as having been with Jesus; 14 and, seeing the cured man standing with them, they were not able to say anything against it.

EWE: Elabena vavãe, wowɔ dzesi gã aɖe to wo dzi, eye Yerusalem nɔlawo katã kpɔe, eye míate ŋu asẽ nu le eŋu o. 17 Gake be wòagakaka ɖe edzi geɖe wu le dukɔ la dome o la, mina míado ŋɔdzi na wo vevie be woagaƒo nu na ame aɖeke le ŋkɔ sia dzi azɔ o. "
ENGLISH: 15 But, giving orders that they should go outside the session, they conferred with each other, 16 saying "What shall we do with these men? that an evident token has been done through them is apparent to all who live in Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it; 17 but, that it may not spread widely among the people, let us warn them with threats not to talk in this name again to any human being. "

EWE: 18 Ale woyɔ wo vɛ, eye wode se na wo be woagagblɔ nya aɖeke kura alo afia nu le Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me azɔ o.
ENGLISH: 18 And they called them and enjoined them not to speak nor teach in the name of Jesus at all.

EWE: 19 Ke Petro kple Yohanes ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Ne edzɔ le Mawu ŋkume be míaɖo to miawo wu Mawu la, miawo ŋutɔwo mibu eŋu kpɔ. 20 Ke míawo ya míate ŋu adzudzɔ nuƒoƒo le nu siwo míekpɔ kple nu siwo míese la ŋu o. " 21 Eya ta esi wogado ŋɔdzi na wo ɖe edzi vɔ la, woɖe asi le wo ŋu, le esi womekpɔ naneke si dzi woanɔ te ɖo ahe to na wo o ta, elabena ameawo katã le Mawu kafum le nu si dzɔ la ta. 22 Elabena ame si woda dɔa na nukutɔe la xɔ wu ƒe blaene.
ENGLISH: 19 But Peter and John answered them "Decide whether it is a right thing before God to listen more to you than to God; 20 for we cannot help telling what we have seen and heard. " 21 And they made additional threats and released them, no way to punish them being found because of the people, since they were all glorifying God over what had taken place; 22 for the man on whom this token of healing was done was more than forty years old.

EWE: 23 Esi woɖe asi le wo ŋu la, woyi wo tɔwo gbɔ, eye woka nya siwo nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo kple amegãwo gblɔ na wo la ta na wo. 24 Esi wosee la, wo katã wokɔ gbe dzi na Mawu ɖekae gblɔ be:
ENGLISH: 23 And, being released, they came to their own company and reported everything the chief priests and elders had said to them; 24 and they, upon hearing it, unanimously raised their voices to God and said

EWE: "Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã, wòe nye Ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba kple atsiaƒu kple wo me nuwo katã, 25 eye nèto gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la dzi na mía tɔgbui David, wò subɔla gblɔ ɖi be: ‘Nu ka tae dukɔwo le nyanyram, eye amewo le adaŋu dem dzodzro? 26 Anyigbadzifiawo tso, eye dziɖulawo ƒo takpli ɖe Yehowa kple eƒe amesiamina la ŋu.’ 27 Elabena le nyateƒe me la, Herodes kple Pontio Pilato kpakple dukɔwo me tɔwo kple Israel dukɔwo ƒo ƒu ɖekae ɖe du sia me ɖe wò subɔla kɔkɔe Yesu, si nèsi ami na la ŋu, 28 be woawɔ nu si nèɖo ɖi do ŋgɔ be wòadzɔ le wò ŋusẽ kple lɔlɔ̃nu me la.
ENGLISH: "Master, thou who madest the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them! 25 As our father thy servant David said by direction of the Holy Spirit, ‘Why have nations blustered and peoples studied useless plans, 26 the kings of the earth taken their stand and the rulers met together, against the Lord and against his anointed?’ for against thy holy servant Jesus, whom thou anointedst, 27 both Herod and Pontius Pilate did certainly meet in this city, with nations and the peoples of Israel, 28 to do so much as thy hand and plan had foreordained should come to pass.

EWE: 29 Ke azɔ Yehowa, kpɔ woƒe ŋɔdzidonamewo ɖa, eye nàna wò kluviwo nayi edzi agblɔ wò nya la kple dzideƒo geɖe, 30 esi nèdo wò asi ɖa hena amewo kpɔ dɔyɔyɔ, eye dzesiwo kple nukunuwo le eme vam to wò subɔla kɔkɔe Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ dzi. " 31 Esi woƒo koko vevie alea vɔ la, teƒe si woƒo ƒu ɖo la ʋuʋu, eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la yɔ wo katã fũu, eye wole Mawu ƒe nya la gblɔm dzinɔameƒotɔe.
ENGLISH: 29 And now, Lord, turn thy eye upon their threats, and grant thy servants the gift of speaking thy word with all boldness 30 while thou dost stretch out thy hand for healing, and tokens and wonders are done through the name of thy holy son Jesus. " 31 And when they had prayed the place where they were met shook, and one and all were filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke God’s word with boldness.

EWE: 32 Ame gbogbo siwo xɔe se la hã ƒe dzi kple luʋɔ wɔ ɖeka, eye wo dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã megblɔna be nu siwo le ye si la nye ye ŋutɔ ye tɔ o, ke boŋ wowɔa nuwo katã ɖekae. 33 Eye apostoloawo tsɔ ŋusẽ gã yi edzi le ɖase ɖim le Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe tsitretsitsi la ŋu, eye Mawu ve wo katã nu geɖe.
ENGLISH: 32 And the community of believers was one in heart and soul, and not one said that any of his property was his own, but they had everything in common; 33 and with great power the apostles gave their testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus; and there was great grace upon them all, 34 nor was there anybody in want among them.

EWE: 34 Nyateƒee, hiã metu ame aɖeke le wo dome o, elabena ame siwo katã si anyigba alo aƒe le la dzraa wo, eye wotsɔa ga si wokpɔ la vanɛ, 35 eye wotsɔa wo va dana ɖe apostoloawo ƒe afɔnu.
ENGLISH: For such as were owners of lands or houses offered them for sale, 35 and brought the price of what were sold and laid it at the apostles’ feet, and distribution was made to each as he needed.

EWE: Azɔ womanɛ na ame sia ame ɖe eƒe hiahiã nu. 36 Eye Yosef, si apostoloawo gayɔna be Barnaba (si gɔmee nye "Akɔfafavi "), eye wònye Lewitɔ, Kipro vidzidzi, 37 si si anyigba aɖe le la, dzrae, eye wòtsɔ ga la va da ɖe apostoloawo ƒe afɔnu.
ENGLISH: 36 And Joseph, also named Barnabas by the apostles (which means Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a Cypriote by nationality, 37 being the owner of a field, sold it and brought the amount and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 5 Ke ŋutsu aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Anania kple srɔ̃a Safira dzra woƒe nunɔamesi aɖe. 2 Gake ŋutsua tsɔ ga la ƒe ɖe ɣla, srɔ̃a hã nya nu tso eŋu, eye wòtsɔ eƒe ɖe ko va da ɖe apostoloawo ƒe afɔnu.
ENGLISH: 5 But a certain man, Hananiah by name, with his wife Shappirah, sold a piece of property 2 and pocketed some of the price, the wife also being in the secret, and brought a part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

EWE: 3 Ke Petro gblɔ be: "Anania, nu ka tae Satana na nèdo dzi da alakpa na gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la, eye nètsɔ anyigbaa ƒe ga la ƒe ɖe ɣla? 4 Zi ale si wòkpɔtɔ le asiwò la, menye tɔwò ko wònye oa? Eye esi nèdzrae vɔ la, ɖe megakpɔtɔ le wò ŋusẽ te oa? Nu ka tae nèɖo nu sia le wò dzi me? Menye amewoe nèda alakpa na o, ke boŋ Mawue. " 5 Esi Anania se nya siawo la, emu dze anyi enumake, eye wòku. Ale vɔvɔ̃ gã aɖe dze ame siwo katã se eŋunya la dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 But Peter said "Hananiah, why has Satan filled your heart to play false with the Holy Spirit and pocket part of the price of the lot? 4 While you kept it was it not in your possession, and when it was sold was it not at your disposal? how came it you resolved on this thing? you did not lie to men but to God. " 5 And Hananiah, hearing these words, fell down and expired; and great fear came upon all who heard of it.

EWE: 6 Eye ɖekakpuiawo tso, woxatsa avɔ ɖe eŋu, eye wokɔe do go yi ɖaɖi.
ENGLISH: 6 And the juniors rose and wrapped him up, and carried him out and buried him.

EWE: 7 Anɔ gaƒoƒo etɔ̃ megbe la, srɔ̃a hã va do, gake menya nu si dzɔ o. 8 Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Gblɔe nam, home siae mi ame evea miedzra anyigba laa? " Egblɔ be: "Ɛ̃, home mae. " 9 Eya ta Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Nu ka tae mi ame evea miewɔ ɖeka be miado Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ la kpɔ? Kpɔ ɖa! Ame siwo ɖi srɔ̃wò la ƒe afɔwo le ʋɔtrua nu; woakɔ wò hã ado goe. " 10 Enumake emu dze anyi ɖe eƒe afɔnu, eye wòku. Esi ɖekakpuiawo ge ɖe eme la, wokpɔe be eku, eye wokɔe do go yi ɖaɖi ɖe srɔ̃a xa.
ENGLISH: 7 And after an interval of about three hours his wife came in, not knowing what had happened; 8 and Peter answered her "Tell me if you sold the lot for so much, " and she said "Yes, so much. " 9 And Peter said to her "How came it you agreed with each other to put the Spirit of the Lord to the test? there are the feet of those who buried your husband coming to the door, and they shall carry you out. " 10 And immediately she fell down at his feet and expired; and the young men came in and found her dead, and carried her out and buried her with her husband.

EWE: 11 Ale vɔvɔ̃ gã aɖe dze hame blibo la kple ame siwo katã se nya siawo la dzi.
ENGLISH: 11 And great fear came upon the whole church and upon all who heard of these things.

EWE: 12 Wonɔ dzesi kple nukunu geɖewo hã wɔm le dukɔ la dome to apostoloawo dzi; eye wo katã wokpea ta le Salomo ƒe Akpata la me kple tame ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 12 And through the agency of the apostles many tokens and wonders were done among the people; and they were one and all in Solomon’s Portico backing each other up.

EWE: 13 Nyateƒee, dzi menɔ ame susɔeawo dometɔ aɖeke ƒo be wòawɔ ɖeka kpli wo o; gake ameawo kafua wo. 14 Gawu la, ame siwo xɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se la nɔ dzidzim ɖe edzi, wonye ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo ƒe ha gã aɖe. 15 Amewo kɔa dɔnɔwo va dana ɖe ablɔwo me gɔ̃ hã, eye wotsɔa wo mlɔa abati suewo kple abawo dzi le afi ma, ale be ne Petro va yina la, eƒe vɔvɔli ya teti nadze wo dometɔ aɖewo dzi.
ENGLISH: 13 And of the rest nobody dared connect himself with them; but the people held them in high regard, 14 and there were more and more additions of masses of both men and women, believing in the Lord, 15 so that they even carried the sick out into the squares and laid them on cots and pallets in order that when Peter came at least his shadow might fall on one or another of them.

EWE: 16 Ame gbogbo aɖewo hã tsoa du siwo ƒo xlã Yerusalem me vana, eye wokɔa dɔnɔwo kple ame siwo gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo le fu ɖem na la vanɛ, eye wodaa gbe le wo katã ŋu.
ENGLISH: 16 And the populace of the suburbs of Jerusalem also came together, bringing sick people and people harassed by unclean spirits, of whom one and all were cured.

EWE: 17 Ke nunɔlagã la kple eŋume siwo nye Zadukitɔwo ƒe kɔmama la me tɔ siwo yɔ fũu kple ŋuʋaʋã la, tso. 18 Eye wolé apostoloawo de dua ƒe gaxɔ me.
ENGLISH: 17 But Annas the high priest and all those who were with him, who constituted the Sadducee party, were seized with jealousy 18 and laid hands on the apostles and put them in custody.

EWE: 19 Ke le zã me la, Yehowa ƒe dɔla va ʋu gaxɔ la ƒe ʋɔtruwo, eye wòkplɔ wo do goe hegblɔ na wo be: 20 "Miyi ɖatsi tsitre ɖe gbedoxɔa me, ne mianɔ agbe sia ŋu nyawo katã gblɔm na amewo. " 21 Esi wose esia la, woyi gbedoxɔa me ŋdi kanya, eye wode asi nufiafia me.
ENGLISH: 19 But an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the prison and brought them out and said 20 "Go stand forward in the temple-precinct and speak to the people all the words that proclaim this life "; 21 and, hearing this, they went into the temple-precinct at dawn and taught there.

EWE: Ke esi nunɔlagã la kple eŋumewo va ɖo la, woyɔ Sanhedrin blibo la kple Israel-viwo ƒe ametsitsiawo ƒe ha blibo la ƒo ƒu, eye wodɔ amewo ɖe gaxɔa me be woakplɔ apostoloawo vɛ.
ENGLISH: But when the high priest arrived, and those who were with him, they called together the Sanhedrin and all the senate of the sons of Israel, and sent to the lockup to have them brought.

EWE: 22 Ke esi atikplɔtɔawo ɖo afi ma la, womekpɔ wo le gaxɔa me o. Eya ta wotrɔ gbɔ va ka nya la ta 23 be: "Míekpɔ gaxɔ la wòle tutu nyuie, eye dzɔlawo hã le tsitre ɖe ʋɔtruawo nu, ke esi míeʋui la, míekpɔ ame aɖeke le eme o. " 24 Esi gbedoxɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã kple nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo se nya siawo la, wotɔtɔ le nya siawo ŋu le nu si ava do tso eme la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 22 But the officers who came did not find them in the prison, but brought back word 23 "We found the lockup most securely locked and the guards standing at the doors, but on opening it we found nobody inside. " 24 And when the provost of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were puzzled about them, to know what it was that had happened.

EWE: 25 Ke ame aɖe va gblɔ na wo be: "Mikpɔ ɖa! Ŋutsu siwo mielé de gaxɔ me lae nye ema tɔ ɖe gbedoxɔa me le nu fiam amewo. " 26 Ale dzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã la kple eƒe atikplɔtɔawo yi ɖakplɔ wo vɛ, ke menye kple sesẽ o, elabena wole vɔvɔ̃m be dukɔa ava ƒu kpe yewo.
ENGLISH: 25 But someone came and reported to them "Here, the men you put in the prison are in the temple-precinct, standing there and teaching the people. " 26 Then the provost went with the officers and brought them; not with violence, for they were afraid of the people, that they would be stoned.

EWE: 27 Eya ta wokplɔ wo va tsi tsitre ɖe Sanhedrin la ŋkume. Eye nunɔlagã la bia gbe wo 28 eye wògblɔ be: "Míede se na mi eme kɔ nyuie be miagayi edzi anɔ nu fiam le ŋkɔ sia dzi o, gake miena miaƒe nufiafia xɔ Yerusalem katã kpe ɖo, eye mieɖoe kplikpaa be yewoahe ŋutsu sia ƒe ʋu ava mía dzi. " 29 Petro kple apostolo bubuawo ɖo eŋu be: "Ele be míaɖo to Mawu abe dziɖula ene wu amewo.
ENGLISH: 27 And they brought them to the Sanhedrin and set them before it; and the high priest questioned them, 28 saying "We positively enjoined you not to teach in this name, and here you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are wanting to make us responsible for this man’s blood. " 29 And Peter and the apostles answered "We must obey God rather than men.

EWE: 30 Mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la fɔ Yesu ɖe tsitre, ame si miawo miewu esi miehee ɖe ati ŋu. 31 Mawu do ame sia ɖe dzi le eƒe ɖusime wòzu Kplɔla Vevitɔ kple Ðela, be wòana Israel natrɔ dzi me, eye woatsɔ nu vɔ̃wo ake.
ENGLISH: 30 The God of our fathers raised Jesus, whom you made away with by hanging him on a tree; 31 him God has raised on high by his right hand as supreme lord and savior, to give Israel repentance and the pardon of sins.

EWE: 32 Eye míawoe nye nu siawo ŋuti ɖasefowo, eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe si Mawu na ame siwo ɖoa toe abe dziɖula ene la hã ɖia ɖase. "
ENGLISH: 32 And we are witnesses of these matters, and the Holy Spirit that God has given to those who obey him. "

EWE: 33 Esi wose esia la, eku dzi na wo vevie, eye wodi be yewoawu wo.
ENGLISH: 33 And at hearing it they were nettled and wanted to take their lives.

EWE: 34 Ke Farisitɔ aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Gamaliel, eye wònye Sefiala si ŋu ameawo katã dea bubui la, tsi tsitre le Sanhedrin la, eye wòɖe gbe be woakplɔ ŋutsuawo ado goe vie. 35 Eye wògblɔ na etɔwo be: "Israel ŋutsuwo, mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le nu si ɖom miele be yewoawɔ ame siawo la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 34 But a certain Pharisee in the Sanhedrin, Gamaliel by name, a teacher of the law highly honored by all the people, gave the word to put the men out a little while, 35 and said to them "Men of Israel, take care what you are going to do in the matter of these men.

EWE: 36 Le kpɔɖeŋu me, hafi ŋkeke siawo naɖo la, Teuda va do nɔ gbɔgblɔm be yenye ame aɖe, eye ame siwo anɔ alafa ene ye nɔ eƒe ha la me.
ENGLISH: 36 For a while ago Theudas stood up, saying he was somebody; whose cause some four hundred men espoused, but who lost his life, and all who had put faith in him disbanded, and nothing came of it.

EWE: Ke wowui, eye ame siwo katã dze eyome la ka hlẽ, eye wo nu va yi. 37 Eya megbe Yuda Galileatɔ la hã va do le ŋkɔŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ŋkekeawo me, eye wòhe amewo ɖe eɖokui ŋu.
ENGLISH: 37 And after him Judas the Galilean stood up during the time of the registration, and induced a set to go off with him; he too perished, and all who had put faith in him were dispersed.

EWE: Elabena ne amewo gbɔe ɖoɖo sia alo dɔ sia tso la, ekema eme ava gblẽ; 39 ke ne Mawu gbɔe wòtso la, miate ŋu agblẽ eme o. Ne menye nenema o la, ava dze abe ɖe miele avu wɔm kple Mawu ŋutɔ ene. " 40 Ale woxɔ aɖaŋu si wòɖo la, eye woyɔ apostoloawo vɛ, ƒo wo, eye wode se na wo be woadzudzɔ nuƒoƒo le Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me, eye woɖe asi le wo ŋu wodzo.
ENGLISH: 38 And this time I say keep clear of these men and let them be, because if this plan or this doing be from men it will break down, 39 but if it is from God you will not be able to break them down; you may turn out to be at war with God. " 40 And they took his advice, and called in the apostles, and gave them a beating and enjoined them not to speak in Jesus’s name, and let them go.

EWE: 41 Eya ta wodzo le Sanhedrin la ŋkume, eye wonɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm be wobu yewo be yewodze woado vlo yewo le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta. 42 Eye gbe sia gbe woyi edzi nɔ nu fiam henɔ nya nyui la gblɔm le Kristo la, si nye Yesu ŋu madzudzɔmadzudzɔe le gbedoxɔa me kple aƒe me yi aƒe me.
ENGLISH: 41 So they went from the presence of the Sanhedrin rejoicing because they were held worthy to suffer insult for the Name; 42 and every day, in the temple-precinct and at home, they never left off teaching and telling the gospel of Christ Jesus.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 6 Ke le ŋkeke mawo me esi nusrɔ̃lawo nɔ agbɔ sɔm ɖe edzi la, Yudatɔ Helagbe dolawo nɔ liʋiliʋĩ lĩm le Yudatɔ Hebrigbe dolawo ŋu, elabena wogblẽa woƒe ahosiwo ɖi le gbe sia gbe nuɖuɖu la mama me.
ENGLISH: 6 And in those days, as the disciples increased in number, there came to be a grumbling of the Greek-speaking members against the Hebrews, that their widows were disregarded in the daily distribution.

EWE: 2 Eya ta Ame Wuieveawo yɔ nusrɔ̃lawo va ƒo ƒu hegblɔ na wo be: "Masɔ be míagblẽ Mawu ƒe nya la ɖi anɔ nuɖuɖu mam le kplɔ̃ ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 2 And the Twelve called in the body of disciples and said "It is not desirable that we should leave God’s word and act as bank-tellers.

EWE: 3 Eya ta nɔviwo, mitia ŋutsu adre tso mia dome, ame siwo dzi woate ŋu aka ɖo, siwo gbɔgbɔ kple nunya yɔ fũu, ne míatsɔ aɖo dɔ vevi sia nu; 4 ke míawo la, míalé fɔ ɖe gbedodoɖa kple mawunya la fiafia ŋu. " 5 Nya si wogblɔ la dze ameha bliboa ŋu, eye wotia Stefano, ame si si xɔse sẽŋu le eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la yɔe fũu, kple Filipo, Prokoro, Nikano, Timon, Parmena kpakple Nikolao si tso Antiokia, ame si trɔ dzi me zu Yudatɔ. 6 Wokplɔ wo va apostoloawo ŋkume, eye esi wodo gbe ɖa vɔ la, woda woƒe asiwo ɖe wo dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 But, brothers, nominate out of your number seven men of attested reputations, whom we will appoint to this duty; 4 and we will devote ourselves to prayer and the distribution of the word. " 5 And all the body approved the idea, and they selected Stephen, a man full of faith and Holy Spirit, and Philip and Prochorus and Nicanor and Timon and Parmenas and Nicolaus, an Antiochene proselyte, 6 all of whom they set before the apostles, and they prayed and laid their hands on them.

EWE: 7 Ale Mawu ƒe nya la yi edzi nɔ ta kekem, eye nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe xexlẽme nɔ dzidzim ɖe edzi ŋutɔ le Yerusalem; eye nunɔla gbogbo aɖewo hã va zu xɔsetɔwo.
ENGLISH: 7 And the word of God grew, and the numbers of the disciples at Jerusalem increased extremely, and a great mass of the priests yielded obedience to the faith.

EWE: 8 Ke Stefano, ame si nu Mawu ve eye wòna ŋusẽ geɖe la, nɔ nukunu kple dzesi gãwo wɔm le ameawo dome.
ENGLISH: 8 And Stephen, full of grace and power, did great wonders and tokens among the people.

EWE: 9 Ke ŋutsu siwo nye Ablɔɖexɔlawo Ƒe Ƒuƒoƒe la me tɔ aɖewo kple Kirenetɔwo, Aleksandriatɔwo, kpakple ame siwo tso Kilikia kple Asia la, dometɔ aɖewo tso be yewoahe nya kple Stefano. 10 Gake womete ŋu nɔ te ɖe nunya kple gbɔgbɔ si wòtsɔ le nu ƒomee la nu o.
ENGLISH: 9 But some from what is known as the Freedmen’s Synagogue, and some of the Cyrenians and Alexandrians and those from Cilicia and Asia, stood up to debate with Stephen, 10 and were not able to stand their ground against the wisdom and inspiration by which he spoke.

EWE: 11 Eya ta wode nya ŋutsu aɖewo nu le adzame be woagblɔ be: "Míesee wòle busunyawo gblɔm ɖe Mose kple Mawu ŋu. " 12 Eye wode zi ameha la kple amegãwo kpakple agbalẽfialawo me, ale wova do ɖe edzi le vo me, lée sesẽe hekplɔe yi Sanhedrin la. 13 Eye wokplɔ aʋatsoɖasefowo vɛ, ame siwo va gblɔ be: "Ame sia medzudzɔ nuƒoƒo tsi tre ɖe kɔkɔeƒe sia kple Se la ŋu o. 14 Le kpɔɖeŋu me, míesee wògblɔ be Yesu Nazaretetɔ la agbã teƒe sia, eye wòatrɔ kɔnu siwo Mose tsɔ de asi na mí la. "
ENGLISH: 11 Then they put out men who said "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God " 12 and stirred up the people and the elders and the scribes, and came down on him and carried him off and brought him into the Sanhedrin, 13 and produced false witnesses who said "This man never stops uttering words against the holy place and the law; 14 for we have heard him say that this Nazarene Jesus is to break down this place and to change the usages that Moses handed down to us. "

EWE: 15 Esi ame siwo katã bɔbɔ nɔ Sanhedrin la fɔ ŋku ɖe edzi gãa la, wokpɔe be eƒe mo le abe mawudɔla ƒe mo ene.
ENGLISH: 15 And all those who were sitting in the Sanhedrin fixed their eyes on him and saw his face looking as if it were an angel’s.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 7 Ke nunɔlagã la biae be: "Nya siawo le emea? " 2 Stefano ɖo eŋu be: "Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwo kple fofowo, miɖo tom.
ENGLISH: 7 And the high priest said "Are these things so? " 2 And he said "Brethren and fathers, listen.

EWE: Ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Mawu la ɖe eɖokui fia mía tɔgbui Abraham esi wònɔ Mesopotamia, hafi wòva ʋu yi Haran, 3 eye wògblɔ nɛ be: ‘Ʋu le mia denyigba dzi kple wò ƒometɔwo gbɔ ne nàyi anyigba si mafia wò la dzi.’ 4 Ale wòdzo le Kaldeatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi va nɔ Haran.
ENGLISH: "The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran, 3 and said to him ‘Come out from your country and your kin, and come to the country I will show you.’ 4 Then he went out from the country of the Chaldeans and lived in Harran.

EWE: Eye le fofoa ƒe ku megbe la, Mawu na wòʋu va anyigba sia, si dzi miele fifia la dzi. 5 Gake mena domenyinu aɖekee le edzi o, ao, mena afɔ ɖeka ƒe kekeme teti hãe o; gake edo ŋugbe nɛ be yeatsɔe anɛ wòazu etɔ, eye emegbe yeatsɔe ana eƒe dzidzimeviwo, evɔ vi aɖeke menɔ esi ɣemaɣi o.
ENGLISH: And from there, after his father was dead, God had him move to this country you are living in now, 5 and did not give him inheritance enough in it even to set his foot on; and he promised to give it to him as a possession, and to his descendants after him when he had no child.

EWE: 6 Ke Mawu gblɔ nɛ hã be eƒe dzidzimeviwo ava zu amedzrowo le dzronyigba dzi, eye anyigba ma dzi tɔwo awɔ wo kluviwoe, eye woawɔ fu wo ƒe alafa ene sɔŋ. 7 Mawu gblɔ be, ‘Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔ ma si woanye kluviwo na la, eye le nu siawo megbe la, woadzo, eye woasubɔm le teƒe sia.’
ENGLISH: 6 But God spoke in this way: that his descendants should live the life of immigrants in an alien country, and they should enslave this posterity and ill-treat it four hundred years; 7 ‘and the nation they are in slavery to I will judge,’ said God, ‘and after that they shall come out and worship me in this place’; 8 and he gave him the covenant of circumcision.

EWE: 8 "Ebla nu kplii, si ƒe dzesidenue nye aʋatsotso, eya ta esi wòdzi Isak la, etso aʋa nɛ le ŋkeke enyia gbe.
ENGLISH: And thus he had his son Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day, and Isaac Jacob, and Jacob the twelve founders of the tribes.

EWE: Isak dzi Yakob, eye Yakob hã dzi ƒome wuieveawo tɔgbuiwo. 9 Ke mía tɔgbui siawo ʋã ŋu Yosef, wodzrae eye wokplɔe yi Egipte. Gake Mawu nɔ kplii, 10 eye wòɖee tso eƒe xaxawo katã me, eve enu, eye wòna nunyae le Egipte-fia Farao ŋkume. Eye Farao ɖoe dziɖula ɖe Egipte kple eƒe aƒe blibo la katã dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 And the Founders, becoming jealous of Joseph, sold him down to Egypt; and God was with him, 10 and rescued him out of all his distresses, and gave him favor and wisdom before the Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and he appointed him ruler over Egypt and over all his household.

EWE: 11 Ke dɔ va to le Egipte bliboa kple Kanaan, xaxa gã aɖe ŋutɔe wònye, eye mía tɔgbuiwo mekpɔ nuɖuɖu aɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 11 "And there came a famine all over Egypt and Canaan, and great distress; and our fathers could not find enough to eat.

EWE: 12 Ke Yakob se be nuɖuɖu le Egipte, eye wòdɔ mía tɔgbuiwo ɖa zi gbãtɔ. 13 Esi woyi zi evelia la, Yosef ɖe eɖokui fia nɔviawo, ale Farao hã va nya Yosef ƒe ƒomea.
ENGLISH: 12 And Jacob, hearing that there were breadstufs in Egypt, sent out our fathers a first time; 13 and at the second sending Joseph’s identity was made known to his brothers, and the Pharaoh discovered Joseph’s race.

EWE: 14 Ale Yosef dɔ woyi ɖakplɔ fofoa Yakob kple eƒe ƒometɔwo katã tso afi ma vɛ; wo katã wole ame blaadre vɔ atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 14 And Joseph sent and had his father Jacob come, and all his kin, numbering seventy-five souls.

EWE: 15 Eya ta Yakob ʋu yi Egipte, eye afi mae eya kple mía tɔgbuiwo ku ɖo. 16 Eye wokɔ wo yi Sekem hetsɔ wo mlɔ yɔdo si Abraham tsɔ klosalo ƒle le Hamor viwo si le Sekem la me.
ENGLISH: 15 And Jacob went down to Egypt, and passed away, he and our fathers, 16 and were conveyed to Shekem and put in the tomb that Abraham had bought for a cash price from the sons of Hamor at Shekem.

EWE: 17 "Esi ɣeyiɣi la gogo be ŋugbe si Mawu do na Abraham nava eme la, dukɔ la dzi hesɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi le Egipte, 18 va se ɖe esime fia bubu aɖe va ɖu Egipte dzi, si menya Yosef o. 19 Ame sia ɖo tame vɔ̃ ɖe míaƒe ƒome la ŋu, eye wòzi vifofowo dzi madzemadzee be woagblẽ woƒe vidzĩwo ɖi ne woaku.
ENGLISH: 17 "But as the time of the promise God had given to Abraham approached, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt 18 until there came up over Egypt another king who did not know Joseph; 19 he, laying a shrewd plan against our race, maltreated our fathers in having their babies exposed so that they should not be kept alive.

EWE: 20 Ɣemaɣie wodzi Mose, edze ɖeka ŋutɔ le Mawu ŋkume. Eye wona noe le fofoa ƒe me ɣleti etɔ̃. 21 Ke esi wogblẽe ɖi la, Farao vinyɔnu va kɔe, eye wòna hehee abe eya ŋutɔ via ene.
ENGLISH: 20 At which time was born Moses, and was divinely pretty; who was nurtured three months in his father’s home, 21 and when he was exposed the Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and raised him as her son.

EWE: 22 Ale wofia Egiptetɔwo ƒe nunya blibo la katã Mose. Nyateƒee, ŋusẽ ɖo eŋu le nya kple nuwɔna me.
ENGLISH: 22 And Moses was educated in all the science of the Egyptians, and was powerful in his words and deeds.

EWE: 23 "Ke esi wòxɔ ƒe blaene la, eva dzi me nɛ be yeayi aɖakpɔ ye nɔvi Israel-viwo ɖa. 24 Esi wòkpɔ be wole nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔm ɖe wo dometɔ ɖeka ŋu la, eʋli eta, eye wòbia hlɔ̃ na ame si wole fu wɔmee la hewu Egiptetɔ la.
ENGLISH: 23 And when he was completing a span of forty years it came into his mind to visit his brothers the sons of Israel, 24 and, seeing one suffering a wrong, he took the part of the maltreated man and did vengeance for him, striking down the Egyptian.

EWE: 25 Esusu be ye nɔviwo ase egɔme be Mawu aɖe wo to yeƒe asi dzi, gake womese egɔme nenema o.
ENGLISH: 25 And he supposed his brothers understood that by his hand God was giving them salvation; but they did not.

EWE: 26 Le ŋufɔke la, eva do ɖe wo dzi esime wole kɔ dam, eye wòdze agbagba be yeadzra wo dome ɖo be ŋutifafa nava aƒe, eye wògblɔ be: ‘Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwoe mienyee! Nu ka tae miele nu vevi wɔm mia nɔewo?’ 27 Ke ame si le nu vevi wɔm nɔvia la tu asii ɖa gblɔ be: ‘Ame kae ɖo wò dziɖula kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃la ɖe mía nu? 28 Ðe nèdi be yeawu nye hã abe ale si nèwu Egiptetɔ la etsɔ enea?’ 29 Esi Mose se nya sia la, esi, eye wòzu amedzro le Midian-nyigba dzi, afi si wodzi ŋutsuvi eve nɛ le.
ENGLISH: 26 And on the following day he appeared to them as they were fighting, and was pacifying them, saying ‘Boys, you are brothers; what do you wrong each other for?’ 27 But he who was wronging his fellow rebuffed him, saying ‘Who appointed you chief justice over us? 28 are you meaning to take my life the same as you took the Egyptian’s yesterday?’ 29 And Moses took flight at those words, and settled as an immigrant in the country of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

EWE: 30 "Le ƒe blaene megbe la, mawudɔla aɖe ɖe eɖokui fiae le ŋuve si le bibim la me le gbedzi le Sinai To la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 30 "And when forty years had elapsed there appeared to him in the desert of Mount Sinai an angel in a flame of fire in a bush.

EWE: 31 Esi Mose kpɔe la, eƒe nu ku le nu si wòkpɔ la ŋuti. Ke esi wòle tetem ɖe eŋu be yealé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie la, ese Yehowa ƒe gbe be: 32 ‘Nyee nye tɔgbuiwòwo ƒe Mawu, Abraham kple Isak kpakple Yakob ƒe Mawu.’ Mose dzo nyanyanya, eye meke atse be yeagalé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie o.
ENGLISH: 31 And Moses, seeing it, wondered at the sight; but as he came up to it to look at it the Lord’s voice came, 32 ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob,’ and Moses, with his flesh creeping, dared not look.

EWE: 33 Yehowa gblɔ nɛ be, ‘Ðe wò afɔkpawo le afɔ, elabena teƒe si nèle tsitre ɖo la, anyigba kɔkɔe wònye.
ENGLISH: 33 And the Lord said to him ‘Unfasten the shoes from your feet; for the place you are standing on is sacred ground.

EWE: 34 Ɛ̃, mekpɔ ale si wole nye dukɔ tem ɖe anyii le Egipte, mese woƒe ŋeŋe, eye meɖi va be maɖe wo.
ENGLISH: 34 I have seen how my people in Egypt are maltreated, and heard their groaning, and come down to rescue them; now come, let me send you to Egypt.’

EWE: Azɔ va madɔ wò ɖe Egipte.’ 35 Mose sia si gbɔ wogbe nu le hegblɔ be: ‘Ame kae ɖo wò dziɖula kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃lae?’ la, ame sia tututue Mawu dɔ to mawudɔla si ɖe eɖokui fiae le ŋuve la me dzi, be wòanye dziɖula kple ɖela.
ENGLISH: 35 "This Moses whom they had repudiated, saying ‘Who appointed you chief justice over us?’ him God has sent as both chief and redeemer with the hand of the angel that had appeared to him in the bush.

EWE: 36 Ŋutsu sia kplɔ wo dzoe; ewɔ nukunuwo kple dzesiwo le Egipte, le Ƒudzĩ la me kple gbea dzi ƒe blaene sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: 36 This man brought them out, doing wonders and tokens in Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the wilderness for forty years.

EWE: 37 "Mose siae gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: ‘Mawu aɖo nyagblɔɖila aɖe tso mia nɔviwo dome na mi abe nye ene.’ 38 Eyae nye ame si nɔ ha la dome le gbea dzi hekpe ɖe mawudɔla si ƒo nu kplii le Sinai Toa dzi la ŋu, eye wòƒo nu kple mía tɔgbuiwo hã, eye wòxɔ gbedeasi kɔkɔe siwo me agbe le la be yeatsɔ ana mí. 39 Mía tɔgbuiwo gbe toɖoɖoe hetu asii ɖa, eye le woƒe dzi me la, wotrɔ yi Egipte, 40 esi wogblɔ na Aron be: ‘Wɔ mawuwo na mí, ne woanɔ ŋgɔ na mí. Elabena míenya nu si dzɔ ɖe Mose sia si kplɔ mí tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la dzi o.’ 41 Ale wowɔ nyivi le ŋkeke mawo me, eye wosa vɔ na legba la, eye wodo dzidzɔ na wo ɖokuiwo le woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 37 This was the Moses who said to the sons of Israel ‘God will raise up for you from among your brothers a prophet, like me.’ 38 This was the one who was in the congregation in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai and with our fathers; he who received living sayings to give to us; 39 to whom our fathers would not yield obedience, but rebuffed him and turned round to Egypt in their hearts, 40 saying to Aaron ‘Make us gods who shall go before us; for we do not know what has become of that Moses who brought us out of Egypt’; 41 and they made a calf in those days and offered sacrifice to the idol, and jubilated in the work of their hands.

EWE: 42 Ale Mawu trɔ megbe de wo, eye wòɖe asi le wo ŋu be woasubɔ dziƒonuwo, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe Nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe agbalẽ la me ene be: ‘Oo, Israel ƒe aƒe, menye nyee miewu lãwo na hesa vɔ na ƒe blaene le gbea dzi o ɖe? 43 Ke boŋ Molok ƒe agbadɔ kple mawu Refan ƒe ɣletivi si ŋu mietrɔ ɖo, siwo ƒe nɔnɔme miewɔ hesubɔ lae.
ENGLISH: 42 But God turned and gave them up to worship the host of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets ‘Did you offer me slaughtered beasts and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, house of Israel? 43 and you took up the tent of Moloch and the star of the god Rephan, the figures you had made to do reverence to and I will remove you beyond Babylon.’

EWE: Eya ta manya mi aɖo ɖe keke Babilon godo ke.’ 44 "Ðaseɖiɖigbadɔ la nɔ mía tɔgbuiwo si le gbea dzi; wowɔe ɖe nɔnɔme si tututu Wòtsɔ fia Mose esi wònɔ nu ƒom kplii la nu. 45 Mía tɔgbui siwo si me wotsɔe dee la kple Yosua hã kɔe ɖe asi yi dukɔ siwo Mawu tu asii ɖa le mía tɔgbuiwo ŋgɔ la ƒe anyigba dzi. Enɔ afi ma va se ɖe David ŋɔli. 46 Mawu ve enu, eye wòbia be woana mɔnukpɔkpɔ ye yeatu xɔ na Yakob ƒe Mawu la.
ENGLISH: 44 "Our fathers had the Tabernacle of the Testimony in the wilderness, as he who spoke to Moses prescribed that he should make it in conformity with the figure he had seen; 45 which same our fathers, succeeding to it, brought in with Joshua at the dispossession of the nations God expelled before our fathers, till the days of David; 46 who found favor before God and asked to find a dwelling for the God of Jacob.

EWE: 47 Gake Salomo ye tu xɔ nɛ.
ENGLISH: 47 And Solomon built him a house.

EWE: 48 Ke Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la menɔa xɔ siwo wotsɔ asi tui la me o, abe ale si nyagblɔɖila la gblɔe ene be: 49 ‘Dziƒoe nye nye fiazikpui, eye anyigbae nye nye afɔɖodzinu. Yehowa be, xɔ ka ƒomevie miebe yewoatu nam? Alo afi kae anye gbɔɖemeƒe nam? 50 Menye nye asie wɔ nu siawo katã oa?’
ENGLISH: 48 But the Most High does not live in man-made abodes, not he; as the prophet says 49 ‘I have the sky for throne, and the earth is the footstool for my feet; what house will you build me, says the Lord? or what is the place for my rest? 50 did not my hand make all this?’

EWE: 51 "Mi kɔlialiatɔ siwo ƒe dzi kple to tri, mietsia tsitre ɖe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu ɣesiaɣi; nu si mia tɔgbuiwo wɔ va yi la ke wɔm miawo hã miele.
ENGLISH: 51 "Stiff-necked men, uncircumcised in hearts and ears, you are always throwing yourselves against the Holy Spirit, you the same as your fathers.

EWE: 52 Nyagblɔɖilawo dometɔ ka yomee mia tɔgbuiwo meti o? Ɛ̃, wowu ame siwo gblɔ ame dzɔdzɔe la ƒe vava ŋu nya ɖi, ke azɔ la, miawoe va zu ame siwo fia ame sia yome mɔ hewui, 53 evɔ miawoe wotsɔ Se la na to mawudɔlawo dzi hafi, gake mielé eme ɖe asi o. "
ENGLISH: 52 Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute, and kill those who announced beforehand about the coming of the Righteous One whose betrayers and murderers you have now become? 53 you who received the law for the prescriptions of angels and did not keep it! "

EWE: 54 Ke esi wose nya siawo la, eku dzi na wo vevie, eye woɖu aɖukli ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 54 And, hearing this, they were nettled at heart and ground their teeth at him.

EWE: 55 Ke eya la, esi gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe yɔe fũu la, ekpɔ dziƒo gãa, eye wòkpɔ Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple Yesu wòle tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖusime, 56 eye wògblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa! Mekpɔ dziƒo nu ʋu, eye mekpɔ Amegbetɔvi la wòle tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖusime. " 57 Ale wodo ɣli sesĩe hetsɔ asi xe tome, eye wo katã wolũ ɖe edzi zi ɖeka. 58 Eyome wohee yi dua godo eye wofɔ kpewo nɔ eƒum.
ENGLISH: 55 But, being full of Holy Spirit, he fixed his eyes on the sky and saw God’s glory and Jesus standing at God’s right hand, 56 and said "Here I see the skies opened and the Son of Man standing at God’s right hand. " 57 But they cried out loudly and stopped their ears and rushed upon him like one man, 58 and took him out outside the city and stoned him.

EWE: Ke ɖasefoawo ɖe woƒe awudziwuiwo da ɖe ɖekakpui aɖe si woyɔna be Saul ƒe afɔnu. 59 Esi wonɔ kpe ƒum Stefano la, eɖe kuku be: "Aƒetɔ Yesu, xɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la. " 60 Eye esi wòdze klo la, edo ɣli sesĩe be: "Yehowa, mègabu nu vɔ̃ sia na wo o. " Esi wògblɔ esia vɔ la, edɔ alɔ̃ le ku me.
ENGLISH: And the witnesses laid off their cloaks at the feet of a young man named Saul 59 and stoned Stephen, while he invoked the Lord and said "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. " 60 And he knelt down and cried out loudly "Lord, do not count this sin against them "; and with that he went to his rest.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 8 Ke Saul da asi ɖe edzi be woawui.
ENGLISH: 8 And Saul approved of his lynching.

EWE: Gbe ma gbe kee yometiti gã aɖe va hame si le Yerusalem la dzi; wo katã woka hlẽ ɖe Yudea kple Samaria nutowo me, negbe apostoloawo ko.
ENGLISH: And on that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem; and they dispersed through the country districts of Judea and Samaria, all but the apostles.

EWE: 2 Ke ŋutsu mawuvɔ̃la aɖewo kɔ Stefano yi ɖaɖi, eye wofae vevie.
ENGLISH: 2 But godly men gave Stephen a funeral and made a great wailing over him.

EWE: 3 Saul ya de asi nugbegblẽ le hame la ŋu me. Egena ɖe aƒewo me ɖekaɖeka, eye wòhea ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa doa goe, eye wònana wodea wo gaxɔ me.
ENGLISH: 3 But Saul committed atrocities against the church, making house-to-house searches, and dragged off men and women to be committed to prison.

EWE: 4 Ke ame siwo woka hlẽ la nɔ gbeƒã ɖem nya nyui la le afi sia afi si woyi.
ENGLISH: 4 So those who dispersed in different directions went along spreading the word.

EWE: 5 Filipo yi Samaria-dua me, eye wònɔ gbeƒã ɖem Kristo la na wo. 6 Esi amehawo se nya siwo gblɔm Filipo nɔ eye wokpɔ dzesi siwo wɔm wònɔ la, woɖo toe nyuie kple dzi blibo.
ENGLISH: 5 And Philip came down to the city of Samaria and preached Christ to them; 6 and the crowds to a man listened respectfully to what Philip said, as they heard and saw the tokens he exhibited.

EWE: 8 Ale dua me tɔwo kpɔ dzidzɔ ale gbegbe. 9 Ke ŋutsu aɖe le dua me, si ŋkɔe nye Simon; enye dzotɔ si wɔa nukunuwo tsã wòwɔa nuku na amewo le Samaria dua me, eye wògblɔna be ŋusẽtɔ gã aɖee yenye.
ENGLISH: 7 For many of those who had unclean spirits had them come out, shrieking loudly; and many paralytics and cripples were cured; 8 and there was great rejoicing in that city.

EWE: 10 Eye wo katã, tso ɖeviwo dzi va se ɖe tsitsiawo dzi, léa to ɖe eŋu hegblɔna be: "Ame siae nye Mawu ƒe Ŋusẽ, si woyɔna be Ŋusẽ Triakɔ. " 11 Ale woléa to ɖe eŋu, elabena tso ɣeaɖeɣi ke la, dzesi siwo wòwɔna nana amewo ƒe nu kuna.
ENGLISH: 9 But there was in the city before them a certain man, Simon by name, playing the magician and surprising the nation of Samaria and saying he was somebody great, 10 to whom they all looked up, great and small, saying "This man is a Power of God, what is called the Great Power. " 11 And they looked up to him because he had for a considerable time been surprising them with his magic tricks.

EWE: 12 Ke esi Filipo nɔ gbeƒã ɖem Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la kple Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ ŋuti nya nyuia la, amewo xɔ Filipo dzi se, eye wonyrɔ ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa ɖe tsi me.
ENGLISH: 12 But when they believed Philip as he brought them word of the Reign of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they had themselves baptized, both men and women.

EWE: 13 Simon ŋutɔ hã va zu xɔsetɔ, eye esi wòxɔ nyɔnyrɔ vɔ la, enɔ Filipo ŋu kplikplikpli; eye esi wòkpɔ dzesiwo kple ŋusẽdɔ gã siwo wɔm wòle la, ewɔ nuku nɛ ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 13 And Simon himself also believed, and, having had himself baptized, was a constant attendant at Philip’s preaching, and was surprised at seeing great tokens and miracles done.

EWE: 14 Esi apostolo siwo le Yerusalem se be Samaria xɔ Mawu ƒe nyaa la, wodɔ Petro kple Yohanes ɖe wo gbɔ; 15 eye ame siawo yi ɖado gbe ɖa ɖe wo ta be woaxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe. 16 Togbɔ be wonyrɔ wo ɖe Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me hã la, womexɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 14 And the apostles at Jerusalem, hearing that Samaria had accepted the word of God, sent Peter and John to them; 15 and they came down and prayed for them that they might receive Holy Spirit 16 (for it had not yet fallen on any of them, and they only had their baptism into the name of the Lord Jesus).

EWE: 17 Eye woda woƒe asiwo ɖe wo dzi, eye woxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.
ENGLISH: 17 Then they laid their hands on them and they received Holy Spirit.

EWE: 18 Ke esi Simon kpɔ be, ne apostoloawo da asi ɖe amewo dzi la, woxɔa gbɔgbɔa la, etsɔ ga vɛ na wo 19 gblɔ be: "Mina ŋusẽ sia nye hã, ale be ame sia ame si dzi mada nye asiwo ɖo la naxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔea. " 20 Ke Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Wò kple wò klosalo la siaa miatsrɔ̃, elabena èbu xaa be yeate ŋu aƒle Mawu ƒe nunana faa la kple ga.
ENGLISH: 18 And Simon, seeing that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, offered them a fee, 19 saying "Give me too this faculty, that anyone I lay my hands on may receive Holy Spirit. " 20 But Peter said to him "Your money go to destruction, and you with it, because you supposed you would get God’s gift with a fee.

EWE: 21 Wɔƒe alo gome aɖeke meli na wò le nya sia me o, elabena wò dzi mele dzɔdzɔe le Mawu ŋkume o.
ENGLISH: 21 You have no portion nor lot in this matter; for your heart is not straightforward before God.

EWE: 22 Eya ta trɔ dzi me tso tame vɔ̃ sia si nèɖo la me nàƒo koko na Yehowa, ɖewohĩ atsɔ tame vɔ̃ si nèɖo le dzi me la ake wò; 23 elabena mekpɔe be aɖi veve kple nu madzɔmadzɔ ƒe kluvie nènye. " 24 Simon ɖo eŋu na wo be: "Miawo ŋutɔwo miɖe kuku na Yehowa ɖe tanye, ne nu siwo miegblɔ la ƒe ɖeke nagadzɔ ɖe dzinye o. "
ENGLISH: 22 So repent of this viciousness of yours, and pray the Lord and see if you may be forgiven the idea you conceived; 23 for I see you are in the gall of bitterness and the tie of wrongness. " 24 And Simon answered "Pray to the Lord for me, you, that there may not come upon me any of the things you have said. "

EWE: 25 Eya ta esi woɖi ɖase tsitotsito hegblɔ Yehowa ƒe nya la na wo vɔ la, wogatrɔ ɖo ta Yerusalem, eye wogblɔ nya nyui la le Samaria kɔƒe geɖe me le mɔa dzi.
ENGLISH: 25 So they, having given their testimony and spoken the word of the Lord, turned back to Jerusalem, and gave the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.

EWE: (Mɔ sia nye gbedzimɔ.) 27 Ale wòtso heyi, eye kpɔ ɖa, Etiopiatɔwo ƒe amegã aɖe, si nye ŋusẽtɔ le Etiopia-fianyɔnu Kandake te, eye wònye eƒe kesinɔnuwo katã dzi kpɔla, lae nye esi.
ENGLISH: 26 But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying "Up, go southward to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza; that is desert "; 27 and he stood up and went.

EWE: Eyi Yerusalem va de ta agu, 28 eye wòtrɔ gbɔna hebɔbɔ nɔ eƒe tasiaɖam me nɔ nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ xlẽm sesĩe.
ENGLISH: And along came an Ethiopian, a powerful eunuch of Candace the queen of the Ethiopians, her treasurer-general, who had been up to Jerusalem to do reverence; 28 and he was on his way back, riding in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

EWE: 29 Eya ta gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na Filipo be: "Te ɖe tasiaɖam sia ŋu. " 30 Filipo ƒu du yi egbɔ, eye wòsee ŋutsua nɔ nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe agbalẽa xlẽm sesĩe, eye wòbiae be: "Èle nu si xlẽm nèle la gɔme sem ŋutɔŋutɔa? " 31 Egblɔ be: "Aleke mawɔ ase egɔme, ne ame aɖeke mefiam o? " Eya ta ebia tso Filipo si be wòaɖo tasiaɖam la anɔ anyi ɖe ye gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 29 And the Spirit said to Philip "Make up to that chariot and join it "; 30 and Philip ran up, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said "Do you get the meaning of what you are reading? " 31 and he said "Why, how could I, unless somebody puts me on the track? " and he invited Philip to get in and ride with him.

EWE: 32 Ke Ŋɔŋlɔa ƒe akpa si xlẽm wònɔ lae nye esi: "Wokplɔe abe alẽ ene yi wuwuƒe, eye meke nu o, abe ale si alẽvi zia ɖoɖoe le eƒe fukola ŋkume ene.
ENGLISH: 32 And the matter of the text he was reading was this: "He was led like a sheep to slaughtering; and like a lamb mute before its shearer, so he does not open his mouth.

EWE: Elabena woɖe eƒe agbe ɖa le anyigba dzi. " 34 Amegã la bia Filipo be: "Meɖe kuku, ame ka ƒe nya gblɔmee nyagblɔɖila la le? Eya ŋutɔ ŋu nyae loo alo ame bubu aɖea? " 35 Ale Filipo ƒo nu, eye wòdze egɔme tso ŋɔŋlɔ sia dzi gblɔ Yesu ŋu nya nyui la nɛ.
ENGLISH: 33 In his lowly condition his judgment was taken away; and of his generation who shall tell the story? because his life is taken away from the earth. " 34 And the eunuch answered Philip "Please, about whom is the prophet saying this? about himself or about somebody else? " 35 And Philip opened his mouth and started from this text and told him the gospel of Jesus.

EWE: 36 Ke esi wole mɔa dzi yina la, wova ɖo tsi aɖe gbɔ, eye amegã la gblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa! Tsie nye esi; nu kae xe mɔ na nye nyɔnyrɔxɔxɔ? " 37 38 Ale wòna wotɔ tasiaɖam la, eye Filipo kple amegã la woɖi yi tsi la me, eye wònyrɔe.
ENGLISH: 36 And as they were going along the road they came to a bit of water, and the eunuch said "Here is water; what hinders my being baptized? " 37 38 And he gave orders for the chariot to halt, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

EWE: 39 Esi wodo le tsia me la, Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ kplɔ Filipo dzoe enumake, eye amegã la megakpɔe o, ke eyi eƒe mɔzɔzɔa dzi kple dzidzɔ.
ENGLISH: 39 But when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away, and the eunuch saw no more of him, for he went joyously on his way.

EWE: 40 Filipo va do ɖe Asdod, eye wòle tsatsam le nutoa me godoo le nya nyui la gblɔm le duawo katã me va se ɖe esime wòɖo Kaisarea.
ENGLISH: 40 But Philip turned up at Ashdod; and as he went along he brought the gospel to all the cities till he came to Cesarea.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 9 Ke Saul galé ŋɔdzidodo kple amewuwu ƒe gbɔgbɔtsixe ɖe ƒo kokoko ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋu, eye wòyi nunɔlagã la gbɔ, 2 eye wòbia be wòana agbalẽwo ye yeatsɔ ayi ƒuƒoƒe siwo le Damasko, ale be yeabla ame sia ame si yeakpɔ, si le Aƒetɔ la ƒe Mɔ La dzi la, ava Yerusalem, eɖanye ŋutsu alo nyɔnu o.
ENGLISH: 9 But Saul, still breathing threat and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest 2 and asked him for letters to the synagogues at Damascus, so that he might bring to Jerusalem in fetters whomever he found to be followers of the Path, both men and women.

EWE: 3 Ke esi wòle mɔa dzi yina eye wògogo Damasko la, kasia kekeli aɖe klẽ tso dziƒo ƒo xlãe, 4 ale wòdze anyi, eye wòse gbe aɖe gblɔ nɛ be: "Saul, Saul, nu ka ŋuti nèle yonyeme tim? " 5 Ebia be: "Wò, ame kae, Aƒetɔ? "
ENGLISH: 3 And as he went on his way he came to be nearing Damascus, when all of a sudden a light flashed round him from the sky, 4 and he fell on the ground and heard a voice say to him "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? " 5 And he said "Who are you, sir? "

EWE: Egblɔ be: "Nyee nye Yesu, ame si yome tim nèle la.
ENGLISH: And he said "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

EWE: 6 Azɔ tso nàge ɖe dua me, eye woagblɔ nu si nàwɔ la na wò. " 7 Ke ame siwo le mɔa zɔm kplii la ƒe nu ku, le nyateƒe me la, wonɔ gbeɖiɖi aɖe sem, gake womenɔ ame aɖeke kpɔm o.
ENGLISH: 6 But stand up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do. " 7 And his traveling-companions stood speechless, hearing the voice but not seeing anybody.

EWE: 8 Ke Saul fɔ le anyigba; togbɔ be eƒe ŋkuwo le ʋuʋu hã la, mele naneke kpɔm o. Eya ta wolé eƒe alɔnu kplɔe yi Damasko.
ENGLISH: 8 And Saul rose from the ground, but when his eyes were open he could see nothing; and they brought him into Damascus leading him by the hand.

EWE: 9 Ŋkeke etɔ̃ sɔŋ mekpɔ nu o, meɖu nu o, eye meno naneke hã o.
ENGLISH: 9 And he was three days unable to see, and did not eat nor drink.

EWE: Eɖo eŋu be: "Nyee nye esi, Aƒetɔ. " 11 Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: "Tso nàyi mɔ si woyɔna be Dzɔdzɔe la dzi, nàyi Yuda ƒe aƒe me, eye nàbia ŋutsu aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Saul tso Tarso la ta. Kpɔ ɖa, ele gbe dom ɖa, 12 eye meɖe ŋutega fiae wòkpɔ ŋutsu aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Anania wòva da eƒe asiwo ɖe edzi, be wòagakpɔ nu. " 13 Ke Anania ɖo eŋu be: "Aƒetɔ, mese nya tso ame geɖewo nu le ame sia ŋuti, ale si wòwɔ vɔ̃ geɖewo ɖe wò ame kɔkɔewo ŋu le Yerusalem. 14 Eye le afi sia hã exɔ ŋusẽ tso nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo gbɔ, be yealé ame siwo katã yɔa wò ŋkɔ la. " 15 Ke Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: "Heyi, elabena ŋutsu sia nye dɔwɔnu tiatia aɖe nam, be wòatsɔ nye ŋkɔ la ayi na dukɔwo kple fiawo kpakple Israel-viwo. 16 Elabena mafia ale si gbegbe wòle be wòakpe fu le nye ŋkɔ ta lae. " 17 Ale Anania dze mɔ yi aƒea me, eye wòda eƒe asiwo ɖe edzi gblɔ be: "Nɔvi Saul, Aƒetɔ Yesu, ame si ɖe eɖokui fia wò le mɔ si nèto gbɔna la dzie dɔm ɖa be nàgakpɔ nu, eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe nayɔ wò fũu. " 18 Enumake nanewo ge tso eƒe ŋkuwo dzi abe tsro ene, eye wògakpɔ nu. Ale wòtso, eye wonyrɔe; 19 eɖu nu eye ŋusẽ ɖo eŋu.
ENGLISH: 10 But there was in Damascus a certain disciple, by name Hananiah, and the Lord said to him in a vision "Hananiah! " and he said "Here I am, Lord. " 11 And the Lord said to him "Stand up and go to the street known as Straight Street, and look at Judah’s house for a Tarsus man, Saul by name; for he is praying, 12 and has seen a man named Hananiah come in and lay his hands on him so that he may recover his sight. " 13 And Hananiah answered "Lord, I have heard about this man from a great many people, how much harm he has done at Jerusalem to thy holy ones; 14 and here he has authority from the chief priests to throw into fetters all who invoke thy name. " 15 But the Lord said to him "Go, because this man is the instrument of my choice to carry my name before nations and kings and the sons of Israel; 16 for I will let him know how much he must suffer for my name. " 17 And Hananiah went, and came into the house and laid his hands on him and said "Brother Saul, the Lord has sent me, Jesus that appeared to you on the road as you were coming, so that you might recover your sight and be filled with Holy Spirit. " 18 And at once it was as if scales dropped off from his eyes; and he recovered his sight, and rose and was baptized, 19 and took food and rallied.

EWE: Enɔ nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ le Damasko ŋkeke aɖewo, 20 eye wòyi ƒuƒoƒewo enumake nɔ gbeƒã ɖem tso Yesu ŋu be, ame siae nye Mawu ƒe Vi la. 21 Ke ame siwo katã nɔ eƒe nyawo sem la ƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye wogblɔ be: "Alo menye ame siae wɔ fu geɖe ame siwo yɔa ŋkɔ sia le Yerusalem oa? Ðe meva afi sia hã le susu ma ke ta, be yealé wo akplɔ wo ayi na nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo oa? " 22 Ke ŋusẽ geɖe nɔ Saul ŋu ɖom, eye wònaa kpeɖodzi siwo me kɔ eye susu le wo me be ame siae nye Kristo la, ale Yudatɔ siwo nɔ Damasko la ƒe nu ku.
ENGLISH: And he was with the disciples at Damascus for some days, 20 and at once preached Jesus in the synagogues, saying "This is the Son of God. " 21 And all who heard it were surprised, and said "Is not this the one who had ravaged at Jerusalem those who invoked this name, and had come here for this purpose, to bring them in fetters before the chief priests? " 22 But Saul grew more and more vigorous, and discomfited the Jews of Damascus, demonstrating that this is the Messiah.

EWE: 23 Le ŋkeke geɖe megbe la, Yudatɔwo ɖo nugbe be yewoawui. 24 Gake Saul va nya nugbe si woɖo ɖe eŋu la.
ENGLISH: 23 But when several days had elapsed, the Jews plotted to take his life; 24 but their plot became known to Saul.

EWE: Wonɔ agboawo hã nu dzɔm nyuie zã kple keli, be yewoabu mo nɛ. 25 Eya ta le zã me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kɔe de kusi me, tsɔe to do aɖe si le glia ŋu la nu heɖiɖii ɖe anyigba.
ENGLISH: And they also watched the gates day and night in order to take his life; 25 but his disciples took him and got him down through the wall by night, lowering him in a basket.

EWE: 26 Esi wòva ɖo Yerusalem la, edze agbagba be yeawɔ ɖeka kple nusrɔ̃laawo, gake wo katã wonɔ vɔvɔ̃m nɛ, elabena womexɔe se be nusrɔ̃lae wònye o.
ENGLISH: 26 And he arrived in Jerusalem and tried to join the disciples; and they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

EWE: 27 Eya ta Barnaba kpe ɖe eŋu eye wòkplɔe yi apostoloawo gbɔ hegblɔ ale si Aƒetɔ la ɖe eɖokui fiae le mɔa dzi eye wòƒo nu nɛ, kple ale si wòyi ɖaƒo nu vɔvɔ̃manɔmee le Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me le Damasko la na wo tsitotsito. 28 Ale wònɔ wo gbɔ le Yerusalem, eye wòyina gbɔna faa heƒoa nu kple kakaɖedzi le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ me.
ENGLISH: 27 But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and told them the story of how he had seen the Lord on the road, and his having spoken to him, and how he had spoken out in the name of Jesus at Damascus; 28 and he was with them going in and out of Jerusalem, speaking out in the Lord’s name.

EWE: 29 Eƒoa nu kple Yudatɔ siwo doa Helagbe hedzroa nya me kpli wo, ke woawo di mɔnu le eŋu be yewoawui. 30 Esi nɔviawo kpɔ esia dze sii la, wokplɔe yi Kaisarea, eye woɖoe ɖe Tarso.
ENGLISH: 29 And he talked and debated with the Greek-speaking Jews; but they undertook to take his life; 30 and the brothers, becoming cognizant of it, took him down to Cesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

EWE: 31 Azɔ hame si le Yudea blibo la kple Galilea kpakple Samaria la ƒe tome fa, eye wodo ŋusẽ wo, eye wonɔ dzidzim ɖe edzi le esi woyi edzi zɔ le Yehowa vɔvɔ̃ me eye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe na akɔfafa wo ta.
ENGLISH: 31 So the church throughout Judea and Galilee and Samaria was left in peace, being built up and walking in the fear of the Lord, and it multiplied by the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.

EWE: 32 Ke esi Petro zɔ mɔ to nutoa katã me la, eva ame kɔkɔe siwo le Lida la hã gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 32 And it so befell that as Peter went along through all parts of the community, among the rest he came down to the people of God at Lydda.

EWE: 33 Ekpɔ ŋutsu aɖe le afi ma, si ŋkɔe nye Ainea, ame si le lãmetutudɔ lém eye wòtsi aba dzi ƒe enyi sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: 33 And he found there a certain man, Eneas by name, who had been lying abed for eight years, being paralyzed.

EWE: 34 Petro gblɔ nɛ be: "Ainea, Yesu Kristo da gbe le ŋuwò. Tso nàɖo wò aba. " Eye wòtso enumake.
ENGLISH: 34 And Peter said to him "Eneas, Jesus Christ cures you; get up and make your bed "; and at once he got up.

EWE: 35 Esi ame siwo katã le Lida kple Saron Tagba la kpɔe la, woxɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.
ENGLISH: 35 And all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him; who turned back to the Lord.

EWE: 36 Ke nusrɔ̃la aɖe le Yopa, eŋkɔe nye Tabita, si woyɔna le Helagbe me be "Dorkas. " Ewɔa dɔ nyui geɖewo eye wònaa nu amewo dɔmenyotɔe. 37 Ke edze dɔ le ŋkeke mawo me, eye wòku.
ENGLISH: 36 And in Joppa there was a certain disciple, Tabitha by name, which is to say in English "Gazelle "; she was full of actions of kindness and charity that she used to do.

EWE: Eya ta wole tsi nɛ eye wokɔe mlɔ dziƒoxɔ aɖe me. 38 Lida medidi tso Yopa gbɔ o, eya ta esi nusrɔ̃lawo se be Petro le du sia me la, wodɔ ame eve ɖo ɖe egbɔ kple kukuɖeɖe be: "Va mía gbɔ, mègahe ɖe megbe o. " 39 Ale Petro tso heyi kpli wo. Esi wòɖo la, wokplɔe yi dziƒoxɔa me; eye ahosiwo katã va egbɔ nɔ avi fam eye wotsɔ awu kple awu ʋlaya geɖe siwo Dorkas tɔ na wo esime wònɔ wo gbɔ la le fiafiam.
ENGLISH: 37 And it happened in those days that she fell sick and died; and they washed her and laid her in an upper room; 38 and, as Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him with the appeal "Do not fail to come right on to us. " 39 And Peter rose and went with them; and when he arrived they took him up to the room, and all the widows presented themselves to him weeping and pointing to their dresses and cloaks that the Gazelle made while she was with them.

EWE: 40 Ke Petro na ame sia ame do go, eye wòdze klo do gbe ɖa.
ENGLISH: 40 But Peter put everybody out and knelt down and prayed, and turned around to the body and said "Tabitha, stand up. "

EWE: Eye wòtrɔ ɖe ame kukua ŋu gblɔ be: "Tabita, tsi tsitre! "
ENGLISH: And she opened her eyes, and, seeing Peter, sat up.

EWE: Ale wòʋu ŋku, eye esi wòkpɔ Petro la, efɔ bɔbɔ nɔ anyi. 41 Ale wòlé eƒe alɔnu wòtso, eye wòyɔ ame kɔkɔeawo kple ahosiawo vɛ, eye wòkplɔe de asi na wo agbagbee.
ENGLISH: 41 And he gave her his hand and raised her to her feet; and he called the members of the church and the widows, and presented her alive.

EWE: 42 Nya sia kaka ɖe Yopa blibo la katã, eye ame geɖewo va xɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.
ENGLISH: 42 And it became known throughout Joppa, and many believed on the Lord.

EWE: 43 Petro nɔ Yopa ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo le lãgbalẽŋudɔwɔla aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Simon gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 43 And it befell that he stayed at Joppa several days with one Simon, a tanner.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 10 Ke ŋutsu aɖe le Kaisarea, si ŋkɔe nye Kornelio, eye wònye asrafowo ƒe hatsotso si woyɔna be Italia-srafoha la ƒe aʋafia. 2 Edoa vevie mawusubɔsubɔ, eya kple eƒe aƒe blibo la katã vɔ̃a Mawu, enyoa dɔme naa nu amewo, eye wònɔa kokoƒoƒo dzi na Mawu ɣeawokatãɣi. 3 Le ŋkekea ƒe gaƒoƒo asiekelia lɔƒo la, ekpɔ mawudɔla aɖe le ŋutega me wòva egbɔ heyɔe be: "Kornelio! " 4 Kornelio kpɔe gãa, vɔvɔ̃ ɖoe, eye wògblɔ be: "Aƒetɔ, nu kae? "
ENGLISH: 10 And a certain man at Cesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what is known as the Italian cohort, 2 a pious man and one who feared God with all his family, doing many acts of charity to the people and praying to God continually, 3 saw in a vision distinctly, at about three o’clock in the afternoon, an angel of God come in to him and say to him "Cornelius! " 4 And he, terror-struck as he fixed his eyes on him, said "What is it, sir? "

EWE: Egblɔ nɛ be: "Wò gbedodoɖawo va ɖo Mawu gbɔ eye wòɖo ŋku wò dɔmenyowɔwɔwo hã dzi.
ENGLISH: And he said to him "Your prayers and charities have gone up for a memorial before God.

EWE: 5 Eya ta dɔ ŋutsuwo ɖo ɖe Yopa ne woayɔ Simon si wogayɔna be Petro la avɛ.
ENGLISH: 5 And now send men to Joppa after a certain Simon, who is also named Peter; 6 he is a guest of a certain Simon, a tanner, who has his house by the seaside. "

EWE: 6 Ŋutsu sia dze lãgbalẽŋudɔwɔla aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Simon, ame si ƒe aƒe le ƒuta, la gbɔ. " 7 Esi mawudɔla si ƒo nu kplii la dzo teti ko la, eyɔ eƒe aƒedzikpɔla eve kpe ɖe asrafo siwo dzɔa eŋu la dometɔ ɖeka si doa vevie mawusubɔsubɔ la ŋu, 8 eye wògblɔ nya sia nya na wo hedɔ wo ɖo ɖe Yopa.
ENGLISH: 7 And when the angel that spoke to him went away, he called two of the domestics and a pious soldier, one of those who were constantly in his company, 8 and gave them an account of the whole event and sent them to Joppa.

EWE: 9 Ke esi ŋu ke, eye wole mɔzɔzɔa dzi hegogo dua la, Petro yi xɔta le gaƒoƒo adelia lɔƒo be yeado gbe ɖa.
ENGLISH: 9 And on the following day, as they were on their way and were nearing the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray at twelve o’clock.

EWE: 10 Dɔ wui vevie, eye wòdi be yeaɖu nu. Esime wole nua ɖam la, ekpɔ ŋutega, 11 eye wòkpɔ dziƒo nu ʋu, eye wòkpɔ nane abe aklala gã aɖe si ƒe dzogoe eneawo wolé hele eɖiɖim ɖe anyigba la ene; 12 eye lã fɔene ƒomeviwo katã kple lã siwo tana le anyigba dzi kpakple dziƒoxewo le eme.
ENGLISH: 10 And he grew hungry and wanted a bite; but while they were getting it ready he fell into a trance 11 and saw the sky opened and a thing like a great sheet coming down, being let down on the earth by four corners, 12 with all the different quadrupeds and reptiles and birds of the air in it.

EWE: 13 Eye wòse gbe aɖe si gblɔ nɛ be: "Petro, tso, wu wo nàɖu! " 14 Ke Petro gblɔ be: "Gbeɖe, Aƒetɔ, elabena nyemeɖu nu ƒoɖi kple nu makɔmakɔ aɖeke kpɔ o. " 15 Eye gbea gagblɔ nɛ zi evelia be: "Dzudzɔ nu siwo ŋuti Mawu kɔ la yɔyɔ be nu ƒoɖi. " 16 Nu sia dzɔ zi gbɔ zi etɔ̃, eye enumake wokɔ nu la dzoe yi dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 13 And there came a voice speaking to him, "Up, Peter, kill and eat. " 14 And Peter said "No, no, sir, I have never eaten anything vile or unclean. " 15 And again there was a voice speaking to him a second time; "What God has made clean do not you make vile. " 16 And this happened three times, and at once the thing was taken up into the sky.

EWE: 17 Petro tɔtɔ eye menya nu si ŋutega si wòkpɔ la fia o; ɣemaɣi tututu ŋutsu siwo Kornelio dɔ la nɔ afi si Simon ƒe aƒe le la ta biam, eye wova tɔ ɖe agboa nu. 18 Eye wokɔ gbe dzi bia be ɖe Simon si wogayɔna be Petro la dze afi ma hã. 19 Esi Petro kpɔtɔ le tame bum le ŋutegaa ŋu la, gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: "Kpɔ ɖa! Ŋutsu etɔ̃ le diwòm.
ENGLISH: 17 And as Peter was at a loss to know what the vision he had seen might be, the men sent from Cornelius made their appearance at the porch, having got themselves directed to Simon’s house, 18 and called out to inquire whether Simon, also named Peter, was a guest there.

EWE: Nyee nye ame si dim miele. Nu ka tae mieva ɖo? " 22 Wogblɔ nɛ be: "Aʋafia Kornelio, ame si nye ame dzɔdzɔe kple mawuvɔ̃la, eye Yuda dukɔ blibo la ƒoa nu nyui le eŋu lae dɔ mí ɖe gbɔwò.
ENGLISH: 19 And while Peter was thinking the vision over, the Spirit said "Here are men looking for you; 20 but rise and come down and go with them without any doubting, because it was I that sent them. " 21 And Peter came down to the men and said "Here, I am the one you are looking for: what is the occasion you are here about? " 22 And they said "Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, vouched for by all the nation of the Jews, had it revealed to him by a holy angel that he should send for you to his house and hear words from you. "

EWE: Mawu na eƒe dɔla kɔkɔe aɖe ɖe eɖokui fiae eye wòbia tso esi be wòadɔ ame ɖe gbɔwò be nàva yeƒe aƒe me, ne wòase nya siwo le asiwò. " 23 Ale wòna woge ɖe eme, eye wodze egbɔ.
ENGLISH: 23 So he invited them in and made them his guests.

EWE: Esi ŋu ke la, etso eye wòyi kpli wo, eye nɔvi siwo le Yopa la dometɔ aɖewo hã yi kplii.
ENGLISH: But on the following day he went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa went with him.

EWE: 24 Le ŋkeke si gakplɔe ɖo dzi la, eva ɖo Kaisarea. Kornelio hã le mɔ kpɔm na wo, eye wòyɔ eƒe ƒometɔwo kple xɔlɔ̃ veviwo ƒo ƒu.
ENGLISH: 24 And on the following day he came into Cesarea; and Cornelius was awaiting them, having called together his relatives and intimate friends.

EWE: 25 Esi Petro ge ɖe aƒea me la, Kornelio va kpee, eye wòdze klo ɖe eƒe afɔnu hebɔbɔ nɛ.
ENGLISH: 25 And when it came to Peter’s going in, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet and did reverence.

EWE: 26 Ke Petro lée wòtso, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: "Tsi tre; nye hã amegbetɔ ko menye. " 27 Esi wòle dze ɖom kplii hege ɖe eme la, ekpɔ ame gbogbo aɖewo ƒo ƒu ɖi. 28 Eye wògblɔ na wo be: "Miawo ŋutɔwo mienyae nyuie, ale si mele se nu be Yudatɔ nade ha kple dukɔ bubu me tɔ alo ava egbɔ o, gake Mawu ɖee fiam be magayɔ ame aɖeke be ame ƒoɖi alo ame makɔmakɔ o.
ENGLISH: 26 But Peter made him rise, saying "Stand up: I am a man myself. " 27 And he went in conversing with him, and found a great many come together, 28 and said to them "You know yourselves it is an impropriety for a Jew to fraternize with an alien or make a call on him.

EWE: 29 Esia tae esi wodɔ ame ɖem la, nyemekpɔ susu aɖeke si ta magbe vava o.
ENGLISH: And God has shown me I am not to call any man vile or unclean; 29 for which very reason I came without making any objection when I was sent for.

EWE: Eya ta medi be manya nu si ta miedɔ ame ɖem ɖo. "
ENGLISH: So I inquire for what reason you sent for me. "

EWE: 30 Eye Kornelio gblɔ be: "Egbee nye ŋkeke enea gbe, le ɣeyiɣi sia tututu dzi esi menɔ gbe dom ɖa le aƒenye me le gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi la, kasia, ŋutsu aɖee nye esi le awu si le dzo dam me va tsi tsitre ɖe ŋgɔnye, 31 eye wògblɔ nam be: ‘Kornelio, wose wò gbedodoɖa, eye Mawu ɖo ŋku wò dɔmenyowɔwɔwo dzi. 32 Eya ta dɔ ame ɖe Yopa ne woayɔ Simon si wogayɔna be Petro la vɛ.
ENGLISH: 30 And Cornelius said "Four days ago, to an hour, I was offering the three o’clock prayer in my house, and there before me stood a man in splendid vesture 31 and said ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard and your charities are remembered before God; 32 so send to Joppa and have Simon who is also named Peter come; he is a guest of Simon a tanner, by the seaside’; 33 so I sent to you instantly, and you did well to come.

EWE: Eya ta fifia mí katã míele afii le Mawu ŋkume, be míase nya siwo katã Yehowa de asiwò be nàgblɔ. "
ENGLISH: So now we are all present before God to hear everything that you are directed to say by the Lord. "

EWE: 34 Eye Petro ke nu gblɔ be: "Azɔ medze sii le nyateƒe me be Mawu mekpɔa ame ŋkume o, 35 ke boŋ le dukɔ sia dukɔ me la, ame si vɔ̃nɛ eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, eya ƒe nue dzea eŋu.
ENGLISH: 34 And Peter opened his mouth and said "I perceive to a certainty that God is not partial, 35 but in every nation he who fears him and practices righteousness is acceptable to him.

EWE: 36 Eɖo nya la ɖe Israel-viwo be woagblɔ ŋutifafanya nyui la na wo to Yesu Kristo dzi ame siae nye amewo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ. 37 Mienya nu si ŋu nya gblɔm wonɔ le Yudea blibo la, si gɔme wodze tso Galilea esi Yohanes ɖe gbeƒã nyɔnyrɔxɔxɔ vɔ megbe: 38 nya si ku ɖe Yesu si tso Nazaret ŋu, ale si Mawu tsɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ si ami nɛ, eye wòyi ɖato anyigba blibo la dzi nɔ nyui wɔm henɔ dɔ dam na ame siwo katã Abosam te ɖe anyi, elabena Mawu nɔ kplii. 39 Eye míawoe nye nu siwo katã wòwɔ le Yudatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi kple Yerusalem siaa la ŋuti ɖasefowo; gake wohee ɖe ati ŋu hewui.
ENGLISH: 36 The word he sent to the sons of Israel bringing the news of peace through Jesus Christ he is Lord of all 37 you know, the thing that took place all over Palestine, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism that John preached, 38 Jesus from Nazareth, how God anointed him with Holy Spirit and power; who went along doing good and healing all who were tyrannized over by the Devil, because God was with him 39 (and we are witnesses to everything that he did both in the countryside of the Jews and in Jerusalem); which same Jesus they put to death by hanging him on a tree.

EWE: 40 Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe, eye wòna wòɖe eɖokui fia amewo, 41 menye dukɔ bliboa katã o, ke boŋ ɖasefo siwo Mawu ɖo do ŋgɔ, mí, ame siwo ɖu nu heno nu kplii le eƒe fɔfɔ tso ame kukuwo dome la megbe. 42 Ede se hã na mí be míaɖe gbeƒã na dukɔ la, eye míaɖi ɖase tsitotsito be ame siae Mawu ɖo be wòanye agbagbeawo kple kukuawo siaa ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la.
ENGLISH: 40 Him God raised on the third day, and had him show himself, 41 not to all the people but to the witnesses preappointed by God, us who ate and drank with him after his rising from the dead, 42 and instructed us to proclaim to the people and to attest that this is the God-ordained judge of living and dead.

EWE: 43 Eya ŋutie nyagblɔɖilawo katã ɖi ɖase le be, woatsɔ ame sia ame si xɔa edzi sena la ƒe nu vɔ̃wo akee le eƒe ŋkɔ me. "
ENGLISH: 43 To him all the prophets testify that everyone who believes in him is to receive pardon of sins through his name. "

EWE: 44 Ke esi Petro gale nu ƒom le nu siawo ŋu la, gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la va ame siwo katã le nyaa sem la dzi. 45 Eye xɔsetɔ siwo tso aʋa siwo kplɔ Petro ɖo va la, ƒe nu ku, elabena wokɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe si nye Mawu ƒe nunana la ɖe dukɔwo me tɔwo hã dzi. 46 Elabena wosee wole gbe bubuwo dom hele Mawu kafum.
ENGLISH: 44 While Peter was still speaking these words the Holy Spirit fell upon all who were listening to the discourse; 45 and the circumcised believers who had come with Peter were surprised that the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out on the foreigners too, 46 for they heard them speak languages and magnify God.

EWE: Eye Petro gblɔ be: 47 "Ðe ame aɖe ate ŋu axe mɔ be woaganyrɔ ame siawo ɖe tsi me, esi woxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la abe míawo ke ene oa? " 48 Ale wògblɔ be woanyrɔ wo ɖe Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ me.
ENGLISH: Then Peter answered 47 "Can anyone bar the water, that these who have received the Holy Spirit the same as we did should not be baptized? " 48 And he directed that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ.

EWE: Eye woɖe kuku nɛ be wòanɔ yewo gbɔ ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo.
ENGLISH: Then they asked him to stay some days.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 11 Ke apostoloawo kple nɔvi siwo le Yudea la se be dukɔwo me tɔwo hã xɔ Mawu ƒe nya la.
ENGLISH: 11 And the apostles, and the Palestinian brothers, heard that the foreigners too had received the word of God.

EWE: 2 Eya ta esi Petro va Yerusalem la, ame siwo de aʋatsotso dzi la he nya ɖe eŋu 3 be: "Èyi aʋamatsomatsotɔwo ƒe me heɖu nu kpli wo. " 4 Esia na Petro ɖe nya la me na wo nyuie be: 5 "Menɔ Yopa dua me nɔ gbe dom ɖa, eye mekpɔ le ŋutega me wole nane si le abe aklala gã aɖe ene, si ƒe dzogoe eneawo wolé la, ɖiɖim tso dziƒo tẽe ɖe gbɔnye.
ENGLISH: 2 But when Peter came up to Jerusalem, the circumcised took issue with him, 3 saying "You went in where men with uncircumcised bodies were and ate with them. " 4 But Peter began and stated the case to them in detail, 5 "I was in the city of Joppa, praying, and in a trance I saw a vision, a thing coming down, like a great sheet being let down by four corners out of the sky, and it came clear down to me.

EWE: 6 Esi melé ŋku ɖe eme nyuie la, mekpɔ anyigbadzilã afɔenewo kple gbemelãwo kple lã siwo tana kpakple dziƒoxewo.
ENGLISH: 6 I fixed my eyes on it and looked, and saw the different quadrupeds, the wild beasts, the reptiles, the birds of the air.

EWE: 7 Eye mese gbe aɖe hã si gblɔ nam be, ‘Petro, tso, wu wo nàɖu!’ 8 Ke megblɔ be: ‘Gbeɖe, Aƒetɔ, elabena nyemede nu ƒoɖi alo nu makɔmakɔ aɖeke nu me kpɔ o.’ 9 Gbe si tso dziƒo la ɖo eŋu zi evelia be: ‘Wò la, dzudzɔ nu siwo ŋuti Mawu kɔ la yɔyɔ be nu ƒoɖi.’ 10 Nu sia dzɔ zi gbɔ zi etɔ̃, eye wogahe nu sia nu dzoe yi dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 7 And I also heard a voice say to me ‘Up, Peter, kill and eat.’ 8 And I said ‘No, no, sir, because a thing vile or unclean has never gone into my mouth.’ 9 And a second time a voice out of the sky answered ‘What God has made clean do not you make vile.’ 10 And this happened three times, and it was all of it drawn up into the sky again.

EWE: 11 Eye ɣemaɣi tututu la, ŋutsu etɔ̃ le tsitre ɖe aƒe si me míele la me; wodɔ wo tso Kaisarea ɖe gbɔnye.
ENGLISH: 11 "And instantly three men made their appearance standing outside the house I was in, sent from Cesarea to me.

EWE: 12 Eye gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ nam be mayi kpli wo, eye magake ɖi kura o.
ENGLISH: 12 And the Spirit told me to go along with them without making any difference.

EWE: Ke nɔvi ade siawo hã yi kplim, eye míege ɖe ŋutsua ƒe aƒe me.
ENGLISH: And these six brothers too went with me, and we went into the man’s house.

EWE: 13 "Egblɔ na mí be yekpɔ mawudɔla wòle tsitre ɖe yeƒe aƒe me eye wògblɔ be: ‘Dɔ ame ɖo ɖe Yopa, ɖe Simon si wogayɔna be Petro gbɔ, 14 eye agblɔ nu siwo ana wò kple wò aƒe blibo la miakpɔ ɖeɖe la na wò.’ 15 Ke esi mede asi nuƒoƒo me la, woxɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la, abe ale si ko míawo hã míexɔe le gɔmedzedzea me ene.
ENGLISH: 13 And he reported to us how he had seen the angel take its stand in his house and say ‘Send to Joppa for Simon, also named Peter, 14 who will speak words to you by which you and all your family shall be saved.’ 15 "And as I began to speak the Holy Spirit fell on them just the same as it had on us at first.

EWE: 16 Ale meɖo ŋku Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya dzi, ale si wògblɔna be, ‘Yohanes tsɔ tsi nyrɔ amewo, ke woatsɔ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe anyrɔ miawo ya.’ 17 Eya ta ne Mawu tsɔ nunana faa ma ke na woawo hã, abe ale si wòna mí ame siwo xɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi se la hã ene ɖe, ame kae menye be maxe mɔ na Mawu? "
ENGLISH: 16 And I remembered the Lord’s word, how he said ‘John baptized with water, but you shall be baptized in Holy Spirit.’ 17 So if God gave them the same gift equally with us when they believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to claim to veto God? "

EWE: 18 Ke esi wose nya siawo la, wodzudzɔ nyaa hehe, eye wokafu Mawu gblɔ be: "Ekema Mawu na mɔnukpɔkpɔ dukɔwo me tɔwo hã be woatrɔ dzi me, ne woakpɔ agbe. "
ENGLISH: 18 At hearing this they let the matter drop, and glorified God, saying "Then God has given the foreigners too repentance into life. "

EWE: 19 Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, ame siwo ka hlẽ le xaxa si va le Stefano ƒe ku megbe la yi keke Foinike kple Kipro kpakple Antiokia ke, gake Yudatɔwo ɖeɖe koe wonɔ nyaa gblɔm na. 20 Ke ame aɖewo le wo dome siwo tso Kipro kple Kirene va Antiokia, eye woƒoa nu na Helagbe dolawo henɔa Aƒetɔ Yesu ŋuti nya nyui la gblɔm na wo. 21 Yehowa ƒe asi hã nɔ wo dzi, eye ame geɖe va zu xɔsetɔwo hetrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 19 So those who dispersed at the distress that arose over Stephen went along as far as Phenicia and Cyprus and Antioch speaking the word to nobody but Jews alone; 20 but there were some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they came to Antioch, spoke also to the Greek-speaking population, announcing the gospel of the Lord Jesus; 21 and the Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number that believed turned to the Lord.

EWE: 22 Hame si le Yerusalem la se wo ŋu nya, eye wodɔ Barnaba ɖo ɖe keke Antiokia ke. 23 Esi wòva ɖo eye wòkpɔ ale si Mawu ve wo nui la, dzi dzɔe ŋutɔ, eye wòde dzi ƒo na wo katã be woayi edzi aɖoe kplikpaa le woƒe dzi me be yewoanɔ Aƒetɔ la me; 24 elabena ame nyui wònye, gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la yɔe fũu eye xɔse sẽŋu le esi. Eye ameha gã aɖe va xɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.
ENGLISH: 22 And word about them came to the ears of the church at Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas off to Antioch; 23 and when he arrived and saw the grace of God he was glad, and exhorted them all to stick to their hearts’ purpose in the Lord, 24 because he was a good man and full of Holy Spirit and of faith; and a considerable number joined the Lord.

EWE: 25 Eye wòdzo yi Tarso be yeaɖadi Saul ake ɖe eŋu godoo. 26 Esi wòkpɔe la, ekplɔe va Antiokia.
ENGLISH: 25 And he went out to Tarsus to look up Saul, 26 and when he found him he brought him to Antioch.

EWE: Wonɔ hamea gbɔ ƒe blibo ɖeka, ƒoa ƒu kpli wo, eye wofia nu ame gbogbo aɖewo. Antiokia ye woyɔ nusrɔ̃lawo le zi gbãtɔ be Kristotɔwo le Mawu ƒe mɔfiafia te.
ENGLISH: And it came to pass that they met with the church through a whole year, and taught a considerable crowd; and that in Antioch the disciples first came to be styled Christians.

EWE: 27 Le ŋkeke mawo me la, nyagblɔɖilawo tso Yerusalem va Antiokia. 28 Wo dometɔ ɖeka si ŋkɔe nye Agabo la tsi tsitre, eye gbɔgbɔ la ʋãe wògblɔ be eteƒe madidi o, dɔ gã aɖe ato le anyigba blibo la dzi, eye esia va eme vavã le Klaudio ŋɔli.
ENGLISH: 27 And meanwhile prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch; 28 and one of them, Agabus by name, stood up and gave an indication by the Spirit that there was to be a great famine all over the world of men; which there was in Claudius’s time.

EWE: 29 Eya ta nusrɔ̃lawo ɖoe be yewoaɖo kpekpeɖeŋununana, ale si wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ate ŋui, ɖe nɔvi siwo le Yudea; 30 nu siae wowɔ hã, eye wotsɔe de Barnaba kple Saul si ɖo ɖe hamemetsitsiawo.
ENGLISH: 29 And the converts, as one and another of them could afford, each set a sum apart to send for relief to the brothers that lived in Palestine; 30 and so they did, sending to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

EWE: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ENGLISH: Acts

EWE: 12 Ɣeyiɣi mawo me la, fia Herodes de asi ŋutasesẽ le hame la me tɔ aɖewo ŋu me. 2 Ewu Yakobo si nye Yohanes nɔvi kple yi.
ENGLISH: 12 And at that time Herod the king lifted his hand to maltreat some of the representatives of the church.

EWE: 3 Esi wòkpɔ be esia dzɔ dzi na Yudatɔwo ta la, elé Petro hã. (Nu sia dzɔ le Amɔwɔ Maʋamaʋã Bolo Ŋkekenyui la ɖuɣi.) 4 Esi eƒe asi su edzi la, edee gaxɔ me, eye wòtsɔe de asi na asrafoha ene siwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me asrafo ene le la be woanɔ wo nɔewo ɖɔlim eye woadzɔ eŋu, elabena eɖoe be yeakplɔe ava dukɔa ŋkume le Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la megbe.
ENGLISH: 2 And he put to death James the brother of John by the sword; 3 and, seeing that it was pleasing to the Jews, he went on to arrest Peter too (it was in the matzoth days), 4 and did capture him and put him in prison, committing him to four fours of soldiers to guard, meaning to bring him up to the people after the passover.

EWE: 5 Eya ta wonɔ Petro ŋu dzɔm le gaxɔa me, ke hame la nɔ gbe dom ɖa vevie na Mawu ɖe eta.
ENGLISH: 5 So Peter was being kept in the prison; but prayer was being ardently made to God for him by the church.

EWE: 6 Ke le zã si do ŋgɔ na gbe si gbe Herodes akplɔe ava dutoƒo me la, Petro nɔ alɔ̃ dɔm hele babla le kɔsɔkɔsɔ eve me le asrafo eve dome, eye dzɔla siwo le ʋɔtrua nu la le gaxɔa ŋu dzɔm. 7 Kasia, Yehowa ƒe dɔla va tsi tsitre ɖe afi ma, eye kekeli aɖe klẽ ɖe gaxɔa me.
ENGLISH: 6 But when Herod was going to produce him, that night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, chained with two chains, and guards in front of the door were watching the prison; 7 and lo, an angel of the Lord made his appearance, and a light shone in the room.

EWE: Eye wòƒo Petro ƒe axadame eye wònyɔe hegblɔ be: "Fɔ kaba! " Ale kɔsɔkɔsɔawo ge le asi ŋu nɛ.
ENGLISH: And he struck Peter on the side and waked him, saying, "Stand up quick "; and his chains dropped off from his hands.

EWE: 8 Mawudɔla la gblɔ nɛ be: "Dzra ɖo, eye nàdo wò afɔkpawo. " Ewɔe nenema.
ENGLISH: 8 And the angel said to him "Tie your belt and put on your sandals "; and he did so.

EWE: Mlɔeba egblɔ nɛ be: "Do wò awudziwui la nàdze yonyeme. " 9 Eye wòdo go hedze eyome, ke menya be nu ŋutɔŋutɔe nu si le dzɔdzɔm to mawudɔlaa dzi la nye o.
ENGLISH: And he said to him "Put on your cloak and follow me "; 9 and he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was being done through the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, esusu be ŋutega kpɔmee yele. 10 Esi woto dzɔla gbãtɔwo kple eveliawo ŋu la, wova ɖo gagbo, si nu wotona yia dua me la nu, eye agboa ŋutɔ ʋu na wo le eɖokui si.
ENGLISH: 10 And they passed a first watch and a second and came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of itself, and they went out and went one block, and at once the angel was gone from him.

EWE: 11 Esi Petro nyɔ le eɖokui me la, egblɔ be: "Azɔ menyae vavã be Yehowa dɔ eƒe dɔla ɖa wòva ɖem tso Herodes si me, kple nu siwo katã Yudatɔwo le mɔ kpɔm na la me. "
ENGLISH: 11 And Peter, coming to himself, said "Now I know certainly that the Lord has sent out his angel and rescued me from Herod’s hands and all the expectation of the Jewish people. "

EWE: 12 Esi wòkpɔe alea la, eyi Yohanes si wogayɔna be Marko la dada Maria ƒe me, afi si ame geɖewo ƒo ƒu ɖo le gbe dom ɖa le.
ENGLISH: 12 And when he realized the situation he came to the house of Mary the mother of John also named Mark, where a number had collected and were praying.

EWE: 13 Esi wòƒo agboa la, dɔlanyɔnuvi aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Roda la do va be yeakpɔ ɖa be ame kae hã. 14 Esi wòse Petro ƒe gbe la, dzi dzɔe ale gbegbe be meʋu agboa o, ke boŋ eƒu du yi aƒea me ɖagblɔ na wo be Petro le tsitre ɖe agboa nu. 15 Wogblɔ nɛ be: "Aɖaʋa dzem nèle. "
ENGLISH: 13 And when he knocked at the porch door a girl named Rhoda came to the door to answer the knock, 14 and, recognizing Peter’s voice, in her gladness she did not open the porch but ran in and reported that Peter was standing at the porch.

EWE: Ke eka ɖe edzi na wo be nyateƒee. Ale wogblɔ be: "Eƒe mawudɔlae. " 16 Ke Petro kpɔtɔ le afi ma le agboa ƒom. Esi woʋu agboa la, wokpɔe, eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo.
