ENGLISH: 14 And take in the one who is sickly in faith, not for decisions on problems: 2 one man has the faith to eat everything, but the sickly one eats vegetables 3 let the eater not scorn the non-eater nor the non-eater pass judgment on the eater, for God has taken him in.

EWE: 4 Ame kae nènye adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame bubu ƒe subɔvi?
ENGLISH: 4 Who are you that are passing judgment on somebody else’s servant? it is to his own master he stands or falls.

EWE: Eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒetɔe anya ne ele tsitre alo edze anyi.
ENGLISH: And he will be kept standing, for God is powerful to keep him standing.

EWE: 5 Ame aɖe bua ŋkeke aɖe be ele vevie wu bubu; ame bubu bua ŋkekewo katã sɔsɔe; ame sia ame neka ɖe nu si ta wòbui nenema ɖo la dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 The one rates day above day, the other rates every day let each have his own conviction.

EWE: 6 Ame si dea asixɔxɔ ŋkeke aɖe ŋu la, edea asixɔxɔ eŋu na Yehowa. Eye ame si ɖua nane la, eɖunɛ na Yehowa, elabena edaa akpe na Mawu; eye ame si meɖua nane o la, meɖunɛ o le Yehowa ta, gake edaa akpe na Mawu.
ENGLISH: 6 He who recognizes the day is recognizing it for the Lord; and he who eats is eating for the Lord, for he thanks God; and he who does not eat does his not eating for the Lord, and thanks God.

EWE: 7 Le nyateƒe me la, mía dometɔ aɖeke mele agbe na eɖokui ɖeɖe ko o, eye ame aɖeke mekuna na eɖokui ɖeɖe ko o.
ENGLISH: 7 For no one of us lives for himself and no one dies for himself; 8 for if we live we live for the Lord and if we die we die for the Lord.

EWE: Eya ta míele agbe alo míeku o, Yehowa tɔe míenye.
ENGLISH: So, live or die, we belong to the Lord.

EWE: 9 Elabena esia tae Kristo ku, eye wògagbɔ agbe ɖo, ne wòanye Aƒetɔ ɖe kukuawo kple agbagbeawo siaa dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 For it was for this that Christ died and came to life, that he might be lord over both dead and living.

EWE: 10 Ke nu ka tae nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu nɔviwò? Alo nu ka tae wò hã nèdoa vlo nɔviwò? Mí katã míava tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui la ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 10 But why do you pass judgment on your brother? or you, why do you scorn your brother? for we shall all be brought up before God’s bench.

EWE: 11 Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi be: "Yehowa be, ‘Zi ale si mele agbe la, ame sia ame adze klo nam, eye aɖe sia aɖe aʋu eme be nyee nye Mawu.’ " 12 Eya ta mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe abu akɔnta le eɖokui ŋu na Mawu.
ENGLISH: 11 For it is written "As I live, says the Lord, to me every knee shall bend and every tongue shall make acknowledgment to God "; 12 each of us, then, will give account for himself.

EWE: 13 Eya ta migana míanɔ ʋɔnu drɔ̃m mía nɔewo azɔ o, ke boŋ miɖoe kplikpaa be miagawɔ naneke si anye nuɖiaɖia alo nukikli na nɔvi aɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 13 So let us no longer pass judgment on each other; but do come to this decision rather, not to set anything to trip one’s brother up.

EWE: 14 Menyae, eye meka ɖe edzi le Aƒetɔ Yesu me be, naneke menye nu makɔmakɔ le eɖokui si o; negbe ne ame aɖe bu nane be enye nu makɔmakɔ hafi wònyea nu makɔmakɔ nɛ.
ENGLISH: 14 I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unholy of itself, only that for the one who thinks something unholy, for him it is unholy.

EWE: 15 Elabena ne nuɖuɖu anye nuɖiaɖia na nɔviwò la, ekema mègale zɔzɔm le lɔlɔ̃ me o ɖe.
ENGLISH: 15 For if because of an article of food your brother is pained, you are no longer going in the way of love.

EWE: 16 Eya ta migana woaƒo nu gbegblẽ le nu nyui si miewɔna la ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 16 Do not by your food bring him to destruction, one for whom Christ died.

EWE: 17 Elabena Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la menye nuɖuɖu kple nunono o, ke dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ŋutifafa kpakple dzidzɔ le gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe me boŋ ye.
ENGLISH: So do not have your good point made a butt for vilification.

EWE: 18 Elabena ame si wɔa eɖokui Kristo ƒe kluvi le nu siawo me la, eƒe nu nyoa Mawu ŋu, eye amewo hã kpɔa ŋudzedze ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 17 For the Reign of God is not eating and drinking but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit; 18 for he who lives in this servitude to the Christ is acceptable to God and estimable to men.

EWE: 19 Eya ta mina míati nu siwo hea ŋutifafa vanɛ kple nu siwo tua ame ɖo la yome. 20 Midzudzɔ Mawu ƒe dɔ la dome gbegblẽ le nuɖuɖu ta.
ENGLISH: 19 So then we will aim at what makes for peace and for mutual upbuilding; 20 do not tear God’s work down on account of an article of food.

EWE: Nyateƒee, nuwo katã le kɔkɔe, gake ne nane ɖuɖu aɖia ame nu la, egblẽa nu.
ENGLISH: Everything is clean, but it is a bad thing for the man who runs himself against a snag by his eating.

EWE: 21 Enyo be nàgaɖu lã, ano wain, alo awɔ nane si aɖia nɔviwò nu o.
ENGLISH: 21 It is a good thing not to eat meat nor drink wine nor one thing that your brother snags himself on.

EWE: 22 Xɔse si le asiwò la, nenɔ asiwò na wò ŋutɔ le Mawu ŋkume. Dzidzɔtɔe nye ame si mebua fɔ eɖokui le nu si wòtia be yeawɔ me o.
ENGLISH: 22 Have faith yourself, such as you have, on your own account before God; happy he who does not pass judgment on himself in regard to what he holds to be right.

EWE: 23 Ke ne ɖikeke le eme la, ekema wobu fɔe xoxo ne eɖui, elabena meɖui le xɔse me o. Le nyateƒe me la, nu sia nu si womewɔ le xɔse me o la, enye nu vɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 23 But he who is in suspense, if he eats, is under condemnation because it is not on the basis of faith, but everything that is not on the basis of faith is a sin.

EWE: Romatɔwo
ENGLISH: Romans

EWE: 15 Ke ele be mí ame siwo ŋu ŋusẽ le la míatsɔ ame siwo ŋu ŋusẽ mele o la ƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo, eye míaganɔ mía ɖokui ŋu dzem o. 2 Mina mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nadze ehavi ŋu hena eƒe nyonyo, be wòatui ɖo.
ENGLISH: 15 And we powerful ones ought to carry the weakenings of the feeble and not to please ourselves; 2 let each of us please his neighbor in what is good toward upbuilding.

EWE: 3 Elabena Kristo la gɔ̃ hã medze eɖokui ŋu o, ke boŋ abe ale si woŋlɔ ɖi ene la: "Ame siwo le vlo dom wò la ƒe vlodoamewo va dzinye. " 4 Elabena nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖi tsã la, woŋlɔ wo ɖi be woatsɔ afia nu mí, ale be to míaƒe dzidodo kple akɔfafa si míekpɔ tso Ŋɔŋlɔawo me dzi la, mɔkpɔkpɔ nasu mía si.
ENGLISH: 3 For neither did the Christ please himself, but, as it is written, "the insults of those who were insulting you fell on me. " 4 For whatever was written before was written for our instruction in order that through the steadfastness and encouragement in the scriptures we may have hope.

EWE: 5 Ke Mawu si naa dzidodo kple akɔfafa la nena tamesusu ƒe nɔnɔme si tututu nɔ Kristo Yesu si la nanɔ miawo hã mia si le mia nɔewo dome, 6 be miatsɔ tame ɖeka kple nusɔsɔe akafu mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe Mawu, si nye Fofoa.
ENGLISH: 5 And may the God of steadfastness and of encouragement grant you to take the same views among yourselves in Christ Jesus’s way, 6 so that you may with one accord, with a single mind, glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 7 Eya ŋuti mixɔ mia nɔewo, abe ale si ko Kristo la hã xɔ mii ene, hena Mawu ƒe kafukafu.
ENGLISH: 7 Wherefore take each other in in the same way as the Christ took you in, to the glory of God.

EWE: 8 Elabena mele egblɔm be, Kristo va zu subɔla na aʋatsotsotɔwo le esi Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ ta, be wòaɖo kpe ŋugbe siwo wòdo na wo tɔgbuiwo la dzi, 9 eye be dukɔwo nakafu Mawu le eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ la ta. Abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene be: "Esia tae makafu wò le dutoƒo le dukɔwo dome, eye madzi kafukafuha na wò ŋkɔ la. " 10 Eye wògagblɔ be: "Mi dukɔwo, mikpɔ dzidzɔ kple eƒe dukɔ la. " 11 Egagblɔ hã be: "Mi dukɔwo katã, mikafu Yehowa, eye amewo katã nekafui. " 12 Eye Yesaya gagblɔ be: "Isai ƒe ke anɔ anyi, ame si aɖu dukɔwo dzi la ado; eya ŋue dukɔwo aziɔ woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖo. " 13 Mawu si naa mɔkpɔkpɔ la natsɔ dzidzɔ kple ŋutifafa katã ayɔ mi fũu le esi miexɔ edzi se ta, ale be mɔkpɔkpɔ nasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi na mi le gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe ŋusẽ me.
ENGLISH: 8 For I tell you that Christ was made a serving-man to circumcised men on account of God’s truth so as to assure the promises made to the fathers, 9 and so that the nations should glorify God on account of mercy, as it is written "Because of this I will make acknowledgments to thee among the nations and sing psalms to thy name "; 10 and again it says "Jubilate, nations, with his people "; 11 and again "Praise the Lord, all nations, and let all the peoples laud him "; 12 and again Isaiah says "There shall be Jesse’s root and he who is set up to rule the nations; upon him the nations shall set their hopes. " 13 And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing so that you may be plentiful in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

EWE: 14 Ke nɔvinyewo, nye ŋutɔ hã meka ɖe mia dzi be nyuiwɔwɔ yɔ miawo hã mia me fũu, sidzedze geɖe yɔ mi fũu, eye be miate ŋu axlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo hã.
ENGLISH: 14 And I am persuaded as to you myself, brothers, that you too are replete with goodness, filled with all knowledge, able to admonish each other yourselves.

EWE: 15 Gake metsɔ dzideƒo geɖe wu le nu ŋlɔm na mi le nya aɖewo ŋu tẽe, ale be magaɖo ŋku wo dzi na mi ake, le amenuveve si mexɔ tso Mawu gbɔ la ta, 16 be manye Kristo Yesu ƒe dutoƒo subɔla na dukɔwo. Mele Mawu ƒe nya nyui la ƒe dɔ kɔkɔe la wɔm, ale be dukɔ siawo nanye nunana si adze eŋu, esi ŋu wokɔ to gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 But I have written to you, somewhat audaciously in parts, by way of reminding you, because of the grace that was given me from God 16 that I should be a chaplain of Christ Jesus’s to the nations, administering the sacramental service of God’s gospel in order that the nations’ offering should become acceptable, hallowed in Holy Spirit.

EWE: 17 Eya ta le nu siwo ku ɖe Mawu ŋu me la, mate ŋu atso aseye le Kristo Yesu me faa. 18 Elabena nye ŋutɔ nyemasusu nane ko agblɔ o, negbe nu si Kristo wɔ to dzinye ale be dukɔwo naɖo to la ko, eye ewɔ esia to nye nyagbɔgblɔ kple dɔwɔwɔ me, 19 le dzesiwo, nukunuwo, kple Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ ƒe ŋusẽ me, ale be tso Yerusalem kple eƒe nutoa me godoo va se ɖe keke Iliriko ke la, meɖe gbeƒã Kristo ŋu nya nyui la tsitotsito. 20 Ɛ̃, aleae meɖoe be nyemagblɔ nya nyui la le afi si woyɔ Kristo ŋkɔ le xoxo o, ale be maganɔ etum ɖe ame bubu ƒe gɔmeɖoanyi dzi o; 21 ke boŋ abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene la: "Ame siwo womegblɔ eŋu nya na o la akpɔe, eye ame siwo mesee o la ase egɔme. "
ENGLISH: 17 So I have my boasting in Christ Jesus as to God’s affairs; 18 for I will not venture to make any talk of what Christ did not accomplish through me toward the obedience of the nations, by word and act, 19 in the power of tokens and wonders, in the power of the Spirit, so that from Jerusalem clear round to Illyricum I have thoroughly spread the Christ’s gospel, 20 and making it my ambition to preach it in this way, not where Christ had been named, in order not to build on somebody else’s foundation, 21 but, as it is written, "they shall see who had not been told of him, and they shall realize who have not heard. "

EWE: 22 Esia tae meɖoe zi geɖe be mava mia gbɔ, ke medze edzi o.
ENGLISH: 22 Which is why I have generally been blocked from coming to you.

EWE: 23 Ke azɔ la, teƒe aɖeke megale nuto siawo me si nyemekpɔ ɖo o, eye ƒe geɖee nye esia wòle dzroyem vevie be mava mia gbɔ. 24 Eya ta ne medze mɔ yina Spania la, mele mɔ kpɔm be mava kpɔ mi ɖa, eye ne menɔ mia gbɔ sẽe nye dzi dze eme la, miaɖom ɖa ne mayi. 25 Ke fifia mele mɔ dze ge ayi Yerusalem be masubɔ ame kɔkɔeawo.
ENGLISH: 23 But now, no longer having any place in these territories, and having for several years past had a longing to come to you 24 when I am on my way to Spain for I hope to take a look at you as I pass through and to be given a send-off on my way there by you, if I have first had my craving for you partly satisfied 25 now I am taking a trip to Jerusalem on an errand of service to God’s people.

EWE: 26 Elabena edze ame siwo le Makedonia kple Akaya ŋu be, yewoadzɔ nu aɖo ɖe ame kɔkɔe siwo le Yerusalem la dometɔ siwo da ahe. 27 Nyateƒee, edzɔ dzi na wo be yewoawɔe alea, le esi wobui abe ɖe yewonyi esia wɔwɔ ƒe fe le wo ŋu ene ta; elabena ne dukɔwo kpɔ gome le woƒe gbɔgbɔmenuwo me la, ekema edze be woawo hã woatsɔ woƒe ŋutilãmenuwo asubɔ ame siawo.
ENGLISH: 26 For Macedonia and Achaea have been pleased to do a certain act of solidarity toward the poor among God’s people at Jerusalem 27 have been pleased to do it and owed it as a debt; for if the nations came to partake of their spiritual goods they ought also to do them service with material goods.

EWE: 28 Eya ta ne mekpɔ nu sia gbɔ, eye metsɔ nudzɔdzɔ sia yi na wo dedie vɔ ko la, mava to mia gbɔ ayi Spania. 29 Eye menyae hã be ne megbɔna mia gbɔ la, mava kple Kristo ƒe yayra gbago la.
ENGLISH: 28 So when I have got through with this and set the seal on this fruit for them I will go to Spain by way of you; 29 and I know that when I come to you I shall come in the fullness of Christ’s blessing.

EWE: 30 Azɔ mele kuku ɖem na mi, nɔviwo, to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi, kple lɔlɔ̃ si gbɔgbɔ la na mí me, be miawɔ ɖeka kplim ado gbe ɖa vevie na Mawu ɖe tanye, 31 be woaɖem tso dzimaxɔsetɔ siwo le Yudea la si me, eye subɔsubɔdɔ si wɔ ge meyina le Yerusalem la nadze ame kɔkɔeawo ŋu; 32 ale be ne Mawu lɔ̃ la, mava mia gbɔ kple dzidzɔ ne nye kple miawo siaa ƒe dzi nadze eme.
ENGLISH: 30 And I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in wrestling in prayer to God for me 31 that I may be delivered from the disobedient in Jerusalem and my errand of service to Jerusalem may turn out acceptable to God’s people, 32 in order that I may come to you with gladness by God’s will.

EWE: 33 Mawu si naa ŋutifafa la nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã.
ENGLISH: 33 And the God of peace be with you all; amen.

EWE: Amen.
ENGLISH: Romans

EWE: 16 Mele mía nɔvinyɔnu Foibe, si le subɔsubɔm le Kenkrea hamea me la, kafum na mi, 2 be miaxɔe le Aƒetɔ la me abe ale si dze ame kɔkɔewo ene, eye miana kpekpeɖeŋu ɖe sia ɖe si wòhiã lae, elabena eya ŋutɔ hã ʋli ame geɖewo ta, eʋli nye ŋutɔ hã tanye.
ENGLISH: 16 And I commend to you our sister Phebe, who is withal a deaconess of the church at Cenchreae, 2 that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of God’s people and assist her in whatever affair she wants anything of you in; for she herself has proved a friend in need to many, including me.

EWE: 3 Mido gbe na Priskila kple Akwila, nye hadɔwɔlawo le Kristo Yesu me nam, 4 ame siawo tsɔ woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe agbe de afɔku me ɖe tanye, eye menye nye ɖeɖe koe le akpe dam na wo o, ke hame siwo katã le dukɔwo me la hãe. 5 Mido gbe na hame si le woƒe aƒe me la nam.
ENGLISH: 3 Give my greetings to Prisca and Aquila, my co-workers in Christ Jesus, 4 who for my life laid down their own necks, whom not I alone thank but also all the churches of the nations; 5 and the meeting at their home.

EWE: Mido gbe na nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ Epeneto, si nye Kristo ƒe kutsetse gbãtɔawo dometɔ ɖeka le Asia la nam.
ENGLISH: Give my greetings to my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first of the province of Asia to come in to Christ.

EWE: 6 Mido gbe na Maria, si dze agbagba geɖe le mia ta la nam.
ENGLISH: 6 Give my greetings to Mary, who did a great deal of hard work for you.

EWE: 7 Mido gbe na Andronika kple Yunia, siwo nye ƒonyemetɔwo kple hati gamenɔlawo la nam, wonye ame siwo apostoloawo nya nyuie, eye wozu Kristotɔwo do ŋgɔ nam.
ENGLISH: 7 Give my greetings to my kinsmen and fellow-prisoners Andronicus and Junias, who are prominent among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

EWE: 8 Mido gbe na Ampliato, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ le Aƒetɔ la me nam.
ENGLISH: 8 Give my greetings to Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.

EWE: 9 Mido gbe na Urbano, míaƒe hadɔwɔla le Kristo me, kple nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ Stakis nam.
ENGLISH: 9 Give my greetings to Urbanus, my co-worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.

EWE: 10 Mido gbe na Apeles, ame si ŋu wokpɔ ŋudzedze ɖo le Kristo me la nam.
ENGLISH: 10 Give my greetings to Apelles, the tried and true in Christ.

EWE: Mido gbe na Aristobulo ƒe aƒemetɔwo nam.
ENGLISH: Give my greetings to those who are among Aristobulus’s people.

EWE: 11 Mido gbe na nye ƒometɔ Herodion nam.
ENGLISH: 11 Give my greetings to my kinsman Herodion.

EWE: Mido gbe na Narkiso ƒe aƒemetɔ siwo le Aƒetɔ la me la nam.
ENGLISH: Give my greetings to those of Narcissus’s people who are in the Lord.

EWE: 12 Mido gbe na Trifena kple Trifosa, nyɔnu siwo dzea agbagba geɖe le Aƒetɔ la me la nam.
ENGLISH: 12 Give my greetings to Tryphena and Tryphosa, who are working hard in the Lord.

EWE: 13 Mido gbe na Rufo, ame tiatia le Aƒetɔ la me, kple dadaa, si nye nye hã danye la nam.
ENGLISH: 13 Give my greetings to Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and to his mother, who was a mother to me too.

EWE: 14 Mido gbe na Asinkrito, Flegon, Hermes, Patroba, Herma kple nɔvi siwo le wo gbɔ la nam.
ENGLISH: 14 Give my greetings to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

EWE: 15 Mido gbe na Filologo kple Yulia, Nerea kple nɔvianyɔnu, kple Olimpa kpakple ame kɔkɔe siwo katã le wo gbɔ la nam.
ENGLISH: 15 Give my greetings to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all God’s people who are with them.

EWE: 16 Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe do gbe na mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 16 Give my greetings to each other with a holy kiss.

EWE: Kristo la ƒe hameawo katã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: All the churches of the Christ send you greetings.

EWE: 17 Azɔ nɔviwo, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi be, miaƒe ŋku nanɔ ame siwo hea mamawo kple nuɖiaɖiawo vanɛ le nu siwo wofia mi ŋu la ŋuti, eye miƒo asa na wo. 18 Elabena ame siawo tɔgbi la, menye mía Aƒetɔ Kristo ƒe kluviwo wonye o, ke wonye kluviwo na woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe dzodzrowo boŋ, eye wotsɔa aɖe ŋanɛ kple kesekukuɖɔɖɔname blea ame siwo mele vɔ̃ aɖeke susum o la ƒe dzi.
ENGLISH: 17 And I urge you, brothers, to have an eye to those who are creating factions and sore points contrary to the teaching you learned; and shun them, 18 for such are in the service not of our Lord Christ but of their own stomachs, and by their fair words and fine talk they turn the heads of the unsuspicious.

EWE: 19 Amewo katã nya nu tso miaƒe toɖoɖo ŋu, eya ta dzi le dzɔyem le mia ta. Ke medi be miadze nunya le nu nyui wɔwɔ me, gake le nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ gome la, mianye ame maɖifɔwo.
ENGLISH: 19 For your obedientness has been reported to everybody; so I am happy over you; but I want you to be wise in what makes for good and innocent in what makes for evil.

EWE: 20 Ke Mawu si naa ŋutifafa la agbã Satana ɖe miaƒe afɔwo te gudugudu kpuie.
ENGLISH: 20 And the God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet.

EWE: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe amenuveve nanɔ kpli mi.
ENGLISH: The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

EWE: 21 Nye hadɔwɔla Timoteo do gbe na mi, Lukio, Yason kple Sosipatro, siwo nye ƒonyemetɔwo, hã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: 21 My co-worker Timothy sends you greetings, and my kinsmen Lucius and Jason and Sosipater.

EWE: 22 Nye, Tertio, ame si ŋlɔ agbalẽ sia la, medo gbe na mi le Aƒetɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 22 I, Tertius, who am writing the letter, send you my greetings in the Lord.

EWE: 23 Gayo, ame si gbɔ medze, ame si ƒe aƒe me hame blibo la kpena le la, do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: 23 Gaius, my host and host to all the church, sends you greetings.

EWE: Dua ƒe gadzikpɔla Erasto do gbe na mi, eye nɔvia Kuarto hã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, and Brother Quartus.

EWE: Nya nyui sia ku ɖe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe si woɣla tso ɣeyiɣi mavɔmavɔwo me ke, si woɖe fia azɔ la ŋu. 26 Woɖe nya ɣaɣla sia fia azɔ, eye woto Nyagblɔɖigbalẽwo dzi na wòdze ƒãa le dukɔwo katã me, le ɖekawɔwɔ me kple Mawu mavɔmavɔtɔ la ƒe sedede la, ale be amewo naxɔe ase ahaɖo toe. 27 Mawu, si nye nunyala ɖeka hɔ̃ la, tɔ nanye kafukafu to Yesu Kristo dzi yi mavɔmavɔ me.
ENGLISH: 24 25 And to him who can fortify you in accordance with my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, in conformity with the revelation of the secret that had been kept in silence through eternal times 26 but has now been disclosed and through prophetic Scripture, by order of the eternal God, made known throughout the nations for obedience to the faith; 27 to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever.

EWE: Amen.
ENGLISH: Amen.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 1 Paulo, ame si woyɔ be wòanye Kristo Yesu ƒe apostolo le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, kple mía nɔviŋutsu Sostene, 2 le esia ŋlɔm na Mawu ƒe hame si le Korinto, mi ame siwo ŋu wokɔ le Kristo Yesu me, ame siwo woyɔ be miava nye ame kɔkɔewo, kple ame siwo katã le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo, si nye woƒe Aƒetɔ kple míawo hã míaƒe Aƒetɔ la, ƒe ŋkɔ yɔm le afi sia afi:
ENGLISH: 1 Paul, a chosen apostle of Christ Jesus through God’s will, and Brother Sosthenes, 2 to God’s church at Corinth, men sanctified in Christ Jesus, holy men called, with all who in every place invoke the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, theirs and ours, 3 grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 3 Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa si tso Mawu, mía Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi. 4 Medaa akpe na nye Mawu ɣesiaɣi ɖe mia ta le Mawu ƒe amenuveve si wòna mi le Kristo Yesu me la ta; 5 elabena miezu kesinɔtɔwo le nu sia nu me le eya amea me, le nuƒoƒo ƒe ŋutete katã kple sidzedze katã me, 6 abe ale si ko Kristo la ŋuti ɖaseɖiɖi ƒo ke ɖe to sesĩe ɖe mia me ene, 7 ale be nunana aɖeke meli si mesu mia si o, esime miele mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖeɖefia la lalam vevie.
ENGLISH: 4 I am always thanking God for you on account of God’s grace given to you in Christ Jesus, 5 that in everything you have been enriched in him, in all the gift of speech and in all knowledge, 6 as the testimony of the Christ has become a settled thing among you, 7 so that you do not come short in any grace while you await the manifestation of our Lord Jesus Christ, 8 who will also settle you to be entirely blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 9 Nuteƒewɔlae Mawu nye, eye eyae yɔ mi vɛ be mianye hadɔwɔlawo kple Via, si nye mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo.
ENGLISH: 9 God is faithful, through whom you were called into solidarity with his son Jesus Christ our Lord.

EWE: 10 Ke mele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo, le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ me be, mi katã miaƒe nu nasɔ, eye mama naganɔ mia dome o, ke boŋ miawɔ ɖeka bliboe le susu kple nuŋububu ɖeka ma ke me.
ENGLISH: 10 But I urge you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, all to say the same thing and not to have rifts among you, but to be welded into the same mind and the same sentiments.

EWE: 11 Elabena nɔvinyewo, Kloe ƒe aƒemetɔ aɖewo na menya be nyahehe le mia dome.
ENGLISH: 11 For it was stated to me about you by Chloe’s people, my brothers, that there are discords among you.

EWE: 12 Nu si mewɔnɛ ye nye be, mia dometɔ aɖewo le gbɔgblɔm be: "Paulo tɔe menye, " ɖewo be "Nye ya Apolo tɔe menye, " bubuwo be "Nye ya Kefas tɔe menye, " eye ɖewo hã be "Nye ya Kristo tɔe menye. " 13 Ðe Kristo la me ma?
ENGLISH: 12 I mean this: that each of you is saying "I am a Paul man, " "And I am an Apollos man, " "And I am a Cephas man, " "And I am a Christ man "; 13 the Christ is broken up!

EWE: Menye Paulo ye wohe ɖe ati ŋu ɖe mia ta o ɖe? Alo Paulo ƒe ŋkɔ mee wonyrɔ mi ɖoa? 14 Medaa akpe na Mawu be nyemena nyɔnyrɔ mia dometɔ aɖeke o, negbe Krispo kple Gayo ko, 15 ne ame aɖeke nagagblɔ be nye ŋkɔ mee wonyrɔ mi ɖo o.
ENGLISH: Was Paul crucified for you, or were you baptized into Paul’s name? 14 I am thankful that I did not baptize any of you but Crispus and Gaius, 15 so as not to have someone say you were baptized into my name.

EWE: 16 Ahã! Mena nyɔnyrɔ Stefana ƒe aƒemetɔwo hã. Ke nyemeɖo ŋku edzi ne megana nyɔnyrɔ ame bubu aɖe hã o.
ENGLISH: 16 And I did baptize Stephanas’s family too; after all, I do not know whether I baptized anybody else.

EWE: 17 Elabena Kristo medɔm be manɔ amewo nyrɔm o, ke boŋ be magblɔ nya nyui la; menye kple agbalẽnyalagãwo ƒe nuƒoƒo o, ale be Kristo ƒe fuwɔameti la nagazu dzodzro o.
ENGLISH: 17 For Christ did not send me to baptize but to bring the gospel; not in wisdom of language, in order that the Christ’s cross may not be nullified.

EWE: 18 Elabena fuwɔameti la ŋuti nya nye bometsinya le ame siwo le tsɔtsrɔ̃m la gbɔ, ke enye Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ le mí ame siwo ɖem wole ya gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 18 For speech about the cross is foolishness to those who are headed for destruction, but to us the saved it is the power of God.

EWE: Afi kae nuɖoanyi sia me glãkahela la le? Ðe Mawu mena xexe sia me nunya zu bometsitsi oa? 21 Elabena le Mawu ƒe nunya me la, esi xexea meto nunya si le esi dzi dze si Mawu o ta la, edze eŋu be yeato gbedeasi si wole gbeƒã ɖemee la ƒe bometsinyanyenye dzi aɖe ame siwo xɔa edzi sena la. 22 Yudatɔwo biaa dzesiwo, eye Helatɔwo hã dia nunya; 23 ke míawo ya, míeɖea gbeƒã Kristo si wohe ɖe ati ŋu la, si nye nuɖiaɖia na Yudatɔwo, eye wònye bometsitsi na dukɔwo. 24 Gake le ame siwo woyɔ, siwo nye Yudatɔwo kple Helatɔwo siaa gome la, Kristo nye Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ kple Mawu ƒe nunya si wòɖe fia. 25 Elabena Mawu ƒe nu si wobuna bometsinui la nyaa nu wu amegbetɔwo, eye Mawu ƒe nu si wobuna nu gbɔdzɔe la sẽa ŋu wu amegbetɔwo.
ENGLISH: 19 For it is written "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the discernment of the discerning I will discredit. " 20 What becomes of a philosopher? of a scholar? of a scientist? did not God make the world’s wisdom foolish? 21 For since in God’s wisdom the world had not through wisdom known God, God was pleased to save believers through the foolishness of the preached message 22 since Jews ask for tokens and Greeks look for wisdom, 23 but we preach a crucified Christ, to Jews a thing unmentionable, and to Gentiles foolishness, 24 but to the called themselves, Jews and Greeks both, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God; 25 because what is foolish of God’s is wiser than men, and what is weak of God’s is stronger than men.

EWE: 26 Nɔviwo, mikpɔ mi ame siwo woyɔ la ɖa, be menye nunyalawo le ŋutilã nu ye mia dometɔ geɖe nye o, menye ŋusẽtɔwoe mia dometɔ geɖe nye o, eye menye ƒome siwo ŋu bubu le hã mee mia dometɔ geɖe dzɔ tso o, 27 ke boŋ Mawu tia nu siwo xexea buna bometsinuwoe, ne wòatsɔ ado ŋukpe nunyalawo; eye Mawu tia nu siwo xexea buna gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔnuwoe, ne wòatsɔ ado ŋukpe nu siwo ŋu ŋusẽ le, 28 eye Mawu tia xexea me nu siwo mele ɖeke me o kple nu siwo wodoa vloe, nu siwo meɖi naneke o, ne wòatsɔ aɖi gbɔ nu siwo nye nane la, 29 ale be ame aɖeke nagaƒo adegbe le Mawu ŋkume o.
ENGLISH: 26 For, brothers, look at your calling, that it is not a case of many who are wise in a mortal sense, many powerful, many aristocratic, 27 but God chose the foolish parts of the world in order to shame the wise men, and God chose the weak parts of the world in order to shame the strong parts, 28 and God chose the lowborn parts and the scorned parts, the nothings, in order to supersede with them the somethings, 29 so that no mortal should boast in the presence of God.

EWE: 30 Ke eya gbɔe wòtso be mia kple Kristo Yesu miewɔ ɖeka, ame si zu nunya si tso Mawu gbɔ na mí, eye wònye dzɔdzɔenyenye kple kɔkɔenyenye kpakple ɖeɖe to tafe dzi hã, 31 be wòanɔ abe ale si tututu woŋlɔe ɖii ene be: "Ame si ƒoa adegbe la, neƒo adegbe le Yehowa me. "
ENGLISH: 30 And from him you are something in Christ Jesus, who became to us wisdom from God, righteousness and sanctification and redemption, 31 in order to have it as is written, "Let him who boasts boast in the Lord. "

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 2 Elabena esi mele mia dome la, nyemebu ɖokuinye be menya nu bubu aɖeke o, negbe Yesu Kristo ko, eye be wohee ɖe ati ŋu. 3 Eye meva mia gbɔ le gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ kple vɔvɔ̃ kpakple dzodzo nyanyanya geɖe me; 4 eye menye agbalẽnyalagãwo ƒe nya siwo wotsɔ ƒoa nya ɖe ame nu lae metsɔ ƒo nu alo tsɔ ɖe gbeƒãe o, ke boŋ gbɔgbɔ kple ŋusẽ ɖeɖe fiae wònye, 5 ale be miaƒe xɔse la naganɔ te ɖe amewo ƒe nunya dzi o, ke boŋ ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 And I, brothers, when I came to you, came not announcing God’s testimony to you with a superior quality of language or wisdom; 2 for I decided not to know anything among you but Jesus Christ, and him crucified; 3 and I showed weakness and fear and much trembling while I was with you, 4 and my language and my proclamation were not with persuasive words of wisdom but with proof by Spirit and power, 5 in order that your faith may not be based on men’s wisdom but on God’s power.

EWE: 6 Ke míeƒoa nu tso nunya ŋu le ame siwo tsi la dome, gake menye nuɖoanyi sia ƒe nunya alo nuɖoanyi sia me dziɖula siwo nu ava yi la tɔ o. 7 Ke boŋ Mawu ƒe nunya si woɖe fia le nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe me, si nye nunya si le ɣaɣla, si Mawu ɖo ɖi do ŋgɔ hena míaƒe ŋutikɔkɔe hafi nuɖoanyiawo dze egɔme la, ŋue míele nu ƒom tsoe.
ENGLISH: 6 But we do speak wisdom among those who are qualified; but a wisdom not of this world nor of this world’s supersedable rulers, 7 but we speak God’s wisdom in a secret knowledge, the wisdom hidden away, which God foreordained for our glory before time was; 8 which no one of this world’s rulers knows, for if they had known it they would not have crucified the Lord of Glory, 9 but, as it is written, what eye has not seen and ear has not heard and man’s heart has not thought of, the things that God has prepared for those who love him; 10 for God has revealed them to us through the Spirit.

EWE: 8 Nunya siae nuɖoanyi sia me dziɖulawo dometɔ aɖeke menya o, elabena ne ɖe wonyae la, anye ne womehe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Aƒetɔ la ɖe ati ŋu o.
ENGLISH: For the Spirit searches everything, even the deep things of God.

EWE: 9 Ke abe ale si ko woŋlɔe ɖi ene la: "Nu siwo Mawu dzra ɖo ɖi na ame siwo lɔ̃nɛ la, ŋku mekpɔ wo kpɔ o, eye to mese wo kpɔ o, eye womeva ame ƒe dzi me hã kpɔ o. " 10 Elabena míawoe Mawu ɖee fia to eƒe gbɔgbɔ la dzi, elabena gbɔgbɔ la dzroa nuwo katã me kpɔ, edzroa keke Mawu ƒe nu goglowo ke hã me. 11 Amegbetɔ kae nya nu siwo le ame me, ne menye ame ƒe gbɔgbɔ si le eme la koe oa? Nenema kee ame aɖeke menya Mawu ƒe nuwo o, negbe Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la koe.
ENGLISH: 11 For who of men knows the things personal to a man except the man’s spirit which is in him? in the same way nobody knows the things personal to God except God’s Spirit.

EWE: 12 Ke menye xexea ƒe gbɔgbɔe míexɔ o, ke boŋ gbɔgbɔ si tso Mawu gbɔ lae míexɔ, ne míanya nu siwo Mawu na mí dɔmenyotɔe la. 13 Nu siawoe míegblɔna hã, menye kple nunya si míesrɔ̃ tso amegbetɔwo gbɔ o, ke esi gbɔgbɔ la fia mí boŋ, esi míetsɔa gbɔgbɔmenyawo ɖea gbɔgbɔmenuwo me.
ENGLISH: 12 And we received not the world’s spirit but the Spirit from God, in order that we might know the things granted to us by God; 13 which things we likewise speak not in words taught by human wisdom but in Spirit-taught, matching spiritual with spiritual.

EWE: 14 Ke ŋutilãmeme mexɔa Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la ƒe nuwo o, elabena wonye bometsitsi le egbɔ; eye mate ŋu anya wo o, elabena gbɔgbɔ wotsɔna dzroa eme. 15 Ke gbɔgbɔmeme ya dzroa nuwo katã me kpɔ, ke ame aɖeke medzroa eya ŋutɔ me kpɔna o.
ENGLISH: 14 But an animal man does not accept the things that belong to God’s Spirit; for they are foolishness to him, and he cannot know them, because they are to be spiritually examined; 15 but the spiritual man examines everything and is himself examined by nobody.

EWE: 16 Elabena "ame kae va nya Yehowa ƒe tamesusu ne wòafia nui? "
ENGLISH: 16 For "who knows the Lord’s mind and will instruct him? "

EWE: Ke Kristo ƒe tamesusu ya le mía si.
ENGLISH: And we have Christ’s mind.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 3 Eya ta nɔviwo, nyemete ŋu ƒo nu na mi abe ame siwo tsi le gbɔgbɔ me ene o, ke boŋ abe ŋutilãmemewo ene, abe vidzĩwo le Kristo me ene.
ENGLISH: 3 And on my part, brothers, I could not speak to you as spiritual men but as flesh men, as infants in Christ.

EWE: 2 Mena notsi mi mieno, ke menye nuɖuɖu sesẽ o, elabena miesẽ ŋu nyuie ɣemaɣi o.
ENGLISH: 2 I fed you milk, not regular food, for as yet you did not have the capability; why, even now you do not.

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, miesẽ ŋu nyuie fifia hã o, 3 elabena ŋutilãmemewo ko mieganye.
ENGLISH: 3 For you are still fleshly.

EWE: Esi ŋuʋaʋã kple dzre le mia dome la, ɖe menye ŋutilãmemewoe mieganye, eye miegale zɔzɔm abe ame bubuwo ke ene oa? 4 Elabena ne ame aɖe be, "Paulo tɔe menye, " eye ame bubu be, "Apolo tɔe nye ya menye " la, ekema menye ɖe miele nu wɔm abe ame bubuwo ke ene oa?
ENGLISH: For where there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not fleshly and walking in human fashion? 4 For when one says "I am a Paul man, " but another "I an Apollos man, " are you not human?

EWE: 5 Evɔ ɖe, ame kae nye Apolo?
ENGLISH: 5 What is Apollos, then?

EWE: Eye ame kae nye Paulo?
ENGLISH: And what is Paul?

EWE: Subɔla siwo dzi mieto zu xɔsetɔwoe wonye, abe ale si Aƒetɔ la dee asi na ame sia ame ene.
ENGLISH: Servitors through whom you believed; and each as the Lord gave to him: 6 I did the setting out, Apollos the watering, but God made the growth.

EWE: 6 Medo nu, Apolo de tsii, ke Mawue nana wòtsina, 7 ale be ame si do nu la menye naneke o, eye ame si de tsii hã menye naneke o, ke Mawu, ame si nana wòtsina la boŋ.
ENGLISH: 7 So that neither the setter-out is anything nor the waterer, but God who makes the growth.

EWE: 8 Ame si doa nu kple ame si dea tsii la wosɔ, ke ame sia ame axɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe fetu le eƒe agbagbadzedze nu.
ENGLISH: 8 And the setter-out and the waterer are one. But each will get his pay appropriately to his labor.

EWE: 9 Elabena Mawu ƒe hadɔwɔlawo míenye. Miawoe nye Mawu ƒe agble si dem wòle, Mawu ƒe xɔtutu.
ENGLISH: 9 For we are God’s assistants; you are God’s farm God’s building.

EWE: 10 Le Mawu ƒe amenuveve la ta la, meɖo xɔ gɔme anyi abe xɔtula bibi ene, ke ame bubu le etum ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: 10 In accordance with the grace given to me, like a wise master-builder I laid a foundation, and another is building on it.

EWE: Gake ame sia ame nakpɔ ale si wòle etum ɖe edzii la gbɔ nyuie.
ENGLISH: But let each one look out how he builds on it.

EWE: 11 Elabena ame aɖeke mate ŋu aɖo gɔmeɖoanyi bubu aɖeke wu esi li xoxo, si nye Yesu Kristo o.
ENGLISH: 11 For nobody can lay any other foundation beside the one that has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

EWE: 12 Ke ne ame aɖe tsɔ sika, klosalo, kpe xɔasiwo, ati, bè, alo gbe tui ɖe gɔmeɖoanyia dzi la, 13 ame sia ame ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ava dze ƒãa woakpɔ, elabena ŋkeke la aɖee afia, elabena dzoe woatsɔ aɖee afia; eye dzo la ŋutɔ ado xɔ si ƒomevi ame sia ame tu la kpɔ.
ENGLISH: 12 But if one builds onto the foundation gold, silver, fine stones, wood, weed-stalks, straw, 13 each man’s work will show up. For the day will reveal it, because in fire it is disclosed, and the very fire will test what sort of work each man’s is.

EWE: 14 Ne ame aɖe ƒe xɔ si wòtu ɖe edzi la tsi anyi la, axɔ fetu; 15 ne ame aɖe ƒe dɔ fiã la, ke nu abu nɛ, ke woaɖe eya ŋutɔ ya; gake anɔ abe dzo mee woɖee tsoe ene.
ENGLISH: 14 If anyone’s work that he built on it stands, he will receive payment; 15 if anyone’s work burns up, he will be the loser, but he will himself come safe through, but in such fashion as one comes through a fire.

EWE: 16 Ðe mienyae be Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔe mienye, eye Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la le mia me oa? 17 Ne ame aɖe gblẽ Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ la dome la, Mawu atsrɔ̃ eya hã; elabena Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ la le kɔkɔe, eye miawoe nye gbedoxɔ ma.
ENGLISH: 16 Do you not know that you are a temple of God, and God’s Spirit makes its home in you? 17 If anybody undoes God’s temple, God will undo him.

EWE: 18 Ame aɖeke nagable eɖokui o: Ne mia dometɔ aɖe susu be yenye nunyala le nuɖoanyi sia me la, nezu bometsila, ale be wòazu nunyala.
ENGLISH: For God’s temple is sacred; and you are it. 18 Let nobody deceive himself.

EWE: 19 Elabena xexe sia me nunya nye bometsitsi le Mawu gbɔ; elabena woŋlɔ ɖi be, "Eléa nunyalawo le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe ayedzedze me. " 20 Eye wogaŋlɔ ɖi be: "Yehowa nya be nunyalawo ƒe tamebubuwo nye dzodzro. " 21 Eya ta ame aɖeke megaƒo adegbe le amewo ŋuti o; elabena nuwo katã nye mia tɔ, 22 eɖanye Paulo, Apolo, alo Kefas o, eɖanye xexea o, eɖanye agbe alo ku o, eɖanye nu siwo li fifia alo nu siwo gbɔna o, nuwo katã nye mia tɔ; 23 ke miawo hã mienye Kristo tɔ; ke Kristo hã nye Mawu tɔ.
ENGLISH: If anybody thinks he is a wise one among you, in these times let him become a fool in order that he may come to be wise; 19 for this world’s wisdom is foolishness in the presence of God, for it is written "he who clutches the wise in the midst of their shiftiness " 20 and again "The Lord knows wise men’s ponderings to be futile. " 21 Consequently let nobody boast about men. For everything belongs to you, 22 be it Paul or Apollos or Cephas or world or life or death or present or future: everything belongs to you, 23 and you to Christ, and Christ to God.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 4 Eya ta mina amewo nabu mí abe Kristo ƒe dɔtsɔlawo kple aƒedzikpɔla siwo Mawu tsɔ eƒe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔewo de asi na la ene.
ENGLISH: 4 Let a man rate us as agents, and trustees of God’s secrets.

EWE: 2 Esia ta nu si wodi tso aƒedzikpɔlawo sie nye be woanye nuteƒewɔlawo.
ENGLISH: 2 Now then, what is wanted in trustees is that one should be found faithful.

EWE: 3 Nye la, meɖe fu nam be miawo alo amegbetɔ bubuwo naɖi ʋɔnu adzro nye nya me o.
ENGLISH: 3 But to me it is highly unimportant that I should be examined by you or by a human investigation.

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, nye ŋutɔ nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖokuinye gɔ̃ hã o. 4 Elabena nye dzitsinya mebua fɔm le naneke ta o.
ENGLISH: Why, I do not even examine myself; 4 for I have nothing on my conscience, but I am not made out righteous by this.

EWE: Gake nyemele gbɔgblɔm be mele dzɔdzɔe o; ame si dzroa menye kpɔ lae nye Yehowa.
ENGLISH: But it is the Lord that is my examiner.

EWE: 5 Eya ta migadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le naneke ŋu hafi ɣeyiɣi la nade o, va se ɖe esime Aƒetɔ la nava. Eyae ahe vivitimenu ɣaɣlawo ava kekeli nu, eye wòana dzimesusuwo nadze ƒãa, eye ame sia ame akpɔ eƒe kafukafu tso Mawu gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 5 Consequently do not pass judgment on anything too soon; not till the Lord comes, who will both throw light on the things hidden in darkness and make the intentions of hearts visible; and then each will get his praise from God.

EWE: 6 Ke nɔviwo, metsɔ nye kple Apolo wɔ esia ƒe kpɔɖeŋu na mi le miaƒe nyonyo ta, ale be miasrɔ̃ esia le mía gbɔ be: "Migagbɔ nu siwo woŋlɔ ɖi la ŋu o, " ne miagado mia ɖokui ɖe dzi ahabu ame aɖe be enye gã wu ame bubu o.
ENGLISH: 6 But in treating all this as though it applied to myself and Apollos I did it on your account, brothers, in order that you might learn on us not to go beyond the record, so that you should not be puffed up one of you on one’s behalf against another.

EWE: 7 Elabena ame kae na nèto vovo tso ame bubu gbɔ? Eye nu kae le asiwò, si menye ɖe nèxɔe o?
ENGLISH: 7 For who is differentiating you? and what do you have that you did not receive?

EWE: Ke ne ɖe nèxɔe la, ekema nu ka tae nèle adegbe ƒom abe menye ɖe nèxɔe o ene? 8 Ðe mieɖi ƒo xoxoa? Ðe mienye kesinɔtɔwo xoxoa? Ðe miedze fiaɖuɖu gɔme xoxo míawo manɔmeea? Ɛ̃, ɖe madi vevie be miadze fiaɖuɖu gɔme, ale be míawo hã míaɖu fia kpli mi hafi.
ENGLISH: And if you did receive it, why are you boasting as if you had not? 8 You have had all you could hold already; you have already grown rich; you have come into the kingship without us and I wish you had come into the kingship so that we too might come into it with you.

EWE: 9 Elabena ewɔna nam abe ɖe Mawu tsɔ mí apostoloawo da ɖi abe ame mlɔetɔ siwo woɖe ɖe go hetso kufia na ene, elabena míezu abe nukpɔkpɔ le fefewɔƒe ene na xexea, na mawudɔlawo kple amegbetɔwo siaa.
ENGLISH: 9 For I guess God has put us apostles last on the program like men condemned to death, because we have become a spectacle for the world, men and angels both.

EWE: 10 Míenye bometsilawo le Kristo ta, ke miawo mienye aɖaŋudzelawo le Kristo me; míegbɔdzɔ, ke miawo miesẽ ŋu; wode bubu mia ŋu, ke míawo ya bubu mele mía ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 10 We are fools for Christ, but you are intelligent men in Christ; we weak, but you strong; you in high standing, but we disreputable.

EWE: 11 Va se ɖe gaƒoƒo sia tututu dzi la, dɔ kple tsikɔ le mía wum, míekpɔ awu ado o, woƒoa mí, aƒe hã mele mía si o, 12 eye míekua kutri tsɔa míaƒe asiwo wɔa dɔ. Ne wodzu mí la, míeyrana; ne woti mía yome la, míedoa dzi tsɔnɛ; 13 ne wogblẽ mía ŋu la, míeɖea mía ɖokui nu tufafatɔe; eye va se ɖe fifia la, wobua mí abe xexea ƒe aɖukpodzinuwo kple gbeɖuɖɔwo katã ƒomevi ene.
ENGLISH: 11 Down to the present moment we go hungry, go thirsty, go naked, get hit with fists, go homeless, 12 work hard with our own hands, pronounce blessings while we are being abused, bear up while we are being persecuted, 13 give encouragement while we are being disparaged; it comes to be as if we were the offscourings of the world, the scum of everything, up to now.

EWE: 14 Menye ɖe mele nya siawo ŋlɔm be matsɔ ado ŋukpe mi o, ke boŋ be maxlɔ̃ nu mi abe vinye lɔlɔ̃awo ene.
ENGLISH: 14 I am not writing these things to shame you, but to admonish you as dearly-loved children of mine.

EWE: 15 Elabena ne ame akpe ewo ye le mia dzi kpɔm abe viwo le Kristo me ene hã la, fofo geɖewo ya mele mia si o; elabena mezu mia fofo le Kristo Yesu me to nya nyui la dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 For if you should have ten thousand tutors in Christ, many fathers you would not; for I, through the gospel, brought you to birth in Christ Jesus.

EWE: 16 Eya ta mele kuku ɖem na mi be, mizu srɔ̃nyelawo.
ENGLISH: 16 So I urge you, be imitators of me.

EWE: 17 Esia tae mele Timoteo dɔm ɖe mia gbɔ, elabena enye vinye lɔlɔ̃a kple nuteƒewɔla le Aƒetɔ la me. Aɖo ŋku mɔnu siwo mezãna le Kristo Yesu me, abe ale si mele nu fiam le hame ɖe sia ɖe me le afi sia afi ene la, dzi na mi.
ENGLISH: 17 That was the very reason why I sent you Timothy, who is my dearly-loved and trusted child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways in Christ Jesus, as I teach everywhere in every church.

EWE: 18 Ame aɖewo doa wo ɖokuiwo ɖe dzi abe ɖe nyemegale mia gbɔ va ge o ene. 19 Gake ne Yehowa lɔ̃ la, mava mia gbɔ kpuie, eye menye be mase ame siwo le wo ɖokuiwo dom ɖe dzi la ƒe nyawo o, ke boŋ be manya ŋusẽ si le wo si.
ENGLISH: 18 But some have been puffed up as if I were not coming to you; 19 but come to you I speedily will, if the Lord permit, and know not the words of the puffed-up ones but their power, 20 for the Reign of God is not in words but in power.

EWE: 20 Elabena Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la mele nuƒoƒo me o, ke boŋ ŋusẽ mee wòle. 21 Kae adze mia ŋu wu?
ENGLISH: 21 What do you want? am I to come to you with a rod or in love and the spirit of meekness?

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 2 Ðe esia nye dada na mia? Ðe mele be miaxa nu boŋ, ale be woaɖe ŋutsu si wɔ nu sia la ɖa le mia dome oa? 3 Togbɔ be nyemele mia dome le ŋutilã me o hã la, mele mia dome le gbɔgbɔ me, eye medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame si wɔ nu sia xoxo abe ɖe mele mia dome ene. 4 Ne miekpe ta le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me, eye mele mia dome le gbɔgbɔ me, eye mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋusẽ hã li kpli mi la, 5 miatsɔ ame sia ade asi na Satana, ne miatsi ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi gbegblẽ ma nu, ale be miakpɔ hamea ƒe gbɔgbɔ ta le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 There is talk of such a thing as unchastity among you, and such unchastity as there is not even among the heathen, so that one has his father’s wife; 2 and you are puffed up, and did not rather go to mourning, so that the one who had done that thing would be got out from your midst? 3 For I, absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as present, come to the decision you and my spirit, 4 together with the power of our Lord Jesus, being assembled in the Lord Jesus Christ’s name 5 to hand over to Satan the man with such a record, the one that did that in that fashion, for destruction of the flesh in order that the spirit may be saved on the day of the Lord.

EWE: 6 Nu si ŋu miele adegbe ƒom le la menyo o.
ENGLISH: 6 Your boast is not a good one.

EWE: Elabena le nyateƒe me la, wotsɔ Kristo, míaƒe Ŋutitotolẽvi la sa vɔe. 8 Eya ta mina míanɔ ŋkekenyui la ɖum, menye kple amɔwɔ ʋaʋã xoxo o, eye menye kple vɔ̃ɖinyenye alo nu vɔ̃ ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã hã o, ke boŋ kple amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã bolo si nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nyateƒetoto.
ENGLISH: Do you not know that a little yeast makes the whole batch of dough yeasty? 7 Clean out the old yeast in order that you may be a new batch as you are unyeasty men for our passover is sacrificed, Christ, 8 so let us keep the feast not with old yeast nor with yeast of viciousness and villainy but with yeastless bread of candor and truth.

EWE: 9 Meŋlɔe na mi le nye agbalẽ la me be miadzudzɔ hadede kple ame siwo ƒoa wo ɖokui ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me; 10 nyemele gbɔgblɔm be miadzudzɔ hadede kura kple ame siwo le xexe sia me siwo ƒoa wo ɖokui ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me alo nye ŋuklẽlawo alo adzodalawo alo trɔ̃subɔlawo o. Ne nenemae la, ke ɖeko miadzo le xexea me.
ENGLISH: 9 I wrote to you in my letter not to be mixed up with libertines; 10 not in general, this world’s libertines, or overreaching and grasping people or idolaters, since you would be obliged to go out of the world; 11 but I did tell you not to be mixed up if anyone who goes by the name of brother is a libertine or overreaching or an idolater or abusive or drunken or grasping, not even to eat with the one who is like that.

EWE: 12 Elabena nya kae le mía kple ame siwo le egodo la dome be madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo? Ðe menye ame siwo le eme lae miedrɔ̃a ʋɔnui, 13 eye Mawu drɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame siwo le egodo la oa?
ENGLISH: 12 For what business is it of mine to judge the outsiders? do not you do the judging of the insiders, 13 but God the judging of the outsiders?

EWE: "Miɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖa le miawo ŋutɔwo mia dome. "
ENGLISH: Get the vicious man out of your company.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 6 Ne nya ɖo mia dometɔ aɖe kple nɔvia dome la, ɖe wòdoa dzi tsɔnɛ yia ʋɔnu le ame madzɔmadzɔwo gbɔ, ke menye le ame kɔkɔewo gbɔ oa? 2 Alo ɖe mienyae be ame kɔkɔewoe adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea oa? Eye ne miawoe adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea ɖe, ekema ɖe miedze adrɔ̃ nya suesuewo ya oa? 3 Ðe mienyae be míadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mawudɔlawo oa?
ENGLISH: 6 Does anyone of you, when he has a difficulty with another, dare to bring the case before the lawless and not before the holy? 2 Or do you not know that the holy will judge the world? and if the world gets judged by you, are you unfit for petty trials? 3 Do you not know we shall judge angels? not to say secular matters.

EWE: Ekema nu ka tae míadrɔ̃ agbe sia me nyawo ya o? 4 Ke ne agbe sia me nyawo li miadrɔ̃ la, ame siwo ŋu hamea medea bubui o lae mieɖoa ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawoea? 5 Mele egblɔm ale be ŋu nakpe mi.
ENGLISH: 4 Then if you do have secular cases to try, it is just those who do not amount to anything in the church that you set on the bench! 5 I say it to your shame.

EWE: Ðe nunyala ɖeka hɔ̃ hã mele mia dome, si ate ŋu adrɔ̃ nɔviawo dome nya oa? 6 Ke boŋ nɔvi kplɔa nɔvi yia ʋɔnu le dzimaxɔsetɔwo gbɔ! 7 Le nyateƒe me la, ne miekplɔa mia nɔewo yia ʋɔnu la, ekema miedo kpo nu xoxo. Nu ka ta miena wowɔ vɔ̃ ɖe mia ŋu boŋ o? Nu ka ta miena wotafa mi boŋ o? 8 Ke boŋ miewɔa vɔ̃, mietafaa ame, eye miele esia wɔm ɖe mia nɔviwo kekeake ŋu! 9 Ðe mienyae be ame madzɔmadzɔwo manyi Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la dome oa? Migana woaflu mi o.
ENGLISH: Are you so totally without any wise man among you who can decide between his brothers, 6 but brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers? 7 It is a blot on you anyhow, to begin with, that you do have lawsuits with each other; why not sooner have injustice done you? why not sooner have your rightful dues held back? 8 But you yourselves do injustice and hold back rightful dues, and to brothers at that; 9 or do you not know that unjust men will not inherit God’s Reign?

EWE: Ame siwo ƒoa wo ɖokuiwo ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me, trɔ̃subɔlawo, ahasiwɔlawo, ŋutsu siwo gbɔ ŋutsuwo dɔna, alo ŋutsu siwo dɔna kple ŋutsuwo, 10 kple fiafitɔwo, ŋuklẽlawo, ahamulawo, amedzulawo kple adzodalawo la, womanyi Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la dome o.
ENGLISH: Make no mistake: neither libertines nor idolaters nor adulterers nor any who practice sodomy or submit to it 10 nor thieves nor overreaching or drunken or abusive or grasping people will inherit the Reign of God.

EWE: 11 Gake nenemae mia dometɔ aɖewo nɔ tsã. Ke wole tsi na mi; ke wona mia ŋuti kɔ; ke wobu mi ame dzɔdzɔewo le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ la kple mía Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 11 And that is what you, some of you, were; but you were washed clean! you were sanctified! but you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God!

EWE: 12 Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ nam, ke menye nuwo katãe dea ame dzi o.
ENGLISH: 12 Everything is free to me, but not everything is advantageous.

EWE: Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ nam, ke nyemaɖe mɔ be nu sia nu nakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzinye o.
ENGLISH: Everything is free to me, but I for my part am not going to be brought into subjection by anything.

EWE: 13 Nuɖuɖu li na ƒodo, eye ƒodo hã li na nuɖuɖu, ke Mawu ana esia kple ekemɛa siaa nazu nu gbɔlo.
ENGLISH: 13 Foods for the stomach, and the stomach for foods but God will supersede both that and those.

EWE: Ke ŋutilã meli na gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu o, ke boŋ na Aƒetɔ la, eye Aƒetɔ la hã li na ŋutilã la. 14 Ke Mawu fɔ Aƒetɔ la ɖe tsitre, eye wòafɔ míawo hã ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome to eƒe ŋusẽ me.
ENGLISH: But the body is not for unchastity but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body; 14 and God both raised the Lord and will raise us up by his power.

EWE: 15 Ðe mienyae be miaƒe ŋutilãwo nye Kristo ƒe ŋutinuwo oa?
ENGLISH: 15 Do you not know that your bodies are organs of Christ?

EWE: Ekema ɖe maɖe Kristo la ƒe ŋutinuwo ɖa ahatsɔ wo awɔ ɖeka kple gbolo ƒe ŋutinuwoea? Gbeɖe! 16 Ðe mienyae be ame si tsɔ eɖokui lé ɖe gbolo ŋu la, eya kplii wozu ŋutilã ɖeka oa?
ENGLISH: So am I to take away the Christ’s organs and make them organs of a loose woman? away with the thought! 16 Or do you not know that he who has a connection with a loose woman is one body? for "the two shall become one flesh, " it says.

EWE: Elabena egblɔ be: "Wo ame evea woazu ŋutilã ɖeka. " 17 Ke ame si tsɔ eɖokui lé ɖe Aƒetɔ la ŋu la, eya kplii wozu gbɔgbɔ ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 17 But he who has a connection with the Lord is one spirit.

EWE: 18 Misi le gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu nu!
ENGLISH: 18 Keep clear of unchastity!

EWE: Nu vɔ̃ bubu ɖe sia ɖe si ame awɔ la, mele eƒe ŋutilã me o, ke ame si ƒoa eɖokui ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me la le nu vɔ̃ wɔm ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã ŋu.
ENGLISH: Any sin that a man commits is outside the body; but he who has unchaste relations sins against his own body.

EWE: 19 Ðe mienyae be miaƒe ŋutilã nye gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe si le mia me, si miexɔ tso Mawu gbɔ la, ƒe gbedoxɔ oa? Eye mienye mia ɖokuiwo tɔ hã o, 20 elabena ho gã aɖee wotsɔ ƒle mi.
ENGLISH: 19 Or do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit that you have in you, which comes to you from God, and you do not belong to yourselves? 20 For you were bought and paid for.

EWE: Eya ta midze agbagba ɖe sia ɖe miakafu Mawu le miaƒe ŋutilã me.
ENGLISH: Glorify God in your body.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 7 Ke le nya siwo miebia le agbalẽ si mieŋlɔ ɖo ɖem me ŋu la, enyo na ŋutsu be wòagade asi nyɔnu ŋu o; 2 ke le gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu ƒe bɔbɔ ta la, srɔ̃ nenɔ ŋutsu sia ŋutsu si, eye srɔ̃ nenɔ nyɔnu sia nyɔnu si.
ENGLISH: 7 But as to what you wrote about: It is a good thing for a man not to touch a woman. 2 But for fear of unchastities let each have his own wife and each woman her own husband.

EWE: 3 Srɔ̃ŋutsu netsɔ nu si srɔ̃a dze na la nɛ, eye srɔ̃nyɔnu hã newɔ nenema ke na srɔ̃a.
ENGLISH: 3 Let the husband pay to the wife what he owes her, and likewise the wife too to the husband.

EWE: 4 Srɔ̃nyɔnu mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi o, ke srɔ̃a ya kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi; nenema kee srɔ̃ŋutsu hã mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi o, ke srɔ̃a ya kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: 4 The wife is not entitled to control her own body, but the husband; and likewise the husband too is not entitled to control his own body, but the wife.

EWE: 5 Migate mia ɖokui mia nɔewo o, negbe ɖe mi ame evea mielɔ̃ ɖe edzi va se ɖe ɣeyiɣi aɖe ko, ne miakpɔ ɣeyiɣi ɖe gbedodoɖa ŋu, eye miagava wɔ ɖeka ake, ale be le ɖokuidzimaɖumaɖu ta, Satana naganɔ mia tem kpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 5 Do not hold back each other’s rightful dues, unless it may be temporarily by agreement in order that you may have a while for prayer and again be together, so that Satan may not tempt you because of your incontinence.

EWE: 6 Gake mele esia gblɔm na mi abe mɔnana ene, ke menye abe sedede ene o. 7 Ke ɖe madi be amewo katã nanɔ abe ale si mele ene hafi. Gake ame sia ame kple nunana si wòxɔ tso Mawu gbɔ, ame aɖe xɔe le mɔ si nu, ame bubu hã xɔe le mɔ kemɛ nu.
ENGLISH: 6 But this I say in the way of tolerance, not as an order; 7 but I wish all men to be the same as I myself am but each has a gift of his own from God, one in this way and one in that.

EWE: 8 Ke mele egblɔm na ame siwo meɖe srɔ̃ o kple ahosiwo be, enyo na wo be woanɔ abe ale si ko nye hã mele ene. 9 Gake ne womate ŋu aɖu wo ɖokuiwo dzi o la, ekema woaɖe srɔ̃, elabena enyo be woaɖe srɔ̃ wu be fieŋufieŋu nanɔ fu ɖem na ame.
ENGLISH: 8 But I say to the unmarried and the widows, it is a good thing for them if they remain the same as I am; 9 but if they are not masters of themselves let them marry, for it is better to marry than to be burned.

EWE: 10 Mele mɔfiame sia nam srɔ̃tɔwo, gake menye nyee o, ke boŋ Aƒetɔ lae, be srɔ̃nyɔnu nagaklã ɖa tso srɔ̃a gbɔ o. 11 Ke ne eklã ɖa tso egbɔ la, nenɔ anyi srɔ̃maɖemaɖee, alo negawɔ ɖeka kple srɔ̃a; eye srɔ̃ŋutsu hã nagagblẽ srɔ̃a ɖi o.
ENGLISH: 10 But married couples I enjoin, not I but the Lord, that wife must not separate from husband 11 or if she does, let her remain unmarried or make up with her husband and that husband must not divorce wife.

EWE: 12 Ke mele egblɔm na ame mamlɛawo, ɛ̃, nyee le egblɔm, menye Aƒetɔ lae o be: Ne nɔvi aɖe srɔ̃nyɔnu nye dzimaxɔsetɔ, eye nyɔnua lɔ̃ be yewoanɔ anyi ɖekae la, ŋutsua megadzo le egbɔ o; 13 eye ne nyɔnu aɖe srɔ̃ nye dzimaxɔsetɔ, eye ŋutsua lɔ̃ be yewoanɔ anyi ɖekae la, nyɔnua megadzo le srɔ̃a gbɔ o.
ENGLISH: 12 But to the rest I, not the Lord, say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife and she is satisfied to live with him, let him not divorce her, 13 and whatever woman has an unbelieving husband and he is satisfied to live with her, let her not divorce her husband.

EWE: 14 Elabena srɔ̃ŋutsu dzimaxɔsetɔ la ŋuti kɔ le srɔ̃a ta, eye srɔ̃nyɔnu dzimaxɔsetɔ la hã ŋuti kɔ le nɔviŋutsua ta; ne menye nenemae o la, anye ne mia viwo nye ame makɔmakɔwo, ke azɔ wole kɔkɔe.
ENGLISH: 14 For the unbelieving husband is consecrated in the wife and the unbelieving wife is consecrated in the husband; else your children would be unclean; but in fact they are holy.

EWE: 15 Ke ne dzimaxɔsetɔ la tiae be yeadzo la, nedzo faa; se mebla nɔviŋutsu alo nɔvinyɔnu le nya siawo me o, ke boŋ Mawu yɔ mi be mianɔ ŋutifafa me.
ENGLISH: 15 But if the unbeliever separates, let him; the brother or sister is not fettered in such cases. But it is in peace that God has called us.

EWE: 16 Ke srɔ̃nyɔnu, aleke nàwɔ anya ne wòe axɔ srɔ̃wò ɖe agbe? Alo srɔ̃ŋutsu, aleke nàwɔ anya ne wòe axɔ srɔ̃wò ɖe agbe?
ENGLISH: 16 For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

EWE: 17 Ke hã, le gome si Yehowa na ame sia ame nu la, ame sia ame nezɔ nenema abe ale si Mawu yɔe ene.
ENGLISH: 17 Only, as the Lord has allotted each his share, as God has called each one, so let him walk.

EWE: Eye mɔfiame siae mena le hameawo katã me.
ENGLISH: And so I direct in all the churches.

EWE: 18 Ðe ame aɖe nye aʋatsotsotɔ esi woyɔea? Megatrɔ eɖokui aʋamatsomatsotɔe o. Ðe ame aɖe nye aʋamatsomatsotɔ esi woyɔea? Megatso aʋa o.
ENGLISH: 18 One was called in circumcised condition let him not obliterate the mark; one was called in uncircumcised condition let him not get himself circumcised.

EWE: 19 Aʋatsotso mefia naneke o, eye aʋamatsomatso hã mefia naneke o; nu si le vevie nye Mawu ƒe sewo dzi wɔwɔ boŋ.
ENGLISH: 19 Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing; but the keeping of God’s commandments.

EWE: 20 Nɔnɔme ka mee woɖayɔ ame aɖe le o, nenɔ eme nenema.
ENGLISH: 20 In the call that came to each, in that let him remain.

EWE: 21 Ðe nènye kluvi esime woyɔ wòa? Megaɖe fu na wò o; gake ne àte ŋu axɔ ablɔɖe la, wɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ ma ŋu dɔ.
ENGLISH: 21 You were called as a slave do not be concerned about it, but if you do have the chance to become free, prefer to carry on.

EWE: 22 Elabena ame sia ame si le Aƒetɔ la me, si nye kluvi esime woyɔe la zu Aƒetɔ la ƒe ablɔɖeme; nenema kee ame si nye ablɔɖeme esime woyɔe la zu Kristo ƒe kluvi. 23 Ho gã aɖee wotsɔ ƒle mi; midzudzɔ amewo ƒe kluviwo zuzu.
ENGLISH: 22 For the slave who has been called in the Lord is the Lord’s freedman; likewise the freeman when he is called is Christ’s slave; 23 you were bought and paid for do not become slaves of men.

EWE: 24 Nɔviwo, nɔnɔme ka mee woɖayɔ ame aɖe le o, nenɔ nɔnɔme ma me le Mawu ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 24 Let each one, brothers, as a member of God’s household remain in what he was called in.

EWE: 25 Ke le ɖekakpui kple ɖetugbui siwo meɖe srɔ̃ o gome la, nyemexɔ sedede aɖeke tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ na wo o, gake mele nye susu dom ɖa, abe ame si Aƒetɔ la kpɔ nublanui na be manye nuteƒewɔla ene.
ENGLISH: 25 But as to maidens I do not have any order given by the Lord, but give my judgment as one to whom the Lord has granted the mercy of being trusted.

EWE: 26 Eya ta mesusu be, anyo be ame nanɔ anyi abe ale si wòle ene le ale si nɔnɔmeawo le fifia ta.
ENGLISH: 26 I think this is best, then, in view of the straits we are in: it is best for a man to be so.

EWE: 27 Ðe wobla wò ɖe nyɔnu ŋua? Dzudzɔ mɔnudidi be yeaɖe ta le eme. Ðe wotu wò le nyɔnu ŋua?
ENGLISH: 27 You are bound to a wife do not try for release; you are free from a wife do not try for a wife.

EWE: Dzudzɔ srɔ̃didi. 28 Ke ne èɖe srɔ̃ hã la, mèwɔ nu vɔ̃ o. Eye ne ɖekakpui si menya nyɔnu o alo ɖetugbui leaƒe ɖe srɔ̃ la, mewɔ nu vɔ̃ o.
ENGLISH: 28 But if you do marry you have not sinned, and if the maiden marries she has not sinned; but such will have distress for the flesh, and I am having consideration for you.

EWE: 29 Azɔ hã, nɔviwo, mele esia gblɔm be, ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe koe susɔ. Tso fifia dzi yina la, ame siwo si srɔ̃ le la nanɔ abe ɖe ɖeke mele wo si o ene, 30 eye ame siwo le avi fam nanɔ abe ame siwo mele avi fam o ene, eye ame siwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm la nanɔ abe ame siwo mele dzidzɔ kpɔm o ene, eye ame siwo le nu ƒlem la nanɔ abe ame siwo si nu mele o ene, 31 eye ame siwo wɔa xexea ŋuti dɔ la nanɔ abe ame siwo mele eŋuti dɔ wɔm bliboe o ene; elabena xexe sia ƒe nɔnɔme le tɔtrɔm.
ENGLISH: 29 But this I do say, brothers, the times are under pressure, so that hereafter those who have wives should be as if they did not have them, 30 and those who weep as if they were not weeping, and those who rejoice as if they were not rejoicing, and those who buy as not having obtained title, 31 and those who deal with the world as not having the use of it; for this world’s shows are transient.

EWE: 32 Ɛ̃, medi be miavo tso dzimaɖitsitsi me.
ENGLISH: 32 But I want you free from anxieties.

EWE: Ŋutsu si meɖe srɔ̃ o la tsia dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe nuwo ŋu, ale si wòawɔ adze Aƒetɔ la ŋu. 33 Ke ŋutsu si ɖe srɔ̃ la tsia dzi ɖe xexea me nuwo ŋu, ale si wòawɔ adze srɔ̃a ŋu, 34 eye wòle evedomesi.
ENGLISH: The unmarried man is anxious over what belongs to the Lord, how to please the Lord; 33 but the man who has married is anxious over what belongs to the world, how to please his wife, 34 and is divided.

EWE: Eye nyɔnu si meɖe srɔ̃ o alo ɖetugbui leaƒe tsia dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe nuwo ŋu, ale be wòanɔ kɔkɔe le eƒe ŋutilã kple eƒe gbɔgbɔ me. Ke nyɔnu si ɖe srɔ̃ la tsia dzi ɖe xexea me nuwo ŋu, ale si wòawɔ adze srɔ̃a ŋu.
ENGLISH: And the unmarried woman and the maiden is anxious over what belongs to the Lord in order that she may be holy both in body and in spirit; but the woman who has married is anxious over what belongs to the world, how to please her husband.

EWE: 35 Ke miawo ŋutɔwo miaƒe nyonyo tae mele esia gblɔm ɖo, menye be mana miaxaxa o, ke boŋ be mana miawɔ nu si dze, eye miatsɔ mia ɖokui ana ahasubɔ Aƒetɔ la ɣesiaɣi susuhenuwo manɔmee.
ENGLISH: 35 But I am saying this in your own interest, not in order to put a halter on you but with a view to what will be respectable and favorable to undistracted listening to the Lord.

EWE: 36 Ke ne ame aɖe susu be yemele nu wɔm ɖe yeƒe ɖekakpuinyenye alo ɖetugbuinyenye ŋu nyuie o, eye wòto sɔhɛnyenye me do la, ekema nu si wòawɔe nye esi: newɔ nu si dim wòle; mewɔ nu vɔ̃ o.
ENGLISH: 36 But if anybody feels that he will be acting discreditably toward his maiden if she is overage, and that is the way it has to be, let him do what he will, he is not sinning; let them marry.

EWE: Neɖe srɔ̃ faa. 37 Ke ne ame aɖe ɖoe kplikpaa le eƒe dzi me, eye naneke mezi edzi o, ke boŋ wòkpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu dzi, eye wòɖoe le eya ŋutɔ ƒe dzi me be yeanɔ anyi srɔ̃maɖemaɖee la, awɔe nyuie.
ENGLISH: 37 But he who stands fast in his heart, not being under a compulsion but having freedom to go by his own will, and has come to this decision in his own heart, to keep his maiden, will be doing well.

EWE: 38 Eye ame si ɖe srɔ̃ hã wɔe nyuie, ke ame si meɖe srɔ̃ o la awɔe nyuie wu.
ENGLISH: 38 So that equally he who marries his maiden is doing well, and he who does not will be doing better.

EWE: 39 Ŋkeke ale si srɔ̃ŋutsu le agbe ko la, se bla srɔ̃nyɔnua. Ke ne ŋutsua dɔ alɔ̃ le ku me la, ekema nyɔnua vo aɖe ame si wòlɔ̃, negbe le Aƒetɔ la me ko.
ENGLISH: 39 A wife is bound for such time as her husband is alive; but if her husband goes to his rest she is free to marry whom she will, only in the Lord; 40 but she is happier if she remains so, in my opinion.

EWE: 40 Ke le nye susu nu la, ne enɔ anyi nenema la, akpɔ dzidzɔ wu; eye meka ɖe edzi be Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ le nye hã dzinye.
ENGLISH: And I think I too have God’s spirit.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 8 Ke le nuɖuɖu si wotsɔ sa vɔ na trɔ̃wo ŋuti la, mí katã míenya nu tso eŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 And as to meat from idol-sacrifices: we are aware that we all have knowledge.

EWE: Sidzedze nana ame doa eɖokui ɖe dzi, ke lɔlɔ̃ tua ame ɖo.
ENGLISH: Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

EWE: 2 Ne ame aɖe susu be yenya nane gɔ̃ hã la, menyae wòde edeƒe haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 2 If anybody thinks he knows anything, he has not known yet as one needs to know.

EWE: 3 Ke ne ame aɖe lɔ̃ Mawu la, ekema Mawu nya eya amea.
ENGLISH: 3 But if anybody loves God, that man is known by him.

EWE: 4 Ke le nu si wotsɔ sa vɔ na trɔ̃wo ɖuɖu ŋu la, míenyae be trɔ̃ menye naneke le xexea me o, eye be Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃ koe li. 5 Togbɔ be nu siwo woyɔna be mawuwo li, eɖanye le dziƒo alo le anyigba dzi o, abe ale si "mawu " geɖewo kple "aƒetɔ " geɖewo li ene hã la, 6 le nyateƒe me la, Mawu ɖeka si nye Fofo la, ame si me nuwo katã dzɔ tso, eye míele agbe nɛ la, koe li na mí; eye Aƒetɔ ɖeka koe li, eyae nye Yesu Kristo, ame si dzi nuwo katã to va dzɔ, eye míawo hã míele agbe to eya dzi.
ENGLISH: 4 Well, then, as to the eating of meat from idol-sacrifices, we are aware that there is no such thing in the world as an idol-god and that there is no God but one 5 for, though it be a fact that there are so-called gods whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many "gods " and many "lords "), 6 yet for us there is one God, the Father, out of whom comes everything and into whom come we; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom comes everything, and through him we.

EWE: 7 Gake menye amewo katã sie sidzedze sia le o. Ke boŋ esi ame aɖewo kpɔ gome le trɔ̃subɔsubɔ me tsã ta la, wobua nu siwo woɖuna la abe trɔ̃wo ƒe vɔsanu ene, eye esia ƒoa ɖi woƒe dzitsinya si gbɔdzɔ la.
ENGLISH: 7 But not everybody has the knowledge in him; and some, by habituation to the idol-god heretofore, eat as from an idol-sacrifice, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

EWE: 8 Ke menye nuɖuɖue ate mí ɖe Mawu ŋu o; ne míeɖu nane o la, megblẽ naneke le mía ŋu o, eye ne míeɖu nane la, medoa mí ɖe ŋgɔ le go aɖeke me o.
ENGLISH: 8 And a food will not be a recommendation to God for us: we are neither in inferior standing if we do not eat nor in especially good standing if we do.

EWE: 9 Ke mikpɔ nyuie be miaƒe tiatiawɔblɔɖe la nagazu nuɖiaɖia na ame siwo gbɔdzɔ la le mɔ aɖeke nu o.
ENGLISH: 9 But look out that this right of yours does not possibly become a snag for the feet of the weak.

EWE: 10 Elabena ne ame aɖe kpɔ wò, ame si si sidzedze le, nèle kplɔ̃ ŋu le nu ɖum le trɔ̃xɔ me la, ɖe ema mana dzi naɖo ame si ƒe dzitsinya gbɔdzɔ la ƒo, be eya hã naɖu nu siwo wotsɔ sa vɔ na trɔ̃wo oa? 11 Eya ta wò sidzedze la agblẽ nu le nɔviwò si gbɔdzɔ, ame si ta Kristo ku ɖo, la ŋu. 12 Ne miewɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe mia nɔviwo ŋu alea, eye miede abi woƒe dzitsinya si gbɔdzɔ ŋu la, ekema miele nu vɔ̃ wɔm ɖe Kristo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 10 For if one sees you, the one who has the knowledge, taking a meal in an idol-temple, will not his conscience, weak as he is, be built up into eating meat from idol-sacrifices? 11 why, by your knowledge the weak one is perishing, the brother on whose account Christ died! 12 And so, sinning against the brothers and battering their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

EWE: 13 Eya ta ne nuɖuɖu aɖia nɔvinye nu la, ekema nyemagaɖu lã akpɔ gbeɖe o, ale be nyemaɖia nɔvinye nu o.
ENGLISH: 13 Wherefore if a food is tripping my brother up I will go without meat forever in order not to trip my brother up.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: Ðe nyemekpɔ Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la oa? Menye miawoe nye dɔ si mewɔ le Aƒetɔ la me la me tsonuwo oa? 2 Ne nyemenye apostolo na ame bubuwo o hã la, menyee na miawo ya! Elabena miawoe nye nutrenu si le kpe ɖom edzi be Aƒetɔ la ƒe apostoloe menye.
ENGLISH: 9 Am I not a free man? am I not an apostle? have I not seen our Lord Jesus? are not you in the Lord my work? 2 If for others I am not an apostle, for you anyhow I am; for you in the Lord are the seal of my apostleship.

EWE: 3 Nya siwo matsɔ aɖe ɖokuinye nu na ame siwo drɔ̃a ʋɔnum lae nye esi: 4 Ðe míekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu alo ano nu oa? 5 Ðe míekpɔ mɔ aɖe nyɔnu haxɔsetɔ akplɔ ɖe ŋuti, abe ale si apostolo susɔeawo kple Aƒetɔ la nɔviwo kpakple Kefas hã wɔna ene oa? 6 Alo nye kple Barnaba koe mekpɔ mɔ adzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ be míatsɔ akpɔ mía ɖokuiwo dzi oa? 7 Asrafo kae wɔa asrafodɔ evɔ eya ŋutɔe kpɔa eɖokui dzi? Ame kae dea waingble evɔ meɖua eme kutsetse o? Alo ame kae kplɔa lãha evɔ menoa lãha la ƒe notsi ƒe ɖe o? 8 Amegbetɔ ƒe susu nue mele nya siawo gblɔm lea? Alo ɖe Se la hã megblɔ nya siawo oa? 9 Elabena woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe Se la me be: "Mègabla nu na nyitsu ne ele nuku tugum o. "
ENGLISH: 3 My defense to my examiners is this: 4 Do we not have the right to eat and drink? 5 do we not have the right to take around a wife who is one of the sisters, the same as the rest of the apostles do, and the Lord’s brothers, and Cephas? 6 or do Barnabas and I alone have no right not to work? 7 Whoever serves in the army and pays his own expenses? who plants a vineyard and does not eat the fruit of it, or who tends a flock and does not eat any of the milk of the flock? 8 Am I talking like this from a human point of view, or does not the law too say this? 9 For in the law of Moses it says "You shall not muzzle a threshing beast. "

EWE: Nyitsuwo ŋue Mawu tsi dzi ɖoa? 10 Alo míawo koŋ tae wògblɔe ɖo?
ENGLISH: Does God care for the beasts, 10 or is it distinctly on our account that he says it?

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, míawo tae woŋlɔe ɖi ɖo, elabena ele be ame si le agble ŋlɔm kple ame si le nuku tugum la nawɔe kple mɔkpɔkpɔ be yewoava kpɔ gome le eme.
ENGLISH: Why, it was put in on our account, because the plower ought to plow in hope, and the thresher in hope of coming in for a share.

EWE: 11 Ne míeƒã gbɔgbɔmenuwo ɖe mia me ɖe, ekema nu gãe wònye ne míeŋe ŋutilãmenuhiahiãwo tso mia domea? 12 Ne ame bubuwo kpɔ mɔ abia nu siawo tso mia si ɖe, ekema ɖe míawo míekpɔ mɔ geɖe wu oa?
ENGLISH: 11 If we sowed the spiritual things for you, is it anything great if we are to harvest the material things from you? 12 If others come in for a share of rights over you, do not we all the more?

EWE: Gake míewɔ ŋusẽ sia ŋu dɔ o, ke boŋ míedoa dzi le nuwo katã me, ale be míagaxe mɔ na Kristo la ŋuti nya nyui la le mɔ aɖeke nu o.
ENGLISH: But we did not use those rights, but are putting up with everything in order that we may not cause any obstruction to the gospel of the Christ.

EWE: 13 Ðe mienyae be ame siwo wɔa dɔ kɔkɔewo la ɖua gbedoxɔa me nuwo, eye ame siwo subɔna le vɔsamlekpuia ŋu ɣesiaɣi la, vɔsamlekpuia ƒe nuwo mee wokpɔa wo tɔ gome tsonɛ oa? 14 Nenema kee Aƒetɔ la ɖo na ame siwo ɖea gbeƒã nya nyui la be, nya nyui la nakpɔ nu si ŋu woanɔ agbe ɖo la gbɔ na wo.
ENGLISH: 13 Do you not know that those who do the sacred work eat the sanctuary’s supplies, those who attend the altar participate with the altar? 14 in the same way the Lord prescribed to those who were announcing the gospel that they should live by the gospel.

EWE: 15 Ke nyemewɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ siawo dometɔ ɖeka teti hã ŋu dɔ o.
ENGLISH: 15 But I have not availed myself of any of this.

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, menye ɖe mele nu siawo ŋlɔm ale be miawɔ nenema nam o, elabena enyo nam be maku wu esi mana ame aɖe naɖe nu si metsɔ ƒoa adegbe la ɖa! 16 Ke ne mele nya nyui la gblɔm hã la, esia menye susu si ta maƒo adegbe ɖo o, elabena agba wònye le dzinye.
ENGLISH: And I did not write this in order that it should come so in my case, for I had better die sooner than nobody shall make my boast an empty one. 16 For if I preach the gospel it is no boast for me, for I am under compulsion; for there is a woe for me if I do not.

EWE: Ɛ̃, ne nyemegblɔ nya nyui la o la, baba nam! 17 Ne mewɔ esia tso dzi me faa la, fetu li nam; ke ne nyemewɔe tso dzi me o hã la, wotsɔ aƒedzikpɔkpɔdɔ de asi nam.
ENGLISH: 17 For if I do this voluntarily I get pay, but if involuntarily I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

EWE: 18 Ekema nu kae nye nye fetua? Eyae nye be, ne mele nya nyui la gblɔm la, magblɔ nya nyui la naneke maxɔmaxɔe, ale be magazã ŋusẽ si le asinye le nya nyuia me la ɖe mɔ madzemadze nu o.
ENGLISH: 18 What is my pay then? that in my preaching I shall render the gospel free of expense, so as to make no use of my rights as preacher.

EWE: 19 Togbɔ be mevo tso amewo katã si me hã la, mewɔ ɖokuinye amewo katã ƒe kluvii, be asinye nasu ame geɖe ale si mate ŋui dzi. 20 Ale mezu abe Yudatɔ ene na Yudatɔwo, ale be asinye nasu Yudatɔwo dzi; mezu abe ame si le se te ene na ame siwo le se te, evɔ nye ŋutɔ nyemele se te hafi o, ale be asinye nasu ame siwo le se te la dzi. 21 Mezu abe semanɔsitɔ ene na semanɔsitɔwo, evɔ le Mawu gbɔ la, nyemenye semanɔsitɔ hafi o, ke boŋ mele Kristo ƒe se te, ale be asinye nasu semanɔsitɔwo dzi. 22 Mezu gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔ na gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo, ale be asinye nasu gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo dzi. Mezu nuwo katã na ame ƒomeviwo katã, ale be mate ŋu aɖe wo dometɔ aɖewo kokoko.
ENGLISH: 19 For when I was free from everybody I enslaved myself to everybody in order to get the greatest number; 20 and I behaved to the Jews like a Jew in order to get Jews, to those under the law like one under the law when I was not myself under the law, in order to get those under the law, 21 to the lawless like a lawless man when I was not lawless for God but law-abiding for Christ, in order to get the lawless; 22 I became anything to anybody in order anyhow to save some.

EWE: 23 Ke nya nyui la tae mewɔa nuwo katã ɖo, ale be nye hã mate ŋu agblɔe na amewo.
ENGLISH: 23 And I do everything on account of the gospel, in order to become a fellow-participant in it.

EWE: 24 Ðe mienyae be duƒula siwo le ho ʋlim la katãe ƒua dua, gake ame ɖeka koe xɔa dziɖuɖufetu la oa?
ENGLISH: 24 Do you not know that those who run in the races all run, but one gets the prize?

EWE: Miƒu du le mɔ si ana miaxɔ fetu la nu.
ENGLISH: Run in such a way that you may arrive.

EWE: 25 Azɔ hã, ame sia ame si le gome kpɔm le hoʋiʋli me la ɖua eɖokui dzi le nuwo katã me. Woawo la, wowɔnɛ be woaxɔ dziɖuɖukuku si gblẽna, ke míawo ya hena esi megblẽna o.
ENGLISH: 25 And everybody who goes into the contests masters himself in every respect; they, indeed, aiming to win a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable.

EWE: 26 Eya ta ale si mele dua ƒum la, nyemele eƒum ɖewoɖewoe o; ale si mele nye kɔwo dam la, menye be mada dadagbo o; 27 ke boŋ meƒoa nye ŋutilã vevie hewɔnɛ kluvii, ale be esi meɖe gbeƒã na ame bubuwo vɔ la, nye ŋutɔ nyemagazu ame madzemadze le mɔ aɖeke nu o.
ENGLISH: 26 Well, then, I run not in aimless fashion; I spar not in the way of shadowboxing, 27 but bang my body about and make a slave of it, for fear that after I had been herald to others I should myself fail to make good.

EWE: 1 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Corinthians

EWE: 10 Ke nɔviwo, medi be mianyae be, mía tɔgbuiwo katã nɔ alilikpo la te, eye wo katã woto ƒu la me, 2 eye wonyrɔ wo katã ɖe Mose me esi wonɔ alilikpo la te heto ƒu la me, 3 eye wo katã woɖu gbɔgbɔmenuɖuɖu ma ke, 4 eye wo katã wono gbɔgbɔmenunono ma ke. Elabena wono tsi tso gbɔgbɔ me agakpe si dze wo yome la me, eye agakpe ma le tsitre ɖi na Kristo la. 5 Gake Mawu mekpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe wo dometɔ akpa gãtɔ ŋu o, elabena ena woku le gbea dzi.
ENGLISH: 10 For we do not want you to lack the knowledge, brothers, that our fathers were all of them under the cloud and all went through the sea 2 and all had themselves baptized to Moses in the cloud and in the sea, 3 and all ate the same spiritual food 4 and all drank the same spiritual drink (for they drank out of a spiritual rock that went along with them; and the rock was the Christ), 5 but God was not pleased with most of them; for they fell along the desert road.

EWE: 6 Ke nu siawo zu kpɔɖeŋu na mí, ale be míaganye nu vɔ̃ɖi dzrolawo, abe ale si wòdzro wo ene o.
ENGLISH: 6 And in these respects they were types of us, so that we may not take to desiring bad things as some of them did.

EWE: Eye wotso hedo dzidzɔ na wo ɖokuiwo. " 8 Migana míaƒo mía ɖokui ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me, abe ale si wo dometɔ aɖewo ƒo wo ɖokuiwo ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me, ale be wodze anyi, ame akpe blaeve vɔ etɔ̃ sɔŋ le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi la ene o.
ENGLISH: 7 And do not become idolaters, as did some of them, as it is written "The people sat down to eat and drink and stood up to play. " 8 And let us not go into sexual debauchery, as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.

EWE: 9 Eye migate Yehowa kpɔ, abe ale si wo dometɔ aɖewo tee kpɔ, eye dawo tsrɔ̃ wo la ene o.
ENGLISH: 9 And let us not put the Lord to a test, as some of them tested him and perished by the snakes.

EWE: 10 Migazu liʋiliʋĩlĩlawo, abe ale si wo dometɔ aɖewo lĩ liʋiliʋĩ, eye nutsrɔ̃la tsrɔ̃ wo la ene o.
ENGLISH: 10 And do not grumble, as some of them grumbled and perished by the destroyer.

EWE: 11 Ke nu siawo dzɔ ɖe wo dzi abe kpɔɖeŋu ene, eye woŋlɔ wo ɖi be wòanye nuxlɔ̃ame na mí ame siwo dzi nuɖoanyi siawo ƒe nuwuwuwo va ɖo la.
ENGLISH: 11 And these things befell them by way of types, and were recorded for admonition to us, in whom the ages have reached their goal.

EWE: 12 Eya ta ame si susu be yele tsitre la nakpɔ nyuie be wòagadze anyi o.
ENGLISH: 12 Consequently, let him who thinks he is standing look out that he does not fall.

EWE: 13 Tetekpɔ aɖeke mevaa mia dzi o, negbe esi tɔgbi vaa amegbetɔwo dzi la ko.
ENGLISH: 13 There has not any temptation caught you but such as is the lot of man.

EWE: Ke nuteƒewɔlae Mawu nye, eye maɖe mɔ woate mi akpɔ wu esi nu miate ŋu anɔ te ɖo o, gake ne tetekpɔa va la, ana mɔ si dzi miato ado le eme la hã, ale be miate ŋu ado dzi atsɔe.
ENGLISH: And God is faithful, who will not let you be tempted beyond your power, but with the temptation will also make the way out so that you may be able to stand it.

EWE: 14 Eya ta nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, misi le trɔ̃subɔsubɔ nu.
ENGLISH: 14 Wherefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.

EWE: 15 Mele nu ƒom na mi ame siwo si gɔmesese le; miawo ŋutɔwo mida nya si gblɔm mele la kpɔ.
ENGLISH: 15 I speak as one does to sensible men; judge of what I say yourselves.

EWE: 16 Yayrakplu si míeyrana la, ɖe menye gomekpɔkpɔ le Kristo la ƒe ʋu mee wònye oa? Abolo si míeŋena la, ɖe menye gomekpɔkpɔ le Kristo la ƒe ŋutilã mee wònye oa? 17 Elabena abolo ɖeka koe, togbɔ be míawo míesɔ gbɔ hã la, ŋutilã ɖekae míenye, elabena mí katã míeɖua abolo ɖeka ma ke ƒe ɖe.
ENGLISH: 16 The blessing-cup that we bless, is it not participation in the blood of the Christ? the loaf of bread that we break, is it not participation in the body of the Christ? 17 because we, many as we are, are one loaf, one body; for we all share in the one loaf.

EWE: 18 Mikpɔ ŋutilã me Israel la ɖa: Ðe ame siwo ɖua vɔsanuawo la mekpɔa gome le wo me kple vɔsamlekpui la oa? 19 Ekema nya ka gblɔm mele?
ENGLISH: 18 Look at Israel, Israel in the fleshly sense: are not those who eat the sacrifices participants with the altar?

EWE: Be nu si wotsɔ sa vɔ na trɔ̃ la nye nanea, alo be trɔ̃ nye nanea? 20 Ao; ke boŋ mele gbɔgblɔm be, nu si dukɔwo tsɔ saa vɔe la, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃woe wotsɔa wo saa vɔe na, ke menye na Mawu o; eye nyemedi be miade ha kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo o.
ENGLISH: 19 What am I saying then? that an idol-sacrifice is anything, or that there is any such thing as an idol-god? 20 no, but that what they sacrifice they sacrifice to demons and not to God. And I do not want you to become participants with demons.

EWE: 21 Miate ŋu anɔ nu nom le Yehowa ƒe kplu nu aganɔ nu nom le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe kplu nu o; miate ŋu anɔ nu ɖum le "Yehowa ƒe kplɔ̃ " ŋu aganɔ nu ɖum le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 21 You cannot drink the Lord’s cup and demons’ cup! you cannot share the Lord’s table and demons’ table! 22 Or are we teasing the Lord into jealousy? are we stronger than he?

EWE: 23 Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ na ame, ke menye nuwo katãe dea ame dzi o.
ENGLISH: 23 Everything is permissible, but not everything is advantageous.

EWE: Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ na ame, ke menye nuwo katãe tua ame ɖo o.
ENGLISH: Everything is permissible, but not everything is constructive.

EWE: 24 Ame aɖeke meganɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe nyonyo ko dim o, ke nedi ame bubu tɔ hã.
ENGLISH: 24 Let nobody look after what is for himself, but what is for the other man.

EWE: 25 Nu sia nu si wodzrana le lãsi me la, miate ŋu aɖui, eye miganɔ nya gɔme biam o le miaƒe dzitsinya ta, 26 elabena "Yehowa tɔe nye anyigba kple edzinuwo katã. " 27 Ne dzimaxɔsetɔ aɖe kpe mi, eye mielɔ̃ be yewoayi la, miɖu nu sia nu si wotsɔ ɖo mia kɔme, eye miganɔ nya gɔme biam o le miaƒe dzitsinya ta.
ENGLISH: 25 Eat anything that is offered for sale at a market, without making any inquiries for reasons of conscience; 26 for "the earth and all that fills it belong to the Lord. " 27 If one of the unbelievers invites you and you choose to go, eat anything that is brought to the table without making any inquiries for reasons of conscience.

EWE: 28 Ke ne ame aɖe gblɔ na mi be, "Wotsɔ nu sia sa vɔe " la, ekema migaɖui o, le ame si gblɔe ta kple dzitsinya ta. 29 Menye miaƒe dzitsinya ye mewɔnɛ o, ke boŋ ame kemɛa tɔ. Elabena nu ka tae ame bubu ƒe dzitsinya nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu nye ablɔɖe? 30 Ne meda akpe hafi le nua ɖum ɖe, nu ka tae woaƒo nu gbegblẽ le ŋunye le nu si ta meda akpe ɖo la ŋu?
ENGLISH: 28 But if somebody tells you "this is sacrifice meat, " do not eat, because of him, the one that informed you, and for reasons of conscience 29 and I do not mean one’s own conscience but the other man’s; for to what purpose is my liberty judged by another conscience? 30 If I partake with gratitude, why am I vilified over what I give thanks for?

EWE: 31 Eya ta ne miele nu ɖum alo le nu nom alo le nu bubu aɖe wɔm la, miwɔ nuwo katã hena Mawu ƒe kafukafu.
ENGLISH: 31 So, whether you are eating or drinking or doing anything, do everything to God’s glory.

EWE: 32 Migazu nuɖiaɖia na Yudatɔwo kple Helatɔwo kpakple Mawu ƒe hame la o, 33 abe ale si nye hã mele amewo katã ŋu dzem le nuwo katã me, eye nyemele nye ŋutɔ nye nyonyo dim o, ke boŋ ame geɖewo tɔ, be woakpɔ ɖeɖe la ene.
