EWE: 15 Eye miaƒe nu léa dzi nɛ geɖe wu ne eɖo ŋku mi katã miaƒe toɖoɖo kple ale si mietsɔ vɔvɔ̃ kple dzodzo nyanyanya xɔe la dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 And his sympathies are most pronounced toward you as he remembers the obedience of all of you, how you received him with fear and trembling.

EWE: 16 Dzi le dzɔyem be le mɔ sia mɔ nu la, dzi ate ŋu aɖo ƒonye le mia ta.
ENGLISH: 16 I am glad to say that on every score I am in good spirits as regards you.

EWE: 2 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Corinthians

EWE: 8 Ke nɔviwo, míedi be míana mianya ale si Mawu ve hame siwo le Makedonia la nui. 2 Esi wonɔ dodokpɔ gã si me wokpe fu le vevie me tom la, wotsɔ dzidzɔ manyagblɔ na nu faa togbɔ be woda ahe ŋutɔ hã, si wɔe be woƒe dɔmenyonyo la ɖe dzesi. 3 Elabena wowɔ esia le woƒe ŋutete nu, ɛ̃, mele ɖase ɖim be, wowɔe wògbɔ woƒe ŋutete ŋu gɔ̃ hã, 4 esi wotso le wo ɖokui si ɖe kuku na mí vevie be míana mɔnukpɔkpɔ yewo yewoana nu dɔmenyotɔe, eye yewoakpɔ gome le kpekpeɖeŋunana ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ si wɔm wole na ame kɔkɔewo la me. 5 Eye menye ale si míekpɔ mɔ nɛ la ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ wotsɔ wo ɖokuiwo na Aƒetɔ la gbã, kple míawo hã to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me. 6 Esia ta míede dzi ƒo na Tito be, esi wònye eyae dze dɔ sia gɔme le mia dome ta la, eya ke nawu miaƒe dɔmenyonunana la nu ƒoƒo ƒu nu.
ENGLISH: 8 But let us make you acquainted, brothers, with God’s grace that has been given among the churches of Macedonia, 2 that under a great test of distress the plentifulness of their joy and their deep poverty became a plentiful source for the wealth of their liberality, 3 because to the extent of their power, I can testify, and beyond it, 4 they gave voluntarily, imploring us with strong appeals for the favor and the participation in the service to God’s people 5 and not as we had hoped, but giving themselves first to the Lord, and to us by God’s will, 6 so that we invited Titus, as he had made the first start, so too to bring to completion in you this grace too.

EWE: 7 Ke ale si miegba go le nuwo katã me, le xɔse kple nya kple sidzedze kple veviedodo katã kpakple lɔlɔ̃ si míeɖe fia mi me la, migba go hã le dɔmenyonunana sia me.
ENGLISH: 7 But as you are plentiful in everything, faith and the gift of speech and knowledge and all earnestness and love on our part toward you, try to be also plentiful in this grace.

EWE: 8 Nyemele egblɔm abe se demee mele na mi ene o, ke boŋ be mianya ale si ame bubuwo le vevie dom nu, eye be mado miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ ƒe vavãnyenye akpɔ. 9 Elabena mienya mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve la be, togbɔ be kesinɔtɔ wònye hã la, eva zu ame dahe le mia ta, ale be miato eƒe ahedada me azu kesinɔtɔwo. 10 Eye mele susu aɖe dom ɖa le esia ŋu: Esia aɖe vi na mi, elabena ƒe ɖekae nye esia la, menye ɖe miedze dɔ sia wɔwɔ gɔme ko o, ke didia nɔ mia me hã ɖe ewɔwɔ ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 I do not say it in the way of an order, but to get proof, through the earnestness of others, of the genuineness of your love too 9 for you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, how on your account he became poor when he was rich, in order that you might become rich by his poverty 10 and as this is what I am doing I offer an opinion; for this will be good for you, who made the first start last year not only in doing but also in wanting to.

EWE: 11 Ke azɔ la, miwu nu si gɔme miedze la nu, ale be ale si ko ewɔwɔ ƒe didia le mia me vevie la, miawu enu hã le nu siwo le mia si la nu. 12 Elabena ne didia nya li ko la, wokpɔa ŋudzedze ɖe eŋu le nu si le ame si la nu, menye le nu si mele ame si o la nu o.
ENGLISH: 11 But now bring to completion the doing too, so that to the heartiness of wanting to there may correspond the completion that comes from having the wherewithal; 12 for if the hearty readiness is there it is acceptable on the basis of what one has, not of what he does not have.

EWE: 13 Nyemedi be wòanɔ bɔbɔe na ame bubuwo, gake wòasesẽ na miawo ya o; 14 ke boŋ be nuwo nasɔ pɛ, eye miaƒe nu siwo gbɔ edzi fifia la, nakpɔ woƒe hiahiã gbɔ na wo, ale be woawo hã ƒe nu siwo gbɔ edzi la, nakpɔ nu siwo hiã mi la gbɔ, ne nuwo nada asɔ. 15 Abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene be: "Ame si si geɖe le la mekpɔe wògbɔ edzi o, eye ame si si nu ʋɛ le la tɔ mele ʋɛ akpa o. "
ENGLISH: 13 For the idea is not that others are to get an easy time, you a hard one, 14 but to have it on an equality, your surplus coming in just now for their shortage in order that their surplus may also come in for your shortage, so that there may be equality, 15 as it is written "The one who had taken more had no surplus and the one who had taken less had no shortage. "

EWE: 16 Ke woada akpe na Mawu be wòdee Tito hã ƒe dzi me be wòado vevie nu nenema ke ɖe mia ta; 17 elabena le nyateƒe me la, ewɔ nu abe ale si míede dzi ƒo nɛ ene, ke esi wònye eƒe didi vevie xoxo ta la, etso le eɖokui si dze mɔ gbɔna mia gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 16 But thanks be to God who is putting into Titus’s heart the same earnestness on your behalf, 17 because he has accepted the invitation and, so earnest he was, has gone off to you on his own initiative.

EWE: 18 Ke míele nɔviŋutsu aɖe, si wokafuna le hameawo katã me le nya nyuia ta la, dɔm ɖa kpe ɖe eŋu. 19 Menye ema ɖeɖe koe o, ke boŋ hameawo tiae hã be wòanye míaƒe mɔzɔhati esi míele dɔmenyonunana ƒe dɔ sia ŋu nyawo gbɔ kpɔm hena Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, ne wòaɖee afia be míele klalo be míana kpekpeɖeŋu. 20 Ale be ame aɖeke nagakpɔ vodada le mía ŋu le lɔlɔ̃nu faa nunana gbogbo sia ŋuti dɔwɔwɔ me o. 21 Elabena ‘míekpɔa nuwo katã gbɔ le anukwareɖiɖi me, menye le Yehowa ŋkume ɖeɖe ko o, ke le amegbetɔwo ŋkume hã.’
ENGLISH: 18 And we sent with him the brother whose praise in the preaching of the gospel runs through all the churches, 19 and, besides, who has with a view to the glory of the Lord himself and our hearty preference been elected by the churches as our fellow-traveler in the matter of this grace that is being administered by us, 20 to avoid having anybody find fault with us in the matter of this bounty that is being administered by us; 21 for we are keeping in mind what is going to look well not only before the Lord but also before men.

EWE: 22 Azɔ hã, míele mía nɔvi si míedo kpɔ enuenu, eye míekpɔe be edoa vevie nu le nu geɖewo me la dɔm kpe ɖe wo ŋu, eye azɔ egale vevie dom nu wu le ale si gbegbe wòka ɖe mia dzii la ta.
ENGLISH: 22 And we sent with them our brother whom we have many times found by many evidences to be energetic, but now much more energetic by the confidence he has in you.

EWE: 23 Ke ne ame aɖe bia nya tso Tito ŋu la, nye zɔhɛ kple hadɔwɔlae wònye le miaƒe nyonyo ta; alo ne ame aɖe bia nya tso mía nɔviŋutsuawo ŋu la, hameawo ƒe apostolowo kple Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe wonye.
ENGLISH: 23 As to Titus, he is our comrade and co-worker for you; our brothers, they are church delegates, glory of Christ.

EWE: 24 Eya ta miɖe miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ fia wo eye miana hameawo nakpɔ nu si ta míetsɔa mi ƒoa adegbee ɖo.
ENGLISH: 24 So when you give the demonstration of your love and of our boast about you to them, it is in presence of the churches.

EWE: 2 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Corinthians

EWE: 9 Ke mekpɔe be mehiã be maŋlɔ nu ɖo ɖe mi tso subɔsubɔdɔ si woawɔ na ame kɔkɔewo la ŋu hafi o, 2 elabena menya be didia le mia me be miawɔe, eye metsɔ esia le adegbe ƒom le mia ŋuti na Makedoniatɔwo, be ƒe ɖekae nye esia si nɔvi siwo le Akaya la le klalo xoxo, eye miaƒe veviedodo nu de dzo wo dometɔ akpa gãtɔ me.
ENGLISH: 9 For about the service to God’s people it is superfluous for me to write to you, 2 for I know your heartiness, as to which I am boasting of you to the Macedonians that Achaea has been prepared ever since last year, and rivalry with you has stirred up the greater part of them.

EWE: 3 Ke mele nɔviawo dɔm ɖa, ale be adegbe si míeƒona le mia ŋu la nagazu dzodzro le nya sia me o, eye be mianɔ klalo ŋutɔŋutɔ abe ale si megblɔe ene. 4 Ne menye nenema o la, ne mía kple Makedoniatɔwo míava ɖo, evɔ woakpɔe be miele klalo o la, ŋu akpe mí le ale si gbegbe míeka ɖe mia dzii la ta; nyemedi be maƒo nu tso ŋu si akpe miawo ya ŋu o. 5 Eya ta mekpɔe be ehiã be made dzi ƒo na nɔviawo be woado ŋgɔ ava mia gbɔ, ne woaƒo nunana gbogbo siwo ŋugbe miedo xoxo la nu ƒu ɖi, ale be wòanye nu siwo miena tso dzi me faa, ke menye ɖe wozi mia dzi hafi o.
ENGLISH: 3 But I send the brothers in order that our boast of you may not be made an empty one in this respect; in order that you may, as I said, be prepared, 4 for fear that if Macedonians should come with me and find you unprepared we (not to say you) should be shamed about this pledge; 5 so I thought it necessary to request the brothers to go to you in advance and get this already promised bounty of yours into shape in advance to be ready in that way, as a bounty and not as a grab.

EWE: 6 Ke le esia gome la, ame si ƒã nu ʋɛ la, aŋe nu ʋɛ, eye ame si ƒã nu wòsɔ gbɔ la, aŋe nu wòasɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 But there is this, he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

EWE: 9 (Abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene be: "Eʋua asi me, enaa nu ame dahewo. Eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye li tegbee. " 10 Ke Ame si naa nuku nuƒãla kple nuɖuɖu amewo la ana nuku si mieƒãna la nasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi na mi, eye wòana miaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse nasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi.) 11 Le nuwo katã me la, wonana miezua kesinɔtɔwo be miate ŋu anyo dɔme le nu sia nu me, ale be nu siwo mienana amewo to mía dzi nawɔe be woada akpe na Mawu; 12 elabena kpekpeɖeŋunana ƒe dutoƒo subɔsubɔdɔ sia menye be wòakpɔ ame kɔkɔewo ƒe hiahiãwo gbɔ na wo nyuie ko o, ke be wòana woada akpe geɖe na Mawu hã. 13 Le kpeɖodzi si kpekpeɖeŋunana ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ sia nana ta la, wokafua Mawu elabena mienana Kristo la ŋuti nya nyui la kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe mia dzi abe ale si mieʋua eme le dutoƒo ene, eye mienaa nu woawo kple ame bubuwo katã dɔmenyotɔe. 14 Eye wole kokoƒoƒo dzi ɖe mia ta, eye wole mia susum vevie le Mawu ƒe amenuveve geɖe si wòna mi la ta.
ENGLISH: 7 Each as he has his mind made up, not in annoyance nor under compulsion, for God "loves a cheerful giver. " 8 And God is powerful to make all grace superabound toward you, in order that you, always having in every respect all sufficiency for yourselves, may superabound to every good work 9 (as it is written "He scattered, gave to the poor, his sainthood lasts forever "; 10 and he who furnishes seed for the sower and bread for eating will furnish your sowings, and that abundantly, and make the produce of your right-doing grow), 11 enriched with everything for all liberality, which through you produces thanksgiving to God 12 because the dispensing of this service not only supplements the shortages of God’s people but also through many thanksgivings superabounds to God; glorifying God, 13 through the evidence of this ministration, with the good discipline of your professed allegiance to the gospel of the Christ, and the generousness of your solidarity to them and to everybody, 14 and their prayers for you as they yearn over you because of God’s surpassing grace upon you.

EWE: 15 Woada akpe na Mawu le eƒe nunana faa si wu gbɔgblɔ la ta.
ENGLISH: 15 Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift.

EWE: 2 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Corinthians

EWE: 10 Ke nye Paulo, metsɔ tufafa kple dɔmenyo si Kristo ɖe fia la le nu xlɔ̃m mi, nye ame si dzena ame beli ne mele mia ŋkume, gake menye dzinɔameƒotɔ ne nyemele mia gbɔ o. 2 Mele kuku ɖem be ne meva mia gbɔ la, mahiã be mawɔ nu dzideƒotɔe aɖe afɔ sesẽ aɖewo abe ale si mesusui ene ɖe ame siwo bua mí be míezɔna le ŋutilã nu la ŋu o. 3 Elabena togbɔ be míenye ŋutilãwo hã la, míewɔa aʋa le ŋutilã nu o.
ENGLISH: 10 And I Paul myself urge you by the Christ’s gentleness and reasonableness, I who face to face am a nobody among you, but at a distance am stouthearted toward you 2 but I beg that I may not at close quarters be stout with that assurance with which I reckon on venturing against some people, those who reckon us as walking in the way of flesh.

EWE: 4 Elabena míaƒe aʋawɔnuwo menye ŋutilã me tɔwo o, ke boŋ woƒe ŋusẽ tso Mawu gbɔ, be míatsɔ amu nu siwo li ke sesĩe la aƒu anyi. 5 Elabena míele tamebubuwo kple nu kɔkɔ sia nu kɔkɔ, si xea mɔ ɖe Mawu ŋuti sidzedze nu la mum ƒu anyi, eye míeɖea aboyo tamesusu ɖe sia ɖe be míana wòaɖo to Kristo la. 6 Eye míele dzadzraɖoɖi be, ne mienya ɖee fia be yewonye toɖolawo bliboe ko la, míahe to na ame sia ame si gbe toɖoɖo.
ENGLISH: 3 For, while we walk in flesh, we do not carry on our campaign in the way of flesh; 4 for the weapons of our campaigning are not fleshly but divinely powerful for the demolishing of fortified positions, 5 demolishing argumentations and every high structure raised against the knowledge of God and taking every idea prisoner into obedience to the Christ, 6 and all ready to deal out penalties for every noncompliance when your obedience has come to the full.

EWE: 7 Mieléa ŋku ɖe nuwo ŋu le ale si wodzena le gota gomee nu.
ENGLISH: 7 Look at what you see before your faces.

EWE: Ne ame aɖe ka ɖe eɖokui dzi be yenye Kristo tɔ la, nebu nyateƒenya sia hã ŋu: Ale si ko wònye Kristo tɔ la, nenema kee míawo hã míenye etɔe.
ENGLISH: If somebody feels confident that he belongs to Christ, let him think this over again to himself, that we belong to Christ just the same as he does.

EWE: 8 Elabena ne maƒo adegbe wòagbɔ eme vie wu ale si dze le ŋusẽ si Aƒetɔ la tsɔ na mí be míatsɔ atu mi ɖo, ke menye be míatsɔ agblẽ nu le mia ŋu o ŋuti hã la, nyemaɖu ŋukpe o. 9 Elabena nyemedi be wòanɔ abe ɖe metsɔ nye agbalẽwo le vɔvɔ̃ dom na mi ene o. 10 Elabena wogblɔna be: "Eƒe agbalẽwo kpena, eye ŋusẽ le wo ŋu, ke ne eya ŋutɔ le afi sia la, edzena ame beli, eye eƒe nyawo mele ɖeke me o. " 11 Nenem me ma nanyae be, nya siwo míegblɔna le míaƒe agbalẽwo me ne míele mia gbɔ o la, nu mawo kee míawɔ ne míele mia gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 8 For if I boast more or less freely about our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for demolishing you, I shall not be shamed; 9 not to speak as if I were sort of scaring you by my letters, 10 because "the letters, " he says, "are impressive and strong, but the personal presence is weak and the talk does not amount to anything. " 11 Let such a man think this over, that what we are like in talk by letters while absent is just what we are like in action when present.

EWE: 12 Elabena míete kpɔ be míabu mía ɖokui ɖe ame aɖewo dome, alo atsɔ mía ɖokui asɔ kple ame siwo kafua wo ɖokui la o. Gake esi wotsɔa wo ɖokui dzidzea wo ɖokui, eye wotsɔa wo ɖokui sɔna kple wo ɖokui la, womenyaa nu o.
ENGLISH: 12 For we do not venture to put ourselves in the same class with, or compare ourselves with, some of those who are recommending themselves; but they, measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves with themselves, do not see what is what.

EWE: 13 Ke hã, míeƒoa adegbe le dɔ si wowɔ le míaƒe liƒo godo la ŋu o, ke boŋ le liƒo si Mawu ɖo na mí la me, si de keke mia gbɔ ke.
ENGLISH: 13 But we will not boast beyond the range of measurement, but suitably to the measurement of the yardstick of the measure God gave us, to come clear through to you.

EWE: 14 Nyateƒee, menye ɖe míegbɔ míaƒe liƒo ŋu esi míeva mia gbɔ tsã abe ɖe míaƒe liƒo meɖo mia gbɔ o ene o, elabena míawoe nye ame gbãtɔ siwo tsɔ Kristo la ŋuti nya nyuia va keke mia gbɔ ke. 15 Ao, menye ame bubu ƒe agbagbadzedze le míaƒe liƒo godo ye míetsɔ le adegbe ƒom o, ke boŋ míele mɔ kpɔm be, esi miaƒe xɔse le sesẽm ɖe edzi la, miava kpɔe be dɔ si míewɔ la ava dzi ɖe edzi. Ekema míagawɔ dɔ gã geɖe awu, 16 be míagblɔ nya nyui la agbɔ mia ŋu ayi dukɔ bubuwo me, ale be míagaƒo adegbe le ame bubu ƒe nuto me, afi si wowɔ dɔ le xoxo la o.
ENGLISH: 14 For we are not overstretching ourselves, as we might be if we were not coming through to you; for we did get clear through to you in preaching the Christ’s gospel; 15 not boasting out of measure on the basis of other people’s hard work, but having a hope that as your faith grows we may be greatened in you, conformably to our yardstick, to a further extension, 16 to preach the gospel in the places out beyond you, not in somebody else’s yard to brag of ready-made progress.

EWE: 17 "Ke boŋ ame si ƒoa adegbe la, neƒo adegbe le Yehowa me. " 18 Elabena menye ame si kafua eɖokui la ŋue wokpɔa ŋudzedze ɖo o, ke ame si Yehowa kafuna la boŋ.
ENGLISH: 17 But "let him who boasts boast of the Lord. " 18 For it is not he who recommends himself that rates as up to the standard, but he whom the Lord recommends.

EWE: 2 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Corinthians

EWE: 11 Madi be miagbɔ dzi ɖi atsɔ nye nya siwo dze bometsinyawoe la.
ENGLISH: 11 I wish you would put up with a little bit of silliness from me; yes, do put up with me.

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, miele dzi gbɔm ɖi hã xoxo! 2 Elabena metsɔ mawumeŋuʋaʋã le ŋu ʋãm ɖe mia nu, elabena nye ŋutɔe do mia ɖeɖe ŋugbe na ŋutsu ɖeka, be matsɔ mi ana Kristo la abe ɖetugbui leaƒe dzadzɛ ene.
ENGLISH: 2 For I am jealous over you, feeling God’s jealousy.

EWE: 3 Ke mele vɔvɔ̃m be le mɔ aɖe nu la, ale si da la tsɔ eƒe ayedzedze ble Xawa la, ɖewohĩ woagblẽ miaƒe susu be miate ɖa tso anukwareɖiɖi kple dzadzɛnyenye si Kristo la dze na la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: For I betrothed you to one husband, to present you to Christ a pure virgin; 3 and I am afraid lest, as the snake befooled Eve by his trickery, your sentiments should be seduced away from Christ-directed single-mindedness and purity.

EWE: 4 Elabena ne ame aɖe va ɖe gbeƒã Yesu bubu aɖe si to vovo na esi míeɖe gbeƒãe, alo miexɔ gbɔgbɔ bubu aɖe si to vovo na esi miexɔ, alo nya nyui bubu aɖe si to vovo na esi miexɔ la, enɔa bɔbɔe na mi be miado dzi axɔ ame ma.
ENGLISH: 4 For if the one who comes preaches another Jesus whom we did not preach, or you get a different spirit that you did not get, or a different gospel that you did not receive, you are quite right in putting up with him.

EWE: 5 Elabena nyemesusu be miaƒe apostolo deŋgɔawo nyo wum le nu ɖeka pɛ hã me o.
ENGLISH: 5 For I figure that I have in no respect fallen behind the superlative apostles.

EWE: 6 Ke ne nyemebi le nuƒoƒo me o hã la, nyemele nenema le sidzedze ya me o; ke boŋ míena esia dze ƒãa na mi le mɔ sia mɔ nu le nuwo katã me.
ENGLISH: 6 And even if I am uneducated in talk I am not in knowledge, but in everything we have made it manifest by everything on all occasions among you.

EWE: 7 Alo nu vɔ̃e wònye mewɔ be mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye, ne woado mi ɖe dzi, esi megblɔ Mawu ŋuti nya nyui la na mi dzidzɔtɔe naneke maxɔmaxɔea? 8 Magblɔ be meba hame bubuwo esi melɔ̃ xɔ woƒe nunanawo, ale be masubɔ mi. 9 Evɔ esi menɔ mia gbɔ, eye nu hiãm la, nyemezu agba na mia dometɔ aɖeke o, elabena nɔvi siwo tso Makedonia va la na nu siwo hiãm la wòsɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 7 Or did I commit a sin by lowering myself to have you upraised, in that I preached God’s gospel to you gratis? 8 I looted other churches, taking pay for service to you; 9 and when I was there with you and was in want I did not squeeze anybody, for the brothers came from Macedonia and supplemented my shortage; and in everything I kept myself from being a load on you, and will do so.

EWE: 10 Zi ale si Kristo ƒe nyateƒea le menye la, nyemadzudzɔ esia tsɔtsɔ aƒo adegbee le Akaya nutoawo me o.
ENGLISH: 10 It is gospel truth what I am telling you, I am not going to have this boast blocked against me in the territories of Achaea.

EWE: 11 Le susu ka ta? Esi nyemelɔ̃ mi o taea?
ENGLISH: 11 Why? because I do not love you?

EWE: Mawu nyae be melɔ̃ mi.
ENGLISH: God knows.

EWE: 12 Ke nu si wɔm mele la, mayi edzi awɔe, ale be mana ame siwo le mɔnu dim be amewo nakpɔ be yewosɔ kpli mí le ɖoƒe sia la ƒe adegbeƒoƒo nu natsi.
ENGLISH: 12 But what I am doing and will do is in order to cut away the foothold of those who desire a foothold to start from, in order that in the point they boast of they may be found to be the same as we are.

EWE: 13 Elabena nenem me siawo nye aʋatso apostolowo, dɔwɔla siwo blea ame, eye wowɔa wo ɖokuiwo abe Kristo ƒe apostolowo ene. 14 Eye esia mewɔ nuku o, elabena Satana ŋutɔ hã wɔa eɖokui abe kekeli ƒe dɔla ene. 15 Eya ta ne eƒe subɔlawo hã wɔa wo ɖokuiwo abe subɔla dzɔdzɔewo ene la, mewɔ nuku kura o. Ke woƒe nuwuwu anɔ ɖe woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu.
ENGLISH: 13 For men of that sort are false apostles, tricky workmen, reshaping themselves into apostles of Christ’s 14 and no wonder, for Satan himself reshapes himself into an angel of light, 15 so it is no great thing if his agents too reshape themselves like agents of righteousness; their end will be suitable to their deeds.

EWE: 16 Megale egblɔm ake be: ame aɖeke megabum bometsilae o.
ENGLISH: 16 I say again, do not any of you think I am silly.

EWE: Gake ne nenemae miebui hã la, ekema mixɔm abe bometsila ene faa, ale be nye hã maƒo adegbe vie.
ENGLISH: But if you do, at least give me a silly man’s hearing so that I too may do a little boasting.

EWE: 17 Nya si gblɔm mele fifia la, nyemele egblɔm le kpɔɖeŋu si Aƒetɔ la ɖo la nu o, ke boŋ abe bometsila ene, abe adegbeƒola si ka ɖe eɖokui dzi ŋutɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 17 What I am saying I am not saying along the Lord’s line but, so to speak, in silliness, in this insistence on boasting.

EWE: 18 Esi ame geɖewo le adegbe ƒom le ŋutilã nu ta la, nye hã maƒo adegbe. 19 Esi mienye "nugɔmeselawo " ŋutɔ ta la, miedoa dzi xɔa bometsilawo dzidzɔtɔe. 20 Le nyateƒe me la, ne ame aɖe wɔ mi kluvii, ne ame aɖe ba mi xɔ miaƒe nunɔamesi, ne ame aɖe xɔ nu si le mia si la sesẽe, ne ame aɖe do eɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe mia ŋu, eye ne ame aɖe ƒo mo gbɔ na mi la, miedoa dzi tsɔnɛ.
ENGLISH: 18 Since many are boasting along the line of flesh, so will I. 19 For you do like to put up with silly people, you being so sensible; 20 for you put up with it if one enslaves you, if one eats you out of house and home, if one takes things, if one holds his head high, if one strikes you in the face.

EWE: 21 Enye ŋukpe na mí be magblɔ nya sia, elabena awɔ na mi be míewɔa nu abe ame siwo gbɔdzɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 21 I am speaking in terms of disrespect as if the point were that we had been weak.

EWE: Israel-viwoe wonyea? Eyae nye hã menye. Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwoe wonyea?
ENGLISH: But as to what anybody presumes on, I say in silliness, so do I presume.

EWE: Eyae nye hã menye. 23 Kristo ƒe subɔlawoe wonyea? Mele eŋu ɖom abe ame si ƒe tame da ene be, menyee wu wo: mewɔ dɔ geɖe wu, menɔ gaxɔ me zi geɖe wu, zi ale si woƒom la mele xexlẽ me o, eye meɖo kudo nu zi geɖe.
ENGLISH: 22 They are Hebrews so am I. They are Israelites so am I. They are descendants of Abraham so am I. 23 They are Christ’s messengers I am out of my senses to say it, more so I, with an uncommon amount of hard work, an uncommon number of imprisonments, a record-breaking number of beatings, a great number of deaths.

EWE: 24 Zi gbɔ zi atɔ̃ sɔŋ Yudatɔwo ƒom ƒoƒo blaene, ɖeka koe do le eme, 25 zi etɔ̃ woƒom kple ati, zi ɖeka woƒu kpem, menɔ tɔdziʋu me wògbã zi etɔ̃, metsi atsiaƒu dzi zã blibo ɖeka kple ŋkeke blibo ɖeka; 26 mezɔ mɔ enuenu, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le tɔsisiwo dzi, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le adzodalawo si me, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le nye ŋutɔ nye dukɔmeviwo dome, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le dukɔwo dome, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le du me, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le gbedzi, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le atsiaƒu dzi, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le aʋatsonɔviwo dome; 27 le agbagbadzedze kple kutrikuku me, le zãdomadɔlɔ̃e zi geɖe me, le dɔwuame kple tsikɔwuame me, le numakpɔɖui zi geɖe me, le vuvɔ kple amamanɔnɔ me.
ENGLISH: 24 At Jews’ hands I five times received forty stripes lacking one; 25 three times I was beaten with Roman rods; once I was stoned; three times I was shipwrecked, I have spent a day and a night in the deep; 26 often on the move, in dangers by rivers, dangers by robbers, dangers from those of my blood, dangers from foreigners, dangers in the city, dangers in the wilderness, dangers on the sea, dangers among pretended brothers, 27 in toil and drudgery, with many a sleepless night, with hunger and thirst, many times without anything to eat, with cold and nakedness.

EWE: 28 Hekpe ɖe nu siawo, siwo tso gota ŋu la, nane tena ɖe dzinye gbe sia gbe, eyae nye dzimaɖitsitsi ɖe hameawo katã ŋu.
ENGLISH: 28 Apart from the things outside me, there is what takes up my mind day after day, anxiety about all the churches.

EWE: Ame ka nue woɖia, eye meku dzi nam o? 30 Ne maƒo adegbe la, ekema maƒo adegbe le nu siwo me megbɔdzɔ le la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 29 Who is sick and I am not sick? who trips up and my face does not burn? 30 If I have to boast I will boast of things connected with my weakness.

EWE: 31 Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe Mawu, si nye Fofoa, Ame si wòle be woakafu yi mavɔmavɔ me la, nyae be nyemele aʋatso kam o. 32 Le Damasko la, nutodziɖula si le fia Areta te la nɔ Damaskotɔwo ƒe dua ŋu dzɔm, be yealém, 33 ke wotsɔm de kusi me ɖiɖi ɖe anyi to fesre aɖe si le glia ŋu la me, eye medo le eƒe asi me.
ENGLISH: 31 The Lord Jesus Christ’s God and Father knows, he who is blessed forever, that I am not lying: 32 at Damascus King Harithath’s sheik had a force in the city of the Damascenes to arrest me, 33 and I was let down in a basket through the wall by a window and escaped his hands.

EWE: 2 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Corinthians

EWE: 12 Ele be maƒo adegbe. Togbɔ be maɖe vi aɖeke o hã, matrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutega wɔnukuwo kple nyaɖeɖefiawo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 12 I have to boast; it is not good for me, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

EWE: 2 Menya ame aɖe si nye Kristo ƒe nusrɔ̃la, ƒe wuienee nye esia si wokɔe yi dziƒo etɔ̃lia ŋutilã mee wònɔ alo menye ŋutilã mee wònɔ o, nyemenya o; Mawue nya. 3 Ɛ̃, menya ame ma ŋutilã mee wònɔ alo menye ŋutilã mee wònɔ o, nyemenya o; Mawue nya 4 wokɔe yi paradiso me, eye wòse nya siwo mele gbɔgblɔ me o, eye womeɖe mɔ na ame be wòagblɔ o.
ENGLISH: 2 I know of a man in Christ fourteen years ago, whether in body I do not know or whether outside the body I do not know, God knows, of that person’s being snatched up to the third heaven; 3 and I know that man (whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows) 4 to have been snatched up into Paradise and heard unutterable words which it is not permissible for a man to speak.

EWE: 5 Maƒo adegbe le nenem me sia ŋu, ke nyemaƒo adegbe le ɖokuinye ŋu o, negbe le nye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo ŋu ko.
ENGLISH: 5 As to that person I will boast, but as to myself I will do no boasting except of my weaknesses.

EWE: 6 Elabena ne medi be maƒo adegbe hã la, nyemazu bometsila o, elabena nyateƒee mato. Ke nyemeƒoa adegbe o, ale be ame aɖeke nagakafum wu ale si wòkpɔam, alo le nya siwo wòsena le nunye la nu o, 7 eye woagakafum le nyaɖeɖefia wɔnuku siwo mexɔ dzaa ko ta o.
ENGLISH: 6 For if I do choose to boast I shall not be silly, for I shall be speaking the truth; but I am holding back for fear somebody should rate me above what he sees me to be or hears from me 7 by the very extraordinariness of the revelations.

EWE: Eya ta be magado ɖokuinye ɖe dzi akpa o la, ŋù aɖe le nye ŋutilã me, abe Satana ƒe dɔla ene, si le fu wɔmem, ale be magado ɖokuinye ɖe dzi akpa o.
ENGLISH: For which reason, in order that I may not feel too lofty, I was given a thorn for my flesh, a messenger of Satan’s to bang me about in order that I may not feel too lofty.

EWE: 8 Meɖe kuku na Aƒetɔ la vevie zi etɔ̃ le esia ŋuti be wòadzo le dzinye. 9 Gake egblɔ nam be: "Nye amenuveve sɔ gbɔ na wò, elabena nye ŋusẽ zua blibo le wò gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ me. "
ENGLISH: 8 As to this I appealed to the Lord three times to have it leave me; 9 and he has said to me "My grace suffices you; for power comes to its completion in weakness. "

EWE: Eya ta matsɔ dzidzɔ aƒo adegbe le nye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo ŋu boŋ, ale be Kristo la ƒe ŋusẽ nanɔ dzinye abe agbadɔ ene.
ENGLISH: Most gladly, then, will I boast rather of weaknesses, in order that the Christ’s power may settle on me.

EWE: 10 Eya ta mekpɔa dzidzɔ le gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo me, le dzudzuwo me, le hiãkamewo me, le yometitiwo kple xaxawo me, le Kristo ta.
ENGLISH: 10 For which reason I welcome weaknesses brutal treatment, necessities, persecutions, and tight pinches for Christ; for when I am weak, then I am powerful.

EWE: Elabena ne megbɔdzɔ la, ekema mesẽa ŋu. 11 Mezu bometsila.
ENGLISH: 11 I have become silly; you drove me to it.

EWE: Miawoe na, elabena ɖe wòle be miakafum hafi.
ENGLISH: For I ought to be getting recommendations from you.

EWE: Elabena ne nyemenye naneke o hã la, miaƒe apostolo deŋgɔawo menyo wum le nu ɖeka pɛ hã me o.
ENGLISH: For there is nothing in which I have fallen behind the superlative apostles, even if I do not amount to anything.

EWE: 12 Le nyateƒe me la, meɖe dzesi siwo ɖo kpe edzi be apostoloe menye la fia mi le dzidodo geɖe me, tsɔ kpe ɖe nukunuwo, dzesiwo kple ŋusẽdɔwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 12 The tokens of the apostle have been produced among you with all perseverance, by tokens and wonders and miracles.

EWE: 13 Elabena nu ka mee meve hame susɔeawo nu le wu mi? Eya koe nye be, nyemezu agba na miawo ya o.
ENGLISH: 13 For what point is there in which you were left worse off than the rest of the churches, except that I did not personally squeeze you? excuse me for this unfairness.

EWE: Mitsɔ vodada sia kem faa. 14 Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 14 This makes the third time now that I have been ready to come to you, and I will not squeeze you, for I am not after what is yours but after you.

EWE: Zi etɔ̃liae nye esia medzra ɖo be mava mia gbɔ, eye nyemava azu agba na mi o.
ENGLISH: For the children ought not to be laying by for the parents, but the parents for the children.

EWE: 15 Ke nye la, adzɔ dzi nam be mazã nye nuwo katã, eye woazãm bliboe, ɖe mia ta.
ENGLISH: 15 And I will most gladly spend and be expended for your souls.

EWE: Ne melɔ̃ mi geɖe wu la, ɖe wòle be miawo ya miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ nam dzi naɖe akpɔtɔa? 16 Ke aleke kee wòɖale o, nyemezu agba na mi o.
ENGLISH: If I specially love you am I less loved? 16 But say I did not burden you myself, but, foxy that I am, I caught you by trickery.

EWE: Gake miegblɔna be "ayetɔe " menye eye meto "amefuflu " dzi lé mi. 17 Ðe meto ame siwo medɔ ɖo ɖe mi la dometɔ aɖe dzi di viɖe le mia ŋua? 18 Mede dzi ƒo na Tito be wòava mia gbɔ, eye medɔ nɔvi aɖe kpe ɖe eŋu. Ðe Tito va di viɖe aɖe le mia ŋua? Menye nɔnɔme ɖekae nye kplii míeɖe fia oa?
ENGLISH: 17 Of those that I have sent to you has there been anyone through whom I took an advantage of you? 18 I invited Titus to go, and I sent the brother with him; did Titus take any advantage of you? did we not walk by the same spirit? in the same steps?

EWE: Menye afɔɖoƒe ɖeka ma ke mee míezɔ le oa? 19 Ðe miele susum le ɣeyiɣi siawo katã me be mía ɖokui ta ko ʋlim míele le mia gbɔa?
ENGLISH: 19 You have been thinking all along that it was to you we were making our defense; it is before God that we have been speaking in Christ.

EWE: Ke lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, nu siwo katã míewɔna la, miaƒe tutuɖo tae. 20 Elabena mele vɔvɔ̃m be le mɔ aɖe nu ne meva la, ɖewohĩ nyemakpɔ mi abe ale si madi ene o, eye be nyemanɔ na mi abe ale si miadi ene o, ke boŋ be dzre, ŋuʋaʋã, dzikudodowo, nyahehewo, ameŋugbegblẽwo, sakplisasawo, ɖokuidodoɖedziwo, kple masɔmasɔwo anɔ anyi le mɔ aɖe nu. 21 Ðewohĩ ne megava la, nye Mawu abɔbɔm ɖe anyi le mia ŋkume, eye maxa nu le ame siwo wɔ nu vɔ̃ tsã evɔ wo dometɔ geɖe metrɔ dzi me le woƒe makɔmakɔnyenye, gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu kple ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ dzimesesẽtɔe me o la ta.
ENGLISH: But everything, dear friends, has been for your upbuilding; 20 for I have been afraid that possibly when I come I may find you not such as I want to, and have you find me such as you do not want to; that possibly quarreling, jealousy, fits of passions, schemes of church politics, detractions, whisperings, inflated airs, disorders 21 that when I come again God is going to humble me in your presence and I am to mourn over great numbers of those who had previously sinned and have not repented over the nastiness and unchastity and indecency they have practiced.

EWE: 2 Korintotɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Corinthians

EWE: 13 Zi etɔ̃liae nye esia si megbɔna mia gbɔ. "Le ɖasefo eve alo etɔ̃ ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi nu la, woaɖo kpe nya sia nya dzi. " 2 Togbɔ be nyemele mia gbɔ fifia o hã, ɖeko wòle abe mele mia gbɔ zi evelia ene, eye mele nu xlɔ̃m ame siwo wɔ nu vɔ̃ tsã, kple ame susɔewo katã hã do ŋgɔ, be ne megava ake la, nyemakpɔ nublanui na wo o, 3 elabena miele kpeɖodzi dim si afia be Kristo le nu ƒom to dzinye vavã, Kristo si megbɔdzɔ le nuwɔwɔ kpli mi me o, ke boŋ wòsẽa ŋu le mia dome. 4 Elabena nyateƒee wònye be wohee ɖe ati ŋu le gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ ƒe nɔnɔme si me wònɔ ta, gake ele agbe le Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ta. Nyateƒee, míawo hã míegbɔdzɔ abe ale si eya hã nɔ nɔnɔme sia me tsã ene, gake míanɔ agbe kplii le Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ si wòɖe fia mi la ta.
ENGLISH: 13 This makes the third time I am coming to you, "Every point shall be established at the mouths of two witnesses, and of three. " 2 I have said beforehand, and am saying beforehand, the same now that I am away as when I was there the second time, that if I come again I will not spare, 3 since you are looking for evidence of the genuineness of the Christ who speaks in me 4 who is not weak toward you, but is powerful in you; for he was crucified as a result of weakness, but he is alive as a result of God’s power; for we too are weak in him but shall live with him as a result of God’s power toward you.

EWE: 5 Minɔ mia ɖokui dom kpɔ be miele xɔse la me hã; minɔ mia ɖokui me dzrom kpɔ ne mianya ame siwo ƒomevi mienye.
ENGLISH: 5 Make the test of yourselves, if you are in the faith; see about your own genuineness.

EWE: Negbe ɖe womekpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe mia ŋu o. 6 Mele mɔ kpɔm vavã be miava kpɔe adze sii be, menye ame siwo ŋu womekpɔ ŋudzedze ɖo o lae míenye o.
ENGLISH: Or do you not recognize in your own case that Jesus Christ is in you? unless you are counterfeit, 6 but I hope you will find that we are not counterfeits.

EWE: 7 Ke míedoa gbe ɖa na Mawu be miagawɔ nu gbegblẽ aɖeke o, menye be míawo míadze ame siwo ŋu wokpɔ ŋudzedze ɖo o, ke boŋ be miawɔ nu si nyo, ne míawo míedze ame siwo ŋu womekpɔ ŋudzedze ɖo o hã.
ENGLISH: 7 But we pray to God that you may not do anything bad, not in order that we may show up as genuine but that you may be doing what is good and we be as if we were counterfeits; 8 for we cannot do anything against the truth, but for the truth.

EWE: 8 Elabena míate ŋu awɔ naneke ɖe nyateƒe la ŋu o, negbe nu si ade nyateƒe la dzi ko. 9 Vavãe, ne míawo míegbɔdzɔ gake miawo miesẽ ŋu la, edzɔa dzi na mí.
ENGLISH: 9 For we are glad when we are weak but you are powerful; this is the very thing we are praying for, your advance to soundness.

EWE: Eye esiae míedoa gbe ɖa biana, be woaɖɔ mi ɖo. 10 Esia tae mele nya siawo ŋlɔm togbɔ be nyemele mia gbɔ o hã, ale be ne mele mia gbɔ la, nye asi nagasẽ ɖe mia dzi le ŋusẽ si Aƒetɔ la nam be matsɔ atu ame ɖo, ke menye be matsɔ agblẽ nu le ame ŋu o, la zazã me o.
ENGLISH: 10 That is why I write this while I am away, so that when I am there I may not act rigorously under the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for demolishing.

EWE: 11 Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, miyi edzi mianɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm, mina woanɔ mia ɖɔm ɖo, woanɔ akɔ fam na mi, miaƒe tamesusu nanɔ ɖeka, minɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me; eye lɔlɔ̃ kple ŋutifafa ƒe Mawu la anɔ anyi kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 11 For the rest, brothers, be joyous, sound, cheerful, unanimous, peaceful, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

EWE: 12 Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe do gbe na mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 12 Give my greetings to each other with a holy kiss.

EWE: 13 Ame kɔkɔewo katã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: 13 All God’s people send you greetings.

EWE: 14 Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve kple Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ kpakple gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe si ɖea vi na mí katã la, nanɔ kpli mi katã.
ENGLISH: 14 The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

EWE: Galatiatɔwo
ENGLISH: Galatians

EWE: 1 Paulo, si nye apostolo, menye tso amegbetɔwo gbɔ alo to ame aɖeke dzi o, ke boŋ to Yesu Kristo kple Mawu Fofo la, ame si fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la dzi, 2 kple nɔvi siwo katã le gbɔnye, le esia ŋlɔm na hame siwo le Galatia: 3 Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa si tso Mawu mía Fofo kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la woana mi. 4 Etsɔ eɖokui na ɖe míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ta, be wòaɖe mí tso fifi nuɖoanyi vɔ̃ɖi sia me le Mawu mía Fofo ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la nu, 5 ame si tɔ anye ŋutikɔkɔe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen.
ENGLISH: 1 Paul, an apostle not from men nor through a man but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised him from the dead, 2 and all the brothers who are with me, to the churches of Galatia: 3 Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ 4 who gave himself for our sins in order to take us out of the present vicious world in accordance with the will of our God and Father, 5 to whom be glory world without end; amen!

EWE: 6 Ewɔ moyaa nam be miele tɔtrɔm ɖa kaba ŋutɔ tso Ame si tsɔ Kristo ƒe amenuveve yɔ mi la gbɔ yina nya nyui bubu ƒomevi aɖe gbɔ. 7 Evɔ nya nyui bubu aɖeke meli o; ke boŋ ɖeko ame aɖewo le fu ɖem na mi, eye wole didim be yewoabaɖa afɔ na Kristo ŋuti nya nyui la.
ENGLISH: 6 I wonder that you are so quickly shifting from the Christ who called you in grace to another gospel, 7 which is not another one, unless there are some who are disturbing you and wanting to turn the gospel of the Christ another way.

EWE: 8 Ke ne míawo alo mawudɔla si tso dziƒo gɔ̃ hã agblɔ nya aɖe be enye nya nyui to vovo na nya nyui si míegblɔ na mi la, neɖi eŋu kpékpekpe.
ENGLISH: 8 But even if we, or if an angel from heaven, preaches to you a gospel inconsistent with the gospel we preached, let him be for God’s destruction.

EWE: 9 Abe ale si míegblɔe do ŋgɔ ene la, megale egblɔm ake be, ame sia ame si va le nya nyui si to vovo na esi miexɔ la gblɔm na mi la, neɖi eŋu kpékpekpe.
ENGLISH: 9 As we have said before, now too I say again, if anyone preaches to you a gospel inconsistent with what you did have given to you, let him be for God’s destruction.

EWE: 10 Ekema amegbetɔwo ŋue medi be madze loo alo Mawu ŋua?
ENGLISH: 10 For am I now persuading men or God? or am I aiming to please men?

EWE: Alo ɖe mele didim be nye nu nanyo amegbetɔwo ŋua?
ENGLISH: If I were still pleasing men I should not be Christ’s property.

EWE: 11 Nɔviwo, medi be mana mianyae be, nya nyui si megblɔ na mi la, metso amegbetɔwo gbɔ o; 12 eye menye amegbetɔ si me hãe mexɔe tsoe alo woawoe fiam o, ke boŋ nyaɖeɖefia wònye tso Yesu Kristo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 11 And I give you notice, brothers, as to the gospel preached by me that it is not along human lines; 12 for I did not even take it over nor receive teaching from a man, but through a revelation of Jesus Christ.

EWE: 13 Nyateƒee, miese nu tso ale si menɔ agbee tsã abe Yudatɔ ene la ŋu, be meti Mawu ƒe hame la yome vevie, eye menɔ edome gblẽm; 14 eye meyi ŋgɔ geɖe le Yudasubɔsubɔ me wu hanyeti geɖewo le nye dukɔ la me, elabena medo vevie nu le mía fofowo ƒe kɔnyinyiwo me geɖe wu.
ENGLISH: 13 For you have heard about my life back in my Jewish days, that I was extraordinarily active in persecuting and ravaging God’s church, 14 and went further in Jewishness than a good many in my race who were of my age, being a very special zealot for the traditions I had from my fathers.

EWE: 15 Ke esi Mawu, ame si na danye dzim eye wòyɔm le eƒe amenuveve me la, kpɔe be enyo 16 be yeaɖe ye Vi la afia to dzinye, ale be magblɔ eŋuti nya nyui la na dukɔwo la, nyemeyi ɖalée kpɔ kple amegbetɔ aɖeke enumake o; 17 eye nyemeyi Yerusalem ɖe ame siwo nye apostolowo do ŋgɔ nam la hã gbɔ o, ke boŋ meyi Arabia, emegbe megatrɔ va Damasko.
ENGLISH: 15 But when he who had set me apart before I was born and had called me by his grace was pleased 16 to reveal his Son in me in order that I might preach his gospel among the nations, at once I did not consult flesh and blood 17 nor go up to Jerusalem to those who had been apostles before me but went off into Arabia, and came back again to Damascus.

EWE: 18 Le ƒe etɔ̃ megbe la, meyi Yerusalem be maɖakpɔ Kefas ɖa, eye menɔ egbɔ ŋkeke wuiatɔ̃. 19 Ke nyemegakpɔ apostolo bubuawo dometɔ aɖeke o, negbe Yakobo, Aƒetɔ la nɔvi ko.
ENGLISH: 18 Then, after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to look up Cephas, and stayed at his house a fortnight, 19 but did not see another of the apostles, except the Lord’s brother James.

EWE: 20 Ke le nu siwo ŋlɔm mele na mi ŋuti la, meka ɖe edzi na mi le Mawu ŋkume be menye aʋatso kam mele o.
ENGLISH: 20 And in what I am writing to you God knows I am not lying.

EWE: 21 Emegbe meyi Siria kple Kilikia nutoawo me.
ENGLISH: 21 Then I came into the Syrian and Cilician neighborhood.

EWE: 22 Ke Yudea hame siwo le Kristo me la mekpɔm kpɔ o. 23 Ðeko wosena be: "Ame si tia mía yome tsã la le xɔse si dome wòdi be yeagblẽ tsã la ŋu nya nyui gblɔm azɔ. " 24 Ale wonɔ Mawu kafum le tanye.
ENGLISH: 22 But I was unknown by face to the churches of Christ in Judea; 23 but they only heard "He who once persecuted us is now preaching the gospel of the faith he used to ravage, " 24 and glorified God over me.

EWE: Galatiatɔwo
ENGLISH: Galatians

EWE: 2 Azɔ le ƒe wuiene megbe la, megayi Yerusalem, nye kple Barnaba, eye mekplɔ Tito hã ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 2 Then, after fourteen years, I went up to Jerusalem again with Barnabas, taking Titus along too.

EWE: 2 Nyaɖeɖefia aɖe si mexɔ tae meyi ɖo, eye megblɔ nya nyui si ƒe gbeƒã ɖem mele na dukɔwo la na wo. Ke hã meɖe kpɔ ame ŋkutawo ɖeɖe hegblɔe na wo, ne wòagadzɔ be ɖe mele du ƒum alo be meƒu du dzodzro o. 3 Gake womeƒoe ɖe Tito si le ŋunye gɔ̃ hã nu be wòatso aʋa o, togbɔ be Helatɔe wònye hã.
ENGLISH: 2 And I went up in accordance with a revelation; and I laid before them the gospel I am proclaiming among the nations, but privately before those who had reputations, for fear that I should be or had been running a bootless course; 3 but there was no requirement that even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, should be circumcised.

EWE: 4 Gake nya sia fɔ ɖe te esi aʋatsonɔviwo va tra ɖe eme dzaa hele mɔnu dim be yewoagblẽ ablɔɖe si le mía si le Kristo Yesu me la me, ale be woawɔ mí kluviwoe keŋkeŋ; 5 míeɖe mɔ ame siawo kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe mía dzi o, ao, míeɖe mɔ na wo vie hã o, ale be nya nyui la ƒe nyateƒe la nanɔ mia me ɖaa.
ENGLISH: 4 But because of the intrusive false brothers who had intruded themselves to spy on our liberty that we have in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us, 5 to whom we did not for a moment give way in submission, in order that the truth of the gospel might remain with you.

EWE: 6 Ke ame siwo wobuna ame veviwoe ame kawo ƒomevi woɖanye tsã o, ema mele vevie nam o, elabena Mawu mewɔa nu ɖe ame ŋu le eƒe dzedzeme nu o ​nyemesrɔ̃ nu yeye aɖeke tso ame mawo siwo wobuna ame ŋkutawoe la gbɔ o. 7 Ke boŋ esi wokpɔ be wotsɔ nya nyui la de asi nam na ame siwo nye aʋamatsomatsotɔwo, abe ale si ko wotsɔe de asi na Petro hã hena aʋatsotsotɔwo ene, 8 elabena ame si na ŋusẽ Petro be wòanye apostolo na ame siwo tso aʋa la kee na ŋusẽ nye hã hena dukɔwo me tɔwo, 9 eye esi wova de dzesi ale si wove nunyee la, Yakobo, Kefas kple Yohanes, ame siwo wobuna sɔtiwoe la, na asi nye kple Barnaba tsɔ ɖee fia be yewowɔ ɖeka kpli mí, be míawo míayi dukɔwo gbɔ, ke yewo yewoayi aʋatsotsotɔwo gbɔ. 10 Negbe ɖeko wobia tso mía si be míanɔ ame dahewo ŋu bum, eye esia tututue medoa vevie wɔna. 11 Ke esi Kefas va Antiokia la, mehe nya ɖe eŋu ŋkume kple ŋkume, elabena edze ƒãa be etɔ medzɔ o. 12 Elabena hafi ame aɖewo natso Yakobo gbɔ ava la, eɖua nu kple dukɔwo me tɔwo; ke esi wova ɖo ko la, edzudzɔ heɖe eɖokui ɖe vovo le vɔvɔ̃ na aʋatsotsotɔwo ta.
ENGLISH: 6 But from those who had the reputation of being something (what they were makes no difference to me; God does not defer to a man’s personality) for those who had reputations propounded nothing to me, 7 but on the contrary, as they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel message for the uncircumcised as Peter had with that for the circumcised, 8 for he who had inspired Peter to the apostleship for the circumcised had inspired me too to the nations, 9 and finding the grace that had been given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who had the reputation of being pillars, shook hands with Barnabas and me on a partnership, we to address ourselves to the nations and they to the circumcised; 10 only we were to remember the poor, which is just what I have made a point of doing.

EWE: 13 Yudatɔ susɔeawo hã wɔ ɖeka kplii le alakpanuwɔwɔ sia me, ale be wohe Barnaba gɔ̃ hã kpe ɖe wo ɖokui ŋu le woƒe alakpanuwɔwɔa me. 14 Ke esi mekpɔ be womele zɔzɔm le nya nyui la ƒe nyateƒe la nu o la, megblɔ na Kefas le wo katã ŋkume be: "Ne wò, ame si nye Yudatɔ, nènɔa agbe abe dukɔwo me tɔwo ene, eye menye abe Yudatɔ ene o la, aleke nàte ŋu aƒoe ɖe dukɔwo me tɔwo nu be woanɔ agbe ɖe Yudatɔwo ƒe kɔnyinyiwo nu? " 15 Mí ame siwo nye Yudatɔwo tso dzɔdzɔme eye míenye nu vɔ̃ wɔla siwo tso dukɔwo dome o la, 16 míenyae be womebua ame be ele dzɔdzɔe to se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me o, ke boŋ to Yesu Kristo dzi xɔxɔ se me ko. Eya ta míexɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se, ale be woabu mí ame dzɔdzɔewoe le Kristo dzi xɔxɔ se me, ke menye le se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ta o, elabena womabu ame aɖeke be ele dzɔdzɔe to se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me o.
ENGLISH: 11 But when Cephas came to Antioch I opposed him face to face because he was recognizably in the wrong; 12 for before a certain person came from James he ate together with the foreigners, but when he came he flinched and separated himself, being afraid of the circumcised party, 13 and the rest of the Jews played the hypocrite together with him, so that even Barnabas was carried along with their hypocrisy; 14 but when I saw that they were not taking a straight line by the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas before everybody "If you, when you are a Jew, are living in foreign fashion and not in Jewish, how is it you are forcing the foreigners to go Jewish? 15 We, as by natural birth Jews and not sinful foreigners, 16 but knowing that a man is not justified as the outcome of deeds in observance of the law but only through faith in Jesus Christ, even we put our faith in Jesus Christ in order that we might be justified as the outcome of faith in Christ and not of deeds under the law, because out of the deeds under the law no mortal will be justified.

EWE: 17 Ke ne wokpɔ míawo ŋutɔwo hã be míenye nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo esi míele didim be woabu mí ame dzɔdzɔewoe to Kristo dzi la, ekema nu vɔ̃ dzi demee Kristo lea? Gbeɖe! 18 Ne nu siwo tututu memu ƒu anyi tsã la tumee megale la, ekema meɖee fia be menye vodala.
ENGLISH: 17 But if in seeking to be justified in Christ we ourselves have been found sinful too, then Christ is an auxiliary to sin! away with the thought! 18 For if I build up again what I did break down, I certify myself a transgressor.

EWE: 19 Elabena meto se la me ku na se la, be magbɔ agbe na Mawu.
ENGLISH: 19 As for me, through the law I died to the law in order that I might be alive to God.

EWE: 20 Wohem ɖe ati ŋu kpe ɖe Kristo ŋu. Meganye nyee le agbe o, ke boŋ Kristo ye le agbe le menye. Ɛ̃, agbe si mele fifia le ŋutilã me la, to Mawu ƒe Vi si lɔ̃m eye wòtsɔ eɖokui na ɖe tanye la dzi xɔxɔ se mee meli ɖo.
ENGLISH: 20 I have been crucified with Christ; and no longer I am alive, but Christ is alive in me; and insofar as I am now alive in flesh I am alive in faith on the Son of God who loved me and gave himself up for me.

EWE: 21 Nyemegbe Mawu ƒe amenuveve la o, elabena ne se la dzie woato anɔ dzɔdzɔe la, ekema Kristo ku dzodzro.
ENGLISH: 21 I do not disregard God’s grace. For if there is righteousness through the law, then Christ died superfluously. "

EWE: Galatiatɔwo
ENGLISH: Galatians

EWE: 3 Oo, Galatiatɔ movitɔwo! Ame kae le ŋusẽ gbegblẽ sia kpɔm ɖe mia dzi, mi ame siwo ŋkume woɖee fia kɔtɛ le be wohe Yesu Kristo ɖe ati ŋu? 2 Nu si ko dim mele be manya tso mia gbɔ lae nye esi: Se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ dzie mieto xɔ gbɔgbɔ la loo alo to nya si miese la dzi xɔxɔ se dzie? 3 Ðe miedzɔ movi nenema gbegbea? Esi miedze egɔme le zɔzɔm le gbɔgbɔ me la, ɖe miawu enu le ŋutilã mea? 4 Ðe mieto fukpekpe geɖe mawo gbegbe me dzodzroa? Mate ŋu anye dzodzro o. 5 Ekema ame si naa gbɔgbɔ la mi eye wòwɔa ŋusẽdɔwo le mia dome la, ɖe wòwɔnɛ le esi miewɔa se la ƒe dɔwo ta loo alo esi miexɔ nu si miese la dzi se taea? 6 Abe ale si Abraham "xɔ Yehowa dzi se, eye wobui dzɔdzɔenyenye nɛ " ene. 7 Mienyae nyuie be ame siwo si xɔse le lae nye Abraham ƒe viwo.
ENGLISH: 3 You stupid Galatians, who hypnotized you, you who had had it advertised before your eyes that Jesus Christ was crucified? 2 I want to find out this one thing from you: was it as the outcome of deeds in observance of the law that you received the Spirit or was it as the outcome of listening in faith? 3 Are you so stupid as this? when you began by Spirit are you now finishing by flesh? 4 Did you undergo so much for nothing? if for nothing it was! 5 Does he who furnishes the Spirit to you, then, and who works miracles among you, do it as the outcome of deeds in observance of the law or as the outcome of listening in faith? 6 As Abraham "believed God, and it was counted as righteousness for him. " 7 Know, then, that it is the men of faith who are sons of Abraham.

EWE: 8 Ke esi ŋɔŋlɔ la kpɔe do ŋgɔ be Mawu abu dukɔwo me tɔwo ame dzɔdzɔewoe le xɔse ta la, egblɔ nya nyui la na Abraham do ŋgɔ be: "Dziwòe woato ayra dukɔwo katã. " 9 Eya ta wole ame siwo si xɔse le la yram kpe ɖe Abraham xɔsetɔ la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 And the text, foreseeing that God is justifying the nations as the outcome of faith, gave Abraham the anticipatory gospel message "In you all the nations shall be blessed, " 9 so that the men of faith are blessed with believing Abraham.

EWE: 10 Ame siwo katã ɖoa ŋu ɖe se ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu la, wole fiƒode te, elabena woŋlɔ ɖi be: "Aɖi ame sia ame si mezɔna ɖe nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe Segbalẽa me hewɔa wo dzi o la ŋu. " 11 Eye edze ƒãa be womebua ame aɖeke ame dzɔdzɔe to se la dzi le Mawu gbɔ o, elabena "ame dzɔdzɔe la ƒe xɔsee ana wòanɔ agbe. " 12 Ke menye xɔse dzie wotu Se la ɖo o. Ke boŋ "ame si wɔa nu siawo dzi la ato wo dzi anɔ agbe. " 13 Kristo ƒle mí heɖe mí tso Se la ƒe fiƒode la me esi wòva zu fiƒodeme ɖe mía teƒe, elabena woŋlɔ ɖi be: "Ame sia ame si wohe ɖe ati ŋu la, fiƒode le edzi. " 14 Esia va eme ale be Abraham ƒe yayra la nava to Kristo Yesu dzi na dukɔwo, be míaxɔ gbɔgbɔ si ŋugbe wodo la to míaƒe xɔse me.
ENGLISH: 10 For as many as are on the basis of deeds in observance of the law are under a curse; for it says "Accursed is everyone who does not persist in everything written in the book of the law to live up to it. " 11 And that in the law nobody is justified in God’s presence is obvious, because "the righteous man shall have life by virtue of faith " 12 and the law is not by virtue of faith but "he who practices them shall have life by them. " 13 Christ bought us off from the curse of the law, becoming a curse for us (because it says "anyone hanging on wood is accursed "), 14 that in Jesus Christ Abraham’s blessing might be on the nations, that we might receive the promised gift of the Spirit through faith.

EWE: 15 Nɔviwo, mele kpɔɖeŋu aɖe si ku ɖe amegbetɔwo ŋu wɔm: Ne wonya ɖo kpe nubabla aɖe dzi ko la, ne amegbetɔe wɔe hã la, ame aɖeke megatea fli ɖe eme alo tsɔa naneke kpenɛ o.
ENGLISH: 15 Brothers, I speak from a human point of view; it is the same with a human engagement: when it has been validated, nobody ignores it or adds new conditions to it.

EWE: 16 Ke wodo ŋugbeawo na Abraham kple eƒe dzidzimevi. Megblɔ be: "Kple dzidzimeviwo, " abe ame geɖewoe ene o, ke boŋ ɖeka ko: "Kple wò dzidzimevi, " si nye Kristo.
ENGLISH: 16 But the promise was uttered to Abraham "and his seed " he does not say "and seeds " as referring to many, but, as referring to one, "and your seed, " who is Christ.

EWE: 17 Mele gbɔgblɔm hã be: Se si wova de ƒe alafa ene kple blaetɔ̃ megbe la, mete fli ɖe Mawu ƒe nubabla si do ŋgɔ la me ne wòaɖe ŋugbedodo la ɖa o.
ENGLISH: 17 And this is what I am saying: when an engagement had been previously validated by God, the law that came into existence four hundred and thirty years later could not invalidate it so as to supersede the promise.

EWE: 18 Elabena ne se la dzie wotu domenyinyi la ɖo la, ekema meganye ŋugbedodo dzie wotui ɖo o; ke boŋ ɖe Mawu to ŋugbedodo dzi tsɔe na Abraham dɔmenyotɔe.
ENGLISH: 18 For if the inheritance is on the basis of a law it is no longer on the basis of a promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by a promise.

EWE: 19 Ekema nu ka tae Se la li ɖo?
ENGLISH: 19 How about the law then?

EWE: Wotsɔe kpe ɖe eŋuti, ne wòana vodadawo nadze, va se ɖe esime dzidzimevi si ŋu ŋugbedodoa ku ɖo la nava ɖo; eye woto mawudɔlawo dzi tsɔe na to domenɔla aɖe si me.
ENGLISH: It was added with a view to transgressions, until the Seed to whom the promise was made should come, and was prescribed through angels by the hand of an intermediary.

EWE: 20 Ke domenɔla menɔa anyi, ne ame ɖeka ko ŋue wòku ɖo o, evɔ Mawu ɖeka koe.
ENGLISH: 20 But an intermediary is not the intermediary of one. But God is one.

EWE: 21 Ekema ɖe Se la tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋugbedodowo ŋua? Gbeɖe!
ENGLISH: 21 So is the law in antagonism to God’s promises? away with the thought!

EWE: Elabena ne ɖe wona se si ate ŋu ana agbe la, anye ne dzɔdzɔenyenye ato se dzi ava. 22 Ke Ŋɔŋlɔ la tsɔ nuwo katã de nu vɔ̃ te, ale be woatsɔ ŋugbedodo, si tsoa Yesu Kristo dzi xɔxɔ se me la, ana ame siwo xɔa edzi sena.
ENGLISH: For if there had been given a law that could bring life, righteousness would really be by the law; 22 but the text has shut up everything under sin in order that as the outcome of faith in Jesus Christ the fulfillment of the promise might be given to those who believe.

EWE: 23 Ke hafi xɔse la nava ɖo la, se la nɔ mía ŋu dzɔm, eye wotsɔ mí de eƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te, eye míenɔ mɔ kpɔm na xɔse si woava ɖe afia la. 24 Ale Se la va zu míaƒe mɔfiala si kplɔa mí yia Kristo gbɔ, ale be woabu mí ame dzɔdzɔewoe le xɔse ta.
ENGLISH: 23 But before faith came we were kept in custody under the law, shut up to be ready for the faith that was going to be revealed, 24 so that the law has been our conductor to Christ in order that we might be justified on the basis of faith.

EWE: 25 Ke esi xɔse la va ɖo azɔ la, míegale mɔfiala aɖeke te o.
ENGLISH: 25 But now that faith has come we are no longer under a conductor.

EWE: 26 Le nyateƒe me la, mi katã mienye Mawu ƒe viwo le esi miexɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se ta.
ENGLISH: 26 For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

EWE: 27 Elabena mi ame siwo katã wonyrɔ ɖe Kristo me la, miedo Kristo. 28 Yudatɔ alo Helatɔ meli o, kluvi alo ablɔɖeme meli o, ŋutsu alo nyɔnu meli o, elabena ame ɖekae mi katã mienye hewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu.
ENGLISH: 27 For all you who have been baptized to Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ; 28 there is no such thing as Jew or Greek, there is no such thing as slave or free, there is no such thing as male and female, for all of you are one in Christ Jesus.

EWE: 29 Eye ne mienye Kristo tɔ la, ekema Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwoe mienye vavã, domenyilawo mienye le ŋugbedodo nu.
ENGLISH: 29 And if you belong to Christ, then you are seed of Abraham, heirs by promise.

EWE: Galatiatɔwo
ENGLISH: Galatians

EWE: 4 Ke mele gbɔgblɔm be, zi ale si domenyila la kpɔtɔ nye ɖevi sue ko la, vovototo aɖeke kura mele eya kple kluvi dome o, togbɔ be eyae nye nuwo katã ƒe aƒetɔ hã, 2 ke boŋ ele vidzikpɔlawo kple aƒedzikpɔlawo te, va se ɖe ŋkeke si fofoa ɖo ɖi la dzi. 3 Nenema kee míawo hã, esime míenye ɖevi suewo la, xexea ƒe gɔmedzenuwo wɔa mí kluviwoe.
ENGLISH: 4 But, I am saying, for so long as the heir is an infant he is no different from a slave though he is master of everything, 2 but is under guardians and stewards until the date that the father sets; 3 in the same way we, when we were infants, were enslaved under the elementary things of the world.

EWE: 4 Ke esi ɣeyiɣi la de keŋkeŋ la, Mawu dɔ Via ɖo ɖa, ame si nyɔnu aɖe dzi, eye wònɔ se te, 5 ne wòaƒle ame siwo le se la te ahaɖe wo, ale be woaxɔ mí abe viwo ene.
ENGLISH: 4 But when the full time had elapsed God sent out his Son, born of a woman, born under the law, 5 to buy off those who were under the law, so that we might receive our adoption as sons.

EWE: 6 Ke esi mienye viwo ta la, Mawu ɖo Via ƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖe míaƒe dziwo me, eye gbɔgbɔ sia doa ɣli be: "Abba, Fofo! " 7 Eya ta mèganye kluvi o, ke boŋ vi nènye; eye ne vi nènye la, ekema domenyila hã nènye to Mawu dzi.
ENGLISH: 6 And because you are sons God sent out his Son’s spirit into our hearts crying "Abba, " Father. 7 So that you are no longer a slave but a son, and if a son, an heir too through God.

EWE: 8 Ke ɣemaɣi, esime mienya Mawu o la, mienye kluviwo na nu siwo dze ƒãa be womenye mawuwo o la.
ENGLISH: 8 But then, not knowing God, you were in slavery to those who in nature are not gods.

EWE: 9 Ke azɔ, esi mieva nya Mawu, alo esi Mawu boŋ va nya mi la, aleke wɔ miegale tɔtrɔm ɖe gɔmedzenu gbɔdzɔ maɖinuawo ŋu, eye miele didim be yewoagazu woƒe kluviwo ake? 10 Miele ŋku lém ɖe ŋkekewo, ɣletiwo, azãgbewo kple ƒewo ŋu tsitotsito.
ENGLISH: 9 But now when you do know God, or rather are known by God, how is it you are turning back again to the weak and cheap elementary things, to which you want to be in slavery over again? 10 you watch days and months and dates and years.

EWE: 11 Mele vɔvɔ̃m ɖe mia nu be medze agbagba dzodzro ɖe mia ta mahĩ.
ENGLISH: 11 I am afraid of you, that I may have done my hard work on you for nothing.

EWE: 12 Nɔviwo, mele kuku ɖem na mi be, minɔ abe nye ene, elabena nye hã menɔ abe miawo ene tsã.
ENGLISH: 12 Become like me, because I myself am becoming like you, brothers, I beg you.

EWE: Mieda vo aɖeke ɖe ŋunye o. 13 Ke mienyae be nye lãmegbegblẽ aɖee ʋu mɔ ɖi nam be magblɔ nya nyui la na mi zi gbãtɔ. 14 Eye togbɔ be nye lãmegbegblẽa zu tetekpɔ na mi hã la, miedo vlom alo nyɔ ŋum o; ke boŋ miexɔm abe mawudɔla ene, abe Kristo Yesu ene.
ENGLISH: You did me no wrong; 13 but you know it was because of a physical infirmity that I preached the gospel to you in the first place; 14 and you were not provoked to scorn or disgust by the temptation to you in my bodily condition, but received me like an angel of God, like Jesus Christ.

EWE: 15 Afi kae dzidzɔ ma si miekpɔ tsã la le fifia?
ENGLISH: 15 What has become of your self-congratulation, then? for I am your witness that if it had been possible you would have dug out your own eyes and given them to me.

EWE: Elabena mele ɖase ɖim le mia ŋu be, ne ɖe wòanya wɔ la, anye ne mieho miaƒe ŋkuwo le to me tsɔ nam.
ENGLISH: 16 So that I have become your enemy by telling you the truth!

EWE: 16 Ke fifia ɖe mezu miaƒe futɔ le esi meto nyateƒe na mi taa? 17 Ame aɖewo le ʋiʋlim vevie be yewoana miatrɔ ɖe yewo ŋu, menye kple susu nyui o; ke boŋ be yewoaɖe mi ɖa le ŋunye, ale be miadi be yewoadze woawo boŋ yome.
ENGLISH: 17 They are jealous of you, not in a good sense, but they want to shut you out in order that you may be jealous of them.

EWE: 18 Ke enyo be ame aɖe natsɔ susu nyui aʋli vevie ɣesiaɣi be miatrɔ ɖe ye ŋu, eye menye ne mele mia gbɔ ɖeɖe ko o; 19 vinyewo, mele veve sem le mia ta abe ale si fu ɖua nyɔnu ene, va se ɖe esime Kristo ƒe nɔnɔme nasu mia si.
ENGLISH: 18 But it is a good thing to have people’s jealousy in a good cause at all times and not only while I am there with you, 19 my children, with whom I am in birth-pangs again till Christ takes shape in you.

EWE: 20 Ðe madi be manɔ mia gbɔ fifi laa, ne maƒo nu le mɔ bubu nu hafi, elabena metɔtɔ le mia ta.
ENGLISH: 20 But I wish I could be there with you now and change my tone, because I am at my wit’s end about you.

EWE: 21 Migblɔe nam, mi ame siwo di be yewoanɔ se te, ɖe miese nu si Se la gblɔ oa? 22 Le kpɔɖeŋu me, woŋlɔe ɖi be vi eve nɔ Abraham si, ɖeka nye kosi la ƒe vi, eye evelia nye ablɔɖenyɔnu la ƒe vi; 23 ke esi kosi la dzi la, wodzii abe ale si ko wòle le dzɔdzɔme nu ene, eye ekemɛ si ablɔɖenyɔnua dzi la, nye esi ƒe ŋugbe wodo. 24 Nu siawo nye kpɔɖeŋu si wotsɔ ɖe nu tɔxɛ aɖe fia; elabena nyɔnu siawo le tsitre ɖi na nubabla eve, ɖeka tso Sinai To la dzi, si dzia vi hena kluvinyenye, eye eyae nye Hagar.
ENGLISH: 21 Tell me, you that want to be under the law, do you not hear the law? 22 For the text says Abraham had two sons, one by the slave-girl and one by the freewoman, 23 but the one by the slave-girl had been begotten in the way of flesh and the one by the freewoman through a promise: 24 which things are said allegorically; for these are two covenants, one from Mount Sinai, producing children for slavery, which is Hagar 25 (and Sinai is a mountain in Arabia); and it corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for that is in slavery with its children.

EWE: 25 Ke Hagar le tsitre ɖi na Sinai, si nye to le Arabia, eye wòsɔ kple egbegbe Yerusalem, elabena eya kple viawo le kluvinyenye me. 26 Ke wona ablɔɖe Yerusalem si le dzi ya, eye eyae nye mía dada. 27 Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi be: "Wò, konɔ si medzi vi o, dzi nedzɔ wò; gli kple dzidzɔ, wò nyɔnu si melé ku kpɔ o; elabena nyɔnu si wogblẽ ɖi la ƒe viwo sɔ gbɔ wu nyɔnu si gbɔ srɔ̃a le la ƒe viwo. " 28 Ke azɔ la, nɔviwo, ŋugbedodo la ƒe viwo mienye abe Isak ene.
ENGLISH: 26 But the Jerusalem above is free, which is our mother; 27 for it says "Jubilate, barren woman who bore no children; break loose and shout, you that felt no birth-pangs; because the deserted mother’s children outnumber those of the husbanded mother. " 28 And you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of a promise; 29 but just as then the one born in the way of flesh persecuted the one born in the way of spirit, 30 so now but what does the text say?

EWE: 29 Ke ale si ko ame si wodzi le dzɔdzɔme nu ti ame si wodzi le gbɔgbɔ la nu yome ɣemaɣi la, nenema kee wògale fifia hã.
ENGLISH: "Turn out the slave-girl and her son, for the slave-girl’s son shall not inherit along with the freewoman’s! "

EWE: 30 Gake nya kae ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ? "Nya kosi la kple via ɖa, elabena kosi la ƒe vi manyi dome kple ablɔɖenyɔnu la ƒe vi akpɔ o. " 31 Eya ta nɔviwo, menye kosi ƒe viwoe míenye o, ke boŋ ablɔɖenyɔnu la ƒe viwoe míenye.
ENGLISH: 31 Wherefore, brothers, we are not children of a slave-girl but of the freewoman.

EWE: Galatiatɔwo
ENGLISH: Galatians

EWE: 5 Ablɔɖe sia tae Kristo na ablɔɖe mí ɖo. Eya ta minɔ te sesĩe, eye migana woatsɔ kluvinyenye ƒe kɔkuti ade kɔ na mi ake o.
ENGLISH: 5 It was to freedom that Christ liberated us; so stand firm and do not be held in a yoke of slavery again.

EWE: 2 Kpɔ ɖa, nye, Paulo mele egblɔm na mi be, ne miena wotso aʋa na mi la, ekema Kristo meganye viɖe aɖeke na mi o.
ENGLISH: 2 Here, it is I, Paul, that am telling you: if you get circumcised, Christ will not do you any good at all.

EWE: 3 Megale ɖase ɖim na ame sia ame si ana woatso aʋa nɛ la be, agba le edzi be wòawɔ Se blibo la katã hã dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 And again I declare to every man who gets circumcised that he owes the performance of the whole of the law.

EWE: 4 Mi ame siwo katã le agbagba dzem be woabu mi ame dzɔdzɔewo to sea dzi la, woklã mi ɖa le Kristo gbɔ; miedo le eƒe amenuveve la te. 5 Ke míawo la, míeto gbɔgbɔ la dzi le dzɔdzɔenyenye, si tsoa xɔse me, si míele mɔ kpɔm na la lalam vevie.
ENGLISH: 4 You are disengaged from Christ, you who are being justified by the law; you have dropped out of grace; 5 for we by the Spirit await on the basis of faith a hope of justification.

EWE: 6 Elabena ame siwo le Kristo Yesu me la, asixɔxɔ aɖeke mele aʋatsotso alo aʋamatsomatso ŋu na wo o, hafi boŋ xɔse si wɔa dɔ le lɔlɔ̃ me ŋue.
ENGLISH: 6 For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any effect, but faith active through love.

EWE: 7 Mienɔ dua ƒum nyuie. Ame kae xe mɔ na mi be miagayi edzi aɖo to nyateƒe la o? 8 Menye Ame si le mia yɔm la gbɔe nyaƒoɖeamenu sia ƒomevi tso o.
ENGLISH: 7 You were running finely; who interfered with you to keep you from obeying truth? 8 the pressure is not from the one who is calling you.

EWE: 9 Amɔwɔʋãnu vi aɖe nana amɔwɔ blibo la katã ʋãna.
ENGLISH: 9 A little piece of yeast makes all the dough yeasty.

EWE: 10 Meka ɖe edzi be, mi ame siwo le Aƒetɔ la me la, miegbɔna miaƒe susu trɔ ge o; ke ame si le fu ɖem na mi la, ame ka kee wòɖanye o, akpɔ eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ si wòdze na.
ENGLISH: 10 But I am confident of you in the Lord that you will not take any other attitude; but he who is disturbing you shall bear the sentence he gets, whoever he is.

EWE: 11 Nye la, nɔviwo, ne ɖe megale gbeƒã ɖem aʋatsotso la, ke nu ka tae wogale yonyeme tim kokoko? Ekema woɖe fuwɔametia ŋuti nuɖiaɖia la ɖae.
ENGLISH: 11 But why am I, brothers, still being persecuted, if I am still preaching circumcision? then the difficulty of the cross is shelved.

EWE: 12 Ðe madi be ame siwo le agbagba dzem be yewoatrɔ miaƒe susu la nana woata woawo ŋutɔwo hafi.
ENGLISH: 12 It would be a good thing if those who are unsettling you would do something more to themselves than circumcision.

EWE: 13 Nɔviwo, ablɔɖe tae woyɔ mi ɖo; ɖeko migaɖe mɔ ablɔɖe sia nazu mɔnukpɔkpɔ na mi miakplɔ ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzrowo ɖo o, ke boŋ misubɔ mia nɔewo abe kluviwo ene le lɔlɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: 13 For you, brothers, were called on terms of liberty; only do not make liberty an opening for the flesh, but be in slavery to each other through love.

EWE: 14 Elabena woƒo Se blibo la katã nu ƒu ɖe sedede ɖeka sia me be: "Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene. " 15 Ke ne miele mia nɔewo ɖum, eye miele mia nɔewo mim la, mikpɔ nyuie be miagatsrɔ̃ mia nɔewo o.
ENGLISH: 14 For all of the law is fulfilled in one proposition, to love one’s neighbor as one’s self. 15 But if you bite and eat each other, look out that you do not get used up by each other.

EWE: 16 Ke mele egblɔm be: Miyi edzi miazɔ le gbɔgbɔ me, ekema miele ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzro aɖeke dzi wɔ ge o.
ENGLISH: 16 But I am saying, walk by the Spirit and you shall not fulfill the desire of flesh.

EWE: 17 Elabena ŋutilã la ƒe nudzodzro tsia tsitre ɖe gbɔgbɔ la ŋu, eye gbɔgbɔ la ɖe ŋutilã la ŋu; nu siawo tsia tsitre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu, ale be miagawɔ nu siwo tututu miadi be yewoawɔ hafi la o.
ENGLISH: 17 For the flesh feels desire against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these two are opposed to each other in order that you may not do whatever you wish.

EWE: 18 Azɔ hã, ne gbɔgbɔ lae le mia kplɔm la, ekema miele se la te o.
ENGLISH: 18 But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

EWE: 19 Ŋutilã la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo dze ƒãa keŋ, eye woawoe nye gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu, makɔmakɔnyenye, ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ dzimesesẽtɔe, 20 trɔ̃subɔsubɔ, gbɔgbɔyɔyɔ, kewɔwɔ, dzrewɔwɔ, ŋuʋaʋã, dɔmedzoedodowo, nyahehewo, mamawo, kɔmamawo, 21 ŋubiabiã, ahamumu, aglotutu siwo gbɔ eme kple nu siawo tɔgbi. Mele nu xlɔ̃m mi ku ɖe nu siawo ŋu do ŋgɔ, abe ale si mexlɔ̃ nu mi xoxo ene be, ame siwo wɔa nu siawo la, womanyi Mawu Fiaɖuƒe la dome o.
ENGLISH: 19 And the activities of the flesh are plain, which are unchastity, nastiness, indecency, 20 idolatry, witchcraft, hatreds, quarreling, jealousy, fits of passion, schemes of church politics, factions, dissensions, 21 envying, getting drunk, wild parties, and things similar to these; as to which I forewarn you, just as I did, that those who do such things will not inherit the Reign of God.

EWE: 22 Ke gbɔgbɔ la ƒe kutsetse ye nye lɔlɔ̃, dzidzɔ, ŋutifafa, dzigbɔgbɔ blewu, dɔmenyonyo, nyuiwɔwɔ, xɔse, 23 tufafa, ɖokuidziɖuɖu.
ENGLISH: 22 But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, 23 meekness, self-mastery; against such things there is no law.

EWE: 24 Azɔ hã, ame siwo nye Kristo Yesu tɔ la he ŋutilã kpakple eƒe dzodzrowo kple didiwo ɖe ati ŋu.
ENGLISH: 24 And those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its susceptibilities and desires.

EWE: 25 Ne gbɔgbɔ nue míele agbe nɔm ɖo la, ekema mina míayi edzi azɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu le gbɔgbɔ me hã. 26 Migana míanɔ bubu dzodzro dim, anɔ ho ʋlim kple mía nɔewo, ahanɔ ŋu biãm mía nɔewo o.
ENGLISH: 25 If we are alive by the Spirit, let us guide ourselves by the Spirit; 26 let us not grow pretentious, challenging each other, envying each other.

EWE: Galatiatɔwo
ENGLISH: Galatians

EWE: 6 Nɔviwo, ne ame aɖe ɖe afɔ baɖa aɖe hafi va nya gɔ̃ hã la, mi ame siwo dze le gbɔgbɔ me la, midze agbagba miaɖɔ amea ɖo le gbɔgbɔ fatu me. Ke nɔ ɖokuiwò dzi kpɔm nyuie be woagate wò ŋutɔ hã kpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 6 Brothers, if a person does get swept into some offense, straighten him out, you spiritual ones, in the spirit of meekness, having an eye to yourself for fear you too should be tempted.

EWE: 2 Miyi edzi miakpe ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu le miaƒe agba kpekpewo tsɔtsɔ me, ale miawɔ Kristo la ƒe se la dzi bliboe.
ENGLISH: 2 Carry each other’s burdens, and so you will fulfill Christ’s law.

EWE: 3 Elabena ne ame aɖe susuna be yenye nane, evɔ menye naneke o la, eɖokui ko blem wòle.
ENGLISH: 3 For if one thinks he is something when he is nothing, he is deluding himself.

EWE: 4 Ke ame sia ame nadzro eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuwɔnawo me kpɔ, ekema akpɔ susu si ta wòatso aseye le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ɖeɖe ŋu, ke menye le eɖokui tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple ame bubu me o.
ENGLISH: 4 But let each test his own work, and then he will have his boast with regard to himself alone and not to the other man; 5 for each will be carrying his own pack.

EWE: 5 Elabena ame sia ame atsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe agba. 6 Ame sia ame si wofia nya lae la, nekpɔ gome kple ame si fiae la le nu nyuiwo katã me.
ENGLISH: 6 But let him who receives instruction in the word share everything good with his instructor.

EWE: 7 Migana woable mi o: Mawu menye ame si woate ŋu aflu o. Elabena nu si ame ƒãna la, esia kee wòaŋe; 8 elabena ame si le nu ƒãm na eƒe ŋutilã la, aŋe gbegblẽ tso eƒe ŋutilã me, ke ame si le nu ƒãm na gbɔgbɔ la, aŋe agbe mavɔ tso gbɔgbɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 7 Make no mistake, there is no thumbing your nose at God; for a man will reap just the same that he sows, 8 because he who sows into his own flesh will reap out of the flesh decay, but who sows into the Spirit shall reap out of the Spirit eternal life.

EWE: 9 Eya ta migana míadzudzɔ nu si nyo la wɔwɔ o, elabena ne ɖeɖi mete mía ŋu o la, míaŋe nu le ɣeyiɣi si sɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 And let us not give up doing what is good, for at the right time reap we shall if we do not weaken.

EWE: 10 Eya ta zi ale si mɔnukpɔkpɔa kpɔtɔ li la, mina míawɔ nyui na amewo katã, ke vevietɔ na ame siwo do ƒome kpli mí le xɔse la me.
ENGLISH: 10 So then let us, as we have opportunity, practice good deeds toward everybody, and especially toward the members of our family of faith.

EWE: 11 Mikpɔ ale si nye ŋutɔ metsɔ nye asi ŋlɔ nya siawo wòloloe na mi la ɖa!
ENGLISH: 11 See in what large letters I am writing to you with my own hand.

ENGLISH: 4 One body and one Spirit, as you were called in one hope too that belongs to your call; 5 one Lord, one faith, one baptism; 6 one God and Father of all, he who is over all and among all and in all.

EWE: 7 Ke wove mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nu le Kristo la ƒe nunana faa si wòdzidze na mí la nu. 8 Elabena egblɔ be: "Esi wòlia yi dzi ʋĩi la, ekplɔ aboyomewo yii; ena nunana siwo nye amewo. " 9 Ke nu ka fiam nya si nye "wòlia yi dzi " la le, ne menye be eɖi va anyi me hã, si nye anyigba dzi oa? 10 Ame si tututu ɖi va la kee lia yi dzi ʋĩi wògbɔ dziƒowo ƒe dziƒo ŋu, ale be wòana nuwo katã nazu blibo. 11 Eye wòna ame aɖewo wonye apostolowo, ɖewo nye nyagblɔɖilawo, ɖewo nye nyanyuigblɔlawo, eye ɖewo nye alẽkplɔlawo kple nufialawo, 12 kple susu be woana hehe ame kɔkɔewo hena subɔsubɔdɔ wɔwɔ, na Kristo la ƒe ŋutilã tutu ɖo, 13 va se ɖe esime mí katã míaɖo xɔse ƒe ɖekanyenye gbɔ, eye míaɖo Mawu ƒe Vi la ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ gbɔ azu ame siwo tsi blibo ahaɖo tsitsime blibo si gbɔ Kristo ɖo la gbɔ; 14 ale be míaganye ɖeviwo ne nufiafia ƒe ya sia ya si ƒona yina gbɔna la nanɔ mía nyamam abe ƒutsotsoewo ene, to amewo ƒe beble kple amefuflu ayetɔe me o. 15 Ke boŋ mina míato nyateƒe, ale be míato lɔlɔ̃ me atsi le nuwo katã me le Kristo, si nye ta la me. 16 Eya gbɔe wòtso be wokpe ŋutilã blibo la ɖekae pɛpɛpɛ, eye wona wòle dɔ wɔm ɖekae esi eƒe kpeƒekpeƒewo katã le woƒe akpa dzi wɔm. Ne ŋutinu ɖe sia ɖe wɔa eƒe dɔ nyuie la, ewɔnɛ be ŋutilã la tsina le esi wòtua eɖokui ɖo le lɔlɔ̃ me ta.
ENGLISH: 7 But each one of us had grace given him in the measure of the Christ’s gift; 8 which is why it says "he went up on high, brought a train of captives, gave presents to men. " 9 And what does "went up " mean if not that he also came down to the lower parts, of the earth? 10 He who came down, he is the one also who went up clear above all the heavens so that he should fill everything; 11 and he gave some to be apostles and some to be prophets and some to be preachers of the gospel and some to be pastors and teachers 12 for the sound training of God’s people, for the work of service for the upbuilding of the Christ’s body, 13 until all of us attain to the oneness of the faith and of awareness of the Son of God, to a grown-up man to the measure of the adulthood of the fullness of the Christ, 14 in order that we may no longer be infants, tossed and driven about by every wind of doctrine in men’s jugglery of tricks governed by the devices of error, 15 but, telling truth in love, may every way grow up into him, him who is the head, Christ, 16 out of whom all the body, fitted together and conjoined by every joint which connects the supply, in accordance with the working of each individual part in measure, produces the growth of the body to its self-upbuilding in love.

EWE: 17 Eya ta nya si gblɔm mele hele ɖase ɖim le eŋu le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ mee nye be, miagayi edzi anɔ zɔzɔm abe ale si dukɔwo hã zɔna le woƒe tamesusu gbɔlowo me la ene o. 18 Woƒe tamesusu do viviti, eye wole adzɔge na agbe si tso Mawu gbɔ, le esi numanyamanya xɔ aƒe ɖe wo me, eye woƒe dzi ku atri hã ta. 19 Naneke megakpea ŋu na wo o, eye woɖe asi le wo ɖokuiwo ŋu na ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ dzimesesẽtɔe, ale be woanɔ nu makɔmakɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi wɔwɔ dzi kɔmaɖimaɖii.
ENGLISH: 17 So this I say and protest in the Lord, that you are no longer to go the same way as the heathen do in their fatuousness of mind, 18 darkened in their thinking as they are, cut off by unrelation from God’s life because of the ignorance they have in them because of their lumpish-heartedness men who, 19 having lost all sensitiveness, have given themselves up to indecency to work at every sort of foulness as a competitive business.

EWE: 20 Ke miawo la, menye alea miesrɔ̃e be Kristo la le o, 21 ne vavãe miese eŋu nya, eye woto edzi fia nu mi, abe ale si nyateƒe la le Yesu me ene. 22 Wofia nu mi be miaɖe amenyenye xoxo si sɔ ɖe miaƒe agbenɔnɔ tsãtɔ nu, si le gbegblẽm le eƒe nudzodzro fluamewo nu, la ɖa. 23 Ke minɔ miaƒe tamesusu ƒe nɔnɔme si kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe mia dzi wɔm yeyee, 24 eye miado amenyenye yeye si wowɔ le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu nu le dzɔdzɔenyenye kple nuteƒewɔwɔ vavãtɔ me la.
ENGLISH: 20 But it was not in that fashion that you learned the Christ; 21 not if you heard of him and were taught in him as is truth in Jesus, 22 that as regards your former way of life you are to throw off the old man who is going bad along the line of the desires he is fooled into, 23 and be renewed in the spirit of your mind 24 and put on the new man who along God’s line has been created in the righteousness and godliness of truth.

EWE: 30 Eye miganɔ nuxaxa dom na Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe, si wotsɔ tre mia nu hena ŋkeke si dzi woato tafe la dzi aɖe mi la o. 31 Miɖe ameléleɖedɔme kaɖikaɖi, dɔmedzoe, dziku, ɣlidodo, kple nya veame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ɖa le mia dome hekpe ɖe nu sia nu si gblẽa nu le ame ŋu la ŋuti. 32 Ke boŋ minyo dɔme na mia nɔewo, miaƒe dɔme netrɔ ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu vevie, eye mitsɔ nɔ mia nɔewo kem faa, abe ale si ko Mawu hã to Kristo dzi tsɔ ke mi faa ene.
ENGLISH: 25 For which reason, laying aside falsehood, each speak truth with his neighbor, because we are organs of each other; 26 "be angry and do not sin, " let the sun not go down on your exasperation, 27 and do not give the Devil a chance; 28 let him who has been stealing no longer steal but rather labor, putting his hands to work at what is good, in order to have something he can share with the one who is in need; 29 let no foul talk go out of your mouths, but any that is good, tending to the required upbuilding, to impart grace to the hearers, 30 and do not grieve God’s Holy Spirit in which you have had the seal set on you to be ready for the day of redemption; 31 let all crossness and passionateness and anger and loud and abusive language be cleared away from you, with all viciousness, 32 and be kind to each other, good-hearted, mutually making allowances in the same way as God in Christ showed grace to you.

EWE: Efesotɔwo
ENGLISH: Ephesians

EWE: 5 Eya ta mizu Mawu srɔ̃lawo abe via lɔlɔ̃awo ene, 2 eye miyi edzi miazɔ le lɔlɔ̃ me, abe ale si ko Kristo la hã lɔ̃ mí, eye wòtsɔ eɖokui na ɖe mía ta wònye nunana kple vɔsa si le ʋeʋẽm lilili na Mawu la ene.
ENGLISH: 5 So be imitators of God like dear children, 2 and walk in love in the same way as the Christ loved you, and gave himself up for us as an offering and sacrifice of genial odor to God.

EWE: 3 Migana woayɔ gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu kple makɔmakɔnyenye aɖeke ƒomevi alo ŋukeklẽ ŋkɔ gɔ̃ hã le mia dome o, abe ale si ko wòdze ame kɔkɔewo ene; 4 kple ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ kple bometsinyagbɔgblɔ kple fefenya madzeto, siwo mesɔ o, ke akpedada boŋ.
ENGLISH: 3 But let unchastity and any sort of uncleanness or grasping greed not be even named among you, as befits people of God’s; 4 and obscenity and foolery or ribaldry, which are not proper things; but rather, proper thankfulness.

EWE: 5 Elabena miawo ŋutɔwo mienya nyuie be, domenyinyi aɖeke meli na ame si ƒoa eɖokui ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me alo ame makɔmakɔ alo ŋuklẽla si sɔ kple trɔ̃subɔla le Kristo la kple Mawu ƒe Fiaɖuƒe la me o.
ENGLISH: 5 For know this well, that any unchaste or unclean person or greedy grasper, which is the same as to say idolater, does not have an inheritance coming to him in the reign of Christ and God.

EWE: 6 Migana ame aɖeke natsɔ nya ƒuƒluwo able mi o, elabena nu siawo tae Mawu ƒe dziku gbɔna vi sẽtowo dzi ɖo.
ENGLISH: 6 Let nobody deceive you with empty words; for it is on account of these things that God’s anger comes upon the sons of disobedience, 7 so do not be sharers in them.

EWE: 7 Eya ta migade ha kpli wo o; 8 elabena tsã la, mienye viviti, ke azɔ miezu kekeli le Aƒetɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 8 For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord.

EWE: 10 Midze agbagba ɖe sia ɖe be nu siwo miewɔna la nadze Aƒetɔ la ŋu; 11 eye midzudzɔ gomekpɔkpɔ le viviti me dɔ matsekuwo me; ke miʋu go wo boŋ. 12 Elabena enye ŋukpe be woaƒo nu le nu siwo wowɔna le ɣaɣlaƒe la ŋu gɔ̃ hã.
ENGLISH: Walk as children of light 9 (for the fruit of the light is in every goodness and righteousness and truth), 10 studying what is pleasing to the Lord; 11 and do not be a party to the unfruitful doings of the darkness rather even expose their character.

EWE: 13 Ke nu sia nu si dzena wokpɔna la kekelie na, elabena nu sia nu si dze ƒãa la, enye kekeli. 14 Esia tae wogblɔ be: "Oo, wò ame si le alɔ̃ dɔm, nyɔ, eye nàfɔ tso ame kukuwo dome, eye Kristo la aklẽ ɖe dziwò. "
ENGLISH: 12 For it is ugly even to mention the things that are done in hiding by them; 13 but everything when it has its character exposed comes into view by the light; for everything that comes into view is light; 14 which is why it says "Wake, you sleeper, and rise from the dead, and the Christ shall beam upon you. "

EWE: 15 Eya ta mikpɔ nyuie be ale si miezɔna la naganye abe numanyalawo ene o, ke boŋ abe nunyalawo ene, 16 eye miwɔ miaƒe ɣeyiɣi ŋu dɔ le mɔ nyuitɔ nu, elabena ŋkekeawo nye vɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 15 So look to it carefully how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, 16 making the best you can of the crisis, because the days are wicked.

EWE: 17 Le esia ta miganɔ nu wɔm abe bometsilawo ene o, ke boŋ miyi edzi miakpɔ nu si nye Yehowa ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu adze sii.
ENGLISH: 17 For this reason do not be silly, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
