EWE: 18 Eye migamu aha, si me nu baɖabaɖa wɔwɔ le la o, ke boŋ mina gbɔgbɔ la nayɔ mi fũu. 19 Mitsɔ psalmowo, Mawu kafukafu nyawo kple gbɔgbɔmehawo ƒo nu na mia nɔewo, midzi ha, eye miƒo ha le miaƒe dziwo me na Yehowa, 20 eye minɔ akpe dam na mía Mawu kple Fofo la le nuwo katã ŋuti ɣesiaɣi le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ me. 21 Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia nɔewo le Kristo vɔvɔ̃ me. 22 Srɔ̃nyɔnuwo nabɔbɔ wo ɖokuiwo na wo srɔ̃wo, abe ale si woabɔbɔ na Aƒetɔ la ene, 23 elabena ŋutsue nye ta na srɔ̃a, abe ale si Kristo la hã nye ta na hame la ene, eye eyae nye ŋutilã sia ɖela.
ENGLISH: 18 And do not get stimulated with wine, which carries dissipation with it, but be filled by the Spirit, 19 talking together in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making music in your hearts to the Lord, 20 giving thanks always for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God the Father, 21 submissive to each other in the fear of Christ; 22 wives to their husbands as they are to the Lord, 23 because a husband is the wife’s head the same as the Christ is the church’s.

EWE: 24 Le nyateƒe me la, ale si hame la bɔbɔa eɖokui na Kristo la, srɔ̃nyɔnuwo hã nabɔbɔ wo ɖokuiwo na wo srɔ̃wo nenema ke le nuwo katã me.
ENGLISH: He is the savior of the body; 24 but as the church is submissive to the Christ, so let the wives also be to their husbands, in everything.

EWE: 25 Srɔ̃ŋutsuwo, miyi edzi mialɔ̃ mia srɔ̃wo abe ale si ko Kristo la hã lɔ̃ hame la, eye wòtsɔ eɖokui na ɖe eta ene, 26 ale be wòakɔ eŋuti, aklɔ eŋu wòadza to Mawu ƒe nya la me, 27 be wòatsɔ hame la aɖo eya ŋutɔ ŋkume le eƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo me, eye ɖiƒoƒo alo ayiléle alo nu siawo tɔgbi aɖeke manɔ eŋu o, ke boŋ wòanɔ kɔkɔe, eye mokaka aɖeke naganɔ eŋu o.
ENGLISH: 25 Husbands, love your wives, as the Christ in his case loved the church, and gave himself up for it 26 in order to hallow it, cleansing it by the bath of water with a word, 27 so that he might himself present the church to himself a glorious creature without a spot or a wrinkle or anything of the sort, but holy and flawless; 28 so ought husbands too to love their wives as they do their own bodies.

EWE: Ŋutsu si lɔ̃a srɔ̃a la lɔ̃a eɖokui, 29 elabena ame aɖeke melé fu eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã kpɔ o, ke boŋ enyinɛ, eye wòléa be nɛ nyuie, abe ale si ko Kristo la hã wɔna na hame la ene, 30 elabena ŋutinuwo míenye na eƒe ŋutilã.
ENGLISH: He who loves his wife is loving himself; 29 for nobody ever hated his own flesh, but one feeds it up and keeps it warm, just as the Christ does with the church 30 because we are organs of his body.

EWE: 31 "Esia tae ŋutsu agblẽ fofoa kple dadaa ɖi, eye wòaku ɖe srɔ̃a ŋu, eye wo ame evea woazu ŋutilã ɖeka. " 32 Nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe sia lolo. Ke Kristo kple hame la ŋue mele nu ƒom le.
ENGLISH: 31 "Owing to this a man will leave father and mother and enter into a connection with his wife, and the two will become one flesh "; 32 this secret truth is a great one.

EWE: 33 Gake srɔ̃ŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe nalɔ̃ srɔ̃a abe ale si wòlɔ̃a eɖokui ene; ke srɔ̃nyɔnu hã nade bubu deto srɔ̃a ŋu.
ENGLISH: I am saying it with reference to Christ and the church; 33 let each of you individually too, though, love his wife just as he does himself.

EWE: Efesotɔwo
ENGLISH: Ephesians

EWE: 6 Mi ɖeviwo, miɖo to mia dzilawo le Aƒetɔ la me, elabena esia le eteƒe.
ENGLISH: 6 Children, obey your parents in the Lord; for this is right.

EWE: 2 "Bu fofowò kple dawò, " esia nye sedede gbãtɔ si ŋu ŋugbedodo kpe ɖo: 3 "Ne eme nanyo na wò, eye nànɔ anyigba la dzi eteƒe nadidi. " 4 Mi fofowo, miganɔ dziku dom na mia viwo o, ke boŋ miyi edzi mianɔ wo hem le Yehowa ƒe amehehe kple nuxɔxlɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: 2 "Honor your father and mother, " which is the first commandment with a promise, 3 "so that it may be well with you and your time may be long on the earth. " 4 And fathers, do not be provoking to your children, but bring them up with the instruction and admonition of the Lord.

EWE: 5 Kluviwo, mikɔ dzi me miaɖo to amegbetɔ siwo nye miaƒe aƒetɔwo le vɔvɔ̃ kple dzodzo nyanyanya me, abe ale si miawɔ na Kristo la ene, 6 menye le ameŋkumenuwɔwɔ me be miadze ame ŋu ko o, ke boŋ abe Kristo ƒe kluvi siwo wɔa Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu tso luʋɔ blibo me ene. 7 Miwɔ miaƒe kluvidɔ la kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa abe Yehowa ye miele ewɔm na ene, ke menye na amewo o, 8 elabena mienyae be nu nyui sia nu nyui si ame wɔna la, eya kee wòaxɔ tso Yehowa gbɔ, eɖanye kluvi alo ablɔɖeme o.
ENGLISH: 5 Servants, obey those who are your masters in the way of flesh with fear and trembling in single-heartedness as you do the Christ, 6 not in the way of eye-service as man-pleasers do but as servants of Christ’s, doing God’s will whole-souledly, 7 serving in a friendly spirit as doing it for the Lord and not for men, 8 knowing that each one, if he does anything good, will have it coming to him from the Lord, be he slave or freeman.

EWE: 9 Eye mi aƒetɔwo hã, miyi edzi mianɔ nu wɔm ɖe wo ŋu nenema ke, eye midzudzɔ ŋɔdzidodo na wo, elabena mienyae be mia kpli wo siaa ƒe Aƒetɔ le dziƒo, eye ameŋkumekpɔkpɔ aɖeke mele egbɔ o.
ENGLISH: 9 And masters, do the same toward them, going easy as to threatening, knowing that in the heavens is the master of them and of you, and there is no favoritism with him.

EWE: 10 Mlɔeba la, miyi edzi miasẽ ŋu ɖe edzi le Aƒetɔ la kple eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la me. 11 Mido aʋawɔnu blibo si tso Mawu gbɔ la, be miate ŋu anɔ te sesĩe ɖe Abosam ƒe aɖaŋu vɔ̃wo nu; 12 elabena míele kame tem, menye kple ʋu kpakple ŋutilã o, ke boŋ mía kple dziɖuɖuwo, ŋusẽwo, xexe doviviti sia me dziɖulawo kple gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽ vɔ̃ɖi siwo le dziƒonutowo me lae le kame tem. 13 Le esia ta mido aʋawɔnu blibo si tso Mawu gbɔ la, ne miate ŋu anɔ te le ŋkeke vɔ̃ la dzi, eye ne miewu nuwo katã nu vɔ la, mianɔ tsitre sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 10 Henceforth be valiant in the Lord and in the mightiness of his strength; 11 put on God’s armor so that you can stand up to the Devil’s devices, 12 because our match is not with flesh and blood but with the governments, the dominions, the cosmocrats of this darkness, the spiritual essences of wickedness in the heavenly sphere; 13 for this reason take God’s armor in order to be able to defend yourselves on the wicked day, and after you have fought every bit through to stand your ground.

EWE: 14 Eya ta minɔ tsitre sesĩe, eye mitsɔ nyateƒe ƒe alidziblanu la bla miaƒe aliwo dzi, eye mido dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe akɔtakpoxɔnu la, 15 eye mitsɔ dzadzraɖo ɖe ŋutifafa nya nyuia gbɔgblɔ ŋu do ɖe miaƒe afɔwo. 16 Gawu la, milé xɔse ƒe akpoxɔnu gã, si miatsɔ atsi vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe aŋutrɔ bibiawo katã nu la ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 14 So stand your ground with your waists belted with truth and wearing the cuirass of righteousness, 15 and with your feet shod with preparation for carrying the gospel of peace; 16 withal taking the shield of faith, on which you will be able to quench all the flaming missiles of the Evil One.

EWE: Eya ŋuti minɔ ŋudzɔ ɣeawokatãɣi ne mianɔ kokoƒoƒo dzi ɖe ame kɔkɔewo katã ta. 19 Mido gbe ɖa ɖe nye hã tanye, be ne meke nu la, mate ŋu aƒo nu faa dzideƒotɔe, ale be mana woanya nya nyui la ƒe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe la, 20 nya nyui si ƒe amedɔdɔ menye hele kɔsɔkɔsɔwo me ɖo, ne dzi naɖo ƒonye maƒo nu tso eŋu abe ale si dze ene.
ENGLISH: 17 And receive the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is God’s word; 18 praying in the Spirit at every time with every kind of prayer and petition and keeping on the alert for it with all intentness and fullness of petition regarding all God’s people, 19 and for me, that I may be given power to speak with open mouth to make known outspokenly the secret 20 for which I am an ambassador in chains, that I may speak it out as I ought.

EWE: 21 Ke be miawo hã mianya ale si nɔnɔmeawo le le gbɔnye, kple ale si mele la, nɔvi lɔlɔ̃tɔ Tikiko, si nye subɔla nuteƒewɔla le Aƒetɔ la me la, ana mianya nuwo katã. 22 Mele edɔm ɖe mia gbɔ le susu sia tututu ta, be mianya ale si míele ne wòafa akɔ na mi.
ENGLISH: 21 But in order that you may know of my affairs, how I am getting on, Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful errand-runner in the Lord, will acquaint you with everything; 22 I have sent him to you for this express purpose, to let you know about us and to let him cheer your hearts.

EWE: 23 Ŋutifafa kple lɔlɔ̃, si ŋu xɔse kpe ɖo la, natso Mawu Fofo la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ na nɔviawo.
ENGLISH: 23 Peace to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 24 Amenuveve nanɔ kple ame siwo katã si lɔlɔ̃ si nu metsina o le na mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la.
ENGLISH: 24 Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ imperishably.

EWE: Kolosetɔwo
ENGLISH: Colossians

EWE: 1 Paulo, Kristo Yesu ƒe apostolo to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, kple mía nɔvi Timoteo, 2 le esia ŋlɔm na ame kɔkɔewo kple nɔvi nuteƒewɔla siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo le Kolose:
ENGLISH: 1 Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through God’s will, and Brother Timothy, 2 to the holy and believing brothers in Christ at Colossae: grace to you, and peace, from God our Father.

EWE: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa si tso Mawu mía Fofo gbɔ la, woana mi. 3 Míedaa akpe na Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo la, ɣesiaɣi ne míele gbe dom ɖa ɖe mia ta, 4 tso esime míese be miexɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se eye mielɔ̃a ame kɔkɔeawo katã 5 le mɔkpɔkpɔ si wodzra ɖo ɖi na mi le dziƒowo la ta. Mɔkpɔkpɔ sia ŋu nyae miese tsã esime woɖe gbeƒã nya nyui la ŋuti nyateƒea na mi 6 ale be wòva ɖo mia gbɔ. Ale si nya nyui la le ku tsem hele ta kekem le xexea me katã la, nenema ko wòle ta kekem le miawo hã mia dome, tso gbe si gbe miese Mawu ƒe amenuveve la ŋuti nya hekpɔe dze sii nyuie le nyateƒe me. 7 Nu siae miesrɔ̃ tso mía hati kluvi lɔlɔ̃tɔ Epafra, si nye Kristo la ƒe subɔla wɔnuteƒe le mía teƒe la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 3 We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, as we pray for you, 4 hearing of your faith in Christ Jesus and the love you cherish to all God’s people 5 because of the hope laid up for you in the heavens, about which you have already heard in the words of the truth of the gospel 6 which has arrived among you as it also is in all the world, bearing fruit and growing as it does among you too since the day that you heard and recognized God’s grace in truth 7 as you learned from our dear fellow-servant Epaphras, who is on your behalf a faithful agent of the Christ, 8 who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.

EWE: 8 Ame si gblɔ lɔlɔ̃ si gbɔgbɔ la na mieɖena fiana la hã ŋu nya na mí. 9 Esia hã tae tso gbe si gbe míesee la, míedzudzɔ gbedodoɖa ɖe mia ta kpɔ o, eye míele kukuɖeɖe dzi be, eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ la nayɔ mi fũu le nunya kple gbɔgbɔ me nugɔmesese katã me, 10 be miazɔ ale si dze Yehowa, ale be miadze eŋu bliboe, esi mieyi edzi le ku tsem le dɔ nyui sia dɔ nyui wɔwɔ me, eye miele tsitsim le Mawu ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ la me; 11 nye didie nye be wòatsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la ado ŋusẽ mi le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ŋutete la nu, ale be miado dzi bliboe le dzigbɔgbɔ blewu kple dzidzɔ me, 12 esi miedaa akpe na Fofo la, ame si na miedze na gomekpɔkpɔ le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe domenyinu la me le kekeli la me. 13 Eɖe mí tso viviti ƒe ŋusẽ la me, eye wòkplɔ mí yi Via lɔlɔ̃a ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me, 14 ame si dzi woto ɖe mí to tafe la dzi, si fia be wotsɔ míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ke mí.
ENGLISH: 9 For this reason we on our part, since the day when we heard of it, never cease to pray for you and ask that you may be filled with awareness of his will in all spiritual wisdom and insight 10 to walk worthily of the Lord to give him all pleasure, bearing fruit in every good work and growing in awareness of God, 11 energized with all power in accordance with the mightiness of his glory for all persistence and patience, 12 joyously thanking the Father who qualified you for your share in the lot of God’s people in the light; 13 who delivered you out of the jurisdiction of darkness and transferred you into the kingdom of the Son of his love, 14 in whom we have redemption, the pardon of sins,

EWE: 15 Eyae nye Mawu makpɔmakpɔ la ƒe nɔnɔme, nuwɔwɔwo katã ƒe gbãtɔ; 16 elabena eya dzie woto wɔ nu bubu siwo katã le dziƒowo kple anyigba dzi, nu siwo wokpɔna kple nu siwo womekpɔna o, woɖanye fiazikpuiwo, alo aƒetɔnyenyewo, alo dziɖuɖuwo, alo ŋusẽwo o. Wowɔ nu bubuwo katã to edzi na eya amea.
ENGLISH: 15 Who is image of the invisible God, firstborn of all creation, 16 because in him everything was created in the heavens and on earth, the visible and the invisible, be it thrones or lordships or governments or dominions everything has been created through him and to come to him, 17 and before everything he is, and in him everything holds together.

EWE: 17 Etre dzɔdzɔ na nu bubuwo katã hã, eye eya dzie woto na nu bubuwo katã va dzɔ, 18 eye eyae nye ŋutilã, si nye hame la, ƒe ta. Eyae nye gɔmedzedze la, ŋgɔgbevi tso ame kukuwo dome, ne wòazu gbãtɔ le nuwo katã me; 19 elabena edze Mawu ŋu be yeana blibonyenye la katã nanɔ eya amea me, 20 eye be yeato eya ke dzi adzra ye kple nu bubuwo katã dome ɖo ake, esi wòto ʋu si Kristo kɔ ɖi le fuwɔameti la ŋu dzi wɔ ŋutifafa, woɖanye nu siwo le anyigba dzi alo nu siwo le dziƒo o. 21 Le nyateƒe me la, mi ame siwo nɔ adzɔge tsã, eye mienye futɔwo, le esi miaƒe susuwo nɔ dɔwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu ta la, 22 Mawu to ame ma ƒe ŋutilã si wokpɔna dzi gadzra mia kplii dome ɖo to eƒe ku me, ne mianye ame kɔkɔewo, mokakamanɔŋutɔwo kple ame siwo ŋu nutsotso aɖeke mele o le eŋkume, 23 nenye be mieyi edzi lé xɔse la me ɖe asi, woɖo mi ɖe eƒe gɔmeɖoanyi la dzi, mieli ke sesĩe, eye miena wote mi ɖa tso nya nyui si miese, si woɖe gbeƒãe le nuwɔwɔ siwo katã le dziƒoa te dome la ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ gbɔ o ko. Nya nyui sia ƒe subɔlae nye, Paulo mezu.
ENGLISH: 18 And he is the head of the body, the church, he who is the beginning, the firstborn out of the dead, in order that he may take the first place in every respect, 19 because in him all the fullness was pleased to make its home 20 and through him to reconcile everything to him, making peace through the blood of his cross, through him whether it were the things on earth or the things in the heavens, 21 and you who had once been estranged and hostile-minded in your wicked deeds, 22 but whom he has now reconciled by his fleshly body through death to present you holy and unblemished and irreproachable before him 23 if so be that you keep to your faith, standing steady on solid foundations and not shifting from the hope of the gospel you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under the heavens; of which I Paul became an agent.

EWE: 24 Azɔ la, mele dzidzɔ kpɔm le fu siwo kpem mele le mia ta la me, eye mele xaxa siwo susɔ le Kristo ta la me tom le nye ŋutilã me ɖe eƒe ŋutilã, si nye hamea la ta. 25 Mezu hame sia ƒe subɔla le aƒedzikpɔkpɔdɔ si tso Mawu gbɔ, si wonam le mia ta, be maɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe nya la bliboe nu, 26 nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe si woɣla tso nuɖoanyi siwo va yi kple dzidzime siwo va yi la me ke. Ke azɔ woɖee fia eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, 27 ame siwo wòdze Mawu ŋu be yeana woanya nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe sia ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe kesinɔnuwo, si nye Kristo si wɔ ɖeka kpli mi, kple eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ la, le dukɔwo dome. 28 Eyae nye ame si míele gbeƒã ɖemee, eye míele nu xlɔ̃m ame sia ame hele nu fiam ame sia ame le nunya katã me, ne míatsɔ ame sia ame aɖo eŋkume bliboe le Kristo me. 29 Esia tae mele kutri kum ɖo, eye mele ʋiʋlim le eƒe ŋusẽ si le dɔ dzi sesĩe le menye la nu.
ENGLISH: 24 I rejoice now in my sufferings for you, and what stopped short of completeness in the Christ’s sufferings I am filling out in my flesh for his body, which is the church, 25 whose servitor I became in accordance with God’s charge given to me as errand to you, to present God’s word in its fullness, 26 the secret that had been hidden since the ages and the generations but has now been disclosed to his devout believers, 27 to whom God chose to make known what was the wealth of the glory of this secret design among the nations, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory; 28 whom we announce, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, in order that we may present every man complete in Christ, 29 to which same end I am toiling and struggling as befits his energy that is powerfully at work in me.

EWE: Kolosetɔwo
ENGLISH: Colossians

EWE: 2 Elabena medi be mianya ale si gbegbe mele ʋiʋlim ɖe miawo kple ame siwo le Laodikea kpakple ame siwo katã mekpɔ ŋkunyeme kpɔ o la ta. 2 Mele esia wɔm be woƒe dzi nadze eme, ne woawɔ ɖeka le lɔlɔ̃ me, be woƒe asi nasu kesinɔnu geɖe si nye be woakpɔ kakaɖedzi blibo le woƒe nugɔmesese me la dzi, ale be Mawu ƒe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe la, si nye Kristo ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ nasu wo si. 3 Eya mee woɣla nunya kple sidzedze ƒe kesinɔnuwo katã ɖo nyuie.
ENGLISH: 2 For I want you to know what a struggle I am having for you and the ones in Laodicea and as many as have not seen my face in person, 2 that their hearts may be encouraged, they being drawn together in love and instructed into the richest certitude of insight, to the recognition of God’s secret, Christ, 3 in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

EWE: 4 Mele esia gblɔm ale be ame aɖeke nagatsɔ aɖe ŋanɛ aflu mi o.
ENGLISH: 4 I say this in order that nobody may cheat you with plausible talk.

EWE: 5 Togbɔ be nyemele mia gbɔ le ŋutilã me o hã la, meli kpli mi le gbɔgbɔ me, eye dzi le dzɔyem be miewɔa nu ɖe ɖoɖo nyui nu, eye miaƒe xɔse li ke le Kristo me.
ENGLISH: 5 For even if I am physically away, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and witnessing your good order and the solidity of your faith in Christ.

EWE: 6 Eya ta ale si ko miexɔ Aƒetɔ Kristo Yesu la, miyi edzi miazɔ kplii le ɖekawɔwɔ me, 7 eye mianye ame siwo ƒo ke ɖe to, siwo wotu ɖe eya amea dzi, eye woli ke wo ɖe xɔse la me, abe ale si wofia mi ene, eye miaƒe akpedada nagba go.
ENGLISH: 6 So, in such fashion as you took over Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him, 7 rooted and upbuilt in him and solidly settled in faith as you were taught, plentiful in thanksgiving.

EWE: 11 Le miaƒe hadede kplii me la, wotso aʋa na miawo hã, menye kple asi o, ke boŋ to nu vɔ̃ ŋutilã la ɖeɖe ɖa me, aʋatsotso si nye Kristo tɔ lae wotso na mi. 12 Elabena woɖi mi kpakplii esi wonyrɔ mi abe eya ke ene, eye to miaƒe hadede kplii me la, wofɔ mi ɖe tsitre kpakplii to Mawu, ame si fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, ƒe ŋusẽdɔ si dzi miexɔ se la dzi. 13 Gawu la, togbɔ be mienye ame kukuwo tsã le miaƒe vodadawo kple aʋamatsomatso ƒe nɔnɔme, si me mienɔ le ŋutilã me la me hã la, Mawu gbɔ agbe mi kpakplii. Elɔ̃ faa tsɔ míaƒe vodadawo katã ke mí, 14 eye wòtutu sedede siwo wotsɔ asi ŋlɔ, sedede siwo tsia tsitre ɖe mía ŋu la ɖa. Eɖee ɖa le mɔa dzi esi wòklãe ɖe fuwɔameti la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 8 Look to it that there be not somebody who carries you off by philosophy and empty deceit along the line of human tradition, of the world’s elements and not of Christ, 9 because in him all the fullness of deity is resident in bodily form, 10 and it is in him you have been brought to fullness, him who is the head of every government and dominion; 11 in whom, also, you were circumcised with a circumcision not done by human hands, in the stripping off of the body of flesh, in the Christ’s circumcision, 12 being buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the activities of God who raised him from the dead; 13 and you, when you were dead with your offenses and the uncircumcisedness of your flesh, he brought to life together with him, condoning all our offenses, 14 canceling the bond over us in decrees, which was opposed to us, and has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.

EWE: 15 Eklo nu le dziɖuɖuwo kple ŋusẽwo ŋu, eye wòɖe wo fia le dutoƒo be woɖu wo dzi, eye wòkplɔ wo le aʋadziɖuɖu ƒe gbɔlɔlɔ gã aɖe me to fuwɔameti la dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 Disarming the governments and the dominions, he made a public show of them, celebrating his triumph over them on it.

EWE: 17 Nu mawo nye nu siwo ava va la ƒe vɔvɔli, ke nua ŋutɔŋutɔ le Kristo la me. 18 Migana ame aɖeke si alakpaɖokuibɔbɔ kple mawudɔlawo subɔsubɔ dzɔa dzi na la nawɔe be fetu la nato mia ŋu o. Ame sia ƒomevi "tea tɔ ɖe " nu siwo wòkpɔ la dzi eye eƒe ŋutilãmetamesusu nana wòdoa eɖokui ɖe dzi glodzoo madzemadzee, 19 eye mekuna ɖe ta la ŋu sesĩe o, evɔ ta sia gbɔe ŋutilã blibo la kpɔa eƒe nunyiame tsonɛ, eye wòto ƒunukpeƒewo kple lãmekawo dzi lée ƒo ƒu ɖekae henana wòtsina, abe ale si Mawu di be wòatsii ene.
ENGLISH: 16 So let nobody pass judgment on you in matters of eating and drinking or in respect to festival or new moon or sabbath, 17 that are a shadow of what was to be but the body belongs to the Christ; 18 let nobody contrive a decision against you with willful humility and worship of the angels, entering into what he has seen, flimsily inflated by his flesh-mind, 19 and not keeping hold of the Head, out of whom all the body, supplied and conjoined through the joints and sinews, makes God’s growth.

EWE: 20 Ne miegbe nu le xexea ƒe gɔmedzenuwo gbɔ heku kple Kristo la, ekema nu ka tae miele agbe nɔm abe ɖe mieganye xexea ƒe akpa aɖe ene hele mia ɖokui bɔbɔm ɖe se siawo te be: 21 "Mègatsɔe o, eye mègaɖɔe kpɔ alo aka asi eŋu o, " 22 si nye nu siwo katã dome gblẽna to wo zazã me, eye wonye amegbetɔwo ƒe sededewo kple nufiafiawo? 23 Togbɔ be nu mawo nye subɔsubɔ si ƒomevi ame ɖo na eɖokui kple alakpaɖokuibɔbɔ kpakple fuwɔwɔ ŋutilã la eye wodzena le gota abe nu siwo me nunya le ene hã la, womekpena ɖe ame ŋu wòɖua ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzrowo dzi o.
ENGLISH: 20 If you died with Christ away from the world’s elements, why, as if alive in the world, do you go in for decrees, 21 "do not take nor taste nor touch, " 22 altogether things that are bound to perish as they are consumed, in conformity with the commands and teachings of men? 23 which do have a show of wisdom in self-contrived religiousness and humility and severity to the body, not in some sort of honor for repletion of the flesh.

EWE: Kolosetɔwo
ENGLISH: Colossians

EWE: 3 Ke ne wofɔ mi ɖe tsitre kple Kristo la, ekema miyi edzi mianɔ nu siwo le dziƒo, afi si Kristo la nɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖusime le, la dim.
ENGLISH: 3 So, if you were raised with the Christ, aim at the things above, where the Christ is, sitting at God’s right hand.

EWE: 2 Mina miaƒe susu nanɔ nu siwo le dziƒo la ŋu, ke menye nu siwo le anyigba dzi la ŋu o. 3 Elabena mieku, eye wotsɔ miaƒe agbe ɣla ɖe Kristo me le Mawu me.
ENGLISH: 2 Have in mind the things above, not the things on the earth; 3 for you did die, and your life is hidden in God with the Christ.

EWE: 4 Ne woɖe Kristo, si nye míaƒe agbe la, ɖe go la, ekema woaɖe miawo hã ɖe go kplii le ŋutikɔkɔe me.
ENGLISH: 4 When the Christ, our life, comes to be seen, then so will you with him come to be seen in glory.

EWE: 5 Eya ta miwu miaƒe ŋutinu siwo le anyigba dzi, le gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu, makɔmakɔnyenye, gbɔdɔdɔ ƒe dzodzro vɔ̃, nudzodzro vɔ̃, kple ŋukeklẽ, si nye trɔ̃subɔsubɔ la gome. 6 Nu mawo tae Mawu ƒe dziku gbɔna ɖo. 7 Nu mawo tututu miawo hã miewɔna le miaƒe tsãgbenɔnɔ me.
ENGLISH: 5 So give over to deadness the organism that rests on the earth, unchastity, uncleanness, passions, evil desire, and greed, which is an idolatry 6 things on account of which God’s anger comes; 7 with which you too occupied yourselves once upon a time, when you were alive in these.

EWE: 8 Ke azɔ miɖe asi le nu siawo katã ŋu keŋkeŋ: dziku, dɔmedzoe, vɔ̃ɖinyenye, eye nya veamewo kple yakanyawo negado le mia nu o. 9 Migaka aʋatso na mia nɔewo o. Miɖe amenyenye xoxo la kple eƒe nuwɔnawo ɖa, 10 eye mido amenyenye yeye la, si wɔm wole yeyee to sidzedze vavãtɔ me le Ame si wɔe la ƒe nɔnɔme nu, 11 afi sia Helatɔ alo Yudatɔ, aʋatsotso alo aʋamatsomatso, amedzro, Skitetɔ, kluvi alo ablɔɖeme meli o; ke boŋ Kristo ye nye nuwo katã, eye wòle wo katã me.
ENGLISH: 8 But now, you too, discard everything, anger, passionateness, viciousness, abusiveness, offensive language out of your mouths, 9 do not lie to each other, stripping off the old man with his doings 10 and putting on the new man who is being reconstituted into intelligence after the likeness of his Creator, 11 where there is no such thing as Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, alien, Scythian, slave, freeman, but Christ is everything and in everybody.

EWE: 12 Eya ta esi mienye Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo, ame kɔkɔewo kple lɔlɔ̃tɔwo ŋuti la, mido dɔmetɔtrɔ, dɔmenyonyo, ɖokuibɔbɔ, tufafa kple dzigbɔgbɔ blewu. 13 Miyi edzi miado dzi anɔ anyi kple mia nɔewo, eye miatsɔ anɔ mia nɔewo kem faa ne nya aɖe le ame aɖe si ɖe nɔvia ŋu. Ale si ko Yehowa tsɔ ke mi faa la, miawo hã miwɔ nenema ke.
ENGLISH: 12 So, as holy and dearly loved chosen ones of God’s, put on compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, patience, 13 bearing with each other and mutually making allowances; if one has found a fault in somebody, in the same way as the Lord showed grace to you, do you the like.

EWE: 14 Hekpe ɖe nu siawo katã ŋu la, mido lɔlɔ̃, elabena enye ɖekawɔwɔ ƒe nublanu deblibo.
ENGLISH: 14 And over all these love, which is the connecting link of perfection.

EWE: 15 Mina Kristo la ƒe ŋutifafa naɖu dzi le miaƒe dziwo me, elabena ŋutifafa ma gbɔe woyɔ mi vɛ le ŋutilã ɖeka me. Eye minye akpedalawo.
ENGLISH: 15 And let Christ’s peace have the deciding voice in your hearts, that same peace into which you were called in one body; and be thankful-hearted.

EWE: 16 Mina Kristo la ƒe nya la naxɔ aƒe ɖe mia me le nunya katã me. Miyi edzi mianɔ nu fiam mia nɔewo, eye mianɔ dzi dem ƒo na mia nɔewo kple psalmowo, Mawu kafukafu nyawo, kple gbɔgbɔmehawo dzidzi ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔtɔe, eye midzi ha le miaƒe dziwo me na Yehowa. 17 Nu sia nu si miewɔna le nya alo nuwɔna me la, miwɔ wo katã le Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me, eye mianɔ akpe dam na Mawu Fofo la to edzi.
ENGLISH: 16 Keep the Christ’s word abiding in you richly, teaching and admonishing each other in all wisdom, singing in your hearts to God in thankfulness with psalms, hymns, spiritual songs; 17 and as to anything whatever that you do in word or in act, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

EWE: 18 Mi srɔ̃nyɔnuwo, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia srɔ̃wo, abe ale si wòdze le Aƒetɔ la me ene.
ENGLISH: 18 Wives, be in such subordination to your husbands as is the proper thing in the Lord.

EWE: 19 Mi srɔ̃ŋutsuwo, miyi edzi mianɔ mia srɔ̃wo lɔ̃m, eye miganɔ dɔmedzoe dom ɖe wo ŋu helĩhelĩ o.
ENGLISH: 19 Husbands, love your wives and do not be cross to them.

EWE: 20 Mi ɖeviwo, miɖo to mia dzilawo le nu sia nu me, elabena esia dzea Aƒetɔ la ŋu nyuie.
ENGLISH: 20 Children, obey your parents in every respect, for this is a winsome way in the Lord.

EWE: 21 Mi fofowo, miganɔ dziku dom na mia viwo o, ale be dzi nagaɖe le wo ƒo o.
ENGLISH: 21 Fathers, do not nettle your children, so that they may not be disheartened.

EWE: 22 Mi kluviwo, miɖo to amegbetɔ siwo nye miaƒe aƒetɔwo le nu sia nu me, menye ne woƒe ŋku le mia ŋu ko le ameŋudzedze ta o, ke boŋ le dzimekɔkɔ me, le Yehowa vɔvɔ̃ me. 23 Nu sia nu si wɔm miele la, miwɔe tso luʋɔ blibo me abe Yehowa ye miele ewɔm na ene, ke menye na amewo o, 24 elabena mienyae be Yehowa gbɔe miaxɔ domenyinyi ƒe fetu la tsoe. Misubɔ Aƒetɔ Kristo abe kluviwo ene.
ENGLISH: 22 Servants, obey in every respect those who are your masters in the way of flesh, not in eye-services as man-pleasers do but in single-heartedness, fearing the Lord; 23 whatever you are doing, work at it with a will, as doing it for the Lord and not for men, 24 knowing that you will be paid up for it by the Lord in your inheritance; you are in the service of the Lord Christ.

EWE: 25 Ame si wɔa nu gbegblẽ la, axɔ nu gbegblẽ si wòwɔ la ŋuti fetu godoo. Ameŋkumekpɔkpɔ aɖeke mele eme o.
ENGLISH: 25 For he who does a wrong will have the wrong he did coming to him, and there is no favoritism.

EWE: Kolosetɔwo
ENGLISH: Colossians

EWE: 4 Mi aƒetɔwo, miwɔ nu si le dzɔdzɔe kple nu si sɔ la ɖe miaƒe kluviwo ŋu, eye minyae be Aƒetɔ le miawo hã mia si le dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 4 Masters, let your servants have justice and equal rights, knowing that you too have a master in heaven.

EWE: 3 Le ɣeyiɣi ma ke me la, mido gbe ɖa ɖe míawo hã mía ta, ale be Mawu naʋu nya la ƒe ʋɔtru na mí, be míate ŋu agblɔ Kristo la ŋuti nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe, si tututu ta mele gaxɔ me ɖo la, 4 ne mate ŋu agblɔe eme nakɔ abe ale si wòdze be mawɔe la ene.
ENGLISH: 2 Keep praying, be on the alert in it, with thanksgiving; 3 praying, along with the rest, for us too, that God will open us a door for the word, for speaking the secret of Christ, that same for which I am in prison, 4 so that I may open it up as I have to speak.

EWE: 5 Miyi edzi miazɔ le nunya me le nuwɔwɔ kple ame siwo le egodo la me, eye miwɔ miaƒe ɣeyiɣi ŋu dɔ le mɔ nyuitɔ nu. 6 Mina miaƒe nya nadze to ɣesiaɣi, eye dze nanɔ eme, ne mianya ale si wòdze be miaɖo nya ŋu na ame sia ame.
ENGLISH: 5 Behave wisely toward outsiders, making the best you can of the crisis; 6 let your talk be always in grace, seasoned with salt to know how you need to answer each one.

EWE: 7 Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔ Tikiko, si nye subɔla wɔnuteƒe kple hati kluvi le Aƒetɔ la me la, agblɔ nu siwo katã dzɔ ɖe dzinye la na mi.
ENGLISH: 7 Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful errand-runner and fellow-servant in the Lord, will acquaint you with everything that relates to me; 8 I am sending him to you for this express purpose, to let you know about me and to let him cheer your hearts, 9 with dear and faithful brother Onesimus, who is one of you.

EWE: 8 Mele edɔm ɖe mia gbɔ be mianya ale si míele, eye wòafa akɔ na miaƒe dziwo.
ENGLISH: They will give you the news about everything here.

EWE: 9 Mele eya kple Onesimo, nɔvinye nuteƒewɔla lɔlɔ̃a, si tso mia gbɔ la dɔm; woagblɔ ale si nuwo le le mía gbɔ afi sia la katã na mi. 10 Aristarko, si le gaxɔ me kplim, do gbe na mi, Barnaba ƒe ƒometɔ Marko hã (ame si ƒe nya míegblɔ na mi be ne eva mia gbɔ la, miaxɔe nyuie), 11 kple Yesu si woyɔna be Yusto, ame siwo nye aʋatsotsotɔwo, hã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: 10 My fellow-prisoner Aristarchus sends greetings, and Barnabas’s cousin Mark, about whom you received injunctions, if he comes to you, receive him, 11 and Jesus, known as Justus, these who represent the circumcised community; these are the only ones who are cooperators for the Reign of God, and they were a comfort to me.

EWE: 12 Epafra, ame si tso mia gbɔ eye wònye Kristo Yesu ƒe kluvi la, do gbe na mi. Edoa gbe ɖa vevie ɖe mia ta ɣesiaɣi, be mlɔeba la, miasu te bliboe, eye kakaɖedzi sẽŋu nanɔ mia si le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu blibo la me. 13 Elabena mele ɖase ɖim le eŋu be, edzea agbagba geɖe ɖe miawo kple ame siwo le Laodikea kpakple ame siwo le Hierapoli la ta.
ENGLISH: 12 Epaphras, who is one of you, sends greetings, a servant of Christ Jesus who is always wrestling for you in his prayers that you may be made to stand complete and convinced in everything that is God’s will; 13 for I can testify that he is deeply concerned for you and those at Laodicea and those at Hierapolis.

EWE: 14 Luka, atikewɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ la, do gbe na mi, eye Dema hã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: 14 Dear Doctor Luke and Demas send greetings.

EWE: 15 Mido gbe na nɔvi siwo le Laodikea nam, eye mido gbe na Nimfa kpakple hame si le eƒe aƒe me la nam.
ENGLISH: 15 Give my greetings to the brothers at Laodicea and to Nymphas and the meeting at their house.

EWE: 16 Eye ne miexlẽ agbalẽ sia vɔ la, miwɔ ɖoɖo woaxlẽe le hame si le Laodikea hã me, eye miawo hã miaxlẽ esi tso Laodikea la.
ENGLISH: 16 And when the letter is read to you, get it read in the Laodiceans’ meeting too, and get to read the one from Laodicea.

EWE: 17 Migblɔ na Arkipo be: "Lé fɔ ɖe subɔsubɔdɔ si nèxɔ le Aƒetɔ la me ŋu nàwɔe ade goe. "
ENGLISH: 17 And tell Archippus "Look out for the office you were given in the Lord, to make good in it. "

EWE: 18 Nye, Paulo ƒe gbedoname si metsɔ nye ŋutɔ nye asi ŋlɔ lae nye esi.
ENGLISH: 18 My greeting, Paul’s, with my own hand.

EWE: Miɖo ŋku edzi be mekpɔtɔ le ga me.
ENGLISH: Remember my fetters.

EWE: Mawu ƒe amenuveve nanɔ kpli mi.
ENGLISH: Grace be with you.

EWE: 1 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Thessalonians

EWE: 1 Paulo, Silvano kple Timoteo le esia ŋlɔm na hame si le Tesalonika, si wɔ ɖeka kple Mawu Fofo la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo:
ENGLISH: 1 Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

EWE: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa woana mi. 2 Míeɖoa ŋku mi katã mia dzi le míaƒe gbedodoɖawo me hedaa akpe na Mawu ɣesiaɣi, 3 elabena míeɖoa ŋku miaƒe xɔsedɔwo kple dɔ siwo miewɔna le lɔlɔ̃ me kpakple miaƒe dzidodo le mɔkpɔkpɔ si le mia si le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo me la dzi ɣesiaɣi le mía Mawu kple Fofo la ŋkume. 4 Nɔviwo, mi ame siwo Mawu lɔ̃, míenya be Mawue tia mi, 5 elabena nya nyui si míeɖe gbeƒãe la, menye nya si míegblɔ kple nu ko wònye o, ke míegblɔe le ŋusẽ kple gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe kpakple kakaɖedzi sẽŋu hã me, abe ale si ko mienya ame siwo ƒomevi míeva zu le mia dome le mia ta la ene.
ENGLISH: 2 We always thank God for you all as we make mention of you in our prayers, 3 continually recalling your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ before our God and Father, 4 knowing, brothers loved by God, your choosing, 5 that our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power and in Holy Spirit and profound conviction, as you know what we were like for your sake when we were among you.

EWE: 6 Ale miezu míawo kple Aƒetɔ la srɔ̃lawo, esi mietsɔ dzidzɔ si gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔea nana la xɔ nya la le yometiti geɖewo me, 7 eye mieva zu kpɔɖeŋu na xɔsetɔ siwo katã le Makedonia kple Akaya.
ENGLISH: 6 And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, receiving the word with joy over the Holy Spirit while in much trouble, 7 so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaea.

EWE: 8 Nyateƒee wònye be menye ɖeko Yehowa ƒe nya la ɖi hoo tso mia gbɔ yi Makedonia kple Akaya o, ke ale si miexɔ Mawu dzi se la ŋu nya hã kaka ɖo afi sia afi, ale be mehiã be míagagblɔ nya aɖeke o. 9 Elabena woawo ŋutɔwo yi edzi le nu ƒom tso ale si míeva mia gbɔ zi gbãtɔ, kple ale si mietrɔ le miaƒe trɔ̃wo yome heva Mawu gbɔ, be miasubɔ Mawu gbagbe vavã la ŋuti, 10 eye mialala Via tso dziƒowo, ame si wòfɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, si nye Yesu, ame si ɖe mí tso dziku si gbɔna la me.
ENGLISH: 8 For from you the word of the Lord has sounded out not only in Macedonia and Achaea, but in every place the news of your faith toward God is out, so that we have no need to talk of anything; 9 for they themselves report about us what sort of entrance to you we had, and how you turned to God from the idols to belong to a live and genuine God 10 and to await his Son from heaven, the one he raised from the dead, Jesus who delivers us out of the coming wrath.

EWE: 1 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Thessalonians

EWE: 2 Nɔviwo, miawo ŋutɔwo mienya nyuie be míaƒe mia gbɔ vava la mezu dzodzro o. 2 Togbɔ be míekpe fu, eye woɖi gbɔ mí gbã le Filipi, abe ale si mienya ene hã la, dzi ɖo mía ƒo to mía Mawu ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu me be míagblɔ Mawu ƒe nya nyui la na mi le tsitretsiɖeŋu geɖe me.
ENGLISH: 2 For you yourselves, brothers, know about our entrance to you, that it was not a failure, 2 but after we had suffered beforehand and been outrageously treated, as you know, at Philippi, we were bold enough in our God to speak God’s gospel to you in a hard struggle.

EWE: 3 Elabena nuxlɔ̃ame si míenana mi la menye alakpanya alo susu vɔ̃ alo amebeble wònye o, 4 ke boŋ ale si ko Mawu kpɔe be míedze be wòatsɔ nya nyui la ade asi na míi la, nenemae míeƒoa nui, menye be wòadze amegbetɔwo ŋu o, ke boŋ be wòadze Mawu, ame si dzroa míaƒe dziwo me kpɔ la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 3 For our exhortation is not a result of crankiness nor of uncleanness, nor by way of a trick; 4 but as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel message, so we speak, not as pleasing men, but God who assays our hearts.

EWE: 5 Le nyateƒe me la, mienyae nyuie be míezã ameflunya ŋɔnɔe aɖeke ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o, alo to aye me klẽ ŋu ɖe ame aɖeke ƒe nu ŋu kpɔ o; Mawue nye ɖasefo! 6 Eye míele bubu hã dim tso amegbetɔwo gbɔ o, míele edim tso miawo alo ame bubuwo gbɔ o, togbɔ be míate ŋu anye agba gã aɖe na mi le Kristo ƒe apostolo siwo míenye ta hafi. 7 Ke boŋ míewɔa nu ɖe mia ŋu tufafatɔe, abe ale si vidada léa be na eya ŋutɔ viawo nyuie ene.
ENGLISH: 5 For we never dealt in flattering talk, as you know, nor in excuses for moneymaking, God knows, 6 nor tried to get glory from men, either you or others, when we could have made ourselves important as apostles of Christ, 7 but behaved gently in your midst; as a woman cherishes her own children, 8 so yearning over you we were willing to pass out to you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives too, because you had become darlings of ours.

EWE: 8 Eya ta esi míelɔ̃a nu le mia gbɔ o ta la, edzɔ dzi na mí vevie be, menye Mawu ƒe nya nyui la ɖeɖe ko míatsɔ ana mi o, ke míawo ŋutɔ mía ɖokuiwo hãe, elabena mieva zu míaƒe lɔlɔ̃tɔwo. 9 Nyateƒee, nɔviwo, mieɖoa ŋku míaƒe agbagbadzedze kple kutrikuku dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 For you remember, brothers, our toil and trouble: it was while working night and day so as not to be burdensome to any of you that we proclaimed God’s gospel among you.

EWE: 10 Miawoe nye ɖasefowo, eye Mawu hã nyee, be míenye nuteƒewɔlawo kple ame dzɔdzɔewo kpakple mokakamanɔŋutɔwo le mi xɔsetɔwo dome. 11 Eye mienya nyuie be míeyi edzi xlɔ̃ nu mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe, eye míefa akɔ na mi heƒo nu na mi abe ale si vifofo wɔna na viawo ene, 12 ale be miayi edzi azɔ ale si dze Mawu, ame si yɔ mi va eƒe Fiaɖuƒe kple ŋutikɔkɔe gbɔ la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 10 You are witnesses, and so is God, in what godly and honest and irreproachable fashion we behaved toward you who believe, 11 you know how it was, animating each one of you as a father would his own children and comforting you and admonishing you 12 that you should walk worthily of the God who is calling you to his own reign and glory.

EWE: 13 Ɛ̃, ema tae míawo hã míedaa akpe na Mawu madzudzɔmadzudzɔe ɖo, elabena esi miexɔ Mawu ƒe nya, si miese tso mía gbɔ la, miexɔe abe amegbetɔwo ƒe nya ene o, ke boŋ abe Mawu ƒe nya ene, abe ale si tututu wòle hã ene, eye wòle dɔ dzi le mi xɔsetɔwo me. 14 Nɔviwo, miezu Mawu ƒe hame siwo le Yudea siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu la srɔ̃lawo, elabena miawo hã miekpe fu le miawo ŋutɔwo mia deviwo si me, abe ale si tututu woawo hã wokpe fu le Yudatɔwo si me la ene, 15 ame siwo wu Aƒetɔ Yesu gɔ̃ hã kple nyagblɔɖilawo, eye woti míawo hã yome. Azɔ hã, womele nu si dze Mawu ŋu la wɔm o, ke boŋ wotsi tsitre ɖe amewo katã ƒe nyonyo ŋu, 16 esi wodze agbagba be yewoaxe mɔ na mí be míagaƒo nu na dukɔwo me tɔwo ne woakpɔ ɖeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 13 And for this reason we too thank God continually, that when you had from us a hearsay report of God you received it as not men’s word but, as it positively is, God’s, the same that is taking effect in you believers; 14 for you, brothers, showed yourselves imitators of the churches of God that there are in Palestine in Christ Jesus, because you too suffered the same things from the men of your own race as did they from the Jews, 15 those who both killed the Lord Jesus and drove us out, and do not please God and are in opposition to all men, 16 forbidding us to speak to the foreigners that they may be saved, so as to fill up their sins always.

EWE: Ale ɣesiaɣi wona woƒe nu vɔ̃wo yɔ gba go.
ENGLISH: But wrath has overtaken them, absolutely.

EWE: Ke eƒe dziku la va wo dzi mlɔeba. 17 Ke nɔviwo, esi mía kpli mi dome klã ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe (le ŋutilã me, menye le míaƒe dzi me ya o), eye miele mía dzrom vevie ta la, míedze agbagba ɖe sia ɖe be míagakpɔ mia ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 17 But we, brothers, bereaved of you for a moment’s space in face, not in heart, made it our very special concern, with strong desire, to see your faces; 18 because we did mean to come to you I, Paul, once and twice too and Satan blocked us.

EWE: 19 Elabena nu kae nye míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ alo dzidzɔ alo aseyetsotso ƒe dziɖuɖukuku le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ŋkume le eƒe anyinɔɣi la?
ENGLISH: 19 For what is our hope or joy or wreath of triumph, or are you not such, before our Lord Jesus at his coming? 20 for you are our glory and joy.

EWE: 1 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Thessalonians

EWE: 3 Eya ta esi dzi meganya le dodom na mí o la, míekpɔe be enyo be míawo ɖeɖe míatsi Atene; 2 eye míedɔ Timoteo, mía nɔvi kple Mawu ƒe subɔla si gblɔa Kristo la ŋuti nya nyui la, be wòava do ŋusẽ mi, eye wòafa akɔ na mi le xɔse la me, 3 ale be xaxa siawo nagaʋuʋu ame aɖeke o. Elabena miawo ŋutɔwo mienyae be, míate ŋu aƒo asa na xaxa siawo o. 4 Elabena esi míenɔ mia gbɔ la, míegblɔnɛ na mi be míato xaxa me tsã, eye esiae le eme vam abe ale si mienyae ene.
ENGLISH: 3 For which reason we could stand it no longer, but were fain to be left alone in Athens, 2 and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s helper in the work of the gospel of the Christ, to reinforce your firmness and encourage you in your faith, 3 for nobody to be flurried with these distresses for you know that this is what we are here for; 4 for even when we were with you we told you beforehand that we were to be distressed, and so it turned out, as you know.

EWE: 5 Esia tae esi dzi meganya le dodom nam o la, medɔ ame ɖa be manya nu tso miaƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ŋu, be ame aɖe menya nu o, Tela la anya te mi kpɔ le mɔ aɖe nu, eye míaƒe agbagbadzedze azu dzodzro mahĩ.
ENGLISH: 5 This was why I myself could stand it no longer and sent to find out about your faith, for fear the Tempter had tempted you and our hard work would not amount to anything.

EWE: 6 Ðeko Timoteo tso mia gbɔ va ɖo mía gbɔ koe nye esia, eye wòva gblɔ nya nyui na mí tso miaƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ kple lɔlɔ̃ ŋu, be mieɖoa ŋku mía dzi vevie ɣesiaɣi, eye wòle mia dzrom be yewoakpɔ mí abe ale si ko wòle míawo hã dzrom be míakpɔ mi ene. 7 Eya ta nɔviwo, le míaƒe hiãkame kple xaxawo katã me hã, dzi ɖo mía ƒo le miaƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ta. 8 Esi miele tsitre sesĩe le Aƒetɔ la me ta la, agbe gaɖo mía me.
ENGLISH: 6 But when just now Timothy came to us from you and brought us the good news about your faith and love, and that you always keep us in kind remembrance, longing to see us just as we do to see you, 7 at this we were cheered up on your account, brothers, in all our difficulties and distresses, by your faith; 8 because we are alive now if you stand firm in the Lord.

EWE: 9 Elabena ɖe míate ŋu ada akpe na Mawu ɖe mia ta wòade edeƒe le dzidzɔ gã si kpɔm míele le mía Mawu ŋkume le mia ta la ŋua? 10 Míele kokoƒoƒo dzi vevie zã kple keli be míakpɔ mia ŋkume, eye míatsɔ nu siwo susɔ le miaƒe xɔse ŋu la akpee na mi. 11 Ke mía Mawu kple Fofo la ŋutɔ kpakple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu naʋu mɔ na mí be míava mia gbɔ. 12 Eye Aƒetɔ la nekpe ɖe mia ŋu miatsi, ɛ̃, miagba go le lɔlɔ̃ na mia nɔewo kple amewo katã me, abe ale si ko míawo hã míaƒe lɔlɔ̃ le na mi ene, 13 ne wòana miaƒe dziwo nali ke, eye mokaka naganɔ mia ŋu o, le kɔkɔenyenye me le mía Mawu kple Fofo la ŋkume, le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu kple eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã ƒe anyinɔɣi la.
ENGLISH: 9 For what adequate thanks can we return to God for you in view of all the joy we feel because of you before our God, 10 night and day making very special prayers for the chance to see your faces and set right the shortcomings of your faith? 11 And may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, clear our road to you; 12 and may the Lord give you increasing and surpassing love for each other and for everybody, the same as we have it for you, 13 to stabilize your hearts in blameless holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his holy.

EWE: 1 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Thessalonians

EWE: 4 Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, abe ale si ko miexɔ mɔfiame tso mía gbɔ le ale si wòdze be miazɔ ne miadze Mawu ŋu abe ale si ko miele zɔzɔm hã ene la, míele kuku ɖem na mi hele nu xlɔ̃m mi to Aƒetɔ Yesu dzi be miayi edzi awɔe geɖe wu.
ENGLISH: 4 For the rest, then, brothers, we request you and urge you in the Lord Jesus that as you had word from us how you have to walk and please God, just the way you are walking, you will do better and better.

EWE: 2 Elabena mienya mɔfiame siwo míena mi to Aƒetɔ Yesu dzi la.
ENGLISH: 2 For you know what instructions we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

EWE: 3 Elabena esiae nye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu be, mianye ame siwo ŋu kɔ, eye miatsri gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu. 4 Mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nanya ale si wòaɖu eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi le kɔkɔenyenye kple bubu me, 5 menye le gbɔdɔdɔ ƒe dzodzro ƒe fieŋufieŋu me, abe ale si dukɔ siwo menya Mawu o la wɔna ene o. 6 Ame aɖeke nagagblẽ nu le nɔvia ŋu alo axɔ eƒe gomewo le esi le nya sia me o, elabena Yehowa hea to na ame le nu siawo katã ŋuti, abe ale si míegblɔe na mi xoxo hexlɔ̃ nu mi vevie ene.
ENGLISH: 3 For this is God’s will, your sanctification, your keeping clear of unchastity, 4 your each knowing how to get his own mate in a dedicative and respectful spirit, 5 not in passion of desire just the same as do the nations who do not know God, 6 so as not to encroach and victimize one’s brother in the business, because the Lord is an avenger of all those things, as we told you beforehand and admonished you.

EWE: 7 Elabena Mawu meyɔ mí na makɔmakɔnyenye o, ke na kɔkɔenyenye boŋ. 8 Eya ta ame si doa vlo esia la, menye amegbetɔe wòdoa vloe o, ke Mawu, ame si naa eƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe mi la boŋ.
ENGLISH: 7 For God did not call us on terms of uncleanness but in sanctification; 8 consequently the disregarder is not disregarding a man but that same God who puts his Holy Spirit in us.

EWE: 9 Ke le nɔvilɔlɔ̃ ŋuti la, mehiã mi be míaŋlɔ naneke na mi tso eŋu o, elabena Mawu fia miawo ŋutɔwo be mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo. 10 Le nyateƒe me la, miele ewɔm hã na nɔvi siwo katã le Makedonia blibo la.
ENGLISH: 9 But as to brotherliness you are in no need of being written to, for you yourselves are taught by God to love each other 10 for you do, all the brothers in all Macedonia.

EWE: Ke míele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo, be miayi edzi awɔe geɖe wu. 11 Miɖoe miaƒe taɖodzinu be yewoanɔ anyi kpoo, eye miakpɔ miawo ŋutɔwo miaƒe nyawo gbɔ eye miatsɔ miaƒe asiwo awɔ dɔ, abe ale si míefia mi ene, 12 ale be miazɔ ale si dze le ame siwo le egodo la ŋkume, eye naneke nagahiã mi o.
ENGLISH: But we urge you, brothers, to do better and better, 11 and to make it your ambition to keep quiet and attend to your own affairs and work with your own hands, as we instructed you, 12 in order that you may behave creditably toward outsiders and not be in want of anything.

EWE: 13 Azɔ hã, nɔviwo, míedi be ame siwo le alɔ̃ dɔm le ku me la ŋu nya nanɔ manyamanya na mi o; ale be miagaxa nu abe ame siwo si mɔkpɔkpɔ aɖeke mele o la ene o.
ENGLISH: 13 But we do not wish you to be ignorant about those who have gone to their rest, brothers, in order that you may not grieve the same as the others do, who do not have a hope.

EWE: 14 Ne míexɔe se be Yesu ku, eye wògafɔ vavã la, ekema Mawu akplɔ ame siwo dɔ alɔ̃ le ku me le Yesu me la ayi kpakplii.
ENGLISH: 14 For if we believe that Jesus died and arose, so also will God, through Jesus, bring with him those who have gone to their rest.

EWE: 15 Elabena nya si gblɔm míele na mi to Yehowa ƒe nya la dzie nye be, mí ame siwo le agbe yi ɖase Aƒetɔ la ƒe anyinɔɣi la, míado ŋgɔ na ame siwo dɔ alɔ̃ le ku me la le mɔ aɖeke nu o; 16 elabena Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ atsɔ gbeɖeɖe sesẽ kple mawudɔla gãtɔ ƒe gbe kpakple Mawu ƒe kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi aɖi tso dziƒo, eye ame siwo ku le Kristo me la atsi tsitre gbã. 17 Emegbe la, woakɔ mí ame susɔe siwo le agbe la le alilikpowo me ayi aɖakpe Aƒetɔ la le yame ahawɔ ɖeka kpli wo; eye ale míanɔ Aƒetɔ la gbɔ ɖaa.
ENGLISH: 15 For we tell you this on the Lord’s word, that we the living who survive till the Lord’s coming shall not be ahead of those who have gone to rest, 16 because the Lord himself will come down from the sky with a word of command, with an archangel’s voice and with God’s trumpet, and first the dead in Christ will rise, 17 then we the living who survive shall together with them be snatched up in clouds to meet the Lord in air, and thus we shall be with the Lord always.

EWE: 18 Eya ta miyi edzi miatsɔ nya siawo anɔ akɔ fam na mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 18 So cheer each other on with these words.

EWE: 1 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 1 Thessalonians

EWE: 5 Ke le ɣeyiɣiwo kple azãgbewo ŋu la, nɔviwo, mehiã be míaŋlɔ naneke na mi tso wo ŋu o. 2 Elabena miawo ŋutɔwo mienyae nyuie be, Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna abe ale si tututu fiafitɔ vana le zã me ene.
ENGLISH: 5 But as to the times, brothers, how long and when, you are in no need of being written to, 2 for you yourselves definitely know that as a thief comes in the night, so comes the Day of the Lord.

EWE: 3 Ne wole gbɔgblɔm be, "Ŋutifafa kple dedienɔnɔ! " la, ekema tsɔtsrɔ̃ kpata ava wo dzi kpoyi, abe ale si fuɖuame va lilia funɔ ene, eye womate ŋu asi le enu le mɔ aɖeke nu o.
ENGLISH: 3 When they say "peace and safety, " then destruction is upon them suddenly, as the birth-pang comes upon a pregnant woman, and they shall not escape.

EWE: 4 Ke miawo la, nɔviwo, miele viviti me o, ale be ŋkeke la nagaɖi ɖe mi abe ale si ŋkeke ɖina ɖe fiafitɔwo ene o, 5 elabena mi katã mienye kekeli viwo kple ŋkeke viwo. Míenye zã alo viviti tɔ o.
ENGLISH: 4 But you, brothers, are not in darkness, to have the Day catch you as a thief does; 5 for you are all of you sons of the light and of the day.

EWE: 6 Eya ta migana míanɔ alɔ̃ dɔm abe ame susɔeawo ke ene o, ke boŋ mina míanɔ ŋudzɔ, eye míanɔ mo xexi.
ENGLISH: We do not belong to the night nor to the darkness; 6 so then let us not sleep as the rest do, but keep awake and sober.

EWE: 7 Elabena ame siwo dɔa alɔ̃ la, zã me koŋ ye wodɔa alɔ̃, eye ame siwo mua aha la, zã mee womua aha. 8 Ke mí ame siwo nye ŋkeke viwo la, mina míanɔ mo xexi, eye míado xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ ƒe akɔtakpoxɔnu la, eye míaɖɔ xɔxɔ ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ la abe gakuku ene; 9 elabena Mawu metia mí na dziku o, ke na ɖeɖekpɔkpɔ boŋ to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi. 10 Eku ɖe mía ta, ale be míeɖale ŋu loo alo le alɔ̃ dɔm o, míanɔ agbe kpakplii.
ENGLISH: 7 For sleepers sleep in the night, and drinkers are drunk in the night; 8 but let us, who belong to the day, keep sober, putting on the armor of faith and love and as helmet the hope of salvation, 9 because God did not destine us to his anger but to be preserved by salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ 10 who died for us in order that whether we were awake or asleep we might along with him be alive.

EWE: 11 Eya ta miyi edzi mianɔ dzi dem ƒo na mia nɔewo, eye mianɔ mia nɔewo tum ɖo, abe ale si ko miele ewɔm vavã hã ene.
ENGLISH: 11 Wherefore cheer each other on and each one build the next one up, the same way you are doing.

EWE: 12 Nɔviwo, míele kuku ɖem na mi be miade bubu ame siwo le dɔ wɔm vevie le mia dome, eye wole mia dzi kpɔm le Aƒetɔ la me hele nu xlɔ̃m mi la ŋu; 13 eye be miade bubu geɖe ŋutɔ wo ŋu le lɔlɔ̃ me, le woƒe dɔwɔwɔ ta.
ENGLISH: 12 And we beg you, brothers, to know those who do the hard work among you and take the lead in your affairs in the Lord and admonish you, 13 and to hold them very specially in love because of their work.

EWE: Minɔ anyi kple mia nɔewo le ŋutifafa me.
ENGLISH: Be at peace among yourselves.

EWE: 14 Gawu la, nɔviwo, míele nu xlɔ̃m mi be, migbe nya na ame siwo le zɔzɔm sakasaka la vevie, mifa akɔ na ame siwo lé blanui, mikpe ɖe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo ŋu, migbɔ dzi ɖi na amewo katã. 15 Midze agbagba be miagaɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe na ame aɖeke o, ke boŋ midi nyui na mia nɔewo kple amewo katã ɣesiaɣi.
ENGLISH: 14 And we urge you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, cheer up the fainthearted, stand by the weak, be patient with everybody; 15 see that nobody pays anybody back a bad turn for a bad, but always make good your object, toward each other and toward everybody.

EWE: 16 Dzi nadzɔ mi ɖaa. 17 Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɣeawokatãɣi. 18 Mida akpe ɖe nu sia nu ta. Esiae nye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu na mi le Kristo Yesu me. 19 Migatsi gbɔgbɔ la ƒe dzo la o.
ENGLISH: 16 Be always joyous, 17 pray continually, 18 give thanks in everything, for this is God’s will in Jesus Christ toward you.

EWE: 20 Migado vlo nyagblɔɖiwo o. 21 Mido nuwo katã kpɔ; milé ɖe nu si nyo la ŋu. 22 Mitsri nu vɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi.
ENGLISH: 19 Do not put out the fire of the Spirit; 20 do not scorn prophesyings; 21 but try the quality of everything, hold on to what is good, 22 reject every bad article.

EWE: 23 Ŋutifafa Mawu la ŋutɔ nakɔ mia ŋu keŋkeŋ. Eye nɔviwo, neva eme be woakpɔ miaƒe gbɔgbɔ kple luʋɔ kpakple ŋutilã, si le blibo le go sia go me la ta dedie mokaka manɔŋui le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe anyinɔɣi la.
ENGLISH: 23 And may he, the God of peace, sanctify you to perfection, and your spirits and souls and bodies be kept faultlessly safe and sound at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 24 Nuteƒewɔlae ame si le mia yɔm la nye, eye awɔe hã.
ENGLISH: 24 He who calls you is trustworthy, and do it he will.

EWE: 25 Nɔviwo, miyi edzi mianɔ gbe dom ɖa ɖe mía ta.
ENGLISH: 25 Brothers, pray for us too.

EWE: 26 Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe do gbe na nɔviawo katã.
ENGLISH: 26 Give our greetings to all the brothers with a holy kiss.

EWE: 27 Mele nu xlɔ̃m mi vevie le Aƒetɔ la me be, miaxlẽ agbalẽ sia na nɔviawo katã.
ENGLISH: 27 I adjure you by the Lord that the letter be read to all the brothers.

EWE: 28 Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nanɔ kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 28 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

EWE: 2 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Thessalonians

EWE: 1 Paulo, Silvano kple Timoteo le esia ŋlɔm na hame si le Tesalonika, si wɔ ɖeka kple Mawu mía Fofo la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo: 2 Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa si tso Mawu Fofo la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi.
ENGLISH: 1 Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: 2 Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 6 Nu si tae wòle aleae nye be, Mawu tɔ dzɔ be wòatsɔ xaxa aɖo eteƒe na ame siwo hea xaxa vaa mia dzi. 7 Ke mi ame siwo le xaxa me tom la, Mawu ana gbɔdzɔe miawo kple míawo le Aƒetɔ Yesu kple eƒe dɔla sẽŋuwo ƒe ɖeɖefia tso dziƒo 8 le dzoƒaɖewo me la me, esime wòabia hlɔ̃ ame siwo menya Mawu o kple ame siwo meɖoa to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ŋuti nya nyui la o. 9 Ame siawo akpɔ tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ ƒe tohehe le Aƒetɔ la ŋkume kple eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la gbɔ, 10 esime wòava be woadoe ɖe dzi kpakple eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, eye be woakpɔe le ŋkeke ma dzi wòawɔ moyaa na ame, le ame siwo katã xɔ edzi se la dome, elabena miexɔ ɖase si míeɖi la dzi se.
ENGLISH: 3 We are bound to thank God always for you, brothers, as is right and proper, that your faith is growing sturdily and the love of each one of you to the others is increasing, 4 so that we ourselves boast of you among the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith amid all your persecutions and the distresses you endure, 5 an exhibit of God’s just rulings so that you are to be deemed worthy of that same Kingdom of God for which you are suffering, 6 if just it is by God’s standard to repay distress to those who distress you, 7 and to you who are distressed relief with us at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power 8 in flaming fire to give punishment to those that do not know God and to those that do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus; 9 these shall pay the penalty, eternal destruction from the Lord’s presence and from the glory of his strength 10 when he comes to manifest his glory among his holy ones and to be venerated among all those who have believed because our testimony to you was believed on that day.

EWE: 11 Esia tututu tae míedoa gbe ɖa ɖe mia ta ɣesiaɣi ɖo, be mía Mawu la nabu mi be miedze na eƒe yɔyɔ la, eye wòatsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ awɔ nu nyui sia nu nyui kple xɔse ƒe dɔ siwo dze eŋu la bliboe. 12 Ale be woado mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe dzi le mia me, eye woado miawo hã ɖe dzi le eya amea me, le mía Mawu la, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo, ƒe amenuveve la nu.
ENGLISH: 11 To this same end we are always praying for you that our God may deem you worthy to be called and may potently bring to full realization every impulse of goodwill and work of faith, 12 so that the name of our Lord Jesus may have its glory manifested in you, and you yours in it, in accordance with the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 2 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Thessalonians

EWE: 2 Ke nɔviwo, le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe anyinɔɣi kple esime woaƒo mía nu ƒu ɖe egbɔ ŋuti la, míele biabiam tso mia si 2 be miagana woatɔtɔ miaƒe susu kaba alo ana nya aɖe si adze abe gbɔgbɔ mee wòtso ene, alo nya aɖe si wogblɔ kple nu, alo agbalẽ aɖe si adze abe mía gbɔe wòtso ene la, naɖe fu na mi, be Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la ɖo vɔ o.
ENGLISH: 2 But we beg you, brothers, as to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, 2 not to shake right out of your senses nor be disquieted either by an inspiration or by an argument, or by a letter as being by us, with the idea that the Day of the Lord is upon us.

EWE: 3 Migana ame aɖeke nakplɔ mi atrae le mɔ aɖeke nu o, elabena ŋkeke ma mava o, negbe ɖe xɔsegbegbe la va gbã, eye woɖe sedzimawɔla, si nye tsɔtsrɔ̃vi la fia hafi. 4 Tsitretsiɖeŋulae wònye, eye wòdoa eɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe nu sia nu si woyɔna be mawu alo nu si wosubɔna la ŋu, eye ale wònɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ me, hele eɖokui ɖem fia gaglã be mawu yenye. 5 Ðe mieɖo ŋkui be, esime menɔ mia gbɔ la, melɔ̃a nya siawo gbɔgblɔ na mi oa? 6 Ke azɔ mienya nu si le mɔ xem nɛ la, ale be woaɖee ɖe go le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi la dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 Do not let anybody deceive you in any way, because unless the apostasy comes first and the Man of Wickedness is disclosed, the man bound for destruction, 4 he who is in opposition to every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God’s temple, declaring himself to be a god 5 do you not remember that while I was still with you I told you all this? 6 and you know now what is holding him back to be disclosed at his own time.

EWE: 8 Ekema woaɖe sedzimawɔla la ɖe go, ame si Aƒetɔ Yesu atsɔ eƒe numegbɔgbɔ aɖe ɖa, eye wòato eƒe anyinɔɣi si adze ƒãa la dzi abu mo nɛ. 9 Ke sedzimawɔla la ƒe anyinɔnɔ la nye Satana ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si me wowɔa ŋusẽdɔwo kple amebeble ƒe dzesiwo kple nukunuwo 10 kpakple nu madzɔmadzɔ ɖe sia ɖe le tsɔ blea ame siwo le tsɔtsrɔ̃m la abe woƒe fetu ene, elabena womexɔ nyateƒe la ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la, ne woakpɔ ɖeɖe o. 11 Esia tae Mawu ɖe mɔ vodada ƒe ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi kplɔ wo trae, ale be woaxɔ aʋatsokaka dzi ase, 12 ne woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo katã le esi womexɔ nyateƒe la dzi se o, ke boŋ wokpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ ŋu ta.
ENGLISH: 7 For the Secret of Wickedness is already at work; only he who is now holding things back until he gets out of the way, 8 and then the Wicked One will be disclosed, whom the Lord will consume by the breath of his mouth and will supersede by the intervention of his presence; 9 whose presence is as is proper for Satan’s working, in all power and tokens and wonders of untruth 10 and in all deceitfulness of wrong for those who are perishing, inasmuch as they did not accept the love of the truth so that they should be saved, 11 and for this reason God is sending them a working of delusion so that they shall believe the untrue, 12 that all may be judged who have not believed the truth but have been satisfied with wrong.

EWE: 13 Gake ele na mí be míada akpe na Mawu ɣesiaɣi ɖe mi, nɔvi siwo Yehowa lɔ̃ la ta, elabena Mawu tia mi tso gɔmedzedzea me na ɖeɖekpɔkpɔ, to eƒe gbɔgbɔ si wòtsɔ kɔ mia ŋu kple miaƒe nyateƒe la dzi xɔxɔ se me. 14 Eyɔ mi va esia gbɔ to nya nyui si míegblɔna la dzi, ale be mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la nasu mia si.
ENGLISH: 13 But we are bound to thank God always for you, brothers loved by the Lord, that God from the first chose you for salvation in sanctification of spirit and faith in truth, 14 to which same thing he called you through our gospel message, for preservation in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 15 Eya ta nɔviwo, minɔ tsitre sesĩe, eye milé nu siwo míefia mi, eɖanye to numenya alo agbalẽ aɖe si míeŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mí dzi o, la me ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 15 So then, brothers, stand firm and hold on to the propositions you were taught by either word or letter of ours.

EWE: 16 Eye mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋutɔ kple Mawu, mía Fofo, ame si lɔ̃ mí, eye wòto eƒe amenuveve me na akɔfafa mavɔ kple mɔkpɔkpɔ nyui mí la, 17 nafa akɔ na miaƒe dziwo, eye wòado ŋusẽ mi le dɔ nyui kple nya nyui ɖe sia ɖe me.
ENGLISH: 16 And may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and graciously gave us an eternal encouragement and a good hope, 17 encourage your hearts and fortify them in every good work and word.

EWE: 2 Tesalonikatɔwo
ENGLISH: 2 Thessalonians

EWE: 3 Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɖe mía ta, be Yehowa ƒe nya la nayi edzi akaka kabakaba, eye woakɔ eŋu abe ale si wòle le mia gome ene, 2 eye be woaɖe mí tso nu vevi wɔamelawo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me, elabena menye amewo katã sie xɔse le o.
ENGLISH: 3 For the rest, pray for us, brothers, that the word of the Lord may speed on and show its gloriousness the same as it does with you, 2 and that we may be delivered from criminal and vicious men; for it is not everybody that has faith.

EWE: 3 Ke nuteƒewɔlae Aƒetɔ la nye, ana mianɔ te sesĩe, eye wòakpɔ mia ta tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la si me.
ENGLISH: 3 But the Lord is faithful, who will fortify you and guard you from the Evil One.

EWE: 4 Gawu la, míeka ɖe mia dzi le Aƒetɔ la me be miele mɔfiame siwo míena mi la dzi wɔm, eye be miayi edzi awɔ wo.
ENGLISH: 4 And we trust to you in the Lord that what we are enjoining you to do you are also doing, and will do.

EWE: 5 Aƒetɔ la neyi edzi wòafia mɔ miaƒe dziwo dzidzedzetɔe ayi Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple dzidodo le Kristo la ta gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 5 And may the Lord pilot your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s steadfastness.

EWE: 6 Ke nɔviwo, míele mɔfiame sia nam mi le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ me be, miate mia ɖokui ɖa le nɔvi sia nɔvi si zɔna sakasaka la ŋu, ame si mezɔna ɖe nu siwo miexɔ tso mía gbɔ nu la dzi o.
ENGLISH: 6 But we enjoin you, brothers, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, that you are to avoid every brother that takes to irregular courses, not in accordance with the instruction you had from us.

EWE: 7 Elabena miawo ŋutɔwo mienya ale si wòle be miasrɔ̃ míi, elabena esi míenɔ mia dome la, míezɔ sakasaka o, 8 eye míeɖu nu le ame aɖeke gbɔ dzodzro o.
ENGLISH: 7 For you know yourselves how you have to imitate us, that we did not live irregularly among you, 8 nor get our board gratis from anybody, but toiling and moiling night and day at work, for the sake of not burdening any of you 9 not that we do not have a right, but in order that we might give ourselves as a model for you to imitate.

EWE: Ke boŋ míeku kutri wɔ dɔ zã kple keli, be míaganye agba gã aɖeke na mia dometɔ aɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 10 For even when we were with you we gave you this injunction, If one will not work let him not eat either.

EWE: 12 Míele se dem na ame siawo, eye míele nu xlɔ̃m wo le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo me be, woawɔ dɔ kpoo, eye woaɖu nu siwo woawo ŋutɔwo wɔ dɔ kpɔ la.
ENGLISH: 11 For we hear of some among you living irregularly, not working at anything but frittering away their time; 12 but such we enjoin and exhort to work quietly and eat bread of their own.

EWE: 13 Ke nɔviwo, miawo la, migadzudzɔ nu si nyo la wɔwɔ o.
ENGLISH: 13 But for yourselves, brothers, do not give up doing what is good.

EWE: 14 Ke ne ame aɖe meɖo to míaƒe agbalẽ sia me nyawo o la, mide dzesi ame sia eye midzudzɔ hadede kplii, ale be ŋu nakpee. 15 Ke hã migabui abe futɔ ene o, ke boŋ miyi edzi mianɔ nu xlɔ̃mee abe nɔvi ene.
ENGLISH: 14 And if anyone does not obey our words in this letter, note that man as a man not to be mixed up with, in order that he may be ashamed of himself; 15 and do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

EWE: 16 Ke ŋutifafa ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ nana ŋutifafa mi ɣeawokatãɣi le mɔ sia mɔ nu.
ENGLISH: 16 And may the Lord of Peace himself give you peace all the time in every way.

EWE: Aƒetɔ la nenɔ anyi kpli mi katã.
ENGLISH: The Lord be with you all.

EWE: 17 Nye, Paulo ƒe gbedoname, si metsɔ nye ŋutɔ nye asi ŋlɔ, si nye dzesi le nye agbalẽ ɖe sia ɖe me, lae nye esi; aleae meŋlɔa nui.
ENGLISH: 17 Greeting in my own hand from me, Paul, which is a token in every letter; this is the way I write.

EWE: 18 Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nanɔ kpli mi katã.
ENGLISH: 18 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

EWE: 1 Timoteo
ENGLISH: 1 Timothy

EWE: 1 Paulo, Kristo Yesu ƒe apostolo, le Mawu mía Xɔla kple Kristo Yesu míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ la ƒe sedede nu, 2 le esia ŋlɔm na Timoteo, vinye vavã le xɔse la me:
ENGLISH: 1 Paul, Christ Jesus’s apostle by order of God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope, 2 to Timothy my own child in faith: grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

EWE: Amenuveve, nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa si tso Mawu Fofo la kple Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ gbɔ la, nanɔ kpli wò. 3 Ale si ko mede dzi ƒo na wò be nànɔ Efeso esime menɔ Makedonia mɔ dzem la, nenema kee mele dzi dem ƒo na wò fifia hã be nàde se na ame aɖewo be, woaganɔ nu bubu fiam o, 4 eye be woagalé to ɖe gliwo kple dzidzimewo xexlẽ fia ŋuti o. Nu mawo meɖea vi aɖeke o, ɖeko wonana amewo susua nyawo gblɔna le esi teƒe be woana amewo nanya nane si ado ŋusẽ wo le Mawu dzi xɔxɔ se me. 5 Le nyateƒe me la, taɖodzinu si le mɔfiame sia ŋue nye be, lɔlɔ̃ si tso dzi dzadzɛ kple dzitsinya nyui kpakple xɔse si me alakpa mele o la me nasu mía si. 6 Esi ame aɖewo tra tso nu siawo gbɔ ta la, wotrɔ ɖe nu kpoloe ƒoƒo si meɖea vi aɖeke o ŋu. 7 Wodi be yewoanye sefialawo, evɔ womesea nya siwo gblɔm wole alo nu siwo dzi wotea tɔ ɖo vevie la gɔme o.
ENGLISH: 3 As I urged you to wait on at Ephesus when I took my trip to Macedonia in order that you might instruct some people not to teach erratic notions 4 nor devote attention to myths and endless genealogies, which give anybody more of fields for research than of attention to God’s affairs in faith, 5 but the object of the injunction is love, out of a pure heart and good conscience and unfeigned faith, 6 things which some have failed to hit upon and have run off into futile talk, 7 wanting to be teachers of the law when they have no sense either of the things they say or of what it is they are being so positive about.

EWE: 8 Ke míenyae be Se la nyo, nenye be ame wɔa eŋu dɔ ale si dze, 9 eye wònyae be menye ame dzɔdzɔe tae wodea se ɖo o, ke ame siwo tae wodenɛ ɖoe nye sedzidalawo kple aglãdzelawo, ame mavɔ̃mawuwo kple nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo, ame mawɔnuteƒewo kple ame siwo medea bubu nu kɔkɔewo ŋu o, tɔwulawo kple nɔwulawo, amewulawo, 10 ame siwo ƒoa wo ɖokuiwo ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me, ŋutsu siwo dɔna kple ŋutsuwo, amefilawo, aʋatsokalawo, atam dzodzro kalawo, kpakple nu bubu ɖe sia ɖe si tsi tsitre ɖe nufiafia si le blibo la ŋu, 11 nufiafia si sɔ ɖe Mawu dzidzɔtɔ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nya nyui, si wotsɔ de asi nam la nu.
ENGLISH: 8 But we know that the law is a fine thing if one uses it in the lawful way, 9 knowing this, that the law is not enacted for an honest man but for such as are lawless and refractory, impious and sinful, unholy and profane, such as raise their hands against father and mother, murderers, 10 libertines, homosexuals, kidnappers, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is in opposition to sound teaching, 11 in accordance with the gospel of the grace of the blessed God which was entrusted to me.

EWE: 12 Medaa akpe na mía Aƒetɔ Kristo Yesu, ame si do ŋusẽm la, elabena ebum nuteƒewɔlae be wòtsɔ subɔsubɔdɔ de asi nam, 13 togbɔ be tsã la, menye busunyagblɔla kple yometila kpakple ame mabuame hã. Gake wokpɔ nublanui nam, elabena mewɔe le manyamanya me kple dzimaxɔse me. 14 Ke mía Aƒetɔ la ve nunye geɖe ŋutɔ ale be xɔse su asinye to lɔlɔ̃ si le Kristo Yesu me la me.
ENGLISH: 12 I thank him who put power into me, our Lord Jesus Christ, that he regarded me as faithful, assigning me to service, 13 when I had previously been a blasphemer and a persecutor and a ruffian; but mercy was shown me because I did it ignorantly in unbelief, 14 and our Lord’s grace overtopped, with faith and hope in Christ Jesus.

EWE: 15 Nya sia nye nyateƒe, eye wòdze be woalɔ̃ ɖe edzi bliboe be: Kristo Yesu va xexea me be yeaɖe nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo.
ENGLISH: 15 The saying is a trustworthy one, and deserves all assent, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.

EWE: Nyee nye ame siawo dometɔ gãtɔ. 16 Gake wokpɔ nublanui nam ale be Kristo Yesu nato nye, ame si nye nu vɔ̃ wɔla gãtɔ dzi aɖe eƒe dzigbɔgbɔ blewu la katã afia, be wòanye kpɔɖeŋu na ame siwo aziɔ woƒe xɔse ɖe eŋu hena agbe mavɔ la.
ENGLISH: Of whom I am the foremost; 16 but this was why mercy was shown me, in order that in me the foremost one Jesus Christ might show utter patience, that I might serve as an outline sketch of those who were to believe on him for eternal life.

EWE: 17 Ke Fia mavɔmavɔtɔ, magblemagblẽ, makpɔmakpɔ, Mawu ɖeka kolia la, tɔ nanye bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.
ENGLISH: 17 And to the King of the Ages, the imperishable, invisible only God, be honor and glory forever and ever; amen.

EWE: Amen. 18 Vinye Timoteo, metsɔ mɔfiame sia le asi dem na wò le nyagblɔɖi siwo ku ɖe ŋuwò la nu, ale be woakpe ɖe ŋuwò nàyi aʋa nyui la wɔwɔ dzi, 19 eye nàlé xɔse kple dzitsinya nyui me ɖe asi, nu siwo ame aɖewo tu asii ɖa, si na woƒe xɔse dome gblẽ abe tɔdziʋu si gbã ene. 20 Himenayo kple Aleksandro le ame siawo dome, eye meɖe asi le wo ŋu na Satana, ne woahe to na wo atsɔ afia wo be woaganɔ busunya gblɔm o.
ENGLISH: 18 This injunction I address to you, my child Timothy, in accordance with the prophecies that led the way to you, that under them you should fight the good campaign, 19 having faith, and a good conscience, which some have thrown overboard and so come to shipwreck as to the faith; 20 among these Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to Satan in order that they might be given a lesson not to blaspheme.

EWE: 1 Timoteo
ENGLISH: 1 Timothy

EWE: 2 Eya ta gbã la, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi be mianɔ kokoƒoƒowo, gbedodoɖawo, kukuɖeɖewo kple akpedadawo dzi ɖe ame ƒomeviwo katã ta, 2 ɖe fiawo kple ame siwo katã le ŋusẽnɔƒewo la ta, ale be míayi edzi anɔ anyi kpoo le tomefafa me le ɖokuitsɔtsɔ na Mawu blibo kple moveviɖoɖo katã me.
ENGLISH: 2 I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be presented for all men; 2 for emperors and all our superiors, in order that we may lead a still and quiet life in all piety and propriety.

EWE: 3 Nu sia nyo, eye wòsɔ le Mawu, mía Xɔla ŋkume, 4 ame si ƒe lɔlɔ̃nue nye be woaɖe ame ƒomeviwo katã, eye nyateƒe ƒe sidzedze vavãtɔ la nasu wo si.
ENGLISH: 3 This is a good thing and a thing welcome to God our Savior, 4 who wills that all men should be saved and come into awareness of truth.

EWE: 5 Elabena Mawu ɖeka kple domenɔla ɖeka si le Mawu kple amegbetɔwo dome, ame si nye Kristo Yesu ye li, 6 ame si tsɔ eɖokui na wònye tafe si sɔ ɖe enu ɖe amewo katã ta nu sia ŋue wòle be woaɖi ɖase le le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi dzi. 7 Ðaseɖiɖi sia tae woɖom gbeƒãɖela kple apostolo kple dukɔwo ƒe nufiala le xɔse kpakple nyateƒe ƒe nya la me ɖo nyateƒe tom mele, nyemele aʋatso kam o.
ENGLISH: 5 For there is one God, one mediator too between God and men, a man, Christ Jesus, 6 he who gave himself as a ransom for everybody; the attestation when the right time came, 7 for which I was appointed a herald and apostle, I am telling the truth, not lying, a teacher of the nations in faith and truth.

EWE: 8 Eya ta medi be le afi sia afi la, ŋutsuwo nanɔ gbe dom ɖa, eye woawu asiwo dzi le kɔkɔenyenye me, dzikudodo kple glãkahehe manɔmee. 9 Nenema kee nyɔnuwo hã nado awu ɖe nɔnɔme nyui me, le ŋukpekpe kple ŋuɖɔɖo me, menye le ɖaƒoƒo ƒe atsyãwo kple sika alo dzonuwo alo awu xɔasiwo dodo me o, 10 ke boŋ woaɖo atsyɔ̃ abe ale si wòdze nyɔnu siwo vɔ̃a Mawu la ene, le dɔ nyuiwo wɔwɔ me.
ENGLISH: 8 So I wish to have the men pray in every place, raising godly hands without anger and argument; 9 in the same way, to have women adorn themselves by virtuous self-restraint with modesty and discretion, not by hairdressing and gold or pearls or expensive clothing, 10 but what befits women who profess religiousness, by means of good works.

EWE: 11 Nyɔnu nasrɔ̃ nu le ɖoɖoezizi me le ɖokuibɔbɔ blibo me. 12 Nyemeɖe mɔ na nyɔnu be wòafia nu alo akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe ŋutsu dzi o, ke boŋ be wòazi ɖoɖoe.
ENGLISH: 11 Let a woman learn in quietness in all submissiveness; 12 but I do not permit a woman to teach nor to dictate to a man, but to be in quietness.

EWE: 13 Elabena Adam ye wowɔ gbã, emegbe la, Xawa. 14 Eye menye Adam ye woble o, ke boŋ nyɔnu lae woble vevie, eye wòdze vodada me.
ENGLISH: 13 For Adam was formed first, then Eve; 14 and Adam was not deceived, but the woman was befooled into violation of the command.

EWE: 15 Gake woakpɔ nyɔnu ta dedie to vidzidzi me, ne eyi edzi zɔ le xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ kple kɔkɔenyenye kpakple ŋuɖɔɖo me ko.
ENGLISH: 15 But she will be saved in her childbearing, if they remain in faith and love and consecration with discretion.

EWE: 1 Timoteo
ENGLISH: 1 Timothy

EWE: 3 Nyateƒenyae nya sia nye: Ne ŋutsu aɖe le dzikpɔladɔ minyam la, ele dɔ nyui minyam. 2 Eya ta ele be dzikpɔla nanye mokakamanɔŋutɔ, nyɔnu ɖeka srɔ̃, wòada asɔ le nuwɔna me, wòanye ame ɖɔŋuɖo, ame si wɔa nu le ɖoɖo nu, amedzrowɔla, ame si nya nufiafia, 3 menye ahamula o, menye ŋutasẽla o, ke boŋ nugɔmesela, menye dzrehela o, menye galɔ̃la o, 4 ke ame si kpɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe dzi nyuie, eye viawo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui anukwaretɔe 5 (elabena ne ame aɖe menya ale si wòakpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe dzi o ɖe, aleke wòawɔ akpɔ Mawu ƒe hame la dzi?), 6 menye ame si ƒe dzimetɔtrɔ teƒe medidi o, ne wòagado eɖokui ɖe dzi glodzoo, eye wòadze ʋɔnu si wodrɔ̃ Abosam la me o.
ENGLISH: 3 The saying is a trustworthy one, "If one has an inclination to a visitor’s place, he is desiring a good work. " 2 So the church visitor must be unimpeachable, husband of one wife, sober, discreet, well-behaved, hospitable, good at teaching, 3 not disorderly over his wine, not apt to come to blows, but reasonable, one who keeps out of fights, who has no love for money, 4 who manages his own household well, having children behaving submissively with all correctness 5 (but if one does not know how to manage his own household, how is he to take care of God’s church?); 6 not a new convert, so that he may not get his head turned and fall under the judgment of gossip.

EWE: 7 Azɔ hã, ele be wòakpɔ ɖaseɖiɖi nyui tso ame siwo le egodo la hã gbɔ, ale be wòagadze vlodoame kple Abosam ƒe mɔ̃ me o.
ENGLISH: 7 And he must also have good attestation from the outsiders, so that he may not fall under the gibes of gossip and into its trap.

EWE: 8 Nenema kee subɔsubɔdɔwɔlawo hã nanye ame siwo léa fɔ ɖe nu ŋu, woaganye aɖeveetɔwo o, woaganye aha geɖe nolawo o, woaganye ame siwo klẽa ŋu ɖe viɖe ƒoɖi kpɔkpɔ ŋu o, 9 woanye ame siwo léa xɔse ƒe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe la me ɖe asi le dzitsinya dzadzɛ me.
ENGLISH: 8 Deacons, in the same way, dignified, not double-tongued, not interested in much wine, not mercenary, 9 holding the secret of the faith in a clean conscience; 10 and let these too be investigated first, then let them serve as deacons when of unblemished reputation.

EWE: 11 Nenema kee nyɔnuwo hã nawɔ nu kple moveviɖoɖo, woaganye ameŋugblẽlawo o, woada asɔ le nuwɔna me, woanye nuteƒewɔlawo le nu sia nu me.
ENGLISH: 11 Women, in the same way, dignified, not scandalmongers, sober, reliable in everything.

EWE: 12 Subɔsubɔdɔwɔla nanye nyɔnu ɖeka srɔ̃, ame si kpɔa viawo kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe dzi nyuie.
ENGLISH: 12 Let deacons be husbands of one wife who manage their children and their own households well.

EWE: 13 Elabena tenɔnɔ nyui sua ŋutsu siwo subɔna nyuie la si, eye dzi nɔa wo ƒo wotea ŋu ƒoa nu faa tso ale si woxɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 13 For those who have done good service as deacons are securing for themselves a good standing and great boldness in faith in Christ Jesus.

EWE: 14 Togbɔ be mele nya siawo ŋlɔm na wò hã la, mele mɔ kpɔm be mava gbɔwò kpuie. 15 Ke ne metsi megbe la, ne nànya ale si nàzɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe, si nye Mawu gbagbe la ƒe hame, si nye nyateƒe la ƒe sɔti kple nu si lée ɖe te la me.
ENGLISH: 14 I am writing you this in hopes of coming to you pretty soon; 15 but if I am long about it, in order that you may know how one has to behave in God’s household, which the church of the living God, pillar and foothold of the truth, is.

EWE: 16 Vavãe, edze ƒãa be ɖokuitsɔtsɔ na Mawu ƒe nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe sia lolo: ‘Woɖee fia le ŋutilã me, wobui ame dzɔdzɔe le gbɔgbɔ me, eɖe eɖokui fia mawudɔlawo, woɖe gbeƒãe le dukɔwo dome, woxɔ edzi se le xexea me, woxɔe yi dziƒo le ŋutikɔkɔe me.’
ENGLISH: 16 And, recognizedly, piety’s secret is a great one: "he who was manifested in flesh, was vindicated in spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among nations, was believed in the world, was taken up in glory. "

EWE: 1 Timoteo
ENGLISH: 1 Timothy

EWE: 4 Gake nya si tso gbɔgbɔ me la gblɔe kɔtɛ be, le ɣeyiɣi siwo ava va me la, ame aɖewo ade megbe tso xɔse la gbɔ, eye woalé to ɖe beblegbɔgbɔwo ƒe nyawo kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe nufiafiawo ŋu, 2 to aʋatsokalawo ƒe alakpanuwɔwɔ me, ame siwo ƒe dzitsinya ku atri. 3 Ame siwo dea se ɖe srɔ̃ɖeɖe nu, eye wogblɔna na amewo be woatsri nuɖuɖu siwo Mawu wɔ be ame siwo si xɔse le, eye wonya nyateƒea nyuie la, naɖu kple akpedada la. 4 Elabena Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ ɖe sia ɖe nyo, eye mele be woatsri naneke o, ne wonya xɔe kple akpedada ko, 5 elabena wokɔ eŋu to Mawu ƒe nya kple gbedodoɖa ɖe eta me.
ENGLISH: 4 But the Spirit says explicitly that in later times some will drop out of the faith, giving their attention to misleading spirits and the teachings of demons 2 in the insincerity of falsifiers who carry a brand on their consciences, 3 who forbid people to marry, and tell them to abstain from foods which God created to be partaken of with thanks by those who have faith and awareness of the truth; 4 because every creature of God’s is good, and nothing is to be rejected when it can be received with thanksgiving; 5 for it is hallowed by God’s word and invocation.

EWE: 6 Ne ètsɔ nuxlɔ̃ame siawo ɖo nɔviawo ŋkume la, ànye Kristo Yesu ƒe subɔla nyui, ame si wotsɔ xɔse ƒe nyawo kple nufiafia nyui si yome nèdze pɛpɛpɛ la nyii. 7 Ke gbe alakpagli siwo medea bubu Mawu ŋu o, siwo ƒomevi nyagãwo tona la. Ke boŋ wò taɖodzinu nanye be nàtsɔ mawusosroɖa anɔ ɖokuiwò mlamee.
ENGLISH: 6 By giving the brothers this advice you will be a good agent of Christ Jesus’s, training yourself in the words of the faith and of the good teaching which you have listened to; 7 but ignore unsanctified puerile fictions.

EWE: 8 Elabena ŋutilãmamla nyo na nu vi aɖe ko, ke mawusosroɖa ya nyo na nuwo katã, elabena elé agbe si li fifi kple esi le vava ge la ƒe ŋugbedodo la ɖe asi. 9 Nya ma nye nyateƒe, eye wòdze be woalɔ̃ ɖe edzi bliboe.
ENGLISH: And exercise yourself in piety; 8 for physical exercise is beneficial in a small way, but piety is beneficial for everything, having a promise of life, life now and the future life; 9 the saying is a trustworthy one, and deserves all assent.

EWE: 10 Esia tae míele dɔ wɔm sesĩe hele ʋiʋlim ɖo, elabena Mawu gbagbe dzie míeda míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖo, ame si nye ame ƒomeviwo katã Xɔla, vevietɔ ame siwo nye nuteƒewɔlawo.
ENGLISH: 10 For it is to this end we are toiling and struggling, because we have set our hopes on the living God, who is the savior of all men, especially of believers.

EWE: 11 Yi edzi nànɔ se siawo dem, eye nànɔ wo fiam.
ENGLISH: 11 Enjoin and teach these things.

EWE: 12 Mègana ame aɖeke nado vlo wò ɖekakpuinyenye o. Ke boŋ nànye kpɔɖeŋu na nuteƒewɔlawo le nuƒoƒo me, le agbenɔnɔ me, le lɔlɔ̃ me, le xɔse me, le agbe dzadzɛ nɔnɔ me.
ENGLISH: 12 Let nobody despise your youthfulness, but set an example to the brothers in words, in life, in love, in faith, in purity.

EWE: 13 Yi edzi nàdo vevie dutoƒo nuxexlẽ, nuxɔxlɔ̃ kple nufiafia, va se ɖe esime mava.
ENGLISH: 13 Till I come, give your attention to the reading, to the exhortation, to the teaching.

EWE: 14 Mègawɔ nunana si le mewò, si wona wò to nyagblɔɖi me esime hamemetsitsiwo ƒe ha la da asi ɖe dziwò la ŋu dɔ ɖewoɖewoe o.
