" 7 Eya ta miawoe wòxɔ asi na, elabena miexɔe se; ke ame siwo mexɔna sena o la, "kpe si xɔtulawo gbe la, eyae va zu dzogoedzikpe vevitɔ, " 8 eye wònye "nukikli ƒe kpe kple nuɖiaɖia ƒe agakpe. " Wokpɔa nuɖiaɖia elabena womeɖoa to nya la o. Alea tututue woƒe nuwuwu anɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 Because there is a text where it reads "Here I am laying in Sion a noble select crowning-stone, and he who believes on him shall not be put to shame. " 7 So the nobility is for you believers; but for disbelievers "The stone that the builders condemned, that stone has come to be the top of the corner " 8 and "a stone to strike against, a rock to stumble over " who stumble by disobeying the word; which is what they were set for.

EWE: 9 Ke miawo la, mienye "dzidzime tiatia, nunɔla siwo nye fiawo, dukɔ kɔkɔe, dukɔ si nye Mawu ƒe nunɔamesi tɔxɛ, be miaɖe gbeƒã " Ame si yɔ mi tso viviti me va eƒe kekeli wɔnukua me la "ƒe nɔnɔme nyuiwo. " 10 Elabena mienye dukɔ tsã o, ke azɔ mienye Mawu ƒe dukɔ; tsã la, womekpɔ nublanui na mi o, ke azɔ la, wokpɔ nublanui na mi.
ENGLISH: 9 But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for preservation, that you may publish the merits of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light 10 you who had once been No Nation but are God’s nation now, who had been Unpitied but have now had pity taken on you.

EWE: 11 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi amedzrowo, ame siwo li hena ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe, be miatsri ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzro siwo le avu wɔm kpli mi la. 12 Mina miaƒe agbenɔnɔ nanyo le dukɔwo dome, ale be ne wotso mia nu be mienye vɔ̃wɔlawo hã la, woawo ŋutɔwo woava de dzesi miaƒe nu nyui wɔwɔwo, eye woakafu Mawu le eƒe kpɔkpɔɖaŋkeke la dzi.
ENGLISH: 11 Dear friends, I exhort you, as men living abroad among an alien race, to abstain from fleshly desires, which wage a war against the soul, 12 and to keep up a good life among the foreigners, that where they decry you as evil-doers they may in consequence of your good deeds, as they watch them, glorify God on the day of visitation.

EWE: 13 Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe amegbetɔwo ƒe nuɖoanyiwo katã te le Aƒetɔ la ta, eɖanye fia si le ɖoƒe kɔkɔ, 14 alo nutodziɖula siwo wòdɔna be woahe to na nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo gake woakafu nu nyui wɔlawo, la o. 15 Elabena Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nue nye be miawɔ nu nyui atsɔ atsi ame mabutamewo ƒe nuƒoƒo numanyamanyatɔe la nu. 16 Minɔ abe ablɔɖemewo ene, ke migazã miaƒe ablɔɖe la abe taflatsɛdonu ene anɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔm o, ke boŋ mizãe abe Mawu ƒe kluviwo ene.
ENGLISH: 13 Be submissive to every human institution for the Lord’s sake, whether to the emperor as sovereign 14 or to governors as sent through him for punishment of evil-doers and praise of right-doers, 15 because such is God’s will, that by doing right you should silence senseless men’s ignorance; 16 as freemen, and not as having freedom for a cover to viciousness, but as servants of God.

EWE: 17 Mibu ame ƒomeviwo katã, milɔ̃ nɔviwo ƒe habɔbɔ blibo la katã, mivɔ̃ Mawu, mibu fia la.
ENGLISH: 17 Honor everybody; love the brotherhood; fear God; honor the emperor.

EWE: 18 Subɔviwo nabɔbɔ wo ɖokuiwo na woƒe aƒetɔwo ahatsɔ bubu si wodze na la na wo, menye wo dometɔ siwo nye ame nyuiwo kple nugɔmeselawo ko o, ke esiwo ŋu nu medzena o hã. 19 Elabena enye nu nyui ne ame aɖe doa dzi le xaxawo me, eye wòkpea fu madzemadzee le esi wòdi be dzitsinya nyui nanɔ ye si le Mawu gbɔ ta.
ENGLISH: 18 Domestics, be submissive to your masters in all fear, not only to the kind and reasonable but also to the cranky; 19 for it is a credit if one bears troubles for the consciousness of God, when one suffers unjustly.

EWE: 20 Elabena ne woƒo mi le nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ta eye miedo dzi tsɔe la, viɖe kae wònye? Gake ne miekpea fu le nu nyui wɔwɔ ta, eye miedo dzi tsɔe la, esia dzea Mawu ŋu.
ENGLISH: 20 For what is there grand about it if you endure when you do wrong and are cuffed? but if you endure when you do right and suffer, that is a credit with God.

EWE: Esi wòle fu kpem la, medo ŋɔdzi na ame o, ke boŋ etsɔ eɖokui de asi na Ame si drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe la. 24 Eya ŋutɔ tsɔ míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ɖo eƒe ŋutilã dzi le ati la ŋu, ale be míaku na nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ahanɔ agbe na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ. Eye "woto eƒe abiwo dzi yɔ dɔ mi. " 25 Elabena mienɔ abe alẽ siwo tra mɔ ene, ke azɔ mietrɔ va miaƒe luʋɔ ƒe kplɔla kple dzikpɔla la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 21 For this is what you were called for, because Christ too suffered on your account, leaving behind a pattern for you that you might follow in his track 22 he who did no sin, nor was trickery found in his mouth; 23 who did not answer with abuse when he was abused, did not make threats when he suffered, but committed his case to him who judges justly; 24 who himself carried our sins up to the tree in his body, that we might perish to sins and live to righteousness; by whose stripes you have been healed, 25 for you were like sheep astray, but you have now turned back to the Shepherd and Visitor of your souls.

EWE: 1 Petro
ENGLISH: 1 Peter

EWE: 3 Nenema kee mi srɔ̃nyɔnuwo hã, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia srɔ̃wo, ale be ne srɔ̃ŋutsu aɖewo meɖoa to nya la o la, wo srɔ̃wo ƒe agbenɔnɔ nya aɖeke magblɔmagblɔe naɖe wo, 2 esi woawo ŋutɔ kpɔ miaƒe agbenɔnɔ dzadzɛ kple bubu deto la ta.
ENGLISH: 3 Likewise, wives, be submissive to your husbands, so that even if some are disobedient to the word they shall through their wives’ life be won without words 2 when they watch your pure life lived in fear.

EWE: 3 Migana miaƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo nanye gota gome tɔ, to ɖaƒoƒo kple sikanuwo dodo alo awu xɔasiwo dodo me o, 4 ke boŋ mina wòanye dzi me ƒe ame ɣaɣla si nye gbɔgbɔ fatu si nɔa anyi kpoo la ƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo si megblẽna o, si xɔ asi ŋutɔ le Mawu ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 3 And be yours not the outward adornment of plaiting hair and wearing jewels or putting on dresses, 4 but the secret person of the heart in the imperishable adornment of a meek and quiet spirit, which is worth a fortune before God.

EWE: 5 Elabena alea nyɔnu kɔkɔe siwo nɔ anyi le blema siwo nɔ mɔ kpɔm na Mawu la hã ɖoa atsyɔ̃e, eye wobɔbɔa wo ɖokuiwo na wo srɔ̃wo, 6 abe ale si Sara ɖoa to Abraham heyɔnɛ be aƒetɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 5 For so in former times did the holy women who hoped in God adorn themselves, submitting to their husbands, 6 as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him "lord "; whose children you have become when you do right and fear no terror.

EWE: Eye ne mieyia edzi wɔa nu nyui, eye mievɔ̃a ŋɔdzidodo aɖeke o la, ekema miezu viawo. 7 Nenema kee mi srɔ̃ŋutsuwo hã, miyi edzi mianɔ anyi kple mia srɔ̃wo le nunya me.
ENGLISH: 7 Husbands likewise, live intelligently with womankind as a weaker thing, according them honor as co-heirs in the grace of life, so as not to have your prayers hindered.

EWE: 9 Migaɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe alo dzudzu dzudzu teƒe o. Ke miyra amewo boŋ, elabena agbenɔnɔmɔ sia tae woyɔ mi ɖo, be mianyi yayra dome. 10 Elabena "ame si lɔ̃a agbe, eye wòdi be yeakpɔ ŋkeke nyuiwo la, nekpɔ eƒe aɖe dzi le vɔ̃ ŋu, kple eƒe nuyiwo dzi le amebeble ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 And finally, all be united, sympathizing, brother-loving, kindly, humble, 9 not paying back hurt for hurt or abuse for abuse, but contrariwise blessing everybody; because this is what you were called for, that you might inherit a blessing.

EWE: 11 Netrɔ ɖa le vɔ̃ ŋu, eye wòawɔ nu nyui; nedi ŋutifafa, eye wòati eyome. 12 Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkuwo le ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu, eye eƒe towo le woƒe kokoƒoƒo ŋu, ke Yehowa tɔa ŋku nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo. " 13 Le nyateƒe me la, ame kae awɔ nu vevi mi, ne miedoa vevie nu le nu nyui wɔwɔ me? 14 Ke ne ehiã be miakpe fu le dzɔdzɔenyenye ta hã la, dzi dzɔa mi. Ke migavɔ̃ nu si vɔ̃m wole la o, eye dzika negatso mia ƒo hã o.
ENGLISH: 10 For "he who would love life and see good days, let him stop his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit, 11 and let him shun evil and do the good, seek peace and pursue it; 12 because the Lord’s eyes are upon the righteous and his ears are toward their petition, but the Lord’s face is against the doers of evil. " 13 And who is it that will harm you if you show yourselves zealous for good?

EWE: 15 Ke boŋ mikɔ Kristo la si nye Aƒetɔ ŋu le miaƒe dziwo me, eye minɔ dzadzraɖoɖi ɣesiaɣi be miaʋli mɔkpɔkpɔ si le mia si la ta le ame sia ame si abia nya mi tso eŋu la ŋkume, gake miwɔe le tufafa kple bubu deto me. 16 Milé dzitsinya nyui me ɖe asi, ale be le nu sia nu si me wogblɔa nya vlo ɖe mia ŋu le me la, ŋu nakpe ame siwo gblɔa nya vlowo ɖe mia ŋu la le esi mienɔa agbe nyui abe Kristo yomedzelawo ene ta.
ENGLISH: 14 But if you do suffer for right-doing, happy are you; and do not stand in fear of them, nor be agitated, 15 but "magnify in your hearts the holiness of the Lord " (Christ), always ready to make your defense to anyone who asks you to give an account of the hope you have in you, but with meekness and fear, 16 keeping a good conscience, that where you are decried those who are spiteful toward your good life in Christ may be put to shame.

EWE: Wowui le ŋutilã me, ke wogbɔ agbee le gbɔgbɔ me. 19 Esi wòle nɔnɔme sia me la, eyi ɖaɖe gbeƒã na gbɔgbɔ siwo le gaxɔ me la hã, 20 gbɔgbɔ siwo sẽ to ɣemaɣi, esime Mawu gbɔ dzi ɖi blewu nɔ lalam le Noa ƒe ŋkekea me esi wonɔ aɖakaʋu, si me ame ʋɛ siwo nye luʋɔ enyi nɔ hetsi agbe le tsiɖɔɖɔa me, la kpam. 21 Nyɔnyrɔxɔxɔ si sɔ kple esia lae na miawo hã miele ɖeɖe kpɔm fifia (menye ŋutilã ƒe ɖiƒoƒo ɖeɖe ɖa o, ke boŋ kukuɖeɖe na Mawu be wòana dzitsinya nyui nanɔ ame si), to Yesu Kristo ƒe tsitretsitsi la dzi. 22 Eyi dziƒo, eye wòle Mawu ƒe ɖusime, eye wotsɔ mawudɔlawo kple dziɖulawo kpakple ŋusẽtɔwo de ete.
ENGLISH: 17 For it is better, if God’s will will have it so, to suffer in doing right than in doing wrong; 18 because so did Christ suffer for sins once, a saint for guilty men, to bring you to God, being put to death in flesh, but given life in spirit 19 while he went and preached to the spirits in prison too, 20 that had once disobeyed when in Noah’s days God’s patience was waiting while an ark was being constructed, into which a few, that is eight souls, came safe through water 21 what in the antitype is now saving you too, baptism, not flesh’s taking off grime but a good conscience’s inquiry after God, saving you through the resurrection of Jesus Christ, 22 who is at God’s right hand, gone to heaven, with angels and authorities and powers put under his control.

EWE: 1 Petro
ENGLISH: 1 Peter

EWE: 4 Esi Kristo kpe fu le ŋutilã me ta la, miawo hã mitsɔ tamesusu ƒe nɔnɔme ma ke bla akpae; elabena ame si kpe fu le ŋutilã me la dzudzɔ nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ, 2 ale be wòagazã ɣeyiɣi si susɔ be wòanɔ agbe le ŋutilã me la na amewo ƒe nudzodzrowo dzi wɔwɔ o, ke boŋ na Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu wɔwɔ.
ENGLISH: 4 So, since Christ has suffered in flesh, arm yourselves too with that same thought, because he who has suffered in flesh has come to a stop in sins; 2 so as to live your remaining time in the flesh no longer by men’s desires but by the will of God.

EWE: 3 Elabena ɣeyiɣi si va yi la sɔ gbɔ be miewɔ dukɔwo ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, esi mieƒo mia ɖokui ɖe ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ, dzodzro vɔ̃wo dzi maɖumaɖu, aha tsu nonowo, aglotutu siwo gbɔ eme, hoʋiʋli le ahanono me kple trɔ̃subɔsubɔ ŋunyɔtɔ me. 4 Ewɔa nuku na wo be miegale du ƒum kpli yewo yina agbe baɖa nɔnɔ ƒe ba ma ke me o, eya ta wole nya manyomanyowo gblɔm ɖe mia ŋu. 5 Ke ame siawo abu akɔnta na ame si le klalo be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame gbagbewo kple ame kukuwo.
ENGLISH: 3 For the bygone time is enough for having done the wish of the nations, going along in immoralities, lusts, hard drinkings, revels, carousals, and unholy idolatries, 4 in which business they find it surprising that you do not run with them into the same inundation of debauchery, and they vilify you; 5 but they shall account for it to him who is in readiness to judge living and dead.

EWE: 6 Le nyateƒe me la, esia tae woɖe gbeƒã nya nyui la na ame siwo nye ame kukuwo hã ɖo, ale be, togbɔ be wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo le ŋutilã me le amegbetɔwo ƒe nukpɔkpɔ nu hã la, woanɔ agbe le gbɔgbɔ me le Mawu ƒe nukpɔkpɔ nu. 7 Ke nuwo katã ƒe nuwuwu ɖo vɔ. Eya ta miɖɔ ŋu ɖo, eye minɔ ŋudzɔ hena gbedodoɖa.
ENGLISH: 6 For it was for this that even dead men had the gospel preached to them, that they might be judged men’s way in flesh, but live God’s way in spirit.

EWE: 9 Miwɔ amedzro na mia nɔewo liʋiliʋĩlilĩ manɔmee. 10 Nunana ale si nu ame sia ame xɔ le Mawu ƒe amenuveve si wòɖe fia le mɔ vovovowo nui la, mitsɔe subɔ mia nɔewo abe aƒedzikpɔla nyuiwo ene. 11 Ne ame aɖe le nya gblɔm la, negblɔe abe Mawu ƒe nya kɔkɔe ene; ne ame aɖe le subɔsubɔm la, netsɔ ŋusẽ si Mawu nana la subɔ; ale be le nuwo katã me la, woakafu Mawu to Yesu Kristo dzi. Eya tɔe nye ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen.
ENGLISH: 7 But the end of everything is almost here; so be sane, and keep sober for prayers, 8 above all having your love to each other ardent, because love covers a multitude of sins; 9 hospitable toward each other without grumbling; 10 as each has received a grant, giving each other the benefit of it as good stewards of God’s diversified grace: 11 if one speaks, speaking as communications of God; if one renders services, doing it as out of strength that God furnishes; that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong glory and might forever and ever amen.

EWE: 12 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migana tetekpɔ sesẽ siwo me tom miele la, nawɔ moyaa na mi, abe nu madzɔkpɔ aɖee le dzɔdzɔm ɖe mia dzi ene o. 13 Ke boŋ miyi edzi mianɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm, be miele edzi le gome kpɔm le fu siwo Kristo kpe la me, ale be miakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye miatso aseye hã le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ɖeɖefiaɣi la.
ENGLISH: 12 Dear friends, do not be taken by surprise at the fiery ordeal among you coming upon you for a test, as if a surprising thing were happening to you, 13 but, insofar as you are solidary with the Christ’s sufferings, be glad, that at the manifestation of his glory too you may exultantly be glad.

EWE: 14 Ne wodo vlo mi le Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ ta la, miekpɔa dzidzɔ, elabena ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe gbɔgbɔ, ɛ̃, Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la, nɔa mia dzi.
ENGLISH: 14 If you are twitted with Christ’s name, happy are you, because the Spirit of glory, the Spirit of God, is resting on you.

EWE: 16 Ke ne ame aɖe kpea fu le esi wònye Kristotɔ ta la, megakpe ŋu nɛ o, ke boŋ neyi edzi wòanɔ Mawu kafum be ŋkɔ sia le ye ŋu. 17 Elabena ɣeyiɣi la de be ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la nadze egɔme, eye adze egɔme tso Mawu ƒe aƒe la dzi. Ke ne edze egɔme tso mía dzi gbã ɖe, ekema aleke wòava wu enu na ame siwo meɖoa to Mawu ƒe nya nyui la o? 18 "Eye ne bebli hafi woaxɔ ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe agbe ɖe, ekema afi kae ame mavɔ̃mawu kple nu vɔ̃ wɔla ya ava do ɖo? " 19 Eya ta ame siwo le fu kpem le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ta la nayi edzi atsɔ wo ɖokuiwo ade Wɔla nuteƒewɔla la si, esi wole nu nyui wɔwɔ dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 For let no one of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or a doer of any harm, or as an intruder into other people’s concerns; 16 but if it is as a Christian let him not be ashamed, but glorify God for that name 17 because it is time for judgment to begin with the house of God; and if it begins first with you, what is to be the end of those who disobey God’s gospel? 18 and if the honest man barely gets through, where will the impious sinner appear? 19 Hence let those also who suffer according to God’s will commit their souls in right-doing to a faithful Creator.

EWE: 1 Petro
ENGLISH: 1 Peter

EWE: 5 Eya ta nye, ame si ŋutɔ hã nye hamemetsitsi, si nye Kristo la ƒe fukpekpewo ŋuti ɖasefo kple ŋutikɔkɔe si woava ɖe ɖe go la ƒe gomekpɔla, mele nu xlɔ̃m hamemetsitsi siwo le mia dome be: 2 Mikplɔ Mawu ƒe alẽha si le miaƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te la, misubɔ abe dzikpɔlawo ene, menye le dzizizi ta o, ke boŋ kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa le Mawu ŋkume; menye le viɖe ƒoɖi didi ta hã o, ke boŋ kple dzi faa; 3 menye be miaɖu aƒetɔ ɖe ame siwo nye Mawu tɔ la dzi o, ke boŋ be miazu kpɔɖeŋu na alẽha la.
ENGLISH: 5 So I exhort elders among you, I a fellow-elder and a witness to the Christ’s sufferings, a sharer too in the glory that is to be disclosed, 2 shepherd God’s flock that you have among you, not as a matter of compulsion, but willingly, God’s way; not mercenarily, but enthusiastically; 3 and not as lording it over the parishes, but setting an example to the flock; 4 and when the Head Shepherd makes his appearance you shall obtain the amaranth-wreath of glory.

EWE: 4 Eye ne wova ɖe alẽkplɔla gã la fia la, ekema miaxɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe dziɖuɖukuku magblemagblẽ la. 5 Nenema kee mi ɖekakpuiwo hã mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe ame tsitsiwo te.
ENGLISH: 5 Likewise, juniors, be submissive to elders; and all of you wear toward each other the livery of humility, because "God sets himself against the proud but gives grace to the lowly. "

EWE: 6 Eya ta mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe Mawu ƒe asi sesẽ la te, ne wòado mi ɖe dzi le ɣeyiɣi si sɔ la dzi, 7 esime miedro miaƒe dzimaɖitsitsiwo katã ɖe edzi, elabena eléa be na mi.
ENGLISH: 6 So humble yourselves under God’s mighty hand that he may uplift you in due time, 7 throwing all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.

EWE: 8 Minɔ mo xexi, minɔ ŋudzɔ!
ENGLISH: 8 Keep sober; keep awake.

EWE: Miaƒe adikãtɔ, Abosam, le tsatsam abe dzata si le gbe ɖem eye wòle ame dim be yeavuvu ami ene. 9 Ke mitsi tsitre ɖe eŋu, minɔ te sesĩe le xɔse me, esi mienyae be mia nɔviwo ƒe habɔbɔ blibo si le xexea me la hã le fukpekpe mawo ke me tom ta.
ENGLISH: Your antagonist the Devil is walking around, like a roaring lion, looking for somebody to swallow down; 9 stand firm against him, solid in faith, knowing that the same series of sufferings is being gone through by your brotherhood in the world.

EWE: 10 Ke ne miekpe fu ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe vɔ la, amenuvevewo katã ƒe Mawu, ame si yɔ mi va eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔ la gbɔ le Kristo me la, ŋutɔ ana miawu miaƒe hehexɔxɔa nu. Ana miali ke, ana miasẽ ŋu, ana mianɔ te sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 10 And the God of all grace, he who in Christ called you to his eternal glory, will himself, after you have suffered a little while, look after your soundness, firmness, strength, foundation.

EWE: 11 Eya tɔ nanye ŋusẽ yi mavɔmavɔ me. Amen.
ENGLISH: 11 To him belongs might forever and ever amen.

EWE: 12 Meŋlɔ nya ʋɛ siawo ɖo ɖe mi to Silvano, ame si mekpɔ be enye nɔviŋutsu nuteƒewɔla la dzi, be made dzi ƒo na mi ahaɖi ɖase na mi vevie be, esiae nye Mawu ƒe amenuveve vavãtɔ la. Milé eme ɖe asi sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 12 By Silvanus, our faithful brother as I reckon him to be, I write you these few words to exhort you and testify to you that this is the veritable grace of God, in which stand firm.

EWE: 13 Nyɔnu si le Babilon, si nye ame tiatia abe miawo ke ene la, do gbe na mi, vinye Marko hã do gbe na mi.
ENGLISH: 13 Your sister in election at Babylon sends greetings, and my son Mark.

EWE: 14 Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ si me lɔlɔ̃ le do gbe na mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 14 Give my greetings to each other with a kiss of love.

EWE: Mawu ƒe ŋutifafa nanɔ kpli mi ame siwo katã wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo.
ENGLISH: Peace to you all, all that are in Christ.

EWE: 2 Petro
ENGLISH: 2 Peter

EWE: 1 Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo ƒe kluvi kple apostolo, le esia ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe ame siwo si xɔse, si xɔ asi abe mía tɔ ke ene, la su to mía Mawu kple mía Ðela Yesu Kristo ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye me: 2 Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa nasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi na mi to Mawu kple Yesu mía Aƒetɔ la ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ me, 3 elabena Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ tsɔ nu siwo katã kpena ɖe mía ŋu míenɔa agbe hetsɔa mía ɖokui naa Mawu la ke mí to Ame si tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple nɔnɔme nyui yɔ mí la ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ dzi. 4 To nu siawo dzi la, etsɔ ŋugbedodo xɔasi gãtɔwo ke mí, ale be to wo dzi la, mawumenɔnɔmewo nasu mia si, esi miesi le xexea ƒe nɔnɔme gbegblẽ si dzodzro vɔ̃wo hena vɛ la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 1 Symeon Peter, servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those whose lot it has been in the justice of our God and Savior Jesus Christ to have as rich a faith as ours: 2 grace be yours in abundance, and peace, in awareness of God and of Jesus our Lord, 3 as his divine power has bestowed all the conditions for life and piety upon us through awareness of him who called us by his own glory and virtue, 4 through which we have the precious and immense promises bestowed on us, that by these you may become sharers in divine nature, having made your escape from the ruin by desire which is in the world.

EWE: 5 Le susu sia tututu ta la, miku kutri vevie miatsɔ nɔnɔme nyui akpe ɖe miaƒe xɔse ŋu, nenema ke sidzedze nekpe ɖe miaƒe nɔnɔme nyui ŋu, 6 ɖokuidziɖuɖu nekpe ɖe miaƒe sidzedze ŋu, dzidodo nekpe ɖe miaƒe ɖokuidziɖuɖu ŋu, ɖokuitsɔtsɔ na Mawu nekpe ɖe miaƒe dzidodo ŋu, 7 nɔvilɔlɔ̃ nekpe ɖe miaƒe ɖokuitsɔtsɔ na Mawu ŋu, lɔlɔ̃ nekpe ɖe miaƒe nɔvilɔlɔ̃ ŋu.
ENGLISH: 5 And on this very account bring all your energies to bear and furnish virtue in your faith, and knowledge in your virtue, 6 and self-restraint in your knowledge, and endurance in your self-restraint, and piety in your endurance, 7 and brotherliness in your piety, and love in your brotherliness; 8 for if you possess these things, and plenty of them, they render you not idle nor unfruitful toward awareness of our Lord Jesus Christ.

EWE: 9 Elabena ne nu siawo mele ame aɖe me o la, ezu ŋkuagbãtɔ, ame si mia eƒe ŋkuwo be yeagakpɔ kekeli la o, eye wòzu ame si ŋlɔ ale si woklɔ eƒe tsã nu vɔ̃wo ɖa le eŋui la be.
ENGLISH: 9 For he who does not have these things about him is blindly nearsighted, oblivious of the purgation of his old-time sins.

EWE: 10 Eya ta nɔviwo, miwɔ miaƒe ŋutete ɖe sia ɖe be miali ke mia yɔyɔ kple mia tiatia la sesĩe, elabena ne miewɔa esiawo la, miado kpo nu gbeɖe o. 11 Ale le nyateƒe me la, woayra mi geɖe miayi ɖe mía Aƒetɔ kple Ðela Yesu Kristo ƒe Fiaɖuƒe mavɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 10 Wherefore take the more pains, brothers, to make your call and election sure; for, doing this, you shall never stumble; 11 for thus shall be richly furnished to you the ingress into the eternal reign of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

EWE: 12 Esia ta meɖoe be manɔ ŋku ɖom nu siawo dzi na mi ɣesiaɣi, togbɔ be mienya wo, eye mieli ke sesĩe le nyateƒe si su mia si fifia me hã. 13 Ke mekpɔe be enyo be zi ale si mekpɔtɔ le agbadɔ sia me la, matsɔ ŋkuɖodzinyawo anɔ mia nyɔm, 14 esi menyae be magadidi hafi woaɖe nye agbadɔ la ɖa o, abe ale si mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo hã ɖee fiam ene. 15 Mawɔ nye ŋutete ɖe sia ɖe ɣesiaɣi, ale be le nye dzodzo megbe la, mianɔ ŋku ɖom nu siawo dzi na mia ɖokuiwo.
ENGLISH: 12 Wherefore I shall ever be reminding you about these things, even though you know and are firmly settled in the truth you have with you; 13 but I think it right, so long as I am in this tabernacle, to rouse you with reminders, 14 knowing that the laying off of my tabernacle is speedily due, as our Lord Jesus Christ too declared to me; 15 and I will also do my best that after my departure you may at every time be able to call these things to mind.

EWE: 16 Menye gli siwo wokpa kple aɖaŋu dzie míetu mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋusẽ kple anyinɔɣi la ŋu nya si míegblɔ na mi la ɖo o, ao, ke boŋ esi míawo ŋutɔwo míekpɔ eƒe gãnyenye kple atsyɔ̃ teƒe tae míegblɔe ɖo.
ENGLISH: 16 For we were not echoing trumped-up myths when we made known to you the power and advent of our Lord Jesus Christ, but had been eyewitnesses of his grandeur.

EWE: 17 Elabena exɔ bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe tso Mawu, Fofo la, gbɔ esime wòse nya siawo le ŋutikɔkɔe gã la me be: "Ame siae nye Vinye, si gbɔ nyemelɔ̃a nu le o, si dze nye ŋutɔ ŋunye. " 18 Ɛ̃, nya siawoe míese tso dziƒo esi míele to kɔkɔe la dzi kplii.
ENGLISH: 17 For as he received honor and glory from God the Father, when such a voice as this came wafted to him by the sublime glory, "My dear son is this, in whom I take pleasure, " 18 and this voice we heard come wafted from the skies when we were with him on the sacred mountain.

EWE: 19 Eya ta kakaɖedzi geɖe wu va le nyagblɔɖinya la ŋu na mí, eye miewɔe nyuie be mieléa ŋku ɖe eŋu abe akaɖi si le keklẽm le viviti me ene (va se ɖe esime agu dze, eye ŋukeɣletivi nadze) le miaƒe dziwo me. 20 Elabena mienya esia gbã be, Ŋɔŋlɔ la me nyagblɔɖi aɖeke metso ame ŋutɔ ƒe susu me o. 21 Elabena nyagblɔɖi aɖeke metso ame ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o, ke boŋ gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ye ʋã amewo wogblɔ Mawu ƒe nyawo ɖi.
ENGLISH: 19 And we have a surer thing, the word of prophecy, to which you do well to be attentive, as if to a lamp in a murky place, till day shall flush the sky and the Morning Star shall rise in your hearts 20 knowing this in the first place, that any prophecy in a text is not a matter for particular interpretation; 21 for not by will of man was prophecy ever wafted to us, but, wafted by Holy Spirit, men spoke from God.

EWE: 2 Petro
ENGLISH: 2 Peter

EWE: Ke tohehe si li na wo tso blema ke la mele hehem ɖe megbe o, eye woƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃ mele akɔlɔ̃e dɔm o. 4 Vavãe, Mawu mehe ɖe megbe le tohehe na mawudɔla siwo wɔ nu vɔ̃ me o, ke boŋ etsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe Tartaro, eye wòtsɔ viviti tsiɖitsiɖi ƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔwo bla wo, ne woadzra wo ɖo ɖi na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃. 5 Eye mehe ɖe megbe le tohehe na blemaxexe aɖe me o, gake wòkpɔ Noa, dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe gbeƒãɖela, kpakple ame adre bubuwo ta dedie esime wòhe tsiɖɔɖɔ va ame mavɔ̃mawuwo ƒe xexea dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 But there came pretended prophets too among the people, the same as among you too shall be pretendant teachers who shall introduce ruinous ideologies, repudiating the very Master that bought them, bringing upon themselves a speedy bane; 2 and many will follow the example of their immoralities, because of whom the path of truth will be vilified; 3 and with rapacious intent they will exploit you by well-turned phrases men for whom judgment is not inert from of old, and their bane is not napping.

EWE: 6 Ebu fɔ du siwo nye Sodom kple Gomora hena wozu afi, wònye nu siwo ava va la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu na ame mavɔ̃mawuwo. 7 Eye wòɖe ame dzɔdzɔe Lot, ame si sedzimawɔlawo ƒe ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ dzimesesẽtɔe ɖe fu na vevie la 8 elabena sedzimawɔmawɔ si teƒe ame dzɔdzɔe ma kpɔna hesena gbe sia gbe esi wòle wo dome la wɔa fu eƒe luʋɔ dzɔdzɔe la. 9 Eya ta Yehowa nya ale si wòaɖe ame siwo tsɔ wo ɖokui na Mawu la tso tetekpɔ me, ke wòadzra ame madzɔmadzɔwo ɖo na tsɔtsrɔ̃ le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la, 10 vevietɔ ame siwo dzea ŋutilã ƒe dzodzrowo yome heƒoa ɖi ame bubuwo, eye wodoa vlo aƒetɔnyenye la.
ENGLISH: 4 For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but, engulfing them in Inferno’s pits of darkness, committed them to be kept for judgment, 5 and did not spare the primitive world, but reserved among seven others Noah, preacher of righteousness, while bringing a deluge upon the world of the impious, and, 6 laying in ashes the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, doomed them to obliteration, making them the example of men who should act impiously, 7 and delivered honest Lot, irked by the immoral living of the conscienceless, 8 for with sight and hearing the honest man, residing among them, day by day tortured his honest soul with their lawless deeds, 9 the Lord knows how to deliver pious men out of temptation but to keep doers of wrong under punishment to the day of judgment, 10 and especially those who go after flesh in desire for pollution and despise lordship.

EWE: Esi woƒe dzi tri eye wonye ɖokuiŋudzelawo ta la, womevɔ̃na ne wole nya vlowo gblɔm ɖe ŋutikɔkɔemewo ŋu o, 11 evɔ mawudɔla siwo nye gã wu le ŋutete kple ŋusẽ me la, metsoa wo nu to nya vlowo gbɔgblɔ ɖe wo ŋu me o, le esi wodea bubu Yehowa ŋu ta.
ENGLISH: Cynically audacious, they do not quail at vilifying glories, 11 when angels, superior in strength and power, do not bring a defamatory charge against them before the Lord.

EWE: 12 Ke ame siawo, siwo le abe lã manyanu siwo wɔa nu ɖe seselelãme nu, siwo li na léle kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ ene la, gblɔa nya vlowo ɖe nu siwo ŋu womenya naneke le o ŋu. Woakpɔ tsɔtsrɔ̃ le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃mɔ la dzi, 13 eye woakpe fu wòanye woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo ŋuti fetu.
ENGLISH: 12 But these, like brute beasts, creatures of nature born to be caught and to perish, vilifying what they are ignorant of, shall perish too in their undoing, 13 suffering injury in payment for injuriousness.

EWE: Wobua agbeɖuɖu le ŋkeke me gɔ̃ hã abe dzidzɔdonamenu ene. Wonye ame ƒoɖiwo kple ame siwo ŋu mokaka le, eye wònyea dzidzɔ na wo be yewoatsɔ yewoƒe alakpanufiafiawo able mi ne wole nu ɖum kpli mi. 14 Ŋku siwo yɔ fũu kple ahasiwɔwɔ li na wo, wometea ŋu trɔna le nu vɔ̃ ŋu o, eye woblea ame malikewo. Wotsɔ ŋukeklẽ mla woƒe dziwo. Fiƒodeviwo wonye. 15 Esi wogblẽ mɔ dzɔdzɔe la ɖi la, wotra mɔ. Woto Bileam, Beor vi ƒe ʋe me, ame si lɔ̃ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe fetu, 16 gake woka mo nɛ le esi wògbe nu si nyo la wɔwɔ ta. Lã maƒonu si tsɔ amegbetɔ ƒe gbe ƒo nu la, xe mɔ na nyagblɔɖila la ƒe aɖaʋanuwɔwɔ.
ENGLISH: Taking luxury for the day as their idea of pleasure, blots and blemishes, luxuriating in their deceits while they feast with you, 14 with eyes full of a paramour who is another man’s wife and unresting in sin, luring unsteady souls, their hearts expert in greed, children of a curse, 15 they left the straight road and strayed, treading over again the road of Balaam the son of Beor, who fell in love with the pay of wrong-doing 16 but he had evidence of his dereliction: a dumb beast, speaking with a man’s voice, checked the prophet’s craziness.

EWE: 17 Ame siawo nye vudo siwo me tsi mele o kple afu siwo ahom sesẽwo lɔ ɖe nu, eye woɖo blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ɖi na wo.
ENGLISH: 17 These are waterless springs and wind-driven puffs of mist, for whom the blackness of darkness is kept.

EWE: 18 Wogblɔa nya gã nya gã siwo meɖea vi aɖeke o. Eye wotsɔa ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzrowo kple woƒe ŋukpenanuwɔwɔwo blea ame siwo te ŋu si le nu gbegblẽ wɔlawo nu teti koe nye ema la. 19 Togbɔ be wole ablɔɖe ŋugbe dom na wo hã la, woawo ŋutɔwo wonye nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ ƒe kluviwo, elabena ne nane ɖu ame aɖe dzi la, amea zu eƒe kluvi.
ENGLISH: 18 For, uttering extravagant futilities, they lure with the desires of flesh, with debaucheries, those who are making a narrow escape from those that live a life of misguided wanderings, 19 promising them liberty when they themselves are slaves of vice; for what one is beaten by he is enslaved to.

EWE: 20 Le nyateƒe me la, ne wosi le xexea ƒe ɖiƒoƒowo gbɔ, esi Aƒetɔ kple Ðela Yesu Kristo ŋuti sidzedze vavãtɔ su wo si, hafi gaƒo wo ɖokuiwo ɖe nu siawo ke me, eye wona woɖu wo dzi la, ekema woƒe nɔnɔme mlɔetɔwo va gblẽna wu gbãtɔwo. 21 Ne ɖe womenya dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ la nyuie o la, ne enyo na wo wu be woanyae hafi agatrɔ ɖa le sedede kɔkɔe si wotsɔ de asi na wo la yome.
ENGLISH: 20 For if they make their escape from the pollutions of the world by awareness of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, and are entangled in them again and beaten, they have the last turn out worse than the first; 21 for it would have been better for them not to been aware of the path of righteousness than after being aware of it to revert from the holy commandment that had been transmitted to them.

EWE: 22 Eva eme na wo le nyateƒelododo la nu be: "Avu gbugbɔ yi eya ŋutɔ ƒe xeɖeɖe gbɔ, eye ha si wole tsi na la gale mimlim le ba me. "
ENGLISH: 22 They have been through what the true proverb speaks of, "A dog turning back to its own vomit, and a bathed hog to wallowing in mud. "

EWE: 2 Petro
ENGLISH: 2 Peter

EWE: 3 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esiae nye agbalẽ evelia si ŋlɔm mele ɖo ɖe mi fifia, si me metsɔ ŋkuɖodzinya siawo le miaƒe nuŋububu nyuie ŋutetewo nyɔm, abe ale si mewɔe le agbalẽ gbãtɔa me ene, 2 be miaɖo ŋku nya siwo nyagblɔɖila kɔkɔeawo gblɔ do ŋgɔ, kpakple Aƒetɔ kple Ðela la ƒe se si wòde to miaƒe apostolowo dzi la dzi. 3 Gbã la, minyae be le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me la, fewuɖulawo ava kple woƒe fewuɖuɖu, eye woawɔ nu le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe nudzodzrowo nu 4 ahanɔ gbɔgblɔm be: "Afi ka eƒe anyinɔɣi sia si ŋugbe wodo la le? Kpɔ ɖa, tso ŋkeke si mía tɔgbuiwo dɔ alɔ̃ le ku me la, nuwo katã le edzi yim abe ale si ko wole tso nuwɔwɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze ene. " 5 Elabena woɖoe koŋ gbe nyateƒenya sia be, tso blema ke la dziƒowo li, eye anyigba hã do tso tsi me heli ke sesĩe eye wòle tsi titina, le Mawu ƒe nya la nu; 6 eye nu siawo dzie woto tsrɔ̃ xexe si nɔ anyi ɣemaɣi esime tsi ɖee. 7 Ke wotsɔ nya ma ke dzra dziƒo kple anyigba si li fifia la ɖo ɖi na dzo, eye woda wo ɖi na ame mavɔ̃mawuwo ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ ŋkeke la.
ENGLISH: 3 This, dear friends, is the second letter I am writing you, in which letters I am rousing your candid minds with reminders 2 to remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the injunction of your Lord and Savior’s apostles 3 knowing this in the first place, that in the last days mockers will come with mockeries, going by their own desires 4 and saying "Where is the promise of his advent? for since the fathers went to their rest everything has remained as it was since the beginning of creation. " 5 For this they willfully ignore, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth, by the word of God compacted out of water and by water, 6 whereby the world of that time met its bane by being flooded with water, 7 but the present heavens and earth are by the same word stored with fire and kept for a day of judgment and the bane of impious men.

EWE: 8 Ke lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migana miaƒe susu nadzo le nya sia dzi o, be ŋkeke ɖeka le Yehowa gbɔ abe ƒe akpe ɖeka ene, eye ƒe akpe ɖeka abe ŋkeke ɖeka ene.
ENGLISH: 8 But do not you ignore this, dear friends, that with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.

EWE: 9 Yehowa mele wɔwɔm blewu le eƒe ŋugbedodo la ŋu abe ale si ame aɖewo se blewuwɔwɔ gɔme ene o, ke boŋ egbɔa dzi ɖi na mi, elabena medi be ame aɖeke natsrɔ̃ o, ke boŋ edi be mɔnukpɔkpɔ nasu amewo katã si woatrɔ dzi me.
ENGLISH: 9 The Lord is not lagging back from his promise, as some take it for a lagging, but is having patience with you, not wishing that any should perish but that all should go to repenting.

EWE: 10 Gake Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la ava abe fiafitɔ ene, si me dziƒowo nu ava yi kple gbeɖiɖi sesẽ, ke wo me nu, siwo xɔ dzo gbãgbãgbã la alólo, eye woaklo nu le anyigba kple eme dɔwɔwɔwo dzi.
ENGLISH: 10 But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief, the day on which the heavens will whiz away and the heavenly bodies will be parched and disintegrated, and earth and the works in it will be fuel for fire.

EWE: 11 Esi woalólo nu siawo katã alea ta la, mibu ame siwo ƒomevi wòle be mianye le agbe kɔkɔe nɔnɔ kple ɖokuitsɔtsɔ na Mawu me ŋu, 12 esi miele lalam eye miaƒe susu le Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la ƒe vava ŋu vevie, esime woatsrɔ̃ dziƒowo le dzo me, eye wo me nuwo alólo le dzoxɔxɔ gbãgbãgbã me. 13 Ke míele dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye, siwo me dzɔdzɔenyenye anɔ la, lalam le eƒe ŋugbedodo la nu.
ENGLISH: 11 When all these things are thus to disintegrate, what men ought you to be in holy lives and pious acts, 12 expecting and speeding the advent of the Day of God, at which the heavens will disintegrate in fire, and the heavenly bodies parch and melt; 13 but in accordance with his promise we expect new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness resides.

EWE: 14 Eya ta lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi miele nu siawo lalam ŋuti la, miwɔ miaƒe ŋutete ɖe sia ɖe be wòakpɔ mi mlɔeba ɖimaƒomaƒoe, mokakamanɔŋui, le ŋutifafa me. 15 Eye mibu mía Aƒetɔ ƒe dzigbɔɖi la be enye xɔxɔ, abe ale si mía nɔvi lɔlɔ̃tɔ Paulo hã ŋlɔ na mi le nunya si wonɛ la nu ene, 16 esi wòƒoa nu tso nu siawo ŋu le eƒe agbalẽwo katã me.
ENGLISH: 14 Wherefore, dear friends, having these expectations, do your best to have him find you spotless and unblamable in peace, 15 and deem our Lord’s patience your salvation, just as our dear brother Paul too wrote to you in accordance with the wisdom given to him, 16 the same as he does in all his letters, speaking in them of these things.

EWE: Ke nanewo gɔme sese sesẽ le wo me, siwo ame masrɔ̃nuwo kple ame malikewo le gbo trɔmee, abe ale si wowɔa Ŋɔŋlɔawo ƒe akpa bubuawo ke ene hena woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃.
ENGLISH: In which letters there are some things hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsteady twist, the same as they do the rest of the scriptures, to their own bane.

EWE: 17 Eya ta nɔvi lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi mienya nu siawo do ŋgɔ ta la, minɔ ŋudzɔ, be sedzimawɔlawo ƒe vodada nagakplɔ mi atrae kpe ɖe wo ŋu o, ale be miage tso teƒe si mieli ke ɖo la o. 18 Ao, ke boŋ miyi edzi miatsi le mía Aƒetɔ kple mía Ðela Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve kple sidzedze la me.
ENGLISH: 17 So for your part, dear friends, being forewarned, keep on your guard against being carried along with the wanderings of the conscienceless and falling away from your own steadiness, 18 but grow in grace and the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

EWE: Eya tɔ nanye ŋutikɔkɔe tso fifia yi mavɔmavɔ me. Amen.
ENGLISH: To him be glory both now and to eternity’s day.

EWE: 1 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 1 John

EWE: 1 Nu si li tso gɔmedzedzea me, nu si míese, nu si míekpɔ kple míaƒe ŋku, nu si ŋu míelé ŋku ɖo, eye míeka asi eŋu, le agbenya la ŋuti, 2 (ɛ̃, woɖe agbe la ɖe go fia mí, eye míekpɔe, eye míele ɖase ɖim hele nu ƒom tso eŋu na mi. Agbe mavɔ sia tso Fofo la gbɔ, eye woɖee ɖe go fia mí), 3 nu si míekpɔ eye míese la, eya ŋue míele nu ƒom le na miawo hã, ale be miawo hã miade ha kpli mí.
ENGLISH: 1 What from the first there was, what we have heard, what we have seen with our own eyes, what we have gazed upon and our hands have handled, about the Word of life 2 and the life made its appearance, and we have seen and are testifying and reporting to you the eternal life which was where the Father is and made its appearance to us 3 what we have seen and heard we are reporting to you too in order that you too may have solidarity with us.

EWE: Eye míele hadede sia me kple Fofo la kpakple Via Yesu Kristo.
ENGLISH: And, too, our solidarity is with the Father and with his son Jesus Christ.

EWE: 4 Esia ŋutie míele nu siawo ŋlɔm na mi, be míaƒe dzidzɔ nade blibo.
ENGLISH: 4 And these things we are writing to you in order that our happiness may be made full.

EWE: 5 Gbedeasi si míese tso egbɔ, eye míele gbeƒã ɖemee na mi lae nye be: Mawu nye kekeli, eye viviti aɖeke mele eya amea me o.
ENGLISH: 5 And this is the message we have heard from him and are announcing to you, that God is light and there is in him no darkness whatever.

EWE: 6 Ne míegblɔna be, "Míele ha dem kplii, " evɔ míegale viviti me zɔm la, ekema míele aʋatso kam, eye míele nyateƒe la dzi wɔm o.
ENGLISH: 6 If we say we have solidarity with him and are walking in the darkness, we are lying and not living up to the truth.

EWE: 7 Ke ne míele zɔzɔm le kekeli la me abe ale si eya ŋutɔ hã le kekeli la me ene la, ekema míele ha dem kple mía nɔewo, eye Via Yesu ƒe ʋu klɔa nu vɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe ɖa le mía ŋu.
ENGLISH: 7 But if we are walking in the light, as he is in the light, we have solidarity with each other, and the blood of his son Jesus cleanses us from every sin.

EWE: 9 Ne míeʋua míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo me la, ekema nuteƒewɔla kple dzɔdzɔetɔe wònye, be wòatsɔ míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ake mí, eye wòaklɔ nu madzɔmadzɔwo katã ɖa le mía ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 If we say we do not have a sin, we are deluding ourselves and the truth is not in us; 9 if we acknowledge our sins, he is loyal and fair to forgive us our sins and cleanse us from every wrongness.

EWE: 10 Ne míegblɔna be, "Míewɔa nu vɔ̃ o " la, ekema míele edom aʋatsokalae, eye eƒe nya la mele mía me o.
ENGLISH: 10 If we say we have not sinned we are making him a liar and his word is not in us.

EWE: 1 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 1 John

EWE: Gake ne edzɔ be ame aɖe wɔ nu vɔ̃ la, kpeɖeŋutɔ le mía si le Fofo la gbɔ, si nye Yesu Kristo, dzɔdzɔetɔ la. 2 Eye eyae nye avulévɔsa ɖe míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ta, gake menye ɖe mía tɔ ɖeɖe ko ta o, ke ɖe xexe blibo la hã tɔ ta.
ENGLISH: 2 My children, I am writing you these things in order that you may not sin; and if one sins, we have a spokesman to the Father, Jesus Christ, a righteous one; 2 and he is a propitiation for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the whole world’s.

EWE: 3 Eye ne míeyi edzi wɔa eƒe sewo dzi la, ekema kakaɖedzi le mía si be míenyae vavã.
ENGLISH: 3 It is by this we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

EWE: 4 Ame si gblɔna be, "Medze sii, " evɔ meléa eƒe seawo me ɖe asi o la, aʋatsokala wònye, eye nyateƒe la mele eme o. 5 Ke ame sia ame si léa eƒe nya la me ɖe asi la, Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ de blibo le eya amea me vavã.
ENGLISH: 4 He who says "I know him " and does not keep his commandments is a liar; in that man the truth is not; 5 but whoever keeps his word, in him God’s love does really come to its completion.

EWE: Esia me míenyana le be míewɔ ɖeka kplii. 6 Ame si gblɔna be yewɔ ɖeka kplii la, ele nɛ be wòayi edzi azɔ abe ale si eya amea zɔe ene.
ENGLISH: It is by this we know that we are in him: 6 he who says he is dwelling in him ought himself to be walking in the same way as he walked.

EWE: 7 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, menye se yeye ŋlɔm mele ɖo ɖe mi o, ke boŋ se xoxo si le mia si tso gɔmedzedzea me ke lae. Se xoxo siae nye nya si miese la.
ENGLISH: 7 Dear friends, it is not a new commandment I am writing you, but an old commandment that you had from the first: the old commandment is the word you did hear.

EWE: 8 Ke hã, megale se yeye ŋlɔm na mi, si dzi eya kple miawo miezɔna ɖo hã nyateƒe, elabena viviti la nu le yiyim, eye kekeli vavãtɔ la le keklẽm xoxo.
ENGLISH: 8 Again, it is a new commandment I am writing you; this is true as to him and as to you, because the darkness is passing and now the true light is shining.

EWE: 9 Ame si gblɔna be yele kekeli la me, evɔ wòléa fu nɔvia la, egakpɔtɔ le viviti la me. 10 Ame si lɔ̃a nɔvia la yia edzi nɔa kekeli la me, eye naneke manye nuɖianu nɛ o. 11 Ke ame si léa fu nɔvia la le viviti me, eye wòle viviti me zɔm, eye menya afi si yim wòle o, elabena viviti la gbã ŋku nɛ.
ENGLISH: 9 He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness up to now; 10 he who loves his brother is dwelling in the light, and there is nothing in him to bring him to a downfall, 11 but he who hates his brother is in the darkness and is walking in the darkness, and does not know where he is going because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

EWE: 12 Mi vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, mele eŋlɔm na mi, elabena wotsɔ miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ke mi le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta.
ENGLISH: 12 I am writing to you, children, because your sins are forgiven you on account of his name.

EWE: 13 Mi fofowo, mele eŋlɔm na mi, elabena mieva nya ame si li tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la.
ENGLISH: 13 I am writing to you, fathers, because you know the one that has been from the first.

EWE: Mi ɖekakpuiwo, mele eŋlɔm na mi, elabena mieɖu vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: I am writing to you, youths, because you have won victories over the Evil One.

EWE: Mi vinye suewo, mele eŋlɔm na mi, elabena mieva nya Fofo la.
ENGLISH: I have written to you, boys, because you know the Father.

EWE: 14 Mi fofowo, mele eŋlɔm na mi, elabena mieva nya ame si li tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la.
ENGLISH: 14 I have written to you, fathers, because you know the one that has been from the first.

EWE: Mi ɖekakpuiwo, mele eŋlɔm na mi, elabena ŋusẽ le mia ŋu, Mawu ƒe nya la le mia me, eye mieɖu vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: I have written to you, youths, because you are strong and God’s word dwells in you and you have won victories over the Evil One.

EWE: 15 Migalɔ̃ xexea alo nu siwo le xexea me la o.
ENGLISH: 15 Do not love the world nor what is in the world.

EWE: Ne ame aɖe lɔ̃a xexea la, Fofo la ƒe lɔlɔ̃ mele eme o; 16 elabena nu sia nu si le xexea me ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzro kple ŋkuwo ƒe nudzodzro kple ame ƒe nunɔamesiwo fiafia adegbeƒoƒotɔe la metso Fofo la gbɔ o, ke boŋ xexea me wotso. 17 Azɔ hã, xexea kple eƒe nudzodzrowo nu va yina, ke ame si wɔa Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la nɔa anyi yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.
ENGLISH: If one loves the world the love of the Father is not in him, 16 because all that is in the world, the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the pretentiousness of our life, does not come from the Father but comes from the world; 17 and the world passes, and so does the desire of it, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

EWE: 18 Vinye suewo, gaƒoƒo mamlɛtɔ lae nye esia, eye abe ale si miesee be Kristo ƒe futɔ la gbɔna ene la, Kristo ƒe futɔ geɖewo do fifia gɔ̃ hã xoxo, eye esia mee míenyae le be gaƒoƒo mamlɛtɔ lae nye esia.
ENGLISH: 18 It is the last moment, boys; and as you have heard that there is an antichrist coming, so there have now come to be many antichrists, from which we know that it is the last moment.

EWE: 19 Mía domee wodo go tso, gake womele abe míawo ene o; elabena ne ɖe wole abe míawo ene la, anye ne woanɔ mía gbɔ ɖaa. Ke boŋ wodo, ale be wòadze nyuie be menye wo katãe le abe míawo ene o.
ENGLISH: 19 They went out from us, but they were not part of us; for if they had been part of us, they would have remained with us, but it was in order that it might be made apparent that they are not any of them part of us.

EWE: 20 Kɔkɔetɔ la si ami na mi, eye sidzedze su mi katã si. 21 Menye esi mienya nyateƒe la o tae mele nya siawo ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi o, ke boŋ esi mienyae, eye esi alakpa aɖeke metso nyateƒe la me o tae.
ENGLISH: 20 And you have an anointment from the Holy One, and you all know; 21 I have not been writing to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it and any lie does not belong to the truth.

EWE: 22 Ame si gbe be menye Yesue nye Kristo la o la, menye eyae nye aʋatsokala oa?
ENGLISH: 22 Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? this is the antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

EWE: Ame si gbe nu le Fofo la kple Vi la gbɔ la, ame siae nye Kristo ƒe futɔ la. 23 Ame sia ame si gbea nu le Vi la gbɔ la, Fofo la hã mele esi o.
ENGLISH: 23 Anyone who denies the Son does not have the Father either; he who acknowledges the Son has the Father too.

EWE: Gake ame si ʋua Vi la me la, Fofo la hã le esi. 24 Ke miawo la, mina nu si miese tso gɔmedzedzea me la nakpɔtɔ anɔ mia me. Ne nu si miese tso gɔmedzedzea me la kpɔtɔ le mia me la, ekema miawɔ ɖeka kple Vi la kpakple Fofo la.
ENGLISH: 24 For your part, let what you heard from the first dwell in you; if what you heard from the first dwells in you, so will you dwell in the Son and in the Father.

EWE: 25 Eye nu si ŋugbe eya ŋutɔ do na mí lae nye agbe mavɔ.
ENGLISH: 25 And the promise he made to us is this: eternal life.

EWE: 26 Mele nya siawo ŋlɔm na mi ku ɖe ame siwo le didim be yewoaflu mi la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 26 These things I have written to you about those who are misleading you.

EWE: 27 Ke le miawo ya gome la, ami si wosi na mi la kpɔtɔ le mia me, eye mehiã be ame aɖeke naganɔ nu fiam mi o; ke boŋ amisisiname si tso egbɔ la le nuwo katã fiam mi, eye wònye nyateƒe ke menye aʋatso o. Ale si tututu wòfia mii la, miyi edzi miawɔ ɖeka kplii.
ENGLISH: 27 And for your part, the anointment you received from him dwells in you, and you have no need that one should teach you; but as his anointment teaches you about everything, and is true and is not a lie, and as he did teach you, dwell in him.

EWE: 28 Eya ta vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, miyi edzi miawɔ ɖeka kplii, ale be ne wova ɖee fia la, dzi naɖo mía ƒo míaƒo nu, eye míagatrɔ ɖa le egbɔ kple ŋukpe le eƒe anyinɔɣi la o.
ENGLISH: 28 And now, children, dwell in him, in order that if he makes his appearance we may have confidence and not be shamed away from him at his coming.

EWE: 29 Ne mienya be dzɔdzɔetɔe wònye la, ekema mienyae hã be ame sia ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, eya mee wodzii tso.
ENGLISH: 29 If you know that he is righteous, you take knowledge that everyone who does right is born out of him.

EWE: 1 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 1 John

EWE: 3 Mikpɔ lɔlɔ̃ si ƒomevi Fofo la tsɔ lɔ̃ míi ɖa, be woayɔ mí be Mawu ƒe viwo; eye míenye viawo hã nyateƒe.
ENGLISH: 3 See what love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God’s, and are such!

EWE: Esia tae xexea medze si mí o ɖo, elabena medze si Mawu o.
ENGLISH: This is why the world does not know us because it did not know him.

EWE: 2 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, azɔ la míenye Mawu ƒe viwo, gake womeɖe nu si míava nye la fia mí haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 2 Dear friends, we are children of God’s now, and it is not yet made apparent what we shall be.

EWE: Míenyae be ne wova ɖee ɖe go la, míanɔ abe eya amea ene, elabena míakpɔe abe ale si wòle ene. 3 Eye ame sia ame si si mɔkpɔkpɔ sia le la, kɔa eɖokui ŋu abe ale si eya ŋutɔ hã le kɔkɔe ene.
ENGLISH: We know that if he makes his appearance we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he is; 3 and everyone who has this hope rested on him purifies himself as he is pure.

EWE: 4 Ame sia ame si tsɔ nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖo dɔe la tsɔ sedzimawɔmawɔ hã ɖo dɔe, eya ta nu vɔ̃e nye sedzimawɔmawɔ.
ENGLISH: 4 Everyone who commits sin is committing immorality too; and sin is immorality.

EWE: 5 Mienyae hã be woɖee ɖe go be wòaɖe míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ɖa, eye nu vɔ̃ aɖeke mele eya ŋutɔ ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 5 And you know that he made his appearance to take sins away, and there is no sin in him.

EWE: 6 Ame sia ame si wɔ ɖeka kplii la metsɔa nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖoa dɔe o; ame si tsɔa nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖoa dɔe la mekpɔe alo dze sii o.
ENGLISH: 6 Anyone who dwells in him does not sin; anyone who sins has not seen him nor known him.

EWE: 7 Vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, migana ame aɖeke naflu mi o; ame si yia edzi wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la nye ame dzɔdzɔe, abe ale si ko eya hã le dzɔdzɔe ene.
ENGLISH: 7 Children, let nobody delude you.

EWE: 8 Ame si tsɔ nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖo dɔe la tso Abosam me, elabena tso gɔmedzedzea me kee Abosam le nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ dzi.
ENGLISH: He who does right is righteous as He is righteous; 8 he who commits sin comes of the Devil, because the Devil has been sinning from the first.

EWE: Esia tae woɖe Mawu ƒe Vi la ɖe go ɖo, be wòagblẽ Abosam ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me.
ENGLISH: It was for this the Son of God made his appearance, that he might break up the Devil’s work.

EWE: 9 Ame sia ame si wodzi tso Mawu me la metsɔa nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖoa dɔe o, elabena nuku si tso Mawu gbɔ la kpɔtɔ le eya amea me, eye mate ŋu anɔ nu vɔ̃ wɔm o, elabena Mawu me wodzii tso.
ENGLISH: 9 Anyone who is born out of God does not commit sin, because seed of his dwells in him and he cannot sin because he is born out of God.

EWE: 10 Esia mee Mawu ƒe viwo kple Abosam ƒe viwo dze ƒãa le: Ame sia ame si mewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe o la metso Mawu me o, nenema kee nye ame si melɔ̃a nɔvia o hã. 11 Elabena esiae nye gbedeasi si miese tso gɔmedzedzea me, be míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo; 12 menye abe Kain, ame si dzɔ tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la me, eye wòwu nɔvia ene o. Eye nu ka tae wòwui ɖo? Elabena eya ŋutɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi, ke nɔvia tɔwo ya le dzɔdzɔe.
ENGLISH: 10 It is by this that God’s children and the Devil’s children are evident: anyone who does not do right does not come of God, nor the one who does not love his brother, 11 because this is the message you heard from the first, that we are to love each other 12 not as Cain came of the Evil One and cut his brother’s throat; and cut his brother’s throat on what account? because his doings were wicked, but his brother’s right.

EWE: 13 Nɔviwo, megawɔ moyaa na mi be xexea léa fu mi o. 14 Míenyae be míeto ku me yi agbe me, elabena míelɔ̃a mía nɔviwo.
ENGLISH: 13 Do not wonder, brothers, that the world should hate you; 14 we know that we have passed from death to life because we love the brothers.

EWE: Ame si melɔ̃a ame o la tsia ku me.
ENGLISH: He who does not love dwells in death.

EWE: 15 Ame sia ame si léa fu nɔvia la, amewulae wònye, eye mienyae be amewula aɖeke makpɔ agbe mavɔ o.
ENGLISH: 15 Anyone who hates his brother is a killer, and you know that any man-killer does not have eternal life dwelling in him.

EWE: 16 Esia me míeva dze si lɔlɔ̃ la le, elabena etsɔ eƒe agbe ɖo anyi ɖe mía ta; eye ele na mí be míatsɔ míaƒe agbe aɖo anyi ɖe mía nɔviwo ta.
ENGLISH: 16 We know love by this, that he laid down his life for us; and we are in duty bound to lay down our lives for the brothers.

EWE: 17 Ke ame si si xexe sia me nunɔamesiwo le, eye wòkpɔ nɔvia hiã tui, gake eƒe dɔme metrɔ ɖe eŋu o la, aleke Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ nɔa emee? 18 Vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, migana míatsɔ nya kple aɖe ko alɔ̃ ame o, ke boŋ míatsɔ nuwɔna kple nyateƒe alɔ̃ ame.
ENGLISH: 17 But one who has earthly resources and sees his brother to be in need and shuts his sympathies against him how is the love of God dwelling in him? 18 Children, let us not love with words nor with the tongue, but in action and in truth.

EWE: 19 Esia mee míanyae le be míedzɔ tso nyateƒe la me, eye míana kakaɖedzi míaƒe dziwo le eŋkume 20 le nu sia nu si me míaƒe dzi abu fɔ mí le la me, elabena Mawu nye gã wu míaƒe dziwo, eye wònya nuwo katã.
ENGLISH: 19 By this we shall know that we belong to the truth; and we shall persuade our heart before him 20 that if our heart finds against us, God is greater than our heart and knows everything.

EWE: 21 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ne míaƒe dzi mebua fɔ mí o la, ekema dzi aɖo mía ƒo míaƒo nu le Mawu ŋkume, 22 eye nu sia nu si míebiae la, míaxɔe tso egbɔ, elabena míeléa eƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye míewɔa nu siwo dzea eŋu.
ENGLISH: 21 Dear friends, if our heart does not find against us we have confidence to come to God, 22 and we receive from him whatever we ask, because we are keeping his commandments and doing what is pleasing before him.

EWE: 23 Nyateƒee, eƒe sedede lae nye be: míaxɔ Via Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ dzi ase, eye míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo, abe ale si wòde se na míi ene.
ENGLISH: 23 And this is his commandment, that we should believe the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love each other as he gave us a commandment.

EWE: 24 Hekpe ɖe eŋu la, ame si léa eƒe sewo me ɖe asi la wɔ ɖeka kplii, eye eya hã nɔa ɖekawɔwɔ me kplii. Le gbɔgbɔ si wòna mí ta la, míenyae be ekpɔtɔ le ɖekawɔwɔ me kpli mí.
ENGLISH: 24 And he who keeps his commandments dwells in him, and he in him; and by this we know that he is dwelling in us, from the Spirit that he gave us.

EWE: 1 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 1 John

EWE: 4 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migaxɔ nya sia nya si wobe etso gbɔgbɔ me la dzi se o, ke boŋ mido nya si wobe etso gbɔgbɔ me la kpɔ be Mawu gbɔe wòtso hã, elabena aʋatsonyagblɔɖila geɖewo do go yi xexea me.
ENGLISH: 4 Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but put the spirits to the test, whether they come from God, because there have many pretended prophets gone out into the world.

EWE: 2 Nu si ana miadze si nya si tso Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ me lae nye esi: Nya sia nya si tso gbɔgbɔ me si ʋua eme be Yesu Kristo va le ŋutilã me la, tso Mawu gbɔ. 3 Gake nya sia nya si tso gbɔgbɔ me si meʋua Yesu me o la, metso Mawu gbɔ o. Gawu la, esiae nye Kristo ƒe futɔ la ƒe nya, si miese be egbɔna, eye azɔ ele xexea me xoxo.
ENGLISH: 2 You know God’s Spirit by this: any spirit that acknowledges Jesus Christ to have come in flesh comes from God, 3 and any spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus does not come from God; and this is that of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming, and it is already in the world now.

EWE: 4 Vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, Mawu mee mietso, eye mieɖu ame mawo dzi, elabena ame si le mia dzi la lolo wu ame si le xexea dzi.
ENGLISH: 4 You come of God, children, and have won the victory over them because he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

EWE: 5 Woawo la, xexea mee wotso; esia tae wogblɔa nya siwo tso xexea me, eye xexea ɖoa to wo.
ENGLISH: 5 They come of the world; that is why they speak words of the world and the world hears them.

EWE: 6 Míawo la, Mawu mee míetso.
ENGLISH: 6 We come of God; he who knows God hears us, he who does not come of God does not hear us.

EWE: Ame si va dze si Mawu la ɖoa to mí; ame si metso Mawu me o la meɖoa to mí o.
ENGLISH: It is from this that we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of delusion.

EWE: 7 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mina míayi edzi alɔ̃ mía nɔewo, elabena lɔlɔ̃ la tso Mawu gbɔ, eye ame sia ame si lɔ̃a ame la, Mawu mee wodzii tso, eye wòdze si Mawu.
ENGLISH: 7 Dear friends, let us love each other, because love is from God and everyone who loves is born out of God and knows God.

EWE: 8 Ame sia ame si melɔ̃a ame o la medze si Mawu o, elabena Mawu nye lɔlɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 8 He who does not love never got to know God, because God is love.

EWE: 9 Esia me woɖe Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ ɖe go fia le le mía me, be Mawu dɔ eƒe Tenuvi la ɖo ɖe xexea me, be míakpɔ agbe to eya amea dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 God’s love was displayed in our case by this, that God has sent his only Son into the world in order that we may live through him.

EWE: 10 Esia me lɔlɔ̃ la le, menye be míawo míelɔ̃ Mawu o, ke boŋ be eya lɔ̃ mí, eye wòdɔ Via be wòanye avulévɔsa ɖe míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ta.
ENGLISH: 10 This is where love comes in, not that we have loved God but that he loved us and sent his Son to be a propitiation for our sins.

EWE: 11 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ne aleae Mawu lɔ̃ míi la, ekema ele na míawo hã be míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 11 Dear friends, if God loved us like that, we are in duty bound to love each other too.

EWE: 12 Ame aɖeke mekpɔ Mawu ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o. Ne míeyi edzi lɔ̃a mía nɔewo la, ekema Mawu kpɔtɔ le mía me, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ la de blibo le mía me.
ENGLISH: 12 Nobody has ever looked upon God; if we love each other God is dwelling in us, and his love has been carried to perfection in us.

EWE: 13 Esia mee míenyae le be míekpɔtɔ le ɖekawɔwɔ me kplii, eye be eya hã kpɔtɔ le ɖekawɔwɔ me kpli mí, elabena ena eƒe gbɔgbɔ la mí.
ENGLISH: 13 That we are dwelling in him and he in us we know by this, that he has given us some of his Spirit.

EWE: 14 Azɔ hã, míawo ŋutɔwo míekpɔ esia eye míele ɖase ɖim be, Fofo la dɔ Via ɖa be wòanye xexea ɖela.
ENGLISH: 14 And we have seen the sight and testify to it that the Father has sent the Son to be savior of the world.

EWE: 15 Ame sia ame si ʋua eme be Yesu Kristoe nye Mawu ƒe Vi la, Mawu kpɔtɔ le ɖekawɔwɔ me kplii, eye eya hã le ɖekawɔwɔ me kple Mawu.
ENGLISH: 15 Whoever acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God is dwelling in him and he in God.

EWE: 16 Eye míawo míeva nya ale si gbegbe Mawu lɔ̃ míi, eye míexɔ esia dzi se hã.
ENGLISH: 16 And we know, and have believed, the love that God has in our case.

EWE: Mawu nye lɔlɔ̃, eye ame si lɔ̃a ame la wɔ ɖeka kple Mawu, eye Mawu hã wɔ ɖeka kplii.
ENGLISH: God is love, and he who dwells in love is dwelling in God and God in him.

EWE: 17 Aleae lɔlɔ̃ la de blibo le mía me, ale be dzi naɖo mía ƒo míaƒo nu faa le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la, elabena ale si eya amea le la, nenema kee míawo hã míele le xexe sia me.
ENGLISH: 17 It is in this that love has been brought to perfection with us, that we should have confidence on the day of judgment because what he is we too, in this world, are.

EWE: 18 Vɔvɔ̃ aɖeke mele lɔlɔ̃ me o, ke boŋ lɔlɔ̃ deblibo nyaa vɔvɔ̃ doa goe, elabena vɔvɔ̃ xea mɔ na mí. Le nyateƒe me la, ame si vɔ̃na la mede blibo le lɔlɔ̃ me o.
ENGLISH: 18 There is no fear in love, but perfect love throws fear out, because fear involves the idea of punishment and he who fears has not come to perfection in love.

EWE: 19 Míelɔ̃a ame, elabena Mawu tre mí lɔlɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 19 We love because he loved us first.

EWE: 20 Ne ame aɖe gblɔ be, "Melɔ̃ Mawu, " gake wòléa fu nɔvia la, aʋatsokalae. Elabena ame si melɔ̃a nɔvia si kpɔm wòle o la, mate ŋu alɔ̃ Mawu si kpɔm mele o la o. 21 Eye míexɔ se sia tso egbɔ be, ame si lɔ̃ Mawu la nalɔ̃ nɔvia hã.
ENGLISH: 20 If one says "I love God " and hates his brother he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen, 21 and we have from him this commandment, that he who loves God should love his brother too.

EWE: 1 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 1 John

EWE: 5 Ame sia ame si xɔna sena be Yesue nye Kristo la, Mawu ƒe vi wònye, eye ame sia ame si lɔ̃a ame si na agbe la, elɔ̃a Mawu ƒe Vi la hã.
ENGLISH: 5 Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born out of God, and everyone who loves the sire loves him who is born from him.

EWE: 2 Esia me míedzea sii le be míelɔ̃a Mawu ƒe viwo, ne míelɔ̃a Mawu hewɔa eƒe sewo dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 It is by this we know that we love God’s children, when we love God and live up to his commandments.

EWE: 3 Elabena nu si lɔlɔ̃ na Mawu fiae nye esi, be míalé eƒe seawo me ɖe asi; eye eƒe seawo menye agba o, 4 elabena ame sia ame si Mawu dzi la ɖua xexea dzi. Eye nu si míetsɔ ɖua xexea dzi dzidzedzetɔe lae nye míaƒe xɔse.
ENGLISH: 3 For this is the love of God, that we should keep his commandments; and his commandments are not burdensome, 4 because everything that is born out of God comes off victorious over the world; and this is the victory that has come off victorious over the world, our faith.

EWE: 5 Ame kae ate ŋu aɖu xexea dzi? Menye ame si xɔe se be Yesue nye Mawu ƒe Vi lae oa? 6 Yesu Kristo siae nye ame si va to tsi kple ʋu me, menye to tsi ɖeɖe ko me o, ke boŋ to tsi kple ʋu me. Eye gbɔgbɔ lae le ɖase ɖim, elabena gbɔgbɔ lae nye nyateƒe la. 7 Elabena ɖaseɖila etɔ̃e li: 8 gbɔgbɔ la, tsi la, kple ʋu la; eye nu etɔ̃ siawo wɔ ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 5 And who is it that is victorious over the world but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God? 6 This is the one that came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not in the water only but in the water and in the blood; and the Spirit is what testifies, because the Spirit is the truth 7 because it is three who testify, 8 the Spirit and the water and the blood, and the three concur.

EWE: 9 Ne míexɔa amegbetɔwo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la, ekema Mawu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la lolo wu. Elabena Mawu ŋutɔ le ɖase ɖim le Via ŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 If we receive men’s testimony, God’s testimony is superior; because this is God’s testimony, that he has testified about his Son.

EWE: 10 Ame si xɔa Mawu ƒe Vi la dzi sena la kpɔa ɖaseɖiɖi le eɖokui me.
ENGLISH: 10 He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in him.

EWE: Ame si mexɔa Mawu dzi sena o la doe aʋatsokala, elabena mexɔ ɖase si Mawu ɖi le Via ŋu la dzi se o.
ENGLISH: He who does not believe God has made a liar of him because he has not believed in the testimony God has borne about his Son.

EWE: 11 Eye ɖase si woɖi lae nye esi be, Mawu na agbe mavɔ mí, eye agbe sia le Via me.
ENGLISH: 11 And this is the testimony, that God has given us eternal life and this life is in his Son.

EWE: 12 Ame si xɔ Vi sia la, agbe sia le esi; ame si mexɔ Mawu ƒe Vi sia o la, agbe sia mele esi o.
ENGLISH: 12 He who has the Son has the life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have the life.

EWE: 13 Mele nya siawo ŋlɔm na mi, ne miadze sii be agbe mavɔ le mi ame siwo xɔa Mawu ƒe Vi la ƒe ŋkɔa dzi sena la si.
ENGLISH: 13 I have written these things to you in order that you may know that you have eternal life, to you who believe in the name of the Son of God.

EWE: 14 Eye kakaɖedzi sia le mía si le eya amea me be, nu sia nu si míabia wòawɔ ɖeka kple eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, aɖo to mí. 15 Eye ne míenya be eɖoa to mí le nu sia nu si biam míele me la, ekema míenya be míakpɔ nu siwo míebia la, elabena eya si mee míebia wo le.
ENGLISH: 14 And this is the confidence we have for coming to him, that if we ask anything in accordance with his will he hears us; 15 and if we know that he hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the things we have asked him for.

EWE: 16 Ne ame aɖe kpɔ nɔvia wòle nu vɔ̃ si mekplɔa ame yia ku me o wɔm la, nedo gbe ɖa ɖe eta, eye Mawu ana agbee, ɛ̃, ana agbe ame siwo mele nu vɔ̃ si kplɔa ame yia ku me o wɔm la.
ENGLISH: 16 If one sees his brother sinning, a sin not for death, he shall ask and give life to him, to those who are sinning not for death.

EWE: Nu vɔ̃ aɖe li si kplɔa ame yia ku me. Nyemegblɔ be wòaɖe kuku ɖe nu vɔ̃ ma ya ta o.
ENGLISH: There is such a thing as a sin for death; it is not as to that that I say he is to solicit.

EWE: 17 Nu madzɔmadzɔ ɖe sia ɖe wɔwɔ nye nu vɔ̃, gake nu vɔ̃ aɖe li, si mekplɔa ame yia ku me o.
ENGLISH: 17 Every wrong act is a sin, and there is such a thing as a sin not for death.

EWE: 18 Míenyae be ame si nye Mawu ƒe vi la metsɔa nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖoa dɔe o, ke boŋ Mawu ƒe vi la dzɔa eŋu, eye vɔ̃ɖitɔ la mekpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe edzi o.
ENGLISH: 18 We know that anyone who has been born out of God does not sin, but he who was born out of God keeps him and the Evil One does not touch him.

EWE: 19 Míenyae be Mawu me míetso, ke xexe blibo la katã le vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe ŋusẽ te. 20 Ke míenyae be Mawu ƒe Vi la va, eye wòna nugɔmesese deto mí be míadze si nyateƒetɔ la. Eye míele ɖekawɔwɔ me kple nyateƒetɔ la, to Via Yesu Kristo dzi.
ENGLISH: 19 We know that we belong with God; and the world is all lying in the Evil One; 20 but we know that the Son of God has come and has given us a mind to know the True One; and we are in the True One, in his Son Jesus Christ.

EWE: Nyateƒetɔ lae nye Mawu vavã la kple agbe mavɔ dzɔtsoƒe la.
ENGLISH: This is the true God, and eternal life.

EWE: 21 Vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi le trɔ̃wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 21 Children, guard yourselves against the idols.

EWE: 2 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 2 John

EWE: 1 Nye, ame tsitsi lae le agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe aƒenɔ tiatia la kple viawo, ame siwo melɔ̃ vevie, eye menye nye ɖeɖe ko o, ke ame siwo katã va dze si nyateƒe la hã, 2 le nyateƒe si kpɔtɔ le mía me, si anɔ kpli mí tegbee la ta. 3 Amenuveve, nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa si tso Mawu Fofo la, kple Yesu Kristo, Fofo la ƒe Vi la gbɔ la, anɔ kpli mí le nyateƒe kple lɔlɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: 1 The Elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I alone but also all who know the truth, 2 because of the truth that abides in us and shall be with us forever: 3 grace, mercy, peace, shall be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Father’s Son, in truth and love.

EWE: 4 Dzi dzɔm ŋutɔ esi mekpɔ be viwò aɖewo le zɔzɔm le nyateƒe la me, abe ale si ko míexɔ sedede tso Fofo la gbɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 4 I have been exceedingly glad to find some children of yours walking in truth as we received a commandment from the Father.

EWE: 5 Eya ta fifia la, mele kuku ɖem na wò, aƒenɔ, be míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 5 And now, lady, not as writing you a new commandment but the one we had from the first, I pray you that we love each other.

EWE: (Menye se yeye wònye ŋlɔm mele na wò o, ke boŋ esi le mía si tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la koe.) 6 Eye lɔlɔ̃ lae nye be, míayi edzi azɔ le eƒe sededewo nu.
ENGLISH: 6 And this is love, that we should walk in accordance with his commandments.

EWE: Esiae nye sedede la, abe ale si miesee tso gɔmedzedzea me ene, be miayi edzi azɔ le lɔlɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: This is the commandment, as you heard from the first, that you should walk in it.

EWE: 7 Elabena ameblela geɖewo do go yi xexea me, ame siwo meʋua Yesu Kristo me be eva le ŋutilã me o. Esiae nye ameblela la kple Kristo ƒe futɔ la.
ENGLISH: 7 Because there have come out into the world many deluders who do not acknowledge that Jesus Christ is coming in flesh: that man is the deluder and the antichrist.

EWE: 8 Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie be nu si míewɔ dɔ kpɔ la nagabu ɖe mi o, ke boŋ be miaxɔ fetu blibo la.
ENGLISH: 8 Look out for yourselves that you do not lose what we worked for, but get paid in full.

EWE: 9 Ame sia ame si ʋlina be yeayi ŋgɔ, gake melina ɖe Kristo la ƒe nufiafia me o la, mexɔ Mawu o. Ame si nɔa nufiafia sia me la, eyae nye ame si xɔ Fofo la kple Vi la siaa.
ENGLISH: 9 Anyone who moves on and does not remain in the Christ’s teaching does not have God; it is he who remains in the teaching that has both the Father and the Son.

EWE: 10 Ne ame aɖe va mia gbɔ eye metsɔ nufiafia sia vɛ o la, migaxɔe ɖe miaƒe aƒe me alo ado gbe nɛ kura o. 11 Elabena ame si do gbe nɛ la kpɔ gome kplii le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiawo me.
ENGLISH: 10 If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him in a house and do not say good morning to him, 11 for he who says good morning to him is in fellowship with his evil deeds.

EWE: 12 Togbɔ be nya geɖewo li maŋlɔ na mi hã la, nyemedi be mazã agbalẽ kple agbalẽŋlɔtsi atsɔ aŋlɔe o, ke mele mɔ kpɔm be mava mia gbɔ ahaƒo nu kpli mi ŋkume kple ŋkume, ale be miakpɔ dzidzɔ wòade edeƒe.
ENGLISH: 12 While I have much to write to you, I do not wish to with paper and ink, but hope to be with you and speak face to face, that your joy may be complete.

EWE: 13 Nɔviwònyɔnu si nye ame tiatia la ƒe viwo do gbe na wò.
ENGLISH: 13 Your chosen sister’s children send greetings.

EWE: 3 Yohanes
ENGLISH: 3 John

EWE: 1 Nye, ame tsitsi lae le agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe Gayo lɔlɔ̃tɔ, ame si melɔ̃ vevie.
ENGLISH: 1 The Elder to dear Gaius, whom I love in truth:

EWE: 2 Lɔlɔ̃tɔ, medoa gbe ɖa be nu sia nu nadze edzi na wò, eye nànɔ lãmesẽ me, abe ale si nu le edzi dzem na wòe ene.
ENGLISH: 2 Dear friend, I pray that you may prosper about everything, and have sound health, as your soul is prospering.

EWE: 3 Elabena mekpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ esi nɔviwo va heɖi ɖase be nèlé nyateƒe la me ɖe asi, eye be nèyi edzi le zɔzɔm le nyateƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 3 For I was exceedingly glad when brothers came and testified to your truth, as you are walking in the truth.

EWE: 4 Nyemekpɔ dzidzɔ gã wu esia o: be mase be vinyewo yi edzi le zɔzɔm le nyateƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 4 I have no greater gladness than this, to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

EWE: Meɖe kuku, do mɔ ame siawo ne woayi woƒe mɔzɔzɔ si dze Mawu ŋu la dzi. 7 Elabena eƒe ŋkɔ la tae wodo yi ɖo, eye womexɔ naneke tso dukɔwo me tɔwo si o. 8 Eya ta ele na mí be míaxɔ ame siawo tɔgbi nyuie awɔ amedzro na wo, ale be míazu hadɔwɔlawo le nyateƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 5 Dear friend, you are doing a Christian thing in anything you are doing for the brothers who are at the same time strangers in your locality, 6 who have testified to your love before the church; to whom you will do well to give a send-off worthy of God, 7 for they went out for the Name, not taking anything from the heathen 8 so we ought to contribute to the support of such, that we may become cooperators with the truth.

EWE: 9 Meŋlɔ nya aɖe na hamea, ke Diotrefo, si dina be yeanɔ nɔƒe gbãtɔ le wo dome la, mexɔa naneke tso mía gbɔ bubutɔe o.
ENGLISH: 9 I wrote something to the church; but Diotrephes, who is so fond of being first among them, will not give us a hearing.

EWE: 10 Esia tae ne meva la, maɖo ŋku nu siwo wɔm wòle, si nye nya vlo siwo gblɔm wòle tsɔ le mía ŋu gblẽm la dzi. Eye esi nu siawo mesu eme nɛ o la, eya ŋutɔ mexɔa nɔviawo bubutɔe o, eye ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ wo la, edzea agbagba be yeaxe mɔ na wo, eye be yeaɖe wo le hamea me.
ENGLISH: 10 For this reason, if I come, I will bring up the matter of his actions in gabbling wicked words against us, and, not content with that, not giving the brothers a hearing himself, and also forbidding and expelling from the church those who would be willing to.

EWE: 11 Lɔlɔ̃tɔ, mègasrɔ̃ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ o, ke srɔ̃ nu nyui wɔwɔ boŋ.
ENGLISH: 11 Dear friend, do not imitate what is wrong but what is right.

EWE: Ame si wɔa nu nyui la, etso Mawu me. Ame si wɔa nu vɔ̃ɖi la, mekpɔ Mawu o.
ENGLISH: He who does right comes of God; he who does wrong has not seen God.

EWE: 12 Nɔviawo katã ɖi ɖase nyui le Demetrio ŋu, eye nyateƒea ŋutɔ hã ɖi ɖase le eŋu.
ENGLISH: 12 Demetrius is vouched for by everybody and by the truth itself; and we too vouch, and you know our testimony is true.

EWE: 13 Nya geɖewo le asinye maŋlɔ na wò hafi, ke nyemedi be matsɔ nuŋlɔti kple agbalẽŋlɔtsi ayi nuŋɔŋlɔa dzi o.
ENGLISH: 13 I had much to write to you, but do not wish to write you by pen and ink; 14 but I hope to see you at once, and we shall speak face to face.

EWE: Ŋutifafa nanɔ kpli wò.
ENGLISH: Peace be upon you.

EWE: Xɔlɔ̃awo do gbe na wò.
ENGLISH: Our friends send greetings.

EWE: Yɔ xɔlɔ̃awo ŋkɔ ɖekaɖeka nàdo gbe na wo nam.
ENGLISH: Give personal greetings to our friends.

EWE: Yuda
ENGLISH: Jude

EWE: 1 Yuda, Yesu Kristo ƒe kluvi, ame si nye Yakobo nɔvi, le esia ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe ame siwo woyɔ, siwo Mawu Fofo la lɔ̃, eye wòkpɔ wo ta na Yesu Kristo: 2 Nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa kpakple lɔlɔ̃ nadzi ɖe edzi na mi.
ENGLISH: 1 Judah, servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to the called who are loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ: 2 mercy and peace and love be yours in abundance.

EWE: 3 Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, togbɔ be menɔ agbagba dzem vevie be maŋlɔ xɔxɔ si mí katã míakpɔ ŋu nya ɖo ɖe mi hã la, mekpɔe be ehiã be maŋlɔ agbalẽ na mi atsɔ axlɔ̃ nu mi be miaʋli sesĩe hena xɔse si wotsɔ na ame kɔkɔewo zi ɖeka ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu la boŋ.
ENGLISH: 3 Dear friends, while I was doing my utmost to write to you about our common salvation, I have found it necessary to write you an exhortation to do battle for the faith once delivered to God’s people.

EWE: 4 Susu si tae nye be, ame aɖewo va tra ɖe mia dome dzaa, ame siwo Ŋɔŋlɔawo ɖo ɖi hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ sia ɣeyiɣi didi aɖee nye esia; wonye ame mavɔ̃mawuwo, ame siwo trɔa mía Mawu ƒe amenuveve la wòzua mɔɖeɖe ɖe ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ dzimesesẽtɔe ŋu, eye womewɔa nuteƒe na míaƒe Aƒetɔ ɖeka kolia, si nye Yesu Kristo, ame si tɔ míenye la o.
ENGLISH: 4 For there have slipped in some men forewritten of old for this doom, impious men who shift the grace of our God into immorality and repudiate our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

EWE: 5 Togbɔ be mienya nu siawo katã nyuie hã la, medi be magaɖo ŋku edzi na mi be Yehowa ɖe dukɔ aɖe tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, gake emegbe etsrɔ̃ ame siwo meɖe xɔse fia o la. 6 Eye mawudɔla siwo menɔ afi si woda wo ɖo le gɔmedzedzea me o, ke boŋ wogblẽ woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe nɔƒe ɖi la, ede kɔsɔkɔsɔ mavɔwo wo, eye wòdzra wo ɖo ɖe viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me hena ŋkeke gã la ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃. 7 Nenema kee Sodom kple Gomora kpakple du siwo ƒo xlã wo hã ƒo wo ɖokuiwo ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me wògbɔ eme, eye wodze ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzro si mele dzɔdzɔme nu o la yome; wotsɔ wo wɔ nuxlɔ̃amekpɔɖeŋu na mí, esi wotsɔ dzo mavɔ he to na woe.
ENGLISH: 5 But I would remind you, though you know the whole once for all, that after the Lord had saved a people out of the land of Egypt he in the second instance destroyed those who did not believe, 6 and angels who did not keep their prerogative but left their domicile he has kept under darkness by everlasting fetters for the judgment of the Great Day, 7 as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having run into debauchery and gone after another flesh in like manner with these, are on exhibition as an example, undergoing the penalty of eternal fire.

EWE: 8 Ke hã, ame siawo hã kua drɔ̃e, woƒoa ɖi ŋutilã la, wodoa vlo ŋusẽ si ɖua wo dzi la, eye woƒoa nu gbegblẽ tso ŋutikɔkɔemewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 However, in the same fashion these too, obsessed by dreams, pollute flesh, and set lordship aside, and vilify glories.

EWE: 9 Ke esi nya ɖo mawudɔla gãtɔ Mikael kple Abosam dome, eye wòle nya hem kplii le Mose ƒe kukua ŋu la, mete kpɔ be yeagblɔ nya vlo aɖeke atsɔ abu fɔe o, ke boŋ egblɔ be: "Yehowa neka mo na wò. " 10 Gake ame siawo le nu gbegblẽ ƒom le nu siwo katã gɔme womese ŋutɔŋutɔ o la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 But the archangel Michael, when he was arguing with the Devil over the body of Moses, did not dare to prefer a defamation-charge, but said "The Lord rebuke you! " 10 But these vilify whatever they do not know; and what they do by nature make out like the brutes, in this they find their undoing.

EWE: Ke le nu siwo katã gɔme wose le dzɔdzɔme nu abe lã manyanuwo ene me la, woyi edzi le nu gblẽm le wo ɖokuiwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 11 Woe to them, because they have traveled Cain’s road, and streamed over Balaam’s devious course for pay, and perished in Korah’s sedition.

EWE: 11 Baba na wo, elabena woto Kain ƒe ʋe me, eye woƒu du dze Bileam ƒe mɔ vɔ̃ɖi la dzi hena fetu, eye wotsrɔ̃ le Kora ƒe nuƒoƒo aglãdzedzetɔe la me! 12 Ame siawoe nye agakpe siwo ɣla ɖe tɔ gɔme, siwo le nu ɖum kpli mi le miaƒe lɔlɔ̃kplɔ̃ɖoɖowo me, alẽkplɔla siwo nyia wo ɖokuiwo vɔvɔ̃manɔmee; alilikpo siwo me tsi mele o, siwo ya lɔna yina gbɔnae; ati siwo li va se ɖe kele ƒe nuwuwu, gake wometsea ku o, woku zi eve, eye woho wo; 13 wonye ƒutsotsoe dzeagbo siwo kplɔa woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe ŋukpenanuwo ƒe futukpɔ va kɔna ɖe gota; ɣletivi siwo mezɔna ɖe ɖoɖo aɖeke nu o, siwo wodzra viviti tsiɖitsiɖi ɖo ɖi na tegbee.
ENGLISH: 12 These are those "who in your love-feasts fearlessly feast with you, and are your sunken rocks, " shepherds that feed themselves, waterless clouds carried along by winds, twice-dead fruitless autumn trees uprooted, 13 wild sea waves frothing up their own shames, wandering stars for which the blackness of darkness is forever kept.

EWE: 14 Ɛ̃, Enok, ame si nye adrelia tso Adam dzi, hã gblɔ nya ɖi tso wo ŋu, esi wògblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa! Yehowa va kple eƒe ame kɔkɔe akpeakpewo, 15 be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo katã, eye yeabu fɔ ame mavɔ̃mawuwo katã le woƒe mawumavɔmavɔ̃nu siwo wowɔ le mawumavɔmavɔ̃ me, kple nya baɖa siwo katã nu vɔ̃ wɔla mavɔ̃mawuwo gblɔ tso eŋu la ta. " 16 Ame siawo nye liʋiliʋĩlĩlawo, ame siwo toa nyatoƒoe le esi nu medzea wo ŋu o ta, ame siwo zɔna le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe nudzodzrowo nu, wotsɔa woƒe nu ƒoa adegbe gãwo, eye wodoa vivi ɖe amewo ŋu le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe viɖe kpɔkpɔ ta.
ENGLISH: 14 And it was to these too that Enoch, seventh from Adam, prophesied "Here the Lord has come with his holy millions 15 to do justice upon all and to call all the impious to account regarding all their impieties that they have committed, and regarding all the hard words that impious sinners have spoken against him. " 16 These are faultfinding grumblers, going by their own desires, with mouths that pour out extravagant talk, deferring to persons for profit’s sake.

EWE: 17 Ke miawo la, lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, miɖo ŋku nya siwo mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolowo gblɔ do ŋgɔ la dzi, 18 ale si wonɔ gbɔgblɔm na mi be: "Le ɣeyiɣi mamlɛa me la, fewuɖulawo ava, ame siwo ati woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe mawumavɔmavɔ̃ ƒe nudzodzrowo yome. " 19 Ame siawoe dea mama amewo me, ame siwo le abe lãwo ene, siwo mebua gbɔgbɔmenuwo ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 17 But as for you, dear friends, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ, 18 how they told you "In the end of time there will be mockers going by their own desires for impieties. " 19 These are the discriminators, soul-men who have no spirit.

EWE: 20 Ke miawo la, lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mitu mia ɖokuiwo ɖo ɖe miaƒe xɔse kɔkɔetɔ la dzi, mido gbe ɖa le gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe me, 21 eye minɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la me ɖaa, esi miele mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ lalam hena agbe mavɔ kpɔkpɔ.
ENGLISH: 20 But do you, dear friends, building yourselves up upon your most holy faith, praying in Holy Spirit, 21 keep yourselves in the love of God, watching for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ which brings us to eternal life.

EWE: 22 Azɔ hã, miyi edzi mianɔ nublanui kpɔm na ame siwo me ɖikekewo le; 23 mihe wo do goe tso dzo la me ne miaxɔ wo ɖe agbe. Ke miyi edzi miakpɔ nublanui na ame bubuwo, eye miwɔ esia kple vɔvɔ̃, eye milé fu woƒe awu si ŋutilã la ƒo ɖii la gɔ̃ hã.
ENGLISH: 22 And convince some by proofs when they doubt, 23 and save some by snatching them out of fire, and pity some with fear, hating the very garment spotted by the flesh.

EWE: 24 Ke ame si ate ŋu adzɔ mia ŋu be miagakli nu o, eye wòana mianɔ te anye mokakamanɔŋutɔwo le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la ŋkume le dzidzɔ gã me, 25 Mawu ɖeka kolia, si nye mía Xɔla to Yesu Kristo, mía Aƒetɔ dzi la, tɔ nanye ŋutikɔkɔe, gãnyenye, ŋusẽ kple dziɖuɖu tso ɣeyiɣi mavɔmavɔ siwo va yi kple fifia, heyi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me. Amen.
ENGLISH: 24 And to him who can guard you safe from stumbling and set you before his glory blameless and exultant, 25 the only God, our Savior, belong glory, majesty, might, and dominion, before all time and now and to all eternity; amen!

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 1 Yesu Kristo ƒe nyaɖeɖefia si Mawu tsɔ nae be wòaɖe nu siwo ava dzɔ kpuie la afia eƒe kluviwo. Edɔ eƒe mawudɔla ɖa wòva ɖe wo fia eƒe kluvi Yohanes to dzesiwo me, 2 Yohanes ɖi ɖase le Mawu ƒe nya kple ɖase si Yesu Kristo ɖi la ŋu, ɛ̃, le nu siwo katã wòkpɔ la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 1 Jesus Christ’s revelation which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place, and which he sent by his angel and indicated to his servant John, 2 who testified to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, all that he saw.

EWE: 3 Dzidzɔtɔe nye ame si xlẽa nyagblɔɖi sia me nyawo sesĩe kple ame siwo sea wo, eye woléa nu siwo woŋlɔ ɖe eme la me ɖe asi, elabena ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖi la tu aƒe.
ENGLISH: 3 Happy are he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy and keep what is written in it; for the time is near.
