EWE: 4 Yohanes le esia ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe hame adre siwo le Asia nuto me: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa si tso "Ame si li, eye wònɔ anyi, eye wògbɔna " la gbɔ kple esi tso gbɔgbɔ adre siwo le eƒe fiazikpuia ŋgɔ la gbɔ, 5 kpakple esi tso Yesu Kristo, "Ðasefo Nuteƒewɔla la, " "ame kukuwo dome ŋgɔgbevi la, " kple "anyigbadzifiawo ƒe Dziɖula la " gbɔ la, nanɔ anyi kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 4 John to the seven churches in Asia: Grace to you, and peace, from him who Is and Was and Is Coming, and from the Seven Spirits that are before his throne, 5 and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth.

EWE: Ame si lɔ̃a mí, eye wòna ablɔɖe mí tso míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo me to eya ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu me 6 eye wòwɔ mí míenye fiaɖuƒe kple nunɔlawo na eƒe Mawu kple Fofoa ɛ̃, eya tɔ nanye ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ yi mavɔmavɔ me. Amen.
ENGLISH: To him who loves us and liberated us from our sins with his blood, 6 and made us into a kingdom, priests to his God and Father, belong glory and might forever and ever; amen! 7 Lo, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye shall see him, and they who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth shall wail over him.

EWE: 7 Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: Yes; amen

EWE: 8 "Nyee nye Alfa kple Omega, " Yehowa Mawu, "Ame si li, eye wònɔ anyi, eye wògbɔna, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, " ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 8 I am the A and the Z, says the Lord God; the one who Is and Was and Is Coming; the Almighty.

EWE: 9 Nye, Yohanes, mia nɔvi, si kpɔ gome kpli mi le xaxa kple fiaɖuƒe kpakple dzidodo me le Yesu ta la, menɔ ƒukpo si woyɔna be Patmo la dzi le nuƒoƒo tso Mawu ŋu kple ɖaseɖiɖi le Yesu ŋu ta.
ENGLISH: 9 I, John, your brother and fellow-participator in distress and royalty and endurance in Jesus, was in the island called Patmos for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

EWE: 10 Gbɔgbɔ la kplɔm yi Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke la me, eye mese gbe sesẽ aɖe le megbenye abe kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi ene, 11 gblɔ be: "Nu si nèkpɔ la, ŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽ me, eye nàɖoe ɖe hame adre, siwo le Efeso, Smirna, Pergamo, Tiatira, Sardes, Filadelfia kple Laodikea. " 12 Metrɔ be makpɔ ame si le nu ƒom kplim la, eye esi metrɔ la, mekpɔ sikakaɖiti adre, 13 eye ame aɖe le akaɖitiawo titina si le abe amegbetɔvi ene, edo awu ʋlaya legbe, si ɖo afɔgɔme nɛ, eye wòtsɔ sikanudziblanu bla akɔta. 14 Gawu la, eƒe ta kple taɖa fu tititi abe alẽfu ɣi alo sno ene, eye eƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzoƒaɖe ene, 15 eye eƒe afɔwo le abe akɔbli nyui si wode kpo me wòbiã hẽe ene, eye eƒe gbe le abe tsi geɖewo ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene. 16 Elé ɣletivi adre ɖe nuɖusi, eye yi ɖaɖɛ nuevee legbe aɖe le dodom tso eƒe nu me, eye eƒe mo le abe ɣe si le keklẽm sesĩe ene.
ENGLISH: 10 I was in the spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a loud voice, as if it were the sound of a trumpet 11 saying "What you see, write in a book and send to the seven churches, to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea. " 12 And I turned around to see the voice that was speaking with me; and when I turned around I saw seven golden lampstands, 13 and in the midst of the lampstands the like of a son of man dressed in a long robe and belted at the breast with a golden belt, 14 his head and hair white like white wool, like snow, and his eyes like flame, 15 and his feet like green gold as if it had been refined in a furnace, and his voice like the sound of much water; 16 with seven stars in his right hand and a sharp two-edged sword coming out of his mouth; and his appearance like the sun when it shines its strongest.

EWE: 17 Esi mekpɔe la, medze anyi ɖe eƒe afɔnu abe ame kuku ene. Eye wòda eƒe nuɖusi ɖe dzinye gblɔ be: "Mègavɔ̃ o.
ENGLISH: 17 And when I saw him I fell at his feet like a dead man; and he put his right hand on me, saying

EWE: Nyee nye Gbãtɔ la kple Mlɔetɔ la, 18 kple ame si le agbe, eye meku kpɔ, ke kpɔ ɖa, mele agbe tegbetegbe, eye ku kple Tsiẽƒe ƒe safuiwo le asinye.
ENGLISH: "Do not be afraid; I am the first and the last, 18 he who is alive and was dead and is alive, lo, forever and ever, and has the keys of death and the grave.

EWE: 19 Eya ta ŋlɔ nu siwo nèkpɔ kple nu siwo le dzɔdzɔm fifia kpakple nu siwo gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge le nu siawo megbe la ɖi.
ENGLISH: 19 So write what you saw, and what is, and what is to be after this.

EWE: 20 Ke nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe si le ɣletivi adre siwo nèkpɔ le nye nuɖusi me kple sikakaɖiti adreawo ŋu lae nye esi: Ɣletivi adreawo le tsitre ɖi na hame adreawo ƒe dɔlawo, eye akaɖiti adreawo le tsitre ɖi na hame adreawo.
ENGLISH: 20 The secret meaning of the seven stars that you saw lying in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches; and the lampstands seven, seven churches.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 2 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Efeso la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo ame si lé ɣletivi adreawo ɖe eƒe nuɖusi, eye wòzɔna le sikakaɖiti adreawo domee la, gblɔe nye esi: 2 ‘Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo, wò kutrikuku kple wò dzidodo, eye be màte ŋu aɖe mɔ ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu o, eye èdo ame siwo gblɔna be apostolowo yewonye evɔ womenyee o la kpɔ hekpɔe be aʋatsokalawo wonye. 3 Azɔ hã èle dzi dom, eye nènɔ te ɖe nu geɖewo nu le nye ŋkɔ la ta, eye ɖeɖi mete ŋuwò o.
ENGLISH: 2 "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write, ‘Says he who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands: 2 I know your deeds and your labor and endurance; and that you cannot bear bad men, and you tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and found them liars; 3 and you have endurance, and have borne things on account of my name and are not tired.

EWE: 4 Ke hã, nya si le asinye ɖe ŋuwòe nye be, ègblẽ lɔlɔ̃ si nɔ asiwò gbã la ɖi. 5 "‘Eya ta ɖo ŋku afi si nège tso la dzi, eye nàtrɔ dzi me, eye nàwɔ dɔ siwo nèwɔna tsã la. Ne menye nenema o la, mava gbɔwò, eye maɖe wò akaɖiti la ɖa le enɔƒe, negbe ɖe nètrɔ dzi me ko hafi.
ENGLISH: 4 But I have against you your having left off your first love; 5 so remember what you have fallen from, and repent and do the deeds that you did at first; else you shall find me coming, and I will move your lampstand out of its place if you do not repent.

EWE: 6 Ke hã, mekpɔ nu nyui sia le ŋuwò be: èlé fu Nikolai ƒe kɔmama la ƒe nuwɔnawo, siwo nye hã melé fui.
ENGLISH: 6 But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I too hate.

EWE: 7 Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo: Ame si ɖu dzi la, maɖe mɔ nɛ wòaɖu agbeti, si le Mawu ƒe paradisoa me la ƒe ɖe.’
ENGLISH: 7 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches. To the victor I will give the privilege of eating from the tree of life that is in God’s paradise.’

EWE: 8 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Smirna la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo ‘Gbãtɔ la kple Mlɔetɔ la,’ ame si ku, eye wògagbɔ agbe la, gblɔe nye esi: 9 ‘Menya wò xaxa kple ahedada, gake kesinɔtɔ nènye, eye menya ame siwo gblɔna be Yudatɔwo yewonye, evɔ womenyee o, ke boŋ Satana ƒe ƒuƒoƒe me tɔwo wonye la, ƒe busunyagbɔgblɔ.
ENGLISH: 8 "And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write, ‘Says the First and the Last, he who was dead and came to life: 9 I know your distress and your poverty (but you are rich) and your vilification on the part of those who profess to be Jews and are not but are a congregation of Satan.

EWE: 10 Mègavɔ̃ fu siwo nàva kpe kpuie la o. Kpɔ ɖa! Abosam ade mia dometɔ aɖewo gaxɔ me bena woado mi akpɔ bliboe, ne miakpɔ xaxa ŋkeke ewo.
ENGLISH: 10 Do not be afraid of what you are to suffer: lo, the devil is to throw some of you into prison that you may be tested, and you shall have ten days’ distress.

EWE: Wɔ nuteƒe va se ɖe ku me ke, eye mana agbefiakuku wò.
ENGLISH: Be faithful even to death, and I will give you the wreath of life.

EWE: 11 Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo: Ame si ɖu dzi la, ku evelia mawɔ nu vevii o.’
ENGLISH: 11 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches. The victor shall not be hurt by the second death.’

EWE: 12 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Pergamo la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo ame si si yi ɖaɖɛ nuevee legbe la le la gblɔe nye esi: 13 ‘Menya afi si nèle. Eyae nye afi si Satana ƒe fiazikpui le; gake èyi edzi lé nye ŋkɔ me ɖe asi sesĩe, ègaxɔ dzinye se kokoko, mègbe nu le gbɔnye le Antipa, nye ɖasefo nuteƒewɔla si wowu le mia gbɔ, afi si Satana le la, ŋɔli gɔ̃ hã o.
ENGLISH: 12 "And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write, ‘Says he who has the sharp two-edged sword: 13 I know where you live where Satan’s throne is; and you hold on to my name, and did not deny my faith even in the days of my witness Antipas, my faithful one, who was killed in your town, where Satan lives.

EWE: 14 "‘Ke hã, nya ʋɛ aɖewo le asinye ɖe ŋuwò: eyae nye be ame siwo lé Bileam ƒe nufiafia me ɖe asi la le gbɔwò afi ma; ame sia fia Balak be wòada nukikli ɖe Israel-viwo ŋgɔ, ne woaɖu nu siwo wotsɔ sa vɔ na trɔ̃wo, eye woaƒo wo ɖokui ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me.
ENGLISH: 14 But I have a few things against you, because you have there people who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to lay a snare to trip up the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to have immoral relations between the sexes.

EWE: 15 Nenema kee ame siwo lé Nikolai ƒe kɔmama la ƒe nufiafia me ɖe asi la hã le gbɔwò.
ENGLISH: 15 Just so you too have men who similarly hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

EWE: 16 Eya ta trɔ dzi me. Ne menye nenema o la, megbɔna gbɔwò kaba, eye matsɔ nye numeyi legbe la awɔ aʋa kpli wo.
ENGLISH: 16 So repent; else you shall quickly find me coming, and I will make war on them with my mouth-sword.

EWE: 17 "‘Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo: Ame si ɖu dzi la, matsɔ mana ɣaɣla la ƒe ɖe anae, eye mana kpe ɣi aɖe si dzi woŋlɔ ŋkɔ yeye aɖe ɖo lae; ame aɖeke menya ŋkɔ ma o, negbe ame si xɔe la ko.’
ENGLISH: 17 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches. To the victor I will give a portion of the hidden manna; and I will give him a white stone, and inscribed on the stone a new name which no one but the receiver knows.’

EWE: 18 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Tiatira la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo Mawu ƒe Vi la, ame si ƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzoƒaɖe ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le abe akɔbli nyui ene la, gblɔe nye esi: 19 ‘Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo, wò lɔlɔ̃, wò xɔse, wò subɔsubɔdɔ kple wò dzidodo, eye wò dɔwɔwɔ fifitɔwo wu tsãtɔwo.
ENGLISH: 18 "And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write, ‘Says the Son of God, he who has eyes like flame and feet like green gold: 19 I know your deeds, and your love and faith and service and endurance, and that your last deeds are more than your first.

EWE: 20 "‘Ke hã, nya si le asinye ɖe ŋuwòe nye be: èɖe mɔ na Izebel, nyɔnu ma si yɔa eɖokui nyagblɔɖila, eye wòfiaa nu nye kluviwo heflua wo be woaƒo wo ɖokuiwo ɖe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu me ahaɖu nu siwo wotsɔ sa vɔ na trɔ̃wo. 21 Mena ɣeyiɣii be wòatrɔ dzi me, gake egbe dzimetɔtrɔ tso eƒe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenua me. 22 Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 20 But I have against you your permitting the woman Jezebel, her who calls herself a prophetess and teaches and misleads my servants to have immoral relations between the sexes and to eat things sacrificed to idols, 21 and I gave her time to repent and she is not willing to repent of her immorality.

EWE: Matsɔe aƒu dɔba dzi kpuie, eye made ame siwo le ahasi wɔm kplii la xaxa gã aɖe me, negbe ɖe wotrɔ dzi me hetrɔ tso eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me ko hafi. 23 Eye matsɔ dɔvɔ̃ dziŋɔ awu viawo, ale be hameawo katã nanyae be, nyee dzroa dzimesusuwo kple dziwo me kpɔ, eye maɖo eteƒe na mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu.
ENGLISH: 22 Lo, I will stretch her on a couch, and throw those who commit adultery with her into great distress if they do not repent of her dealings, 23 and will kill her children with an epidemic, and all the churches shall know that I am he who searches hearts and bosoms; and I will give to each of you according to his deeds.

EWE: 24 "‘Ke hã, mele egblɔm na mi ame mamlɛ siwo le Tiatira, ame siwo katã meléa nufiafia sia me ɖe asi o, ame siwo menya naneke tso nu siwo yɔm wole be "Satana ƒe nu goglowo " ŋu o la be: Nyemele agba bubu aɖeke dam ɖe mia dzi o.
ENGLISH: 24 But you others in Thyatira, as many as do not have this teaching, those who do not, as they say, know the deep things of Satan, to you I say, I put on you no other burden; 25 what you have, though, hold till I come.

EWE: 26 Ame si lé nye dɔwɔwɔwo me ɖe asi va se ɖe nuwuwu eye wòɖu dzi la, mana ŋusẽe ɖe dukɔwo dzi, 27 eye wòatsɔ gatikplɔ akplɔ wo, ale be woagbã gudugudu abe anyinuwo ene, abe ale si ko mexɔ ŋusẽ tso Fofonye gbɔ ene. 28 Eye mana ŋukeɣletivi lae.
ENGLISH: And to the victor, 26 the man who keeps my dealings till the end, I will give dominion over the nations, 27 that he should drive them with an iron rod as earthen dishes are shattered, as I too received from my Father; 28 and I will give him the morning star.

EWE: 29 Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo.’
ENGLISH: 29 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches.’

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 3 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Sardes la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo ame si si Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adreawo kple ɣletivi adreawo le la, gblɔe nye esi: ‘Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo, èxɔ ŋkɔ be èle agbe, gake èku.
ENGLISH: 3 "And to the angel of the church in Sardis write, ‘Says he who has the Seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your deeds, that you have the name of being alive and are dead.

EWE: 2 Nɔ ŋudzɔ, eye nàdo ŋusẽ nu siwo susɔ siwo le kukum la, elabena nyemekpɔe be èwɔ wò dɔwo bliboe le nye Mawu ŋkume o. 3 Eya ta nɔ ŋku ɖom nu si nèxɔ kple nu si nèse la dzi, eye yi edzi nàlé eme ɖe asi, eye nàtrɔ dzi me.
ENGLISH: 2 Get awake, and strengthen what is left, that was about to die; for I have not found work of yours accomplished before my God; 3 so remember how it was that you received and heard, and keep it and repent.

EWE: Ke ne mènyɔ o la, mava abe fiafitɔ ene, eye mànya gaƒoƒo si dzi mava do ɖe dziwò la kura o.
ENGLISH: So if you do not keep awake I will come like a thief, and you shall not know at what hour I will come upon you.

EWE: 4 "‘Ke hã, ame ʋɛ aɖewo le mewò le Sardes, siwo meƒo ɖi woƒe awuwo o, eye woazɔ kplim le awu ɣiwo me, elabena wodze.
ENGLISH: 4 But you have a few names in Sardis that did not soil their clothing, and they shall walk with me in white, because they are worthy to.

EWE: 5 Ame si ɖu dzi la, woado awu ɣiwo nɛ, eye nyematutu eƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le agbegbalẽ la me akpɔ o, ke boŋ maʋu eƒe ŋkɔ me le Fofonye ŋkume kple eƒe dɔlawo ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 5 The victor shall be thus clad in white clothing; and I will not blot out his name from the book of life, and I will acknowledge his name before my Father and before his angels.

EWE: 6 Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo.’
ENGLISH: 6 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches.’

EWE: 7 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Filadelfia la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo ame si le kɔkɔe, ame si nye nyateƒetɔ, ame si si David ƒe safui la le, ame si ʋunɛ ale be ame aɖeke metunɛ o, eye wòtunɛ ale be ame aɖeke meʋunɛ o la, gblɔe nye esi: 8 ‘Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo. Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ ʋɔtru aɖe si le ʋuʋu ɖi la ɖo ŋkuwòme, si ame aɖeke mate ŋu atu o.
ENGLISH: 7 "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write, ‘Says the Holy, the True, he who has David’s key, who opens and nobody shall shut, and shuts and nobody shall open: 8 I know your deeds; lo, I have set before you an open door which nobody can shut, because you have a little power and have kept my word and not disowned my name.

EWE: 9 Kpɔ ɖa, mana Satana ƒe ƒuƒoƒe me tɔ siwo gblɔna be Yudatɔwo yewonye, evɔ womenyee o ke boŋ aʋatso kam wole la, nava bɔbɔ ɖe wò afɔnu ade bubu ŋuwò, eye mana woanyae be melɔ̃ wò.
ENGLISH: 9 Lo, I grant men out of Satan’s congregation, of those who profess to be Jews and are not but are lying, lo, I will make them come and do reverence before your face and know that I have loved you.

EWE: 10 Esi nèlé nye dzidodo ŋuti nya la me ɖe asi ta la, nye hã makpɔ tawò le dodokpɔ ƒe gaƒoƒo si gbɔna anyigbadzinɔlawo katã dzi be wòado ame siwo katã le anyigba dzi kpɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 10 Because you kept my word of endurance, so will I keep you from the hour of testing that is to come all over the world of men, to test those who live on the earth.

EWE: 11 Megbɔna kpuie. Lé nu si le asiwò la me ɖe asi goŋgoŋ, ale be ame aɖeke nagaxɔ wò fiakuku la o.
ENGLISH: 11 I am coming quickly; hold what you have, that no one may get your wreath.

EWE: 12 "‘Ame si ɖu dzi la, mawɔe wòanye sɔti le nye Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ la me, eye magado le eme akpɔ o, eye maŋlɔ nye Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ kple nye Mawu ƒe du si nye Yerusalem Yeye, si le ɖiɖim tso dziƒo tso nye Mawu gbɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ kple nye ŋkɔ yeye la ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 12 The victor I will make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall never again go outside; and I will inscribe on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem that is coming down out of heaven from my God, and my new name.

EWE: 13 Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo.’
ENGLISH: 13 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches.’

EWE: 14 "Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame si le Laodikea la ƒe dɔla be: Nya siwo Amen la, ɖasefo nuteƒewɔla kple nyateƒetɔ, ame si nye Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze la, gblɔe nye esi: 15 ‘Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo, be mèfa o, eye mèxɔ dzo hã o.
ENGLISH: 14 "And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write, ‘Says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation: 15 I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot.

EWE: Ðe madi be nàfa alo nàxɔ dzo hafi. 16 Eya ta esi nèle yɔyrɔe, mèxɔ dzo o eye mèfa hã o ta la, matu wò aƒu gbe tso nye nu me.
ENGLISH: I wish you were cold or hot! 16 Thus, because you are lukewarm and neither hot nor cold, I am going to vomit you out of my mouth.

EWE: 17 Elabena ègblɔna be, "Kesinɔtɔ menye, eye kesinɔnuwo le asinye, eye naneke mehiãm kura o, " ke mènya be hiãtɔ, nublanuitɔ, ame dahe, ŋkuagbãtɔ kple amamanɔla yenye o; 18 mele aɖaŋu ɖom na wò be nàƒle sika si wolólo le dzo me hedza eŋu la le asinye be nàzu kesinɔtɔ. Ƒle awu ɣiwo, ne awu nanɔ ŋuwò, be màganɔ amama eye ŋu nakpe wò o. Eye nàƒle ŋkutike be nàsi ɖe wò ŋkuwo ne nàkpɔ nu.
ENGLISH: 17 Because you say "I am rich, my fortune is made, I am in no want of anything, " and do not know that you are the very one who is wretched and pitiable and poor and blind and naked, 18 I advise you to buy of me fire-refined gold so that you may be rich, and white clothes so that you may be clad and the shame of your nakedness not be exposed, and eye-salve to put on your eyes so that you may see.

EWE: 19 "‘Ame siwo katã gbɔ nyemelɔ̃a nu le o la, mekaa mo na wo, eye mehea to na wo.
ENGLISH: 19 As many as I love I reprove and discipline; so be jealous and repent.

EWE: Eya ta do vevie nu eye nàtrɔ dzi me. 20 Kpɔ ɖa! Mele tsitre ɖe ʋɔtrua nu le ʋɔa ƒom. Ne ame aɖe se nye gbe, eye wòʋu ʋɔa la, mage ɖe eƒe aƒe me, eye maɖu fiẽnuɖuɖu kplii, eye eya hã aɖui kplim.
ENGLISH: 20 Here I am standing at the door and knocking: if one hears my voice and opens the door I will come in to him and have supper with him, and he with me.

EWE: 21 Ame si ɖu dzi la, maɖe mɔ nɛ wòabɔbɔ anɔ nye fiazikpui la dzi kplim, abe ale si nye hã meɖu dzi, eye mebɔbɔ nɔ Fofonye ƒe fiazikpui dzi kplii ene.
ENGLISH: 21 To the victor I will give a seat with me on my throne, as I too won the victory and took the seat with my Father on his throne.

EWE: 22 Ame si to li na la nese nya si gblɔm gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo.’ "
ENGLISH: 22 Let him who has an ear hear what it is that the Spirit is saying to the churches.’ "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 4 Le nu sia megbe la, kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ ʋɔtru aɖe le ʋuʋu le dziƒo, eye gbe gbãtɔ si mese la le abe kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi ene, eye wògblɔ nam be: "Va dzi afii, ne mafia nu siwo ava dzɔ la wò. " 2 Le esia megbe la, Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ va dzinye enumake, eye kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ fiazikpui aɖe le dziƒo, eye ame aɖe bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi. 3 Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la ƒe dzedzeme le abe yaspis-kpe kple sardis-kpe ene, eye anyieʋɔ si le abe emerald-kpe ene la ƒo xlã fiazikpui la.
ENGLISH: 4 After this I saw, and there in the sky was an opened door; and the first voice that I had heard, as if of a trumpet talking with me, saying "Come up here and I will show you what must take place after this. " 2 At once I was in the spirit, and there a throne stood in heaven, and on the throne one was sitting; 3 and he who was sitting there was in aspect like a jaspid stone and a sard; and a rainbow around the throne, in aspect like an emerald.

EWE: 4 Eye fiazikpui blaeve vɔ ene ƒo xlã fiazikpui la, eye mekpɔ ametsitsi blaeve vɔ ene wobɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui siawo dzi, wodo awu ʋlaya ɣiwo, eye sikafiakukuwo le ta na wo.
ENGLISH: 4 And around the throne twenty-four thrones, and sitting on the thrones twenty-four aged men clad in white clothes, and on their heads golden wreaths.

EWE: 8 Eye aʋala ade li na nu gbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe; ŋkuwo yɔ aʋalawo ŋuti kple wo me fũu. Eye wole gbɔgblɔm madzudzɔmadzudzɔe zã kple keli be: "Kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe nye Yehowa Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, ame si nɔ anyi, eye wòli, eye wògbɔna. " 9 Ɣesiaɣi si nu gbagbeawo tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe, bubu kple akpedada na Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi, Ame si le agbe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me la, 10 ametsitsi blaeve vɔ eneawo tsyɔa mo anyi ɖe Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la ŋkume, eye wodea ta agu na Ame si le agbe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me la, eye wotsɔa woƒe fiakukuawo dana ɖe fiazikpuia ŋgɔ henɔa gbɔgblɔm be: 11 "Yehowa, mía Mawu, wòe dze be nàxɔ ŋutikɔkɔe, bubu kple ŋusẽ, elabena wòe wɔ nuwo katã, eye wò lɔlɔ̃nu ta woli, eye wowɔ wo ɖo. "
ENGLISH: 5 And out of the throne go lightnings and noises and thunderclaps; and there are seven torches of fire burning before the throne, which are the Seven Spirits of God; 6 and before the throne is what seems as if it were a sea of glass, like crystal; and in the middle of the throne and round about the throne four creatures full of eyes before and behind, 7 the first creature being like a lion and the second creature like a steer, and the third creature with a face like a man’s, and the fourth creature like a flying eagle, 8 and all four creatures with six wings apiece; they are full of eyes all around and inward, and they have no rest day and night saying "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, the one who Is and Was and Is Coming. " 9 And when the creatures give glory and honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne, him who lives forever and ever, 10 the twenty-four aged men will throw themselves down before him who sits on the throne and do reverence to him who lives forever and ever, and drop their wreaths before the throne saying 11 "Worthy art thou, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, because thou didst create all things, and at thy will they were and were created. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: Woŋlɔ nu ɖe agbalẽa me kple egodo siaa, eye wotsɔ nutrenu adre tre enu sesĩe. 2 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla sesẽ aɖe le gbeƒã ɖem kple gbe gã aɖe be: "Ame kae dze aɖe nutrenuawo ɖa ahaʋu agbalẽ xatsaxatsa la? " 3 Gake ame aɖeke menɔ dziƒo alo anyigba dzi alo anyigba te, si te ŋu ʋu agbalẽ la alo kpɔ eme o.
ENGLISH: 5 And I saw lying in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a book written on the inside and on the back, sealed up with seven seals; 2 and I saw a strong angel making proclamation in a loud voice "Who is worthy to open the book and break its seals? " 3 and nobody in heaven nor on earth nor under the earth could open the book or look at it.

EWE: 4 Eye mefa avi ʋuu, elabena womekpɔ ame aɖeke si dze aʋu agbalẽ la alo akpɔ eme o.
ENGLISH: 4 And I wept much because nobody worthy to open the book or look at it was found.

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa! Dzata si tso Yuda-toa me, ame si nye David ƒe kè la, ɖu dzi, eya ta ate ŋu aɖe nutrenu adreawo ɖa, eye wòaʋu agbalẽ la. " 6 Eye le fiazikpui la kple nu gbagbe eneawo titina kple ametsitsiawo titina la, mekpɔ alẽvi aɖe le tsitre ɖi, edze abe ɖe wowui kpɔ ene, eye dzo adre kple ŋku adre li nɛ; ŋku siawo tsi tsitre ɖi na Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adre siwo wodɔ ɖo ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi. 7 Enumake alẽvi la va xɔ agbalẽ la le Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la ƒe nuɖusi me.
ENGLISH: 5 And one of the aged men said to me "Do not weep; here, the Lion out of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has won the day to open the book and its seven seals. " 6 And in the middle of the throne and the four creatures, and in the middle of the aged men, I saw standing a lamb looking as if it had been slaughtered, with seven heads and seven eyes, which are God’s Seven Spirits sent out into all the earth; 7 and it came, and it took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

EWE: 8 Esi wòxɔ agbalẽa la, nu gbagbe eneawo kple ametsitsi blaeve vɔ eneawo tsyɔ mo anyi ɖe Alẽvi la ŋkume, eye saŋku kple sikakplu siwo yɔ fũu kple dzudzɔdonu ʋeʋĩ la le ametsitsiawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe si.
ENGLISH: 8 And when it took the book the four creatures and the twenty-four aged men threw themselves down before the lamb, having each one a harp, and golden saucers full of incense which are the prayers of God’s people.

EWE: (Dzudzɔdonu ʋeʋĩ la le tsitre ɖi na ame kɔkɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖawo.) 9 Eye wodzi ha yeye le gbɔgblɔm be: "Wòe dze be nàxɔ agbalẽa, eye nàɖe eƒe nutrenuawo ɖa, elabena wowu wò, eye nètsɔ wò ʋu ƒle amewo tso to sia to kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kple ame ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe kple dukɔ sia dukɔ me na Mawu, 10 eye nèwɔ wo wonye fiaɖuƒe kple nunɔlawo na mía Mawu la, eye woaɖu fia ɖe anyigba la dzi. " 11 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla gbogbo aɖewo ƒo xlã fiazikpui la kple nu gbagbeawo kpakple ametsitsiawo, eye mese woƒe gbe, eye woƒe xexlẽme nye akpe ewo teƒe akpe ewowo kpakple akpe teƒe akpewo, 12 eye wole gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã aɖe be: "Alẽvi si wowu la dze, be wòaxɔ ŋusẽ kple kesinɔnu, nunya, ŋutete, bubu, ŋutikɔkɔe kple kafukafu. " 13 Eye mese nuwɔwɔ ɖe sia ɖe si le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi kple anyigba te kple atsiaƒu dzi, kpakple nu siwo katã le wo me la le gbɔgblɔm be: "Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi kple Alẽvi la tɔ nanye kafukafu, bubu, ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. " 14 Eye nu gbagbe eneawo gblɔ be: "Amen! " Eye ametsitsiawo tsyɔ mo anyi hede ta agu.
ENGLISH: 9 And they sing a new song, "Worthy you are to take the book and open its seals, because you were slaughtered and bought men for God with your blood out of every tribe and language and people and race, 10 and made them a kingdom and priests for our God, and they shall reign on the earth. " 11 And I saw and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the creatures and the aged men; and their number was thousands of thousands and millions of millions, 12 saying in a loud voice "Worthy is the slaughtered lamb to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing. " 13 And every created thing that there is in the heavens and on the earth and under the earth and over the sea, and everything in them, I heard saying "To him who sits on the throne, and to the lamb, belong blessing and honor and glory and might forever and ever. " 14 And the four creatures said "Amen "; and the aged men threw themselves down and did reverence.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 6 Esi mekpɔ Alẽvi la wòɖe nutrenu adreawo dometɔ ɖeka ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ kple gbe si le abe dziɖegbe ene be: "Va! " 2 Eye kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ ɣi aɖe, eye ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la lé dati ɖe asi, eye wotsɔ fiakuku nɛ, eye wòdo go yi ɖale aʋa dzi ɖum be yeawu yeƒe aʋadziɖuɖu la nu.
ENGLISH: 6 And I saw when the lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four creatures say in a voice that sounded like a clap of thunder "Come! " 2 And I saw, and there was a white horse with a rider that had a bow and was given a wreath and went out victorious and to win victories.

EWE: 3 Esi wòɖe nutrenu evelia ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe evelia gblɔ be: "Va! " 4 Eye sɔ bubu aɖe do, ebiã hɛ̃, eye woɖe mɔ na ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la be wòaɖe ŋutifafa ɖa le anyigba dzi, ne amewo nawu wo nɔewo, eye wotsɔ yi gã aɖe nɛ.
ENGLISH: 3 And when he opened the second seal I heard the second creature say "Come! " 4 and another horse went out, a red one, with a rider to whom it was given to take peace from earth and that they should slaughter each other; and he was given a great sword.

EWE: 5 Esi wòɖe nutrenu etɔ̃lia ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe etɔ̃lia gblɔ be: "Va! "
ENGLISH: 5 And when he opened the third seal I heard the third creature say "Come! "

EWE: Eye kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ yibɔ aɖe, eye ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la lé nudanu ɖe asi. 6 Mese gbe aɖe abe nu gbagbe eneawo domee wòɖi le ene gblɔ be: "Lu kuart ɖeka naxɔ denario ɖeka, eye ƒo kuart etɔ̃ naxɔ denario ɖeka; eye mègawɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke ami kple wain o. "
ENGLISH: And I saw, and there was a black horse with a rider that had a balance in his hand; 6 and I heard what seemed to be a voice among the four creatures say "A quart of wheat for a shilling and three quarts of barley for a shilling; and do not injure the oil and the wine. "

EWE: 7 Esi wòɖe nutrenu enelia ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe enelia ƒe gbe wògblɔ be: "Va! " 8 Eye kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ aɖe si fu kpii, eye ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la ŋkɔe nye Ku. Eye Tsiẽƒe le eyome tututu. Eye wona ŋusẽ wo ɖe anyigba ƒe akpa enelia dzi, be woatsɔ yi legbe, dɔwuame, dɔvɔ̃ wuame kple anyigbadzilã wɔadãwo awu amewoe.
ENGLISH: 7 And when he opened the fourth seal I heard the voice of the fourth creature saying "Come! " 8 And I saw, and there was an ashy horse with a rider whose name was Death, and the Grave followed with him, and they were given dominion over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword and by starvation and by epidemics and by the beasts of the earth.

EWE: 9 Esi wòɖe nutrenu atɔ̃lia ɖa la, mekpɔ ame siwo wowu le Mawu ƒe nya la kple ɖase si woɖina ta la ƒe luʋɔwo le vɔsamlekpui la te.
ENGLISH: 9 And when he opened the fifth seal I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been slaughtered because of the word of God and of the testimony that they had.

EWE: 10 Eye wodo ɣli kple gbe gã aɖe le gbɔgblɔm be: "Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã, kɔkɔetɔ kple nyateƒetɔ, ɣekaɣie nàdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigbadzinɔlawo ahabia hlɔ̃ wo ɖe míaƒe ʋu ta? " 11 Eye wona awu ʋlaya ɣi wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe; eye wogblɔ na wo be woalala vie, va se ɖe esime wo hati kluviwo kple wo nɔvi siwo wu ge woala abe ale si wowu woawo hã ene la ƒe xexlẽme nade.
ENGLISH: 10 And they cried out loudly "How long will it be, holy and true Master, before thou wilt do justice and avenge our blood upon those who live on earth? " 11 and they were each given a white robe, and were told to rest a little while longer till the number of their fellow-servants and their brothers, who were to be killed the same as they had been, should also be completed.

EWE: 14 Eye dziƒo bú abe agbalẽ aɖe si woŋlɔ́ ene, eye woɖe to sia to kple ƒukpo sia ƒukpo ɖa le wo teƒe. 15 Eye anyigbadzifiawo, dziɖuɖumegãwo, aʋafiagãwo, kesinɔtɔwo, ŋusẽtɔwo, kluviwo kple ablɔɖemewo katã ɣla wo ɖokuiwo ɖe agadowo me kple towo ƒe agakpewo dome. 16 Eye wole gbɔgblɔm na toawo kple agakpeawo be: "Mimu dze mía dzi, eye miɣla mí tso Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la ŋkume, kple Alẽvi la ƒe dziku la nu, 17 elabena woƒe dzikuŋkeke gã la ɖo, eye ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe enu? "
ENGLISH: 12 And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like haircloth, and the whole moon became like blood, 13 and the stars of the sky fell to the earth as a fig-tree shaken by a great wind throws off its green fruit, 14 and the sky broke away like a sheet of paper rolling up, and every mountain and island were moved out of their places; 15 and the kings of the earth and the magnates and the generals and the rich and the strong and every slave and freeman hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains, 16 and kept saying to the mountains and to the rocks "Fall on us and cover us away from him who sits on the throne and from the lamb’s anger, 17 because the great day of their anger has come, and who can stand? "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 7 Le esia megbe la, mekpɔ mawudɔla ene wole tsitre ɖe anyigba ƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi, eye wolé anyigba ƒe ya eneawo ɖe asi goŋgoŋ, ale be ya aɖeke nagaƒo ɖe anyigba dzi alo ɖe atsiaƒu dzi alo ɖe ati aɖeke dzi o. 2 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu aɖe wòdo tso ɣedzeƒe le dzi yim, eye Mawu gbagbe la ƒe nutrenu aɖe le esi; eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe gã aɖe ɖo ɖe mawudɔla ene siwo wona ŋusẽ be woawɔ vɔ̃ anyigba kple atsiaƒu la, 3 le gbɔgblɔm be: "Migawɔ vɔ̃ anyigba alo atsiaƒu alo atiawo o, va se ɖe esime míetre mía Mawu ƒe kluviwo ƒe ŋgonu vɔ hafi. " 4 Eye mese ame siwo nu wotre la ƒe xexlẽme, wotre ame akpe alafa ɖeka blaene vɔ ene nu le Israel-viwo ƒe toawo katã me: 5 Le Yuda-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Ruben-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Gad-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; 6 le Aser-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Naftali-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Manase-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; 7 le Simeon-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Lewi-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Isakar-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; 8 le Zebulon-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu; le Yosef-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu;
ENGLISH: 7 After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth holding the four winds of the earth, that no wind might blow over the land nor over the sea nor on any tree; 2 and I saw another angel coming up from the eastern horizon with the seal of the living God, and he cried out loudly to the four angels to whom it was given to injure the land and the sea 3 "Do not injure the land nor the sea nor the trees till we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads. " 4 And I heard the number of the sealed, a hundred and forty-four thousand sealed out of every tribe of the sons of Israel: 5 out of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand sealed, out of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand, 6 out of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand, 7 out of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand, 8 out of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, out of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand sealed.

EWE: le Benyamin-toa me la, wotre ame akpe wuieve nu. 9 Le nu sia megbe la mekpɔ, eye kpɔ ɖa, ameha gã aɖe si ame aɖeke mete ŋu xlẽ o la, tso dukɔ sia dukɔ, to sia to, ame ƒomeviwo katã kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ me, le tsitre ɖe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ kple Alẽvi la ŋkume, wodo awu ʋlaya ɣiwo, eye wolé deʋayawo ɖe asi. 10 Eye wole ɣli dom kple gbe gã aɖe le gbɔgblɔm be: "Míaƒe xɔname tso mía Mawu, ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi kple Alẽvi la gbɔ. " 11 Eye mawudɔlawo katã le tsitre ƒo xlã fiazikpui la kple ametsitsiawo kpakple nu gbagbe eneawo, eye wotsyɔ mo anyi ɖe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ hede ta agu na Mawu, 12 le gbɔgblɔm be: "Amen!
ENGLISH: 9 After this I saw, and there was a great crowd, that no one could count, out of every race and tribe and people and language, standing before the throne and before the lamb, clad in white robes and with palms in their hands, 10 and they cried loudly "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne and to the lamb. " 11 And all the angels stood round about the throne and the aged men and the four creatures, and threw themselves down on their faces before the throne and did reverence to God, 12 saying "Amen, blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength belong to our God forever and ever; amen. " 13 And one of the aged men answered by saying to me "Who are these that are clad in the white robes, and where did they come from? " 14 Said I to him, "Sir, you know. "

EWE: Mía Mawu la tɔ nanye kafukafu, ŋutikɔkɔe, nunya, akpedada, bubu, ŋusẽ kple ŋutete tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen. "
ENGLISH: And he said to me "These are the ones who come from the great distress, and who washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the lamb.

EWE: Eye wògblɔ nam be: "Ame siawoe nye ame siwo do go tso xaxa gã la me, eye wonya woƒe awu ʋlayawo, eye wowɔ wo ɣie le Alẽvi la ƒe ʋu la me. 15 Esia tae wole Mawu ƒe fiazikpuia ŋgɔ ɖo, eye wole subɔsubɔdɔ kɔkɔe wɔm nɛ zã kple keli le eƒe gbedoxɔ la me; eye Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la akeke eƒe agbadɔ la ɖe wo dzi. 16 Dɔ magawu wo azɔ o, eye tsikɔ hã magawu wo azɔ o, ɣe kple ŋdɔkutsu magaɖu wo o, 17 elabena Alẽvi si le fiazikpuia gbɔ la, akplɔ wo, eye wòafia mɔ wo ayi agbetsidzidziwo gbɔ. Eye Mawu atutu aɖatsi sia aɖatsi ɖa le woƒe ŋkume. "
ENGLISH: 15 This is why they are before God’s throne and worship him day and night in his temple, and he who sits on the throne will spread his presence over them; 16 they will hunger no more and thirst no more, nor shall the sun strike upon them, nor any heat, 17 because the lamb in the center of the throne will take care of them and guide them to springs of waters of life; and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 8 Esi wòɖe nutrenu adrelia ɖa la, ɖoɖoe zi le dziƒo anɔ abe gaƒoƒo afã ene.
ENGLISH: 8 And when he opened the seventh seal there came a silence in heaven for a half-hour.

EWE: 2 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla adre siwo le tsitre ɖe Mawu ŋkume la, eye wotsɔ kpẽ adre na wo.
ENGLISH: 2 And I saw the seven angels who stand before God; and they were given seven trumpets.

EWE: 3 Mawudɔla bubu aɖe si lé sikadzudzɔdosonu ɖe asi la va tsi tsitre ɖe vɔsamlekpui la xa, eye wotsɔ dzudzɔdonu ʋeʋĩ gbogbo aɖe nɛ be wòado dzudzɔ ɖe sikavɔsamlekpui si le fiazikpuia ŋgɔ la dzi esi wose ame kɔkɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖawo.
ENGLISH: 3 And another angel came and took his stand on the altar with a golden censer, and was given much incense to use for the prayers of all God’s people on the golden altar before the throne; 4 and the smoke of the incense went up before God out of the angel’s hand for the prayers of God’s people.

EWE: 4 Eye dzudzɔdonu ʋeʋĩ si le mawudɔla la si me ƒe dzudzɔ kple ame kɔkɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖawo de dzi le Mawu ŋkume. 5 Ke mawudɔla la tsɔ dzudzɔdosonu la enumake, eye wòɖe dzo le vɔsamlekpuia me de eme wòyɔ, eye wòtsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 And the angel took the censer, and he filled it with fire off the altar and threw it on the earth, and there came thunderclaps and noises and lightnings and an earthquake; 6 and the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared to blow.

EWE: 6 Eye mawudɔla adre, siwo si kpẽ adreawo le la, dzra ɖo be yewoaku kpẽawo. 7 Mawudɔla gbãtɔ ku eƒe kpẽ la. Eye kpetsi kple dzo kpakple ʋu tsaka dza ɖe anyigba dzi; eye anyigba ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia fiã, eye atiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia fiã, eye gbe mumuwo katã fiã. 8 Mawudɔla evelia ku eƒe kpẽ la.
ENGLISH: 7 And the first blew, and there was hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was thrown on the earth; and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green herbage was burned up.

EWE: Eye wotsɔ nane si le abe to gã aɖe si le bibim ene la ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu me. Ale atsiaƒu ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia trɔ zu ʋu; 9 eye nu gbagbe siwo le atsiaƒu me la ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia ku, eye tɔdziʋuwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia gbã.
ENGLISH: 8 And the second angel blew, and what seemed like a great mountain on fire was thrown into the sea; 9 and a third of the sea turned to blood, and a third of the live creatures in the sea died, and a third of the shipping was wrecked.

EWE: 10 Mawudɔla etɔ̃lia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Eye ɣletivi gã aɖe si le bibim abe akaɖi ene la ge tso dziƒo, eye wòge dze tɔsisiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia me kple tsidzɔƒewo. 11 Woyɔa ɣletivi la be Gbe Veve.
ENGLISH: 10 And the third angel blew, and there fell out of the sky a great star blazing like a torch; and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water; 11 and the star was named Wormwood.

EWE: Eye tsiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia le vevem abe atsa ene, eye tsiawo wu ame geɖewo, elabena tsiawo le vevem.
ENGLISH: And a third of the waters turned to wormwood, and many of the men died of the waters because they were turned bitter.

EWE: 12 Mawudɔla enelia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Eye woƒo ɣe ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple ɣleti ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kpakple ɣletiviwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia, ne woƒe akpa etɔ̃lia nado viviti, eye ŋkeke ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia nagakpɔ kekeli o, eye zã hã nenema ke.
ENGLISH: 12 And the fourth angel blew, and a third of the sun was blasted and a third of the moon and a third of the stars, so that a third of them should be darkened and the day should not be light for a third of it, and likewise the night.

EWE: 13 Mekpɔ hɔ̃ aɖe wòle dzodzom le yame ʋĩi, eye mese wògblɔ kple gbe gã aɖe be: "Baba, baba, baba na anyigbadzinɔlawo le kpẽ susɔe siwo mawudɔla etɔ̃awo le kuku ge la ta! "
ENGLISH: 13 And I saw, and I heard an eagle flying in the zenith say loudly "Woe, woe, woe to those who live on the earth, from the remaining trumpet-notes of the three angels that are to blow. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 9 Mawudɔla atɔ̃lia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Eye mekpɔ ɣletivi aɖe ge tso dziƒo va dze anyigba, eye wotsɔ aʋlimesafui la nɛ.
ENGLISH: 9 And the fifth angel blew, and I saw a star from the sky fallen to the earth, and it was given the key to the well of the abyss.

EWE: 2 Eye wòʋu aʋli la nu, eye dzudzɔ tu tso eme abe kpodzo gã aɖe me dzudzɔ ene, eye dzudzɔ la na ɣe do viviti, yame hã do viviti.
ENGLISH: 2 And it opened the well of the abyss, and smoke came up out of the well like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the well.

EWE: 3 Eye ʋetsuviwo do tso dzudzɔ la me va anyigba la dzi, eye wona ŋusẽ wo, abe ŋusẽ si tɔgbi le dziɖegbe siwo le anyigba dzi la si ene. 4 Eye wogblɔ na wo be woagawɔ vɔ̃ anyigbadzinu miemie, gbe mumu, alo ati aɖeke o, negbe ame siwo Mawu ƒe nutrenu mele ŋgonu na o la ko. 5 Womeɖe mɔ na ʋetsuviawo be woawu wo o, ke boŋ be woawɔ fu wo vevie ɣleti atɔ̃, eye fu si wowɔ wo la le abe veve si ame sena ne dziɖegbe tee ene. 6 Eye le ŋkeke mawo me la, amewo adi ku, ke womakpɔe akpɔ o, eye adzro wo vevie be yewoaku, gake ku asi le wo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 3 And out of the smoke grasshoppers came out upon the ground, and they were given such powers as the scorpions on the ground have, 4 and were told not to injure the grass of the earth nor any green thing nor any tree, anything but the men who do not have God’s seal on their foreheads; 5 and it was given to them not to kill them, but that they should be tortured five months (and their torture was like the torture of a scorpion when it strikes a man), 6 and in those days men should look for death and not find it, and should desire to die and death should be fleeing away from them.

EWE: 7 Ʋetsuviawo ƒe dzedzeme le abe sɔ siwo wobla akpa na hena aʋawɔwɔ ene; eye nane le ta na wo abe sikafiakukuwo ene, eye woƒe mo le abe amegbetɔwo ƒe mo ene, 8 ke woƒe ɖa le abe nyɔnuwo ƒe ɖa ene. Woƒe aɖuwo le abe dzatawo tɔ ene, 9 eye woƒe akɔtakpoxɔnuwo le abe gayibɔkɔtakpoxɔnuwo ene. Eye woƒe aʋalawo le ɖiɖim abe tasiaɖam siwo sɔwo le hehem yina aʋa la ƒe ɖiɖi ene.
ENGLISH: 7 And the semblance of the grasshoppers was like horses prepared for war; and on their heads were what seemed to be wreaths like gold, and their faces were like faces of human beings, 8 and they had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions, 9 and they had coats of armor like iron armor, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of many-horsed chariots galloping to war.

EWE: 10 Eye asike kple ti le wo si abe dziɖegbewo tɔ ene, eye woƒe asikewo mee woƒe ŋusẽ le be woawɔ nu vevi ameawo ɣleti atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 10 And they have tails like scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to injure men five months.

EWE: 11 Fia le wo nu, eyae nye mawudɔla si le aʋli la nu. Woyɔnɛ le Hebrigbe me be Abadon, ke woyɔnɛ le Helagbe me be Apolion.
ENGLISH: 11 They have over them a king, the angel of the abyss; his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek language he bears the name Apollyon.

EWE: 12 Fuwɔame ɖeka nu va yi. Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 12 The one Woe has gone; two more Woes are coming after.

EWE: Fuwɔame eve bubu ava ɖe nu siawo yome. 13 Mawudɔla adelia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Eye mese gbe aɖe tso sikavɔsamlekpui si le Mawu ŋkume la ƒe dzowo me, 14 wògblɔ na mawudɔla adelia si si kpẽ le la be: "Tu ka mawudɔla ene siwo wobla ɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la to. " 15 Eye wotu ka mawudɔla eneawo, siwo le dzadzraɖoɖi na gaƒoƒo la, ŋkeke la, ɣleti la kple ƒe la, be woawu amewo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia.
ENGLISH: 13 And the sixth angel blew, and I heard one voice from the horns of the golden altar before God, 14 saying to the sixth angel, the one who had the trumpet, "Unchain the four angels that are chained at the great river Euphrates. " 15 And the four angels that were kept in readiness for the hour and day and month and year, to kill a third of mankind, were unchained.

EWE: 16 Eye sɔdolawo ƒe aʋakɔ la ƒe xexlẽme le akpe blaeve teƒe akpe ewo: Mese woƒe xexlẽme.
ENGLISH: 16 And the number of the armies of cavalry was two hundred million; I heard their number.

EWE: 17 Ale si mekpɔ sɔawo kple ame siwo bɔbɔ nɔ wo dzi le ŋutega me lae nye esi: Akɔtakpoxɔnu siwo biã abe dzo ene, siwo le blɔ, eye wole abe dzokpe ene la, le wo si, eye sɔawo ƒe ta le abe dzatawo ƒe ta ene, eye dzo, dzudzɔ kple dzokpe do tso woƒe nu me.
ENGLISH: 17 And in my vision I saw the horses and their riders like this, with fire-colored and violet and sulfur-colored coats of armor; and the horses’ heads like lions’ heads, and out of their mouths went fire and smoke and sulfur-fumes.

EWE: 18 Wotsɔ fuwɔame etɔ̃ siawo siwo nye dzo kple dzudzɔ kpakple dzokpe si do tso woƒe nu me la wu amewo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia. 19 Elabena sɔawo ƒe ŋusẽ le woƒe nuwo kple woƒe asikewo me, elabena woƒe asikewo le abe dawo ene, eye ta li na wo, eye esiawoe wotsɔna wɔa vɔ̃ amewoe.
ENGLISH: 18 By these three scourges a third of men were killed, by the fire and the smoke and the sulfur-fumes that went out of their mouths; 19 for the powers of the horses are in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails are like snakes, with heads, and with them they do injury.

EWE: 20 Ke ame susɔe siwo fuwɔame siawo mewu o la metrɔ dzi me tso woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo me o; womedzudzɔ tadede agu na gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo, kple legba siwo wotsɔ sika, klosalo, akɔbli, kpe kple ati wɔ, siwo metea ŋu kpɔa nu alo sea nu alo zɔa azɔli o la o. 21 Eye wometrɔ dzi me tso woƒe amewuwu, woƒe gbɔgbɔyɔyɔ, woƒe gbɔdɔdɔ manɔsenu kple woƒe fififi me o.
ENGLISH: 20 And the rest of mankind, those who were not killed with these scourges, did not even repent of the deeds of their hands, not to do reverence to demons and to golden and silver and bronze and stone and wooden idols that can neither see nor hear nor walk, 21 and did not repent of their murders nor of their witchcraft nor of their unchastity nor of their thefts.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 10 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla sesẽ bubu aɖe wòle ɖiɖim tso dziƒo, edo alilikpo, anyieʋɔ le ta nɛ, eƒe mo le abe ɣe ene, eƒe afɔwo le abe dzosɔtiwo ene, 2 eye agbalẽ sue aɖe si woʋu la le esi.
ENGLISH: 10 And I saw another angel, a strong one, come down out of the sky, wrapped in a cloud, the rainbow on his head and his face like the sun and his legs like pillars of fire, 2 and with a little open book in his hand; and he set his right foot on the sea and his left on the land, and cried out loudly, as a lion roars.

EWE: Etsɔ eƒe ɖusifɔ ɖo atsiaƒu dzi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe miafɔ ya ɖo anyigba dzi, 3 eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ aɖe abe dzata ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene.
ENGLISH: 3 And when he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their peals.

EWE: Esi wòdo ɣli la, dziɖegbe adreawo ƒo nu. 4 Esi dziɖegbe adreawo ƒo nu la, medi be maŋlɔe; gake mese gbe aɖe tso dziƒo gblɔ be: "Tre nya siwo dziɖegbe adreawo gblɔ la nu, eye mègaŋlɔ wo o. " 5 Eye mawudɔla si mekpɔ wòle tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu kple anyigba dzi la do eƒe nuɖusi ɖe dziƒo, 6 eye wòtà Ame si le agbe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me, ame si wɔ dziƒo kple emenuwo, anyigba kple edzinuwo, kpakple atsiaƒu kple emenuwo la be: "Womagahe ɖe megbe azɔ o. 7 Ke le ŋkeke siwo me mawudɔla adrelia aku eƒe kpẽa la, nya ɣaɣla kɔkɔe, si nye nya nyui si Mawu gblɔ na eya ŋutɔ ƒe kluvi nyagblɔɖilawo la ava eme. "
ENGLISH: 4 And when the seven thunders spoke, I was going to write, and I heard a voice out of the sky say "Seal up what the seven thunders spoke and do not write it. " 5 And the angel that I saw standing on the sea and the land lifted his right hand to the sky 6 and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created the heavens and what is in them and the earth and what is in it and the sea and what is in it, that there should be no more delay, 7 but in the days of the blast of the seventh angel, when he was to sound, God’s secret plan as he had communicated it to his servants the prophets would be all done.

EWE: 8 Eye gbe si mese tso dziƒo la gaƒo nu kplim gblɔ be: "Heyi, xɔ agbalẽ si le ʋuʋu le mawudɔla si le tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu kple anyigba dzi la si. " 9 Eye meyi mawudɔla la gbɔ ɖagblɔ nɛ be wòatsɔ agbalẽ sue la nam. Egblɔ nam be: "Xɔe, eye nàɖui, ele veve ge le dɔ me na wò, ke avivi le nu me na wò abe anyitsi ene. " 10 Eye mexɔ agbalẽ sue la le mawudɔla la si ɖu, eye wòvivi le nye nu me abe anyitsi ene, ke esi meɖui vɔ la, enɔ vevem le dɔ me nam.
ENGLISH: 8 And the voice that I had heard out of the sky I heard speaking with me again and saying "Go take the open book in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and the land. " 9 And I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book; and he said to me "Take it and eat it up, and it shall turn your stomach bitter; but in your mouth it shall be as sweet as honey. " 10 And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand and ate it up, and it was like sweet honey in my mouth; and when I had eaten it my stomach turned bitter.

EWE: 11 Eye wogblɔ nam be: "Ele be nàgagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe amewo kple dukɔwo kple gbegbɔgblɔwo kpakple fia geɖewo ŋuti. "
ENGLISH: 11 And they said to me "You must prophesy again over many peoples and races and languages and kings. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 11 Eye wotsɔ aɖa aɖe si le abe atizɔti ene la de asi nam hegblɔ be: "Tso nàdzidze Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔa ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la kple vɔsamlekpui la kpakple ame siwo dea ta agu le eme la.
ENGLISH: 11 And I was given a reed like a staff, with the words "Rise and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

EWE: 2 Gake ɖe xɔxɔnu si le gbedoxɔa ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la godo ya le eme, mègadzidzee o, elabena wotsɔe na dukɔwo, eye woafanya du kɔkɔe la ɣleti blaene vɔ eve.
ENGLISH: 2 And exclude the court outside the temple, and do not measure it; because it is given to the nations, and they shall tread the sacred city underfoot forty-two months.

EWE: 3 Eye mana nye ɖasefo eveawo nanɔ akpanya me agblɔ nya ɖi ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve blaade. " 4 Ame siawoe amiti eveawo kple akaɖiti eveawo le tsitre ɖi na, eye wole tsitre ɖe anyigba ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 3 And I will give to my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy twelve hundred and sixty days, clad in sackcloth. 4 These are the two olive-trees, and the two lampstands, that stand before the Lord of the Earth.

EWE: 5 Ne ame aɖe di be yeawɔ nu vevi wo la, dzo dona tso woƒe nu me fiãa woƒe futɔwo. Ne ame aɖe adi be yeawɔ nu vevi wo la, woawu eya hã nenema ke.
ENGLISH: And if one intends to injure them fire goes out of their mouths and consumes their enemies: 5 anyone who intends to injure them must be killed in this way.

EWE: 6 Ŋusẽ le ame siawo si be woatu dziƒo nu, ale be tsi nagadza le ŋkeke siwo me wole nya gblɔm ɖi la me o, ŋusẽ le wo si hã be woatrɔ tsiwo woazu ʋu, eye woahe fuwɔame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ava anyigba la dzi zi gbɔ zi geɖe ale si wolɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 6 These have authority to shut the sky, that rain may not fall during the days of their prophesying, and have authority over the waters to convert them into blood, and to smite the earth with every scourge as often as they wish.

EWE: 7 Ne wowu woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la nu la, lã wɔadã si do tso aʋli me la awɔ aʋa kpli wo, eye wòaɖu wo dzi ahawu wo. 8 Woƒe kukuawo anɔ du gã, si woyɔ le lododo me be Sodom kple Egipte, afi si wohe woƒe Aƒetɔ hã ɖe ati ŋu le la, ƒe mɔdodo gã la dzi. 9 Eye ame ƒomeviwo, towo kple gbegbɔgblɔwo kple dukɔwo me tɔwo akpɔ woƒe kukuawo ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã, eye womaɖe mɔ be woaɖi wo o.
ENGLISH: 7 And when they have finished their testimony the beast that comes up out of the abyss shall make war with them and defeat them and kill them; 8 and their corpses lie in the main street of the great city that is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, the same where their Lord was crucified; 9 and men of the peoples and tribes and languages and races look at their corpses three and a half days, and will not let their corpses be put in a tomb; 10 and those who live on the earth rejoice over them and jubilate, and shall send presents to each other, because these two prophets had tortured those who live on the earth. " 11 And after the three and a half days a spirit of life from God came into them, and they stood up on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.

EWE: 10 Eye anyigbadzinɔlawo kpɔ dzidzɔ hetso aseye le woƒe kua ŋuti, eye woɖo nunana ɖe wo nɔewo, elabena nyagblɔɖila eve siawo wɔ fu wo ŋutɔ. 11 Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã la megbe la, agbegbɔgbɔ tso Mawu gbɔ ge ɖe wo me, eye wotso ɖe woƒe afɔwo dzi, ale vɔvɔ̃ gã aɖe ɖo ame siwo kpɔ wo la. 12 Eye wose gbe gã aɖe tso dziƒo wògblɔ na wo be: "Miva afii. " Eye wole alilikpo me yi dziƒo, eye woƒe futɔwo kpɔ wo.
ENGLISH: 12 And they heard a loud voice out of the sky say to them "Come up here "; and they went up into the sky in a cloud, and their enemies saw them; 13 and at that moment there came a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell, and there were killed in the earthquake seven thousand persons, and the rest were terror-struck and gave glory to the God of Heaven.

EWE: 14 Fuwɔame evelia nu va yi. Kpɔ ɖa! Fuwɔame etɔ̃lia gbɔna kaba.
ENGLISH: 14 The second Woe has gone; the third Woe is coming quickly.

EWE: Eye gbe gãwo ɖi le dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be: "Xexemefiaɖuƒe la trɔ zu mía Aƒetɔ kple eƒe Kristo la ƒe Fiaɖuƒe, eye aɖu fia tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. " 16 Eye ametsitsi blaeve vɔ ene siwo bɔbɔ nɔ woƒe fiazikpuiwo dzi le Mawu ŋkume la tsyɔ mo anyi, eye wode ta agu na Mawu, 17 le gbɔgblɔm be: "Míeda akpe na wò, Yehowa Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, ame si li, eye wònɔ anyi, elabena èxɔ wò ŋusẽ gã la, eye nèdze fiaɖuɖu gɔme. 18 Ke dukɔwo do dɔmedzoe, eye wò ŋutɔ nèɖe wò dziku ɖe go, eye ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖi la de be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame kukuwo, eye nàɖo eteƒe na wò kluvi nyagblɔɖilawo kple ame kɔkɔewo kpakple ame siwo vɔ̃a wò ŋkɔ la, ame tsɛwo kple ame ŋkutawo siaa, eye nàtsrɔ̃ ame siwo le anyigba la gblẽm. " 19 Eye woʋu Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ ƒe kɔkɔeƒe si le dziƒo la, eye wokpɔ eƒe nubablaɖaka la le eƒe gbedoxɔ ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la. Eye dzi ke dzo, gbeɖiɖiwo ɖi, dzi ɖe gbe, anyigba ʋuʋu, eye kpetsi gã aɖe dza.
ENGLISH: 15 And the seventh angel blew, and there came loud voices in heaven saying "The empire of the world has come to be our Lord’s and his Christ’s, and he shall reign forever and ever. " 16 And the twenty-four aged men that were sitting on their thrones before God threw themselves down on their faces and did reverence to God, 17 saying "We thank thee, Lord God Almighty, who Is and Was, because thou hast taken thy great power and begun to reign, 18 and the nations have raged, and thy wrath has come and the time for the dead to be judged, and to give their reward to thy servants the prophets and the holy and to those who fear thy name, the small and the great, and to make havoc of the havoc-makers of the earth. " 19 And the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was visible in his temple; and there came lightnings and noises and thunderclaps and an earthquake and a great storm of hail.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 12 Eyome wokpɔ dzesi gã aɖe le dziƒo: Nyɔnu aɖe do ɣe, ɣleti le eƒe afɔ te, eye fiakuku si wotsɔ ɣletivi wuieve wɔ la le eta, 2 eye fu le eƒo. Ele ku lém hele ɣli dom le veve si sem wòle la ta. 3 Wokpɔ dzesi bubu aɖe le dziƒo.
ENGLISH: 12 And a great portent appeared in the sky, a woman clad in the sun, the moon under her feet and a wreath of twelve stars on her head, 2 about to have a child; and she was screaming in her labor-pains, in the torture of giving birth.

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa, ʋɔ driba hɛ̃ gã aɖee nye esi, ta adre kple dzo ewo li nɛ, eye fiakuku adre le eƒe tawo; 4 eye eƒe asike he dziƒoɣletiviwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia, eye wòtsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba.
ENGLISH: 3 And another portent appeared in the sky: lo, a great fiery-red serpent with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads, 4 its tail dragging a third of the stars in the sky and throwing them to earth.

EWE: Eye ʋɔ driba la le tsitre ɖe nyɔnu si le vi dzi ge la ŋkume, be ne edzi via ko la, yeatsɔ ɖevia ami.
ENGLISH: And the serpent was standing before the woman who was to bear the child, in order to eat up her child when she did bear it.

EWE: 5 Eye nyɔnua dzi ŋutsuvi, ame si atsɔ gatikplɔ akplɔ dukɔwo katã. Ale wokɔ via enumake yi Mawu kple eƒe fiazikpui la gbɔ. 6 Eye nyɔnu la si yi gbedzi, afi si Mawu dzra teƒe ɖo ɖi nɛ le, eye wonyii le afi ma ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve blaade.
ENGLISH: 5 And she bore a son, a male, who is to drive all nations with an iron rod; and her child was snatched away to God and his throne; 6 and the woman fled to the desert, where she has a place prepared by God where they are to feed her twelve hundred and sixty days.

EWE: 7 Eye aʋa dzɔ le dziƒo: Mikael kple eƒe dɔlawo wɔ aʋa kple ʋɔ driba la, eye ʋɔ driba la kple eƒe dɔlawo wɔ aʋa kpli wo, 8 gake womeɖu dzi o, eye womegakpɔ teƒe aɖeke hã na wo le dziƒo o.
ENGLISH: 7 And there came a war in the sky, Michael and his angels battling with the serpent; and the serpent and its angels battled, 8 and did not succeed, nor was there any longer to be found in the sky a place for them.

EWE: 9 Eya ta wotsɔ ʋɔ driba gã, si nye da xoxo la, si woyɔna be Abosam kple Satana, ame si le anyigbadzinɔlawo katã blem la, ƒu gbe; wotsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba, eye wotsɔ eƒe dɔlawo hã ƒu gbe kpe ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 And the great serpent was thrown down, the primeval snake, he who is called the Devil and Satan, the misleader of the whole world of men thrown down to the earth, and its angels thrown down with it.

EWE: 10 Eye mese gbe gã aɖe tso dziƒo wògblɔ be: "Azɔ mía Mawu ƒe xɔname kple ŋusẽ kple Fiaɖuƒe kpakple eƒe Kristo ƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe ŋusẽ la va ɖo, elabena wotsɔ mía nɔviwo nu tsola, ame si tsoa wo nu zã kple keli le mía Mawu ŋkume la, ƒu gbe! 11 Eye woɖu edzi le Alẽvi la ƒe ʋu kple woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe nya la ta, eye esi wodze ŋgɔ ku gɔ̃ hã la, wolɔ̃ faa be yewoabu yewoƒe luʋɔ.
ENGLISH: 10 And I heard a loud voice in the sky say "Now is come our God’s salvation and power and empire, and his Christ’s dominion, because the accuser of our brothers is thrown down: he who accuses them before our God day and night, 11 and they won against him because of the Lamb’s blood and because of the word of their testimony, and did not love their lives even in the face of death.

EWE: 12 Eya ta dzi nedzɔ mi, mi dziƒowo kple mi ame siwo le wo me la! Baba na anyigba kple atsiaƒu, elabena Abosam ɖi va mia gbɔ, eye dzi le ekum vevie, elabena enyae be ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe koe susɔ na ye. "
ENGLISH: 12 Therefore jubilate, heavens and you that dwell in them! woe for the earth and the sea! because the Devil has gone down to you in a great rage, knowing that he has little time. "

EWE: 13 Ke esi ʋɔ driba la kpɔ be wotsɔ ye ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba la, eti nyɔnu si dzi ŋutsuvi la yome.
ENGLISH: 13 And when the serpent saw that it was thrown down to the earth it chased the woman that had borne the male child.

EWE: 14 Ke wotsɔ hɔ̃ gã la ƒe aʋala eveawo na nyɔnu la, ne wòadzo ayi enɔƒe le gbedzi; afi mae wonyii le ɣeyiɣi kple ɣeyiɣiwo kpakple ɣeyiɣi afã le adzɔge tso da la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 14 And the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle that she might fly to her place in the desert, where she is fed for a time and times and half a time to keep her from the snake.

EWE: 15 Eye da la tu tsi si le sisim abe tɔsisi ene tso eƒe nu me ɖo ɖe nyɔnu la yome, ne tsi la nalée. 16 Gake anyigba va xɔ na nyɔnu la, eye anyigba ke nu no tsi si ʋɔ driba la tu tso eƒe nu me la.
ENGLISH: 15 And the snake threw out of its mouth after the woman water like a river to sweep her off her feet; 16 and the earth took the woman’s part, and opened its mouth and drank up the river that the serpent threw out of its mouth.

EWE: 17 Eya ta dzi ku ʋɔ driba la ɖe nyɔnu la ŋu, eye wòdzo yi aʋa wɔ ge kple nyɔnu la ƒe dzidzimevi susɔe siwo léa Mawu ƒe sewo me ɖe asi, eye wode dɔ asi na wo be woaɖi ɖase le Yesu ŋuti la.
ENGLISH: 17 And the serpent was angry with the woman, and went off to make war on the rest of her issue, that keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus; and it planted itself on the sand of the sea.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 13 Eye ʋɔ driba la tɔ ɖe ƒutake la dzi. Eyome mekpɔ lã wɔadã aɖe wòle dodom tso atsiaƒu me, dzo ewo kple ta adre li nɛ, fiakuku ewo le eƒe dzoawo dzi, eye busuŋkɔwo le eƒe taawo ŋu. 2 Lã wɔadã si mekpɔ la le abe lãklẽ ene, gake eƒe afɔwo le abe sisiblisi tɔwo ene, eye eƒe nu le abe dzata ƒe nu ene. Eye ʋɔ driba la tsɔ eƒe ŋutete, fiazikpui kple ŋusẽ gã na lã la.
ENGLISH: 13 And I saw come up out of the sea a beast with ten horns and seven heads, ten crowns on its horns and names of blasphemy on its heads; 2 and the beast that I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like a bear’s, and its mouth like that of a lion, and the serpent gave it its own power and its throne and great dominion; 3 and one of its heads as if it had had its throat cut and was dying; and its death-wound was cured.

EWE: 3 Eye eƒe tawo dometɔ ɖeka dze abe ɖe wode kubi eŋu ene, ke eƒe kubi la ku nɛ, eye anyigbadzinɔlawo katã ƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye wodze lã la yome. 4 Wode ta agu na ʋɔ driba la, elabena etsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ na lã wɔadã la, eye wode ta agu na lã wɔadã la gblɔ be: "Ame kae le abe lã wɔadã la ene, eye ame kae ate ŋu awɔ aʋa kplii? " 5 Eye wotsɔ nu, si gblɔa nya gã nya gãwo kple busunyawo la nɛ, eye wona ŋusẽe be wòawɔ dɔ ɣleti blaene vɔ eve. 6 Eke nu gblɔ busunyawo ɖe Mawu, eƒe ŋkɔ kple eƒe nɔƒe kpakple ame siwo le dziƒo ŋu.
ENGLISH: And the whole earth was fascinated over the beast; 4 and they did reverence to the serpent because it had given the beast the dominion, and did reverence to the beast saying "Who is like the beast? and who can war with it? " 5 And it was given a mouth uttering big speeches and blasphemies; and it was given dominion to act forty-two months; 6 and it opened its mouth for blasphemies against God, to blaspheme his name and his tabernacle, those who dwell in heaven.

EWE: 7 Eye woɖe mɔ nɛ be wòawɔ aʋa kple ame kɔkɔewo ahaɖu wo dzi, eye wona ŋusẽe ɖe to sia to kple ame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple dukɔ sia dukɔ dzi. 8 Eye anyigbadzinɔlawo katã ade ta agu nɛ.
ENGLISH: 7 And it was privileged to make war with God’s people and to defeat them; and it was given dominion over every tribe and people and language and race; 8 and all that live on the earth shall do it reverence, whoever has not had his name written in the Slaughtered Lamb’s book of life since the foundation of the world.

EWE: Womeŋlɔ wo dometɔ aɖeke ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe Alẽvi si wowu la ƒe agbegbalẽ si li tso xexea ƒe gɔmeɖoanyiɣi la me o. 9 Ame si to li na la, nesee. 10 Ne aboyo mee wòle be ame aɖe nayi la, ayi aboyo me.
ENGLISH: 9 If anyone has an ear, let him listen: 10 whoever leads into captivity proceeds into captivity; whoever shall kill with the sword must be killed with the sword.

EWE: Ne ame aɖe wu ame kple yi la, woawu eya hã kple yi.
ENGLISH: Here is the endurance and faith of God’s people.

EWE: 11 Mekpɔ lã wɔadã bubu aɖe wòle dodom tso anyigba me, eye dzo eve le eta abe alẽvi tɔ ene, ke ede asi nuƒoƒo me abe ʋɔ driba ene.
ENGLISH: 11 And I saw another beast come up out of the earth; and it had two horns like a lamb, and it spoke like a serpent.

EWE: 12 Eye wòwɔ lã wɔadã gbãtɔ la ƒe ŋusẽwo katã ŋu dɔ le eƒe ŋkume. Eye wòna anyigba kple edzinɔlawo de ta agu na lã wɔadã gbãtɔ si ƒe kubi ku nɛ la.
ENGLISH: 12 And it exercises all the first beast’s dominion in its presence; and it makes the earth and those who live in it do reverence to the first beast whose death-wound was cured.

EWE: 13 Ewɔ dzesi gãwo, eye wòna dzo gɔ̃ hã ge tso dziƒo va dze anyigba dzi le amegbetɔwo ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 13 And it exhibits great tokens, so as even to make fire come down out of the sky to the earth before men.

EWE: 14 Eye wòflua anyigbadzinɔlawo to dzesi siwo woɖe mɔ nɛ be wòawɔ le lã wɔadã la ŋkume la me, eye wògblɔna na ame siwo le anyigba la dzi hã be woawɔ lã wɔadã si ŋu wotsɔ yi de abii, eye wògagbɔ agbe la, ƒe legba.
ENGLISH: 14 And it misleads those who live on the earth because of the tokens that it is privileged to exhibit before the beast, telling those who live on the earth to make an image of the beast that has the sword-cut and has come to life.

EWE: 15 Eye woɖe mɔ nɛ be wòade gbɔgbɔ lã wɔadã la ƒe legba la me, ne lã wɔadã la ƒe legba la naƒo nu, eye wòana woawu ame siwo katã gbe be yewomade ta agu na lã wɔadã la ƒe legbaa o la.
ENGLISH: 15 And it is privileged to give the beast’s image a spirit, so that the beast’s image shall even speak and cause as many as do not do reverence to the beast’s image to be killed.

EWE: 16 Eye wòzi amewo katã, ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo, kesinɔtɔwo kple ame dahewo, ablɔɖemewo kple kluviwo dzi be woaxɔ dzesi ɖe woƒe nuɖusi alo woƒe ŋgonu, 17 eye be ame aɖeke nagate ŋu aƒle nu alo adzra nu o, negbe ame si ŋu dzesi, si nye lã wɔadã la ƒe ŋkɔ alo xexlẽdzesi si le tsitre ɖi na eƒe ŋkɔ, le la ko.
ENGLISH: 16 And it causes everybody, small and great and rich and poor and free and slave, to have a stamp put on his right hand or on his forehead, 17 and that no one shall be able to buy or sell except one who has the stamp, the beast’s name or the number of its name.

EWE: 18 Afi siae nunya hiã le: Ame si sea nu gɔme la, nebu lã wɔadã la ƒe xexlẽdzesia kpɔ, elabena ame ƒe xexlẽdzesi wònye; eye eƒe xexlẽdzesie nye alafa ade blaade vɔ ade.
ENGLISH: 18 Here is wisdom: let him who has intelligence calculate the beast’s number; for it is a man’s number. And its number is six hundred and sixty-six.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 14 Mekpɔ Alẽvi la le tsitre ɖe Zion To la dzi, eye ame akpe alafa ɖeka blaene vɔ ene, siwo ƒe ŋgonu woŋlɔ eƒe ŋkɔ kple Fofoa ƒe ŋkɔ ɖo la, le eŋu.
ENGLISH: 14 And I saw, and there was the lamb standing on Mount Sion, and with it a hundred and forty-four thousand who had its name and its Father’s name written on their foreheads.

EWE: 2 Eye mese gbe aɖe tso dziƒo abe tsi geɖewo ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene, abe dziɖegbe sesẽ ƒe ɖiɖi ene; eye gbe si mese la le abe hadzilawoe le saŋku ƒom ɖe ha dzi ene.
ENGLISH: 2 And I heard a sound out of heaven like the sound of much water and like the sound of loud thunder; and the sound that I heard was like that of harpers playing on their harps.

EWE: 3 Eye wole ha aɖe si ɖi ha yeye dzim le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ kple nu gbagbe eneawo kpakple ametsitsiawo ŋkume, eye ame aɖeke mete ŋu srɔ̃ ha la o, negbe ame akpe alafa ɖeka blaene vɔ ene, siwo woƒle tso anyigba dzi la ko.
ENGLISH: 3 And they were singing what seemed to be a new song before the throne and before the four creatures and the aged men; and nobody could learn the song except the hundred and forty-four thousand who had been bought from the earth.

EWE: 4 Ame siawo meƒo ɖi wo ɖokuiwo kple nyɔnuwo o; le nyateƒe me la, wole abe ɖetugbui leaƒewo ene.
ENGLISH: 4 These are they who were not defiled with women: for they are virgins.

EWE: Ame siawoe dzea Alẽvi la yome yia afi sia afi si wòyina.
ENGLISH: These are they who follow the lamb wherever it goes.

EWE: Woƒle ame siawo tso amegbetɔwo dome be woanye kutsetse gbãtɔ na Mawu kple Alẽvi la, 5 eye womekpɔ aʋatsokaka aɖeke le woƒe nu me o; mokaka mele wo ŋu o.
ENGLISH: These were bought from mankind as firstfruits for God and the lamb, 5 and in their mouths was found no falsehood: they are without a flaw.

EWE: 6 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu aɖe wòle dzodzom le yame, eye nya nyui mavɔ aɖe le esi wòagblɔ na ame siwo le anyigba dzi, kple dukɔ sia dukɔ kple to sia to kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple ame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi. 7 Eye wòle gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã aɖe be: "Mivɔ̃ Mawu, eye mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe nɛ, elabena eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃gaƒoƒo la ɖo, eye mide ta agu na Ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba kple atsiaƒu kple tsidzɔƒewo. "
ENGLISH: 6 And I saw another angel flying in the zenith with an eternal gospel to preach to those who dwell on the earth and to every race and tribe and language and people, 7 saying in a loud voice "Fear God and give him glory, because the hour for his judgment has come; and do reverence to him who made the heavens and the earth and sea and springs of water. "

EWE: 8 Mawudɔla bubu aɖe, si nye evelia, dze eyome le gbɔgblɔm be: "Emu loo!
ENGLISH: 8 And a second angel followed, saying "She has fallen, she has fallen, great Babylon who gave all nations the wine of her rage of unchastity to drink. "

EWE: Babilon Gã la mu, eya si na dukɔwo katã no eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe dzodzro sesẽ ƒe wain la! " 9 Mawudɔla bubu aɖe, si nye etɔ̃lia, dze wo yome hele gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã aɖe be: "Ne ame aɖe de ta agu na lã wɔadã la kple eƒe legba la, eye wòxɔ dzesi ɖe eƒe ŋgonu alo ɖe eƒe asi ŋu la, 10 ano Mawu ƒe dziku ƒe wain si wometɔ tsii o, si wokɔ ɖe Eƒe dɔmedzoekplu me la hã ƒe ɖe, eye woatsɔ dzo kple dzokpe awɔ fui vevie le mawudɔla kɔkɔewo ŋkume kple Alẽvi la ŋkume. 11 Eye woƒe fuwɔame ƒe dzudzɔ la anɔ tutum yi dzi tegbetegbe. Ame siwo dea ta agu na lã wɔadã la kple eƒe legba la kpakple ame sia ame si xɔa eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe dzesi la, makpɔ gbɔɖeme o zã kple keli.
ENGLISH: 9 And a third angel followed them, saying in a loud voice "Whoever is doing reverence to the beast and its image, and taking a stamp on his forehead or on his hand, 10 he too shall drink the wine of God’s wrath that is mixed undiluted in the cup of his anger, and shall be tortured with fire and sulfur before holy angels and before the lamb; 11 and the smoke of their torture goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest day nor night, those who do reverence to the beast and its image and whoever takes the stamp of its name.

EWE: 12 Afi siae ame kɔkɔewo ƒe dzidodo hiã le, ame siwo léa Mawu ƒe sewo kple Yesu dzi xɔse me ɖe asi. "
ENGLISH: 12 Here is the endurance of God’s people, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus. "

EWE: 13 Eye mese gbe aɖe tso dziƒo wògblɔ be, "Ŋlɔ bena: Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye ame siwo ku le Aƒetɔ la me tso fifia dzi. Ɛ̃, gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ be, mina woagbɔ ɖe eme tso woƒe agbagbadzedzewo me, elabena woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo dze wo yome enumake. "
ENGLISH: 13 And I heard a voice out of the sky say "Write ‘Happy are the dead who die in the Lord henceforth yes, says the Spirit, to rest from their labors; for their deeds follow with them.’ "

EWE: 14 Eye mekpɔ alilikpo ɣi aɖe, eye ame si le abe amegbetɔvi ene la bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi, sikafiakuku le ta nɛ, eye hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ aɖe le esi.
ENGLISH: 14 And I saw, and there was a white cloud; and sitting on the cloud the like of a son of man, with a golden wreath on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

EWE: 15 Mawudɔla bubu aɖe do tso gbedoxɔ la ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe gã aɖe ɖo ɖe ame si bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi be: "Do wò hɛ gobɛ la ɖa nàŋe nu, elabena gaƒoƒo la de be woaŋe nu, elabena anyigbadzinukuwo ɖi keŋkeŋ. " 16 Eye ame si bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi la do eƒe hɛ gobɛ la ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòŋe anyigbadzinukuwo.
ENGLISH: 15 And another angel came out of the temple, calling in a loud voice to the one who was sitting on the cloud "Out with your sickle and reap, because reaping-time has come, because the harvest of the earth is dry "; 16 and the one who was sitting on the cloud threw his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

EWE: 17 Mawudɔla bubu aɖe gado tso gbedoxɔ la ƒe kɔkɔeƒe si le dziƒo, eye hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ le eya hã si.
ENGLISH: 17 And another angel came out of the temple in heaven, also with a sharp sickle.

EWE: 18 Mawudɔla bubu aɖe, si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzo dzi la, do tso vɔsamlekpui la me. Edo ɣli kple gbe gã aɖe ɖo ɖe ame si si hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛa le la be: "Do wò hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ la ɖa nàtso anyigbadziwainka la ƒe kpowo, elabena eƒe tsetseawo ɖi. " 19 Eye mawudɔla la do eƒe hɛ gobɛ la ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòtso anyigbadziwainka la tsɔ ƒu gbe ɖe Mawu ƒe dziku ƒe wainfiãnu gã la me.
ENGLISH: 18 And another angel came out of the altar, he who has dominion over fire, and called loudly to the one who had the sharp sickle "Out with your sharp sickle and harvest the clusters of the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe "; 19 and the angel threw his sickle to the earth, and harvested the vintage of the vine of the earth and threw it into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

EWE: 20 Eye wofanya waintsetse si le wainfiãnu la me le dua godo, ʋu do le wainfiãnu la me eye wòɖɔ va ɖo keke sɔwo ƒe numegawo ŋuti ke, eye wòde stadio akpe ɖeka alafa ade.
ENGLISH: 20 And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress up to horses’ bridles two hundred miles off.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 15 Megakpɔ dzesi gã bubu aɖe le dziƒo si wɔ nuku ale gbegbe: eyae nye mawudɔla adre siwo si fuwɔame adreawo le. Fuwɔame siawoe nye mamlɛtɔwo, elabena woawo dzie woato ahe Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe la ava nuwuwu.
ENGLISH: 15 And I saw another portent in the sky, a great and wonderful: seven angels with the seven last plagues the last, because in them the wrath of God is finished.

EWE: 2 Eye mekpɔ nane si ɖi ahuhɔ̃etsiaƒu, si wotsɔ dzo tsaka, kple ame siwo ɖu lã wɔadã la kple eƒe legba la kpakple xexlẽdzesi si tsi tsitre ɖi na eƒe ŋkɔ la dzi, wole tsitre ɖe ahuhɔ̃etsiaƒu la gbɔ, eye Mawu ƒe saŋkuwo le wo si.
ENGLISH: 2 And I saw what seemed as if it were a sea of glass mixed with fire; and standing on the sea of glass, with harps divine, those who have come off victorious from the beast and from its image and from its name-number.

EWE: 3 Eye wole Mose, Mawu ƒe kluvi la, ƒe ha kple Alẽvi la ƒe ha dzim le gbɔgblɔm be: "Yehowa Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, wò dɔwɔwɔwo lolo eye wowɔ nuku loo!
ENGLISH: 3 And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the lamb: "Great and wonderful are thy deeds, Lord God Almighty; right and true are thy courses, King of the nations.

EWE: Fia mavɔmavɔtɔ, wò mɔwo le dzɔdzɔe, eye wonye nyateƒe. 4 Yehowa, ame kae mavɔ̃ wò o, eye ame kae makafu wò ŋkɔ la o? Elabena wò ɖeɖe koe nye nuteƒewɔla!
ENGLISH: 4 Who shall not be afraid, Lord, and glorify thy name because thou alone art holy? because all nations shall come and do reverence before thee, because thy right-doing is made manifest. "

EWE: 5 Le nu sia megbe la, mekpɔ woʋu ɖaseɖigbadɔ la ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la le dziƒo, 6 eye mawudɔla adre siwo si fuwɔame adreawo le la do tso kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wodo aklalawu dzadzɛ si le dzo dam, eye wotsɔ sikanudziblanuwo bla akɔta.
ENGLISH: 5 And after this I saw, and the temple of the tent of attestation in heaven was opened, 6 and out of the temple came the seven angels that had the seven plagues, dressed in bright clean flax and belted round the chest with golden belts.

EWE: 7 Eye nu gbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖeka tsɔ sikakplu adre siwo Mawu, ame si le agbe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me, ƒe dɔmedzoe yɔ taŋ la na mawudɔla adreawo.
ENGLISH: 7 And one of the four creatures gave the seven angels seven golden saucers full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

EWE: 8 Eye dzudzɔ yɔ kɔkɔeƒe la taŋ, le Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple eƒe ŋusẽ la ta, eye ame aɖeke mete ŋu ge ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la o va se ɖe esime mawudɔla adreawo ƒe fuwɔame adreawo wu enu.
ENGLISH: 8 And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and nobody could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels should be finished.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 16 Eye mese gbe gã aɖe tso kɔkɔeƒe la wògblɔ na mawudɔla adreawo be: "Miyi ne miatrɔ nu siwo le Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoekplu adreawo me la kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi. "
ENGLISH: 16 And I heard a loud voice out of the temple say to the seven angels "Go and pour out the seven saucers full of the wrath of God on the earth. "

EWE: 2 Mawudɔla gbãtɔ yi ɖatrɔ nu si le eƒe kplua me la kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi. Eye ame siwo ŋu lã wɔadã la ƒe dzesi le, eye wole ta dem agu na eƒe legba la dze abi vɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 2 And the first went and poured out his saucer on the earth, and it became a rank malignant sore on the men who had the beast’s stamp and who did reverence to its image.

EWE: 3 Mawudɔla evelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplua me la kɔ ɖe atsiaƒu me. Eye wòtrɔ zu abe ame kuku ƒe ʋu ene, eye nu gbagbe siwo katã le atsiaƒua me la ku.
ENGLISH: 3 And the second poured out his saucer on the sea, and it became blood like that of a dead man, and all animate life died, what was in the sea.

EWE: Eye wotrɔ zu ʋu. 5 Eye mese mawudɔla si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe tsiawo dzi la gblɔ be: "Wò, Ame si li, eye nènɔ anyi, wò, Nuteƒewɔla la, èle dzɔdzɔe, le esi nèdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu alea ta, 6 esi wokɔ ame kɔkɔewo kple nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe ʋu ɖe anyi ta la, ètsɔ ʋu na wo be woano; eye wodze nɛ hã. " 7 Eye mese vɔsamlekpui la gblɔ be: "Ɛ̃, Yehowa Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo le eteƒe hele dzɔdzɔe. "
ENGLISH: 4 And the third poured out his saucer on the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood; 5 and I heard the angel of the water say "Thou art just, O holy Who Is and Was, in that thou didst pronounce these sentences, 6 because they shed the blood of holy men and of prophets and thou hast given them blood to drink: they deserve it "; 7 and I heard the altar say "Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are thy judgments. "

EWE: 8 Mawudɔla enelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplua me la kɔ ɖe ɣe dzi, eye woɖe mɔ na ɣe be wòafiã ameawo. 9 Eye dzoxɔxɔ gã aɖe ɖu ameawo, gake wogblɔ busunyawo ɖe Mawu, ame si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe fuwɔame siawo dzi la ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu, eye wometrɔ dzi me, ne woatsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe anɛ o.
ENGLISH: 8 And the fourth poured out his saucer on the sun, and it was given to the sun to scorch men with fire, 9 and men suffered a great scorching and blasphemed the name of the God who has dominion over these plagues, and did not repent to give him glory.

EWE: 10 Mawudɔla atɔ̃lia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplua me la kɔ ɖe lã wɔadã la ƒe fiazikpui dzi. Eye eƒe fiaɖuƒe do viviti, eye amewo te aɖukliɖuɖu le woƒe vevesese la ta, 11 gake wogblɔ busunyawo ɖe dziƒo Mawu la ŋu le woƒe veveseseawo kple woƒe abiawo ta, eye wometrɔ dzi me tso woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me o.
ENGLISH: 10 And the fifth poured out his saucer on the beast’s throne, and its empire was thrown into darkness, and they chewed their tongues for pain 11 and blasphemed the God of heaven for their pains and their sores, and did not repent of their deeds.

EWE: 12 Mawudɔla adelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplua me la kɔ ɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la dzi, eye emetsi la mie, ne woadzra mɔ dzi ɖo na fia siwo tso ɣedzeƒe la.
ENGLISH: 12 And the sixth poured out his saucer on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up that the road for the kings from the sunrise might be prepared.

EWE: 13 Eye mekpɔ gbɔgbɔmenya makɔmakɔ etɔ̃ siwo le abe akpɔkplɔwo ene la, do tso ʋɔ driba la ƒe nu me kple lã wɔadã la ƒe nu me kpakple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila la ƒe nu me. 14 Le nyateƒe me la, wonye nya siwo tso gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo gbɔ, eye wowɔa dzesiwo, eye woyia anyigba blibo la dzi fiawo gbɔ be woaƒo wo nu ƒu hena Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe ŋkeke gã la ƒe aʋawɔwɔ.
