ENGLISH: 13 And I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, out of the serpent’s mouth and out of the beast’s mouth and out of the pretended prophet’s mouth; 14 for there are spirits of demons, doing tokens, that go out after the kings of the whole world of men to bring them together for the war of the great day of God Almighty.

EWE: 15 "Kpɔ ɖa! Megbɔna abe fiafitɔ ene. Dzidzɔtɔe nye ame si nɔa ŋudzɔ, eye wòdzraa eƒe awudziwuiwo ɖo be wòagazɔ amama, eye amewo nakpɔ eƒe ŋukpeƒe o. "
ENGLISH: 15 I am coming like a thief: happy is he who keeps awake and guards his clothes, that he may not go naked and have people see his indecent condition.

EWE: 16 Eye woƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe teƒe si woyɔna le Hebrigbe me be, Armagedon.
ENGLISH: 16 And he brought them together to the place called in Hebrew Har Magedon.

EWE: 17 Mawudɔla adrelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplua me la kɔ ɖe yame. Eye gbe gã aɖe ɖi tso fiazikpui la gbɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la le gbɔgblɔm be: "Wowu enu! " 18 Eye dzi le dzo kem, gbeɖiɖi sesẽwo ɖi, dzi ɖe gbe, eye anyigba de asi ʋuʋu me sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 17 And the seventh poured out his saucer on the air, and there came out of the temple from the throne a loud voice saying "It is done "; 18 and there were lightnings and noises and thunderclaps, and there was a great earthquake, such an earthquake as there has not been since there was a man on earth, 19 and the great city went into three parts and the cities of the nations fell.

EWE: Anyigba meʋuʋu sesĩe hede didiƒe nenema gbegbe kpɔ tso esime wowɔ amegbetɔ ɖe anyigba dzi o.
ENGLISH: And great Babylon was remembered before God, to give her the wine-cup of his fierce anger.

EWE: 20 Azɔ hã, ƒukpowo katã sí, eye womegakpɔ towo o.
ENGLISH: 20 And every island took flight, and mountains left no trace.

EWE: 21 Eye kpetsi gã siwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe kpekpeme anɔ talento ɖeka la, dza tso dziƒo ɖe ameawo dzi, eye ameawo gblɔ busunya ɖe Mawu ŋu le fu si kpetsi la wɔ wo la ta, elabena eƒe fuwɔame la nu sẽ wu gbɔgblɔ.
ENGLISH: 21 And great hailstones, about a hundredweight each, came down upon men out of the sky; and men blasphemed God at the plague of the hail, because it was a very great plague.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 17 Eye mawudɔla adre, siwo si kplu adreawo le la, dometɔ ɖeka va gblɔ nam be: "Va mafia gbolo gã si bɔbɔ nɔ tsi geɖewo dzi la ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ wò, 2 anyigbadzifiawo wɔ ahasi kplii, eye anyigbadzinɔlawo no eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe wain la mu. " 3 Eye wòkɔm le gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ŋusẽ me yi gbedzi.
ENGLISH: 17 And one of the seven angels that had the seven saucers came and talked with me, saying "Come here, I will show you the sentence of the great prostitute seated on a great water, 2 with whom the kings of the earth debauched themselves and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her unchaste embraces "; 3 and he carried me away to a desert in the spirit.

EWE: Eye mekpɔ nyɔnu aɖe wòbɔbɔ nɔ lã wɔadã aɖe si biã helĩhelĩ, si ŋuti yɔ fũu kple busuŋkɔwo, eye ta adre kple dzo ewo li nɛ, la dzi. 4 Eye nyɔnu la do aɖabɛwu kple awu dzĩ, eye wòtsɔ sika kple kpe xɔasiwo kple dzonuwo ɖo atsyɔ̃ na eɖokui, eye wòlé sikakplu aɖe si yɔ taŋ kple ŋunyɔnuwo kpakple nu makɔmakɔ siwo wòkpɔ tso eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ me la ɖe asi. 5 Eye woŋlɔ ŋkɔ aɖe, si nye nya ɣaɣla, ɖe eƒe ŋgonu be: "Babilon Gã la, gbolowo kple anyigbadziŋunyɔnuwo dada. " 6 Eye mekpɔ be nyɔnu la mu ame kɔkɔewo ƒe ʋu kple Yesu ƒe ɖasefowo ƒe ʋu.
ENGLISH: And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast full of names of blasphemy, with seven heads and ten horns; 4 and the woman was clad in purple and scarlet and jeweled with gold and precious stones and pearls, with a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and the filth of her prostitution, 5 and written on her forehead a name with a secret meaning, "Great Babylon, mother of the prostitutes and abominations of the earth. " 6 And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of God’s people and with the blood of Jesus’s witnesses.

EWE: Esi mekpɔe la, ewɔ moyaa nam ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: And great was my wonder at seeing her.

EWE: 7 Eye mawudɔla la biam be: "Nu ka tae wòwɔ moyaa na wò ɖo?
ENGLISH: 7 And the angel said to me "Why did you wonder?

EWE: Magblɔ nyɔnu la kple lã wɔadã si dzi wòbɔbɔ nɔ, si si ta adreawo kple dzo ewoawo le la, ŋuti nya ɣaɣla la na wò: 8 Lã wɔadã si nèkpɔ la nɔ anyi kpɔ, gake megali o, ado tso aʋli me, eye wòayi ɖe tsɔtsrɔ̃ me. Eye anyigbadzinɔla siwo ƒe ŋkɔwo womeŋlɔ ɖe agbegbalẽ si li tso xexea ƒe gɔmeɖoanyiɣi la me o la, ƒe mo awɔ yaa ne wokpɔ ale si lã wɔadã la nɔ anyi kpɔ, ke megali o, eye wògado la.
ENGLISH: 8 The beast that you saw was and is not, and is to come up out of the abyss, and goes to destruction; and those who live on the earth shall wonder, those whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, as they see how the beast was and is not and shall make its appearance.

EWE: 9 "Esia hiã susu si me nunya le: Ta adreawo le tsitre ɖi na to adre, siwo dzi nyɔnu la bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖo.
ENGLISH: 9 Here is the mind that has wisdom.

EWE: 10 Eye wonye fia adre: Atɔ̃ dze anyi, ɖeka li, mamlɛtɔ la meva ɖo haɖe o; ke ne eva ɖo la, anɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe ko.
ENGLISH: The seven heads are seven hills that the woman is seated on; 10 and they are seven kings five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come, and must remain a little while when he does come.

EWE: 11 Eye lã wɔadã si nɔ anyi kpɔ, gake megali o lae nye fia enyilia, ke fia adreawo mee wòdo tso, eye wòyina ɖe tsɔtsrɔ̃ me.
ENGLISH: 11 And the beast that was and is not is himself an eighth and one of the seven, and goes to destruction.

EWE: 12 "Eye dzo ewo siwo nèkpɔ la le tsitre ɖi na fia ewo, siwo mexɔ fiaɖuƒe haɖe o, ke woana ŋusẽ wo woanye fiawo kpe ɖe lã wɔadã la ŋu gaƒoƒo ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 12 And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings who had not yet received empire, but they do receive dominion as kings for one hour with the beast.

EWE: 13 Taɖodzinu ɖekae le wo si, eya ta wotsɔ woƒe ŋutete kple ŋusẽ na lã wɔadã la.
ENGLISH: 13 These are of one mind, and give their power and dominion to the beast.

EWE: 14 Woawɔ aʋa kple Alẽvi la, gake esi wònye aƒetɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ kple fiawo ƒe Fiae Alẽvi la nye ta la, aɖu wo dzi. Eye ame siwo kpe ɖe eŋu, siwo nye ame yɔyɔwo kple ame tiatiawo kple nuteƒewɔlawo la hã aɖu wo dzi. "
ENGLISH: 14 These shall make war with the lamb, and the lamb shall defeat them, because he is Lord of Lords and King of Kings and those who are with him are called and chosen and faithful. "

EWE: 15 Eye wògblɔ nam be: "Tsi siwo nèkpɔ, siwo dzi gbolo la bɔbɔ nɔ la, le tsitre ɖi na amewo kple amehawo kple dukɔwo kpakple gbegbɔgblɔwo.
ENGLISH: 15 And he said to me "The waters that you saw, where the prostitute is seated, are peoples and masses and races and languages.

EWE: 16 Eye dzo ewo siwo nèkpɔ kple lã wɔadã la, woawo alé fu gbolo la, woagblẽe aɖe amae, aɖu eƒe ŋutilã, eye woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ. 17 Elabena Mawu tsɔe de woƒe dzi me be woawɔ nu si yeɖo ɖe tame la dzi, si nye be woawɔ woƒe tameɖoɖo ɖeka la dzi, be woatsɔ woƒe fiaɖuƒe ana lã wɔadã la, va se ɖe esime Mawu ƒe nyawo nava eme.
ENGLISH: 16 And the ten horns that you saw, and the beast, these shall hate the prostitute and make her destitute and naked, and eat her flesh, and burn her in a fire; 17 for God has put it into their hearts to do what is in his mind, and to concur unanimously in giving their empire to the beast till God’s words are all done.

EWE: 18 Eye nyɔnu si nèkpɔ la, le tsitre ɖi na du gã, si ƒe fiaɖuƒe kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe anyigbadzifiawo dzi la. "
ENGLISH: 18 And the woman that you saw is the great city that has empire over the kings of the earth. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 18 Le nu sia megbe la, mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu aɖe wòle ɖiɖim tso dziƒo, eye ŋusẽ gã le esi, eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe na anyigba la dzi klẽ.
ENGLISH: 18 After this I saw coming down out of the sky another angel, one that had great dominion, and the earth was lighted up with his glory.

EWE: 2 Eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ aɖe gblɔ be: "Emu loo! Babilon Gã la mu, eye wòzu gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo kple gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo katã kpakple xe makɔmakɔ siwo wotsri la katã ƒe nɔƒe! 3 Elabena dukɔwo katã no eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe dzodzro sesẽ ƒe wain la mu, eye anyigbadzifiawo wɔ ahasi kplii, eye anyigbadzisitsalawo zu kesinɔtɔwo le eƒe agbeɖuɖu vivivo la ƒe ŋusẽ ŋuti. " 4 Eye mese gbe bubu aɖe tso dziƒo wògblɔ be: "Nye dukɔ, mido go le eme, ne miedi be yewoakpɔ gome kplii le eƒe nu vɔ̃wo me o, eye ne miedi be yewoaxɔ eƒe fuwɔamewo ƒe ɖeke o. 5 Elabena eƒe nu vɔ̃wo li kɔ yi ɖatɔ keke dziƒo ke, eye Mawu ɖo ŋku eƒe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔwo dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 And he cried with a strong voice "She has fallen, she has fallen, great Babylon has fallen and become a home of demons and a haunt of every unclean spirit and a haunt of every unclean and odious bird, 3 because all the nations have drunk the wine of her rage of unchastity and the kings of the earth have debauched themselves with her and the merchants of the earth have grown rich out of the rush of her luxurious life. " 4 And I heard another voice out of the sky say "Come out of her, my people, that you may not be a party to her sins and may not share in her scourges, 5 because her sins have been crowded up to the sky and God has remembered her iniquities.

EWE: 6 Miɖo eteƒe nɛ abe ale si wòwɔ amewo ene, ɛ̃, miɖo nu si wòwɔ la teƒe nɛ zi gbɔ zi eve; kplu si me wòtɔtɔ nu le la, mitɔtɔ nu teƒe eve nu ɖe eme nɛ. 7 Ale si nu wòdo eɖokui ɖe dzi heɖu agbe vivivoe la, miwɔ fui, eye mina wòaxa nu nenema ke.
ENGLISH: 6 Pay her in the same coin that she paid in, and redouble to her the double of her own deeds; in the cup that she mixed in mix a double draft for her; 7 for every bit of her self-glorification and luxury give her as much of torment and mourning.

EWE: Elabena ele gbɔgblɔm le eƒe dzi me be: ‘Mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi abe fianyɔnu ene, nyemenye ahosi o, eye nyemaxa nu akpɔ o.’ 8 Esia tae le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi la, fuwɔame siwo nye ku, nuxaxa kple dɔwuame ava edzi, eye woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ, elabena Yehowa Mawu, ame si drɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, ŋusẽtɔ wònye.
ENGLISH: Because she says in her heart ‘I am enthroned queen, I am not a widow, I shall not see mourning,’ 8 for this reason her scourges shall come in one day, pestilence and mourning and starvation, and she shall be burned in a fire, because strong is the Lord God who has judged her.

EWE: 9 "Eye ne anyigbadzifia siwo wɔ ahasi kplii heɖu agbe kplii ŋumakpemakpee la kpɔ eƒe bibi ƒe dzudzɔa la, woafa avi, eye woaxa nu vevie le eŋuti. 10 Woanɔ adzɔge ke le vɔvɔ̃ na eƒe fuwɔame la ta agblɔ be: ‘Baba na wò, baba na wò, wò, du gã, Babilon, wò, du sesẽ, elabena wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ va ɖo le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me!’ 11 "Eye anyigbadzisitsalawo hã le avi fam hele nu xam ɖe eta, elabena ame aɖeke megali aƒle woƒe adzɔnuwo katã azɔ o, 12 adzɔnu siawoe nye sika, klosalo, kpe xɔasiwo, dzonuwo, aklala biɖibiɖi, avɔ hẽ, seda kple avɔ dzĩ, kpakple nu sia nu si wotsɔ ati ʋeʋĩ kpa kple nu sia nu si wotsɔ nyiɖu kpa kpakple nu sia nu si wotsɔ ati xɔasi, akɔbli, gayibɔ kple kpe fufu xɔasi wɔ; 13 kple nu ʋeʋĩ si woyɔna be sinamɔn kple ataku, atike ʋeʋĩ, ami ʋeʋĩ, lifi, wain, ami, wɔ memee, lu, nyiwo, alẽwo, sɔwo, tasiaɖamwo, kluviwo kple amewo ƒe agbe.
ENGLISH: 9 And the kings of the earth, who have debauched themselves with her and lived luxuriously in her company, shall weep and wail over her when they see the smoke of the burning of her, 10 standing far away for the fear of her torture, saying ‘Alas, alas, great city, Babylon, powerful city! because in one moment your judgment has come.’ 11 And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her because nobody buys their cargoes any longer, 12 cargoes of gold and silver and precious stones and pearls and lawn and purple and silk and crimson, and every variety of sandarac-wood and every article of ivory and every article made of costliest wood and of bronze and iron and marble, 13 and cinnamon and amomum and incense and perfume and frankincense and wine and oil and farina and wheat and cattle and sheep, and horses and carriages and slaves, and human lives.

EWE: 14 Ɛ̃, kutsetse nyui si dzroa wò la dzo le gbɔwò, eye wò nu viviwo kple atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo katã bu ɖe wò vĩi, eye womagakpɔ wo akpɔ gbeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 14 And your summer dainties of heart’s desire are gone from you, and everything sumptuous and splendid of yours has perished, and nevermore shall anyone find them.

EWE: 15 "Asitsala siwo dzraa nu siawo, siwo to eya amea dzi zu kesinɔtɔwo la, atɔ ɖe adzɔge ke le vɔvɔ̃ na eƒe fuwɔame la ta, eye woafa avi ahafa konyi 16 agblɔ be: ‘Baba na wò, baba na wò, wò du gã, si do aklala biɖibiɖi wu kple awu hẽ kple awu dzĩ, eye nètsɔ sikanuwo kple kpe xɔasiwo kpakple dzonuwo ɖo atsyɔ̃ na ɖokuiwò fũu, 17 elabena le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me wogblẽ kesinɔnu gbogbo siawo dome!’
ENGLISH: 15 The merchants of these things, those who had grown rich from her, shall stand far away for the fear of her torture weeping and mourning, 16 saying ‘Alas, alas, great city clad in lawn and purple and crimson and jeweled with gold and precious stones and pearls! 17 because in one moment such wealth has been desolated.’

EWE: "Eye tɔdziʋukula ɖe sia ɖe kple ame sia ame si ɖoa ʋu toa tɔ dzi, kple ƒudzidɔwɔlawo kple ame siwo katã kpɔa woƒe abolo tso ƒudzidɔwɔwɔ me la le tsitre ɖe adzɔge ke, 18 eye esi wokpɔ eƒe bibi ƒe dzudzɔa la, wodo ɣli gblɔ be: ‘Du kae le abe du gã la ene?’ 19 Eye wolɔ ke kɔ ɖe tame, le ɣli dom le avi fam hele konyi fam le gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Baba na wò, baba na wò, wò du gã, si me ame siwo katã si tɔdziʋu le le atsiaƒu dzi to zu kesinɔtɔwo le wò kesinɔtɔnyenye ta, elabena wotsrɔ̃ wò le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me!’ 20 "O dziƒo, dzi nedzɔ wò le eta, dzi nedzɔ mi ame kɔkɔewo kple mi apostolowo kpakple mi nyagblɔɖilawo hã, elabena Mawu drɔ̃ ʋɔnui na mi! "
ENGLISH: And every ship-captain and every voyager, and sailors and as many as get their living from the sea, stood far away 18 and cried, as they saw the smoke of the burning of her, ‘Who is like the great city?’ 19 and threw earth on their heads and cried, weeping and mourning, ‘Alas, alas, great city where all who had shipping at sea grew rich out of her costly fashions! because in one moment she has been desolated.’ 20 Jubilate over her, heaven! and God’s people and the apostles and the prophets! because God has passed judgment on her in your cause. "

EWE: 21 Eye mawudɔla sesẽ aɖe kɔ kpe aɖe, si le abe té gã aɖe ene tsɔ ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu me gblɔ be: "Aleae woatsɔ Babilon, si nye du gã la, axlã ɖe anyi sesĩe zi ɖekae nye esi, eye womagakpɔe gbeɖegbeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 21 And one strong angel took up a stone that seemed like a great millstone and hurled it into the sea, saying "Thus shall the great city Babylon be hurled down with a plunge and never be found again.

EWE: Eye womagakpɔ aɖaŋudɔwɔla aɖeke le mewò azɔ o, eye womagase tétutu ŋkɔ le mewò azɔ o. 23 Eye akaɖi ƒe keklẽ aɖeke magaklẽ le mewò azɔ o, eye womagase ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ kple ŋugbetɔ ƒe gbe le mewò azɔ o. Elabena wò asitsalawo nye ame ŋkutawo le anyigba la dzi, eye nèflu dukɔwo katã to wò gbɔgbɔyɔnuwɔnawo me.
ENGLISH: 22 And there shall never be heard in you again the sound of harpers and minstrels and flute-players and trumpeters; and there shall never be found in you again any master of any art; and there shall never be heard in you again the sound of a mill; 23 and there shall never shine in you again the light of a lamp; and there shall never be heard in you again the voices of bridegroom and bride; because it was the magnates of the earth who were your merchants, because by your witchcraft all the nations were misguided.

EWE: 24 Ɛ̃, wokpɔ nyagblɔɖilawo kple ame kɔkɔewo kpakple ame siwo katã wowu le anyigba dzi la ƒe ʋu le du sia me. "
ENGLISH: 24 And in her was found the blood of prophets and holy men and of all who have been slaughtered on earth. "

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 19 Le nu sia megbe la, mese gbe aɖe abe ameha gã aɖe ƒe gbe ene le dziƒo. Wogblɔ be: "Mikafu Yah!
ENGLISH: 19 After this I heard what seemed like the loud voice of a great crowd in heaven saying "Hallelujah!

EWE: Xɔname kple ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ nye mía Mawu la tɔ, 2 elabena eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo nye nyateƒe, eye wole dzɔdzɔe. Elabena edrɔ̃ ʋɔnu gbolo gã si tsɔ eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ gblẽ anyigba la, eye wòbia eƒe kluviwo ƒe ʋu ƒe hlɔ̃e. " 3 Eye enumake wogblɔ zi evelia be: "Mikafu Yah!
ENGLISH: Salvation and glory and power belong to our God, 2 because his judgments are true and just; because he has done justice on the great prostitute who debauched the earth with her prostitution, and has avenged his servants’ blood at her hands "; 3 and for the second time they said "Hallelujah! "

EWE: Eye gbolo la ƒe dzudzɔ le tutum le dziƒo yim tegbetegbe. "
ENGLISH: And her smoke goes up forever and ever.

EWE: 6 Eye mese gbe aɖe abe ameha gã aɖe ƒe gbeɖiɖi kple tsi geɖewo ƒe gbeɖiɖi kple dziɖegbe sesẽwo ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene. Wogblɔ be: "Mikafu Yah, elabena Yehowa, mía Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, dze fiaɖuɖu gɔme! 7 Mina míakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye míatso aseye ahatsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe anae, elabena Alẽvi la ƒe srɔ̃ɖeɖe la ɖo, eye srɔ̃a dzra eɖokui ɖo. 8 Ɛ̃, woɖe mɔ be woatsɔ aklala biɖibiɖi wu dzadzɛ si le dzo dam la aɖo atsyɔ̃ nɛ, elabena aklala biɖibiɖi wu la le tsitre ɖi na ame kɔkɔewo ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔwo. " 9 Eye mawudɔla la gblɔ nam be, "Ŋlɔ bena: Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye ame siwo wokpe va Alẽvi la ƒe srɔ̃ɖeɖe ƒe fiẽnuɖuƒe la. " Eye wògagblɔ nam be: "Nya siawo nye Mawu ƒe nya vavãwo. " 10 Ale medze klo ɖe eƒe afɔnu be made ta agu nɛ. Ke egblɔ nam be: "Kpɔ nyuie! Mègawɔ nu ma o!
ENGLISH: 4 And the twenty-four aged men and the four creatures threw themselves down and did reverence to God who sits on the throne, saying "Amen; hallelujah! " 5 And from the throne came a voice saying "Praise our God, all his servants, you who fear him, small and great! " 6 And I heard what seemed as if it were the voices of a great crowd and the sound of much water and the pealing of strong thunders, all saying "Hallelujah, because the Lord our God Almighty has come into his reign! 7 Let us be glad and exult and give him glory, because the Lamb’s wedding has come and his wife has made her preparations 8 and has been given the privilege of dressing in bright clean lawn (because the lawn is the righteousnesses of God’s people). " 9 And he said to me "Write ‘Happy are those who are invited to the Lamb’s wedding dinner’ "; and he said to me "These words are true words of God’s. " 10 And I threw myself down before his feet to do him reverence; and he said to me "See that you do not!

EWE: Nye hã kluvi ko menye abe wò ke ene kpe ɖe nɔviwò siwo lé Yesu ŋuti ɖaseɖiɖidɔ la me ɖe asi ŋu. De ta agu na Mawu!
ENGLISH: I am a fellow-servant with you and your brothers that have the testimony of Jesus; do reverence to God.

EWE: Elabena ɖaseɖiɖi tso Yesu ŋue ʋãa amewo wogblɔa nya ɖi. "
ENGLISH: For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. "

EWE: Eye woyɔ ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la be Nuteƒewɔla kple Nyateƒetɔ, eye wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu hewɔa aʋa dzɔdzɔe. 12 Eƒe ŋkuwo nye dzoƒaɖe, eye fiakuku geɖewo le ta nɛ. Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ si ame aɖeke menya o, negbe eya ŋutɔ ko la ɖe eŋu, 13 edo awudziwui si ƒo ʋu, eye eŋkɔe nye, Mawu Ƒe Nya La.
ENGLISH: 11 And I saw heaven opened, and there was a white horse with a rider called Faithful and True, who judges and wars on the side of right: 12 his eyes are flame and there are many crowns on his head, and he has a written name which nobody knows but he, 13 and is clad in a mantle dyed in blood, and is named The Word of God.

EWE: 14 Eye dziƒoʋakɔwo le sɔ ɣiwo dzi dze eyome, eye wodo aklala biɖibiɖi wu ɣi dzadzɛwo.
ENGLISH: 14 And the armies in heaven followed him on white horses, dressed in clean white lawn.

EWE: 15 Eye yi ɖaɖɛ legbe aɖe do tso eƒe nu me, be wòatsɔ adza dukɔwo, eye wòatsɔ gatikplɔ akplɔ wo. Efanyaa nu si le Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe dɔmedzoe helĩhehĩ ƒe wainfiãnu la me hã.
ENGLISH: 15 And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword to smite the nations with, and he shall drive them with an iron rod; and he treads the press of God Almighty’s fierce anger-wine.

EWE: 16 Eye woŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe eƒe awudziwui ŋu le eƒe ata ŋu be: fiawo dzi Fia kple aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ.
ENGLISH: 16 And he has on his mantle and on his thigh a written name, "King of Kings and Lord of Lords. "

EWE: 17 Mekpɔ mawudɔla aɖe hã wòle tsitre ɖe ɣe ŋkume, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe gã aɖe ɖo ɖe xe siwo katã dzona le yame la be: "Miva afii, miva ƒo ƒu ɖe Mawu ƒe fiẽnuɖuɖu gã la ŋu, 18 ne miaɖu fiawo ƒe lã, aʋafiagãwo ƒe lã, ame sesẽwo ƒe lã, sɔwo kple wo dolawo ƒe lã, kple amewo katã, ablɔɖemewo kpakple kluviwo, ame tsɛwo kple ame ŋkutawo ƒe lã. "
ENGLISH: 17 And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried with a loud voice to all the birds that fly in the zenith "Come, gather to God’s great banquet 18 to eat kings’ flesh and generals’ flesh and strong men’s flesh and flesh of horses and their riders and flesh of everybody, freemen and slaves and small and great. " 19 And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered for the war with the rider on the horse and with his army.

EWE: 19 Eye mekpɔ lã wɔadã la kple anyigbadzifiawo kpakple woƒe aʋakɔwo woƒo ƒu be yewoawɔ aʋa kple ame si bɔbɔ nɔ sɔ la dzi kple eƒe aʋakɔ la. 20 Eye wolé lã wɔadã la kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila, si wɔ dzesiwo le eŋkume tsɔ flu ame siwo xɔ lã wɔadã la ƒe dzesia, kple ame siwo de ta agu na eƒe legba la. Wotsɔ wo kple evea siaa ƒu gbe agbagbee ɖe dzota si me dzokpe le bibim le la me. 21 Ke wowu ame susɔeawo kple yi legbe si do tso sɔdola la ƒe nu me. Eye xewo katã ɖu woƒe lã ɖi ƒo.
ENGLISH: 20 And the beast was captured, and with it the pretended prophet who did before it the tokens by which he misled those that took the beast’s stamp and that did reverence to its image: the two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur; 21 and the rest were killed by the rider’s sword that came out of his mouth, and all the birds gorged on their flesh.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 20 Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla aɖe wòle ɖiɖim tso dziƒo, eye aʋlimesafui kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ gã aɖe le esi. 2 Elé ʋɔ driba, si nye da xoxo la, si nye Abosam kple Satana, eye wòblae ƒe akpe ɖeka. 3 Etsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe aʋli la me, eye wòtu nu ɖe enu hetre enu be wòagaflu dukɔwo azɔ o va se ɖe esime ƒe akpe ɖeka la wu enu hafi.
ENGLISH: 20 And I saw an angel come down out of the sky with the key of the abyss, and a great chain over his arm; 2 and he seized the serpent, the primeval snake, who is the Devil and Satan, and chained him for a thousand years 3 and threw him into the abyss and locked and sealed it over him, that he might no longer mislead the nations until the thousand years are finished: after this he must be unchained a little while.

EWE: Le nu sia megbe la, woaɖe asi le eŋu ɣeyiɣi vi aɖe. 4 Eye mekpɔ fiazikpuiwo, eye wona ŋusẽ ame siwo bɔbɔ nɔ wo dzi la be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu. Ɛ̃, mekpɔ ame siwo wowu le ɖaseɖiɖi le Yesu ŋu kple nuƒoƒo tso Mawu ŋu ta la ƒe luʋɔwo, kple ame siwo mede ta agu na lã wɔadã la alo eƒe legba la o, eye womexɔ dzesi la ɖe woƒe ŋgonu kple woƒe asi ŋu o. Wogbɔ agbe, eye woɖu fia kple Kristo la ƒe akpe ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 4 And I saw thrones, and they sat on them and were given a judgment to render; and the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as had not done reverence to the beast nor to its image and had not taken the stamp on their foreheads and hands, and they came to life and reigned with the Christ for a thousand years.

EWE: 5 (Ame kuku mamlɛawo megbɔ agbe o va se ɖe esime ƒe akpe ɖeka la wu enu hafi.)
ENGLISH: 5 The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years are finished.

EWE: Esiae nye tsitretsitsi gbãtɔ la.
ENGLISH: This is the first resurrection.

EWE: 6 Dzidzɔtɔ kple kɔkɔetɔe nye ame si kpɔ gome le tsitretsitsi gbãtɔ la me; ku evelia mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe ame siawo dzi o, ke boŋ woanye Mawu kple Kristo ƒe nunɔlawo, eye woaɖu fia kplii ƒe akpe ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 6 Happy and holy is he who has a part in the first resurrection: over these the second death does not have dominion, but they shall be priests of God and the Christ and shall reign with him for the thousand years.

EWE: 7 Ke ne ƒe akpe ɖeka la wu enu ko la, woaɖe Satana le gaxɔa me, 8 eye wòayi aɖaflu dukɔ siwo le anyigba la ƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi, siwo nye Gog kple Magog, be wòaƒo wo nu ƒu hena aʋawɔwɔ. Ame siawo ƒe xexlẽme le abe ƒutake ene.
ENGLISH: 7 And when the thousand years are finished Satan will be unchained from his prison 8 and will come out to mislead the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them to the war; of whom the number is like the sand of the sea.

EWE: 9 Wokaka ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi, eye woƒo xlã ame kɔkɔewo ƒe asaɖa kple du lɔlɔ̃a. Ke dzo tso dziƒo va fiã wo. 10 Eye wotsɔ Abosam si le wo blem la ƒu gbe ɖe dzota, si me dzokpe le bibim le la me, afi si lã wɔadã la kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila la siaa le xoxo; eye woawɔ fu wo zã kple keli tegbetegbee.
ENGLISH: 9 And they came up over the breadth of the land and surrounded the camp of God’s people and the beloved city; and fire came down out of the sky and devoured them, 10 and the Devil their misleader was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, the same where the beast and the pretended prophet are, and they shall be tortured day and night forever and ever.

EWE: 11 Eye mekpɔ fiazikpui ɣi gã aɖe kple Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi. Anyigba kple dziƒo sí le eŋkume, eye womekpɔ teƒe aɖeke na wo o.
ENGLISH: 11 And I saw a great white throne and the One who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heavens fled and there was no place to be found for them.

EWE: 12 Eye mekpɔ ame kukuwo, ame tsɛwo kple ame ŋkutawo siaa, le tsitre ɖe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, eye woʋu agbalẽwo. Eye woʋu agbalẽ bubu aɖe; eyae nye agbegbalẽ la. Eye wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame kukuawo ɖe nu siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽawo me le woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋuti la nu.
ENGLISH: 12 And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened; and another book was opened, which is that of life; and the dead were judged out of what was written in the books, in accordance with their deeds.

EWE: 13 Eye atsiaƒu ɖe ame kuku siwo le eme la na, eye ku kple Tsiẽƒe ɖe ame kuku siwo le wo me la na, eye wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu.
ENGLISH: 13 And the sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and the world below gave up the dead that were in them, and they were judged each one in accordance with their deeds.

EWE: 14 Eye wotsɔ ku kple Tsiẽƒe ƒu gbe ɖe dzota la me. Dzota sia le tsitre ɖi na ku evelia.
ENGLISH: 14 And death and the world below were thrown into the lake of fire: this is the second death, the lake of fire.

EWE: 15 Azɔ hã, wotsɔ ame sia ame si ƒe ŋkɔ womekpɔ le agbegbalẽa me o la ƒu gbe ɖe dzota la me.
ENGLISH: 15 And whoever was not found written down in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 21 Eye mekpɔ dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye; elabena dziƒo tsãtɔ kple anyigba tsãtɔ nu va yi, eye atsiaƒu megali o. 2 Mekpɔ du kɔkɔe, si nye Yerusalem Yeye la hã wòle ɖiɖim tso dziƒo gbɔna tso Mawu gbɔ, eye wodzrae ɖo abe ŋugbetɔ si wowɔ leke na hena srɔ̃a ene. 3 Eye mese gbe gã aɖe tso fiazikpui la gbɔ wògblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 21 And I saw new heavens and a new earth for the former heavens and the former earth are gone, and the sea no longer exists 2 and I saw the sacred city Jerusalem new, I saw it come down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

EWE: 5 Eye Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la gblɔ be: "Kpɔ ɖa! Mele nuwo katã wɔm yeyee. " Eye wògagblɔ hã be: "Ŋlɔe, elabena nya siawo nye nyateƒenyawo kple nya vavãwo. " 6 Eye wògblɔ nam be: "Wova eme!
ENGLISH: 3 And I heard a loud voice out of the throne say "Lo, God’s abode is with men and he will abide with them, and they shall be his peoples and he will be God with them 4 and will wipe away every tear out of their eyes, and death will no longer exist, nor will mourning nor outcry nor pain any longer exist, because former things are gone "; 5 and he who sat on the throne said "Lo, I am making everything new "; and it said "Write, because these words are true and trustworthy. " 6 And he said to me "The work is done.

EWE: Nyee nye Alfa kple Omega, gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu.
ENGLISH: I am the A and the Z, the beginning and the end.

EWE: Ame sia ame si tsikɔ le wuwum la, mana tsi si le sisim tso agbetsidzɔƒe lae faa.
ENGLISH: I will give him who is thirsty free water from the spring of the water of life.

EWE: 7 Ame sia ame si ɖu dzi la anyi nu siawo ƒe dome, eye manye eƒe Mawu, eye eya anye vinye.
ENGLISH: 7 The victor shall inherit these things, and I will be his God and he shall be my son.

EWE: 8 Ke vɔvɔ̃nɔtɔwo, dzimaxɔsetɔwo, ŋunyɔnuwɔlawo, amewulawo, ahasiwɔlawo, gbɔgbɔyɔlawo, trɔ̃subɔlawo kple aʋatsokalawo katã ya la, woakpɔ wo tɔ gome le dzota si me dzokpe le bibim le la me.
ENGLISH: 8 But as for cowards and disbelievers and scoundrels and murderers and libertines and witchcraft-users and idolaters, and all liars, their portion shall be in the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is the second death. "

EWE: Esia le tsitre ɖi na ku evelia. " 9 Eye mawudɔla adre siwo lé kplu adre siwo me yɔ fũu kple fuwɔame adre mamlɛawo ɖe asi la dometɔ ɖeka va gblɔ nam be: "Va mafia ŋugbetɔ la, ame si nye Alẽvi la srɔ̃ la wò. " 10 Eye wòkɔm le gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ŋusẽ me yi to gã kɔkɔ aɖe dzi, eye wòɖe du kɔkɔe, Yerusalem, si le ɖiɖim tso dziƒo tso Mawu gbɔ la fiam, 11 eye Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le eŋu. Eƒe keklẽ le abe kpe xɔasi ŋutɔ aɖe ene, eye wòle dzo dam abe yaspis-kpe si me kɔ abe kristalo ene. 12 Gli kɔkɔ titri aɖe le eŋu, eye agbo wuieve le eŋu, eye mawudɔla wuieve le agboawo nu, eye woŋlɔ Israel-to wuieveawo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe agboawo ŋu. 13 Agbo etɔ̃ le ɣedzeƒe gome, eye agbo etɔ̃ le dziehe gome, agbo etɔ̃ le anyiehe gome, eye agbo etɔ̃ le ɣetoɖoƒe gome. 14 Woɖo gɔmeɖokpe wuieve na dua ƒe gli la hã, eye woŋlɔ Alẽvi la ƒe apostolo wuieveawo ƒe ŋkɔ wuieveawo ɖe wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 And one of the seven angels that had the seven saucers full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying "Come, I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife. " 10 And he took me in the spirit to a great high mountain and showed me the sacred city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God, 11 having God’s glory: what it is lighted by is like a most precious stone, as if it were a crystalline jaspid stone; 12 it has a great high wall, and has twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on the gates which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel 13 on the east three gates and on the north three gates and on the south three gates and on the west three gates; 14 and the wall of the city has twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the Lamb’s twelve apostles.

EWE: 15 Ke ame si le nu ƒom kplim la lé sikanudzidzeti si le abe aɖa ene la ɖe asi be yeadzidze du la kple eƒe agbowo kpakple eƒe gli la.
ENGLISH: 15 And the one who spoke with me had a measure, a golden reed, to measure the city and its gates and its wall.

EWE: 16 Du la le dzogoe ene me, eye eƒe didime kple eƒe kekeme sɔ.
ENGLISH: 16 And the city stands as a square, its length the same as its breadth.

EWE: Eye wòtsɔ nudzidzeti la dzidze du la: ele stadio akpe wuieve; eƒe didime, kekeme kple kɔkɔme sɔ.
ENGLISH: And he measured the city with the reed for twelve thousand stadia: its length and its breadth and its height are equal.

EWE: 17 Edzidze eƒe gli la hã kple amegbetɔ ƒe nudzidzenu si ganye mawudɔla hã ƒe nudzidzenu wòle abɔklugui alafa ɖeka blaene vɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 17 And he measured its wall, a hundred and forty-four cubits, man’s measure, which is angel’s measure.

EWE: 18 Ke wotsɔ yaspis-kpe ɖo eƒe gli lae, eye du la nye sika dzadzɛ abe ahuhɔ̃e si me kɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 18 And the masonry of its wall was jaspid; and the city was pure gold like pure glass.

EWE: 19 Wotsɔ kpe xɔasi ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ɖo atsyɔ̃ na dua ƒe gɔmeɖoanyi: gɔmeɖokpe gbãtɔ nye yaspis, evelia nye safir, etɔ̃lia nye kalkedon, enelia nye emerald, 20 atɔ̃lia nye sardonik, adelia nye sardis, adrelia nye krisolit, enyilia nye beril, asiekelia nye topaz, ewolia nye krisopas, wuiɖekɛlia nye hiakint, eye wuievelia nye ametist.
ENGLISH: 19 The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jaspid, the second lapis lazuli, the third dioptase, the fourth emerald, 20 the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sard, the seventh topaz, the eighth beryl, the ninth peridot, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh sapphire, the twelfth amethyst.

EWE: 21 Eye agbo wuieveawo nye dzonu wuieve; wotsɔ dzonu ɖeka wɔ agboawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe.
ENGLISH: 21 And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: each one of the gates was made of one pearl.

EWE: Eye du la ƒe ablɔ gã la nye sika dzadzɛ, abe ahuhɔ̃e, si me wokpɔa nu tonɛ ene.
ENGLISH: And the avenues of the city were pure gold, that seemed as if it were transparent glass.

EWE: 22 Nyemekpɔ gbedoxɔ le dua me o, elabena Yehowa Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la kple Alẽvi lae nye eƒe gbedoxɔ.
ENGLISH: 22 And I did not see any temple in it; for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.

EWE: 23 Eye du la mehiã ɣe alo ɣleti be woaklẽ ɖe edzi o, elabena Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe klẽ ɖe edzi, eye Alẽvi lae nye eƒe akaɖi.
ENGLISH: 23 And the city does not need the sun or the moon to shine for it; for God’s glory lights it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

EWE: 25 Womatu eƒe agbowo le ŋkeke me akpɔ o, elabena zã mado le afi ma o. 26 Eye woatsɔ dukɔwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu ava eme. 27 Ke nu makɔmakɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple ame sia ame si wɔa ŋunyɔnu hekaa aʋatso la mage ɖe eme akpɔ o; negbe ame siwo ƒe ŋkɔ woŋlɔ ɖe Alẽvi la ƒe agbegbalẽ la me koe age ɖe eme.
ENGLISH: 24 And the nations will walk through its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory to it; 25 and its gates shall not be shut by day (for there will be no night there), 26 and they will bring the glory and honor of the nations to it; 27 and there shall not enter it any unholy thing and doer of abomination and falsehood, but those who are written down in the Lamb’s book of life.

EWE: Nyaɖeɖefia
ENGLISH: Revelation

EWE: 22 Eye wòfia agbetsitɔsisi aɖem, si me kɔ abe kristalo-kpe ene, eye wòle sisim tso Mawu kple Alẽvi la ƒe fiazikpui la gbɔ 2 va to du la ƒe ablɔ gã la titina. Eye agbetiwo le tɔsisi la ƒe go eveawo dzi, eye wotsena zi wuieve ƒe sia ƒe, wotsena ɣleti sia ɣleti. Woƒe aŋgbawo nye dɔyɔgbe na dukɔwo.
ENGLISH: 22 And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, running out of the throne of God and the Lamb 2 through the middle of its main avenue; and on this side of the river and on that side were trees of life producing twelve crops of fruit, bringing in their fruit each month; and the leaves of the trees were for curing the diseases of the nations.

EWE: 3 Eye fiƒode aɖeke maganɔ anyi azɔ o.
ENGLISH: 3 And there will no longer be any ban.

EWE: Ke boŋ Mawu kple Alẽvi la ƒe fiazikpui la anɔ du la me, eye Mawu ƒe kluviwo awɔ subɔsubɔdɔ kɔkɔe nɛ; 4 eye woakpɔ eƒe ŋkume, eye eƒe ŋkɔ anɔ woƒe ŋgonu.
ENGLISH: And the throne of God and the Lamb will be in it; and his servants, 4 his name on their foreheads, will worship him and see his face.

EWE: 5 Eye zã megale dodo ge o, womahiã akaɖi alo ɣe ƒe keklẽ o, elabena Yehowa Mawu aklẽ na wo, eye woaɖu fia tegbetegbee.
ENGLISH: 5 And there will no longer be night, and they do not need lamplight and sunlight, because the Lord God will light them; and they will reign forever and ever.

EWE: 6 Eye wògblɔ nam be: "Nya siawo nye nyateƒenyawo kple nya vavãwo, ɛ̃, Yehowa, Mawu si na eƒe gbɔgbɔ ʋã nyagblɔɖilawo la, dɔ eƒe dɔla ɖa be wòaɖe nu siwo ava dzɔ kpuie la afia eƒe kluviwo.
ENGLISH: 6 And he said to me "These words are true and trustworthy, and the Lord, the God of the prophets’ spirits, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.

EWE: 7 Kpɔ ɖa! Megbɔna kpuie.
ENGLISH: 7 And lo, I am coming quickly.

EWE: Dzidzɔtɔe nye ame sia ame si léa nyagblɔɖinya siwo le agbalẽ sia me la me ɖe asi. " 8 Nye Yohanes, nyee nye ame si se nu siawo eye mekpɔ wo. Eye esi mese nu siawo eye mekpɔ wo la, medze klo ɖe mawudɔla si ɖe wo fiam la ƒe afɔnu be made ta agu nɛ. 9 Ke egblɔ nam be: "Kpɔ nyuie! Mègawɔ nu ma o!
ENGLISH: Happy is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book. " 8 And it was I, John, who heard and saw these things; and when I heard and saw, I threw myself down to do reverence before the feet of the angel who was showing me these things, 9 and he said to me "See that you do not!

EWE: Nye hã kluvi ko menye abe wò ke ene kpe ɖe nɔviwò, siwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo kpakple ame siwo léa agbalẽ sia me nyawo me ɖe asi la ŋu. De ta agu na Mawu. "
ENGLISH: I am a fellow-servant with you and your brothers the prophets and those who keep the words of this book; do reverence to God. "

EWE: 10 Egagblɔ nam be: "Mègatre nyagblɔɖinya siwo le agbalẽ sia me la nu o, elabena ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖi la tu aƒe.
ENGLISH: 10 And he said to me "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is near.

EWE: 11 Nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔla nenɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ la dzi, ɖinuwɔla nenɔ ɖinuwɔwɔ la dzi; ke nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla hã nenɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ la dzi, eye ame si le kɔkɔe la neyi edzi wòanɔ kɔkɔe. 12 "‘Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 11 Let the wronger still wrong and the grimy still go grimy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still act holily: 12 lo, I am coming quickly, with my pay with me to pay each as his work is.

EWE: 13 Nyee nye Alfa kple Omega, gbãtɔ kple mlɔetɔ, gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu.
ENGLISH: 13 I am the A and the Z, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

EWE: 14 Dzidzɔtɔwoe nye ame siwo nya woƒe awu ʋlayawo, ne woana ŋusẽ wo be woayi agbetiawo gbɔ, eye woato du la ƒe agbowo nu age ɖe eme. 15 Avuwo kple afakalawo kple ahasiwɔlawo kple amewulawo kple trɔ̃subɔlawo kple ame sia ame si lɔ̃a aʋatsokaka, eye wòkanɛ la, woawo ya woatsi agbo la godo.’
ENGLISH: 14 Happy are those who wash their robes, that their rights may extend to the trees of life and they may enter the city by the gates; 15 outside are the dogs and the witchcraft-users and the libertines and the murderers and the idolaters and everybody who loves falsehood and does it.

EWE: 16 "‘Nye, Yesu, ye dɔ nye mawudɔla ɖa be wòaɖi ɖase le nu siawo ŋuti na mi hena hameawo.
ENGLISH: 16 I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony over the churches.

EWE: Nyee nye David ƒe kè kple eƒe dzidzimevi kpakple ŋukeɣletivi keklẽ la.’ "
ENGLISH: I am the root and line of David, the bright morning star. "

EWE: 17 Eye gbɔgbɔ la kple ŋugbetɔ la le gbɔgblɔm be, "Va! " eye ame sia ame si le esem la negblɔ be, "Va! " eye ame sia ame si tsikɔ le wuwum la neva; ame sia ame si lɔ̃ la, nexɔ agbetsi la no faa.
ENGLISH: 17 And the Spirit and the Bride are saying "Come! " and let him who hears say "Come! " and whoever is thirsty, come! take water of life free, whoever will!

EWE: 18 "Mele ɖase ɖim na ame sia ame si sea nyagblɔɖinya siwo le agbalẽ sia me la be: Ne ame aɖe tsɔ nane kpe ɖe nu siawo ŋu la, Mawu atsɔ fuwɔame siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la akpe ɖe eŋu nɛ; 19 eye ne ame aɖe ɖe nane le nyagblɔɖinya siwo le agbalẽ sia me la me la, Mawu aɖe eƒe gome ɖa le nu siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la me: maɖe mɔ nɛ be wòaɖu agbetiawo ƒe tsetsewo o, eye maɖe mɔ nɛ be wòanɔ du kɔkɔe la me o.
ENGLISH: 18 I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book that if one puts anything on to it God will put on him the scourges that are written in this book, 19 and if one takes anything away from the words of the book of this prophecy God will take his portion away from the trees of life, and from the sacred city, that are written in this book.

EWE: 20 "Ame si le ɖase ɖim le nu siawo ŋu la gblɔ be: ‘Ɛ̃, megbɔna kpuie.’ "
ENGLISH: 20 Says he who gives this testimony, "Yes, I am coming quickly. "

EWE: "Amen! Aƒetɔ Yesu, va. "
ENGLISH: Amen: come, Lord Jesus.

EWE: 21 Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe amenuveve nanɔ anyi kple ame kɔkɔeawo.
ENGLISH: 21 The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s people.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 1 Le Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose ƒe ku megbe la, Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua, Nun vi, si nye Mose ƒe subɔvi be:
ENGLISH: 1 And after the death of Jehovah’s servant Moses, Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ the son of Nun, Moses’s attendant,

EWE: 2 “Nye subɔla Mose ku. Azɔ tso nàtso Yordan, wò kple dukɔ blibo sia katã, ne miayi anyigba si metsɔ le Israel-viwo nam la dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 “My servant Moses is dead; now set out and cross this Jordan, you and all this people, to the country I am giving to them.

EWE: 3 Matsɔ teƒe sia teƒe si miaɖo afɔe la ana mi, abe ale si medo ŋugbe na Mose ene.
ENGLISH: 3 Every place that your foot shall tread on I have given to you, as I promised Moses.

EWE: 4 Miaƒe anyigba la akeke tso gbea dzi ayi Lebanon, eye wòatso Frat, tɔsisi gã la nu, Hititɔwo ƒe anyigba blibo la katã, va se ɖe Ƒu Gã la nu le ɣetoɖoƒe.
ENGLISH: 4 From the wilderness and the Lebanon to the great river, the river Euphrates, and to the great sea where the sun sets, shall be your territory.

EWE: 5 Ame aɖeke manɔ te ɖe nuwò le wò agbemeŋkekewo katã me o. Ale si ko menɔ kple Mose la, nenemae manɔ kpli wò hã. Nyemaɖe asi le ŋuwò o, eye nyemagblẽ wò ɖi o.
ENGLISH: 5 Not a man shall stand his ground before you as long as you live; as I was with Moses I will be with you; I will not neglect you nor abandon you.

EWE: 6 Lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye nàsẽ ŋu, elabena wòe akplɔ dukɔ sia wòaxɔ anyigba si ŋu meka atam ɖo na wo tɔgbuiwo be matsɔ ana wo wòazu wo tɔ la.
ENGLISH: 6 Courage, and do your best, because you shall establish this people in the country I swore to their fathers to give them.

EWE: 7 “Lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye nàsẽ ŋu vevie eye nàwɔ Se siwo katã nye subɔla Mose de na wò la dzi pɛpɛpɛ ko. Mègadze le eŋu ɖe ɖusime alo miame o, ne nàwɔ nu le nunya me le afi sia afi si nàyi.
ENGLISH: 7 Only courage, and do your very best to take care to live up to all that my servant Moses enjoined upon you; do not turn from it to right or to left, in order that you may do well wherever you go.

EWE: 8 Mègaɖe nu le Segbalẽ sia ŋu o, ke boŋ xlẽe kple gbe blewu zã kple keli, be nàwɔ nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe eme la dzi pɛpɛpɛ; ekema wò mɔwo adze edzi na wò, eye àwɔ nu le nunya me.
ENGLISH: 8 This book of the code is never to pass out of your mouth: you are to study it day and night, in order that you may take care to live up to everything that is written in it, because then you will succeed in your efforts and will do well.

EWE: 9 Ðe nyemede se na wò be nàlé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye nàsẽ ŋu oa? Mègavɔ̃ o, eye ŋɔ megadzi wò o, elabena Yehowa wò Mawu li kpli wò le afi sia afi si nàyi.”
ENGLISH: 9 You have my orders: courage, and do your best; do not be overawed nor dismayed, because your God Jehovah is with you wherever you go.”

EWE: 10 Eye Yosua de se na dukɔ la dzi kpɔlawo gblɔ be:
ENGLISH: 10 And Joshuaʽ gave orders to the marshals of the people,

EWE: 11 “Mitsa le asaɖa la me, eye mide se na dukɔ la be: ‘Midzra nu siwo ahiã mi la ɖo, elabena ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la, miatso Yordan ayi anyigba, si Yehowa mia Mawu tsɔ le mia nam be miaxɔe wòazu mia tɔ la dzi.’”
ENGLISH: 11 “Pass through the interior of the camp and give the people the order ‘Get ready provisions for yourselves, because in three days more you are crossing this Jordan to go in to take possession of the country your God Jehovah is giving to you to possess.’”

EWE: 12 Eye Yosua gblɔ na Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo kpakple Manase-toa ƒe afã la be:
ENGLISH: 12 And to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshuaʽ said

EWE: 13 “Miɖo ŋku nya si Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose gblɔ na mi la dzi be: ‘Yehowa mia Mawu ana gbɔɖeme mi, eye wòatsɔ anyigba sia ana mi.
ENGLISH: 13 “Remember the thing Jehovah’s servant Moses enjoined on you: your God Jehovah is bringing you to rest and giving you this country;

EWE: 14 Mia srɔ̃wo, mia viwo kple miaƒe lãhawo anɔ anyigba si Mose tsɔ na mi le Yordan ƒe go sia dzi la dzi, gake miaƒe aʋakalẽawo katã nabla aʋakpa atso tɔa le mia nɔviwo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 14 your women, your children, and your stock shall stay in the country Jehovah’s servant Moses gave you on the other side of the Jordan, but you shall go over under arms before your brothers, all the first-class men, and help them,

EWE: Eye miakpe ɖe wo ŋu 15 va se ɖe esime Yehowa nana gbɔɖeme mia nɔviwo, abe ale si wòna mii ene, eye woawo hã woaxɔ anyigba si Yehowa mia Mawu tsɔ le wo nam be wòazu wo tɔ la. Emegbe hafi miatrɔ ayi anyigba si wotsɔ na mi be mianɔ edzi eye wòazu mia tɔ la dzi, anyigba si Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose tsɔ na mi le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe.’”
ENGLISH: 15 till Jehovah brings your brothers to rest like you and they too take possession of the country your God Jehovah is giving them, and you come back to the country that is your possession, which Jehovah’s servant Moses gave to you on the other side of the Jordan.”

EWE: 16 Woɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Míawɔ se siwo katã nède na mí la dzi, eye míayi afi sia afi si nàɖo mí ɖo.
ENGLISH: 16 And they answered Joshuaʽ “We will do just as you have ordered us and go wherever you send us;

EWE: 17 Ale si ko míeɖo to Mose le nu sia nu mee la, nenema ke míaɖo to wò hãe.
ENGLISH: 17 we will obey you just the same as we obeyed Moses; only your God Jehovah be with you as he was with Moses.

EWE: Yehowa wò Mawu nenɔ kpli wò ko, abe ale si wònɔ kple Mose ene. 18 Ame sia ame si adze aglã ɖe wò sedede ŋu, eye maɖo to wò nya siwo katã nàgblɔ nɛ o la, woawui.
ENGLISH: 18 Any man who disobeys you and does not listen to your words as to any order you give us shall be put to death; only courage, and do your best.”

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 2 Eye Yosua, Nun vi la, dɔ ŋutsu eve tso Sitim le adzame be woayi aɖatsa ŋku. Egblɔ na wo be: “Miyi ɖakpɔ ale si anyigba la le, vevietɔ Yeriko.”
ENGLISH: 2 And Joshuaʽ the son of Nun sent from the Acacias two men as scouts quietly, with the commission “Go see the country, and Jericho.”

EWE: Eya ta woyi, eye woge ɖe gbolo aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Rahab la ƒe me, eye wotsi afi ma.
ENGLISH: And they went, and came into the house of a prostitute name Rahab, and went to bed.

EWE: 2 Amewo yi ɖagblɔ na Yeriko-fia be: “Kpɔ ɖa! Israel ŋutsu aɖewo va afi sia zã sia me be yewoatsa ŋku le anyigba la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 2 And the king of Jericho was told “Men from the sons of Israel ha come here tonight to examine the country”;

EWE: 3 Ale Yeriko-fia dɔ ame ɖe Rahab be: “Kplɔ ŋutsu siwo va dze aƒewò me la do goe, elabena ŋku tsa gee wova le anyigba blibo la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 3 and the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab “Hand out the men that went in to you, that have come to you, that have come to your house, because it was to examine all the country that they came.”

EWE: 4 Ke nyɔnu la tsɔ ŋutsu eveawo ɣla. Eye wògblɔ be: “Nyateƒee, ŋutsuawo nya va gbɔnye baa, gake nyemenya afi si wotso o.
ENGLISH: 4 And the woman took the two men and secreted them, and said “The men did come in to me, but I did not know where they were from;

EWE: 5 Esime anyigba tsyɔ, eye agboawo tuɣi ɖo la, ŋutsuawo do go.
ENGLISH: 5 and when the gate was going to be shut at dark the men went out.

EWE: Nyemenya afi si woɖo tae o, gake ne mieti wo yome kaba la, miatu wo.”
ENGLISH: I do not know where the men went; follow them up quick, you will overtake them.”

EWE: 6 (Evɔ wònye ekplɔ wo yi xɔ ta, eye wòɣla wo ɖe ɖetifu siwo woli kɔ ɖe fliwo me le xɔa ta la dome hafi.)
ENGLISH: 6 But she had taken them up on the roof and buried them in the flax-stalks she had laid out on the roof;

EWE: 7 Eye ameawo ti wo yome ɖo ta Yordan tɔtsoƒe la, eye esi ame siwo ti wo yome nya do go ko la, wodo agbo la.
ENGLISH: 7 and the men pursued them on the Jordan road to the fords, and they shut the gate when the men pursuing them had gone out.

EWE: 8 Hafi ŋutsuawo namlɔ anyi la, nyɔnua va wo gbɔ le xɔa ta.
ENGLISH: 8 And they had not yet gone to bed when she came up on the roof to them

EWE: 9 Eye wògblɔ na ŋutsuawo be: “Menya be Yehowa atsɔ anyigba la ana mi, eye vɔvɔ̃ si le mia ŋu la lé mí.
ENGLISH: 9 and said to the men “I know that Jehovah has given the country to you, and that the terror of you has fallen on us

EWE: Dzi ɖe le anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã ƒo le mia ta, 10 elabena míese ale si Yehowa na Ƒudzĩ la mie le mia ŋgɔ esime mieʋu dzo le Egipte, kple nu si miewɔ Amori-fia eve, siwo nye Sihon kple Og, ame siwo mietsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi le Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi.
ENGLISH: 10 because we have heard how Jehovah dried up the water of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites on the other side of the Jordan, Sihon and ʽOg, whom you cut down without quarter

EWE: 11 Esi míesee la, dzi ɖe le mía ƒo, eye dzi megale ame aɖeke ƒo o le mia ta, elabena Yehowa mia Mawu lae nye Mawu le dziƒo afi mɛ kple anyigba dzi afii.
ENGLISH: 11 and we heard of it and of hearts melted down, and no spirit stood up again in anybody because of you, because your god Jehovah is a god in the sky above and on the earth below.

EWE: 12 Eya ta meɖe kuku, mika atam nam le Yehowa ŋkɔ me, be esi meve mia nu ta la, miawo hã miave fofonye ƒe aƒe la nu; eye mina dzesi si ŋu kakaɖedzi le lam, 13 be miana fofonye kple danye, nɔvinyeŋutsuwo kple nɔvinyenyɔnuwo kple wo ƒemetɔwo katã natsi agbe, eye miaɖe mí tso ku me.”
ENGLISH: 12 Now swear to me by Jehovah, because I have befriended you, and befriend me and my family and give me a pledge of loyalty, 13 and keep my father and mother and brothers and sisters alive, and all that belongs to them, and rescue our persons from death.”

EWE: 14 Eye ŋutsuawo gblɔ nɛ be: “Míatsɔ míaƒe agbe ana ɖe mia ta! Ne miegblɔ nu si wɔ ge míeva ame aɖeke se o la, ekema míave nuwò ahawɔ nuteƒe na wò ne Yehowa tsɔ anyigba la na mí.”
ENGLISH: 14 And the men said to her “Our persons instead of yours for death if you do not tell this affair of ours; and when Jehovah gives us the country we will befriend you loyally.”

EWE: 15 Ema megbe la, ena woɖiɖi kple ka to eƒe xɔ si le dua ƒe gli dzi la, ƒe fesre nu ɖe anyi.
ENGLISH: 15 And she let them down by a cord through the window, because her house was built into the wall and she lived against the wall,

EWE: Le nyateƒe me la, glia dzie eƒe aƒe le. 16 Eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Miyi tonuto la me, ne miabe ɖe afi ma ŋkeke etɔ̃, ale be mia yometilawo nagake ɖe mia ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 16 and said to them “Go to the highland, for fear you should meet with the pursuers, and hide there three days till the pursuers get back, and afterward you may go your own way.”

EWE: 17 Ŋutsuawo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Atam sia si nèna míeka la ƒe fɔɖiɖi manɔ mía dzi o
ENGLISH: 17 And the men said to her “We are clear of this oath of ours that you had us swear.

EWE: 18 negbe ne míeva anyigba la dzi, eye nèsa ka dzĩ sia ɖe fesre si nu nèɖiɖi mí toe la ŋu ko hafi. Eye ele be nàƒo fofowò kple dawò kple nɔviwòŋutsuwo kple fofowò ƒe aƒe blibo la katã nu ƒu ɖe gbɔwò le aƒea me.
ENGLISH: 18 Here, when we are coming into the country you shall tie this skein of scarlet thread in the window you let us down by, and get in your father and mother and brothers and all your family into the house with you;

EWE: 19 Eye ne ame aɖe do le wò aƒea me yi gota la, eƒe ʋu anɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ta dzi, ke míawo la, míaɖi fɔ o. Gake ne vɔ̃ aɖe dzɔ ɖe ame aɖe si le gbɔwò le aƒea me dzi la, ekema eƒe ʋu ava míaƒe ta dzi.
ENGLISH: 19 and anyone who goes outside the doors of your house, his blood shall be on his own head and we shall be clear; but anyone who is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our heads if hands are laid on him.

EWE: 20 Gake ne ègblɔ nu si wɔ ge míeva ame aɖe se la, ekema atam si nèna míeka la ƒe fɔɖiɖi aɖeke megale mía dzi o.”
ENGLISH: 20 But if you tell this affair of ours we are to be clear of your oath that you had us swear.”

EWE: 21 Eɖo eŋu be: “Neva eme le miaƒe nyawo nu.” Edo mɔ wo, eye wodzo. Emegbe esa ka dzĩ la ɖe fesrea ŋu.
ENGLISH: 21 And she said “That is right, as you say,” and sent them off, and they went; and she tied the skein of scarlet in the window.

EWE: 22 Ale wodzo, eye woyi tonuto la me, eye wonɔ afi ma ŋkeke etɔ̃, va se ɖe esime wo yometilawo trɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 22 And they went off into the highland and stayed there three days till the pursuers had got back; and the pursuers looked all along the road and did not find anybody.

EWE: Wo yometilawo di wo le mɔ sia mɔ dzi, gake womeke ɖe wo ŋu o. 23 Azɔ ŋutsu eveawo gbugbɔ tso toawo dzi, eye wotso tɔa va Yosua, Nun vi la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 23 And the two men came down again out of the highland and across to Joshuaʽ the son of Nun, and told him the story of everything that had happened to them;

EWE: Woka nu siwo katã dzɔ ɖe wo dzi la ta nɛ. 24 Eye wogblɔ na Yosua be: “Yehowa tsɔ anyigba blibo la de asi na mí. Le nyateƒe me la, dzi ɖe le anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã ƒo le mía ta.”
ENGLISH: 24 and they said to Joshuaʽ “Jehovah has given all the country into our hands, all the inhabitants of the country are in collapse before us.”

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 3 Yosua fɔ ŋdi kanya, eye eya kple Israel-viwo katã woho tso Sitim heva Yordan nu. Wotsi afi ma dɔ hafi tso tɔ la.
ENGLISH: 3 And the first thing in the morning Joshuaʽ, he and all the sons of Israel, marched from the Acacias and came to the Jordan; and they bivouacked there, not crossing yet.

EWE: 2 Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la, dzikpɔlawo tsa le asaɖa la me,
ENGLISH: 2 And at the end of three days the marshals passed through the camp

EWE: 3 eye wode se na dukɔ la be: “Ne mienya kpɔ nunɔla Lewi viwo wokɔ Yehowa mia Mawu ƒe nubablaɖaka la ko la, ekema miaho le mia nɔƒewo adze eyome.
ENGLISH: 3 and gave the people orders, “When you see the ark of the covenant of our God Jehovah, and the Levite priests carrying it, take up the march yourselves from your places and follow it.

EWE: 4 Gake mina mia kplii dome nadidi abe abɔklugui akpe eve ene; migate ɖe eŋu wu ema o, be mianya mɔ si miato, elabena miezɔ mɔ sia kpɔ o.”
ENGLISH: 4 Only have a long distance between you and it, a full half-mile; do not come near it, in order that you may know the road you are to go by, because you have never gone over this road before.”

EWE: 5 Azɔ Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Mikɔ mia ɖokuiwo ŋu, elabena etsɔ la, Yehowa le nukunuwo wɔ ge le mia dome.”
ENGLISH: 5 And Joshuaʽ said to the people “Hallow yourselves, because tomorrow Jehovah will do wonders among you.”

EWE: 6 Eye Yosua gblɔ na nunɔlawo be: “Mikɔ nubablaɖaka la dze dukɔ la ŋgɔ.” Ale wokɔ nubablaɖaka la, eye wodze dukɔ la ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 And Joshuaʽ said to the priests “Take up the ark of the covenant and pass before the people”; and they took up the ark of the covenant and went, before the people.

EWE: 7 Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Madze egɔme egbea ado gã wò le Israel blibo la katã ŋkume, ne woadze sii be, ale si tututu menɔ kple Mose la, nenemae manɔ kpli wò hã.
ENGLISH: 7 And Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ “This day I will begin to make you great before the eyes of all Israel, who shall know that as I was with Moses I will be with you.

EWE: 8 De se sia na nunɔla siwo kɔ nubablaɖaka la be: ‘Ne mienya ɖo afɔ Yordan tɔa me ko la, mitɔ ɖe tɔa me le afi ma.’”
ENGLISH: 8 And do you give the priests who carry the ark of the covenant the order ‘When you come to the edge of the water of the Jordan, stand still in the Jordan.’”

EWE: 9 Eye Yosua gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: “Miva afii, ne miase Yehowa mia Mawu ƒe nyawo.”
ENGLISH: 9 And Joshuaʽ said to the sons of Israel “Come here and listen to the words of your God Jehovah.”

EWE: 10 Yosua gagblɔ be: “Esia mee mianyae le be, Mawu gbagbe aɖe le mia dome, eye be anya Kanaantɔwo, Hititɔwo, Hivitɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Girgasitɔwo, Amoritɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ godoo.
ENGLISH: 10 And Joshuaʽ said “By this you are to know that you have a living Deity among you and he will dispossess before you the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Hivvites and the Perizzites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Jebusites.

EWE: 11 Kpɔ ɖa! Anyigba blibo la katã ƒe Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la dze mia ŋgɔ yina Yordan la me.
ENGLISH: 11 Here is the ark of the covenant of the Lord of All the Earth going along before you into the Jordan.

EWE: 12 Azɔ la, miɖe ŋutsu wuieve tso Israel-toawo me, to ɖeka ŋutsu ɖeka,
ENGLISH: 12 Now take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, one man to a tribe;

EWE: 13 eye ne nunɔla siwo kɔ Yehowa, anyigba blibo la katã ƒe Aƒetɔ la, ƒe Aɖaka la ƒe afɔƒome nya ka Yordan tsia me ko la, Yordan me tsi siwo le sisim tso dzigbe gbɔna anyime la nu atso, eye woatɔ ahamli ɖe teƒe ɖeka abe gli ene.”
ENGLISH: 13 and when the feet of the priests who carry the ark of Jehovah the Lord of All the Earth rest in the water of the Jordan, the water of the Jordan will be cut off, the water that comes down from above, and stand up in one heap.”

EWE: 14 Eya ta dukɔ la do go le woƒe agbadɔwo me yina Yordan tso ge, eye esi wòsusɔ vie woatso tɔa la, nunɔla siwo kɔ nubablaɖaka la nɔ dukɔ la ŋgɔ ɖe zɔ yi ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 14 And when the people took up the march from their tents to cross the Jordan, the priests that carried the ark of the covenant were ahead of the people;

EWE: 15 Eye esi Aɖaka la kɔlawo va ɖo Yordan nu, eye nunɔla siwo kɔ Aɖaka la ƒe afɔ nya ka tsiawo me ko la (Yordan ɖɔ gbagba gbɔ eƒe goawo katã ŋu le nuŋeɣi blibo la katã),
ENGLISH: 15 and when the bearers of the ark came to the Jordan and the feet of the priests carrying the ark dipped into the edge of the water (and the Jordan was full all over its flood-plain throughout harvesttime)

EWE: 16 tsi siwo le sisim tso dzigbe gbɔna anyime la tɔ. Womli kɔ abe gli ene va ɖo keke Adam, si nye du si le Zaretan xa ke, eye tsi siwo nɔ sisim yi Araba-ƒu, si nye Dzeƒu la, me la mie. Wo nu tso, eye dukɔ la tso tɔa le Yeriko ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 16 the water that came down from above stood still, rose up in one heap at a great distance, at Adam, the city to one side of Sarethan, and what was running down to the Dead Sea, the Sea of Salt, exhausted itself and was gone, and the people crossed over opposite Jericho.

EWE: 17 Nunɔla siwo kɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la tɔ ɖi maʋamaʋãe le ƒuƒuiƒe le Yordan titina, eye Israel blibo la zɔ to ƒuƒuiƒe le tɔa me nɔ yiyim va se ɖe esime dukɔ blibo la katã tso Yordan vɔ.
ENGLISH: 17 And the priests that carried the ark of Jehovah’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel were going across on dry ground, till all the nation were done crossing the Jordan.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 4 Esi dukɔ blibo la katã nya tso Yordan vɔ ko la, Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be:
ENGLISH: 4 And when all the nation were done crossing the Jordan, Jehovah spoke to Joshuaʽ, saying

EWE: 2 “Miɖe ŋutsu wuieve tso dukɔ la dome, to ɖeka ŋutsu ɖeka,
ENGLISH: 2 “Take out of the people twelve men, on man out of a tribe,

EWE: 3 eye nàde se sia na wo be: ‘Mikɔ kpe wuieve le Yordan titina, le afi si nunɔlawo tɔ ɖo maʋamaʋãe la, eye miakɔ wo ɖe asi aɖada ɖe teƒe si miatsi adɔ zã sia.’”
ENGLISH: 3 and give them the order ‘Take up from here, from the middle of the Jordan, from the standing-place of the priests’ feet, twelve stones, and take them over with you and put them down at the halting-place where you halt for the night.’”

EWE: 4 Eya ta Yosua yɔ ŋutsu wuieve siwo wòtia tso Israel-viwo dome, to ɖeka ŋutsu ɖeka,
ENGLISH: 4 And Joshuaʽ called the twelve men he had made ready out of the sons of Israel, one man out of a tribe;

EWE: 5 eye Yosua gblɔ na wo be: “Miyi Yehowa mia Mawu ƒe Aɖaka la ŋgɔ le Yordan titina, eye mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nakɔ kpe ɖeka ɖe abɔta, ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu,
ENGLISH: 5 and Joshuaʽ said to them “Go over before the ark of your God Jehovah to the middle of the Jordan and lift to your shoulders one stone each, for the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,

EWE: 6 ne woanye dzesi le mia dome. Ne mia viwo va bia mi gbe aɖe gbe be: ‘Nu ka tae kpe siawo le afii?’ mahã la,
ENGLISH: 6 in order that this may be a token among you, because your sons shall ask you tomorrow ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

EWE: 7 migblɔ na wo be: ‘Elabena Yordan me tsiawo nu tso le Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ. Esi wòto Yordan me la, Yordan me tsiawo nu tso.
ENGLISH: 7 and you shall say ‘That the water of the Jordan was cut off before the ark of Jehovah’s covenant when it crossed the Jordan’; and these stones shall be a commemoration to the sons of Israel forever.”

EWE: Kpe siawo anye ŋkuɖodzinu na Israel-viwo ɖaa.’” 8 Eya ta Israel-viwo wɔ abe ale si tututu Yosua de se ene. Wokɔ kpe wuieve le Yordan titina, abe ale si tututu Yehowa gblɔe na Yosua ene, ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu.
ENGLISH: 8 An the sons of Israel did so, as Joshuaʽ had commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Jehovah had told Joshuaʽ, for the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel, and took them over with them to the halting-place and put them down there.

EWE: Wokɔ wo yi afi si woatsi adɔ, eye woda wo ɖe afi ma. 9 Yosua ɖi kpe wuieve hã ɖe Yordan titina le afi si nunɔla siwo kɔ nubablaɖaka la tsi tsitre ɖo, eye wole afi ma va se ɖe egbe sia.
ENGLISH: 9 And Joshuaʽ set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan on that standing-place of the feet of the priests who carried the ark of the covenant, and they are there to this day.

EWE: 10 Nunɔla siwo kɔ Aɖakaa la tsi tsitre ɖe Yordan titina va se ɖe esime wowɔ nu siwo katã ƒe se Yehowa de na Yosua be wòagblɔ na dukɔa la vɔ, le se siwo katã Mose de na Yosua la nu. Ɣemaɣi la, dukɔ la zɔ kabakaba tso tɔa.
ENGLISH: 10 And the priests who carried the ark stood still in the middle of the Jordan till all the matter that Jehovah commanded Joshuaʽ to tell the people was done; and the people went across in haste;

EWE: 11 Esi dukɔ bliboa tso tɔa vɔ la, nunɔlawo kɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la va tɔa godo le dukɔ la ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 11 and when all the people were done crossing, the ark of Jehovah and the priests went across before the people.

EWE: 12 Eye Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase-to afã la bla aʋakpa dze Israel-viwo ŋgɔ tso tɔa abe ale si Mose de se na wo ene.
ENGLISH: 12 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh went across under arms before the sons of Israel as Moses had told them.

EWE: 13 Aʋawɔla siwo ade akpe blaene ye bla aʋakpa tso tɔa le Yehowa ŋkume yi Yeriko tagba.
ENGLISH: 13 About forty thousand, armed for service, went across before Jehovah to the flats of Jericho to the war.

EWE: 14 Yehowa do gã Yosua le Israel blibo la katã ŋkume gbe ma gbe, eye wode bubu gã eŋu le eƒe agbemeŋkekewo katã me, abe ale si ko wode bubu gã Mose ŋu ene.
ENGLISH: 14 That day Jehovah made Joshuaʽ great before the eyes of all Israel; and they stood in fear of him as they had stood in fear of Moses as long as he lived.

EWE: 15 Azɔ Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be:
ENGLISH: 15 And Jehovah spoke to Joshuaʽ, saying

EWE: 16 “Gblɔ na nunɔla siwo kɔ Ðaseɖiɖiɖaka la be woado go le Yordan me.”
ENGLISH: 16 “Give the priests who carry the ark of the Lessons the order to come up out of the Jordan.”

EWE: 17 Eya ta Yosua gblɔ na nunɔlawo be: “Mido go le Yordan me.”
ENGLISH: 17 And Joshuaʽ gave the priests the order “Come up out of the Jordan”;

EWE: 18 Esi nunɔla siwo kɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la do go le Yordan titina, eye nunɔlawo ƒe afɔƒome nya ka ƒuƒuiƒe ko la, Yordan me tsiawo gate sisi, eye woɖɔ gbagba ɖe goawo katã dzi abe tsã ene.
ENGLISH: 18 and when the priests who carried the ark of Jehovah’s covenant came up out of the middle of the Jordan, the priests’ feet were drawn out to the dry ground as the water of the Jordan came back to its place and ran as it had been doing, all over its flood-plain.

EWE: 19 Dukɔ la tso Yordan le ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi, eye woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Gilgal le Yeriko ƒe ɣedzeƒeliƒo dzi.
ENGLISH: 19 And the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth of the first month and camped at the Gilgal, on the east edge of Jericho’s territory.

EWE: 20 Ke Yosua ɖi kpe wuieve siwo wofɔ le Yordan me la ɖe Gilgal.
ENGLISH: 20 And Joshuaʽ set up at the Gilgal these twelve stones which they had taken out of the Jordan;

EWE: 21 Eye wògblɔ na Israel-viwo be: “Ne mia viwo va bia mi gbe aɖe gbe be: ‘Kpe siawo gɔme ɖe?’ hã la,
ENGLISH: 21 and he said to the sons of Israel “When hereafter your children ask their fathers ‘What do these stones mean?’

EWE: 22 ekema miaɖe eme na mia viwo be: ‘Ƒuƒuiƒee Israel to tsò Yordan,
ENGLISH: 22 you are to inform your children ‘On dry ground Israel came across this Jordan,’

EWE: 23 esime Yehowa mia Mawu na Yordan me tsiawo mie le wo ŋgɔ va se ɖe esime wotsoe, abe ale si tututu Yehowa mia Mawu wɔ Ƒudzĩ la, esime wòna wòmie le mía ŋgɔ va se ɖe esime míetsoe ene.
ENGLISH: 23 because your God Jehovah dried up the water of the Jordan before you till you had come across, as your God Jehovah did to the Red Sea, which he dried up before you till you had come across,

EWE: 24 Ewɔ esia be anyigbadzidukɔwo katã nanya ale si gbegbe Yehowa ƒe alɔkame sẽe, ale be miavɔ̃ Yehowa mia Mawu la ɣesiaɣi.’”
ENGLISH: 24 in order that all the peoples of the earth might know Jehovah’s hand was strong, in order that you might fear your God Jehovah evermore.”

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 5 Esi Amoritɔwo ƒe fia siwo katã le Yordan ƒe ɣetoɖoƒekpa dzi, kple Kanaantɔwo ƒe fia siwo katã le atsiaƒua nu, see be Yehowa na Yordan me tsiawo mie le Israel-viwo ŋgɔ, va se ɖe esime wotsoe la, dzi ɖe le wo ƒo, eye kalẽwɔwɔ bú ɖe wo le Israel-viwo ta.
ENGLISH: 5 And when all the kings of the Amorites on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites by the seaside, heard that Jehovah had dried up the water of the Jordan before the sons of Israel till they had come across, their hearts melted down and they no longer had any spirit in them because of the sons of Israel.

EWE: 2 Ɣemaɣi la, Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Tsɔ kpe sesẽ wɔ hɛwo, eye nàtso aʋa na Israel ŋutsuwo zi evelia.”
ENGLISH: 2 At that time Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ “Make yourself flint blades and re-circumcise the sons of Israel”;

EWE: 3 Ale Yosua tsɔ kpe sesẽ wɔ hɛwo, eye wòtso aʋa na Israel ŋutsuwo le Gibeat-Haaralot.
ENGLISH: 3 and Joshuaʽ made himself flint blades and circumcised the sons of Israel at Foreskin Hill.

EWE: 4 Nu si ta Yosua tso aʋa na wo ɖoe nye be, Ŋutsu siwo katã ʋu tso Egipte, siwo katã nye aʋawɔlawo la, ku le mɔa dzi esi woʋu le Egipte megbe.
ENGLISH: 4 And this was the occasion of Joshuaʽ’s circumcising: all the males of the people that had come out of Egypt, all the fighting men, had died in the wilderness on the way as they came out of Egypt

EWE: 5 Wotso aʋa na ame siwo katã ʋu tso Egipte la, gake wometso aʋa na ame siwo katã wodzi le gbea dzi le mɔa dzi, esime woʋu le Egipte megbe ya o.
ENGLISH: 5 for all the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people that were born in the wilderness on the way as they came out of Egypt had not,

EWE: 6 Elabena Israel-viwo zɔ gbea dzi ƒe blaene va se ɖe esime dukɔ blibo la ku vɔ, ame siawoe nye ŋutsu aʋawɔla siwo katã ʋu tso Egipte, siwo meɖo to Yehowa ƒe gbe o la. Yehowa ka atam na wo be, yemana woakpɔ anyigba si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na wo tɔgbuiwo be yeatsɔe ana mí, anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi le sisim le la gbeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 6 because the sons of Israel had been going in the wilderness forty years till all the nation were gone, the fighting men that had come out of Egypt, who had not obeyed Jehovah, to whom Jehovah had sworn that he would not have them see the country Jehovah had sworn to their fathers to give us, a country that runs milk and honey;

EWE: 7 Eya ta etsɔ wo viwo ɖo wo teƒe.
ENGLISH: 7 and he had raised up their sons in their place.

EWE: Woawoe Yosua tso aʋa na, elabena wometso aʋa na wo le mɔa dzi o.
ENGLISH: Them Joshuaʽ circumcised, because they were uncircumcised; for they had not circumcised them on the way.

EWE: 8 Esi wotso aʋa na dukɔ bliboa vɔ la, wotsi wo nɔƒe le asaɖa la me, va se ɖe esime wohaya.
ENGLISH: 8 And when all the nation were done being circumcised, they stayed in camp where they were till they were well.

EWE: 9 Azɔ Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Meɖe Egipte ƒe vlodoame ɖa le mia ŋu egbea.” Eya ta woyɔa teƒe ma be Gilgal va se ɖe egbe sia.
ENGLISH: 9 And Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ “Today I have galal, rolled off, the slur of the Egyptians from you,” and that place has been named Gilgal to this day.

EWE: 10 Israel-viwo ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Gilgal, eye woɖu Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la le ɣletia ƒe ŋkeke wuienelia ƒe fiẽ le Yeriko tagba.
ENGLISH: 10 And the sons of Israel camped at the Gilgal, and celebrated the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the flats of Jericho.

EWE: 11 Eye wodze anyigba la dzi nuwo ɖuɖu gɔme le Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ƒe ŋufɔke, woɖu amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã bolowo kple nuku tɔtɔewo le ŋkeke sia ke dzi.
ENGLISH: 11 And they ate corn of the country on the day after the passover, matzoth and roasted grain. That very day

EWE: 12 Eye mana la nu tso gbe si gbe woɖu anyigba la dzi nuku aɖewo; mana aɖeke megali na Israel-viwo azɔ o, ke boŋ wodze Kanaan-nyigba la dzi nuwo ɖuɖu gɔme le ƒe ma me.
ENGLISH: 12 the manna left off, on their eating corn of the country, and the sons of Israel no longer had manna but ate produce of Canaan that year.

EWE: 13 Esi Yosua gogo Yeriko la, efɔ mo dzi, eye wòkpɔ ŋutsu aɖe lé yi ɖe asi tɔ ɖe eŋgɔ. Ale Yosua zɔ ɖe edzi hebiae be: “Mía dzie nèle loo alo míaƒe futɔwo dzie nèle?”
ENGLISH: 13 And while Joshuaʽ was at Jericho he raised his eyes and found a man standing before him with his sword drawn in his hand; and Joshuaʽ went to him and said “Are you on our side or the enemy’s?”

EWE: 14 Eɖo eŋu be: “Ao, ke boŋ Yehowa ƒe aʋakɔ ƒe amegã menye va.”
ENGLISH: 14 And he said “No, I am Jehovah’s general, I have just come.”

EWE: Eye Yosua bɔbɔ hetsyɔ mo anyi hebiae be: “Nya kae le nye aƒetɔ si na eƒe subɔla?”
ENGLISH: And Joshuaʽ threw himself on his face on the ground and did reverence, and said to him “What has my lord to say to his servant?”

EWE: 15 Ale Yehowa ƒe aʋakɔ ƒe amegã la ɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Ðe wò afɔkpawo le afɔ, elabena teƒe si nètsi tsitre ɖo la le kɔkɔe.” Enumake Yosua wɔe nenema.
ENGLISH: 15 And Jehovah’s general said to Joshuaʽ “Slip your shoes off your feet, because the place you are standing on is sacred”; and Joshuaʽ did so.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 6 Wodo Yeriko ƒe agbowo goŋgoŋ le Israel-viwo ta, ame aɖeke medona alo gena ɖe eme o.
ENGLISH: 6 And Jericho was locked and blocked for fear of the sons of Israel, nobody going out or coming in.

EWE: 2 Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ Yeriko kple eƒe fia kpakple eƒe kalẽtɔwo de asi na wò.
ENGLISH: 2 And Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ “See, I have given into your hands Jericho and its king, the stalwart men.

EWE: 3 Mi ŋutsu aʋawɔlawo katã mizɔ ƒo xlã dua zi ɖeka. Aleae miawɔ ŋkeke ade.
ENGLISH: 3 And you shall go round the city, all the fighting men, making the round of the city once; thus you shall do six days.

EWE: 4 Na nunɔla adre natsɔ agbodzokpẽ adre ɖe asi adze Aɖaka la ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 4 And seven priests shall carry the seven bugle-horns before the ark.

EWE: Gake le ŋkeke adrea gbe la, miazɔ aƒo xlã dua zi adre, eye nunɔlawo naku kpẽawo.
ENGLISH: And on the seventh day you shall go round the city seven times, the priests blowing the horns;

EWE: 5 Eye ne woku agbodzokpẽawo, eye mienya se kpẽawo ƒe ɖiɖi ko la, aʋawɔlawo katã nado aʋaɣli sesĩe. Eye du la ƒe gli amu adze anyi, eye aʋawɔlaawo nage ɖe eme, ame sia ame nayi ŋgɔ tẽe.”
ENGLISH: 5 and at the winding of the bugle-horn, when you hear the horn-blast, all the people shall give a loud cheer, and the wall of the city will fall flat and the people shall go up each man straight in.”

EWE: 6 Eya ta Yosua, Nun vi, yɔ nunɔlawo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Mikɔ nubablaɖaka la, eye nunɔla adre natsɔ agbodzokpẽ adre adze Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la ŋgɔ.”
ENGLISH: 6 And Joshuaʽ the son of Nun summoned the priests and said to them “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry seven bugle-horns before Jehovah’s ark”;

EWE: 7 Egblɔ na aʋawɔlaawo be: “Mizɔ yi ŋgɔ, mizɔ ƒo xlã dua, eye aʋakpablalawo nadze Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la ŋgɔ.”
ENGLISH: 7 and he said to the people “Pass on and go round the city, and let the armed contingent from the east pass ahead of Jehovah’s ark,

EWE: 8 Eye abe ale si Yosua gblɔ na aʋawɔlawo ene la, nunɔla adre siwo lé agbodzokpẽ adreawo ɖe asi le Yehowa ŋkume la zɔ yi ŋgɔ heku kpẽawo, eye Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la dze wo yome.
ENGLISH: 8 and let seven priests carrying the seven bugle-horns before Jehovah pass on and blow the horns, the ark of Jehovah’s covenant going behind them

EWE: 9 Aʋakpablalaawo dze nunɔla siwo nɔ kpẽawo kum la ŋgɔ, eye aʋawɔla megbexeawo dze Aɖaka la yome esime nunɔlawo le kpẽawo kum atraɖii.
ENGLISH: 9 and the armed contingent from the east going before the priests that blow the horns and the rearguard going behind the ark blowing horns as they go.”

EWE: 10 Ke Yosua de se na aʋawɔlawo be: “Migado ɣli alo ana woase miaƒe gbe o. Nya aɖeke megado le mia nu o, va se ɖe gbe si gbe magblɔ na mi be: ‘Mido ɣli!’ Ekema miado ɣli.”
ENGLISH: 10 And to the people Joshuaʽ gave the order “Do not cheer nor make your voices heard nor let a word come out of your mouths till the day that I say to you ‘Cheer’ and you cheer.”

EWE: 11 Ena wokɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la ƒo xlã du la zi ɖeka, emegbe wogbugbɔ yi asaɖa la me hetsi afi ma dɔ le zã ma me.
ENGLISH: 11 And Jehovah’s ark went round the city, making one round; and they came to the camp and spent the night in camp.

EWE: 12 Le ŋufɔke la, Yosua fɔ ŋdi kanya, eye nunɔlawo kɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la,
ENGLISH: 12 And the first thing Joshuaʽ did in the morning, the priests took up Jehovah’s ark,

EWE: 13 eye nunɔla adre siwo lé agbodzokpẽ adre ɖe asi dze Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka ŋgɔ la le kpẽawo kum atraɖii. Aʋakpablalaawo nɔ zɔzɔm le wo ŋgɔ, eye aʋawɔla megbexeawo dze Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la yome esime nunɔlawo le kpẽawo kum atraɖii.
ENGLISH: 13 with seven priests carrying the seven bugle-horns before Jehovah, going along blowing the horns as they went, and the armed contingent from the east going before them and the rearguard going behind Jehovah’s ark blowing horns as they went,

EWE: 14 Wozɔ ƒo xlã du la zi ɖeka le ŋkeke evelia dzi, emegbe wotrɔ yi asaɖa la me.
ENGLISH: 14 and they went round the city once on the second day and back to the camp.

EWE: Aleae wowɔ ŋkeke ade sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: So they did six days.

EWE: 15 Ke le ŋkeke adrelia dzi la, wofɔ ŋdi kanya, esi agu nya dze teti ko, eye wozɔ ƒo xlã dua alea zi adre. Ŋkeke ma dzi koe wozɔ ƒo xlã dua zi adre.
ENGLISH: 15 And on the seventh day the first thing in the morning, at dawn, they went round the city this same way seven times (it was only on that day that they went round the city seven times),

EWE: 16 Esi woƒo xlãe zi adrelia la, nunɔlawo ku kpẽawo, eye Yosua gblɔ na aʋawɔlaawo be: “Mido ɣli; elabena Yehowa tsɔ du la de asi na mi!
ENGLISH: 16 and at the seventh time the priests blew the horns and Joshuaʽ said to the people “Cheer, because Jehovah has given you the city;

EWE: 17 Miatsrɔ̃ du la kple nu sia nu si le eme la gbidigbidi; wo katã nye Yehowa tɔ.
ENGLISH: 17 and the city shall be deodand to Jehovah for destruction, it and all that is in it

EWE: Negbe Rahab gbolo la koe atsi agbe, eya kple ame siwo katã le egbɔ le aƒea me, elabena eɣla ame siwo míedɔ ɖa la.
ENGLISH: only the prostitute Rahab is to live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers we sent.

EWE: 18 Ke migate ɖe nu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi la ŋu o, ale be nu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi la ƒe ɖeke nagadzro mi miahayi etsɔ ge, eye miahe vɔ̃ ava Israel ƒe asaɖa la dzi ahana woatsrɔ̃e gbidii o.
ENGLISH: 18 Only for your part beware of the deodand, that you do not covet and take any of the deodand and render the Israelite camp deodand and breed trouble for it.

EWE: 19 Ke klosalo kple sika kple akɔblinuwo kpakple gayibɔnuwo ŋu kɔ na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 19 And all silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron are sacred to Jehovah; they shall come into Jehovah’s treasury.”

EWE: Ele be mialɔ wo ayi Yehowa ƒe nu xɔasiwo dzraɖoƒe.” 20 Aʋawɔlaawo do ɣli esi woku kpẽawo. Esi aʋawɔlaawo nya se kpẽawo ƒe ɖiɖi eye wodo aʋaɣli ko la, gli la mu dze anyi. Emegbe aʋawɔlaawo ge ɖe dua me, ame sia ame yi ŋgɔ tẽe, eye woxɔ du la.
ENGLISH: 20 And the people cheered, and they blew the horns, and when the people heard the horn-blast the people gave a loud cheer, and the wall fell flat and the people went up to the city every man straight in, and took the city,

EWE: 21 Wotsrɔ̃ nu siwo katã le dua me, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo, ɖekakpuiwo kple amegãɖeɖiwo, nyiwo kple alẽwo kpakple tedziwo kple yi.
ENGLISH: 21 and massacred all in the city, man and woman, boy and graybeard and cow and sheep and donkey, without quarter.

EWE: 22 Yosua gblɔ na ŋutsu eve siwo yi ɖatsa ŋku le anyigba la dzi be: “Miyi gbolo la ƒe me, eye miakplɔ nyɔnu la kple eƒemetɔwo katã do goe, abe ale si mieka atam nɛ ene.”
ENGLISH: 22 And to the two men who had reconnoitered the country Joshuaʽ said “Go into the prostitute woman’s house and bring out from there the woman and all that belong to her, as you swore to her.”

EWE: 23 Ale ɖekakpui siwo va tsa ŋku la yi ɖakplɔ Rahab kple fofoa kple dadaa kple nɔviawo kpakple eƒe amewo katã do goe, ɛ̃, wokplɔ eƒemetɔwo katã do goe; eye wokplɔ wo dedie va teƒe aɖe le Israel ƒe asaɖa la godo.
ENGLISH: 23 And the young men who had reconnoitered went in and brought out Rahab and her father and mother and brothers and all that belonged to her, and brought out all her clan, and left them outside the Israelite camp.

EWE: 24 Eye wotɔ dzo du la kple nu sia nu si le eme. Negbe klosalo, sika, akɔblinuwo kple gayibɔnuwo koe wolɔ yi Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me nu xɔasiwo dzraɖoƒe.
ENGLISH: 24 And the city they burned up, and all in it; only the silver and gold and the bronze and iron articles they put in the treasury of Jehovah’s house,

EWE: 25 Rahab gbolo la kple fofoa ƒemetɔwo kpakple eya ŋutɔ ƒemetɔwo katã koe Yosua na wotsi agbe; eye wòle Israel va se ɖe egbe sia, elabena eɣla ame siwo Yosua dɔ ɖa be woaɖatsa ŋku le Yeriko la.
ENGLISH: 25 and the prostitute Rahab and her family and all that belonged to her Joshuaʽ kept alive and they have lived among the Israelites to this day because she had hid the messengers Joshuaʽ sent to reconnoiter Jericho.

EWE: 26 Eye Yosua ka atam sia ɣemaɣi be: “Aɖi ŋutsu si agbugbɔ Yeriko du sia atso la ŋu kpékpekpe le Yehowa ŋkume. Eƒe ŋgɔgbevi ƒe agbee wòatsɔ aɖo egɔme anyi, eye eƒe dɔmlɔea ƒe agbee wòatsɔ ade agbo enu.”
ENGLISH: 26 And Joshuaʽ imposed an oath at that time, “Cursed be the man before Jehovah who stands up and fortifies the city, Jericho: with his firstborn he shall lay its foundation and with his youngest son he shall set up its gates.”

EWE: 27 Ale Yehowa nɔ kple Yosua, eye eƒe ŋkɔ ɖi le anyigba blibo la katã dzi.
ENGLISH: 27 And Jehovah was with Joshuaʽ, and his fame was all through the country.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 7 Ke Israel-viwo meɖi anukware le nu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi la me o, elabena Akan, Karmi vi, ame si nye Zabdi vi, ame si nye Zera vi, si tso Yuda-to la me tsɔ nu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidii la ƒe ɖe.
ENGLISH: 7 But the Israelites were unfaithful with regard to what had been devoted to destruction, for Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was devoted to destruction.

EWE: Eye Yehowa ƒe dziku fla ɖe Israel-viwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: At this Jehovah’s anger blazed against the Israelites.

EWE: 2 Eye Yosua dɔ ŋutsuwo tso Yeriko ɖo ɖe Ai, si te ɖe Bet-Aven ŋu le Betel ƒe ɣedzeƒe, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Miyi ɖatsa ŋku le anyigba la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 2 Then Joshua sent men out from Jericho to Ai, which is close by Beth-aven and east of Bethel, telling them: “Go up and spy on the land.”

EWE: Eya ta ŋutsuawo yi ɖatsa ŋku le Ai.
ENGLISH: So the men went up and spied on Ai.

EWE: 3 Esi wotrɔ gbɔ va Yosua gbɔ la, wogblɔ nɛ be: “Mehiã be aʋawɔlawo katã nayi o.
