ENGLISH: 3 When they returned to Joshua, they told him: “Not all the people need to go up.

EWE: Ame akpe eve alo akpe etɔ̃ ko ate ŋu asi Ai.
ENGLISH: About two or three thousand men are enough to defeat Ai.

EWE: Mègaɖe fu na aʋawɔlawo katã be woayi o, elabena ameawo mesɔ gbɔ o.”
ENGLISH: Do not tire out all the people by making them go, for there are only a few of them.”

EWE: 4 Eya ta aʋawɔla siwo anɔ abe akpe etɔ̃ ene yi, gake wosi le Aitɔwo nu.
ENGLISH: 4 So about 3,000 men went up there, but they had to flee from the men of Ai.

EWE: 5 Aitɔwo wu ŋutsu blaetɔ̃ vɔ ade, eye wonya wo ɖe nu tso dugbo la nu va se ɖe keke Sebarim ke, eye wonɔ wo wum le aga la me.
ENGLISH: 5 The men of Ai struck down 36 men, and they pursued them from outside the city gate as far as Shebarim, and they continued striking them down on the descent.

EWE: Eya ta dukɔ la ƒe dzi lólo zu tsi.
ENGLISH: So the courage of the people melted and flowed away like water.

EWE: 6 Enumake Yosua dze eƒe awuwo, eye wòtsyɔ mo anyi ɖe Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la ŋgɔ va se ɖe fiẽ, Israel ametsitsiwo hã wɔ nenema, eye wonɔ ke lɔm kɔ ɖe tame.
ENGLISH: 6 At this Joshua ripped his garments and fell with his face to the ground before the Ark of Jehovah until the evening, he and the elders of Israel, and they kept throwing dust on their heads.

EWE: 7 Eye Yosua gblɔ be: “Oo Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa, nu ka tae nèkplɔ dukɔ sia wotso Yordan-tɔsisia be nàtsɔ mí ade asi na Amoritɔwo woatsrɔ̃?
ENGLISH: 7 Joshua said: “Alas, Sovereign Lord Jehovah, why did you bring this people all the way across the Jordan just to hand us over to the Amorites to be destroyed?

EWE: Ne ɖe míenya hetsi Yordan godo la, ne enyo wu ɖe!
ENGLISH: If only we had been satisfied to remain on the other side of the Jordan!

EWE: 8 Oo Yehowa, meɖe kuku, esi Israel si le eƒe futɔwo nu ɖe, aleke gblɔ ge mala fifia?
ENGLISH: 8 Pardon me, O Jehovah, what can I say now that Israel has retreated before his enemies?

EWE: 9 Ne Kanaantɔwo kple anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã see la, woaɖe to ɖe mí, ahatsrɔ̃ míaƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba la dzi; ekema nu kae nàwɔ le wò ŋkɔ gã la ŋu?”
ENGLISH: 9 When the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land hear about it, they will surround us and wipe out our very name from the earth, and what will you do about your great name?”

EWE: 10 Eye Yehowa ɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Tso ɖe tsitre!
ENGLISH: 10 Jehovah replied to Joshua: “Get up!

EWE: Nu ka tae nètsyɔ mo anyi?
ENGLISH: Why are you lying on your face?

EWE: 11 Israel wɔ nu vɔ̃, eye wotu nu, si mebla kpli wo la.
ENGLISH: 11 Israel has sinned. They have violated my covenant that I commanded them to keep.

EWE: Wotsɔ nu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi la dometɔ aɖewo, wofi wo, eye wotsɔ wo ɣla ɖe woƒe nuwo dome.
ENGLISH: They took some of what was devoted to destruction, stealing it and secretly putting it among their own possessions.

EWE: 12 Eya ta Israel-viwo mate ŋu anɔ te ɖe woƒe futɔwo nu o.
ENGLISH: 12 Therefore, the Israelites will not be able to stand against their enemies.

EWE: Woatrɔ megbe ade woƒe futɔwo ahasi le wo nu, elabena wozu nu si wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi.
ENGLISH: They will turn their backs and flee from their enemies, because they have become something devoted to destruction.

EWE: Nyemaganɔ kpli mi o, negbe ɖe mieɖe nu si wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidii la ɖa le mia dome hafi.
ENGLISH: I will not be with you again unless you annihilate from your midst what was devoted to destruction.

EWE: 13 Tso nàkɔ dukɔ la ŋu!
ENGLISH: 13 Get up and sanctify the people!

EWE: Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Mikɔ mia ɖokuiwo ŋu etsɔ, elabena ale Yehowa Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔe nye esi: “Oo Israel, nu si wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidii la le dowòme.
ENGLISH: Tell them, ‘Sanctify yourselves tomorrow, for this is what Jehovah the God of Israel says: “What is devoted to destruction is among you, O Israel.

EWE: Màgate ŋu anɔ te ɖe wò futɔwo nu o, va se ɖe esime mieɖe nu si wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi la ɖa le mia dome hafi.
ENGLISH: You will not be able to stand against your enemies until you remove from your midst the thing devoted to destruction.

EWE: 14 Miva etsɔ ŋdi, to sia to, eye to si dzi Yehowa atɔ asii la nate va, ƒome sia ƒome, eye ƒome si dzi Yehowa atɔ asii la nate va, aƒe sia aƒe, eye aƒe si dzi Yehowa atɔ asii la nate va ŋutsu ɖekaɖeka.
ENGLISH: 14 You are to present yourselves in the morning, tribe by tribe, and the tribe that Jehovah selects will come near, family by family, and the family that Jehovah selects will come near, household by household, and the household that Jehovah selects will come near, man by man.

EWE: 15 Woatɔ dzo ame si gbɔ wokpɔ nu si wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidii la le, eya kple eƒe nuwo katã, elabena etu Yehowa ƒe nubabla la, eye wòwɔ ŋukpenanu le Israel.”’”
ENGLISH: 15 And the one who is caught with the thing devoted to destruction will be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has violated the covenant of Jehovah and because he has committed a disgraceful act in Israel.”’”

EWE: 16 Le ŋufɔke la, Yosua fɔ ŋdi kanya, eye wòna Israel te va, to sia to, eye wotɔ asi Yuda-to la dzi.
ENGLISH: 16 So Joshua rose early the next morning and had Israel come near, tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.

EWE: 17 Ena Yuda ƒomeawo te va, eye wotɔ asi Zera viwo ƒe ƒome la dzi, eye emegbe wòna Zera viwo ƒe ƒomea te va, ŋutsu sia ŋutsu, eye wotɔ asi Zabdi dzi.
ENGLISH: 17 He had the families of Judah come near and the family of the Zerahites was selected, after which he had the family of the Zerahites come near, man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

EWE: 18 Mlɔeba ena Zabdi ƒe aƒe la te va, ŋutsu sia ŋutsu, eye wotɔ asi Akan, Karmi vi, Zabdi vi, ame si nye Zera vi, tso Yuda-toa me la dzi.
ENGLISH: 18 Finally he had the household of Zabdi come near, man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

EWE: 19 Eye Yosua gblɔ na Akan be: “Vinye, meɖe kuku, de bubu Yehowa Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu, eye nàʋu eme nam.
ENGLISH: 19 Then Joshua said to Achan: “My son, please, honor Jehovah the God of Israel and make confession to him.

EWE: Meɖe kuku, gblɔ nu si nèwɔ la nam.
ENGLISH: Tell me, please, what you have done.

EWE: Mègaɣlae ɖem o.”
ENGLISH: Do not hide it from me.”

EWE: 20 Eye Akan ɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Le nyateƒe me la, nyee wɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu, eye nu si mewɔ lae nye esi:
ENGLISH: 20 Achan answered Joshua: “For a fact I am the one who sinned against Jehovah the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.

EWE: 21 Esi mekpɔ awu xɔasi nyakpɔ aɖe si tso Sinar kple klosalo sekel alafa eve, kple sikakpɔti ɖeka, si ƒe kpekpeme nye sekel blaatɔ̃ le aboyonuawo dome la, wobiã ŋu nam, eye metsɔ wo.
ENGLISH: 21 When I saw among the spoil a good-looking official garment from Shinar and 200 shekels of silver and one gold bar weighing 50 shekels, I desired them, so I took them.

EWE: Meɖi nuawo ɖe nye agbadɔ me, eye ga la le wo te.”
ENGLISH: They are now hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the money underneath.”

EWE: 22 Enumake Yosua dɔ amewo woƒu du yi agbadɔ la me, eye vavãe woɖi awuawo ɖe eƒe agbadɔ la me, eye ga la hã le wo te.
ENGLISH: 22 At once Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there the garment was hidden in his tent, with the money underneath it.

EWE: 23 Ale wotsɔ nuawo tso agbadɔ la me vɛ na Yosua kple Israel-viwo katã, eye wotsɔ wo da ɖe Yehowa ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 23 So they took the things out of the tent and brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and placed them before Jehovah.

EWE: 24 Azɔ Yosua kple Israel blibo si le eŋu la kplɔ Akan, Zera vi la, eye wotsɔ klosaloa, awu xɔasia kple sikakpɔti la, eye wokplɔ viaŋutsuwo, vianyɔnuwo, eƒe nyiwo, tedziwo, alẽwo, eye wotsɔ eƒe agbadɔ kple eƒe nuwo katã yi Akor Bali la me.
ENGLISH: 24 Joshua and all Israel with him then took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the official garment, and the bar of gold, along with his sons, his daughters, his bull, his donkey, his flock, his tent, and everything that was his, and they brought them up to the Valley of Achor.

EWE: 25 Eye Yosua gblɔ be: “Nu ka tae nèhe vɔ̃ va mía dzi?
ENGLISH: 25 Joshua said: “Why have you brought disaster upon us?

EWE: Yehowa hã ahe vɔ̃ ava dziwò egbe sia.”
ENGLISH: Jehovah will bring disaster upon you on this day.”

EWE: Israel blibo la ƒu kpe wo woku, eye wotɔ dzo wo.
ENGLISH: With that all Israel stoned him, after which they burned them with fire.

EWE: Ale woƒu kpe wo katã woku.
ENGLISH: Thus they stoned all of them.

EWE: 26 Eye wofɔ kpewo li kɔ gã aɖe ɖe edzi, eye kɔ sia li va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: 26 And they raised a huge pile of stones over him that remains to this day.

EWE: Eye Yehowa ƒe dziku helĩhelĩ la nu fa.
ENGLISH: At this Jehovah’s hot anger subsided.

EWE: Esia tae wona ŋkɔ teƒe ma be Akor Bali me va se ɖe egbe sia.
ENGLISH: That is why the name of that place is Valley of Achor to this day.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 8 Azɔ Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Mègavɔ̃ o, eye ŋɔ megadzi wò o.
ENGLISH: 8 Then Jehovah said to Joshua: “Do not be afraid or be terrified.

EWE: Kplɔ aʋawɔlawo katã nàho ɖe Ai ŋu.
ENGLISH: Take with you all the fighting men and go up against Ai.

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ Ai-fia, eƒe dukɔ, eƒe du la kple eƒe anyigba de asi na wò.
ENGLISH: See, I have handed over to you the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.

EWE: 2 Wɔ Ai kple eƒe fia la abe ale si tututu nèwɔ Yeriko kple eƒe fia la ene, ke le eya gome la, miate ŋu aha eƒe nuwo kple eƒe lãwo na mia ɖokuiwo.
ENGLISH: 2 Do to Ai and to its king just as you did to Jericho and its king, except you may plunder its spoil and its livestock for yourselves.

EWE: Na amewo nade xa ɖe du la megbe.”
ENGLISH: Set an ambush behind the city.”

EWE: 3 Eya ta Yosua kple aʋawɔlawo katã ho ɖe Ai ŋu, eye Yosua tia aʋakalẽtɔ akpe blaetɔ̃, eye wòdɔ wo ɖa le zã me.
ENGLISH: 3 So Joshua and all the fighting men went up against Ai. Joshua chose 30,000 mighty warriors and sent them off by night.

EWE: 4 Ede se sia na wo be: “Miyi ɖade xa ɖe du la megbe.
ENGLISH: 4 He gave them this command: “See, you are to lie in ambush behind the city.

EWE: Migayi adzɔge boo tso dua gbɔ o, eye mi katã minɔ klalo.
ENGLISH: Do not go very far from the city, and all of you be ready.

EWE: 5 Ke nye kple ame siwo katã le ŋunye la míate ɖe du la ŋu, eye ne wodo go va kpe mí abe tsã ene la, ekema míasi le wo nu.
ENGLISH: 5 I and all the people with me will approach the city, and when they come out against us as before, we will retreat from them.

EWE: 6 Ne woyɔ mí ɖe enu la, míahe wo ɖa le dua gbɔ, elabena woagblɔ be: ‘Wole sisim le mía nu abe tsã ene.’
ENGLISH: 6 When they come out after us, we will draw them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are retreating from us just as before.’

EWE: Ale míasi le wo nu.
ENGLISH: And we will retreat from them.

EWE: 7 Ekema miado le xadeƒe la axɔ dua; Yehowa mia Mawu atsɔe ade asi na mi.
ENGLISH: 7 Then you should rise up from the ambush and capture the city; Jehovah your God will hand it over to you.

EWE: 8 Ne mienya xɔ dua ko la, mitɔ dzoe.
ENGLISH: 8 As soon as you have seized the city, you should set it on fire.

EWE: Miwɔ abe ale si Yehowa gblɔ ene.
ENGLISH: You should do according to Jehovah’s word.

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa, se siawoe mede na mi.”
ENGLISH: See, I have given you your orders.”

EWE: 9 Emegbe Yosua dɔ wo ɖa, eye woyi xadeƒe la; wode xa ɖe Betel kple Ai dome, le Ai ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe, eye Yosua tsi aʋawɔla susɔeawo gbɔ zã ma.
ENGLISH: 9 Then Joshua sent them out, and they marched to the place of ambush; they took a position between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai, while Joshua spent that night with the people.

EWE: 10 Esi Yosua fɔ ŋdi kanya, eye wòƒo aʋawɔlaawo nu ƒu la, eya kple Israel ametsitsiwo kplɔ wo ɖo ta Ai.
ENGLISH: 10 After Joshua rose up early in the morning and gathered the troops, he and the elders of Israel led them to Ai.

EWE: 11 Eye aʋawɔla siwo katã le eŋu la zɔ yi dua ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 11 All the fighting men who were with him marched up and advanced to the front of the city.

EWE: Woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Ai ƒe dziehe, eye bali aɖe tso wo kple Ai dome.
ENGLISH: They camped to the north of Ai, with the valley between them and Ai.

EWE: 12 Le ɣeyiɣi ma me la, eɖe ŋutsu siwo anɔ akpe atɔ̃, eye wòna wode xa ɖe Betel kple Ai dome le dua ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe.
ENGLISH: 12 In the meantime, he had taken about 5,000 men and had set them as an ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

EWE: 13 Ale aʋawɔlawo ƒe akpa gãtɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe dua ƒe dziehe, eye aʋawɔla megbexeawo ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe dua ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe, eye Yosua yi bali la me le zã ma me.
ENGLISH: 13 So the people set the main camp to the north of the city and the rear guard west of the city, and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

EWE: 14 Esi Ai-fia kpɔ esia ko la, eya kple dua me ŋutsuwo katã fɔ ŋdi kanya hewɔ kaba do yi aʋa kpe ge kple Israel le teƒe aɖe si dze ŋgɔ tagba la.
ENGLISH: 14 And as soon as the king of Ai saw this, he and the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the desert plain.

EWE: Ke menya be wode xa ɖi na ye le dua megbe o.
ENGLISH: But he did not know that there was an ambush set against him to the rear of the city.

EWE: 15 Esi Ai ŋutsuwo dze aʋa ɖe wo ŋu la, Yosua kple Israel blibo la katã si to mɔ si ɖo ta gbedzi.
ENGLISH: 15 When the men of Ai attacked, Joshua and all Israel fled along the road in the direction of the wilderness.

EWE: 16 Eye woyɔ ame siwo katã le dua me ƒo ƒu be woanya wo ɖe nu; esi wonya Yosua ɖe nu la, wohe wo yi adzɔge tso dua gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 16 Then all the people who were in the city were summoned to pursue them; and as they pursued Joshua they were drawn away from the city.

EWE: 17 Ŋutsu aɖeke mekpɔtɔ ɖe Ai kple Betel, si medo go heti Israel yome o.
ENGLISH: 17 Not a man was remaining in Ai and Bethel who did not go out after Israel.

EWE: Ale wogblẽ du la ɖe nuvo henya Israel ɖe nu.
ENGLISH: They left the city wide open and pursued Israel.

EWE: 18 Azɔ Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Do akplɔ si le asiwò la ɖe Ai lɔƒo, elabena asiwò mee matsɔe ade.”
ENGLISH: 18 Jehovah now said to Joshua: “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for into your hand I will give it.”

EWE: Eya ta Yosua do akplɔ si le esi la ɖe du la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: So Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.

EWE: 19 Esi wònya do eƒe asi ɖa teti ko la, xadelawo do le xadeƒea kaba, eye woƒu du ge ɖe dua me hexɔe.
ENGLISH: 19 The moment he stretched out his hand, the ambush rose up quickly from its place and ran into the city and captured it.

EWE: Eye wotɔ dzo du la enumake.
ENGLISH: They immediately set the city on fire.

EWE: 20 Esi Ai ŋutsuwo trɔ kpɔ megbe la, wokpɔ be dzudzɔ de dzi kɔtɔɔ le dua me, eye ŋusẽ meganɔ wo ŋu woasi aɖo ta afi aɖeke o.
ENGLISH: 20 When the men of Ai turned around, they saw the smoke of the city rising to the sky, and they had no strength to flee in any direction.

EWE: Eye Israel-vi siwo si yina gbea dzi la trɔ ɖe wo yometilawo ŋu.
ENGLISH: Then the people who had been fleeing toward the wilderness turned on their pursuers.

EWE: 21 Esi Yosua kple Israel blibo la katã kpɔ be xadelawo xɔ dua, eye dzudzɔ de dzi le dua me la, wotrɔ ɖe Ai ŋutsuawo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 21 When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured the city and saw the smoke of the city rising, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.

EWE: 22 Ame siwo xɔ dua la do go va kpe wo, ale wɔ Ai ŋutsuwo tsi to me, Israel-viwo le woƒe akpa si kple akpa kemɛ, eye wosi wo va se ɖe esime agbetsila alo sisila aɖeke mekpɔtɔ o.
ENGLISH: 22 And the others came out of the city to meet them, so that the men of Ai were trapped in the middle, with some Israelites on this side and some on that side, and they struck them down until there was not one survivor or escapee remaining.

EWE: 23 Gake wolé Ai-fia agbagbee hekplɔe vɛ na Yosua.
ENGLISH: 23 But they caught the king of Ai alive and brought him before Joshua.

EWE: 24 Esi Israel wu Aitɔwo katã le tagba, le gbedzi afi si woti wo yome va, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple yi vɔ keŋkeŋ la, Israel blibo la trɔ yi Ai, eye wòtsrɔ̃e kple yi.
ENGLISH: 24 After Israel finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they had pursued them, and every last one of them had fallen by the sword, then all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the sword.

EWE: 25 Aitɔ siwo katã tsi yi nu gbe ma gbe, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa le ame akpe wuieve.
ENGLISH: 25 All those who fell on that day, from man to woman, amounted to 12,000, all the people of Ai.

EWE: 26 Yosua megbugbɔ eƒe asi si wòtsɔ do akplɔ la ɖa la ɖe megbe o, va se ɖe esime wòtsrɔ̃ Aitɔwo katã vɔ keŋkeŋ.
ENGLISH: 26 Joshua did not draw back his hand with which he had stretched out the javelin until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Ai to destruction.

EWE: 27 Ke Israel ha lãwo kple dua me nuwo na wo ɖokuiwo, abe ale si Yehowa de se na Yosua ene.
ENGLISH: 27 However, Israel took the livestock and the spoil of that city for themselves, according to the orders that Jehovah had given to Joshua.

EWE: 28 Eye Yosua tɔ dzo Ai, eye wòzu aƒedo gbidigbidi va se ɖe egbe sia.
ENGLISH: 28 Then Joshua burned Ai and reduced it to a permanent mound of ruins, as it remains to this day.

EWE: 29 Ehe Ai-fia ɖe ati ŋu va se ɖe fiẽ, eye esi ɣe yina to ɖo ge la, Yosua ɖe gbe be woaɖe eƒe kukua le atia ŋu.
ENGLISH: 29 He hung the king of Ai on a stake until the evening, and as the sun was about to set, Joshua gave the order to take his dead body down from the stake.

EWE: Eye wotsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe dua ƒe agbo nu, eye wofɔ kpewo li kɔ gã aɖe ɖe edzi, kpekɔa le afi ma va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: Then they pitched it at the entrance of the city gate and raised up a great pile of stones over him, which is there to this day.

EWE: 30 Ɣemaɣie Yosua ɖi vɔsamlekpui na Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ɖe Ebal To la dzi,
ENGLISH: 30 It was then that Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal to Jehovah the God of Israel,

EWE: 31 abe ale si Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose de se na Israel-viwo, eye woŋlɔe ɖe Mose ƒe Segbalẽa me ene, be wòanye “Kpe blibo siwo wometsɔ gadɔwɔnu aɖeke fui o la ƒe vɔsamlekpui.”
ENGLISH: 31 just as Moses the servant of Jehovah had commanded the Israelites and as it is written in the book of the Law of Moses: “An altar of whole stones on which no iron tool has been wielded.”

EWE: Wosa numevɔwo kple ŋutifafavɔwo le edzi na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: On it they offered up burnt offerings to Jehovah as well as communion sacrifices.

EWE: 32 Yosua gbugbɔ ŋlɔ Mose ƒe Se, si wòŋlɔ le Israel-viwo ŋkume la, ɖe kpewo dzi le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 32 Then he wrote there on the stones a copy of the Law that Moses had written before the Israelites.

EWE: 33 Eye Israel blibo la katã, woƒe ametsitsiwo, dzikpɔlawo kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo tɔ ɖe Aɖaka la ƒe axa eveawo dzi le Lewi vi nunɔla siwo kɔa Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 33 All Israel, their elders, the officers, and their judges were standing on both sides of the Ark in front of the Levitical priests who were carrying the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.

EWE: Amedzrowo kple dumeviwo siaa nɔ afi ma.
ENGLISH: The foreign residents were there as well as the natives.

EWE: Woƒe afã tɔ ɖe Gerizim To la ŋgɔ, eye afã tɔ ɖe Ebal To la ŋgɔ, be woayra Israel dukɔ la (abe ale si tututu Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose de se na wo gbe aɖe gbe ene).
ENGLISH: Half of them stood in front of Mount Gerizim, and the other half in front of Mount Ebal (just as Moses the servant of Jehovah had previously commanded), to bless the people of Israel.

EWE: 34 Emegbe exlẽ Se la me nyawo katã, yayrawo kple fiƒodewo, sesĩe le nya siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe Segbalẽa me la nu.
ENGLISH: 34 After this he read aloud all the words of the Law, the blessings and the curses, according to all that is written in the book of the Law.

EWE: 35 Nya siwo katã ƒe se Mose de la dometɔ aɖeke metsi anyi, si Yosua mexlẽ sesĩe le Israel ƒe ha blibo la katã, si me nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo kpakple amedzro siwo le wo dome hã le la ŋkume o.
ENGLISH: 35 There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read aloud in front of all the congregation of Israel, including the women and children and the foreign residents who were living among them.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 9 Esi fia siwo katã le Yordan ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe, siwo le tonuto la me, le Sefela kple Ƒu Gã blibo la nu kpakple Lebanon ŋgɔ, siwo nye Hititɔwo kple Amoritɔwo, Kanaantɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Hivitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo, nya se nu si dzɔ ko la,
ENGLISH: 9 And when all the kings that side of the Jordan in the highland and the lowland and all along the beach of the great sea up to the latitude of the Lebanon heard of it, the Hittites and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Perizzites and the Hivvites and the Jebusites,

EWE: 2 wo katã wowɔ ɖeka be yewoawɔ aʋa kple Yosua kpakple Israel.
ENGLISH: 2 they joined forces unanimously to fight Joshuaʽ and Israel.

EWE: 3 Gibeontɔwo hã se nu si Yosua tu kple Yeriko kple Ai.
ENGLISH: 3 And the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshuaʽ had done to Jericho and the Ghai,

EWE: 4 Eya ta wowɔ ayenu, eye wodi mɔdzinuɖuɖu de kotoku xoxowo me tsɔ ɖo woƒe tedziwo dzi, eye wotsɔ waingolo xoxo vuvu siwo wogbugbɔ tɔ,
ENGLISH: 4 and they acted too by trickery, and went and put on false colors, and took worn-out sackcloths for their donkeys, and worn-out skins of wine, punctured and mended with puckers,

EWE: 5 eye wodo afɔkpa xoxo siwo woka, kple awu xoxowo. Abolo siwo katã wotsɔ ɖe asi la ƒu hefli kakɛkakɛ.
ENGLISH: 5 and patched worn-out sandals on their feet, and worn-out cloaks on their backs, and all the bread in their provisions was dried up, gone to crumbling.

EWE: 6 Woyi Yosua gbɔ le asaɖa la me le Gilgal, eye wogblɔ na eya kple Israel ŋutsuwo be: “Anyigba didi aɖe dzie míetso va. Eye míedi be miabla nu kpli mí.”
ENGLISH: 6 And they went to the camp at the Gilgal to Joshuaʽ, and said to him and to the men of Israel “We have come from a distant country: now make a treaty with us.”

EWE: 7 Ke Israel ŋutsuwo gblɔ na Hivitɔawo be: “Ðewohĩ mía gbɔ afi sia koe miele. Ekema aleke wɔ míabla nu kpli mi?”
ENGLISH: 7 And the men of Israel said to the Hivvites “Maybe you live in among us: how should we make a treaty with you?”

EWE: 8 Woɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Wò subɔviwoe míenye.”
ENGLISH: 8 But they said to Joshuaʽ “We are your servants.”

EWE: Eye Yosua bia wo be: “Ame kawoe mienye, eye afi kae mietso?”
ENGLISH: And Joshuaʽ said to them “Who are you, and where do you come from?”

EWE: 9 Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Anyigba didi aɖe ŋutɔ dzie wò subɔviwo tso le Yehowa wò Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ la ta, elabena míese eŋkɔ kple nu siwo katã wòwɔ le Egipte,
ENGLISH: 9 And they said to him “Your servants have come from a very distant country for the fame of your God Jehovah, because we heard the report of him and all that he did in Egypt

EWE: 10 kple nu siwo katã wòwɔ Amoritɔwo ƒe fia eve siwo nɔ Yordan godo, siwo nye Sihon, Hesbon-fia, kple Og, Basan-fia si nɔ Astarot.
ENGLISH: 10 and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites on the other side of the Jordan, King Sihon of Heshbon and King ʽOg of the Bashan whose capital was ʽAshtaroth,

EWE: 11 Eya ta míaƒe ametsitsiwo kple míaƒe anyigbadzitɔwo katã gblɔ na mí be: ‘Mitsɔ mɔdzinuɖuɖu ɖe asi miayi aɖakpe wo. Migblɔ na wo be: “Míazu miaƒe subɔviwo; eya ta mibla nu kpli mí.”’
ENGLISH: 11 and our elders and all the inhabitants of our country said to us ‘Take provisions with you for the journey and go to meet them and say to them “We are your servants; now make a treaty with us.’”

EWE: 12 Abolo siawo la, abolo dzodzoe wonye nɔ mía si gbe si gbe míedzo le míaƒe aƒewo me gbɔna mia gbɔ afi sia. Ke azɔ abe ale si miawo ŋutɔwo miakpɔe ene la, woƒu hefli kakɛkakɛ.
ENGLISH: 12 This is our bread: we provisioned ourselves with it hot out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you, and now here it is dried up and gone to crumbling.

EWE: 13 Eye waingolo siawo le yeye hafi míeku wain ɖe wo me, ke azɔ la wovuvu.
ENGLISH: 13 These are the skins of wine that we filled new, and here they are punctured.

EWE: Eye míaƒe awuwo kple afɔkpawo vuvu le ale si gbegbe mɔa didii ta.”
ENGLISH: And these are our clothes and sandals; they are worn out with the great length of the journey.”

EWE: 14 Eye ŋutsuawo xɔ woƒe nuɖuɖuawo ƒe ɖe, gake womebia gbe Yehowa se o.
ENGLISH: 14 And the men took some of their provisions without having asked Jehovah’s voice.

EWE: 15 Eye Yosua wɔ ŋutifafa kpli wo, eye wòbla nu kpli wo be yeana woanɔ agbe, eye ha la ƒe tatɔwo ka atam na wo tsɔ ɖo kpe esia dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 And Joshuaʽ made with them a treaty of peace and security for their lives, and the princes of the congregation swore to them.

EWE: 16 Esi wobla nu kpli wo ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la, wova se be womele adzɔge tso yewo gbɔ o, yewoƒe nutoa me koe wole.
ENGLISH: 16 And at the end of three days after they had made a treaty with them they heard that they were neighbors and lived in among them.

EWE: 17 Eye Israel-viwo dze mɔ eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, wova ɖo woƒe duwo me; woƒe duawoe nye Gibeon, Kefira, Beerot kple Kiriat-Yearim.
ENGLISH: 17 And the sons of Israel marched, and came to their cities on the third day, their cities being Gibeon and the Kephirah and Beeroth and Kirjath-Jeʽarim;

EWE: 18 Gake Israel-viwo medze wo dzi o, elabena ha la ƒe tatɔwo ka atam na wo le Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ me.
ENGLISH: 18 and the sons of Israel did not kill them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Israel’s God Jehovah.

EWE: Eye ha blibo la lĩ liʋiliʋĩ le tatɔawo ŋu.
ENGLISH: And all the congregation complained against the princes;

EWE: 19 Eye tatɔawo gblɔ na ha blibo la be: “Esi míeka atam na wo le Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋkɔ me ta la, míekpɔ mɔ awɔ nu vevi wo o.
ENGLISH: 19 but all the princes said to all the congregation “We have sworn to them by Israel’s God Jehovah, and now we cannot touch them.

EWE: 20 Nu si wɔ ge míalae nye esi: Míana woanɔ agbe, ne dziku nagava mía dzi le atam si míeka na wo la ta o.”
ENGLISH: 20 This we will do to them, and spare their lives, and not have wrath upon us for the oath we swore to them.

EWE: 21 Eye tatɔawo gblɔ kpee be: “Mina woanɔ agbe, gake woazu nakefɔlawo kple tsidulawo na ha blibo la katã.”
ENGLISH: 21 Let them live and be wood-gatherer and water-carriers for all the congregation.”

EWE: Nya siawoe tatɔawo tsɔ do ŋugbee na wo.”
ENGLISH: And all the congregation did as the princes had said for them.

EWE: 22 Azɔ Yosua yɔ wo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Nu ka tae mieflu mí gblɔ be, ‘Didiƒe kee míetso,’ evɔ wònye mía gbɔ afi sia ko miele?
ENGLISH: 22 And Joshuaʽ called them and spoke to them, saying “Why have you played this trick on us, to say ‘we are very distant from you’ when you live in among us?

EWE: 23 Tso fifia la, woƒo fi de mi, eye mianye kluviwo ahazu nakefɔlawo kple tsidulawo na nye Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖaa.”
ENGLISH: 23 now cursed are you, you shall never cease to furnish slaves gathering wood and carrying water for the house of my God.”

EWE: 24 Eye woɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Nu si tae nye be, wogblɔ na wò subɔviwo be Yehowa wò Mawu la de se na eƒe subɔla Mose be wòatsɔ anyigba blibo la katã ana mi, eye wòatsrɔ̃ anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã gbidigbidi le mia ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 24 And they answered Joshuaʽ “Because your servants had been told what commission your God Jehovah had given his servant Moses, to give you all the country and to root out before you all the inhabitants of the country; and we were in great fear for our lives on your account, and did this thing.

EWE: Eya ta míevɔ̃ ɖe míaƒe agbe ta le mia ta, esia tae míewɔ nu sia ɖo. 25 Azɔ míele asiwò me.
ENGLISH: 25 Now here we are in your hands: do with us as you think best and fittest to.”

EWE: Wɔ nu sia nu si nèkpɔ be enyo hesɔ la kpli mí.” 26 Eye nenemae wòwɔ wo; eɖe wo tso Israel-viwo si me, eye womewu wo o.
ENGLISH: 26 And he did so for them, and delivered them out of the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them;

EWE: 27 Gake tso gbe ma gbe la, Yosua na wozu nakefɔlawo kple tsidulawo na ha la kple Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la le teƒe si Mawu atia la, wogale esia wɔwɔ dzi va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: 27 but on that day Joshuaʽ gave them to be wood-gatherers and water-carriers for the congregation and for Jehovah’s altar, as they are to this day, at the place he was to choose.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 10 Esi Yerusalem-fia Adoni-Zedek nya se be Yosua xɔ Ai eye wòtsrɔ̃e gbidii, ewɔ Ai kple eƒe fia abe ale si tututu wòwɔ Yeriko kple eƒe fia ene, eye Gibeontɔwo wɔ ŋutifafa kple Israel, eye wole wo dome ko la,
ENGLISH: 10 And when King Adoni-Sedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshuaʽ had taken the Ghai and destroyed it without quarter, had done to the Ghai and its king the same as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with the Israelites and were among them,

EWE: 2 dzidzi ƒoe ŋutɔ, elabena Gibeon du la lolo abe fiaduawo dometɔ ɖeka ene. Elolo wu Ai, eye eme ŋutsuwo katã nye aʋakalẽtɔwo.
ENGLISH: 2 he was badly frightened, because Gibeon was a great city like one of the royal capitals, and because it was larger than the Ghai and all its men were champion warriors.

EWE: 3 Eya ta Yerusalem-fia Adoni-Zedek ɖo du sia ɖe Hebron-fia Hoham kple Yarmut-fia Piram kple Lakis-fia Yafia kpakple Eglon-fia Debir be:
ENGLISH: 3 And King Adoni-Sedek of Jerusalem sent word to King Hoham of Hebron and King Piram of Jarmuth and King Japhiaʽ of Lakish and King Debir of ʽEglon

EWE: 4 “Miva kpe ɖe ŋunye ne míaho aʋa ɖe Gibeon ŋu, elabena ewɔ ŋutifafa kple Yosua kpakple Israel-viwo.”
ENGLISH: 4 “Come up to me and help me conquer Gibeon, because it has made peace with Joshuaʽ and the sons of Israel”;

EWE: 5 Ale Amoritɔwo ƒe fia atɔ̃ siwo nye Yerusalem-fia, Hebron-fia, Yarmut-fia, Lakis-fia, Eglon-fia kple woƒe aʋakɔwo katã ƒo ƒu, eye wova ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Gibeon ŋu be yewoakpe aʋa kplii.
ENGLISH: 5 and the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lakish, the king of ʽEglon, they and all their armies, came together and went up and beleaguered Gibeon and attacked it.

EWE: 6 Eye Gibeon ŋutsuwo dɔ ame ɖo ɖe Yosua le asaɖa la me le Gilgal be: “Mègagblẽ wò kluviwo ɖi o. Va kaba ne nàxɔ na mí, eye nàkpe ɖe mía ŋu! Amoritɔwo ƒe fia siwo katã le tonutoa me la ƒo takpli ɖe mía ŋu.”
ENGLISH: 6 And the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshuaʽ at the camp at the Gilgal “Do not neglect your servants; come right up to us and help us and save us, because all the Amorite kings in the highland have gathered against us.”

EWE: 7 Eya ta Yosua kple aʋawɔlawo kpakple kalẽtɔwo katã ho tso Gilgal yi.
ENGLISH: 7 And Joshuaʽ went up from the Gilgal, he and all the fighting force with him, and all the first-class men.

EWE: 8 Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Mègavɔ̃ wo o, elabena metsɔ wo de asi na wò. Wo dometɔ aɖeke mate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwò o.”
ENGLISH: 8 And Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ “Do not be afraid of them, because I have given them into your hands; not a man of them shall stand before you.”

EWE: 9 Eye Yosua zɔ zã blibo la katã tso Gilgal va dze wo dzi le vo me.
ENGLISH: 9 And Joshuaʽ came upon them suddenly, having made an all-night march up from the Gilgal;

EWE: 10 Eye Yehowa na wotɔtɔ le Israel ŋkume, eye wowu wo eteƒe mekɔ o le Gibeon, eye wokplɔ wo ɖo to todzimɔ si yi Bet-Horon, eye wonɔ wo wum va se ɖe keke Azeka kple Makeda ke.
ENGLISH: 10 and Jehovah threw them into confusion before the Israelites, and they inflicted a great defeat on them at Gibeon and pursued them along the road to the place where it goes up at Beth-Horon, and cut them down clear to ʽAzekah and to Makkedah.

EWE: 11 Esime wonɔ sisim le Israel nu, eye wonɔ Bet-Horon ƒe abu ɖim la, Yehowa na tsikpe gãwo dza tso dziƒo ɖe wo dzi, va se ɖe keke Azeka ke eye woku. Le nyateƒe me la, ame siwo tsikpeawo wu sɔ gbɔ wu ame siwo Israel-viwo wu kple yi.
ENGLISH: 11 And when they ran before the Israelites, as they were on the downward road at Beth-Horon Jehovah threw great stones on them out of the sky as far as ʽAzekah, and they were more of them killed by the hailstones than the sons of Israel killed with swords.

EWE: 12 Ɣemaɣi, le gbe si gbe Yehowa si Amoritɔwo vevie le Israel-viwo ŋgɔ lae Yosua gblɔ na Yehowa le Israel-viwo ŋkume be: “Ɣe, tɔ ɖe Gibeon tame, Eye ɣleti, tɔ ɖe Aiyalon Bali la tame!”
ENGLISH: 12 Then Joshuaʽ spoke to Jehovah on the day that Jehovah gave the Amorites to be defeated before the sons of Israel, and said before the Israelites “Sun, halt at Gibeon, and moon, in Aijalon Vale!”

EWE: 13 Ale ɣe la tɔ ɖi, eye ɣleti hã meɖe zɔ o va se ɖe esime dukɔ la bia hlɔ̃ eƒe futɔwo.
ENGLISH: 13 And the sun halted and the moon stood still till a nation avenged itself on its enemies.

EWE: Ðe womeŋlɔe ɖe Yasar ƒe agbalẽ me oa?
ENGLISH: (This is included in the Book of the Upright.)

EWE: Eye ɣe tɔ ɖe dziƒo titina, eye meɖe abla yi ɖaɖo to o abe ŋkeke ɖeka blibo ene.
ENGLISH: And the sun stood still halfway across the sky and did not press on to setting for about an entire day.

EWE: 14 Ŋkeke aɖeke menɔ abe esia ene kpɔ o, eɖanye do ŋgɔ nɛ alo le emegbe, si me Yehowa ɖo to amegbetɔ ƒe gbe o, elabena Yehowa nɔ aʋa wɔm na Israel.
ENGLISH: 14 And there was never a day like that, before or after, of Jehovah’s obeying a man; for Jehovah was fighting for Israel.

EWE: 15 Le ema megbe la, Yosua kple Israel-viwo katã gbugbɔ va asaɖa la me le Gilgal.
ENGLISH: 15 And Joshuaʽ, and all Israel with him, went back to the camp at the Gilgal.

EWE: 16 Ke fia atɔ̃awo si yi ɖabe ɖe agado me le Makeda.
ENGLISH: 16 And these five kings took flight and hid in the cave at Makkedah.

EWE: 17 Eye wova gblɔ na Yosua be: “Wokpɔ fia atɔ̃awo wobe ɖe agado me le Makeda.”
ENGLISH: 17 And Joshuaʽ was told “The five kings are found, hiding in the cave at Makkedah.”

EWE: 18 Eya ta Yosua gblɔ be: “Mimli kpe gãwo ɖo agado la nu, eye miɖe ŋutsuwo woadzɔ wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 18 And Joshuaʽ said “Roll great stones to the mouth of the cave, and station men over it to watch them,

EWE: 19 Ke mi ame susɔeawo, migatɔ o. Minya miaƒe futɔwo ɖe nu, eye minɔ wo wum tso wo megbe. Migaɖe mɔ na wo woage ɖe woƒe duawo me o, elabena Yehowa mia Mawu tsɔ wo de asi na mi.”
ENGLISH: 19 but do not stop yourselves; pursue your enemies and keep cutting off their rear, give them no chance to get into their cities, because your God Jehovah has given them into your hands.”

EWE: 20 Yosua kple Israel-viwo wu wo dometɔ gbogbo aɖewo hetsrɔ̃ wo katã kloe, negbe agbetsila ʋɛ aɖewo koe susɔ siwo si yi ɖabe ɖe woƒe du sesẽwo me;
ENGLISH: 20 But when Joshuaʽ and the sons of Israel finished slaying them by wholesale till they were all gone and the survivors had made good their escape and got into the fortified cities,

EWE: 21 ke aʋakɔ blibo la katã trɔ yi asaɖa la me le Yosua gbɔ le Makeda dedie. Ame aɖeke megake atse gblɔ nya aɖeke ɖe Israel-viwo ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 21 and all the people had come back to Makkedah to Joshuaʽ safe and sound, not a man putting out his tongue against the sons of Israel,

EWE: 22 Azɔ Yosua gblɔ be: “Miʋu nu le agado la nu, ne miakplɔ fia atɔ̃awo do goe tso agado la me vɛ nam.”
ENGLISH: 22 Joshuaʽ said “Open the mouth of the cave and bring these five kings out of the cave to me”;

EWE: 23 Eye wokplɔ fia atɔ̃awo tso agado la me vɛ nɛ: Yerusalem-fia, Hebron-fia, Yarmut-fia, Lakis-fia kple Eglon-fia.
ENGLISH: 23 and they did so, and brought these five kings out of the cave to him, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lakish, the king of ʽEglon.

EWE: 24 Esi wokplɔ fia siawo vɛ na Yosua la, eyɔ Israel ŋutsuwo katã, eye wògblɔ na aʋakplɔla siwo yi kplii la be: “Mite va ŋgɔ. Mitsɔ miaƒe afɔwo ɖo fia siawo ƒe ʋume.”
ENGLISH: 24 And when they brought these kings out to Joshuaʽ, Joshuaʽ called all the men of Israel and said to the chieftains of the fighting men who had gone with him “Come here, set your feet on the necks of these kings”; and they came up and set their feet on their necks.

EWE: Eya ta wote va ŋgɔ, eye wotsɔ woƒe afɔwo ɖo woƒe ʋume. 25 Eye Yosua gblɔ na wo be: “Migavɔ̃ o, eye ŋɔ megadzi mi o. Milé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye misẽ ŋu, elabena aleae Yehowa awɔ miaƒe futɔ siwo katã ŋu mieho aʋa ɖo lae.”
ENGLISH: 25 And Joshuaʽ said to them “Do not be afraid nor dismayed; courage, and do your best, because Jehovah will do the like to all your enemies with whom you are fighting.”

EWE: 26 Emegbe Yosua wu wo, eye wòhe wo ɖe ati atɔ̃ ŋu, eye wonɔ atiawo ŋu va se ɖe fiẽ.
ENGLISH: 26 And after that Joshuaʽ struck them dead and hung them on five trees, and they hung on the trees till evening;

EWE: 27 Le ɣetrɔ la, Yosua ɖe gbe be woayi aɖaɖe wo le atiawo ŋu, eye wokɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe agado si me wobe ɖo la me.
ENGLISH: 27 and at sunset Joshuaʽ gave orders and they took them down off the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden and placed great stones on the mouth of the cave, where they remain to this very day.

EWE: Eye wotsɔ kpe gãwo ɖo agado la nu, eye wogale afi ma va se ɖe egbe. 28 Gbe ma gbe Yosua xɔ Makeda, eye wòsii kple yi. Etsrɔ̃ eƒe fia kple ame siwo katã le eme la gbidigbidi. Mena ame aɖeke tsi agbe o. Ewɔ Makeda-fia abe ale si wòwɔ Yeriko-fia ene.
ENGLISH: 28 And Joshuaʽ took Makkedah that day and massacred its people, giving no quarter to anything in it that breathed, not leaving a survivor, and did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

EWE: 29 Eye Yosua kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔ blibo la ho tso Makeda yi Libna, eye wowɔ aʋa kple Libna.
ENGLISH: 29 And Joshuaʽ and all Israel with him went over from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked Libnah;

EWE: 30 Eye Yehowa tsɔ Libna hã kple eƒe fia de asi na Israel, eye wotsrɔ̃ emenɔlawo katã kple yi, womena ame aɖeke tsi agbe le eme o. Ale wowɔ eƒe fia la abe ale si wowɔ Yeriko-fia ene.
ENGLISH: 30 and Jehovah gave it too, and its king, into Israel’s hands, and they massacred its people and everything in it that breathed, not leaving a survivor in it, and did to its king as they had to the king of Jericho.

EWE: 31 Eyome Yosua kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔ blibo la ho tso Libna yi Lakis, eye woyi ɖaƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe afi ma eye wowɔ aʋa kplii.
ENGLISH: 31 And Joshuaʽ and all Israel with him went over from Libnah to Lakish and beleaguered it and attacked it,

EWE: 32 Yehowa tsɔ Lakis de asi na Israel, eye woxɔe le ŋkeke evea gbe. Wotsrɔ̃ dua kple emenɔlawo katã kple yi, abe ale si ko wowɔ Libna ene.
ENGLISH: 32 and Jehovah gave Lakish into Israel’s hands, and they took it on the second day and massacred its people and destroyed it all without quarter, just as they had done to Libnah.

EWE: 33 Eye Gezer-fia Horam yi ɖakpe ɖe Lakis ŋu, gake Yosua si eya kple eƒe dukɔ la va se ɖe esime ame aɖeke metsi agbe o.
ENGLISH: 33 Then King Horam of Gezer came up to help Lakish, and Joshuaʽ defeated him and his people and cut them down till he did not leave him a survivor.

EWE: 34 Yosua kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔ blibo la ho tso Lakis yi Eglon, eye woyi ɖaƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe eŋu hewɔ aʋa kplii.
ENGLISH: 34 And Joshuaʽ and all Israel with him went over from Lakish to ʽEglon and beleaguered it and attacked it,

EWE: 35 Woxɔe gbe ma gbe, eye wosii kple yi. Wotsrɔ̃ emenɔlawo katã gbe ma gbe, abe ale si ko wowɔ Lakis ene.
ENGLISH: 35 and took it that same day and massacred its people and everything in it that breathed, destroying all without quarter that same day, just as they had done to Lakish.

EWE: 36 Eye Yosua kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔ blibo la ho tso Eglon yi Hebron, eye wowɔ aʋa kplii.
ENGLISH: 36 And Joshuaʽ and all Israel with him went up from ʽEglon to Hebron and attacked it,

EWE: 37 Woxɔe hetsrɔ̃e kple eƒe fia, eƒe duwo kple emenɔlawo katã kple yi. Mena ame aɖeke tsi agbe o, abe ale si ko wòwɔ Eglon ene, etsrɔ̃ eya kple emenɔlawo katã gbidii.
ENGLISH: 37 and took it, and massacred its people and everything in it that breathed, not leaving a survivor, just as they had done to ʽEglon, and destroyed without quarter it and everything in it.

EWE: 38 Eyome Yosua kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔ blibo la trɔ ɖo ta Debir, eye wowɔ aʋa kplii.
ENGLISH: 38 And Joshuaʽ and all Israel with him came back to Debir and attacked it,

EWE: 39 Exɔe kple eŋu duwo katã, elé eƒe fia la, eye wotsrɔ̃ duawo kple wo me nɔlawo katã kple yi, mena ame aɖeke tsi agbe o. Ewɔ Debir kple eƒe fia abe ale si tututu wòwɔ Hebron kpakple Libna kple eƒe fia ene.
ENGLISH: 39 and took it and its king and all its cities, and massacred their people and destroyed without quarter everything in it that breathed, not leaving a survivor; they did to Debir and its king the same as they had done to Hebron and as they had done to Libnah and its king.

EWE: 40 Yosua ɖu anyigba siwo katã le tonutoa me, Negeb, Sefela kple toŋuduwo kpakple woƒe fiawo katã dzi, mena ame aɖeke tsi agbe o; etsrɔ̃ ame sia ame gbidigbidi, abe ale si tututu Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, de see ene.
ENGLISH: 40 And Joshuaʽ conquered all the country, the highland and the South and the lowland and the steeps, and all their kings, not leaving a survivor, and everything that breathed he destroyed without quarter, as Israel’s God Jehovah had commanded.

EWE: 41 Yosua ɖu wo dzi tso Kades-Barnea va se ɖe Gaza, tso Gosen-nyigba blibo la dzi va se ɖe Gibeon.
ENGLISH: 41 And Joshuaʽ conquered them from Kadesh-Barneaʽ to Ghaza, and all the Goshen country, to Gibeon;

EWE: 42 Eye Yosua ɖu fia siawo kple woƒe anyigbawo katã dzi le aʋahoho ɖeka me, elabena Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, lae nɔ aʋa wɔm na Israel.
ENGLISH: 42 and all these kings and their country Joshuaʽ took at one time, because Israel’s God Jehovah was fighting for Israel.

EWE: 43 Emegbe Yosua kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔ blibo la katã trɔ gbɔ va asaɖa la me le Gilgal.
ENGLISH: 43 And Joshuaʽ and all Israel with him went back to the camp at the Gilgal.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 11 Esi Hazor-fia Yabin nya see ko la, eɖo du ɖe Madon-fia Yobab, Simron-fia kple Aksaf-fia,
ENGLISH: 11 And when King Jabin of Hasor heard of it he sent to King Jobab of Madon and the king of Shimron and the king of Acshaph

EWE: 2 fia siwo le tonutowo me le dziehe, esiwo le tagba le Kineret ƒe anyiehe, Sefela kple Dor togbɛwo dzi le ɣetoɖoƒe,
ENGLISH: 2 and the kings on the north, in the highland and in the Rift Valley about Kinneroth and in the lowland, and in Naphath-Dor on the west,

EWE: 3 kpakple Kanaantɔ siwo le ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, Amoritɔwo, Hititɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Yebusitɔ siwo le tonutoa me, kple Hivitɔ siwo le Hermon To la ƒe bali me le Mizpa-nyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 the Canaanites to east and to west and the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Jebusites in the highland and the Hivvites under Hermon in the Mispah country;

EWE: 4 Eya ta woho va kple woƒe aʋakɔwo katã, wosɔ gbɔ abe ƒutake ene; wova kple sɔwo kple aʋatasiaɖam gbogbo aɖewo.
ENGLISH: 4 and they came out, they and all their armies with them, a great body, as numerous as the grains of sand on the seashore, and ponies and chariots in great numbers;

EWE: 5 Fia siawo katã ɖo gbe ɖi, eye wova ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Merom-tɔʋu la nu be yewoakpe aʋa kple Israel.
ENGLISH: 5 and all these kings combined and came and encamped together by Merom Water to make war with Israel.

EWE: 6 Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be: “Mègavɔ̃ wo o, elabena etsɔ ɣealewoɣi la, mawu wo katã na Israel. Nàtso agbeka na woƒe sɔwo, eye nàtɔ dzo woƒe tasiaɖamwo.”
ENGLISH: 6 And Jehovah said to Joshuaʽ “Do not be afraid of them, because at this time tomorrow I am going to have them all fallen before Israel; their ponies you shall hamstring and their chariots you shall burn up.”

EWE: 7 Yosua kple aʋawɔlaawo katã va ƒo ɖe wo dzi le vo me le Merom-tɔʋu la nu.
ENGLISH: 7 And Joshuaʽ, and all the fighting men with him, came against them by Merom Water suddenly, and came down on them;

EWE: 8 Yehowa tsɔ wo de asi na Israel, eye woɖu wo dzi, eye wonya wo ɖe nu va se ɖe keke Sidon Gã kple Misrefot-Mayim kpakple gbadzaƒe si le Mizpe Bali si le ɣedzeƒe la me ke, wonɔ wo wum va se ɖe esime ame aɖeke metsi agbe o.
ENGLISH: 8 and Jehovah gave them into Israel’s hands, and they defeated them and pursued them to great Sidon and to Misrephoth-Mayim, and to Mispeh Plain on the east; and they cut them down till they did not leave them a survivor.

EWE: 9 Emegbe Yosua wɔ wo abe ale si tututu Yehowa gblɔ nɛ ene; etso agbeka na woƒe sɔwo, eye wòtɔ dzo woƒe tasiaɖamwo.
ENGLISH: 9 And Joshuaʽ did to them as Jehovah had told him to, hamstrung their ponies and burned up their chariots.

EWE: 10 Gawu la, Yosua trɔ va xɔ Hazor, eye wòwu eƒe fia kple yi, elabena Hazor ye nye fiaɖuƒe siawo katã ƒe ta tsã.
ENGLISH: 10 And, as before, at that time Joshuaʽ took Hasor and killed its king in the fighting, for Hasor used to be the head of all these kingdoms.

EWE: 11 Wowu emenɔlawo katã kple yi hetsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi. Womegblẽ ame aɖeke ɖi o.
ENGLISH: 11 And they massacred every person in it, giving no quarter; none that breathed was left; and Hasor they burned down.

EWE: Eye wòtɔ dzo Hazor. 12 Yosua xɔ fia siawo ƒe duwo katã, eye wòwu woƒe fiawo katã kple yi. Etsrɔ̃ wo gbidii, abe ale si tututu Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose de se ene.
ENGLISH: 12 And all the capitals of these kings, and all their kings, Joshuaʽ took, and massacred their people without quarter, as Jehovah’s servant Moses had commanded.

EWE: 13 Ke Israel metɔ dzo du siwo le woƒe togbɛwo dzi la dometɔ aɖeke o, negbe Hazor koe Yosua tɔ dzoe.
ENGLISH: 13 Only all the cities that are standing on their old sites Israel did not burn, but that Joshuaʽ burned Hasor alone.

EWE: 14 Israel-viwo ha du siawo ƒe aboyonuwo katã kple lãwo na wo ɖokuiwo. Gake wowu ame sia ame kple yi va se ɖe esime wotsrɔ̃ wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe.
ENGLISH: 14 And all the booty of these cities, and the cattle, the sons of Israel plundered for themselves; only all the human beings they massacred till they had rooted them out; they left none that breathed.

EWE: Womena ame aɖeke tsi agbe o. 15 Ale si tututu Yehowa de se na eƒe subɔla Mose la, nenemae Mose de se na Yosua, eye nenema tututue Yosua wɔ.
ENGLISH: 15 As Jehovah had commanded his servant Moses, so Moses had commanded Joshuaʽ, and so Joshuaʽ did; he did not take off a thing from all that Jehovah had commanded Moses.

EWE: Ewɔ nu siwo katã ƒe se Yehowa de na Mose la pɛpɛpɛ, meɖe ɖeke le eme o. 16 Yosua xɔ anyigba siawo katã, tonuto la, Negeb blibo la, Gosen-nyigba blibo la, Sefela, Araba, Israel tonuto la kple eƒe Sefela,
ENGLISH: 16 And Joshuaʽ took all this country, the highland and all the South and all the Goshen country and the lowland and the Rift Valley, and the highland of Israel and its lowland,

EWE: 17 tso Halak To si ɖo ta Seir la gbɔ va se ɖe keke Baal-Gad si le Lebanon Bali me le Hermon Toa te ke, eye wòɖu woƒe fiawo katã dzi hewu wo.
ENGLISH: 17 from Bald Mountain that goes up to Seʽir to Baal-Gad in the Lebanon Plain under Mount Hermon; and all their kings he took and struck them dead.

EWE: 18 Yosua wɔ aʋa kple fia siawo ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe.
ENGLISH: 18 Joshuaʽ was a long time making war with all these kings.

EWE: 19 Du aɖeke mewɔ ŋutifafa kple Israel-viwo o, negbe Hivitɔwo, ame siwo le Gibeon la ko.
ENGLISH: 19 There was not a city that made peace with the sons of Israel except the Hivvites that lived in Gibeon: they took all by war,

EWE: Ke wowɔ aʋa xɔ du bubuawo katã. 20 Elabena Yehowa ye ɖe mɔ woƒe dzi me sẽ, be woaho aʋa ɖe Israel ŋu, ale be wòatsrɔ̃ wo nublanuimakpɔmakpɔe.
ENGLISH: 20 because it was determined by Jehovah to make them headstrong to face the war with Israel in order that they might be destroyed without quarter and have no claim to mercy, because the purpose was to root them out as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

EWE: Ele be woatsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi, abe ale si tututu Yehowa de se na Mose ene. 21 Ɣemaɣi la, Yosua yi ɖatsrɔ̃ Anakitɔwo ɖa le tonuto la me, le Hebron, le Debir, le Anab, le Yuda tonuto bliboa me kple Israel tonuto bliboa katã me.
ENGLISH: 21 And at that time Joshuaʽ went in and exterminated the ʽAnakites out of the highland: out of Hebron, out of Debir, out of ʽAnab, and out of all the highland of Judah and out of all the highland of Israel; Joshuaʽ destroyed them without quarter with their cities.

EWE: Yosua tsrɔ̃ wo kple woƒe duwo gbidii. 22 Anakitɔ aɖeke mekpɔtɔ ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe anyigba dzi o.
ENGLISH: 22 There were no ʽAnakites left in the Israelite country; only in Ghaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod did any remain.

EWE: Negbe Gaza, Gat kple Asdod ko. 23 Ale Yosua xɔ anyigba blibo la katã, abe ale si Yehowa do ŋugbe na Mose ene, eye Yosua tsɔ anyigba la na Israel-viwo wotɔwotɔe wòzu woƒe domenyinu be woamae le woƒe toawo me.
ENGLISH: 23 And Joshuaʽ took all the country, just as Jehovah had promised Moses; and Joshuaʽ gave it to the Israelites by their divisions, tribe by tribe, as an estate.

EWE: Eye anyigba la kpɔ gbɔdzɔe tso aʋawɔwɔ me.
ENGLISH: And the country was at rest from war.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 12 Azɔ esiawoe nye anyigba la dzi fia siwo dzi Israel-viwo ɖu, ame siwo ƒe anyigba woxɔ le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, tso Arnon Bali la nu va se ɖe Hermon To la gbɔ kple Araba blibo la le ɣedzeƒe:
ENGLISH: 12 And these are the kings of the country, whom the sons of Israel defeated and took possession of their country, on the east side of the Jordan, from Arnon Arroyo to Mount Hermon and all the eastern Rift Valley:

EWE: 2 Sihon, Amori-fia si nɔ Hesbon ƒe dziɖuƒe tso Aroer si le Arnon Bali nu, kple tso balia titina hekpe ɖe Gilead ƒe afã ŋu va se ɖe keke Yabok Bali, si nye Amonitɔwo ƒe liƒo, la me ke.
ENGLISH: 2 King Sihon of the Amorites, whose capital was Heshbon, ruler from ʽAroer on the brink of Arnon Arroyo, and the middle of the arroyo, and half Gilead, to Jabbok Arroyo, the boundary of the Bene-ʽAmmon,

EWE: 3 Eƒe dziɖuƒe la gatso Araba va se ɖe keke Kineret-ƒu la nu le ɣedzeƒe gome va se ɖe keke Araba-ƒu, si nye Dzeƒu la nu le ɣedzeƒe ɖo ta Bet-Yesimot, va se ɖe Pisga-to ƒe aga nu le anyiehe.
ENGLISH: 3 and the Rift Valley to the eastern shore of the Sea of Kinneroth and to the eastern shore of the Dead Sea, the Salt Sea, on the way to Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, and to the south under the steeps of the Pisgah.

EWE: 4 Hekpe ɖe Og, Basan-fia, si nye Refaimtɔ mamlɛawo dometɔ ɖeka si nɔ Astarot kple Edrei la ƒe anyigba hã ŋu,
ENGLISH: 4 And King ʽOg of the Bashan, one of the remnant of the ogres, whose capitals were ʽAshtaroth and Edrei,

EWE: 5 ame si ƒe dziɖuƒe nye Hermon To, Saleka kple Basan blibo la va se ɖe keke Gesurtɔwo kple Maakatitɔwo ƒe liƒo dzi ke, hekpe ɖe Gilead ƒe afã ŋu va se ɖe Hesbon-fia, Sihon, ƒe anyigba dzi ke.
ENGLISH: 5 and ruler in Mount Hermon and in Salcah and in all the Bashan to the boundary of the Geshurites and the Maʽacathites, and half Gilead, bordering on King Sihon of Heshbon.

EWE: 6 Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose kple Israel-viwo ɖu wo dzi, eye Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose tsɔ woƒe anyigba na Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo kpakple Manase-toa ƒe afã la be wòanye wo tɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 Jehovah’s servant Moses and the sons of Israel defeated them, and Moses gave it to the Reubenites and the Gadites and half the tribe of Manasseh as their possession.

EWE: 7 Esiawoe nye anyigba la dzi fia siwo dzi Yosua kple Israel-viwo ɖu le Yordan ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe gome, tso Baal-Gad si le Lebanon Bali la me va se ɖe keke Halak To, si ɖo ta Seir gbɔ ke; emegbe Yosua ma woƒe anyigba la na Israel-toawo wotɔwotɔwoe be wòanye wo tɔ,
ENGLISH: 7 And these are the kings of the country that Joshuaʽ and the sons of Israel conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal-Gad in the Lebanon Plain to Bald Mountain that goes up to Seʽir, and Joshuaʽ gave it to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their divisions:

EWE: 8 le tonuto la me, le Sefela, Araba, agawo me, gbegbe kple Negeb. Esiawoe nye Hititɔwo, Amoritɔwo kple Kanaantɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Hivitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo ƒe anyigba. Fia siawoe nye:
ENGLISH: 8 in the highland and the lowland and the Rift Valley and the steeps and the wilderness and the South, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivvites, and the Jebusites:

EWE: 9 Yeriko-fia, ɖeka; Ai, si le Betel xa la ƒe fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 9 the king of Jericho, one; the king of the Ghai beside Bethel, one;

EWE: 10 Yerusalem-fia, ɖeka; Hebron-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 10 the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

EWE: 11 Yarmut-fia, ɖeka; Lakis-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 11 the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lakish, one;

EWE: 12 Eglon-fia, ɖeka; Gezer-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 12 the king of ʽEglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

EWE: 13 Debir-fia, ɖeka; Geder-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 13 the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

EWE: 14 Horma-fia, ɖeka; Arad-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 14 the king of Hormah, one; the king of ʽArad, one;

EWE: 15 Libna-fia, ɖeka; Adulam-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 15 the king of Libnah, one; the king of ʽAdullam, one;

EWE: 16 Makeda-fia, ɖeka; Betel-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 16 the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

EWE: 17 Tapua-fia, ɖeka; Hefer-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 17 the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

EWE: 18 Afek-fia, ɖeka; Lasaron-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 18 the king of Aphek in the Sharon, one;

EWE: 19 Madon-fia, ɖeka; Hazor-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 19 the king of Madon, one; the king of Hasor, one;

EWE: 20 Simron-Meron fia, ɖeka; Aksaf-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 20 the king of Shimron-Meron, one; the king of Acshaph, one;

EWE: 21 Taanak-fia, ɖeka; Megido-fia, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 21 the king of Taʽanac, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

EWE: 22 Kedes-fia, ɖeka; Yokneam-fia si le Karmel, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 22 the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneʽam in Carmel, one;

EWE: 23 Dor-fia si le Dor togbɛ dzi, ɖeka; Goim-fia si le Gilgal, ɖeka;
ENGLISH: 23 the king of Dor in Naphoth-Dor, one; the king of nations in the mark, one;

EWE: 24 Tirza-fia, ɖeka; fiaawo katã le blaetɔ̃ vɔ ɖekɛ.
ENGLISH: 24 the king of Tirsah, one; total, thirty-one kings.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 13 Yosua tsi xɔ ƒe geɖe. Eya ta Yehowa gblɔ nɛ be: “Ètsi ku amegã hexɔ ƒe geɖe, gake anyigba la ƒe akpa gã aɖe gakpɔtɔ li woaxɔ.
ENGLISH: 13 And when Joshuaʽ was an old man, far gone in years, Jehovah said to him “You are an old man, far gone in years, and the country to a very great extent remains to be taken possession of.

EWE: 2 Anyigba siwo susɔ la woe nye esi: Filistitɔwo ƒe nutowo katã kple Gesurtɔwo ƒe nutowo katã,
ENGLISH: 2 This is the country that remains: all the marks of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites,

EWE: 3 (tso Nil ƒe alɔdze si le Egipte ƒe ɣedzeƒe va se ɖe Ekron ƒe liƒo dzi le dziehe, si wobuna tsã be enye Kanaantɔwo ƒe anyigba) kple Filistitɔwo ƒe kplɔla atɔ̃awo ƒe anyigbawo: Gazatɔwo, Asdodtɔwo, Askelontɔwo, Gititɔwo kple Ekrontɔwo; hekpe ɖe Avitɔwo ƒe anyigba ŋu
ENGLISH: 3 from the Delta River on the frontier of Egypt to the northern boundary of ʽEkron (it counts as Canaanite), the five Sarns of the Philistines, the Ghazaite, the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gathite, and the ʽEkronite, and the ʽAvvites

EWE: 4 le anyiehe; Kanaantɔwo ƒe anyigbawo katã; Meara, si nye Sidontɔwo tɔ, va se ɖe Afek, yi Amoritɔwo ƒe liƒo dzi;
ENGLISH: 4 on the south; all the Canaanite country, from Meʽarah, which belongs to the Phenicians, to Aphek, to the boundary of the Amorites;

EWE: 5 kple Gebaltɔwo ƒe anyigbawo kple Lebanon blibo la le ɣedzeƒe, tso Baal-Gad le Hermon To la ƒe bali me va se ɖe Lebo-Hamat;
ENGLISH: 5 and the Gebalite country and all the Lebanon to the eastward, from Baal-Gad under Mount Hermon to Lebo-Hamath.

EWE: 6 tonuto la me tɔwo katã, tso Lebanon va ɖo Misrefot-Mayim; kple Sidontɔwo katã. Manya wo ɖa le Israel-viwo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 All the inhabitants of the highland, from the Lebanon to Misrephoth-Mayim, all the Phenicians, I will dispossess before the sons of Israel; only allot it to the Israelites as estate, as I commanded you to.

EWE: Ðeko wò ya nàmae na Israel wòanye eƒe domenyinu, abe ale si mede se na wò ene. 7 Azɔ ma anyigba sia wòanye domenyinu na to asiekeawo kple Manase-toa ƒe afã la.”
ENGLISH: 7 Now apportion this country as estate: to the nine tribes and the half-tribe Manasseh you shall give it from the Jordan to the great sea where the sun sets; the great sea shall bound it.”

EWE: 8 Manase-toa ƒe afã susɔea, Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo xɔ woƒe domenyinu si Mose na wo le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, abe ale si Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose na woe ene:
ENGLISH: 8 To the two tribes and the half-tribe Manasseh Moses gave on the east side of the Jordan; Jehovah’s servant Moses gave them

EWE: 9 tso Aroer, si le Arnon Bali la nu, kple du si le bali la titina, kple Medeba tonyigba gbadza blibo la va se ɖe keke Dibon ke;
ENGLISH: 9 from ʽAroʽer on the brink of Arnon Arroyo and the city in the middle of the arroyo, and all the level from Medeba to Dibon,

EWE: 10 kple Sihon, Amori-fia si ɖu fia le Hesbon la, ƒe duwo katã va se ɖe Amonitɔwo ƒe liƒo dzi;
ENGLISH: 10 and all the cities of King Sihon of the Amorites, whose capital was Heshbon, to the boundary of the Bene-ʽAmmon,

EWE: 11 kple Gilead, Gesurtɔwo kple Maakatitɔwo ƒe anyigba, hekpe ɖe Hermon To blibo la kple Basan blibo la ŋu va se ɖe keke Saleka ke;
ENGLISH: 11 and Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all the Bashan to Salcah,

EWE: 12 Og ƒe dziɖuƒe si le Basan la katã, ame si ɖu fia le Astarot kple Edrei. (Eyae nye Refaimtɔ mamlɛ si susɔ.) Mose ɖu wo dzi henya wo ɖa.
ENGLISH: 12 all the kingdom of King ʽOg of the Bashan whose capitals were ʽAshtaroth and Edrei he was left over of the remnant of the ogres; Moses defeated them and dispossessed them.

EWE: 13 Ke Israel-viwo menya Gesurtɔwo kple Maakatitɔwo ɖa o, eye Gesurtɔwo kple Maakatitɔwo kpɔtɔ le Israel-viwo dome va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: 13 But the sons of Israel did not dispossess the Geshurites and the Maʽacathites, but Geshur and Maʽacah live in the midst of Israel to this day.

EWE: 14 Lewi-to la koe mena domenyinu aɖeke o. Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, ƒe dzovɔsawoe nye woƒe domenyinu, abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na wo ene.
ENGLISH: 14 Only to the tribe of the Levites he gave no estate: Israel’s God Jehovah is their estate as he promised them.

EWE: 15 Eye Mose na domenyinu Ruben viwo ƒe to la le woƒe ƒomewo nu,
ENGLISH: 15 And this is the assignment that Moses assigned to the sons of Israel in the Moab flats on the other side of the Jordan at Jericho.

EWE: 16 eye woxɔ anyigba tso Aroer, si le Arnon Bali la nu, kple du si le bali la titina, kple Medeba tonyigba gbadza blibo la;
ENGLISH: 16 and they had their boundary from ʽAroer on the brink of Arnon Arroyo and the city in the middle of the arroyo, and all the level by Medeba,

EWE: 17 Hesbon kple eŋu du siwo katã le tonyigba gbadza la dzi, Dibon, Bamot-Baal kple Bet-Baal-Meon,
ENGLISH: 17 Heshbon and all its cities in the level, Dibon and Bamoth-Baal and Beth-Baal-Meon

EWE: 18 Yahaz, Kedemot, Mefaat,
ENGLISH: 18 and Jahsah and Kedemoth and Mephaath

EWE: 19 Kiriatayim, Sibma kple Zeret-Sahar le to si le bali me la dzi,
ENGLISH: 19 and Kirjathaim and Sibmah and Sereth-hash-Shahar on Vale Mountain

EWE: 20 Bet-Peor, Pisga ƒe agawo, Bet-Yesimot,
ENGLISH: 20 and Beth-Peghor and the steeps of the Pisgah and Beth-ha-Jeshimoth

EWE: 21 du siwo katã le tonyigba gbadza la dzi kple Sihon, Amori-fia si ɖu fia le Hesbon la, ƒe dziɖuƒe blibo la katã. Mose ɖu eya kple Midian-megã siwo nye Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, Reba, kple ame siwo nye Sihon ƒe dziɖula siwo nɔ anyigbaa dzi la dzi.
ENGLISH: 21 and all the cities of the level and all the kingdom of King Sihon of the Amorites, whose capital was Heshbon, whom Moses defeated along with the princes of Midian, Evi and Rekem and Sur and Hur and Rebaʽ, Sihon’s dukes, the natives of the country;

EWE: 22 Israel-viwo wu nukala Bileam, Beor vi, kple yi hekpe ɖe ame bubu siwo wowu la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 22 and the soothsayer Balaam the son of Beʽor the sons of Israel killed with the sword over the slain.

EWE: 23 Yordan nye Ruben viwo ƒe liƒo; eye anyigba sia nye Ruben viwo ƒe domenyinu le woƒe ƒomewo nu hekpe ɖe eƒe duwo kple kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 23 And the boundary of the sons of Reuben was the Jordan as boundary. This is the estate of the sons of Reuben clan by clan, the cities and their villages.

EWE: 24 Eye Mose na domenyinu Gad-to la le woƒe ƒomewo nu,
ENGLISH: 24 And Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, the sons of Gad, clan by clan;

EWE: 25 Yazer kple Gilead ƒe duwo katã kple Amonitɔwo ƒe anyigba ƒe afã, va se ɖe keke Aroer, si dze ŋgɔ Raba la kpe ɖe woƒe anyigba ŋu;
ENGLISH: 25 and they had as their territory Jaʽzer and all the cities of Gilead and half the country of the Bene-ʽAmmon, up to ʽAroʽer facing Rabbah,

EWE: 26 tso Hesbon yi Ramat-Mizpe kple Betonim, tso Mahanayim yi Debir ƒe liƒo dzi;
ENGLISH: 26 and from Heshbon to Mispeh Fell and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the boundary of Lodebar,

EWE: 27 Bet-Haran, Bet-Nimra, Sukot kple Zafon, siwo nye Hesbon-fia Sihon ƒe dziɖuƒe susɔea le bali la me, Yordan ye nye woƒe liƒo le Kineret-ƒu la ƒe mlɔenu le anyime, le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.
ENGLISH: 27 and in the vale Beth-Haram and Beth-Nimrah and Succoth and Saphon, the rest of the kingdom of King Sihon of Heshbon, with the Jordan as boundary, to the edge of the Sea of Kinnereth, on the east side of the Jordan.

EWE: 28 Esiae nye Gad viwo ƒe domenyinu, woƒe duwo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu, le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 28 This is the estate of the sons of Gad clan by clan, the cities and their villages.

EWE: 29 Mlɔeba Mose na domenyinu Manase-to afã la, ena Manase viwo ƒe to afã la le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 29 And Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasseh clan by clan;

EWE: 30 Woƒe anyigba tso Mahanayim hekpe ɖe Basan blibo la, si nye Basan-fia Og ƒe dziɖuƒe blibo la katã kple Yair ƒe avɔgbadɔkɔƒe siwo katã le Basan la ŋu, wole du blaade.
ENGLISH: 30 and their boundary was, from Mahanaim, all the Bashan, all the kingdom of King ʽOg of the Bashan, and all the Havvoth of Jair in the Bashan, sixty cities,

EWE: 31 Eye Gilead ƒe afã, kpakple Astarot kple Edrei, du siwo le Basan-fia Og ƒe dziɖuƒe la, zu Manase vi Makir viwo tɔ, ezu Makir viwo ƒe afã tɔ le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 31 and half of Gilead, and ʽAshtaroth and Edreʽi, ʽOg’s capitals in the Bashan, for the sons of Makir the son of Manasseh, for half the sons of Manasseh, clan by clan.

EWE: 32 Esiawoe nye domenyinu siwo Mose na wo le Moab tagba le Yordan godo le Yeriko ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.
ENGLISH: 32 This is what Moses assigned in the Moab flats on the east side of the Jordan at Jericho.

EWE: 33 Ke Mose mena domenyinu Lewi viwo o. Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawue nye woƒe domenyinu, abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na wo ene.
ENGLISH: 33 But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no estate: Israel’s God Jehovah is their estate as he promised them.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 14 Ke esiae nye domenyinu si Israel-viwo xɔ le Kanaan-nyigba dzi, si nunɔla Eleazar kple Yosua, Nun vi, kpakple Israel-viwo ƒe tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu la na wo.
ENGLISH: 14 And this is what the sons of Israel were assigned in Canaan, what Priest Eleazar and Joshuaʽ the son of Nun and the heads of families of the tribes assigned to the sons of Israel;

EWE: 2 Wodzidze nu hafi mae na to asieke kple afã la, abe ale si ko Yehowa de se to Mose dzi ene.
ENGLISH: 2 their assignment was by lot, as Jehovah had commanded by Moses, to the nine tribes and the half-tribe,

EWE: 3 Elabena Mose na domenyinu to eve kple afã kemɛawo ɖe Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi, ke mena domenyinu Lewi viwo le wo dome o.
ENGLISH: 3 because Moses had given the assignment of the two and a half tribes on the other side of the Jordan, and the Levites were given no assignment among them.

EWE: 4 Elabena wobu Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo to eve, woawoe nye Manase kple Efrayim; eye womena gome Lewi viwo le anyigba la dzi o, negbe du siwo me woanɔ kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo hena woƒe lãwo nyinyi kple woƒe nunɔamesiwo ko.
ENGLISH: 4 For the sons of Joseph had come to be two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and they gave the Levites no share in the country except cities to live in and their glebes for their stock and means.

EWE: 5 Israel-viwo ma anyigba la abe ale si tututu Yehowa de se na Mose ene.
ENGLISH: 5 As Jehovah had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did, and divided the country.

EWE: 6 Azɔ Yuda viwo va Yosua gbɔ le Gilgal, eye Kaleb, Yefune vi, si nye Kenizitɔ la, gblɔ nɛ be: “Ènya nya si Yehowa gblɔ na Mawu vavã la ƒe ame Mose le nye kpli wò ŋu le Kades-Barnea la nyuie.
ENGLISH: 6 And the sons of Judah approached Joshuaʽ at the Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenazite said to him “You know the word Jehovah spoke to Moses the man of God about you and me at Kadesh-Barneaʽ.

EWE: 7 Mexɔ ƒe blaene esime Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose dɔm tso Kades-Barnea be mayi aɖatsa ŋku le anyigba la dzi, eye meva gblɔ nu siwo mekpɔ la tututu nɛ.
ENGLISH: 7 I was forty years old when Jehovah’s servant Moses sent me from Kadesh-Barneaʽ to reconnoiter the country, and I brought him back word as I honestly thought,

EWE: 8 Togbɔ be nɔvinye siwo yi kplim la ɖe dzi le dukɔ la ƒo hã la, nye ya medze Yehowa nye Mawu yome kple dzi blibo.
ENGLISH: 8 but my brothers who had gone up with me melted down the people’s hearts while I altogether followed my God Jehovah.

EWE: 9 Mose ka atam gbe ma gbe gblɔ be: ‘Anyigba si dzi nèɖo afɔe la, azu wò kple viwòwo ƒe domenyinu ɖaa, elabena èdze Yehowa nye Mawu la yome kple dzi blibo.’
ENGLISH: 9 And Moses swore that day ‘The country your feet trod on shall belong to you and to your sons forever as estate because you altogether followed my God Jehovah.’

EWE: 10 Azɔ Yehowa na mekpɔtɔ le agbe, abe ale si tututu wòdo ŋugbee ene, ƒe blaene vɔ atɔ̃e nye esia tso esime Yehowa do ŋugbe sia na Mose esime Israel zɔ gbea dzi, mekpɔtɔ le agbe, eye mexɔ ƒe blaenyi vɔ atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 10 And now here has Jehovah kept me alive, as he promised, these forty-five years since Jehovah spoke this word to Moses, while Israel went in the wilderness; and now here I am today eighty-five years old.

EWE: 11 Gake ŋusẽ gale ŋunye egbea abe ale si wònɔ gbe si gbe Mose dɔm ene.
ENGLISH: 11 I am still strong today as I was on the day Moses sent me; my strength now is the same as my strength then, for fighting and for going out and in.

EWE: Ŋusẽ gakpɔtɔ le ŋunye egbea mate ŋu awɔ aʋa kple nu bubuwo abe ɣemaɣi ene. 12 Eya ta tsɔ tonuto si ŋugbe Yehowa do gbe ma gbe la nam. Togbɔ be èsee gbe ma gbe be Anakitɔ siwo le du gã sesẽwo me la le afi ma hã la, Yehowa anɔ kplim godoo, eye manya wo ɖa, abe ale si tututu Yehowa do ŋugbee ene.”
ENGLISH: 12 Now give me this highland that Jehovah promised on that day, because you heard on that day that there were ʽAnakites there and great fortified cities; perhaps Jehovah will be with me and I shall dispossess them as Jehovah promised.”

EWE: 13 Ale Yosua yrae, eye wòtsɔ Hebron na Kaleb, Yefune vi la, be wòanye eƒe domenyinu.
ENGLISH: 13 And Joshuaʽ blessed him and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as estate;

EWE: 14 Esia tae Hebron zu Kaleb, Yefune vi, si nye Kenizitɔ la tɔ eye wònye eƒe domenyinu va se ɖe egbe, elabena edze Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, yome kple dzi blibo.
ENGLISH: 14 that is how Hebron came to belong to Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenazite to this day, since he had altogether followed Israel’s God Jehovah.

EWE: 15 Tsã la, woyɔa Hebron be Kiriat-Arba, (Arba siae nye ame si xɔ ŋkɔ wu le Anakitɔwo dome).
ENGLISH: 15 And the former name of Hebron was Kirjath-Arbogh; it was the headquarters of the ʽAnakites.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 15 Anyigba si wona Yuda-to la ɖe woƒe ƒomeawo nu la de keke Edom ƒe liƒo dzi ke le Zin gbedzi va ɖo Negeb le eƒe nuwuƒe si le anyiehekpa dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 And the lot for the tribe of the sons of Judah, clan by clan, was to the boundary of Edom in the south of the wilderness of Sin, at its southern extremity.

EWE: 2 Woƒe anyieheliƒo tso Dzeƒu la ƒe mlɔenu, tso adɔ̃ si dze ŋgɔ anyiehe gome la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 2 And they had their southern boundary from the end of the Salt Sea, from the inlet that points south;

EWE: 3 Eye wòɖo ta anyiehe gome yi Akrabim-todzimɔ la gbɔ hemlo yi Zin, eye wòtso anyiehe yi Kades-Barnea hegamlo yi Hezron kple Adar, eye wògɔdɔ̃ ɖo ta Karka.
ENGLISH: 3 and it went out to a point south of Scorpion Pass and over to Sin and up south of Kadesh-Barneaʽ and over to Hesron and up to Addar and around to the Karkaʽ,

EWE: 4 Eto Azmon va do ɖe Egipte-tɔʋu la me, eye liƒoa va wu nu ɖe ƒu la nu. Esiae nye woƒe anyieheliƒo.
ENGLISH: 4 and over to ʽAsmon and out to Egypt Arroyo, and the termination of the boundary was at the sea: this is to be your south boundary.

EWE: 5 Ɣedzeƒeliƒo lae nye Dzeƒu la va se ɖe Yordan ƒe mlɔenu, eye liƒo si le dzogoe si le dziehe la, le ƒu la ƒe adɔ̃ nu, le Yordan ƒe mlɔenu.
ENGLISH: 5 And the east boundary was the Salt Sea to the end of the Jordan. And the boundary for the north border was from the inlet of sea at the mouth of the Jordan;

EWE: 6 Liƒo la tso afi ma va ɖo Bet-Hogla, eye wòmlo to Bet-Araba ƒe dziehe, azɔ liƒo la gayi ŋgɔ ɖado ɖe Ruben vi Bohan ƒe kpe la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 and the boundary went up to Beth-Hoglah and over north of Beth-ha-ʽArabah; and the boundary went up to Reuben’s son Bohan’s stone;

EWE: 7 Liƒo la tso afi ma va ɖo Debir le Akor Bali me, eye wòtrɔ to dziehe gome ɖo ta Gilgal, si le Adumim-todzimɔ ŋgɔ, le tɔʋu la ƒe anyiehe; eye liƒo la va to En-Semes-tɔ la ŋu, eye wòva wu nu ɖe En-Rogel.
ENGLISH: 7 and the boundary went up to Debir from Trouble Vale and bent toward the Gilgal opposite Red Pass on the south of the arroyo; and the boundary went over to the ʽEn-Shemesh water and had its termination at ʽEn-Rogel.

EWE: 8 Eye liƒo la to Hinom Vi Ƒe Bali la me va to Yebusitɔwo ƒe to la ŋu le anyiehe, si nye Yerusalem; eye wòto to, si dze ŋgɔ Hinom Balia le ɣetoɖoƒe gome la tame le Refaim Bali la ƒe seƒe le eƒe dziehe.
ENGLISH: 8 And the boundary went up to Ben-Hinnom’s Valley, to the southern front of the Jebusites, that is, Jerusalem; and the boundary went up to the crest of the mountain along Hinnom’s Valley on the west, at the west end of Ghost Hollow.

EWE: 9 Eye liƒo la to toa tame va ɖo Neftoa-tsidzɔƒea gbɔ, eye wòyi ɖado ɖe du siwo le Efron To dzi la gbɔ yi ɖado ɖe Baala, si nye Kiriat-Yearim.
ENGLISH: 9 And the boundary curved from the crest of the mountain to the spring of Nephtoah Water and went out to the peak of Ghephron Mountain; and the boundary curved to Baalah, that is, Kirjath-Jearim.

EWE: 10 Liƒo la gɔdɔ̃ tso Baala le ɣetoɖoƒe gome ɖo ta Seir To la gbɔ, eye wòmlo to Yearim To la ŋu le dziehe, si nye Kesalon, eye wòɖiɖi va Bet-Semes hemlo ɖo ta Timna.
ENGLISH: 10 And the boundary went round westward of Baalah to Seir Mountain, and over to the northern ledge of Jearim Mountain, that is, Kesalon, and down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.

EWE: 11 Eye liƒo la va do ɖe Ekron To la ŋu le dziehe, eye wòva to Sikeron hemlo yi Baala To la gbɔ heva do ɖe Yabneel, eye liƒoa va wu nu ɖe ƒu la nu.
ENGLISH: 11 And the boundary went out to the northern front of ʽEkron. And the boundary curved to Shikkeron and went over to the Baalah highland and out to Jabneel; and the termination of the boundary was at the sea.

EWE: 12 Ɣetoɖoƒeliƒo la nye Ƒu Gã la kple eƒe ƒuta.
ENGLISH: 12 And the west boundary was the great sea as boundary.

EWE: Esiae nye Yuda ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe liƒo la godoo va kpe le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: This is the boundary of the sons of Judah all round, clan by clan.

EWE: 13 Eye Yosua na anyigba Kaleb, Yefune vi la, ɖe Yuda ƒe dzidzimeviwo dome le se si Yehowa de nɛ la nu, eye anyigba lae nye Kiriat-Arba si woyɔna be Hebron (Arba siae nye Anak fofo).
ENGLISH: 13 And to Caleb the son of Jephunneh was given a share in the middle of the sons of Judah by Jehovah’s direction to Joshuaʽ, Kirjath-Arbogh the headquarters of the ʽAnakites, that is, Hebron;

EWE: 14 Eya ta Kaleb nya Anak viŋutsu etɔ̃ siwo nye Sesai, Ahiman kple Talmai, siwo nye Anak ƒe dzidzimeviwo la ɖa le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 14 and Caleb dispossessed from there the three sons of the ʽAnak, She-shai and Ahiman and Talmai, the breed of the ʽAnak.

EWE: 15 Eye wòho tso afi ma yi ɖawɔ aʋa kple Debirtɔwo. (Tsã la woyɔa Debir be Kiriat-Sefer.)
ENGLISH: 15 And from there he went up against the inhabitants of Debir (the name of Debir formerly being Kirjath-Sepher);

EWE: 16 Eye Kaleb gblɔ be: “Ame si asi Kiriat-Sefer, eye wòaxɔe la, matsɔ vinyenyɔnu Aksa nɛ wòaɖe.”
ENGLISH: 16 and Caleb said “To the one who conquers and takes Kirjath-Sepher I will give my daughter ʽAcsah as wife”;

EWE: 17 Eye Otniel, Kaleb nɔvi Kenaz ƒe vi, xɔ dua. Ale wòtsɔ vianyɔnu Aksa nɛ wòɖe.
ENGLISH: 17 and Ghothniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, and Caleb gave him his daughter ʽAcsah as wife.

EWE: 18 Eye esi nyɔnua kple srɔ̃a yina aƒe me la, nyɔnua ƒoe ɖe srɔ̃a nu be yeabia agble ye fofo. Eye nyɔnu la ɖi le eƒe tedzi dzi. Eye Kaleb biae be: “Nu ka dim nèle?”
ENGLISH: 18 And when she came she instigated him to ask her father for land; and she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her “What is the matter?”

EWE: 19 Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Meɖe kuku yram, elabena èna anyigbam le anyiehe; tsɔ Gulot-Mayim hã nam.”
ENGLISH: 19 and she said “Give me a blessing, because you have put me in the South: give me bowls of water.”

EWE: Ale wòtsɔ Dzigbe Gulot kple Anyigbe Gulot nɛ.
ENGLISH: And he gave her Upper Gulloth and Nether Gulloth.

EWE: 20 Esiae nye Yuda-to la ƒe domenyinu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 20 This is the estate of the tribe of the sons of Judah, clan by clan.

EWE: 21 Du siwo le Yuda-to la ƒe mlɔenu le Edom ƒe liƒo dzi le anyiehe la woe nye Kabzeel, Eder, Yagur,
ENGLISH: 21 And the cities on the frontier of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the boundary of Edom, in the South, were Kabseel and Gheder and Jagur

EWE: 22 Kina, Dimona, Adada,
ENGLISH: 22 and Kinah and Dimonah and ʽAdʽadah

EWE: 23 Kedes, Hazor, Yitnan,
ENGLISH: 23 and Kedesh and Hasor and Ithnan-Ziph

EWE: 24 Zif, Telem, Bealot,
ENGLISH: 24 and Telem and Baʽaloth

EWE: 25 Hazor-Hadata, Keriot-Hezron, si nye Hazor,
ENGLISH: 25 and Hasor-Hadattah and Kirjath-Hesron (that is, Hasor-

EWE: 26 Amam, Sema, Molada,
ENGLISH: 26 Amam) and Shemaʽ and Moladah

EWE: 27 Hazar-Gada, Hesmon, Bet-Pelet,
ENGLISH: 27 and Hasar-Gaddah and Heshmon and Beth-Pelet

EWE: 28 Hazar-Sual, Beer-Seba, Biziotiya,
ENGLISH: 28 and Hasar-Shuʽal and Beer-Shebaʽ and its dependencies,

EWE: 29 Baala, Iyim, Ezem,
ENGLISH: 29 Baʽalah and ʽIjim and ʽEsem

EWE: 30 Eltolad, Kesil, Horma,
ENGLISH: 30 and Eltolad and Kesil and Hormah

EWE: 31 Ziklag, Madmana, Sansana,
ENGLISH: 31 and Siklag and Madmannah and Sansannah

EWE: 32 Lebaot, Silhim, Ayin kple Rimon wo katã le du blaeve vɔ asieke hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 32 and Lebaoth and Shilhim and ʽEn-Rimmon: total twenty-nine cities and their villages.

EWE: 33 Du siwo le Sefela woe nye: Estaol, Zora, Asna,
ENGLISH: 33 In the lowland: Eshtaol and Soreah and Ashnah

EWE: 34 Zanoa, En-Ganim, Tapua, Enam,
ENGLISH: 34 and Zanoah and ʽEn-Gannim, Tappuah and the ʽEnam,

EWE: 35 Yarmut, Adulam, Soko, Azeka,
ENGLISH: 35 Jarmuth and ʽAdullam, Socoh and ʽAzekah

EWE: 36 Saarayim, Aditayim, Gedera kple Gederotayim wole du wuiene hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 36 and Shagharaim and ʽAdithaim and the Gederah and Gederothaim, fourteen cities and their villages;

EWE: 37 Zenan, Hadasa, Migdal-Gad,
ENGLISH: 37 Senan and Hadashah and Migdal-Gad

EWE: 38 Dilean, Mizpe, Yokteel,
ENGLISH: 38 and Dilean and the Mispeh and Joktheel,

EWE: 39 Lakis, Bozkat, Eglon,
ENGLISH: 39 Lakish and Boskath and ʽEglon

EWE: 40 Kabon, Lahmam, Kitlis,
ENGLISH: 40 and Cabbon and Lahmas and Kithlish

EWE: 41 Gederot, Bet-Dagon, Naama kple Makeda: wole du wuiade hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 41 and Gederoth, Beth-Dagon and Naʽamah and Makkedah, sixteen cities and their villages;

EWE: 42 Libna, Eter, Asan,
ENGLISH: 42 Libnah and ʽEther and ʽAshan

EWE: 43 Yifta, Asna, Nezib,
ENGLISH: 43 and Iphtah and Ashnah and Nesib

EWE: 44 Keila, Akzib kple Maresa: wole du asieke hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 44 and Keilah and Aczib and Mareshah, nine cities and their villages;

EWE: 45 Ekron kple eŋu duwo kple kɔƒewo;
ENGLISH: 45 ʽEkron and its dependencies and villages

EWE: 46 tso Ekron ɖo ta ɣetoɖoƒe gome, teƒe siwo katã le Asdod ŋu kple woƒe kɔƒewo.
ENGLISH: 46 from ʽEkron westward, everything along the steeps and their villages,

EWE: 47 Asdod, eŋu duwo kple kɔƒewo; Gaza, eŋu duwo kple kɔƒewo va ɖo Egipte-tɔʋu la gbɔ, kple Ƒu Gã la kple eƒe nutoa.
ENGLISH: 47 Ashdod and its dependencies and villages, Ghaza and its dependencies and villages, to Egypt Arroyo, and the great sea as boundary.

EWE: 48 Du siwo le tonuto la me woe nye Samir, Yatir, Soko,
ENGLISH: 48 And in the highland: Shamir and Jattir and Socoh

EWE: 49 Dana, Kiriat-Sana, si nye Debir,
ENGLISH: 49 and Dannah and Kirjath-Sannah (that is, Debir)

EWE: 50 Anab, Estemo, Anim,
ENGLISH: 50 and ʽAnab and Eshtemoh and Ghanim

EWE: 51 Gosen, Holon kple Gilo wole du wuiɖekɛ hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 51 and Goshen and Holon and Giloh, eleven cities and their villages;

EWE: 52 Arab, Duma, Esan,
ENGLISH: 52 Arab and Dumah and Eshean

EWE: 53 Yanim, Bet-Tapua, Afeka,
ENGLISH: 53 and Janum and Beth-Tappuah and Aphekah

EWE: 54 Humta, Kiriat-Arba, si nye Hebron, kple Zior: wole du asieke hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 54 and Humtah and Kirjath-Arbogh (that is, Hebron) and Sighor, nine cities and their villages;

EWE: 55 Maon, Karmel, Zif, Yuta,
ENGLISH: 55 Ma’on, Carmel and Ziph and Juttah

EWE: 56 Yezreel, Yokdeam, Zanoa,
ENGLISH: 56 and Jezreʽel and Jokdeam and Zanoah,

EWE: 57 Kain, Gibea kple Timna wole du ewo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 57 the Cain, Gibeah and Timnah, ten cities and their villages;

EWE: 58 Halhul, Bet-Zur, Gedor,
ENGLISH: 58 Halhul, Beth-Sur and Gedor

EWE: 59 Maarat, Bet-Anot kple Eltekon wole du ade hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 59 and Maʽarath and Beth-ʽAnoth and Eltekon, six cities and their villages;

EWE: 60 Kiriat-Baal, si nye Kiriat-Yearim, kple Raba wole du eve hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 60 Tekoaʽ and Ephrathah (that is, Bethlehem) and Peghor and ʽEtam and Kolan and Tetam and Sores and Kerem and Gallim and Bether and Menohoh, eleven cities and their villages; Kirjath-Baal (that is, Kirjath-Jeʽarim) and the Rabbah, two cities and their villages.

EWE: 61 Du siwo le gbedzi la woe nye: Bet-Araba, Midin, Sekaka,
ENGLISH: 61 In the wilderness: Beth-ha-ʽArabah, Middin and Secacah

EWE: 62 Nibsan, Dzedu la kple En-Gedi wole du ade hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 62 and the Nibshan and Salt City and ʽEn-Gedi, six cities and their villages.

EWE: 63 Ke Yuda ŋutsuwo mete ŋu nya Yebusitɔ siwo le Yerusalem la ɖa o; eye Yebusitɔwo kpɔtɔ le Yuda viwo dome le Yerusalem va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: 63 And the Jebusites, who lived in Jerusalem, the sons of Judah could not dispossess, and the Jebusites live with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 16 Anyigba si wona Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo la tso Yordan nu le Yeriko yi ɖe Yeriko-tɔ la nu le ɣedzeƒe, eye wòva to gbegbe si le Yeriko ŋgɔ heyi Betel tonuto la me.
ENGLISH: 16 And for the sons of Joseph the lot went out from the Jordan at Jericho, eastward of Jericho Water, to the wilderness, up from Jericho to the highland of Bethel,

EWE: 2 Etso Betel si le Luz, eye wòmlo to Atarot, si nye Arkitɔwo ƒe liƒo la ŋu,
ENGLISH: 2 and out from Bethel to Luz, and over to the Arkite boundary, ʽAtaroth,

EWE: 3 eye wòɖiɖi to ɣetoɖoƒe gome yi Yaflettɔwo ƒe liƒo dzi va se ɖe keke Anyigbe Bet-Horon kple Gezer ƒe liƒo dzi ke, eye wòva wu nu ɖe ƒu la nu.
ENGLISH: 3 and down west to the Japhletite boundary, to the boundary of Lower Beth-Horon, and to Gezer, and its termination was at the sea.

EWE: 4 Ale Yosef ƒe dzidzimevi siwo nye Manase kple Efrayim xɔ woƒe anyigba.
ENGLISH: 4 And the sons of Joseph had their estates assigned, Manasseh and Ephraim.
