EWE: 5 Efrayim ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe liƒo lae nye esi le woƒe ƒomewo nu: Woƒe anyigba ƒe liƒo le ɣedzeƒe gomee nye Atarot-Adar va se ɖe keke Dzigbe Bet-Horon ke, 6 eye liƒo la tso afi ma yi ƒu la nu.
ENGLISH: 5 And the territory of the sons of Ephraim was clan by clan; and the boundary of their estate on the east was ʽAtaroth-Addar, to Upper Beth-Horon, 6 and the boundary terminated at the sea.

EWE: Mikmetat le eƒe dziehe, eye liƒo la gɔdɔ̃ to ɣedzeƒe gome yi Taanat-Silo heto ɣedzeƒe gome yi Yanoa.
ENGLISH: The Micmethath on the north, and the boundary went round east to Taanath, Shiloh, and over it east of Janohah

EWE: 7 Eɖiɖi tso Yanoa va to Atarot kple Naara, yi Yeriko heva do ɖe Yordan nu.
ENGLISH: 7 and down from Janohah to ʽAtaroth and Naʽarathah, and came against Jericho, and terminated at the Jordan.

EWE: 8 Liƒo la tso Tapua le ɣetoɖoƒe gome va ɖo Kana-tɔʋu la me, eye wòva wu nu ɖe ƒu la nu.
ENGLISH: 8 From Tappuah the boundary went west to Kanah Arroyo, and its termination was at the sea.

EWE: Esiae nye Efrayim-to la ƒe domenyinu le woƒe ƒomewo nu;
ENGLISH: This was the estate of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim clan by clan,

EWE: 9 hekpe ɖe du aɖewo kple wo ŋu kɔƒe siwo wotsɔ na Efrayim ƒe dzidzimeviwo le Manase viwo ƒe domenyinu dome la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 this and the cities set apart for the sons of Ephraim in the middle of the estate of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.

EWE: 10 Gake womenya Kanaantɔ siwo le Gezer la ɖa o, eye Kanaantɔwo le Efrayim va se ɖe egbe sia, eye wona wozu dzizizidɔwɔlawo na wo.
ENGLISH: 10 But they did not dispossess the Canaanites that lived in Gezer, and the Canaanites live among the Ephraimites to this day and have become subject to servile forced labor.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 17 Eye wona anyigba Manase-to la, elabena eyae nye Yosef ƒe ŋgɔgbevi. Esi wònye aʋamee Makir, Manase ƒe ŋgɔgbevi, ame si nye Gilead fofo, nye ta la, wotsɔ Gilead kple Basan nɛ.
ENGLISH: 17 And the lot for the tribe of Manasseh was as follows: because he was Joseph’s firstborn, Manasseh’s firstborn Makir the father of Gilead, because they were men of war, had Gilead and the Bashan.

EWE: 2 Eye wona anyigba Manase ƒe dzidzimevi siwo kpɔtɔ la le woƒe ƒomewo nu, woawoe nye Abi-Ezer viwo, Helek viwo, Asriel viwo, Sekem viwo, Hefer viwo kple Semida viwo.
ENGLISH: 2 And for the rest of Manasseh’s sons, clan by clan, the sons of Abiezer and the sons of Helek and the sons of Asriel and the sons of Shekem and the sons of Hepher and the sons of Shemidaʽ

EWE: Esiawoe nye Yosef vi Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo, woƒe ŋutsuwo le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: these are the male sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, clan by clan;

EWE: 3 Ke Zelofehad, Hefer vi, si nye Gilead vi, Makir vi, Manase vi medzi ŋutsuvi aɖeke o, negbe nyɔnuviwo ko, eye vianyɔnuawo ŋkɔwoe nye: Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka kple Tirza.
ENGLISH: 3 but Silpahad the son of Hepher the son of Gilead the son of Makir the son of Manasseh had no sons, but daughters, the names of his daughters being these, Mahlah and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirsah,

EWE: 4 Eya ta wova nunɔla Eleazar kple Yosua, Nun vi la, kpakple tatɔwo ŋkume, gblɔ be: “Yehowa de se na Mose be wòana domenyinu mí ɖe mía nɔviŋutsuwo dome.” Eya ta ena domenyinu wo ɖe wo fofo nɔviŋutsuwo dome abe ale si Yehowa de see ene.
ENGLISH: 4 and they drew near before Priest Eleazar and Joshuaʽ the son of Nun and the princes with the words “Jehovah commanded Moses to give us an estate among our brothers,” and by Jehovah’s direction he gave them an estate among their father’s brothers

EWE: 5 Manase xɔ akpa ewo hekpe ɖe Gilead-nyigba kple Basan-nyigba, si le Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi la ŋu,
ENGLISH: 5 Manasseh’s pales fell ten of them, besides the country of Gilead and the Bashan on the other side of the Jordan,

EWE: 6 elabena Manase vinyɔnuwo hã xɔ domenyinu kpe ɖe viaŋutsuwo ŋu, eye Gilead-nyigba la zu Manase viŋutsu siwo susɔ la tɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 because Manasseh’s daughters were assigned estate among their brothers, and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the country of Gilead.

EWE: 7 Manase ƒe liƒo la tso Aser yi Mikmetat, si dze ŋgɔ Sekem, eye liƒo la tso afi ma yi anyiehe va ɖo En-Tapuatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 And the boundary of Manasseh was from Asher-ham-Micmethah in front of Shekem, and the boundary went to the south to the inhabitants of ʽEn-Tappuah

EWE: 8 Tapua-nyigba la zu Manase tɔ, gake Tapua-du si le Manase ƒe liƒo dzi la nye Efrayim viwo tɔ.
ENGLISH: 8 (the Tappuah country belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah, on the boundary of Manasseh, to the sons of Ephraim),

EWE: 9 Eye liƒo la ɖiɖi yi Kana-tɔʋu la me le tɔʋua ƒe anyiehe. Efrayim ƒe du aɖewo le Manase ƒe duwo dome, eye Manase ƒe liƒo la le tɔʋua ƒe dziehe, eye wòva wu nu ɖe ƒua nu.
ENGLISH: 9 and the boundary went down to Kanah Arroyo, south of the arroyo, these cities belonged to Ephraim in the middle of the cities of Manasseh, and the boundary of Manasseh was north of the arroyo, and its termination was at the sea;

EWE: 10 Anyiehe gome nye Efrayim tɔ, eye dziehe gome nye Manase tɔ, ƒu lae nye liƒo nɛ, Manase do liƒo kple Aser le dziehe, eye wodo liƒo kple Isakar le ɣedzeƒe.
ENGLISH: 10 southward Ephraim’s and northward Manasseh’s, and the sea was its boundary. And they came against Asher on the north and Issacar on the east;

EWE: 11 Le Isakar kple Aser ƒe anyigbawo dzi la, wona du aɖewo Manase, woawoe nye Bet-Sean kple eŋu duwo, Yibleam kple eŋu duwo, Dortɔwo kple woƒe duwo, En-Dortɔwo kple woƒe duwo, Taanaktɔwo kple woƒe duwo, kpakple Megidotɔwo kple woƒe duwo; eye woawoe nye togbɛnuto etɔ̃awo.
ENGLISH: 11 and in Issacar and Asher Manasseh had Beth-Shean and its dependencies and Ibleam and its dependencies and the inhabitants of Dor and its dependencies and the inhabitants of ʽEn-Dor and its dependencies and the inhabitants of Taʽanac and its dependencies and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependencies, the three Naphaths;

EWE: 12 Gake Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo mete ŋu xɔ du siawo o; Kanaantɔwo do dzi nɔ anyigba sia dzi kpiŋ.
ENGLISH: 12 but the sons of Manasseh could not dispossess these cities, and the Canaanites persisted in living in this country,

EWE: 13 Gake esi ŋusẽ va ɖo Israel-viwo ŋu la, wozi Kanaantɔwo dzi wowɔ dɔ sesẽ, negbe ɖeko womenya wo ɖa keŋkeŋ o.
ENGLISH: 13 and when the sons of Israel grew strong they put the Canaanites to forced labor; they did not dispossess them.

EWE: 14 Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo bia Yosua be: “Nu ka ta nèna anyigba dzidze ɖeka ko mí be wòanye míaƒe domenyinu? Evɔ míesɔ gbɔ, eye Yehowa yra mí va se ɖe fifia.”
ENGLISH: 14 And the sons of Joseph spoke to Joshuaʽ, saying “How came you to give us an estate of a single lot and a single portion when we are a great people, Jehovah having so blessed us?”

EWE: 15 Yosua ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Ne miesɔ gbɔ nenema gbegbe la, ekema miyi Perizitɔwo kple Refaimtɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi, eye miƒo aveawo ɖa le afi ma ne woazu mia tɔ, le esi Efrayim tonuto la xaxa na mi akpa ta.”
ENGLISH: 15 And Joshuaʽ said to them “If you are a great people go up to the Badlands and cut out for yourselves there in the country of the Perizzites and the ogres, because the highland of Ephraim crowds you.”

EWE: 16 Eye Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo gblɔ be: “Tonuto la mede mía nu o, gake aʋatasiaɖam siwo ƒe afɔtiwo ŋu lãnuwo le la le Kanaantɔ siwo katã le balia me la si; wole ame siwo le Bet-Sean kple eŋu duwo me kple ame siwo le Yezreel Bali me la siaa si.”
ENGLISH: 16 And the sons of Joseph said “The highland will not suffice for us, and all the Canaanites that live in the Vale country have iron chariots among them, those in Beth-Shean and its dependencies and those in the Vale of Jezreel.”

EWE: 17 Eya ta Yosua gblɔ na Yosef ƒe aƒe la, si nye Efrayim kple Manase be: “Miesɔ gbɔ, eye ŋusẽ geɖe le mia ŋu.
ENGLISH: 17 But Joshuaʽ said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, “You are a great people and have great strength; you shall not have a single lot,

EWE: Menye anyigba dzidze ɖeka koe wòle be miaxɔ o, 18 ke boŋ tonuto la hã azu mia tɔ. Togbɔ be enye ave hã la, miaƒoe eye wòazu miaƒe anyigba la ƒe nuwuƒe. Elabena ele be mianya Kanaantɔwo ɖa, togbɔ be aʋatasiaɖam siwo ƒe afɔtiwo ŋu lãnuwo le la le wo si, eye wosesẽ hã.”
ENGLISH: 18 because you shall have a highland; because it is badlands, you shall carve it out and have its issues, because you will dispossess the Canaanites though they do have iron chariots, because you are stronger.”

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 18 Israel ƒe ha blibo la katã va ƒo ƒu ɖe Silo, eye wotu takpegbadɔ ɖe afi ma, elabena woɖu anyigba la dzi keŋ le wo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 18 And all the congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh and established the Tent of Meeting there, with the subjugated country before them.

EWE: 2 Gake Israel-viwo ƒe to adre gasusɔ siwo mexɔ woƒe domenyinu haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 2 And there were left among the sons of Israel, who had not divided their estates, seven tribes.

EWE: 3 Eya ta Yosua gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: “Ɣekaɣie mialala ase ɖo hafi ayi aɖaxɔ anyigba si Yehowa mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu tsɔ na mi?
ENGLISH: 3 And Joshuaʽ said to the sons of Israel “How much are you going to lag back from going in to take possession of the country your God Jehovah gave to your fathers?

EWE: 4 Mitia ŋutsu etɔ̃ tso to sia to me, ne madɔ wo; woayi aɖatsa le anyigba la dzi, ne woatae ɖe agbalẽ dzi le woƒe domenyinuwo nu.
ENGLISH: 4 Nominate three men to each tribe whom I may send to start out and explore the country and list it in proportion to the estates they are to have and come to me;

EWE: Emegbe woatrɔ ava gbɔnye. 5 Ele be woamae ɖe akpa adre me ɖe wo nɔewo dome. Yuda akpɔtɔ anɔ eƒe anyigba dzi le anyiehe, eye Yosef ƒe aƒe la akpɔtɔ anɔ woƒe anyigba dzi le dziehe.
ENGLISH: 5 and divide it into seven shares, Judah standing fast in his territory on the south and the house of Joseph standing fast in their territory on the north;

EWE: 6 Ke miawo la, mima anyigba la ɖe akpa adre me ɖe agbalẽ dzi miatsɔ vɛ nam le afii, eye madzidze nu ɖe edzi na mi le Yehowa mía Mawu la ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 6 and do you list the country in seven shares and bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you here before our God Jehovah.

EWE: 7 Lewi viwo mexɔ anyigba aɖeke le mia dome o, elabena Yehowa ƒe nunɔladɔ lae nye woƒe domenyinu; Gad kple Ruben kpakple Manase-to afã la xɔ woƒe domenyinu, si Yehowa ƒe subɔla Mose na wo la, ɖe Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.”
ENGLISH: 7 For the Levites have no share among you, because Jehovah’s priesthood is their estate; and Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have taken their estates on the east side of the Jordan, what Jehovah’s servant Moses gave to them.”

EWE: 8 Ŋutsuawo dzra ɖo be yewoadze mɔ, ke Yosua de se na ame siwo yina anyigba la ta ge la be: “Miyi ɖatsa le anyigba la dzi, mitae ɖe agbalẽ dzi, emegbe miatrɔ va gbɔnye, eye madzidze nu ɖe edzi na mi le afi sia le Yehowa ŋkume le Silo.”
ENGLISH: 8 And the men started out and went; and Joshuaʽ commissioned the ones that went to list the country, saying “Go and explore the country and list it and come back to me, and here I will throw lots for you before Jehovah at Shiloh.”

EWE: 9 Ale ŋutsuawo yi ɖatsa le anyigba la dzi, eye wotae hemae ɖe akpa adre me le woƒe duwo nu ɖe agbalẽ dzi. Emegbe wogbugbɔ va Yosua gbɔ le asaɖa la me le Silo.
ENGLISH: 9 And the men went and passed through the country and listed it in a book city by city into seven shares, and came to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh,

EWE: 10 Eye Yosua dzidze nu ɖe edzi na wo le Silo le Yehowa ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 10 and Joshuaʽ threw lots for them at Shiloh before Jehovah.

EWE: Yosua ma anyigba la na Israel-viwo le afi ma wotɔwotɔwoe. 11 Nudzidze gbãtɔ dze Benyamin-to la dzi le woƒe ƒomewo nu, eye anyigba si woxɔ le nudzidzea nu la le Yuda viwo kple Yosef viwo tɔwo dome.
ENGLISH: 11 And the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, clan by clan, came up; and the boundary of their lot went out between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

EWE: 12 Le dziehekpa dzi la, liƒo la dze egɔme tso Yordan nu, eye wòyi ɖato Yeriko ƒe aga ŋu le dziehe heto to la dzi le ɣetoɖoƒe gome, eye wòva do ɖe Bet-Aven gbedzi.
ENGLISH: 12 And they had their boundary, for the north quarter, from the Jordan; and the boundary went up to the northern front of Jericho and up into the highland westward, coming out in the wilderness of Beth-Aven;

EWE: 13 Eye liƒo la tso afi ma yi ɖado ɖe Luz, le Luz si wogayɔna be Betel la ƒe aga ŋu le anyiehekpa dzi; liƒo la yi ɖato Atarot-Adar le to si le Anyigbe Bet-Horon ƒe anyiehe la tame.
ENGLISH: 13 and the boundary went over from there to Luz, to the southern front of Luz, that is, Bethel; and the boundary went down to ʽAtaroth-Addar on the mountain south of Lower Beth-Horon.

EWE: 14 Le ɣetoɖoƒekpa dzi la, liƒo la gɔdɔ̃ ɖo ta anyiehe tso to si dze ŋgɔ Bet-Horon le anyiehe la gbɔ; eye wòva wu nu ɖe Kiriat-Baal, si wogayɔna be Kiriat-Yearim, si nye Yuda du. Esiae nye ɣetoɖoƒeliƒo la.
ENGLISH: 14 And the boundary curved round to the west border south of the mountain facing Beth-Horon on the south, and its termination was at Kirjath-Baal, that is, Kirjath-Jearim, city of the sons of Judah; this was the west border.

EWE: 15 Anyieheliƒo la dze egɔme tso Kiriat-Yearim ƒe mlɔenu, liƒo la ɖo ta ɣetoɖoƒe gome; eye wòva do ɖe Neftoa-tsidzɔƒe gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 15 And the south border was from the edge of Kirjath-Jearim; and the boundary went out west and out to the spring of Nephtoah Water,

EWE: 16 Liƒo la ɖiɖi va do ɖe to si dze ŋgɔ Hinom Vi Ƒe Bali, si le Refaim Balia ƒe dziehe gome la ƒe mlɔenu, eye wòɖiɖi va Hinom Bali la me va to Yebusitɔwo ƒe to la ƒe aga ŋu le anyiehe heva do ɖe En-Rogel.
ENGLISH: 16 and the boundary went down to the edge of the mountain facing Ben-Hinnom’s Valley in Ghost Hollow on the north, and down to Hinnom’s Valley to the south front of the Jebusites and down to ʽEn-Rogel,

EWE: 17 Eye liƒo la yi ɖato dziehe gome va do ɖe En-Semes va ɖo Gelilot, si dze ŋgɔ Adumim-todzimɔ, eye wòɖiɖi va ɖo Ruben vi Bohan ƒe kpe la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 17 and curved north and went out to ʽEn-Shemesh and out to Geliloth opposite Red Pass and down to Reuben’s son Bohan’s stone

EWE: 18 Eye wòyi ɖado ɖe aga si le dziehekpa dzi le Araba ŋgɔ la ŋu, eye wòɖiɖi yi Araba.
ENGLISH: 18 and over to the north front of Beth-ha-ʽArabah and down to the Rift Valley,

EWE: 19 Eye liƒo la mlo to Bet-Hogla ƒe aga ŋu le dziehekpa dzi, eye wòva wu nu ɖe Dzeƒu la ƒe adɔ̃ si le dziehe le Yordan ƒe mlɔenu si le anyiehe la nu.
ENGLISH: 19 and the boundary went over to the north front of Beth-Hoglah, and the termination of the boundary was at the north inlet of the Salt Sea, at the south extremity of the Jordan.

EWE: Esiae nye anyieheliƒo la.
ENGLISH: This was the south boundary.

EWE: 20 Yordan ye nye eƒe liƒo le ɣedzeƒekpa dzi.
ENGLISH: 20 And the Jordan bounded it on the east border.

EWE: Esiae nye Benyamin ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe domenyinu la ƒe liƒowo godoo va kpe le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: This was the estate of the sons of Benjamin boundary by boundary all round, clan by clan.

EWE: 21 Benyamin-to la ƒe duwo le woƒe ƒomewo nu la woe nye: Yeriko, Bet-Hogla, kple Emek-Keziz,
ENGLISH: 21 And the cities for the tribe of the sons of Benjamin clan by clan were Jericho and Beth-Hoglah and ʽEmek-Kesis

EWE: 22 Bet-Araba, Zemarayim, Betel,
ENGLISH: 22 and Beth-ha-Arabah and Semaraim and Bethel

EWE: 23 Avim, Para, Ofra,
ENGLISH: 23 and the ʽAvvim and the Parah and Ghophrah

EWE: 24 Kefar-Amoni, Ofni kple Geba wole du wuieve hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 24 and Kephir-ha-Ammonai and ʽOphni and Gebaʽ, twelve cities and their villages,

EWE: 25 Gibeon, Rama, Beerot,
ENGLISH: 25 Gibeon and the Ramah and Beeroth

EWE: 26 Mizpe, Kefira, Moza,
ENGLISH: 26 and the Mispeh and the Kephirah and the Mosah

EWE: 27 Rekem, Yirpel, Tarala,
ENGLISH: 27 and Rekem and Irpeel and Taralah

EWE: 28 Zela, Ha-Elef, Yebusi, si nye Yerusalem, Gibea kple Kiriat
ENGLISH: 28 and Sela-ha-Eleph and the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and Gibeath and Kirjath-Jeʽarim, fourteen cities and their villages.

EWE: wole du wuiene hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: This was the estate of the sons of Benjamin clan by clan.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 19 Azɔ nudzidze evelia dze Simeon dzi, eye Simeon-to la xɔ woƒe gome le woƒe ƒomewo nu. Eye woƒe domenyinu si woxɔ la le Yuda viwo tɔ me.
ENGLISH: 19 And the second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon clan by clan; and their estate was in the middle of the estate of the sons of Judah.

EWE: 2 Woƒe domenyinu la nye Beer-Seba, Seba, Molada,
ENGLISH: 2 And they had in their estate Beer-Shebaʽ and Shemaʽ and Moladah

EWE: 3 Hazar-Sual, Bala, Ezem,
ENGLISH: 3 and Hasar-Shuʽal and Balah and ʽEsem

EWE: 4 Eltolad, Betul, Horma,
ENGLISH: 4 and Eltolad and Bethul and Hormah

EWE: 5 Ziklag, Bet-Markabot, Hazar-Susa,
ENGLISH: 5 and Siklag and Beth-ham-Marcaboth and Hasar-Susah

EWE: 6 Bet-Lebaot kple Saruhen
ENGLISH: 6 and Beth-Lebaoth and Sharuhen, thirteen cities and their villages,

EWE: wole du wuietɔ̃ hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu; 7 Ayin, Rimon, Eter kple Asan
ENGLISH: 7 ʽEn-Rimmon and Token and ʽEther and ʽAshan, four cities and their villages,

EWE: 8 kple kɔƒe siwo katã le du siawo ŋu godoo va kpe va se ɖe keke Baalat-Beer, si wogayɔna be anyiehe Rama la ke.
ENGLISH: 8 and all the villages round these cities to Baalath-Beer, Ramath-Negeb.

EWE: Esiae nye Simeon-to la ƒe domenyinu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: This was the estate of the tribe of the sons of Simeon clan by clan.

EWE: 9 Yuda ƒe anyigba la mee wona teƒe Simeon ƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖo wònye woƒe domenyinu, elabena Yuda-to la ƒe gome lolo na wo akpa. Eya ta Simeon ƒe dzidzimeviwo xɔ wo tɔ ɖe Yuda viwo ƒe domenyinu la me.
ENGLISH: 9 The estate of the sons of Simeon was out of the pale of the sons of Judah, because the share of the sons of Judah was too large for them and the sons of Simeon were assigned part in the middle of their estate.

EWE: 10 Azɔ nudzidze etɔ̃lia dze Zebulon dzi, eye woxɔ woƒe gome le woƒe ƒomewo nu, eye woƒe domenyinu la ƒe liƒo va ɖo keke Sarid ke.
ENGLISH: 10 And the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun clan by clan; and the boundary of their estate reached to Sarid.

EWE: 11 Eye woƒe liƒo la yi ɖato ɣetoɖoƒe gome yi Mareal va ɖo Dabeset, eye wòva do ɖe bali si le Yokneam ŋgɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 11 And their boundary went up westward and to Marealah, and came against Dabbesheth, and came up to the arroyo alongside Jokneʽam;

EWE: 12 Etso Sarid le ɣedzeƒe gome yi Kislot-Tabor ƒe liƒo dzi, eye wòva do ɖe Daberat heyi Yafia.
ENGLISH: 12 and going back, from Sarid eastward, toward the sunrise along the boundary of Kisloth-Tabor and out to the Daberath and up to Japhiaʽ,

EWE: 13 Eye wòtso afi ma to ɣedzeƒe gome yi Gat-Hefer kple Et-Kazin, eye wòva ɖo Rimon heyi ɖado ɖe Nea.
ENGLISH: 13 and from there over eastward, sunriseward, to Gath Hepher, to ʽEth-Kasin, and out to Rimmonah and curving to the Neʽah,

EWE: 14 Liƒo la gɔdɔ̃ le dziehe yi Hanaton, eye wòva wu nu ɖe Yifta-El Bali la me,
ENGLISH: 14 and the boundary went round it to the north of Hannathon, and its termination was at Iphtah-El Valley.

EWE: 15 kpakple Katat, Nahalal, Simron, Yidala kple Betlehem woƒe duawo katã le wuieve hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 15 And Kattath and Nahalal and Shimron and Idalah and Beth-Lehem, twelve cities and their villages.

EWE: 16 Esiae nye Zebulon ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe domenyinu, woƒe duwo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 16 This was the estate of the sons of Zebulun clan by clan, these cities and their villages.

EWE: 17 Azɔ nudzidze enelia dze Isakar dzi, eye Isakar ƒe dzidzimeviwo xɔ woƒe gome le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 17 And for Issacar the fourth lot came out, for the sons of Issacar clan by clan;

EWE: 18 Woƒe liƒo la to Yezreel, Kesulot, Sunem,
ENGLISH: 18 and their boundary was at Jezreʽel and the Kesulloth and Shunem

EWE: 19 Hafarayim, Sion, Anaharat,
ENGLISH: 19 and Hapharaim and Shion and Anaharah

EWE: 20 Rabit, Kision, Ebez,
ENGLISH: 20 and the Rabbith and Kishjon and Ebes

EWE: 21 Remet, En-Ganim, En-Hada kple Bet-Pazez.
ENGLISH: 21 and Remeth and ʽEn-Gannim and ʽEn-Haddah and Beth-Passes;

EWE: 22 Liƒo la va ɖo Tabor, Sahazuma kple Bet-Semes, eye woƒe liƒo la va wu nu ɖe Yordan nu wole du wuiade hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 22 and the boundary came against Tabor and Shahasimah and Beth-Shemesh, and the termination of their boundary was at the Jordan: sixteen cities and their villages.

EWE: 23 Esiae nye Isakar-to la ƒe domenyinu, woƒe duwo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 23 This was the estate of the tribe of the sons of Issacar clan by clan, the cities and their villages.

EWE: 24 Azɔ nudzidze atɔ̃lia dze Aser-to la dzi, eye woxɔ woƒe gome le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 24 And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher clan by clan;

EWE: 25 Woƒe liƒo la to Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf,
ENGLISH: 25 and their boundary was Helkath and Hali and Beten and Acshaph

EWE: 26 Alamelek, Amad kple Misal. Eye wòva ɖo Karmel kple Sihor-Libnat le ɣetoɖoƒe gome,
ENGLISH: 26 and Alammelec and ʽAdʽad and Mishal, and came against Carmel at the sea and against Shihor-Libnath,

EWE: 27 etrɔ ɖo ta ɣedzeƒe yi Bet-Dagon, eye wòva do ɖe Zebulon kple Yifta-El Bali la ƒe dziehe, yi Bet-Emek kple Neiel, eye wòva do ɖe Kabul ƒe miame,
ENGLISH: 27 and went back east to Beth-Dagon, and came against Zebulun and the north side of Iphtah-El Valley; and the boundary came to Beth-ha-ʽEmek and Neʽiel and went out to Cabul on the left,

EWE: 28 va to Ebron, Rehob, Hamon kple Kana va se ɖe keke Sidon Gã la ke.
ENGLISH: 28 and ʽEbron and Rehob and Hammon and Kanah, to great Sidon;

EWE: 29 Liƒo la trɔ to Rama va ɖo keke Tiro du sesẽ la gbɔ ke. Eye liƒo la trɔ ɖo ta Hosa, eva wu nu ɖe ƒutanuto me afi si Akzib,
ENGLISH: 29 and the boundary went back to the Ramah and clear to the fortress-spring of Tyre; and the boundary went back to Hosah, and its termination was at the sea; and Mahalab and Aczib

EWE: 30 Uma, Afek kple Rehob le wole du blaeve vɔ eve hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 30 and ʽUmmah and Aphek and Rehob; twenty-two cities and their villages.

EWE: 31 Esiae nye Aser-to la ƒe domenyinu, woƒe duwo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 31 This was the estate of the tribe of the sons of Asher clan by clan, these cities and their villages.

EWE: 32 Nudzidze adelia dze Naftali ƒe dzidzimeviwo dzi, eye Naftali ƒe dzidzimeviwo xɔ woƒe gome le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 32 And for the sons of Naphtali the sixth lot came out, for the sons of Naphtali clan by clan;

EWE: 33 Woƒe liƒo la tso Helef, tso ati gã si le Zaananim gbɔ, heto Adami-Nekeb, Yabneel va se ɖe keke Lakum ke, eye wòva wu nu ɖe Yordan nu.
ENGLISH: 33 and their boundary was from Heleph, from the Besaʽannim Oak, and Adami-han-Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum, and its termination was at the Jordan;

EWE: 34 Liƒo la trɔ le ɣetoɖoƒe gome yi Aznot-Tabor, etso afi ma va do ɖe Hukok heyi Zebulon le anyiehe, eye wòyi Aser le ɣetoɖoƒe ɖado ɖe Yuda le Yordan nu le ɣedzeƒe gome.
ENGLISH: 34 and the boundary went back westward to Aznoth-Tabor and out from there to Hukkok, and came against Zebulun on the south and against Asher on the west and against the Jordan swamp on the east.

EWE: 35 Woƒe du sesẽwoe nye Zidim, Zer, Hamat, Rakat, Kineret,
ENGLISH: 35 And the side fortified cities, Ser and Hammath-Rakkath and Kinnereth

EWE: 36 Adama, Rama, Hazor,
ENGLISH: 36 and Adamah and the Ramah and Hasor

EWE: 37 Kedes, Edrei, En-Hazor,
ENGLISH: 37 and Kedesh and Edreʽi and ʽEn-Hasor

EWE: 38 Yiron, Migdal-El, Horem, Bet-Anat kple Bet-Semes wole du wuiasieke hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 38 and Iron and Migdal-El-Horem and Beth-ʽAnath and Beth-Shemesh, nineteen cities and their villages.

EWE: 39 Esiae nye Naftali-to la ƒe domenyinu, woƒe duwo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 39 This was the estate of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali clan by clan, the cities and their villages.

EWE: 40 Azɔ nudzidze adrelia dze Dan-to la dzi, eye woxɔ woƒe gome le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 40 For the tribe of the sons of Dan clan by clan the seventh lot came out;

EWE: 41 Eye woƒe domenyinu la ƒe liƒo to Zora, Estaol, Ir-Semes,
ENGLISH: 41 and the boundary of their estate was Soreah and Eshtaol and ʽIr-Shemesh

EWE: 42 Saalabin, Aiyalon, Yitla,
ENGLISH: 42 and Shaʽalbin and Aijalon and Ithlah

EWE: 43 Elon, Timna, Ekron,
ENGLISH: 43 and Elon and Timnathah and ʽEkron

EWE: 44 Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat,
ENGLISH: 44 and Eltekeh and Gibbethon and Baʽalath

EWE: 45 Yehud, Bene-Berak, Gat-Rimon,
ENGLISH: 45 and Jehud and Bene-Berak and Gath-Rimmon

EWE: 46 Me-Yarkon kple Rakon, eye liƒo la to Yopa ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 46 and Jarkon Water and the Rakkon, together with the boundary, fronting Joppa.

EWE: 47 Ke Dan ƒe anyigba la xaxa na wo akpa.
ENGLISH: 47 This was the estate of the tribe of the sons of Dan clan by clan, these cities and their villages.

EWE: Eya ta woyi ɖawɔ aʋa kple Lesem, eye wowu wo kple yi hexɔ du la. Woxɔe wòzu wo tɔ henɔ afi ma, eye wotrɔ ŋkɔ na Lesem dua be Dan, si nye wo tɔgbui Dan ƒe ŋkɔ.
ENGLISH: And the sons of Dan did not crowd out the Amorites who carried on hostilities with them in the highland, and the Amorites did not let them get down to the vale and made the territory of their share too cramped for them; and the sons of Dan went up and attacked Leshem and took it and massacred its people and took possession of it and settled there, and named Leshem “Dan” after their father Dan.

EWE: 48 Esiae nye Dan-to la ƒe domenyinu, woƒe duwo hekpe ɖe woƒe kɔƒewo ŋu le woƒe ƒomewo nu.
ENGLISH: 48 And the Amorites persisted in living in Aijalon and in Shaʽalbin; but the hand of Ephraim grew heavy on them and they became subject to forced labor.

EWE: 49 Ale woma anyigba la vɔ keŋ wòzu woƒe domenyinu. Eye Israel-viwo na domenyinu Yosua, Nun vi la, ɖe wo dome.
ENGLISH: 49 And they finished having the country assigned boundary by boundary; and the sons of Israel gave Joshuaʽ the son of Nun an estate in their central part;

EWE: 50 Wotsɔ du si nye Timna-Sera si wòbia la nɛ le Efrayim tonuto la me abe ale si Yehowa de see ene; egbugbɔ du la tso henɔ eme.
ENGLISH: 50 by Jehovah’s direction they gave him the city he asked for, Timnath-Heres in the highland of Ephraim, and he fortified the city and lived in it.

EWE: 51 Esiawoe nye domenyinu siwo dzi nunɔla Eleazar kple Yosua, Nun vi, kpakple Israel-viwo ƒe tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu dzidze nu ɖo hema be woaxɔ le Silo le Yehowa ŋkume, le takpegbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu.
ENGLISH: 51 These are the estates Priest Eleazar and Joshuaʽ the son of Nun and the heads of families of the tribes of the sons of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh before Jehovah at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

EWE: Ale wowu anyigba la mama nu.
ENGLISH: So they finished dividing the country.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 20 Azɔ Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua be:
ENGLISH: 20 And Jehovah spoke to Joshuaʽ, saying

EWE: 2 “Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: ‘Mitia sitsoƒedu siwo ŋu nya megblɔ na mi to Mose dzi la na mia ɖokuiwo,
ENGLISH: 2 “Tell the sons of Israel ‘Institute the asylum cities of which I spoke to you by Moses,

EWE: 3 ale be ame si meɖoe alo nya hafi wu ame o la nasi ayi afi ma.
ENGLISH: 3 for the homicide who strikes down a person inadvertently

EWE: 4 Ele be wòasi ayi du siawo dometɔ ɖeka me, eye wòatɔ ɖe dugbo la nu, ne wòagblɔ eƒe nya na dumemetsitsiawo woase.
ENGLISH: 4 to flee to;

EWE: 5 Ne hlɔ̃biala la ti eyome va la, mele be woatsɔ amewula la ade asi nɛ o, elabena menya hafi wu ehavi o, eye melé fui tsã hã o.
ENGLISH: 5 you shall have them as an asylum from the blood-reclaimer,

EWE: 6 Ele be wòanɔ du ma me va se ɖe esime woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui le ha la ŋkume, eye wòanɔ afi ma va se ɖe esime nunɔlagã si li ɣemaɣi la ku.
ENGLISH: 6 and the homicide shall not die by the blood-reclaimer till he stands before the congregation for trial.’”

EWE: 7 Eya ta woɖe Kedes le Galilea le Naftali tonuto la me, kple Sekem le Efrayim tonuto la me, kple Kiriat-Arba, si nye Hebron, le Yuda tonuto la me be woanye du kɔkɔewo.
ENGLISH: 7 And they hallowed Kedesh in the Mark, in the highland of Naphtali, and Shekem in the highland of Ephraim, and Kirjath-Arbogh (that is, Hebron) in the highland of Judah.

EWE: 8 Le Yordan nutoa me le Yeriko ƒe ɣedzeƒe la, wotia Bezer si le gbedzi le tonyigba gbadza la dzi tso Ruben-to la me, kple Ramot si le Gilead la tso Gad-to la me, kpakple Golan si le Basan la tso Manase-to la me.
ENGLISH: 8 And on the east side of the Jordan at Jericho they instituted Beser in the wilderness, in the level, out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in the Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

EWE: 9 Du siawoe wotia na Israel-viwo katã kple amedzro siwo katã le wo dome, ale be ame sia ame si meɖoe hafi wu ame o la nasi ayi afi ma, ne hlɔ̃biala la nagawui o, va se ɖe esime wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnui le ha la ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 9 These were the appointed cities for all the sons of Israel and for the immigrants that lived among them, for everyone who struck down a person inadvertently to flee to and not die by the blood-reclaimer till he stood before the congregation.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 21 Azɔ Lewi viwo ƒe tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu va nunɔla Eleazar kple Yosua, Nun vi la, kpakple Israel-toawo ƒe tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu la gbɔ,
ENGLISH: 21 And the heads of families of the Levites approached Priest Eleazar and Joshuaʽ the son of Nun and the heads of families of the tribes of the sons of Israel

EWE: 2 eye wogblɔ na wo le Silo le Kanaan-nyigba dzi be: “Yehowa de se to Mose dzi be woatsɔ du aɖewo ana mí míanɔ wo me hekpe ɖe wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo ŋu na míaƒe lãwo.”
ENGLISH: 2 and spoke to them at Shiloh in Canaan, saying “Jehovah gave commandment through Moses to give us cities to live in, and their glebes for our cattle.”

EWE: 3 Eya ta Israel-viwo tsɔ duawo kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo na Lewi viwo tso woƒe domenyinu me le Yehowa ƒe sedede la nu.
ENGLISH: 3 And the sons of Israel gave the Levites out of their estate, by Jehovah’s direction, these cities and their glebes:

EWE: 4 Azɔ nudzidze la dze Kohat viwo ƒe ƒomewo dzi, eye wotsɔ du wuietɔ̃ na nunɔla Aron vi siwo nye Lewi viwo la tso Yuda-to, Simeon-to kple Benyamin-to la me le nudzidze la nu.
ENGLISH: 4 And the lot came out for the clan of the Kehathites; and Priest Aaron’s sons had, out of the Levites, out of the tribe of Judah and out of the tribe of the Simeonites and out of the tribe of Benjamin, by lot thirteen cities;

EWE: 5 Wotsɔ du ewo na Kohat vi mamlɛawo tso Efrayim-to, Dan-to, kple Manase-to afã la ƒe ƒomeawo me.
ENGLISH: 5 and the remaining sons of Kehath had out of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim and out of the tribe of Dan and out of half the tribe of Manasseh by lot ten cities.

EWE: 6 Wotsɔ du wuietɔ̃ na Gerson viwo tso Isakar-to, Aser-to, Naftali-to, kple Manase-to afã si le Basan la ƒe ƒomeawo me.
ENGLISH: 6 And the sons of Gershon had out of the clans of the tribe of Issacar and out of the tribe of Asher and out of the tribe of Naphtali and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in the Bashan by lot thirteen cities.

EWE: 7 Wotsɔ du wuieve na Merari viwo le woƒe ƒomewo nu tso Ruben-to, Gad-to kple Zebulon-to la me.
ENGLISH: 7 And the sons of Merari had, clan by clan, out of the tribe of Reuben and out of the tribe of Gad and out of the tribe of Zebulun twelve cities.

EWE: 8 Ale Israel-viwo dzidze nu tsɔ du siawo kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo na Lewi viwo, abe ale si tututu Yehowa de se to Mose dzi ene.
ENGLISH: 8 And the sons of Israel gave the Levites these cities and their glebes, as Jehovah commanded through Moses, by lot.

EWE: 9 Eya ta woɖe du siwo gbɔna la tso Yuda-to kple Simeon-to la me,
ENGLISH: 9 And they gave out of the tribe of the sons of Judah and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon these cities which are to be named:

EWE: 10 eye wotsɔ wo na Aron viwo, ame siwo tso Kohat-ƒomeawo me le Lewi viwo dome la, elabena woawo dzie nudzidze la dze gbã.
ENGLISH: 10 to the sons of Aaron, out of the clans of the Kehathites, out of the sons of Levi, (because they had the first lot,)

EWE: 11 Wotsɔ Kiriat-Arba (Arba ye nye Anak fofo) si nye Hebron na wo le Yuda tonuto la me, kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo.
ENGLISH: 11 they gave Kirjath-Arbogh the headquarters of the ʽAnak, that is, Hebron, in the highland of Judah, and its glebe around it,

EWE: 12 Ke wotsɔ agbledenyigba si le du la ŋu kple eƒe kɔƒewo na Kaleb, Yefune vi wòzu etɔ.
ENGLISH: 12 but the range of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as his property.

EWE: 13 Eye du si wotsɔ na nunɔla Aron viwoe nye: Hebron, si nye sitsoƒedu na amewula kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Libna kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 13 And to the sons of Priest Aaron they gave the city of asylum for the homicide, Hebron, and its glebes, and Libnah and its glebes,

EWE: 14 Yatir kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Estemoa kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 14 and Jattir and its glebe, and Eshtemoaʽ and its glebes,

EWE: 15 Holon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Debir kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 15 and Holon and its glebe, and Debir and its glebe,

EWE: 16 Ayin kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Yuta kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Bet-Semes kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du asieke tso to eve siawo me.
ENGLISH: 16 and ʽAshan and its glebe, and Juttah and its glebe, and Beth-Shemesh and its glebe, nine cities out of these two tribes;

EWE: 17 Le Benyamin-toa me la, woxɔ Gibeon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Geba kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 17 and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon and its glebe, and Gebaʽ and its glebe,

EWE: 18 Anatot kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Almon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 18 ʽAnathoth and its glebe, and ʽAlmon and its glebe, four cities:

EWE: 19 Eye du siwo katã wotsɔ na nunɔla Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo le du wuietɔ̃ kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo.
ENGLISH: 19 the total of the cities of Aaron’s sons, the priests, was thirteen cities and their glebes.

EWE: 20 Le Kohat viwo ƒe ƒome mamlɛa, siwo hã nye Lewi viwo gome la, wodzidze nu tsɔ duwo na wo tso Efrayim-to la me.
ENGLISH: 20 And for the Levite clans of the sons of Kehath, those of the sons of Kehath who were left, the cities of their lot were, out of the tribe of Ephraim

EWE: 21 Ale wotsɔ Sekem si nye sitsoƒedu na amewula kple eŋu lãnyiƒe na wo le Efrayim tonuto la me, Gezer kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 21 they gave them the city of asylum for the homicide, Shekem, and its glebe, in the highland of Ephraim, and Gezer and its glebe,

EWE: 22 Kibzaim kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Bet-Horon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 22 and Kibsaim and its glebe, and Beth-Horon and its glebe, four cities;

EWE: 23 Le Dan-toa me la, woxɔ Elteke kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Gibeton kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 23 and out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh and its glebe, Gibbethon and its glebe,

EWE: 24 Aiyalon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Gat-Rimon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 24 Aijalon and its glebe, Gath-Rimmon and its glebe, four cities;

EWE: 25 Le Manase-to afã la me la, woxɔ Taanak kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Gat-Rimon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du eve.
ENGLISH: 25 and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taʽanac and its glebe, Ibleʽam and its glebe, two cities:

EWE: 26 Duawo katã kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒe siwo wotsɔ na Kohat viwo ƒe ƒome mamlɛawo la le du ewo.
ENGLISH: 26 total ten cities and their glebes for the clans of the rest of the sons of Kehath.

EWE: 27 Du siwo Gerson viwo, ame siwo tso Lewi viwo ƒe ƒomeawo me, xɔ tso Manase-to afã la mee nye: Golan le Basan si nye sitsoƒedu na amewula kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Beestera kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du eve.
ENGLISH: 27 And the sons of Gershon, out of the clans of the Levites, had out of the half-tribe of Manasseh the city of asylum for the homicide, Golan in the Bashan, and its glebe, and Beʽeshterah and its glebe, two cities;

EWE: 28 Le Isakar-toa me la, woxɔ Kision kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Daberat kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 28 and out of the tribe of Issacar, Kishjon and its glebe, Daberath and its glebe,

EWE: 29 Yarmut kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple En-Ganim kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 29 Jarmuth and its glebe, ʽEn-Gannim and its glebe, four cities;

EWE: 30 Le Aser-toa me la, woxɔ Misal kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Abdon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 30 and out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal and its glebe, ʽAbdon and its glebe,

EWE: 31 Helkat kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Rehob kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 31 Helkath and its glebe, Rehob and its glebe, four cities;

EWE: 32 Le Naftali-toa me la, woxɔ Kedes le Galilea si nye sitsoƒedu na amewula kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Hamot-Dor kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Kartan kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du etɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 32 and out of the tribe of Naphtali the city of asylum for the homicide, Kedesh in the Mark, and its glebe, and Hammoth-Dor and its glebe, and Kartan and its glebe, three cities: 33 the total of the cities of the Gershonites, clan by clan, was thirteen cities and their glebes.

EWE: 33 Gerson viwo ƒe duwo katã le woƒe ƒomewo nu le du wuietɔ̃ kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo.
ENGLISH: 34 And the clans of the sons of Merari, the rest of the Levites, had, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneʽam and its glebe, Kartah and its glebe,

EWE: 34 Le Zebulon-toa me la, Merari viwo ƒe ƒomewo, ame siwo nye Lewi vi mamlɛawo, xɔ Yokneam kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Karta kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, 35 Dimna kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Nahalal kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 35 Dimnah and its glebe, Nahalal and its glebe, four cities; and on the other side of the Jordan at Jericho

EWE: 36 Le Ruben-toa me la, woxɔ Bezer kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Yahaz kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 36 out of the tribe of Reuben the city of asylum for the homicide, Beser in the wilderness, and its glebe, and Jahsah and its glebe,

EWE: 37 Kedemot kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Mefaat kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wole du ene.
ENGLISH: 37 Kedemoth and its glebe, and Mephaʽath and its glebe, four cities;

EWE: 38 Le Gad-toa me la, woxɔ Ramot le Gilead si nye sitsoƒedu na amewula kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Mahanayim kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 38 and out of the tribe of Gad the city of asylum for the homicide, Ramoth in Gilead, and its glebe, and Mahanaim and its glebe,

EWE: 39 Hesbon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, kpakple Yazer kple eŋu lãnyiƒe wo katã le du ene.
ENGLISH: 39 Heshbon and its glebe, Jaʽzer and its glebe, four cities.

EWE: 40 Du siwo katã wotsɔ na Merari-ƒomeawo, siwo nye Lewi viwo ƒe ƒome mamlɛawo la, le du wuieve.
ENGLISH: 40 All the cities belonged to the sons of Merari clan by clan, the rest of the clans of the Levites; and their lot was twelve cities.

EWE: 41 Lewi viwo ƒe du siwo katã le Israel-viwo ƒe anyigba dzi la le du blaene vɔ enyi kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo.
ENGLISH: 41 The total of the cities of the Levites in the midst of the property of the sons of Israel was forty-eight cities and their glebes,

EWE: 42 Lãnyiƒe le du siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋu; aleae du siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le.
ENGLISH: 42 these cities being each with its glebes around it, so for all these cities.

EWE: 43 Ale Yehowa tsɔ anyigba blibo la katã na Israel abe ale si wòka atam na wo tɔgbuiwo ene, eye woxɔe henɔ edzi.
ENGLISH: 43 And Jehovah gave Israel all the country he had sworn to give to their fathers, and they took possession of it and lived in it;

EWE: 44 Eye Yehowa na gbɔdzɔe wo godoo va kpe, abe ale si wòka atam na wo tɔgbuiwo ene, eye woƒe futɔwo katã dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã mete ŋu nɔ te ɖe wo nu o. Yehowa tsɔ woƒe futɔwo katã de asi na wo.
ENGLISH: 44 and Jehovah gave them rest on all sides, just as he had sworn to their fathers, and of all their enemies not a man stood before them; Jehovah gave all their enemies into their hands.

EWE: 45 Ŋugbe nyui siwo katã Yehowa do na Israel ƒe aƒe la dometɔ ɖeka hɔ̃ hã medo kpo emevava o; wo katã va eme.
ENGLISH: 45 Of all the good promise Jehovah had made to the house of Israel not a point failed; all came true.

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 22 Yosua yɔ Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo kpakple Manase-to afã la,
ENGLISH: 22 Then Joshuaʽ called the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

EWE: 2 eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Miewɔ nu siwo katã ƒe se Mose, Yehowa ƒe subɔla, de na mi la dzi, eye mieɖo to nye gbe le nu siwo katã ƒe se mede na mi la me.
ENGLISH: 2 and said to them “You have kept all the commands Jehovah’s servant Moses gave you, and obeyed every order of mine;

EWE: 3 Miegblẽ mia nɔviwo ɖi le ɣeyiɣi siawo katã me va se ɖe egbe sia o, eye miewɔ se si Yehowa mia Mawu de na mi la dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 you have not deserted your brothers, these many days. To this day you have kept the charge of your God Jehovah’s commandments.

EWE: 4 Ke azɔ Yehowa mia Mawu la na gbɔdzɔe mia nɔviwo, abe ale si tututu wòdo ŋugbe na wo ene. Eya ta azɔ miate ŋu atrɔ ayi miaƒe agbadɔwo me le anyigba si Mose, Yehowa ƒe subɔla, tsɔ na mi le Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi be wòazu mia tɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 4 And now Jehovah has brought your brothers to rest as he promised them; so now about-face and go to your homes in the country you have as your property, which Jehovah’s servant Moses gave to you on the other side of the Jordan.

EWE: 5 Ðeko mikpɔ nyuie, be miawɔ ɖoɖo kple Se siwo Mose, Yehowa ƒe subɔla, de na mi la dzi, ahalɔ̃ Yehowa mia Mawu la, azɔ le eƒe mɔwo katã dzi, alé eƒe sededewo me ɖe asi, aku ɖe eŋu, eye miasubɔe kple dzi blibo kpakple luʋɔ blibo.”
ENGLISH: 5 Only be very careful to live up to the commandment and instruction which Jehovah’s servant Moses enjoined upon you, loving your God Jehovah and walking in all his ways and keeping his commandments and holding fast to him, and worshiping him with all your hearts and souls.”

EWE: 6 Azɔ Yosua yra wo heɖe asi le wo ŋu, eye wodzo yi woƒe agbadɔwo me.
ENGLISH: 6 And Joshuaʽ blessed them, and they went to their homes.

EWE: 7 Mose na domenyinu Manase-to afã la le Basan, eye Yosua na anyigba to la ƒe afã mamlɛa kpe ɖe wo nɔviwo ŋu le Yordan ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe.
ENGLISH: 7 And Moses had given in the Bashan to half the tribe of Manasseh, and to half of it Joshuaʽ gave on the west side of the Jordan with their brothers.

EWE: Esi Yosua ɖe asi le wo ŋu be woayi woƒe agbadɔwo me la, eyra wo
ENGLISH: And when Joshuaʽ sent them away to their homes and blessed them,

EWE: 8 hegblɔ na wo be: “Mitsɔ kesinɔnu geɖewo kple lãha gbogbowo, klosalo, sika, akɔbli, gayibɔ kple awu geɖewo fũu ne miagbugbɔ ayi miaƒe agbadɔwo me. Eye mima miaƒe futɔwo ƒe aboyonuwo kple mia nɔviwo.”
ENGLISH: 8 they went back to their homes with great substance, with a very great quantity of stock, with silver and gold and bronze and iron, and with a very great quantity of clothing, and divided the booty from their enemies with their brothers.

EWE: 9 Emegbe Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo kpakple Manase-to afã la dzo le Israel-vi bubuawo gbɔ le Silo, le Kanaan-nyigba dzi, hetrɔ yi Gilead-nyigba si woxɔ henɔ edzi le se si Yehowa de to Mose dzi nu la dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh went back from Shiloh in Canaan, from the company of the sons of Israel, to go to Gilead, the country of their property appropriated to them by Jehovah’s direction through Moses.

EWE: 10 Esi Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo kpakple Manase-to afã la va ɖo Yordan nutowo me le Kanaan-nyigba dzi la, woɖi vɔsamlekpui ɖe Yordan nu, enye vɔsamlekpui gã aɖe ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 10 And they came to the marks of the Jordan, in Canaan, and there the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar by the Jordan, an imposing altar.

EWE: 11 Emegbe Israel-vi bubuawo see wogblɔ be: “Mikpɔ ɖa! Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo kpakple Manase-to afã la ɖi vɔsamlekpui ɖe Kanaan-nyigba la ƒe liƒo dzi le Yordan nutowo me, le eƒe go si nye Israel-viwo tɔ la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 11 And the sons of Israel heard “There have the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar toward Canaan in the marks of the Jordan, on the sons of Israel’s side,”

EWE: 12 Esi Israel-viwo see la, Israel-viwo ƒe ha blibo la va kpe ta ɖe Silo be yewoawɔ aʋa kpli wo.
ENGLISH: 12 and all the congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go up in an expedition against them.

EWE: 13 Eye Israel-viwo dɔ Finehas, nunɔla Eleazar vi, ɖo ɖe Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase-to afã la le Gilead-nyigba dzi,
ENGLISH: 13 And the sons of Israel sent to Gilead, to the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Pinehas the son of Priest Eleazar

EWE: 14 eye tatɔ ewo kpe ɖe eŋu, tatɔ ɖeka tso Israel-toawo ƒe aƒekɔ ɖe sia ɖe me, wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nye wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔ ƒe tatɔ le Israel-viwo ƒe ame akpeawo dome.
ENGLISH: 14 and ten princes with him, one prince from each family of all the tribes of Israel; each was one of the heads of families of the thousands of Israel.

EWE: 15 Esi wova ɖo Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase-to afã la gbɔ le Gilead-nyigba dzi la, wogblɔ na wo be:
ENGLISH: 15 And they came to Gilead to the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh and spoke with them, saying

EWE: 16 “Ale Yehowa ƒe ha blibo la katã gblɔe nye esi: ‘Anukwaremaɖimaɖinu kae nye esi miewɔ ɖe Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu?
ENGLISH: 16 “Says all Jehovah’s congregation, What does this unfaithfulness mean which you have been guilty of toward the God of Israel, going back today from following Jehovah, in that you have built yourselves an altar to break your allegiance to Jehovah today?

EWE: Mietrɔ le Yehowa yome egbea esi mieɖi vɔsamlekpui na mia ɖokui eye miedze aglã ɖe Yehowa ŋu. 17 Ðe vo si míeda le Peor la mesɔ gbɔ na mí oa?
ENGLISH: 17 Was the offense of Peghor a little thing for us, that from which we are not cleansed to this day, and by which there came the calamity in Jehovah’s congregation,

EWE: Míeklɔe ɖa le mía ɖokui ŋu vɔ o va se ɖe egbe, togbɔ be dɔvɔ̃ va Yehowa ƒe ha la dzi hã. 18 Eye miagatrɔ ɖa le Yehowa yome egbea!
ENGLISH: 18 and are you turning back from following Jehovah? and when you break your allegiance to Jehovah today, tomorrow he will be incensed at all the congregation of Israel.

EWE: Ne miedze aglã ɖe Yehowa ŋu egbea la, ekema Israel ƒe ha blibo la katã ŋue wòava do dziku ɖo etsɔ. 19 Ke nenye be anyigba si miexɔ wòzu mia tɔ la ŋue mekɔ o la, ekema mitso tɔ va anyigba si nye Yehowa tɔ la dzi, afi si Yehowa ƒe avɔgbadɔ la le, ne mianɔ mía dome, gake ɖeko migaɖi vɔsamlekpui aɖeke kpe ɖe Yehowa, mía Mawu la, ƒe vɔsamlekpui ŋu ahadze aglã ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye miana míazu aglãdzelawo o.
ENGLISH: 19 If the country you have as your property is unclean, just come over to the country that is Jehovah’s property, where Jehovah’s tabernacle is present, and receive a property among us; but do not break your allegiance to Jehovah and put us in the position of breaking ours by your building yourselves an altar other than the altar of our God Jehovah.

EWE: 20 Esi Akan, Zera vi la, meɖi anukware le nu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi la me o la, menye Israel ƒe ha blibo la katã ŋue wodo dziku ɖo oa?
ENGLISH: 20 ʽAcan the son of Zabdi was guilty of unfaithfulness in the deodand, and did there not come a wrath against all the congregation of Israel? and he did not perish a single man in his guilt.”

EWE: Eye menye eya ɖeka koe ku le eƒe vodada ta o.’” 21 Eye Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase-toa ƒe afã la ɖo eŋu na Israel ƒe ame akpewo ƒe tatɔawo be:
ENGLISH: 21 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered to the heads of the thousands of Israel “Jehovah is God of gods.

EWE: 22 “Yehowa, mawuwo dzi Mawu!
ENGLISH: 22 Jehovah is God of gods.

EWE: Yehowa, mawuwo dzi Mawu! Enyae, eye Israel hã anyae. Yehowa, ne aglãe míedze, eye míewɔ nuteƒe na wò o la, ekema mègaxɔ na mí egbea o.
ENGLISH: He knows, and let Israel know: if it be in breach of allegiance or if it be in unfaithfulness to Jehovah let him not help us this day,

EWE: 23 Ne ɖe míeɖi vɔsamlekpui na mía ɖokuiwo, be míatrɔ le Yehowa yome, ne míasa numevɔwo, nuɖuvɔwo kple ŋutifafavɔwo le edzi la, Yehowa ahe to na mí.
ENGLISH: 23 building us an altar to turn back from following Jehovah; or if it be to offer burnt-offerings and grain-offerings on, or if it be to do welfare-sacrifices on, Jehovah himself look into it;

EWE: 24 Gake kpao, susu bubu aɖe tae míewɔ nu sia ɖo, elabe míegblɔ be: ‘Mia viwo ava gblɔ na mía viwo gbe aɖe gbe be: “Nya kae le mi kple Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la dome?
ENGLISH: 24 if it be not for anxiety about a certain point that we have done this, thinking ‘Tomorrow your sons will say to ours “What has Israel’s God Jehovah to do with you,

EWE: 25 Yehowa tsɔ Yordan do liƒo na míawo kpakple mi Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo. Gome aɖeke mele mia si le Yehowa gbɔ o.” Ale mia viwo axe mɔ na mía viwo be woagasubɔ Yehowa o.’
ENGLISH: 25 Jehovah having put a boundary between you sons of Reuben and of Gad and us, the Jordan? you have no share in Jehovah,” and your sons will make ours leave off fearing Jehovah.’

EWE: 26 “Eya tae míegblɔ be: ‘Mina míawɔ nane godoo, míaɖi vɔsamlekpui, menye le numevɔwo alo vɔ bubuwo sasa ta o,
ENGLISH: 26 And we thought ‘Let us make ourselves a model of the altar,’ not for burnt-offering and not for sacrifice,

EWE: 27 ke boŋ be wòanye ɖase le míawo kpli miawo kpakple míaƒe dzidzimevi siwo ava ɖe mía yome la dome, be míasa míaƒe numevɔwo, míaƒe vɔ bubuwo kple míaƒe ŋutifafavɔwo ahasubɔ le Yehowa ŋkume, ne mia viwo magava gblɔ na mía viwo gbe aɖe gbe be: “Gome aɖeke mele mia si le Yehowa gbɔ o.”’
ENGLISH: 27 because it is a witness between you and us, and between our generations after us, for rendering Jehovah’s worship before him with our burnt-offerings and our sacrifices and our welfare-sacrifices, and your sons are not to say to ours tomorrow ‘you have no share in Jehovah.’

EWE: 28 Eya ta míegblɔ be: ‘Ne woava gblɔ nya ma na míawo ŋutɔ kple míaƒe dzidzimeviwo gbe aɖe gbe la, ekema míawo hã míagblɔ be: “Mikpɔ Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui tɔgbi si mía fofowo ɖi la ɖa, menye le numevɔwo alo vɔ bubuwo sasa ta o, ke boŋ be wòanye ɖase le míawo kpli miawo dome.”’
ENGLISH: 28 And we thought ‘And when they say so to us and to our generations tomorrow, we will say “See the model of Jehovah’s altar that our fathers made, not for burnt-offering and not for sacrifice, because it is a witness between you and us.”’

EWE: 29 Nede megbe xaa tso mía gbɔ be míadze aglã ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye míatrɔ le Yehowa yome egbea ahaɖi vɔsamlekpui bubu akpe ɖe Yehowa mía Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui si le eƒe avɔgbadɔ ŋgɔ la ŋu hena numevɔ, nuɖuvɔ kple vɔ bubuwo sasa!”
ENGLISH: 29 Away from us with the thought of breaking our allegiance to Jehovah or turning back today from following Jehovah, building an altar for burnt-offering, grain-offering, and sacrifice, apart from our God Jehovah’s altar before his tabernacle.”

EWE: 30 Esi nunɔla Finehas, ha la ƒe tatɔ siwo kpe ɖe eŋu, siwo nye Israel ƒe ame akpewo ƒe tatɔwo, se nya siwo Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase viwo gblɔ la, edze wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 30 And Priest Pinehas and the princes of the congregation who were with him heard the words the sons of Reuben and of Gad and of Manasseh spoke, and approved of them.

EWE: 31 Eya ta Finehas, nunɔla Eleazar vi gblɔ na Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase viwo be: “Míenyae egbea be, Yehowa le mía dome, elabena miewɔ anukwaremaɖimaɖinu aɖeke ɖe Yehowa ŋu o. Azɔ mieɖe Israel-viwo tso Yehowa si me.”
ENGLISH: 31 And Priest Pinehas said to the sons of Reuben and of Gad and of Manasseh “Today we know that Jehovah is among us; in that you were not guilty of this unfaithfulness toward Jehovah, you then delivered the sons of Israel out of Jehovah’s hands.”

EWE: 32 Eye Finehas, nunɔla Eleazar vi kple tatɔawo gbugbɔ tso Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo gbɔ le Gilead-nyigba dzi heva Kanaan-nyigba dzi, eye wogblɔ dɔgbedenyaa na Israel-vi bubuawo.
ENGLISH: 32 And Priest Pinehas and the princes returned from conferring with the sons of Reuben and of Gad in Gilead to the sons of Israel in Canaan and brought them back word;

EWE: 33 Eye nya si wova gblɔ la dze Israel-viwo ŋu. Ale Israel-viwo kafu Mawu, eye womegagblɔ kpɔ be yewoaho aʋa ɖe Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo ŋu ahagblẽ anyigba si dzi wole la o.
ENGLISH: 33 and the sons of Israel approved of the word, and the sons of Israel blessed God and did not think of going up on an expedition against them to ravage the country the sons of Reuben and of Gad lived in.

EWE: 34 Eye Ruben viwo kple Gad viwo na ŋkɔ vɔsamlekpuia hegblɔ be: “Enye ɖase le mía dome be, Yehowae nye Mawu vavã la.”
ENGLISH: 34 And the sons of Reuben and of Gad called the altar ʽEd, “because it is an ʽed, witness, between us that Jehovah is our God.”

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 23 Le ƒe geɖe megbe, esi Yehowa na gbɔdzɔe Israel tso eƒe futɔ siwo ƒo xlãe godoo si me vɔ, eye Yosua tsi xɔ ƒe geɖe la,
ENGLISH: 23 And long after Jehovah had given Israel rest from all their enemies on all sides, Joshuaʽ, being an old man, far gone in years,

EWE: 2 Yosua yɔ Israel blibo la katã, eƒe ametsitsiwo, tatɔwo, ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple dzikpɔlawo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Metsi ku amegã xɔ ƒe geɖe.
ENGLISH: 2 called all Israel, its elders and its chiefs and its judges and its marshals, and said to them “I am an old man, far gone in years;

EWE: 3 Miawo ŋutɔwo miekpɔ nu siwo katã Yehowa mia Mawu wɔ dukɔ siawo katã le mia ta, elabena Yehowa mia Mawue le aʋa wɔm na mi.
ENGLISH: 3 and you have seen everything that your God Jehovah did to all these nations on your account, because it was your God Jehovah that fought for you.

EWE: 4 Kpɔ ɖa, medzidze nu ɖe dukɔ siwo susɔ la ƒe anyigbawo dzi hema wo na mi wozu domenyinu na miaƒe toawo hekpe ɖe dukɔ siwo katã metsrɔ̃ le Yordan nu va se ɖe Ƒu Gã la nu le ɣetoɖoƒe la ƒe anyigbawo ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 4 See, I have allotted these remaining nations to you as estate, tribe by tribe, from the Jordan and all the nations I exterminated and the great sea where the sun sets.

EWE: 5 Yehowa mia Mawue tutu wo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ henya wo ɖa na mi, eye miexɔ woƒe anyigba, abe ale si tututu Yehowa mia Mawu do ŋugbe na mi ene.
ENGLISH: 5 And your God Jehovah will himself push them out of your way and dispossess them from before you, and you shall take possession of their country as your God Jehovah promised you;

EWE: 6 “Azɔ ele be mialé dzi ɖe ƒo vevie, ne mialé nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe Segbalẽa me la me ɖe asi ahawɔ wo dzi, ne miagadze le eŋu ɖe ɖusime alo miame 7 ahade ha kple dukɔ siawo, siwo kpɔtɔ le mia dome la gbeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 6 and you are to be very determined to take care and live up to everything that is written in the code of Moses, not turning off from it to right or to left,

EWE: Migayɔ woƒe mawuwo ŋkɔ alo atsɔ wo aka atam gɔ̃ hã o, eye migasubɔ wo alo ade ta agu na wo gbeɖe o.
ENGLISH: 7 not going in among these nations that remain with you, nor mentioning the names of their gods nor putting an oath by them nor worshiping them nor doing reverence to them,

EWE: 8 Ke boŋ miku ɖe Yehowa mia Mawu la ŋu, abe ale si tututu miewɔe va se ɖe egbe sia ene.
ENGLISH: 8 but sticking to your God Jehovah, as you have done it to this day

EWE: 9 Yehowa anya dukɔ gã sesẽwo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ, elabena ame aɖeke kura mete ŋu nɔ te ɖe mia nu va se ɖe egbe sia o.
ENGLISH: 9 and Jehovah has dispossessed before you great and numerous nations, and not a man has stood before you to this day;

EWE: 10 Mia dometɔ ɖeka pɛ anya ame akpe ɖe nu, elabena Yehowa mia Mawu le aʋa wɔm na mi, abe ale si tututu wòdo ŋugbe na mi ene.
ENGLISH: 10 one man of you would chase a thousand, because it was your God Jehovah that fought for you as he had promised you.

EWE: 11 Eya ta mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie ɣesiaɣi ne mialɔ̃ Yehowa mia Mawu la.
ENGLISH: 11 And you are to keep a sharp watch on your ownselves to love your God Jehovah,

EWE: 12 “Gake ne mietrɔ megbe heku ɖe dukɔ siawo me tɔ siwo kpɔtɔ le mia gbɔ la ŋu, eye miena srɔ̃ɖekadodo le mi kpli wo dome, miede ha kpli wo eye woawo hã wode ha kpli mi la,
ENGLISH: 12 because if you do turn back and adhere to the rest of these nations that remain with you and intermarry with them and go in among them and they among you,

EWE: 13 ekema minyae nyuie be Yehowa mia Mawu mayi edzi anya dukɔ siawo ɖa na mi o. Woazu mɔ̃ kple kamɔ̃ aɖe mi, woazu abe ameƒoti ene anɔ axadame ƒom na mi, eye woanye ŋù anɔ ŋku dzi na mi va se ɖe esime mietsrɔ̃ vɔ keŋ le anyigba nyui sia si Yehowa mia Mawu tsɔ na mi la dzi.
ENGLISH: 13 you are to know positively that your God Jehovah will do no more of dispossessing these nations from before you, and they will become to you a trap and a snare, and a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, till you perish off this good soil your God Jehovah has given you.

EWE: 14 “Kpɔ ɖa, nye kuɣi ɖo, eye mienyae nyuie tso miaƒe dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me be, nya ɖeka pɛ hã medo kpo emevava le ŋugbe nyui siwo katã Yehowa mia Mawu do na mi la me o. Wo katã va eme na mi.
ENGLISH: 14 Here I am today going the way of all the earth, and you know in all your hearts and souls that not one point of all the good things your God Jehovah promised about you has failed;

EWE: Wo dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã medo kpo emevava o. 15 Gake ale si ko ŋugbe nyui siwo katã Yehowa mia Mawu do na mi va eme na mi la, nenema kee Yehowa ahe vɔ̃ siwo katã ƒe ŋugbe wòdo la ava mia dzi, eye wòatsrɔ̃ mi ɖa keŋkeŋ le anyigba nyui sia si Yehowa mia Mawu tsɔ na mi la dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 it all came true for you, not one point of it failed. And as all the good word your God Jehovah promised about you has come true to you, so will Jehovah make all the bad word come true to you till he roots you out from this good soil that he gave you,

EWE: 16 Ne mietu Yehowa mia Mawu ƒe nu, si wòbla kpli mi, eye mieyi ɖasubɔ mawu bubuwo hede ta agu na wo la, ekema Yehowa ƒe dziku afla ɖe mia ŋu, eye miatsrɔ̃ avɔ kaba ŋutɔ le anyigba nyui si wòtsɔ na mi la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 16 when you overstep Jehovah’s covenant that he enjoined on you and go and worship other gods and do reverence to them, and Jehovah is angry with you and you perish quickly off the good country he gave you.”

EWE: Yosua
ENGLISH: Joshua

EWE: 24 Yosua ƒo Israel-toawo katã nu ƒu ɖe Sekem, eye wòyɔ Israel ƒe ametsitsiwo, tatɔwo, ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple dzikpɔlawo, eye wova tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu vavã la ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 24 And Joshuaʽ brought together all the tribes of Israel at Shekem and summoned the elders of Israel and its chiefs and judges and marshals, and they took their stand before God.

EWE: 2 Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be: “Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔe nye esi: ‘Le blema la, Tɔsisi la ƒe go kemɛ dzie mia tɔgbuiwo nɔ wo dometɔ ɖekae nye Tera, si nye Abraham kple Nahor fofo eye wosubɔ mawu bubuwo.
ENGLISH: 2 And Joshuaʽ said to all the people “Says Israel’s God Jehovah, Of old your forefathers lived on the other side of the River, Terah the father of Abraham and of Nahor, and worshiped other gods.

EWE: 3 “‘Emegbe mekplɔ mia tɔgbui Abraham tso Tɔsisi la ƒe go kemɛ dzi, mena wòtsa le Kanaan-nyigba blibo la dzi, eye mena eƒe dzidzimeviwo sɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 3 And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the River and had him go throughout Canaan, and I made him prolific and gave him Isaac

EWE: Metsɔ Isak nɛ, 4 eye metsɔ Yakob kple Esau na Isak. Emegbe metsɔ Seir To la na Esau be wòazu etɔ; eye Yakob kple viawo yi Egipte.
ENGLISH: 4 and gave Isaac Jacob and ʽEsau, and gave ʽEsau the highland of Seʽir to take possession of, while Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

EWE: 5 Emegbe medɔ Mose kple Aron, eye metsɔ nu siwo mewɔ le Egipte la wɔ fu dukɔ ma, eye mekplɔ mi dzoe.
ENGLISH: 5 And I sent Moses and Aaron and smote the Egyptians with what I did among them,

EWE: 6 Esime mekplɔ mia fofowo tso Egipte gbɔna, eye mieva ɖo ƒua nu la, Egiptetɔwo ti mia fofowo yome kple aʋatasiaɖamwo kpakple sɔdolawo va ɖo keke Ƒudzĩ la nu ke.
ENGLISH: 6 and afterward I brought you out of Egypt; and you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and cavalry at the Red Sea,

EWE: 7 Wodo ɣli na Yehowa, eye wòna viviti va nɔ mi kple Egiptetɔwo dome, ena ƒu la nyè tsyɔ wo dzi, eye miaƒe ŋkuwo kpɔ nu si mewɔ le Egipte.
ENGLISH: 7 and they cried out to Jehovah, and he placed a mass of darkness between you and the Egyptians and brought the sea on them, and it covered them, and your eyes saw what I had done to the Egyptians; and you lived in the wilderness a long time.

EWE: Eye mieva nɔ gbea dzi ƒe geɖe. 8 “‘Eye mekplɔ mi va Amoritɔ siwo nɔ Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi la ƒe anyigba dzi, eye wowɔ aʋa kpli mi.
ENGLISH: 8 And I brought you to the country of the Amorites who lived on the other side of the Jordan; and they made war with you, and I gave them into your hands, and you took possession of their country, and I rooted them out before you.

EWE: Gake metsɔ wo de asi na mi, ale be miete ŋu xɔ woƒe anyigba, eye metsrɔ̃ wo ɖa gbidigbidi le mia ŋgɔ. 9 Eye Moab-fia Balak, Zipor vi, ho aʋa ɖe Israel ŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 And the king of Moab, Balak the son of Sippor, stood up and made war on Israel, and called in Balaam the son of Beʽor to misspeak you;

EWE: Eya ta edɔ woyi ɖayɔ Bileam, Beor vi vɛ, be wòaƒo fi ade mi. 10 Gake nyemeɖo to Bileam o.
ENGLISH: 10 but I was not willing to listen to Balaam, and he positively blessed you, and I delivered you out of his hands.

EWE: Eya ta eyra mi enuenu, eye meɖe mi tso esi me. 11 “‘Emegbe mietso Yordan va Yeriko. Ke Yerikotɔwo ƒe kplɔlawo, Amoritɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Kanaantɔwo, Hititɔwo, Girgasitɔwo, Hivitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo wɔ aʋa kpli mi, ke metsɔ wo de asi na mi.
ENGLISH: 11 And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho, and the burghers of Jericho made war on you, and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Hivvites and the Jebusites, and I gave them into your hands.

EWE: 12 Eya ta mena dzi ɖe le amewo ƒo le mia ŋgɔ, eye esia nya wo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ abe ale si ko wonya Amoritɔwo ƒe fia eveawo ene.
ENGLISH: 12 And I sent before you hornets which expelled them before you, the twelve kings of the Amorites, not by your sword or bow.

EWE: Ke menye wò yi kple wò da ye wɔ esia o. 13 Ale metsɔ anyigba si ŋu mieku kutri aɖeke le o kple du siwo mietso o la na mi miele wo me. Waingble siwo miede o kple amitibɔ siwo mietso o la me nuwo ɖumee miele.’
ENGLISH: 13 And I gave you a country you had not labored on, and cities you had not built, and you settled in them; it is vineyards and olive-trees which you did not plant that you are eating from.

EWE: 14 “Eya ta mivɔ̃ Yehowa, eye misubɔe le fɔmaɖimaɖi kple nuteƒewɔwɔ me, miɖe mawu siwo mia tɔgbuiwo subɔ le Tɔsisi la ƒe go kemɛ dzi kple Egipte la ɖa, eye misubɔ Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 14 Now fear Jehovah and worship him wholeheartedly and loyally, and clear away the gods your forefathers worshiped on the other side of the River and in Egypt, and worship Jehovah.

EWE: 15 Ke ne medze mia ŋu be miasubɔ Yehowa o la, ekema mitia ame si subɔ ge miala egbea, eɖanye mawu siwo mia tɔgbuiwo subɔ le Tɔsisi la ƒe go kemɛ dzi alo Amoritɔ siwo ƒe anyigba dzi miele la ƒe mawuwo o. Ke nye kple nye aƒe ya, míasubɔ Yehowa.”
ENGLISH: 15 And if you do not like to worship Jehovah, make your choice today whom you will worship, whether the gods your forefathers on the other side of the River worshiped or the gods of the Amorites whose country you are living in; but I and my family will worship Jehovah.”

EWE: 16 Eye dukɔ la ɖo eŋu be: “Madzɔ akpɔ gbeɖe be míagblẽ Yehowa ɖi aɖasubɔ mawu bubuwo o.
ENGLISH: 16 And the people answered “Away with the thought of our leaving Jehovah to worship other gods,

EWE: 17 Yehowa mía Mawu ye kplɔ mí kple mía fofowo dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi, tso kluviwo ƒe me, eye eyae wɔ dzesi gã siawo le mía ŋkume, eye wòdzɔ mía ŋu le mɔ blibo si míezɔ la katã dzi kple dukɔ siwo katã dome míeto la me.
ENGLISH: 17 for it was our God Jehovah that brought us up out of Egypt and guarded us through all the distance we went and all the peoples we passed among,

EWE: 18 Yehowa nya dukɔwo katã kple Amoritɔ siwo nɔ anyigbaa dzi la ɖa le mía ŋgɔ. Eya ta míawo hã míasubɔ Yehowa, elabena eyae nye mía Mawu.”
ENGLISH: 18 and expelled before us the Amorites that lived in the country; we too will worship Jehovah, because he is our God.”

EWE: 19 Eye Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Miate ŋu asubɔ Yehowa o, elabena Mawu kɔkɔe wònye; Mawu si biaa ɖokuitsɔtsɔna blibo ye wònye. Matsɔ miaƒe dzidadawo kple miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ake o.
ENGLISH: 19 And Joshuaʽ said to the people “You will not be able to worship Jehovah, because he is a holy God; he is a jealous deity who will not pardon your crimes and sins;

EWE: 20 Ne miegblẽ Yehowa ɖi, eye miesubɔ dutamawuwo la, ekema eya hã atɔ ŋku mi ahatsrɔ̃ mi ɖa keŋkeŋ evɔ wònye ewɔ nyui na mi hafi.”
ENGLISH: 20 for you will leave Jehovah and worship foreign gods, and he will turn back and do you harm and exterminate you after he had done you good.”

EWE: 21 Ke dukɔ la ɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Gbeɖe, Yehowa koe míasubɔ!”
ENGLISH: 21 And the people said to Joshuaʽ “No, we will worship Jehovah.”

EWE: 22 Eya ta Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Miawo ŋutɔe nye ɖasefowo na mia ɖokui be, yewo ŋutɔe tiae be yewoasubɔ Yehowa.”
ENGLISH: 22 And Joshuaʽ said to the people “You are witnesses to your bargain, that you have made your choice of Jehovah, to worship him.

EWE: 23 “‘Ekema miɖe dutamawu siwo le mia dome la ɖa, eye mitrɔ miaƒe dzi ɖe Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu.”
ENGLISH: 23 Now clear away the foreign gods you have among you and bend your hearts to Israel’s God Jehovah.”

EWE: 24 Eye dukɔ la ɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Míasubɔ Yehowa mía Mawu la, eye míaɖo to eƒe gbe!”
ENGLISH: 24 And the people said to Joshuaʽ “We will worship our God Jehovah and obey him.”

EWE: 25 Ale Yosua bla nu kple dukɔ la gbe ma gbe, eye wòwɔ ɖoɖowo kple sewo na wo le Sekem.
ENGLISH: 25 And Joshuaʽ made an agreement with the people that day, and established a usage and law for them at Shekem.

EWE: 26 Eye Yosua ŋlɔ nya siawo ɖe Mawu ƒe Segbalẽ la me, eye wòtsɔ kpe gã aɖe ɖi ɖe ati gã si le Yehowa ƒe kɔkɔeƒea gbɔ la te.
ENGLISH: 26 And Joshuaʽ wrote these terms in the book of the code of Moses, and took a great stone and set it up there under the oak at Jehovah’s sanctuary;

EWE: 27 Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be: “Kpɔ ɖa! Kpe sia azu ɖasefo ɖe mía ŋu, elabena ese nya siwo katã Yehowa gblɔ na mí, eye wòazu ɖasefo ɖe mia ŋu, ne miagagbe nu le mia Mawu la gbɔ o.”
ENGLISH: 27 and Joshuaʽ said to all the people “There, we will have this stone for a witness to our bargain, because it had heard all Jehovah’s words that he spoke with us and will be a witness to your bargain so that you may not cheat your God Jehovah.”

EWE: 28 Eye Yosua ɖe asi le dukɔ la ŋu, eye ame sia ame yi eƒe anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 28 And Joshuaʽ sent the people away to their estates.

EWE: 29 Le nu siawo megbe la, Yehowa ƒe subɔla Yosua, Nun vi la, ku esime wòxɔ ƒe alafa ɖeka kple ewo.
ENGLISH: 29 And after this Jehovah’s servant Joshuaʽ the son of Nun died at the age of a hundred and ten years,

EWE: 30 Eye woɖii ɖe eƒe anyigba si dome wònyi la dzi le Timna-Sera, si le Efrayim tonuto la me, le Gaas To la ƒe dziehe.
ENGLISH: 30 and they buried him within the bounds of his estate at Timnath-Heres in the highland of Ephraim, north of Gaʽash Mountain.

EWE: 31 Eye Israel yi edzi subɔ Yehowa le Yosua ƒe agbemeŋkekewo katã kple ame tsitsi siwo ganɔ agbe le Yosua ƒe ku megbe, siwo nya dɔ siwo katã Yehowa wɔ na Israel la ƒe agbenɔɣi katã.
ENGLISH: 31 And Israel worshiped Jehovah throughout Joshuaʽ’s time and throughout the time of the elders who survived after Joshuaʽ who had known all Jehovah’s work which he had done for Israel.

EWE: 32 Eye Israel-viwo ɖi Yosef ƒe ƒu siwo wotsɔ tso Egipte vɛ la ɖe Sekem le anyigba si Yakob ƒle gaku alafa ɖeka le Sekem fofo Hamor ƒe viwo si la dzi; eye anyigba la zu Yosef viwo ƒe domenyinu.
ENGLISH: 32 And Joseph’s bones, which the sons of Israel had brought up out of Egypt, they buried at Shekem in the lot of land that Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shekem for a hundred kesitahs and that had become Joseph’s estate.

EWE: 33 Eleazar, Aron vi la hã ku. Eye woɖii ɖe via Finehas Ƒe Togbɛ si wotsɔ nɛ le Efrayim tonuto me la dzi.
ENGLISH: 33 And Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him on his son Pinehas’s hill which had been given to him in the highland of Ephraim.

EWE: Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo
ENGLISH: Judges

EWE: 1 Le Yosua ƒe ku megbe la, Israel-viwo bia gbe Yehowa be: “Mía dometɔ kae aho aɖawɔ aʋa kple Kanaantɔwo?”
ENGLISH: 1 And after Joshuaʽ’s death the sons of Israel put the question to Jehovah “Whom shall we have go up against the Canaanites to begin with, and attack them?”

EWE: 2 Yehowa ɖo eŋu be: “Yuda neho yi. Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ anyigba la le asi dem nɛ.”
ENGLISH: 2 And Jehovah said “Judah shall go up: I have given the land into his hands.”

EWE: 3 Eye Yuda gblɔ na nɔvia Simeon be: “Va kplɔm yi anyigba si wotsɔ nam la dzi míaɖawɔ aʋa kple Kanaantɔwo. Emegbe nye hã makplɔ wò ayi anyigba si wotsɔ na wò la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 3 And Judah said to his brother Simeon “Come up with me into my allotment to attack the Canaanites, and so will I go with you into your allotment”; and Simeon went with him.

EWE: Ale Simeon yi kplii. 4 Esi Yuda ho yi la, Yehowa tsɔ Kanaantɔwo kple Perizitɔwo de asi na wo, eye wowu ame akpe ewo le Bezek.
ENGLISH: 4 So Judah went up, and Jehovah gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into his hands, and they defeated them at Bezek, killing ten thousand men.

EWE: 5 Wokpɔ Adoni-Bezek le Bezek, wowɔ aʋa kplii le afi ma, eye woɖu Kanaantɔwo kple Perizitɔwo dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 And they found Adoni-Bezek at Bezek and attacked him, and defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites;

EWE: 6 Esi Adoni-Bezek si yina la, woti eyome ɖalée, eye wolã eƒe asidegblefetsuwo kple afɔdegblefetsuwo.
ENGLISH: 6 and Adoni-Bezek fled, and they ran him down and laid hold of him and cut off his thumbs and great toes,

EWE: 7 Eye Adoni-Bezek gblɔ be: “Fia blaadre siwo wolã asidegblefetsuwo kple afɔdegblefetsuwo na la fɔa nuɖuɖu le nye kplɔ̃ te. Ale si tututu mewɔ la, eya teƒe Mawu ɖo nam.”
ENGLISH: 7 and Adoni-Bezek said “Seventy kings have picked up their food under my table with their thumbs and great toes cut off; God has paid me back just what I had done.”

EWE: Emegbe wokplɔe yi Yerusalem, eye wòku ɖe afi ma.
ENGLISH: And they brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.

EWE: 8 Azɔ Yuda ŋutsuwo wɔ aʋa kple Yerusalem eye woxɔe; wosii kple yi eye wotɔ dzo dua.
ENGLISH: 8 And the sons of Judah attacked Jerusalem and took it, and massacred the people and put the torch to the city.

EWE: 9 Emegbe Yuda ŋutsuwo ho yi ɖawɔ aʋa kple Kanaantɔ siwo le tonuto la me kple esiwo le Negeb kpakple esiwo le Sefela.
ENGLISH: 9 And afterward the sons of Judah went down to attack the Canaanites who lived in the highlands and in the South and in the lowlands;

EWE: 10 Ale Yuda ho ɖe Kanaantɔ siwo nɔ Hebron la ŋu (tsã la, woyɔa Hebron be Kiriat-Arba), eye woɖu Sesai, Ahiman kple Talmai dzi.
ENGLISH: 10 and Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron (the name of Hebron formerly being Kirjath-Arbogh) and killed Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.

EWE: 11 Eye woho tso afi ma ɖe Debirtɔwo ŋu. (Tsã la, woyɔa Debir be Kiriat-Sefer.)
ENGLISH: 11 And from there he went against the inhabitants of Debir (the name of Debir formerly being Kirjath-Sepher);

EWE: 12 Eye Kaleb gblɔ be: “Ame si asi Kiriat-Sefer eye wòaxɔe la, matsɔ vinyenyɔnu Aksa nɛ wòaɖe.”
ENGLISH: 12 and Caleb said “To the one who conquers and takes Kirjath-Sepher I will give my daughter ʽAcsah as wife”;

EWE: 13 Eye Otniel, Kaleb ƒe tsɛ Kenaz ƒe vi xɔe. Ale wòtsɔ vianyɔnu Aksa nɛ wòɖe.
ENGLISH: 13 and Ghothniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, and Caleb gave him his daughter ʽAcsah as wife.

EWE: 14 Eye esi nyɔnua kple srɔ̃a yina aƒe me la, nyɔnua ƒoe ɖe srɔ̃a nu be yeabia agble ye fofo. Eye nyɔnu la ɖi le eƒe tedzi dzi. Eye Kaleb biae be: “Nu ka dim nèle?”
ENGLISH: 14 And when she came she instigated him to ask her father for land: and she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her “What is the matter?”

EWE: 15 Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Meɖe kuku yram, elabena èna anyigbam le anyiehe; tsɔ Gulot-Mayim hã nam.”
ENGLISH: 15 and she said to him “Give me a blessing, because you have put me in the South: give me bowls of water.”

EWE: Ale Kaleb tsɔ Dzigbe Gulot kple Anyigbe Gulot nɛ.
ENGLISH: And Caleb gave her Upper Gulloth and Nether Gulloth.

EWE: 16 Eye Mose to, Kenitɔ la, ƒe dzidzimeviwo ʋu tso devedu la me kpe ɖe Yudatɔwo ŋu yi Yuda gbedzi, le Arad ƒe anyiehe.
ENGLISH: 16 And Hobab the Cainite, Moses’s father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms with the sons of Judah to the wilderness of Judah, in the South about ʽArad, and went and lived with the ʽAmalekites.

EWE: Eye woyi afi ma ɖanɔ dukɔ la dome. 17 Ke Yuda kple nɔvia Simeon yi ɖadze Kanaantɔ siwo le Zefat la dzi hetsrɔ̃ dua gbidigbidi. Eya ta wona ŋkɔ du la be Horma.
ENGLISH: 17 And Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they defeated the Canaanites who lived in Sephath; and they destroyed it without quarter, and named the city Hormah.

EWE: 18 Emegbe Yuda xɔ Gaza kple eƒe anyigba, Askelon kple eƒe anyigba, kpakple Ekron kple eƒe anyigba.
ENGLISH: 18 And Judah took Ghaza and its territory, and Ashkelon and its territory, and ʽEkron and its territory;

EWE: 19 Eye Yehowa nɔ kple Yuda, ale be wòxɔ tonuto la, gake mete ŋu nya ame siwo le gbadzaƒe la ɖa o, elabena aʋatasiaɖam siwo ƒe afɔtiwo ŋu lãnuwo le la le wo si.
ENGLISH: 19 and Jehovah was with Judah, and they took possession of the highland for they were not able to dispossess the inhabitants of the vale, because they had iron chariots.

EWE: 20 Wotsɔ Hebron na Kaleb, abe ale si tututu Mose do ŋugbee ene, eye wònya Anak viŋutsu etɔ̃awo ɖa le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 20 And they gave Caleb Hebron, as Moses had promised, and he dispossessed from there the three sons of the ʽAnak.

EWE: 21 Ke Benyamin viwo menya Yebusitɔ siwo nɔ Yerusalem la ɖa o, ale wɔ Yebusitɔwo le Benyamin viwo dome le Yerusalem va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: 21 And the sons of Benjamin did not dispossess the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem, and the Jebusites lived with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

EWE: 22 Yosef ƒe aƒe la ho ɖe Betel ŋu, eye Yehowa nɔ kpli wo.
ENGLISH: 22 And the house of Joseph too went up to Bethel, and Jehovah was with them.

EWE: 23 Yosef ƒe aƒe la nɔ ŋku tsam le Betel (tsã la, woyɔa du la be Luz),
ENGLISH: 23 And the house of Joseph made a reconnaissance at Bethel (the name of the city formerly was Luz);

EWE: 24 eye ŋkutsalaawo kpɔ ŋutsu aɖe do tso dua me. Eye wogblɔ nɛ be: “Míeɖe kuku, fia mɔ si míato age ɖe dua me la mí, ekema míave nuwò.”
ENGLISH: 24 and the sentinels saw a man come out of the city, and said to him “Show us the way into the city and we will befriend you.”

EWE: 25 Eya ta ŋutsua fia mɔ si woato age ɖe dua me la wo; eye woyi ɖasi du la kple yi, ke woɖe asi le ŋutsua kple eƒe ƒomea me tɔwo katã ŋu.
ENGLISH: 25 And he showed them the way into the city; and they massacred the people of the city, but let the man and his clan go.

EWE: 26 Ŋutsua dzo yi Hititɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi eye wòtso du hena ŋkɔe be Luz, esiae nye du la ŋkɔ va se ɖe egbe.
ENGLISH: 26 And the man went to the country of the Hittites and built a city and named it Luz; that is its name to this day.

EWE: 27 Manase mexɔ Bet-Sean kple eŋu duwo, Taanak kple eŋu duwo, Dortɔwo kple woƒe duwo, Yibleamtɔwo kple woƒe duwo, kpakple Megidotɔwo kple woƒe duwo o. Kanaantɔwo do dzi nɔ anyigba sia dzi kpiŋ.
ENGLISH: 27 And Manasseh did not dispossess Beth-Shean and its dependencies, and Taʽanac and its dependencies, and the inhabitants of Dor and its dependencies, and the inhabitants of Jibleʽam and its dependencies, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependencies, but the Canaanites persisted in living in this country.

EWE: 28 Esi ŋusẽ va ɖo Israel ŋu la, wona Kanaantɔwo wɔ dzizizidɔ na wo, negbe ɖeko womenya wo ɖa keŋkeŋ o.
ENGLISH: 28 And when Israel grew strong they subjected them to forced labor; they did not dispossess them.

EWE: 29 Efrayim hã menya Kanaantɔ siwo le Gezer la ɖa o. Kanaantɔwo tsi wo dome le Gezer.
ENGLISH: 29 And Ephraim did not dispossess the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived among them in Gezer.

EWE: 30 Zebulon menya Kitrontɔwo kple Nahaloltɔwo ɖa o. Kanaantɔwo tsi wo dome, gake Zebulon na wowɔ dzizizidɔ na wo.
ENGLISH: 30 Zebulun did not dispossess the inhabitants of Kitron and the inhabitants of Nahalol, but the Canaanites lived among them and became subject to forced labor.

EWE: 31 Aser menya ame siwo le Ako, Sidon, Ahlab, Akzib, Helba, Afik kple Rehob la ɖa o.
ENGLISH: 31 Asher did not dispossess the inhabitants of ʽAcco and the inhabitants of Sidon, and Ahlab and Aczib and Helbah and Aphik and Rehob;

EWE: 32 Ale wɔ Aser viwo nɔ Kanaantɔ siwo nɔ anyigbaa dzi la dome, elabena Aser menya wo ɖa o.
ENGLISH: 32 and the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the country, but had not dispossessed them.

EWE: 33 Naftali menya ame siwo le Bet-Semes kple Bet-Anat ɖa o, ke boŋ wonɔ Kanaantɔ siwo nɔ anyigbaa dzi la dome. Bet-Semestɔwo kple Bet-Anattɔwo zu dzizizidɔwɔlawo na wo.
ENGLISH: 33 Naphtali did not dispossess the inhabitants of Beth-Shemesh and the inhabitants of Beth-ʽAnath, but lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the country, and the inhabitants of Beth-Shemesh and Beth-ʽAnath became subject to forced labor under them.

EWE: 34 Amoritɔwo na Dan viwo tsi tonuto la me, eye womeɖe mɔ na wo be woava gbadzaƒe la o.
ENGLISH: 34 And the Amorites crowded the sons of Dan into the highland; for they did not let them get down to the vale,

EWE: 35 Eya ta Amoritɔwo ɖoe kplikpaa nɔ Heres To la dzi kple Aiyalon kpakple Saalbim.
ENGLISH: 35 and the Amorites persisted in living in Har-Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaʽalbim.

EWE: Gake esi ŋusẽ ɖo Yosef ƒe aƒe la ŋu la, wozi wo dzi wowɔ dɔ sesẽ na wo.
ENGLISH: But the hand of the house of Joseph grew heavy, and they became subject to forced labor.

EWE: 36 Amoritɔwo ƒe anyigba tso Akrabim-todzimɔ la gbɔ kple Sela hemlo ɖo ta dzi.
ENGLISH: 36 And the territory of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass, from Selaʽ upward.

EWE: Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo
ENGLISH: Judges

EWE: 2 Eye Yehowa ƒe dɔla tso Gilgal yi Bokim eye wògblɔ be: “Mekplɔ mi tso Egipte va anyigba si ŋu meka atam ɖo na mia tɔgbuiwo la dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 And the Angel of Jehovah went up from the Gilgal to Bokim, and said “. . .

EWE: Eye megblɔ hã be: ‘Nyematu nu, si mebla kpli mi la gbeɖe o. 2 Migabla nu kple anyigba sia dzi nɔlawo o, eye migbã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo ƒu anyi.’
ENGLISH: I led you up from Egypt, and brought you into the country that I had sworn to your fathers I would, and said ‘I will not break my covenant with you forever; 2 and you shall make no treaties with the inhabitants of this country; you shall pull down their altars’

EWE: Ke mieɖo to nye gbe o. Nu ka ŋuti miewɔ alea ɖo?
ENGLISH: and you did not obey me; what is this you have done?

EWE: 3 Eya ta nye hã megblɔ be: ‘Nyemanya wo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ o, woazu mɔ̃ na mi, eye woatsɔ woƒe mawuwo akplɔ mi atrae.’”
ENGLISH: 3 So I have said I would not drive them out before you, but you shall have them as foes and their gods as a snare.”

EWE: 4 Esi Yehowa ƒe dɔla la gblɔ nya siawo na Israel-viwo katã la, dukɔ la fa avi hoo.
ENGLISH: 4 And when the Angel of Jehovah said these things to all the sons of Israel, the people raised their voices and wept;

EWE: 5 Eya ta wona ŋkɔ teƒe la be Bokim, eye wosa vɔ le afi ma na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 5 and they named the place Bokim, “Weepers,” and sacrificed there to Jehovah.

EWE: 6 Esi Yosua na dukɔa dzo la, Israel-viwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe yi anyigba si dome wònyi la dzi ne wòaxɔe.
ENGLISH: 6 And Joshuaʽ dismissed the people, and the sons of Israel went home to their farms to take possession of the country.

EWE: 7 Eye dukɔ la yi edzi subɔ Yehowa le Yosua ƒe agbemeŋkekewo katã kple ame tsitsi siwo ganɔ agbe le Yosua ƒe ku megbe, siwo kpɔ dɔ gã siwo katã Yehowa wɔ na Israel teƒe la, ƒe agbenɔɣi katã.
