ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 6 Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la nɔ Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi ɣleti adre.
ENGLISH: 6 And the ark of Jehovah was in the Philistines’ countryside seven months.

EWE: 2 Eye Filistitɔwo yɔ nunɔlawo kple afakalawo bia wo be: “Aleke míawɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka lae? Mina míanya ale si míawɔ agbugbɔe aɖo ɖe enɔƒe.”
ENGLISH: 2 And the Philistines called the priests and the diviners with the question “What shall we do with the ark of Jehovah? inform us with what observance we shall send it away to its own place.”

EWE: 3 Woɖo eŋu be: “Ne miele Israel ƒe Mawu, Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖakaa ɖom ɖa la, migaɖoe ɖa nunana manɔmee o. Mitsɔ fɔɖivɔsa kpe ɖe eŋu. Ema ko hafi miahaya, eye mianya nu si tae eƒe asi gbe dzodzo le mia dzi ɖo.”
ENGLISH: 3 And they said “If you are sending away the ark of the god of Israel, do not send it away portionless but return it an indemnity: then you shall be restored to health, and it shall become manifest to you why his hand is not taken off from you.”

EWE: 4 Eya ta wobia be: “Fɔɖivɔsa kae míaɖo ɖee?”
ENGLISH: 4 And they said “What is to be the indemnity that we return to it?”

EWE: Woɖo eŋu be: “Sikakookoo atɔ̃ kple sikafi atɔ̃, le Filistitɔwo ƒe kplɔlawo ƒe xexlẽme nu, elabena dɔvɔ̃ ɖeka ma kee va dze mi kple miaƒe kplɔlawo katã dzi.
ENGLISH: And they said “The same number as the Sarns of the Philistines, five golden buboes, because you and your Sarns suffered one and the same calamity.

EWE: 5 Miwɔ miaƒe kookoawo ƒe nɔnɔme kple afi siwo le anyigba la gblẽm la ƒe nɔnɔme, eye miade bubu Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 5 And you shall make golden mice, a likeness of your mice that are ravaging the country, and give glory to the god of Israel: perhaps he may lift off his hand from you and your gods and your country.

EWE: Ðewohĩ ana eƒe asi si va mia kple miaƒe mawu la kpakple miaƒe anyigba dzi la dzi naka aɖe. 6 Nu ka tae miasẽ dzi me abe ale si Egiptetɔwo kple Farao sẽ dzi me ene?
ENGLISH: 6 And why should you act haughtily as the Pharaoh and the Egyptians did? after he had done his will upon them they let them go in the end, did they not?

EWE: Esi wòtu nu kpli wo vevie la, woɖe asi le Israel ŋu wòdzo. 7 Eya ta miwɔ tasiaɖam yeye, eye milé nyinɔ eve siwo ŋu vi le, siwo womede kɔkuti kɔ na kpɔ o. Mitsi nyinɔawo ɖe tasiaɖam la ŋu, eye miɖe nyiviawo le wo ŋu de kpo.
ENGLISH: 7 Now get and fit out a new cart and two cows with sucking calves, cows that have never had a yoke put on them, and hitch the cows to the cart and take the calves back home away from the mothers,

EWE: 8 Mikɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la da ɖe tasiaɖam la dzi, eye mitsɔ sikanu siwo nye fɔɖivɔsa si ɖom miele ɖee la de aɖakavi me da ɖe exa, eye miaɖoe ɖa wòayi,
ENGLISH: 8 and take the ark of Jehovah and set it on the cart, and put in the box at its side the golden objects that you return to it as indemnity, and send it off and let it go,

EWE: 9 eye minɔ ekpɔm: ne Bet-Semes mɔe wòto ɖo ta eƒe anyigba dzi la, ekema eyae wɔ vɔ̃ gã sia mí.
ENGLISH: 9 and see: if it goes up toward Beth-Shemesh, toward its own territory, it was he that did us this great harm; but if not, we shall know that it was not his hand that touched us, it was a chance that happened to us.”

EWE: Ke ne mele alea o la, ekema míanyae be menye eyae ka asi mía ŋu o, ke boŋ nu dogoɖenunue.” 10 Eye ameawo wɔe alea.
ENGLISH: 10 And the men did so: they took two cows with sucking calves and hitched them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home,

EWE: 11 Eye wokɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la da ɖe tasiaɖam la dzi hekpe ɖe aɖakavi si me afiawo kple woƒe kookoawo ƒe nɔnɔmeawo le la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 11 and put the ark of Jehovah on the cart, and the box and the golden mice;

EWE: 12 Eye nyinɔawo zɔ tẽe to mɔ si ɖo ta Bet-Semes. Wolé mɔ gã ɖeka tsɔ, eye wole xɔxlɔ̃m le yiyim; eye womedze ɖe ɖusi alo mia me o.
ENGLISH: 12 and the cows took a straight course toward Beth-Shemesh, going along one highway, mooing as they went, and not turning off to right or to left; and the Sarns of the Philistines went behind them to the Beth-Shemesh boundary.

EWE: Eye Filistitɔwo ƒe kplɔlawo kplɔ wo ɖo va ɖo keke Bet-Semes ƒe liƒo dzi ke. 13 Bet-Semestɔwo nɔ lu ŋem le bali la me.
ENGLISH: 13 And the men of Beth-Shemesh, who were reaping the wheat harvest in the vale, raised their eyes and saw the ark and came joyfully to meet it;

EWE: Esi wofɔ mo dzi hekpɔ Aɖakaa la, dzi dzɔ wo ale gbegbe. 14 Eye tasiaɖam la va ɖo Yosua, Bet-Semestɔ la, ƒe agble me, afi si kpe gã aɖe le, eye wòtɔ ɖe afi ma.
ENGLISH: 14 and the cart came into the field of Joshuaʽ the Beth-Shemite, and stood there, where there was a great stone; and they split the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt-offering to Jehovah.

EWE: Eya ta wofli tasiaɖam la tsɔ wɔ nakee, eye wotsɔ nyinɔawo sa numevɔ na Yehowa. 15 Eye Lewi viwo ɖiɖi Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la kple aɖakavi si kpe ɖe eŋu, si me sikanuawo le la ɖe anyi, eye wotsɔ wo da ɖe kpe gã la dzi. Bet-Semestɔwo sa numevɔ, eye wosa vɔ na Yehowa gbe ma gbe.
ENGLISH: 15 And the Levites took down the ark of Jehovah and the box that was with it, in which the golden objects were, and put them on the great stone, and the men of Beth-Shemesh offered burnt-offerings and sacrifices on that day to Jehovah;

EWE: 16 Esi Filistitɔwo ƒe kplɔla atɔ̃awo kpɔe la, wotrɔ yi Ekron gbe ma gbe.
ENGLISH: 16 and the five Sarns of the Philistines saw it, and went back to ʽEkron that same day.

EWE: 17 Ke sikakookoo siwo Filistitɔwo tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu vɛ be woatsɔ asa fɔɖivɔ na Yehowa lae nye esiawo: Asdod tɔ ɖeka, Gaza tɔ ɖeka, Askelon tɔ ɖeka, Gat tɔ ɖeka, Ekron tɔ ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 17 And these are the golden buboes which the Philistines returned as indemnity to Jehovah: for Ashdod one, for Ghaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for ʽEkron one;

EWE: 18 Eye afiawo le Filistitɔwo ƒe du siwo katã me kplɔla atɔ̃awo tso la ƒe xexlẽme nu, tso du siwo ŋu woɖo gli ɖo dzi va ɖo kɔƒe siwo le agbleta la dzi.
ENGLISH: 18 and golden mice to the number of all the cities of the Philistines, for the five Sarns, from fortified city to country hamlet.

EWE: Eye kpe gã si dzi wokɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la da ɖo la nye ɖaseɖikpe le Yosua, Bet-Semestɔ la, ƒe agble me va se ɖe egbe sia.
ENGLISH: And the great stone on which they put down the ark of Jehovah is still in the field of Joshuaʽ the Beth-Shemite to this day.

EWE: 19 Eye Yehowa wu Bet-Semestɔwo, elabena wokpɔ eƒe Aɖaka la. Ale wòwu ame akpe blaatɔ̃ kple blaadre le dukɔ la dome, eye dukɔ la fa konyi le esi Yehowa wu ame geɖe ta.
ENGLISH: 19 And the sons of Jeconiah were not blithe among the men of Beth-Shemesh when they looked upon the ark of Jehovah; and he smote among them seventy men; and the people mourned, because Jehovah had made great havoc among the people.

EWE: 20 Eya ta Bet-Semestɔwo bia be: “Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe Yehowa, Mawu kɔkɔe sia ŋkume, eye ame ka gbɔe wòadzo le mía gbɔ ayi?”
ENGLISH: 20 And the men of Beth-Shemesh said “Who can stand before this holy God Jehovah? to whom may he go up away from us?”

EWE: 21 Ale wodɔ ame ɖo ɖe Kiriat-Yearimtɔwo gbɔ, gblɔ be: “Filistitɔwo gbugbɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la vɛ. Miva kɔe yi mia gbɔ.”
ENGLISH: 21 and sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath-Jeʽarim to say “The Philistines have sent back the ark of Jehovah: come down and fetch it up to yourselves.”

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 7 Eya ta Kiriat-Yearimtɔwo va kɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la yi ɖada ɖe Abinadab ƒe me le togbɛ la dzi, eye wokɔ via Eleazar ŋu be wòakpɔ Yehowa ƒe Aɖaka la dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 And the men of Kirjath-Jeʽarim came and fetched up the ark of Jehovah and put it into the house of Abinadab on the hill, and consecrated his son Eleazar to have charge of the ark of Jehovah.

EWE: 2 Nubablaɖaka la nɔ Kiriat-Yearim ƒe geɖe, anɔ abe ƒe blaeve sɔŋ ene, eye Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la katã di Yehowa yome mɔ.
ENGLISH: 2 And from the day of the settlement of the ark in Kirjath-Jeʽarim, the time was long: it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel turned to follow Jehovah.

EWE: 3 Eye Samuel gblɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la be: “Ne mietrɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu kple dzi blibo la, ekema miɖe dutamawuwo kple Astoret legbawo ɖa le mia dome, eye mitrɔ miaƒe dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu bliboe, ne miasubɔ eya ɖeɖe ko, ekema aɖe mi tso Filistitɔwo si me.”
ENGLISH: 3 And Samuel said to all the house of Israel “If you are coming back to Jehovah with all your hearts, remove the foreign gods from among you, and the ʽAshtarts, and direct your hearts to Jehovah and worship him alone, that he may deliver you out of the hands of the Philistines”;

EWE: 4 Ale Israel-viwo ɖe Baal kple Astoret legbawo ɖa, eye wosubɔ Yehowa ɖeɖe ko.
ENGLISH: 4 and the sons of Israel removed the Baals and the ʽAshtarts, and worshiped Jehovah alone.

EWE: 5 Eye Samuel gblɔ be: “Miƒo Israel blibo la katã nu ƒu ɖe Mizpa, ne mado gbe ɖa na Yehowa ɖe mia ta.”
ENGLISH: 5 And Samuel said “Gather all Israel at Mispah, and let me pray to Jehovah for you”;

EWE: 6 Ale wova ƒo ƒu ɖe Mizpa, eye wodu tsi kɔ ɖe anyigba le Yehowa ŋkume hetsi nu dɔ gbe ma gbe. Eye wogblɔ le afi ma be: “Míewɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu.”
ENGLISH: 6 and they gathered at Mispah, and drew water and poured it out before Jehovah, and fasted on that day; and they said there “We have sinned against Jehovah.”

EWE: Mizpa ye Samuel dze ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ na Israel-viwo gɔme le.
ENGLISH: And Samuel passed judgment on the sons of Israel at Mispah.

EWE: 7 Esi Filistitɔwo se be Israel-viwo va ƒo ƒu ɖe Mizpa la, Filistitɔwo ƒe kplɔlawo ho ɖe Israel ŋu. Esi Israel-viwo see la, vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo le Filistitɔwo ta.
ENGLISH: 7 And the Philistines heard that the sons of Israel had gathered themselves at Mispah, and the Sarns of the Philistines came up against Israel; and the sons of Israel heard of it, and were afraid of the Philistines.

EWE: 8 Eye Israel-viwo gblɔ na Samuel be: “Mègagbe Yehowa mía Mawu la yɔyɔ be wòaxɔ na mí o, ne wòaɖe mí tso Filistitɔwo si me.”
ENGLISH: 8 And the sons of Israel said to Samuel “Do not shut your mouth against us and refuse to cry to our God Jehovah to deliver us out of the hands of the Philistines.”

EWE: 9 Eye Samuel lé alẽvi si gale no nom hetsɔe sa numevɔ na Yehowa; eye Samuel yɔ Yehowa be wòaxɔ na Israel, eye Yehowa tɔ nɛ.
ENGLISH: 9 And Samuel took a sucking lamb and offered it as an entire burnt-offering to Jehovah; and Samuel cried to Jehovah for Israel, and Jehovah answered him.

EWE: 10 Esi Samuel le numevɔa sam la, Filistitɔwo ho va aʋa wɔ ge kple Israel. Eye Yehowa na dzi ɖe gbe sesĩe ɖe Filistitɔwo dzi gbe ma gbe, eye wòde tɔtɔ wo dome, ale Israel ɖu wo dzi.
ENGLISH: 10 And as Samuel was offering the burnt-offering the Philistines came on to fight a battle with the Israelites; and Jehovah thundered loudly over the Philistines on that day, and threw them into confusion, and they were beaten by the Israelites.

EWE: 11 Eye Israel ŋutsuwo ho tso Mizpa heti Filistitɔwo yome, eye wonɔ nu dam wo ƒu anyi va se ɖe keke Bet-Kar ƒe anyiehe ke.
ENGLISH: 11 And the men of Israel came out from Mispah and pursued the Philistines and cut them down till below Beth-Car.

EWE: 12 Eye Samuel ɖi kpe aɖe ɖe Mizpa kple Yesana dome, eye wòna ŋkɔe be Ebenezer, eye wògblɔ be: “Yehowa kpe ɖe mía ŋu va ɖo fifia.”
ENGLISH: 12 And Samuel took a stone and set it between Mispah and Jeshanah, and named it the Help Stone, and said “Thus far Jehovah helped us.”

EWE: 13 Ale wobɔbɔ Filistitɔwo ɖe anyi, eye womegava Israel-nyigba dzi kpɔ o; eye Yehowa ƒe asi sẽ ɖe Filistitɔwo dzi le Samuel ƒe ŋkekeawo katã me.
ENGLISH: 13 And the Philistines were humbled, and no longer entered the territory of Israel; and Jehovah’s hand was against the Philistines throughout Samuel’s life.

EWE: 14 Eye Israel gbugbɔ xɔ du siwo Filistitɔwo xɔ le wo si tso Ekron va ɖo Gat, ale Israel gbugbɔ woƒe anyigbawo xɔ le Filistitɔwo si. Eye ŋutifafa ɖo Israel kple Amoritɔwo dome.
ENGLISH: 14 And the cities that the Philistines had taken from Israel came back to Israel, from ʽEkron to Gath, and Israel recovered the territory of these cities out of the hands of the Philistines.

EWE: 15 Samuel drɔ̃ ʋɔnu na Israel le eƒe agbemeŋkekewo katã me.
ENGLISH: 15 And Samuel judged Israel all his life;

EWE: 16 Ezɔa mɔ yia Betel, Gilgal kple Mizpa ƒe sia ƒe, eye wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu na Israel le teƒe siawo katã.
ENGLISH: 16 and he went year by year in circuit to Bethel and the Gilgal and Mispah, and judged Israel at all these sanctuaries.

EWE: 17 Emegbe egatrɔna vaa Rama, elabena afi mae eƒe aƒe le, eye wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu na Israel le afi ma hã. Eye wòɖi vɔsamlekpui ɖe afi ma na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 17 But his headquarters was at Ramah, because his home was there; and there he judged Israel, and built an altar there to Jehovah.

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 8 Esi Samuel tsi la, etsɔ viaŋutsuwo ɖo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawoe ɖe Israel nu.
ENGLISH: 8 And when Samuel grew old he installed his sons as judges of Israel:

EWE: 2 Viaŋutsu ŋgɔgbea ŋkɔe nye Yoel, eye via evelia ŋkɔe nye Abiya; wodrɔ̃a ʋɔnu le Beer-Seba.
ENGLISH: 2 the name of his older son was Joel, and of his second son Abijah, judges at Beer-Shebaʽ.

EWE: 3 Gake viaŋutsuwo meto eƒe ʋe me o, ke boŋ wodi viɖe ƒoɖi, eye woxɔ zãnu hetrɔ gbo nya dzɔdzɔe.
ENGLISH: 3 And his sons did not follow his paths, but turned aside after profit, and took bribes, and warped the law.

EWE: 4 Gbe ɖeka Israel ƒe ametsitsiwo katã kpe ta, eye wova Samuel gbɔ le Rama.
ENGLISH: 4 And all the elders of Israel assembled and came to Samuel at Ramah

EWE: 5 Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa! Wò la, ètsi, ke viwòŋutsuwo meto wò ʋe me o.
ENGLISH: 5 and said to him “Here you have grown old, and your sons have not been following your paths: now appoint us a king to judge us, like all the nations.”

EWE: Eya ta ɖo fia na mí, ne wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na mí, abe ale si wòle le dukɔwo katã dome ene.” 6 Ke nya si wogblɔ be, “Ðo fia na mí ne wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na mí” la medze Samuel ŋu o. Eya ta Samuel do gbe ɖa na Yehowa,
ENGLISH: 6 And the thing displeased Samuel when they said “Give us a king to judge us,” and Samuel prayed to Jehovah.

EWE: 7 eye Yehowa gblɔ na Samuel be: “Ðo to dukɔ la ƒe gbe le nya siwo katã gblɔm wole na wò la me; elabena menye wòe wogbe o, ke boŋ nyee wogbe be maganye fia na yewo o.
ENGLISH: 7 And Jehovah said to Samuel “Obey the people in everything that they say to you; for it is not you but me that they have rejected as king over them.

EWE: 8 Ale si wowɔ tso gbe si gbe mekplɔ wo dzoe le Egipte va se ɖe egbe sia la, nenema ko wɔm wole; ale si wogblẽam ɖi hesubɔa mawu bubuwo la, nu mawo ke ko wɔm wole ɖe wò hã ŋuwò.
ENGLISH: 8 As in all the things that they have done to me from the day that I brought them up out of Egypt to this day, leaving me and worshiping other gods, so they are doing to you too.

EWE: 9 Eya ta ɖo to woƒe gbe. Gake xlɔ̃ nu wo vevie; eye nàgblɔ nu si fia si aɖu wo dzi la abia tso wo si la na wo.”
ENGLISH: 9 Now obey them; only you shall make a protest to them and tell them about the government of the king who will reign over them.”

EWE: 10 Eya ta Samuel gblɔ Yehowa ƒe nyawo katã na dukɔ si le fia biamee la.
ENGLISH: 10 And Samuel told all Jehovah’s words to the people who were asking him for a king:

EWE: 11 Eye wògblɔ be: “Esiae anye nu si fia si aɖu mia dzi la abia tso mia si: Axɔ mia viŋutsuwo atsɔ wo aɖo eƒe tasiaɖamwo me, woanye eƒe sɔdolawo, eye wo dometɔ aɖewo aƒu du le eƒe tasiaɖamwo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 11 he said “This is what the government of the king who will reign over you will be. He will take your sons and put them to his carriages and his horse guards, and they shall run before his carriages;

EWE: 12 Atsɔ wo dometɔ aɖewo aɖo ame akpewo nu, eye ɖewo hã ɖe ame blaatɔ̃wo nu, aɖo ame aɖewo be woaŋlɔ agble nɛ ahaŋe nu nɛ, eye woatu aʋawɔnuwo nɛ ahawɔ tasiaɖamŋunuwo nɛ.
ENGLISH: 12 and to be appointed as his captains over a thousand or over fifty, and to do his plowing and harvesting, and to make his weapons and the fittings for his carriages.

EWE: 13 Axɔ mia vinyɔnuwo woazu ami ʋeʋĩ wɔlawo kple nuɖalawo kpakple abolomelawo nɛ.
ENGLISH: 13 And he will take your daughters for perfumers and cooks and bakers.

EWE: 14 Axɔ miaƒe agble kple miaƒe waingble kpakple miaƒe amitibɔ nyuitɔwo atsɔ ana eƒe subɔviwo.
ENGLISH: 14 And he will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive-orchards and give them to his officers.

EWE: 15 Axɔ miaƒe agblemenukuwo kple miaƒe waintsetsewo ƒe ewolia atsɔ ana eŋumewo kple eƒe subɔviwo.
ENGLISH: 15 And he will take a tenth of your grain and fruit and give it to his eunuchs and officers.

EWE: 16 Axɔ miaƒe dɔlaŋutsuwo, miaƒe dɔlanyɔnuwo, miaƒe nyihawo dome lã nyuitɔwo kple miaƒe tedziwo, ne woawɔ dɔ nɛ.
ENGLISH: 16 And he will take the best of your slaves and oxen and your donkeys to do his work with.

EWE: 17 Axɔ miaƒe alẽhawo ƒe ewolia, eye miawo ŋutɔwo miazu subɔviwo nɛ.
ENGLISH: 17 And he will take a tenth of your sheep and you will be his slaves,

EWE: 18 Ɣemaɣi la, miado ɣli le miaƒe fia, si mietia na mia ɖokui la ta, ke Yehowa matɔ na mi o.”
ENGLISH: 18 and will cry out in that day because of your king whom you chose to have, and Jehovah will not hear you in that day.”

EWE: 19 Gake dukɔ la gbe toɖoɖo Samuel ƒe gbe hegblɔ be: “Gbeɖe, ke boŋ fia nenɔ mía nu.
ENGLISH: 19 But the people refused to obey Samuel, and said “No, we will have a king over us

EWE: 20 Eye míawo hã míanɔ abe dukɔ bubuawo katã ene, eye míaƒe fia nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na mí ahadze mía ŋgɔ awɔ aʋa na mí.”
ENGLISH: 20 and be the same as all the nations are, and have our king judge us and go out before us and fight our battles.”

EWE: 21 Eye Samuel se dukɔ la ƒe nyawo katã, eye wòyi ɖagblɔ wo na Yehowa ake.
ENGLISH: 21 And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and repeated them for Jehovah to hear;

EWE: 22 Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Samuel be: “Ðo to woƒe gbe, eye nàɖo fia na wo.”
ENGLISH: 22 and Jehovah said to Samuel “Obey them and set up a king over them.”

EWE: Eya ta Samuel gblɔ na Israel ŋutsuawo be: “Mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe negbugbɔ yi eƒe du me.”
ENGLISH: And Samuel said to the men of Israel “Go home to your cities.”

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 9 Ŋutsu aɖe tso Benyamin, eŋkɔe nye Kis, eye wònye Abiel vi, Zeror vi, Bekorat vi, Afiya vi, ame sia nye Benyamintɔ kesinɔtɔ gã aɖe.
ENGLISH: 9 And there was a man in Benjamin, named Kish, son of Abiel the son of Seror the son of Becorath the son of Aphiah the son of a Benjamite, a stalwart man;

EWE: 2 Viŋutsu aɖe le esi si ŋkɔe nye Saul, enye ɖekakpui si dze ɖeka ŋutɔ, eye ame aɖeke medze ɖeka de enu le Israel-viwo dome o; ekɔ ale gbegbe be ameawo katã se abɔta nɛ.
ENGLISH: 2 and he had a son named Saul, a young man and a fine one; not a man of the sons of Israel was finer than he; he was head and shoulders taller than any of the people.

EWE: 3 Esi Saul fofo Kis ƒe tedziwo bu la, Kis gblɔ na via Saul be: “Meɖe kuku, kplɔ subɔviawo dometɔ ɖeka ɖe asi, eye tso nàyi aɖadi tedziawo.”
ENGLISH: 3 And Saul’s father Kish lost his donkeys; and Kish said to his son Saul “Take one of the men with you and go look for the donkeys.”

EWE: 4 Woyi ɖatsa le Efrayim tonuto la me heto Salisa-nuto me, ke womekpɔ wo o. Eye woyi ɖatsa le Saalim-nyigba dzi, ke tedziawo mele afi ma o. Eye woyi ɖatsa le Benyamin viwo ƒe anyigba la katã dzi, ke womeke ɖe wo ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 4 And they went through the highland of Ephraim and through the Shalishah country and did not find them, and through the Shaʽalim country and they were not there, and through the Benjamite country and did not find them;

EWE: 5 Wova ɖo Zuf-nyigba dzi, eye Saul gblɔ na eƒe subɔvi si le eŋu la be: “Na míatrɔ ayi aƒe me, ne fofonye nagaɖe susu ɖa le tedziawo ŋu ava tsi dzi ɖe míawo boŋ ŋu o.”
ENGLISH: 5 and when they came to the country of Suph, Saul said to his man who was with him “Come, let us go back, for fear father should leave off about the donkeys and grow anxious about us.”

EWE: 6 Ke egblɔ nɛ be: “Meɖe kuku, kpɔ ɖa! Mawu ƒe ame aɖe le du sia me, eye wodea bubu eŋu.
ENGLISH: 6 And he said to him “Here, in this city there is a man of God, and the man is highly thought of; everything that he says is sure to come true.

EWE: Nya siwo katã wògblɔna la vaa eme godoo. Eya ta na míayi afi ma.
ENGLISH: Now let us go there; perhaps he will tell us about our errand that we went on.”

EWE: Ðewohĩ agblɔ mɔ si míato la na mí.” 7 Ke Saul gblɔ na eƒe subɔvi la be: “Ne míeyi ɖe, nu kae míatsɔ ayi na ame la? Elabena abolo vɔ le akplo me na mí; eye naneke mele mía si míatsɔ ayi aɖana Mawu vavã la ƒe ame la o.
ENGLISH: 7 And Saul said to his servant “Well, suppose we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is gone out of our haversacks, and there is no fee to bring to the man of God; what have we with us?”

EWE: Nu kae le mía si?” 8 Eya ta subɔvi la ɖo eŋu na Saul be: “Kpɔ ɖa! Klosalo sekel afã ƒe afã le asinye.
ENGLISH: 8 And the servant still had an answer for Saul, and said “Here, I have about me a quarter of a shekel of silver that I will give to the man of God and have him tell us about our errand.”

EWE: Matsɔe ana Mawu vavã la ƒe ame la, ekema agblɔ mɔ si míato la na mí.” 9 (Tsã le Israel la, ne ame yina nu bia ge Mawu la, egblɔna be: “Mina míayi nukpɔla gbɔ.”
ENGLISH: 9 (Formerly in Israel a man said, when he went to inquire of God, “Come, let us go to the seer”; for the prophet of today used to be called seer.)

EWE: Elabena ame si woyɔna fifia be nyagblɔɖila la, eyae woyɔna tsã be nukpɔla.) 10 Eye Saul gblɔ na eƒe subɔvi la be: “Wò nya la nyo. Na míayi.”
ENGLISH: 10 And Saul said to his man “All right; come, let us go”; and they went to the city where the man of God was.

EWE: Eya ta wodze mɔ yi du si me Mawu vavã la ƒe amea le la me. 11 Esi wolia toa yina dua me la, wokpɔ nyɔnuviwo wodo go yina tsi du ge.
ENGLISH: 11 As they were going up the slope to the city they found girls coming out to draw water, and said to them “Is the seer here?”

EWE: Eye wobia wo be: “Nukpɔlaa le afi sia?” 12 Woɖo eŋu be: “Ɛ̃, eli. Kpɔ ɖa! Ele mia ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 12 and they answered “Yes, he is right ahead of you; he has just come to the city today, because today the people have a sacrifice at the height;

EWE: Afɔ netsɔ na mi, eva dua me egbea, elabena dukɔ la le vɔ sa ge egbea le togbɛ la dzi. 13 Ne mienya ɖo dua me teti ko la, miake ɖe eŋu hafi wòayi togbɛ la dzi be wòaɖaɖu nu.
ENGLISH: 13 just as you go into the city you will find him, before he goes up to the height to eat for the people will not eat till he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice and afterward the guests eat.

EWE: Ema megbe ko hafi ame siwo wokpe la aɖu nu.
ENGLISH: Go right up, for today you will find him.”

EWE: Eya ta miyi, elabena miake ɖe eŋu fifi laa.” 14 Ale woyi du la me. Esi wonya ge ɖe dua me ko la, wodo go Samuel wòyina ɖe togbɛ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 14 And they went up to the city; and as they were coming into the city, there was Samuel coming toward them on his way out to go up to the height.

EWE: 15 Ke le ŋkeke si do ŋgɔ na Saul ƒe vava dzi la, Yehowa gblɔ na Samuel be:
ENGLISH: 15 And Jehovah had given Samuel notice one day before Saul came,

EWE: 16 “Etsɔ ɣealewoɣi la, madɔ ŋutsu aɖe ɖe wò tso Benyamin-nyigba dzi. Si ami nɛ wòazu kplɔla ɖe nye dukɔ Israel nu, aɖe nye dukɔ tso Filistitɔwo si me. Elabena mekpɔ nye dukɔ ƒe fukpekpe la ɖa, eye woƒe ɣli va ɖo gbɔnye.”
ENGLISH: 16 “At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the Benjamites’ country, and you shall anoint him warden over my people Israel, to save my people out of the hands of the Philistines; for I have seen the wretched state of my people; for their outcry has reached me.”

EWE: 17 Esi Samuel kpɔ Saul la, Yehowa gblɔ nɛ be: “Ŋutsu sia ŋu nyae megblɔ na wò be: ‘Ame siae aɖu nye dukɔ la dzi.’”
ENGLISH: 17 And as Samuel saw Saul, Jehovah answered him “Here is the man of whom I said to you ‘He shall sway my people.’”

EWE: 18 Eye Saul te ɖe Samuel ŋu le dugbo la nu hebiae be: “Meɖe kuku, afi kae nukpɔla la ƒe aƒe me le?” 19 Eye Samuel ɖo eŋu na Saul be: “Nyee nye nukpɔla la. Dze ŋgɔnye nàyi togbɛ la dzi, eye miaɖu nu kplim egbea.
ENGLISH: 18 And Saul approached Samuel in the middle of the gate and said “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.” 19 And Samuel answered Saul “I am the seer; go up to the height before me and eat with me today, and I will send you away in the morning and tell you everything that you have in mind.

EWE: Ne ŋu ke la, mado mɔ wò, eye magblɔ nu siwo katã nèdi be yeanya la na wò. 20 Ke tedzi siwo bú na wò ŋkeke etɔ̃e nye esia la, mègatsi dzi ɖe wo ŋu o, elabena woke ɖe wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 20 And as to the donkeys you lost three days ago today, do not mind them, for they are found and whose is everything choice in Israel? is it not yours, and for all your family?”

EWE: Ðe menye wò kple fofowò ƒe aƒe blibo la tɔe oa?” 21 Eye Saul ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ðe menye Benyamin vi menye, tso Israel-to suetɔ me, eye nye ƒomee nye suetɔ le Benyamin-to la ƒe ƒomewo katã dome oa? Ekema nya kae nye esi gblɔm nèle nam?”
ENGLISH: 21 And Saul answered “Am I not a Benjamite, from one of the smallest tribes in Israel, and my clan the least of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? why do you talk like that to me?”

EWE: 22 Eye Samuel kplɔ Saul kple eƒe subɔvi la yi nuɖuxɔa me, eye wòna nɔƒe wo ɖe kplɔ̃ ta le ame siwo wokpe la dome; woanɔ ame blaetɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 22 And Samuel took Saul and his man and brought them to the vestry and gave them a place at the head of the guests, of whom there were about thirty.

EWE: 23 Samuel gblɔ na nuɖala la be: “Tsɔ lã si metsɔ na wò hegblɔ be, ‘Nenɔ vovo’ la vɛ.”
ENGLISH: 23 And Samuel said to the cook “Bring the portion that I gave you, that I told you to put by.”

EWE: 24 Ale nuɖala la kɔ ata la va ɖo Saul kɔme. Eye Samuel gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, nu si wodzra ɖo ɖi lae nye esi wotsɔ ɖo akɔwòme. Ðui, elabena wòe wodzrae ɖo ɖi na. Elabena megblɔ na wo be, ‘mekpe amewo.’”
ENGLISH: 24 And the cook lifted the leg and carried it up and set it before Saul; and he said “Here what is left is set before you; eat, for it was kept to this occasion for you; carve before the people.”

EWE: Ale Saul ɖu nu kple Samuel gbe ma gbe.
ENGLISH: And Saul ate with Samuel that day,

EWE: 25 Emegbe woɖi tso togbɛ la dzi yi dua me, eye Samuel kple Saul ɖo dze le xɔta.
ENGLISH: 25 and they went down from the height to the city; and they made a bed for Saul on the roof, and he slept there.

EWE: 26 Wofɔ ŋdi kanya, eye esi agu nya dze ko la, Samuel yɔ Saul le xɔta gblɔ be: “Dzra ɖo ne mado mɔ wò.”
ENGLISH: 26 And at dawn Samuel called to the roof to Saul “Get up, and I will start you off”; and Saul got up, and the two of them, he and Samuel, went outdoors.

EWE: Eya ta Saul dzra ɖo eye wo ame evea, eya kple Samuel, wodo ɖe xexe. 27 Esi woɖo dua ƒe gbɔto la, Samuel gblɔ na Saul be: “Gblɔ na subɔvi la be wòado ŋgɔ na mí”​ eya ta edo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 27 And as they were in the skirts of the city going down, Samuel said to Saul “Tell the man to pass on before us and stop here yourself; now I will let you hear God’s word.”

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 10 Eye Samuel tsɔ amigoe la hekɔ ami ɖe tame na Saul. Egbugbɔ nu nɛ gblɔ be: “Ðe Yehowa mesi ami na wò be nànye kplɔla ɖe eƒe domenyinu dzi oa?
ENGLISH: 10 And Samuel took his flask of oil and poured it on his head, and kissed him, and said to him “It is because Jehovah has anointed you warden over his people Israel, and you shall sway Jehovah’s people, and you shall save them out of the hands of their enemies on all sides.

EWE: 2 Ne èdzo le gbɔnye egbea yina la, àkpɔ ŋutsu eve le Rahel ƒe yɔdo gbɔ le Benyamin-nuto la me le Zelza, eye woagblɔ na wò be: ‘Wokpɔ tedzi siwo di ge nèyi la, ke azɔ fofowò ɖe asi le tedziawo ƒe nya ŋu, eye wòtsi dzi ɖe ŋuwò le gbɔgblɔm be: “Nu kae mawɔ le vinye la ŋu?”’
ENGLISH: 2 And this is the sign you are to have that Jehovah has anointed you as warden of his estate: as you go from me today you will find two men by Rachel’s grave at the boundary-line of Benjamin, at Selsah, and they will say to you ‘The donkeys that you went to look for are found, and now your father has dropped the matter of the donkeys and is anxious about you, saying “What shall I do for my son?”’

EWE: 3 Yi azɔlia dzi tso afi ma va ɖo Tabor ƒe ati gã la gbɔ, eye àdo go ŋutsu etɔ̃ siwo yina Mawu vavã la gbɔ le Betel, ɖeka tsɔ gbɔ̃vi etɔ̃, ɖeka tsɔ abolo etɔ̃, eye ɖeka tsɔ wainze gã ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 3 And you will go on beyond there and come to the Tabor Oak, and three men going up to God’s place at Bethel will fall in with you there, one carrying three kids and one carrying three cakes of bread and one carrying a skin of wine;

EWE: 4 Woabia wò agbe ta se, eye woana abolo eve wò; xɔ aboloawo.
ENGLISH: 4 and they will ask you how you are doing, and give you two cakes of bread, and you shall receive it from them.

EWE: 5 Ema megbe àva Mawu vavã la ƒe togbɛ la dzi, afi si Filistitɔwo ƒe asrafoha aɖe le. Ne èva ɖo dua me la, àdo go nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe ha aɖe siwo ɖi tso togbɛ la dzi gbɔna, eye kasaŋku, axatsɛ, dze kple saŋku anɔ ɖiɖim le wo ŋgɔ, ke woawo ŋutɔwo anɔ nya gblɔm ɖi.
ENGLISH: 5 After that you will come to Gibeath-ha-Elohim, where the Philistines’ prefect is; and as you come to the city there you will encounter a company of prophets coming down from the height, with harp and tambourine and flute and lyre before them, and under the power;

EWE: 6 Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ ava dziwò, eye àgblɔ nya ɖi kpe ɖe wo ŋu, eye àtrɔ azu ame bubu sãa.
ENGLISH: 6 and the spirit of Jehovah will seize upon you, and you will fall under the power with them and be turned into another man.

EWE: 7 Ne dzesi siawo va eme la, ekema wɔ nu sia nu si wò asi ate ŋui, elabena Mawu vavã la li kpli wò.
ENGLISH: 7 And when these tokens present themselves to you, do as occasion offers; for God is with you.

EWE: 8 Eye nàdze ŋgɔnye ayi Gilgal, mava gbɔwò ava sa numevɔwo kple ŋutifafavɔwo. Nàlala ŋkeke adre va se ɖe esime mava gbɔwò, eye magblɔ nu si nàwɔ la na wò.”
ENGLISH: 8 And go down before me to the Gilgal; I will be coming down to you to offer burnt-offerings and sacrifice welfare-sacrifices; seven days you shall wait, till I come to you and let you know what you are to do.”

EWE: 9 Eye esi Saul trɔ be yeadzo le Samuel gbɔ ko la, Mawu trɔ eƒe dzi bubui, eye dzesi siawo katã va eme gbe ma gbe.
ENGLISH: 9 And when he turned his back to go from Samuel, God transformed his heart, and all these tokens presented themselves to him that same day.

EWE: 10 Eye wodzo le afi ma yi togbɛ la dzi, eye nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe ha aɖe va do goe. Enumake Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ va edzi, eye wòde asi nyagbɔgblɔɖi me le wo dome.
ENGLISH: 10 And they came there to Gibeah, and found a company of prophets coming on and meeting them; and a divine spirit seized upon him, and he fell under the power and was among them.

EWE: 11 Eye esi ame siwo katã nyae tsã la kpɔe be ele nya gblɔm ɖi kpe ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo ŋu la, wobia wo nɔewo be: “Nu kae le Kis vi la wɔm? Ãa, Saul hãe le nyagblɔɖilawo domea?”
ENGLISH: 11 And everybody who had known him previously saw how he was with the prophets and under the power; and the people said to each other “What is this that has happened to Kish’s son? is Saul too among the prophets?”

EWE: 12 Eye ame aɖe bia be: “Ame kae nye wo fofo?”
ENGLISH: 12 and a man from there answered “And who is their father?”

EWE: Esia tae wòzu lodonya wogblɔna be: “Ãa, Saul hãe le nyagblɔɖilawo domea?”
ENGLISH: Hence it became a proverb “Is Saul too among the prophets?”

EWE: 13 Esi wòwu nyagbɔgblɔɖia nu la, eyi togbɛ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 13 And he came out of the power and came to the height;

EWE: 14 Emegbe Saul fofo nɔviŋutsu bia eya kple eƒe subɔvi la be: “Afi kae mieyi?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Tedziawo di gee míetso, eye míenɔ wo didi dzi, ke esi míekpɔ wo o la, míeyi Samuel gbɔ.”
ENGLISH: 14 and Saul’s uncle said to him and his man “Where did you go?” and he said “Looking for the donkeys; and we saw there was nothing to be found of them, and came to Samuel.”

EWE: 15 Eye Saul fofo nɔviŋutsua bia be: “Meɖe kuku, gblɔe nam: nya kae Samuel gblɔ na mi?”
ENGLISH: 15 And Saul’s uncle said “O, tell me what Samuel said to you.”

EWE: 16 Saul ɖo eŋu na fofoa nɔviŋutsu la be: “Egblɔ na mí be woke ɖe tedziawo ŋu xoxo.” Ke Saul megblɔ fiaɖuɖu ŋu nya si Samuel gblɔ la ya nɛ o.
ENGLISH: 16 And Saul said to his uncle “He told us all right that the donkeys had been found,” but did not tell him that about the kingship that Samuel had said.

EWE: 17 Eye Samuel yɔ dukɔ la ƒo ƒu ɖe Yehowa gbɔ le Mizpa,
ENGLISH: 17 And Samuel called the people out to Jehovah’s place at Mispah,

EWE: 18 eye wògblɔ na Israel-viwo be: “Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔe nye esi: ‘Nyee kplɔ Israel dzoe le Egipte, eye meɖe mi tso Egipte si me kple fiaɖuƒe siwo katã nɔ mia tem ɖe anyi la si me.
ENGLISH: 18 and said to the sons of Israel “Says Jehovah, the God of Israel, ‘I brought Israel up from Egypt, and delivered you out of the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you;

EWE: 19 Ke miawo miegbe mia Mawu, ame si ɖe mi tso vɔ̃ siwo tu mi kple miaƒe xaxawo katã me la egbea, eye miegblɔ be: “Gbeɖe, ke boŋ ɖo fia ɖe mía nu.”
ENGLISH: 19 and you today have rejected your God who was your savior out of all your hardships and distresses, and have said “No, but appoint a king over us.”

EWE: Eya ta mitɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋkume le miaƒe toawo kple miaƒe ame akpeakpeawo nu.’”
ENGLISH: Now, then, take your stand before Jehovah by tribes and by thousands.’”

EWE: 20 Eya ta Samuel na Israel-toawo katã te va, eye wotia Benyamin-to la.
ENGLISH: 20 And Samuel brought forward all the tribes of Israel, and the tribe of Benjamin was fixed upon;

EWE: 21 Emegbe wòna Benyamin-to la ƒe ƒomeawo te va, eye wotia Matri viwo ƒe ƒome la. Mlɔeba wotia Saul, Kis vi.
ENGLISH: 21 and he brought forward the tribe of Benjamin by clans, and the clan of the Matrites was fixed upon; and he brought forward the clan of the Matrites by men, and Saul the son of Kish was fixed upon; and they looked for him, but he was not to be found.

EWE: Ke esi wodii la, womekpɔe o. 22 Eya ta wobia gbe Yehowa be: “Ðe ŋutsu la hã va afi sia?”
ENGLISH: 22 And they put the question to Jehovah again “Has the man come here?” and Jehovah said “He is in among the baggage hiding.”

EWE: Yehowa ɖo eŋu be: “Eyae nye esi be ɖe agbawo dome.” 23 Eya ta woƒu du yi ɖahee tso afi ma vɛ.
ENGLISH: 23 And they ran and fetched him from there, and he stood up among the people and was tallest of the people by a head and shoulders;

EWE: Esi wòva tɔ ɖe dukɔa dome la, ekɔ ale gbegbe be ame bubuwo katã se abɔta nɛ. 24 Samuel gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be: “Miele ame si Yehowa tia la kpɔma? Ame aɖeke mede enu le dukɔ blibo la katã me o!”
ENGLISH: 24 and Samuel said to all the people “Do you see the man Jehovah has chosen, how there is no one like him among all the people?” and all the people cheered and said “Long live the king!”

EWE: Eye dukɔ blibo la de asi ɣlidodo me be: “Fia nenɔ agbe tegbee!” 25 Eye Samuel gblɔ nu si fia la abia tso wo si la na dukɔa, eye wòŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽ me tsɔ da ɖe Yehowa ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 25 And Samuel stated to the people the law of the kingship, and wrote it down as a document and deposited it before Jehovah; and Samuel sent all the people home.

EWE: 26 Saul dzo yi eƒe me le Gibea, eye kalẽtɔ siwo ƒe dzi Yehowa ʋã la yi kplii.
ENGLISH: 26 And Saul too went home to Gibeah, and with him went the brave men whose hearts God had touched.

EWE: 27 Ke ŋutsu yakame aɖewo ya gblɔ be: “Aleke ame sia awɔ aɖe mí?” Eya ta wodo vloe, eye wometsɔ nunana aɖeke vɛ nɛ o. Ke ezi kpi, mede nu eme o.
ENGLISH: 27 But the reprobates said “What will this man do toward saving us?” and despised him and brought him no present.

ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 11 Eye Nahas, Amonitɔ la, ho yi ɖaƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Yabes ŋu le Gilead. Yabes ŋutsuwo katã gblɔ na Nahas be: “Bla nu kpli mí ne míasubɔ wò.”
ENGLISH: 11 And after about a month Nahash the ʽAmmonite came up and beleaguered Jabesh in Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash “Make terms with us, and we will be your subjects.”

EWE: 2 Nahas, Amonitɔ la, gblɔ na wo be: “Nu si mawɔ hafi abla nu kpli mi lae nye esi: maŋɔ ɖusimeŋku na mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe.
ENGLISH: 2 And Nahash the ʽAmmonite said to them “I will make these terms with you, to put out every right eye among you and lay it on all Israel for a slur.”

EWE: Mawɔ esia atsɔ ado vlo Israel blibo la katã.” 3 Yabes ƒe ametsitsiawo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Na ŋkeke adre mí, ne míadɔ ame ɖo ɖe Israel-nyigba blibo la katã dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 And the elders of Jabesh said to him “Give us seven days’ truce to send men through all the territory of Israel, and if there is no one who rescues us we will come out to you.”

EWE: 4 Emegbe ame dɔdɔawo va ɖo Saul ƒe Gibea hegblɔ nyaawo dukɔ bliboa se, eye dukɔ blibo la katã fa avi sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 4 And the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and gave the message publicly, and all the people raised their voices and wept.

EWE: 5 Ke Saul kplɔ nyihawo tso gbe me gbɔna aƒe me, eye Saul bia be: “Nu kae le dukɔ la wɔm? Nu ka tae wole avi fam?” Eya ta wogblɔ Yabes ŋutsuawo ƒe nyawo nɛ.
ENGLISH: 5 And in came Saul from the field, behind his oxen; and Saul said “What is the matter with the people that they are weeping?” and they recounted to him the story of the men of Jabesh.

EWE: 6 Esi Saul se nya siawo ko la, Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ va edzi, eye eƒe dziku fla.
ENGLISH: 6 And the spirit of Jehovah seized upon Saul when he heard this story, and he was very angry,

EWE: 7 Eya ta elé nyitsu eve hefli wo kakɛkakɛe, eye wòtsɔ wo de dɔlawo si ɖo ɖe Israel-nyigba blibo la katã dzi hegblɔ kpe ɖe eŋu be: “Mía dometɔ si mado adze Saul kple Samuel yome o la, alea woawɔ eƒe nyiwoe nye esi!”
ENGLISH: 7 and took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces and sent the pieces through all the territory of Israel by messengers with the message “He who does not come out with Saul and Samuel shall have his oxen treated so.”

EWE: Ale Yehowa ƒe ŋɔdzi lé dukɔ la, eye wova kple tame ɖeka.
ENGLISH: And the dread of Jehovah fell upon the people, and they came out like one man;

EWE: 8 Eye wòxlẽ wo le Bezek: Israel-viwo ƒe xexlẽme le ame akpe alafa etɔ̃, eye Yuda ŋutsuwo le ame akpe blaetɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 8 and he mustered them at Bezek, and there were three hundred thousand of the sons of Israel and thirty thousand of the men of Judah.

EWE: 9 Azɔ wogblɔ na ame dɔdɔ siwo va la be: “Ale miagblɔ na Yabes ŋutsuwo le Gilead ye nye esi: ‘Le etsɔ ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ la, woaxɔ na mi.’” Ale ame dɔdɔawo va gblɔe na Yabes ŋutsuwo, eye dzi dzɔ wo ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 9 And they said to the messengers that had come “Say to the men of Jabesh in Gilead, Tomorrow you shall have help when the sun grows hot’”; and the messengers came and told the men of Jabesh, and they were glad.

EWE: 10 Eya ta Yabes ŋutsuwo gblɔ na Amonitɔwo be: “Míana ta mi etsɔ, eye miawɔ nu sia nu si dze mia ŋu la ɖe mía ŋu.”
ENGLISH: 10 And the men of Jabesh said “Tomorrow we will come out to you and you shall do with us just as you think best.”

EWE: 11 Esi ŋu ke la, Saul ma dukɔ la ɖe aʋalɔgo etɔ̃ me, eye wodze mɔ yi asaɖa la me le ŋdi me ŋudzɔɣi ɖasi Amonitɔwo va se ɖe ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ. Woka ame siwo susɔ la hlẽ, ale be ame eve mekpɔtɔ ɖe teƒe ɖeka o.
ENGLISH: 11 But on the next day Saul arranged the men in three columns, and they came into the camp in the morning watch and killed ʽAmmonites till the day grew hot; and as for those who were left, they were scattered and there were not left among them two together.

EWE: 12 Eye dukɔ la gblɔ na Samuel be: “Ame kae gblɔ be: ‘Saul hãe anye fia ɖe mía nua?’ Kplɔ wo vɛ míawu.”
ENGLISH: 12 And the people said to Samuel “Who was it that said ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ give us those men to put to death.”

EWE: 13 Ke Saul gblɔ be: “Womawu ame aɖeke egbe sia o, elabena Yehowa xɔ na Israel egbea.”
ENGLISH: 13 But Saul said “Nobody shall be put to death on this day; for today Jehovah has made victory in Israel.”

EWE: 14 Emegbe Samuel gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Miva míayi Gilgal, ne míaɖo kpe Saul ƒe fianyenye la dzi le afi ma.”
ENGLISH: 14 And Samuel said to the people “Come, let us go to the Gilgal and renew the kingship there”;

EWE: 15 Ale dukɔ blibo la yi Gilgal, eye woɖo Saul fiae le afi ma le Yehowa ŋkume le Gilgal. Eye wosa ŋutifafavɔwo le Yehowa ŋkume le afi ma, eye Saul kple Israel ŋutsuwo katã kpɔ dzidzɔ le afi ma eteƒe mekɔ o.
ENGLISH: 15 and all the people went to the Gilgal and made Saul king there before Jehovah at the Gilgal, and sacrificed welfare-sacrifices there before Jehovah; and Saul and all the men of Israel had a great rejoicing there.

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 12 Mlɔeba Samuel gblɔ na Israel blibo la katã be: “Mewɔ nu siwo katã miebia tso asinye la, eye meɖo fia na mi.
ENGLISH: 12 And Samuel said to all Israel “Here I have obeyed you in everything that you said to me, and have established a king over you.

EWE: 2 Azɔ fia lae akplɔ mi!
ENGLISH: 2 And now, here is the king going about before you, and I am old and gray-headed; and here are my sons among you; and I have been going about before you from my youth to this day.

EWE: Nye la, metsi heƒo wɔ, eye vinyewo le mia dome, eye mekplɔ mi tso nye ɖekakpuime va se ɖe egbe sia. 3 Nyee nye esi. Miɖo eŋu nam le Yehowa ŋkume kple eƒe amesiamina la ŋkume: Ame ka ƒe nyitsu alo tedzie mexɔ? Alo ame kae metafa, ame kae mete ɖe anyi, alo ame ka sie mexɔ zãnu le heŋe aɖaba ƒu nu si wòwɔ la dzi? Ne maɖo eteƒe na mi.”
ENGLISH: 3 Here I am: bring your charges against me in the presence of Jehovah and his anointed: whose bull have I taken, and whose donkey have I taken? and to whom have I denied justice, and whom have I persecuted? and from whom have I taken composition-money to blind my eyes with? and I will return it to you.”

EWE: 4 Woɖo eŋu be: “Mètafa mí o, mète mí ɖe anyi o, eye mèxɔ naneke le ame aɖeke si o.”
ENGLISH: 4 And they said “You have never denied us justice nor persecuted us, nor taken anything from us.”

EWE: 5 Eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Yehowae nye ɖasefo ɖe mia ŋu, eye eƒe amesiamina hã nye ɖasefo egbea, be miate ŋu atso nunye le naneke ŋu o.”
ENGLISH: 5 And he said to them “Jehovah is witness against you this day, and so is his anointed, that you have not found anything in my hands.”

EWE: Woɖo eŋu be: “Eyae nye ɖasefo.”
ENGLISH: And they said “He is.”

EWE: 6 Eya ta Samuel gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Yehowa, ame si zã Mose kple Aron tsɔ kplɔ mia tɔgbuiwo dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi lae nye ɖasefo.
ENGLISH: 6 And Samuel said to the people “Jehovah, who made Moses and Aaron and who brought your fathers up from Egypt, is witness.

EWE: 7 Azɔ miva tɔ ɖi ne madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi le Yehowa ŋkume, le nu dzɔdzɔe siwo katã Yehowa wɔ na mi kple mia tɔgbuiwo la gome.
ENGLISH: 7 And now stand out and let me plead against you before Jehovah the case of all Jehovah’s fair dealing by you and by your fathers.

EWE: 8 “Esi Yakob va Egipte, eye mia tɔgbuiwo de asi Yehowa yɔyɔ me be wòaxɔ na yewo ko la, Yehowa dɔ Mose kple Aron, be woakplɔ mia tɔgbuiwo adzoe le Egipte, eye wona wova nɔ teƒe sia.
ENGLISH: 8 When Jacob had gone into Egypt, your fathers cried to Jehovah, and Jehovah sent Moses and Aaron and took your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.

EWE: 9 Ke woŋlɔ Yehowa woƒe Mawu la be, eye wòtsɔ wo dzra na Hazor ƒe aʋafia Sisera kple Filistitɔwo kpakple Moab-fia, eye wowɔ aʋa kpli wo.
ENGLISH: 9 And they forgot their God Jehovah, and he sold them into the hands of Sisera the general of the army of Hasor and into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the king of Moab, and they made war on them.

EWE: 10 Eye woyɔ Yehowa be wòaxɔ na yewo hegblɔ be: ‘Míewɔ nu vɔ̃, elabena míegblẽ Yehowa ɖi hesubɔ Baal kple Astoret legbawo; ke azɔ la, ɖe mí tso míaƒe futɔwo si me, ne míasubɔ wò.’
ENGLISH: 10 And they cried to Jehovah, and said ‘We have sinned, because we have left Jehovah and worshiped the Baals and the ʽAshtarts: now deliver us out of the hands of our enemies, and we will worship you’;

EWE: 11 Ale Yehowa dɔ Yerubaal, Bedan, Yefta kple Samuel, eye wòɖe mi tso miaƒe futɔwo si me godoo va kpe, be mianɔ dedie.
ENGLISH: 11 and Jehovah sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel and delivered you out of the hands of your enemies on all sides, and you lived in security.

EWE: 12 Esi miekpɔ be Amonitɔwo ƒe fia Nahas ho ɖe mia ŋu la, miegblɔ nam be: ‘Gbeɖe, ke boŋ fia neɖu mía dzi!’ evɔ Yehowa mia Mawue nye miaƒe Fia hafi.
ENGLISH: 12 And you saw that King Nahash of the Bene-ʽAmmon had come against you, and you said to me ‘No, but let there be a king reigning over us’ when your God Jehovah was your king.

EWE: 13 Azɔ fia si mietia, eye miebia lae nye esi; kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ɖo fia ɖe mia nu.
ENGLISH: 13 And now here is the king that you have chosen to have: here Jehovah has put a king over you.

EWE: 14 Ne mi kple fia si le mia dzi ɖum la, miadze Yehowa, mia Mawu la yome, eye miavɔ̃e, asubɔe ahaɖo to eƒe gbe, eye miadze aglã ɖe Yehowa ƒe sedede ŋu o la, ekema nu adze edzi na mi.
ENGLISH: 14 If you fear Jehovah and worship him and listen to him, and do not disobey Jehovah, and both you and the king who has come to reign over you keep on the side of your God Jehovah,

EWE: 15 Ke ne mieɖo to Yehowa ƒe gbe o, eye miedze aglã ɖe Yehowa ƒe sedede ŋu la, ekema Yehowa ƒe asi ava mia kple mia fofowo dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 but if you do not listen to Jehovah, and disobey Jehovah, then Jehovah’s hand will be upon you and upon your king to destroy you.

EWE: 16 Azɔ miva tɔ ɖi, ne miakpɔ nu gã sia si wɔ ge Yehowa le le mia ŋkume la ɖa.
ENGLISH: 16 Stand out even now and see this great thing which Jehovah does before your eyes!

EWE: 17 Alo menye luxaɣie nye esia oa?
ENGLISH: 17 It is wheat harvest today, is it not?

EWE: Mayɔ Yehowa, ne wòana dzi naɖe gbe, eye tsi nadza; ne miadze sii, eye miakpɔe be nu vɔ̃ɖie miewɔ le Yehowa ŋkume, be miebia fia na mia ɖokui.”
ENGLISH: I will call on Jehovah and he will give thunder and rain; so see for yourselves that what you have done in asking to have a king is a great wickedness of yours in Jehovah’s sight.”

EWE: 18 Ale Samuel yɔ Yehowa, eye Yehowa na dzi ɖe gbe, eye tsi dza gbe ma gbe, ale be dukɔ blibo la katã vɔ̃ Yehowa kple Samuel ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 18 And Samuel called on Jehovah, and Jehovah gave thunder and rain that day. And all the people were in great fear of Jehovah and of Samuel;

EWE: 19 Eye dukɔ blibo la katã gblɔ na Samuel be: “Do gbe ɖa na Yehowa wò Mawu la ɖe wò dɔlawo ta, elabena míedi be míaku o, elabena míewɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi tsɔ ƒu míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo katã dzi, be míebia fia na mía ɖokui.”
ENGLISH: 19 and all the people said to Samuel “Pray for your servants to your God Jehovah; do not let us die; for we have added a wickedness to all our sins in asking to have a king.”

EWE: 20 Eye Samuel gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Migavɔ̃ o. Miewɔ vɔ̃ sia katã xoxo. Ðeko migatrɔ le Yehowa yome o, ke boŋ misubɔ Yehowa kple dzi blibo.
ENGLISH: 20 And Samuel said to the people “Do not be afraid; you have done all this wickedness, but only do not turn aside from following Jehovah, and worship Jehovah with all your hearts,

EWE: 21 Migatrɔ dze nu dzodzro siwo ŋu viɖe aɖeke mele o, eye womeɖea ame o la yome o, elabena nu dzodzrowoe wonye.
ENGLISH: 21 and do not turn aside to follow the nonentities that do no good and deliver nobody because they are nonentities.

EWE: 22 Yehowa magblẽ eƒe dukɔ la ɖi o le eƒe ŋkɔ gã la ta, elabena Yehowa tsɔe ɖo eɖokui dzi be, yeawɔ mi mianye yeƒe dukɔ.
ENGLISH: 22 For Jehovah will not abandon his people, for the sake of his great name, because Jehovah has chosen to make you his own people.

EWE: 23 Eye nede megbe xaa tso gbɔnye be madzudzɔ gbedodoɖa ɖe mia ta, si anye nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, mayi edzi afia nu mi le mɔ nyui kple mɔ dzɔdzɔe la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 23 For me too, away with the thought of my sinning against Jehovah by ceasing to pray for you; and I will guide you in the way of what is good and right.

EWE: 24 Ðeko mivɔ̃ Yehowa, eye misubɔe nuteƒewɔwɔtɔe tso dzi blibo me, elabena mikpɔ nu gã siwo gbegbe wòwɔ na mi la ɖa!
ENGLISH: 24 Only fear Jehovah and worship him loyally with all your hearts; for see what great things he has done for you.

EWE: 25 Ke ne miesẽ dzi me hewɔ nu si nye vɔ̃ la, ekema atsrɔ̃ mi kple miaƒe fia la siaa.”
ENGLISH: 25 But if you do misbehave, both you and your king will be swept away.”

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 13 Saul xɔ ƒe . . . esime wòzu fia, eye wòɖu fia ɖe Israel dzi ƒe eve.
ENGLISH: 13 Saul was . . . years old when he became king,and for two years he reigned over Israel.

EWE: 2 Eye Saul tia ame akpe etɔ̃ tso Israel; ame akpe eve le Saul ŋu le Mikmas kple Betel tonuto la me, eye ame akpe ɖeka le Yonatan ŋu le Gibea si nye Benyamin viwo ƒe du la me.
ENGLISH: 2 And Saul selected three thousand men out of Israel, and two thousand were with Saul at Micmas and in the highland of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin; and the rest of the people he dismissed to their homes.

EWE: Ke eɖe asi le dukɔ la ƒe ame susɔeawo ŋu, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe yi eƒe agbadɔ me. 3 Eye Yonatan si Filistitɔwo ƒe asrafoha si le Geba, eye Filistitɔwo see.
ENGLISH: 3 And Jonathan killed the prefect whom the Philistines had at Gibeah, and Saul blew the ram-horn throughout the country; and the Philistines heard the word “The Hebrews have revolted,”

EWE: Ke Saul na woku kpẽ le anyigba blibo la katã dzi gblɔ be: “Hebritɔwo nesee!” 4 Eye Israel blibo la katã se be: “Saul si Filistitɔwo ƒe asrafoha aɖe, eya ta Israel va le ʋeʋẽm ɖe Filistitɔwo.”
ENGLISH: 4 and all Israel heard “Saul has killed the Philistines’ prefect, so Israel is at deadly feud with the Philistines,” and the people came out in arms behind Saul at the Gilgal.

EWE: Ale woyɔ dukɔ la ƒo ƒu, be woadze Saul yome ayi Gilgal. 5 Ke Filistitɔwo hã ƒo ƒu be yewoawɔ aʋa kple Israel: woƒe tasiaɖamwo le akpe blaetɔ̃, sɔdolawo le akpe ade hekpe ɖe ame siwo sɔ gbɔ kpaŋkpaŋ abe ƒutake ene la ŋu; eye woyi ɖaƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Mikmas le Bet-Aven ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.
ENGLISH: 5 And the Philistines came together to make war with Israel, three thousand chariots and six hundred cavalry and men in numbers like the sand on the seabeach, and came up and encamped at Micmas, east of Beth-Aven.

EWE: 6 Israel ŋutsuwo kpɔ be yewoɖo xaxa me, eye womimi yewo ɖo; ale dukɔ la yi ɖabe ɖe agadowo, ʋewo, agakpewo, tomexɔwo kple tsido ƒuƒluwo me.
ENGLISH: 6 And the men of Israel saw that they were in straits, because the people were hard pushed; and the people hid in the caves and the briers and the cliffs and the burial-vaults and the cisterns,

EWE: 7 Hebritɔ aɖewo gɔ̃ hã tso Yordan-tɔsisi la yi Gad kple Gilead-nyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 and crossed the fords of the Jordan to the country of Gad and Gilead.

EWE: Ke Saul ŋutɔ ya gakpɔtɔ le Gilgal, eye ame siwo katã le eyome la nɔ dzodzom nyanyanya.
ENGLISH: And Saul was still at the Gilgal; and the people were all dropping away from him in a panic.

EWE: 8 Eye wòlala ŋkeke adre, va se ɖe esime ɣeyiɣi si Samuel ɖo la de, ke Samuel meva Gilgal o, eye dukɔ la le kakam le Saul ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 And he waited seven days, in accordance with the appointment that Samuel had made; but Samuel did not come to the Gilgal, and the people were scattering away from him.

EWE: 9 Mlɔeba Saul gblɔ be: “Mitsɔ numevɔsa la kple ŋutifafavɔsaawo vɛ nam.”
ENGLISH: 9 And Saul said “Bring the burnt-offering and the welfare-sacrifices to me,” and offered the burnt-offering.

EWE: Eye wòsa numevɔ la. 10 Esi wònya sa numevɔ la vɔ teti ko la, Samuel ye nye esi va ɖo.
ENGLISH: 10 And as he finished offering the burnt-offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to meet him and salute him.

EWE: Eya ta Saul yi ɖakpee heyrae. 11 Eye Samuel biae be: “Nu kae nye esi nèwɔ?” Saul ɖo eŋu be: “Mekpɔ be dukɔ la kaka le ŋunye, wò hã mèva le ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖia dzi o, eye Filistitɔwo ƒo ƒu ɖe Mikmas.
ENGLISH: 11 And Samuel said “What have you done?” and Saul said “Why, I saw that the people were scattered away from me, and you had not come within the appointed days, and the Philistines had come together at Micmas,

EWE: 12 Eya ta mebu be: ‘Filistitɔwo ava dze dzinye fifia le Gilgal, evɔ nyemekpɔ ƒo koko na Yehowa be wòave nunye haɖe o.’
ENGLISH: 12 and I thought ‘Now the Philistines will be coming down to the Gilgal against me, and I have not propitiated Jehovah’; and I strained a point and offered the burnt-offering.”

EWE: Eya tae mezi ɖokuinye dzi hesa numevɔ la.” 13 Eye Samuel gblɔ na Saul be: “Èwɔ bometsinu. Mèlé se si Yehowa wò Mawu de na wò la me ɖe asi o.
ENGLISH: 13 And Samuel said to Saul “You did foolishly: you did not keep your God Jehovah’s commandment that he had given you.

EWE: Ðe nèlé eme ɖe asi la, anye ne Yehowa ana wò fiaɖuƒe nali ke ɖe Israel dzi tegbee.
ENGLISH: For then Jehovah would have established your kingship over Israel forever;

EWE: 14 Ke azɔ wò fiaɖuƒe manɔ anyi eteƒe nadidi o.
ENGLISH: 14 but now your kingship shall not stand.

EWE: Yehowa adi ŋutsu si ƒe nu dze eƒe dzi ŋu la, Yehowa aɖoe eƒe dukɔ la kplɔlae, elabena mèɖo to se si Yehowa de na wò la o.”
ENGLISH: Jehovah has looked out for himself a man to his mind, and Jehovah has appointed him warden over his people, because you did not keep what Jehovah commanded you.”

EWE: 15 Eye Samuel dze mɔ tso Gilgal yi Gibea si nye Benyamin ƒe du la me, eye Saul xlẽ dukɔ la me tɔ siwo susɔ ɖe eŋu la, eye woanɔ ame alafa ade.
ENGLISH: 15 And Samuel left the Gilgal and went his own way; but the rest of the people went up behind Saul to the front, and came from the Gilgal to Gibeah in Benjamin; and Saul mustered the men that he had with him, and found that there were about six hundred of them.

EWE: 16 Eye Saul kple via Yonatan kpakple ame siwo susɔ ɖe eŋu la nɔ Geba si nye Benyamin viwo ƒe du la me, eye Filistitɔwo ya ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Mikmas.
ENGLISH: 16 And Saul and his son Jonathan, and the men he had with him, were staying at Gebaʽ in Benjamin, and the Philistines were encamped at Micmas.

EWE: 17 Eye Filistitɔwo ƒe nuhalawo ma ɖe hatsotso etɔ̃ me. Hatsotso ɖeka ɖo ta Ofra mɔ si yi Sual-nyigba dzi;
ENGLISH: 17 And the ravaging force went out from the Philistines’ camp in three columns, one column taking the direction of Ghophrah, toward the country of Shuʽal,

EWE: 18 evelia to Bet-Horon mɔ, eye etɔ̃lia to mɔ si yi liƒo si dze ŋgɔ Zeboim Bali me ɖo ta gbedzi la.
ENGLISH: 18 and one that of Beth-Horon, and one that of the boundary that looks down on Hyena Valley, toward the wilderness.

EWE: 19 Ke gbede aɖeke mele Israel-nyigba blibo la katã dzi o, elabena Filistitɔwo gblɔ be: “Ne Hebritɔwo nagatu yi alo akplɔ na wo ɖokuiwo o.”
ENGLISH: 19 And there was not a smith to be found in all the country of Israel, because the Philistines had thought “The Hebrews might make swords and spears”;

EWE: 20 Eye Israel-vi ɖe sia ɖe yi ɖanyrea eƒe agblenu alo eƒe dziga alo eƒe fía alo eƒe hɛ gobɛ le Filistitɔwo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 20 and all Israel went down to the Philistines for sharpening a man’s plowshare and hoe and ax and goad-point,

EWE: 21 Eye ga si woxɔna ne wonyre agblenuawo, dzigaawo, gaflowo kple fíaawo, alo ɖe nyikplɔti si nu le tsutsuẽ la dzadzra ɖo tae nye pim ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 21 and the charge for the smith’s work was two-thirds for plowshares and hoes and a third of a shekel for ax-whetting and for goad-shoeing.

EWE: 22 Eye le aʋakpegbea la, womekpɔ yi alo akplɔ le ame siwo le Saul kple Yonatan ŋu la dometɔ aɖeke si o, negbe Saul kple via Yonatan si koe wole.
ENGLISH: 22 And on the day of the battle of Micmas there were no swords and spears to be found in the hands of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and his son Jonathan had them.

EWE: 23 Ke Filistitɔwo ƒe asrafoha aɖe ho yi Mikmas todomemɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 23 And the Philistines’ supporting force went out to Micmas Crossing.

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 14 Gbe ɖeka Saul viŋutsu Yonatan gblɔ na eƒe adekplɔvi la be: “Va míayi Filistitɔwo ƒe dzɔla siwo le go kemɛ dzi la gbɔ.”
ENGLISH: 14 And one day Saul’s son Jonathan said to the young man who was squire to him “Come, let us go across to the Philistines’ force over yonder,” but did not tell his father.

EWE: Ke megblɔe na fofoa o. 2 Eye Saul nɔ yevuboɖati si le Migron la te le Gibea gbɔto, eye ŋutsu siwo le eŋu la anɔ alafa ade.
ENGLISH: 2 Saul was staying in the outskirts of Gebaʽ, under the pomegranate-tree in Migron; the people with him amounted to about six hundred men,

EWE: 3 (Eye Ahiya, si nye Ahitub vi, Ikabod nɔvi, Finehas vi, Eli vi, ame si nye Yehowa ƒe nunɔla le Silo, sie kɔmewu la le.) Gake ameawo menya be Yonatan dzo o.
ENGLISH: 3 and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub the brother of Icabod the son of Pinehas the son of ʽEli Jehovah’s priest at Shiloh, bearing an ephod; and the people did not know that Jonathan went.

EWE: 4 Ke agakpe si le abe aɖu ene la le mɔ si Yonatan di be yeato aɖo Filistitɔwo ƒe dzɔlawo gbɔ la ƒe akpa evea; ɖeka ŋkɔe nye Bozez, eye evelia ŋkɔe nye Sene.
ENGLISH: 4 And between the crossings, where Jonathan tried to go across to the Philistine force, there is a tooth of rock over on this side and a tooth of rock over on that side, one named Boses and the other named Seneh,

EWE: 5 Agakpeawo dometɔ ɖeka le abe sɔti ene le dziehekpa dzi dze ŋgɔ Mikmas, eye evelia le anyiehekpa dzi dze ŋgɔ Geba.
ENGLISH: 5 the one tooth towering up on the north, toward Micmas, and the other on the south, toward Gebaʽ.

EWE: 6 Eye Yonatan gblɔ na eƒe adekplɔvi la be: “Va míayi go kemɛ dzi le dzɔla aʋamatsomatsotɔ siawo gbɔ. Ðewohĩ Yehowa axɔ na mí, elabena naneke mexea mɔ na Yehowa, be wòatsɔ ame geɖe alo ame ʋɛ axɔ na ame o.”
ENGLISH: 6 And Jonathan said to the young man who was squire to him “Come, let us go across to those uncircumcised fellows’ supporting force; maybe Jehovah will do something for us, for Jehovah has no lack of power to give victory by many or by few”;

EWE: 7 Eye eƒe adekplɔvi la gblɔ nɛ be: “Wɔ nu sia nu si le wò dzi me. Trɔ ɖe afi si nèlɔ̃ eye manɔ yowòme ayi afi sia afi si nèdi.”
ENGLISH: 7 and his squire said to him “Do whatever you feel inclined to: I am with you, just as you feel.”

EWE: 8 Eye Yonatan gblɔ be: “ Míayi ɖe ameawo gbɔ le go kemɛ dzi, eye míana woakpɔ mí.
ENGLISH: 8 And Jonathan said “You see, we shall be going across to the men and exposing ourselves to their sight:

EWE: 9 Ne wogblɔ na mí be: ‘Mitɔ, va se ɖe esime míava mia gbɔ!’ la, ekema míatɔ ɖe afi si míele, eye míayi wo gbɔ o.
ENGLISH: 9 if they tell us ‘keep still till we get to you’ we will stand where we are and not go up to them;

EWE: 10 Ke ne wogblɔ na mí be: ‘Miva kpe kpli mí!’ la, ekema míayi, elabena Yehowa atsɔ wo ade asi na mí.
ENGLISH: 10 but if they say ‘come up to us’ we will go up, because Jehovah will have given them into our hands, and this will be the token for us.”

EWE: Esiae anye dzesi na mí.” 11 Azɔ wo ame evea na Filistitɔwo ƒe dzɔlawo kpɔ wo. Eye Filistitɔwo gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa! Hebritɔwoe nye esi do tso do siwo me wobe ɖo la me.”
ENGLISH: 11 And the two of them exposed themselves to the sight of the Philistine supporting force, and the Philistines said “There are some Hebrews coming out of the holes they were hiding themselves in”;

EWE: 12 Ke ŋutsu siwo woɖo dzɔlawoe la gblɔ na Yonatan kple eƒe adekplɔvi la be: “Miva kpe kpli mí, ne míafia nane mi!”
ENGLISH: 12 and the men of the supporting force answered Jonathan and his squire “Come up to us and we will let you know something.”

EWE: Enumake Yonatan gblɔ na eƒe adekplɔvi la be: “Dze yonyeme, elabena Yehowa atsɔ wo ade asi na Israel.”
ENGLISH: And Jonathan said to his squire “Come up behind me, because Jehovah has given them into Israel’s hands.”

EWE: 13 Eye Yonatan ta asi kple afɔ, eye eƒe adekplɔvi la le eyome; Yonatan le wo ƒom ƒu anyi, eye eƒe adekplɔvi la le wo wum le eyome.
ENGLISH: 13 And Jonathan climbed up on hands and feet, and his squire behind him; and they fell before Jonathan, while his squire finished killing them behind him.

EWE: 14 Ame siwo Yonatan kple eƒe adekplɔvi wu gbã la anɔ ame blaeve, eye teƒea anɔ abe agbleka afã ƒe didime ene.
ENGLISH: 14 And the first havoc that Jonathan and his squire made was about twenty men, in about half a furrow of a one-yoke plowing.

EWE: 15 Eye ŋɔdzi lé Filistitɔ siwo le asaɖa la me le gbea dzi kple dzɔlawo katã, dzidzi ƒo nuhalawo gɔ̃ hã. Anyigba nɔ ʋuʋum eye ŋɔdzi tso Mawu gbɔ lé wo.
ENGLISH: 15 And there came a panic in the camp and in the field, among all the people in the supporting force; and the ravagers were panic-struck too, and would not work; and the earth quivered, and it became an unearthly panic.

EWE: 16 Eye Saul ƒe gbetakpɔla siwo le Gibea si nye Benyamin viwo ƒe dua me la kpɔ be zi tɔ le afi sia afi!
ENGLISH: 16 And the sentinels Saul had at Gebaʽ in Benjamin saw how the uproar was surging back and forth;

EWE: 17 Saul gblɔ na ame siwo le eŋu la be: “Mixlẽ ameawo, ne míakpɔ ame si dzo le mía dome.” Esi woxlẽ ameawo la, wokpɔ be Yonatan kple eƒe adekplɔvi la meli o.
ENGLISH: 17 and Saul said to the people who were with him “Look up the men and see who has left us”; and they looked up and found Jonathan and his squire missing.

EWE: 18 Eye Saul gblɔ na Ahiya be: “Tsɔ Mawu vavã la ƒe Aɖaka la vɛ!”
ENGLISH: 18 And Saul said to Ahijah “Bring the ephod here”; for he was bearing the ephod before Israel that day.

EWE: (Elabena Mawu vavã la ƒe Aɖaka la le Israel-viwo gbɔ ɣemaɣi.) 19 Eye esi Saul le nu ƒom na nunɔlaa la, zitɔtɔ la ganɔ sesẽm ɖe edzi le Filistitɔwo ƒe asaɖaa me.
ENGLISH: 19 And while Saul was speaking to the priest the uproar in the Philistine camp kept growing greater; and Saul said to the priest “Take your hand off,”

EWE: 20 Eye Saul kple ame siwo katã le eŋu la ƒo ƒu eye woyi aʋa la nu, eye wokpɔ be Filistitɔawo dome ame sia ame trɔ yi ɖe ehavi ŋu; eye Filistitɔawo tɔtɔ ale gbegbe.
ENGLISH: 20 and Saul and all the people who were with him took the field. And they came to the battle and found it had come to be one man’s sword against another in utter anarchy.

EWE: 21 Eye Hebritɔ siwo nɔ Filistitɔwo ƒe akpa dzi tsã, siwo ho kpli wo ɖaƒu asaɖa anyi la gɔ̃ hã va de Israel-vi siwo le Saul kple Yonatan ŋu la dzi.
ENGLISH: 21 And the Hebrews that had belonged to the Philistines as before, who had come up with them to the camp, also faced about to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan;

EWE: 22 Israel ŋutsu siwo katã be ɖe Efrayim tonutoa me hã se be Filistitɔwo si, eye woawo hã do go va ti wo yome le aʋa la nu.
ENGLISH: 22 and all the men of Israel that had been hiding in the highland of Ephraim heard that the Philistines had run, and they too dogged them with a running fight.

EWE: 23 Ale Yehowa ɖe Israel gbe ma gbe, eye aʋa la de Bet-Aven ke.
ENGLISH: 23 And Jehovah gave Israel the victory that day.

EWE: 24 Ke ɖeɖi te Israel ŋutsuwo ŋu gbe ma gbe, elabena Saul ka atam gblɔ na ameawo be: “Ne ame aɖe aɖu nu hafi fiẽ naɖo, esime nyemebia hlɔ̃ nye futɔwo vɔ haɖe o la, aɖi amea ŋu kpékpekpe!”
ENGLISH: And the fighting went past Beth-Aven, 24 and all the people came to be with Saul, about ten thousand men, and the fighting spread out all over the highland of Ephraim.

EWE: Eya ta ameawo dometɔ aɖeke mede naneke nu me o.
ENGLISH: And Saul laid a great interdict that day, and banned the people with the words “Cursed be the man who eats food till it is evening and I am revenged on my enemies”; and none of the people tasted food, but all the countryside fasted.

EWE: 25 Eye ameawo katã va ɖo ave me, eye wokpɔ anyitsi le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 25 And there were combs of honey over the wilds;

EWE: 26 Esi wova ɖo avea me la, kpɔ ɖa, anyitsie nye ema le tsyɔtsyɔm, ke ame aɖeke mede ɖeke nu me o, elabena wovɔ̃ atamkaka la.
ENGLISH: 26 and the people came to the combs and found that the bees had gone away from them; but there was no one that put his hand to his mouth, because the people were afraid of the oath.

EWE: 27 Ke Yonatan ya mesee be ye fofo ka atam na ameawo o, eya ta edo atikplɔ si le esi la ɖa tɔ anyiɖaɖa la me. Esi wòdee nu me la, eƒe mo kɔ.
ENGLISH: 27 But Jonathan had not heard when his father put the people to the oath; and he reached out the tip of a stick he had in his hand and dipped it into a comb of honey, and put his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened up.

EWE: 28 Eye ameawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ nɛ be: “Fofowò ka atam gblɔ na ameawo be: ‘Aɖi ame si aɖu nu egbea ŋu!’
ENGLISH: 28 And a man of the people answered “Your father has put the people to an oath ‘Cursed be the man who eats food today’; and the people have grown faint.”

EWE: Esia tae ɖeɖi te ameawo ŋu vevie ɖo.” 29 Ke Yonatan gblɔ be: “Fofonye he vɔ̃ gã aɖe va anyigba la dzi.
ENGLISH: 29 And Jonathan said “My father has brought the country into trouble: see how my eyes brightened up when I tasted that little bit of honey;

EWE: Mikpɔ ale si nye mo kɔ esi mede anyitsi vi sia nu mee ɖa. 30 Ne ɖe ameawo ɖu woƒe futɔwo ƒe aboyonu siwo wokpɔ la ƒe ɖe egbea la, anye ne míesi wo wu alea hafi!
ENGLISH: 30 what if the people had eaten out of the plunder they have got from the enemy? then there would have been plenty of Philistines killed.”

EWE: 31 Gbe ma gbe la, wosi Filistitɔwo tso Mikmas va se ɖe Aiyalon, eye ɖeɖi te dukɔ la ŋu belibeli.
ENGLISH: 31 And they were killing Philistines that day from Micmas to Aijalon, and the people grew very faint;

EWE: 32 Eye aʋakɔ la dze aboyonuawo dzi ŋukeklẽtɔe, wolé alẽwo, nyiwo kple nyiviwo hewu wo kɔ ɖe anyigba, eye woɖu lãa kple ʋua siaa.
ENGLISH: 32 and the people flew upon the plunder and took sheep and cows and calves and slaughtered them on the ground, and the people ate over the blood.

EWE: 33 Eye wova gblɔe na Saul be: “Kpɔ ɖa! Dukɔ la le nu vɔ̃ wɔm ɖe Yehowa ŋu, elabena wole lã kple ʋu ɖum.” Eye wògblɔ be: “Miewɔ nuteƒe o.
ENGLISH: 33 And they told Saul “There are the people sinning against Jehovah by eating over the blood”; and he said “You have dealt falsely; roll a big stone here to me.”

EWE: Mimli kpe gã aɖe vɛ nam gbã gbɔ.” 34 Eye Saul gblɔ be: “Mikaka ɖe ameawo dome miagblɔ na wo be: ‘Mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nekplɔ eƒe nyi alo alẽ va gbɔnye, ne miawu wo le teƒe sia ahaɖu. Migawɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu aɖu lã kple ʋu o.’”
ENGLISH: 34 And Saul said “Scatter among the people and tell them to bring their bulls and sheep here to me and slaughter them here and eat them, and not sin against Jehovah by eating over the blood”; and all the people brought what they had and slaughtered it there.

EWE: Ale ameawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe kplɔ eƒe nyitsu vɛ zã ma me, eye wowui le afi ma. 35 Eye Saul ɖi vɔsamlekpui na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 35 And Saul built an altar to Jehovah: that was his first start in altar-building to Jehovah.

EWE: Esiae nye vɔsamlekpui gbãtɔ si wòɖi na Yehowa. 36 Emegbe Saul gblɔ be: “Mina míayi Filistitɔwo gbɔ le zã me, eye míaha wo va se ɖe esime ŋu ke. Míasusɔ wo dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã ɖi o.”
ENGLISH: 36 And Saul said “Let us go down after the Philistines by night and plunder among them till morning daylight, and not leave a man among them”; and they said “Do anything you think best.”

EWE: Woɖo eŋu be: “Nu sia nu si nyo ŋuwò la, wɔe.”
ENGLISH: But the priest said “Let us approach God here.”

EWE: Eye nunɔla la gblɔ be: “Mina míate ɖe Mawu vavã la ŋu le afi sia.” 37 Eye Saul bia gbe Mawu be: “Maho adze Filistitɔwo yomea? Àtsɔ wo ade asi na Israel mahã?” Ke Mawu meɖo eŋu nɛ gbe ma gbe o.
ENGLISH: 37 And Saul put the question to God “Shall I go down after the Philistines? will you give them into Israel’s hands?” but he did not answer him that day.

EWE: 38 Eya ta Saul gblɔ be: “Mi dukɔ la ƒe tatɔwo katã, mite va afii, eye miku eme miakpɔ be nu vɔ̃ kae ame aɖe wɔ egbea hã.
ENGLISH: 38 And Saul said “Come here, all the headmen of the people, and see for yourselves what the sin is in today;

EWE: 39 Elabena zi ale si Yehowa, Israel Ðela, le agbe la, ne vinye Yonatan ye hã la, ku kee wòaku.”
ENGLISH: 39 for, by Jehovah who gives Israel the victory, be it in my son Jonathan, he shall die.”

EWE: Ke ame aɖeke meɖo eŋu nɛ o. 40 Eye wògblɔ na Israel blibo la be: “Mianɔ akpa ɖeka, eye nye kple vinye Yonatan hã míanɔ akpa ɖeka.”
ENGLISH: 40 And he said to all Israel “Be you one side and I and my son Jonathan will be one side”; and the people said to Saul “Do what you think best.”

EWE: Eye ameawo gblɔ na Saul be: “Nu si nyo ŋuwò la, wɔe.” 41 Eye Saul gblɔ na Yehowa be: “Oo, Israel ƒe Mawu, na nyateƒea nadze to Tumim dzi!”
ENGLISH: 41 And Saul said “Jehovah, God of Israel, why have you not answered your servant today? if this crime is in me or my son Jonathan, Jehovah, God of Israel, give Urim; and if this crime is in your people Israel, give Thummim.”

EWE: Eye wòlé Yonatan kple Saul, ke dukɔ la do le eme.
ENGLISH: And Jonathan and Saul were fixed upon, and the people went clear.

EWE: 42 Eye Saul gblɔ be: “Midzidze nu, ne miatso nya me le nye kple vinye Yonatan dome.”
ENGLISH: 42 And Saul said “Toss between me and my son Jonathan: whichever Jehovah fixes upon, let him die”; and the people said to Saul “This thing shall not be,” but Saul overbore the people and they tossed between him and his son Jonathan, and Jonathan was fixed upon.

EWE: Eye nudzidze la dze Yonatan dzi. 43 Eye Saul bia Yonatan be: “Gblɔe nam, nu kae nèwɔ?”
ENGLISH: 43 And Saul said to Jonathan “Tell me what you have done”; and Jonathan told him, saying “Tasted a little honey with the tip of the stick I had in my hand: here I am, I will die.”

EWE: Eya ta Yonatan ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Metsɔ atikplɔ si le asinye la tɔ anyitsi me de nu me. Nyee nye esi!
ENGLISH: 44 And Saul said “God do so, and more, but die you shall, Jonathan.”

EWE: Maku faa!” 44 Eye Saul gblɔ be: “Yonatan, Mawu nefiam, ne wòagafiam ɖe edzi, ne mèku o fĩ!” 45 Ke ameawo bia Saul be: “Yonatan, ame si he dziɖuɖu gã sia vɛ na Israel la nakua? Gbeɖe!
ENGLISH: 45 But the people said to Saul “Jonathan die, who has won this great victory of Israel? away with the thought! by Jehovah, not a hair of his head shall fall to the ground, because he cooperated with God today.”

EWE: Ale dukɔ la xɔ Yonatan ɖe agbe, be meku o.
ENGLISH: And the people ransomed Jonathan so that he did not die.

EWE: 46 Eya ta Saul gbugbɔ le Filistitɔwo yome, eye Filistitɔwo yi wo nɔƒe.
ENGLISH: 46 And Saul came up from following the Philistines, and the Philistines went home.

EWE: 47 Eye Saul ƒe fiaɖuɖu ɖe Israel dzi li ke, eye wòwɔ aʋa kple eƒe futɔ siwo nye Moabtɔwo, Amonitɔwo, Edomtɔwo, Zoba-fiawo kple Filistitɔwo godoo va kpe; eye afi sia afi si wòtrɔ ɖo la, eɖua wo dzi.
ENGLISH: 47 And Saul took the kingship over Israel, and made war round about on all his enemies, on Moab and on the Bene-ʽAmmon and on Edom and on the kings of Sobah and on the Philistines, and wherever he went he was victorious; and he built up a power.

EWE: 48 Ewɔ kalẽ, eye wòsi Amalektɔwo heɖe Israel tso ame siwo da adzo wo la si me.
ENGLISH: 48 And he defeated the ʽAmalekites and delivered Israel out of the hands of its pillagers.

EWE: 49 Saul viŋutsuwoe nye Yonatan, Yiswi kple Malki-Sua. Eye vinyɔnuvi eve nɔ esi; tsitsitɔ ŋkɔe nye Merab, eye ɖevitɔ ŋkɔe nye Mikal.
ENGLISH: 49 And Saul’s sons were Jonathan and Ishbaal and Malkishuaʽ; and of his two daughters the older one’s name was Merab and the younger’s Mical;

EWE: 50 Saul srɔ̃ ŋkɔe nye Ahinoam, Ahimaaz vinyɔnu.
ENGLISH: 50 and the name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoʽam the daughter of Ahimaʽas.

EWE: Eƒe aʋafia ŋkɔe nye Abner, Ner vi, ame si nye Saul fofo nɔvi.
ENGLISH: And his general’s name was Abner the son of Saul’s uncle Ner:

EWE: 51 Saul fofoe nye Kis, eye Abner fofo Ner nye Abiel vi.
ENGLISH: 51 Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were the sons of Abiel.

EWE: 52 Saul wɔ aʋa kple Filistitɔwo vevie le eƒe agbenɔɣi katã. Ne Saul kpɔ ŋutsu sesẽ alo kalẽtɔ aɖe ko la, ekplɔnɛ dea eƒe aʋawɔlawo dome.
ENGLISH: 52 And there was hard fighting with the Philistines throughout Saul’s time; and as Saul saw any brave and stalwart man he took him into his service.

EWE: 1 Samuel
ENGLISH: 1 Samuel

EWE: 15 Eye Samuel gblɔ na Saul be: “Yehowa dɔm be masi ami na wò nàzu fia ɖe eƒe dukɔ Israel dzi; eya ta ɖo to nàse Yehowa ƒe nya.
ENGLISH: 15 And Samuel said to Saul “I was the one whom Jehovah sent to anoint you king over his people Israel: now obey Jehovah’s words.

EWE: 2 Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Mabia akɔnta Amalektɔwo le nu si wowɔ ɖe Israel ŋu, esi wotso ɖe eŋu le mɔ dzi, esime Israel tso Egipte gbɔna la ta.
ENGLISH: 2 Says Jehovah of Armies, ‘I have taken up what the ʽAmalekites did to Israel, that they beset them on the way when they were coming up out of Egypt.

EWE: 3 Eya ta yi ɖasi Amalektɔwo, eye nàtsrɔ̃ wo kple woƒe nuwo katã gbidigbidi. Mègakpɔ nublanui na wo o; ke boŋ nàwu wo: ŋutsu kple nyɔnu, ɖevi kple vi nono, nyi kple alẽ, kposɔ kple tedziwo siaa.’”
ENGLISH: 3 Now go and attack the ʽAmalekites and destroy without quarter all that belongs to them; have no mercy on them; put to death man and woman, child at play and baby at the breast, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”

EWE: 4 Eya ta Saul yɔ dukɔ la ƒo ƒu, eye wòxlẽ wo le Telaim, aʋawɔla afɔzɔlawo le ŋutsu akpe alafa eve, eye Yuda ŋutsuwo le akpe ewo.
ENGLISH: 4 And Saul summoned the people and mustered them at Telam, ten thousand infantry;

EWE: 5 Eye Saul va Amalek dua gbɔ hede xa ɖe bali la me.
ENGLISH: 5 and Saul came to the capital of ʽAmalek and lay in ambush in the arroyo.

EWE: 6 Eye Saul gblɔ na Kenitɔwo be: “Midzo, mite ɖa, midzo le Amalektɔwo dome, ne magatsrɔ̃ mi kpe ɖe wo ŋu o. Elabena mieve Israel-viwo nu esime wotso Egipte gbɔna.” Ale Kenitɔwo te ɖa le Amalektɔwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 6 And Saul said to the Cainites “Go and move out from among the ʽAmalekites, that I may not sweep you away with them, you who befriended all the sons of Israel when they were coming up out of Egypt”; and the Cainites moved out from among the ʽAmalekites.

EWE: 7 Emegbe Saul yi ɖasi Amalektɔwo tso Havila va ɖo keke Sur, si le Egipte ŋgɔ ke.
ENGLISH: 7 And Saul made havoc of the ʽAmalekites from Havilah till you come to Shur, east of Egypt,

EWE: 8 Elé Amalek-fia Agag agbagbee, eye wòtsɔ yi tsrɔ̃ ame bubuawo katã gbidii.
ENGLISH: 8 and captured Agag, the king of the ʽAmalekites, alive, and massacred all the people without quarter.

EWE: 9 Ke Saul kple dukɔ la mewɔ naneke Agag o, wokpɔ alẽ nyuitɔwo, nyiwo kple lã siwo da ami, kpakple agbowo kple nu nyuiwo katã ta. Womedi be yewoatsrɔ̃ wo o. Ke nu siwo katã nye nu siwo ŋu viɖe mele o kple esiwo womedi o la koe wotsrɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 9 But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fatlings and the he-lambs, and everything good, and would not destroy them; but all insignificant and undesirable articles they destroyed as deodand.

EWE: 10 Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Samuel be:
ENGLISH: 10 And Jehovah’s word came to Samuel,

EWE: 11 “Evem be meɖo Saul fiae, elabena etrɔ le yonyeme, eye mewɔ nye nyawo dzi o.”
ENGLISH: 11 “I am sorry I made Saul king; for he has turned back from following me, and has not acted on my words.”

EWE: Nu sia te ɖe Samuel dzi, ale be wòfa avi na Yehowa zã blibo la katã.
ENGLISH: And Samuel was shocked, and cried to Jehovah all night.

EWE: 12 Esi Samuel fɔ kaba be yeayi aɖakpe Saul le ŋdi la, wogblɔ na Samuel be: “Saul yi Karmel, eye wòɖi ŋkuɖodzikpe ɖe afi ma na eɖokui.
ENGLISH: 12 But the first thing in the morning Samuel started to meet Saul; and Samuel was told “Saul came to Carmel and went down to the Gilgal, and is erecting himself a monument”; and he turned and went across and down to the Gilgal to Saul, and found him offering a burnt-offering to Jehovah, the prime of the booty he had brought from the ʽAmalekites.

EWE: Eye wòtrɔ yi Gilgal.” 13 Esi Samuel va Saul gbɔ mlɔeba la, Saul gblɔ nɛ be: “Yehowa neyra wò.
ENGLISH: 13 And Samuel came to Saul, and Saul said to him “Jehovah bless you; I have acted on Jehovah’s words.”

EWE: Mewɔ Yehowa ƒe gbe dzi.” 14 Ke Samuel biae be: “Ke alẽwo kple nyiwo ƒe xɔxlɔ̃ kae nye ema sem mele ɖe to me?”
ENGLISH: 14 And Samuel said “Then what is this bleating that my ears are full of, and this mooing I hear?”

EWE: 15 Saul ɖo eŋu be: “Amalektɔwo gbɔe wokplɔ wo tsoe, elabena dukɔ la kpɔ alẽ kple nyi nyuitɔwo ta, be woatsɔ wo asa vɔ na Yehowa wò Mawu; ke míetsrɔ̃ nu susɔeawo ya gbidigbidi.”
ENGLISH: 15 And Saul said “They brought them from the ʽAmalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and cattle for sacrificing to your God Jehovah; and the rest we destroyed.”

EWE: 16 Eye Samuel gblɔ na Saul be: “Tɔ gbɔ! Magblɔ nya si Yehowa gblɔ nam etsɔ zã me la na wò.”
ENGLISH: 16 And Samuel said “Wait and let me tell you what Jehovah said to me last night.”

EWE: Eya ta egblɔ nɛ be: “Ƒo nu!”
ENGLISH: And he said “Say it.”

EWE: 17 Eye Samuel gblɔ be: “Ðe menye esime mèbu ɖokuiwò ɖe naneke me o ye nèzu Israel-toawo ƒe tatɔ, eye Yehowa si ami na wò nèzu fia ɖe Israel nu oa?
ENGLISH: 17 And Samuel said “If you do seem small to yourself, are you not head of the tribes of Israel? And Jehovah anointed you king over Israel,

EWE: 18 Emegbe Yehowa dɔ wò ɖe dɔgbe gblɔ be: ‘Heyi, ne nàtsrɔ̃ nu vɔ̃ wɔla siwo nye Amalektɔwo gbidigbidi.
ENGLISH: 18 and Jehovah sent you on an errand and said ‘Go and destroy the ʽAmalekite sinners without quarter, and fight them till you have exterminated them’:

EWE: Wɔ aʋa kpli wo va se ɖe esime nètsrɔ̃ wo vɔ keŋkeŋ.’ 19 Ekema nu ka tae mèɖo to Yehowa ƒe gbe o?
ENGLISH: 19 why did you not obey Jehovah, but pounced on the booty and did what displeased Jehovah?”

EWE: Ke boŋ nètsɔ ŋukeklẽ yi ɖaha aboyonuwo hewɔ nu si nye vɔ̃ le Yehowa ŋkume!” 20 Ke Saul gblɔ na Samuel be: “Gake meɖo to Yehowa ƒe gbe ɖe! Mede nu si gbe Yehowa dɔm ɖo, eye mekplɔ Amalek-fia Agag vɛ, ke metsrɔ̃ Amalektɔwo ya gbidigbidi.
ENGLISH: 20 And Saul said to Samuel “I did obey Jehovah, and went on the errand Jehovah sent me on, and brought Agag the king of the ʽAmalekites, and destroyed the ʽAmalekites without quarter;

EWE: 21 Gake dukɔ la ha alẽwo kple nyi siwo nye aboyonu siwo wòle be woatsrɔ̃ gbidii la ƒe nyuitɔwo be woatsɔ asa vɔ na Yehowa wò Mawu le Gilgal.”
ENGLISH: 21 but the people took out of the booty sheep and cattle, the prime of the deodand to sacrifice to your God Jehovah at the Gilgal.”

EWE: 22 Eye Samuel ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ðe numevɔsawo kple vɔsawo dzea Yehowa ŋu wu toɖoɖo Yehowa ƒe gbea?
ENGLISH: 22 And Samuel said “Does Jehovah take as much pleasure in burnt-offerings and sacrifices as in obedience to Jehovah’s words?

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: Obedience is better than sacrifice, and listening than rams’ fat.

EWE: Toɖoɖo nyo wu vɔsa, eye nusese nyo wu agbo ƒe ami; 23 elabena aglãdzedze kple afakaka ƒe nu vɔ̃e sɔ, eye dada kple akunyawɔwɔ kpakple trɔ̃subɔsubɔe sɔ.
ENGLISH: 23 For disobedience is the sin of soothsaying, and pushing is fetish and teraphim.

EWE: Esi nègbe Yehowa ƒe nya ta la, eya hã gbe wò be màgaɖu fia o.”
ENGLISH: Because you have rejected Jehovah’s word, he has rejected you as king.”

EWE: 24 Eye Saul gblɔ na Samuel be: “Mewɔ nu vɔ̃, meda Yehowa ƒe se kple wò nyawo dzi, elabena ɖe mevɔ̃ dukɔ la, eya tae meɖo to woƒe gbe ɖo.
ENGLISH: 24 And Saul said to Samuel “I did wrong, in that I have violated Jehovah’s charge and your words, because I was afraid of the people and obeyed them.

EWE: 25 Ke azɔ meɖe kuku, tsɔ nye nu vɔ̃ la kem, eye nàgbugbɔ ayi kplim, ne maɖade ta agu na Yehowa.”
ENGLISH: 25 But now pardon my sin and come back with me and let me do reverence to Jehovah.”

EWE: 26 Ke Samuel gblɔ na Saul be: “Nyemagbugbɔ kpli wò o, elabena ègbe Yehowa ƒe nya, eye Yehowa hã gbe wò be màgaɖu fia ɖe Israel dzi o.”
ENGLISH: 26 But Samuel said to Saul “I will not come back with you, because you have rejected Jehovah’s word and Jehovah has rejected you from being king over Israel”;

EWE: 27 Esi Samuel trɔ be yeadzo la, Saul lé eƒe awu ʋlaya si ŋu abɔ mele o la toga, eye wòdze.
ENGLISH: 27 and Samuel turned to go. And Saul took hold of the flap of his robe, and it tore;

EWE: 28 Eye Samuel gblɔ nɛ be: “Yehowa dze Israel ƒe fiaɖuƒe la le asiwò egbea, eye wòatsɔe ana hawòvi si nyo wu wò.
ENGLISH: 28 and Samuel said to him “Jehovah has torn the kingship of Israel off from you and given it to your better.

EWE: 29 Hekpe ɖe eŋu la, Israel ƒe Bubutɔ la maka aʋatso o, eye matrɔ susu o, elabena menye amegbetɔ wònye, ne wòatrɔ susu o.”
