EWE: 3 Le ɣleti adrelia me, esi Israel-viwo le woƒe duwo me keŋ la, wova kpe ta ɖe Yerusalem kple tame ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 8 And these are the heads of families, and their lists, that came up with me in the reign of King Artaxerxes from Babylon:

EWE: 2 Eye Yesua, Yehozadak vi, kple nɔvia siwo nye nunɔlawo kpakple Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple nɔviawo tso, eye woɖi Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe vɔsamlekpui, ne woasa numevɔwo le edzi, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe Mawu vavã la ƒe ame Mose ƒe Sea me ene.
ENGLISH: 2 Of the sons of Pinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel.

EWE: 3 Ale woɖi vɔsamlekpui la ɖe afi si wònɔ tsã, togbɔ be wonɔ vɔvɔ̃m na dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã wo hã, eye wode asi ŋdi kple fiẽ numevɔwo sasa me le edzi na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: Of the sons of David, Hattush, 3 one of the sons of Shecaniah. Of the sons of Pareosh, Zecariah, and with him were listed, of males, a hundred and fifty.

EWE: 4 Emegbe woɖu Agbadɔŋkekenyui la abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖii ene, eye wosa numevɔ gbe sia gbe ɖe xexlẽme la nu, abe ale si woɖo na ŋkeke ɖe sia ɖe ene.
ENGLISH: 4 Of the sons of Pahath Moab, Eljehoʽenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred, the males.

EWE: 5 Emegbe wosa numevɔ si wosana ɖaa, kple dzinu yeyewo ƒe vɔsawo, kple Yehowa ƒe azãɖuɣi kɔkɔewo katã ƒe vɔsawo kpakple ame sia ame si lɔ̃ faa va na nu Yehowa la ƒe numevɔwo.
ENGLISH: 5 Of the sons of Zattu, Shecaniah the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred, the males.

EWE: 6 Wodze numevɔwo sasa na Yehowa gɔme tso ɣleti adrelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi, togbɔ be womeɖo Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔa gɔme anyi haɖe o hã.
ENGLISH: 6 And of the sons of ʽAdin, ʽEbed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty, the males.

EWE: 7 Wotsɔ ga na kpekpalawo kple aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo, eye wotsɔ nuɖuɖu, nunono kple ami na Sidontɔwo kple Tirotɔwo, ne woatsɔ sedertiwo tso Lebanon ava Yopa le ƒu la nu, abe ale si Persia-fia Kores ɖe mɔ na woe ene.
ENGLISH: 7 And of the sons of ʽElam, Jeshaʽiah the son of ʽAthaliah, and with him seventy, the males.

EWE: 8 Esi wogbɔ va Mawu vavã ƒe aƒe la gbɔ le Yerusalem ƒe ƒe evelia ƒe ɣleti evelia me la, Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple Yesua, Yehozadak vi, kpakple wo nɔvi susɔeawo, nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo, kpakple ame siwo katã gbɔ tso aboyo me va Yerusalem la dze dɔ gɔme; eye woɖo Lewi vi siwo xɔ ƒe blaeve kple edzivɔ la be woakpɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe dɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 8 And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Micael, and with him eighty, the males.

EWE: 9 Eya ta Yesua, viawo kple nɔviawo, Kadmiel kple viawo, Yuda viwo, wɔ ɖeka be yewoanye dzikpɔlawo anɔ Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la me dɔwɔlawo nu, hekpe ɖe Henada viwo, wo viwo kple wo nɔvi siwo hã nye Lewi viwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 9 And of the sons of Joab, ʽObadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen, the males.

EWE: 10 Esi xɔtulawo ɖo Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la gɔme anyi la, nunɔla siwo le nunɔlawu me, eye kpẽwo le wo si, kple Lewi vi siwo nye Asaf viwo, eye gakogoewo le wo si la tso be woakafu Yehowa abe ale si Israel-fia David ɖoe ene.
ENGLISH: 10 And of the sons of Bani, Shelomith the son of Josiphiah, and with him a hundred and sixty, the males.

EWE: 11 Eye wodzi ha kafu Yehowa heda akpe nɛ, “elabena eya amea nyo; eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si nu metsina o la li na Israel tegbee.”
ENGLISH: 11 And of the sons of Bebai, Zecariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight, the males.

EWE: 12 Eye nunɔlawo dometɔ geɖe kple Lewi viwo kpakple tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔawo nu, siwo nye ame tsitsi siwo kpɔ xɔ tsãtɔ la, fa avi hehehe esi woɖo xɔ sia gɔme anyi wokpɔ, esime ame bubu geɖewo ya le aseye tsom hoo.
ENGLISH: 12 And of the sons of ʽAzgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him a hundred and ten, the males.

EWE: 13 Ale dukɔ la mete ŋu de vovo dzidzɔɣli la kple ameawo ƒe avifafa la dome o, elabena dukɔ la le ɣli dom sesĩe, eye woƒe gbe de didiƒe ke. Ezra
ENGLISH: 13 And of the sons of Adonikam latecomers, and these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaʽiah; and with them sixty, the males.

EWE: 4 Eye anyigba la dzi tɔwo ɖe dzi le Yuda dukɔ la ƒo, eye wodo vɔvɔ̃ na wo le xɔ la tutu me.
ENGLISH: 14 And of the sons of Bigvai, Ghuthai the son of Zaccur, and with him seventy, the males.

EWE: 5 Woda aɖaŋuɖolawo ɖe wo ŋu be woagblẽ woƒe ɖoɖowo me le Persia-fia Kores ƒe ŋkekeawo katã me, va se ɖe Persia-fia Dario ƒe fiaɖuɣi.
ENGLISH: 15 And I gathered them to the river that runs into Ahava; and when we had been there three days I looked over the people and the priests, and did not find any of the sons of Levi there.

EWE: 6 Le Ahasweros ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe gɔmedzedze la, woŋlɔ agbalẽ tsɔ tso Yuda kple Yerusalem nɔlawo nu. 7 Le Persia-fia Artasasta ŋɔli la, Bislam, Mitredat, Tabeel kple eƒe hadɔwɔla susɔeawo ŋlɔ agbalẽ na fia Artasasta; eye woɖe agbalẽ la gɔme ɖe Aramgbe me hetsɔ Aram ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ŋlɔe. 8 Dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe tatɔ Rehum kple agbalẽŋlɔla Simsai ŋlɔ agbalẽ tsɔ tso Yerusalem nu ɖo ɖe fia Artasasta ale: 9 (Dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe tatɔ Rehum kple agbalẽŋlɔla Simsai kpakple woƒe hadɔwɔla susɔeawo, siwo nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple nutodziɖula siwo ƒe ɖoƒe ɖiɖi wu, agbalẽŋlɔlawo, Erektɔwo, Babilontɔwo, ame siwo le Susa, siwo nye Elamtɔwo, 10 kple dukɔ siwo katã bubutɔ gã Asenapar ɖe aboyoe hena wole Samaria duwo me la dometɔ susɔeawo kpakple ame siwo susɔ ɖe nuto si le Tɔsisia godo me la gbɔe wòtso, azɔ 11 agbalẽ si woɖo ɖee la me nyawoe nye esi.) “Na fia Artasasta, tso wò subɔvi siwo le nuto si le Tɔsisia godo gbɔ: Azɔ 12 fia la nanyae be, Yudatɔ siwo tso gbɔwò va mía gbɔ le afi sia la va ɖo Yerusalem. Wogbugbɔ le du dzeaglã vɔ̃ɖi la tsom, wole gliawo nu wum, eye wole gɔmeɖoanyiawo ɖɔm ɖo. 13 Azɔ fia la nanyae be ne wogbugbɔ du sia tso eye wowu eƒe gliawo nu la, ekema woagbe adzɔ, nudzɔdzɔ, alo mɔtaho nana, eye ana fiawo ƒe gakpɔkpɔ dzi naɖe kpɔtɔ. 14 Ke esi wònye fiasã me dzee míeɖuna, eye medze be míanɔ ekpɔm nu nagblẽ le fia ƒe viɖekpɔƒe ŋu alea o tae míedɔ ame ne míana fia la nanya, 15 ne woadzro tɔgbuiwo ƒe nuŋlɔɖigbalẽwo me. Àkpɔe le nuŋlɔɖigbalẽawo me be du sia nye du dzeaglã, si nana nu gblẽna le fiawo kple nutowo ŋu, eye ame siwo dea aglãdzedze ɖe dziɖuɖu ŋu ƒe dzi ƒo la le eme tso gbe aɖe gbe ke. Esia tae wotsrɔ̃ du sia ɖo. 16 Míedi be míana fia nanyae be, ne wogbugbɔ du sia tso hewu eƒe gliwo nu la, ekema màgakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe nuto si le Tɔsisia godo la dzi o.” 17 Fia la ɖo du ɖe dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe tatɔ Rehum kple agbalẽŋlɔla Simsai kpakple woƒe hadɔwɔla susɔe siwo le Samaria kple nuto siwo susɔ ɖe Tɔsisia godo be: “Medo gbe na mi! Azɔ 18 woxlẽ agbalẽ si mieɖo ɖe mí la le ŋkunyeme eme kɔ nyuie. 19 Eya ta mede se be woaku nyaa me, eye wokpɔe be du la nye du si tsia tsitre ɖe fiawo ŋu tso gbe aɖe gbe ke, eye wònye du si me wodzea aglã hewɔa ʋunyaʋunya le.
ENGLISH: 16 And I sent Eliʽezer, Ariel, Shemaʽiah and Elnathan and Jarib and Elnathan and Nathan and Zecariah and Meshullam, headmen, and Jojarib and Elnathan, expounders, 17 and commissioned them to Iddo the head at the place Casiphja, and gave them a message for speaking to Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphja to bring us servitors for the house of our God; 18 and they brought us, in accordance with the good hand of our God resting on us, a sensible man, one of the sons of Mahli the son of Levi the son of Israel, Sherebiah, and his sons and his brothers, eighteen of them; 19 and Hashabiah and with him Jeshaʽiah, of the sons of Merari, his brothers and sons, twenty of them; 20 and of the temple servants whom David and the generals had given for the service of the Levites two hundred and twenty temple servants, all listed by name.

EWE: 20 Fia sesẽwo nɔ Yerusalem nu, woɖu nuto siwo katã le Tɔsisia godo dzi, eye woxe adzɔ kple nudzɔdzɔ kpakple mɔtaho na wo. 21 Azɔ mide se, ne ŋutsu siawo nadzudzɔ dɔa wɔwɔ, ale be woagagbugbɔ du ma atso o, va se ɖe esime meɖe gbe hafi.
ENGLISH: 21 And I proclaimed a fast there by the river Ahava to present ourselves submissively before our God to seek from him a clear course for us and our children and all our chattels.

EWE: 22 Mikpɔ nyuie be miatsɔ nya sia vevie, ne nu nagagblẽ le fia ƒe viɖekpɔƒe ŋu ɖe edzi o.” 23 Ke esi woxlẽ agbalẽ si tso Fia Artasasta gbɔ la me nyawo le Rehum kple agbalẽŋlɔla Simsai kpakple woƒe hadɔwɔlawo ŋkume la, wowɔ kaba yi ɖe Yudatɔwo gbɔ le Yerusalem, eye wotɔ te wo sesẽe. 24 Ɣemaɣie Mawu ƒe xɔ si nɔ Yerusalem la ƒe dɔ la tɔ; eye dɔ la tsi akpo dzi va se ɖe Persia-fia Dario ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe evelia me. Ezra 5:1-17
ENGLISH: 22 For I had been ashamed to ask the king for troops and riders to help us against enemies on the road, because I had said to the king “All who betake themselves to our God have over them his hand for their good, but those who leave him have over them his might and anger.” 23 And we fasted and besought our God about this, and he granted our prayer.

EWE: 2 Ɣemaɣie Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple Yesua, Yehozadak vi, gbugbɔ dze Mawu ƒe xɔ si nɔ Yerusalem la tutu gɔme; eye Mawu ƒe nyagblɔɖilawo nɔ wo ŋu hekpe ɖe wo ŋu. 3 Ɣemaɣi Tatenai, si nye nutodziɖula le nuto si le Tɔsisi la godo kple Setar-Bozenai kpakple woƒe hadɔwɔlawo va wo gbɔ hebia wo be: “Ame kae ɖe mɔ na mi be miatu xɔ sia ahawu gli sia nu?” 4 Eye wobia wo hã be: “Ŋutsu siwo le xɔ sia tum la ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe?” 5 Ke Mawu ƒe ŋku le Yudatɔwo ƒe ametsitsiwo ŋu, ale be womena wodzudzɔ o, va se ɖe esime woɖo nyatakaka la ɖe Dario, eye wòɖo agbalẽ ɖa le nya sia ŋu.
ENGLISH: 24 And I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, and Sherebiah and Hashabiah and with them ten of their brothers, 25 and weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the vessels, the contribution for the house of our God that the king and his counselors and generals and all of Israel that were to be found had made; 26 and I weighed into their hands six hundred and twenty-five hundredweight of silver, and a hundred silver vessels, two hundredweight, ninety-six hundredweight of gold, 27 and twenty gold stoups, two hundred and seventy ounces, and ten vessels of fine bright bronze as desirable as gold.

EWE: Ameawo le dɔa dzi vevie, eye dɔa le zɔ ɖem le woƒe kutrikuku ta. 9 Eye míebia gbe woƒe ametsitsiawo be: ‘Ame kae ɖe mɔ na mi be miatu xɔ sia ahawu gli sia nu?’ 10 Míebia woƒe ŋkɔwo hã, ale be míaŋlɔ ŋutsu siwo nye woƒe tatɔwo la ƒe ŋkɔwo ne míana nànya. 11 “Ale woɖo nya ŋu na míe nye esi: ‘Dziƒowo kple anyigba ƒe Mawu la ƒe subɔlawoe míenye, eye míegbugbɔ le xɔ si Israel-fia gã aɖe tu hewu enu ƒe gbogbo aɖewoe nye esi va yi la tum.
ENGLISH: 28 And I said to them “You are consecrated to Jehovah, and the vessels are sacred, and the silver and gold are a donation to our fathers’ God Jehovah; 29 guard them carefully till you weigh them out before the chiefs of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of families of Israel in the vestries at Jehovah’s house at Jerusalem.” 30 And the priests and Levites received the weighed-out silver and gold and the vessels to bring to Jehovah’s house at Jerusalem.

EWE: 12 Ke esi mía fofowo do dziku na dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la ta la, etsɔ wo de asi na Kaldeatɔ Babilon-fia Nebukadnezar, ame si gbã xɔ sia heɖe aboyo dukɔ la yi Babilon.
ENGLISH: 31 And we set out from the river of Ahava on the twelfth of the first month to go to Jerusalem; and our God’s hand was over us, and he delivered us from the hands of enemy and prowler on the road.

EWE: 13 Ke le Babilon-fia Kores ƒe ƒe gbãtɔ me la, Fia Kores ɖe gbe be woagbugbɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ sia atu. 14 Azɔ hã, Fia Kores fɔ sikanu kple klosalonu siwo nɔ Mawu ƒe aƒe la me siwo Nebukadnezar lɔ tso gbedoxɔ si nɔ Yerusalem me yi Babilon ƒe gbedoxɔ me la, eye wòtsɔ wo na Sesbazar, ame si Kores ɖo nutodziɖulae.
ENGLISH: 32 And we came to Jerusalem and stayed there three days, 33 and on the fourth day the silver and gold and vessels were weighed out in our God’s house into the hands of Priest Meremoth the son of Urijah, and with him Eleazar the son of Pinehas, and with them the Levites Jozabad the son of Jeshuaʽ and Noʽadiah the son of Binnui, 34

EWE: 15 Kores gblɔ nɛ be: “Tsɔ nu siawo.
ENGLISH: all by count and by weight; and all the weight was written down.

EWE: Tsɔ wo yi ɖada ɖe gbedoxɔ si le Yerusalem la me, eye na woagbugbɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ la atu ɖe afi si wònɔ tsã.” 16 Ale Sesbazar va, eye wòɖo Mawu ƒe xɔ si le Yerusalem la gɔme anyi; eye wole etutu dzi tso ɣemaɣi va se ɖe fifia, ke womekpɔ wu enu o.’
ENGLISH: 35 At that time those who had come in from their serfdom, the returned deportees, presented burnt-offerings to the God of Israel: twelve steers on behalf of all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven sheep, twelve he-goats for sin-offering, all a burnt-offering to Jehovah.

EWE: 17 “Eya ta ne enyo fia ŋu la, ekema woaku nu me le fia ƒe kesinɔnudzraɖoƒe le Babilon afi ma, ne woakpɔe ɖa be ele eme vavã be Fia Kores ɖe gbe be woagbugbɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ ma atu ɖe Yerusalem hã; eye ale si fia la tso nya me le nya sia ŋu la, negblɔe ɖo ɖe mí.”
ENGLISH: 36 And they gave the king’s mandates to the king’s satraps and the governors of Trans-Euphrates, and they helped on the people and the house of God.

EWE: Ezra
ENGLISH: Ezra

EWE: 6 Ɣemaɣie Fia Dario ɖe gbe woku nu me le nuŋlɔɖidzraɖoƒewo, afi si wodzraa nu veviwo ɖo le Babilon la me. 2 Eye woke ɖe agbalẽ xatsaxatsa aɖe ŋu le mɔ́ sesẽ si le Ekbatana le Media nutoa me, eye nyatakaka si le emee nye esi: 3 “Le Fia Kores ƒe ƒe gbãtɔ me la, Fia Kores de se le Mawu ƒe xɔ si le Yerusalem la ŋu be: ‘Woagbugbɔ xɔ la atu wòanye teƒe si woasa vɔ le, woaɖo egɔme anyi, eye wòakɔ abɔklugui blaade akeke abɔklugui blaade, 4 eye woatsɔ kpe gãwo aɖo amli etɔ̃, eye amli ɖeka nanye ati; woaxe eŋu fewo tso fiaƒe me.
ENGLISH: 9 And when these things were finished the chiefs approached me with the word “The people, Israel, and the priests and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the peoples of the countries with their abominable ways, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, the ʽAmmonite, the Moabite, the Egyptian, and the Amorite; 2 for they have taken daughters of theirs as wives for themselves and their sons, and mixed the sacred blood with the peoples of the countries; and the hands of the chiefs and the magnates have been first in this disloyalty.” 3 And when I heard this word I tore my cloak and my robe and tore hair out of my head and beard and sat down horror-struck, 4 and all who were alarmed by the words of the God of Israel came together to me on account of the deportees’ disloyalty.

EWE: 5 Azɔ hã, woagbugbɔ Mawu ƒe aƒe la me sikanu kple klosalonu siwo Nebukadnezar lɔ tso gbedoxɔ si nɔ Yerusalem me va Babilon la ayii, ne woatsɔ wo ada ɖe wo teƒe le gbedoxɔ si le Yerusalem la me, eye woada wo ɖe Mawu ƒe xɔ la me.’
ENGLISH: And I sat horror-struck till evening grain-offering 5 and at evening grain-offering I stood up from my abasement and, in the torn pieces of my cloak and robe, fell on my knees and spread out my hands to my God Jehovah and said

EWE: 6 “Eya ta Tatenai, si nye nutodziɖula le nuto si le Tɔsisi la godo, Setar-Bozenai kple miaƒe hadɔwɔla siwo nye nutodziɖula siwo ƒe ɖoƒe ɖiɖi wu, siwo le nuto si le Tɔsisia godo me
ENGLISH: 6 “My God, I am ashamed and humiliated to raise my face, my God, to you, because our offenses are so many as to overtop our heads and our guilts so great as to reach to the skies.

EWE: mite ɖa tso afi ma! 7 Miɖe asi le Mawu ƒe xɔtudɔ ma ƒe nya me. Yudatɔwo ƒe nutodziɖula la kple Yudatɔwo ƒe ametsitsiwo agbugbɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ la atu ɖe afi si wònɔ tsã.
ENGLISH: 7 Since our fathers’ days we have been in great guilt up to this day, and for our offenses we, our kings, our priests, have been given into the hands of the kings of one country after another in slaughter, in serfdom, and in plundering and shame of face as at this day.

EWE: 8 Azɔ hã mele se dem tso nu si miawɔ na Yudatɔwo ƒe ametsitsi siawo be woagbugbɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ ma atu ŋu: Miɖe ga le fia ƒe kesinɔnudzraɖoƒe tso adzɔ si woxɔna tso nuto si le Tɔsisia godo me na ŋutsu siawo enumake be woatsɔ ayi dɔa dzi, eye migaxe mɔ na wo o.
ENGLISH: 8 And now for a brief moment there has come favor from our God Jehovah, letting us have an escaping remnant and giving us a peg in his holy place, our God brightening up our eyes and making us germ of a little life in our slavery

EWE: 9 Eye ne nu bubu aɖe gahiã, eɖanye nyitsuiwo, agbowo, alẽviwo ɖe dziƒo ƒe Mawu la ƒe numevɔsawo ŋu, eɖanye lu, dze, wain kple ami o, mina woatsɔe ana wo ɖaa gbe sia gbe dedie, abe ale si ko nunɔla siwo le Yerusalem agblɔe ene, 10 ne woayi edzi anɔ vɔ siwo dzea dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la ŋu la sam, eye woanɔ gbe dom ɖa ɖe fia la kple viawo ƒe agbe ta.
ENGLISH: 9 for we are slaves, but in our slavery our God has not abandoned us but has given the kings of Persia a friendly disposition toward us, giving us a germ of life for rearing aloft the house of our God and for reoccupying his waste sites, and giving us a fence in Judah and Jerusalem.

EWE: 11 Eye mele gbe ɖem be, ame sia ame si ada se sia dzi la, woaɖe ati le eƒe xɔ me ahee ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe aƒe atrɔ azu dua ƒe nugododeƒe le nya sia ta. 12 Eye Mawu si na eƒe ŋkɔ le afi ma la naɖe fia sia fia si ado eƒe asi ɖa be yeagblẽ sedede sia me alo agbã Mawu ƒe xɔ sia si le Yerusalem la ɖa le zi dzi, eye wòatu nu kple dukɔ sia dukɔ si awɔ nenema la hã.
ENGLISH: 10 And now, our God, what shall we say after this, when we have forsaken your commandments 11 which you enjoined upon us through your servants the prophets, ‘The country you are going into to take possession of it is a filthy country by the filth of the peoples of the countries, by their abominable doings in which they have filled it from end to end with their uncleanness; 12 now do not give your daughters to their sons nor take their daughters for your sons; and you are not to attempt anything for their welfare or advantage, world without end, in order that you may be strong and eat the good things of the country and pass the possession on to your sons forever.’ 13 And after all that has come upon us by our evil deeds and our great guilt, when you, our God, have held down part of our guilt and given us such survival as this, 14 should we go back to breaking your commandments and intermarrying with these abominable peoples? will you not be angry at us to the point of finishing us off to leave no remnant or survivors? 15 Jehovah, God of Israel, you are doing the right thing that we remain surviving as we are this day; here we are before you in our guilt, because there is no such thing as standing before you on this account.”

EWE: Nye Dario ye de sea.

15 Wowu xɔ la nu le dzinu Adar ƒe ŋkeke etɔ̃lia dzi, le Fia Dario ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe adelia me. 16 Eye Israel-viwo, nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo kple ame siwo nɔ aboyo me tsã la ƒe ame susɔeawo kɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ sia ŋu kple dzidzɔ.
ENGLISH: 10 And as ʽEzra made his prayer and confession, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, there gathered to him a very great assembly out of Israel, men and women and children; for the people were weeping at a great rate.

EWE: 17 Eye wotsɔ nyitsu alafa ɖeka, agbo alafa eve kple alẽvi alafa ene vɛ ɖe Mawu ƒe xɔ sia ŋu kɔkɔ ŋuti, kple gbɔ̃tsu wuieve be woatsɔ asa nuvɔ̃vɔ ɖe Israel blibo la katã ta, le Israel-toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu.
ENGLISH: 2 And Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, of the sons of ʽElam, replied to ʽEzra “We have been disloyal to our God and taken in foreign women out of the peoples of the country; but now there is a chance of hope for Israel as to this.

EWE: 19 Eye ame siwo nɔ aboyo me tsã la ɖu Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui la le ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke wuienelia dzi.
ENGLISH: 3 Now let us make a covenant to our God to turn out all women and what is born from them in accordance with my lord’s recommendations.”

EWE: 20 Nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo siaa kɔ wo ɖokuiwo ŋu, ale wo katã ŋu kɔ; wowu Ŋutitotolã na ame siwo katã nɔ aboyo me tsã, wo nɔvi nunɔlawo kple woawo ŋutɔwo.
ENGLISH: And those who were alarmed by the commandments of our God stood up 4 and said “Stand up, because the matter is in your sphere, and you have us with you; take a strong stand, and act.”

EWE: 21 Eye Israel-vi siwo gbɔ tso aboyo me la ɖui, hekpe ɖe ame sia ame si wɔ ɖeka kpli wo heɖe eɖokui ɖa tso anyigbadzidukɔwo ƒe nu makɔmakɔwo gbɔ be yewoasubɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 5 And ʽEzra stood up and swore the chiefs of the priests and Levites and all Israel to act in accordance with these words, and they took the oath.

EWE: Enye Seraya vi, Azariya vi, Hilkiya vi, 2 Salum vi, Zadok vi, Ahitub vi, 3 Amariya vi, Azariya vi, Merayot vi, 4 Zerahiya vi, Uzi vi, Buki vi, 5 Abisua vi, Finehas vi, Eleazar vi, nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔ Aron ƒe vi. 6 Ezra sia trɔ gbɔ tso Babilon.
ENGLISH: 6 And ʽEzra left his place before the house of God and went to the vestry of Jehohanan the son of Eljashib and spent the night there, not eating nor drinking water, because he was mourning over the deportees’ disloyalty.

EWE: Fia la lɔ̃ ɖe nu siwo katã wòbia dzi nɛ, elabena Yehowa eƒe Mawu ƒe asi le edzi. 7 Eya ta Israel-viwo dometɔ aɖewo, nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo, hadzilawo, agbonudzɔlawo kple gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo dometɔ aɖewo yi Yerusalem le Fia Artasasta ƒe ƒe adrelia me. 8 Eye Ezra va ɖo Yerusalem le ɣleti atɔ̃lia me, le fia la ƒe ƒe adrelia me.
ENGLISH: 7 And they sent around a proclamation in Judah and Jerusalem to all the returned deportees to gather at Jerusalem; 8 and anybody who did not come in after three days should, by resolution of the chiefs and elders, have all his chattels declared deodand and be excommunicated from the assembly of the deportees.

EWE: 9 Elabena eya ŋutɔ ɖoe be yewoaho le Babilon le ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi, eye le ɣleti atɔ̃lia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la, eva ɖo Yerusalem, le eƒe Mawu ƒe asi nyui si le edzi la ta.
ENGLISH: 9 And all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered at Jerusalem after three days; that was the ninth month, on the tenth of the month; and all the people sat down in the square of the house of God, shivering over the business and because of the rainy weather.

EWE: 10 Elabena Ezra dzra eƒe dzi ɖo, ne wòadzro Yehowa ƒe Se la me ahawɔ edzi, eye wòafia ɖoɖowo kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋuti mɔfiamewo le Israel.
ENGLISH: 10 And Priest ʽEzra stood up and said to them “You have been disloyal and taken in foreign women, adding to Israel’s guilt.

EWE: 11 Agbalẽ si Fia Artasasta tsɔ na nunɔla Ezra si nye nugbugbɔŋlɔla, ame si nye Yehowa ƒe sedede kple ɖoɖo siwo wòtsɔ na Israel la srɔ̃la bibi la, me nyawoe nye esi: 12 “Artasasta, fiawo ƒe fia, le nya sia ŋlɔm na nunɔla Ezra, si nye dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la ƒe Se la gbugbɔŋlɔla: Wò ŋutifafa nede blibo.
ENGLISH: 11 But now give praise to your fathers’ God Jehovah and do what he will approve, and separate yourselves from the peoples of the country and from the foreign women.” 12 And all the assembly answered with a loud voice “We will do just as you are telling us to.

EWE: Azɔ 13 mede se be, Israel dukɔ si kpɔtɔ le nye dziɖuƒe la kple woƒe nunɔlawo kpakple Lewi viwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe si lɔ̃ be yeayi Yerusalem kpli wò la, neyi faa.
ENGLISH: 13 The people are numerous, though, and it is the rainy season, and we have not the strength to stand outdoors; and it is not a one-day or two-day business, because we have committed a great deal of crime in this respect.

EWE: 14 Elabena fia la kple eƒe adaŋudela adreawoe le dɔwòm be nàyi aɖaku nu me akpɔ be wole wɔwɔm ɖe wò Mawu ƒe Se si le asiwò la dzi le Yuda kple Yerusalem hã, 15 eye nàtsɔ klosalo kple sika si fia la kple eƒe adaŋudelawo lɔ̃ faa na Israel ƒe Mawu, ame si ƒe nɔƒe le Yerusalem, la ayii, 16 hekpe ɖe klosalo kpakple sika siwo katã nèxɔ le Babilon nutowo katã me, kple nu siwo dukɔ la kple nunɔlawo, ame siwo na nu faa ɖe woƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe si le Yerusalem ŋu la, ŋuti. 17 Eye nàtsɔ ga sia aƒle nyitsuwo, agbowo, alẽviwo kple wo ŋuti nuɖuvɔsawo kpakple wo ŋuti nunovɔsawo, eye nàtsɔ wo asa vɔ le wò Mawu ƒe aƒe la me vɔsamlekpui si le Yerusalem la dzi. 18 “Eye nu sia nu si nyo wò kple nɔviwòwo ŋu miebe miatsɔ klosalo kple sika susɔea awɔe la, miwɔe le mia Mawu la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu nu.
ENGLISH: 14 Let our chiefs be a standing commission for all the assembly, and let everybody in our cities who has taken in foreign women come at specified times, and with them the elders and judges of each city, till we have turned back our God’s anger from us as to this matter.” 15 (Only Jonathan the son of ʽAsahel and Jahziah the son of Tikvah made a stand against this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.) 16 And the returned deportees did so; and Priest ʽEzra picked out men, heads of the families they belonged to, all by name, and they took their seats on the first day of the tenth month to see about the matter; 17 and they finished with all the men who had taken in foreign women by the first day of the first month.

EWE: 19 Eye nu siwo katã wotsɔ na wò ɖe wò Mawu ƒe aƒe la ŋuti subɔsubɔdɔa ŋu la, tsɔ wo na le Mawu ŋkume le Yerusalem. 20 Eye nu bubu siwo hiã le wò Mawu ƒe xɔ la ŋu, si wòle na wò be nàna la, tsɔ wo le fia ƒe kesinɔnudzraɖoƒe la ana. 21 “Nye Fia Artasasta, mede se na kesinɔnuwo dzi kpɔla siwo katã le nuto si le Tɔsisia godo be, nu sia nu si nunɔla Ezra, dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la ƒe Se la gbugbɔŋlɔla la abia mi la, miwɔe nɛ kaba, 22 va se ɖe klosalo talento alafa ɖeka, lu kɔr alafa ɖeka, wain baf alafa ɖeka kple ami baf alafa ɖeka dzi kpakple dze ale si nu wodi.
ENGLISH: 18 And there were found of the sons of the priests that had taken in foreign women, of the sons of Jeshuaʽ the son of Josadak and his brothers Maʽasejah and Eliʽezer and Jarib and Gedaliah; 19 and they gave their hands to turn out their wives, and were obligated to indemnity of a ram for their guilt; 20 and of the sons of Immer Hanani and Zebadiah; 21 and of the sons of Harim Maʽasejah and Elijah and Shemaʽiah and Jehiel and ʽUzzijah; 22 and of the sons of Pashhur Eljoʽenai, Maʽasejah, Ishmaʽel, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Eleasah.

EWE: 23 Woawɔ nu sia nu si ƒe se dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la de ɖe dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la ƒe aƒea ŋu la veviedodotɔe, ne dɔmedzoe nagava fia ƒe dziɖuƒe la kple viawo dzi o.
ENGLISH: 23 And of the Levites, Jozabad and Shimei and Kelajah (that is, Kelitah), Pethahiah, Jehudah, and Eliʽezer.

EWE: 24 Azɔ meɖe ame wuieve le nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo dome ɖe vovo, siwo nye Serebiya kple Hasabiya hekpe ɖe wo nɔvi ewo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 24 And of the singers, Eljashib.

EWE: 32 Ale míeva Yerusalem, eye míenɔ afi ma ŋkeke etɔ̃.
ENGLISH: And of the gatemen, Shallum and Telem and Uri.

EWE: 33 Eye le ŋkeke enelia dzi la, míeda klosalo kple sika kpakple ŋudɔwɔnuawo le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me de asi na nunɔla Meremot, Uriya vi, eye Eleazar, Finehas vi, nɔ egbɔ, eye Yozabad, Yesua vi kple Noadiya, Binui vi, ame siwo nye Lewi viwo, hã nɔ wo gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 25 And of Israel, of the sons of Pareosh Ramiah and Izzijah and Malkijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Malkijah and Benajah; 26 and of the sons of ʽElam Mattaniah and Zecariah and Jehiel and ʽAbdi and Jeremoth and Elijah; 27 and of the sons of Zattu Eljoʽenai, Eljashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth and Zabad and ʽAzizah; 28 and of the sons of Bebai Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, ʽAthli; 29 and of the sons of Bani Meshullam, Malluc, Jedaʽiah, Jashub, Ishal, Jeremoth; 30 and of the sons of Pahath Moab Ghadna and Kelal, Benajah, Maʽasejah, Mattaniah, Besalel and Binnui and Menassheh; 31 and of the sons of Harim Eliʽezer, Isshijah, Malkijah, Shemaʽiah, Shimeon, 32 Benjamin, Malluc, Shemariah; 33 and of the sons of Hashum Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Menassheh, Shimei; 34 and of the sons of Bani Maʽadi, ʽAmram and Uel, 35 Benajah, Bediah, Keluhi, 36 Vaniah, Meremoth, Eljashib, 37 Mattaniah, Mattenai and Jaʽasai; 38 and of the sons of Binnui Shimei 39 and Shelemiah and Nathan and ʽAdajah; 40 and of the sons of ʽAzgad Shashai, Sharai, 41 ʽAzarel and Shelemjahu, Shemariah, 42 Shallum, Amariah, Joseph; 43 of the sons of Nebo Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai and Joel, Benajah.

EWE: 34 Woxlẽ nuawo katã eye woda wo heŋlɔ woƒe kpekpeme blibo la katã ɖi.
ENGLISH: 44 All these had married foreign wives, and some of them wives and had begotten sons.

EWE: Ezra
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 2 Woawo ŋutɔwo kple wo viŋutsuwo ɖe wo vinyɔnuwo dometɔ aɖewo.
ENGLISH: 1 The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah.

EWE: Amegãawo kple dziɖulaawo koŋ ye xɔ ŋgɔ le nuteƒemawɔmawɔ sia me.” 3 Ke esi mese nya sia ko la, medze nye awu kple nye awu ʋlaya, eye menyɔ nye taɖa kple nye ge ƒe ɖewo, nye nu ku eye mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖi. 4 Eye ame sia ame si dea bubu Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe nyawo ŋu la ƒo ƒu ɖe gbɔnye le aboyomeawo ƒe nuteƒemawɔmawɔ ta, esime nye nu ku mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖi va se ɖe fiẽnuɖuvɔsaɣi.
ENGLISH: And in the month of Kislev of the year twenty I was in Susa Citadel, 2 and in came Hanani, one of my brothers, he and some men from Judah; and I asked them about the Judahites, the survivors that remained from the foreign servitude, and about Jerusalem; 3 and they told me “The remnant, those who remain there in the province from the foreign servitude, are in great hardship and in ignominy, and the wall of Jerusalem is broken and its gates have been burned down.”

EWE: 5 Le fiẽnuɖuvɔsaɣi la, metso le nye nuxaxa la me, eye nye awu kple nye awu ʋlaya kpɔtɔ le dzedze le ŋunye, eye medze klo heke nye abɔwo me na Yehowa nye Mawu. 6 Eye megblɔ be: “Oo nye Mawu, ŋu le kpeyem, eye wòte ɖe dzinye be mawu mo dzi na wò, Oo nye Mawu, elabena míaƒe vodadawo dzi ɖe edzi gbɔ mía ta, eye míaƒe fɔɖiɖi la kɔ yi ɖatɔ keke dziƒowo ke.
ENGLISH: 4 And when I heard these things I sat down and wept, and mourned some days, and was fasting and praying before the God of heaven; 5 and I said “Ah, Jehovah, God of heaven, great and terrible Deity, keeper of covenant and friendship for those who love you and keep your commandments, 6 let your ears be attentive and your eyes open to hear your servant’s prayer as I am today praying before you day and night for your servants the sons of Israel and acknowledging the sins of the sons of Israel, that we have sinned against you

EWE: 7 Tso mía tɔgbuiwo ŋɔli ke la, fɔɖiɖi gã aɖe le mía dzi va se ɖe egbe sia; eye le míaƒe vodadawo ta wotsɔ mía kple míaƒe fiawo kpakple míaƒe nunɔlawo de asi na anyigbadzifiawo, na yi kple aboyoɖeɖe, na haha kple ŋukpedodo, abe ale si wòle egbe sia ene.
ENGLISH: I and my family have sinned; 7 we have treated you badly and not kept your commandments and usages and laws which you enjoined on your servant Moses.

EWE: 8 Ke azɔ la, Yehowa mía Mawu, ève mía nu vie, esi nèkpɔtɔ ame aɖewo ɖi na mí, eye nèna dedienɔƒe mí le wò nɔƒe kɔkɔe la, ne míaƒe ŋku dzi nakɔ, Oo mía Mawu, ne agbe vi aɖe nagaɖo mía me le míaƒe kluvinyenye la me.
ENGLISH: 8 Remember the word you charged your servant Moses with: ‘You will be disloyal

EWE: 9 Elabena togbɔ be kluviwo míenye hã la, mía Mawu megblẽ mí ɖi le míaƒe kluvinyenye la me o; ke boŋ eve mía nu le Persia-fiawo ŋkume, ne wòana agbe nagaɖo mía me, ne míafɔ mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖe te, ne míaɖɔ eƒe gli gbagbãwo ɖo, ne wòana gli nanɔ mía si le Yuda kple Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: I will scatter you among the peoples; 9 and you will come back to me and keep my commandments and live up to them

EWE: 10 “Azɔ mía Mawu, nya kae míagblɔ le esia megbe?
ENGLISH: if your exile be at the edge of the sky, from there I will gather you and bring you to the place I choose to install my name there.’ 10 And those are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great power and strong hand.

EWE: Elabena míegblẽ wò sededewo ɖi, 11 se siwo nède na mí to wò subɔla nyagblɔɖilawo dzi be: ‘Anyigba si dzi yim miele be miaxɔe wòazu mia tɔ la, anyigba makɔmakɔ wònye le anyigba la dzi dukɔwo ƒe nuwɔna makɔmakɔwo ta, le woƒe ŋunyɔnuwɔwɔ si wotsɔ yɔ edzi tso go ɖeka me va se ɖe go kemɛ me le woƒe makɔmakɔnyenye ta la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 11 Ah, Lord, let your ears be attentive to your servant’s prayer and to the prayer of your servants who find pleasure in fearing your name, and give your servant success today and make him an object of sympathy to this man” (I was a cupbearer of the king’s).

EWE: Ezra
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 10 Esi Ezra nɔ gbea dom ɖa, eye wònɔ eɖokui me ʋum, nɔ avi fam hetsyɔ akɔ anyi ɖe Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ŋgɔ la, Israel-viwo ƒe ha gã aɖe, si me tɔwo nye ŋutsuwo, nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo, va ƒo ƒu ɖe egbɔ, eye dukɔ la nɔ avi fam vevie.
ENGLISH: 2 And in the month of Nisan of the year twenty of King Artaxerxes he had wine before him, and I took up the wine and gave it to the king.

EWE: 2 Eye Sekaniya, Yehiel vi, si tso Elam viwo dome gblɔ na Ezra be: “Míawo la, míewɔ nuteƒe na mía Mawu la o, elabena míeɖe dutanyɔnuwo tso anyigba la dzi dukɔwo dome.
ENGLISH: And I had not been sad before him; 2 and the king said to me “How comes your face to be sad, when you are not sick? this is nothing else but a heart sadness.”

EWE: 3 Azɔ mina míabla nu kple mía Mawu la, ne míaɖe nyɔnuawo katã kple vi siwo wodzi la ɖa, le Yehowa kple ame siwo dea bubu mía Mawu ƒe sedede la ŋu la ƒe mɔfiafia nu.
ENGLISH: And I was very much afraid, 3 but said to the king “May the king live forever

EWE: Mina míawɔ ɖe Sea dzi.
ENGLISH: how should my face not be sad when the city, the burial-place of my fathers, is lying waste and its gates have been burned down?”

EWE: 4 Tso, elabena wò dɔdeasie, eye míele megbe na wò.
ENGLISH: 4 And the king said to me “What is it you want to ask for?”

EWE: Sẽ ŋu, eye nàwɔe.” 5 Ale Ezra tso, eye wòna tatɔ, siwo tso nunɔla Lewi viwo kple Israel blibo la katã dome la ka atam be yewoawɔ ɖe nya sia dzi.
ENGLISH: And I prayed to the God of heaven 5 and said to the king “If the king thinks best and if you hold your servant in esteem, that you would send me to Jerusalem, to the city of my fathers’ graves, to rebuild it.”

EWE: Ale woka atam. 6 Azɔ Ezra tso le Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ŋgɔ, eye wòyi Yehohanan, Eliyasib vi, ƒe xɔ me.
ENGLISH: 6 And the king said to me, while my lady was sitting beside him, “In how long would you go and when would you be back?”

EWE: Esi wòyi afi ma la, meɖu nu alo no tsi hã o, elabena ele nu xam le aboyomeawo ƒe nuteƒemawɔmawɔ la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: And the king approved and sent me; and I set him a date.

EWE: 7 Azɔ wona woɖe gbeƒã le Yuda kple Yerusalem blibo la be aboyomeawo katã nava ƒo ƒu ɖe Yerusalem; 8 eye ame si mava le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me abe ale si amegãwo kple ametsitsiawo ɖoe ene o la, woaɖo asi eƒe nunɔamesiwo katã dzi, eye woaɖe eya ŋutɔ ɖa le aboyomeawo ƒe ha la me.
ENGLISH: 7 And I said to the king “If the king thinks best, let me be given letters to the governors of Trans-Euphrates to pass me through till I come to Judah, 8 and a letter to Asaph the king’s forester to give me timber for constructing the citadel gates for the house and for the wall of the city and for the house I am to occupy”; and the king gave me these, in accordance with God’s kindly hand upon me.

EWE: 9 Eya ta Yuda kple Benyamin ŋutsuwo katã va ƒo ƒu ɖe Yerusalem le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me le ɣleti asiekelia ƒe ŋkeke blaevelia dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 And I came to the governors of Trans-Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters; and the king sent with me army officers and cavalry.

EWE: 10 Eye nunɔla Ezra tso hegblɔ na wo be: “Miewɔ nuteƒe o, elabena mieɖe dutanyɔnuwo, eye miena Israel ƒe fɔɖiɖi dzi ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: 10 And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobijah the ʽAmmonite slave heard of it and took it very hard that somebody had come to attempt something good for the sons of Israel.

EWE: 11 Azɔ miʋu mia ɖokuiwo me na Yehowa, mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, eye miwɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu. Miɖe mia ɖokuiwo ɖa tso anyigba la dzi dukɔwo kple dutanyɔnu siawo ŋu.” 12 Eye ha blibo la katã gblɔ kple gbe sesẽ be: “Míelɔ̃ be míawɔ nya si nègblɔ la dzi pɛpɛpɛ.
ENGLISH: 11 And I came to Jerusalem and was there three days; 12 and I rose in the night, I and a few men with me (I had not told anybody what God had put it into my heart to do for Jerusalem), but had no beast with me except the beast I rode on.

EWE: 13 Ke hã dukɔ la sɔ gbɔ, eye wònye tsidzaɣi.
ENGLISH: 13 And I went out by the Valley Gate in the night to the front of the Dragon Spring and to the Dump Gate, and kept inspecting the walls of Jerusalem, how they were broken and its gates had been burned down.

EWE: Manya wɔ be woatɔ ɖe xexe o, eye menye ŋkeke ɖeka alo eve ƒe dɔe o, elabena míaƒe aglãdzedzea nu sẽ ŋutɔ le nya sia me.
ENGLISH: 14 And I went over to the Spring Gate and to the King’s Reservoir, and there was no way for the beast to get over with me on its back.

EWE: 14 Eya ta míeɖe kuku, mina míaƒe amegãwo nanɔ ha blibo la teƒe; eye ame siwo katã le míaƒe duwo me, siwo ɖe dutanyɔnuwo la nava le ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiawo dzi, eye du sia du ƒe ametsitsiwo kple eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo nava kpli wo, va se ɖe esime míana mía Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ si wòdo ɖe mía ŋu la nu nafa le nya sia me.”
ENGLISH: 15 And I kept on up the Arroyo in the night, and kept inspecting the wall; and I came back and went in by the Valley Gate, and home; 16 and the men on guard did not know where I had gone and what I was doing, and thus far I had not told the Judahites and the priests and the nobles and the magnates and the rest of the administrators.

EWE: 15 Gake Yonatan, Asahel vi kple Yahzeya, Tikva vi, tsi tsitre ɖe nya sia ŋu; eye Mesulam kple Sabetai, siwo nye Lewi viwo de wo dzi.
ENGLISH: 17 And I said to them “You see for yourselves the bad state we are in, how Jerusalem is lying waste and its gates have been burned down.

EWE: 16 Ke aboyometsolawo wɔ nu si dzi woda asi ɖo; eye nunɔla Ezra kple tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔawo nu siwo katã ƒe ŋkɔwo woyɔ ɖekaɖeka la, ɖeɖe va ƒo ƒu le ɣleti ewolia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi ne woagalé ŋku ɖe nya la ŋu; 17 eye kaka ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ naɖo la, wokpɔ ŋutsu siwo katã ɖe dutanyɔnuwo ƒe nya la gbɔ vɔ. 18 Eye wokpɔ be nunɔlawo ƒe vi aɖewo hã ɖe dutanyɔnuwo: ame siwo tso Yesua, Yehozadak vi, ƒe viwo kple nɔviawo domee nye Maaseya, Eliezer, Yarib kple Gedaliya.
ENGLISH: Come on, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem and not be a butt for insults any longer”; 18 and I told them of God’s hand, how it had rested kindly on me, and all the words of the king, what he had said to me; and they said “Let us stand up and build,” and took heart for the good cause.

EWE: 19 Gake wodo ŋugbe be yewoaɖe asi le yewo srɔ̃wo ŋu, eye esi yewoɖi fɔ ta la, yewoana agbo ɖeka ɖe yewoƒe fɔɖiɖi la ta. 20 Ame siwo tso Imer viwo domee nye Hanani kple Zebadiya; 21 ame siwo tso Harim viwo domee nye Maaseya, Eliya, Semaya, Yehiel kple Uziya; 22 ame siwo tso Pashur viwo domee nye Elioenai, Maaseya, Ismael, Netanel, Yozabad kple Eleasa.
ENGLISH: 19 And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobijah the ʽAmmonite slave and Gusham the Arab heard of it and made fun of us and treated us contemptuously, and said “What’s that you are doing? rebelling against the king?” 20 But I gave them their answer, “The God of heaven himself will make us successful, and we his worshipers will stand up and build; but you have no share nor right nor memories in Jerusalem.”

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 3 Eye wogblɔ nam be: “Ame siwo susɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi, siwo meyi aboyo me o la le nɔnɔme sesẽ ŋutɔ aɖe me, eye wònye ŋukpe sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: 3 And High Priest Eljashib and his brother priests stood up and built the Sheep Gate

EWE: Wogbã Yerusalem ƒe gli la, eye wotɔ dzo eƒe agbowo.”
ENGLISH: it was they who performed the ceremonies for it and hung the gates in the building

EWE: Nye kple fofonye ƒe aƒe la siaa míewɔ nu vɔ̃.
ENGLISH: and to the Hundred Tower, performed the ceremonies for it, to Hananel’s Tower.

EWE: 2 Eya ta fia la biam be: “Nu ka tae nèlé blanui evɔ mèle dɔ lém o?
ENGLISH: 2 And next the men of Jericho built.

EWE: Ale vɔvɔ̃ ɖom ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: And next Zaccur the son of Imri built.

EWE: 3 Eye megblɔ na fia la be: “Fia nenɔ agbe tegbee!
ENGLISH: 3 And the Fish Gate the sons of the Senaah built; it was they who framed the gateway and hung the gates in it and put in place the sockets for the bars, and the bars.

EWE: Nu ka tae nyemalé blanui o, esi du si me woɖi tɔgbuinyewo ɖo la zu aƒedo, eye dzo fiã eƒe agbowo keŋkeŋ?” 4 Eye fia la biam be: “Nu ka dim nèle?”
ENGLISH: 4 And next Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Hakkos repaired. And next Meshullam the son of Berekiah the son of Meshezabel repaired.

EWE: Enumake medo gbe ɖa na dziƒowo ƒe Mawu la.
ENGLISH: And next Sadok the son of Baʽana repaired.

EWE: 5 Eye meɖo eŋu na fia la be: “Ne enyo fia ŋu, eye wò subɔvi ƒe nu nyo ŋuwò la, ekema ɖom ɖe Yuda, du si nye tɔgbuinyewo ɖiƒe la, ne magbugbɔe atso.” 6 Eye fia la, ame si xa fiasrɔ̃ bɔbɔ nɔ la, biam be: “Ɣeyiɣi didi kae wò mɔzɔzɔa axɔ, eye ɣekaɣie nàtrɔ agbɔ?”
ENGLISH: 5 And next the Tekoʽites repaired; but their grandees did not bring their necks into their Lord’s service. 6 And the Old-Town Gate Jojadaʽ the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodiah repaired; it was they who framed the gateway and hung the gates in it and put in place the sockets for the bars, and the bars.

EWE: Ale esi meɖo ɣeyiɣi na fiaa la, edze eŋu be yeaɖom ɖa.
ENGLISH: 8 Next ʽUzziel the son of Harhiah, goldsmiths, repaired.

EWE: Eya ta fia la tsɔ wo nam le nye Mawu ƒe asi nyui si le dzinye la ta.
ENGLISH: And next Hananiah the son of the perfumers repaired.

EWE: 9 Mlɔeba meva ɖo nutodziɖula siwo le nuto si le Tɔsisia godo la gbɔ, eye metsɔ fia la ƒe agbalẽawo na wo. Azɔ hã, fia la dɔ aʋakplɔlawo kple sɔdolawo ɖa kpe ɖe ŋunye.
ENGLISH: And they stoned up Jerusalem to the Broad Wall. 9 And next Rephajah the son of Hur, chief of half the department of Jerusalem, repaired.

EWE: 10 Esi Horontɔ Sanbalat kple Amonitɔwo ƒe dumegã Tobiya see la, mevivi wo nu be ame aɖe va nyui di ge na Israel-viwo o.
ENGLISH: 10 And next Jedajah the son of Harumaph repaired opposite his house. And next Hattush the son of Hashabnejah repaired.

EWE: 11 Mlɔeba meva ɖo Yerusalem, eye menɔ afi ma ŋkeke etɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 11 Malkijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahath Moab repaired a second assignment, and the Baking-Crock Tower.

EWE: 12 Eye nye kple ŋutsu ʋɛ aɖewo siwo le ŋunye la míefɔ le zã me, ke nyemegblɔ nu si nye Mawu de dzi me nam be mawɔ na Yerusalem la na ame aɖeke o, eye lã aɖeke menɔ ŋunye o, negbe esi dom menɔ la ko.
ENGLISH: 12 And next Shallum the son of Hallohesh, chief of half the department of Jerusalem, he and his daughters, repaired.

EWE: 13 Eye meto Balimegbo la nu do go le zã me le Dagãvudo la ŋgɔ ɖo ta Aɖukpogbo la gbɔ, eye melé ŋku ɖe Yerusalem ƒe gli siwo wogbã kple agbo siwo dzo fiã la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 13 The Valley Gate Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired; it was they who built it and hung the gates in the building and put in place the sockets for the bars, and the bars; and five hundred yards to the Dump Gate.

EWE: 14 Emegbe meyi ŋgɔ va ɖo Vudogbo la gbɔ kple Fia Ƒe Ta la gbɔ, eye teƒe aɖeke meli na lã si dom mele be wòato ayi ŋgɔ o.
ENGLISH: 14 And the Dump Gate Malkijah the son of Recab, chief of the department of Beth-hak-Kerem, repaired; it was he who built it and hung the gates in the building and put in place the sockets for the bars, and the bars.

EWE: 15 Gake meto bali la me le zã me henɔ ŋku lém ɖe glia ŋu, emegbe metrɔ va to Balimegbo la nu hetrɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 15 And the Spring Gate Shallun the son of Col-Hozeh, chief of the department of Mispah, repaired; it was he who built it and canopied it and hung the gates in the building and put in place the sockets for the bars, and the bars; and the wall by the Tunnel Reservoir at the King’s Garden and to the stairs that go down from David’s City.

EWE: 16 Dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔwo menya afi si meyi kple nu si meyi ɖawɔ o; eye nyemegblɔ nya aɖeke na Yudatɔwo, nunɔlawo, bubumewo, dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔawo kple ame bubu siwo le dɔa wɔ ge la haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 16 After him Nehemiah the son of ʽAzbuk, chief of half the department of Beth-Sur, repaired to opposite David’s Graves and to the Artificial Reservoir and to the Champions’ House.

EWE: 17 Emegbe megblɔ na wo be: “Mikpɔ nɔnɔme wɔnublanui si me míele, ale si Yerusalem zu aƒedo, eye wotɔ dzo eƒe agboawo la ɖa.
ENGLISH: 17 After him the Levites repaired, Rehum the son of Bani.

EWE: 2 Yeriko ŋutsuwo hã ɖɔ glia ɖo tso afi ma; eye Zakur, Imri vi, hã ɖɔe ɖo tso wo tɔ nu.
ENGLISH: After him Hashabiah, chief of half the department of Keilah, repaired for his department.

EWE: 18 Eya yome wo nɔviwo ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo: Bavai, Henada vi, si nye Keila nuto la ƒe afã dzi ɖula ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo.
ENGLISH: 18 After him their brothers repaired, Bavvai the son of Henadad, chief of half the department of Keilah.

EWE: 19 Eyome Ezer, Yesua vi, si nye Mizpa dziɖula, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa bubu si le todzimɔ si yi Aʋawɔnuwo Dzraɖoƒe le Sɔti la gbɔ la ɖo.
ENGLISH: 19 And ʽEzer the son of Jeshuaʽ, chief of Mispah, next repaired a second assignment, opposite the armory stairs at the angle.

EWE: 20 Eya yome Baruk, Zabai vi, do vevie nu ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa bubu si tso Sɔti la gbɔ va se ɖe keke nunɔlagã Eliyasib ƒe aƒe mɔnu ke la ɖo.
ENGLISH: 20 After him Baruc the son of Zabbai repaired a second assignment from the angle to the door of High Priest Eljashib’s house.

EWE: 21 Eya yome Meremot, Uriya vi, Hakoz vi, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa bubu si tso Eliyasib ƒe aƒe la ƒe mɔnu va se ɖe Eliyasib ƒe aƒe la ƒe mlɔenu la ɖo.
ENGLISH: 21 After him Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Hakkos repaired a second assignment, from the door of Eljashib’s house all along Eljashib’s house.

EWE: 22 Eya yome nunɔla siwo nye Yordan-nuto la me ŋutsuwo, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo.
ENGLISH: 22 And after him the priests repaired, the men of the Pale.

EWE: 23 Woawo yome Benyamin kple Hasub ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe aƒe ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 23 After them Benjamin and Hasshub repaired opposite their house.

EWE: Woawo yome Azariya, Maaseya vi, Ananiya vi, ɖɔ akpa aɖe ɖo le eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe gbɔ.
ENGLISH: After them ʽAzariah the son of Maʽasejah the son of ʽAnaniah repaired alongside his house.

EWE: 24 Le eya yome Binui, Henada vi, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa bubu si tso Azariya ƒe aƒe gbɔ yi Sɔti la gbɔ, va se ɖe keke dzogoe la dzi ke la ɖo.
ENGLISH: 24 After him Binnui the son of Henadad repaired a second assignment, from ʽAzariah’s house to the angle and to the corner.

EWE: 25 Eya yome Palal, Uzai vi ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo le Sɔti la kple xɔ tsrala si le Fia Ƒe Aƒe la ŋu ŋgɔ, si nye dzigbetɔ si le Dzɔlawo Ƒe Xɔxɔnu la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 25 Palal the son of Uzai from opposite the angle and the tower that bulges out from the upper royal palace with the court of the guard.

EWE: Eya yome Pedaya, Paros vi ɖo glia kplɔe ɖo.
ENGLISH: After him Pedajah the son of Pareosh.

EWE: 26 Gbedoxɔmesubɔla siwo nɔ Ofel ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo va ɖo keke Tsigbo la ŋgɔ le ɣedzeƒekpa dzi kple xɔ tsrala si do gɔ̃ɔ la ŋu ke.
ENGLISH: 26 And the temple servants lived on the castle ridge to opposite the Eastern Water Gate and the bulging-out tower.

EWE: 27 Woawo yome Tekoatɔwo ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa bubu si tso xɔ tsrala si do gɔ̃ɔ la ŋgɔ va ɖo keke Ofel gli la gbɔ ke la ɖo.
ENGLISH: 27 After him the Tekoʽites repaired a second assignment, from opposite the great bulging-out tower to the wall of the castle ridge.

EWE: 28 Nunɔlawo ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo tso Sɔgbo la tame, ame sia ame le eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 28 Above the Pony Gate the priests repaired, each opposite his own house.

EWE: 29 Woawo yome Zadok, Imer vi, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo le eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe ŋgɔ. Eya yome Semaya, Sekaniya vi, si nye Ɣedzeƒegbo la ŋu dzɔla, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo. 30 Eya yome Hananiya, Selemiya vi kple Hanun, si nye Zalaf vi adelia, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa bubu ɖo. Eya yome Mesulam, Berekiya vi, ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo le eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 29 After it Sadok the son of Immer repaired opposite his house, and after him Shemaʽiah the son of Shecaniah, the warder of the East Gate; 30 after him Hananiah the son of Shelemiah and Hanun the sixth son of Salaph a second assignment; after him Meshullam the son of Berekiah repaired opposite his vestry.

EWE: 31 Eya yome Malkiya, si nye sikanutulawo dometɔ ɖeka ɖɔ glia ƒe akpa aɖe ɖo va ɖo gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo kple asitsalawo ƒe aƒe la gbɔ, le Ŋkuléɖeŋugbo la ŋgɔ va se ɖe keke xɔtaxɔ dzogoedzitɔ la gbɔ ke.
ENGLISH: 31 After him Malkijah the son of the goldsmith repaired to the house of the temple servants and the traders, opposite the Assigned Tract Gate, and to the upper room on the corner.

EWE: 32 Eye sikanutulawo kple asitsalawo ɖɔ glia ɖo le xɔtaxɔ dzogoedzitɔ la kple Alẽgbo la dome.
ENGLISH: 32 And between the upper room on the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and the traders repaired.

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 4 Esi Sanbalat se be míegbugbɔ glia le ɖoɖom la, eku dzi nɛ, eye wòdo domedzoe vevie heɖe alɔme le Yudatɔwo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 6 But we built the wall, and the whole wall was connected halfway up, because the people’s hearts were in the work.

EWE: 2 Egblɔ le nɔviawo kple Samaria-ʋakɔ la ŋkume be: “Nu ka wɔm Yudatɔ beliawo le?
ENGLISH: 9 But we prayed to our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

EWE: Ðe wosusu be yewoate ŋuia? Ðe woasa vɔa?
ENGLISH: 15 And when our enemies had heard that we had learned of it and God had balked their scheme, we all went back to the wall, each to his work.

EWE: Ðe woawu enu le ŋkeke ɖeka mea?
ENGLISH: Nehemiah 5:1-19

EWE: Ðe woaho kpe ƒodzowo tso gli gbagbã siwo li kɔ ɖi la mea azãa?” 3 Ke Amonitɔ Tobiya le exa, eye wògblɔ be: “Gli si ɖom wole la, ne abei teti de edzi la, akaka woƒe kpegli la.” 4 Oo mía Mawu, see, elabena míezu alɔmeɖenu, eya ta na woƒe vlododo la natrɔ ava woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe ta dzi, eye nàna woaha wo ayi aboyonyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 And there arose a great outcry of the people and their wives against their brother Judahites; 2 and there were some who said “We are pawning our sons and daughters to get grain to eat to keep ourselves alive”; 3 and there were some who said “We are pawning our fields and vineyards to get grain in the famine”; 4 and there were some who said “We have borrowed money on our fields and vineyards for the king’s taxes.

EWE: 5 Mègatsyɔ nu woƒe vodada kple woƒe nu vɔ̃ dzi le ŋkuwòme o. Mègana woatutu wo ɖa o, elabena wodzu gliɖolaawo.
ENGLISH: 5 And now our flesh is like our brothers’ flesh, our sons like theirs, and here we are reducing our sons and daughters to slavery, and some of our daughters have been enslaved, and we are helpless; and the aristocrats have our fields and vineyards.”

EWE: 6 Ke míegbugbɔ ɖo gli bliboa va kpe wòɖo eƒe kɔkɔme ƒe afã, eye dzi nɔ dukɔ la ƒo ɖe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu. 7 Esi Sanbalat, Tobiya, Arabiatɔwo, Amonitɔwo kple Asdodtɔwo se be Yerusalem ƒe gliawo ɖɔɖɔ ɖo dɔa le zɔ ɖem nyuie eye wole glia ƒe gbagbãƒewo xem la, dzi ku wo vevie. 8 Eya ta wo katã woɖo nugbe be yewoava wɔ aʋa kple Yerusalem, ne yewoade zitɔtɔ eme.
ENGLISH: 6 And I was very angry when I heard their outcry and these words, 7 and I followed my impulse and came down on the aristocrats and magnates and said to them “You are taking usury of your brothers”; and I held a great assembly about them, 8 and said to them “We have been buying up our brother Judahites who had been sold to, the heathens, as much as we could, and you are even selling your brothers and they get sold to us”; and they were silent and could not find a word.

EWE: 9 Ke míedo gbe ɖa na mía Mawu la, eye míeɖo dzɔlawo ɖe wo ŋu zã kple keli. 10 Ke Yudatɔwo nɔ gbɔgblɔm be: “Ŋusẽ vɔ le ame siwo le gli gbagbãwo lɔm la ŋu, eye gli gbagbãwo gali zã míalɔ; míete ŋu le gli sia ɖo ge gbeɖe o.” 11 Eye míaƒe futɔwo nɔ gbɔgblɔm be: “Kaka woanya alo akpɔe la, míage ɖe wo dome, eye míawu wo ahana dɔ la natɔ.” 12 Ɣesiaɣi si Yudatɔ siwo te ɖe wo ŋu la va la, wogblɔna na mí enuenu be: “Woatso goawo katã me ava dze mía dzi.” 13 Eya ta meɖe amewo ɖo glia godo le akpa siwo le anyime siwo le nuvo, eye meɖo wo ɖe woƒe ƒomewo nu, eye wolé woƒe yiwo, akplɔwo kple datiwo ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 9 And I said “The thing you are doing is not good; will you not go in the fear of God on account of taunts from our heathen enemies? 10 And I too, my brothers and my men, are charging them interest in money and grain; let us leave off this interest-taking; 11 return to them at once their fields, vineyards, olive-trees, and houses, and the percent of money and grain and grape-juice and oil that you are charging them.” 12 And they said “We will return these and not try to get them; we will do just as you say”; and I, called the priests and swore them to do as they said; 13 I also shook out the bosom of my robe and said “So may God shake out from his house and his goods every man who does not make good this word, and so may he be shaken out and empty”; and all the assembly said “Amen” and praised Jehovah; and the people lived up to this word.

EWE: 14 Esi mekpɔ be vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo la, enumake metso, eye megblɔ na bubumeawo kple dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔwo kpakple ame susɔeawo be: “Migavɔ̃ wo o.
ENGLISH: 14 Besides, from the day when he commissioned me to be governor in Judah, from the year twenty to the year thirty-two of King Artaxerxes, twelve years, I and my brothers did not live at public expense.

EWE: Miaƒe susu nenɔ Yehowa, Ŋusẽtɔ si ŋu ŋɔdzi le la ŋu; eye miwɔ aʋa ɖe mia nɔviwo, mia viŋutsuwo, mia vinyɔnuwo, mia srɔ̃wo, kple miaƒe aƒewo ta.” 15 Esi míaƒe futɔwo se be míese nugbe si ɖom yewole, eye be Mawu vavã la gblẽ yewoƒe adaŋudede me la, mí katã míetrɔ yi ɖate gli la ɖoɖo.
ENGLISH: 15 But the former governors, the ones before me, had burdened the people and taken from them in bread and wine the equivalent of forty shekels of silver; their men too lorded it over the people; but I did not do thus, on account of the fear of God.

EWE: 16 Tso ŋkeke ma dzi la, nye ɖekakpuiawo ƒe afã wɔa dɔ la, eye woƒe afã hã léa akplɔwo, akpoxɔnuwo kple aŋutrɔwo ɖe asi eye wodo gawuwo.
ENGLISH: 16 And I also took hold in this work of the wall; and we bought no land, but all my men were gathered there at the wall.

EWE: Amegãwo tɔ ɖe Yuda ƒe aƒe blibo si nɔ 17 glia ɖom la megbe. Agbatsɔlawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe tsɔ asi ɖeka le dɔa wɔm, eye wotsɔ asi evelia lé aʋawɔnu ɖe asi. 18 Eye gliɖolawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ta yi ɖe ali hafi le glia ɖom, eye lãdzokula la le tsitre ɖe axanye.
ENGLISH: 17 And the Judahites and the magnates, a hundred and fifty men, and those who came to us from the nations around us, ate at my table; 18 and what was done for one day was one head of beef cattle, six select sheep or goats, and birds were done for me, and every ten days numerous skins of wine; and with this I did not take the public allowance, because the servitude was heavy on the people.

EWE: 19 Eye megblɔ na bubumeawo kple dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔawo kpakple ame susɔeawo be: “Dɔ la lolo hekeke ta, eye míekaka ɖe glia dzi hele adzɔge tso mía nɔewo gbɔ akpa.
ENGLISH: 19 Remember for me for good, my God, all that I did for this people.

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 5 Gake dukɔ la kple wo srɔ̃wo fa konyi vevie ɖe wo nɔvi Yudatɔwo ƒe nuwɔna ta. 2 Ame aɖewo gblɔ be: “Mía kple mía viŋutsuwo kple mía vinyɔnuwo míesɔ gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 6 And when the report came to Sanballat and Tobijah, and Gusham the Arab and the rest of our enemies, that I had built the wall and there were no breaches left in it (even up to that time I had not hung gates in the gateways), 2 Sanballat and Gusham sent word to me “Come, let us make an appointment for an interview in the villages on the Ono plain”

EWE: Ehiã be míakpɔ nu aɖu anɔ agbe.” 3 Ame aɖewo hã gblɔ be: “Míetsɔ míaƒe agblewo, míaƒe waingblewo kple míaƒe aƒewo le awɔba ɖom hafi le nu kpɔm le ɖuɖum le dɔŋɔli sia.” 4 Eye ame bubuwo hã gblɔ be: “Ðe míedo ga hafi xe adzɔ na fia la ɖe míaƒe agblewo kple míaƒe waingblewo ta.
ENGLISH: and they were planning to do me harm. 3 But I sent messengers to them with the word “I am doing a great piece of work and cannot go down; why should the work come to a stop while I take time off and go down to you?” 4 And they sent me this same word four times, and I gave them this same answer.

EWE: 5 Evɔ ɖeko míaƒe ŋutilã le abe mía nɔviwo tɔ ene, eye mía viwo le abe wo viwo ene; gake kpɔ ɖa, ele na mí be míatsɔ mía viŋutsuwo kple mía vinyɔnuwo awɔ kluviwoe, eye mía vinyɔnu aɖewo zu kluviwo xoxo. Evɔ wɔna aɖeke mele mía ŋu ne míatsi nu sia nu o, elabena míaƒe agblewo kple míaƒe waingblewo zu ame bubuwo tɔ keŋ.” 6 Esi mese woƒe ɣli kple nya siawo la, dɔme vem ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 5 And Sanballat sent his man to me a fifth time on this same errand with an open letter in his hand 6 in which was written “There is a report among the nations, and Gushmu says, you and the Judahites are planning to rebel; that is why you are building the wall; and they are going to have you for king”; things of this sort.

EWE: 7 Eya ta mede ŋugble tso nya siawo ŋu, eye mehe nya ɖe bubumeawo kple dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔawo ŋu hegblɔ na wo be: “Mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le deme biam tso eya ŋutɔ nɔvia si.”
ENGLISH: 7 “And you have also set up prophets to proclaim about you in Jerusalem ‘There is a king in Judah’; and now the report will come to the king”

EWE: Azɔ hã, meyɔ takpekpe gã aɖe le woawo ta.
ENGLISH: things of this sort.

EWE: 8 Eye megblɔ na wo be: “Míedze agbagba ale si míate ŋui gbugbɔ mía nɔvi Yudatɔ siwo wodzra na dukɔwo la ƒle, eye azɔ la, ɖe miawo ŋutɔwo miatsɔ mia nɔviwo adzra be míagbugbɔ wo aƒle le miawo hã mia sia?”
ENGLISH: “Now come on, let us talk it over.” 8 But I sent them word “There are no such facts as you say, but you are inventing them out of your own head.” 9 For they were all scaring us, thinking “Get them discouraged from the work, and it will not be done.”

EWE: Ke wozi kpi, eye womekpɔ nya aɖeke gblɔ o.
ENGLISH: But as it was, he braced up my determination.

EWE: Meɖe kuku, mina míadzudzɔ demexɔxɔ alea. 11 Meɖe kuku, migbugbɔ woƒe agblewo, woƒe waingblewo, woƒe amitibɔwo kple woƒe aƒewo na wo egbe sia, eye migbugbɔ deme, si nye akpa ɖeka le alafa ɖe sia ɖe me si miexɔna ɖe ga, nuku, wain yeye kple ami ta la hã na wo.” 12 Woɖo eŋu be: “Míagbugbɔ wo ana wo, eye míabia naneke tso wo si azɔ o. Míawɔe pɛpɛpɛ abe ale si nègblɔ ene.”
ENGLISH: 10 And I had gone into the house of Shemaʽiah the son of Delajah the son of Mehetabel, he being debarred, and he said “Let us make an appointment to meet in God’s house, in the interior of the temple, and shut the temple doors, because there are people coming in to kill you, coming in in the night to kill you.” 11 But I said “Is a man in my position to play the fugitive? and who in my position would go into the temple for his life?

EWE: Eya ta meyɔ nunɔlawo, eye mena ŋutsuawo ka atam be yewoawɔ ɖe ŋugbedodo sia dzi. 13 Azɔ hã, meʋuʋu nye awu ƒe akɔnu, eye megblɔ be: “Ale Mawu vavã la aʋuʋu ame sia ame si mawɔ ŋugbedodo sia dzi o la tso eƒe aƒe kple eƒe nunɔamesi gbɔe, eye wòaʋuʋui alea wòaɖi gbɔlo.” Eye ha blibo la katã ɖo eŋu be: “Amen!” Eye wode asi Yehowa kafukafu me. Eye dukɔ la wɔ ɖe ŋugbedodo sia dzi.
ENGLISH: I will not go in.” 12 And I recognized it was not God that sent him, that he uttered the prophecy against me, but Tobijah and Sanballat had hired him 13 in order that I might be scared into doing so and sinning, and they might have it as a scandal to taunt me with.

EWE: 14 Azɔ hã, tso gbe si gbe wòɖom nutodziɖulae le Yuda-nyigba dzi, tso Fia Artasasta ƒe ƒe blaevelia me va se ɖe ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ evelia me, si le ƒe wuieve la, mía kple nɔvinyewo míeɖu abolo si nutodziɖula dze na la kpɔ o.
ENGLISH: 14 My God, remember Tobijah and Sanballat suitably to these deeds of his, and also Noʽadiah the prophetess and the rest of the prophets who were scaring me.

EWE: 15 Ke nutodziɖula siwo do ŋgɔ nam ya do agba na dukɔ la, eye woxɔa klosalo sekel blaene le wo si ɖe abolo kple wain ŋu gbe sia gbe.
ENGLISH: 15 And the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.

EWE: Ke nye ya nyemewɔ nenema o, le esi mevɔ̃a Mawu ta. 16 Hekpe ɖe eŋu la, mekpe asi ɖe gliɖoɖodɔ sia ŋu, eye míeƒle agble aɖeke o; eye nye dɔlawo katã kpe asi ɖe dɔa ŋu le afi ma.
ENGLISH: 16 And when all our enemies heard of it and all the nations around us saw it, they felt themselves decidedly set down and knew that the doing of this work came from our God.

EWE: 17 Nye kplɔ̃ ŋue Yudatɔwo kple dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔawo, siwo nye ame alafa ɖeka blaatɔ̃, kple ame siwo tso dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã mí me va mía gbɔ la ɖua nu le. 18 Nu siwo woɖana nam gbe sia gbee nye nyitsu ɖeka, alẽ tiatia ade kple xewo; hekpe ɖe wain ƒomevi geɖe ŋu zi ɖeka ŋkeke ewo ɖe sia ɖe.
ENGLISH: 17 Besides, in those days the aristocrats of Judah had many of their letters going to Tobijah and Tobijah’s coming to them; 18 for many in Judah were sworn to him because he was son-in-law to Shecaniah the son of Arah and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berekiah.

EWE: Azɔ hã, nyemebia nuɖuɖu si nutodziɖula dze na la kpɔ o, elabena dɔ si le dukɔ sia dzi la kpe.
ENGLISH: 19 They also kept talking of his good points before me and carrying my words to him.

EWE: 19 Oo nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku nu siwo katã mewɔ ɖe dukɔ sia ta la dzi hena nye nyui.
ENGLISH: And Tobijah sent letters to scare me.

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 6 Esi wogblɔ na Sanbalat, Tobiya, Arabiatɔ Gesem kple míaƒe futɔ susɔeawo be megbugbɔ gli la ɖo, eye gbagbãƒe aɖeke mesusɔ ɖe eŋu o la (gake va se ɖe ɣemaɣi la, nyemekpɔ de ʋɔtru agboawo nu haɖe o), 2 enumake Sanbalat kple Gesem dɔ ame ɖem gblɔ be: “Va míaɖo ɣeyiɣi ado go le kɔƒe siwo le gbadzaƒe si le Ono Balia me la dometɔ ɖeka me.”
ENGLISH: 6 “These are the sons of the province, those who came up out of the serfdom of the deportees whom King Nebucadnessar of Babylon had deported to Babylon and came back to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his city, 7 who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshuaʽ, Nehemiah, Serajah, Raghamiah, Nahamani, Mordocai, Bishlan, Masparath, Bigvai, Rehum, Baʽanah.

EWE: Ke ɖe woɖo tame be yewoawɔ nu vevim.
ENGLISH: 43 “The Levites: the sons of Jeshuaʽ and Kadmiel, of the sons of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

EWE: 3 Eya ta medɔ ame ɖe wo be: “Dɔ gã aɖe wɔm mele, eya ta nyemate ŋu ava o.
ENGLISH: 44 “The singers: the sons of Asaph, a hundred and twenty-eight.

EWE: Nu ka tae matɔ te dɔa, eye madzo le dɔa gbɔ ava mia gbɔ?” 4 Wogaɖo du ɖem alea zi ene sɔŋ, eye metsɔ nya ma ke ɖo eŋu na wo.
ENGLISH: 45 “The gatemen: the sons of Shallum, the sons of Ater, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Akkub, the sons of Hatita, the sons of Shobai, total a hundred and thirty-nine.

EWE: 5 Eye Sanbalat dɔ eƒe dɔla ɖem kple nya ma ke zi atɔ̃lia, eye agbalẽ aɖe si nu wometre o la le esi. 6 Ale woŋlɔ ɖe emee nye esi: “Wosee le dukɔwo me, eye Gesem hã le gbɔgblɔm be, wò kple Yudatɔwo mieɖoe be yewoadze aglã.
ENGLISH: 57 “The sons of Solomon’s servants: the sons of Sotai, the sons of the Sophereth, the sons of Peruda, 58 the sons of Jaʽalah, the sons of Darkon, the sons of Giddel, 59 the sons of Shephatiah, the sons of Hattil, the sons of Pokereth Hassebajim, the sons of Amon.

EWE: Esia tae nèle gli sia ɖom, eye le nya si gblɔm wole nu la, èdi be yeazu fia ɖe wo nu.
ENGLISH: 60 Total of temple servants and sons of Solomon’s servants, three hundred and ninety-two.

EWE: 7 Èɖo nyagblɔɖilawo gɔ̃ hã ne woaɖe gbeƒã le ŋuwò le Yerusalem blibo la katã be, ‘Fia le Yuda si!’
ENGLISH: 61 “And these are those who came up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addan, Immer, and could not state their families and their blood, whether they belonged to Israel: 62 the sons of Delajah, the sons of Tobijah, the sons of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty-two.

EWE: Azɔ wole nya siawo gblɔ ge na fia la. Eya ta va ne míade adaŋu.”
ENGLISH: 63 “And of the priests the sons of Habajah, the sons of Hakkos, the sons of Barzillai who married one of the descendants of Barzillai the Gileadite and took their name, 64

EWE: 8 Ke meɖo eŋu ɖo ɖee be: “Nu siwo gblɔm nèle la dometɔ aɖeke mele eme o, ke boŋ wò ŋutɔe le wo kpam.” 9 Elabena wo katã wole didim be yewoado ŋɔdzi na mí hele gbɔgblɔm be: “Woƒe asiwo ado agblɔ ale be womawɔ dɔa ade goe o.”
ENGLISH: the registrars looked for the record of these, and they were not to be found; and they were disqualified from priestly functions, 65 and the Tarshata told them they were not to eat any of the holiest of the holy till there should stand a priest with the gift of Urim and Thummim.

EWE: Eya ta mele gbe dom ɖa be nàdo ŋusẽ nye asiwo. 10 Eye meyi Semaya, Delaya vi, Mehetabel vi, si do ʋɔ ɖe eɖokui nu la, ƒe aƒe me.
ENGLISH: 66 “The whole assembly as a unit came to forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty, 67 besides their slaves; of these, men and women, there were seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singers, men and women.

EWE: Eye wògblɔ be: “Na míaɖo ɣeyiɣi ado go le Mawu vavã ƒe aƒe la me, le gbedoxɔa me, eye míado gbedoxɔ la ƒe ʋɔtruwo, elabena wogbɔna wu wò ge.
ENGLISH: 68 And of their ponies there were seven hundred and thirty-six, of their mules two hundred and forty-five, 69 of their camels four hundred and thirty-five, of donkeys six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

EWE: Zã mee wogbɔna wu wò ge.” 11 Ke megblɔ be: “Ame abe nye ene nasia? Eye ame abe nye ene nayi gbedoxɔ me aganɔ agbea?
ENGLISH: 70 7:69 “And some of the number of the heads of families gave for the work: the Tarshata gave to the treasury a thousand drachmas of gold, fifty bowls, five hundred and thirty priests’ tunics.

EWE: Nyemele eme yi ge o!” 12 Eya ta mekpɔe dze sii be menye Mawue dɔe o, ke boŋ egblɔ nya sia ɖi ɖe ŋunye le esi Tobiya kple Sanbalat dae ta.
ENGLISH: 71 7:70 And some of the heads of families gave to the treasury of the work twenty thousand drachmas of gold and twenty-two hundred minas of silver.

EWE: 13 Wodae be wòado vɔvɔ̃ nam ne mawɔ nu vɔ̃, ale be woakpɔ nya le ŋunye agblẽ nye ŋkɔ ahado vlom.
ENGLISH: 72 7:71 And what the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drachmas of gold and two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ tunics.

EWE: 14 Oo nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku Tobiya kple Sanbalat dzi, le wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe nuwɔna siawo nu, hekpe ɖe nyɔnunyagblɔɖila Noadiya kple nyagblɔɖila susɔe siwo le didim be yewoado vɔvɔ̃ nam la ŋuti.
ENGLISH: 73 7:72 “And the priests and the Levites and part of the people settled in Jerusalem and in the country, and the singers and the gatemen and the temple servants in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.”

EWE: 15 Ale míewu gli la ɖoɖo nu le ŋkeke blaatɔ̃ vɔ eve me, le Elul ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ atɔ̃lia dzi.
ENGLISH: And the seventh month drew on, with the sons of Israel in their cities, Nehemiah 8:1-18

EWE: 16 Esi míaƒe futɔwo katã see, eye dukɔ siwo katã ƒo xlã mí la kpɔe ko la, ŋukpe lé wo vevie, eye wodze sii be, mía Mawu la gbɔe wòtso be wowɔ dɔ sia.
ENGLISH: 8 and all the people to a man came together in the square before the Water Gate and told ʽEzra the scribe to bring the book of Moses’s code which Jehovah had enjoined on Israel.

EWE: 17 Le ŋkeke mawo me la, Yuda bubumewo ŋlɔ agbalẽ geɖe ɖo ɖe Tobiya, eye Tobiya hã ŋlɔ agbalẽ geɖe tsɔ ɖo eŋu na wo.
ENGLISH: 8 And he read from the book of God’s code by sections, bringing out the sense, and they expounded the text.

EWE: 18 Yudatɔ geɖewo de edzi, elabena Sekaniya, Arak vi, ƒe toyɔvie wònye, eye via Yehohanan hã ɖe Berekiya viŋutsu Mesulam ƒe vinyɔnu.
ENGLISH: 9 And the Tarshata and Priest ʽEzra the scribe and the Levites who were expounding to the people said to all the people “The day is sacred to your God Jehovah; do not mourn nor weep”

EWE: 19 Azɔ hã, woƒoa nu nyui le eŋu le gbɔnye zi geɖe.
ENGLISH: for all the people were weeping as they heard the words of the code.

EWE: Eye wotoa nya siwo katã megblɔna la nɛ.
ENGLISH: For the sons of Israel had never done so since the days of Joshuaʽ the son of Nun until that day.

EWE: Eye Tobiya ɖoa agbalẽwo ɖa be yeatsɔ ado ŋɔdzi nam.
ENGLISH: And there was a very great merrymaking.
