ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 7 Esi wonya gbugbɔ gliawo ɖo vɔ ko la, mede ʋɔtruawo enumake, eye woɖo agbonudzɔlawo kple hadzilawo kpakple Lewi viwo. 2 Eye metsɔ Yerusalem dzi kpɔkpɔ de asi na nɔvinye Hanani kple Hananiya, si nye Mɔ́ la ƒe amegã, elabena enye ŋutsu si dzi woate ŋu aka ɖo, eye wòvɔ̃a Mawu vavã la wu ame bubu geɖewo.
ENGLISH: 9 And on the twenty-fourth day of this month the sons of Israel came together with fasting and in sackcloths and with earth on them, 2 and the descendants of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the guilts of their fathers.

EWE: 3 Eye megblɔ na wo be: “Womegaʋu Yerusalem ƒe agboawo o, va se ɖe esime ŋdɔ ʋu hafi, eye ne agbonudzɔlawo tɔ ɖe ʋɔtruawo nu la, woado wo ade gameti wo me.
ENGLISH: 3 And they stood up in their places, and they read from the book of their God Jehovah’s code a quarter of the day, and a quarter they were confessing and doing reverence to their God Jehovah.

EWE: Woaɖo Yerusalem nɔla aɖewo dzɔlawoe, wo dometɔ aɖewo nadzɔ teƒe siwo wode asi na wo, eye wo dometɔ aɖewo nanɔ woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe aƒewo ŋgɔ.” 4 Ke du la keke helolo, gake ame ʋɛ aɖewo koe le eme, eye womekpɔ gbugbɔ xɔwo tu haɖe o.
ENGLISH: 4 And Jeshuaʽ and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, Kanani, stood up on the Levites’ platform, and they cried out in a loud voice to their God Jehovah.

EWE: 5 Ke nye Mawu dee dzi me nam be maƒo bubumewo kple dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔawo kpakple dukɔ la nu ƒu ne woaŋlɔ wo ŋkɔwo le dzidzimeawo nu.
ENGLISH: 5 And the Levites Jeshuaʽ and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabnejah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, Pethahiah, said

EWE: Azɔ meke ɖe ame siwo gbɔ zi gbãtɔ la ƒe dzidzimenuŋlɔɖiawo ŋu, eye mekpɔ woŋlɔ ɖe eme be:
ENGLISH: “Stand up, bless your God Jehovah, and let them bless your name, glorious and exalted above all blessing and praise!

EWE: 6 Babilon dziɖuƒea me tɔ siwo gbɔ tso aboyo me, ame siwo Babilon-fia Nebukadnezar ɖe aboyoe, eye wotrɔ gbɔ va Yerusalem kple Yuda, eye ame sia ame yi eya ŋutɔ ƒe du me la woe nye esi, 7 ame siwo gbɔ kple Zerubabel, Yesua, Nehemiya, Azariya, Raamiya, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilsan, Misperet, Bigvai, Nehum, kple Baana.
ENGLISH: 6 “You it was, Jehovah, you alone, that made the sky, the sky of the sky, and all its legions, the earth and everything on it, the seas and everything in them, and you give life to them all, and the legions of the sky do reverence to you.

EWE: 39 Nunɔlawoe nye: Yedaya vi siwo tso Yesua ƒe me, wole ame alafa asieke blaadre vɔ etɔ̃; 40 Imer viwo le ame akpe ɖeka kple blaatɔ̃ vɔ eve; 41 Pashur viwo le ame akpe ɖeka alafa eve blaene vɔ adre; 42 Harim viwo le ame akpe ɖeka kple wuiadre.
ENGLISH: 7 You it was, Jehovah God, that called Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham, 8 and found his heart loyal before you and made a covenant with him to give the country of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites and the Jebusites and the Girgashites to his descendants, and made good your words because you are a doer of right.

EWE: 43 Lewi viwoe nye Yesua viwo kple Kadmiel vi siwo katã tso Hodeva viwo dome, wole ame blaadre vɔ ene. 44 Hadzila siwo nye Asaf viwo le ame alafa ɖeka blaene vɔ enyi.
ENGLISH: 9 “And you saw the wretched state of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry at the Red Sea, 10 and dealt out tokens and miracles upon the Pharaoh and all his officers and all the people of his country because you knew they had been arrogant against them, and you made yourself famous as at this day.

EWE: 45 Agbonudzɔlawoe nye: Salum viwo, Ater viwo, Talmon viwo, Akub viwo, Hatita viwo, Sobai viwo: wole ame alafa ɖeka blaetɔ̃ vɔ enyi.
ENGLISH: 11 And you split the sea apart before them, and took them across through the middle of the sea on dry land, and threw their pursuers into depths of ooze like a stone into a mighty water; 12 and you led them by a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night to light up for them the road they were to go on.

EWE: 46 Gbedoxɔmesubɔlawoe nye: Ziha viwo, Hasufa viwo, Tabaot viwo, 47 Keros viwo, Sia viwo, Padon viwo, 48 Lebana viwo, Hagaba viwo, Salmai viwo, 49 Hanan viwo, Gidel viwo, Gahar viwo; 50 Reaya viwo, Rezin viwo, Nekoda viwo, 51 Gazam viwo, Uza viwo, Pasea viwo, 52 Besai viwo, Meunim viwo, Nefusesim viwo, 53 Bakbuk viwo, Hakufa viwo, Harhur viwo, 54 Bazlit viwo, Mehida viwo, Harsa viwo, 55 Barkos viwo, Sisera viwo, Tema viwo, 56 Neziya viwo kple Hatifa viwo.
ENGLISH: 13 And on Mount Sinai you came down and spoke with them out of the sky and gave them correct laws and true rulings, good institutions and commandments, 14 and made known to them your holy sabbath, and enjoined on them commandments and institutions and rulings through your servant Moses, 15 and gave them bread out of the sky for their hunger and brought them out water from a crag for their thirst, and told them to go in to take possession of the country you had pledged yourself to give to them.

EWE: 57 Salomo ƒe subɔviwo ƒe viwoe nye: Sotai viwo, Soferet viwo, Perida viwo, 58 Yaala viwo, Darkon viwo, Gidel viwo, 59 Sefatiya viwo, Hatil viwo, Pokeret-Hazebayim viwo kple Amon viwo. 60 Gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo kple Salomo ƒe subɔviwo ƒe viwo katã le alafa etɔ̃ blaasieke vɔ eve.
ENGLISH: 16 “But they, our fathers, were headstrong and stiffened up their necks and did not listen to your commandments; 17 and they refused to listen, and did not remember your wonders that you had done in their presence, but stiffened up their necks and elected a chief to go back to their slavery in Egypt.

EWE: 61 Ame siwo tso Tel-Mela, Tel-Harsa, Kerub, Adon kple Imer, eye womete ŋu fia wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo kple woƒe dzɔtsoƒe be Israel-viwoe yewonye o lae nye: 62 Delaya viwo, Tobiya viwo, Nekoda viwo: wole ame alafa ade blaene vɔ eve. 63 Ame siwo tso nunɔlawo domee nye: Habayiya viwo, Hakoz viwo, Barzilai, si ɖe srɔ̃ tso Gileadtɔ Barzilai ƒe vinyɔnuwo dome, eye wòtsɔ woƒe ŋkɔ la, ƒe viwo.
ENGLISH: But you are a God of forgiveness, kindly and tenderhearted, patient and very friendly, and did not abandon them, 18 even when they made themselves a metal calf and said ‘This is your God that brought you up out of Egypt’ and committed acts of great contumely; 19 you in your great tenderheartedness did not abandon them in the wilderness: the pillar of cloud never left its place over them by day, guiding them on the road, and the pillar of fire by night to light up for them the road they were to go on; 20 and you gave your good Spirit to enlighten them, and did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and gave them water for their thirst, 21 and for forty years you supported them in the wilderness: they were in want of nothing; their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.

EWE: 64 Ame siawoe di woƒe ƒomeŋkɔ le dzidzimenuŋlɔɖiawo me, ne woaɖo kpe dzidzime si me wotso la dzi, ke womekpɔe o, eya ta woɖe wo le nunɔladɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 22 “And you gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted them for frontier, and they took possession of the country of King Sihon of Heshbon and the country of King ‘Og of the Bashan.

EWE: 65 Nutodziɖula la gblɔ na wo be womaɖu nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔeawo ƒe ɖeke o, va se ɖe esime nunɔla aɖe bia gbe to Urim kple Tumim la dzi hafi.
ENGLISH: 23 And you made their sons numerous as the stars in the sky, and brought them into the country you had told their fathers to go into to take possession.

EWE: 66 Ha blibo la katã le ame akpe blaene vɔ eve alafa etɔ̃ blaade, 67 woƒe kluviwo kple kosiwo mele eme o, woawo le ame akpe adre alafa etɔ̃ blaetɔ̃ vɔ adre; woƒe ŋutsuhadzilawo kple nyɔnuhadzilawo le alafa eve blaene vɔ atɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 24 And the sons went in and took possession of the country, and you humbled before them the inhabitants of the country, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, and their kings and the peoples of the country, to do as they pleased with.

EWE: 68 Woƒe sɔwo le alafa adre blaetɔ̃ vɔ ade, eye woƒe tedzisɔwo le alafa eve blaene vɔ atɔ̃, 69 woƒe kposɔwo le alafa ene blaetɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃, eye woƒe tedziwo le akpe ade alafa adre blaeve.
ENGLISH: 25 And they took fortified cities and fat soil, and got possession of houses full of good things, rock-hewn cisterns, vineyards and olive-trees and fruit-trees in great numbers, and they ate and had their fill and grew fat and lived in luxury by your great goodness.

EWE: 70 Tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu dometɔ aɖewo na nu ɖe dɔ la ŋu. Nutodziɖula la na sika drakma akpe ɖeka, agba goboe blaatɔ̃, kple nunɔlawu ʋlaya alafa atɔ̃ blaetɔ̃ wotsɔ de kesinɔnudzraɖoƒe la.
ENGLISH: 26 “But they were disobedient and rebelled against you and threw your code behind their backs, and killed your prophets who had testified to them to bring them back to you, and committed acts of great contumely; and you gave them into the hands of their foes and they distressed them.

EWE: 71 Tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu dometɔ aɖewo na sika drakma akpe blaeve kple klosalo mina akpe eve alafa eve wotsɔ de kesinɔnudzraɖoƒe la ɖe dɔ la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 27 And in their distress they would cry out to you, and you in heaven would hear and, in accordance with your great tenderheartedness, would give them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their foes.

EWE: 72 Nu siwo dukɔ la ƒe ame susɔeawo na la le sika drakma akpe blaeve kple klosalo mina akpe eve kpakple nunɔlawu ʋlaya blaade vɔ adre. 73 Eye nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo, agbonudzɔlawo, hadzilawo, dukɔ la me tɔ aɖewo kple gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo kpakple Israel-vi susɔeawo katã yi ɖanɔ woƒe duwo me. Kaka ɣleti adrelia naɖo la, Israel-viwo nɔ woƒe duwo me.
ENGLISH: 28 But when they were at rest they would go back to doing bad things before you, and you left them in their enemies’ hands and they had them at their mercy; and they went back to crying out to you, and you in heaven would hear and, in accordance with your great tenderheartedness, would deliver them.

EWE: Nehemiya 8:1-18 8 Dukɔ blibo la kpe ta ɖekae ɖe ablɔ si le Tsigboa ŋgɔ la me, eye wogblɔ na nugbugbɔŋlɔla Ezra be wòatsɔ Mose ƒe Se, si Yehowa de na Israel la, ƒe agbalẽ la vɛ.
ENGLISH: 29 And you testified to them to bring them back to your code; but they were headstrong and did not listen to your commands and sinned against your laws, which men should conform to and have life by them, and turned a stubborn shoulder and stiffened up their necks and did not listen.

EWE: 2 Eya ta nunɔla Ezra tsɔ Se la va ŋutsuwo, nyɔnuwo kple ame siwo katã ate ŋu ase nya ahase egɔme la ƒe ha bliboa ŋkume le ɣleti adrelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi.
ENGLISH: 30 And you kept on with them many years, and testified to them by your Spirit through your prophets, but they did not give ear, and you gave them into the hands of the peoples of the countries.

EWE: 3 Eye wòxlẽe sesĩe le ablɔ si le Tsigboa ŋgɔ la me, tso ŋdi va se ɖe ɣeɖota, le ŋutsuwo, nyɔnuwo kple ame bubu siwo ate ŋu ase nu gɔme la ŋkume; eye dukɔ blibo la ƒe to nɔ Segbalẽ la ŋu vevie.
ENGLISH: 31 But in your great tenderness you did not finish them off nor abandon them, because you are a kindly and tenderhearted Deity.

EWE: 4 Eye nugbugbɔŋlɔla Ezra tɔ ɖe teƒe kɔkɔ si wotsɔ ʋuƒo wɔ ɖe wɔnaa ŋu; eye Matitiya, Sema, Anaiya, Uriya, Hilkiya kple Maaseya tɔ ɖe exa le eƒe ɖusime, eye Pedaya, Misael, Malkiya, Hasum, Has-Badana, Zakariya kple Mesulam le eƒe miame. 5 Ezra ʋu agbalẽ la le dukɔ blibo la ŋkume, elabena eya le kɔkɔƒe wu dukɔ blibo la. Esi wòʋui la, dukɔ blibo la tso.
ENGLISH: 32 “And now, our God, great and invincible and terrible Deity, keeper of covenant and friendship, let all the hard experience we have had, we, our kings and our generals and our priests and our prophets and our fathers and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria to this day, not be a little thing before you.

EWE: 6 Eye Ezra kafu Yehowa, Mawu vavã, Mawu gã la, eye dukɔ blibo la katã wu woƒe asiwo dzi ɖo eŋu be: “Amen!
ENGLISH: 33 And you are in the right as to all that has come upon us, because you have done loyally; and we are in the wrong.

EWE: Amen!” Azɔ wobɔbɔ tsyɔ mo anyi hede ta agu na Yehowa. 7 Yesua, Bani, Serebiya, Yamin, Akub, Sabetai, Hodiya, Maaseya, Kelita, Azariya, Yozabad, Hanan, Pelaya, siwo nye Lewi viwo, nɔ Se la me ɖem na dukɔ la, esime dukɔ la le tsitrenu.
ENGLISH: 34 And our kings, our generals, our priests, and our fathers did not live up to your code nor listen to your commandments and your testimonies that you gave them; 35 but they, in their independent sovereignty and in your abundant good things that you gave them and in the broad and fat country that you put before them, did not serve you nor turn back from their bad practices.

EWE: 8 Eye wokɔ gbe dzi xlẽ agbalẽ si nye Mawu vavã la ƒe Se la, woɖe eme tsitotsito, wona gɔmesese si le eŋu la dze, ale wona ameawo se nu si xlẽm wole la gɔme.
ENGLISH: 36 Here we are in servitude today; and as to the country you gave to our fathers to eat the fruits of and the good things of, here we are in servitude in it, 37 and it is bearing its produce in great crops for the kings you have put over us for our sins, and they are ruling over our bodies and our cattle as they please, and we are in great distress.”

EWE: 9 Eye Nehemiya, si nye nutodziɖula la, kple nunɔla Ezra, si nye nugbugbɔŋlɔla la kpakple Lewi vi siwo nɔ nu fiam dukɔa la gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be: “Egbeŋkeke sia le kɔkɔe na Yehowa mia Mawu la.
ENGLISH: 38 “And for all this we agree to a schedule and write it down; and on the sealed copy are our chiefs, our Levites, our priests.”

EWE: Migaxa nu alo afa avi o.”
ENGLISH: Nehemiah 10:1-39

EWE: Elabena dukɔ blibo la katã nɔ avi fam esime wonɔ Se la me nyawo sem. 10 Eye wògagblɔ na wo be: “Miyi, ne miaɖu nu damiwo, eye miano nu viviwo, eye miɖo ɖe ɖe ame siwo si naneke mele o; elabena ŋkeke sia le kɔkɔe na míaƒe Aƒetɔ la, eya ta migaxa nu o, elabena dzidzɔ si tsoa Yehowa gbɔe nye miaƒe mɔ́ sesẽ.” 11 Eye Lewi viwo gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be: “Mizi ɖoɖoe! Elabena ŋkeke sia le kɔkɔe, eya ta migaxa nu o.” 12 Eya ta dukɔ blibo la katã dzo yi ɖaɖu nu no nu, eye woɖo ɖewo ɖe amewo, eye wotu aglo gã, elabena wose nya siwo wogblɔ na wo la gɔme. 13 Le ŋkeke evelia dzi la, dukɔ blibo la ƒe tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu, nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo, kpe ta ɖe nugbugbɔŋlɔla Ezra gbɔ, ne woase Se la me nyawo gɔme nyuie wu.
ENGLISH: 10 And on the sealed copies “Nehemiah the Tarshata the son of Hacaliah, and Sidkijah; 2 Serajah, ʽAzariah, Jeremiah, 3 Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah, 4 Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluc, 5 Harim, Meremoth, ʽObadiah, 6 Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruc, 7 Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, 8 Maʽaziah, Bilgai, Shemaʽiah; these are the priests; 9 and the Levites, Jeshuaʽ the son of Azaniah, Binnui, of the sons of Henadad Kadmiel, 10 and their brothers She[b]aniah, Hodaviah, Kelita, Pelajah, Hanan, 11 Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah, 12 Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah, 13 Hodijah, Bani, Beninu; 14 heads of the people, Pareosh, Pahath Moab, ʽElam, Zattu, Bani, 15 Bunni, ʽAzgad, Bebai, 16 Adonijah, Bigvai, Ghadin, 17 Ater, Hizkijah, ʽAzzur, 18 Hodijah, Hashum, Besai, 19 Hariph, ʽAnathoth, Nobai, 20 Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir, 21 Meshezabel, Sadok, Jadduaʽ, 22 Pelatiah, Hanan, ʽAnajah, 23 Hosheaʽ, Hananiah, Hasshub, 24 Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek, 25 Rehum, Hashabnah, Maʽasejah, 26 and Ahijah, Hanan, ʽAnan, 27 Malluc, Harim, Baʽanah.”

EWE: 14 Eye wokpɔ woŋlɔ ɖe Se si Yehowa de to Mose dzi me be, Israel-viwo nanɔ agbadɔwo me le ŋkekenyui la dzi le ɣleti adrelia me, 15 eye be woaɖe gbeƒã ahaɖo du ɖe woƒe duwo katã me kple Yerusalem blibo la be: “Miyi tonuto la me, eye mitso amiti ƒe alɔwo, gbemiti ƒe alɔwo, mirte ƒe alɔwo, deʋayawo kple ati dodoewo ƒe alɔwo vɛ, ne míatsɔ atu agbadɔwo, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene.” 16 Eye dukɔ la do go yi ɖatso wo vɛ, eye wotu agbadɔwo, wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe tui ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe xɔ ta, woƒe xɔxɔnuwo, Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnuwo, Tsigbo la ƒe ablɔ me kple Efrayim-gbo la ƒe ablɔ me.
ENGLISH: 28 “And the remainder of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatemen, the singers, the temple servants, and everybody who has separated himself from the peoples of the countries to God’s code, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, everybody that knows enough to understand, 29 concur with their brothers, their notables, and take upon themselves an imprecation and an oath to go by God’s code which was given through God’s servant Moses and to observe and live up to all the commandments of our Lord Jehovah and his laws and usages; 30 and that we will not give our daughters to the peoples of the country nor take their daughters for our sons; 31 and from the peoples of the country who bring commodities and provisions of any kind on the sabbath day to sell we will not take any on the sabbath or on a holy day; and we will give up enforcing claims on goods in anybody’s hands in the seventh year.

EWE: 17 Ale ame siwo gbɔ tso aboyo me la ƒe ha blibo la katã tu agbadɔwo, eye wonɔ agbadɔawo me, elabena tso Yosua, Nun vi, ƒe ŋkekeawo me va se ɖe ŋkeke ma dzi la, Israel-viwo mewɔe alea kpɔ o, ale wokpɔ dzidzɔ gã aɖe.
ENGLISH: 39 For it is into the vestries that the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi are to bring in the contribution of grain and grape-juice and oil, and there the belongings of the sanctuary and the officiating priests and the gatemen and the singers are.

EWE: Woɖu ŋkekenyui la ŋkeke adre, eye le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, wowɔ takpekpe tɔxɛ le ɖoɖo la nu.
ENGLISH: And we will not abandon our God’s house.”

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 9 Le ɣleti sia ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ enelia dzi la, Israel-viwo kpe ta; wotsi nu dɔ, wota akpanya, eye wolɔ ke kɔ ɖe tame.
ENGLISH: 11 And the chiefs of the people lived in Jerusalem, and the remainder of the people cast lots to bring in one out of ten to live in Jerusalem, the sacred city, and ten parts in the cities.

EWE: 2 Eye Israel vidzidziwo ɖe wo ɖokuiwo ɖa tso amedzroviwo katã ŋu, eye wotso heʋu woƒe nu vɔ̃wo kple wo fofowo ƒe vodadawo me.
ENGLISH: 2 And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

EWE: 3 Azɔ wotso ɖe tsitrenu le wo nɔƒe, eye wokɔ gbe dzi xlẽ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la ƒe Segbalẽ la gaƒoƒo etɔ̃; eye wotsɔ gaƒoƒo etɔ̃ bubu ʋu woƒe nu vɔ̃wo me hede ta agu na Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la.
ENGLISH: 3 And these are the heads of the province who lived in Jerusalem; and in the cities of Judah Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the temple servants, and the sons of Solomon’s servants, lived each on his own holding in their cities.

EWE: 4 Eye Yesua, Bani, Kadmiel, Sebaniya, Buni, Serebiya, Bani kple Kenani tsi tsitre ɖe Lewi viwo ƒe kɔkɔƒe la, eye wodo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ na Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la.
ENGLISH: 4 And there lived in Jerusalem, of the sons of Judah and of the sons of Benjamin,

EWE: 5 Eye Lewi vi siwo nye Yesua kple Kadmiel, Bani, Hasabneya, Serebiya, Hodiya, Sebaniya kple Petahiya gblɔ be: “Mitso, ne miakafu Yehowa mia Mawu la tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Woakafu wò bubuŋkɔ si ƒo yayra kple kafukafu ɖe sia ɖe ta la.
ENGLISH: Of the sons of Judah: Ghathajah the son of ʽUzzijah the son of Zecariah the son of Amariah the son of Shephatiah the son of Mahalalel a son of Peres, 5 and Maʽasejah the son of Baruc the son of Col-Hozeh the son of Hazajah the son of ʽAdajah the son of Jojarib the son of Zecariah the son of the Shelanite.

EWE: 6 “Wò ɖeka koe nye Yehowa; wòe wɔ dziƒowo, ɛ̃, dziƒowo ƒe dziƒo kple woƒe aʋakɔ blibo la katã, anyigba kple edzinuwo katã, atsiaƒuwo kple wo me nuwo katã.
ENGLISH: 6 Of all the sons of Peres who lived in Jerusalem there were four hundred and sixty-eight able-bodied men.

EWE: 8 Èkpɔ nuteƒewɔwɔ le dzi me nɛ; eya ta èbla nu kplii be yeatsɔ Kanaantɔwo, Hititɔwo, Amoritɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Yebusitɔwo kple Girgasitɔwo ƒe anyigbawo ana eya kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo; eye nèwɔ wò nyawo dzi, elabena dzɔdzɔetɔ nènye. 9 “Èkpɔ mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe fukpekpe le Egipte, eye nèse woƒe ɣlidodo le Ƒudzĩ la nu.
ENGLISH: 7 And these were the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam the son of Joʽed the son of Pedajah the son of Kolajah the son of Maʽasejah the son of Ithiel the son of Jeshaʽiah, 8 and after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight; 9 and Joel the son of Zicri had the oversight over them, and Jehudah the son of Hassenuah over the city as second.

EWE: Eye nèwɔ ŋkɔ na ɖokuiwò, abe ale si wòle egbe sia ene. 11 Èma atsiaƒu la me le wo ŋgɔ, ale be woto ƒuƒuiƒe le atsiaƒua me, eye nètsɔ wo yome tilawo ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒewo, abe kpe le ƒu dzeagbo me ene. 12 Ètsɔ alilikpo dodo kplɔ wo le ŋkeke me, eye nètsɔ dzobibi kplɔ wo le zã me, be wòana mɔ si woato la dzi nakɔ na wo. 13 Èɖi va Sinai To la dzi, eye nèƒo nu kpli wo tso dziƒo, ètsɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔewo kple se vavãwo, mɔfiamewo kple sedede nyuiwo na wo. 14 Èna wonya wò Sabat kɔkɔe la, eye nètsɔ sededewo kple ɖoɖowo kpakple se na wo to wò subɔla Mose dzi.
ENGLISH: 10 Of the priests: Jedaʽiah, Jojarib, Jakin, 11 Serajah the son of Hilkijah the son of Meshullam the son of Sadok the son of Merajoth the son of Ahitub the warden of God’s house, 12 and their brothers who did the, work of God’s house, eight hundred and twenty-two, and ʽAdajah the son of Jeroham the son of Pelaliah the son of Amsi the son of Zecariah the son of Pashhur the son of Malkijah, 13 and his brothers, two hundred and forty-two heads of families; and ʽAmasai the son of ʽAzarel the son of Ahzai the son of Meshillemoth the son of Immer, 14 and his brothers, a hundred and twenty-eight stalwart men; and Zabdiel the son of Haggedolim had the oversight over them.

EWE: 15 Esi dɔ wu wo la, èna abolo wo tso dziƒo, eye esi tsikɔ wu wo la, èna tsi do tso agakpe me na wo, eye nègblɔ na wo be woayi anyigba si nèka atam be yeatsɔ ana wo la dzi ahaxɔe wòazu wo tɔ.
ENGLISH: 15 And of the Levites: Shemaʽiah the son of Hasshub the son of ʽAzrikam the son of Hashabiah the son of Bunni; 16 and Shabbethai and Jozabad, over the work outside the house of God, of heads of Levites.

EWE: 16 “Ke woawo, ɛ̃, mía tɔgbuiwo, wɔ nu dadatɔe, wosẽ dzi me, eye womeɖo to wò sededewo o. 17 Wogbe nusese, eye womeɖo ŋku wò nukudɔ siwo nèwɔ na wo la dzi o, ke boŋ wosẽ dzi me, eye woɖo kplɔla na wo ɖokui be yewoatrɔ ayi kluvinyenye me le Egipte.
ENGLISH: 17 And Mattaniah the son of Micah the son of Zabdi the son of Asaph, head of the beginning, spoke the thanks in the prayer; and Bakbukiah was second of his brothers; and ʽAbda the son of Shammuaʽ the son of Galal the son of Jeduthun.

EWE: 18 Esi wotsɔ ga wɔ nyivilegba na wo ɖokui, eye wonɔ gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Esiae nye wò Mawu si kplɔ wò tso Egipte,’ eye wowɔ amemabumabunu gãwo hã la, 19 le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ geɖe ta la, mègblẽ wo ɖe gbea dzi o.
ENGLISH: 18 Of all the Levites in the sacred city there were two hundred and eighty-four.

EWE: Alilikpo dodo la medzo le wo tame le ŋkeke me o, ne wòakplɔ wo le mɔa dzi, eye dzobibi la medzo le wo gbɔ le zã me o, ne wòaklẽ na wo le mɔ si dzi woato la dzi.
ENGLISH: 19 And the gatemen: ʽAkkub, Talmon, and their brothers who guarded the gates, a hundred and seventy-two.

EWE: 20 Èna wò gbɔgbɔ nyui la wo, be nugɔmesese deto nasu wo si, eye mèɖe wò mana la ɖa le nu me na wo o, eye esi tsikɔ wu wo la, èna tsi wo wono.
ENGLISH: 20 And the remainder of Israel, the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, each on his estate.

EWE: 21 Ƒe blaene sɔŋ nèna nuɖuɖu wo le gbea dzi. Naneke mehiã wo o. Awu mevuvu le wo ŋu o, eye woƒe afɔwo hã mete o.
ENGLISH: 21 And the temple servants lived on the castle ridge, and Siha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

EWE: 22 “Ètsɔ fiaɖuƒewo kple dukɔwo de asi na wo, eye nèma woƒe anyigbawo na wo; ale be woxɔ Sihon ƒe anyigba, si nye Hesbon-fia ƒe anyigba hekpe ɖe Basan-fia Og ƒe anyigba ŋu wòzu wo tɔ.
ENGLISH: 22 And ʽUzzi the son of Bani the son of Hashabiah the son of Mattaniah the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, had they oversight over the Levites in Jerusalem with reference to the business of God’s house.

EWE: 23 Èna wo viwo sɔ gbɔ abe dziƒoɣletiviwo ene. Eye nèkplɔ wo va anyigba si ŋugbe nèdo na wo tɔgbuiwo be woaxɔe wòazu wo tɔ la dzi.
ENGLISH: 23 For the king’s command governed them, and there was a schedule for the singers, and appointment for each day.

EWE: 24 Ale wo viwo yi ɖaxɔ anyigba la wòzu wo tɔ, eye nèbɔbɔ Kanaantɔ siwo nye anyigba la dzi nɔlawo ɖe anyi le wo ŋkume, eye nètsɔ wo de asi na wo, woƒe fiawo kple anyigba la dzi dukɔwo siaa, ne woawɔ wo ale si wodi.
ENGLISH: 24 And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the sons of Zerah the son of Judah, was court agent for every affair for the people.

EWE: Mlɔeba ètsɔ wo de asi na anyigba la dzi dukɔwo. 31 Le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gbogbo la ta la, mètsrɔ̃ wo ɖa keŋkeŋ alo gbe wo o, elabena Mawu veveseɖeamenula kple nublanuikpɔlae nènye. 32 “Azɔ Oo mía Mawu, Mawu gã sẽŋu si ŋu ŋɔdzi le, ame si wɔa nubabla dzi, eye wòvea ame nu, mègana fukpekpe blibo si va míawo ŋutɔwo, míaƒe fiawo, míaƒe amegãwo, míaƒe nunɔlawo, míaƒe nyagblɔɖilawo, mía tɔgbuiwo kple wò dukɔ blibo la katã dzi, tso Asiria-fiawo ƒe ŋkekeawo me va se ɖe egbe sia la, naɖi nu tsɛ le ŋkuwòme o. 33 Tɔwò dzɔ le nu siwo katã va mía dzi la me, elabena èwɔ nuteƒe, gake míawo ya míewɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi.
ENGLISH: 25 And toward the villages in their country districts, sons of Judah lived in Kirjath-ha-Arbogh and its dependencies, and in Dibon and its dependencies, and in Jekabseel and its villages, 26 and in Jeshuaʽ, and in Moladah, and in Beth-Pelet, 27 and in Hasar-Shuʽal, and in Beer-Shebaʽ and its dependencies, 28 and in Siklag, and in Meconah and in its dependencies, 29 and in ʽEn-Rimmon, and in Soreah, and in Jarmuth, 30 Zanoah, ʽAdullam, and their villages, Lakish and its country districts, ʽAzekah and its dependencies, and were camped from Beer-Shebaʽ to Hinnom’s Valley.

EWE: 35 Esi wonɔ woƒe fiaɖuƒea me nɔ vivi sem na nu nyui gbogbo siwo nèna wo, eye wonɔ anyigba gã wɔnu si nètsɔ na wo dzi hã la, womesubɔ wò o, eye wometrɔ tso woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo me o.
ENGLISH: 31 And the sons of Benjamin, from Gebaʽ, Micmas and Ghaijah and Bethel and its dependencies, 32 ʽAnathoth, Nob, ʽAnaniah, 33 Hasor, Ramah, Gittaim, 34 Hadid, Seboʽim, Neballat, 35 Lod and Ono, the Carpenters’ Valley.

EWE: 36 Gake míawoe nye esia zu kluviwo egbea, ɛ̃, míezu kluviwo le anyigba si nètsɔ na mía tɔgbuiwo be woaɖu edzi kutsetse kple eƒe nu nyuiwo la dzi.
ENGLISH: 36 And of the Levites some Judah divisions were placed with Benjamin.

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: Nehemiya, si nye nutodziɖula la, si nye Hakaliya vi, Kple Zedekiya, 2 Seraya, Azariya, Yeremiya, 3 Pashur, Amariya, Malkiya, 4 Hatus, Sebaniya, Maluk, 5 Harim, Meremot, Obadiya, 6 Daniel, Gineton, Baruk, 7 Mesulam, Abiya, Miyamin, 8 Maaziya, Bilgai kple Semaya; ame siawoe nye nunɔlawo.
ENGLISH: 12 And these are the priests and Levites who came up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshuaʽ: Serajah, Jeremiah, ʽEzra, 2 Amariah, Malluc, Hattush, 3 Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth, 4 ʽIddo, Ginnethon, Abijah, 5 Mijamin, Maʽadiah, Bilgah, 6 Shemaʽiah and Jojarib, Jedaʽiah, 7 Sallu, ʽAmok, Hilkijah, Jedaʽiah; these were the heads of the priests and their brothers in Jeshuaʽ’s time.

EWE: 9 Lewi vi siwo hã tre enue nye: Yesua, si nye Azaniya vi, Binui, si tso Henada viwo dome, Kadmiel 10 kple nɔvia siwo nye Sebaniya, Hodiya, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanan, 11 Mika, Rehob, Hasabiya, 12 Zakur, Serebiya, Sebaniya, 13 Hodiya, Bani kple Beninu.
ENGLISH: 8 And the Levites: Jeshuaʽ, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Jehudah, Mattaniah (he and his brothers over thanksgivings), 9 and Bakbukiah and ʽUnni, their brothers opposite to them for charges. 10 And Jeshuaʽ had the son Jojakim, and Jojakim had the son Eljashib, and Eljashib the son Jojadaʽ, 11 and Jojadaʽ had the son Jonathan, and Jonathan had the son Jadduaʽ.

EWE: 14 Dukɔ la ƒe tatɔ siwo tre enue nye: Paros, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Zatu, Bani, 15 Buni, Azgad, Bebai, 16 Adoniya, Bigvai, Adin, 17 Ater, Hizkiya, Azur, 18 Hodiya, Hasum, Bezai, 19 Harif, Anatot, Nebai, 20 Magpias, Mesulam, Hezir, 21 Mesezabel, Zadok, Yadua, 22 Pelatiya, Hanan, Anaiya, 23 Hosea, Hananiya, Hasub, 24 Halohes, Pilha, Sobek, 25 Rehum, Hasabna, Maaseya, 26 Ahiya, Hanan, Anan, 27 Maluk, Harim kple Baana. 28 Ke dukɔ la dometɔ susɔeawo
ENGLISH: 12 And in Jojakim’s time were priests, the heads of families, for Serajah, Merajah; for Jeremiah, Hananiah; 13 for ʽEzra, Meshullam; for Amariah, Jehohanan; 14 for Malluc, Jonathan; for Shecaniah, Joseph; 15 for Harim, Ghadna; for Merajoth, Helkai; 16 for ʽIddo, Zecariah; for Ginnethon, Meshullam; 17 for Abijah, Zicri; for Minjamin; for Moʽadiah, Piltai; 18 for Bilgah, Shammuaʽ; for Shemaʽiah, Jehonathan, 19 and for Jojarib, Mattenai; for Jedaʽiah, ʽUzzi; 20 for Sallai, Kallai; for ʽAmok, ʽEber; 21 for Hilkijah, Hashabiah; for Jedaʽiah, Nathanel.

EWE: nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo, agbonudzɔlawo, hadzilawo, gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo kple ame siwo katã ɖe wo ɖokuiwo ɖa le anyigba la dzi dukɔwo ŋu helé Mawu vavã la ƒe Se la me ɖe asi, wo srɔ̃wo, wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo, ame siwo katã si sidzedze kple gɔmesese le la
ENGLISH: 22 The Levites: in the times of Eljashib, Jojadaʽ and Johanan and Jadduaʽ, heads of families were written down, and the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian. 23 The sons of Levi, the heads of the families, are written in the book of the chronicles down to the time of Johanan the son of Eljashib.

EWE: 29 wɔ ɖeka kple wo nɔvi, siwo nye woƒe bubumeawo, eye woka atam be fiƒode nava yewo dzi ne yewomezɔ le Mawu vavã la ƒe se, si wode to Mawu vavã la ƒe subɔla Mose dzi la nu helé Yehowa míaƒe Aƒetɔ la ƒe sededewo, eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ɖoɖowo kple eƒe ɖoɖowo katã me ɖe asi hewɔ wo dzi pɛpɛpɛ o.
ENGLISH: 24 And the heads of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah and Jeshuaʽ and Bani and Kadmiel, and their brothers opposite them to praise, to give thanks, in accordance with the command David the man of God, watch against watch, 25 Mattaniah and Bakbukiah, ʽObadiah; Meshullam, Talmon, ʽAkkub, gatemen keeping watch at the gate storerooms.

EWE: 30 Míatsɔ mía vinyɔnuwo ana anyigba la dzi dukɔwo o, eye míaɖe wo vinyɔnuwo na mía viŋutsuwo o.
ENGLISH: 30 And the priests and the Levites purified themselves and the people and the gates and the wall.

EWE: 31 Ne anyigba la dzi dukɔwo tsɔ adzɔnuwo kple agblemenuku ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi va dzadzra ge le Sabat ŋkeke dzi la, míaƒle naneke le wo si le Sabat la dzi alo le ŋkeke kɔkɔe dzi o. Azɔ hã, míade agble le ƒe adrelia me o, eye míatsɔ ame sia ame ƒe fe akee. 32 Míeɖoe mía ɖokuiwo dzi hã be mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nana sekel me mama ɖe etɔ̃ ƒe akpa ɖeka ƒe sia ƒe ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me subɔsubɔdɔ la ŋu, 33 ɖe abolo siwo woɖona ɖe wo nɔewo dzi, nuɖuvɔsa si wonana ɖaa kple numevɔsa si wonana ɖaa, le Sabat kple dzinu yeyewo dzi la ŋu, ɖe azã ɖoɖiwo, nu kɔkɔewo kple nuvɔ̃vɔsawo ŋu, be woalé avu ɖe Israel kple mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me dɔ blibo la katã ta.
ENGLISH: 31 And I brought the chiefs of Judah up above the wall; and I arranged two great thanksgiving companies, and the one went to the right above the wall to the Dump Gate, 32 and behind them went Hoshaʽajah and half the princes of Judah, 33 and ʽAzariah, ʽEzra, and Meshullam, 34 Judah and Benjamin and Shemaʽiah and Jeremiah, 35 and some of the sons of the priests with trumpets; Zecariah the son of Jonathan the son of Shemaʽiah the son of Mattaniah the son of Micajah the son of Zaccur the son of Asaph, 36 and his brothers Shemaʽiah and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maʽai, Nethanel and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and ʽEzra the scribe before them.

EWE: 34 Azɔ hã, míedzidze nu ɖe nake si nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo kple dukɔ la atsɔ ava mía Mawu ƒe aƒea me, le mía fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu, le ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiawo dzi ƒe sia ƒe la dzi, be woatsɔ ado dzo ɖe Yehowa mía Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe Se la me ene.
ENGLISH: 37 And past the Spring Gate and straight ahead they went up over the stairs of David’s City, up the slope of the wall above David’s house, to the Water Gate on the east.

EWE: 35 Eye míebla se na mía ɖokuiwo be míatsɔ míaƒe anyigba la dzi kutsetse gbãtɔwo kple ati sia ati ƒomevi ƒe tsetse gbãtɔwo katã ava Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me ƒe sia ƒe, 36 eye míakplɔ mía viŋutsu ŋgɔgbeawo kple míaƒe aƒemelãwo ƒe vi gbãtɔwo kple míaƒe nyiwo kple alẽwo ƒe vi gbãtɔwo avɛ, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe se la me ene.
ENGLISH: 38 And the second thanksgiving company went to the left, and I behind it, and half the people, above the wall, above the Baking-Crock Tower, to the Broad Wall, 39 and above the Ephraim Gate and past the Old-Town Gate and past the Fish Gate and Hananel’s Tower and the Hundred Tower to the Sheep Gate, and halted at the Guardhouse Gate.

EWE: Míakplɔ wo ava mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me, na nunɔla siwo le subɔsubɔm le mía Mawu ƒe aƒea me. 37 Eye míatsɔ míaƒe wɔ gbãtɔwo kple míaƒe nudzɔdzɔwo kple ati sia ati ƒomevi ƒe tsetse, wain yeye kple ami avɛ na nunɔlawo le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ƒe nudzraɖoƒexɔwo me, hekpe ɖe míaƒe anyigbadzinuwo ƒe ewolia ŋu na Lewi viwo, elabena Lewi viwoe xɔa míaƒe agblededuwo katã ƒe nuwo ƒe ewolia.
ENGLISH: 40 And both the thanksgiving companies halted at God’s house, and I and half the magnates with me, 41 and the priests Eljakim, Maʽasejah, Minjamin, Micajah, Eljoʽenai, Zecariah, Hananiah, with trumpets, 42 and Maʽasejah and Shemaʽiah and Eleazar and ʽUzzi and Jehohanan and Malkijah and ʽElam and ʽEzer; and the singers sounded their notes, and Izrahiah had the oversight.

EWE: 38 Eye nunɔla, si nye Aron viŋutsu, nanɔ Lewi viwo ŋu ne Lewi viwo le nuawo ƒe ewolia xɔm; Lewi viwo hã natsɔ nu ewoliawo ƒe ewolia ana le nudzraɖoƒexɔ la ƒe xɔwo me le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 43 And on that day they sacrificed great sacrifices and made merry, because God had gladdened them to a great merrymaking; and the women and children made merry too, and Jerusalem’s merrymaking was heard to a great distance.

EWE: 39 Elabena nudzraɖoƒexɔawo mee Israel-viwo kple Lewi viwo atsɔ agblemenuku, wain yeye kple ami ƒe nudzɔdzɔ la ayii, afi mae kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu dɔwɔnuawo, nunɔla siwo le subɔsubɔm, agbonudzɔlawo kple hadzilawo le. Míagblẽ mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖi o.
ENGLISH: 44 And on that day officers were appointed over the vestries for the stores, for the contributions, the first things, and the tithes, to collect in them by regions of cities the prescribed portions for the priests and the Levites, because Judah was happy over the priests and Levites in service, 45 and they kept their God’s charge and the charge of the purification, and the singers and the gatemen conformed to the orders of David and his son Solomon, 46 for in the days of David and Asaph of old there were heads of the singers and song of praise and thanks to God; 47 and in Zerubbabel’s days all Israel gave the portions of the singers and the gatemen punctually day by day and set apart consecrations for the Levites, and the Levites set apart consecrations for the sons of Aaron.

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Nehemiah

EWE: 11 Dukɔ la ƒe amegãwo nɔ Yerusalem; ke dukɔ la dometɔ susɔeawo dzidze nu, ne woakplɔ wo dometɔ ɖeka le ame ewo ɖe sia ɖe dome vɛ be wòava nɔ du kɔkɔe Yerusalem me, ne asieke bubuawo nanɔ du bubuawo me. 2 Eye dukɔ la yra ŋutsu siwo katã lɔ̃ faa be yewoava nɔ Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: 13 And on that day there was a public reading to the people out of the book of Moses, and it was found written in it that an ʽAmmonite or Moabite should not come into God’s assembly forever 2 because they did not offer the sons of Israel bread and water, and hired Balaam against them to misspeak them, but our God turned the curse into a blessing.

EWE: 3 Nutoa dzi kpɔla siwo nɔ Yerusalem woe nye esiwo gbɔna.
ENGLISH: 3 And when they heard the ruling they separated all intruded population from Israel.

EWE: (Ame siwo susɔ le Israel-viwo, nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo, gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo kple Salomo ƒe subɔviwo ƒe viwo katã dome ya nɔ Yuda du bubuawo me, wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi, le eƒe du me. 4 Yuda vi aɖewo kple Benyamin vi aɖewo hã nɔ Yerusalem.) Ame siwo nye tatɔwo tso Yuda viwo domee nye Ataya, si nye Uziya vi, Zakariya vi, Amariya vi, Sefatiya vi, Mahalalel vi tso Perez viwo dome, 5 Maaseya, si nye Baruk vi, Kolhoze vi, Hazaya vi, Adaya vi, Yoyarib vi, Zakariya vi, tso Sela viwo dome.
ENGLISH: 4 But earlier than this Priest Eljashib had been in office about the vestries of our God’s house, a connection of Tobijah’s, 5 and he had turned over to him a great vestry where they used to put the grain-offering and the frankincense and the vessels and the tithe of grain and grape-juice and oil, the ordinance for the Levites and singers and gatemen, and the contribution for the priests.

EWE: 6 Perez vi siwo katã nɔ Yerusalem la le ame alafa ene blaade vɔ enyi, eye wonye ŋutsu veviedolawo.
ENGLISH: 6 But during all this I was not in Jerusalem; for in the year thirty-two of Artaxerxes as king of Babylon I had come in to the king.

EWE: 7 Ame siwo tso Benyamin viwo domee nye Salu, si nye Mesulam vi, Yoed vi, Pedaya vi, Kolaya vi, Maaseya vi, Itiel vi, Yesaya vi, 8 hekpe ɖe Gabai kple Salai ƒe aƒekɔwo ŋu, wole ame alafa asieke blaeve vɔ enyi; 9 Yoel, si nye Zikri vi, ye nye woƒe dzikpɔla, eye Yuda, Hasenua vi, nye dua dzi kpɔla ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: And a while later I asked leave from the king, 7 and I came to Jerusalem and learned of the nuisance Eljashib had committed for Tobijah, turning over to him a vestry in the courts of God’s house; 8 and I did not like it at all, and I threw all Tobijah’s household goods outside out of the vestry; 9 and I ordered the vestries cleansed, and I put back there the vessels of God’s house, the meal-offering and frankincense.

EWE: 15 Ame siwo tso Lewi viwo domee nye: Semaya, si nye Hasub vi, Azrikam vi, Hasabiya vi, Buni vi, 16 Sabetai kple Yozabad, wotso Lewi viwo ƒe tatɔwo dome, eye wole Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ƒe gotadɔwo nu; 17 Mataniya, ame si nye Mika vi, Zabdi vi, Asaf vi, si nye kafukafuhawo dzi kpɔla la, doa kafukafuha ɖa le gbedoɖaɣi, eye Bakbukia nye evelia kplɔe ɖo le nɔviawo dome, hekpe ɖe Abda, si nye Samua vi, Galal vi, Yedutun vi ŋu.
ENGLISH: 10 And I learned that the Levites’ portions had not been given, and the Levites had gone off to their lands, and it was the singers who were doing the work; 11 and I came down on the magnates and said “How comes it that God’s house is abandoned?” and I gathered them and stationed them at their posts.

EWE: 18 Lewi vi siwo katã le du kɔkɔe la me la le ame alafa eve blaenyi vɔ ene. 19 Agbonudzɔlawoe nye Akub, Talmon kple wo nɔvi siwo nye dzɔlawo le agboawo nu, wole ame alafa ɖeka blaadre vɔ eve. 20 Ke ame siwo susɔ le Israel-viwo, nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo dome ya nɔ Yuda du bubuawo katã me, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 12 And all Judah brought in the tithe of grain and grape-juice and oil to the storerooms 13 into the hands of Priest Shelemiah, and Scribe Sadok and Pedajah of the Levites, and their assistant Hanan the son of Zaccur the son of Mattaniah, because they were considered reliable; and it was their responsibility to distribute to their brothers.

EWE: 21 Gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo nɔ Ofel; eye Ziha kple Gispa le gbedoxɔmesubɔlawo nu.
ENGLISH: 14 Remember me for this, my God, and do not efface the record of my befriending God’s house and his charge.

EWE: 22 Ame si nye Lewi viwo ƒe dzikpɔla le Yerusalem ye nye Uzi, si nye Bani vi, Hasabiya vi, Mataniya vi, Mika vi, eye wòtso hadzila Asaf viwo dome; eyae le Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ƒe dɔ la nu. 23 Elabena fia la de se le hadzilawo ŋuti, eye woɖo be woanɔ nu siwo hiã wo gbe sia gbe la nam wo.
ENGLISH: 15 During that time I saw in Judah people treading winepresses on the sabbath and bringing in the heaps of grain and loading donkeys with it, and also with wine, grapes, and figs, and all sorts of loads, and bringing them to Jerusalem on the sabbath day; and I warned them on the day when they sold provisions.

EWE: 24 Petahiya, si nye Mesezabel vi, tso Yuda vi Zera viwo dome la, nye fia la ƒe aɖaŋuɖola le dukɔ la ƒe nya sia nya gbɔ kpɔkpɔ me.
ENGLISH: 16 And the Tyrians lived in it, bringing in fish and all kinds of goods and selling on the sabbath to the sons of Judah and in Jerusalem.

EWE: 25 Ke wo nɔƒewo kple wo ŋu anyigbawoe nye esi: Yuda viwo dometɔ aɖewo nɔ Kiriat-Arba kple eŋu duwo, Dibon kple eŋu duwo kpakple Yekabzeel kple eŋu kɔƒewo me, 26 kple Yesua, Molada, Bet-Pelet, 27 Hazar-Sual kpakple Beer-Seba kple eŋu duwo me, 28 Ziklag kpakple Mekona kple eŋu duwo, 29 En-Rimon, Zora, Yarmut, 30 Zanoa, Adulam kple wo ŋu kɔƒewo, Lakis kple eŋu gblewo kpakple Azeka kple eŋu duwo me. Eye wonɔ Beer-Seba va se ɖe keke Hinom Bali la me ke. 31 Benyamin viwo nɔ Geba, Mikmas, Aya kpakple Betel kple eŋu duwo me, 32 Anatot, Nob, Ananiya, 33 Hazor, Rama, Gitayim, 34 Hadid, Zeboim, Nebalat, 35 Lod kple Ono, si nye aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ƒe bali la me. 36 Eye woɖo Lewi viwo ƒe hatsotso siwo nɔ Yuda la dometɔ aɖewo ɖe Benyamin. Nehemiya 12:1-47
ENGLISH: 17 And I came down on the nobles of Judah and said to them “What is this bad thing you are doing and profaning the sabbath day? 18 was it not so that your fathers did, and our God brought upon us all this disaster, and upon this city? and you are breeding additional wrath against Israel, profaning the sabbath.” 19 And when the gateways of Jerusalem grew shady before the sabbath I ordered the gates closed, and that they should not be opened till after the sabbath, and I stationed men of my own at the gates; no load was to come in on the sabbath day.

EWE: 8 Lewi viwoe nye Yesua, Binui, Kadmiel, Serebiya, Yuda, kple Mataniya, ame si kple nɔviawo xɔa ŋgɔ le akpedahawo dzidzi me. 9 Eye wo nɔvi Bakbukia kple Uni nɔa tsitre ɖe woƒe dzɔladɔwɔƒewo dzea ŋgɔ wo.
ENGLISH: 20 And the traders and those who had goods to sell put up outside Jerusalem a time or two; 21 and I warned them and said to them “How is it you are putting up in front of the wall? if you do it another time I will lay hands on you.”

EWE: 11 Yoyada dzi Yonatan, eye Yonatan hã dzi Yadua.
ENGLISH: From that time on they did not come on the sabbath.

EWE: 22 Le Eliyasib, Yoyada, Yohanan kple Yadua ŋɔli la, woŋlɔ Lewi viwo kple nunɔlawo siaa ƒe tatɔ siwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖi va ɖo Persiatɔ Dario ƒe fiaɖuɣi.
ENGLISH: 22 And I told the Levites to be purified and in, watching the gates, to maintain the sanctity of the sabbath day.

EWE: 23 Woŋlɔ Lewi vi siwo nye tatɔwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒekɔwo nu ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe ŋutinyagbalẽ me va ɖo Yohanan, Eliyasib vi ŋɔli.
ENGLISH: Remember this too for me, my God, and spare me in accordance with the greatness of your friendship.

EWE: 24 Lewi viwo ƒe tatɔwoe nye Hasabiya, Serebiya kple Yesua, Kadmiel vi, kple wo nɔvi siwo nɔa tsitre dzea ŋgɔ wo dzia kafukafuha kple akpedaha na Mawu, abe ale si Mawu vavã la ƒe ame David de se ene, dzɔlawo ƒe ha ɖeka nɔa akpa si, eye dzɔlawo ƒe ha bubu nɔa akpa kemɛ.
ENGLISH: 23 During that time I also saw the Judahites who had taken in Ashdodite, ʽAmmonite, and Moabite wives; 24 and their sons half of them talked Ashdodite and did not know how to talk Judaic, and so in the language of each people.

EWE: 25 Mataniya kple Bakbukia, Obadiya, Mesulam, Talmon kple Akub nye agbonudzɔla siwo nɔa tsitre dzɔa nudzraɖoƒexɔ siwo le agboawo nu la ŋu. 26 Ame siawo subɔ le Yoyakim, Yesua vi, Yozadak vi, ƒe ŋkekeawo kple nutodziɖula Nehemiya kpakple nunɔla Ezra, si nye nugbugbɔŋlɔla ŋɔli.
ENGLISH: 25 And I came down on them and beat some of them and pulled out their beards, and swore them by God “not to give your daughters to their sons and not to take their daughters for your sons and yourselves; 26 was it not over these that King Solomon of Israel went wrong? and among the nations, many as they were, there had never been a king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God set him as king over all Israel; even him the foreign wives seduced into sin.

EWE: 27 Esi wole Yerusalem glia ŋu kɔ ge la, woyi ɖadi Lewi viwo be woakplɔ wo tso wo nɔƒewo katã ava Yerusalem, ne woatsɔ akpedaha, hadzidziwo, gakogoewo, kasaŋkuwo, kple saŋkuwo akɔ eŋu kple dzidzɔ.
ENGLISH: 27 And is it not an unheard-of thing for you to do all this great evil, being unfaithful to our God, taking in foreign wives?”

EWE: 28 Eye hadzilawo viŋutsuwo va kpe ta tso nuto la kple du siwo le Yerusalem ŋu godoo la me kpakple Netofatɔwo ƒe kɔƒewo me, 29 kple Bet-Gilgal, Geba-gblewo kple Azmavet, elabena hadzilawo tso kɔƒewo na wo ɖokuiwo ɖe Yerusalem ŋu godoo.
ENGLISH: 28 And one of the sons of Jojadaʽ the son of High Priest Eljashib had married into the family of Sanballat the Horonite; and I drove him off. 29 Remember them, my God, for the pollution of the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood.

EWE: 30 Eye nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo kɔ wo ɖokuiwo ŋu, eye wokɔ dukɔ la kple agboawo kpakple gli la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 30 And the Levites I cleansed from every foreign element.

EWE: 31 Eye mena Yuda-megãwo de gli la dzi.
ENGLISH: And I arranged turns of service for the priests and Levites, each at his work, 31 and for the wood donation at stated times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, my God, for good. Esther 1:1-22

EWE: Azɔ hã, meɖo akpedahadziha gã eve kple ameha eve siwo kplɔ wo ɖo, eye ɖeka zɔ ɖusime to glia dzi ɖo ta Aɖukpogbo la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 1 And in Xerxes’ days that was the Xerxes who reigned from India to Nubia, a hundred and twenty-seven provinces 2

EWE: 32 Eye Hosaya kple Yuda-megãwo ƒe afã zɔ dze wo yome, 33 hekpe ɖe Azariya, Ezra kple Mesulam, 34 Yuda, Benyamin, Semaya kple Yeremiya ŋu. 35 Nunɔlawo ƒe viwo dometɔ siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu, siwo si kpẽwo le la woe nye: Zakariya, si nye Yonatan vi, Semaya vi, Mataniya vi, Mikaya vi, Zakur vi, Asaf vi, 36 kple nɔvia siwo nye Semaya kple Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanel, Yuda kple Hanani, ame siwo si Mawu vavã la ƒe ame David ƒe haƒonuwo le; eye nugbugbɔŋlɔla Ezra le wo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: in those days, when King Xerxes took his seat on his royal throne in Susa Citadel 3 in the year three of his reign, he gave a banquet to all his generals and officers, having before him the troops of Persia and Media, the highest nobles, and the provincial generals, 4 exhibiting his glorious royal wealth and the exquisite magnificence of his greatness for a long time, a hundred and eighty days; 5 and when these days were completed the king gave a banquet to all the people that were to be found in Susa Citadel, great and small, for seven days in the garden court of the royal palace.

EWE: 37 Esi woɖo Vudogbo la gbɔ la, woyi ŋgɔ tẽe va to David Ƒe Du La Ƒe Atrakpuimɔ la tame hezɔ gli la dzi le David Ƒe Aƒe la tame va do ɖe Tsigbo la gbɔ, le ɣedzeƒe gome. 38 Akpedahadziha kemɛa to akpa kemɛ, eye medze wo yome hekpe ɖe dukɔ la ƒe afã ŋu, to glia dzi va to Abolomèkpowo Ƒe Mɔ́ la ŋu va ɖo Gli Gbadza la gbɔ, 39 to Efrayim-gbo la tame va ɖo Du Xoxo La Ƒe Agbo la gbɔ ɖado ɖe Tɔmelãgbo la kple Hananel Mɔ́ la gbɔ kple Mea Mɔ́ la kpakple Alẽgbo la gbɔ; eye wova tɔ ɖe Dzɔlawo Ƒe Agbo la nu.
ENGLISH: 6 White muslin and violet cloth was fastened with white linen and purple cords to silver rods and marble columns; couches of gold and silver stood on a floor paved with four colors of marble; 7 and drinks were poured in golden vessels, some vessels different from others, and there was royal wine in abundance in accordance with the king’s custom; 8 and the drinking was on the principle of no compulsion, for the king had given this fundamental order to the head of every department of his household, to do as each man pleased.

EWE: Eye hadzila siwo le Yizrahiya ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te la dzi ha sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 9 Queen Vashti also gave a women’s banquet in King Xerxes’ royal residence.

EWE: 43 Wosa vɔ gã aɖe gbe ma gbe, eye wokpɔ dzidzɔ, elabena Mawu vavã la na wokpɔ dzidzɔ gã aɖe. Eye nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo hã kpɔ dzidzɔ, ale be wose Yerusalem ƒe aseyetsotso le didiƒe ke.
ENGLISH: 10 On the seventh day, when the king was feeling jolly with wine, he told Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Vaabagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven eunuchs in attendance before King Xerxes, 11 to bring Queen Vashti before the king in her royal tiara to let the people and the generals see her beauty; for she was handsome.

EWE: 44 Gbe ma gbe woɖo ŋutsuwo ɖe nudzraɖoƒexɔawo kple xɔ siwo me nudzɔdzɔawo, agblemenuku gbãtɔwo kple nuwo ƒe ewoliawo le la nu. Ne woaƒo nu siwo Se la bia be woana nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo la nu ƒu tso agblededuwo me ade wo me, elabena amewo kpɔ dzidzɔ le Yuda le nunɔla kple Lewi vi siwo le subɔsubɔm ta.
ENGLISH: 16 And Memucan said before the king and the princes “Queen Vashti has misbehaved not only against the king but against all the princes and against the people in all King Xerxes’ provinces; 17 for the queen’s story will go out to all women to bring their husbands into contempt with them, when people say ‘King Xerxes ordered Queen Vashti brought before him and she did not come,’ 18 and this day the princesses of Persia and Media, who will have heard the queen’s story, will be saying plenty of contemptuous and exasperating things to all the king’s princes.

EWE: 45 Wowɔa woƒe Mawu ƒe dɔ kple nuŋukɔkɔdɔ la, eye hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo hã wɔa woƒe dɔ abe ale si David kple via Salomo ɖoe ene. 46 Elabena tso gbe aɖe gbe ke le David kple Asaf ŋɔli la, woɖo hadzilawo dzikpɔlawo hena kafukafuhawo dzidzi kple akpedada na Mawu.
ENGLISH: 19 If the king thinks best, let an official announcement be issued with your sanction and engrossed in the laws of Persia and Media to be permanent, that Vashti shall never come before King Xerxes, and the king shall give her position as queen to a better, 20 so that the king’s sentence that he has executed shall be heard of throughout his realm, great as it is, and all women shall pay honor to their husbands, great and small.”

EWE: 47 Eye le Zerubabel ŋɔli kple Nehemiya ŋɔli la, Israel blibo la katã tsɔa hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo ƒe gome nana le gbe sia gbe ƒe hiahiã nu. Woɖea nu si nye Lewi viwo tɔ gome la na wo, eye Lewi viwo hã ɖea nu si nye Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo tɔ gome la na wo.
ENGLISH: 21 And the king and the princes approved the idea; and the king did as Memucan had proposed, 22 and sent writs to all the king’s provinces, to each province in its own form of writing and to each people in its own language, that every man should be master in his house and talk in his people’s language.

EWE: Nehemiya
ENGLISH: Esther

EWE: 13 Gbe ma gbe la, woxlẽ Mose ƒe agbalẽ la ɖe dukɔ la ƒe to me; eye wokpɔ woŋlɔ ɖe eme be, Amonitɔ loo alo Moabtɔ megava Mawu vavã la ƒe ha la me gbeɖegbeɖe o, 2 elabena wometsɔ abolo kple tsi yi ɖakpe Israel-viwo o, ke boŋ woda Bileam ɖe wo ŋu be wòaƒo fi ade wo.
ENGLISH: 2 But the king’s pages who were in attendance on him said “Let handsome maiden girls be hunted up for the king, 3 and let the king appoint commissioners in all the provinces of his realm and let them gather every handsome maiden girl to the women’s house in Susa Citadel, into the hands of the king’s eunuch Hegai the guardian of the women, and cleansing-creams be furnished them, 4 and the girl that the king likes best be queen in Vashti’s place.”

EWE: Gake mía Mawu trɔ fiƒode la wòzu yayra.
ENGLISH: And the king approved the idea and did so.

EWE: 5 Edzra nudzraɖoƒexɔ gã aɖe me ɖo nɛ, afi si wotsɔa nuɖuvɔsa, lifi, ŋudɔwɔnuawo, agblemenuku, wain yeye kple ami ƒe ewolia, siwo Lewi viwo, hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo dze na, kpakple nunɔlawo ƒe nudzɔdzɔ, dana ɖo tsã. 6 Le ɣeyiɣi mawo katã me la, nyemenɔ Yerusalem o, elabena le Babilon-fia Artasasta ƒe ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ evelia me la, meyi ɖe fia la gbɔ, eye le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe la, mebia mɔ le fia la gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 5 There was a certain Jew in Susa Citadel named Mordocai the son of Jair the son of Shimei the son of Kish, a Benjamite, 6 who had been deported from Jerusalem with the deportees that were deported with King Jeconiah of Judah whom King Nebucadnessar of Babylon deported; 7 and he was foster-father to his cousin Hadassah (that is, Esther) because she had no father or mother.

EWE: 7 Metrɔ va Yerusalem hekpɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi si Eliyasib wɔ esi wòdzra nudzraɖoƒexɔ ɖeka me ɖo na Tobiya le Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnu.
ENGLISH: And the girl was shapely and handsome; and at the death of her father and mother Mordocai had adopted her.

EWE: 8 Esia medze ŋunye kura o. Eya ta mefɔ Tobiya ƒe xɔmenuwo katã tso nudzraɖoƒexɔ la me ƒu gbe.
ENGLISH: 8 And when the king’s announcement and his law were heard of, and when many girls were being gathered in Hegai’s hands in Susa Citadel, Esther was taken to the king’s house into the hands of Hegai the guardian of the women.

EWE: 9 Meɖe gbe wokɔ nudzraɖoƒexɔwo ŋu; eye megafɔ Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la me ŋudɔwɔnuawo kple nuɖuvɔsa kpakple lifi la va eme.
ENGLISH: 9 And he liked the girl and was friendly to her, and made haste to give her her cleansing-creams and her rations and to give her the seven choicest maids out of the king’s house, and gave her and her maids preferential treatment in the women’s house.

EWE: 10 Eye mese be womenaa Lewi viwo ƒe gome wo o, ale be Lewi viwo kple hadzila siwo nɔ subɔsubɔdɔa wɔm la dzo, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe yi eya ŋutɔ ƒe agble me.
ENGLISH: 10 Esther had not told her nationality and lineage, because Mordocai had charged her not to.

EWE: 11 Mehe nya ɖe dumegãwo ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔawo ŋu gblɔ be: “Nu ka ŋuti miegblẽ Mawu vavã la ƒe aƒe la ɖi?”
ENGLISH: 11 But every single day Mordocai walked in front of the court of the women’s house to find out how Esther was and what was being done with her.

EWE: Eya ta meƒo Lewi viawo nu ƒu hetsɔ wo ɖo woƒe dɔwo nu. 12 Yuda blibo la katã tsɔ agblemenuku kple wain yeye kpakple ami ƒe ewoliawo va nudzraɖoƒeawo. 13 Metsɔ nunɔla Selemiya kple nugbugbɔŋlɔla Zadok kpakple Pedaya, si tso Lewi viwo dome, ɖo nudzraɖoƒeawo nu, eye Hanan, Zakur vi, Mataniya vi, nye woƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ, elabena wobua wo nuteƒewɔlawoe. Woawo ŋkumee wòkpɔ be woama nu na wo nɔviwo. 14 Oo nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku dzinye, le esia ta, eye mègaŋlɔ dɔ nyui siwo mewɔ ɖe nye Mawu ƒe aƒe la ŋu kple eŋutisubɔsubɔdɔwo be o.
ENGLISH: 12 And when each girl’s turn came to go in to King Xerxes at the end of twelve months of the women’s regular treatment (for that was the way their time of cleansing was to be gone through, six months with the oil of myrrh and six months with the spices and the women’s cleansing-creams), 13 the girl went in to the king on these terms: she was given anything that she said, to go in from the women’s house to the king’s house with; 14 in the evening she went in, and in the morning she came back to the women’s house, a second one, into the hands of the king’s eunuch Shaʽashgaz, the guardian of the concubines; she did not go in to the king again unless the king had taken a fancy to her and she was called for by name.

EWE: 15 Le ŋkeke mawo me la, mekpɔ be amewo le waintsetse fiãm le Sabat dzi le Yuda, eye wotsɔa agblemenuku bablawo doa agba ɖe tedziwo dzi vanɛ, hekpe ɖe wain, waintsetsewo, gbotsetsewo kple agba ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ŋu, eye wotsɔa wo vaa Yerusalem le Sabat ŋkeke dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 But when it came the turn of Esther the daughter of Mordocai’s uncle Abihail, whom he had adopted, to go in to the king, she did not ask for anything but what the king’s eunuch Hegai, the guardian of the women, said; and Esther won the admiration of all who saw her.

EWE: Eya ta mexlɔ̃ nu wo be woagadzra nu le ŋkeke ma dzi o. 16 Tirotɔ siwo le dua me tsɔa tɔmelã kple adzɔnu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi va dzrana na Yuda viwo le Yerusalem le Sabat dzi.
ENGLISH: 16 And Esther was taken to King Xerxes, into his royal residence, in the tenth month, that is the month of Tebeth, in the year seven of his reign.

EWE: 17 Eya ta mehe nya ɖe Yuda bubumewo ŋu hebia wo be: “Nu vɔ̃ɖi kae nye esi wɔm miele hele kɔ gblẽm ɖo na Sabat ŋkeke la? 18 Ðe menye aleae mia tɔgbuiwo wɔ, eye mía Mawu la he vɔ̃ siawo katã va mía kple du sia dzi oa?
ENGLISH: 17 And the king loved Esther better than any of the women, and she won more admiration and favor from him than any of the maidens; and he set a royal tiara on her head and made her queen in Vashti’s place.

EWE: Azɔ miele dɔmedzoe dzim ɖe edzi na Israel esi miele kɔ gblẽm ɖo na Sabat la.” 19 Eya ta esi vɔvɔli nya ɖo Yerusalem ƒe agbowo nu do ŋgɔ na Sabat la ko la, meɖe gbe be woado ʋɔawo.
ENGLISH: 18 And the king gave a great banquet to all his generals and officers, the Banquet for Esther, and enacted a suspension of taxation for the provinces, and gave gifts of food in accordance with the king’s custom.

EWE: 20 Eya ta asitsalawo kple adzɔnu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi dzralawo tsi Yerusalem godo dɔ zi ɖeka alo eve.
ENGLISH: 19 And when maidens were being gathered a second time, Mordocai sitting in the king’s gate, 20

EWE: 21 Eye mehe nya ɖe wo ŋu be: “Nu ka tae mietsia gli la godo dɔna?
ENGLISH: Esther was not telling her lineage and nationality, as Mordocai had charged her not to, and Esther did as Mordocai said since she had been in his family as foster-daughter, 21

EWE: Ne miegawɔe la, matu nu kpli mi.”
ENGLISH: Esther 3:1-15

EWE: Tso ɣemaɣi la, womegavana le Sabat dzi o.
ENGLISH: But Mordocai did not bow nor do reverence.

EWE: 22 Eye megblɔ na Lewi viwo be woanɔ wo ɖokuiwo ŋu kɔm, eye woava nɔ agboawo ŋu dzɔm, be woakɔ Sabat ŋkeke la ŋu.
ENGLISH: 3 And the officials in the king’s gate said to Mordocai “How comes it you are going against the king’s orders?” 4 and when they said so to him day by day and he did not listen to them they told Haman, to see whether the position Mordocai had taken would stand.

EWE: Oo nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku esia hã dzi, eye nàkpɔ nublanui nam le wò amenuveve gbogbo la nu. 23 Azɔ hã, le ŋkeke mawo me la, mekpɔe be Yudatɔ aɖewo ɖe Asdod, Amon kple Moab nyɔnuwo.
ENGLISH: For he had told them he was a Jew. 5 And Haman saw that Mordocai was not bowing and doing reverence to him; and Haman was filled with ire, 6 and scorned to lay hands on Mordocai alone (for they had told him Mordocai’s nationality), and Haman undertook to root out all the Jews in Xerxes’ empire, Mordocai’s people.

EWE: 24 Eye wo viwo ƒe afã doa Asdodgbe, eye woƒe afã doa dukɔ bubuwo ƒe gbe, wo dometɔ aɖeke metea ŋu doa Yudagbe o.
ENGLISH: 7 In the first month (that is, the month of Nisan) in the year twelve of Xerxes’ reign, they cast pur (that is, the lot) before Haman from day to day and from month to month, and the lot fell on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month (that is, the month of Adar).

EWE: 25 Mehe nya ɖe wo ŋu heka mo na wo, meƒo fi de wo, meƒo ŋutsuawo dometɔ aɖewo henyɔ ɖa na wo, mena wotà Mawu, eye megblɔ na wo be: “Migatsɔ mia vinyɔnuwo na wo viŋutsuwo o, eye migaɖe wo vinyɔnuwo dometɔ aɖeke na mia viŋutsuwo alo miawo ŋutɔwo miaɖe wo o.
ENGLISH: 8 And Haman said to King Xerxes “There is one people scattered and keeping separate among the peoples in all the provinces of your empire, and their laws are different from those of any people, and they do not comply with the king’s laws; and it does not pay the king to tolerate them.

EWE: 26 Ðe menye esiawoe na Israel-fia Salomo wɔ nu vɔ̃ oa? Fia aɖeke mede enu le dukɔwo dome o; eye eƒe Mawu lɔ̃e, eye Mawu tsɔe ɖo fiae ɖe Israel blibo la nu.
ENGLISH: 9 If the king thinks best, let writs be issued to destroy them; and I will turn over ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of the administrators to put into the royal treasury.”

EWE: Gake dutanyɔnuwo na eya gɔ̃ hã wɔ nu vɔ̃. 27 Ðe woagase le mia ŋu ake be miewɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi sia gbegbe hedo kpo nuteƒewɔwɔ na mía Mawu la to dutanyɔnuwo ɖeɖe mea?”
ENGLISH: 10 And the king took his ring off his hand and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ assailant; 11 and the king said to Haman “The silver is given to you, and so is the people, to do as you think best with.”

EWE: 28 Nunɔlagã Eliyasib viŋutsu Yoyada ƒe viwo dometɔ ɖeka nye Horontɔ Sanbalat ƒe toyɔvi. Eya ta menyae ɖa le ɖokuinye ŋu.
ENGLISH: 13 And there was sending of writs by couriers to all the king’s provinces to kill and destroy and root out all the Jews from boy to old man, children and women, on one day, on the thirteenth of the twelfth month (that is, the month of Adar), and to take their plunder.

EWE: 29 Oo nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku wo dzi, le esi wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na nunɔlanyenye la kpakple nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo ƒe nubabla la ta.
ENGLISH: 14 A copy of the document, to be promulgated as law in each and every province, was publicly displayed to all the peoples, that they be ready on this day.

EWE: 30 Eye mekɔ wo ŋu tso dutatɔwo ƒe ɖiƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe me, eye mede dɔ asi na nunɔlawo kple Lewi viwo, ame sia ame kple etɔ, 31 eye mewɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nakenana ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiawo dzi kple kutsetse gbãtɔwo nana ŋu. Oo nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku dzinye, hena nye nyui.
ENGLISH: 15 The couriers went out posthaste by royal order, and the law was promulgated in Susa Citadel, and the king and Haman sat down to drink; and the city of Susa was in confusion.

EWE: Esta
ENGLISH: Esther

EWE: 1 Le Ahasweros si ɖu fia ɖe nuto alafa ɖeka blaeve vɔ adre dzi tso India va se ɖe Etiopia ŋɔli,
ENGLISH: 4 And Mordocai, finding out all that had been done, tore his clothes and put on a sackcloth and ashes and went out through the middle of the city giving a loud and bitter cry.

EWE: 2 le ŋkeke mawo me esi Fia Ahasweros bɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi le Susan mɔ́ me la,
ENGLISH: 2 And he came in front of the king’s gate (for there was no going into the king’s gate in sackcloth costume).

EWE: 3 eɖo kplɔ̃ na eƒe amegãwo katã kple eŋumewo le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe etɔ̃lia me.
Persia kple Media ƒe aʋakɔ la, bubumewo kple nutodziɖulawo nɔ eŋkume,
ENGLISH: And in each and every province in the place where the king’s word and law arrived there was great mourning of the Jews, and fasting and weeping and wailing, and sackcloth and ashes were spread for most of them. 4

EWE: 4 eye wòɖe eƒe fiaɖuƒe gã la ƒe kesinɔnuwo kple eƒe gãnyenye ƒe bubu kple nyonyo fia wo ŋkeke geɖe, ŋkeke alafa ɖeka blaenyi sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: And Esther’s maids and eunuchs came in and told her; and the queen was quite horrified and sent clothing to dress Mordocai and get his sackcloth off him, but he would not receive it.

EWE: 5 Eye esi ŋkeke siawo wu enu la, fia la ɖo kplɔ̃ na ame siwo katã le Susan mɔ́ la me, ame ŋkutawo kple ame tsɛwo siaa, ɖe fia ƒe fiasã la ƒe abɔ me, le xɔxɔnu la, ŋkeke adre sɔŋ.
ENGLISH: 5 And Esther called Hathac, one of the king’s eunuchs whom he had set to wait on her, and gave him an errand to Mordocai to find out what was the story and why.

EWE: 6 Wotsi avɔ ɣitɔ, dzĩtɔ kple blɔtɔ, siwo ŋu wosa aklala kple aɖabɛ dzĩtɔ ƒe kawo ɖo la ɖe klosalosigɛ siwo wowɔ ɖe kpe xɔasi sɔtiwo ŋu la ŋuti, eye woda sikabatiwo kple klosalobatiwo ɖe anyigba si woɖo kpe zɔzrɔ̃e xɔasi hẽtɔ, ɣitɔ, adzagba kple kpe zɔzrɔ̃e xɔasi yibɔtɔ ɖo la dzi. 7 Wotsɔ wain tsae be woano le sikakpluwo me; kplu ɖe sia ɖe to vovo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ, eye wain si fia na la sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ, abe ale si dze fia ene.
ENGLISH: 6 And Hathac went out to Mordocai in the city square in front of the king’s gate, 7 and Mordocai told him everything that had happened to him and the details about the money Haman had said he would turn over to the royal treasury for the Jews, to have them destroyed, 8 and gave him a copy of the engrossed law that had been promulgated in Susa to root them out, which he was to show to Esther and tell her of, and to charge her to go in to the king and supplicate him and intercede with him for her people.

EWE: 9 Fianyɔnu Wasti hã ɖo kplɔ̃ na nyɔnuwo le Fia Ahasweros ƒe fiasã me.
ENGLISH: 9 And Hathac went in and told Esther what Mordocai said.

EWE: 10 Le ŋkeke adrea gbe, esi wain na fia la ƒe dzi le dzidzɔ kpɔm la, egblɔ na Mehuman, Bizta, Harbona, Bigta, Abagta, Zetar kple Karka, siwo nye fiaŋume adre siwo subɔa Fia Ahasweros ŋutɔ la 11 be woakplɔ fianyɔnu Wasti ava fia la ŋkume, eye eƒe fiakuku nanɔ eta, ne wòaɖe eƒe tugbedzedze afia dukɔawo kple amegãawo, elabena edze tugbe ŋutɔ. 12 Ke esi fiaŋumewo va gblɔ fia ƒe nya la na Fianyɔnu Wasti la, egbe be yemava o. Ale fia la do dziku vevie, eye dzi bi ɖe dɔme nɛ.
ENGLISH: 10 But Esther said to Hathac and ordered him to tell Mordocai 11 “All the king’s household and the people of the king’s provinces know that for any man or woman who goes in to the king in the inner court uninvited the law is uniform to put him to death except for the one to whom the king holds out the golden scepter to grant him life; but I have not been summoned in to the king these thirty days”; 12 and he told Mordocai what Esther said.

EWE: 13 Eya ta fia la ƒo nu kple nunyala siwo nya ɣeyiɣiwo me nyuie (elabena aleae fia la dea adaŋu kple ame siwo bi ɖe se kple senyawo me nyuie la le eƒe nyawo katã mee,
ENGLISH: 13 But Mordocai told him to take back to Esther the word “Do not imagine that you in the king’s house will get away with your life any more than all the Jews.

EWE: 14 eye eƒe aɖaŋuɖola vevi siwo nɔa eŋue nye Karsena, Setar, Admata, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena, kple Memukan, Persia kple Media ƒe amegã adre, siwo dona ɖe fia la ŋkume, eye woawoe le ɖoƒe kɔkɔtɔ le fiaɖuƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 14 For if you do keep silence at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will present itself from elsewhere, but you and your family will perish.

EWE: 15 Fia la bia wo be: “Esi Fianyɔnu Wasti mewɔ ɖe Fia Ahasweros ƒe nya si wògblɔ to fiaŋumewo dzi la dzi o ɖe, nu kae wòle be woawɔ nɛ le se nu?”
ENGLISH: And who knows if it was for an occasion like this that you came to queenhood?”

EWE: 16 Eye Memukan gblɔ le fia la kple amegãawo ŋkume be: “Menye fia la ɖeɖe ko ŋue Fianyɔnu Wasti da vo ɖo o, ke boŋ amegãwo katã kple ame siwo katã le Fia Ahasweros ƒe fiaɖuƒea ƒe nutowo katã me ŋue. 17 Elabena srɔ̃nyɔnuwo katã le fianyɔnu la ƒe nuwɔna la ŋu nya se ge, eye wogbɔna vlo do ge wo srɔ̃ŋutsuwo agblɔ be, ‘Fia Ahasweros ŋutɔ gblɔ be woakplɔ Fianyɔnu Wasti ava ye ŋkume, gake egbe meyi o ɖe.’
ENGLISH: 15 And Esther told him to take back word to Mordocai 16 “Go gather all the Jews that are to be found in Susa and fast for me, and do not eat nor drink for three days, night and day; I and my maids will fast in the same way too; and with that I will go in to the king, which is not according to law, and when I perish I perish.” 17 And Mordocai went along and did just as Esther ordered him to.

EWE: Esta
ENGLISH: Esther

EWE: 2 Le nu siawo megbe esi Fia Ahasweros ƒe dziku la nu fa la, eɖo ŋku nu si Wasti wɔ kple ale si wòtso nya me le eŋu la dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 And on the third day Esther put on royal robes and stood in the inner court of the king’s house opposite the king’s house, while the king was sitting on his royal throne in the royal house opposite the door of the house.

EWE: 2 Eye fiaŋume siwo subɔnɛ gblɔ nɛ be: “Woadi ɖetugbui leaƒe dzetugbewo na fia la.
ENGLISH: 2 And when the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court he admired her; and the king held out for Esther the golden scepter he had in his hand, and Esther came up and touched the head of the scepter.

EWE: 3 Eye fia la neɖo dzikpɔlawo le eƒe fiaɖuƒea ƒe nutowo katã me, ne woaƒo ɖetugbui leaƒe dzetugbewo katã nu ƒu ɖe Susan mɔ́ la me, le nyɔnuwo ƒe aƒe la me.
ENGLISH: 3 And the king said to her “What is the matter, Queen Esther? what is the boon you want? up to half the empire, it shall be given you.”
