EWE: 5 Nu kae miawɔ le takpegbe Kple Yehowa ƒe ŋkekenyui la ɖugbe?
ENGLISH: 5 And you shall stumble today, and a prophet too with you shall stumble in the night; and I will cut off your mother.

EWE: 6 Elabena kpɔ ɖa, woasi le esi wotsrɔ̃ wo ta.
ENGLISH: 6 My people is cut off because of not knowing.

EWE: Egipte aƒo wo nu ƒu, eye Memfis aɖi wo. Dza amie ɖe woƒe klosalonu veviwo dzi,
ENGLISH: Because you have rejected knowledge I have rejected you from being priest to me; you have forgotten your God’s instructions, I on my part will forget your sons.

EWE: Eye ŋù amie ɖe woƒe agbadɔwo me. 7 Kpɔkpɔɖaŋkeke la gbɔna, Tohegbe la aɖo, Eye Israel anya nu si wònye.
ENGLISH: 7 The more there were of them the more they sinned against me I will substitute contempt for your honors.

EWE: Le wò vodada gbogboawo ta, elabena wolé fu wò vevie ŋutɔ.” 8 Efrayim ƒe gbetakpɔla nɔ nye Mawu gbɔ.
ENGLISH: 8 They eat my people’s sin and fix their appetite on its guilt.

EWE: Fuléle le eƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me. 9 Woƒo wo ɖokuiwo ɖe nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ me vĩi abe le Gibea ŋɔli ene.
ENGLISH: 9 And the priest will be the same as the people, and I will punish him for his courses and send retribution for his practices.

EWE: Aɖo ŋku woƒe vodada la dzi eye wòahe to na wo ɖe woƒe nu vɔ̃wo ta. 10 “Mekpɔ Israel le gbegbe abe waintsetse ene.
ENGLISH: 10 And they shall eat and not feel full, live licentiously and not be prolific, because they have left Jehovah,

EWE: Eye wozu ŋunyɔnu abe nu si ŋu woƒe dzi ku ɖo la ke ene. 11 Efrayim hã ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe dzo dzo abe xevi ene;
ENGLISH: 11 faithfully keeping up unchastity and wine and grape-juice that take away the brain.

EWE: Ale be vidzidzi, fufɔfɔ kple fudodo aɖeke meli o. 12 Ne wonyi viwo wotsi hã la, Mana woaku na wo, ale be ame aɖeke maganɔ anyi o;
ENGLISH: 12 My people puts questions to its bit of wood, and its staff informs it, because a spirit of prostitution has misled them and they have gone from under Jehovah into prostitution.

EWE: Baba na wo, ne metrɔ ɖa le wo ŋu! 13 Efrayim, si wodo ɖe lãnyiƒe la le nam abe Tiro ene;
ENGLISH: 13 They sacrifice on the mountaintops and make burnings on the hilltops, under oak and storax and terebinth, because their shade is good.

EWE: Azɔ Efrayim akplɔ viawo ayi amewuƒe.”
ENGLISH: Therefore your daughters prostitute themselves and your daughters-in-law take to adultery.

EWE: 14 Oo Yehowa, na nu si wòle be nàna wo la wo. Na vidzidɔ si metsɔa fu o kple no ƒuƒui kplalɛ wo.
ENGLISH: 14 I will not punish your daughters because they prostitute themselves nor your daughters-in-law because they take to adultery, for those men themselves go apart with loose women and sacrifice with religious prostitutes; and an unintelligent class lets itself be hustled down.

EWE: 15 “Gilgal ye wowɔ woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖiwo katã le, eye tso afi mae melé fu wo.
ENGLISH: 15 If you, Israel, are unchaste, let Judah not incur guilt.

EWE: Nyemayi edzi alɔ̃ wo ɖaa o; Woƒe amegãwo katã nye aglãdzelawo.
ENGLISH: And do not go into the Gilgal nor up to Beth-Aven, nor swear “By Jehovah.”

EWE: 16 Woada nu Efrayim. Woƒe kè aƒu, womatse ku aɖeke o. Eye ne wodzi vi hã la, mana woƒe dɔmevi siwo gbɔ womelɔ̃a nu le o la naku.”
ENGLISH: 16 For Israel has been balking like a balky cow now Jehovah is to pasture them like a sheep in the open!

EWE: 17 Nye Mawu agbe wo,
ENGLISH: 17 Ephraim is partner with idols; let him alone.

EWE: Elabena womeɖo toe o, Eye woazu sisilawo le dukɔwo dome.
ENGLISH: 18 Their drink passes off, they take to lechery; her shields do love contempt.

EWE: Hosea
ENGLISH: Hosea

EWE: 10 “Wainka si le gbegblẽm ye Israel nye, etsea ku.
ENGLISH: 10 Judah’s generals have been like those that displace a boundary-mark; I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

EWE: Ale si eƒe tsetsewo dzi ɖe edzii la, nenemae wòna eƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo sɔa gbɔ ɖe edzii;
ENGLISH: 11 Ephraim is denied justice, is persecuted in judgment, because they insisted on following a mandate.

EWE: Ale si eƒe anyigba wɔ nui la, nenemae wòɖi sɔti dzeani geɖewoe.
ENGLISH: 12 And I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like dry-rot to the house of Judah.

EWE: 2 Alakpadzi ye le wo si; Azɔ woabu fɔ wo. Ame aɖe agbã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo eye wòagblẽ woƒe sɔtiwo.
ENGLISH: 2 He will make us well in two days, the third day he will have us standing up, to be alive before him and know him.

EWE: 3 Azɔ woagblɔ be, ‘Fia aɖeke mele mía si o, elabena míegbe Yehowa vɔvɔ̃.
ENGLISH: 3 Let us strive to know Jehovah; like gray dawn, his coming up is ready; and he will come to us like rain, like spring rains watering earth.

EWE: Nu ka gɔ̃e fia awɔ na mí?’ 4 Wogblɔa nya gbɔlowo, kaa atam dzodzro heblaa nu kple wo nɔewo;
ENGLISH: 4 What shall I do with you, Ephraim? what shall I do with you, Judah? your friendliness is like a morning cloud and like dew that goes off the first thing in the morning.

EWE: Eya ta ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ mie abe aɖigbe ene le agble me. 5 Ŋɔdzi alé Samaria nɔlawo le Bet-Aven ƒe nyivilegba la ta. Esubɔlawo axa nu
ENGLISH: 5 Therefore I have hewed with prophets, killed them with the say of my mouth; and my judgment comes out like daylight,

EWE: Elabena woatsɔe adzoe le wo gbɔ ayi aboyo me. 6 Woatsɔe ayi Asiria wòanye nunana na fia gã aɖe. Woado ŋukpe Efrayim,
ENGLISH: 6 that I take pleasure in friendliness, not in sacrifice, and in acquaintance with God rather than in burnt-offerings.

EWE: Eye ŋu akpe Israel le aɖaŋuɖoɖo si dzi wòzɔ ɖo la ta. 7 Woatsrɔ̃ Samaria kple eƒe fia,
ENGLISH: 7 But they have broken treaty at Adam; there they have played me false;

EWE: 8 Woakaka Bet-Aven ƒe nuxeƒe siwo kplɔ Israel de nu vɔ̃ me la keŋkeŋ.
ENGLISH: 8 Gilead is a town of villains, tracked with blood;

EWE: Eye na togbɛwo be, ‘Mimu dze mía dzi!’ 9 Oo Israel, èwɔ nu vɔ̃ tso Gibea ŋɔli ke. Ègale edzi ko.
ENGLISH: 9 and as a man hides seed-corn priests have hid my ways; they have murdered at Shekem because they were committing enormity.

EWE: Womeɖu ame madzɔmadzɔwo dzi le aʋa me le Gibea keŋkeŋ o. 10 Ne melɔ̃ la, mahe to na wo.
ENGLISH: 10 In the house of Israel I have seen a horror; there Ephraim had prostitution, Israel was defiled;

EWE: 11 Efrayim nye nyinɔe si womla, eye nukuƒoƒo vivia enu,
ENGLISH: 11 Judah too has fixed a harvest for you. Hosea 7:1-16

EWE: Eya ta nyemeɖe fu na eƒe kɔ dzeani la o.
ENGLISH: 3 In their wickedness they make a king merry, in their deceitfulness generals;

EWE: Azɔ mana ame aɖe nado Efrayim.
ENGLISH: 4 they are all carrying on adultery.

EWE: Yuda aŋlɔ anyigba; Yakob adzoboe nɛ.
ENGLISH: 5 On our king’s day they have made generals sick with heat from wine; he dragged his hand with cynics.

EWE: 12 Miƒã dzɔdzɔenyenyekuwo na mia ɖokuiwo, eye miŋe lɔlɔ̃ si nu metsina o.
ENGLISH: 7 They all grow hot like a baking-crock, and eat up their judges: all their kings have fallen, there is no one that calls on me among them.

EWE: Mide agble ɖe anyigba wɔnu dzi na mia ɖokuiwo,
ENGLISH: 8 Ephraim is getting stirred in among the nations; Ephraim has come to be an unturned cake.

EWE: Esi ɣeyiɣi kpɔtɔ li be miadi Yehowa,
ENGLISH: 11 And Ephraim has come to be like a brainless unwary pigeon: they call Egypt, they go to Assyria.

EWE: Va se ɖe esime wòava fia nu mi le dzɔdzɔenyenye me.
ENGLISH: 12 While they are going I will spread my net over them, bring them down like birds of the air, cage them for trouble like quails.

EWE: 13 Ke hã, miede nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe agble, Mieŋe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ, Eye mieɖu beblekutsetse; Elabena mieɖo ŋu ɖe miaƒe zɔzɔme ŋu,
ENGLISH: 13 It is woe to them, because they have lost touch with me; it is spoliation for them, because they have rebelled against me; and I was ransoming them and they made lying talk against me,

EWE: Ðe miaƒe aʋawɔla gbogboawo ŋu. 14 Hoowɔwɔ le ɖiɖim ɖe wò dukɔ la ŋu, Woagbã wò du sesẽwo katã, Abe ale si Salman gbã Bet-Arbel
ENGLISH: 14 and they did not cry to me in their hearts when they were howling on their beds, lodging away from home on account of grain and grape-juice, turning in to lodge with me.

EWE: Le aʋakpegbe, esime woxlã vidada kple viawo ɖe nu ene. 15 Oo Betel, alea kee woawɔ mi, le miaƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ si gbɔ eme la ta.
ENGLISH: 15 And I had disciplined, strengthened their arms, and they were thinking up evil against me.

EWE: Woatsrɔ̃ Israel-fia godoo le agudzeɣi.”
ENGLISH: In their own country foes oppress them;

EWE: Hosea
ENGLISH: Hosea

EWE: 11 “Esi Israel nɔ ɖevime la, melɔ̃e, Eye meyɔ vinye la tso Egipte vɛ.
ENGLISH: 8 they fly like a vulture against Jehovah’s house since they have violated my covenant and been rebellious against my instructions.

EWE: 2 Zi ale si woyɔ woe la, Zi nenemae wote yi adzɔgee.
ENGLISH: 2 They cry to me “My God”; we know you, Israel.

EWE: 3 Evɔ wònye nyee fia azɔlizɔzɔ Efrayim, eye mekɔa wo ɖe nye abɔwo dome hafi;
ENGLISH: 3 Israel has repudiated what is good; an enemy will pursue them.

EWE: Ke womekpɔe dze sii be meda gbe le yewo ŋu o. 4 Mede lɔlɔ̃ka, si nye amegbetɔ ƒe ka wo tsɔ kplɔ woe;
ENGLISH: 4 They have set up kings, but not from me; a government, and I did not know it.

EWE: Eye metsɔ nuɖuɖu vɛ na wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe beléletɔe.
ENGLISH: Their silver and gold they have made into idols, to have it swept away.

EWE: 5 Womagbugbɔ ayi Egipte-nyigba dzi o, ke boŋ Asiria anye eƒe fia,
ENGLISH: 5 Your calf, Samaria, is repudiated; I am angry with them how long will they be incapable of innocence?

EWE: Elabena wogbe be yewomatrɔ ava gbɔnye o. 6 Yi atro ɖe eƒe duwo ŋu,
ENGLISH: 6 because it comes from Israel, a mechanic has made it, it is not a god.

EWE: Agblẽ eƒe gametiwo eye wòaɖu wo le woƒe nugbeɖoɖowo ta.
ENGLISH: For Samaria’s calf shall go to splinters.

EWE: 7 Nye dukɔ ɖoe be yemawɔ nuteƒe nam o. Ne woyɔ wo be woatrɔ ɖe dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋu hã, wo dometɔ aɖeke metsona o.
ENGLISH: 7 For they sow wind and reap whirlwind; it all has no stalk, a greenery that will yield no meal or if it should, outsiders would swallow it.

EWE: 8 Oo Efrayim, aleke wɔ maɖe asi le ŋuwò? Oo Israel, aleke wɔ matsɔ wò ade asi? Aleke mawɔ wò abe Adma ene?
ENGLISH: 8 Israel is swallowed up; now they have become among the nations like an unwanted piece of furniture.

EWE: Eye nye dɔme hã trɔ ɖe ŋuwò. 9 Nyematrɔ nye dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ la aƒo ɖi o. Nyemagatsrɔ̃ Efrayim azɔ o,
ENGLISH: 9 For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild ass running alone; to Egypt they have given love-gifts.

EWE: Nyematso ɖe mia ŋu le dziku me o. 10 Woadze Yehowa yome, eye wòaɖe gbe abe dzata ene;
ENGLISH: 10 When they do give among the nations, now I will gather them and they shall begin a small part of the burden of the king of princes.

EWE: Ne eɖe gbe la, viawo anɔ ƒoƒom tititi atso ɣetoɖoƒe ava. 11 Woanɔ ƒoƒom tititi abe xevi ene ahatso Egipte ava,
ENGLISH: 11 Because Ephraim has made many altars for sin-offerings, they have had them as altars for offering sins.

EWE: Eye mana woanɔ woƒe aƒewo me,” Yehowa ye gblɔe. 12 “Efrayim tsɔ alakpa ɖe to ɖem,
ENGLISH: 12 I would write down for them my multitudinous instructions; they have been rated a sickening thing.

EWE: Eye Israel ƒe aƒe la hã tsɔ beble ƒo xlãm. Ke Yuda gale zɔzɔm kple Mawu kokoko,
ENGLISH: 13 They sacrifice meat as broiled sacrifices and eat it; Jehovah has not accepted them; now he will remember their guilt and punish their sins: they shall go back to Egypt.

EWE: Eye wòwɔa nuteƒe na Kɔkɔetɔwo Ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.”
ENGLISH: 14 And Israel has forgotten his Maker and built temples, and Judah has fortified many a city; but I will send a fire into his cities and it shall devour his palaces.

EWE: Hosea
ENGLISH: Hosea

EWE: 12 “Efrayim le ya ɖum, Eye wòtia ɣedzeƒeya yome ŋkeke blibo la katã. Edzia alakpadada kple ŋutasesẽ ɖe edzi.
ENGLISH: 9 Do not make merry exultantly like the peoples, Israel, because you have prostituted yourself to be disloyal to Jehovah; you have loved the prostitute’s gain on every threshing-floor of grain.

EWE: Wobla nu kple Asiria, eye wotsɔ ami yi Egipte. 2 Yehowa le nya he ge kple Yuda; Abia akɔnta Yakob ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme nu,
ENGLISH: 2 Threshing-floor and wine-vat shall not feed them, and grape-juice shall disappoint them;

EWE: Eye wòaɖo eteƒe nɛ ɖe eƒe nuwɔnawo nu. 3 Elé nɔvia ƒe afɔkpodzi le dɔ me,
ENGLISH: 3 they shall not live in Jehovah’s country, but Ephraim shall go back to Egypt and they shall eat unclean food in Assyria.

EWE: Eye wòtsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ te kame kple Mawu. 4 Ete kame kple mawudɔla ʋuu ɖu edzi. Efa avi, eye wòƒo koko be woave ye nu.”
ENGLISH: 4 They shall not pour libations of wine to Jehovah, not lay out their sacrifices for him; their sacrifices shall be to them like trouble-bread, whose eaters all become unclean, because their bread is for their appetites, it is not to come into Jehovah’s house.

EWE: Ekpɔe le Betel, eye wòƒo nu kpli mí le afi ma. 5 Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu,
ENGLISH: 5 What will you do on the anniversary day, the day of Jehovah’s feasts?

EWE: Yehowae nye ŋkɔ si wotsɔ ɖoa ŋku edzii. 6 “Eya ta trɔ ɖe wò Mawu ŋu, Nɔ dɔmenyonyo kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ dzi,
ENGLISH: 6 because they are gone owing to rapine, Egypt is to gather them, Memphis is to bury them; their silver attractions nettles shall possess, briers be in their homes.

EWE: Eye kpɔ mɔ na wò Mawu ɣeawokatãɣi. 7 Ke alakpanudanu le asitsala si;
ENGLISH: 7 The days of punishment have come, the days of retribution have come, Israel shall know; the prophet is an ignoramus, the inspired man a lunatic, because of the excess of your guilt.

EWE: Elɔ̃a amebaba. 8 Efrayim le gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Nyateƒee, mezu kesinɔtɔ; Kesinɔnuwo su asinye. Le nye dagbadagbawo katã me la, womakpɔ nu gbegblẽ alo nu vɔ̃ aɖeke o.’
ENGLISH: 8 Ephraim’s watchman with my God suffers great spite; the prophet has fowlers’ traps on all his paths, spite in his God’s house; they have dug his pit deep.

EWE: 9 Nyee nye Yehowa wò Mawu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ke. Magana nànɔ agbadɔwo me
ENGLISH: 9 As in Gibeah’s days he will remember their guilt, will punish their sins.

EWE: Abe le ŋkekenyuiɖuɣi ene. 10 Meƒo nu kple nyagblɔɖilawo, Meɖe ŋutega geɖe fia wo,
ENGLISH: 10 I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness, I saw your fathers like an early fig on the tree at the first of its crop; they came to Baal-Peghor and performed rites to the Shame and became objects of disgust as they loved to.

EWE: Eye medo lowo to nyagblɔɖilawo dzi. 11 Wowɔa ameflunu le Gilead, eye wowɔa alakpanuwo hã.
ENGLISH: 11 Ephraim’s glories are taking flight like a bird: off from birth, off from expectations of birth.

EWE: Eye woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo hã le abe kpe siwo woli kɔ ɖe agble me ene. 12 Yakob si yi Aram-nyigba dzi; Israel subɔ le afi ma ɖe nyɔnu ta,
ENGLISH: 12 If they do raise their children I will bereave them of every human being; yea, woe to them when I go back from them.

EWE: Eye nyɔnu tae wòdzɔ alẽwo ŋu ɖo. 13 Yehowa kplɔ Israel dzoe le Egipte to nyagblɔɖila aɖe dzi,
ENGLISH: 13 Ephraim has stocked himself with daughters for a foe; Ephraim has to bring out his sons to a killer.

EWE: Eye wòto nyagblɔɖila aɖe dzi dzɔ eŋu. 14 Efrayim do dziku nɛ vevie;
ENGLISH: 14 Give them, Jehovah what will you give? give them a miscarrying womb and shriveled breasts.

EWE: Eƒe ʋufɔɖiɖi anɔ eya ŋutɔ dzi,
ENGLISH: 16 Ephraim is smitten; their roots are dried up, no fruit will they produce.

EWE: Eƒe Aƒetɔ la aɖo eteƒe nɛ ɖe eƒe vlodoame la nu.”
ENGLISH: Even if they have T children I will bring death to their welcome offspring.

EWE: Hosea
ENGLISH: Hosea

EWE: 13 “Ne Efrayim ƒo nu la, amewo dzona nyanyanya,
ENGLISH: 10 Israel is a luxuriant grapevine that loads itself with fruit.

EWE: Elabena ame vevi wònye le Israel. Gake le Baal ta, eɖi fɔ, eye wòku.
ENGLISH: The more he had of fruit, the more he made of altars; the better off his country, the finer he made obelisks.

EWE: 2 Azɔ wogawɔ nu vɔ̃ bubu kpee
ENGLISH: 2 Their hearts are slippery.

EWE: Eye wotsɔ klosalo wɔ legbawoe; Wowɔ legbawo aɖaŋutɔe, wo katã wonye aɖaŋudɔwɔla ƒe asinudɔ.
ENGLISH: Now they must smart for it; he will break the necks of their altars, make havoc of their obelisks.

EWE: Wole gbɔgblɔm na wo be, ‘Ŋutsu vɔsalawo negbugbɔ nu na nyiviwo.’ 3 Eya ta woazu abe ŋdililikpo ene,
ENGLISH: 3 For now they will be saying “We have no king, because we do not fear Jehovah and what will the king do to us?”

EWE: Abe dzudzɔ si toa xɔtadowo nu yina ene. 4 Nyee nye Yehowa wò Mawu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ke; Mènya Mawu bubu aɖeke o, negbe nye ko,
ENGLISH: 4 talking and talking, taking empty oaths, making covenants, and justice shooting up like poppies in furrows in the field.

EWE: Xɔnametɔ aɖeke menɔ anyi o, negbe nye ko. 5 Melé be na wò le gbea dzi, le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 The denizens of Samaria shall quail for the calf of Beth-Aven because his people and his komers are mourning for him, they howl for him because of his glory, because it is deported from him.

EWE: 6 Woƒe gbeɖuƒewo ɖi ƒo na wo. Woɖi ƒo, eye woƒe dzi de asi dada me.
ENGLISH: 6 It too shall be taken to Assyria for a present to King Jareb; Ephraim shall take a humiliation, Israel be put to shame for its policy.

EWE: Ale woŋlɔm be. 7 Manɔ abe dzata ene na wo,
ENGLISH: 7 Samaria is cut off; her king is like a chip on the face of water.

EWE: Made xa ɖi abe lãklẽ ene le mɔ to. 8 Madze wo dzi abe sisiblisinɔ si ƒe vi bu ene, Eye mavuvu woƒe akɔta. Mavuvu wo le afi ma abe dzata ene;
ENGLISH: 8 And the heights of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be extirpated; thorns and thistles shall grow up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains “Cover us” and to the hills “Fall on us.”

EWE: Lã wɔadã avuvu wo ʋayaʋaya. 9 Oo Israel, atsrɔ̃ wò,
ENGLISH: 9 Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, Israel: there they stood, war was not to come home to them at Gibeah.

EWE: Elabena ètso ɖe nye, wò xɔnametɔ ŋu. 10 Azɔ afi kae wò fia la le, ne wòaxɔ na wò le wò duwo katã me, Eye afi kae wò dziɖula siwo ŋu nègblɔ le be,
ENGLISH: 10 I have come against men of foul play to chastise them, and peoples shall be brought together against them, for their going off to their two crimes.

EWE: ‘Na fia kple amegãm’ la le? 11 Mena fia wò le nye dɔmedzoe me,
ENGLISH: 11 And Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh and I myself have passed over her fine neck; I will harness Ephraim; Judah shall plow, Jacob shall harrow for him.

EWE: Maɖee ɖa le nye dziku helĩhelĩ me. 12 Wobla Efrayim ƒe vodada da ɖi;
ENGLISH: 12 Sow with honesty, reap in the way of friendliness, break new ground, and it is time to resort to Jehovah till he comes and gives you autumn rain of righteousness.

EWE: Wodzra eƒe nu vɔ̃ ɖo. 13 Ase veve abe nyɔnu si le ku lém ene. Ke vi manyanu wònye;
ENGLISH: 13 You have been plowing lawlessness, reaping foul play, eating the fruit of deceitfulness, because you have had confidence in your course, in the numerousness of your champions;

EWE: Ne azã de la, medoa ta ɖa be woadzi ye o. 14 Maɖe wo le Tsiẽƒe si me; Magbugbɔ wo axɔ le ku si me. Oo Ku, afi kae wò ti si nètsɔ le ame tém la le? Oo Tsiẽƒe, afi kae wò nugbegblẽ le?
ENGLISH: 14 and yells shall rise in your cities, and all your fortress towns shall be sacked as Shalman sacked Beth-Arbel on a battle-day, mothers’ brains dashed out after their children’s:

EWE: Dɔmetɔtrɔ aɣla ɖe nye ŋkuwo. 15 Ne etsi vlɔvlɔvlɔ le aɖawo dome hã,
ENGLISH: 15 I will do the like to you, house of Israel, because of your wicked wickedness; the king of Israel is cut off in the gray dawn.

EWE: Ɣedzeƒeya, Yehowa ƒe ya, aƒo.
ENGLISH: Hosea 11:1-12

EWE: Eƒo tso gbegbe gbɔna, ana eƒe vudo namie keŋ, eye wòana eƒe tsidzɔƒe naƒu.

ENGLISH: 2 12:3 Jehovah has a quarrel with Judah, to give Jacob a punishment to match his courses, a return to match his practices.

ENGLISH: 5 12:6 But Jehovah is the God of Armies; Jehovah is his proper name;

ENGLISH: Attend to friendliness and justice, and hope toward your God always.

ENGLISH: 7 12:8 Canaan has cheating balances in his hands; he loves to overreach.

ENGLISH: 8 12:9 And Ephraim thinks “I have got downright rich, I have made a fortune”; all that he has got by his work will not suffice for the guilt he has incurred.

EWE: Dzinyee miakpɔ kutsetse le.” 9 Ame kae nye nunyala?
ENGLISH: 9 12:10 But I am your God Jehovah since Egypt; I will set you to living in tents again as you do in the days of an annual feast,

EWE: Nese nu siawo gɔme. Ame kae nye aɖaŋudzela?
ENGLISH: 10 12:11 and I will speak to prophets, having myself given many a vision, and by prophets I will whisper.

EWE: Nedze si nu siawo. Elabena Yehowa ƒe mɔwo dzɔ,
ENGLISH: 12 12:13 And Jacob emigrated to the plains of Syria, and Israel worked for a wife, and for a wife he kept guard;

EWE: Eye ame dzɔdzɔewoe ato wo dzi; Ke nu tovo wɔlawo adze anyi le wo dzi.

ENGLISH: Hosea

ENGLISH: 13 When Ephraim spoke he made Israel’s hair stand on end; but he incurred guilt by the Baal, and he died.

EWE: 2 “Mi ametsitsiwo, mise nya sia, Eye mi anyigbadzinɔlawo katã, miƒu to anyi. Ðe esia tɔgbi dzɔ le mia ŋɔli
ENGLISH: 2 And now they go on sinning and have made themselves figures in idol form out of their silver, all artisans’ work; “to them,” say they, “sacrifice”; men kiss calves.

EWE: Alo le mia tɔgbuiwo ŋɔli kpɔa? 3 Migblɔ eŋu nya na mia viwo, Eye mia viwo nagblɔe na wo viwo,
ENGLISH: 3 So they shall be like a morning cloud and like dew that goes off the first thing in the morning, like chaff driving off a threshing-floor and like smoke out of a smoke-hole.

ENGLISH: 4 But I am your God Jehovah since Egypt, and you are not to know any God but me, and beside me there is no savior.

EWE: Eye nu si abɔwo kpɔtɔ ɖi la, ʋetsuvi gblẽnuwo ɖui. 5 Mi ahamulawo, minyɔ, eye mifa avi!

EWE: Elabena woɖe wain vivi le nu me na mi. 6 Elabena dukɔ aɖe ho va nye anyigba dzi, ŋusẽ le eŋu, eye mele xexlẽ me o.
ENGLISH: 6 When they had pasture they ate their fill; they ate their fill and their hearts went high; therefore they forgot me.

EWE: 7 Egblẽ nye wainka, eye wona nye gboti zu atitakpo,
ENGLISH: 7 And I became like a lion to them, gazing like a leopard by a road,

EWE: Ena eƒe alɔwo fu ɣie. 8 Fa avi vevie abe ɖetugbui leaƒe si ta akpanya Le eƒe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ta ene.
ENGLISH: 8 meeting with them like a bear that has lost its cubs, to tear their chests and eat them there like a lioness and have the wild beasts rip them up.

EWE: 9 Nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa nu tso le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me;
ENGLISH: 9 You are ruined, Israel, for who is your help?

EWE: Nunɔla siwo wɔa subɔsubɔdɔ na Yehowa la le konyi fam. 10 Woha agblewo, eye anyigba le nu xam; Elabena wogblẽ nukuwo, wain yeye no ƒiaƒiaƒia, ami hã nu tso.
ENGLISH: 10 Where is your king to save you, and all your generals to do you justice, that you said “Give me a king and generals”?

EWE: 11 Ŋukpe lé agbledelawo; waingbledelawo le avi fam vevie
ENGLISH: 11 I give you a king in my anger and take him from you in my wrath.

EWE: Elabena nuŋeŋe nu tso le agble me. 12 Wainka ƒu,
ENGLISH: 12 Ephraim’s guilt is packed up, his sin is laid by.

EWE: Elabena aseyetsotso trɔ zu ŋukpe le dukɔ la me. 13 Mi nunɔlawo, mita akpanya, ne miafa konyi;
ENGLISH: 13 A mother’s birth-pains are coming for him; he is an unwise son, for it is time children should not stop in the mouth of the womb.

EWE: Mi vɔsamlekpui la ƒe subɔlawo, mifa avi sesĩe.
ENGLISH: 14 I was to redeem them out of the hands of the grave, to bring them off out of death.

EWE: Mi nye Mawu ƒe subɔlawo, miva, ne miatsi akpanya me adɔ;
ENGLISH: Up with your pestilences, death! up with your poison, grave! compunction is shrouded from my sight.

EWE: Elabena nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa nu tso le mia Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.
ENGLISH: That one will pillage the whole hoard of choice articles;

EWE: 14 Miɖe gbeƒã nutsitsidɔ; miyɔ takpekpe tɔxɛ.
ENGLISH: 14 Come back, Israel, to your God, because you came to grief by your guilt.

EWE: Miƒo ametsitsiwo kple anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã nu ƒu
ENGLISH: 1:1-20 1 Jehovah’s word that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

ENGLISH: 8 Lament like a maiden with a sackcloth tied round her for the spouse of her girlhood.

EWE: 15 Aléle, ŋkeke la! Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe,

ENGLISH: 16 Is not food swept away before your eyes, gladness and glee from the house of our God?

EWE: Ðe wometsi dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyetsotso nu le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe me oa? 17 Nukuwo lé akpɔ̃ le woƒe sofiwo te. Nudzraɖoƒewo ɖi gbɔlo.
ENGLISH: 17 Kernels are befouled with dirt under their brooms; storehouses are desolate; bins are demolished, because grain is a disappointment; what should we put in them?

EWE: Womu avawo, elabena nukuwo fiã. 18 Aƒemelãwo gɔ̃ hã le xɔxlɔ̃m! Nyihawo le tsaglãla tsam, elabena gbeɖuƒe aɖeke meli na wo o!
ENGLISH: 18 Herds of cows wander about at random because there is no pasturage for them; the flocks of sheep too stand aghast.

EWE: Fɔɖiɖi la ŋuti tohehe va alẽhawo dzi. 19 Oo Yehowa, wòe mayɔ; Elabena dzo bi gbeɖuƒewo le gbedzi,
ENGLISH: 19 To you, Jehovah, they call; for fire has eaten up wilderness pastures and flame has set ablaze all the trees on the range.

EWE: Eye dzoƒaɖe fiã gbemetiwo katã. 20 Gbemelãwo gɔ̃ hã le asiwònu kpɔm, Elabena tɔʋuwo mie keŋ Eye dzo bi gbeɖuƒewo le gbedzi.”
ENGLISH: 20 Even range beasts stretch up to you because water-bearing gorges are dried out and fire has eaten up wilderness pastures.

EWE: Yoel
ENGLISH: Joel

EWE: 2 “Miku kpẽ le Zion! Mido aʋaɣli le nye to kɔkɔe la dzi. Anyigbadzinɔlawo katã nedzo nyanyanya, Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna!
ENGLISH: 2 Blow a ram-horn in Sion and sound an alarm on my sacred mountain; let all the inhabitants of the country quake, because Jehovah’s day is coming, it is almost here,

EWE: Etu aƒe! 2 Viviti kple blukɔ dogbee,
ENGLISH: 2 a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and thick air.

EWE: Alilikpo kple tsizi dogbee; Anɔ abe ale si agudzedze ƒe kekeli xɔa towo tame ene. Dukɔ aɖe li, si me tɔwo sɔ gbɔ, eye wòsẽ ŋu; Etɔgbi menɔ anyi kpɔ o, Eye ɖeke mava ɖe eyome o,
ENGLISH: Over the mountains is spread like a daybreak a great and numerous people whose like has not come since the beginning of time nor will again be for generation after generation.

EWE: Tso dzidzime yi dzidzime. 3 Dzo le nu bim le eŋgɔ, Eye dzoƒaɖe le nu fiãm le emegbe. Anyigba la le eŋgɔ abe Eden-bɔ ene; Ke emegbe nye gbegbe ɖeɖe sɔŋ,
ENGLISH: 3 Before them a fire has eaten and behind them a flame blazes; the country is like the garden of ʽEden before them and is a desolate wilderness behind them, and there is not a thing that has escaped them.

EWE: Eye naneke mate ŋu asi le enu o. 4 Wole abe sɔwo ene,
ENGLISH: 4 Their looks are as if they were ponies, and just like horses they run;

EWE: Eye woƒua du abe sɔwoe le aʋagbe dzi ene. 5 Wole kpo tim eye woƒe nuwɔna le ɖiɖim abe tasiaɖamwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ le towo tame ene, Abe dzoe le gbe ƒuƒu bim ene.
ENGLISH: 5 with a sound as if of chariots they dance on the mountaintops, with a sound as if of a flame of fire eating up stubble, like a numerous soldiery drawn up for battle.

EWE: Ele abe dukɔ sẽŋu aɖe si ho le aʋalɔgowo me ene. 6 Dukɔwo adzo nyanyanya le wo ta.

EWE: Mowo katã afu kpii. 7 Woƒua du abe aʋawɔlawo ene, Woliaa gli abe aʋamewo ene, Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le eƒe mɔ dzi,
ENGLISH: 7 They run like warriors, go up a wall like soldiers; and each goes along his own course, they do not borrow each other’s paths,

EWE: Eye womedzena le woƒe toƒewo o. 8 Wo dometɔ aɖeke memimi nɔvia o; Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe lé eƒe mɔ tsɔ; Ne wo dometɔ aɖe tsi aŋutrɔ nu hã la,
ENGLISH: 8 nor jostle each other, they go each along his own street; and they throw themselves in among the weapons without breaking their march.

EWE: Mamlɛawo metɔna o. 9 Wolũ ɖe du la dzi hege ɖe eme, woƒu du to gliwo dzi.
ENGLISH: 9 They invade the city; they run on the wall, get up into the houses, get in through the windows like a thief.

EWE: Wolia aƒewo, eye woto fesrewo nu ge ɖe eme abe fiafitɔ ene. 10 Anyigba la dzo kpekpekpe le eŋgɔ, dziƒo ʋuʋu. Ɣe kple ɣleti do viviti,
ENGLISH: 10 Before them earth shook, sky quaked, sun and moon went dark and stars withheld their radiance,

EWE: Eye ɣletiviwo hã megale keklẽm o. 11 Yehowa aɖe gbe le eƒe aʋakɔ la ŋgɔ, elabena eƒe aʋakɔ la me tɔwo sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 11 and Jehovah made his voice heard before his troops, for very large is his army, numerous are they that carry out his will.

EWE: Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la nye ŋkeke gã aɖe eye ŋɔdzi le eŋu ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: For great is Jehovah’s day, and very terrible, and who will hold out through it?

EWE: Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe enu?” 12 Yehowa be: “Azɔ la, mitsɔ dzi blibo,

EWE: Nutsitsidɔ, avifafa kple konyifafa va gbɔnye. 13 Midze miaƒe dziwo, menye miaƒe awuwo o, Eye migbugbɔ va Yehowa mia Mawu la gbɔ,
ENGLISH: 13 and tear your hearts and not your clothes and turn back to your God Jehovah, because he is kindly and tenderhearted, patient and very friendly, and repents of evil.

EWE: Eye wòagbugbɔ vɔ̃ la ŋu abu. 14 Ame kae nya ne atrɔ, eye wòagbugbɔ eŋu abu, Ale be wòagblẽ yayra ɖe megbe,
ENGLISH: 14 Who knows but he will turn back and repent and leave a blessing remaining behind him, a grain-offering and libation for our God Jehovah?

EWE: Ne woatsɔ nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa ana Yehowa mia Mawu la? 15 Miku kpẽ le Zion!
ENGLISH: 15 Sound a ram-horn in Sion, ordain a fast, proclaim a holiday; bring people together, ordain an assembly,

EWE: Miɖe gbeƒã nutsitsidɔ kɔkɔe; miyɔ takpekpe tɔxɛ. 16 Miƒo dukɔ la nu ƒu; mikɔ ameha la ŋu. Miƒo amegãɖeɖiwo nu ƒu; miƒo ɖeviwo kple vi nonowo nu ƒu.
ENGLISH: 16 gather old men, bring together children from play and babies at the breasts; let bridegroom come out from his chamber, bride from her bower; let the priests, the servitors of Jehovah,

ENGLISH: 18 And Jehovah was jealous for his country and had mercy on his people;

ENGLISH: 19 and Jehovah answered his people “Here, I am sending you the grain and the grape-juice and the oil, and you shall have your fill of them, and I will not give you to be taunted again among the nations.

EWE: Nyemagana miazu vlodonu le dukɔwo dome azɔ o. 20 Manya dziehetɔ la ɖa le mia ŋu ayi adzɔge ʋĩi; Manyae ɖo ɖe kuɖiɖinyigba dzi kple gbegbe, Atrɔ mo ɖe ɣedzeƒeƒu la ŋu, Eye wòatrɔ megbe ade ɣetoɖoƒeƒu la. Eƒe ʋeʋẽ ade dzi, Eye eƒe ʋeʋẽ kũu la axɔ yame katã;
ENGLISH: 20 And I will take the northerner off you far away, and banish him to a country of drought and desolation, his face to the eastern sea and his hinder end to the western sea, for his stench to come up, because he has done great things.

EWE: Elabena Mawu awɔ nu gãgãwo.’ 21 Oo anyigba, mègavɔ̃ o.
ENGLISH: 21 Do not be afraid, soil; jubilate and make merry, because Jehovah has done great things.

ENGLISH: 23 and the sons of Sion will jubilate and make merry in your God Jehovah because he has given you refreshment fairly and sent down showers for you, autumn rain and spring rain as he had at first,

EWE: Keletsi kple adatsi adza na mi abe tsã ene. 24 Nukuƒoƒewo ayɔ fũu kple nuku nyui,
ENGLISH: 24 and the threshing-floors will be full of grain and the presses brimming with grape-juice and oil;

EWE: Wain yeye ayɔ wainfiãƒewo agbagba, eye ami ado agbogbo ɖe amiɖaƒewo. 25 Maɖo ƒe siwo Ʋetsuviwo ƒe ha gã, abɔwo, ʋetsuvi gblẽnuwo kple ʋetrawo ɖu nuwo la teƒe na mi;
ENGLISH: 25 and I will make good to you the years that the spring and summer and fall and early grasshoppers ate, my great corps that I sent among you;

EWE: Woawoe nye nye aʋakɔ gã si medɔ ɖe mia ŋu. 26 Miaɖu nu, aɖi ƒo, Eye miakafu Yehowa mia Mawu, Ame si wɔ nukunu siawo na mi la ƒe ŋkɔ;
ENGLISH: 26 and you shall eat your fill on and on, and praise the name of your God Jehovah who has worked with you in extraordinary fashion; and my people shall not be put to shame forever,

EWE: Ŋu magakpe nye dukɔ la azɔ o. 27 Eye miadze sii be, mele nye dukɔ Israel dome, Be nyee nye Yehowa mia Mawu, eye ɖeke megali o!
ENGLISH: 27 and you shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and I Jehovah am your God and there is no other, and my people shall not be put to shame forever.

EWE: Ŋu magakpe nye dukɔ la azɔ o. 28 Le nu siawo megbe la, matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la akɔ ɖe ŋutilãwo katã ƒomevi dzi, Eye mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo agblɔ nya ɖi. Miaƒe amegãɖeɖiwo aku drɔ̃ewo.
ENGLISH: 28 And after this I will pour out my spirit on all mortals and your sons and daughters will be under the power, your old men will have dreams and your young men visions,

EWE: Eye miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo akpɔ ŋutegawo. 29 Matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la akɔ ɖe
ENGLISH: 29 and on the very slaves I will pour out my spirit in those days;

EWE: Nye kluviwo kple nye kosiwo gɔ̃ hã dzi le ŋkeke mawo me. 30 Mana dzesi wɔnukuwo nado ɖe dziƒo kple anyigba dzi:
ENGLISH: 30 and I will give prodigies in the sky and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke;

EWE: Ʋu, dzo kple dzudzɔ babla kɔtɔɔ. 31 Ɣe ado viviti, eye ɣleti azu ʋu,
ENGLISH: 31 the sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of Jehovah’s great and terrible day.

EWE: Hafi Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke gã dziŋɔ la nava ɖo. 32 Eye ame sia ame si yɔa Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ la, woaɖee; Elabena amewo ado le eme dedie le Zion To dzi kple Yerusalem, abe ale si tututu Yehowa gblɔe ene, Woawoe nye agbetsila siwo Yehowa yɔ.”
ENGLISH: 32 And everyone who calls on Jehovah’s name will come off safe; for on Mount Sion and in Jerusalem there will be escape, as Jehovah has said, and among the survivors whom Jehovah calls.

ENGLISH: Joel

ENGLISH: 3 For lo, in those days and at that time, when I come back to Judah and Jerusalem,

ENGLISH: 2 I will gather all the nations and bring them down to Jehoshaphat Vale, and I will plead against them there the case of my people and of my estate Israel, whom they have dispersed among the nations and divided up my country;

EWE: Eye woma nye anyigba ɖe wo nɔewo dome. 3 Wodzidze nu ɖe nye dukɔ dzi; Wotsɔa ŋutsuvi ɖɔa li gboloe,
ENGLISH: 3 and over my people they threw lots, and gave a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine and drank it up.

EWE: Eye wotsɔa nyɔnuvi dzea wain nona. 4 Oo Tiro kple Sidon kpakple mi Filistia nutowo katã, Miawo hã nya kae le nye kpli mi dome? Nane teƒe ɖom miele nama? Ne nenemae la,
ENGLISH: 4 And, too, what is your relation to me, Tyre and Sidon and all the marches of Philistia? are you paying off a score against me? and if you are starting dealings with me, with promptest speed I will send your dealings back on your own heads,

EWE: Ekema mawɔ kaba ahe miaƒe nuwɔna ava miaƒe ta dzi alɔtsɔtsɔe. 5 Elabena mielɔ nye klosalo kple sika dzoe,
ENGLISH: 5 that you have taken my silver and gold and brought into your temples the best of my things of beauty,

EWE: Eye mietsɔ nye kesinɔnu vevitɔwo yi miaƒe gbedoxɔwo me; 6 Eye mietsɔ Yuda viwo kple Yerusalem viwo dzra na Helatɔwo,
ENGLISH: 6 and the sons of Judah and of Jerusalem you have sold to the sons of the Greeks so as to get them far away from their territory:

EWE: Be miana woaɖanɔ adzɔge ʋĩi tso woƒe anyigba gbɔ; 7 Kpɔ ɖa, mana woatrɔ tso teƒe siwo miedzra wo woyi la,
ENGLISH: 7 here I am going to rouse them out of the place to which you sold them, and will send your dealings back on your own heads

EWE: Eye mahe miaƒe nuwɔna la ava miaƒe ta dzi. 8 Madzra mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo na Yuda viwo, Eye woawo woadzra wo na Sebatɔwo, dukɔ si le didiƒe ke;
ENGLISH: 8 and sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them to the Shebaites into a far-off nation, because Jehovah has spoken.

EWE: Elabena Yehowa ŋutɔe gblɔe. 9 Miɖe gbeƒã nya sia le dukɔwo dome be: ‘Mibla akpa ɖe aʋawɔwɔ ŋu!
ENGLISH: 9 Proclaim this among the nations: ordain war, rouse the champions, let all the soldiers come on and come up.

EWE: Mina aʋakalẽtɔwo katã naho va! 10 Mitsɔ miaƒe agblenuwo tu yiwoe, eye mitsɔ miaƒe hɛ gobɛwo tu akplɔwoe.
ENGLISH: 10 Pound your hoes into swords and your pruning-hooks into lances; let the weakling declare himself a champion.

EWE: Ame beli negblɔ be: “Kalẽtɔ menye.” 11 Mi dukɔ siwo katã ƒo xlã mí godoo, miva ƒo takpli!’”
ENGLISH: 11 Come with a rush, all nations from all sides, and gather; there, Jehovah, have your champions come down.

EWE: Oo Yehowa, na wò kalẽtɔwo naɖi va afi ma. 12 Dukɔwo netso, ne woayi Yehosafat Bali la me;
ENGLISH: 12 Let the nations be roused and come up to Jehoshaphat Vale; for there I will sit to judge all the nations from all sides.

EWE: Elabena afi mae manɔ anyi ɖo adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo katã godoo. 13 Mido hɛ gobɛ ɖa, elabena nukuawo ɖi. Miva miafanya nu, elabena wainfiãƒe la yɔ.
ENGLISH: 13 Reach out a sickle, because harvest is ripe; go in, tread, because winepress is full, the presses are brimming because there is so much of their foam.

EWE: Wainfiãnuawo ɖɔ gbagba, elabena woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo do agbogbo. 14 Amehawo, ameha geɖewo le nyametsobali la me,
ENGLISH: 14 Hosts, hosts, in Decision Vale! for Jehovah’s day is near in Decision Vale.

EWE: Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe, le nyametsobali la me. 15 Ɣe kple ɣleti ado viviti,
ENGLISH: 15 Sun and moon go dark and stars withhold their radiance,

EWE: Eye ɣletiviwo ƒe keklẽ nu atsi. 16 Yehowa aɖe gbe tso Zion, Eye wòana woase eƒe gbe tso Yerusalem. Dziƒo kple anyigba aʋuʋu; Ke Yehowa anye sitsoƒe na eƒe dukɔ,
ENGLISH: 16 and Jehovah roars out of Sion and raises his voice from Jerusalem, and sky and earth shake, but Jehovah is a refuge for his people and a citadel for the sons of Israel.

EWE: Kple mɔ́ sesẽ na Israel-viwo. 17 Eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa mia Mawu, ame si le nye to kɔkɔe Zion dzi. Yerusalem azu teƒe kɔkɔe,
ENGLISH: 17 And you shall know that I your God Jehovah make my abode on my sacred mountain Sion; and Jerusalem shall be sacred, and outsiders shall not pass through it again.

EWE: Eye ame tutɔwo magato afi ma ava yi azɔ o. 18 Ava eme gbe ma gbe be, towo atsyɔ wain vivi, Togbɛwo aɖuɖu notsi, Eye tsi asi ato Yuda-tɔʋuwo katã me. Tsi adzi tso Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me
ENGLISH: 18 And on that day the mountains will drip pomegranate-wine and the hills will run milk, and all the ravines of Judah will run water; and a spring will come out of Jehovah’s house and water Acacia Arroyo.

EWE: Ade tsi Akasiatibali la. 19 Gake Egipte azu aƒedo, Eye Edom hã azu gbegbe ƒeƒle sɔŋ, Elabena wosẽ ŋuta le Yuda viwo ŋu,
ENGLISH: 19 Egypt will become a desolation and Edom will become a desolate wilderness, for their outrage on the sons of Judah whose innocent blood they shed in their country;

EWE: Eye woƒe anyigba dzie wokɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖe anyi le. 20 Ke amewo anɔ Yuda ya ɖaa,
ENGLISH: 20 but Judah will be settled forever and Jerusalem to generation after generation.

EWE: Eye woanɔ Yerusalem tso dzidzime yi dzidzime. 21 Mabu woƒe ʋu si nyemebu ʋu maɖifɔe tsã o la, ʋu maɖifɔe, Eye Yehowa anɔ Zion.”
ENGLISH: 21 And I will avenge their blood which I did not avenge; and Jehovah makes his abode in Sion.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 1 Esiae nye Amos, si nye alẽkplɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka le Tekoa la, ƒe ŋutega si wòkpɔ ku ɖe Israel ŋu ƒe eve do ŋgɔ na anyigbaʋuʋu la, le Yuda-fia Uziya ŋɔli, kple Israel-fia Yeroboam, si nye Yoas vi ŋɔli la, me nyawo.
ENGLISH: 1 The words of ʽAmos, who was among the Tekoaʽ breeders of shortlegged sheep, which he beheld about Israel in the time of King ʽUzzijah of Judah and of King Jeroboam the son of Joash of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

EWE: 2 Egblɔ be: “Yehowa aɖe gbe tso Zion, Eye wòana eƒe gbe naɖi tso Yerusalem. Lãkplɔviwo ƒe lãnyiƒewo axa nu,
ENGLISH: 2 Said he, Jehovah will roar out of Sion and from Jerusalem he will raise his voice, and the shepherds’ pastures shall mourn and the top of Carmel dry up.

EWE: Eye Karmel tame aƒu.” 3 “Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘“Le Damasko ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o,
ENGLISH: 3 Says Jehovah, For Damascus’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for their threshing Gilead with iron threshing-drags;

EWE: Elabena wohe galuƒotasiaɖam to Gilead dzi. 4 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Hazael ƒe me,
ENGLISH: 4 but I will send a fire into Hazael’s house and it shall devour Ben-Hadad’s palaces,

EWE: Ne wòafiã Ben-Hadad ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo. 5 Maŋe Damasko ƒe gametiwo; Matsrɔ̃ Bikat-Aven nɔlawo, Eye matsrɔ̃ ame si le dzi ɖum le Bet-Eden;
ENGLISH: 5 and I will break Damascus’s bar and cut off inhabitant from Aven’s plain and scepter-wielder from ʽEden’s house, and Syria’s people shall be deported to Kir, says Jehovah.

EWE: Eye woaɖe aboyo Siria dukɔ la ayi Kir,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.’ 6 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘“Le Gaza ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o,
ENGLISH: 6 Says Jehovah, For Ghaza’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for their deporting an entire population to hand them over to Edom;

EWE: Elabena woɖe aboyo ha blibo la hekplɔe yi ɖade asi na Edom. 7 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Gaza ƒe gliwo dzi,
ENGLISH: 7 but I will send a fire into Ghaza’s wall and it shall devour her palaces,

EWE: Ne wòafiã eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo. 8 Matsrɔ̃ Asdod nɔlawo, Eye matsrɔ̃ ame si le dzi ɖum le Askelon; Matrɔ nye asi ɖe Ekron ŋu,
ENGLISH: 8 and I will cut off inhabitant from Ashdod and scepter-wielder from Ashkelon and bring my hand back against ʽEkron, and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, says Jehovah.

EWE: Eye Filistitɔwo ƒe ame susɔeawo nu ayi,” Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa ye gblɔe.’ 9 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Le Tiro ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o,
ENGLISH: 9 Says Jehovah, For Tyre’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for their handing over an entire population to Edom, and not remembering a treaty of brotherhood;

EWE: Eye womeɖo ŋku nɔviwo dome nubabla la dzi o. 10 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Tiro ƒe gliwo dzi,
ENGLISH: 10 but I will send a fire into Tyre’s wall and it shall devour her palaces.

EWE: Ne wòafiã eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo.’ 11 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Le Edom ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o, Elabena eɖe eya ŋutɔ nɔvia ɖe nu kple yi, Egbe nublanuikpɔkpɔ, Ele wo vuvu dzi ɖaa le dɔmedzoe me;
ENGLISH: 11 Says Jehovah, For Edom’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for his chasing his brother with the sword and brutalizing his sympathies, letting his anger ravage everlastingly and keeping his wrath persistently;

EWE: Eye wòlé wo ɖe dɔme ɖikaa. 12 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Teman,
ENGLISH: 12 but I will send a fire into Teman and it shall devour Bosrah’s palaces.

EWE: Ne wòafiã Bozra ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo.’ 13 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘“Le Amonitɔwo ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o,
ENGLISH: 13 Says Jehovah, For the Bene-ʽAmmon’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for their cutting open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to extend their territory;

EWE: Elabena wodze ƒo le Gilead-funɔwo nu, ne woakeke woƒe anyigba ɖe enu. 14 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Raba ƒe gliwo dzi, Ne wòafiã eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo, Ne aʋaɣli ɖi le aʋakpegbe,
ENGLISH: 14 but I will kindle a fire in Rabbah’s wall and it shall devour her palaces with cheering in a day of battle, with tempest in a day of gale,

EWE: Eye ya ƒo ʋuduʋudu le ahomtugbe. 15 Woƒe fia kple eƒe amegãwo siaa ayi aboyo me,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 15 and their king shall go to deportation, he and his generals together, says Jehovah.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 2 “Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘“Le Moab ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o,
ENGLISH: 2 Says Jehovah, For Moab’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for his burning the bones of the king of Edom for lime;

EWE: Elabena etsɔ Edom-fiawo ƒe ƒuwo mè akaloe. 2 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Moab, Ne wòafiã Keriot ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo; Moab aku le zitɔtɔ me,
ENGLISH: 2 but I will send a fire into Moab and it shall devour Kerijoth’s palaces, and Moab shall die in hubbub, with cheering, with sound of horn,

EWE: Ne aʋaɣli ɖi, eye kpẽ ɖi. 3 Maɖe dziɖula la ɖa le eme,
ENGLISH: 3 and I will cut off judge from her midst and kill all his generals with him, says Jehovah.

EWE: Eye mawu eya kple eƒe amegãwo katã,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.’ 4 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Le Yuda ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o, Elabena wogbe Yehowa ƒe se la, Eye womelé eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi o;
ENGLISH: 4 Says Jehovah, For Judah’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for their rejecting Jehovah’s instructions and not keeping his usages, and being misled by their lies which their fathers followed;

EWE: Ke boŋ alakpa siwo yome wo tɔgbuiwo dze la kplɔ wo trae. 5 Eya ta maɖo dzo ɖe Yuda,
ENGLISH: 5 but I will send a fire into Judah, and it shall devour Jerusalem’s palaces.

EWE: Ne wòafiã Yerusalem ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo.’ 6 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Le Israel ƒe aglãdzenuwɔna etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyemagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe o,
ENGLISH: 6 Says Jehovah, For Israel’s three crimes and four, I will not turn it back, for their selling out an honest man for silver and a poor man for a fee of a pair of sandals,

EWE: Eye wotsɔ ame dahe dzra ɖe afɔkpa dodo ɖeka ta. 7 Wotea ame dahewo ƒe ta ɖe to, Eye woxea mɔ na ame tsɛwo. Ame kple fofoa de ɖetugbui ɖeka gbɔ,
ENGLISH: 7 they who gulp at roadside dust on needy men’s heads and force humble men off their course, and a man and his father go to a girl so as to profane my hallowed name,

EWE: Ne woaƒo ɖi nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la. 8 Wodra ɖe avɔ siwo woxɔ awɔbae la dzi le vɔsamlekpui ɖe sia ɖe gbɔ;
ENGLISH: 8 and on blankets pawned to them they turn in beside every altar and drink at the house of their God wine paid to them in fines.

EWE: Eye wonoa agɔdzeha si woxɔ le amewo si le woƒe mawuwo ƒe me.’ 9 ‘Evɔ nyee tsrɔ̃ Amoritɔ la, Si kɔ abe sederti ene, eye wòsesẽ abe logoti ene la gbidigbidi le wo ta hafi;
ENGLISH: 9 And I had destroyed before them the Amorites whose tallness was like that of cedars and who were sturdy as oaks, but I destroyed their fruit above and their roots beneath.

EWE: Metsrɔ̃ eƒe tsetse le dzi kple eƒe ke le to me. 10 Mekplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, Eye mena miezɔ gbea dzi ƒe blaene,
ENGLISH: 10 And I had brought you up out of Egypt, and caused you to go through the wilderness forty years to take possession of the Amorites’ country,

EWE: Ne miaxɔ Amoritɔ la ƒe anyigba wòazu mia tɔ. 11 Eye meɖo mia viŋutsu aɖewo nyagblɔɖilawo Kple miaƒe ɖekakpui aɖewo Naziritɔwoe.
ENGLISH: 11 and had caused sons of yours to rise as prophets and youths of yours as devotees is this not so, sons of Israel? quoth Jehovah;

EWE: Yehowa ye gblɔe. 12 ‘Ke mienaa wain Naziritɔwo be woano,
ENGLISH: 12 but you gave the devotees wine and gave the prophets the order “You shall not prophesy.”

EWE: Eye miede se na nyagblɔɖilawo be: “Migagblɔ nya ɖi o.” 13 Eya ta magbã mi gudugudu ɖe mia nɔƒe,
ENGLISH: 13 Here I am going to make you groan where you stand as a cart full of hay groans.

EWE: Abe ale si tasiaɖam si wodo nukugba na gbãa nu le ete gudugudui ene. 14 Ame ɖeablɛ makpɔ afi aɖeke asi ayi o, Ŋusẽ avɔ le ŋusẽtɔ ŋu,
ENGLISH: 14 And a swift man shall lose the power of flight, and a strong man shall not rally his strength, and a brave man shall not save his life,

EWE: Eye aʋawɔla maɖe eƒe agbe o. 15 Aŋutrɔdala manɔ te o, Afɔ ɖeablɛtɔ masi o,
ENGLISH: 15 and the bowman shall not stand, and the swift-footed shall not escape, and the mounted man shall not save his life,

EWE: Eye sɔdola maɖe eƒe agbe o. 16 Eye ame si ƒo dzi le le aʋawɔlawo dome gɔ̃ hã
ENGLISH: 16 and the stoutest-hearted among the brave shall run away naked that day, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 3 “Oo Israel-viwo, mise nya si Yehowa gblɔ tso mia ŋu, tso ƒome blibo si wòkplɔ tso Egipte la ŋu:
ENGLISH: 3 Listen to this word that Jehovah has spoken about you, sons of Israel, about all the clan that I brought up out of Egypt:

EWE: 2 ‘Miawo koe menya le anyigbadziƒomewo katã dome. Esia tae mabia akɔnta mi ɖe miaƒe vodadawo katã ta ɖo.
ENGLISH: 2 You only I have known out of all the clans of the earth for that reason I will punish you for all your offenses.

EWE: 3 ‘Ðe ame eve dzea mɔ ɖekae ne womeɖo gbe ɖi oa?
ENGLISH: 3 Will two be walking together without their having held a tryst?

EWE: 4 Ðe dzata ɖea gbe le ave me ne mekpɔ nuléle aɖeke oa? Ðe dzatatsui tea gbe le eƒe bebeƒe ne melé naneke oa?
ENGLISH: 4 will a lion roar in the badlands without having a kill? will a two-year-old lion give tongue out of his lair without having caught anything?

EWE: 5 Ðe xevi gena ɖe mɔ̃ me le anyigba ne wometre mɔ̃ nɛ oa?
ENGLISH: 5 will a bird drop into a trap on the ground without its having a bait? will a trap spring up from the ground without making a catch?

EWE: Ðe mɔ̃ fena ne naneke meɖo eme oa? 6 Ne woku kpẽ le du me la, ɖe vɔvɔ̃ meɖoa amewo oa?
ENGLISH: 6 or will a ram-horn be blown in a city and the people not be alarmed? or will there be disaster in a city and Jehovah not have made it?

EWE: Ne vɔ̃ va du dzi la, menye Yehowa ye hee vɛ oa? 7 Elabena Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa mewɔa naneke
ENGLISH: 7 For Jehovah does not do a thing but he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

EWE: 8 Dzata ɖe gbe!
ENGLISH: 8 A lion roars: who will not fear?

EWE: Ame kae mavɔ̃ o? Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa ƒo nu!
ENGLISH: The Lord Jehovah speaks: who will not prophesy?

EWE: Ame kae agbe nyagbɔgblɔ ɖi?’ 9 ‘Miɖe gbeƒã le mɔ́ sesẽwo tame le Asdod Kple mɔ́ sesẽwo tame le Egipte-nyigba dzi. Migblɔ be: “Miƒo ƒu miaho ɖe Samaria-towo ŋu; Mikpɔ ʋunyaʋunyawɔwɔ si le eme
ENGLISH: 9 Sound a summons over palaces in Ashdod and over palaces in Egypt and say “Come together on the mountains of Samaria and see many disorders in its midst and denials of justice within it.

EWE: Kple ametafatafa siwo le edzi yim le eme la ɖa. 10 Elabena womenya nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ o,
ENGLISH: 10 And they do not know how to act squarely, quoth Jehovah, they who amass outrage and rapine in their palaces.”

EWE: Woli kɔ ŋutasesẽ kple gbegblẽ ɖe woƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo me gleglegle,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.’ 11 Eya ta ale Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa gblɔe nye esi:
ENGLISH: 11 So the Lord Jehovah says, Distress shall surround the land and strip your might off you, and your palaces shall be plundered.

EWE: Eye wòaha wò mɔ́ sesẽwo.’ 12 Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Ale si ko lãkplɔvi hea lã ƒe afɔ eve alo eƒe to kakɛ tso dzata ƒe nu mee la, Nenemae woahe Israel-vi Siwo bɔbɔ nɔ abati xɔasiwo kple aba nyuiwo dzi le Samaria la hãe.’
ENGLISH: 12 Says Jehovah, As a shepherd rescues out of a lion’s mouth two legs or a piece of an ear, so will the sons of Israel be rescued, those who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch and on the damask of a divan.

EWE: 13 ‘Misee, ne miaxlɔ̃ nu Yakob ƒe aƒe la,’ Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu, ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 13 Listen, and warn the house of Jacob, quoth Jehovah the God of Armies,

EWE: 14 ‘Elabena gbe si gbe mabia akɔnta Israel ɖe eƒe aglãdzedze ta la, Mabia akɔnta Betel ƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo hã;
ENGLISH: 14 because on the day when I punish Israel for its crimes I will punish the altars of Bethel, and the horns of the altar shall be chopped off and fall on the ground;

EWE: Woaŋe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo woage adze anyigba. 15 Magbã vuvɔŋɔlixɔ kple dzomeŋɔlixɔwo siaa.’ ‘Nyiɖuxɔwo atsrɔ̃,
ENGLISH: 15 and I will strike the winter house along with the summer house, and the ivory houses shall go, and many a house shall come to its end, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 4 “Mise nya sia, mi Basan nyinɔ Siwo le Samaria-to dzi, Mi nyɔnu siwo le ame tsɛwo tafam hele ame dahewo gbãm gudugudu,
ENGLISH: 4 Listen to this word, Bashan cows on Samaria’s highland, that deny justice to needy men and persecute poor men, that say to their lords “Bring on, let’s drink!”

EWE: Siwo le gbɔgblɔm na mia srɔ̃ŋutsuwo be: ‘Midi nane vɛ míano!’ 2 Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa tà eƒe kɔkɔenyenye be: ‘“Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 2 The Lord Jehovah has sworn by his divinity, Here are days coming upon you when you will be taken away with hooks and the last of you with fishhooks;

EWE: Eye woatsɔ ƒu akɔ miaƒe ame susɔewo ɖe dzi. 3 Miato gli ƒe gbagbãƒewo adzo, eye ame sia ame akpɔ eŋgɔ tẽe;
ENGLISH: 3 and you will go out of breaches, each straight out, and be thrown to the Harmon, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Woatsɔ mi aƒu gbe ɖe Harmon,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.’ 4 ‘Miva Betel, ne miawɔ nu tovo, Miva Gilgal, ne miawɔ nu tovo geɖe wu!
ENGLISH: 4 Come to Bethel and commit crimes, to the Gilgal and commit many; and bring your sacrifices next morning, your tithes in three days,

EWE: Kple miaƒe nu ewoliawo vɛ le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe. 5 Mitsɔ abolo ʋaʋã do dzudzɔ wòanye akpedavɔsa; Miɖe gbeƒã lɔlɔ̃nu faa nunanawo sesĩe;
ENGLISH: 5 and burn a thank-offering out of raised bread and proclaim volunteer offerings, advertise them, because that is the sort of thing you like, sons of Israel, quoth the Lord Jehovah.

EWE: Elabena aleae mielɔ̃a wɔwɔ, Oo Israel-viwo,’ Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa ye gblɔe. 6 ‘Mena miaƒe aɖuwo fu tititi le dɔwuame ta le miaƒe duwo katã me,
ENGLISH: 6 And I on my part have given your cleanness of teeth in all your cities and scarcity of bread in all your places, and you did not come back to me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Ke mietrɔ va gbɔnye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 7 “‘Mete tsidzadza mi esi wòsusɔ ɣleti etɔ̃ ne nuŋeɣi naɖo; Mena tsi dzana le du ɖeka me, ke medzana le du evelia me o. Tsi dza ɖe agble ɖeka me,
ENGLISH: 7 And so have I withheld the rain from you when it was still three months to harvest, and made it rain on one city and not made it rain on another city; one field would be rained on, and a field that I did not make it rain on would dry up;

EWE: Ke agble si me nyemena tsi dza ɖo o la me ƒu kplakplakpla. 8 Du eve alo etɔ̃ me tɔwo mu ya sagasaga yi du ɖeka gbɔ, be yewoano tsi, Ke womeɖia kɔ o;
ENGLISH: 8 and two or three cities would tramp to one city to drink water, and not get enough, and you did not come back to me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Gake mietrɔ va gbɔnye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 9 “Mena ŋdɔ sesẽ ɖu miaƒe nukuwo wofiã eye mena wodze heteku. Miedzi miaƒe abɔwo kple miaƒe waingblewo ɖe edzi, Ke ʋetsuviwo ɖu miaƒe gbotiwo kple miaƒe amitiwo;
ENGLISH: 9 I have struck you with blasting and mildew; the bourgeoning of your gardens and vineyards, your fig-trees and olive-trees, the early grasshoppers would eat, and you did not come back to me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Gake mietrɔ va gbɔnye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 10 ‘Meɖo dɔvɔ̃ ɖe mia dome abe esi va Egipte dzi ene. Metsɔ yi wu miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo, eye meha miaƒe sɔwo. Mena miaƒe asaɖawo me ƒe ʋeʋẽ kũu ɖo ŋɔti me na mi;
ENGLISH: 10 I have sent epidemics among you in Egyptian fashion; I have killed your young men in warfare, together with the carrying off of your ponies, and I have brought up into your nostrils the stench of the putrefaction of your armies, and you did not come back to me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Gake mietrɔ va gbɔnye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 11 ‘Metrɔ mi bu anyi, Abe ale si metrɔ Sodom kple Gomora bu anyi ene. Eye mienɔ abe atikpo si woɖe tso dzo me ene; Gake mietrɔ va gbɔnye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 11 I have done such overthrowing among you as God did to Sodom and Ghomorrah, and you have been like a burnt stick rescued out of a conflagration, and you did not come back to me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: 12 Eya ta Israel, aleae mawɔ wòe.
ENGLISH: 12 So I will do like this to you, Israel.

EWE: Esi wònye aleae mawɔ wòe ta la, Israel, dzra ɖo nàɖakpe kple wò Mawu.
ENGLISH: Because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel;

EWE: 13 Elabena eyae nye Ame si mè towo, eye wòwɔ ya; Ame si ɖea Eƒe susuwo fiaa amegbetɔwo, Ame si nana agudzedze zua viviti, Eye wòzɔa anyigba ƒe kɔkɔƒewo; Eŋkɔe nye Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu.”
ENGLISH: 13 for here is he who shaped mountains and created wind and tells man what is his inmost thought, he who makes dawn dusk and walks the heights of earth his name is Jehovah God of Armies.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 5 “Oo Israel ƒe aƒe, miɖo to miase konyifaha si dzi ge mala ɖe mia ŋu:
ENGLISH: 5 Listen to this word that I am striking up about you, a dirge, house of Israel:

EWE: 2 ‘Israel, si nye ɖetugbui la, dze anyi; Magate ŋu afɔ o. Wogblẽe ɖi ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi;
ENGLISH: 2 Maid Israel is down, shall rise no more, Is flung down on her own ground, has nobody to help her up.

EWE: Ame aɖeke meli afɔe ɖe tsitrenu o.’ 3 “Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Du si tsɔa ame akpe ɖeka hoa aʋa tsã la ƒe ame alafa ɖeka koe asusɔ;
ENGLISH: 3 For the Lord Jehovah says, The house of Israel shall have the city that went out a thousand left with a hundred and the city that went out a hundred left with ten.

EWE: 4 “Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe lae nye esi:
ENGLISH: 4 For the Lord Jehovah says to the house of Israel, Resort to me and live,

EWE: ‘Midim, ne mianɔ agbe. 5 Migabia Betel ta se o,
ENGLISH: 5 and do not resort to Bethel; nor are you to go into the Gilgal nor pass Beer-Shebaʽ.

EWE: Migava Gilgal o, eye migatso eme yi Beer-Seba o Elabena Gilgal ayi aboyo me godoo,
ENGLISH: For the Gilgal shall depart deported and Beth-El shall become Aven.

EWE: Eye Betel hã atsrɔ̃. 6 Midi Yehowa, ne mianɔ agbe, Ne wòagado abe dzo ene ɖe Yosef ƒe aƒe la ŋu,
ENGLISH: 6 Resort to Jehovah and live, for fear he should strike in with fire in the house of Joseph and Bethel have nobody to quench it,

EWE: Afiã Betel, eye ame aɖeke manɔ anyi atsii o. 7 Mietrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe wòzu atsa.
ENGLISH: 7 those who turn the law to wormwood and leave right lying on the ground:

EWE: Eye mietsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba. 8 Ame si wɔ Kima ɣletivihatsotso kple Kesil ɣletivihatsotso, Ame si trɔa blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi wòzua ŋdi,
ENGLISH: 8 him who makes the Pleiades and Orion, and turns gloom to morning and darkens day to night, him who calls the waves of the sea and pours them on the land his name is Jehovah;

EWE: Eŋkɔe nye Yehowa. 9 Ahe tsɔtsrɔ̃ ava ame sesẽ la dzi,
ENGLISH: 9 him who launches wreck upon a mighty one, and rapine comes upon a fortress.

EWE: Ne tsɔtsrɔ̃ nava du sesẽwo hã dzi. 10 ‘Wolé fu ame si kaa mo na ame le dugbo la nu,
ENGLISH: 10 They hate in the gate a corrector, and detest an honest talker.

EWE: Eye wonyɔa ŋu ame si toa nyateƒe. 11 Esi miexɔa agblefe le ame dahe si, Eye miexɔa eƒe nuku ɖe adzɔ nu ta la, Miaganɔ xɔ siwo mietsɔ kpe fufuwo tu la me loo,
ENGLISH: 11 So, since you trample on a needy man and take from him exactions of grain, you have built houses of dressed stone but you shall not live in them, you have planted fancy vineyards but you shall not drink the wine from them;

EWE: Alo ano wain tso waingble nyui siwo miede la me o. 12 Elabena menya miaƒe aglãdzedzewo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ Kple ale si miaƒe nu vɔ̃wo tri akɔe Mieɖea fu na ame dzɔdzɔe vevie, Miexɔa zãnu
ENGLISH: 12 for I know your crimes are many and your sins profuse people that assail a man who has right on his side, that take composition-money, and put poor men out of court.

EWE: Eye miedrɔ̃a nya dzɔdzɔe na ame dahe le dugbo la nu o. 13 Eya ta nunyala azi ɖoɖoe ɣemaɣi,
ENGLISH: 13 So the canny man in that time will be quiet, because it is a bad time.

EWE: Elabena xaxaɣi wòanye. 14 Midi nyui, menye vɔ̃ o, Ne mianɔ agbe. Ale be Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu nanɔ kpli mi,
ENGLISH: 14 Make good and not evil your object, in order that you may live and so Jehovah the God of Armies be with you as you say.

EWE: Abe ale si miawo ŋutɔwo miegblɔnɛ ene. 15 Milé fu vɔ̃, milɔ̃ nyui, Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe le dugbo la nu.
ENGLISH: 15 Hate evil and love good and plant justice in the gate: perhaps Jehovah the God of Armies will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.

EWE: Ave Yosef ƒe ame susɔeawo nu hĩ.’ 16 “Eya ta ale Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu, Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Konyifafa anɔ ablɔwo katã me, Eye woanɔ “Alele, Alele!” dom le kpɔdomeewo katã. Woayɔ agbledelawo be woava fa avi,
ENGLISH: 16 So Jehovah the God of Armies, the Lord, says, In all squares shall be wailing and in all streets they shall say “Alack, clack!” and issue a call of mourning to the farmer and wailing to experts in lamentation,

EWE: Eye woayɔ konyifala bibiwo woava fa avi.’ 17 ‘Avi aɖi le waingblewo katã me;
ENGLISH: 17 and in all vineyards shall be wailing, because I will go through your midst, says Jehovah.

EWE: Elabena mato dowòme ava yi,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 18 ‘Baba na ame siwo dzrom Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la le!
ENGLISH: 18 Ha, you who hanker after Jehovah’s day! what do you want of Jehovah’s day? it is darkness and not light;

EWE: Anye viviti, menye kekeli o. 19 Anɔ abe ale si ame nasi le dzata nu, eye sisiblisi nava do goe ene, Eye esi wòge ɖe eƒe aƒe me hetsɔ asi ɖo gli ŋu la, da ɖui.
ENGLISH: 19 as a man runs away from a lion and encounters a bear, and goes into a house and rests his hand on the wall and a snake bites him.

EWE: 20 Ðe menye vivitie Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la anye, eye menye kekeli oa;
ENGLISH: 20 Is not Jehovah’s day darkness and not light? murky and not radiant?

EWE: Ðe mado blukɔ, eye eme makɔ oa? 21 Melé fu miaƒe ŋkekenyuiwo, eye wonyɔ ŋu nam,
ENGLISH: 21 I hate, I reject your feasts, and will not smell your holiday scents.

EWE: Eye miaƒe takpekpe tɔxɛwo maʋẽ ɖem lilili o. 22 Ne miesa numevɔ blibowo kple nunavɔwo nam gɔ̃ hã la, Madze ŋunye o;
ENGLISH: 22 For if you offer me burnt-offerings, I will not accept your offerings, nor will I look at your welfare-sacrifice of stall-fed calves.

EWE: 23 Te wò hadzidziwo ƒe toɣliɖeɖe ɖa le gbɔnye;
ENGLISH: 23 Get your uproar of songs out of my way; your harp-music I do not listen to;

EWE: Nyemedi wò kasaŋkuƒoƒo viviwo mase o. 24 Nya dzɔdzɔe nesi abe tsi ene,
ENGLISH: 24 but let justice roll like water, and right like a perennial brook.

EWE: Eye dzɔdzɔenyenye nesi abe tɔ si nɔa sisim ɖaa ene. 25 Oo Israel ƒe aƒe, ɖe mietsɔ vɔsawo kple nunavɔsawo vɛ nam
ENGLISH: 25 Did you bring on to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

EWE: Le gbea dzi le ƒe blaeneawo mea? 26 Miakɔ miaƒe fia Sakut kple Kaiwan,
ENGLISH: 26 but you carried your King’s pavilion and your God’s housing.

EWE: 27 Eye mana woaɖe aboyo mi agbɔ Damasko ŋu ʋĩi ayi,’ ame si ŋkɔe nye Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 27 But I will deport you beyond Damascus, says Jehovah, whose name is God of Armies.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 6 “Baba na ame siwo kana ɖe wo ɖokuiwo dzi le Zion, Baba na ame siwo susu be yewole dedie le Samaria-to la dzi, Mi dukɔ veviwo ƒe ame ŋkutawo,
ENGLISH: 6 Ha, you who are at ease in Sion, and you who are sure of your ground on Samaria Mountain, the distinguished of the first of nations, you to whom the house of Israel come!

EWE: Ame siwo gbɔ Israel ƒe aƒe la vana! 2 Miyi Kalne ne miakpɔ. Mitso afi ma miayi Hamat Gã,
ENGLISH: 2 Go over to Calneh and see, and from there to great Hamath, and down to Philistine Gath.

EWE: Ðe wonyo wu fiaɖuƒe siawo, Alo ɖe woƒe anyigba lolo wu mia tɔa?
ENGLISH: Superior to these nations, or is their territory greater than yours?

EWE: 3 Ðe miele ŋkeke vɔ̃ la ɖem ɖa le susu me
ENGLISH: 3 you that chase a dull day and bring on an outrage-party!

EWE: Eye miele ŋutasesẽ ƒe dziɖuɖu hem vɛa? 4 Womlɔa nyiɖubatiwo dzi, eye wodrana ɖe abawo dzi
ENGLISH: 4 men that lie on ivory couches and sprawl on their divans, and eat he-lambs out of flocks and calves from the middle of a fattening-pen,

EWE: Henɔa agbowo kple nyivi damiwo ɖum le lãha la dome; 5 Wonɔa ha kpam ɖe kasaŋkuwo ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu,
ENGLISH: 5 that make verses to the harp, like David have contrived instruments of their own for accompaniment,

EWE: Eye wotoa haƒonuwo vɛ abe David ene; 6 Wokua wain ɖe kplu gãwo me wòyɔnɛ banaa wonona, Eye wosia ami nyuitɔwo.
ENGLISH: 6 that drink temple-bowls of wine and anoint themselves with prime oils, and are not put out of health by Joseph’s collapse.

EWE: Eye vɔ̃ si dzɔ ɖe Yosef dzi la meka wo o. 7 Eya ta woanɔ ŋgɔ na aboyomewo ayi aboyo me,
ENGLISH: 7 So they shall now be deported at the head of deportees, and sprawlers’ wakes shall pass away;

EWE: 8 ‘Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa tà eɖokui be:
ENGLISH: 8 Jehovah has sworn by himself.

EWE: “Yakob ƒe dàda nyɔ ŋu nam, Melé fu eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo, Eye matsɔ du la kple emenuwo ade asi,”’ Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: Quoth Jehovah the God of Armies, I abominate Jacob’s pride and hate his palaces, and will hand over city and contents.

EWE: 9 “‘“Eye ne ame ewo kpɔtɔ ɖe aƒe aɖe me la, woawo hã woaku.
ENGLISH: 9 And if there are left ten men in one house they shall die.

EWE: 10 Ƒometɔ aɖe ava fɔ wo ahatɔ dzo wo ɖekaɖeka. Alɔ woƒe ƒuawo ado goe le aƒea me, eye ne ame aɖe le xɔgã me la, abiae be, ‘Ðe ame aɖe gale gbɔwòa?’ Eye wòaɖo eŋu nɛ be, ‘Ame aɖeke meli o!’ Ekema agblɔ be, ‘Zi ɖoɖoe!
ENGLISH: 10 And his uncle and his burner shall take him up, carrying bones out of the house, and say to the one that was in the back of the house “Have you anyone else here?” and he shall say “Nobody,” and he shall say “Hush,” because Jehovah is not to be mentioned.

EWE: Elabena menye Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ yɔɣie nye esia o.’” 11 Elabena Yehowa le se dem Eye wòagbã xɔ gãwo
ENGLISH: 11 For here is Jehovah giving the order and they are to knock the big house to shivers and the little house to breaks.

EWE: Kple xɔ suewo gudugudu. 12 Ðe sɔ ate ŋu aƒu du le agakpe dzia? Alo ɖe woana nyi naŋlɔ nu le edzia? Elabena mietrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe wòzu aɖigbe,
ENGLISH: 12 Do horses run on cliffs or do cattle plow in them, that you have turned justice to opium and the fruit of right to wormwood,

EWE: Kple dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse wòle abe atsa ene. 13 Miedzɔa dzi ɖe nu maɖinuwo ŋu,
ENGLISH: 13 you that are gay over what is not an occasion, that say “Haven’t we got ourselves horns by our strength?”

EWE: Eye miegblɔna be, “Ðe menye míawo ŋutɔwo ƒe ŋutetee na ŋusẽ ɖo mía ŋu oa?” 14 Eya ta Israel ƒe aƒe, maɖo dukɔ aɖe ɖe mia ŋu,’ Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu ye gblɔe,
ENGLISH: 14 For here I am raising up against you, house of Israel, a nation that will oppress you from Lebo-Hamath to Rift Valley Arroyo.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 7 Nu si Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa na mekpɔe nye esi: Kpɔ ɖa! Edɔ ʋetsuviwo ƒe ha gã aɖe ɖa, esime nuku megbetɔwo de asi miemie me.
ENGLISH: 7 Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: there was he shaping young grasshoppers when the spring growth was starting, and there came full-grown grasshoppers after the king’s clipping.

EWE: Kpɔ ɖa, nuku siwo woƒã esime woya gbe na fia la vɔ megbee. 2 Esi ʋetsuviwo ƒe ha la ɖu anyigbadzinu miemiewo vɔ keŋkeŋ la, megblɔ be: “Oo Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa, meɖe kuku, tsɔe ke dzro! Aleke Yakob awɔ anɔ te? Elabena ŋusẽ mele eŋu o!” 3 Ale Yehowa trɔ susu.
ENGLISH: 2 They were finishing eating the herbage on the ground when I said “Lord Jehovah, forgive! how is Jacob to stand, when he is so little?” 3 Jehovah repented of this: “It shall not happen,” said Jehovah.

EWE: Eye Yehowa gblɔ be: “Madzɔ o.” 4 Nu si Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa na mekpɔe nye esi: Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 4 Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: there was the Lord Jehovah challenging to a contest by fire.

EWE: Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa yɔ dzo vɛ, be wòatsɔ ahe toe. Dzo la bi heno tsi goglowo eye wòfiã anyigba la ƒe akpa aɖe. 5 Eye megblɔ be: “Oo Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa, meɖe kuku, mègawɔe o. Aleke Yakob awɔ anɔ te? Elabena ŋusẽ mele eŋu o!” 6 Ale Yehowa trɔ susu.
ENGLISH: And it devoured the great deep and was devouring all nature, 5 and I said “Lord Jehovah, let be! how is Jacob to stand, when he is so little?” 6 Jehovah repented of this: “It shall not happen either,” said the Lord Jehovah.

EWE: Eye Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa gblɔ be: “Esia hã madzɔ o.” 7 Nu si wòna megakpɔe nye esi: Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 7 Thus he showed me: there the Lord had taken his stand by a plumb-line wall, plumb-line in hand.

EWE: Yehowa le tsitre ɖe gli si wotsɔ tsumikpe dzidzee la dzi, eye wòlé tsumikpe ɖe asi. 8 Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: “Amos, nu ka kpɔm nèle?”
ENGLISH: 8 And Jehovah said to me “What do you see, ʽAmos?” and I said “A plumb-line.”

EWE: Eye meɖo eŋu be: “Tsumikpee.” Eye Yehowa gagblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mada tsumikpe ɖe nye dukɔ Israel dome.
ENGLISH: And the Lord said “Here I am hanging a plumb-line among my people Israel: I will not go on passing them by anymore.

EWE: Nyemagatsɔe akee azɔ o. 9 Isak ƒe nuxeƒewo azu gbegbe, eye Israel ƒe kɔkɔeƒewo azu aƒedo; matsɔ yi aho ɖe Yeroboam ƒe aƒe la ŋu.”
ENGLISH: 9 And Isaac’s heights shall be desolated and Israel’s sanctuaries laid waste, and I will stand up against Jeroboam’s house with the sword.”

EWE: 10 Amaziya, si nye nunɔla le Betel, dɔ ame ɖo ɖe Israel-fia Yeroboam, ne woagblɔ nɛ be: “Amos ɖo nugbe ɖe ŋuwò le Israel ƒe aƒe la dome. Anyigba la mate ŋu ado dzi atsɔ eƒe nyawo katã o.
ENGLISH: 10 And Priest Amasiah of Bethel sent word to King Jeroboam of Israel “ʽAmos has been organizing for a revolution against you among the house of Israel; there is not room in the country for all his talk;

EWE: 11 Elabena ale Amos gblɔe nye esi: ‘Yeroboam atsi yi nu, eye woaɖe aboyo Israel tso eƒe anyigba dzi kokoko.’”
ENGLISH: 11 for ʽAmos has been saying ‘Jeroboam shall die by the sword and Israel shall depart deported from its soil.’”

EWE: 12 Eye Amaziya gblɔ na Amos be: “Oo ŋutegakpɔla, dzo, si nàyi Yuda-nyigba dzi, ne nàɖu wò abolo le afi ma, eye nàgblɔ nya ɖi le afi ma. 13 Ke mègagblɔ nya ɖi le Betel azɔ o, elabena fia ƒe kɔkɔeƒee, eye wònye fiaɖuƒe la nɔƒe.”
ENGLISH: 12 And Amasiah said to ʽAmos “Be going, seer, get safe away to Judah and eat bread there, and there you may prophesy; 13 but at Bethel you are not to go on prophesying anymore, because it is a royal sanctuary and it is a state building.”

EWE: 14 Eye Amos ɖo eŋu na Amaziya be: “Menye nyagblɔɖilae menye tsã o, eye menye nyagblɔɖila ƒe vi hãe menye o; ke boŋ lãkplɔvi kple gbotigble dzi kpɔla menye.
ENGLISH: 14 And ʽAmos answered Amasiah “I am not a prophet and I am not a member of their fellowship, for I am a sheep man and a sycamore-nipper;

EWE: 15 Ke Yehowa ɖem le lãhawo yome, eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: ‘Yi ɖagblɔ nya ɖi na nye dukɔ Israel.’ 16 Azɔ se Yehowa ƒe nya: ‘Ègblɔ be, “Mègagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe Israel ŋu o, eye mègagblɔ nya aɖeke tsi tsitre ɖe Isak ƒe aƒe la ŋu o.” 17 Eya ta ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: “Srɔ̃wò azu gbolo le dua me, eye viwòŋutsuwo kple viwònyɔnuwo atsi yi nu.
ENGLISH: 15 but Jehovah took me from behind the sheep, and Jehovah said to me ‘Go prophesy to my people Israel.’ 16 Now listen to Jehovah’s word: you say ‘You are not to prophesy about Israel nor pour out revelations about Isaac’s house’;

EWE: Woatsɔ dzidzeka ama wò anyigba, eye wò ŋutɔ àku ɖe anyigba makɔmakɔ dzi; eye woaɖe aboyo Israel tso eƒe anyigba dzi godoo.”’”
ENGLISH: 17 so Jehovah says, Your wife shall become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by measure, and you yourself shall die on unclean soil; and Israel shall depart deported from its soil.”

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 8 Nu si Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa na mekpɔe nye esi: Mekpɔ dzomeŋɔlikutsetse kusi ɖeka.
ENGLISH: 8 Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: there was a basket of fruit.

EWE: 2 Eye wògblɔ be, “Amos, nu ka kpɔm nèle?” Eye meɖo eŋu be, “Kusi si yɔ kple dzomeŋɔlikutsetsewo.”
ENGLISH: 2 And he said to me “What do you see, ʽAmos?” and I said “A basket of fruit.”

EWE: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: “Nye dukɔ Israel ƒe nuwuwu ɖo. Nyemagatsɔe ake wo azɔ o.
ENGLISH: And Jehovah said to me “The end has come to my people Israel: I will not go on passing them by anymore.”

EWE: 3 ‘Gbedoxɔmehadzidziwo atrɔ azu konyifafa gbe ma gbe,’ Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa ye gblɔe. ‘Woatsɔ ame kukuwo aƒu gbe ɖe afi sia afi
ENGLISH: 3 And palace songs shall howl on that day, quoth the Lord Jehovah; we are tired of corpses, they are tossed in every place hush!

EWE: ɖoɖoe azi toŋ!’ 4 Misee, mi ame siwo fanyaa ame dahewo, Ame siwo nana ame fafawo nu yina le anyigba la dzi,
ENGLISH: 4 Listen to this, you that gulp at a poor man’s cattle and at the sheep of the most wretched men of a country,

EWE: 5 Ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Ɣekaɣi dzinu yeye nu le yiyi ge, ne míadzra míaƒe agblemenukuwo, Eye ɣekaɣie Sabat nu le yiyi ge, ne míadzra agblemenuku? Ne míatò efa nudzidzenu ɖe eme wòanɔ sue, Ne míadzi sekel ɖe edzi
ENGLISH: 5 saying “When will the new moon be over so we can sell foodstuffs, and the sabbath, so we can open up grain, using small bushel and big shekel and juggling a cheating pair of scales,

EWE: Eye míaŋe nudanu ɖe eme atsɔ aba amee; 6 Ne míaƒle hiãtɔ ɖe klosalo nu,
ENGLISH: 6 buying needy men for money and a poor man for sandals, and sell the refuse grain?”

EWE: Eye míadzra nuku manyomanyo na amewo?’ 7 Yehowa tà Yakob ƒe Dàda be:
ENGLISH: 7 Jehovah has sworn by Jacob’s pride “I will never forget all your doings.”

EWE: ‘Nyemaŋlɔ woƒe nuwɔnawo be akpɔ gbeɖe o. 8 Menye esia tae anyigba la adzo kpekpekpe, Eye edzinɔlawo katã axa nu, Anyigba la aɖɔ abe Nil ene,
ENGLISH: 8 For all this shall not the earth quiver and have all who live on it mourn, and all of it go up like the Nile and sink down like the Nile of Egypt?

EWE: Eye wòadze agbo ahadze eme abe Egipte ƒe Nil ene oa?’ 9 Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa be,
ENGLISH: 9 And on that day, quoth the Lord Jehovah, I will make the sun set at noon and darken the earth in broad day,

EWE: Eye mana viviti nado ɖe anyigba la dzi le ŋkeke me. 10 Matrɔ miaƒe ŋkekenyuiwo woazu nuxaxa, Kple miaƒe hadzidziwo katã woazu konyifahawo. Mana amewo katã nasa akpanya ɖe ali, eye tawo katã abebe; Mana wòanɔ abe ale si woxaa nu le tenuvi ta ene,
ENGLISH: 10 and I will turn your feasts to mourning and all your songs to dirge, and place a sackcloth on every waist and baldness on every head, and make it like mourning for an only son and the last of it like a bitter day.

EWE: Eye eƒe nuwuwu anɔ abe ŋkeke vɔ̃ ene.’ 11 ‘Kpɔ ɖa! ŋkekewo li gbɔna,’ Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘Esime maɖo dɔwuame ɖe anyigba la dzi,
ENGLISH: 11 Here are days coming, quoth the Lord Jehovah, when I will send a famine in the country, not hunger for bread nor thirst for water but for hearing Jehovah’s word,

EWE: Ke boŋ ɖe Yehowa ƒe nyawo sese ŋu. 12 Woanɔ ya mum tso atsiaƒu nu yi atsiaƒu nu, Tso dziehe yi ɣedzeƒe.
ENGLISH: 12 and they shall tramp from sea to sea and straggle from north to east looking for Jehovah’s word and not finding it.

EWE: Woanɔ tsatsam anɔ Yehowa ƒe nya dim, ke womakpɔe o. 13 Gbe ma gbe la, ɖetugbui dzetugbeewo
ENGLISH: 13 On that day the beautiful maidens and the young men will swoon with thirst,

EWE: Kple ɖekakpuiwo aku ƒenyi le tsikɔwuame ta; 14 Ame siwo tàa Samaria ƒe legbawo, eye wogblɔna be, “Oo Dan, zi ale si wò mawu le agbe!
ENGLISH: 14 those that swear by the Guilt of Samaria and say “by your God, Dan” and “by the Beer-Shebaʽ road,” and they will fall and rise no more.

EWE: Amos
ENGLISH: Amos

EWE: 9 Mekpɔ Yehowa wòle tsitre ɖe vɔsamlekpui la tame, eye wògblɔ nam be: “Ƒo sɔti la ƒe tagbɔ, ne xɔa ƒe agunu naʋuʋu. Ðe ta le wo nu, eye matsɔ yi awu woƒe ame mamlɛawo.
ENGLISH: 9 I saw the Lord where he had taken his stand by the altar, and he said “Strike the pillar-head and let the ceiling shake, knock them off on the heads of them all, and the last of them I will kill with the sword: they shall not have a fugitive run away nor a refugee get to safety.

EWE: Asi atu wo dometɔ si asi, eye wo dometɔ si ate kpɔ be yeasi la ado kpo nu. 2 Ne woɖe do yi ɖabe ɖe Tsiẽƒe ke hã la, Nye asi ahe wo tso afi ma; Eye ne wolia yi dziƒowo la,
ENGLISH: 2 If they break into the world of the dead, from there my hand shall take them; and if they go up in the sky, from there I will bring them down;

EWE: Maɖiɖi wo ɖe anyi tso afi ma. 3 Ne wobe ɖe Karmel-to tame la, Madi wo le afi ma alé. Eye ne wobe ɖe atsiaƒu gɔme be magakpɔ yewo o hã la,
ENGLISH: 3 and if they hide in the top of Carmel, from there I will hunt them out and take them; and if they conceal themselves away from my eyes on the floor of the sea, from there I will commission the snake and have it bite them;

EWE: Maɖe gbe na da wòaɖu wo le afi ma. 4 Eye ne wodze woƒe futɔwo ŋgɔ yi aboyo me la, Maɖe gbe na yi wòawu wo le afi ma;
ENGLISH: 4 and if they go into foreign slavery under their enemies, from there I will commission the sword and have it kill them; and I will fasten my eyes on them for mischief and not for good.”

EWE: Maɖe ŋku atɔ wo hena woƒe gbegblẽ, ke menye na nyui o. 5 Elabena Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa ye nye Ame si ka asi anyigba la ŋu Ale be wòlólo, eye edzinɔlawo katã axa nu; Anyigba bliboa aɖɔ abe Nil ene,
ENGLISH: 5 But the Lord Jehovah of Armies who touches the earth and it surges and all who live on it mourn, and it all goes up like the Nile and sinks down like the Nile of Egypt,

EWE: Eye wòadze eme abe Egipte ƒe Nil ene. 6 ‘Ame si ɖo eƒe atrakpui ɖe dziƒowo, Eye wòtu eƒe xɔ ɖe anyigba la tame; Ame si yɔa atsiaƒumetsiwo yia dzi, Ne wòatrɔ wo akɔ ɖe anyigba dzi la,
ENGLISH: 6 who builds his stairways in the sky and founds his pyramid on earth, who calls the water of the sea and pours it over the face of the earth his name is Jehovah.

EWE: Eŋkɔe nye Yehowa.’ 7 ‘Oo Israel-viwo, ɖe miele nam abe Kustɔwo ƒe viwo ene oa?’
ENGLISH: 7 Are you not the same as sons of the Negro race to me, sons of Israel? quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Yehowa ye gblɔe. ‘Ðe nyemekplɔ Israel tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, Filistitɔwo tso Kreta, kple Siriatɔwo tso Kir oa?’
ENGLISH: Did I not bring up the Israelites from Egypt and the Philistines from Caphtor and the Syrians from Kir?

EWE: 8 ‘Kpɔ ɖa! Nye, Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa, nye ŋku le fiaɖuƒe wɔnuvɔ̃ la ŋu, Eye mele etsrɔ̃ ge ɖa le anyigba la dzi.
ENGLISH: 8 Here Jehovah’s eyes are on the sinful realm, and I will root it out from the face of the ground; I will not downright root out the house of Jacob, though, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Gake nyematsrɔ̃ Yakob ƒe aƒe la ɖa keŋkeŋ o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 9 ‘Elabena kpɔ ɖa, made se, Eye maʋuʋu Israel ƒe aƒe la le dukɔwo katã dome
ENGLISH: 9 For here I am giving the command and I will tumble the house of Israel among all the nations like the tumbling in a sieve, and not a pebble shall fall on the ground.

EWE: Ale be nuku ɖeka hɔ̃ hã megena ɖe anyigba o ene. 10 Nye dukɔ ƒe nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo katã atsi yi nu,
ENGLISH: 10 By the sword shall all the sinners in my people die, those who say “Mischief will not overtake us nor cross our path.”

EWE: Wo ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Vɔ̃ la mate ɖe mía ŋu o, eye maɖo mía gbɔ o.”’ 11 ‘Gbe ma gbe la, mafɔ David ƒe agbadɔ si mu la ɖe te, Eye maɖɔ eƒe gbagbãƒewo ɖo, Mafɔ eƒe glikpowo ɖe tsitrenu,
ENGLISH: 11 On that day I will set up David’s fallen booth and mend what of it was burst and set up what of it was knocked down and build it as of old,

EWE: Magatui wòanɔ abe ale si wònɔ le blemaŋkekeawo me ene, 12 Ne woaxɔ Edom ƒe susɔea
ENGLISH: 12 in order that those who wear my name may take possession of the remnant of Edom and all the nations, quoth Jehovah who is doing this.

EWE: Kple dukɔ siwo katã ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo la wòazu wo tɔ,’ Yehowa, ame si le nu sia wɔm, lae gblɔe. 13 ‘Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘Esime agbleŋlɔla ato nuŋela ŋu, Wainfiãla ato nukuwula ŋu; Towo atsyɔ wain vivi,
ENGLISH: 13 Here are days coming, quoth Jehovah, when a plower shall overtake the reaper and a wine-treader the seed-sower, and the mountains shall drip pomegranate-wine and all the hills shall ripple;

EWE: Eye wòasi tso togbɛwo katã tame. 14 Maƒo nye dukɔ Israel ƒe aboyomewo nu ƒu akplɔ wo agbɔe, Eye woagbugbɔ du siwo zu aƒedo la atso ahanɔ wo me, Woade waingblewo ano wo me wain,
ENGLISH: 14 and I will come back to my people Israel, and they shall rebuild cities that lie waste and shall live there, and set out vineyards and drink the wine from them, and make gardens and eat their fruit.

EWE: Eye woatso abɔwo aɖu wo me kutsetsewo.’ 15 ‘Mado wo ɖe woƒe anyigba dzi, Eye womagaho wo ɖa Le woƒe anyigba si mena wo la dzi gbeɖe o,’ Yehowa wò Mawu ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 15 And I will plant them in their own soil, and they shall not again be uprooted from their soil that I gave them, says your God Jehovah.

EWE: Obadiya
ENGLISH: Obadiah

EWE: 1 Obadiya ƒe ŋutega:
ENGLISH: 1 The vision of ʽObadiah.

EWE: Ale Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Edom ŋue nye esi:“Míese nya aɖe tso Yehowa gbɔ, Woɖo ame ɖe dukɔwo dome be:“Mitso, mina míadzra ɖo aho aʋa ɖe eŋu.’”
ENGLISH: Says the Lord Jehovah for Edom, We have heard a report from Jehovah, and a courier has been sent among the nations, “Up, let us stand up against her for war.”
