ENGLISH: 12 And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps; and I will punish the men that are stiffened on their lees, that say to themselves “Jehovah will do no good and no harm.” 13 And their wealth shall be for pillage, and their houses become a desolation; and they shall build houses and not live there, and plant vineyards and not drink the wine of them.

EWE: Woade waingble, ke womano wo me wain o. 14 Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke gã la tu aƒe! Etu aƒe, eye wòle du dzi sesĩe gbɔna!
ENGLISH: 14 Jehovah’s great day is near, near and speeding swiftly on; the sound of Jehovah’s day is bitter, a champion is yelling there.

EWE: Gbe ma gbe la, kalẽtɔ la afa avi hehehe. 15 Dɔmedzoedogbee, Xaxagbe kple veve helĩhelĩ segbee, Ahomtugbe kple aƒedoɖigbee, Viviti kple tsizidogbee,
ENGLISH: 15 That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and hard straits, a day of blast and blight, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and thick air,

EWE: Alilikpo kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi dogbee, 16 Lãdzokugbe kple aʋaɣlidogbee
ENGLISH: 16 a day of horn-blowing and cheering against the fortified cities and against the high corner-towers.

EWE: Wòanye ava du sesẽwo kple gbetakpɔxɔ siwo le dzogoewo dzi la dzi. 17 Mahe xaxa ava amegbetɔwo dzi, Eye woanɔ yiyim abe ŋkunɔwo ene, Elabena Yehowa ŋue wowɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖo. Woakɔ woƒe ʋu ɖe anyi abe ke ene,
ENGLISH: 17 And I will bring distress on men, and they shall go like blind men, because they have sinned against Jehovah; and their blood shall be spilled like dust, and their entrails like cow-droppings.

EWE: Eye woatsɔ woƒe ŋutilã aƒu gbe abe mĩ ene. 18 Woƒe klosalo kple sika mate ŋu aɖe wo le Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoedogbe la o;
ENGLISH: 18 Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them on the day of Jehovah’s wrath; and by the fire of his jealousy all the country shall be consumed.

EWE: Eƒe ŋuʋaʋã ƒe dzo afiã anyigba blibo la katã, Elabena atsrɔ̃ anyigbadzinɔlawo katã eteƒe makɔ o.”
ENGLISH: For he will dispatch all the inhabitants of the country in a finish full of sheer consternation.

EWE: Zefaniya
ENGLISH: Zephaniah

EWE: 2 Oo dukɔ si ŋu mekpena o,
ENGLISH: 2 Get in your straw, get in your straw, nation unabashed,

EWE: Miƒo mia ɖokuiwo nu ƒu, ɛ̃, miƒo takpli. 2 Hafi ne nu si Mawu ɖo la nava eme, Hafi ŋkeke la nava yi abe ale si tsro ʋua yae ene,
ENGLISH: 2 before you become like chaff blowing along, before the day of Jehovah’s anger comes upon you.

EWE: Eye hafi Yehowa ƒe dzikudogbe nava mia dzi la, 3 Midi Yehowa, mi ame siwo katã bɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe anyi le anyigba dzi Hezɔna ɖe eƒe se dzɔdzɔewo nu. Midi dzɔdzɔenyenye, midi ɖokuibɔbɔ yome mɔ.
ENGLISH: 3 Go looking for Jehovah, all you humble of the earth, you who have put his law in practice; look out for honesty, for humility you may be screened on the day of Jehovah’s anger.

EWE: Ðewohĩ woatsɔ mi aɣla le Yehowa ƒe dzikudogbe la. 4 Elabena Gaza azu du si me ame aɖeke manɔ o; Eye Askelon azu aƒedo.
ENGLISH: 4 For Ghaza shall be abandoned, and Ashkelon become a desolation; Ashdod they shall oust at noon, and ‘Ekron shall be uprooted.

EWE: 5 “Baba na ame siwo le ƒutanuto la me, Keretitɔwo ƒe dukɔ la!
ENGLISH: 5 Ha, inhabitants of the seacoast strip, nation of the Cretans!

EWE: Yehowa ƒe nya tsi tre ɖe mia ŋu. Oo Kanaan, Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba, matsrɔ̃ wò,
ENGLISH: Jehovah’s word is against you, Canaan, country of the Philistines, and I will destroy you to the last inhabitant;

EWE: Ale be ame aɖeke masusɔ o. 6 Ƒutanuto la azu lãnyiƒe,
ENGLISH: 6 and the Cretan country shall be shepherds’ pastures and folds for sheep.

EWE: Eye vudowo anɔ afi ma na lãkplɔviwo, eye alẽkpowo anɔ afi ma na alẽwo. 7 Nuto la azu Yuda ƒe aƒe la ƒe ame susɔeawo tɔ; Woaɖu gbe le afi ma. Woatsyɔ akɔ ɖe Askelon ƒe aƒewo me le fiẽ. Elabena Yehowa woƒe Mawu atrɔ susu ɖe wo ŋu,
ENGLISH: 7 And the seacoast strip shall belong to the remnant of the house of Judah, they shall pasture on them, they shall have the flocks lie down at evening in the houses of Ashkelon, because their God Jehovah will take up their case and come back to them.

EWE: Eye wòaƒo woƒe aboyomewo nu ƒu agbɔe.” 8 “Mese Moab ƒe alɔmeɖeɖe kple Amonitɔwo ƒe dzugbe,
ENGLISH: 8 I have heard Moab’s taunts and the insults of the Bene-ʽAmmon, with which they have taunted my people and blustered against their territory.

EWE: Ame siwo ɖe alɔme le nye dukɔ ŋu, eye wole kakam ɖe woƒe anyigba ŋu. 9 Eya ta zi ale si mele agbe la,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu lae gblɔe, “Moab azu abe Sodom ene, Amon azu abe Gomora ene, Eye woazu ŋuve, dzeʋe kple gbegbe tegbee. Nye dukɔ ƒe ame siwo kpɔtɔ la aha wo,
ENGLISH: 9 So by my life, quoth Israel’s God Jehovah of Armies, Moab shall become like Sodom and the Bene-ʽAmmon like Ghomorrah, a place for brakes of weeds and for digging salt and a desolation forever; the remnant of my people shall plunder them, what is left of my nation shall fall heir to them;

EWE: Eye nye dukɔ ƒe ame susɔeawo axɔ wo wòazu wo tɔ. 10 Esiae adzɔ ɖe wo dzi ɖe woƒe dada ta,
ENGLISH: 10 this is what they get for their pride, for having taunted and blustered against the people of Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: Elabena woɖe alɔme le aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe dukɔ ŋu hedo wo ɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe wo ŋu. 11 Yehowa anye ŋɔdzi na wo; Elabena ana anyigbadzimawuwo katã nazu tofloko,
ENGLISH: 11 Jehovah is terrible over them, because he has dwindled all the gods of the earth, and all the coasts of the nations shall do reverence to him each man at his own place.

EWE: Ame sia ame le enɔƒe. 12 Mi Etiopiatɔwo, nye yi awu miawo hã.
ENGLISH: 12 You too, Nubians, are run through by Jehovah’s sword.

EWE: 13 Ado eƒe asi ɖa ɖe dziehe gome, eye wòatsrɔ̃ Asiria, Ana Niniwe nazu aƒedo, eye wòaƒu kplakplakpla abe gbegbe ene.
ENGLISH: 13 And he will stretch out his hand over the north and destroy Assyria and render Nineveh a dried-out desolation like the wilderness.

EWE: 14 Lãhawo kple gbemelã ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi atsyɔ akɔ ɖe afi ma. Aluge kple hlɔ̃made atsi eƒe sɔtiwo ƒe tawo dome adɔ. Ha anɔ ɖiɖim le fesre nu. Nuwo akaka ɖe woƒe kpuiwo nu;
ENGLISH: 14 And flocks shall lie down in the middle of her, every beast of pasture; both barn-owl and porcupine shall lodge in the capitals of her columns; there is a great owl’s voice in the window, a raven’s on the threshold.

EWE: Eye sederʋuƒo atsi go. 15 Esiae nye du si dzi wodana ɖo si nɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ tsã, Si gblɔna le eƒe dzi me be: ‘Nyee, ame bubu aɖeke megali o.’ Oo aleke wòhezu ŋɔdzinu, Eye wòzu afi si gbemelãwo tsyɔa akɔ ɖo ale!
ENGLISH: 15 This is the hilarious city that was seated in security, that said to herself “There’s me and that’s all!” how she has become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down! everyone who passes her shall whistle and wave his hand.

EWE: Zefaniya
ENGLISH: Zephaniah

EWE: 3 Baba na du si yɔ fũu kple aglãdzedze, ɖiƒoƒo kple ameteteɖeanyi!
ENGLISH: 3 Alas, the disobedient and polluted one, the arbitrary city,

EWE: 2 Egbe toɖoɖo; egbe be yemaxɔ amehehe o. Meɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu o; mete ɖe eƒe Mawu ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 2 that obeyed no voice, learned nothing by discipline, had no confidence in Jehovah, would not come near her God!

EWE: 3 Eƒe amegã siwo le eme la nye dzata siwo le gbe ɖem. Eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo nye amegãxi siwo dona le zã me,
ENGLISH: 3 her generals in her midst are roaring lions, her judges evening wolves that do no morning gnawing;

EWE: Eye wogbãa ƒuwo katã hafi ŋu kena. 4 Eƒe nyagblɔɖilawo doa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi, eye wonye alakpanuwɔlawo.
ENGLISH: 4 her prophets are reckless, faithless men, her priests treat sanctities as profane, they tamper with rulings.

EWE: Wodaa se la dzi. 5 Yehowa nye dzɔdzɔetɔ le wo dome; mewɔa nu gbegblẽ aɖeke o. Eɖea eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ɖoɖowo fiana ŋdi sia ŋdi, Ewɔnɛ alea ɖaa abe ale si ko kekeli dona godoo ene.
ENGLISH: 5 Jehovah, a righteous one, is in her; he will do no foul play; morning by morning he brings his justice to the light, he does not default, he does not know how to play foul.

EWE: Ke ame madzɔmadzɔ menya nu si nye ŋukpe o. 6 “Metsrɔ̃ dukɔwo; woƒe dzogoedzixɔ sesẽwo zu glikpo. Mena woƒe ablɔwo ɖi gbɔlo, ale be ame aɖeke megatoa wo dzi o.
ENGLISH: 6 I made away with nations, their corner-towers are desolate, I laid their streets waste till there is not a passer, their cities are wrecked till there is not a man, to the last inhabitant;

EWE: Woƒe duwo zu aƒedo, ale be ame vɔ le wo me, ame aɖeke megale wo me o. 7 Megblɔ be: ‘Àvɔ̃m azɔ, eye àlɔ̃ axɔ amehehe,’ Ale be womagagblẽ enɔƒe o Mabia akɔntae ɖe eƒe nuwɔna siawo katã ta.
ENGLISH: 7 I thought “It must be you will fear me, will let yourself learn, and she will not lose sight of all the visitations I have sent her”; in fact the first thing they did was to make all their practices vicious.

EWE: Ke wogale nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ dzi atraɖii. 8 ‘Eya ta mikpɔ asinyenu,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘Va se ɖe gbe si gbe matso ɖe nuhaha ŋu, Elabena nye ɖoɖoe nye be maƒo dukɔwo nu ƒu, mana fiaɖuƒewo nakpe ta, Ale be matrɔ nye dziku, nye dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ la katã, akɔ ɖe wo dzi;
ENGLISH: 8 So wait for me, quoth Jehovah, for my day of standing up as witness; for it is my judgment to bring nations together, to gather kingdoms, to pour out my hostility on them, all the heat of my anger; for in the fire of my jealousy all the earth shall be consumed.

EWE: Elabena nye ŋuʋaʋã ƒe dzo afiã anyigba blibo la. 9 Ɣemaɣi la, matrɔ dukɔwo ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ wòanye gbegbɔgblɔ dzadzɛ,
ENGLISH: 9 For then I will turn the lips of all the peoples clean, that they may all call on Jehovah’s name and cooperate in his service.

EWE: Eye woasubɔe le ɖekawɔwɔ me.’ 10 Nye ame siwo ka hlẽ, siwo le koko ƒom nam la, atsɔ nunana
ENGLISH: 10 From beyond the African rivers the Pathrusites shall bring my aromas, my offering.

EWE: Tso Etiopia-tɔsisiwo ƒe nuto la me avɛ nam. 11 Gbe ma gbe la, womado ŋukpe wò Le nu siwo katã nèwɔ tsɔ dze aglã ɖe ŋunye la ta o, Elabena maɖe ame siwo doa wo ɖokuiwo ɖe dzi glodzoo la ɖa le mewò ɣemaɣi;
ENGLISH: 11 On that day you shall not be put to shame for all your practices in which you have been so rebellious against me: for then I will remove from among you your hilariously self-confident men, and they shall never again be pretentious in my holy mountain,

EWE: Eye màgado ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi le nye to kɔkɔe la dzi azɔ gbeɖe o. 12 Mana ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui hefa tu la nakpɔtɔ ɖe mewò,
ENGLISH: 12 and I will leave among you a people in hardship and poverty, who shall take refuge in Jehovah’s name.

EWE: Eye woatsɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ awɔ woƒe sitsoƒee. 13 Israel ƒe ame susɔeawo mawɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ aɖeke o;
ENGLISH: 13 The remnant of Israel shall do no foul play and tell no lie, and a dishonest tongue shall not be found in their mouth.

EWE: Woaɖu nu amlɔ anyi, eye ame aɖeke mado voɖi na wo o.”
ENGLISH: For they shall pasture and lie down with no one to alarm them.

EWE: 14 Oo Zion vinyɔnu, tso aseye! Oo Israel, gli kple dzidzɔ!
ENGLISH: 14 Shout, daughter of Sion; cheer, Israel; be heartily glad and gleeful, daughter of Jerusalem.

EWE: Oo Yerusalem vinyɔnu, kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye nàtso aseye tso dzi blibo me! 15 Yehowa ɖe wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ɖa. Ena wò futɔ trɔ. Yehowa, Israel-fia la, le dowòme,
ENGLISH: 15 Jehovah has taken off all your judgments, has cleared away all your enemies; Jehovah is king in your midst, you shall not see trouble again.

EWE: Vɔ̃ aɖeke magadzi ŋɔ na wò azɔ o. 16 Gbe ma gbe la, woagblɔ na Yerusalem be: “Mègavɔ̃ o, Oo Zion.
ENGLISH: 16 On that day Jerusalem shall have it said to her “Do not be afraid, Sion, do not lose heart:

EWE: Wò asiwo megado agblɔ o. 17 Yehowa wò Mawu le dowòme. Kalẽtɔ si xɔna na ame wònye. Akpɔ dzidzɔ ahatso aseye ɖe ŋuwò. Azi ɖoɖoe le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ ta.
ENGLISH: 17 your God Jehovah is in your midst, a saving champion; he will blithely delight in you, will be quiet in his love, will jubilate over you with a shout.”

EWE: Ado dzidzɔɣli ahatso aseye ɖe ŋuwò. 18 Maƒo ame siwo le nu xam, le esi womegakpɔa gome le wò azãɖuɖuwo me o ta la nu ƒu;
ENGLISH: 18 As on an anniversary day I bring together her smitten ones on the day of taking off taunting from her.

EWE: Womenɔ mewò o, elabena eƒe ŋukpe nɔ wo dzi. 19 Kpɔ ɖa, matu nu kple ame siwo katã le fu wɔm wò la ɣemaɣi; Eye maxɔ na ame si le bu tɔm, Eye maƒo ame siwo woka hlẽ la nu ƒu. Mana woazu kafukafu eye mana woƒe ŋkɔ nanyɔ
ENGLISH: 19 Here I will at that time be making an end of those who inflict hardships on you, and will save what was breaking down and gather together what was straying, and render them a praise and a name in every country of their shame.

EWE: Le anyigba siwo katã dzi wodo ŋukpe wo le la dzi. 20 Ɣemaɣi la, maƒo mia nu ƒu, Ɣemaɣi la, makplɔ mi agbɔe. Elabena mana miaƒe ŋkɔ nanyɔ eye miazu kafukafu le anyigbadzidukɔwo katã dome,
ENGLISH: 20 At that time I will bring you, and at that time I will gather you together; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I come back to you before your eyes, says Jehovah.

EWE: Hagai
ENGLISH: Haggai

EWE: 1 Le fia Dario ƒe ƒe evelia me, le ɣleti adelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va to nyagblɔɖila Hagai dzi na Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, si nye nutodziɖula le Yuda, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yehozadak vi be:
ENGLISH: 1 In the year two of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, Jehovah’s word came by the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshuaʽ the son of Jehosadak, the high priest:

EWE: 2 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi, ‘Dukɔ sia le gbɔgblɔm be: “Ɣeyiɣi la mede haɖe be woatu Yehowa ƒe xɔ la o.”’”
ENGLISH: 2 “Says Jehovah of Armies, This people say ‘The time for Jehovah’s house to be built has not come yet.’”

EWE: 3 Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe gava to nyagblɔɖila Hagai dzi be: 4 “Ðe ɣeyiɣi de na miawo ya be mianɔ xɔ siwo me wofa ʋuƒowo ɖo la me, eye xɔ sia ya nanye glikpoa? 5 Eya ta ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi, ‘Milé ŋku ɖe miaƒe zɔzɔme ŋu nyuie.
ENGLISH: 3 And Jehovah’s word came by the prophet Haggai: 4 “Is it time for you yourselves to be living in your houses with wainscoting while this house lies in ruins? 5 Now Jehovah of Armies says, Pay attention to what you are about.

EWE: 6 Mieƒãa nu geɖe, gake ʋɛ aɖe koe mieŋena. Mieɖua nu, gake meɖia ƒo na mi o. Mienoa nu, gake medena na mi o. Miedoa awu, gake medea dzo lãme na mi o. Eye dɔwɔla xɔa fetu dea kotoku ŋɔŋɔ me.’”
ENGLISH: 6 You have been sowing much and bringing in little, eating but not so as to have your fill, drinking but not so as to feel the effects, dressing but not so as to be warm, and the wage-earner earning into a pocket with a hole in it.

EWE: 7 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Milé ŋku ɖe miaƒe zɔzɔme ŋu nyuie.’
ENGLISH: 7 Says Jehovah of Armies, Pay attention to what you are about.

EWE: 8 “‘Miyi to la dzi ne miatsɔ atiwo vɛ. Mitu xɔ la ne makpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe eŋu, eye bubu nanɔ ŋunye,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 8 Go up to the mountain and bring wood and build the house and have me accept it and be an object of respect, says Jehovah.

EWE: 9 “‘Miele mɔ kpɔm na nu geɖe, gake kpɔ ɖa, nu ʋɛ aɖe koe miekpɔ; eye esi mietsɔe va aƒee la, meɖo ƒuƒu ɖee. Ðe susu ka ta?’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe. ‘Le esi nye xɔ la kpɔtɔ nye glikpo, evɔ mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le du dzi ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe xɔ ŋu ta.
ENGLISH: 9 Facing round toward a great deal and finding it turns out a little, bringing a crop into the house and finding I have blown on it what for? quoth Jehovah of Armies; on account of my house which is in ruins while you are each running for his own house;

EWE: 10 Eya ta dziƒowo te zãmu mi, eye anyigba hã te nuku mi ɖo.
ENGLISH: 10 that is why the sky has shut off dew and the ground has shut off its growth,

EWE: 11 Meyɔ kuɖiɖi ɖe anyigba kple towo ŋu, ɖe agblemenuku, wain yeye kple ami ŋu, ɖe anyigbadzinu miemiewo ŋu, ɖe amegbetɔwo kple lãwo ŋu, ɖe dɔ siwo katã wotsɔa asi wɔna la ŋu.’”
ENGLISH: 11 and I have called up a drought over the country and over the mountains, and over the grain and over the grapejuice and over the oil and over everything the soil puts out and over man and over beast and over all the hands have toiled for.”

EWE: 12 Eye Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yehozadak vi, kpakple dukɔ la me tɔ susɔeawo katã se Yehowa woƒe Mawu ƒe gbe kple nyagblɔɖila Hagai ƒe nyawo, elabena Yehowa woƒe Mawu lae dɔe; ale dukɔ la vɔ̃ Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 12 And Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshuaʽ the son of Jehosadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people, obeyed their God Jehovah and listened to the words of the prophet

EWE: 13 Eye Hagai, Yehowa ƒe ame dɔdɔ la, gagblɔ gbedeasi si wòxɔ tso Yehowa gbɔ la na dukɔa be: “‘Meli kpli mi,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 13 Haggai as their God Jehovah had sent him to them; and the people were afraid of Jehovah, but Jehovah’s messenger Haggai, on Jehovah’s mission, said to the people “I am with you, quoth Jehovah.”

EWE: 14 Ale Yehowa de dzo Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, si nye nutodziɖula le Yuda, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yehozadak vi, kpakple dukɔ la me tɔ susɔeawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ me; ale wova hedze woƒe Mawu, aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa, ƒe aƒe la ŋu dɔwo gɔme.
ENGLISH: 14 And Jehovah stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and of Joshuaʽ the son of Jehosadak, the high priest, and of all the remnant of the people, and they came and did work on the house of their God Jehovah of Armies,

EWE: 15 Esia dzɔ le fia Dario ƒe ƒe evelia me, le ɣleti adelia ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ enelia dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 on the twenty-fourth day of the month in the sixth month.

EWE: Hagai
ENGLISH: Haggai

EWE: 2 Le ɣleti adrelia ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ ɖekɛlia dzi la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va to nyagblɔɖila Hagai dzi be, 2 “Meɖe kuku, bia Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, si nye nutodziɖula le Yuda, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yehozadak vi, kple dukɔ la me tɔ susɔeawo be: 3 ‘Ame siwo kpɔ xɔ sia ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe tsãtɔ teƒe la dometɔ kae gakpɔtɔ le mia dome?
ENGLISH: 2 In the year two of King Darius, in the seventh month, on the twenty-first of the month, Jehovah’s word came by the prophet Haggai: 2 “Say to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshuaʽ the son of Jehosadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people,

EWE: Eye aleke miele ekpɔmee fifia? Ne mietsɔe sɔ kple ema la, ɖe esia ɖi nane le mia ŋkumea?’
ENGLISH: 3 ‘Who is there among you of the older generation, one that saw this house in its former glory? and what do you see it now? does it not look to you the same as nothing?

EWE: 4 “‘Ke azɔ la, Zerubabel, do ŋusẽ nu,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘nunɔlagã Yosua, Yehozadak vi, do ŋusẽ nu.’ “‘Mi dukɔ la me tɔwo katã, mido ŋusẽ nu,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘eye miwɔ dɔ la.’
ENGLISH: 4 But now be resolute, Zerubbabel, quoth Jehovah, and be resolute, High Priest Joshuaʽ son of Jehosadak, and be resolute, all people of the country, quoth Jehovah, and keep at work, for I am with you, quoth Jehovah of Armies,

EWE: 5 ‘Miɖo ŋku nu si ŋugbe medo na mi esime mieʋu tso Egipte, eye nye gbɔgbɔ nɔ mia dome la dzi.
ENGLISH: 5 and my spirit stands fast in your midst; do not be afraid.’

EWE: Migavɔ̃ o.’” 6 “Elabena ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Egasusɔ zi ɖeka​ eteƒe madidi o maʋuʋu dziƒowo kple anyigba, atsiaƒu kple ƒuƒuiƒe.’
ENGLISH: 6 “For Jehovah of Armies says ‘One period more it is a little one and I am going to shake the sky and the earth, and the sea and the dry land;

EWE: 7 “‘Maʋuʋu dukɔwo katã, eye dukɔwo katã ƒe nu vevitɔwo ava; eye matsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ayɔ xɔ sia taŋ,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 7 and I will shake all the nations, and the choice things of all the nations shall come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 8 “‘Tɔnyee nye klosalo, eye tɔnyee nye sika,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 8 The silver is mine and the gold is mine, quoth Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 9 “‘Xɔ yeye sia ƒe atsyɔ̃ agbɔ tsãtɔ tɔ ŋu,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 9 The future glory of this house shall be greater than the first, says Jehovah of Armies, and in this place I will make all well, quoth Jehovah of Armies.’”

EWE: “‘Mana ŋutifafa nanɔ teƒe sia,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 10 On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month in the year two of Darius, Jehovah’s word came by the prophet Haggai

EWE: 10 Le Dario ƒe ƒe evelia me, le ɣleti asiekelia ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ enelia dzi la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va na nyagblɔɖila Hagai be: 11 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi, ‘Bia nunɔlawo nu si sea gblɔ, 12 “Ne ame aɖe tsɔ lã kɔkɔe ɖe eƒe awu me, eye awua ka abolo, atadi, wain, ami alo nuɖuɖu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ŋu la, ɖe nu siawo ŋu akɔa?”’”
ENGLISH: 11 “Says Jehovah of Armies, Ask the priests for a ruling: 12 suppose a man carries consecrated flesh in the flap of his coat, and touches with his flap bread or vegetables or wine or oil or any eatable, will it become consecrated?”

EWE: Eye nunɔlawo ɖo eŋu be: “Kpao!”
ENGLISH: And the priests answered “No.”

EWE: 13 Eye Hagai gabia be: “Ne nu kuku aɖe na ame aɖe ŋu mekɔ o, eye amea ka asi nu siawo dometɔ aɖe ŋu la, ɖe nu siawo azu nu makɔmakɔa?”
ENGLISH: 13 And Haggai said “If one who is unclean by a dead body touches any of these will it become unclean?”

EWE: Nunɔlawo ɖo eŋu be: “Azu nu makɔmakɔ.”
ENGLISH: And the priests answered “It will.”

EWE: 14 Eya ta Hagai gblɔ na wo be: “‘Aleae ame siawo le, eye aleae dukɔ sia le le ŋkunyeme,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘eye aleae woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã le; nu sia nu si wotsɔ yi ɖana le afi ma la ŋu mekɔ o.’ 15 “‘Azɔ, meɖe kuku, mitsɔ miaƒe dzi ɖo nu sia ŋu tso egbe dzi: Hafi woaɖo kpe kpe dzi hena Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la tutu la, 16 aleke wònɔ ɣemaɣi?
ENGLISH: 14 And Haggai answered “So it is with this people and so with this nation before me, quoth Jehovah, and so with all the work of their hands and what they come near: it is unclean. 15 And now pay attention from this day on. When a stone had not yet been laid on a stone in Jehovah’s temple

EWE: Ne ame aɖe va nuku si woli kɔ ɖi, si wobu be ade dzidzenu blaeve gbɔ la, ewo ko wònyena; eye ne ame aɖe va wainfiãƒe be wòaku wain si wobu be ade dzidzenu blaatɔ̃ la, blaeve ko wònyena; 17 mena miaƒe nukuwo hlɔ̃, eye wodze heteku, mena kpetsi dza, eye megblẽ miaƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã dome, ke hã mia dometɔ aɖeke metrɔ ɖe ŋunye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 16 how were you doing? coming to a heap good for twenty sacks and having it turn out ten, coming to the winepress to dip out fifty jars and having it turn out twenty; 17 I have struck you with blasting and mildew and hail, all the work of your hands, and you were not heading toward me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: 18 “‘Meɖe kuku, mitsɔ miaƒe dzi ɖo nu sia ŋu tso egbe dzi, tso ɣleti asiekelia ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ enelia dzi, gbe si gbe woɖo Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la gɔme anyi; mibu nya sia ŋu le miaƒe dzi me: 19 Ðe nuku gale ava mea?
ENGLISH: 18 Pay attention from this day on, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the day that the foundation of Jehovah’s temple was laid; pay attention;

EWE: Eye ɖe wainka, gboti, yevuboɖati kple amiti tsea? Ke mayra mi tso ŋkeke sia dzi.’”
ENGLISH: 19 is the seed still in the barn? and the grapevine and the fig-tree and the pomegranate-tree have not set; from this day I will bless.”

EWE: 20 Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe gava na Hagai zi evelia le ɣletia ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ enelia dzi be: 21 “Gblɔ na Yuda nutodziɖula Zerubabel be: ‘Mele dziƒowo kple anyigba ʋuʋu ge.
ENGLISH: 20 And Jehovah’s word came a second time to Haggai on the twenty-fourth of the month, 21 “Say to Zerubbabel the governor of Judah ‘I am going to shake the sky and the earth,

EWE: 22 Mamu fiaɖuƒewo ƒe fiazikpuiwo aƒu anyi, eye matsrɔ̃ dukɔwo ƒe fiaɖuƒewo ƒe ŋusẽ ɖa; mamu tasiaɖam kple emenɔlawo aƒu anyi, sɔwo kple wo dolawo adze anyi, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe atsi nɔvia ƒe yi nu.’”
ENGLISH: 22 and overturn imperial thrones and quell the force of the nations’ empires, and overturn chariots and their riders, and ponies and their riders shall go down by each other’s swords.

EWE: 23 “‘Gbe ma gbe la,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘makplɔ wò, nye subɔla Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘matsɔ wò awɔ ŋkɔsigɛ, elabena wòe metia,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 23 On that day, quoth Jehovah of Armies, I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, quoth Jehovah, and make you like a seal, for you I have chosen, quoth Jehovah of Armies.’”

EWE: Malaki
ENGLISH: Malachi

EWE: 1 Gbedeasi vevi aɖe: Yehowa ƒe nya si wògblɔ le Israel ŋu to Malaki dzi:
ENGLISH: 1 The boding of Jehovah’s word to Israel by Malaki.

EWE: 2 Yehowa be: “Melɔ̃ mi.”
ENGLISH: 2 I loved you, says Jehovah.

EWE: Ke miawo miebe: “Aleke nèlɔ̃ míi?”
ENGLISH: And you say “In what did you love us?”

EWE: Yehowa be: “Ðe menye Yakob nɔvie nye Esau oa?
ENGLISH: Was not ʽEsau brother to Jacob? quoth Jehovah; and I loved Jacob,

EWE: Gake melɔ̃ Yakob, 3 eye melé fu Esau ya; mena eƒe towo zu gbegbe, eye eƒe domenyinu zu agbotoe siwo nɔa gbedadaƒo la nɔƒe.”
ENGLISH: 3 and ʽEsau I hated and made a desolation of his mountains and wilderness pastures of his estate.

EWE: 4 “Togbɔ be Edom le gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Wogbã mí gudugudu, ke míatrɔ agbɔ agbugbɔ teƒe siwo zu aƒedo la atso’ hã la, ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Woatsoe, gake magbãe aƒu anyi.
ENGLISH: 4 Whereas Edom says “We have had our houses wrecked, but we shall come back and rebuild the ruins,” Jehovah of Armies says “They will build, but I will demolish; and they will be called ‘Wrong Side Precinct’ and ‘the people to whom Jehovah is hostile forever’;

EWE: Eye woayɔ wo be “vɔ̃ɖinyenye ƒe anyigba” kple “dukɔ si Yehowa bu fɔe tegbee.” 5 Miaƒe ŋkuwo akpɔe, eye miagblɔ be: “Woado kɔkɔ Yehowa le Israel-nyigba blibo la dzi.”’”
ENGLISH: 5 and your eyes will see it and you will say ‘Jehovah proves great beyond the boundary of Israel.’”

EWE: 6 “‘Vi dea bubu fofoa ŋu, eye subɔvi dea bubu eƒe aƒetɔ ŋu.
ENGLISH: 6 Son honors father, and servant his master.

EWE: Ne fofoe menye la, ke afi kae nye bubu le? Eye ne aƒetɔe menye la, ekema afi kae vɔvɔ̃ si le ŋunye la le?’ aleae aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔ na mi nunɔla siwo le vlo dom nye ŋkɔ la.
ENGLISH: Then if I am a father where is my honor, and if I am a master where is my fear? says Jehovah of Armies to you priests, despisers of my name and you say “In what have we despised your name?”

EWE: 7 “‘Esi mietsɔ nuɖuɖu makɔmakɔ va nye vɔsamlekpui la dzi tae.’
ENGLISH: 7 You bring polluted food up to my altar and you say “In what have we polluted you?”

EWE: “‘Eye miebia be: “Aleke míegblẽ kɔ ɖo na wòe?”’
ENGLISH: In your saying “Jehovah’s table is of no account.”

EWE: “‘Eyae nye be miele gbɔgblɔm be: “Yehowa ƒe kplɔ̃ ɖi gbɔ.” 8 Eye ne mietsɔ lã ŋkuagbã va vɔ sa gee la, miegblɔna be: “Megblẽ naneke o.”
ENGLISH: 8 And when you bring on a blind creature for sacrificing, it is no harm! and when you bring on a lame one, it is no harm!

EWE: “Tsɔe yi na wò nutodziɖula kpɔ be akpɔ ŋudzedze ɖe ŋuwò alo axɔ wò nyuie hã?” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: Present it to your governor! will he be conciliated, or do favors for you? says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 9 “Eya ta miƒo koko na Mawu ne wòave mía nu. Esi vɔsa siawo ƒomevi tso mia si me la, ɖe wòave mia dometɔ aɖe nua?” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 9 And now propitiate Deity that he may be gracious to us; this came from your hands will he favor any of you? says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 10 “Eye mia dometɔ kae alɔ̃ ado gbedoxɔ la ƒe ʋɔtruawo?
ENGLISH: 10 Ah, and O for one among you to shut the doors so that you should not light up my altar for nothing!

EWE: Elabena miedoa dzudzɔ ʋeʋĩ ɖe nye vɔsamlekpui la gɔ̃ hã dzi naneke maxɔmaxɔe o.
ENGLISH: I have no liking for you, says Jehovah of Armies, and will not accept offerings from your hands.

EWE: Nyemekpɔa dzidzɔ aɖeke ɖe mia ŋu o, eye miaƒe nunavɔsa aɖeke menyoa ŋunye o,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe. 11 “Elabena nye ŋkɔ ade dzi le dukɔwo dome tso ɣedzeƒe va se ɖe ɣetoɖoƒe.
ENGLISH: 11 For from utmost east to utmost west my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense is offered up to my name, and pure offerings; for my name is great among the nations, says Jehovah of Armies;

EWE: Eye le teƒewo katã la, woasa vɔ hena nye ŋkɔ wòanye nunana dzadzɛ; elabena nye ŋkɔ ade dzi le dukɔwo dome,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 12 but you profane it by saying “Jehovah’s table is polluted and the eating of its yield is unsatisfactory.”

EWE: 12 “Ke miawo miegblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ esi miele gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Yehowa ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋu mekɔ o, eye edzi kutsetse, si nye nuɖuɖu si le edzi la, le ŋu nyɔm.’ 13 Eye miegblɔna hã be, ‘Kpɔ ɖa! Eti kɔ na ame!’ eye mienyɔ ŋui,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 13 And you say “O, the tiresomeness!” and pooh-pooh me, says Jehovah of Armies; and you bring stolen property and the lame and the sick, and bring it as an offering; am I to accept it from your hands? says Jehovah.

EWE: Yehowa ye gblɔe. 14 “Aɖi ameflula ŋu kpékpekpe, ne lãtsu si sɔ blibo le eƒe lãha dome, evɔ wòɖe adzɔgbe hetsɔ lã nuwɔe vɛ na Yehowa. Elabena Fia gã menye, eye vɔvɔ̃ le nye ŋkɔ ŋu le dukɔwo dome,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 14 But cursed is a schemer who, when there is a male in his flock and he vows it, sacrifices a mutilated creature to the Lord; for I am a great king, says Jehovah of Armies, and my name is terrible among the nations.

EWE: Malaki
ENGLISH: Malachi

EWE: 2 “Azɔ mi nunɔlawo, miawoe sedede sia yi na.
ENGLISH: 2 And now this message is to you priests.

EWE: 2 Ne miegbe toɖoɖo, eye miena nye nyawo de dzi gbɔ na mi be miatsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ana nye ŋkɔ o la, ekema nye hã mana fiƒode la nava mia dzi, eye mana miaƒe yayrawo nazu fiƒodewo.
ENGLISH: 2 If you do not listen and do not pay attention, giving glory to my name, says Jehovah of Armies, I will send the curse upon you and curse your blessings; and cursed it I have, too, because you are not paying attention.

EWE: Ɛ̃, mena miaƒe yayrawo zu fiƒode xoxo, elabena miena wòde dzi gbɔ na mi o,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe. 3 “Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 3 Here I am rebuking the seed for you and will sprinkle offal on your faces, the offal from your feasts, and they shall carry you to it.

EWE: 4 Eye miadze sii be, nyee ɖo se sia ɖe mi, ne nu, si mebla kple Lewi la nakpɔtɔ anɔ anyi,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 4 And you shall know that I have sent this message to you to have my covenant be with Levi, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 5 “Nu, si mebla kplii la nye agbe kple ŋutifafa tɔ, eye metsɔe nɛ ne wòavɔ̃m.
ENGLISH: 5 My covenant with him was life and well-being, and I gave them to him; fear, and he feared me, and he was in terror at my name.

EWE: Evɔ̃am, ɛ̃, evɔ̃a nye ŋkɔ la vevie. 6 Nyateƒe ƒe se la nɔ eƒe nu me, eye eƒe nuyiwo megblɔa nya vɔ̃ aɖeke o. Ezɔ kplim le ŋutifafa kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye wòna ame geɖewo trɔ tso woƒe vodada me.
ENGLISH: 6 Trustworthy rulings were in his mouth and dishonesty was never found on his lips; he walked with me staunchly and straightforwardly, and turned many back from offending.

EWE: 7 Elabena nunɔla ƒe nuyiwoe wòle be wòadzra sidzedze ɖo, eye eƒe nu mee amewo adi se la le, elabena eyae nye aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe ame dɔdɔ.
ENGLISH: 7 For a priest’s lips are to keep knowledge, and they seek rulings from his mouth, because he is the messenger of Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 8 “Ke miawo mietra tso mɔ la dzi. Miena se la zu nukikli na ame geɖewo. Miegblẽ Lewi ƒe nubabla la dome,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 8 But you have quitted the road, you have brought many to a fall by rulings; you have wrecked Levi’s covenant, says Jehovah of Armies,

EWE: 9 “Eya ta nye hã maɖi gbɔ mi, eye mabɔbɔ mi ɖe anyi le dukɔwo katã ŋkume, elabena miezɔ nye mɔwo dzi o, ke boŋ miekpɔa ame ŋkume le se la ŋu dɔ wɔwɔ me.”
ENGLISH: 9 and I on my part have made your status low and despised by all the people, in harmony with your not keeping my ways and favoring persons in rulings.

EWE: 10 “Ðe menye fofo ɖekae li na mí katã oa? Ðe menye Mawu ɖekae wɔ mí oa?
ENGLISH: 10 Do we not all have one father? did not one Deity create us? how is it we are faithless to our brothers, nullifying our fathers’ covenant?

EWE: Ke nu ka tae míewɔa alakpanu ɖe mía nɔewo ŋu hegblẽ kɔ na mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe nubabla la? 11 Yuda wɔ alakpanu, eye wowɔ ŋunyɔnu le Israel kple Yerusalem; elabena Yuda gblẽ kɔ ɖo na Yehowa ƒe kɔkɔenyenye si wòlɔ̃na la, eye wòɖe dutamawu ƒe vinyɔnu.
ENGLISH: 11 Judah has acted faithlessly, and an abominable thing has been done in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has nullified Jehovah’s sanctities which he loves and has married a foreign deity’s daughter.

EWE: 12 Yehowa atsrɔ̃ ame sia ame si wɔa nu sia la ɖa le Yakob ƒe agbadɔwo me, ame ka kee wòɖanye o, togbɔ be etsɔ nunavɔsa vɛ na aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa hã.”
ENGLISH: 12 Jehovah deprive the man who does it of waker and answerer in Jacob’s tents, and of offerer to Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 13 “Miegawɔ nu bubu si wɔe be aɖatsi, avifafa kple hũɖeɖe yɔ Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, ale be megatsɔa ɖeke le miaƒe nunavɔsawo me o, eye megakpɔa ŋudzedze ɖe naneke ŋu tso mia si me o.
ENGLISH: 13 And this second thing you do, covering Jehovah’s altar with tears, with weeping and groaning, beyond any more possibility of facing toward the offering or having satisfaction from your hands.

EWE: 14 Eye miebia be: ‘Nu ka tae?’
ENGLISH: 14 And you say “On what account?”

EWE: Esi Yehowa ŋutɔ nye ɖasefo ɖe ŋuwò, le esi mèwɔ nuteƒe na wò ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃ o ta, evɔ wò zɔhɛ kple nyɔnu si nèbla nu kplii wònye hafi.
ENGLISH: On account of Jehovah’s having borne witness between you and the wife of your youth, toward whom you have broken faith, though she is your consort and your contracted spouse.

EWE: 15 Ame aɖe ya mewɔ nu alea o, elabena Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ɖe le edzi. Eye nu ka dim wòle? Mawu ƒe dzidzime la dim wòle.
ENGLISH: 15 And did he not make one, though he had a remainder of breath? and what was the one aiming at? posterity of God.

EWE: Eya ta mikpɔ miaƒe gbɔgbɔ dzi, eye mia dometɔ aɖeke megawɔ alakpanu ɖe eƒe ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃ ŋu o.
ENGLISH: But be on your guard as to your spirits, and let one not break faith toward the wife of his youth.

EWE: 16 Elabena melé fu srɔ̃gbegbe,” Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu lae gblɔe, “kple ame si ta ŋutasesẽ abe avɔ ene,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 16 For Israel’s God Jehovah hates divorce, and outrage covers his garment, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: “Mikpɔ miaƒe gbɔgbɔ dzi, eye migawɔ alakpanu o.
ENGLISH: But be on your guard as to your spirits and do not break faith.

EWE: 17 “Miena miaƒe nyawo ti kɔ na Yehowa.
ENGLISH: 17 You have made it hard for Jehovah with your words.

EWE: Gake miegblɔ be, ‘Aleke míena míaƒe nyawo ti kɔ nɛ?’
ENGLISH: And you say “In what have we made it hard?”

EWE: Eyae nye be miele gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Ame sia ame si wɔa nu vɔ̃ɖi la nye ame nyui le Yehowa ŋkume, eye eya ƒe nue dzea eŋu.’
ENGLISH: In your saying “Everybody that does bad things pleases Jehovah, he has a fancy for them or where is the God of justice?”

EWE: Malaki
ENGLISH: Malachi

EWE: 3 “Kpɔ ɖa! Mele nye dɔla dɔm, ne wòata mɔ le ŋgɔnye. Eye Aƒetɔ vavã si dim miele la, ava eƒe gbedoxɔ me kpoyi; eye nubabla ƒe dɔla, si miele mɔ kpɔm na kple dzidzɔ la hã ava. Kpɔ ɖa!
ENGLISH: 3 Here I am sending my messenger who shall clear a road before me, and suddenly the Lord, whom you are seeking for, will come to his temple; and the messenger of the covenant, whom you are wishing for, here he comes, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: Ele vava ge godoo,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe. 2 “Gake ame kae ado dzi anɔ anyi le eƒe vavagbe, eye ame kae anɔ te ne eva do? Elabena anɔ abe galólola ƒe dzo ene, abe avɔnyala ƒe adzalẽ ene.
ENGLISH: 2 But who will hold out through the day of his coming? or who will stand at his appearing? for he is like a smelter’s fire and like washermen’s alkali,

EWE: 3 Abɔbɔ nɔ anyi abe ame si lóloa klosalo hedzaa eŋu ene, eye wòakɔ Lewi viwo ŋu; ana wo ŋu nadza abe sika kple klosalo ene, eye woasa nunavɔ na Yehowa le dzɔdzɔenyenye me.
ENGLISH: 3 and he will sit smelting and purifying silver, and purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver, and they will be rightly offering-presenters of Jehovah’s,

EWE: 4 Yuda kple Yerusalem ƒe nunavɔsa ado dzidzɔ na Yehowa abe ale si wònɔ le blemaŋkekewo kple gbe aɖe gbe ƒewo me ene.
ENGLISH: 4 and the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be sweet to Jehovah as in days of yore and as in olden years; and

EWE: 5 “Maɖi ʋɔnu ɖe mia ŋu, eye manye ɖasefo zazɛ̃ ɖe dzotɔwo, ahasiwɔlawo, alakpatamkalawo, kple ame siwo baa dɔwɔlawo, ahosiwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo la ŋu, kpakple ame siwo gbea kpekpeɖeŋunana amedzrowo. Ame siawo mevɔ̃am o,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 5 I will draw near you for judgment, and will be an expeditious witness against the wizards and adulterers and perjurers and those who fail to pay the wages of a hired man and to allow the rights of a widow and an orphan, and who warp a decision in an immigrant’s case, and do not fear me, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 6 “Elabena nyee nye Yehowa; nyemetrɔna o.
ENGLISH: 6 For I Jehovah have not changed, and you sons of Jacob have not come to an end.

EWE: Eye miawoe nye Yakob viwo; mia nu meyi haɖe o. 7 Tso mia tɔgbuiwo ŋɔli kee mietrɔ le nye ɖoɖoawo yome, eye mielé wo me ɖe asi o.
ENGLISH: 7 From your fathers’ days you have gone away from my usages and not kept them: come back to me and I will come back to you, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: Ke miebe: “Aleke míatrɔ ɖe ŋuwòe?”
ENGLISH: And you say “Come back in what respect?”

EWE: 8 “Ðe amegbetɔ dzro ada adzo Mawua? Ke miawo miele adzo damem.”
ENGLISH: 8 Is man to shave down God? for you are shaving me down.

EWE: Eye miebia be: “Nu ka mee míeda adzo wò le?”
ENGLISH: And you say “Shaving you down in what respect?”

EWE: “Le nuwo ƒe ewoliawo kple miaƒe nunanawo mee.
ENGLISH: The tithe and the contribution you neglect,

EWE: 9 Woƒo fi de mi, elabena miele adzo damem, ɛ̃, dukɔ bliboa le adzo damem.
ENGLISH: 9 and me you shave down, the whole nation.

EWE: 10 Mitsɔ nuwo ƒe ewoliawo katã yi nudzraɖoƒe la, ne nuɖuɖu nanɔ aƒenye me; eye mitsɔ esia dom kpɔ be nyemaʋu dziƒowo ƒe tsigbowo na mi, eye nyemadudu yayra akɔ ɖe mia dzi va se ɖe esime naneke magahiã mi o hã,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 10 Bring all the tithe to the storehouse so there will be provisions in my house, and test me by this, says Jehovah of Armies, whether I will not open the hatchways of the sky for you and empty out for you more of a blessing than you have any use for;

EWE: 11 “Mablu ɖe nu siwo gblẽa miaƒe agblemenukuwo la ta, eye womagblẽ miaƒe anyigbadzikutsetsewo o, eye miaƒe wainkawo hã magbe tsetse o,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 11 and I will rebuke the eater for you, and you shall not have him spoiling the crops of the soil, nor shall you have the grapevines losing their fruit in the fields, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 12 “Eye dukɔwo katã ayɔ mi be dzidzɔtɔwo, elabena woakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe miaƒe anyigba la ŋu,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 12 And all the nations will congratulate you, because you will be a delightful country, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 13 “Miegblɔ nya sesẽwo ɖe ŋunye,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 13 You have used strong language against me, says Jehovah.

EWE: Eye miebia be: “Nya kae míegblɔ ɖe ŋuwò?”
ENGLISH: And you say “What language have we used against you?”

EWE: 14 “Miegblɔ be, ‘Viɖe aɖeke mele Mawu subɔsubɔ me o.
ENGLISH: 14 You have said “Worshiping God does not amount to anything; and what do we get out of it that we have kept his charge and gone in mourning because of Jehovah of Armies?

EWE: Eye viɖe kae wònye be míeléa eƒe ɖoɖo me ɖe asi, eye míeléa blanui nɔa yiyim le aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ta? 15 Gake fifia míele dadalawo yɔm be dzidzɔtɔwo.
ENGLISH: 15 And now we are having to congratulate presumptuous people; yes, misdoers make fortunes; yes, they put God to the test and come off safe.”

EWE: Eye wotea Mawu kpɔ, gake naneke medzɔna ɖe wo dzi o.’” 16 Ɣemaɣi la, Yehowa vɔ̃lawo ƒo nu kple wo nɔewo, ame sia ame kple ehavi, eye Yehowa ɖo to see.
ENGLISH: 16 Thus did those who fear Jehovah talk to each other; and Jehovah listened and heard it, and a commemorative book was written before him for those who fear Jehovah and those who give consideration to his name.

EWE: Eye Yehowa na woŋlɔ ŋkuɖodzigbalẽ le eŋkume tso evɔ̃lawo kple ame siwo dea ŋugble le eƒe ŋkɔ ŋu la ŋu. 17 Aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa be: “Woazu tɔnye le gbe si gbe mawɔ wo woanye nye nunɔamesi tɔxɛ.
ENGLISH: 17 And, says Jehovah of Armies, they shall on the day when I take action be for me a special reserve, and I will spare them as a man spares his own son that serves him;

EWE: 18 Ekema miagakpɔ vovototo si le ame dzɔdzɔe kple ame vɔ̃ɖi dome, kple vovototo si le ame si subɔa Mawu kple ame si mesubɔnɛ o la dome.”
ENGLISH: 18 and you will come back to seeing the difference between a right-doer and a wrong-doer, between a worshiper and a non-worshiper of Jehovah.

EWE: Malaki
ENGLISH: Malachi

EWE: 4 “Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke si gbɔna la le bibim abe kpodzo ene, esime dadalawo kple nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã azu abe ahɔ̃liti ene. Eye ŋkeke si gbɔna la afiã wo keŋkeŋ ale be ke alo alɔ gɔ̃ hã masusɔ na wo o,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 4 For here comes the day, burning like a baking-crock; and all presumptuous people and all wrong-doers will be stubble, and the day that is coming will set them ablaze, says Jehovah of Armies, so that it will not leave them root nor branch;

EWE: 2 “Ke mi ame siwo dea bubu nye ŋkɔ ŋu la, dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe ɣe, si ƒe keklẽ me gbedada le la, adze na mi, ame siwo vɔ̃a nye ŋkɔ la; eye miado anɔ kpo tim abe nyivi damiwo ene.”
ENGLISH: 2 but for you fearers of my name a sun of right will rise, with healing in its wings, and you will go out and gambol like calves out of a pen,

EWE: 3 “Miafanya ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe miaƒe afɔ te, elabena woanɔ abe ʋuʋudedi ene anɔ miaƒe afɔ te le gbe si gbe matso,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 3 and tread the life out of the wicked, for they will be ashes under your feet on the day when I take action, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 4 “Miɖo ŋku nye subɔla Mose ƒe Se, si mede nɛ le Horeb, be wòanye ɖoɖowo kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋuti mɔfiamewo na Israel blibo la katã, la dzi.
ENGLISH: 4 Remember my servant Moses’s instructions that I charged him with at Horeb for all Israel, usages and laws.

EWE: 5 “Kpɔ ɖa! Mele nyagblɔɖila Eliya dɔm ɖe mi, hafi Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke gã dziŋɔ la nava ɖo.
ENGLISH: 5 Here, I am sending you the prophet Elijah before the coming of Jehovah’s great and terrible day,

EWE: 6 Agatrɔ fofowo ƒe dzi ɖe viwo ŋu, kple viwo ƒe dzi ɖe fofowo ŋu, ale be nyemava tsrɔ̃ anyigba la gbidii o.”
ENGLISH: 6 and he will bring fathers’ hearts back to children and children’s back to their fathers, for fear I should come and strike the country with doom.

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 1 Le Dario ƒe ƒe evelia ƒe ɣleti enyilia me la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va na nyagblɔɖila Zakariya, Berekiya vi, ame si nye Ido vi be: 2 “Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe mia fofowo ŋu vevie.
ENGLISH: 1 On the eighth new moon in the year two of Darius, Jehovah’s word came to the prophet Zecariah the son of Berekiah the son of ʽIddo, 2 “Jehovah was provoked at your fathers.

EWE: 3 “Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: “‘Mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe, ‘ekema nye hã matrɔ ɖe mia ŋu,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.”’
ENGLISH: 3 And say to them ‘Says Jehovah of Armies, Come back to me, quoth Jehovah of Armies, and I will come back to you, says Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 4 “‘Miganɔ abe mia fofowo ene o; ame siwo nyagblɔɖila tsãtɔwo gblɔ na be: “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Meɖe kuku, mitrɔ tso miaƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo dzi kple miaƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo me.’”’
ENGLISH: 4 Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets called out “Says Jehovah of Armies, Come back from your bad courses and practices” and they did not hear nor listen to me, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: “‘Gake womeɖo to o, eye womelé to ɖe ŋunye o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe. 5 “‘Afi kae mia fofowo le fifia?
ENGLISH: 5 Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live forever?

EWE: Eye ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo nɔ agbe tegbeea? 6 Ke hã ɖe nye nya kple nye sedede siwo mede asi na nye subɔla nyagblɔɖilawo la meva eme ɖe mia fofowo dzi oa?’ Eya ta wotrɔ ɖe ŋunye hegblɔ be: ‘Ale si aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ɖo be yeawɔ mí ɖe míaƒe zɔzɔme kple míaƒe nuwɔnawo nu la, nenemae wòwɔ míi.’”
ENGLISH: 6 But my words and my decrees with which I charged my servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? and they turned back and said “As Jehovah of Armies designed to do to us, in accordance with our courses and practices, so he has done with us.”’”

EWE: 7 Le Dario ƒe ƒe evelia ƒe ɣleti wuiɖekɛlia, si nye Sebat, ƒe ŋkeke blaeve vɔ enelia dzi la, Yehowa ƒe nya va na nyagblɔɖila Zakariya, Berekiya vi, ame si nye Ido vi be: 8 “Mekpɔ ŋutega le zã me.
ENGLISH: 7 On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month (the month of Shebat) in the year two of Darius, Jehovah’s word came to the prophet Zecariah the son of Berekiah the son of ʽIddo,

EWE: Mekpɔ ŋutsu aɖe le sɔ dzĩ aɖe dom, eye wòtɔ ɖe gbemiti siwo le bali me la dome; eye sɔ dzĩwo, sɔ hẽwo kple sɔ ɣiwo le emegbe.”
ENGLISH: 8 “I saw last night, and there was a man riding on a brown pony standing between the myrtles in the bog, and behind him ponies brown, sorrel, and white.

EWE: 9 Ale mebiae be: “Nye aƒetɔ, ame kawoe nye esiawo?”
ENGLISH: 9 And I said ‘What are these, sir?’ and the angel that was speaking with me said to me ‘I will let you see what these are.’

EWE: Eye mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la gblɔ nam be: “Mafia ame si tututu ame siawo nye la wò.”
ENGLISH: 10 And the man standing between the myrtles answered ‘These are what Jehovah has sent to patrol the earth.’

EWE: 10 Ale ŋutsu si tɔ ɖe gbemitiawo dome la ɖo eŋu be: “Ame siawoe Yehowa dɔ be woatsa le anyigba la dzi.” 11 Eye wogblɔ na Yehowa ƒe dɔla si tɔ ɖe gbemitiawo dome la be: “Míeyi ɖatsa le anyigba la dzi, eye kpɔ ɖa, anyigba bliboa dzi zi ɖoɖoe, eye fuɖename aɖeke meli o.”
ENGLISH: 11 And they answered Jehovah’s angel that stood between the myrtles ‘We have patrolled the earth and find all the earth settled and quiet.’

EWE: 12 Eye Yehowa ƒe dɔla la bia be: “Oo aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa, ɣekaɣie nàgbe nublanuikpɔkpɔ na Yerusalem kple Yuda du, siwo nèbu fɔe ƒe blaadre siawo la, ase ɖo?”
ENGLISH: 12 And Jehovah’s angel answered ‘Jehovah of Armies, how long before you will have any tenderness for Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, to which you have been hostile these seventy years?’

EWE: 13 Eye Yehowa tsɔ nya nyuiwo kple akɔfanyawo ɖo eŋu na mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la.
ENGLISH: 13 And Jehovah answered the angel that was speaking with me with kindly words, comforting words;

EWE: 14 Eye mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la gagblɔ nam be: “Ðe gbeƒã be, ‘Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: “Mele ŋu ʋãm ɖe Yerusalem kple Zion nu vevie ŋutɔ.
ENGLISH: 14 and the angel that was speaking with me said to me ‘Call out “Says Jehovah of Armies, I am greatly jealous for Jerusalem and Sion,

EWE: 15 Dzi le kuyem vevie ɖe dukɔ siwo ɖe dzi ɖi bɔkɔɔ la ŋu, elabena dziku vi aɖe koe nye ya medo, gake woawo la, wona vɔ̃ la do gã ɖe edzi.”’
ENGLISH: 15 and I am greatly incensed with the nations that are at ease, because I had been a little incensed and they helped on to disaster.

EWE: 16 “Eya ta ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘“Matrɔ ɖe Yerusalem ŋu ahakpɔ nublanui nɛ. Woagbugbɔ atu nye xɔ ɖe eme, eye woada dzidzeka ɖe Yerusalem ŋu,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.’
ENGLISH: 16 So Jehovah says, I have come back to Jerusalem in tenderness; my house shall be built in it, quoth Jehovah of Armies, and a measuring-line shall be stretched over Jerusalem.”

EWE: 17 “Gaɖe gbeƒã be, ‘Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: “Nu nyuiwo agagbagba ɖe nye duwo me; eye Yehowa agafa akɔ na Zion, eye wòagatia Yerusalem.”’”
ENGLISH: 17 Call out again “Says Jehovah of Armies, My cities shall again overflow with good things, and Jehovah will again comfort Sion and again choose Jerusalem.”’”

EWE: 18 Eye mefɔ kɔ dzi hekpɔ lãdzo ene.
ENGLISH: 18 And I raised my eyes and saw, and there were four horns;

EWE: 19 Eye mebia mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la be: “Nu kae lãdzo siawo fia?” Eɖo eŋu nam be: “Lãdzo siawoe ka Yuda, Israel kple Yerusalem hlẽ.”
ENGLISH: 19 and I said to the angel that was speaking with me “What are these?” and he said to me “These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel and Jerusalem.”

EWE: 20 Emegbe Yehowa na mekpɔ gbede ene.
ENGLISH: 20 And Jehovah showed me four smiths;

EWE: 21 Eye mebiae be: “Nu ka wɔ ge ame siawo gbɔna?” Eye wòɖo eŋu be: “Esiawoe nye lãdzo siwo ka Yuda hlẽ ale gbegbe be, ame aɖeke mete ŋu fɔ ta dzi o. Gbede siawo ava do ŋɔdzi na lãdzoawo, eye woatutu dukɔ siwo do woƒe dzowo ɖe dzi ɖe Yuda-nyigba ŋu, be yewoaka edzinɔlawo ahlẽ la, ƒe dzowo aƒu anyi.”
ENGLISH: 21 and I said “What are these coming to do?” and he said “These are the horns that have scattered Judah so that not a man raised his head; and these have come to sharpen blades to knock off the horns of the nations that raised horns against the country of Judah to scatter it.”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 2 Eye mefɔ kɔ dzi, eye mekpɔ ŋutsu aɖe wòlé dzidzeka ɖe asi.
ENGLISH: 2 And I raised my eyes and saw, and there was a man with a measuring-line in his hand.

EWE: 2 Eya ta mebiae be: “Afi kae nèyina?” Eye wòɖo eŋu nam be: “Meyina Yerusalem dzidze ge, ne makpɔ eƒe kekeme kple eƒe didime.”
ENGLISH: 2 And I said “Where are you going?” and he said to me “To measure Jerusalem, to see how wide and how long it is.”

EWE: 3 Eye kpɔ ɖa, mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la dzo yina, eye mawudɔla bubu aɖe va kpee.
ENGLISH: 3 And out went the angel that was speaking with me, and another angel came out to meet him;

EWE: 4 Eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Netsɔ, yi ɖagblɔ na ɖekakpui ma be: ‘“Amewo anɔ Yerusalem abe kɔƒedu me ene, le ame kple lã siwo le eme la ta.
ENGLISH: 4 and he said to him “Run, tell yonder young man ‘Jerusalem will live the life of rural towns owing to the number of men and beasts in her;

EWE: 5 Ke manye dzobibi ƒe gli aƒo xlãe, eye manye ŋutikɔkɔe anɔ eme,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.’”
ENGLISH: 5 and I, quoth Jehovah, will be to her a wall of fire all round, and I will be glory within her.’”

EWE: 6 “Netsɔ! Netsɔ! Misi tso dziehenyigba dzi,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 6 Ha, ha, off with you out of the north country, quoth Jehovah, because I have spread you along the four winds of the sky, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: “Elabena meka mi hlẽ ɖe dziƒo ƒe ya eneawo dzi,” Yehowa ye gblɔe. 7 “Netsɔ! Zion!
ENGLISH: 7 Ha, make your escape to Sion, you that are living in Babylon.

EWE: 8 Le Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la megbe la, edɔm ɖo ɖe dukɔ siwo nɔ mia ham la gbɔ, elabena ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Ame si ka asi mia ŋu la ka asi nye gadaglamakui ŋu.
ENGLISH: 8 For Jehovah of Armies says “After glory, he has sent me against the nations that were despoiling you, because he who touches you is touching the apple of his eye;

EWE: 9 Elabena fifia la, manyè nye asi ɖe wo ŋu, ne woazu nuhaha na woƒe kluviwo.’ Eye miadze sii be, aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye dɔm.
ENGLISH: 9 for here I am swinging my hand over them and they shall be booty for their slaves, and you shall know that Jehovah of Armies sent me.

EWE: 10 “Oo Zion vinyɔnu, do dzidzɔɣli nàtso aseye; elabena megbɔna be manɔ dowòme,” Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 10 Shout and be joyful, daughter of Sion, because here I am coming to take up my abode in your midst, quoth Jehovah,

EWE: 11 “Gbe ma gbe la, dukɔ geɖewo aku ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye woazu nye dukɔ; eye manɔ dowòme.” Eye àdze sii be, aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye dɔm ɖe gbɔwò.
ENGLISH: 11 and many nations will enlist under Jehovah on that day and become his people, and take up their abode in your midst, and you will know that Jehovah of Armies sent me to you.

EWE: 12 Yehowa axɔ Yuda wòazu eya ŋutɔ ƒe gome le anyigba kɔkɔe la dzi, eye wòagatia Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: 12 And Jehovah will take Judah, his portion, as his own estate on the sacred soil, and will choose Jerusalem again.

EWE: 13 Ŋutilãwo katã, mizi ɖoɖoe le Yehowa ŋkume, elabena eho tso eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la.
ENGLISH: 13 Silence, all mortals, because of Jehovah, for he is astir from his holy dwelling.”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 3 Eye wòna mekpɔ nunɔlagã Yosua le tsitre ɖe Yehowa ƒe dɔla la ŋkume, eye Satana tɔ ɖe eƒe ɖusime be yeatsi tsitre ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 3 And he showed me High Priest Joshuaʽ standing before Jehovah’s angel, and the Adversary standing at his right to be adversary to him.

EWE: 2 Eye Yehowa ƒe dɔla la gblɔ na Satana be: “Yehowa neka mo na wò, Oo Satana, Yehowa, ame si tia Yerusalem la, neka mo na wò! Ðe menye dzoti bibi wònye woɖe tso dzo me oa?”
ENGLISH: 2 And He said to the Adversary “Jehovah rebuke you, Adversary, Jehovah that chooses Jerusalem rebuke you this is a brand pulled out of a fire!”

EWE: 3 Ke Yosua le awu ƒoɖiwo me tɔ ɖe mawudɔla la ŋkume.
ENGLISH: 3 And Joshuaʽ was wearing filthy garments and standing before the angel;

EWE: 4 Eye mawudɔlaa gblɔ na ame siwo tɔ ɖe eŋkume la be, “Miɖe awu ƒoɖiawo le eŋu.”
ENGLISH: 4 and He answered by saying to those who stood before Him “Take the filthy garments off him” (and He said to him “See, I cause the guilt that was on you to pass away”) “and dress him in full-dress garments,

EWE: Eye wògblɔ nɛ be, “Kpɔ ɖa, meɖe wò vodada ɖa le ŋuwò, eye woado awu nyuiwo na wò.” 5 Eya ta megblɔ be: “Mitsɔ tablanu dzadzɛ bla ta nɛ.”
ENGLISH: 5 and place a clean tiara on his head”; and they placed the clean tiara on his head and dressed him in garments while Jehovah’s angel stood there.

EWE: Eye wotsɔ tablanu dzadzɛ bla ta nɛ, eye wodo awuwo nɛ; ke Yehowa ƒe dɔla la tɔ ɖe afi si gogo afi ma.
ENGLISH: 6 And Jehovah’s angel admonished Joshuaʽ

EWE: 6 Eye Yehowa ƒe dɔla gblɔ na Yosua be: 7 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Ne èzɔ le nye mɔwo dzi eye nèwɔ dɔ si mede asi na wò la, ekema ànye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la le nye aƒe me ahakpɔ nye xɔxɔnuawo dzi; eye maɖe mɔ na wò nànɔ ame siawo, siwo le tsitre ɖe afi sia la dome.’
ENGLISH: 7 “Says Jehovah of Armies, If you walk in my ways and keep my charge, then it shall be yours to pronounce judgment for my house and to keep my courts, and I will give you free passage between those who stand here.

EWE: 8 “‘Oo Nunɔlagã Yosua, meɖe kuku, wò kple wò zɔhɛ siwo bɔbɔ nɔ ŋkuwòme la misee, elabena dzesie ŋutsu siawo nye; eye kpɔ ɖa, mekplɔ nye subɔla si ŋkɔe nye Dzedze gbɔnae! 9 Elabena kpɔ kpe si metsɔ ɖo Yosua ŋgɔ la ɖa!
ENGLISH: 8 Listen, High Priest Joshuaʽ, you and your colleagues who sit before you, for they are men of portent; for here I am bringing in my servant New Growth.

EWE: Ŋku adre le kpe la ŋu; maŋlɔ nu ɖe edzi, eye maɖe anyigba ma ƒe fɔɖiɖi ɖa le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 9 For here is the stone I have put before Joshuaʽ, on one stone seven eyes; here I am going to engrave its marking, quoth Jehovah of Armies, and dislodge the guilt of this country in one day.

EWE: 10 “‘Gbe ma gbe la, mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe anɔ eƒe wainka kple gboti te ayɔ nɔvia,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 10 On that day, quoth Jehovah of Armies, you shall each invite another to come under vine and fig-tree.”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 4 Mawudɔla si nɔ nu ƒom kplim la trɔ gbɔ va nyɔm, abe ale si wonyɔa ame tso alɔ̃ me ene.
ENGLISH: 4 And the angel who spoke with me came back and roused me like a man that is roused from sleep,

EWE: 2 Eye wòbiam be: “Nu ka kpɔm nèle?” Eye meɖo eŋu be: “Mele akaɖiti si nye sika sɔŋ, eye agba goboe aɖe le etame, la kpɔm.
ENGLISH: 2 and said to me “What do you see?” and I said “I see a lampstand there, all gold, with its bowl at its top and its seven lamps on it, and seven pipes, for the lamps on top of it,

EWE: Akaɖigbɛ adre le akaɖitia dzi, eye alɔ adre siwo me to le la tso agba goboe la me ɖo akaɖigbɛ ɖe sia ɖe me. 3 Amiti eve le akaɖitia xa, ɖeka le agba goboe la ƒe ɖusime, eye evelia le eƒe miame.”
ENGLISH: 3 and two olive-trees over it, one on the right of the bowl and one on the left.” 4 And I answered by saying to the angel that was speaking with me “What are these, sir?”

EWE: 4 Eye mebia mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la be: “Nye aƒetɔ, nu kae nu siawo fia?” 5 Eye mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la biam be: “Mènya nu si nu siawo fia oa?”
ENGLISH: 5 and the angel that was speaking with me answered me “Do you not know what these are?” and I said “No, sir.”

EWE: Meɖo eŋu be: “Ao, nye aƒetɔ.” 6 Eya ta egblɔ nam be: “Yehowa ƒe gbedeasi na Zerubabel ye nye esi, ‘“Mava eme to aʋakɔ alo ŋusẽ me o, ke boŋ to nye gbɔgbɔ dzi,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 6 And he answered me “This is Jehovah’s word to Zerubbabel, ‘Not my resources nor by strength but by my spirit, says Jehovah of Armies.’

EWE: 7 Oo to gã, nu ka kee nènye o, àzu sɔsɔeƒe le Zerubabel ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 7 For I will make the great mountain into a plain before Zerubbabel, and he shall bring out the headstone among shouts ‘fine! fine!’”

EWE: Eyae aɖe etamekpe ɖe go.
ENGLISH: 8 And Jehovah’s word came to me

EWE: Enya kpɔ loo!”’” 8 Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe gava nam be: 9 “Zerubabel ƒe asie ɖo xɔ sia gɔme anyi, eye eƒe asie awu enu.”
ENGLISH: 9 “Zerubbabel’s hands laid the foundation of this house, and his hands shall finish off; and you shall know that Jehovah of Armies sent me to you.

EWE: Ne miadze sii be, aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye dɔm ɖe mia gbɔ. 10 “Elabena ame kae ado vlo ŋkeke si nuwo dze egɔme sue?
ENGLISH: 10 For who despises the day of little things? and they will rejoice and see the designated stone in Zerubbabel’s hand.

EWE: Elabena amewo akpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woakpɔ tsumikpe si le Zerubabel si.
ENGLISH: These seven are Jehovah’s eyes ranging through all the earth.”

EWE: Ŋku adre siawoe nye Yehowa ƒe ŋku, siwo le tsatsam le anyigba blibo la dzi.”
ENGLISH: 11 And I answered him “What are these two olive-trees to right and left of the lampstand?”

EWE: 11 Eye mebiae be: “Nu kae amiti eve siwo le akaɖiti la ƒe ɖusime kple eƒe miame la fia?” 12 Eye megabiae zi evelia be: “Nu kae amitilɔ eve siwo me sikami le tsyɔtsyɔm le to sikalɔ eveawo me, la fia?”
ENGLISH: 12 and I answered him a second time “What are the two olive-spikes adjoining the two gold spouts that pour the gold off them?”

EWE: 13 Eye wòbiam be: “Mènya nu si nu siawo fia oa?” Eye meɖo eŋu be: “Ao, nye aƒetɔ.”
ENGLISH: 13 And he said to me “Do you not know what these are?” and I said “No, sir.”

EWE: 14 Egblɔ nam be: “Wole tsitre ɖi na amesiamina eve siwo tɔ ɖe anyigba bliboa ƒe Aƒetɔ la gbɔ.”
ENGLISH: 14 And he said “These are the two sons of oil that stand by the Lord of all the earth.”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 5 Megafɔ kɔ dzi eye mekpɔ agbalẽ xatsaxatsa aɖe le dzodzom le yame.
ENGLISH: 5 And once more I raised my eyes and saw, and there was a document flying.

EWE: 2 Eye wòbiam be: “Nu ka kpɔm nèle?” Eye meɖo eŋu be: “Mele agbalẽ xatsaxatsa aɖe si le dzodzom le yame la kpɔm; edidi abɔklugui blaeve, eye wòkeke abɔklugui ewo.”
ENGLISH: 2 And he said to me “What do you see?” and I said “I see a document flying, thirty feet long and fifteen wide.”

EWE: 3 Eye wògblɔ nam be: “Esiae nye fiƒode si yina ɖe anyigba bliboa dzi, elabena womehea to na ame siwo le fi fim la ɖe fiƒodenya si le agbalẽa ƒe axa si la nu o, eye womehea to na ame siwo le alakpatam kam la ɖe fiƒodenya si le eƒe axa kemɛa la nu o.
ENGLISH: 3 And he said to me “This is the anathema that is going out all over the country; for every stealer will be cleared out on this side in accordance with it and every swearer will be cleared out on that side in accordance with it.

EWE: 4 ‘Nyee ɖoe ɖa be wòage ɖe fiafitɔ ƒe aƒe me kple ame si le alakpatam kam le nye ŋkɔ me la ƒe aƒe me, ne wòanɔ aƒe ma me ahagbã aƒea, eye wòakaka eƒe xɔtiwo kple kpewo siaa,’” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 4 I put it out, quoth Jehovah of Armies, and it will go into the thief’s house and into the house of the one who swears by my name to a lie, and it will lodge inside the house and make an end of it wood and stones and all.”

EWE: 5 Eye mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la do va gblɔ nam be: “Meɖe kuku, fɔ mo dzi nàkpɔ nu sia si do gbɔna la ɖa!”
ENGLISH: 5 And the angel that was speaking with me came out and said to me “Raise your eyes and see what this is that is going out.”

EWE: 6 Eya ta mebiae be: “Nu kae?”
ENGLISH: 6 And I said “What is that?”

EWE: Eɖo eŋu be: “Esiae nye efa nudzidzenu si do gbɔna.”
ENGLISH: And he said “This is the bushel that is going out”; and he said “This is their guilt throughout the country.”

EWE: Eye wògagblɔ be: “Aleae woƒe dzedzeme le le anyigba blibo la dzi.” 7 Eye mekpɔ be woɖe nutunu kotoo si wotsɔ tsumi wɔ la ɖa, eye nyɔnu aɖe bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe nugo la me.
ENGLISH: 7 And there a disk of lead lifted itself up, and there sitting inside the bushel was a woman.

EWE: 8 Eye wògblɔ be: “Nyɔnu sia ŋkɔe nye Vɔ̃ɖinyenye.”
ENGLISH: 8 And he said “This is Wickedness” and threw her into the bushel and threw the block of lead on its mouth.

EWE: Eye wòtigii ɖe efa-nugo la me, eye wòtsɔ nutuvi kpekpe si wotsɔ tsumi wɔ la tu ɖe enu. 9 Eye mefɔ kɔ dzi kpɔ nyɔnu eve do gbɔna, eye ya ɖo woƒe aʋalawo me.
ENGLISH: 9 And I raised my eyes and saw, and there were two women coming out, with wind in their wings; they had wings like a stork’s.

EWE: Woto aʋala abe damixe ƒe aʋala ene. Eye wokɔ nugo la ɖe anyigba kple dziƒo domee.
ENGLISH: And they carried the bushel up between the earth and the sky,

EWE: 10 Eya ta mebia mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la be: “Afi kae wokɔ efa-nugo la yinae?”
ENGLISH: 10 and I said to the angel that was speaking with me “Where are they taking the bushel to?”

EWE: 11 Eɖo eŋu nam be: “Wokɔe yina Sinar-nyigba dzi be woaɖatu xɔ na nyɔnua; ne wotui vɔ la, woatsɔe ada ɖe afi si dze nɛ.”
ENGLISH: 11 and he said to me “To build it a house in Shinear, and have a base ready, and they will set it down there on its base.”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 6 Eye megafɔ mo dzi, eye mekpɔ tasiaɖam ene le dodom tso to eve dome, eye toawo nye akɔbli.
ENGLISH: 6 And once more I raised my eyes and saw, and there were four chariots coming out from between the two mountains; and the mountains were of bronze.

EWE: 2 Sɔ dzĩwo le tasiaɖam gbãtɔ ŋu, eye sɔ yibɔwo le tasiaɖam evelia ŋu.
ENGLISH: 2 In the first chariot were brown ponies, and in the second chariot black ponies,

EWE: 3 Sɔ ɣiwo le tasiaɖam etɔ̃lia ŋu, eye sɔ ŋɔtaŋɔta ŋɔŋɔewo le tasiaɖam enelia ŋu.
ENGLISH: 3 and in the third chariot white ponies, and in the fourth chariot strong dappled ponies.

EWE: 4 Eye mebia mawudɔla si le nu ƒom kplim la be: “Nye aƒetɔ, nu kawoe nye esiawo?”
ENGLISH: 4 And I answered by saying to the angel that was speaking with me “What are these, sir?”

EWE: 5 Mawudɔla la ɖo eŋu nam be: “Esiawoe nye dziƒowo ƒe gbɔgbɔ ene siwo do yina, esi wotsi tre ɖe anyigba blibo la ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋkume vɔ megbe.
ENGLISH: 5 and the angel answered me “These are the four winds of the sky coming out from presenting themselves before the Lord of all the earth.

EWE: 6 Esi ŋu sɔ yibɔawo le la do yina dziehenyigba dzi; ɣiawo yina atsiaƒu la godo; eye ŋɔtaŋɔtaawo yina anyiehenyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 6 The one with the black ponies in it, they were going out to the north country, and the white went out to a part behind them, and the dappled went out to the south country;

EWE: 7 Ŋɔŋɔeawo hã di be yewoado ayi aɖatsa le anyigba la dzi.” Eye wògblɔ be: “Miheyi ɖatsa le anyigba la dzi.” Ale wode asi tsatsa me le anyigba la dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 and the brown went out and wanted to go walking back and forth in the earth, and he said to them ‘Walk back and forth in the earth,’ and they did.”

EWE: 8 Eye wòdo ɣli ɖo ɖem gblɔ nam be: “Kpɔ ɖa, esiwo do yina dziehenyigba dzi la na Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe nu fa le dziehenyigba dzi.”
ENGLISH: 8 And he called me up and spoke to me, saying “See, those that were going out to the north country have laid my spirit in the north country.”

EWE: 9 Yehowa ƒe gbe gava nam be: 10 “Xɔ nu si Heldai, Tobiya kple Yedaya tsɔ tso aboyomeawo gbɔ la; eye gbe ma gbe la, wò ŋutɔ kple ame siawo siwo tso Babilon va la miyi Yosiya, Zefaniya vi la ƒe aƒe me.
ENGLISH: 9 And Jehovah’s word came to me, 10 “Take from the emigrants out of Heldai, from Tobijah and from Jedaiah, and go in yourself and go in into the house of Josiah the son of Sephaniah, who have come from Babylon,

EWE: 11 Eye nàtsɔ klosalo kple sika awɔ fiakuku aɖɔ na nunɔlagã Yosua, Yehozadak vi la.
ENGLISH: 11 and take silver and gold and make a crown and place on the head of High Priest Joshuaʽ the son of Josadak,

EWE: 12 Eye nàgblɔ nɛ be, “‘Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: “Ŋutsu si ŋkɔe nye Dzedze lae nye esi.
ENGLISH: 12 and say to him ‘Says Jehovah of Armies, Here is a man named New Growth, and he shall grow new in his place and build Jehovah’s temple.

EWE: Adze tso enɔƒe, eye wòatu Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la. 13 Eyae atu Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la, eye eya ŋue fianyenye ƒe bubu anɔ. Anɔ anyi ɖe eƒe fiazikpui dzi aɖu fia, anye nunɔla hã anɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi, eye ŋutifafa anɔ wo kple eve la dome.
ENGLISH: 13 And he shall build Jehovah’s temple, and he shall take on majesty and shall sit and rule on his throne, and there shall be a priest at his right hand, and there shall be peaceable policy between the two.’”

EWE: 14 Fiakuku la anɔ Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la me woatsɔ aɖo ŋku Helem, Tobiya, Yedaya, kple Hen, Zefaniya vi, dzi.
ENGLISH: 14 And Helem and Tobijah and Jedaʽiah, and the graciousness of the son of Sephaniah, shall have the crown for a memorial in Jehovah’s temple;

EWE: 15 Ame siwo le didiƒe la ava kpe asi ɖe Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la tutu ŋu.” Ekema miadze sii be aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye dɔm ɖe mia gbɔ. Esia ava eme ne mieɖo to Yehowa mia Mawu ƒe gbe.’”
ENGLISH: 15 and far-off men shall come and build on Jehovah’s temple, and you shall know that Jehovah of Armies sent me to you; and if you shall obey your God Jehovah

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 7 Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Zakariya le Fia Dario ƒe ƒe enelia me, le ɣleti asiekelia, si nye Kislev ƒe ŋkeke enelia dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 And in the year four of King Darius Jehovah’s word came to Zecariah on the fourth of the ninth month, in Kislev;

EWE: 2 Eye ame siwo le Betel la dɔ Sarezer kple Regem-Melek kpakple eƒe amewo ɖa, be woaɖaƒo koko na Yehowa ne wòave yewo nu, 3 eye woabia nunɔla siwo le aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me kple nyagblɔɖilawo be: “Ðe mafa avi le ɣleti atɔ̃lia me, ahate nuɖuɖu ɖokuinye, abe ale si mewɔ ƒe gbogbo siawo enea?”
ENGLISH: 2 and Bethel sent Shareser and Regem-Melec and his men to propitiate Jehovah, 3 to say to the priests of the house of Jehovah of Armies and to the prophets “Are we to weep in the fifth month with devotee observances as we have been doing ever so many years?”

EWE: 4 Aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe gbe gava nam be: 5 “Bia dukɔ la me tɔwo katã kple nunɔlawo be: ‘Esi mietsi nu dɔ, eye miefa avi le ɣleti atɔ̃lia kple ɣleti adrelia me, eye miewɔ esia ƒe blaadre la, nyee mietsi nu dɔ na? 6 Eye ne mieɖu nu no nu la, ɖe menye miawo ŋutɔwoe mieɖu nu no nu na oa? 7 Ðe mele be miaɖo to nya siwo Yehowa gblɔ to nyagblɔɖila tsãtɔwo dzi, esime amewo nɔ Yerusalem kple eŋuduwo me, eye amewo nɔ Negeb kple Sefela oa?’”
ENGLISH: 4 And the word of Jehovah of Armies came to me 5 “Say to all the people of the country and to the priests ‘When you fasted and wailed in the fifth and seventh months these seventy years were you fasting me? 6 and when you eat, and when you drink, is it not you that eat and drink? 7 Are not these the words Jehovah proclaimed by the former prophets while Jerusalem was settled and quiet, and her cities around her, and the South and the lowland settled,

EWE: 8 Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe gava na Zakariya be: 9 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe; minyo dɔme eye mikpɔ nublanui na mia nɔewo.
ENGLISH: 8 The word of Jehovah again came to Zechariah, saying: 9 “Says Jehovah of Armies, Give true verdicts and practice friendliness and sympathy, brother with brother,

EWE: 10 Migatafa ahosi alo tsyɔ̃evi, amedzro alo ame dahe o; eye migaɖo tame vɔ̃ ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu le miaƒe dzi me o.’ 11 Ke wogbe toɖoɖo, eye wolia ʋume kpakoo, eye woxe to be yewomase nu o.
ENGLISH: 10 and do not deny justice to widow and orphan, immigrant and penniless man, and do not think up harm for a brother”? 11 and they refused to listen and turned a stubborn shoulder and a deaf ear,

EWE: 12 Wona woƒe dzi me sẽ abe lotamekpe ene, eye womeɖo to se la kple nya siwo aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa to eƒe gbɔgbɔ dzi na nyagblɔɖila tsãtɔwo gblɔ la o. Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa do dziku ɖe wo ŋu vevie.”
ENGLISH: 12 and made their hearts adamant against listening to the instructions and messages that Jehovah of Armies had sent by his spirit through the former prophets, and there was great wrath from Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 13 “‘Eya ta ale si ko meyɔ wo, eye wogbe esese la, nenema kee woawo hã woayɔm, ke magbe esese,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 13 And as he called and they did not hear, so, says Jehovah of Armies, will they call and I not hear.

EWE: 14 ‘Eye metsɔ ahom ka wo hlẽ ɖe dukɔ siwo katã womenya o la dome, eye anyigba la zu gbegbe le wo megbe, ame aɖeke metoa edzi yina loo alo toa edzi gbɔna o; ale wona anyigba nyui la zu ŋɔdzinu.’”
ENGLISH: 14 And I blew them away to all the nations they had never known, and the country lay desolate behind them without goer or comer. And they rendered a charming country a desolation.’”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 8 Aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe gbe gava be, 2 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Maʋã ŋu vevie ɖe Zion nu, eye maʋã ŋu ɖe enu le dɔmedzoe me.’”
ENGLISH: 8 And Jehovah’s word came to me 2 “Says Jehovah of Armies, I am greatly jealous for Sion, very resentfully jealous.

EWE: 3 “Ale Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Matrɔ ayi Zion, eye manɔ Yerusalem; woayɔ Yerusalem be nyateƒedu, eye woayɔ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe to la be to kɔkɔe.’”
ENGLISH: 3 Says Jehovah, I have come back to Sion and will dwell within Jerusalem; and Jerusalem shall be called ‘the loyal city’ and ‘the city of Jehovah of Armies, the sacred city.’

EWE: 4 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Amegãɖeɖiwo kple nyagãɖeɖiwo aganɔ Yerusalem ƒe ablɔwo me ake, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe alé atizɔti ɖe asi le ƒe geɖe xɔxɔ ta.
ENGLISH: 4 Says Jehovah of Armies, Again shall old men and old women sit in the squares of Jerusalem, each with staff in hand for length of years;

EWE: 5 Ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo asɔ gbɔ ɖe duawo ƒe ablɔwo me taŋ anɔ fefem le eƒe ablɔwo me.’”
ENGLISH: 5 and the squares of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its squares.

EWE: 6 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Togbɔ be adze nu sesẽ aɖe ŋutɔ na dukɔ sia ƒe ame susɔeawo le ŋkeke mawo me hã la, ɖe wòanye nu sesẽ na nye hã?’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 6 Says Jehovah of Armies, Because it looks impossible to the remnant of this people in those days is it to look impossible to me too? quoth Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: 7 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, maɖe nye dukɔ tso ɣedzeƒenyigba dzi kple ɣetoɖoƒenyigba dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 “Says Jehovah of Armies, Here, I am saving my people out of the East and out of the West,

EWE: 8 Makplɔ wo agbɔe, eye woanɔ Yerusalem; woanye nye dukɔ, eye nye hã manye woƒe Mawu le nyateƒe kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me.’”
ENGLISH: 8 and bringing them in where they are to settle inside of Jerusalem; and I will have them for my people, and they shall have me for their God, loyally and honestly.

EWE: 9 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Mido ŋusẽ miaƒe asiwo, mi, ame siwo le nya siawo sem fifia tso nyagblɔɖilawo nu, nya siwo wogblɔ le gbe si gbe woɖo aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe xɔ la gɔme anyi, be woagatu gbedoxɔ la.
ENGLISH: 9 “Says Jehovah of Armies, Courage, you that in these days hear these words from the mouths of the prophets who spoke on the day of the founding of Jehovah of Armies’ house, the temple, to be built;

EWE: 10 Elabena hafi ɣemaɣi naɖo la, fetu aɖeke menɔ anyi na amegbetɔwo kple lãwo o; ame aɖeke medona alo gbɔna dedie o, le futɔ la ta, elabena mena amewo katã tso ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu.’
ENGLISH: 10 for before those days there had not come any pay for man and there was no pay for beast, and goer and comer had no peace from the foe, and I set all mankind man against man.

EWE: 11 “‘Ke azɔ la, nyemawɔ nu ɖe dukɔ sia ƒe ame susɔeawo ŋu abe ale si mewɔ le tsãŋkekewo me ene o,’ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 11 But now I am not as I was in the former days toward the remnant of this people, quoth Jehovah of Armies;

EWE: 12 ‘Elabena woaƒã ŋutifafaku; wainka atse, anyigba awɔ nu, eye dziƒo adza zãmu; mana dukɔ sia ƒe ame susɔeawo nanyi nu siawo katã dome.
ENGLISH: 12 for I will sow peace, the vines shall give their fruit and the earth its growth and the sky its dew, and I will allot all this to the remnant of this people;

EWE: 13 Oo Yuda ƒe aƒe kple Israel ƒe aƒe, ale si ko miezu fiƒode le dukɔwo dome la, nenema kee maxɔ na mii, be miazu yayra. Migavɔ̃ o! Mido ŋusẽ miaƒe asiwo.’
ENGLISH: 13 and as you have been a word of cursing among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you and you shall be a blessing; do not be afraid, courage!

EWE: 14 “Elabena ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘“Ale si ko mia tɔgbuiwo do dziku nam eye meɖoe be mahe vɔ̃ ava mia dzi, eye mevem o la,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe, 15 “nenemae magaɖoe le ŋkeke siawo me be mawɔ nyui na Yerusalem kple Yuda ƒe aƒe la.
ENGLISH: 14 For Jehovah of Armies says, As I designed to do bad things to you when your fathers incensed me, says Jehovah of Armies, and I did not change my mind, 15 so I have in these days come back and design to do good to Jerusalem and the house of Judah; do not be afraid.

EWE: Migavɔ̃ o!”’ 16 “‘Nu siwo miawɔ lae nye esi: Mito nyateƒe na mia nɔewo. Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe le miaƒe dugbowo nu ne nyateƒe kple ŋutifafa naxɔ aƒe ɖi.
ENGLISH: 16 These are the things you are to do: speak truth to each other, give judgments true in fact and sound in law in your gates,

EWE: 17 Migaɖo vɔ̃ ɖe dzi me ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu o, eye alakpatam megavivi mia nu o; elabena melé fu nu siawo katã,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 17 and do not think up harm for each other in your minds, and do not love a false oath; for all these things I hate, quoth Jehovah.”

EWE: 18 Yehowa, aʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu la, ƒe gbe gava nam be: 19 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Miaƒe nutsitsidɔ le ɣleti enelia me, le ɣleti atɔ̃lia me, le ɣleti adrelia me, kple ɣleti ewolia me la, azu aseyetsotso kple dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kpakple ŋkekenyuiwo na Yuda ƒe aƒe la.
ENGLISH: 18 And Jehovah of Armies’ word came to me 19 “Says Jehovah of Armies, The fourth-month fast and the fifth-month fast and the seventh-month fast and the tenth-month fast shall become rejoicings and merry-makings and happy occasions for the house of Judah; so love truth and peace.

EWE: Eya ta milɔ̃ nyateƒe kple ŋutifafa.’
ENGLISH: 20 Says Jehovah of Armies, Peoples and the inhabitants of many cities shall yet come in,

EWE: 20 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Dukɔwo kple du geɖe me nɔlawo ava; 21 eye du ɖeka me nɔlawo ayi aɖagblɔ na du bubu me nɔlawo be: “Mina míadze agbagba aɖaƒo koko na Yehowa, eye míadi aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa yome mɔ.
ENGLISH: 21 and the inhabitants of one shall go to another saying ‘Yes, let us go to propitiate Jehovah, to look up Jehovah of Armies; I will go too.’

EWE: Nye hã mayi.” 22 Eye dukɔ geɖewo kple dukɔ sesẽwo ava di aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa le Yerusalem, eye woaƒo koko na Yehowa be wòave yewo nu.’
ENGLISH: 22 And many peoples and mighty nations shall come to look up Jehovah of Armies at Jerusalem and to propitiate Jehovah.

EWE: 23 “Ale aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa gblɔe nye esi: ‘Le ŋkeke mawo me la, ame ewo atso dukɔwo ƒe gbegbɔgblɔwo katã me alé Yudatɔ ɖeka ƒe awu toga agblɔ be: “Míayi kpli mi, elabena míese be Mawu li kpli mi.”’”
ENGLISH: 23 Says Jehovah of Armies, In those days ten men out of all the languages of the nations shall take hold of the flap of a Jewish man’s coat saying ‘Let us go with you, because we have heard you have God with you.’”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 9 Gbedeasi vevi aɖe: “Yehowa ƒe nya va ɖe Hadrak-nyigba ŋu, Ðe Damasko koŋ ŋu, Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋku le amegbetɔwo
ENGLISH: 9 The boding of Jehovah’s word in Hadrac, its resting-place Damascus; for Jehovah’s are the eyes of mankind, and all the tribes of Israel;

EWE: Kple Israel ƒe toawo katã ŋu. 2 Ava Hamat si do liƒo kplii,
ENGLISH: 2 Hamath too, bordering on it; Tyre and Sidon, very wise as they are.

EWE: Kple Tiro kpakple Sidon hã dzi, elabena wodze aɖaŋu ŋutɔ. 3 Tiro ɖo gli sesẽwo na eɖokui.
ENGLISH: 3 And Tyre built itself siege-works and piled up silver like earth and hard gold like street mud.

EWE: Kple sika abe ba le kpɔdomee ene. 4 Kpɔ ɖa! Yehowa axɔ eƒe nunɔamesiwo le esi, Eye wòatsrɔ̃ eƒe aʋakɔ la le atsiaƒu me;
ENGLISH: 4 Here Jehovah will dispossess her and knock her wealth into the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

EWE: Eye dzo afiãe. 5 Askelon akpɔe, eye vɔvɔ̃ aɖoe; Ŋɔdzi alé Gaza hã vevie, Eye aleae wòanɔ na Ekron hã, elabena eƒe ŋuɖoɖeŋua azu ŋukpe nɛ. Fia atsrɔ̃ le Gaza,
ENGLISH: 5 Ashkelon will see and be afraid; Ghaza, and be utterly unmanned; and ʽEkron, because her cynosure has come to grief and king is lost to Ghaza; and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.

EWE: Eye ame maganɔ Askelon o. 6 Ame tutɔ anɔ Asdod,
ENGLISH: 6 And a mongrel rabble will live in Ashdod, and I will abolish the Philistines’ pride;

EWE: Eye matsi Filistitɔwo ƒe dàda nu. 7 Maɖe ʋu ɖa le nu me nɛ Kple ŋunyɔnuwo ɖa le aɖutɛ me nɛ, Eye ame si asusɔ nɛ la azu mía Mawu tɔ; Anɔ abe amegã ene le Yuda,
ENGLISH: 7 and I will take out its blood from its mouth and its carrion from between its teeth, and it too will be left belonging to our God, and be like a privileged guest in Judah, and ʽEkron like a Jebusite.

EWE: Eye Ekron anɔ abe Yebusitɔ la ene. 8 Maƒu asaɖa anyi abe dzɔla ene ɖe nye aƒe ŋu, Ale be ame aɖeke manɔ yiyim anɔ gbɔgbɔm o; Eye amedzizila aɖeke magato eme ayi azɔ o,
ENGLISH: 8 And I will camp as garrison for my house against comer and goer, and never again shall a coercer pass through them; for now I have seen with my own eyes.

EWE: Elabena nye ŋutɔ mekpɔe kple nye ŋkuwo azɔ. 9 Oo Zion vinyɔnu, kpɔ dzidzɔ vevie. Oo Yerusalem vinyɔnu, tso aseye. Kpɔ ɖa! Wò fia gbɔna gbɔwò. Dzɔdzɔetɔ wònye, eye wòhe ɖeɖekpɔkpɔ gbɔnɛ; Ebɔbɔa eɖokui, eye wòdo tedzi,
ENGLISH: 9 Jubilate most gayly, daughter of Sion; cheer, daughter of Jerusalem; here you shall have your kind come in; just and victorious is he, poor and mounted on a donkey, on a young beast born of donkeys.

EWE: Si nye tedzinɔ ƒe vi. 10 Maɖe aʋatasiaɖamwo ɖa le Efrayim, Kple sɔwo ɖa le Yerusalem. Woaɖe aʋawɔdati ɖa. Agblɔ ŋutifafanya na dukɔwo; Eƒe dziɖuɖu atso atsiaƒu nu ayi atsiaƒu nu,
ENGLISH: 10 And he will abolish chariots from Ephraim and ponies from Jerusalem, and war-bows will be abolished, and he will pronounce peace to the nations; and his rule will be from sea to sea and from River to ends of earth.

EWE: Tso Tɔsisi la nu va se ɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo ke. 11 Oo nyɔnu, mato wò nubabla ƒe ʋu la dzi
ENGLISH: 11 Your prisoners too for your covenant blood I have let go out of the dry cistern.

EWE: Aɖe asi le wò gamenɔlawo ŋu tso vudo ƒuƒlu la me. 12 Mi, gamenɔla siwo si mɔkpɔkpɔ le, mitrɔ gbɔ va mɔ́ sesẽ la me.
ENGLISH: 12 The prisoners of hope shall come back to you, Sion, today too; double dower I will bring back to you.

EWE: ‘Oo, nyɔnu, maɖo eteƒe na wò zi gbɔ zi eve. 13 Elabena mahe Yuda me abe nye dati ene. Matsɔ Efrayim ade dati la me, Eye manyɔ viwòwo, Oo Zion, Ðe viwòwo ŋu, Oo Hela,
ENGLISH: 13 For I have bent Judah for my bow, put Ephraim in for arrow; and I will rouse your sons, Sion, against the sons of Greece, and make you like a champion’s sword.

EWE: Eye mana nànɔ abe kalẽtɔ ƒe yi ene, Oo Zion.’ 14 Woakpɔ Yehowa le wo tame, Eye eƒe aŋutrɔwo anɔ ʋɔ lũm abe dzikedzo ene. Aƒetɔ Dziɖulagã Yehowa aku kpẽ,
ENGLISH: 14 And Jehovah will appear over them, and his arrow will go out like the lightning; and the Lord Jehovah will blow the ram-horn and go with southern tempests.
