EWE: Eye wòanɔ dziehe ƒe ahom me aho. 15 Aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa aʋli wo ta, Eye woami futɔwo ƒe akafokpewo eye woanya avuzi le edzi. Woano nu agli abe wain ye wono ene; Eye woayɔ banaa abe agba goboe Kple vɔsamlekpui ƒe dzogoewo ene.
ENGLISH: 15 Jehovah of Armies will shield them, and they will eat up and stamp down slingstones and drink their blood like wine, and be filled like a sacrificer’s bowl, like the corners of an altar,

EWE: 16 Yehowa woƒe Mawu axɔ na eƒe dukɔ la gbe ma gbe
ENGLISH: 16 and their God Jehovah will give them the victory.

EWE: Abe eƒe lãha ene; Elabena woanɔ dzo dam le eƒe anyigba dzi abe kpe xɔasiwo le fiakuku ŋu ene.
ENGLISH: On that day his people’s sheep will be like sparkling diadem-stones over his soil.

EWE: 17 Elabena aleke eƒe nyuiwɔwɔ keke tae, Eye eƒe nyonyo teƒe mekɔ o ale! Nuɖuɖu ana ɖekakpuiwo natsi nyuie,
ENGLISH: 17 For how good and what a beauty-giver is he! grain will ripen young men, grape-juice maidens.

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 10 “Mibia Yehowa ne wòana tsi nadza na mi le adame. Yehowae nye ame si wɔ alilikpowo, Eye wònana tsi dzana tso wo me,
ENGLISH: 10 Ask Jehovah for rain at spring-rain time, Jehovah who makes chain-lightning, and he will give you rain in bursts so there will be herbage on the range.

EWE: Eye wònana anyigba miea nu na ame sia ame. 2 Elabena terafim legbawo gblɔa ameflunyawo; Eye afakalawo hã kpɔa alakpaŋutegawo. Wolĩa drɔ̃e siwo mele eme o, Gake dzodzroe wodzea agbagba be yewoafa akɔ na amewo. Esia tae woaka hlẽ abe alẽwo ene.
ENGLISH: 2 For the teraphim have spoken rubbish and the soothsayers have visioned a lie, and they tell futile dreams, give unsubstantial comfort; therefore they stray like sheep, go hungry because there is no shepherd.

EWE: Fu awɔ wo, elabena kplɔla aɖeke meli o. 3 Nye dɔmedzoe bi ɖe lãkplɔviwo ŋu,
ENGLISH: 3 Against the shepherds I am angry, and the he-goats I will punish.

EWE: Eye mabia akɔnta kplɔla ŋutasẽlawo; Elabena aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa trɔ susu ɖe Yuda ƒe aƒe si nye eƒe lãha ŋu,
ENGLISH: For Jehovah of Armies has visited his flock the house of Judah and will make them like ponies whose passion is for battle.

EWE: Eye wòna wole abe eƒe sɔ si ŋu bubu le le aʋa me ene. 4 Yuda mee ame vevitɔ la ado tso,
ENGLISH: 4 From him headman, from him staff, from him war-bow, from him will come every officer together.

EWE: Eya mee dɔdzikpɔla ɖe sia ɖe ado tso, wo katã woado tso eme. 5 Woanɔ abe aʋawɔlawo, Ame siwo fanyaa ba le kpɔdomeewo le aʋa me ene. Woawɔ aʋa, elabena Yehowa li kpli wo,
ENGLISH: 5 And they will be like champions trampling through street mud in battle; and they will fight, because Jehovah is with them, and discomfit pony-riders.

EWE: Eye sɔdolawo aɖu ŋukpe. 6 Mana Yuda ƒe aƒe la nasẽ ŋu, Eye maxɔ na Yosef ƒe aƒe la. Magaɖo wo te, Elabena makpɔ nublanui na wo; Eye woanɔ abe ɖe nyemegbe nu le wo gbɔ kpɔ o ene;
ENGLISH: 6 And I will invigorate the house of Judah, and save the house of Joseph and bring them back, because I have tender feelings for them, and they will be as if I had not repudiated them; for I am their God Jehovah and will answer them.

EWE: Elabena nyee nye Yehowa woƒe Mawu, matɔ na wo. 7 Efrayim anɔ abe kalẽtɔ sesẽ ene, Eye woƒe dzi akpɔ dzidzɔ abe wain ye wono ene. Wo viwo akpɔe, eye dzi adzɔ wo;
ENGLISH: 7 And Ephraim will be like a champion, and their hearts will be merry as if with wine; and their sons will see and be merry, and their hearts will jubilate in Jehovah.

EWE: Woƒe dzi atso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu. 8 ‘Malia aku ayɔ wo aƒo ƒu; Elabena maɖe wo, woade ha kpaŋkpaŋ
ENGLISH: 8 I will whistle for them and collect them, because I have ransomed them; and there shall be as many of them as there had been;

EWE: Eye woanɔ agbɔ sɔm ɖe edzi. 9 Togbɔ be meka wo hlẽ abe nuku ene ɖe dukɔwo dome hã, Woaɖo ŋku dzinye le didiƒe ke;
ENGLISH: 9 and I will sow them among the peoples, and in the distant places they will remember me and come to life with their sons and come back.

EWE: Agbe agaɖo woawo kple wo viwo me, eye woatrɔ agbɔ. 10 Makplɔ wo agbɔe tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, Eye maƒo wo nu ƒu tso Asiria; Makplɔ wo ava Gilead-nyigba dzi kple Lebanon,
ENGLISH: 10 And I will bring them back from Egypt and collect them from Assyria, and bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will be no finding any place for them.

EWE: Eye teƒe masu na wo gɔ̃ hã o. 11 Ahe xaxa ava atsiaƒu la dzi ne etsoe; Atsi atsiaƒu la ƒe tsotsoewo nu, Eye Nil-tɔsisi ƒe gogloeƒewo katã amie. Woaɖiɖi Asiria ƒe dàda vivivo la ɖe anyi,
ENGLISH: 11 And they will go through the sea in distress, and he will strike waves into the sea and dry out all the bogs of the Nile, and Assyria’s pride will be brought down and Egypt’s cudgel will pass away;

EWE: Eye fiatikplɔ age le Egipte si. 12 Nye, Yehowa ŋutɔ mado ŋusẽ wo, Eye woazɔ le nye ŋkɔ me,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.”
ENGLISH: 12 and I will give them vigor in Jehovah, and in his name they shall triumph, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 11 “Oo Lebanon, ʋu wò ʋɔtruwo,
ENGLISH: 11 Lebanon, open your doors for fire to eat among your cedars.

EWE: Ne dzo nafiã wò sedertiwo. 2 Oo sesewu, fa avi, elabena sederti mu; Elabena wotsrɔ̃ ati gãwo! Mi, Basan logotiwo, mifa avi,
ENGLISH: 2 Howl, cypress, because a cedar has fallen, that parklands are ravaged! howl, Bashan oaks, because the Basor bush is down!

EWE: Elabena avetsu la megali o! 3 Mise ɖa! Lãkplɔviwo le avi fam,
ENGLISH: 3 I hear the shepherds howling because their park-realm is ravaged; I hear the two-year-old lions roaring because the Jordan jungle is ravaged.

EWE: Elabena wogblẽ woƒe lãnyiƒe nyui la dome. Mise ɖa!
ENGLISH: 4 Said my God Jehovah, “Shepherd the slaughtering sheep,

EWE: Elabena wotsrɔ̃ ave dodo siwo le Yordan ŋu la keŋ. 4 “Ale Yehowa, nye Mawu, gblɔe nye esi: ‘Kplɔ alẽ siwo woɖo na wuwu la, 5 elabena wo ƒlelawo wua wo, evɔ womebua fɔ wo o.
ENGLISH: 5 whose buyers kill and are not responsible, and whose sellers say ‘Bless Jehovah, I have been getting rich,’ and whose shepherds have no mercy on them;

EWE: 6 “‘Nyemagakpɔ nublanui na anyigba la dzi nɔlawo azɔ o,’ Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 6 for I will no longer have mercy on the inhabitants of the earth, quoth Jehovah.

EWE: ‘Eya ta matsɔ ame sia ame ade asi na ehavi, kple eƒe fia, eye woagblẽ anyigba la, eye nyemaɖe wo le wo si me o.’”
ENGLISH: Here I am handing mankind over to each other and to their respective kings, and they will pound the earth up, and I will not deliver out of their hands.”

EWE: 7 Menyi alẽ siwo woɖo na wuwu la, le miaƒe nyonyo ta, Oo, alẽ siwo le fu kpem. Metsɔ atikplɔ eve. Meyɔ ɖeka be Nyonyo, eye meyɔ evelia be Ðekawɔwɔ, eye meyi alẽawo kpɔkplɔ dzi.
ENGLISH: 7 And I shepherded the slaughtering sheep for the sheep-traders; I got myself two staves, one of which I called Goodwill and the other Ties, and shepherded the sheep.

EWE: 8 Emegbe meɖe lãkplɔvi etɔ̃ ɖa le dzinu ɖeka me, elabena nyemegbɔ dzi ɖi na wo o, eye woawo hã wolé fum.
ENGLISH: 8 And I killed off the three shepherds in one month; and I lost patience with them, and they on their part were disgusted with me.

EWE: 9 Eye megblɔ be: “Nyemegale mia kplɔ ge o. Esi be yeaku la, neku faa. Esi be yeatsrɔ̃ la, netsrɔ̃ faa.
ENGLISH: 9 And I said “I will not shepherd you: what dies shall die and what is missing shall be missing, and what remains shall eat each other’s flesh”;

EWE: Ke esiwo susɔ la neɖu wo nɔewo ƒe lã.” 10 Eya ta metsɔ nye atikplɔ si nye Nyonyo, eye meŋee, ne matu nu, si mebla kple dukɔwo katã la.
ENGLISH: 10 and I took my staff Goodwill and chopped it in two, to break the terms I had come to with all the peoples,

EWE: 11 Eya ta metui gbe ma gbe, eye alẽ siwo wowɔ fui, siwo nɔ kpɔyem la, va dze sii be Yehowa ƒe nyae wònye.
ENGLISH: 11 and they were broken on that day; and the sheep-traders who were watching me knew it was Jehovah’s word.

EWE: 12 Eye megblɔ na wo be: “Ne edze mia ŋu la, ekema mina nye fetum; ke ne medze mia ŋu o la, ekema midzudzɔ.”
ENGLISH: 12 And I said to them “If you think best, give me my pay; if not, don’t”; and they weighed out my pay, thirty shekels of silver.

EWE: Ale wotsɔ klosalo blaetɔ̃ xe fe nam. 13 Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: “Fetu gã sia si woawo wokpɔ be edze nam la, tsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe nudzraɖoƒe la.”
ENGLISH: 13 And Jehovah said to me “Throw it to the treasury, the grand valuation I got out of them”; and I threw it in Jehovah’s house, to the treasury.

EWE: 14 Emegbe meŋe nye atikplɔ evelia, si nye Ðekawɔwɔ, ne magblẽ Yuda kple Israel ƒe nɔviwɔwɔ la me.
ENGLISH: 14 And I chopped my second staff in two, Ties, to break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

EWE: 15 Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: “Gatsɔ lãkplɔvi yakame la ƒe lãkplɔnuwo.
ENGLISH: 15 And Jehovah said to me “Take a shepherd’s outfit again, an incompetent one’s.

EWE: 16 Elabena mana lãkplɔvi aɖe nado le anyigba la dzi. Matsɔ ɖeke le eme na alẽ siwo le tsɔtsrɔ̃m la o. Madi alẽviawo o, eye mada gbe le alẽ siwo xɔ abi la ŋu o.
ENGLISH: 16 For here I am setting up in the country a shepherd who will not attend to what is missing nor hunt up what strays nor cure what breaks a leg nor feed what is on its feet, but eat the flesh of what is fat and tear their hoofs.

EWE: Mana nuɖuɖu esiwo le sesĩe la o, ke aɖu esiwo da ami ƒe lã, eye wòatú alẽawo ƒe afɔkliwo ɖa. 17 Baba na nye lãkplɔvi maɖinu, si gblẽ alẽawo ɖi!
ENGLISH: 17 Woe to my sham shepherd who quits the sheep! a sword on his arm and on his right eye! his arm shall dry out and his right eye shall go dim.

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 12 Gbedeasi vevi aɖe: “Esiae nye Yehowa ƒe nya si wògblɔ ɖe Israel ŋu.”
ENGLISH: 12 The boding of Jehovah’s word about Israel.

EWE: Eye wòɖo anyigba gɔme anyi, Eya ame si de gbɔgbɔ amegbetɔ me la, gblɔe nye esi:
ENGLISH: Quoth Jehovah who stretched sky and founded earth and shaped man’s spirit within him:

EWE: 2 “Kpɔ ɖa, mana Yerusalem nazu kplu si ana dukɔwo katã nanɔ ya mum sagasaga; woaɖe to ɖe Yuda kple Yerusalem siaa.
ENGLISH: 2 Here I am setting Jerusalem as a staggering-bowl for all the peoples around, and Judah too will be involved in the siege against Jerusalem.

EWE: 3 Eye wòava eme gbe ma gbe be, mana Yerusalem nanye kpe kpekpe na dukɔwo katã. Ame siwo katã be yewoakɔe la, ade abi wo ɖokuiwo ŋu vevie; anyigbadzidukɔwo katã aƒo takpli ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 3 And on that day I will set Jerusalem as a loading-stone for all the peoples; all who load themselves with it will rupture themselves; and all the nations on earth will come together against Jerusalem.

EWE: 4 Gbe ma gbe la,” Yehowa ye gblɔe, “mana vɔvɔ̃ naɖo sɔwo katã, eye mana sɔdolawo naku tsu.
ENGLISH: 4 On that day, quoth Jehovah, I will strike every pony with the staggers and its rider with frenzy, and on the house of Judah I will open my eyes but I will strike every pony of the peoples with blindness;

EWE: Nye ŋku anɔ Yuda ƒe aƒe la ŋu, ke mana dukɔwo ƒe sɔwo katã ƒe ŋku natsi.
ENGLISH: 5 and the allufs of Judah will say to themselves “The inhabitants of Jerusalem have might in their God Jehovah of Armies.”

EWE: 5 Yuda-megãwo agblɔ le woƒe dzi me be: ‘Yerusalem nɔlawo nye ŋusẽ na mí le aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa woƒe Mawu la ta.’ 6 Gbe ma gbe la, mana Yuda-megãwo nanɔ abe dzoɖenu le atiwo dome ene, abe akakati bibi le nuku siwo wotso heli kɔ ɖi la dome ene, woafiã dukɔwo katã kpe ɖo le ɖusime kple miame; ke Yerusalem aganɔ enɔƒe, eye amewo anɔ Yerusalem.
ENGLISH: 6 On that day I will make the allufs of Judah like a pan of fire among wood and like a torch of fire in hay, and to right and to left they shall consume all the peoples around; and Jerusalem shall again be inhabited on its site, in Jerusalem.

EWE: 7 “Yehowa axɔ na Yuda ƒe agbadɔwo gbã, ne David ƒe aƒe ƒe bubu kple Yerusalem nɔlawo ƒe bubu nagagbɔ Yuda tɔ ŋu akpa o.
ENGLISH: 7 And Jehovah will save the tents of Judah first, in order that the vaunting of the house of David and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not put on airs against Judah.

EWE: 8 Gbe ma gbe la, Yehowa anye Yerusalem nɔlawo takpɔla; eye woƒe ame beliwo anɔ abe David ene gbe ma gbe, eye David ƒe aƒe la anɔ abe Mawu ene, abe Yehowa ƒe dɔla ene le wo ŋgɔ.
ENGLISH: 8 On that day Jehovah will shield the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the most limping one among them will be like David, and the house of David like God, like Jehovah’s Angel before them.

EWE: 9 Eye wòava eme gbe ma gbe be, matsrɔ̃ dukɔ siwo katã ho ɖe Yerusalem ŋu la godoo.
ENGLISH: 9 And on that day I will set to work to root out all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

EWE: 10 “Makɔ amenuveve kple kokoƒoƒo ƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖe David ƒe aƒe kple Yerusalem nɔlawo dzi, eye woafɔ ŋku ɖe ame si woƒo nu ɖo la dzi, woafa nɛ abe ale si wofaa tenuvi ene; woaxa nu vevie abe ale si woxaa nu le ŋgɔgbevi ta ene.
ENGLISH: 10 And I will pour upon the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and of supplication; and they will look at the one they stabbed to death and wail over him like the wailing over an only son, and be in agony over him as one is over a firstborn.

EWE: 11 Gbe ma gbe la, konyifafa teƒe makɔ le Yerusalem o, abe ale si wofa konyi le Hadadrimon le Megido Bali me la ene.
ENGLISH: 11 On that day the wailing will be great in Jerusalem, like the bewailing of Hadadrimmon on the Megiddo bottom-lands,

EWE: 12 Anyigba blibo la afa konyi, ƒome sia ƒome: David ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒome la afa konyi le wo ɖokui si, woƒe nyɔnuwo hã afae le wo ɖokui si; Natan ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒome la afa konyi le wo ɖokui si, woƒe nyɔnuwo hã afae le wo ɖokui si; 13 Lewi ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒome la afa konyi le wo ɖokui si, woƒe nyɔnuwo hã afae le wo ɖokui si; Simei viwo ƒe ƒome la afa konyi le wo ɖokui si, woƒe nyɔnuwo hã afae le wo ɖokui si; 14 eye ƒome siwo katã susɔ la, wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe afa konyi le eɖokui si, woƒe nyɔnuwo katã hã afae le wo ɖokui si.
ENGLISH: 12 and the country will wail clan by clan separately: the clan of the house of David separately and their women separately, the clan of the house of Nathan separately and their women separately, 13 the clan of the house of Levi separately and their women separately, the clan of the house of Shimei separately and their women separately, 14 all the remaining clans clan by clan separately and their women separately.

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 13 “Gbe ma gbe la, woaɖe vudo na David ƒe aƒe la kple Yerusalem nɔlawo, ne woaklɔ nu vɔ̃ kple makɔmakɔnyenye ɖa le wo ŋu.
ENGLISH: 13 There will be on that day a fountain opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for pollution.

EWE: 2 Aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa be, “Gbe ma gbe la, matutu legbawo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖa le anyigba la dzi, eye womagaɖo ŋku wo dzi azɔ o; eye mana nyagblɔɖilawo kple gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo hã nu nayi le anyigba la dzi.
ENGLISH: 2 And on that day, quoth Jehovah, I will abolish the names of the idols out of the country, and they will not be mentioned anymore; and the prophets too, and the tainting spirit, I will have pass away from the country.

EWE: 3 Eye ne ame aɖe gale nya gblɔm ɖi la, ekema edzilawo, fofoa kple dadaa, agblɔ nɛ be: ‘Èdze na ku, elabena ègblɔ alakpanya le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me.’ Eye edzilawo, fofoa kple dadaa, aƒo nu ɖee, le esi wògblɔ nya ɖi ta.
ENGLISH: 3 And when a man does still prophesy, his father and mother who gave him birth will say to him “You shall not live, because you have spoken falsehood in Jehovah’s name,” and his father and mother who gave him birth will stab him to death for his prophesying.

EWE: 4 “Gbe ma gbe la, nyagblɔɖila ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ŋutega kple eƒe nyagblɔɖi akpe ŋu nɛ; eye womagado nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe lãfuwu be woaflu ame o.
ENGLISH: 4 And on that day the prophets will be ashamed of their visions when they prophesy, and will not wear a hairy mantle with lying intent;

EWE: 5 Eye wòagblɔ be: ‘Menye nyagblɔɖila menye o.
ENGLISH: 5 and one will say “I am not a prophet, I am a man that works the soil, because the soil has been my living from my boyhood”;

EWE: Agbledelae menye, elabena ame aɖee ƒlem kluvii tso nye ɖevime ke.’ 6 Eye ne ame aɖe biae be, ‘Ke abi kawoe nye esiawo le wò medome?’ hã la, aɖo eŋu be, ‘Esiwo wode ŋunye le xɔ̃nyewo ƒe aƒe mee.’”
ENGLISH: 6 and one will say to him “What are these wounds between your hands?” and he will say “What I got in my lovers’ house.”

EWE: 7 “Oo yi, ho ɖe nye alẽkplɔla ŋu, Ðe ŋutsu si le ŋunye kplikplikpli ŋu,” aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ye gblɔe.
ENGLISH: 7 Sword, wake against my shepherd and against a man my neighbor! quoth Jehovah of Armies.

EWE: “Da nu alẽkplɔla la, ne lãhaa naka hlẽ; Eye matrɔ nye asi ɖe alẽ suetɔawo ŋu.”
ENGLISH: Strike the shepherd and the sheep will scatter and I will bring my hand back against the smallest.

EWE: 8 “Eye wòava eme be, woaɖe anyigba blibo la dzi nɔlawo ƒe akpa eve le etɔ̃ me ɖa, eye woatsrɔ̃;
ENGLISH: 8 And in all the country, quoth Jehovah, two parts will be swept away, will perish, and a third will be left in it;

EWE: Yehowa ye gblɔe. 9 “Matsɔ akpa ɖeka le etɔ̃ me la ade dzo me;
ENGLISH: 9 and I will bring the third into the fire and smelt them like smelting silver and assay them like assaying gold.

EWE: Eye madza wo ŋu abe ale si wodzaa klosalo ŋui ene, Eye mado wo akpɔ abe ale si wodoa sika kpɔnae ene. Woayɔ nye ŋkɔ, Eye matɔ na wo.
ENGLISH: It will call on my name, and I will answer it and say “It is my people,” and it will say “Jehovah is my God.”

EWE: Zakariya
ENGLISH: Zechariah

EWE: 14 “Kpɔ ɖa! Ŋkeke li gbɔna, Yehowa ƒe ŋkekee, esime woama wò nu si woha le mewò.
ENGLISH: 14 Here, Jehovah has a day coming, and the booty from you, Jerusalem, will be divided inside you.

EWE: 2 Maƒo dukɔwo katã nu ƒu ɖe Yerusalem ŋu ne woawɔ aʋa kplii; woaxɔ du la, woaha aƒewo, eye woadɔ nyɔnuwo gbɔ sesẽe.
ENGLISH: 2 And I will bring all the nations together to Jerusalem for battle; and the city will be taken and the houses pillaged and the women ravished.

EWE: Du la ƒe afã ayi aboyo me, ke womakplɔ dukɔ la ƒe ame susɔeawo ya adzoe le dua me o.
ENGLISH: And half the city will go out in deportation, but the rest of the people will not be ousted from the city.

EWE: 3 “Yehowa aho aɖawɔ aʋa kple dukɔ mawo, abe ale si wòwɔ aʋa le aʋakpegbe ene.
ENGLISH: 3 And Jehovah will go out and fight those nations as he fights on a day of battle,

EWE: 4 Gbe ma gbe la, atɔ ɖe Amito si dze ŋgɔ Yerusalem le ɣedzeƒe la dzi; eye Amito la afe ɖe titina kpla, tso ɣedzeƒe va se ɖe ɣetoɖoƒe, eye bali gã aɖe anɔ wo dome; to la ƒe afã ayi dziehe, eye eƒe afã ayi anyiehe.
ENGLISH: 4 and his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives that day, the mountain in front of Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives will split in halves from east to west in a very great valley, and half the mountain will move off to the north and half to the south,

EWE: 5 Miasi ayi nye towo ƒe bali la me, elabena bali si le toawo domee la ade Azel ke. Miasi, abe ale si ko miesi le anyigbaʋuʋu nu le Yuda-fia Uziya ŋɔli ene. Yehowa, nye Mawu la ava, eye ame kɔkɔeawo katã akpe ɖe eŋu.
ENGLISH: 5 and the valley of Hinnom will be choked for the valley of Hinnom lies along its side, and will be choked as it was in consequence of the earthquake in the time of King ʽUzzijah of Judah and my God Jehovah will come and all his holy ones with him.

EWE: 6 “Gbe ma gbe la, kekeli vavã aɖeke manɔ anyi o, ke fafa ana nuwo nabla.
ENGLISH: 6 And on that day there will not be light and cold and frost;

EWE: 7 Anye ŋkeke aɖe si nye Yehowa tɔ. Ŋu make o, eye zã hã mado o; xexea me akɔ le fiẽ gɔ̃ hã.
ENGLISH: 7 and it will be all one day Jehovah knows about it not day and not night; and at evening time there will be light.

EWE: 8 Gbe ma gbe la, tsi gbagbe asi tso Yerusalem, eƒe afã aɖo ta ɣedzeƒeƒu la me, eye afã aɖo ta ɣetoɖoƒeƒu la me.
ENGLISH: 8 And on that day living water will go out from Jerusalem, half to the eastern sea and half to the western; this will be in summer and in winter.

EWE: Anɔ sisim le dzomeŋɔli kple vuvɔŋɔli siaa. 9 Yehowa anye Fia ɖe anyigba blibo la nu.
ENGLISH: 9 And Jehovah will become king over all the earth; on that day Jehovah will be one and his name one.

EWE: Gbe ma gbe la, Yehowa ɖeka koe anye Mawu, eye wòatɔ ŋkɔ ɖeka. 10 “Anyigba blibo la anɔ abe Araba ene, tso Geba yi Rimon va se ɖe anyiehe; woagakɔ Yerusalem ɖe dzi ɖe afi si wònɔ, eye amewo aganɔ eme, tso Benyamin-gbo la nu yi Agbo Gbãtɔ nu va se ɖe Dzogoedzigbo la nu, tso Hananel Gbetakpɔxɔ la gbɔ va se ɖe fia ƒe wainfiãƒewo.
ENGLISH: 10 All the country will go round like the Rift Valley, from Gebaʽ to Rimmon of the South; and Jerusalem will tower up and stay where it was, from the Benjamin Gate to the place of the former gate, to the Corner Gate and Hananel’s Tower, to the King’s Winepresses.

EWE: 11 Amewo anɔ eme; eye naneke maganye busunu si adze na tsɔtsrɔ̃ o, eye amewo anɔ Yerusalem le dziɖeɖi me.
ENGLISH: 11 And they will live in it, and there will be no more doom, and Jerusalem will rest secure.

EWE: 12 “Fuwɔame si Yehowa ahe ava dukɔ siwo katã aho aʋa ɖe Yerusalem ŋu dzi lae nye esi: Woƒe ŋutilã aƒaƒã esime wogale woƒe afɔwo dzi; ŋku aƒaƒã ɖe to me na wo, eye woƒe aɖe aƒaƒã ɖe nu me na wo.
ENGLISH: 12 And this will be the plague that Jehovah will inflict on all the peoples that made the campaign against Jerusalem: rotting one’s flesh while he stands on his feet, and his eyes rotting in their sockets and his tongue rotting in his mouth.

EWE: 13 “Gbe ma gbe la, Yehowa ade tɔtɔ gã aɖe wo dome; eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe asi asu ehavi dzi, eye wòakɔ asi dzi ɖe ehavi ŋu.
ENGLISH: 13 And on that day there will be a great confusion from Jehovah among them, and they will hold each other’s hands and their hands will be raised against each other,

EWE: 14 Yuda hã awɔ aʋa le Yerusalem; eye woaƒo dukɔ siwo katã ƒo xlã wo ƒe kesinɔnuwo nu ƒu kpaŋkpaŋ; sika, klosalo kple awuwo.
ENGLISH: 14 and even Judah will fight Jerusalem. And the wealth of all the nations around will be brought in, gold and silver and clothing in great quantities.

EWE: 15 “Fuwɔame ma tɔgbi ava sɔwo, tedzisɔwo, kposɔwo, tedziwo kple lã siwo katã le asaɖa mawo me dzi.
ENGLISH: 15 And the same will be the plague of the ponies, the mules, the camels, the donkeys, and all the beasts that there shall be in those camps, like this plague.

EWE: 16 “Dukɔ siwo katã ho ɖe Yerusalem ŋu la, ƒe ame susɔeawo katã ayi aɖade ta agu na Fia, aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa, eye woaɖu Agbadɔŋkekenyui la ƒe sia ƒe.
ENGLISH: 16 And everybody that is left of all the nations that had come against Jerusalem will come up annually to do reverence to the King, Jehovah of Armies, and to keep the Feast of Booths.

EWE: 17 Ke anyigbadziƒomeawo dometɔ si mayi Yerusalem aɖade ta agu na Fia, aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa o la, tsi madza nɛ o.
ENGLISH: 17 And whoever in the clans of the earth does not come up to Jerusalem to do reverence to the King, Jehovah of Armies, on them there will be no showers;

EWE: 18 Eye ne Egiptetɔwo meva o la, ekema tsi aɖeke madza na wo o. Ke boŋ fuwɔame si Yehowa ahe ava dukɔ siwo meva Agbadɔŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe o dzi la, ava wo dzi.
ENGLISH: 18 and if the clan of Egypt does not come up and come in, on them will be the plague which Jehovah will inflict on the nations that do not come up to keep the Feast of Booths.

EWE: 19 Esiae anye Egipte kple dukɔ siwo katã mava Agbadɔŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe o la ƒe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti tohehe.
ENGLISH: 19 This will be the penalty for Egypt and the penalty for all the nations that do not come up to keep the Feast of Booths.

EWE: 20 “Gbe ma gbe la, woaŋlɔ ɖe sɔwo ƒe nyawowoewo ŋu be: ‘Kɔkɔenyenye nye Yehowa tɔ!’ Nuɖaze siwo le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me la anɔ abe agba goboe siwo le vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ ene.
ENGLISH: 20 On that day the ponies will have on their jinglets “Sacred to Jehovah,” and the pots in Jehovah’s house will be like the bowls before the altar;

EWE: 21 Nuɖaze ɖe sia ɖe si le Yerusalem kple Yuda azu nu kɔkɔe na aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa, eye ame siwo katã le vɔ sam la ava ɖa nu le wo me.
ENGLISH: 21 and every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be sacred to Jehovah of Armies, and all the sacrificers will go in and take any of them and cook in them.

EWE: Kanaantɔ aɖeke maganɔ aʋakɔwo ƒe Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me gbe ma gbe o.”
ENGLISH: And there will no longer be a trader in Jehovah of Armies’ house on that day.
